rows.original: You hesitate a moment, taken aback by the sudden question. Didn’t her secretary... wait. When you heard there was a Director Rhenesuune, you expected one of the company’s beardy old leithan executives, but instead a familiar, bipedal figure is staring you down, human in shape save for the long, plated elfin ears sprouting from her head and the alien, starry eyes iconic of her leithan parentage. Dark blue hair falls in long, lush locks around her shoulders, half-hiding the tiny scales that dot her grayish skin. She gives you a sly smile, leaning forward on her elbows and propping up her chin.
rows.translation: 你迟疑了片刻，被这突如其来的问题问得一愣。她的秘书难道没... 等等。听说这里有位雷内桑主管时，你还以为会是公司里某个蓄着胡子的莱萨人老高管，然而此刻盯着你的却是一道熟悉的双足身影：除了头上伸出的修长覆甲精灵耳，以及彰显其莱萨血统的异星星眸外，她的体形与人类无异。深蓝色的长发丰盈地披散在肩头，半遮住灰色皮肤上点缀的细小鳞片。她狡黠一笑，双肘撑桌，托起下巴。

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah,” you say, refusing to take the bait. Only way to keep Anyxine’s biting wit at bay is to just shrug it off before she can get her hooks in you - once she does, she’ll gaily reel you along for hours! Instead, you ask how things are going on the station: you didn’t expect to see her here.
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧，”你说道，拒绝上她的钩。要压住安妮克辛那尖刻的机锋，唯一的办法就是在她抓住把柄之前一笑置之；一旦让她得手，她能兴高采烈地拿你取乐好几个小时！于是你转而问起空间站近况如何：你没想到会在这里见到她。

Instead, you ask how things are going on the station: you didn’t expect to see her here."

rows.original: Anyx clicks her tongue and reclines back in her chair. “As well as can be expected for a backwater trading post. Profits are up seventy percent since RhenWorld took over local mineral extraction, and I’ve counter-litigated the Tove into a more favorable trade tariff arrangement. Amazing what you can get done when someone capable of thinking about something other than poon is put in charge. Feel free to commend me to the Steele Tech board next time you talk to them.”
rows.translation: 安妮克辛咂了咂舌，靠回椅背。“对一个偏远贸易站来说，已经算符合预期了。自从雷恩世界接管当地矿产开采以来，利润上升了百分之七十，我还通过反诉迫使托芙接受了对我们更有利的贸易关税协议。让一个有能力思考交配以外事情的人来掌权，能办成的事真是令人惊讶。下次你跟斯蒂尔科技董事会谈话时，别忘了替我美言几句。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyx clicks her tongue and reclines back in her chair. “As well as can be expected for a backwater trading post. Profits are up seventy percent since RhenWorld took over local mineral extraction, and I’ve counter-litigated the Tove into a more favorable trade tariff arrangement. Amazing what you can get done when someone capable of thinking about something other than poon is put in charge. Feel free to commend me to the Steele Tech board next time you talk to them.”"

rows.original: Oh? Is Anyxine here replacing someone less... goal-oriented, then?
rows.translation: 哦？所以安妮克辛是来接替某个没那么... 专注于目标的人？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh? Is Anyxine here replacing someone less... goal-oriented, then?"

rows.original: “One of my brothers, yes,” she smirks. “Castian was the first RhenWorld director here, and promptly almost sunk the venture. Apparently one of the local hussies - I mean, ‘huskars’ - wrapped him so tight around her chubby little finger that he all but abdicated his duties. Now he’s safely back in the core with his ausar-shaped undercarriage attachment, and as the only Rhenesuune scion not already loftily employed, here I am.”
rows.translation: “对，我的一个兄弟，”她坏笑道。“卡斯蒂安是雷恩世界派到这里的第一任主管，结果差点把这项事业搞垮。显然，本地某个小荡妇，我是说‘赫斯卡’，把他牢牢缠在自己胖乎乎的小指头上，弄得他几乎彻底放弃了职责。现在他和他那个奥萨尔人外形的胯下挂件安全地回到了核心星域，而我是雷内桑家唯一还没身居高位的子嗣，所以我就来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of my brothers, yes,” she smirks. “Castian was the first RhenWorld director here, and promptly almost sunk the venture. Apparently one of the local hussies - I mean, ‘huskars’ - wrapped him so tight around her chubby little finger that he all but abdicated his duties. Now he’s safely back in the core with his ausar-shaped undercarriage attachment, and as the only Rhenesuune scion not already loftily employed, here I am.”"

rows.original: Well, you guess that worked out for her. She always wanted to be in charge, didn’t she?
rows.translation: 好吧，你想这对她来说也算因祸得福。她一直都想掌权，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you guess that worked out for her. She always wanted to be in charge, didn’t she?"

rows.original: Anyx answers with a contemptuous grunt and hikes her feet up onto the desk. “I suppose. Uveto is a little out of the way for my tastes... and damnably cold, too. Even in space the chill just seeps up that space elevator.
rows.translation: 安妮克辛不屑地哼了一声，把双脚架到桌上。“算是吧。乌维托对我的口味来说有点太偏僻了... 而且还冷得要命。就连在太空里，那股寒气也会顺着太空电梯一直渗上来。

How’d a half-leithan end up walking on two legs, anyway, and covered in gryvain scales all over? You’re not sure miss pony-dragon has room to throw stones in her nice glass house here!
rows.translation: ...你也一样。你咧嘴笑着提醒安妮克辛：也许你在变形方面需要继承家族传统，可她一出生就是各种身体部位拼成的大杂烩。一个半莱萨人究竟怎么会用两条腿走路，身上还到处覆着格里文鳞片？你可不觉得这位小马龙小姐有资格在自己的漂亮玻璃房里朝别人扔石头！

rows.original: You head over to Anyxine’s desk, watching the half-leithan’s fingers fly across her holographic keyboard at breakneck pace. She acknowledges you with an absent-minded wave of her tail, gesturing it towards the chair across from her. “Juuuust a sec, I gotta get this email out to the old man and the board. Annnnd alright, there we go. Quarterly profit reports sent out, and very much in the black. I’m sure future-[pc.name] will be delighted.”
rows.translation: 你走到安妮克辛的办公桌旁，看着这个半莱萨人的手指以惊人的速度在全息键盘上飞舞。她心不在焉地甩了甩尾巴向你致意，又用尾巴指向对面的椅子。“稍等一下，我得把这封邮件发给老头子和董事会。好啦，搞定。季度利润报告已经发出，而且盈利相当可观。我相信未来的[pc.name]一定会很高兴。”

rows.original: Anyx gives you a faint smile and taps another button on her keyboard. rows.original: You don’t know her well enough for this. Ask her something else?
rows.translation: 你跟她还没熟到能谈这个。问她点别的？
rows.raw: "You don’t know her well enough for this. Ask her something else?"

rows.translation: 返回

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You know RhenWorld is a subsidiary of Steele Tech, and has been since around when you were born, but you’d be interested in hearing more about the company from someone involved with it. That you have the daughter of the C.E.O. on hand to talk to is pretty convenient.
rows.translation: 你知道雷恩世界是斯蒂尔科技的子公司，而且在你出生前后就已经如此；不过你还是很想从一位公司内部人士口中听到更多消息。恰好首席执行官的女儿就在眼前，实在方便得很。
rows.raw: "You know RhenWorld is a subsidiary of Steele Tech, and has been since around when you were born, but you’d be interested in hearing more about the company from someone involved with it. That you have the daughter of the C.E.O. on hand to talk to is pretty convenient."

rows.original: “Time to talk shop?” Anyx smirks, resting her chin on her hands. “My favorite subject. Unfortunately for you, you’re not the head of Steele Tech. Technically not even an employee if I understand correctly, so I’m afraid I can’t share any of the juicy details re: the dark, slimy underbelly of mega-corporate operations. As much as I’d love to pick your
rows.translation: “该谈公事了？”安妮克丝坏笑着把下巴搁在手上。“我最喜欢的话题。可惜你并不是斯蒂尔科技的掌门人。据我所知，严格来说你甚至都不算雇员，所以恐怕我不能向你透露关于超级企业运作中那些阴暗肮脏内幕的劲爆细节。虽然我很想钻进你那
rows.raw: "\n\n“Time to talk shop?” Anyx smirks, resting her chin on her hands. “My favorite subject. Unfortunately for you, you’re not the head of Steele Tech. Technically not even an employee if I understand correctly, so I’m afraid I can’t share any of the juicy details re: the dark, slimy underbelly of mega-corporate operations. As much as I’d love to pick your"

rows.original: , well, whatever you’ve got rattling around in that airhead of yours
rows.translation: 个，呃，不知道装着什么、晃来晃去的空脑袋里
rows.raw: ", well, whatever you’ve got rattling around in that airhead of yours"

rows.original: big, delicious brain
rows.translation: 颗聪明又美味的大脑里
rows.raw: " big, delicious brain"

rows.original: brain
rows.translation: 颗脑袋里
rows.raw: " brain"

rows.original: about all my problems, binding NDAs and all that... you understand.”
rows.translation: ，把我的所有麻烦都倾诉出来，但保密协议之类的东西还约束着我...你明白吧。”
rows.raw: " about all my problems, binding NDAs and all that... you understand.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: huff
rows.translation: 哼了一声
rows.raw: "huff"

rows.original: chuckle
rows.translation: 轻笑一声
rows.raw: "chuckle"

rows.original: and tell her that’s alright. You’ll settle for the surface details.
rows.translation: ，告诉她没关系。你听听表面情况就满足了。
rows.raw: " and tell her that’s alright. You’ll settle for the surface details."

rows.original: “Fine. The boring version, then,” Anyx mock-sighs.
rows.translation: “那好吧，就讲无聊的版本，”安妮克丝装模作样地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine. The boring version, then,” Anyx mock-sighs."

rows.original: “Try not to forget everything this time, hmm?”
rows.translation: “这次尽量别全忘了，好吗？”
rows.raw: " “Try not to forget everything this time, hmm?”"

rows.original: “As you may or may not have guessed from the overabundance of six-legged secretaries outside, RhenWorld Stellar Excavations hails from the horrible desert hellhole of Leitha, founded by the Rhenesuune family - a wealthy family genetically predisposed towards beauty and intelligence, as you must know - shortly after First Contact with Terra.”
rows.translation: “你大概已经从外面多得过分的六足秘书猜到了，雷恩世界恒星开采公司来自利塔那个糟透了的沙漠地狱。它由雷内桑家族创立——一个天生丽质、智慧超群的富裕家族，这你肯定知道——成立时间就在地球首次接触之后不久。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As you may or may not have guessed from the overabundance of six-legged secretaries outside, RhenWorld Stellar Excavations hails from the horrible desert hellhole of Leitha, founded by the Rhenesuune family - a wealthy family genetically predisposed towards beauty and intelligence, as you must know - shortly after First Contact with Terra.”"

rows.original: Alright. You did sort of grow up knowing Anyx and her family... and her company... so that’s super helpful.
rows.translation: 好吧。你小时候确实就认识安妮克丝和她的家人...以及她的公司...这可真是太有帮助了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright. You did sort of grow up knowing Anyx and her family... and her company... so that’s super helpful."

rows.original: “Sorry. When you asked about the company, I assumed you’re just suffering from crippling amnesia. All that head-trauma from adventuring. That’s all to say we’re a very old and very prestigious company, with roots all the way back to the first Planet Rushes. But some more recent... mismanagement... ended with us in pretty dire financial straits, back when you and I were both just little kids. Lucky for RhenWorld, Uncle Vic was just starting to expand his company, and had plenty of cash to spare. Enough to buy all fifty percent of our outstanding stock, which pretty much makes, well, made, him co-owner. It’s a good fit, honestly: we mine, Steele refines. Nowadays we’re working together all over the galaxy, from here in the core all the way out to the Rush. Any time your company finds a rock too tough to crack, you can just call in RhenWorld and we’ll get it done or die trying.”
rows.translation: “抱歉。你既然问起公司，我还以为你只是患上了严重的失忆症。毕竟冒险让你的脑袋挨了那么多下。总之，我们是一家历史悠久、声望卓著的公司，根基可以一直追溯到最早的行星开拓潮。但在你我都还年幼的时候，近代某些...经营不善...让我们陷入了相当严重的财务困境。雷恩世界运气不错，当时维克叔叔正开始扩张他的公司，手头有大把现金可用。足够买下我们全部百分之五十的流通股，这基本让他成了，呃，曾经是，共同所有人。说实话，这很合适：我们采矿，斯蒂尔公司精炼。如今我们在银河各地合作，从核心区域一路延伸到开拓区。只要你的公司碰到一块难啃的石头，叫来雷恩世界，我们要么把活干完，要么死在现场。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry. When you asked about the company, I assumed you’re just suffering from crippling amnesia. All that head-trauma from adventuring. That’s all to say we’re a very old and very prestigious company, with roots all the way back to the first Planet Rushes. But some more recent... mismanagement... ended with us in pretty dire financial straits, back when you and I were both just little kids. Lucky for RhenWorld, Uncle Vic was just starting to expand his company, and had plenty of cash to spare. Enough to buy all fifty percent of our outstanding stock, which pretty much makes, well, made, him co-owner. It’s a good fit, honestly: we mine, Steele refines. Nowadays we’re working together all over the galaxy, from here in the core all the way out to the Rush. Any time your company finds a rock too tough to crack, you can just call in RhenWorld and we’ll get it done or die trying.”"

rows.original: Isn’t that a little over-dramatic?
rows.translation: 这是不是有点太夸张了？
rows.raw: "\n\nIsn’t that a little over-dramatic?"

rows.original: Anyx snorts. “Hardly. RhenWorld operates the biggest, heaviest, excavation equipment anywhere in the galaxy! If you don’t wanna be gentle about it, we can rip whole planets apart and harvest them hollow. It’s dangerous work, no two ways about it. But leithans are sturdy and tough. Not many races better suited to dangerous environment work!”
rows.translation: 安妮克丝哼了一声。“一点也不。雷恩世界操作着全银河最大、最重的开采设备！如果不想手下留情，我们可以把整颗星球撕开，挖空它们的内部。无论怎么说，这都是危险的工作。但莱萨人结实又强壮，没有多少种族比我们更适合在危险环境中工作！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyx snorts. “Hardly. RhenWorld operates the biggest, heaviest, excavation equipment anywhere in the galaxy! If you don’t wanna be gentle about it, we can rip whole planets apart and harvest them hollow. It’s dangerous work, no two ways about it. But leithans are sturdy and tough. Not many races better suited to dangerous environment work!”"

rows.original: “Of course, Uveto’s its own special brand of problems that’s made it hard to pick clean. Corporate treaties being the worst of them,” she laughs. “But now that I’m in charge, nothing will stand between us and our profits.”
rows.translation: “当然，乌维托有自己独有的一堆麻烦，很难把它采得一干二净。企业间条约是其中最糟的，”她笑道。“不过现在由我掌权，没有任何东西能挡在我们和利润之间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, Uveto’s its own special brand of problems that’s made it hard to pick clean. Corporate treaties being the worst of them,” she laughs. “But now that I’m in charge, nothing will stand between us and our profits.”"

rows.original: ANYXINE_RHENWORLD_TALKS
rows.raw: "ANYXINE_RHENWORLD_TALKS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Hows the family doing, Anyxine?”
rows.translation: “家里人过得怎么样，安妮克辛？”
rows.raw: "“Hows the family doing, Anyxine?”"

rows.original: The half-leithan takes a measured breath, steepling her fingers. “They... are fine, thanks for asking.”
rows.translation: 这位半莱萨人深吸一口气，将十指指尖相抵。“他们...都挺好，谢谢关心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe half-leithan takes a measured breath, steepling her fingers. “They... are fine, thanks for asking.”"

rows.original: A moment passes, leading you to prompt her for a little more info than that.
rows.translation: 片刻过去，你只好催她再多说一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment passes, leading you to prompt her for a little more info than that. "

rows.original: “Aww, come on, tell me about ‘em!”
rows.translation: “哎呀，别这样，说说他们嘛！”
rows.raw: "“Aww, come on, tell me about ‘em!”"

rows.original: “So... for example?”
rows.translation: “那么...举个例子？”
rows.raw: "“So... for example?”"

rows.original: Anyx sighs. “Ugh, fine. My father, our inestimable C.E.O., is getting on in years even with anti-agathics, starting to wind down and train up my eldest sister, Ashinari, to take his place. She’s got a new half-ausar girlfriend, I hear, but I haven’t had the chance to meet big sis’s new puppy yet. Aside from that, Ash is as bubbly and full of overflowing positivity and love as she ever was. I’m sure she’d insist on passing on hugs and kisses, were she here.”
rows.translation: 安妮克丝叹了口气。“唉，好吧。我父亲，也就是我们尊贵无比的首席执行官，即使有抗衰老药也终究年事已高，正开始慢慢退居幕后，培养我的大姐阿希娜莉接他的班。我听说她新交了一个半奥萨女朋友，但我还没机会见见大姐的新小狗。除此之外，阿希依旧那么活泼，满心都是多得溢出来的乐观和爱。她要是在这里，肯定会坚持让我替她送上拥抱和亲吻。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyx sighs. “Ugh, fine. My father, our inestimable C.E.O., is getting on in years even with anti-agathics, starting to wind down and train up my eldest sister, Ashinari, to take his place. She’s got a new half-ausar girlfriend, I hear, but I haven’t had the chance to meet big sis’s new puppy yet. Aside from that, Ash is as bubbly and full of overflowing positivity and love as she ever was. I’m sure she’d insist on passing on hugs and kisses, were she here.”"

rows.original: The memory of being swept up into the arms of an extremely affectionate, and extremely well-endowed, leithan girl come flooding back, and it puts a smile on your face. Ashinari is a good few years older than you, so you never spent that much time with her, but she certainly made an impression.
rows.translation: 你回忆起自己曾被一个极其热情、胸部也极其丰满的莱萨人女孩一把搂进怀里，脸上不禁浮起笑容。阿希娜莉比你大好几岁，所以你们相处的时间并不多，但她显然给你留下了深刻印象。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe memory of being swept up into the arms of an extremely affectionate, and extremely well-endowed, leithan girl come flooding back, and it puts a smile on your face. Ashinari is a good few years older than you, so you never spent that much time with her, but she certainly made an impression."

rows.original: “As for my brothers,” Anyx continues, “They’re all managing system offices like me. Except for Reshnan, who like I said has decided to leave the company entirely to marry one of the local huskar.
rows.translation: “至于我的兄弟们，”安妮克丝继续说道，“他们和我一样，都在管理各个星系的办事处。只有雷什南例外，就像我说过的，他决定彻底离开公司，娶一位本地的赫斯卡族。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As for my brothers,” Anyx continues, “They’re all managing system offices like me. Except for Reshnan, who like I said has decided to leave the company entirely to marry one of the local huskar. "

rows.original: half-ausar
rows.raw: "half-ausar"

rows.original: Yeah, this generation seems to have a thing for pups. Go figure.
rows.translation: 是啊，这一代人看来特别喜欢小狗。谁知道为什么。
rows.raw: "Yeah, this generation seems to have a thing for pups. Go figure. "

rows.original: They’re on their honeymoon around the core now, won’t see them back here on Uveto for a while... but I think they’ve decided to make their home down on the surface. I can’t imagine wanting to live on that frozen water balloon, but the heart wants what it wants...”
rows.translation: 他们目前正在核心区度蜜月，一时半会儿不会回乌维托...不过我想他们已经决定在地表安家。我无法想象有人会想住在那个冰冻水球上，但感情这种事就是不由自主...”
rows.raw: "They’re on their honeymoon around the core now, won’t see them back here on Uveto for a while... but I think they’ve decided to make their home down on the surface. I can’t imagine wanting to live on that frozen water balloon, but the heart wants what it wants...”"

rows.original: “And your mom?”
rows.translation: “那你母亲呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And your mom?”"

rows.original: She shrugs, glancing down at her work station. “Sarrin is... keeping busy. Her crew comes through once in a while. I hadn’t realized Uveto was part of her route when I took the post; you can imagine how awkward it was to go down to the docks to get a signature from a random long-hauler captain only to realize it’s your mother. She stops by for tea once every quarter now, though, so that’s nice.”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩，低头看向工作台。“萨琳...一直很忙。她的船员偶尔会经过这里。我接下这份职务时不知道乌维托也在她的航线上；你可以想象，去码头找一位陌生的长途货船船长签字，结果发现那人是自己母亲，这有多尴尬。不过她现在每季度会过来喝一次茶，所以也挺好的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shrugs, glancing down at her work station. “Sarrin is... keeping busy. Her crew comes through once in a while. I hadn’t realized Uveto was part of her route when I took the post; you can imagine how awkward it was to go down to the docks to get a signature from a random long-hauler captain only to realize it’s your mother. She stops by for tea once every quarter now, though, so that’s nice.”"

rows.original: ANYXINE_FAMILY_TALKS
rows.raw: "ANYXINE_FAMILY_TALKS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I remember when I first met Uncle Vic,” Anyxine muses, rubbing at the scales on her forearms. “I think he’d just started getting sick, since he was actually human and... normal. Not like the stories I’d start hearing. Later, not then. I was maybe 5 at the time. Dad introduced him as ‘the man that saved our company’ so Vic’d barely made it through the door before I hugged him. Even back then I knew there was nothing more important than the company. I remember... he’d brought a present for me, too. A stuffed monster from Terran mythology, a ‘bear.’ He was never like the other corporate types I met growing up. He was...
rows.translation: “我还记得第一次见到维克叔叔的时候，”安妮克辛抚摸着前臂上的鳞片，沉思道。“我想他那时应该才刚开始生病，因为他看起来还是个人类，而且...很正常。不像我后来听到的那些故事。是后来，不是当时。那时候我大概五岁。爸爸介绍他说是‘拯救了我们公司的人’，所以维克才刚进门，我就抱住了他。即使在那个年纪，我也知道没有什么比公司更重要。我记得...他还给我带了礼物。一只以地球神话怪兽为原型的毛绒玩具，叫‘熊’。他从来不像我小时候见过的其他企业人士。他是...
rows.raw: "“I remember when I first met Uncle Vic,” Anyxine muses, rubbing at the scales on her forearms. “I think he’d just started getting sick, since he was actually human and... normal. Not like the stories I’d start hearing. Later, not then. I was maybe 5 at the time. Dad introduced him as ‘the man that saved our company’ so Vic’d barely made it through the door before I hugged him. Even back then I knew there was nothing more important than the company. I remember... he’d brought a present for me, too. A stuffed monster from Terran mythology, a ‘bear.’ He was never like the other corporate types I met growing up. He was... "

rows.original: hardened, sure, but you could tell just looking at him that he had a good heart.
rows.translation: 强硬，没错，但你看他一眼就能知道，他有一颗善良的心。
rows.raw: "hardened, sure, but you could tell just looking at him that he had a good heart."

rows.original: always smiling, like there was a joke only he got. It was infectious.
rows.translation: 总是笑眯眯的，仿佛知道一个只有他自己才懂的笑话。那笑容很有感染力。
rows.raw: "always smiling, like there was a joke only he got. It was infectious."

rows.original: always kind, like he actually viewed everyone around him as an equal. Even five-year-old me.
rows.translation: 总是那么和善，仿佛真的把身边每个人都视为平等的人。哪怕是五岁的我也一样。
rows.raw: "always kind, like he actually viewed everyone around him as an equal. Even five-year-old me."

rows.original: I’m sorry I couldn’t be there for the funeral. I’m sorry for your loss.”
rows.translation: 很抱歉我没能参加葬礼。也很遗憾你失去了他。”
rows.raw: " I’m sorry I couldn’t be there for the funeral. I’m sorry for your loss.”"

rows.original: In a lull in conversation, Anyx offers up, “Remember when we first met?”
rows.translation: 谈话稍稍冷场时，安妮克丝主动说道：“还记得我们第一次见面吗？”
rows.raw: "In a lull in conversation, Anyx offers up, “Remember when we first met?”"

rows.original: You nod, though it was so long ago, you have to admit the memory’s suffered the vagaries of age. It was more than a decade ago, closer to two, after all. It was the dedication of a new Steele Tech mining vessel, if you recall.
rows.translation: 你点点头，不过那已经是很久以前的事了，你不得不承认，岁月让那段记忆变得模糊。毕竟那是十多年前、快二十年前的事了。要是你没记错，那是一艘斯蒂尔科技新采矿船的命名典礼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, though it was so long ago, you have to admit the memory’s suffered the vagaries of age. It was more than a decade ago, closer to two, after all. It was the dedication of a new Steele Tech mining vessel, if you recall."

rows.original: It might have actually been the Kashima, now that you think about it.
rows.translation: 现在想来，那甚至可能就是鹿岛号。
rows.raw: " It might have actually been the Kashima, now that you think about it."

rows.original: The Kashima, was it?
rows.translation: 是鹿岛号，对吗？
rows.raw: " The Kashima, was it?"

rows.original: <i>“That’s right. An asteroid miner, one of the first made directly by your company, so of course my family ended up invited. I think we were both around... seven, you and I, both trotting along with our dads. We were the only kids there, of course; everyone else was some snooty corporate type or a shipbuilder.
rows.translation: <i>“没错。一艘小行星采矿船，也是你们公司最早直接制造的船只之一，所以我们全家当然受到了邀请。你和我当时大概都是...七岁，分别跟着自己的父亲到处跑。那里当然只有我们两个孩子；其他人全是些目中无人的企业人士或造船工。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“That’s right. An asteroid miner, one of the first made directly by your company, so of course my family ended up invited. I think we were both around... seven, you and I, both trotting along with our dads. We were the only kids there, of course; everyone else was some snooty corporate type or a shipbuilder."

rows.original: The first time I saw you, you were scowling and miserable. Could tell you didn’t want to be there any more than I did!
rows.translation: 我第一次见到你时，你正皱着脸，一副惨兮兮的样子。一眼就能看出，你和我一样不想待在那里！”
rows.raw: " The first time I saw you, you were scowling and miserable. Could tell you didn’t want to be there any more than I did!"

rows.original: When I first saw you, you had this devilish little smirk and I’m pretty sure you’d just stolen a fist-full of sweet pie off the table. So proud of yourself!
rows.translation: 我第一次见到你时，你脸上挂着小恶魔般的坏笑，而且我很确定你刚从桌上偷了一大把甜馅饼。得意极了！”
rows.raw: " When I first saw you, you had this devilish little smirk and I’m pretty sure you’d just stolen a fist-full of sweet pie off the table. So proud of yourself!"

rows.original: You already had plenty of adults gawking by the time I noticed you. Even back then you were a charmer!
rows.translation: 等我注意到你时，已经有很多成年人在盯着你看了。你从小就是个万人迷！”
rows.raw: " You already had plenty of adults gawking by the time I noticed you. Even back then you were a charmer!"

rows.original: And you remember seeing a tiny purple Anyxine weaving between her dad’s six legs as they came over to greet your dad. She was holding a stuffed animal to her chest like it was the most precious thing in the world to her. And then...
rows.translation: 你还记得小小的紫色安妮克辛在父亲的六条腿之间穿梭，两人过来迎接你父亲。她把一只毛绒玩具紧紧抱在胸前，仿佛那是世上最珍贵的宝物。然后...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd you remember seeing a tiny purple Anyxine weaving between her dad’s six legs as they came over to greet your dad. She was holding a stuffed animal to her chest like it was the most precious thing in the world to her. And then..."

rows.original: “...Then I tripped over one of my father’s claws and went tumbling right into you!” Anyx chuckles. Her reptilian tail swishes behind her, scraping the floor of her office. “Listen, you try growing up as the only biped in a house full of hexapedal behemoths three times your size. I won’t make excuses for literally struggling to learn to walk, but it wasn’t easy. I was so embarrassed just from falling that I could have died on the spot, and to come crashing like a scaly battering-ram into the only other kid at the party...”
rows.translation: “...然后我被父亲的一只爪子绊倒，一头摔进了你怀里！”安妮克丝轻笑起来。她的爬行类尾巴在身后甩动，擦过办公室的地板。“你倒是在满屋子体型是你三倍、还全都长着六条腿的庞然大物里，做唯一的两足生物试试。我不会拿自己确实学走路都很费劲当借口，但这真的不容易。光是摔倒就已经让我恨不得当场死掉，更别说像一根披着鳞片的攻城槌一样，撞向派对上唯一的另一个孩子...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...Then I tripped over one of my father’s claws and went tumbling right into you!” Anyx chuckles. Her reptilian tail swishes behind her, scraping the floor of her office. “Listen, you try growing up as the only biped in a house full of hexapedal behemoths three times your size. I won’t make excuses for literally struggling to learn to walk, but it wasn’t easy. I was so embarrassed just from falling that I could have died on the spot, and to come crashing like a scaly battering-ram into the only other kid at the party...”"

rows.original: You laugh. “And then you realized who I was.”
rows.translation: 你笑了。“然后你意识到了我是谁。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh. “And then you realized who I was.”"

rows.original: “Oh, yeah... I didn’t make the connection until I heard you speak. Oh! I suppose the thing to do then would have been to swoon or faint, but...”
rows.translation: “哦，对...直到听见你开口，我才把事情联系起来。啊！我想当时正确的做法应该是吓得软倒或者昏过去，可是...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, yeah... I didn’t make the connection until I heard you speak. Oh! I suppose the thing to do then would have been to swoon or faint, but...”"

rows.original: “... but then you shoved me down and told me to get off?”
rows.translation: “...可你却把我推倒，叫我滚开？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“... but then you shoved me down and told me to get off?”"

rows.original: She snickers.
rows.translation: 她窃笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snickers. "

rows.original: <i>“I’ll never tell you that again, at least...
rows.translation: <i>“我至少不会再对你说那句话了...
rows.raw: "<i>“I’ll never tell you that again, at least..."

rows.original: <i>“Shouldn’t have grabbed my tail, idiot.
rows.translation: <i>“谁叫你抓我的尾巴，白痴。
rows.raw: "<i>“Shouldn’t have grabbed my tail, idiot."

rows.original: Anyway, our dads got into an argument over whose fault it was - both blaming their own kid. They decided to settle it over shots, and pretty soon forgot all about it... which just left you and me to get to know one another.”
rows.translation: 总之，我们的父亲开始争论是谁的错——两个人都怪自己的孩子。他们决定用喝酒来解决，很快就把这事彻底忘了...于是只剩下你和我慢慢熟悉彼此。”
rows.raw: " Anyway, our dads got into an argument over whose fault it was - both blaming their own kid. They decided to settle it over shots, and pretty soon forgot all about it... which just left you and me to get to know one another.”"

rows.original: “So this ‘quest’ Uncle Vic left you,” the half-leithan prompts. “Tell me he didn’t seriously leave your entire inheritance up to your adventuring skills. I mean, you were just starting your first job not long ago.”
rows.translation: “所以，维克叔叔留给你的这个‘任务’，”这位半莱萨人开口道，“别告诉我，他真的把你的全部遗产都押在了你的冒险本领上。我是说，不久前你才刚开始第一份工作。”

rows.original: “Well that’s all very impressive, but it’s still flaberghastingly stupid that Uncle Vic would put you through all that. If he wanted you to prove your mettle before you run the company, he could have given you control of a branch outpost, or a subsidiary, or just sent you to business school or something! Ah, I never understood his obsession with the adventurer mystique. Skill with the blade doesn’t exactly translate to understanding market forces and Confederate bureaucracy. Do you even know what a Form Thirteen-Thirteen-dash-Seventy-Alpha-Oh-Four is? Tsk! You’re going to be totally unprepared for actually running your business!”
rows.translation: “好吧，这一切都很了不起，但维克叔叔让你经历这些，还是愚蠢得令人瞠目。如果他希望你在经营公司前证明自己的本事，他大可以让你掌管一个分部据点、一家子公司，或者干脆送你去商学院之类的地方！唉，我从来不理解他为什么如此迷恋冒险家的浪漫形象。挥刀舞剑的本领可不会直接变成对市场力量和邦联官僚体系的理解。你甚至知道十三-十三-横杠-七十-阿尔法-零四表格是什么吗？啧！真到经营公司的时候，你肯定会毫无准备！”

If he wanted you to prove your mettle before you run the company, he could have given you control of a branch outpost, or a subsidiary, or just sent you to business school or something! Ah, I never understood his obsession with the adventurer mystique. Skill with the blade doesn’t exactly translate to understanding market forces and Confederate bureaucracy. Do you even know what a Form Thirteen-Thirteen-dash-Seventy-Alpha-Oh-Four is? Tsk! You’re going to be totally unprepared for actually running your business!”"

rows.original: That’s not entirely fair... you’re certainly getting hands-on lessons with courage, charisma, and reckless disregard for your own safety. There’s gotta be some moral lesson that’s rubbing off on you in all this, right?

rows.original: “How’s your office holding up?” you ask, leaning in on the desk. “Everything seems pretty organized around here.”
rows.translation: “你的办事处经营得怎么样？”你靠向桌面问道。“这里看起来井井有条。”
rows.raw: "“How’s your office holding up?” you ask, leaning in on the desk. “Everything seems pretty organized around here.”"

rows.original: “Damn right,” Anyx grins, “I don’t do anything half-assed. When I took over, the Uveto office was a mess, so in the red I thought my father was joking when he gave me the specs. But I’ve turned it around. The cold is an ever-present problem, especially for my poor leithans - we’re from a desert world, and the workers really suffer in the freeze - but we’ve brought in heavy enclosed-cabin equipment and built monorails to minimize exposure. But I wish the cold was our only problem...”
rows.translation: “那当然，”安妮克丝咧嘴一笑，“我做什么都不会敷衍了事。刚接手时，乌维托办事处一团糟，亏损严重得让我看到数据时还以为父亲在开玩笑。但我把局面扭转过来了。寒冷始终是个问题，尤其对我那些可怜的莱萨人员工来说——我们来自沙漠世界，工人们在严寒中真的很难熬——不过我们引进了带全封闭驾驶舱的重型设备，还修建了单轨铁路，尽量减少暴露在户外的时间。但愿寒冷就是我们唯一的问题...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” Anyx grins, “I don’t do anything half-assed. When I took over, the Uveto office was a mess, so in the red I thought my father was joking when he gave me the specs. But I’ve turned it around. The cold is an ever-present problem, especially for my poor leithans - we’re from a desert world, and the workers really suffer in the freeze - but we’ve brought in heavy enclosed-cabin equipment and built monorails to minimize exposure. But I wish the cold was our only problem...”"

rows.original: You’ve got a guess what’s being a pain in Anyx’s side, and it’s small and feathery and loves money more than sex.
rows.translation: 你大概猜得到是什么在给安妮克丝添堵了：体型小，长着羽毛，而且爱钱胜过爱做爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve got a guess what’s being a pain in Anyx’s side, and it’s small and feathery and loves money more than sex."

rows.original: She snickers. “The Tove are obnoxious but easily handled with judicious litigation and bureaucromancy of the darkest order. At this point we’ve sued and counter-sued each other into a legal standstill and I think by Tove standards that means either I’ve earned the Maven’s respect or we’re married. Birds are weird like that. But no, I wish they were my biggest issue. Uveto would be more fun than miserable then, even with the cold.”
rows.translation: 她窃笑起来。“托芙族确实惹人厌，但只要适度诉讼，再施展最黑暗的官僚法术，就很容易对付。如今我们彼此起诉、反诉，已经陷入法律僵局；按托芙族的标准，这大概意味着我不是赢得了那位贤者的尊重，就是跟她结婚了。鸟人就是这么古怪。不过不是，我倒希望她们是最大的问题。那样一来，即使天气这么冷，乌维托也会有趣多过痛苦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snickers. “The Tove are obnoxious but easily handled with judicious litigation and bureaucromancy of the darkest order. At this point we’ve sued and counter-sued each other into a legal standstill and I think by Tove standards that means either I’ve earned the Maven’s respect or we’re married. Birds are weird like that. But no, I wish they were my biggest issue. Uveto would be more fun than miserable then, even with the cold.”"

rows.original: Anyxine sighs and leans back, curling her tail around a leg. “No, our problem is the damn planet is fighting us at every turn! Somehow after centuries of occupation, Akkadi hasn’t managed to break the natives’ will! They should have been uplifted generations ago, but instead our miners constantly have to contend with barbarian tiger-people and dwarf-dogs harassing them, kidnapping them, sometimes worse. Lucky us, leithans aren’t fertile with most live-birthing races... or we’d be rotating out workers faster than we can train them.”
rows.translation: 安妮克辛叹了口气，向后靠去，把尾巴缠在一条腿上。“不，我们的问题是这颗该死的星球处处跟我们作对！被占领了足足几个世纪，阿卡迪竟然还是没能摧毁原住民的意志！他们早在好几代人以前就该被提升文明了，可我们的矿工却仍得不断应付那些虎人和矮狗野蛮人的骚扰、绑架，有时甚至是更糟的事。幸好莱萨人和大多数胎生种族无法繁衍...否则我们轮换工人的速度会比培训他们还快。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyxine sighs and leans back, curling her tail around a leg. “No, our problem is the damn planet is fighting us at every turn! Somehow after centuries of occupation, Akkadi hasn’t managed to break the natives’ will! They should have been uplifted generations ago, but instead our miners constantly have to contend with barbarian tiger-people and dwarf-dogs harassing them, kidnapping them, sometimes worse. Lucky us, leithans aren’t fertile with most live-birthing races... or we’d be rotating out workers faster than we can train them.”"

rows.original: She shakes her head. “Our security force is always stretched thin, and these savages come in warbands. If it wasn’t the middle of a Rush I’d cut into our profits to hire mercenaries, but all the reputable companies are out rushing the virgin worlds. Tsk! And then there’s the dragon!”
rows.translation: 她摇了摇头。“我们的安保力量总是捉襟见肘，而这些野蛮人成群结队地袭来。要不是如今正值开拓热潮，我宁愿削减利润也会雇些佣兵，可所有信誉良好的公司都赶去开拓处女世界了。啧！而且还有那条龙！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head. “Our security force is always stretched thin, and these savages come in warbands. If it wasn’t the middle of a Rush I’d cut into our profits to hire mercenaries, but all the reputable companies are out rushing the virgin worlds. Tsk! And then there’s the dragon!”"

rows.original: “Well, you don’t have to worry about that anymore!” you say proudly.
rows.translation: “这个你不用再担心了！”你自豪地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you don’t have to worry about that anymore!” you say proudly."

rows.original: Anyx gives you a wicked smirk. “So I hear. That’s a hell of a feat, [pc.name]. Hopefully frostwyrms are as rare as their codex indicates, and we won’t have to deal with another of them for some time.”
rows.translation: 安妮克丝坏坏地朝你一笑。“我听说了。那可真是了不起的壮举，[pc.name]。希望霜龙真的像CODEX终端记载的那样罕见，让我们暂时不用再对付第二条。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyx gives you a wicked smirk. “So I hear. That’s a hell of a feat, [pc.name]. Hopefully frostwyrms are as rare as their codex indicates, and we won’t have to deal with another of them for some time.”"

rows.translation: “不过...”她一边低声说，一边翻阅桌上的平板。“自从你第一次抵达以来，霜龙袭击我们设备的报告减少了将近一半。这...还真是有趣的巧合。”

rows.original: The de-facto head honcho of Uveto Station sits before you, reclining in a padded swivel chair and surrounded by glowing holo-terminals in an otherwise spartan, utilitarian office. Anyxine is a biological unicorn - the almost-unheard-of offspring of a leithan and another race: in her case, one of the dragon-like hermaphrodites called gryvain. Anyx is a tall bipedal humanoid, standing around 6' 5" with the normal assortment of arms and legs, with the addition of a thick, smooth, and soft-scaled tail that grows from a thick base above her waist and tapered to a finger-thing blunted tip well past her feet.
rows.translation: 乌维托空间站事实上的最高负责人坐在你面前，斜倚在一把带软垫的转椅中；这间简朴实用的办公室里，发光的全息终端环绕着她。安妮克辛是一位生物学上的奇迹混血儿——莱萨人和另一种族极其罕见的后代；在她身上，另一半血统来自形似巨龙的双性格里文族。安妮克丝是一个高大的双足类人生物，身高约六英尺五英寸，手臂和双腿的数量都很普通，此外还长着一条粗壮、光滑、覆着柔软鳞片的尾巴。尾巴从腰部上方粗厚的根部伸出，逐渐收细，在远过脚部的位置以近似手指的钝头结束。
rows.raw: "The de-facto head honcho of Uveto Station sits before you, reclining in a padded swivel chair and surrounded by glowing holo-terminals in an otherwise spartan, utilitarian office. Anyxine is a biological unicorn - the almost-unheard-of offspring of a leithan and another race: in her case, one of the dragon-like hermaphrodites called gryvain. Anyx is a tall bipedal humanoid, standing around 6' 5\" with the normal assortment of arms and legs, with the addition of a thick, smooth, and soft-scaled tail that grows from a thick base above her waist and tapered to a finger-thing blunted tip well past her feet."

rows.original: Anyx’s skin is an ashen, off-purple color, peppered with small scales around her cheeks and upper chest, almost like freckles, complementing the smooth, chitinous armored plates that appear on her tapered elfin ears and forelimbs. The plates on her arms and shins are augmented with small lines of bioluminescent patterns, glowing faintly yellow to the beat of her heart, and match a pair of straight glowing lines running down the length of her tail.
rows.translation: 安妮克丝的皮肤呈灰暗的浅紫色，脸颊和上胸部点缀着细小鳞片，几乎就像雀斑；这些鳞片与她尖细的精灵耳和四肢上光滑的几丁质甲片相映成趣。她手臂和小腿上的甲片点缀着一道道细小的生物发光纹路，随心跳发出淡黄色光芒，与沿尾巴延伸的两条笔直发光线条互相呼应。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyx’s skin is an ashen, off-purple color, peppered with small scales around her cheeks and upper chest, almost like freckles, complementing the smooth, chitinous armored plates that appear on her tapered elfin ears and forelimbs. The plates on her arms and shins are augmented with small lines of bioluminescent patterns, glowing faintly yellow to the beat of her heart, and match a pair of straight glowing lines running down the length of her tail."

rows.original: Blue hair, so wine-dark and lustrous that it’s almost black, hangs in loose locks around her shoulders. She’s combed it mostly off to one side, letting it half-shield one of her starry-irised, slitted blue eyes and studded ears. Past the Sheriff’s office, and the meteorological survey, and then around a corner and down another hall to a big pair of sliding frosted-glass doors. When they open, you’re hit with a billowing wave of wet heat that seems to fight back the moon’s deep freeze with everything it’s got, welcoming you into a lobby that seems like a blessed relief from Uveto itself.

rows.translation: “总之，爸爸出场时，那家伙的银河摔跤之旅已经进行很久了，我想他当时大概每十场只输一场。他既过度自信又感到无聊，所以爸爸第一回合把他摔倒时，他差点当场输掉。不过这不是什么奇迹电影，第二回合那家伙重新站稳了脚跟。爸爸让他吃尽苦头，但还是没赢。”她咧嘴大笑，凑近了一点。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway, dad was pretty far into this guy’s galactic wrestle-quest, and at that point I think he had lost maybe one in ten matches. He was some mix of overconfident and bored, so when my dad floored him in the first round he almost lost on the spot. It wasn’t some miracle movie though, and the guy got his footing back in the second round. Dad gave him a run for his money, but didn’t win.” She gets a big grin, leaning a little closer."

rows.original: “Didn’t win the fight anyway. One family watching the game had a daughter about my dad’s age, and she was immediately smitten with dad to astronomically cliched levels. So much so that she walked up to him after the match was over, a blushing nervous wreck, and asked him to marry her. Do you know what he said? He said no.” She mocks a frown, shaking her head to match the notion.
rows.translation: “反正没赢下比赛。当时有一家人在看比赛，他们的女儿和爸爸年纪相仿，对他一见钟情，程度老套得简直突破天际。她在比赛结束后直接走上前，羞得紧张兮兮，问他愿不愿意娶自己。你知道他说什么吗？他说不。”她故意皱起眉头，摇头配合这个荒唐说法。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Didn’t win the fight anyway. One family watching the game had a daughter about my dad’s age, and she was immediately smitten with dad to astronomically cliched levels. So much so that she walked up to him after the match was over, a blushing nervous wreck, and asked him to marry her. Do you know what he said? He said no.” She mocks a frown, shaking her head to match the notion."

rows.original: “Now, mom really was that shy, and probably would’ve accepted this outcome, but he offered to get to know her if she wanted another chance to ask. She hastily accepted, getting her parents’ permission to visit him here on Uveto over the next few years, and eventually moving in with him after she finished school. He said yes the second time she asked, the day after she graduated. Her parents weren’t very happy,” she continues, her frown losing its joviality.
rows.translation: “其实妈妈当时真的那么害羞，大概会接受这个结果，可爸爸提出，如果她想再问一次，两人可以先互相了解。她立刻答应了，接下来几年里征得父母同意来乌维托探望他，最后毕业后搬来和他同住。她第二次求婚，就在毕业后的第二天，爸爸答应了。她父母可不太高兴，”她继续讲述，脸上的皱眉渐渐失去玩笑意味。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, mom really was that shy, and probably would’ve accepted this outcome, but he offered to get to know her if she wanted another chance to ask. She hastily accepted, getting her parents’ permission to visit him here on Uveto over the next few years, and eventually moving in with him after she finished school. He said yes the second time she asked, the day after she graduated. Her parents weren’t very happy,” she continues, her frown losing its joviality."

rows.original: “She really wanted to have a kid, but bruchandus don’t exactly have the same kind of plumbing as huskar, and that kind of change isn’t something an average person can do easily. So she scrounged up all the money she could find, and with dad’s help got a surgery to make her fertile. I happened about a year later,” she says, returning to a slightly happier mood.
rows.translation: “她真的很想要孩子，但布鲁坎德斯人的器官结构和赫斯卡人不太一样，而且那种改造绝非普通人轻易能做的。所以她搜罗出能找到的每一分钱，在爸爸帮助下做了手术，让自己能够生育。大约一年后就有了我，”她说着，情绪重新明朗了些。
rows.raw: "\n\n“She really wanted to have a kid, but bruchandus don’t exactly have the same kind of plumbing as huskar, and that kind of change isn’t something an average person can do easily. So she scrounged up all the money she could find, and with dad’s help got a surgery to make her fertile. I happened about a year later,” she says, returning to a slightly happier mood."

rows.original: “Mom loved every second of it, even the painful bits. Her parents didn’t. They all but disowned her as soon as they found out she was planning it. My grandmother doesn’t acknowledge that she is one, and sometimes I think she might not admit to people that she has a daughter. My mom had a hard time with it at first, but dad’s parents were more than happy to have a grandchild, and spoiled the everloving fuck out of both me and mom.” The half-bruchandus’ eyes mist a little, but she still laughs as she goes on.
rows.translation: “妈妈喜欢其中每一秒，连痛苦的部分也不例外。她父母可不喜欢，一发现她有这个打算，就几乎与她断绝关系。我外婆不承认自己是外婆，有时我觉得她甚至不会向别人承认自己有个女儿。妈妈起初很难受，不过爸爸的父母非常乐意有个孙女，对我和妈妈都他妈宠上了天。”半布鲁坎德斯人的双眼泛起泪光，不过讲下去时仍然笑着。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mom loved every second of it, even the painful bits. Her parents didn’t. They all but disowned her as soon as they found out she was planning it. My grandmother doesn’t acknowledge that she is one, and sometimes I think she might not admit to people that she has a daughter. My mom had a hard time with it at first, but dad’s parents were more than happy to have a grandchild, and spoiled the everloving fuck out of both me and mom.” The half-bruchandus’ eyes mist a little, but she still laughs as she goes on."

rows.original: “Mom didn’t even bat an eye when I told her I was gay, or that my girlfriend was a puazi. The first thing she asked was whether or not she needed to worry about her human friends having been in the house the day before Gwen came for dinner. Dad was just worried about how ‘young’ I was. Not everyone waits till they’re thirty six,” the sable shopkeep looks down, finding her fingers steepled.
rows.translation: “我告诉妈妈自己喜欢女人，女朋友还是普阿兹人时，她连眼睛都没眨一下。她问的第一件事，是不是需要担心格温来吃晚饭的前一天，她那些人类朋友刚到过家里。爸爸只是担心我还‘年轻’。又不是每个人都会等到三十六岁，”黑肤店主低下头，发现自己的十指已经相抵在一起。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mom didn’t even bat an eye when I told her I was gay, or that my girlfriend was a puazi. The first thing she asked was whether or not she needed to worry about her human friends having been in the house the day before Gwen came for dinner. Dad was just worried about how ‘young’ I was. Not everyone waits till they’re thirty six,” the sable shopkeep looks down, finding her fingers steepled."

rows.original: “I’m really happy with my family. It’s nice when thinking with your heart gets you exactly where you want to be,” she finishes.
rows.translation: “我真的很爱我的家人。听从内心便恰好抵达想去的地方，这种感觉真好，”她总结道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m really happy with my family. It’s nice when thinking with your heart gets you exactly where you want to be,” she finishes."

rows.original: “Now that I got that out, did you want anything else?”
rows.translation: “该说的都说完了，还有别的想问吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now that I got that out, did you want anything else?”"

rows.original: Gardeford
rows.raw: "Gardeford"

rows.original: You see the shopkeeper couple exiting their store and walk up to greet them. Gwen waves as she sees you, totally encased in fluffy winter gear.
rows.translation: 你看见店主情侣离开商店，便走上前打招呼。格温看见你时挥了挥手，整个人完全裹在蓬松的冬装里。
rows.raw: "You see the shopkeeper couple exiting their store and walk up to greet them. Gwen waves as she sees you, totally encased in fluffy winter gear."

rows.original: “Steele! Glad you could make it. Our place is just down the elevator,” she relates,
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔！很高兴你能来。我们家坐电梯下去就到，”她说道，
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele! Glad you could make it. Our place is just down the elevator,” she relates,"

rows.original: looping her arm under your own to walk alongside you
rows.translation: 将手臂挽进你的臂弯，与你并肩而行
rows.raw: " looping her arm under your own to walk alongside you"

rows.original: grasping hold of your hand to walk beside you
rows.translation: 握住你的手，走在你身旁
rows.raw: " grasping hold of your hand to walk beside you"

rows.original: . She pulls you toward the large tunnel, directing you towards the section designated for personnel use. Eimear lines up on your other side, matching her wife’s gesture. You notice a fair share of jealous stares as you enter the elevator, framed by the two alluring aliens.
rows.translation: 。她拉着你走向巨大的隧道，把你带往标为工作人员专用的区域。艾梅尔来到你另一侧，学着妻子的动作。当你被两位诱人的外星人簇拥着走进电梯时，注意到不少嫉妒的目光。
rows.raw: ". She pulls you toward the large tunnel, directing you towards the section designated for personnel use. Eimear lines up on your other side, matching her wife’s gesture. You notice a fair share of jealous stares as you enter the elevator, framed by the two alluring aliens."

rows.original: Despite the elevators foreboding size, it doesn’t take long at all before you reach the city proper. You let yourself be lead through the main thoroughfare, your guides directing you toward a large condominium. Despite the heat-belt strapped to her waist, steam trails in thin wisps from Eimear’s skin. Even inside the city the cold still nips relentlessly. The three of you take a regular sized elevator up to the fourth floor, stepping out into a short hallway with a single door.
rows.translation: 尽管电梯的尺寸令人望而生畏，你们很快便抵达了城市本体。你任由两位向导带自己穿过主干道，来到一栋大型公寓楼。即使腰间系着保温带，艾梅尔的皮肤上仍有蒸汽化作缕缕细丝飘散。哪怕在城内，寒意依旧无情刺骨。你们三人搭乘普通大小的电梯来到四楼，走进一条只有一扇门的短走廊。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite the elevators foreboding size, it doesn’t take long at all before you reach the city proper. You let yourself be lead through the main thoroughfare, your guides directing you toward a large condominium. Despite the heat-belt strapped to her waist, steam trails in thin wisps from Eimear’s skin. Even inside the city the cold still nips relentlessly. The three of you take a regular sized elevator up to the fourth floor, stepping out into a short hallway with a single door."

rows.original: Gwen rummages through her purse, pulling out a slate blue keycard. The door clicks and pops open, revealing an expansive living room complete with cushioned computer gaming areas and a massive projection screen on the wall in front of an equally gigantic couch. Holotapes and videogame consoles border the screen, stacked neatly in short piles. To your right, a large kitchen area dominates the east wall. There are two closed doors along the other walls.
rows.translation: 格温翻找手提包，拿出一张石板蓝色钥匙卡。房门咔嗒一声弹开，露出宽敞的客厅：带软垫的电脑游戏区、墙上的巨型投影屏幕，以及屏幕前同样巨大的沙发，一应俱全。全息影带和电子游戏主机环绕屏幕，整齐堆成一个个小垛。右边是一片占据东墙的大厨房区域，其他墙边则有两扇紧闭的门。
rows.raw: "\n\nGwen rummages through her purse, pulling out a slate blue keycard. The door clicks and pops open, revealing an expansive living room complete with cushioned computer gaming areas and a massive projection screen on the wall in front of an equally gigantic couch. Holotapes and videogame consoles border the screen, stacked neatly in short piles. To your right, a large kitchen area dominates the east wall. There are two closed doors along the other walls."

rows.original: “This is our house! Over there is our bedroom, and that one is the bathroom. I’m gonna go grab some snacks, so please make yourself at home,” Gwen gushes as you enter. She rushes off to the kitchen, ditching her winter jacket as she goes. Eimear hangs her heat belt on a wall rack by the door, and you follow her as she moves to the couch.
rows.translation: “这就是我们家！那边是卧室，那一间是浴室。我要去拿点零食，请把这里当自己家，”格温进门后滔滔不绝地介绍。她冲向厨房，途中脱下冬季外套。艾梅尔把保温带挂在门边墙架上，走向沙发，你则跟在她身后。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is our house! Over there is our bedroom, and that one is the bathroom. I’m gonna go grab some snacks, so please make yourself at home,” Gwen gushes as you enter. She rushes off to the kitchen, ditching her winter jacket as she goes. Eimear hangs her heat belt on a wall rack by the door, and you follow her as she moves to the couch."

rows.original: “I’m thinking an episode of The Flare. The new season is starting up soon, so we can start with the first episode,” she states as you
rows.translation: “我想看一集耀焰侠。新一季很快就要开播，所以我们可以从第一集看起，”她说道，同时你
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m thinking an episode of The Flare. The new season is starting up soon, so we can start with the first episode,” she states as you"

rows.original: ease your way onto the cushions
rows.translation: 慢慢挪到软垫上
rows.raw: " ease your way onto the cushions"

rows.original: drop yourself onto the cushions
rows.translation: 一屁股坐到软垫上
rows.raw: " drop yourself onto the cushions"

rows.original: . You sink into the comfortable plush material, taking your time to get situated.
rows.translation: 。你陷进舒适蓬松的材质里，不慌不忙地调整坐姿。
rows.raw: ". You sink into the comfortable plush material, taking your time to get situated."

rows.original: You’re surprised to find the material wicking away the excess liquid produced by your body, leaving it dry and pillowy.
rows.translation: 你惊讶地发现，这种材质会吸走身体产生的多余液体，令其保持干爽柔软。
rows.raw: " You’re surprised to find the material wicking away the excess liquid produced by your body, leaving it dry and pillowy."

rows.original: Eimear quickly finds what she is looking for, slotting the holotape into a nearby player and joining you on the couch. Gwen butts in moments later, squishing herself between the two of you with a large bucket of popcorn.
rows.translation: 艾梅尔很快找到目标，把全息影带插进附近的播放器，坐到你身边。片刻后格温挤了进来，抱着一大桶爆米花塞在你们之间。
rows.raw: " Eimear quickly finds what she is looking for, slotting the holotape into a nearby player and joining you on the couch. Gwen butts in moments later, squishing herself between the two of you with a large bucket of popcorn."

rows.original: “Alright! First episode, go!” she says, prompting the device to begin playing.
rows.translation: “好啦！第一集，播放！”她说道，播放器随之开始运转。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright! First episode, go!” she says, prompting the device to begin playing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A large spaceship cruises through the black expanse of space, following a much smaller ship through an asteroid field, firing weapons as it moves. Inside the ship, a tall, armored knight stands stoically. He glares at the smaller ship through the windows of the control deck.
rows.translation: 一艘大型飞船巡航于漆黑太空，在小行星带中追逐一艘小得多的飞船，并在飞行中不断开火。大船内部，一名高大的铠甲骑士岿然站立，透过控制甲板的舷窗怒视小船。
rows.raw: "A large spaceship cruises through the black expanse of space, following a much smaller ship through an asteroid field, firing weapons as it moves. Inside the ship, a tall, armored knight stands stoically. He glares at the smaller ship through the windows of the control deck."

rows.original: “You have evaded me long enough,” he remarks under his breath. “No one can run from me forever.” Upon the completion of this statement, he is surrounded by a large animated nameplate, large barriers surrounding the name ‘Ironwall, The Turgid Terror.’
rows.translation: “你躲我躲得够久了，”他低声说道。“没人能永远逃出我的手掌。”话音刚落，一块巨大的动态名牌便将他包围，硕大屏障环绕着名字‘铁壁，胀欲恐魔’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You have evaded me long enough,” he remarks under his breath. “No one can run from me forever.” Upon the completion of this statement, he is surrounded by a large animated nameplate, large barriers surrounding the name ‘Ironwall, The Turgid Terror.’"

rows.original: Gwen leans over, cupping a hand to your ear. “That’s Ironwall, he’s a supervillain with the ability to create barriers. His armor enhances latent psionic powers to increase their str-oww” she yelps as Eimear jabs her in the side to shut her up.
rows.translation: 格温靠过来，一手拢在你耳边。“那是铁壁，他是能制造屏障的超级反派。他的盔甲会强化潜在的灵能，提高它们的强——嗷”艾梅尔戳了她肋下一下，让她闭嘴，她不禁叫出声来。
rows.raw: "\n\nGwen leans over, cupping a hand to your ear. “That’s Ironwall, he’s a supervillain with the ability to create barriers. His armor enhances latent psionic powers to increase their str-oww” she yelps as Eimear jabs her in the side to shut her up."

rows.original: “Let [pc.himHer] watch,” she whispers.
rows.translation: “让[pc.himHer]看，”她低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let [pc.himHer] watch,” she whispers."

rows.original: When you look back to the show, the focus has changed to what must be the interior of the smaller ship. A man in a rather phallic looking suit of armor sits at the controls, with warning sirens blaring and outside explosions rocking the cockpit. His suit is navy blue, with gauntlets that flare out like metallic horsecocks. Phosphorescent green shades shield his eyes, leaving only a wide grin visible.
rows.translation: 你重新看向节目时，画面已切到小飞船内部。一名穿着颇似阳具铠甲的男人坐在操纵台前，警报声大作，外面的爆炸震撼着驾驶舱。他的战甲呈海军蓝，护手向外张开，形似金属马鸡巴。荧光绿色墨镜遮住双眼，只露出灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you look back to the show, the focus has changed to what must be the interior of the smaller ship. A man in a rather phallic looking suit of armor sits at the controls, with warning sirens blaring and outside explosions rocking the cockpit. His suit is navy blue, with gauntlets that flare out like metallic horsecocks. Phosphorescent green shades shield his eyes, leaving only a wide grin visible."

rows.original: “Damn him! Hold on guys! It looks like we’ll just have to finish him here and now,” he shouts, a nameplate proclaiming him to be ‘The Flare, Hero of Justice.’ He turns hard on the ship’s controls, moving directly toward the larger craft.
rows.translation: “该死的家伙！抓稳了，各位！看来我们只能在这里立刻解决他，”他大喊道，名牌宣布他是‘正义英雄耀焰侠’。他猛扳飞船操纵装置，径直冲向大型飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn him! Hold on guys! It looks like we’ll just have to finish him here and now,” he shouts, a nameplate proclaiming him to be ‘The Flare, Hero of Justice.’ He turns hard on the ship’s controls, moving directly toward the larger craft."

rows.original: “You idiot, you’re going to get us killed!” comes a voice from the ship’s rear quarters.
rows.translation: “你这个白痴，会害死我们的！”声音从飞船后舱传来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You idiot, you’re going to get us killed!” comes a voice from the ship’s rear quarters."

rows.original: “Not today I’m not, just get ready to jump,” he shouts in reply.
rows.translation: “今天不会，准备跳船就行，”他高声回应。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not today I’m not, just get ready to jump,” he shouts in reply."

rows.original: “We don’t have the money to buy another ship!”
rows.translation: “我们没钱再买一艘飞船！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We don’t have the money to buy another ship!”"

rows.original: “His mind is set, girlie, just hunker down.”
rows.translation: “他心意已决，小姑娘，趴稳就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“His mind is set, girlie, just hunker down.”"

rows.original: The scene switches to a ship’s interior. Robotic soldiers mill about, carrying out various cleaning duties. Suddenly an immense explosion rocks the wall, with the Flare leaping out of the flames, flanked by a sumo-sized man carrying a massive hammer and a robotic centauress wielding a plasma rifle.
rows.translation: 画面切换到飞船内部。机器人士兵来回走动，执行各种清洁工作。忽然，一场剧烈爆炸震撼墙壁，耀焰侠从火焰中跃出，身旁跟着一名相扑选手般魁梧、手持巨锤的男人，以及一位端着等离子步枪的机器人半人马女性。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe scene switches to a ship’s interior. Robotic soldiers mill about, carrying out various cleaning duties. Suddenly an immense explosion rocks the wall, with the Flare leaping out of the flames, flanked by a sumo-sized man carrying a massive hammer and a robotic centauress wielding a plasma rifle."

rows.original: “This is not an effective strategy!” shouts the centaur, a nameplate labeling her ‘Taurina, master tactician.’ She blasts away some approaching droids, but doesn’t notice a larger one approaching behind her. Before it can attack, it is smashed to pieces by the hammer from before.
rows.translation: “这不是有效的战术！”半人马大喊，名牌标明她是‘战术大师陶丽娜’。她轰倒几台接近的机器人，却没发现一台更大的正从背后逼近。它还没来得及攻击，便被刚才那柄巨锤砸成碎片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is not an effective strategy!” shouts the centaur, a nameplate labeling her ‘Taurina, master tactician.’ She blasts away some approaching droids, but doesn’t notice a larger one approaching behind her. Before it can attack, it is smashed to pieces by the hammer from before."

rows.original: “How many times have I told you to watch your back. Master tactician, bah!” the heavyset titan shouts, hefting his weapon. Ironclad bars label him as ‘Ivan Orgoth, The Shaft of Strength.’
rows.translation: “我跟你说过多少次，要留意背后。战术大师，呸！”那名魁梧巨人高喊着扛起武器。铁箍般的名牌称他为‘力量之柱伊万·奥戈斯’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How many times have I told you to watch your back. Master tactician, bah!” the heavyset titan shouts, hefting his weapon. Ironclad bars label him as ‘Ivan Orgoth, The Shaft of Strength.’"

rows.original: Robots with wicked looking sharp bits approach from every side, and the three heroes group in a tight cluster. A loud noise alerts them to the hole their ship punched in the larger spacecraft. A vacuum begins that pulls many of the robots into the vastness of space. Taurina grabs her compatriots, her hooves magnetically anchoring her to the floor. She trudges toward an open hallway, managing to get through just before it closes off, and dropping her cargo to the ground. The two men cough and sputter for a few seconds, steadily recovering their bearings.
rows.translation: 带着狰狞利刃的机器人从四面八方逼近，三位英雄紧紧聚成一团。一声巨响使他们注意到自家飞船在大型飞船上撞出的破洞。真空吸力骤然出现，将许多机器人拖入浩瀚太空。陶丽娜一把抓住同伴，磁性马蹄牢牢吸附在地板上。她艰难走向一条开放走廊，赶在舱门封闭前进入，将两件货物扔到地上。两名男子咳嗽喘息数秒，逐渐恢复神智。
rows.raw: "\n\nRobots with wicked looking sharp bits approach from every side, and the three heroes group in a tight cluster. A loud noise alerts them to the hole their ship punched in the larger spacecraft. A vacuum begins that pulls many of the robots into the vastness of space. Taurina grabs her compatriots, her hooves magnetically anchoring her to the floor. She trudges toward an open hallway, managing to get through just before it closes off, and dropping her cargo to the ground. The two men cough and sputter for a few seconds, steadily recovering their bearings."

rows.original: “Thanks Taurina, we’d be dead without your help,” Flare declares with a grin. The digital display that makes up the mechanical centaurs face shows a blush, and she struggles to find words. She trots down the hallway, huffing and shaking her head.
rows.translation: “谢谢你，陶丽娜，没有你帮忙，我们早死了，”耀焰侠咧嘴说道。机械半人马脸部的数字显示屏浮现红晕，她一时找不到话说，只得小跑着沿走廊离开，气呼呼地摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks Taurina, we’d be dead without your help,” Flare declares with a grin. The digital display that makes up the mechanical centaurs face shows a blush, and she struggles to find words. She trots down the hallway, huffing and shaking her head."

rows.original: “Damn right you would. Don’t ever let me hear about you going on a mission without me, you’d somehow wind up killing yourself before you got there,” she laments, reaching the end door before they begin to follow. When the group reaches the end of the corridor, Flare presses a button to open the door, only to reveal a wall of armed murderbots, weapons trained on the surprised heroes.
rows.translation: “没错，你们就是会死。永远别让我听说你没带我就出任务，不然你大概还没到地方就稀里糊涂害死自己了，”她抱怨着，在另外两人开始跟上前便抵达尽头的门。众人来到走廊末端，耀焰侠按下按钮开门，却发现门后站满武装杀戮机器人，武器全都瞄准了惊讶的英雄们。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right you would. Don’t ever let me hear about you going on a mission without me, you’d somehow wind up killing yourself before you got there,” she laments, reaching the end door before they begin to follow. When the group reaches the end of the corridor, Flare presses a button to open the door, only to reveal a wall of armed murderbots, weapons trained on the surprised heroes."

rows.original: “We have you surrounded, don’t move,” barks one of the droids, pointing menacingly at the unorthodox ensemble of fighters.
rows.translation: “你们已被包围，别动，”一台机器人厉声说道，武器气势汹汹地指向这群不同寻常的战士。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We have you surrounded, don’t move,” barks one of the droids, pointing menacingly at the unorthodox ensemble of fighters."

rows.original: “You villains will never stop the motion of justice! You’ve given me enough time to prepare one of my special attacks! Expel, bursting white explosion!” shouts the Flare, punching the air towards the corridor. A pulse of glowing white energy bursts from his gauntlet, washing over the battalion of bots and penetrating their armor. When the light dies down all that’s left is a scrap-heap.
rows.translation: “你们这些恶徒永远无法阻挡正义前进！你们给了我足够时间准备特殊攻击！驱逐，爆裂白光！”耀焰侠大喊着，朝走廊挥拳。一股发光的白色能量从护手爆发，扫过机器人军团并穿透装甲。光芒消散后，只剩一堆废铁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You villains will never stop the motion of justice! You’ve given me enough time to prepare one of my special attacks! Expel, bursting white explosion!” shouts the Flare, punching the air towards the corridor. A pulse of glowing white energy bursts from his gauntlet, washing over the battalion of bots and penetrating their armor. When the light dies down all that’s left is a scrap-heap."

rows.original: “You idiot!” yells Taurina, bashing him on the shoulder before continuing, “That attack leaves your arm unusable for the next hour. What happens if there’s another ambush, or if you need your full strength to stop Ironwall?”
rows.translation: “你这个白痴！”陶丽娜大叫，一拳砸在他肩上，随后继续说道，“那招会让你的手臂接下来一小时都无法使用。如果又有伏击，或者你需要全力阻止铁壁，该怎么办？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You idiot!” yells Taurina, bashing him on the shoulder before continuing, “That attack leaves your arm unusable for the next hour. What happens if there’s another ambush, or if you need your full strength to stop Ironwall?”"

rows.original: “You worry too much, Taurina. With you and Ivan by my side, there’s no way he can stop us,” he says, patting her on the back of her tauric half. His left arm hangs limply at his side, fingers twitching on occasion, but otherwise immobile.
rows.translation: “你担心得太多了，陶丽娜。有你和伊万陪在身边，他不可能阻止我们，”他说着，拍了拍她半人马身体的背部。他左臂无力地垂在身旁，手指偶尔抽动，除此以外一动不动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You worry too much, Taurina. With you and Ivan by my side, there’s no way he can stop us,” he says, patting her on the back of her tauric half. His left arm hangs limply at his side, fingers twitching on occasion, but otherwise immobile."

rows.original: The trio make their way forward, reaching the ship’s bridge in a surprisingly short time. After a few steps in the group gives a collective gasp as sapphire energy surrounds the Flare’s companions, locking them inside impenetrable cages of pure energy.
rows.translation: 三人继续前进，快得出奇地抵达飞船舰桥。队伍刚走几步，便一同倒抽冷气：蓝宝石色能量包围耀焰侠的伙伴，将他们锁进纯能量组成、无法穿透的牢笼。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe trio make their way forward, reaching the ship’s bridge in a surprisingly short time. After a few steps in the group gives a collective gasp as sapphire energy surrounds the Flare’s companions, locking them inside impenetrable cages of pure energy."

rows.original: “You thought to burst in guns blazing against a psionic of my caliber? Perhaps you thought you were being stealthy; I’ve known stupider soldiers,” comes the deep rumbling of Ironwall’s voice. The large captain’s chair turns around to reveal his seated frame.
rows.translation: “你以为能对我这种等级的灵能者大张旗鼓地闯进来？也许你还以为自己悄无声息；我见过比这更蠢的士兵，”铁壁低沉如雷的声音响起。巨大的舰长椅转过来，露出他端坐其上的身影。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You thought to burst in guns blazing against a psionic of my caliber? Perhaps you thought you were being stealthy; I’ve known stupider soldiers,” comes the deep rumbling of Ironwall’s voice. The large captain’s chair turns around to reveal his seated frame."

rows.original: “Or maybe you’re brazen enough to think that you can defeat me. I’ve analyzed your techniques, and I know you won’t be able to use that attack again using that arm. Even with the other arm available, that level of power won’t puncture my barriers. I’m going to end your heroic career here and now,” the wicked knight threatens. Globes of evil energy begin to form in his hands, humming menacingly as they grow.
rows.translation: “又或许你狂妄到认为自己能打败我。我已经分析过你的招式，知道那条手臂无法再次发动刚才的攻击。即便另一条手臂还能用，那种程度的力量也无法击穿我的屏障。我要在此时此地终结你的英雄生涯，”邪恶骑士威胁道。邪能光球开始在他双手中成形，随着膨胀发出骇人的嗡鸣。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or maybe you’re brazen enough to think that you can defeat me. I’ve analyzed your techniques, and I know you won’t be able to use that attack again using that arm. Even with the other arm available, that level of power won’t puncture my barriers. I’m going to end your heroic career here and now,” the wicked knight threatens. Globes of evil energy begin to form in his hands, humming menacingly as they grow."

rows.original: “You’ve made a tactical error, Ironwall,” Flare replies, his tone sharp and serious, “assuming that a hero like me is limited to one burst of energy. Double fist armor penetrating technique! Ivory thrust!”
rows.translation: “你犯了一个战术错误，铁壁，”耀焰侠语气尖锐而严肃地回答，“你以为我这样的英雄只能爆发一次能量。双拳破甲技！象牙突刺！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve made a tactical error, Ironwall,” Flare replies, his tone sharp and serious, “assuming that a hero like me is limited to one burst of energy. Double fist armor penetrating technique! Ivory thrust!”"

rows.original: He links his hands together as he shouts, a pearl of radiant energy forming between the gauntlets flared tips. Ironwall hisses, diverting the attack orb’s energy into a shield. A tornado of energy picks up around the superhero as he unleashes his attack, firing the tiny orb of force into the shield with enough strength to crack it on impact. Ironwall struggles, releasing Taurina and the Shaft and returning the excess power to his main shield.
rows.translation: 他一边高喊，一边将双手扣在一起，护手张开的尖端之间凝聚出一颗璀璨能量明珠。铁壁嘶声喘气，将攻击光球的能量转入护盾。耀焰侠发动攻击时，一道能量龙卷在超级英雄周身卷起，将微小的力场光球射向护盾，冲击之强足以令其开裂。铁壁艰难支撑，释放陶丽娜与力量之柱，把多余力量转回主护盾。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe links his hands together as he shouts, a pearl of radiant energy forming between the gauntlets flared tips. Ironwall hisses, diverting the attack orb’s energy into a shield. A tornado of energy picks up around the superhero as he unleashes his attack, firing the tiny orb of force into the shield with enough strength to crack it on impact. Ironwall struggles, releasing Taurina and the Shaft and returning the excess power to his main shield."

rows.original: “Justice! Flow and extinguish evil’s flame!” The bright flash increases in intensity until nothing can be seen save an expanse of pure white. When the light dies down, Ironwall lies unconscious on the floor. Flare huffs and falls to his knees, breathing heavily. His suit is torn up the right arm, with trails of blood leaking onto the floor.
rows.translation: “正义！奔流吧，熄灭邪恶之火！”耀眼闪光愈发强烈，直至纯白铺满一切，再也看不见其他东西。光芒散去时，铁壁昏迷着倒在地上。耀焰侠喘息着跪倒，呼吸沉重。他战衣的右臂已经破损，鲜血顺着手臂流淌到地板上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Justice! Flow and extinguish evil’s flame!” The bright flash increases in intensity until nothing can be seen save an expanse of pure white. When the light dies down, Ironwall lies unconscious on the floor. Flare huffs and falls to his knees, breathing heavily. His suit is torn up the right arm, with trails of blood leaking onto the floor."

rows.original: “Flare! Are you alright? Your body was too strained for an attack like that,” Taurina exclaims as she rushes to his side, her voice rife with concern. He leans into her support, letting her assist him as he rises.
rows.translation: “耀焰侠！你还好吗？那种攻击对身体的负担太重了，”陶丽娜冲到他身边惊呼，声音里满是关切。他倚靠她的搀扶，在她帮助下站起身来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Flare! Are you alright? Your body was too strained for an attack like that,” Taurina exclaims as she rushes to his side, her voice rife with concern. He leans into her support, letting her assist him as he rises."

rows.original: “The police will be here soon to take care of Ironwall. You can treat me on the ship while we travel. For now just make sure he’s restrained. If this was all it took to defeat me the galaxy would’ve been overtaken by evil long ago. I won’t let that happen. As long as I live the peaceful inhabitants of the Universe League will have nothing to fear.” The camera zooms in on his face for this increasingly serious monologue before cutting to black. Credits roll, accompanied by an upbeat exit theme.
rows.translation: “警察很快就会来处理铁壁。我们赶路时，你可以在飞船上替我治疗。现在只要确保他被牢牢束缚。如果这种程度就能击败我，银河早已被邪恶占领。我不会允许那种事发生。只要我还活着，宇宙联盟的和平居民就不必害怕。”在这段越来越严肃的独白中，镜头逐渐推近他的脸，随后切入黑屏。片尾字幕伴随欢快的结束曲滚动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The police will be here soon to take care of Ironwall. You can treat me on the ship while we travel. For now just make sure he’s restrained. If this was all it took to defeat me the galaxy would’ve been overtaken by evil long ago. I won’t let that happen. As long as I live the peaceful inhabitants of the Universe League will have nothing to fear.” The camera zooms in on his face for this increasingly serious monologue before cutting to black. Credits roll, accompanied by an upbeat exit theme."

rows.original: Gwen grabs your shoulder, beaming at you and tearing your attention away from the tv.
rows.translation: 格温抓住你的肩膀，笑容满面地把你的注意力从电视上拉开。
rows.raw: "\n\nGwen grabs your shoulder, beaming at you and tearing your attention away from the tv."

rows.original: “So, what did you think?” she asks, cocking an eyebrow.
rows.translation: “你觉得怎么样？”她扬起一边眉毛问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what did you think?” she asks, cocking an eyebrow."

rows.original: Good
rows.translation: 不错
rows.raw: "Good"

rows.original: Not My Thing
rows.translation: 不对胃口
rows.raw: "Not My Thing"

rows.original: Garbage
rows.translation: 垃圾
rows.raw: "Garbage"

rows.original: <i>“That was
rows.translation: <i>“那真是
rows.raw: "<i>“That was"

rows.original: , like, the greatest movie I’ve ever seen
rows.translation: 我看过最棒的电影
rows.raw: ", like, the greatest movie I’ve ever seen"

rows.original: awesome
rows.translation: 太精彩了
rows.raw: " awesome"

rows.original: !” you exclaim, prompting an equally giddy nod from Gwen.
rows.translation: !”你惊叹道，格温也同样兴奋地点头。
rows.raw: "!” you exclaim, prompting an equally giddy nod from Gwen."

rows.original: “I know right! It only gets better as the plot progresses and they work out the kinks. Lots of people quit in the first couple episodes ‘cause they don’t like the writing or some other stupid reason like that. But they have no idea what they’re missing. The writing has improved a million times over the five seasons it’s been running, and even this old stuff has that charm that only beginning shows can get.” As she speaks, she shuts off the movie player. You hop up, helping the pair of them to clean up the snacks.
rows.translation: “就是啊！随着剧情推进，他们解决掉各种小毛病，只会越来越好看。好多人看了开头几集就弃剧，因为不喜欢编剧，或者别的什么蠢理由。但他们根本不知道自己错过了什么。五季下来，编剧水准进步了一百万倍，连这些旧内容也有一种只有新剧刚起步时才会出现的魅力。”她说话时关掉了电影播放器。你跳起来，帮两人收拾零食。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know right! It only gets better as the plot progresses and they work out the kinks. Lots of people quit in the first couple episodes ‘cause they don’t like the writing or some other stupid reason like that. But they have no idea what they’re missing. The writing has improved a million times over the five seasons it’s been running, and even this old stuff has that charm that only beginning shows can get.” As she speaks, she shuts off the movie player. You hop up, helping the pair of them to clean up the snacks."

rows.original: <i>“That was...
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“That was..."

rows.original: okay, I guess, but like, it needs more boobs
rows.translation: 还行吧，不过，比如说，它应该多露点奶子
rows.raw: " okay, I guess, but like, it needs more boobs"

rows.original: not my kind of show
rows.translation: 不是我喜欢的节目
rows.raw: " not my kind of show"

rows.original: ,” you express, prompting an understanding shrug from the excitable puazi.
rows.translation: ，”你表达了看法，兴奋的普阿兹人理解地耸耸肩。
rows.raw: ",” you express, prompting an understanding shrug from the excitable puazi."

rows.original: “Oh well, it’s not for everyone. If you ever think about giving it a second chance we could watch one of the movies. They were all made after the initial rough period, so they aren’t quite as cheesy and shoddily written. The first few still have some cheese, but definitely not that bad. If you come over some other time I’m sure we can find something you can have more fun with,” she says as she shuts off the movie player. You rise from the couch, helping the pair with cleaning up snacks.
rows.translation: “好吧，它并不适合所有人。如果你哪天想再给它一次机会，我们可以看其中一部电影。电影全是在早期粗糙阶段结束后拍的，所以没那么俗套，编剧也不那么潦草。前几部还是有点俗，但绝对没有这么严重。你下次过来时，我们肯定能找到让你玩得更开心的东西，”她一边说，一边关掉电影播放器。你从沙发起身，帮两人收拾零食。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh well, it’s not for everyone. If you ever think about giving it a second chance we could watch one of the movies. They were all made after the initial rough period, so they aren’t quite as cheesy and shoddily written. The first few still have some cheese, but definitely not that bad. If you come over some other time I’m sure we can find something you can have more fun with,” she says as she shuts off the movie player. You rise from the couch, helping the pair with cleaning up snacks."

rows.original: <i>“That was
rows.translation: <i>“那个
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“That was"

rows.original: like, the wastiest waste of time. I could’ve been masturbating
rows.translation: 简直是最浪费时间的浪费。我本来可以去自慰
rows.raw: " like, the wastiest waste of time. I could’ve been masturbating"

rows.original: pretty terrible
rows.translation: 烂透了
rows.raw: " pretty terrible"

rows.original: ,” you frown, shaking your head and garnering a dejected frown from Gwen.
rows.translation: ，”你皱着眉摇头，格温也因此失望地皱起眉。
rows.raw: ",” you frown, shaking your head and garnering a dejected frown from Gwen."

rows.original: “I’m sorry you feel that way. It really does get better as the series goes on, the writing improves and the characters have meaningful relationships. But If that’s how you feel then I guess we’ll need to find some other way to have fun if you come over some other time,” she says, ending on a much more cheerful note. You rise from the couch, helping the pair with cleaning up snacks.
rows.translation: “很遗憾你这么想。这个系列后来真的越来越好，编剧有所进步，角色之间也发展出有意义的关系。但如果你是这种感觉，那你下次过来时，我们大概得找别的娱乐方式，”她用欢快许多的语气收尾。你从沙发起身，帮两人收拾零食。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry you feel that way. It really does get better as the series goes on, the writing improves and the characters have meaningful relationships. But If that’s how you feel then I guess we’ll need to find some other way to have fun if you come over some other time,” she says, ending on a much more cheerful note. You rise from the couch, helping the pair with cleaning up snacks."

rows.original: “Just ask either of us around closing time if you want to hang out again, we’re free most nights,” Gwen explains, bringing you to the door. As you leave the house, Eimear steps out with you and taps you on the shoulder to get your attention.
rows.translation: “如果想再来玩，快关门时问我们任何一个就好，我们大部分晚上都有空，”格温解释着，把你送到门口。你离开房子时，艾梅尔也跟出来，轻拍你的肩膀吸引注意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just ask either of us around closing time if you want to hang out again, we’re free most nights,” Gwen explains, bringing you to the door. As you leave the house, Eimear steps out with you and taps you on the shoulder to get your attention."

rows.original: “Hey Steele! One more thing before you go. If Gwen ever has an episode while you’re around, I’d be okay if you, you know, helped her out with it. I already know she’d be up for it, but I just wanted you to know its good with me in case that would be a trouble spot,” she declares, growing more flustered with every word. You can see a blush even through her ebon cheeks, but she grows suddenly somber. “Just don’t fuck her up. If I see her with any kind of drugs or anything that screws up her head I’ll sooner crack yours than call the authorities.”
rows.translation: “嘿，斯蒂尔！走之前还有一件事。要是格温在你身边发作，我不介意你，那个，帮她解决。我已经知道她会愿意，不过怕这可能让你为难，所以只想告诉你，我同意，”她宣布道，每说一个词便显得更加窘迫。即使隔着乌黑的脸颊，你也能看见红晕，但她忽然严肃起来。“只要别把她弄坏。要是让我看见她碰任何毒品，或者别的会搞坏脑子的东西，我会先敲碎你的脑袋，再考虑叫当局。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey Steele! One more thing before you go. If Gwen ever has an episode while you’re around, I’d be okay if you, you know, helped her out with it. I already know she’d be up for it, but I just wanted you to know its good with me in case that would be a trouble spot,” she declares, growing more flustered with every word. You can see a blush even through her ebon cheeks, but she grows suddenly somber. “Just don’t fuck her up. If I see her with any kind of drugs or anything that screws up her head I’ll sooner crack yours than call the authorities.”"

rows.original: You gulp, nodding confirmation. At your answer she smiles again, patting you on the shoulder before hopping back.
rows.translation: 你咽了口唾沫，点头确认。得到答复，她再度微笑，拍拍你的肩膀，随后跳回去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gulp, nodding confirmation. At your answer she smiles again, patting you on the shoulder before hopping back."

rows.original: “Great. Hope to see you again soon, tonight was a lot of fun. I’ll tell you what. I’m not as loose as Gwen, but I’ll give you a massage on the house if you want, might even get you off while I’m at it. It’s happened before without me even trying, the poor guy was super embarrassed. Have a great night!” She returns to the house, leaving you to return to the city at large.
rows.translation: “太好了。希望很快能再见到你，今晚真的很有趣。这样吧，我没格温那么开放，不过你愿意的话，我可以免费替你按摩，说不定过程中还能让你高潮。以前我没刻意做什么都发生过，那可怜家伙尴尬得要命。祝你今晚愉快！”她回到屋里，留下你返回广阔的城市。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great. Hope to see you again soon, tonight was a lot of fun. I’ll tell you what. I’m not as loose as Gwen, but I’ll give you a massage on the house if you want, might even get you off while I’m at it. It’s happened before without me even trying, the poor guy was super embarrassed. Have a great night!” She returns to the house, leaving you to return to the city at large."
