The character himself is a tall, lanky man wielding two futuristic sawed off shotguns. He wears a fancy jacket and khaki pants, with jewel encrusted rings of various colors on his fingers. He has spiky blonde hair and aviator sunglasses with a target symbol embossed on the left lens. A digitized billboard in the back declares him to be “Hollyhock”.
rows.translation: “这也算吓人？我可不会向小孩子的噩梦低头，”对手角色的声音传来，音调很高，但仍有男性味。艾梅尔听见后皱起眉，向前挪了挪。角色本人是个高瘦男人，手持两把未来风格的短管霰弹枪。他穿着华丽夹克和卡其裤，手指戴有各色宝石镶嵌的戒指。他留着金色刺猬头，飞行员墨镜的左侧镜片印有靶心符号。后方一块数字广告牌宣布他名叫“蜀葵”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that supposed to be scary? I won’t bow to some child’s nightmare,” comes your opponent characters voice, a high but masculine tone. Eimear frowns and scoots up upon hearing it. The character himself is a tall, lanky man wielding two futuristic sawed off shotguns. He wears a fancy jacket and khaki pants, with jewel encrusted rings of various colors on his fingers. He has spiky blonde hair and aviator sunglasses with a target symbol embossed on the left lens. A digitized billboard in the back declares him to be “Hollyhock”."

rows.original: “Shit. He’s the reward character for arena tournament one. You can’t even get him anymore,” Your alien companion warns, her lion-like tail flitting worriedly. A countdown begins on the screen, and you prepare yourself as best you can. The best you can do doesn’t count for much in the end. As soon as the countdown reaches zero, your opponent bursts forward and catches you with a point blank blast from one of the shotguns. Instead of bullets, it produces a fist like burst of energy. Your character is sent flying, and before you can react he has you in a corner, smashing repeatedly to keep you locked in the air.
rows.translation: “操。他是第一届竞技场锦标赛的奖励角色，现在已经根本拿不到了，”你的外星同伴警告道，狮子般的尾巴担忧地快速摆动。屏幕开始倒计时，你尽可能做好准备。可最终，你所谓的尽可能根本毫无意义。倒计时刚归零，对手便猛冲上前，其中一把霰弹枪贴身轰中你。枪里打出的不是子弹，而是一团拳头形状的能量。你的角色被轰飞出去，你还没来得及反应，就被他堵在角落连续猛击，始终悬在半空。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit. He’s the reward character for arena tournament one. You can’t even get him anymore,” Your alien companion warns, her lion-like tail flitting worriedly. A countdown begins on the screen, and you prepare yourself as best you can. The best you can do doesn’t count for much in the end. As soon as the countdown reaches zero, your opponent bursts forward and catches you with a point blank blast from one of the shotguns. Instead of bullets, it produces a fist like burst of energy. Your character is sent flying, and before you can react he has you in a corner, smashing repeatedly to keep you locked in the air."

rows.original: You’re dead in under a minute, and you see a message pop up in the bottom corner. “BlastMaster has sent you a communication: Get rekt scrub!” Eimear grunts an expletive, taking the controller from you and dropping down next to you on the couch.
rows.translation: 不到一分钟你就死了，屏幕底角弹出一条消息。“爆破大师向你发送通讯：菜鸡，受死吧!”艾梅尔骂了一句，从你手中接过控制器，在沙发上挨着你坐下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re dead in under a minute, and you see a message pop up in the bottom corner. “BlastMaster has sent you a communication: Get rekt scrub!” Eimear grunts an expletive, taking the controller from you and dropping down next to you on the couch."

rows.original: “This guy wants to be a fucking smartass, I’ll show him who’s a damn scrub,” she growls fiercely, maneuvering back to the character select menu. The screen flits about quickly before settling on a humanoid alligator in a trench-coat and bowler hat. Bubbling green and purple liquids leak from the cracks in his scales and drip from his mouth. The label at the top proclaims his title, or name you aren’t sure which, as “The Infestigator”.
rows.translation: “这家伙想耍嘴皮子，看我让他知道谁才是该死的菜鸡，”她恶狠狠地咆哮，操作画面返回角色选择菜单。屏幕飞快闪动，最后停在一个穿风衣、戴圆顶礼帽的人形鳄鱼身上。冒泡的绿色与紫色液体从鳞片裂缝中渗出，也从嘴里滴落。顶部标签宣告他的称号——或名字，你也不确定——是“疫病调查鳄”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This guy wants to be a fucking smartass, I’ll show him who’s a damn scrub,” she growls fiercely, maneuvering back to the character select menu. The screen flits about quickly before settling on a humanoid alligator in a trench-coat and bowler hat. Bubbling green and purple liquids leak from the cracks in his scales and drip from his mouth. The label at the top proclaims his title, or name you aren’t sure which, as “The Infestigator”."

rows.original: The second match countdown begins once she chooses her selection, with the gator inspector crawling in from the side of the screen. The moment the number reaches zero your former opponent attempts the same swift combo that got you locked into a corner. Out of the corner of your eye you see Eimear take a quick breath and tighten her grip on the controller. The alligator detective on-screen explodes in a shower of toxic fumes, damaging the shotgun wielding fighter even as he continues his dash.
rows.translation: 她选好角色后，第二场倒计时开始，鳄鱼调查员从屏幕侧边爬入。数字一归零，刚才的对手便试图重演那套把你逼进角落的快速连招。你用余光看见艾梅尔迅速吸气，握紧控制器。屏幕上的鳄鱼侦探轰然炸成一片毒雾，即便持霰弹枪的斗士仍在冲刺，也受到了伤害。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe second match countdown begins once she chooses her selection, with the gator inspector crawling in from the side of the screen. The moment the number reaches zero your former opponent attempts the same swift combo that got you locked into a corner. Out of the corner of your eye you see Eimear take a quick breath and tighten her grip on the controller. The alligator detective on-screen explodes in a shower of toxic fumes, damaging the shotgun wielding fighter even as he continues his dash."

rows.original: Eimear comes back in from behind, leaping out of the puddle left by the poisonous burst. Infestigator rips into Hollyhock’s shoulder, making a few rending tears before taking two vials out from his coat and smashing them into the open wound. Following this he backs away, but BlastMaster’s HP is still rapidly trickling down, and they don’t seem to be making any moves to counterattack.
rows.translation: 艾梅尔从后方杀回，从毒爆留下的水洼中跃出。疫病调查鳄撕咬蜀葵的肩膀，划出几道裂口，又从外套中掏出两支药瓶砸进伤口。随后他向后退开，但爆破大师的生命仍在迅速流失，对方似乎完全没有反击。
rows.raw: "\n\nEimear comes back in from behind, leaping out of the puddle left by the poisonous burst. Infestigator rips into Hollyhock’s shoulder, making a few rending tears before taking two vials out from his coat and smashing them into the open wound. Following this he backs away, but BlastMaster’s HP is still rapidly trickling down, and they don’t seem to be making any moves to counterattack."

rows.original: “There we go. They wanna talk shit, they get the fatal flaw kill,” Eimear remarks smugly. As she speaks, her opponent melts into a gaseous puddle, complete with wisps of smoke in the shape of tiny skulls. She’s still smirking as the third round begins, rolling her thumbs in tune with the game’s background music. This time her opponent doesn’t get a chance to dash in. He puts up a block as soon as the round begins, but Eimear simply has the gator belch a splash of gunk onto his arms, breaking the guard and laying into him with claws and tail smashes.
rows.translation: “这就对了。敢嘴臭，就让他死于致命缺陷，”艾梅尔得意地说。说话间，对手融化成一滩气体般的液体，升起形似小骷髅的烟缕。第三回合开始时她仍在坏笑，拇指随背景音乐打着节拍。这次对手没机会冲来。回合一开始他便格挡，但艾梅尔让鳄鱼朝他双臂喷出一团黏液，破防后用利爪和尾击猛攻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There we go. They wanna talk shit, they get the fatal flaw kill,” Eimear remarks smugly. As she speaks, her opponent melts into a gaseous puddle, complete with wisps of smoke in the shape of tiny skulls. She’s still smirking as the third round begins, rolling her thumbs in tune with the game’s background music. This time her opponent doesn’t get a chance to dash in. He puts up a block as soon as the round begins, but Eimear simply has the gator belch a splash of gunk onto his arms, breaking the guard and laying into him with claws and tail smashes."

rows.original: The other player gets in a few hits, but the incensed shopkeeper doesn’t give him any chances for a real comeback. A meter on the sidebar that had been filling up reaches its peak, and the Infestigator roars. He leaps into the air, pulling out a comically large magnifying glass and lining it up with a purple sun that appears in the sky behind him. When the light travels through the glass, it turns into a laser that causes his opponent to collapse into a half melted pile of fuming decay. As the victory screen begins, he leaps onto the corpse to begin devouring it.
rows.translation: 另一名玩家打中了几下，但恼火的店主没给他真正翻盘的机会。侧栏中不断蓄积的量表达到顶峰，疫病调查鳄发出咆哮。他跃上空中，掏出一面大得滑稽的放大镜，对准身后天空中出现的紫色太阳。光线穿过镜片后化作激光，使对手坍缩成半融化、冒烟腐烂的一堆。胜利画面开始时，他扑到尸体上啃食起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other player gets in a few hits, but the incensed shopkeeper doesn’t give him any chances for a real comeback. A meter on the sidebar that had been filling up reaches its peak, and the Infestigator roars. He leaps into the air, pulling out a comically large magnifying glass and lining it up with a purple sun that appears in the sky behind him. When the light travels through the glass, it turns into a laser that causes his opponent to collapse into a half melted pile of fuming decay. As the victory screen begins, he leaps onto the corpse to begin devouring it."

rows.original: “I hate people who talk shit. Maybe we should just play local,” Eimear states plainly, handing the controller back to you. Gwen grabs another controller, bouncing in place and looking excited at the prospect.
rows.translation: “我讨厌嘴臭的人。也许我们还是玩本地模式吧，”艾梅尔平静地说，把控制器还给你。格温抓起另一只控制器，兴奋地原地蹦跳。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I hate people who talk shit. Maybe we should just play local,” Eimear states plainly, handing the controller back to you. Gwen grabs another controller, bouncing in place and looking excited at the prospect."

rows.original: “I like that idea, we can play together that way!” she exclaims. You laugh as she maneuvers to the co-op menu, and decide to pick the same character from before as you get into the game. She picks an elfish demonic man with a black hole looking sphere where his stomach should be. Your games are much more fun than the tournament round, with you and her trading wins pretty evenly throughout three matches. You even manage to pull ahead and win the final round. You hand the controller off to Eimear, letting the two lovers duke it out in a game.
rows.translation: “这个主意好，这样我们就能一起玩了！”她叫道。她切到合作菜单时你笑了起来，进入游戏后仍选了先前的角色。她选择一个精灵般的恶魔男子，腹部本应所在的位置悬着一颗仿佛黑洞的球体。你们玩得比锦标赛那局有趣得多，三场比赛中胜负相当。你甚至在最后一局领先并获胜。你把控制器递给艾梅尔，让这对恋人在游戏里一决高下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like that idea, we can play together that way!” she exclaims. You laugh as she maneuvers to the co-op menu, and decide to pick the same character from before as you get into the game. She picks an elfish demonic man with a black hole looking sphere where his stomach should be. Your games are much more fun than the tournament round, with you and her trading wins pretty evenly throughout three matches. You even manage to pull ahead and win the final round. You hand the controller off to Eimear, letting the two lovers duke it out in a game."

rows.original: “Oh no you don’t, If I’m playing her I’ll have to break out the big guns,” Gwen says, flexing comically. Her character flash changes to The Flare, the character from the show you watched earlier. Her gameplay seems markedly improved with this character, going toe to toe with Eimear on the infectious alligator from before. The towering half-bruchandus nudges you during the fight, diverting a little of her attention.
rows.translation: “想都别想，既然要和她打，我就得亮出大杀器，”格温滑稽地绷紧肌肉。她的角色闪变成你们先前看过的节目人物“耀焰”。换上这个角色后，她的表现明显提升，与艾梅尔先前使用的传染鳄鱼打得不相上下。战斗中，高大的半布鲁坎杜斯用肘碰了碰你，稍稍分散注意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no you don’t, If I’m playing her I’ll have to break out the big guns,” Gwen says, flexing comically. Her character flash changes to The Flare, the character from the show you watched earlier. Her gameplay seems markedly improved with this character, going toe to toe with Eimear on the infectious alligator from before. The towering half-bruchandus nudges you during the fight, diverting a little of her attention."

rows.original: “This is the only guy she’s any good at, but I’ve got a secret strategy to win every time,” she confides with a wink. Her hand darts downward, slipping through layers of clothing to reach Gwen’s crotch. The intensely focused puazi gives a surprised yip, and her character locks up mid jump. Eimear leans back, relaxing as she multitasks her way to a quick victory. Her hapless girlfriend doesn’t even try to voice a complaint, dropping the controller to tightly grip the invading arm.
rows.translation: “这是她唯一擅长的角色，不过我有一套每次都能赢的秘密策略，”她眨眼透露。她的手猛然向下，穿过层层衣物探向格温胯间。全神贯注的普阿兹惊叫一声，角色在半空中僵住。艾梅尔向后靠下，一边忙着另一件事，一边轻松迅速取胜。她倒霉的女友甚至没有抱怨，只丢下控制器，紧紧抓住入侵的手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is the only guy she’s any good at, but I’ve got a secret strategy to win every time,” she confides with a wink. Her hand darts downward, slipping through layers of clothing to reach Gwen’s crotch. The intensely focused puazi gives a surprised yip, and her character locks up mid jump. Eimear leans back, relaxing as she multitasks her way to a quick victory. Her hapless girlfriend doesn’t even try to voice a complaint, dropping the controller to tightly grip the invading arm."

rows.original: “No fair. That’s cheating,” the prurient puazi frowns, her chest heaving.
rows.translation: “不公平。这是作弊，”好色的普阿兹皱起眉头，胸口剧烈起伏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No fair. That’s cheating,” the prurient puazi frowns, her chest heaving."

rows.original: “Yes, but you love it,” Eimear replies, kissing her on the nose....
rows.translation: “没错，但你喜欢，”艾梅尔回答，在她鼻尖亲了一口....
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, but you love it,” Eimear replies, kissing her on the nose...."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You stand, stretching and giving each girl a goodbye hug.
rows.translation: 你站起身伸展身体，给两个女孩各一个告别拥抱。
rows.raw: "You stand, stretching and giving each girl a goodbye hug."

rows.original: “It was awesome to have you over again, [pc.name]. If you ever feel like hanging out you know where we’re at,” Eimear says, embracing you tightly before letting go.
rows.translation: “你能再来玩真是太棒了，[pc.name]。以后想一起消遣，你知道我们在哪里，”艾梅尔紧紧拥抱你，随后松开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was awesome to have you over again, [pc.name]. If you ever feel like hanging out you know where we’re at,” Eimear says, embracing you tightly before letting go."

rows.original: “Yeah, hope to see you again soon,” Gwen chimes in.
rows.translation: “对，希望很快再见到你，”格温插话道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, hope to see you again soon,” Gwen chimes in."

rows.original: Oh yeah! Maybe we can do it shirtless next time!
rows.translation: 好啊！也许下次我们可以脱掉上衣玩！

rows.raw: "It was fun, next time we can spice it up. Strip gaming maybe?"

rows.original: Yeah okay, it was pretty fun,

rows.raw: "Yeah okay, it was pretty fun,"

rows.original: You walk up to Eimear’s counter, and ask if you can have a massage. The amazonian half-breed flashes a smile, scrolling on her tablet to find a specific button.
rows.translation: 你走到艾梅尔的柜台前，询问能否做按摩。高大健壮的混血儿露出笑容，在平板电脑上滑动，寻找某个按钮。
rows.raw: "You walk up to Eimear’s counter, and ask if you can have a massage. The amazonian half-breed flashes a smile, scrolling on her tablet to find a specific button."

rows.original: “Definitely! If you’ll just choose which of our wonderful masseurs or masseuses you’d like to receive your massage from,” she asks, swiveling the tablet computer in your direction. Three different buttons, labeled with names you can only assume belong to the variety of workers also manning the counter, blink on screen. It looks like you have a choice to make, or you could ask Eimear for a personal massage.
rows.translation: “当然！请选择一位优秀的男按摩师或女按摩师来为你服务，”她问道，把平板转向你。屏幕上闪烁着三个不同按钮，标注的名字想必属于同样守在柜台的不同员工。看来你得做出选择，也可以请艾梅尔亲自按摩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Definitely! If you’ll just choose which of our wonderful masseurs or masseuses you’d like to receive your massage from,” she asks, swiveling the tablet computer in your direction. Three different buttons, labeled with names you can only assume belong to the variety of workers also manning the counter, blink on screen. It looks like you have a choice to make, or you could ask Eimear for a personal massage."

rows.translation: ，但芳香精油的美妙气味让这里不至于太难受。你在小更衣室脱掉衣服，将衣物留在篮中，走进高级按摩室。
rows.raw: " right away, but the wonderful smell of scented oils prevents it from being too uncomfortable. You undress in a small changing room, leaving your clothing in a basket and heading into the executive massage parlor."

The space within the glacial cleavage is thankfully wider than the creature-made trail - it looks at least several dozen feet wide, you think - and you sigh in relief. Wide enough to allow you moderate maneuverability, and the sleek walls of ice with nary a blemish making an ambush unlikely, the chasm looks as safe as one might get.
rows.translation: 来到巨大深渊入口，两侧高耸在头顶，你漫不经心地注意到狂风已经减弱；无疑是被深裂缝的墙壁挡住，刺骨疾风的尖啸被撕碎，迫使其在冰封峡谷中回荡。冰川裂口内部好在比生物开出的路径宽阔——你估计至少有数十英尺——令你松了口气。这里足够宽，可以适度机动，而光滑冰壁几乎毫无瑕疵，让埋伏不太可能发生；这道峡谷看来已算尽可能安全。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you find yourself at the mouth of the great chasm, its sides towering above, you absently note that the harsh wind has died down; blocked by the walls of the deep fissure, no doubt, as the shrill wails are torn from the frigid gale and forced to echo throughout the frozen cleft. The space within the glacial cleavage is thankfully wider than the creature-made trail - it looks at least several dozen feet wide, you think - and you sigh in relief. Wide enough to allow you moderate maneuverability, and the sleek walls of ice with nary a blemish making an ambush unlikely, the chasm looks as safe as one might get."

rows.original: Well, it’s now or never.
rows.translation: 好吧，要么现在，要么永远别去。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, it’s now or never."

rows.original: As soon as you enter, the cold tundra outside virtually disappears when your eyes adjust to the light, and everything is silent. Other than the gusts shrieking at you from above, the crevasse is incredibly quiet. Though unsettling, it also gives you a moment to marvel at the icy walls around you; the pristine, crystalline surface lets you see further into the ageless ice, where it almost glows, casting you and your surroundings in shades of cold blues. Breathing in the crisp air, you make a mental note to consider the possibility of going off the beaten path more often.
rows.translation: 进入后，双眼适应光线，外面的寒冷苔原几乎消失，一切归于寂静。除了上方阵风的尖啸，裂谷安静得惊人。虽令人不安，却也给你片刻欣赏周围冰壁；纯净晶莹的表面让视线深入亘古冰层，那里近乎发光，将你与四周染成寒冷蓝色。呼吸清冽空气，你暗自提醒自己以后可以更常偏离寻常路线。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you enter, the cold tundra outside virtually disappears when your eyes adjust to the light, and everything is silent. Other than the gusts shrieking at you from above, the crevasse is incredibly quiet. Though unsettling, it also gives you a moment to marvel at the icy walls around you; the pristine, crystalline surface lets you see further into the ageless ice, where it almost glows, casting you and your surroundings in shades of cold blues. Breathing in the crisp air, you make a mental note to consider the possibility of going off the beaten path more often."

rows.original: Your thoughts, and [pc.feet], are stopped in their tracks when a new sound echoes from further in, something resembling a snarl, or a bark, reverberating within the chasm. Without turning away from the direction the noise came from, you cast a glance over your shoulder, confirming that you’re not getting boxed in; you still have a way out, it seems, and you continue moving ever deeper into the frosty fissure knowing your back is safe.
rows.translation: 一个新声音从深处回荡，像低吼又像犬吠，让你的思绪和[pc.feet]同时停住。你没有移开朝向声源的视线，只回头确认自己没被包围；似乎仍有退路，于是在确保背后安全的情况下，继续深入冰霜裂隙。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour thoughts, and [pc.feet], are stopped in their tracks when a new sound echoes from further in, something resembling a snarl, or a bark, reverberating within the chasm. Without turning away from the direction the noise came from, you cast a glance over your shoulder, confirming that you’re not getting boxed in; you still have a way out, it seems, and you continue moving ever deeper into the frosty fissure knowing your back is safe."

rows.original: A short time later you find yourself gradually losing patience for this place, but just as you start wondering if you shouldn’t turn back, your eyes spot a single, dark hollow along a wall.
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，你渐渐对这里失去耐心；正开始考虑是否该返回，眼睛便发现墙边唯一一处黑暗洞口。
rows.raw: "\n\nA short time later you find yourself gradually losing patience for this place, but just as you start wondering if you shouldn’t turn back, your eyes spot a single, dark hollow along a wall."

rows.original: Now, either something’s in there, or your name isn’t ‘[pc.name] Steele’.
rows.translation: 那里要么藏着东西，要么你就不叫‘[pc.name]·斯蒂尔’。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow, either something’s in there, or your name isn’t ‘[pc.name] Steele’."

rows.original: A grin spreads across your [pc.face], and you cautiously approach the glacial hollow with renewed interest. Pausing at the mouth of the cavern, you hear the occasional metallic shuffle and smack on the frozen surface. Footsteps? Whatever it is, it’s getting closer, and with no hiding spots along the smooth walls, you straighten your
rows.translation: 笑容爬上[pc.face]，你重新提起兴趣，小心走向冰川洞穴。停在洞口时，你听见冰面偶尔传来金属摩擦与拍击。脚步声？不管是什么，都越来越近；光滑墙壁没有藏身处，你挺直
rows.raw: "\n\nA grin spreads across your [pc.face], and you cautiously approach the glacial hollow with renewed interest. Pausing at the mouth of the cavern, you hear the occasional metallic shuffle and smack on the frozen surface. Footsteps? Whatever it is, it’s getting closer, and with no hiding spots along the smooth walls, you straighten your "

rows.original: bestial body
rows.translation: 野兽般的身体
rows.raw: "bestial body"

rows.original: back
rows.translation: 后背
rows.raw: "back"

rows.original: in preparation.
rows.translation: ，做好准备。
rows.raw: " in preparation."

rows.original: “[pc.name]?” the cavern itself seems to rumble out.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]?”仿佛整个洞穴都低沉轰鸣起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]?” the cavern itself seems to rumble out."

rows.original: What the-
rows.translation: 什么鬼——
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat the-"

rows.original: A familiar, bulky form with metallic silver scales over tough amber hide stomps out from the nippy darkness, sweltering body steaming in the cold air. It’s Chaurmine.
rows.translation: 一个熟悉的魁梧身影从寒冷黑暗中重步走出，坚韧琥珀皮肤覆盖金属银鳞，灼热身体在冷空气中蒸腾。是乔敏。
rows.raw: "\n\nA familiar, bulky form with metallic silver scales over tough amber hide stomps out from the nippy darkness, sweltering body steaming in the cold air. It’s Chaurmine."

rows.original: “Yeah, it’s me,” he redundantly confirms
rows.translation: “对，是我，”他多余地确认道
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, it’s me,” he redundantly confirms"

rows.original: , redundantly
rows.translation: ，说了句废话
rows.raw: ", redundantly"

rows.original: . His heavy scales clank and scrape together as he shivers excitedly to the feeling of the frigid draft from above, also rattling his gear - which seem to consist of his usual tactical groin armor, in addition to what looks like a massive, spiked sledge hammer and a heavy, black cannon.
rows.translation: 。他因上方寒风而兴奋战栗，厚重鳞片铿锵摩擦，装备也跟着作响——除了平常的战术护裆甲，似乎还有一柄巨大尖刺战锤和一门沉重黑炮。
rows.raw: ". His heavy scales clank and scrape together as he shivers excitedly to the feeling of the frigid draft from above, also rattling his gear - which seem to consist of his usual tactical groin armor, in addition to what looks like a massive, spiked sledge hammer and a heavy, black cannon."

rows.original: With a raised brow, you ask what he’s doing here.
rows.translation: 你扬起眉毛，问他在这里做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a raised brow, you ask what he’s doing here."

rows.original: The titan lets out a huff of steamy breath, “I was out here with the idea that there might be a group of milodans needing a beat down, but that turned out to be bullshit. Granted, this was days ago.”
rows.translation: 泰坦吐出一口蒸汽般的气息，“我本来以为这里可能有一群米洛丹需要挨揍，结果全是屁话。当然，那已经是几天前了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe titan lets out a huff of steamy breath, “I was out here with the idea that there might be a group of milodans needing a beat down, but that turned out to be bullshit. Granted, this was days ago.”"

rows.original: Days? What’s he been doing-
rows.translation: 几天？他一直在做什么——
rows.raw: "\n\nDays? What’s he been doing-"

rows.original: “This frozen moon has been a godsend, [pc.name],” he growls, indicating the wisps of mist flowing off his form with a shrug, “There’s been a fire in me ever since I left Tarkus, except this won’t go away with a quick fap or a fuck - this refuses to be quenched,” he finishes with clenched teeth.
rows.translation: “这颗冰冻卫星简直是天赐之物，[pc.name]，”他咆哮着耸肩示意身体散出的雾气，“自从离开塔库斯，我体内一直燃着一团火，但这不是快速撸一发或干一炮就能消除的——它拒绝熄灭，”他咬紧牙关说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This frozen moon has been a godsend, [pc.name],” he growls, indicating the wisps of mist flowing off his form with a shrug, “There’s been a fire in me ever since I left Tarkus, except this won’t go away with a quick fap or a fuck - this refuses to be quenched,” he finishes with clenched teeth."

rows.original: Wow. Feeling rather nervous in the face of his growing fervor, you’re reminded of the similar state he was in when you found him out in the wastes on Tarkus - though that was from an aphrodisiac, and seemed to go away once he shot a load.
rows.translation: 哇。面对他不断增长的狂热，你颇为紧张，想起在塔库斯荒野发现他时的类似状态——不过那次源于催情药，而且射过一次后似乎就消退了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow. Feeling rather nervous in the face of his growing fervor, you’re reminded of the similar state he was in when you found him out in the wastes on Tarkus - though that was from an aphrodisiac, and seemed to go away once he shot a load."

rows.original: Though you know the answer already
rows.translation: 虽然你早已知道答案
rows.raw: " Though you know the answer already"

rows.original: Curious
rows.translation: 出于好奇
rows.raw: " Curious"

rows.original: , you ask what has him so heated.
rows.translation: ，你还是问是什么让他如此火热。
rows.raw: ", you ask what has him so heated."

rows.original: “You,” he growls bluntly. His eyes scan your immediate surroundings before shifting back onto you, the azure orbs virtually ablaze with passion, “I’m glad that we met out here, actually. There’s something I want you to do.”
rows.translation: “你，”他直白地咆哮。双眼扫过你们身边，又重新落在你身上，那对蔚蓝眼眸几乎燃烧着激情，“其实我很高兴在这里遇见你。有件事想让你做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You,” he growls bluntly. His eyes scan your immediate surroundings before shifting back onto you, the azure orbs virtually ablaze with passion, “I’m glad that we met out here, actually. There’s something I want you to do.”"

rows.original: Figuring if he was just wanting a roll in the hay, you’d be doing that by now, so you carefully ask what it is he wants - or more accurately, needs - from you.
rows.translation: 你心想，如果他只想滚床单，现在早已开始了，于是谨慎询问他究竟想要——更准确地说，需要——你做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nFiguring if he was just wanting a roll in the hay, you’d be doing that by now, so you carefully ask what it is he wants - or more accurately, needs - from you."

rows.original: Not quite in the blink of an eye, but still surprisingly swift, Chaurmine grabs the haft of his hammer with an armored hand and swings the head to his feet - the impact enough to make you flinch as it smashes a large dent into the icy floor. “I want you to fight me,” he says, his massive frame tense, “I want you to fight me without holding back, as if your life were at risk.”
rows.translation: 虽没快到一眨眼，却依然惊人迅速；乔敏用装甲手抓住战锤长柄，将锤头挥向脚边——撞击在冰面砸出巨大凹坑，令你不禁畏缩。“我要你和我战斗，”他庞大身躯紧绷着说道，“我要你毫无保留地战斗，就像生命受到威胁一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNot quite in the blink of an eye, but still surprisingly swift, Chaurmine grabs the haft of his hammer with an armored hand and swings the head to his feet - the impact enough to make you flinch as it smashes a large dent into the icy floor. “I want you to fight me,” he says, his massive frame tense, “I want you to fight me without holding back, as if your life were at risk.”"

rows.original: You hesitate, having no desire to cause either of you injury - especially all the way out here.
rows.translation: 你犹豫了，不想让你们任何一方受伤——尤其是在如此偏远的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hesitate, having no desire to cause either of you injury - especially all the way out here."

rows.original: Noticing your nervous demeanor, Chaurmine gives a bittersweet smile, “Saurmorians aren’t people of complex feelings or relationships, [pc.name]. Saurmorians don’t feel these things - not the same way you do, at least. I need to know why I feel this way, and the best way I can do that is through what I do best.” He pulls his lips back into a rumbling growl, “Win or lose, I need to know why you have started this inferno inside me!” The cold, humid air whips against the two of you from above, carrying the steam hissing off of his molten body in swaying motions, reminding you of tattered cloth. “I need to know why you have claimed my heart!”
rows.translation: 乔敏注意到你紧张的神情，露出苦涩的微笑，“索莫里安人没有复杂的情感或关系，[pc.name]。索莫里安人感受不到这些东西——至少和你的感受方式不同。我需要知道自己为什么会有这种感觉，而最好的办法，就是用我最擅长的方式找出答案。”他向后扯起双唇，发出低沉咆哮，“无论输赢，我都要知道你为什么在我体内点燃了这场烈焰！”冰冷潮湿的空气从上方扑打着你们，将他熔融身体上嘶嘶蒸腾的水汽卷得左右摇摆，宛如破布。“我必须知道你为何夺走了我的心！”
rows.raw: "\n\nNoticing your nervous demeanor, Chaurmine gives a bittersweet smile, “Saurmorians aren’t people of complex feelings or relationships, [pc.name]. Saurmorians don’t feel these things - not the same way you do, at least. I need to know why I feel this way, and the best way I can do that is through what I do best.” He pulls his lips back into a rumbling growl, “Win or lose, I need to know why you have started this inferno inside me!” The cold, humid air whips against the two of you from above, carrying the steam hissing off of his molten body in swaying motions, reminding you of tattered cloth. “I need to know why you have claimed my heart!”"

rows.original: It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 开打了！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a fight!"

rows.original: CHAURMINE
rows.raw: "CHAURMINE"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Aullama
rows.raw: "Aullama"

rows.original: Panting in exhaustion, Chaurmine falls to his knees with a crash, cracking and chipping the ice with his weight. Darting forward, you ready yourself to catch the big lizard while you ascertain if he’s about to pass out or not. He’s not wobbling or shifting at all, and after roughly half a dozen heartbeats, he seems fine.
rows.translation: 乔敏精疲力尽地喘息着，轰然跪倒，体重将冰面压得开裂崩碎。你迅速冲上前，做好接住这头大蜥蜴的准备，同时判断他是不是快要昏过去了。他没有摇晃，也没有挪动；大约六次心跳后，看起来并无大碍。
rows.raw: "Panting in exhaustion, Chaurmine falls to his knees with a crash, cracking and chipping the ice with his weight. Darting forward, you ready yourself to catch the big lizard while you ascertain if he’s about to pass out or not. He’s not wobbling or shifting at all, and after roughly half a dozen heartbeats, he seems fine."

rows.original: With that settled, you figure it’s time to really confront the elephant in the room. Making sure he hears you, you
rows.translation: 此事解决后，你觉得该真正面对那个显而易见的问题了。你确保他能听见，随后
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that settled, you figure it’s time to really confront the elephant in the room. Making sure he hears you, you "

rows.original: gently turn his snout in your direction
rows.translation: 轻轻把他的吻部转向你
rows.raw: "gently turn his snout in your direction"

rows.original: snap your fingers in an effort to grab his attention
rows.translation: 打了个响指，试图引起他的注意
rows.raw: "snap your fingers in an effort to grab his attention"

rows.original: . With as much of his focus on you as you’re going to get, you softly mention what he’s feeling is something most species feel - though it can affect every individual differently, the general meaning is the same. That feeling is
rows.translation: 。等他的注意力尽可能集中到你身上后，你轻声提到，他的感受是大多数种族都会体验的东西——尽管它对每个人的影响各不相同，总体含义却是一致的。那种感觉就是
rows.raw: ". With as much of his focus on you as you’re going to get, you softly mention what he’s feeling is something most species feel - though it can affect every individual differently, the general meaning is the same. That feeling is"

rows.original: - you can’t help but give a little squee -
rows.translation: ——你忍不住轻轻尖叫了一声——
rows.raw: " - you can’t help but give a little squee -"

rows.original: love.
rows.raw: " love."

rows.original: “Love...” he cautiously rolls the word around on his tongue, as if trying a bitter food for the first time. Your eyes widen in surprise; he must have said the word in english, bypassing your translators - his guttural voice has a distinctly Italian accent to it.
rows.translation: “爱...”他谨慎地让这个词在舌尖滚动，仿佛第一次品尝苦涩的食物。你惊讶地睁大眼睛；他肯定是绕过翻译器，直接用英语说出了这个词——低沉粗粝的声音带着鲜明的意大利口音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Love...” he cautiously rolls the word around on his tongue, as if trying a bitter food for the first time. Your eyes widen in surprise; he must have said the word in english, bypassing your translators - his guttural voice has a distinctly Italian accent to it."

rows.original: <i>“Ahh...
I can see clearly now
rows.translation: 我现在看清楚了
rows.raw: "I can see clearly now"

rows.original: I understand
rows.translation: 我明白了
rows.raw: "I understand"

rows.original: ,” he murmurs between heavy breaths before looking straight into your eyes; his own no longer a chaotic blaze of emotion, but shining bright with affection, “Yeah... It’s - this feeling is still alien as fuck. I may never... Hah... never understand it. But it won’t scare me like that... never again.”
rows.translation: ，”他在沉重喘息间低声说道，随后直视你的双眼；他的眼中不再燃烧着混乱的情绪，而是闪耀着爱意，“是啊... 这种——这种感觉还是他妈的陌生。我也许永远... 哈... 永远无法理解。但它再也不会像刚才那样吓到我... 永远不会。”
rows.raw: ",” he murmurs between heavy breaths before looking straight into your eyes; his own no longer a chaotic blaze of emotion, but shining bright with affection, “Yeah... It’s - this feeling is still alien as fuck. I may never... Hah... never understand it. But it won’t scare me like that... never again.”"

rows.original: You blink in surprise, a hand absently dabbing away some sweat. After the state he was in, he’s all better now? Just like that?
rows.translation: 你惊讶地眨眨眼，一只手心不在焉地擦去汗水。他刚才还是那副状态，现在就完全好了？就这样？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink in surprise, a hand absently dabbing away some sweat. After the state he was in, he’s all better now? Just like that?"

rows.original: The brute grimaces slightly, “No, my blood’s gonna burn every time I see you, [pc.name]. I’m still going to need your help with these... with this stuff. It still unnerves me, you know.”
rows.translation: 这个壮汉微微皱起脸，“不，每次看见你，我的血液还是会燃烧，[pc.name]。这些... 这些事情，我仍然需要你帮忙。你知道，它还是让我不安。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe brute grimaces slightly, “No, my blood’s gonna burn every time I see you, [pc.name]. I’m still going to need your help with these... with this stuff. It still unnerves me, you know.”"

rows.original: You nod
rows.translation: 你点点头
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod"

rows.original: You shrug
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug"

rows.original: , offering that you’re willing to help, even do this again if needed.
rows.translation: ，表示自己愿意帮忙，必要时甚至可以再来一次这样的事。
rows.raw: ", offering that you’re willing to help, even do this again if needed."

rows.original: Helping Chaurmine to his feet as he catches his breath, you give his shoulders a squeeze, a small reminder that you’re still here.
rows.translation: 乔敏喘息着恢复体力时，你扶他站起来，又捏了捏他的肩膀，轻轻提醒他你依然在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nHelping Chaurmine to his feet as he catches his breath, you give his shoulders a squeeze, a small reminder that you’re still here."

rows.original: “See, that’s it right there,” he mumbles, sniffling, “I’m not alone...
rows.translation: “看，就是这样，”他吸着鼻子咕哝道，“我不是孤身一人...
rows.raw: "\n\n“See, that’s it right there,” he mumbles, sniffling, “I’m not alone..."

rows.original: Even if you don’t really feel the same way back, or whatever... You’re a good friend, [pc.name]
rows.translation: 就算你没有同样的感觉，或者别的什么... 你也是个好朋友，[pc.name]
rows.raw: " Even if you don’t really feel the same way back, or whatever... You’re a good friend, [pc.name]"

rows.original: Is that a tear?
rows.translation: 那是眼泪吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIs that a tear?"

rows.original: The lizard abruptly looks away, growling, “Get outta here before you freeze, dumbass.”
rows.translation: 蜥蜴猛地转开视线，低吼道：“赶紧滚，免得冻死，你这蠢货。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lizard abruptly looks away, growling, “Get outta here before you freeze, dumbass.”"

rows.original: CHAURMINE_WINS
rows.raw: "CHAURMINE_WINS"

rows.translation: 温柔照料
rows.raw: "Tender Care"

rows.original: Tender Care
rows.translation: 温柔照料
rows.raw: "Tender Care"

rows.original: Looks like he could use a little TLC.
rows.translation: 看来他需要一点悉心照顾。
rows.raw: "Looks like he could use a little TLC."

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: Fix
rows.translation: 治疗
rows.raw: "Fix"

rows.original: Patch him - and you - up before heading out into the cold.
rows.translation: 在进入严寒前，先替他——还有你自己——处理好伤势。
rows.raw: "Patch him - and you - up before heading out into the cold."

rows.original: “Though I’m not as resourceful as you are, hopefully this is enough of a thanks,” he leans against a workbench, snout gesturing towards it, “For, uh, being... you, I guess.” The movement draws your eyes to the table’s contents.
rows.translation: “虽然我不像你那么足智多谋，但希望这些足够表达谢意，”他倚着工作台，用吻部朝桌面示意，“感谢你，呃，一直... 做你自己吧，我猜。”这个动作将你的目光引向桌上的物品。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Though I’m not as resourceful as you are, hopefully this is enough of a thanks,” he leans against a workbench, snout gesturing towards it, “For, uh, being... you, I guess.” The movement draws your eyes to the table’s contents."

rows.original: What you see are two weapons, a hammer and some sort of large gun - virtually identical to the weapons Chaurmine uses; the hammer looks like little more than a massive block of dark gray metal with each end covered in spikes, the handle a thick pole made of incredibly dense and durable looking red-mahogany wood reinforced with the same metal as the head - it’s basically an intricately exaggerated bushing hammer. Meanwhile, the other weapon is a matte black gun with a long and bulky barrel - looking more like the barrel to a ship’s cannon - leading to the heavy receiver and its dual drum magazine. The huge hand-grip and stock are reinforced with what looks like a carbon fiber of some sort, while a carrying grip stands idle near the receiver.
rows.translation: 你看到两件武器：一把锤子，以及某种大型枪械——几乎与乔敏使用的武器完全相同。锤子看起来不过是一块巨大的深灰色金属，两端布满尖刺；握柄则是一根粗杆，由显得极其致密耐用的红褐色木材制成，并用和锤头相同的金属加固——基本就是一把被精细夸张化的衬套锤。另一件武器则是一把哑光黑色枪械，长而笨重的枪管更像舰炮炮管，连接着沉重的机匣和双弹鼓。巨大的握把与枪托由某种类似碳纤维的材料加固，机匣附近还有一道提把。

rows.original: Chaurmine smiles with a hint of pride as you look over the displayed weapons, “Saurmorian railgun, custom made for adjustable sized grips; and a ‘morian hammer, a high-frequency weapon made to shatter through armor.” He idly picks at the work table with a scale-claw before continuing, “Yeah, they’re not your fancy high tech lasers, but you’ll never find a ‘morian that would take anything but their own tech - these’ll last a lifetime, kick ass, and are satisfying to use. If you don’t mind the noise, at least...” Chaurmine shrugs, a moment of silence between you. “They’re for you... I uh, I made them. For you,” he stammers.
rows.translation: 你打量展示的武器时，乔敏带着一丝自豪微笑。“索莫里安轨道炮，定制了可调尺寸握把；还有一把‘莫里安锤，一种能击碎装甲的高频武器。”他漫不经心地用鳞爪抠着工作台，随后继续说道，“是啊，它们不是什么花哨的高科技激光武器，但你绝不会遇到愿意放弃自家技术的‘莫里安人——这些东西能用一辈子，威力十足，用起来也很过瘾。至少，只要你不介意噪音...”乔敏耸耸肩，你们之间沉默片刻。“它们是给你的... 我，呃，是我造的。给你，”他结巴道。

rows.original: Turning back to you, Chaurmine’s already aggressive visage darkens as a weak sneer splits his muzzle. “Yeah, that’s it. Sorry [pc.name], not all of us have a grand scavenger hunt made by our sire with a priceless lollipop to suck on afterwards,” he says lowly, then pauses as his reptilian face softens, “That was, uh... That came out more shitty than I meant...” With a sigh, he returns to a much more neutral demeanor, “Yeah, that’s ‘bout it right now. Wait for a client to contact me - usually an UGC officer or a warden that fucked up - then go pound the baddy and bring them in, and enjoy a hefty payday; that, and slothing it up between jobs is my life, and how it will be for a while. I’m happy with that, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 乔敏转回头来，本就凶悍的脸色一沉，吻部咧出一抹无力的冷笑。“对，就这样。抱歉，[pc.name]，不是每个人都有自家老爹安排的盛大寻宝之旅，事后还能舔上一根价值连城的棒棒糖，”他压低声音说道，随后停顿下来，爬行动物般的脸庞缓和了些，“刚才那句，呃...比我本意难听多了...”他叹了口气，恢复了平静得多的神态，“对，我现在差不多就干这些。等客户联系我——通常是联合银河邦联的军官，或是搞砸了事情的狱警——然后去揍趴坏蛋，把他们抓回来，再拿一笔丰厚的报酬；除此以外，我的人生就是在两份工作之间懒散度日，而且一段时间内都会这样。我对此很满意，[pc.name]。”

rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh,” Chrissy stutters, shifting uncomfortably in her place, “Guess I should’ve expected that, probably busy with more important stuff like... flying ships... and stuff to worry about video games, huh?”"

rows.original: The girl looks a little down after that, her shoulders slumping and betraying her normally happy demeanor, prompting you to change the subject and ask her where she lived before her move to this frozen moon.
rows.translation: 女孩听完后显得有些低落，双肩垮了下来，显露出与平日开朗举止不同的一面；于是你换了个话题，问她搬来这颗冰冻卫星前住在哪里。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girl looks a little down after that, her shoulders slumping and betraying her normally happy demeanor, prompting you to change the subject and ask her where she lived before her move to this frozen moon."

rows.original: <i>“I was born on Earth, and I like to move around every now and then. I’m not a spacer, but I enjoy going to new places. Then moved to Tavros for a bit. It was a little too noisy and busy for me, so I went back to Terra.
rows.translation: <i>“我出生在地球，喜欢偶尔换个地方住。我不是太空客，但喜欢去新地方。后来又搬到塔夫罗斯站住了一阵。那里对我来说有点太吵、太忙了，所以我回到了泰拉。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I was born on Earth, and I like to move around every now and then. I’m not a spacer, but I enjoy going to new places. Then moved to Tavros for a bit. It was a little too noisy and busy for me, so I went back to Terra. "

rows.translation: 后来乌维托在这里举办了锦标赛
rows.raw: "Then the tournament here on Uveto happened"

rows.original: , and after a few nights and a few huskar... I just really liked it here, so I moved in. Still likin’ it so far.”

rows.raw: ", and after a few nights and a few huskar... I just really liked it here, so I moved in. Still likin’ it so far.”"

rows.original: Once Chrissy finished her tale of how she got to this moon, she sighs and leans back in her seat, staring at her drink for a moment before she turns to you again, “Like I said, there’s not much you don’t already know, and I hope I don’t sound weird by saying this, but I like to be held, ya know? Feeling someone’s arms around you... covered in blankets until the sound of their breathing makes you fall asleep.” As she’s explaining herself, the half-breed seems lost in her own thoughts, a clear bit of blush appearing on her cheeks until she pulls herself back to reality, when her cheeks get even more red. “That’s not a weird thing to tell someone, r- right?”
rows.translation: 克丽丝讲完自己如何来到这颗卫星后，叹了口气，向后靠在座位上，盯着饮料看了片刻才再次转向你，“就像我说的，你已经知道得差不多了。我希望这样说听起来不会很怪，但我喜欢被人抱着，你懂吧？感受某人的双臂环绕着自己...裹在毯子里，直到对方的呼吸声让你睡着。”这位混血儿解释时似乎又沉浸在自己的思绪中，脸颊上泛起明显红晕；直到她回过神来，双颊顿时变得更红。“把这种事告诉别人不算奇怪，对、对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce Chrissy finished her tale of how she got to this moon, she sighs and leans back in her seat, staring at her drink for a moment before she turns to you again, “Like I said, there’s not much you don’t already know, and I hope I don’t sound weird by saying this, but I like to be held, ya know? Feeling someone’s arms around you... covered in blankets until the sound of their breathing makes you fall asleep.” As she’s explaining herself, the half-breed seems lost in her own thoughts, a clear bit of blush appearing on her cheeks until she pulls herself back to reality, when her cheeks get even more red. “That’s not a weird thing to tell someone, r- right?”"

rows.original: “There’s not much,” Chrissy begins with a little shrug of her little shoulders, resting her hands on her drink, “Just me, my mom, and my... uh, other mom.” She chuckles for second, leaning forward with her head resting in one hand, and dawdling her glass with the other, “I don’t know if you can tell or not, but I’m only half human. The other half is kui-tan. My mom is human, and my other mom, uh, ‘dad-mom’ is a kui-tan [herm|npc|f].” With that said, your half-breed friend sighs halfheartedly, her back slouching a bit.
rows.translation: “没什么可说的，”克丽丝微微耸动小巧的肩膀，双手扶着饮料，“只有我、我妈妈，还有我的...呃，另一个妈妈。”她轻笑一声，俯身用一只手托着头，另一只手慢悠悠地摆弄玻璃杯，“我不知道你看不看得出来，但我只有一半人类血统。另一半是奎坦血统。我妈妈是人类，而我的另一个妈妈，呃，‘爸爸妈妈’则是一位奎坦[herm|npc|f]。”说完，你的混血朋友无精打采地叹了口气，后背也略微垮下。

The other half is kui-tan. My mom is human, and my other mom, uh, ‘dad-mom’ is a kui-tan [herm|npc|f].” With that said, your half-breed friend sighs halfheartedly, her back slouching a bit."

rows.original: That seems like a rather odd reaction to Chrissy simply explaining her parents to you, leading you to ask her what it was like growing up with them.
rows.translation: 克丽丝只是向你解释父母，反应却显得相当奇怪；于是你问她，在两人的养育下长大是什么感受。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat seems like a rather odd reaction to Chrissy simply explaining her parents to you, leading you to ask her what it was like growing up with them."

rows.original: The ‘nuki girl picks herself up, sitting straight for a moment and keeping herself from making eye contact with you as she stares into her glass, “I mean... I love them to pieces. It’s just that sometimes I wish mom, mom-mom, could’ve been into dudes.” She pauses and leans forward against the table, “If you don’t know, kui-tan don’t have females, and can’t have girls as kids, just [herms|npc|f] and guys. You can probably guess which one I got. It was just really, really weird growing up on Earth, surrounded by girls who didn’t have cocks. Just makes you feel a little self conscious about your body, you know?”
rows.translation: 狸猫女孩振作起来，挺直身体坐了片刻，却始终避免与你对视，只盯着自己的杯子，“我的意思是...我爱死她们了。只是有时我希望妈妈，也就是妈妈妈妈，会喜欢男人。”她停顿片刻，向前靠上桌面，“如果你不知道，奎坦人没有女性，也生不出女孩，孩子只会是[herms|npc|f]或男性。你大概能猜到我是哪一种。在地球长大真的非常、非常奇怪，周围的女孩都没有鸡巴。这会让你对自己的身体感到有点不自在，明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ‘nuki girl picks herself up, sitting straight for a moment and keeping herself from making eye contact with you as she stares into her glass, “I mean... I love them to pieces. It’s just that sometimes I wish mom, mom-mom, could’ve been into dudes.” She pauses and leans forward against the table, “If you don’t know, kui-tan don’t have females, and can’t have girls as kids, just [herms|npc|f] and guys. You can probably guess which one I got. It was just really, really weird growing up on Earth, surrounded by girls who didn’t have cocks. Just makes you feel a little self conscious about your body, you know?”"

rows.original: Wondering if Chrissy really has that much of a problem with her kui-tan biology, you ask her so, but you don’t think it bothers her that much, otherwise she would have more than likely modded those bits of her away.
rows.translation: 你想知道克丽丝是否真的如此介意自己的奎坦生理特征，于是便问了她；不过你觉得那并没有让她太过困扰，否则她十有八九早就用改造除掉那些部位了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWondering if Chrissy really has that much of a problem with her kui-tan biology, you ask her so, but you don’t think it bothers her that much, otherwise she would have more than likely modded those bits of her away."

rows.original: “I’m not as weirded out by it as I used to be,” the kui-girl responds, picking herself up again, looking a bit more confident this time, “I still don’t, you know, use it often, or care enough to get rid of those parts... I’m still kinda attached to ‘em. I don’t know why, but I always feel like people are bothered by it, probably just some leftovers from growing up on Earth, and all that stuff.”
rows.translation: “我不像以前那么介意了，”奎坦女孩回答道，再次挺直身体，这次看起来多了几分自信，“我还是不会，你知道，经常使用它们，也没有在意到想除掉那些部位...我多少还是舍不得它们。我不知道为什么，但总觉得别人会介意，大概只是因为在地球长大留下了些影响之类的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not as weirded out by it as I used to be,” the kui-girl responds, picking herself up again, looking a bit more confident this time, “I still don’t, you know, use it often, or care enough to get rid of those parts... I’m still kinda attached to ‘em. I don’t know why, but I always feel like people are bothered by it, probably just some leftovers from growing up on Earth, and all that stuff.”"

rows.original: She smirks after that, staring down into her drink, “Feels pretty nice when you can cum from two spots at once, too.” Though, once she says that she looks back at you and blood rushes to her face, turning her a bright red, “Th- that... I shoulda kept that to myself, sorry.”
rows.translation: 说完后，她坏笑着低头看向饮料，“而且能同时从两个地方高潮，感觉相当不错。”不过话一出口，她便重新看向你，鲜血涌上脸颊，把脸涨得通红，“那、那个...我应该把这话留在心里的，抱歉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smirks after that, staring down into her drink, “Feels pretty nice when you can cum from two spots at once, too.” Though, once she says that she looks back at you and blood rushes to her face, turning her a bright red, “Th- that... I shoulda kept that to myself, sorry.”"

rows.original: “I like it a lot here!” Chrissy exclaims with a big smile on her face, her voice filled with excitement and joy, “Most people stay inside because of the cold so it’s pretty quiet around here, and that’s something I always look for when picking out a new home.”
rows.translation: “我非常喜欢这里！”克丽丝满面笑容地惊叹道，声音中充满兴奋与喜悦，“天气太冷，大多数人都会待在室内，所以这一带相当安静，而我每次挑选新家时都会寻找这样的地方。”
rows.raw: "“I like it a lot here!” Chrissy exclaims with a big smile on her face, her voice filled with excitement and joy, “Most people stay inside because of the cold so it’s pretty quiet around here, and that’s something I always look for when picking out a new home.”"

rows.original: You cock an eyebrow and tell her “quiet” doesn’t exactly sound like enough of a reason to move to one of the coldest places in the void.
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛，告诉她“安静”听起来并不足以成为搬到虚空中最寒冷之地之一的理由。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock an eyebrow and tell her “quiet” doesn’t exactly sound like enough of a reason to move to one of the coldest places in the void. "

rows.original: The tanuki girl grins at the question, “The cold is nice, gives me a reason to stay inside most of the time, or go to the bar and have a few drinks to warm up.” Chrissy finishes that sentence with a giggle before picking up where she left of, “Ever just listen to the wind at night and imagine how freezing it is out there? Makes being in bed feel that much better... that and it’s good weather for cuddling. Everything about this place just makes you feel so warm and cozy when you’re inside, and I love that, not to mention all the nice clothes I get to wear.” With that, the half kui-tan grins wide and holds up her arms to reveal the rather-thick sweater she’s wearing over her small, svelte body.
rows.translation: 狸猫姑娘听到这个问题咧嘴一笑，“寒冷挺好的，让我有理由大部分时间都待在室内，或者去酒吧喝上几杯暖暖身子。”克丽丝说完咯咯一笑，接着刚才的话说道：“你有没有在夜里只听着风声，想象外面有多冷？这样躺在床上就感觉舒服多了...而且这种天气也很适合依偎在一起。这里的一切都会让待在室内的你感觉无比温暖舒适，我就喜欢这一点，更不用说我还能穿上各种漂亮衣服。”说着，这位半奎坦人灿烂一笑，举起双臂，展示套在她纤小苗条身体外的厚实毛衣。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tanuki girl grins at the question, “The cold is nice, gives me a reason to stay inside most of the time, or go to the bar and have a few drinks to warm up.” Chrissy finishes that sentence with a giggle before picking up where she left of, “Ever just listen to the wind at night and imagine how freezing it is out there? Makes being in bed feel that much better... that and it’s good weather for cuddling. Everything about this place just makes you feel so warm and cozy when you’re inside, and I love that, not to mention all the nice clothes I get to wear.” With that, the half kui-tan grins wide and holds up her arms to reveal the rather-thick sweater she’s wearing over her small, svelte body."

rows.original: “And I don’t know if I mentioned this,” Chrissy says, placing her arms back on the table, though, now her sleeves are falling over her hands, a sure sign that sweater is a couple sizes too-big, “but, uh... I like huskar, a lot. I don’t want to sound like an airhead or anything when I say this, but they’re so fluffy and warm-looking. Every time I see one I just want them to give me a big hug and take me home and... well, you know... uh, sorry if I got carried away.”
rows.translation: “而且我不知道自己有没有提过，”克丽丝说着，把手臂重新放到桌上，不过现在袖子已经垂下来盖住双手，显然这件毛衣大了好几码，“不过，呃...我很喜欢赫斯卡人，非常喜欢。我这么说不想显得像个没脑子的花痴，但他们看起来那么毛茸茸、暖乎乎的。每次见到他们，我都想让他们紧紧抱住我、把我带回家，然后...嗯，你懂的...呃，抱歉，我好像说得太投入了。”

Every time I see one I just want them to give me a big hug and take me home and... well, you know... uh, sorry if I got carried away.”"

rows.original: “Well...” she’s says with more than a hint of tentativeness, “Not really... I’m not very good at asking people out or stuff like that. So I just sort’ve... do whatever, and sometimes people come up to me, which is nice, but I don’t go out of my way for sex... even if I did, I wouldn’t be very good at it because I just get so nervous when I have to go up to someone, which is weird because I’m perfectly fine when someone comes up to me. It’s just weird.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛...”她迟疑得十分明显，“其实也不是...我不太会约别人出去之类的。所以我只是...随便做自己的事，有时会有人主动来找我，这挺好的，可我不会特意去找人上床...就算真去，我也做不好，因为只要必须主动接近别人，我就会特别紧张。很奇怪吧，明明别人主动接近我时，我就完全没事。真的很奇怪。”

rows.original: Her face immediately lights up at that suggestion, her brown eyes suddenly filled with a long-lost joy and a big grin appearing on her face. “Yeah! Let’s do it!” the tanuki girl exclaims, standing up from her seat, “I usually don’t ever get to play with anyone in real life anymore, almost everything I do is online.” With that last sentence Chrissy finishes picking herself up and grabs a coat lying next to her, “It’ll be nice to play with someone else next to me for a change.”
rows.translation: 听到这个提议，她立刻眉开眼笑，棕色双眸突然充满久违的喜悦，脸上绽开灿烂笑容。“好啊！走吧！”狸猫姑娘一边惊呼，一边从座位上站起来，“我平时几乎没机会在现实里和别人一起玩了，基本上什么都在线上做。”说完最后一句话，克丽丝也站稳身子，拿起放在身旁的外套，“偶尔换成旁边真有个人陪我玩，一定很不错。”

rows.translation: 你向那顶大帐篷走近。途中，你发现了几组由截然不同的生物留下的足迹。它们彼此非常靠近，留下足迹的显然是同伴或一同狩猎的猎手。一组跖行足迹和一串带爪鸟足大小相仿。旁边还有巨大的趾行脚印，深深陷入雪中。你并不熟悉乌维托的动物，但留下脚印的生物看起来极为庞大。希望它不是食肉动物。
rows.raw: "You step closer to the large tent. On the way, you spot a couple of tracks done by very different kinds of creatures. They are very close to one another, certainly colleagues or hunters. There’s a set of plantigrade ones about the same size as a trail of avian, taloned feet. Next to them, enormous, digitigrade footprints sink deep into the snow. You aren’t an expert in uvetan fauna, but it looks big enough to be a very large creature. You hope it’s not carnivorous."

rows.original: Small pebbles taken from the lake protect the shelter’s many supporting pegs. The howling winds try relentlessly to tear the fabric apart, but the sturdy structure doesn’t show any sign of flinching. Looking at it more closely, you identify a small, hardlight mesh woven on top of the flexible tissue. A faint warmth radiates from it, like a pleasant caress that beckons you to enter. Before you can do so, an imperious voice booms from the inside.
rows.translation: 从湖边取来的小石块压住了庇护所众多支撑钉。呼啸狂风不懈地试图撕裂布料，但结实的结构纹丝不动。仔细观察后，你认出柔韧织物上还编织着一层细密的硬光网。淡淡暖意从中散出，如同舒适爱抚，召唤你走进去。然而在你付诸行动前，一道威严的声音从里面响起。
rows.raw: "\n\nSmall pebbles taken from the lake protect the shelter’s many supporting pegs. The howling winds try relentlessly to tear the fabric apart, but the sturdy structure doesn’t show any sign of flinching. Looking at it more closely, you identify a small, hardlight mesh woven on top of the flexible tissue. A faint warmth radiates from it, like a pleasant caress that beckons you to enter. Before you can do so, an imperious voice booms from the inside."

rows.original: “Shake the snow out before entering, would you? I’d like my doormat to stay dry for once.”
rows.translation: “进来前先把雪抖掉，好吗？我希望自家的门垫至少能干燥一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shake the snow out before entering, would you? I’d like my doormat to stay dry for once.”"

rows.original: Not willing to infuriate your host, you dutifully dust yourself off the worst of the snow
rows.translation: 你不想激怒主人，便顺从地拍掉身上最厚的积雪
rows.raw: "Not willing to infuriate your host, you dutifully dust yourself off the worst of the snow"

rows.original: You shrug, removing the worst of the icey flakes
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，拂去身上最厚的冰冷雪花
rows.raw: "You shrug, removing the worst of the icey flakes"

rows.original: You barely dust yourself
rows.translation: 你只是随便拍了拍自己
rows.raw: "You barely dust yourself"

rows.original: You spin around, making the little snowflakes on you fly up
rows.translation: 你旋转身体，让身上的细小雪花飞散开来
rows.raw: "You spin around, making the little snowflakes on you fly up"

rows.original: You shrug, casually dusting the cool snowflakes off you
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，随意拂掉身上冰凉的雪花
rows.raw: "You shrug, casually dusting the cool snowflakes off you"

rows.original: before stepping into the controlled habitat. Your face brightens as soon as you walk into the large, circular room, a stove in the center spreading a fiendish warmth all around the segmented shelter. You could easily cook a small feast with it, but its main function seems to be repelling the arctic cold. A blue, velvety couch and a couple of sofas line the artificial fireplace. A big pile of pillows and blankets takes a good chunk of the left side - certainly the beast’s bed. Three layers of rugs and cloth cover the floor, barring the cold from sneaking in through the soil.
rows.translation: ，随后走进这个受控栖息地。刚踏入宽阔的圆形房间，你的脸便亮了起来；中央的炉子向分段式庇护所四周散发出灼热暖意。你可以轻易用它烹制一顿小型宴席，不过它的主要用途似乎还是抵御北极严寒。一张蓝色天鹅绒长沙发和几张沙发椅围绕着人工壁炉摆放。左侧有一大堆枕头与毯子，占去了相当大的空间，显然是那头野兽的床。三层地毯和织物覆盖地面，阻挡寒气从土壤中渗入。
rows.raw: " before stepping into the controlled habitat. Your face brightens as soon as you walk into the large, circular room, a stove in the center spreading a fiendish warmth all around the segmented shelter. You could easily cook a small feast with it, but its main function seems to be repelling the arctic cold. A blue, velvety couch and a couple of sofas line the artificial fireplace. A big pile of pillows and blankets takes a good chunk of the left side - certainly the beast’s bed. Three layers of rugs and cloth cover the floor, barring the cold from sneaking in through the soil."

rows.original: On the left lies a smaller chamber filled to the brim with food and supplies. A couple of indigenous species happily swim in a couple of observation tanks: crabs, silverfish-like crustaceans, and bioluminescent fishes you’ve never seen before.
rows.translation: 左边还有一个较小的房间，里面塞满食物与补给。几种本地物种在一对观察水箱中欢快游动：螃蟹、类似衣鱼的甲壳动物，以及你从未见过的生物发光鱼类。
rows.raw: "\n\nOn the left lies a smaller chamber filled to the brim with food and supplies. A couple of indigenous species happily swim in a couple of observation tanks: crabs, silverfish-like crustaceans, and bioluminescent fishes you’ve never seen before."

rows.original: More concerningly, a huge
rows.translation: 更令人担忧的是，一只巨大的
rows.raw: " More concerningly, a huge "

rows.original: Lurelings
rows.raw: "Lurelings"

rows.original: lureling
rows.translation: 诱灵族
rows.raw: "lureling"

rows.original: anglerfish-like thing
rows.translation: 类似鮟鱇鱼的生物
rows.raw: "anglerfish-like thing"

rows.original: snoozes in a reinforced, pressurized tank. It blinks at you a couple of times before resuming its nap, unshaken by your presence.
rows.translation: 正在加固加压水箱中沉睡。它朝你眨了几次眼，随后便不受你存在的影响，继续打起盹来。
rows.raw: " snoozes in a reinforced, pressurized tank. It blinks at you a couple of times before resuming its nap, unshaken by your presence."

rows.original: Before you can scan the place more, a tall anat female joins you from the smaller room on the right. “Greetings. You must be terribly cold, aren’t you? Please, take a seat and make yourself comfortable.”
rows.translation: 你还没来得及进一步观察此处，一位高挑的安纳泰女性便从右侧较小的房间走出来。“你好。你一定冷得受不了，对吧？请坐，放松一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can scan the place more, a tall anat female joins you from the smaller room on the right. “Greetings. You must be terribly cold, aren’t you? Please, take a seat and make yourself comfortable.”"

rows.original: And she is?
rows.translation: 那么，她是谁？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd she is?"

rows.original: The amber-feathered avian blushes. “My apologies, I don’t have many visitors so my manners are a bit rusty. I’m Dahlia and this is my little nest. May I know your name, [pc.mf|handsome|cutie]?”
rows.translation: 这位长着琥珀色羽毛的鸟类女性脸红了。“请原谅，我没什么访客，所以礼数有些生疏。我叫达莉娅，这里是我的小巢。能告诉我你的名字吗，[pc.mf|帅哥|小可爱]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe amber-feathered avian blushes. “My apologies, I don’t have many visitors so my manners are a bit rusty. I’m Dahlia and this is my little nest. May I know your name, [pc.mf|handsome|cutie]?”"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” you simply answer.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]。”你只是简单答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name],” you simply answer."

rows.original: She smiles. “Well, what brings you to my outpost, [pc.name]? Let me guess... you are a savicite prospector. No, you look more like an adventurer... or maybe a tourist looking for a brutal, primal mate? You wouldn’t believe how many sex fiends become milodan [pc.mf|boytoys|broodmothers] after an eventful weekend on our lovely moon,” she says, a bright fire in her chestnut eyes.
rows.translation: 她微笑起来。“那么，是什么风把你吹到我的前哨站来了，[pc.name]？让我猜猜...你是赛维矿勘探者。不，你看起来更像冒险者...或者是来寻找野蛮原始伴侣的游客？你绝对想不到，有多少性欲狂在我们这颗可爱的卫星度过一个热闹周末后，会变成米洛丹的[pc.mf|男宠|育母]，”她说道，栗色双眼中燃烧着明亮火焰。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles. “Well, what brings you to my outpost, [pc.name]? Let me guess... you are a savicite prospector. No, you look more like an adventurer... or maybe a tourist looking for a brutal, primal mate? You wouldn’t believe how many sex fiends become milodan [pc.mf|boytoys|broodmothers] after an eventful weekend on our lovely moon,” she says, a bright fire in her chestnut eyes."

rows.original: You shrug. “And what are you doing here?”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。“那你在这里做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug. “And what are you doing here?”"

rows.original: Dahlia recovers a teapot from her stove and serves you a mug of fuming tea before taking her place on a sofa. “Surveying the wildlife. Not a job one can do from a desk in Uveto station.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅从炉子上取下一只茶壶，为你倒了一杯冒着热气的茶，随后在一张沙发椅上坐下。“调查野生动物。这可不是坐在乌维托空间站的办公桌前就能完成的工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia recovers a teapot from her stove and serves you a mug of fuming tea before taking her place on a sofa. “Surveying the wildlife. Not a job one can do from a desk in Uveto station.”"

rows.original: That’s not the easiest job. It must be hard to live here, away from the city, exposed to the moon’s unforgiving environment.
rows.translation: 这工作可不轻松。远离城市，直接暴露在这颗卫星无情的环境中，生活一定很艰难。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not the easiest job. It must be hard to live here, away from the city, exposed to the moon’s unforgiving environment."

rows.original: The amber bird takes a sip of searing hot tea. “It’s not all bad. I’ve pretty flexible work hours, very good pay, and almost all my expenses are covered. I also get to meet some interesting people. The icy plains are full of surprises,” she says before checking her watch. “Speaking of, we shouldn’t be alone for lo-”
rows.translation: 琥珀色的鸟儿啜饮了一口滚烫的茶。“这里也不全是坏处。我的工作时间很灵活，薪水很高，而且几乎所有开销都能报销。我还能遇到一些有趣的人。冰原上处处充满惊喜，”她说着看了看手表。“说到这个，我们不会单独待太久——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe amber bird takes a sip of searing hot tea. “It’s not all bad. I’ve pretty flexible work hours, very good pay, and almost all my expenses are covered. I also get to meet some interesting people. The icy plains are full of surprises,” she says before checking her watch. “Speaking of, we shouldn’t be alone for lo-”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Magenta Needle
rows.raw: "Magenta Needle"

rows.original: She doesn’t have the time to finish her sentence before a hulking, bear-like creature surges into the tent. It shakes many layers of snow off his russet fur - all over the carpets - then lazily collapses on the pillow pile, not bothered in the slightest by your presence. A moment later, a very plush figure follows suit. She’s slightly shorter than Dahlia, but a lot wider, especially stuffed in her polar coat. Nine white-furred tails with violet tips sprout from her back and perky, vulpine ears frame her round face. She’s blushing so brightly, her ebony skin looks as red as a tomato.
rows.translation: 她还没来得及说完，一头熊般魁梧的生物便冲进帐篷。它抖落赤褐色毛皮上层层积雪——弄得到处都是，连地毯也没能幸免——然后懒洋洋地瘫倒在枕头堆上，丝毫没把你的存在放在心上。片刻之后，一个非常丰腴的身影也跟了进来。她比达莉娅稍矮，却宽上许多，尤其是裹在极地大衣里时。九条尖端呈紫色的白毛尾巴从她背后伸出，一对精神的狐耳衬着她圆润的脸庞。她羞得满脸通红，乌黑的皮肤看起来都红得像番茄。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe doesn’t have the time to finish her sentence before a hulking, bear-like creature surges into the tent. It shakes many layers of snow off his russet fur - all over the carpets - then lazily collapses on the pillow pile, not bothered in the slightest by your presence. A moment later, a very plush figure follows suit. She’s slightly shorter than Dahlia, but a lot wider, especially stuffed in her polar coat. Nine white-furred tails with violet tips sprout from her back and perky, vulpine ears frame her round face. She’s blushing so brightly, her ebony skin looks as red as a tomato."

rows.original: “Guggoth no! Bad boy! I’m so sorry Dahlia, he left snow all over the carpet again.”
rows.translation: “古戈斯，不行！坏孩子！真对不起，达莉娅，它又把雪弄得满地毯都是。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guggoth no! Bad boy! I’m so sorry Dahlia, he left snow all over the carpet again.”"

rows.original: Your host sighs then taps her lap. “No worries. Come here, sweetie, we’ve got a lovely guest.”
rows.translation: 你的主人叹了口气，随后拍了拍自己的大腿。“没关系。过来吧，亲爱的，我们有一位可爱的客人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour host sighs then taps her lap. “No worries. Come here, sweetie, we’ve got a lovely guest.”"

rows.original: The overweight essyra blushes even deeper. She slowly waddles to Dahlia’s side, babbling incomprehensible words through her juicy lips. As soon as Dahlia’s fingers touch the flustered girl’s ears, she immediately relaxes.
rows.translation: 肥胖的埃西拉脸红得更加厉害。她慢慢摇摆着走到达莉娅身边，丰满的嘴唇间含糊地嘟囔着听不懂的话。达莉娅的手指一碰到这个慌乱女孩的耳朵，她立刻便放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe overweight essyra blushes even deeper. She slowly waddles to Dahlia’s side, babbling incomprehensible words through her juicy lips. As soon as Dahlia’s fingers touch the flustered girl’s ears, she immediately relaxes."

rows.original: “Feeling better, hon?”
rows.translation: “感觉好些了吗，亲爱的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Feeling better, hon?”"

rows.original: “Yes,” the fox girl mutters. “Who’s our new friend?”
rows.translation: “嗯，”狐女低声说。“我们的新朋友是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” the fox girl mutters. “Who’s our new friend?”"

rows.original: “[pc.name],” you answer. “We were chatting a little before you arrived, Miss...?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”你回答。“你来之前我们聊了一会儿，女士...？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name],” you answer. “We were chatting a little before you arrived, Miss...?”"

rows.original: “S-Sloan. My name is Sloan. N-Nice to meet you, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “斯、斯隆。我叫斯隆。很、很高兴认识你，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-Sloan. My name is Sloan. N-Nice to meet you, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Dahlia ruffles the big woman’s hair. “It’s always frightening to see you [silly|fold like origami|become a blushing violet] whenever you’re in public. Where did my big, tough huntress go?”
rows.translation: 达莉娅揉乱大个子女人的头发。“每次看到你一到公共场合就[silly|像折纸一样缩起来|变成一朵羞答答的紫罗兰]，我都觉得不可思议。我的高大强壮的女猎手去哪儿了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia ruffles the big woman’s hair. “It’s always frightening to see you [silly|fold like origami|become a blushing violet] whenever you’re in public. Where did my big, tough huntress go?”"

rows.original: “Hunting easy, words hard,” she grumbles back.
rows.translation: “打猎容易，说话难，”她咕哝着回道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hunting easy, words hard,” she grumbles back."

rows.original: Her big, tough huntress? Are they married?
rows.translation: 她高大强壮的女猎手？她们结婚了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nHer big, tough huntress? Are they married?"

rows.original: “Indeed. Sloan’s keeping me safe and helps me capture interesting specimens. She also keeps me warm through uveto’s cold, gloomy nights,” she teases. “You can stay here as long as you want. We’ll make your stay as enjoyable as possible. We can even share some body warmth, if you need.”
rows.translation: “没错。斯隆保护着我的安全，还帮我捕捉有趣的样本。她也会在乌维托寒冷阴郁的夜晚为我取暖，”她调笑道。“你想住多久都可以。我们会尽可能让你住得愉快。如果你需要，我们甚至可以分享一些体温。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Indeed. Sloan’s keeping me safe and helps me capture interesting specimens. She also keeps me warm through uveto’s cold, gloomy nights,” she teases. “You can stay here as long as you want. We’ll make your stay as enjoyable as possible. We can even share some body warmth, if you need.”"

rows.original: “Dahlia! We barely know [pc.himHer]! You can’t just share our bed with strangers like this.”
rows.translation: “达莉娅！我们都还不怎么认识[pc.himHer]！你不能就这样让陌生人和我们同床。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dahlia! We barely know [pc.himHer]! You can’t just share our bed with strangers like this.”"

rows.original: The anat girl reaches for her mug and takes a large gulp of tea. “Sorry, I got a little carried away. Is there anything we can do for you, [pc.name]? We’ve got spare arctic gear, if you need help crossing the tundra. Sloan can cook you a fine meal with our homemade goods, or we can talk about the wonderful ecosystem of my beloved homeworld. If there’s one thing we Uvetan are good at, it’s being charming hosts.”
rows.translation: 安纳泰女孩拿起杯子，大口喝了一口茶。“抱歉，我有点得意忘形了。有什么是我们能为你做的吗，[pc.name]？我们有多余的极地装备，如果你需要穿越冻原，它们能帮上忙。斯隆可以用我们的自制食品为你烹制一顿美餐，或者我们也可以聊聊我挚爱的故乡那美妙的生态系统。我们乌维托人若有什么特别擅长的，那就是热情待客。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe anat girl reaches for her mug and takes a large gulp of tea. “Sorry, I got a little carried away. Is there anything we can do for you, [pc.name]? We’ve got spare arctic gear, if you need help crossing the tundra. Sloan can cook you a fine meal with our homemade goods, or we can talk about the wonderful ecosystem of my beloved homeworld. If there’s one thing we Uvetan are good at, it’s being charming hosts.”"

rows.original: Is there something else you’d like to do with Dahlia and Sloan?
rows.translation: 你还想和达莉娅与斯隆做些什么吗？
rows.raw: "Is there something else you’d like to do with Dahlia and Sloan?"

rows.original: Magenta Needle
rows.raw: "Magenta Needle"

rows.original: You head to Dahlia’s huge, segmented tent. Despite how hard the wind blows, it still stands defiantly against the elements. On the way, the anat researcher leaves her refuge, a cumbersome scanner in hand. She observes the readings and her surroundings for a moment before noticing you. She makes ample moves with her arms, fighting the merciless gale to urge you to get to safety. You quickly cross the last few yards between you and the warm, cozy shelter.
rows.translation: 你走向达莉娅那顶巨大的分段式帐篷。无论狂风吹得多么猛烈，它依然傲然屹立，与严酷的环境抗衡。路上，那位安纳泰研究员走出自己的避难所，手里拿着一台笨重的扫描仪。她观察了一会儿读数和周围环境，才注意到你。她大幅挥动双臂，顶着无情的狂风催促你赶快躲到安全处。你迅速穿过最后几码距离，进入温暖舒适的庇护所。
rows.raw: "You head to Dahlia’s huge, segmented tent. Despite how hard the wind blows, it still stands defiantly against the elements. On the way, the anat researcher leaves her refuge, a cumbersome scanner in hand. She observes the readings and her surroundings for a moment before noticing you. She makes ample moves with her arms, fighting the merciless gale to urge you to get to safety. You quickly cross the last few yards between you and the warm, cozy shelter."

rows.original: “Welcome back, [pc.name]. Let me just-” she says, [pc.isNude|wrapping you with a wooly blanket. “Better. I wouldn’t want my favorite [pc.raceShort] to freeze solid. Please, come in, I just put some water to boil.”|dusting some snow off your shoulders[pc.isTaur| and tauric lower body]. “Better. As much as I love the snow, I’d rather it stays outside of my home. Please come in, I just put some water to boil.”]
rows.translation: “欢迎回来，[pc.name]。让我先——”她说道，[pc.isNude|用一条羊毛毯裹住你。“好多了。我可不想让我最喜欢的[pc.raceShort]冻成冰块。请进吧，我刚烧上水。”|掸去你肩膀[pc.isTaur|以及兽身下半身]上的积雪。“好多了。虽然我喜欢雪，但我更希望它留在家门外。请进吧，我刚烧上水。”]
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back, [pc.name]. Let me just-” she says, [pc.isNude|wrapping you with a wooly blanket. “Better. I wouldn’t want my favorite [pc.raceShort] to freeze solid. Please, come in, I just put some water to boil.”|dusting some snow off your shoulders[pc.isTaur| and tauric lower body]. “Better. As much as I love the snow, I’d rather it stays outside of my home. Please come in, I just put some water to boil.”]"

rows.original: The place is as lovely as you remember.
