rows.original: “Us? There’s a lot to say. Where to start?”
rows.translation: “我们？那可有很多话能说。该从哪儿讲起呢？”
rows.raw: "“Us? There’s a lot to say. Where to start?”"

rows.original: “M-Maybe our first date,” the essyra mumbles, almost melting on the spot. Their first time must have been wonderful, if its memory alone flusters her so much.
rows.translation: “也、也许从我们的第一次约会讲起，”埃西拉低声说道，整个人几乎要当场融化。光是回忆就让她如此慌乱，她们的第一次一定美妙极了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“M-Maybe our first date,” the essyra mumbles, almost melting on the spot. Their first time must have been wonderful, if its memory alone flusters her so much."

rows.original: Dahlia shakes her head. “It was a few years back. I just finished my degree in xenobiology from Ausaril Tech... I can’t believe I managed to get a grant for the number one ausar institute of technology.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅摇了摇头。“那是几年前的事了。我刚刚拿到奥萨瑞尔理工的异种生物学学位...真不敢相信我居然从奥萨第一的理工学院拿到了资助。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia shakes her head. “It was a few years back. I just finished my degree in xenobiology from Ausaril Tech... I can’t believe I managed to get a grant for the number one ausar institute of technology.”"

rows.original: “It’s because you are the best[silly|est],” Sloan murmurs, cheeks as bright as a tomato.
rows.translation: “因为你就是最[silly|最最]优秀的，”斯隆低声说道，双颊红得像番茄。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s because you are the best[silly|est],” Sloan murmurs, cheeks as bright as a tomato."

rows.original: “Maybe. So, I was preparing for my first field trip and the yearly Irestead fair had just begun. After work, I took my old ice skating gear and went to the ice ring. I was a bit rusty, but I still managed to make a few swirls and leaps. All was going well until a beginner bumped into me. I caught the poor thing a moment before she hit the ground.”
rows.translation: “也许吧。当时我正在为第一次野外考察做准备，而一年一度的伊尔斯泰德集市刚刚开幕。下班后，我拿上旧冰鞋去了溜冰场。我有点生疏，但还是成功转了几个圈，也跳了几下。本来一切顺利，直到一个初学者撞上我。我在那个可怜家伙倒地前一刻接住了她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe. So, I was preparing for my first field trip and the yearly Irestead fair had just begun. After work, I took my old ice skating gear and went to the ice ring. I was a bit rusty, but I still managed to make a few swirls and leaps. All was going well until a beginner bumped into me. I caught the poor thing a moment before she hit the ground.”"

rows.original: Sloan’s ears perk up. “My balance was so bad. How many times have I apologized for that?”
rows.translation: 斯隆的耳朵竖了起来。“我当时平衡感太差了。我为那件事道歉多少次了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSloan’s ears perk up. “My balance was so bad. How many times have I apologized for that?”"

rows.original: “Exactly twenty-five times. I shut her up with my index finger, then offered her a hand. When I saw just how little experience she had, I gave her a first lesson. She was a pretty good student, very involved. We then spent the evening and night together at the fair and we never truly separated afterward.”
rows.translation: “整整二十五次。我用食指堵住她的嘴，然后向她伸出一只手。看到她几乎毫无经验，我就给她上了第一堂课。她是个相当不错的学生，非常投入。之后我们一起在集市度过了整个傍晚和夜晚，从那以后就再也没有真正分开过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Exactly twenty-five times. I shut her up with my index finger, then offered her a hand. When I saw just how little experience she had, I gave her a first lesson. She was a pretty good student, very involved. We then spent the evening and night together at the fair and we never truly separated afterward.”"

rows.original: That’s a lot cuter than you expected it to be. No “lone avian lost in a blizzard and rescued by a curious fox” story.
rows.translation: 这故事比你预想的可爱多了。完全不是“孤独的鸟女在暴风雪中迷路，随后被好奇的狐狸救下”那种故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a lot cuter than you expected it to be. No “lone avian lost in a blizzard and rescued by a curious fox” story."

rows.original: “I know better than to get lost in a snowstorm. Although, I wouldn’t be against being rescued by a big, plush essyra. She could wrap me up in her tails and share her body warmth with me,” she teases, passing a hand through the overweight lady’s tail fluff. “I’d love to be pampered by a strong huntress with big, chocolate boobs and thighs as soft as a down-stuffed pillow.”
rows.translation: “我很清楚不能在暴风雪里迷路。不过，我倒不介意被一只高大丰腴的埃西拉救下。她可以用尾巴把我裹起来，与我分享体温，”她一边调笑，一边用手抚过肥胖女士尾巴上的绒毛。“我很乐意被一位强壮的女猎手宠爱，她有着硕大的巧克力色乳房，以及如羽绒枕般柔软的大腿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know better than to get lost in a snowstorm. Although, I wouldn’t be against being rescued by a big, plush essyra. She could wrap me up in her tails and share her body warmth with me,” she teases, passing a hand through the overweight lady’s tail fluff. “I’d love to be pampered by a strong huntress with big, chocolate boobs and thighs as soft as a down-stuffed pillow.”"

rows.original: “I-I won’t fall for that again,” the dark-skinned essyra pouts. “I was genuinely worried about you! Skilled trekkers disappear each year in the tundra, never to be seen again. I almost had a stroke when I received your distress signal! And I almost had another when I found you in your tent, waiting for me, naked on your bunk, and your eyes... staring at me like an alpha Hcep about to swoop an adult kor’diiak.”
rows.translation: “我、我不会再上那种当了，”黑皮肤的埃西拉撅嘴说道。“我当时真的很担心你！每年都有经验丰富的跋涉者消失在冻原上，从此杳无踪影。收到你的求救信号时，我差点心脏病发作！而当我发现你就在帐篷里等我，赤身裸体地躺在铺位上，眼睛...像一头正要扑向成年科迪亚克的头领级赫塞普兽那样盯着我时，我差点又发作一次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I-I won’t fall for that again,” the dark-skinned essyra pouts. “I was genuinely worried about you! Skilled trekkers disappear each year in the tundra, never to be seen again. I almost had a stroke when I received your distress signal! And I almost had another when I found you in your tent, waiting for me, naked on your bunk, and your eyes... staring at me like an alpha Hcep about to swoop an adult kor’diiak.”"

rows.original: Dahlia takes a sip of warm tea. “The patient hunter gets the prey.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅啜饮了一口热茶。“耐心的猎人才能捕获猎物。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia takes a sip of warm tea. “The patient hunter gets the prey.”"

rows.original: Speaking of hunting, you don’t know much about the shy essyra. Can she tell you more about herself?
rows.translation: 说到打猎，你对这位害羞的埃西拉了解不多。她能多讲讲自己吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nSpeaking of hunting, you don’t know much about the shy essyra. Can she tell you more about herself?"

rows.original: Sloan slowly nods. “There’s not much to say. I’m an essyra born in a village on the other side of Uveto, raised with her sisters, who became a huntress like many others of her kin since the dawn of time. Nothing fancy, really.”
rows.translation: 斯隆缓缓点头。“没什么可说的。我是一名出生在乌维托另一侧某座村庄的埃西拉，和姐妹们一起长大，自远古以来，族中许多女性都会成为女猎手，我也一样。真的没什么特别。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSloan slowly nods. “There’s not much to say. I’m an essyra born in a village on the other side of Uveto, raised with her sisters, who became a huntress like many others of her kin since the dawn of time. Nothing fancy, really.”"

rows.original: Dahlia sighs. “Come on, hon. Your family was the first to be uplifted. It’s their knowledge of the ice that allowed the creation of the underground railway. Heck, your mom spliced cold-resistant crops with the genes of an aquatic fern. And you certainly are the best pathfinder and interceptor of your generation.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅叹了口气。“得了吧，亲爱的。你的家族是第一批获得文明提升的族人。正是她们对冰层的了解促成了地下铁路的建造。天啊，你妈妈还把耐寒作物与一种水生蕨类的基因拼接在一起。而你无疑是你们这一代最出色的寻路者和拦截者。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia sighs. “Come on, hon. Your family was the first to be uplifted. It’s their knowledge of the ice that allowed the creation of the underground railway. Heck, your mom spliced cold-resistant crops with the genes of an aquatic fern. And you certainly are the best pathfinder and interceptor of your generation.”"

rows.original: The big vulpine blushes harder than ever. If she were a boiler, she’d be near the meltdown point. “I-I... no. I’m just doing normal stuff every other huntress does.”
rows.translation: 大个子狐女脸红得前所未有。假如她是台锅炉，现在已经快要熔毁了。“我、我...才没有。我只是在做其他女猎手都会做的普通事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe big vulpine blushes harder than ever. If she were a boiler, she’d be near the meltdown point. “I-I... no. I’m just doing normal stuff every other huntress does.”"

rows.original: “Like raising an orphaned kor’diiak from infancy to adulthood, rather than taming an adult one? Or using psionically-attuned lures to distract lurelings from vulnerable prey? No, there’s only one arctic fox brave and bold enough to try something so dangerous and live to tell the story,” the amber-feathered lady remarks. “And besides, do you truly think I’d marry a garden-variety essyra?”
rows.translation: “比如从幼年一直把一头失去双亲的科迪亚克养到成年，而不是驯服一头成年个体？又或者使用经过灵能调谐的诱饵，把诱灵族从脆弱的猎物身边引开？不，只有一只足够勇敢大胆的极地狐狸敢于尝试这么危险的事，而且还能活着讲出这段经历，”琥珀羽毛的女士评论道。“更何况，你真觉得我会娶一个普普通通的埃西拉吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like raising an orphaned kor’diiak from infancy to adulthood, rather than taming an adult one? Or using psionically-attuned lures to distract lurelings from vulnerable prey? No, there’s only one arctic fox brave and bold enough to try something so dangerous and live to tell the story,” the amber-feathered lady remarks. “And besides, do you truly think I’d marry a garden-variety essyra?”"

rows.original: She doesn’t look like one at all, if it can reassure her. They go well together; no wonder they married and settled together.
rows.translation: 如果这能让她安心的话，她看起来一点也不普通。她们十分般配；难怪会结为夫妻，共同定居。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe doesn’t look like one at all, if it can reassure her. They go well together; no wonder they married and settled together."

rows.original: “Yeah, I tied her knot a couple of times already,” Dahlia teases, making her love shiver. Taking advantage of her flustered state, she reaches for a small holopad and scrolls through her files. The avian hands you a bright picture of them in wedding attire. Dahlia is wearing a Stormguard-branded dress that looks a lot like ancient terran outfits. Sloan’s body, on the other hand, is adorned with trophies, bones, and jewels, her skin painted with tribal swirls and symbols. She looks like an ancient spirit that lured a poor maiden to her fluffy grasp.
rows.translation: “是啊，我已经套过她的肉结好几次了，”达莉娅调笑着，惹得爱人浑身一颤。她趁斯隆慌乱之际拿起一块小型全息板，翻找起自己的文件。鸟女递给你一张她们身穿婚礼服饰的明亮照片。达莉娅穿着一条风暴卫士品牌的裙子，看起来很像古代地球人的服装。斯隆的身体则饰有战利品、骨头和珠宝，皮肤上画满部落的旋纹与符号。她看起来像一位将可怜少女诱入毛茸茸怀抱的远古精灵。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, I tied her knot a couple of times already,” Dahlia teases, making her love shiver. Taking advantage of her flustered state, she reaches for a small holopad and scrolls through her files. The avian hands you a bright picture of them in wedding attire. Dahlia is wearing a Stormguard-branded dress that looks a lot like ancient terran outfits. Sloan’s body, on the other hand, is adorned with trophies, bones, and jewels, her skin painted with tribal swirls and symbols. She looks like an ancient spirit that lured a poor maiden to her fluffy grasp."

rows.original: They look beautiful.
rows.translation: 她们看起来美极了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey look beautiful."

rows.original: “I know, right? I still can’t believe mom let me borrow grandma’s dress. Sloan wanted a simple dress too, but as a huntress, she had to be in traditional garb. You know, she got each of these trophies herself, using nothing but an old, wooden spear and an obsidian knife. Her headdress and shoulders come from a blorgg prime - a blind megalodon with a huge segmented mouth! Its arm-length fangs and plated bones made a magnificent diadem and corset. [silly|Wotan’s beard|Stars], I’m so lucky to have a warrior queen all to myself.”
rows.translation: “可不是吗？我还是不敢相信妈妈肯把奶奶的裙子借给我。斯隆也想穿一条简单的裙子，但她身为女猎手，必须穿传统服装。你知道吗，这些战利品全是她仅凭一杆古老的木矛和一把黑曜石小刀亲手取得的。她的头饰和肩饰来自一头至尊布洛格——那是一条长着巨大分节嘴巴的盲眼巨齿鲨！它那手臂般长的獠牙和覆甲骨骼被制成了华丽的冠冕和束胸。[silly|沃坦的胡子啊|星辰啊]，能独占这样一位战士女王，我实在太幸运了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, right? I still can’t believe mom let me borrow grandma’s dress. Sloan wanted a simple dress too, but as a huntress, she had to be in traditional garb. You know, she got each of these trophies herself, using nothing but an old, wooden spear and an obsidian knife. Her headdress and shoulders come from a blorgg prime - a blind megalodon with a huge segmented mouth! Its arm-length fangs and plated bones made a magnificent diadem and corset. [silly|Wotan’s beard|Stars], I’m so lucky to have a warrior queen all to myself.”"

rows.original: The plush fox girl frowns. “I don’t like fighting. Also, I looked better in my dancing gown,” she murmurs. She then gently slides to the next picture. Dahlia is still in her classic dress, but the plump vulpine has changed into a bright red dress woven with amethysts. “We danced all night long. Your dad had to stop us to slice the cake.”
rows.translation: 丰腴的狐女皱起眉头。“我不喜欢战斗。而且我穿舞裙更好看，”她低声说道。随后，她轻轻滑到下一张照片。达莉娅依旧穿着她那条古典裙装，丰满的狐女却换上了一条镶嵌紫水晶的鲜红长裙。“我们跳了一整夜。你爸爸不得不叫停我们，好让我们切蛋糕。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe plush fox girl frowns. “I don’t like fighting. Also, I looked better in my dancing gown,” she murmurs. She then gently slides to the next picture. Dahlia is still in her classic dress, but the plump vulpine has changed into a bright red dress woven with amethysts. “We danced all night long. Your dad had to stop us to slice the cake.”"

rows.original: “Yeah. My old man’s a typical anat guy. Always an eye on the clock. [silly|Freya’s tits|Stars], I could use some of mom’s homemade jam-filled rolls.”
rows.translation: “是啊。我家老头就是典型的安纳泰男人，总是盯着时间。[silly|弗蕾亚的奶子啊|星辰啊]，我真想吃些妈妈亲手做的果酱夹心面包卷。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. My old man’s a typical anat guy. Always an eye on the clock. [silly|Freya’s tits|Stars], I could use some of mom’s homemade jam-filled rolls.”"

rows.original: “Me too,” Sloan replies, “especially if the biscuit is gorged with cherry liquor. I love it when it’s extra spongy. Maybe I can bring some back the next time I shop in Irestead.”
rows.translation: “我也是，”斯隆回答，“特别是饼干里塞满樱桃酒的时候。我喜欢它格外松软的样子。也许下次去伊尔斯泰德采购时，我可以带一些回来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me too,” Sloan replies, “especially if the biscuit is gorged with cherry liquor. I love it when it’s extra spongy. Maybe I can bring some back the next time I shop in Irestead.”"

rows.original: Speaking of Irestead. Why are they living so far from the city?
rows.translation: 说到伊尔斯泰德，她们为什么住得离城市这么远？
rows.raw: "\n\nSpeaking of Irestead. Why are they living so far from the city?"

rows.original: Dahlia finishes her mug in one big gulp before answering. “I’m a xenobiologist specialized in wildlife surveillance and growth. My task is to study the frozen lakes’ ecosystems and determine the optimal equilibrium to sustain the largest number of various specimens. As for Sloan, she’s paid to keep the main roads safe from beasts and to hunt down aggressive specimens that can’t be handled otherwise. My job covers most of my expenses since I’m out here in the field, [silly|fighting for my meal|exposed to the elements]. We made a lot out of this old XXL Akkadi Arctic Expedition Tent. It’s ancient tech, but the heating system and hardlight shielding are pretty resilient and easy to maintain. The only problem is that we went overboard and furnished it with so many things. We’ll need to borrow a stormguard shuttle to move all our stuff.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅一口喝完杯中的饮料才回答。“我是一名专攻野生动物监测与繁育的异种生物学家。我的任务是研究冰封湖泊的生态系统，并确定维持数量最多、种类最丰富的样本所需的最佳平衡。至于斯隆，她受雇保护主要道路免遭野兽袭击，并猎杀无法用其他手段处理的攻击性个体。由于我在野外[silly|为一餐饭而战|经受自然环境的考验]，这份工作报销了我的大部分开销。我们把这顶老旧的阿卡迪XXL极地探险帐篷改造得很不错。虽然是古老技术，但供暖系统和硬光护盾相当耐用，也很容易维护。唯一的问题是我们做过头了，往里面塞了太多家具。要搬走全部家当，我们得借一架风暴卫士的穿梭机。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia finishes her mug in one big gulp before answering. “I’m a xenobiologist specialized in wildlife surveillance and growth. My task is to study the frozen lakes’ ecosystems and determine the optimal equilibrium to sustain the largest number of various specimens. As for Sloan, she’s paid to keep the main roads safe from beasts and to hunt down aggressive specimens that can’t be handled otherwise. My job covers most of my expenses since I’m out here in the field, [silly|fighting for my meal|exposed to the elements]. We made a lot out of this old XXL Akkadi Arctic Expedition Tent. It’s ancient tech, but the heating system and hardlight shielding are pretty resilient and easy to maintain. The only problem is that we went overboard and furnished it with so many things. We’ll need to borrow a stormguard shuttle to move all our stuff.”"

rows.original: “Please Dally, your mom will requisition it on the double and your little brother will be in the pilot’s seat in a heartbeat. If you have a cold, the Stormguard will be here to bring you medicine and zhor beast soup - even the old Sigvald will crawl out of his cloister to help you.”
rows.translation: “拜托，达莉，你妈妈转眼就会把它征用过来，你弟弟也会立刻坐进驾驶座。只要你一感冒，风暴卫士就会赶来给你送药和佐尔兽汤——就连老西格瓦尔德都会爬出修道院来帮你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please Dally, your mom will requisition it on the double and your little brother will be in the pilot’s seat in a heartbeat. If you have a cold, the Stormguard will be here to bring you medicine and zhor beast soup - even the old Sigvald will crawl out of his cloister to help you.”"

rows.original: They seem to have a peaceful but busy life.
rows.translation: 她们的生活似乎平静而忙碌。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey seem to have a peaceful but busy life."

rows.original: “Indeed. Now, what to do with our guest? I’ve got a couple positio- I mean ideas I’d like to try.”
rows.translation: “没错。那么，该怎么招待我们的客人呢？我倒有几个姿势——我是说，有几个想法想试试。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Indeed. Now, what to do with our guest? I’ve got a couple positio- I mean ideas I’d like to try.”"

rows.original: “You are irredeemable,” Sloan sighs.
rows.translation: “你真是没救了，”斯隆叹道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You are irredeemable,” Sloan sighs."

rows.original: Magenta Needle
rows.raw: "Magenta Needle"

rows.original: “Standing out here in the wild, waiting for prey to fall into our carefully laid trap.” “Dahlia please, you’ll scare [pc.name] off. [pc.HeShe] will think we are nothing but sex fiends,” Sloan pouts. If they aren’t sex-crazed outcasts, what are they doing for a living? The athletic avian rises from the couch and walks toward a couple of aquariums filled with indigenous fishes, crustaceans, and batrachians. “I’m a xenobiologist. I’m here to survey the evolution of the fauna and flora around the frozen lakes. Our goal is to optimize the variety and growth of the current population without significantly changing the ecosystem. We’ve found out that the bigger anormalocaris and rimetrouts are, the more diverse a frozen body of water becomes,” she says, glancing at a silverfish-like crustacean gently floating in its tank. “It’s no surprise that in an arctic environment, most resources come from the rivers and oceans. Sometimes I wish I could join the undersea research department, to study the strange creatures roaming the glacial depths.”
rows.translation: “站在荒野里，等着猎物落入我们精心布置的陷阱。” “达莉娅，拜托，你会把[pc.name]吓跑的。[pc.HeShe]会以为我们满脑子只有性，”斯隆撅起嘴。 如果她们不是性欲旺盛的离群者，那她们靠什么谋生？ 体格矫健的鸟族女子从沙发上起身，走向几个装满本土鱼类、甲壳类和两栖类生物的水族箱。“我是异星生物学家。我来这里考察冰湖周边动植物的演化情况。我们的目标是在不显著改变生态系统的前提下，优化现有种群的多样性和繁衍状况。我们发现，奇虾和霜鳟的体型越大，冰封水域的生物多样性就越丰富，”她说道，同时瞥向一只在水箱中轻轻漂浮、形似蠹虫的甲壳动物。“在极地环境里，大多数资源都来自河流和海洋，这并不奇怪。有时我真希望能加入海底研究部门，去研究那些游荡在冰川深处的奇异生物。”
rows.raw: "“Standing out here in the wild, waiting for prey to fall into our carefully laid trap.” “Dahlia please, you’ll scare [pc.name] off. [pc.HeShe] will think we are nothing but sex fiends,” Sloan pouts. If they aren’t sex-crazed outcasts, what are they doing for a living? The athletic avian rises from the couch and walks toward a couple of aquariums filled with indigenous fishes, crustaceans, and batrachians. “I’m a xenobiologist. I’m here to survey the evolution of the fauna and flora around the frozen lakes. Our goal is to optimize the variety and growth of the current population without significantly changing the ecosystem. We’ve found out that the bigger anormalocaris and rimetrouts are, the more diverse a frozen body of water becomes,” she says, glancing at a silverfish-like crustacean gently floating in its tank. “It’s no surprise that in an arctic environment, most resources come from the rivers and oceans. Sometimes I wish I could join the undersea research department, to study the strange creatures roaming the glacial depths.”"

rows.original: You’ll pass on this one. The giant electric jellyfish that attacked you in the Deep Sea research facility was enough of a cautionary tale.
rows.translation: 这次你还是算了吧。在深海研究设施袭击你的巨型电水母已经足以让你引以为戒了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll pass on this one. The giant electric jellyfish that attacked you in the Deep Sea research facility was enough of a cautionary tale."

rows.original: She’s a strange one. Her job allows for work inside, protected from the elements, and yet she’s happy to be at the mercy of this moon’s devastating thunderstorms and blizzard.
rows.translation: 她真是个怪人。她的工作明明能在室内进行，免受恶劣天气侵扰，可她却乐于任由这颗卫星上肆虐的雷暴和暴风雪摆布。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s a strange one. Her job allows for work inside, protected from the elements, and yet she’s happy to be at the mercy of this moon’s devastating thunderstorms and blizzard."

rows.original: The amber-feathered scientist shrugs. “There’s only so much automated drones can do. Compared to the meteorology center, we have little to no ressources for replacing broken instruments. A strong tempest will wreck robots worth more than my yearly income, but a skilled field agent can endure, especially if she’s got two big, meaty bodyguards,” she says, giving the russet kor’diiak some belly rubs. The humongous beast barks happily, like a small puppy. “Go slow, Dahlia, Guggoth’s been disobeying me a lot lately. I don’t want to reward his bad behavior.” The bird lady shakes her head. “It’s just a bit of snow on the carpet, that’s not a big deal. How can you be so cruel to deny pats for that?” Sloan pouts. “Cruel? You’re the one that berates me when ONE snowflake falls from my tails and melts on your soil.” “The difference between you and him, dear, is that you are the one sleeping with me. I like my furs warm and dry, not wet and soggy.” Maybe you should intervene before they start a cat fight. Speaking of furs, do they come from the essyra’s prey? The shy lady suddenly builds some courage; you can see pride in her eyes. “Yes and no. A lot of mammals on Uveto shed their wool and fur when they grow older, so it’s easy to harvest raw materials from them to make rugs, blankets, clothes, and so on. Walruses, kor’diiaks, giant sky rays, and veiny eels provide good sources of food. If you take one down, you can have meat for an entire trimester - assuming you can salt, steam, or pickle it of course.” Are there specific techniques essyra huntresses use? Sloan shakes her head. “Not anymore, no. We used to fish with our tails and lay primitive traps to catch small frys, but we don’t use them anymore. We still learn the old ways in case we end up isolated from one another and desperately need to eat. As rewarding as drawing a homemade bow feels, I’d rather use an energy rifle or an old carbine. Don’t get me wrong, I’m not an anti-tradition protester. I still use a spear to threaten large predators like my ancestors did, but I mostly strike with the side equipped with the taser goad. A stun rifle also does wonders on a target. It keeps the meat, fur, down, and scales in great shape.” Does she hunt a lot of prey? “No. We essyra used to be prey as well. There’s a reason we breed true and are short-lived without genetic uplifting. Before the U.G.C settled our moon, even the weakest lurelings could have a tribe of marion at their beck and call. I can’t imagine being naught but a manipulative monster’s feeding slave.” Dahlia raises an eyebrow. “Oh? So I’m finally getting an oily massage?” The vulpine huntress pouts. “You know what I mean, Dahlia. You are nothing like the lureling dominators of the past. They would pimp my people to milodan mating ceremonies and korgonne packs just for their amusement. And no, I’m not buying coconut oil just to give you a happy ending.” They look quite open about their sexuality. Dahlia joins Sloan on the couch and reaches for her mug. “Indeed. We agreed in our vows to have a little freedom concerning our respective needs. As much as I love my sweet, plump love, I’m always looking for new pre- uh, partners, new partners. I wonder how they yelp and moan.” “Hon please, you’ll scare [pc.himHer] off!” The feathered researcher smirks. “If you want a more obedient and kind lay, I know a big fluffy girl. I’ve been told she loves being tied with her own tails and teased for hours. Some bold souls tried to take us both at the same time and lost many hours of their lives to intense, debilitating lovemaking. We don’t have a lot of visitors, so I tend to give it my all to make things memorable.” [silly|Don’t they fear they’ll over-excite toad in the tank? you ask, glancing at the snoozing lureling rolling in his tank. “This fellow is old, very old, possibly over a hundred years,” Sloan replies, her eyes nothing but an ocean of compassion. “His psionic aura is so weak. I need to have forehead-to-antenna contact to hear him. We found him unconscious, floating on the lake’s surface. No matter how much damage his species has done to mine, I couldn’t let him starve to death.” “Don’t worry, [pc.name]. Sloan’s immune to psionic control, her entire family is. The lureling isn’t talking through her. Our intense cuddling suffices to keep him well fed - that and malt balls. Drop one in his tank and you’ll be his best friend. I feel a bit bad to keep him like this, but he’s an excellent test subject - and he gives me new ideas to top Sloan :p”]

rows.original: “You wanna make a throuple without buying me dinner first? That’s quite bold of you,” Dahlia mockingly winks.
rows.translation: “连晚饭都不请我吃，就想组建三人伴侣关系？你胆子不小嘛，”达莉娅戏谑地眨了眨眼。
rows.raw: "“You wanna make a throuple without buying me dinner first? That’s quite bold of you,” Dahlia mockingly winks."

rows.original: “Hon, you are such a horndog,” Sloan sighs. “We are a happy, married couple. Not with child yet but we’ll get to it eventually,” she mumbles, becoming redder as she exposes her plans.
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你真是条色狗，”斯隆叹道。“我们是一对幸福的已婚伴侣。虽然还没有孩子，但以后总会有的，”她喃喃说道，透露自己的计划时，脸变得更红了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hon, you are such a horndog,” Sloan sighs. “We are a happy, married couple. Not with child yet but we’ll get to it eventually,” she mumbles, becoming redder as she exposes her plans."

rows.original: Dahlia nods. “One day, sweetie. Unfortunately, I can’t get pregnant without fertility boosters. My anat genes are too weak to reproduce with another species without help.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅点点头。“总有一天，甜心。可惜不用生育强化剂，我就怀不了孕。我的安纳泰基因太弱，没法在没有帮助的情况下和其他物种繁衍。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia nods. “One day, sweetie. Unfortunately, I can’t get pregnant without fertility boosters. My anat genes are too weak to reproduce with another species without help.”"

rows.original: Anats aren’t native to this moon. How did she end up here?
rows.translation: 安纳泰族并非这颗卫星的原生种族。她怎么会来到这里？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnats aren’t native to this moon. How did she end up here?"

rows.original: Dahlia takes a sip of herbal tea. “It might surprise you, but I was born here. My father is from the Anat Empire. He’s working as a logistic agent with the Camarilla to secure savicite exports to Caphist, his homeworld. As for my mother, she’s a human with modded wings. Her family participated in the foundation of the Stormguard back in the tenth Planet Rush. They met in a diplomatic mission with the korgonne that ended poorly. A couple of months later, they were engaged and Dad started the genetic therapy needed to crossbreed with humans. Long story short, a year later, I was born. Luckily, I inherited a lot from my mother’s side, stuff anat women don’t usually have like hair and nipples. They were a bit shocked that I wasn’t born with blue eyes like them, but my great-grandmother on my father’s side had hazel eyes so it wasn’t a big deal. Troubles came later.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅啜了一口花草茶。“你也许会觉得意外，但我出生在这里。我父亲来自安纳泰帝国。他在卡玛利拉担任物流专员，负责确保萨维晶能顺利出口到他的母星卡菲斯。至于我母亲，她是一名装上改造翅膀的人类。她的家族曾在第十次行星淘金热期间参与创立风暴卫士。他们在一次与科尔贡的外交任务中相遇，那次任务最后一团糟。几个月后，他们订了婚，爸爸也开始接受与人类跨种生育所需的基因治疗。长话短说，一年后我出生了。幸运的是，我从母亲那边继承了很多东西，包括安纳泰女性通常没有的头发和乳头。他们发现我没有像他们一样天生蓝眼睛时有些震惊，不过我父系的曾祖母是淡褐色眼睛，所以也不算什么大事。麻烦后来才出现。”

rows.original: Troubles? What happened?
rows.translation: 麻烦？发生了什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nTroubles? What happened?"

rows.original: “In retrospect, it sounds silly, but it was a big drama in my family. When I was four, Mother got pregnant again. Dad wasn’t supposed to still be fertile at the time, so he accused her of cheating on him. They bickered a lot, and it became worse the closer she was to the term. Eventually, she gave birth to a half-anat boy that had the feathers and the eyes of Father. Unfortunately, the seeds they sow already germinated and the things they said to each other couldn’t be so easily forgotten. Poor Grimald had it rougher than I, especially since Mom wanted him to be a Stormguard warrior. My brother was too kind and pure to be a frontliner.”
rows.translation: “现在回想起来，这听着有些可笑，但当时在我家里闹得很大。我四岁时，母亲又怀孕了。爸爸那时本来不该还有生育能力，于是指控她背叛了自己。他们争吵不休，越接近预产期，情况就越糟。最终，她生下一个半安纳泰男孩，有着父亲的羽毛和眼睛。可惜，他们播下的种子已经发芽，彼此说过的话也无法轻易忘记。可怜的格里马尔德过得比我还苦，尤其是妈妈希望他成为风暴卫士战士。我的弟弟太善良、太纯真，不适合冲锋陷阵。”

Eventually, she gave birth to a half-anat boy that had the feathers and the eyes of Father. Unfortunately, the seeds they sow already germinated and the things they said to each other couldn’t be so easily forgotten. Poor Grimald had it rougher than I, especially since Mom wanted him to be a Stormguard warrior. My brother was too kind and pure to be a frontliner.”"

rows.original: You’ve met him before; he is indeed very sweet and passionate. It’s true that he’s a bit too frail to be a warrior, but you wouldn’t call him weak.
rows.translation: 你以前见过他；他确实非常温柔而热情。他的确有点过于瘦弱，不适合当战士，但你不会说他软弱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve met him before; he is indeed very sweet and passionate. It’s true that he’s a bit too frail to be a warrior, but you wouldn’t call him weak."

rows.original: That sounds rough. You hope their childhood wasn’t too dire.
rows.translation: 听起来很艰难。你希望她们的童年没有太过悲惨。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounds rough. You hope their childhood wasn’t too dire."

rows.original: “I was lucky. School and sports were easy for me, so I quickly became the prodigy child of the family, not that it left Grimald off the hook. With an anat father and a stormguard mother, let’s just say that everything was a challenge to be overcome. I excelled in high school and since I fared well, I got a scholarship to study at Ausaril Tech. My college years were among the best of my life. I finally had some freedom and, for once, I wasn’t the top bitch in everything. I also partied a lot: men, women, herms... there’s nothing I didn’t taste. There was this PhD student I looked up to, an ausar girl who went to all the parties. She was a real sex fiend and a brilliant mind. She worked for Akkadi for a couple of years then left for a smaller company. Last I heard about her, she’d moved to a recently-discovered planet. If it weren’t for her, I wouldn’t know half my kinks. Anyway, with my degree in hand, I came back to Uveto and got a job as a xenobiologist. First, I upgraded the survey probes, then I became a field agent when I met Sloan.”
rows.translation: “我很幸运。学业和体育对我来说都很轻松，所以我很快就成了家里的天才儿童，但格里马尔德可没有因此得到解脱。父亲是安纳泰，母亲是风暴卫士，这么说吧，任何事都成了必须克服的挑战。我在高中成绩优异，也因此获得奖学金，进入奥萨瑞尔理工学院学习。大学时光是我人生中最美好的岁月之一。我终于有了些自由，而且难得没有在所有领域里都独占鳌头。我也经常参加派对：男人、女人、双性人...没有什么是我没尝过的。那时有个我很崇拜的博士生，是个每场派对都参加的奥萨族姑娘。她既是个不折不扣的性魔，也是个才华横溢的天才。她在阿卡迪工作了几年，后来跳槽到一家较小的公司。我最后听到她的消息时，她已经搬到一颗新近发现的星球去了。要不是她，我连自己一半的癖好都不会知道。总之，我拿到学位后回到乌维托，找到一份异星生物学家的工作。一开始，我负责升级勘测探针，后来遇到斯隆后，就成了外勤人员。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was lucky. School and sports were easy for me, so I quickly became the prodigy child of the family, not that it left Grimald off the hook. With an anat father and a stormguard mother, let’s just say that everything was a challenge to be overcome. I excelled in high school and since I fared well, I got a scholarship to study at Ausaril Tech. My college years were among the best of my life. I finally had some freedom and, for once, I wasn’t the top bitch in everything. I also partied a lot: men, women, herms... there’s nothing I didn’t taste. There was this PhD student I looked up to, an ausar girl who went to all the parties. She was a real sex fiend and a brilliant mind. She worked for Akkadi for a couple of years then left for a smaller company. Last I heard about her, she’d moved to a recently-discovered planet. If it weren’t for her, I wouldn’t know half my kinks. Anyway, with my degree in hand, I came back to Uveto and got a job as a xenobiologist. First, I upgraded the survey probes, then I became a field agent when I met Sloan.”"

rows.original: “You know, I could have settled with you in Irestead. You didn’t need to follow me in the wilds,” the fat essyra murmurs.
rows.translation: “你知道吗，我本来可以和你一起定居在伊尔斯泰德。你没必要跟着我来到荒野，”丰满的埃西拉低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know, I could have settled with you in Irestead. You didn’t need to follow me in the wilds,” the fat essyra murmurs."

rows.original: The half-anat shrugs. “Life doesn’t have the same thrill in Irestead. And besides, I don’t think our neighbors would tolerate our intense cuddling sessions.”
rows.translation: 半安纳泰女子耸了耸肩。“伊尔斯泰德的生活没这么刺激。而且，我觉得邻居们不会容忍我们那些激烈的拥抱活动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe half-anat shrugs. “Life doesn’t have the same thrill in Irestead. And besides, I don’t think our neighbors would tolerate our intense cuddling sessions.”"

rows.original: What’s Sloan story?
rows.translation: 斯隆有着怎样的故事？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat’s Sloan story?"

rows.original: “I’m just an essyra huntress.”
rows.translation: “我只是个埃西拉女猎手。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m just an essyra huntress.”"

rows.original: “A pretty good essyra huntress,” Dahlia remarks. “Did you know she’s got a dragon sire?”
rows.translation: “是个很出色的埃西拉女猎手，”达莉娅说道。“你知道她有个龙族生父吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A pretty good essyra huntress,” Dahlia remarks. “Did you know she’s got a dragon sire?”"

rows.original: Wait really?
rows.translation: 等等，真的？
rows.raw: "\n\nWait really?"

rows.original: “N-No! Mama’s a gryvain, not a Frostwyrm!”
rows.translation: “才——才不是！妈妈是格里文，不是霜龙！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“N-No! Mama’s a gryvain, not a Frostwyrm!”"

rows.original: “Hon, I’ve been with gryvains, none had your girth.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，我和格里文做过，可没有谁像你这么粗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hon, I’ve been with gryvains, none had your girth.”"

rows.original: Sloan sighs. “Listen, I know there’s stories about my ancestors being graced by a benevolent Frostwyrm to fight lurelings, but these are nothing but legends. My kin mixed with lots of gryvain, that’s true, and many followed them across the stars, but that’s it.”
rows.translation: 斯隆叹了口气。“听着，我知道有传说称，我的祖先曾蒙一条仁慈霜龙赐福，以对抗诱灵族，但那不过是传说。我的族人确实与许多格里文混血，也有不少族人跟着他们去了群星之间，但仅此而已。”
rows.raw: "\n\nSloan sighs. “Listen, I know there’s stories about my ancestors being graced by a benevolent Frostwyrm to fight lurelings, but these are nothing but legends. My kin mixed with lots of gryvain, that’s true, and many followed them across the stars, but that’s it.”"

rows.original: Does she have sisters?
rows.translation: 她有姐妹吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDoes she have sisters?"

rows.original: “Many. My mothers made sure they’d have a large family, so they impregnated each other. They gave birth to me and to my nine siblings the same day. My sisters are all tall, strong amazons with draconic features they either inherited or modded themselves with.”
rows.translation: “有很多。我的母亲们决心要组建一个大家庭，所以她们让彼此怀了孕。她们在同一天生下了我和我的九个兄弟姐妹。我的姐妹全都是高大强壮的亚马逊女战士，身上的龙族特征有些是遗传来的，有些是自己改造出来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Many. My mothers made sure they’d have a large family, so they impregnated each other. They gave birth to me and to my nine siblings the same day. My sisters are all tall, strong amazons with draconic features they either inherited or modded themselves with.”"

rows.original: What’s her gryvain features?
rows.translation: 她身上有哪些格里文特征？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat’s her gryvain features?"

rows.original: The huntress’s cheeks turn crimson. “I... that’s a little personal.”
rows.translation: 女猎手的双颊变得通红。“我...这有点私人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe huntress’s cheeks turn crimson. “I... that’s a little personal.”"

rows.original: You see. She said her sisters were all muscle-bound ladies, is she the only plus-sized one?
rows.translation: 明白了。她说姐妹们个个肌肉发达，难道只有她一个人体型丰满？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see. She said her sisters were all muscle-bound ladies, is she the only plus-sized one?"

rows.original: Dahlia’s hands settle on the ebony fox’s shoulders. “You don’t have to talk about it.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅的双手落在黑毛狐狸的肩膀上。“你不用非得谈这件事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia’s hands settle on the ebony fox’s shoulders. “You don’t have to talk about it.”"

rows.original: “It’s fine. A few years ago, I used to be as bulky and shredded as my siblings - a [silly|kitsune|vulpine] bodybuilder without a hint of fat. Truth be told, no matter how good people said I looked, I felt disgusted with myself. Seeing myself in a mirror, getting praised for my chiseled body, being lusted over by men and women for my gains, all these things made me feel terrible. I felt like I didn’t belong in my own flesh.”
rows.translation: “没关系。几年前，我曾经和兄弟姐妹们一样壮硕精悍——是个[silly|狐仙|狐族]健美运动员，身上一点脂肪都没有。说实话，不管别人说我多么好看，我都厌恶自己。看着镜中的自己，因棱角分明的身体受到称赞，因为练出的肌肉招来男人和女人的垂涎，所有这些都让我感觉糟透了。我觉得自己不属于这副躯体。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s fine. A few years ago, I used to be as bulky and shredded as my siblings - a [silly|kitsune|vulpine] bodybuilder without a hint of fat. Truth be told, no matter how good people said I looked, I felt disgusted with myself. Seeing myself in a mirror, getting praised for my chiseled body, being lusted over by men and women for my gains, all these things made me feel terrible. I felt like I didn’t belong in my own flesh.”"

rows.original: You didn’t know someone could have this kind of dysphoria. Usually, it’s people that long to change their gender or apparent race that suffer from this kind of disorder.
rows.translation: 你不知道有人会产生这样的身体焦虑。通常都是渴望改变自身性别或外在种族的人，才会受到这类失调的折磨。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou didn’t know someone could have this kind of dysphoria. Usually, it’s people that long to change their gender or apparent race that suffer from this kind of disorder."

rows.original: “Well, [silly|I’m built different|I’m a weird gal],” Sloan murmurs.
rows.translation: “这个嘛，[silly|我的构造与众不同|我是个怪姑娘]，”斯隆低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, [silly|I’m built different|I’m a weird gal],” Sloan murmurs."

rows.original: Did Dahlia help her get her dream body?
rows.translation: 是达莉娅帮她获得了梦想中的身体吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDid Dahlia help her get her dream body?"

rows.original: The half-anat shakes her head. “Unfortunately no. She had to go through it alone.”
rows.translation: 半安纳泰女子摇了摇头。“很遗憾，不是。她不得不独自挺过那段经历。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe half-anat shakes her head. “Unfortunately no. She had to go through it alone.”"

rows.original: “Seeing my unease, my essyra mother told me to head south and fish as many coolcods, iceberg eels, and frost lobsters as possible. It was about that time I found Guggoth. The poor thing was but a little furball at the time, a russet, famished furball. I spent two months there, gorging him and myself on the fattest seafood our glacial waters can provide. Rainbow mussels and zhor beast were also on the menu when I could get my hands on them. It was a nice change of pace from all the rich fish steaks. My new proportions made quite an impression on my family, but it was for the best.”
rows.translation: “看到我心神不宁，我的埃西拉母亲让我南下，尽可能多捕些冷水鳕、冰山鳗和霜龙虾。大约就是那时候，我发现了古戈斯。当时这可怜的小家伙不过是个小毛球，一个赤褐色、饿得皮包骨头的小毛球。我在那里待了两个月，用冰川水域能提供的最肥美海鲜，把他和自己都喂得饱饱的。只要能弄到，彩虹贻贝和佐尔兽也会登上菜单。和那些油腻的鱼排相比，这算是很不错的口味变化。我的新体型给家人留下了相当深刻的印象，但这是最好的结果。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seeing my unease, my essyra mother told me to head south and fish as many coolcods, iceberg eels, and frost lobsters as possible. It was about that time I found Guggoth. The poor thing was but a little furball at the time, a russet, famished furball. I spent two months there, gorging him and myself on the fattest seafood our glacial waters can provide. Rainbow mussels and zhor beast were also on the menu when I could get my hands on them. It was a nice change of pace from all the rich fish steaks. My new proportions made quite an impression on my family, but it was for the best.”"

rows.original: “A few days later, we went to the yearly Irestead fair. I wanted to taste some honey candies but my sisters forcefully brought me with them to the ice ring. I was never good at skating, and that was before I bulked up. I fell off balance a couple of times. It really hurt, even with my extra softness. The third time was the charm, since the junior ice skating champion stopped my fall,” she says, turning her eyes on her spouse.
rows.translation: “几天后，我们去了伊尔斯泰德一年一度的集市。我本来想尝些蜂蜜糖，但姐妹们强行把我带去了冰场。我一直不擅长滑冰，那还是在我长胖之前。我有几次失去平衡摔倒了。即使身上多了层柔软的肉垫，摔起来还是很疼。不过事不过三，第三次摔倒时，青少年滑冰冠军接住了我，”她说着，把目光转向自己的妻子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“A few days later, we went to the yearly Irestead fair. I wanted to taste some honey candies but my sisters forcefully brought me with them to the ice ring. I was never good at skating, and that was before I bulked up. I fell off balance a couple of times. It really hurt, even with my extra softness. The third time was the charm, since the junior ice skating champion stopped my fall,” she says, turning her eyes on her spouse."

rows.original: Dahlia hugs her lover close. “That’s now how you spell your Goddess.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅紧紧抱住爱人。“你把‘女神’拼错了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia hugs her lover close. “That’s now how you spell your Goddess.”"

rows.original: “Dally, you filthy tease,” she shakily replies.
rows.translation: “达莉，你这个下流的坏蛋，”她颤声回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Dally, you filthy tease,” she shakily replies."

rows.original: Does she have pictures of her transformation?
rows.translation: 她有自己转变过程的照片吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDoes she have pictures of her transformation?"

rows.original: The plush vulpine hesitates for a couple of seconds then reaches for her holopad. After a couple of scrolls, her face sours. “This is who I used to be.”
rows.translation: 毛茸茸的狐族女子犹豫几秒，随后拿起全息平板。翻动几下后，她脸色阴沉下来。“这就是以前的我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe plush vulpine hesitates for a couple of seconds then reaches for her holopad. After a couple of scrolls, her face sours. “This is who I used to be.”"

rows.original: She didn’t lie, she had a bodybuilder’s physique: almost no breasts, a muscular back, washboard abs, biceps the size of quadriceps and a thraggen’s quadriceps. Heck, her past self could lift her current self without breaking a sweat!
rows.translation: 她没有说谎，那时的她有着健美运动员般的体格：胸部几乎一马平川，背部肌肉发达，腹肌像搓衣板一样分明，肱二头肌足有股四头肌那么粗，股四头肌则像斯拉根一样夸张。天哪，过去的她能不费吹灰之力地举起现在的自己！
rows.raw: "\n\nShe didn’t lie, she had a bodybuilder’s physique: almost no breasts, a muscular back, washboard abs, biceps the size of quadriceps and a thraggen’s quadriceps. Heck, her past self could lift her current self without breaking a sweat!"

rows.original: “I’m not gonna lie, I’m a bit envious of this version of you. These muscles look so firm, so strong, so powerful. I bet they tasted wonderful after an intense workout,” Dahlia salivates.
rows.translation: “说实话，我有点羡慕那时的你。这些肌肉看起来如此紧实、强壮、有力。我敢说，剧烈锻炼后舔起来一定妙极了，”达莉娅馋得直流口水。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not gonna lie, I’m a bit envious of this version of you. These muscles look so firm, so strong, so powerful. I bet they tasted wonderful after an intense workout,” Dahlia salivates."

rows.original: “They still do, they are just well-hidden beneath my choccy plumpness.”
rows.translation: “现在舔起来也一样，只是好好藏在我巧克力般甜美的丰腴之下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They still do, they are just well-hidden beneath my choccy plumpness.”"

rows.original: You see why they tied the knot. They are really cute together.
rows.translation: 你明白她们为什么会喜结连理了。她们在一起真的很可爱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou see why they tied the knot. They are really cute together."

rows.original: “I know, right? If it weren’t for Dally’s anat genes, we’d already be mommies now. She’s got such a big libido.”
rows.translation: “可不是吗？要不是达莉娅的安纳泰基因，我们现在早就当妈妈了。她的性欲可旺盛了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know, right? If it weren’t for Dally’s anat genes, we’d already be mommies now. She’s got such a big libido.”"

rows.original: The feathered chick shrugs. “I don’t think I’m ready to take care of a little one yet.”
rows.translation: 长着羽毛的姑娘耸了耸肩。“我觉得自己还没准备好照顾小孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe feathered chick shrugs. “I don’t think I’m ready to take care of a little one yet.”"

rows.original: “But your mother will be so thrilled to finally have a granddaughter. She was on the verge of tears at our wedding, when my niece called her auntie angel.”
rows.translation: “可你母亲终于能有个外孙女，一定会欣喜若狂。婚礼上，我侄女叫她天使阿姨时，她都快哭出来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But your mother will be so thrilled to finally have a granddaughter. She was on the verge of tears at our wedding, when my niece called her auntie angel.”"

rows.original: You can go if they need some intimacy.
rows.translation: 如果她们需要一些独处时间，你可以离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can go if they need some intimacy."

rows.original: “It won’t be necessary. What poor hosts would we be if we didn’t place our guests’ pleasure above ours? Is there anything my wife or I can offer you? Something to drink? Something to eat? A deep massage? A warm, fluffy blanket?”
rows.translation: “没必要。要是不把客人的快乐置于自己之上，我们岂不是成了糟糕的主人？我或我的妻子能为你提供些什么吗？喝的？吃的？深层按摩？温暖蓬松的毯子？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It won’t be necessary. What poor hosts would we be if we didn’t place our guests’ pleasure above ours? Is there anything my wife or I can offer you? Something to drink? Something to eat? A deep massage? A warm, fluffy blanket?”"

rows.original: You’ll think about it.
rows.translation: 你会考虑一下。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ll think about it."

rows.original: What do you need? A parka? Insulated underwear? A thermal pack? We’ve got lots of stuff we don’t use in reserve.
rows.translation: 你需要什么？一件派克大衣？保暖内衣？一个保温包？我们储备了很多用不上的东西。
rows.raw: "What do you need? A parka? Insulated underwear? A thermal pack? We’ve got lots of stuff we don’t use in reserve."

rows.original: Dahlia & Sloan
rows.translation: 达莉娅与斯隆
rows.raw: "Dahlia & Sloan"

rows.original: Magenta Needle
rows.raw: "Magenta Needle"

rows.original: DAHLIA_N_SLOAN_EATING_TIMES
rows.raw: "DAHLIA_N_SLOAN_EATING_TIMES"

rows.original: DahliaNSloanDindinCD
rows.raw: "DahliaNSloanDindinCD"

rows.original: DahliaNSloanDindinCD
rows.raw: "DahliaNSloanDindinCD"

rows.original: “I’d love to taste some of your cooking. I’m a little hungry and I could use something warm and hot before heading back outside.” Sloan frowns. “I-I don’t know. My cuisine is nothing special, really.” “Hon please, you make exquisite dishes. Now, get to work and make us a little feast for three. And before you ask, yes, that’s an order![silly| Any objections, Lady?]” Dahlia barks before placing a wet kiss on her spouse’s cheek. The plush essyra freezes for a couple of seconds. Cheeks red as a tomato, the large huntress slowly stands and heads to the reserve.
rows.translation: “我很想尝尝你做的饭。我有点饿了，而且在回到外面之前，正需要吃点暖和又热腾腾的东西。” 斯隆皱起眉头。“我——我不知道。我的厨艺真的没什么特别的。” “亲爱的，拜托，你做的菜精致极了。现在，动手给我们三个做顿小小的盛宴吧。没错，在你开口前我就告诉你，这是命令！[silly| 女士，有异议吗？]”达莉娅厉声说道，随后在妻子的脸颊上留下一个湿吻。 毛茸茸的埃西拉僵住了几秒。脸颊红得像番茄，高大的女猎手缓缓站起来，走向储藏室。
rows.raw: "“I’d love to taste some of your cooking. I’m a little hungry and I could use something warm and hot before heading back outside.” Sloan frowns. “I-I don’t know. My cuisine is nothing special, really.” “Hon please, you make exquisite dishes. Now, get to work and make us a little feast for three. And before you ask, yes, that’s an order![silly| Any objections, Lady?]” Dahlia barks before placing a wet kiss on her spouse’s cheek. The plush essyra freezes for a couple of seconds. Cheeks red as a tomato, the large huntress slowly stands and heads to the reserve."

rows.original: “I would like to eat some of your homemade cooking,” you say. “Your plates are so generous and so tasty.” Sloan blushes deeply. “T-Thank you. My cuisine is nothing to talk about so it means a lot to me.” “Hon, you could rival the best chefs on Uveto. Stop being so dismissive about your skills. Now, get up and make us your specialty,” Dahlia barks, shutting down her wife’s reply with a surprise kiss. “If it wasn’t clear, this is a direct order from your Goddess.[silly| Any objections, Lady?]” The plush essyra’s face turns crimson. She gives her wife a quick smooch before heading to the reserve.
rows.translation: “我想吃些你亲手做的饭菜，”你说道。“你做的菜分量十足，味道也好极了。” 斯隆满脸通红。“谢——谢谢你。我的厨艺实在不值一提，所以你这么说对我意义重大。” “亲爱的，你足以媲美乌维托最出色的厨师。别再这样贬低自己的本事了。现在，起来给我们做你的拿手菜，”达莉娅厉声说道，用一个突如其来的吻堵住妻子的回答。“要是还不够清楚，这可是你的女神直接下达的命令。[silly| 女士，有异议吗？]” 毛茸茸的埃西拉脸颊变得通红。她匆匆亲了妻子一下，便走向储藏室。

rows.original: She rummages through a couple of bags and crates, gathering a couple of meaty sausages and slabs of meat. Even from here, you can see them shine with fat. About a minute later, she comes back with a large platter filled with pickled vegetables, herbs, potatoes, and meats in one hand and a bottle branded with the Stormguard’s emblem - certainly some kind of mead or wine. She places her bounty on a table near the electric stove then arranges a pan and a large casserole on the induction plates. “Dahlia? [pc.name]? Can you please peel the potatoes and cut them into fries while the yak fat is heating?” she asks, turning the burners and fryer on. “Sure, hon. What’s on the menu?” The vulpine huntress puts on a large apron before dropping fat slabs of pickled fish into the casserole. “Boreal bream with pickled turnip and carrots, stewed in [silly|mirrorwine|ice grape wine] served on a bed of seal steak, smoked sausages, and fries. Nothing fancy,” she enumerates, casually slicing onions, mincing herbs, and seasoning her main dish. That sounds incredibly fancy for a dish she came up with a minute ago. You follow Dahlia to the cutting board and take a small knife.
rows.translation: 她在几个袋子和板条箱中翻找，收集了几根多肉香肠和几大块肉。即使隔着这段距离，你也能看见上面闪亮的油脂。大约一分钟后，她一手端着装满腌渍蔬菜、香草、土豆和肉类的大盘子，另一手拿着一瓶印有风暴卫士徽记的酒——肯定是某种蜂蜜酒或葡萄酒。她把战利品放到电炉旁的桌子上，然后在电磁炉灶上摆好一只平底锅和一口大炖锅。 “达莉娅？[pc.name]?牦牛油正在加热，你们能帮忙削土豆皮，再切成薯条吗？”她问道，同时打开炉灶和炸锅。 “当然，亲爱的。菜单上有什么？” 狐族女猎手穿上一条大围裙，随后把厚厚的腌鱼块放进炖锅。“北境鲷配腌芜菁和胡萝卜，用[silly|镜酒|冰葡萄酒]炖煮，铺在海豹排、烟熏香肠和薯条上。没什么特别的，”她一边列举，一边随手切洋葱、剁香草，并为主菜调味。 对于一道她一分钟前才想出来的菜，这听起来精致得不可思议。你跟着达莉娅走到砧板旁，拿起一把小刀。

rows.original: Briget and Vic made sure you’d know how to cook by yourself, so preparing potatoes for three is right up your alley. Dahlia, on the other hand, struggles to make regular cuts.
rows.translation: 布丽姬特和维克确保你学会了独自做饭，所以准备三个人份的土豆正是你的拿手好戏。反倒是达莉娅很难把土豆切得大小均匀。
rows.raw: " Briget and Vic made sure you’d know how to cook by yourself, so preparing potatoes for three is right up your alley. Dahlia, on the other hand, struggles to make regular cuts."

rows.original: Briget showed you how to prepare vegetables, but you are far from as good as she was. Fortunately, Dahlia also struggles with her potatoes.
rows.translation: 布丽姬特教过你如何处理蔬菜，但你的手艺远不如她。好在达莉娅处理土豆时也同样笨拙。
rows.raw: " Briget showed you how to prepare vegetables, but you are far from as good as she was. Fortunately, Dahlia also struggles with her potatoes."

rows.original: About halfway through, Sloan quickly checks on your work, smiles proudly, then goes to the stove.
rows.translation: 做到一半左右时，斯隆迅速检查了一下你的成果，自豪地笑了笑，随后走向炉灶。
rows.raw: " About halfway through, Sloan quickly checks on your work, smiles proudly, then goes to the stove."

rows.original: Next to you, the russet kor’diiak bear huffs the fumes. The tamed beast trots like a puppy toward his mistress and rubs his muzzle against Sloan’s side. Dahlia reaches for an extra fat slab of meat and waves it at Guggoth. “Come here, big boy.”
rows.translation: 在你身旁，赤褐色科迪亚克熊嗅着香气。这只驯服的野兽像小狗一样小跑到女主人身边，用口鼻蹭着斯隆的腰侧。达莉娅拿起另一块肥厚的肉，在古戈斯面前晃了晃。“过来，大男孩。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNext to you, the russet kor’diiak bear huffs the fumes. The tamed beast trots like a puppy toward his mistress and rubs his muzzle against Sloan’s side. Dahlia reaches for an extra fat slab of meat and waves it at Guggoth. “Come here, big boy.”"

rows.original: The fluffy animal slowly approaches the half-anat, a hungry light in his eyes. He sits next to her, resting his head on her lap. “Yes, you are my good boy. My big, fat boy. If you were a bit fatter, you’d make a delicious roast,” she teases, earning an angry groan from the russet ursine. “Hey! I was joking!”
rows.translation: 毛茸茸的动物慢慢走向半安纳泰女子，眼中闪着饥饿的光。他在她身边坐下，把头枕在她腿上。“没错，你是我的乖男孩。我的大胖男孩。要是再胖一点，你肯定能烤得非常美味，”她调侃道，引来赤褐色巨熊恼怒的低吼。“嘿！我开玩笑的！”

rows.original: Did they have kor’diiak meat in the past?
rows.translation: 她们以前吃过科迪亚克的肉吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDid they have kor’diiak meat in the past?"

rows.original: “Twice,” Sloan whispers. “It’s very sinewy so you need to marinate it for months for it to be edible, but it’s a refined meat fit for banquets and special events. I haven’t had any since I adopted Guggoth, though. It took me some time to train this big glutton... time and lots of seal steaks.”
rows.translation: “吃过两次，”斯隆轻声说道。“那种肉筋很多，要腌上几个月才能入口，但也是适合宴会和特殊活动的精致肉品。不过自从收养古戈斯以后，我就再没吃过。训练这个大馋鬼花了我不少时间...还有许许多多的海豹排。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Twice,” Sloan whispers. “It’s very sinewy so you need to marinate it for months for it to be edible, but it’s a refined meat fit for banquets and special events. I haven’t had any since I adopted Guggoth, though. It took me some time to train this big glutton... time and lots of seal steaks.”"

rows.original: Dahlia feeds the largest piece of meat to the alien bear. With his prize in mouth, Guggoth returns to his comfy pile of pillows to savor his dish. Meanwhile, Sloan recovers the fries and plunges them into the hot fryer before putting the remaining steaks and some thinly-cut sausages into the pan. “I’ll take it from here. Can you please set the table? It’ll be ready in five minutes.”
rows.translation: 达莉娅把最大的一块肉喂给外星巨熊。古戈斯叼着自己的奖品，回到舒适的枕头堆里享用美食。与此同时，斯隆收起薯条，将它们倒进滚烫的炸锅，然后把剩余的肉排和一些切成薄片的香肠放进平底锅。“接下来交给我。你们能摆一下餐桌吗？五分钟后就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDahlia feeds the largest piece of meat to the alien bear. With his prize in mouth, Guggoth returns to his comfy pile of pillows to savor his dish. Meanwhile, Sloan recovers the fries and plunges them into the hot fryer before putting the remaining steaks and some thinly-cut sausages into the pan. “I’ll take it from here. Can you please set the table? It’ll be ready in five minutes.”"

rows.original: You follow the half-anat back to the couch. She serves you a warm mug of herbal tea then recovers three sets of plates and cutlery. The plates are very wide, big enough to fit one of Guggoth’s steaks! They didn’t lie about making you a small feast. Minutes later, Sloan moves the fuming pots on the table and a basket filled with golden fries. She places a large slab of seal meat on your plate, lines it with sausage bits, adds a large ladle of stewed bream, turnip, and carrots on top with lots of sauce, and fills the rest of the plate with potatoes. The smell alone is gorgeous. You can’t wait to dig in!
rows.translation: 你跟着半安纳泰女子回到沙发旁。她为你倒了一杯热乎乎的花草茶，然后取出三套餐盘和餐具。那些盘子非常宽大，大得足以放下一整块古戈斯的肉排！看来她们说要为你做一顿小小的盛宴并不是夸张。几分钟后，斯隆把冒着热气的锅端上桌，又端来一篮金黄色的薯条。她在你的盘中放下一大块海豹肉，周围铺上香肠块，再舀一大勺炖鲷鱼、芜菁和胡萝卜盖在上面，淋上许多酱汁，最后用土豆填满盘子剩余的空间。光是香味就美妙至极。你迫不及待想大快朵颐！

She places a large slab of seal meat on your plate, lines it with sausage bits, adds a large ladle of stewed bream, turnip, and carrots on top with lots of sauce, and fills the rest of the plate with potatoes. The smell alone is gorgeous. You can’t wait to dig in!"

rows.original: Dahlia cocks an eyebrow when she receives her plate. “Love? Why aren’t my veggies cut into little hearts?” “Because it’s a quick recipe. If I knew we’d have a guest, I’d have stewed it for two hours and put more effort into it,” the huntress pouts. You decide to taste her cooking while they’re play-bickering. You blow a couple of times to cool it down before taking a bite of steak with sauce. Surprisingly, the chunky slabs of meat melt like butter on your tongue. Dahlia didn’t lie: Sloan’s cuisine is delicious. The pickled meat and fish shouldn’t go well together, but the sauce corrects the excess saltiness perfectly. The carrots and turnip help deal with the richness of the meat. Dahlia makes a small skewer with seal, sausage slices, and bream to experience all the flavors in one go. Conversely, Sloan eats very slowly, taking one bite after the other. She accompanies each piece of meat with either vegetables or fries, maybe to get the most of each bite. “[silly|Wotan’s beard|Stars], it’s so gooood!” the bird lady says. She’s right. The seasoning and sauce really bring the best out of each ingredient. Maybe mashed potatoes or wedges would be better than fries though? “Good point. A little volcano made out of mashed potato filled with stew, with sausage slices here and there could be fun. A shame I was short on time and low on milk,” the essyra shyly comments. The more you eat, the more you want to savor. There’s so many ways to mix the veggies, potatoes, and meat: seal with bream, seal with bream and sausage, sausage and fries in sauce, fries and seal without sauce, and so on. By the time you are done experimenting, there’s only a handful of fries left on your plate to sip in the leftover sauce. You were so hungry you didn’t even realize you ate a bear-sized portion! Your stomach feels so full and warm. Dahlia reluctantly chews the vegetables left on her plate, drinking fuming tea between each mouthful to wash the taste away. Someone’s a little picky. Feeling merciful, Sloan takes the last carrot slices from her spouse’s plate and trades sausage bits with her. “I appreciate your efforts, hon. You almost made it this time,” the plush essyra teases. “I tried really hard this time,” she sighs. What’s with her and vegetables? “Dahlia hates them, all of them. Back when she was a kid, she gave them to her little brother when her mom wasn’t looking. It took me years, but now she can almost finish her plate,” she proudly boasts. The half-anat frowns. “I hope, for your sake, that you didn’t lie about your gryvain mom’s extra large pizzas.” “I never lie when food is involved,” Sloan replies, rubbing her plump belly. “Can I serve you again, [pc.name]? Or maybe you want a dessert?” No, you think you had enough. The vulpine smiles and quietly takes the last handful of potatoes. A minute later, she gathers your emptied plates and puts them into a small washing machine. The herbal tea helps digest the rich food, but you feel bloated and warm nonetheless. “We can help you burn some extra calories if you want,” the bird lady proposes. Sloan sighs. “Dally, you are insatiable.” It’s not a bad idea. You could graciously thank the cook for this meal now that you think about it. You can make some room for chocolate pudding.
rows.translation: 达莉娅接过自己的盘子时挑起一边眉毛。“亲爱的？为什么我的蔬菜没有切成小爱心？” “因为这是道快手菜。要是早知道会有客人，我就会炖上两个小时，再多花些心思，”女猎手撅起嘴。 趁她们嬉闹着拌嘴，你决定尝尝她的手艺。你吹了几下，让食物凉一些，随后咬下一口裹着酱汁的肉排。出人意料的是，厚实的肉块入口即化。达莉娅没有说谎：斯隆的厨艺非常出色。腌肉和腌鱼本不该搭配得如此融洽，但酱汁恰到好处地中和了过重的咸味。胡萝卜和芜菁则缓解了肉类的油腻。达莉娅用海豹肉、香肠片和鲷鱼做成一小串，一口尝遍所有风味。斯隆则相反，她吃得很慢，一口接着一口。每块肉都会搭配蔬菜或薯条，也许是为了让每一口都物尽其味。 “[silly|沃坦的胡子啊|群星在上]，太好吃了！”鸟族女子说道。 她说得没错。调味和酱汁确实把每种食材的优点都发挥得淋漓尽致。不过，比起薯条，土豆泥或薯角也许会更合适？ “说得好。用土豆泥堆一座小火山，里面填满炖菜，再到处点缀些香肠片，应该会很有趣。可惜时间太紧，牛奶也不够了，”埃西拉羞涩地评论道。 你越吃，越想细细品味。蔬菜、土豆和肉能有太多种组合：海豹肉配鲷鱼，海豹肉配鲷鱼和香肠，香肠和薯条蘸酱汁，薯条和海豹肉不蘸酱汁，诸如此类。等你尝试完各种组合时，盘中只剩下一小把薯条，可以蘸着剩余的酱汁吃掉。 你饿得甚至没意识到，自己竟吃掉了一份熊那么大的餐食！你的肚子感觉饱满又温暖。达莉娅不情不愿地嚼着盘中剩下的蔬菜，每咽下一口，都会喝一口冒着热气的茶冲淡味道。看来某人有点挑食。斯隆大发慈悲，从妻子的盘中取走最后几片胡萝卜，拿香肠块与她交换。 “我很欣赏你的努力，亲爱的。这次你差一点就成功了，”毛茸茸的埃西拉调侃道。 “这次我真的很努力了，”她叹道。 她和蔬菜到底有什么仇？ “达莉娅讨厌蔬菜，所有蔬菜都讨厌。小时候，她会趁妈妈不注意，把蔬菜塞给弟弟。我花了好几年时间，但现在她已经几乎能吃完一整盘了，”她骄傲地夸耀道。 半安纳泰女子皱起眉头。“为了你自己好，我希望你没在格里文妈妈做的超大号披萨这件事上撒谎。” “只要涉及食物，我从不撒谎，”斯隆揉着自己丰满的肚子回答。“[pc.name]，要我再给你盛一份吗？还是你想吃甜点？” 不了，你觉得自己已经吃够了。狐族女子笑了笑，安静地拿走最后一把土豆。一分钟后，她收走你们吃空的盘子，放进一台小型洗碗机。花草茶有助于消化这些油腻食物，但你仍感到腹胀而温暖。 “如果你愿意，我们可以帮你燃烧一些额外的热量，”鸟族女子提议。 斯隆叹了口气。“达莉，你真是欲壑难填。” 这主意并不坏。仔细想来，你现在可以好好感谢厨师准备了这顿饭。你还能为巧克力布丁腾出些空间。

rows.original: That’s good to hear, actions can speak much louder than words sometimes. Glad you two could become friendly
rows.translation: 听到这个消息真好，有时行动比言语响亮得多。很高兴你们能友好相处

rows.original: Still, it’s pleasant to hear he keeps in touch with some of the korgs he’s helped along the way.
rows.translation: 不过，听说他仍和一路帮助过的一些科尔格人保持联系，还是令人愉快。

rows.original: The hold isn’t all that big, so it’s not too hard to see people. Still, it’s nice to talk with them every so often
rows.translation: 堡垒并不大，所以见到别人并不难。不过偶尔和他们聊聊天仍然很好

rows.raw: "Is small hold so not too hard. Still, is nice to see again and talk"

rows.raw: ".” Again, he’s lost in thought, eyes darting back and forth as he’s lost in thought. A gentle smirk settles on his face."

rows.original: You tell him you’re glad his fellow hunters and scavengers have someone looking after them. It can be a real frozen hell hole out there.
rows.translation: 你告诉他，很高兴他的猎人与拾荒者同伴有人照看。外面有时真像冰封地狱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell him you’re glad his fellow hunters and scavengers have someone looking after them. It can be a real frozen hell hole out there."

rows.original: Yeah, but it’s just me. Most others are too scared of the milodan to try. Can’t blame them
rows.translation: 是啊，但只有我。大多数人太害怕米洛丹人，不敢尝试。不能责怪他们
rows.raw: "Yeah, but it’s just me. Most others are too scared of the milodan to try. Can’t blame them"

rows.original: Yes, but just me. Most too scared of catdogs. No blame them
rows.translation: 是，但只有我。大多数太怕猫狗。不能怪他们
rows.raw: "Yes, but just me. Most too scared of catdogs. No blame them"

rows.original: ...” His ears droop a little as he admits his fear, and he looks away for a moment.
rows.translation: ...”他承认自己的恐惧时，耳朵稍稍垂下，目光也短暂移开。
rows.raw: "...” His ears droop a little as he admits his fear, and he looks away for a moment."

rows.original: You try to reassure him,

rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to reassure him,"

rows.original: insisting that he’s doing what he can for his people.
rows.translation: 坚持说他已经在为族人尽己所能。
rows.raw: " insisting that he’s doing what he can for his people."

rows.original: His smile returns at that. <i>“
rows.translation: 他的笑容因此重新浮现。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nHis smile returns at that. <i>“"

rows.original: I also rescue those who pass out in the cold. We may be born here, but it still claims many young Korgs
rows.translation: 我也会救回那些冻晕过去的人。我们也许出生在这里，但寒冷仍会夺走许多年轻科尔格人的生命
rows.raw: "I also rescue those who pass out in the cold. We may be born here, but it still claims many young Korgs"

rows.original: Also bring back korgs who fall to cold when they out too long. We born here but cold still take many young Korg
rows.translation: 也带回在外太久被冻倒的科尔格。我们生在这里，但寒冷仍带走许多年轻科尔格
rows.raw: "Also bring back korgs who fall to cold when they out too long. We born here but cold still take many young Korg"

rows.translation: 。”他望向你。“

rows.raw: "Keeping eye"

rows.original: on you now.”
rows.raw: " on you now.”"

rows.raw: "You ask him if he has any family in the hold, maybe even a mate."

rows.original: “Hm,” he takes a moment to stop fiddling with his bow, placing it on the table before continuing, “
rows.translation: “嗯，”他停下摆弄长弓，把它放到桌上，随后继续道，“
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm,” he takes a moment to stop fiddling with his bow, placing it on the table before continuing, “"

rows.original: I had a mate, but she passed away a few years back
rows.translation: 我曾有过一位伴侣，但她几年前去世了
rows.raw: "I had a mate, but she passed away a few years back"

rows.original: Had mate, she take long sleep time ago
rows.translation: 有过伴侣，她很久前长眠了
rows.raw: "Had mate, she take long sleep time ago"

rows.original: ...” Dreghan pauses to hold the savicite necklace he wears. You wonder if she gave it to him, or maybe if it was hers.
rows.translation: ...”德雷甘停下来，握住佩戴的萨维石项链。你不禁猜想，那是她送给他的，还是原本就属于她。
rows.raw: "...” Dreghan pauses to hold the savicite necklace he wears. You wonder if she gave it to him, or maybe if it was hers."

rows.translation: 你向他表示哀悼，随后轻声问他有没有孩子。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give him your condolences, then gently ask if he has any kids."

rows.original: We had two pups: a boy and a girl

rows.raw: ".” He smiles as he reminisces about them. “"

rows.translation: 我们的儿子很像我，成了一名猎人。他不像我这么魁梧，但动作很快。他很固执，也不喜欢异星人...你探索时也许被他袭击过。
rows.raw: "Our son took after me and became a hunter. He’s not big like me but he’s quick. He’s stubborn, and doesn’t like aliens... maybe he’s attacked you while exploring."

rows.original: Son take after me and become hunter. Not big like me but quick. He stubborn, no like aliens... maybe he attack you while exploring.

rows.translation: 希望你还没有碰到他。那么他的女儿呢？

rows.raw: "She takes after her mother as a priestess of the Great Forge"

rows.raw: "She take after mom, priestess of Great Forge"

rows.translation: 。”他的表情稍稍阴沉。“总是那么忙...
rows.raw: ".” His expression sours ever so slightly. “Always so busy..."

rows.original: never takes any time for herself, I barely ever see her... she’s happy, and that’s all that matters to me
rows.translation: 从来不留时间给自己，我几乎见不到她...她很幸福，这就是对我最重要的事

rows.translation: 尽管他心有不舍，听到他为女儿感到高兴仍令人欣慰。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite his misgivings, it’s nice to hear that he’s happy for her."

rows.raw: "\n\nDreghan leans back, stopping his work as he glances around the room. <i>“"

rows.translation: 我怀念为他们唱摇篮曲。那是生活中令人愉快的休憩
rows.raw: "I miss singing lullabies to them. It was a nice break from life"

rows.translation: 没人愿意和我在一起。总是匆匆交配一次，然后她们便离开

rows.original: You’re sure if he keeps getting himself out there he’ll eventually find someone.
rows.translation: 你相信，只要他继续主动寻找，迟早会遇到某个人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re sure if he keeps getting himself out there he’ll eventually find someone."

rows.raw: "Thanks"

rows.raw: "Much thanking"

rows.translation: 随后，沉默充满房间。也许你可以告诉他，自己也愿意玩玩，或者换个话题。

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家人
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: You coyly suggest that, possibly, a friendly, willing alien could offer him some intimate friendship.
rows.translation: 你含蓄地暗示，也许某个友好而自愿的异星人可以为他提供一些亲密友谊。

rows.original: He raises an eyebrow at that, clearly surprised by the offer, before saying, “Maybe.” He quickly gets back to work on his bow, but there’s a faint smile on his face, and his tail is wagging happily behind him.
rows.translation: 他闻言挑起眉毛，显然对这个提议颇感意外，随后说道：“也许吧。”他很快重新低头保养长弓，不过脸上带着淡淡笑容，尾巴也在身后开心摆动。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe raises an eyebrow at that, clearly surprised by the offer, before saying, “Maybe.” He quickly gets back to work on his bow, but there’s a faint smile on his face, and his tail is wagging happily behind him."

rows.original: Perhaps you have a chance with this burly korg!
rows.translation: 也许你有机会赢得这个魁梧科尔格的青睐！
rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps you have a chance with this burly korg!"

rows.original: You decide to ask him about his bow. He’s been fiddling with it this entire time, it must be special to him.
rows.translation: 你决定问问他的长弓。他一直在摆弄它，这东西对他一定很特别。
rows.raw: "You decide to ask him about his bow. He’s been fiddling with it this entire time, it must be special to him."

rows.translation: 这是铁匠图瓦送的礼物

rows.raw: "Is gift from korg blacksmith, Tuuva"

rows.raw: ".” He mutters as he continues his careful work, “"

rows.original: She does good work, makes great weapons for our hunters and warriors
rows.translation: 她手艺很好，为我们的猎人与战士打造出色武器

rows.original: Does good work, make gooding weapons for hunters and warriors
rows.translation: 手艺好，为猎人和战士造很好的武器
rows.raw: "Does good work, make gooding weapons for hunters and warriors"

rows.original: It’s nice that the hold has a capable blacksmith
rows.translation: 堡垒里有位能干的铁匠真不错

rows.translation: 帮助一位有需要的朋友
rows.raw: "Helping a friend in need"

rows.original: Much helpings of a friend

rows.raw: "Much helpings of a friend"

rows.original: I’m not telling you anything
rows.translation: 我什么都不会告诉你

rows.translation: 德雷甘不说秘密
rows.raw: "Dreghan no telling of secrets"

rows.translation: 他思考片刻，随后继续道：<i>“

rows.translation: 你继续与高大的科尔格依偎，他把你的手带到胸膛，正正放在心口。手心感受到令人安心而有节奏的跳动；那颗强壮心脏每搏动一下，你就把他拉近一点。他毫不抗拒，只是满足地接受你有力的拥抱，而你最喜欢的正是这样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou continue spooning with the big korg as he brings your hand to his chest, placing it right over his heart. You feel the soothing, rhythmic beats in your hand, pulling him just a little bit closer with each thump of his strong heart. He offers no resistance, only content acceptance of your strong grip, and you wouldn’t want it any other way."

rows.original: It’s nice to take it slow every now and then; to take a break from the hectic life of the Rush and just hold someone close. The worries of the world fade away under the sheets, the close contact lulling you. It makes you smile sleepily, happy that you took the chance to snuggle with him.
rows.translation: 偶尔放慢脚步也很不错；从星球淘金热的忙乱生活中暂歇，只把某个人紧紧抱在怀里。世界的烦恼在床单下渐渐远去，亲密接触哄你入眠。你困倦地微笑起来，很高兴自己抓住机会与他依偎。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s nice to take it slow every now and then; to take a break from the hectic life of the Rush and just hold someone close. The worries of the world fade away under the sheets, the close contact lulling you. It makes you smile sleepily, happy that you took the chance to snuggle with him."

rows.original: Your thoughts wander, come slower, as sleep creeps over you.
rows.translation: 思绪逐渐飘远、放缓，睡意悄然将你笼罩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour thoughts wander, come slower, as sleep creeps over you. "

rows.original: The large korgonne holds you close
rows.translation: 高大的科尔贡人把你紧紧抱住
rows.raw: "The large korgonne holds you close"

rows.original: You hold your korgonne lover close to your heart
rows.translation: 你把科尔贡恋人紧紧抱在胸前
rows.raw: "You hold your korgonne lover close to your heart"

rows.original: as consciousness passes into untroubled slumber.
rows.translation: ，意识随即沉入无忧的梦乡。
rows.raw: " as consciousness passes into untroubled slumber."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You awaken slowly, still wrapped in the warmth of the sheets of Dreghan’s bed. The bed seems much larger this morning, and it takes you a moment to realize that you’re not entwined with your beefy lover. As you search around, searching for the furry man you spent the night with, you, your [pc.eyes] snap open to confirm what your hand already told you: you’re in bed alone. The bed is empty but for you, the covers wrapped around you to keep you warm. You sit up and notice your [pc.gear] has been collected from the foot of the bed, now resting on the nearby nightstand. Atop the stack is a bundle of primitive gauze with some string keeping it compact; how sweet!
rows.translation: 你缓缓醒来，仍被德雷甘床铺上温暖的床单包裹。今早这张床似乎大了许多，你花了一会儿才意识到自己并未与魁梧恋人缠在一起。你四处摸索，寻找共度一夜的毛茸茸男人；[pc.eyes]猛地睁开，确认手掌已经告诉你的事实：床上只有你一个人。除你以外，床铺空空荡荡，只有被子裹在身上为你保暖。你坐起身，注意到床脚的[pc.gear]已被收拢，如今放在旁边的床头柜上。整齐堆放的装备顶端还有一卷用线扎紧的原始纱布；真贴心！
rows.raw: "You awaken slowly, still wrapped in the warmth of the sheets of Dreghan’s bed. The bed seems much larger this morning, and it takes you a moment to realize that you’re not entwined with your beefy lover. As you search around, searching for the furry man you spent the night with, you, your [pc.eyes] snap open to confirm what your hand already told you: you’re in bed alone. The bed is empty but for you, the covers wrapped around you to keep you warm. You sit up and notice your [pc.gear] has been collected from the foot of the bed, now resting on the nearby nightstand. Atop the stack is a bundle of primitive gauze with some string keeping it compact; how sweet!"

rows.original: You take a moment to collect yourself, stretching in bed, blinking away the weight of sleep on your eyes. Eventually, you crawl out of your warm cocoon and don your equipment before ducking under the curtain and back into Dreghan’s main room. As you clear the cloth covered doorway, you spot him sitting - naked, as usual - at his usual spot, but unusually he’s not fiddling with his bow. Instead, he’s inspecting his necklace, checking the string. The hunter quickly finishes his inspection, attaching the cord around his neck once more. He looks at the table in front of him, at his bow, but he seems lost, not sure what to do next.
rows.translation: 你花片刻整理状态，在床上伸展身体，眨去眼中沉重的睡意。最终，你爬出温暖的茧，穿戴好装备，钻过帘子回到德雷甘的主室。走出布帘遮盖的门口时，你看见他像往常一样赤裸地坐在惯常的位置，但反常的是，他并没有摆弄长弓，而是在检查项链，查看绳线。猎人很快结束检查，重新把绳索系在颈间。他看向面前桌上的长弓，却显得茫然，不知道接下来该做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to collect yourself, stretching in bed, blinking away the weight of sleep on your eyes. Eventually, you crawl out of your warm cocoon and don your equipment before ducking under the curtain and back into Dreghan’s main room. As you clear the cloth covered doorway, you spot him sitting - naked, as usual - at his usual spot, but unusually he’s not fiddling with his bow. Instead, he’s inspecting his necklace, checking the string. The hunter quickly finishes his inspection, attaching the cord around his neck once more. He looks at the table in front of him, at his bow, but he seems lost, not sure what to do next."

rows.original: You fake a cough to get his attention.
rows.translation: 你假咳一声，引起他的注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou fake a cough to get his attention."

rows.original: He turns to face you, a bright smile on his doggy snout, <i>“[pc.name],
rows.translation: 他转身面向你，狗狗般的口鼻上绽开灿烂笑容，<i>“[pc.name]，
rows.raw: "\n\nHe turns to face you, a bright smile on his doggy snout, <i>“[pc.name], "

rows.original: it’s about time
rows.translation: 你总算起来了
rows.raw: "it’s about time"

rows.original: about timing
rows.translation: 时间到了
rows.raw: "about timing"

rows.original: You can already see his tail wagging in excitement,
rows.translation: 你已经能看到他的尾巴兴奋地摇来摇去，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can already see his tail wagging in excitement, "

rows.original: making you wonder if he has something planned for the morning
rows.translation: 让你不禁猜想，他是不是为这个早晨安排了什么
rows.raw: "making you wonder if he has something planned for the morning"

rows.original: and you have a pretty good idea why
rows.translation: ，而且你很清楚原因是什么
rows.raw: " and you have a pretty good idea why"

rows.original: . You’re glad he’s happy to see you the morning after.
rows.translation: 。你很高兴共度一夜后的早晨，他见到你会如此开心。
rows.raw: ". You’re glad he’s happy to see you the morning after."
