korgiTranslate()
                ? "I have a gift for you"
                : "Having gift for you"

rows.original: I have a gift for you
rows.translation: 我有件礼物要送给你
rows.raw: "I have a gift for you"

rows.original: Having gift for you
rows.translation: 有礼物给你
rows.raw: "Having gift for you"

rows.original: ,” he stands up from his seat and starts to head for the door, then gestures for you to follow, “
rows.translation: 。”他从座位上站起身，朝门口走去，随后示意你跟上，“
rows.raw: ",” he stands up from his seat and starts to head for the door, then gestures for you to follow, “"

rows.original: I wanted to give something back for last night, come on
rows.translation: 昨晚承蒙照顾，我想回报你一些东西，来吧
rows.raw: "I wanted to give something back for last night, come on"

rows.original: wanting to give back for holdy - warms, come, come
rows.translation: 想回报抱抱取暖，来，来
rows.raw: "wanting to give back for holdy - warms, come, come"

rows.original: His excitement is infectious, and you follow him out the door of his home, ending up deeper in the Hold than you’re usually allowed to wander. The two of you eventually come to a room filled with a number of korgs eating a breakfast meal. A dining hall, you surmise. A few of the Korg’ii give you odd looks, some don’t even look up at your entrance, and a handful seem happy to see you, or at least a new face.
rows.translation: 他的兴奋很有感染力，你跟着他走出家门，来到据点深处，远超你平常获准活动的范围。最终，你们来到一个房间，里面有许多正在吃早餐的科尔格。你推测这里是餐厅。几个科尔吉人向你投来古怪目光，有些人甚至没有因你的到来而抬头，还有少数似乎很高兴见到你，或者至少很高兴看到一张新面孔。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis excitement is infectious, and you follow him out the door of his home, ending up deeper in the Hold than you’re usually allowed to wander. The two of you eventually come to a room filled with a number of korgs eating a breakfast meal. A dining hall, you surmise. A few of the Korg’ii give you odd looks, some don’t even look up at your entrance, and a handful seem happy to see you, or at least a new face."

rows.original: You spot a few familiar faces in the crowd, but they don’t seem to notice you.
rows.translation: 你在人群中发现几张熟悉面孔，但他们似乎没有注意到你。
rows.raw: " You spot a few familiar faces in the crowd, but they don’t seem to notice you."

rows.original: Dreghan spots some open seats by what looks almost like a bar, the counter looking over a gaggle of korgs of various sizes, shapes and breeds, all of them busy cooking large batches of food for their hungry tribe. A mix of smells, some enticing, some intriguing, assail your nose as you draw closer to the bar. You watch them season an unfamiliar species of egg, hear the sizzle of slabs of thick meat cooking in hissing, spitting fat, while odd-looking tubers and plants are cut up and thrown together in huge pots. The smells, exotic, foreign and odoriferous, set your mouth watering in hunger.
rows.translation: 德雷甘在一处近似吧台的地方发现了几个空位。柜台另一侧，一群体型、外貌和品种各异的科尔格正忙着为饥饿的部族烹制大批食物。你靠近吧台时，各种气味扑鼻而来，有些诱人，有些则引人好奇。你看着他们给某种陌生生物的蛋调味；厚肉片在嘶嘶作响、四处飞溅的油脂中煎烤，声音传入耳中；外形古怪的块茎和植物则被切碎，混在一起丢进巨锅。这些充满异域气息、陌生又浓郁的香味让你馋得直流口水。
rows.raw: "\n\nDreghan spots some open seats by what looks almost like a bar, the counter looking over a gaggle of korgs of various sizes, shapes and breeds, all of them busy cooking large batches of food for their hungry tribe. A mix of smells, some enticing, some intriguing, assail your nose as you draw closer to the bar. You watch them season an unfamiliar species of egg, hear the sizzle of slabs of thick meat cooking in hissing, spitting fat, while odd-looking tubers and plants are cut up and thrown together in huge pots. The smells, exotic, foreign and odoriferous, set your mouth watering in hunger."

rows.original: You take your seat and get comfy as you wonder if you’re supposed to order food or-
rows.translation: 你坐下来调整到舒服姿势，心想是不是该点餐了，还是-
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your seat and get comfy as you wonder if you’re supposed to order food or-"

rows.original: Wait here, I’ll go cook you something up
rows.translation: 在这里等着，我去给你做点吃的
rows.raw: "Wait here, I’ll go cook you something up"

rows.original: Waiting here, I go cook
rows.translation: 这里等，我去做饭
rows.raw: "Waiting here, I go cook"

rows.original: Wait, he can cook?
rows.translation: 等等，他还会做饭？
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, he can cook?"

rows.original: Without further ado, Dreghan sets off into the kitchen area, grabbing a well-used, patchwork apron that just barely fits him. You take the opportunity to enjoy the wondrous view of his perfectly sculpted ass as he sets about making you both breakfast. The hustle and bustle of the kitchen and dining room seems to fade away as you focus your attention on him. You believe he’s preparing eggs and bacon
rows.translation: 德雷甘不再多说，径直走进厨房区域，拿起一条饱经使用、满是补丁而且几乎套不上他的围裙。趁他开始为你们俩准备早餐，你欣赏起他那雕塑般完美臀部的绝妙景致。你把注意力集中在他身上，厨房和餐厅的喧嚣似乎渐渐远去。你觉得他正在准备鸡蛋和培根
rows.raw: "\n\nWithout further ado, Dreghan sets off into the kitchen area, grabbing a well-used, patchwork apron that just barely fits him. You take the opportunity to enjoy the wondrous view of his perfectly sculpted ass as he sets about making you both breakfast. The hustle and bustle of the kitchen and dining room seems to fade away as you focus your attention on him. You believe he’s preparing eggs and bacon"

rows.original: , though you’ve never seen
rows.translation: ，尽管你以前从没见过
rows.raw: ", though you’ve never seen "

rows.original: green
rows.translation: 绿色
rows.raw: "green"

rows.original: blue
rows.translation: 蓝色
rows.raw: "blue"

rows.original: eggs before.
rows.translation: 的蛋。
rows.raw: " eggs before."

rows.original: , clearly spotting the
rows.translation: ，显然认出了
rows.raw: ", clearly spotting the "

rows.original: green
rows.translation: 绿色
rows.raw: "green"

rows.original: blue
rows.translation: 蓝色
rows.raw: "blue"

rows.original: eggs he used last time. They must be a staple around here.
rows.translation: 的蛋，和他上次用的一样。这一定是当地的主食。
rows.raw: " eggs he used last time. They must be a staple around here."

rows.original: You don’t bother to hide your ogling of his butt, watching it tense and relax, his tail wagging happily as he prepares your meal. You’re so caught up in the impromptu show that you almost miss his stunning cooking show, your attention drawn away by his skilled flip of the bacon in the skillet, the eggs sizzling in another pan that he watches carefully.
rows.translation: 你毫不掩饰地盯着他的屁股，看它时而绷紧、时而放松，而他准备餐点时，尾巴也开心地摇摆。你太沉迷这场即兴演出了，差点错过同样精彩的厨艺展示；直到他熟练地把平底锅中的培根翻面，你的注意力才被拉开。他还仔细照看着另一口锅中滋滋作响的鸡蛋。
rows.raw: " You don’t bother to hide your ogling of his butt, watching it tense and relax, his tail wagging happily as he prepares your meal. You’re so caught up in the impromptu show that you almost miss his stunning cooking show, your attention drawn away by his skilled flip of the bacon in the skillet, the eggs sizzling in another pan that he watches carefully."

rows.original: His hips sway as he cooks, swinging left to season the crisping bacon, right to check and flip the eggs, back and forth. His shoulders move with a definite grace, his arms working with practiced ease, as he switches from one task to the next. Every so often, he looks over his shoulder to make sure that you’re still enraptured with the view, giving you a toothy grin when he sees you watching. The smell of freshly, expertly cooked food wafts towards you, and you’re quickly trying to suppress a sharp pang of hunger, betrayed by the loud growls of your stomach.
rows.translation: 他一边烹饪，一边摆动髋部，向左晃去给逐渐变脆的培根调味，再向右检查鸡蛋并翻面，如此来来回回。他的肩膀带着明确的优雅韵律，双臂凭借熟练动作轻松工作，在一项项任务间切换。每隔一会儿，他都会回头确认你是否仍沉醉于眼前景色；发现你在观看，便露出满口牙齿的笑容。新鲜食物经过精湛烹调散发出的香气向你飘来，你赶紧压下突如其来的强烈饥饿感，肚子却响亮地咕咕作响，把你彻底出卖。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis hips sway as he cooks, swinging left to season the crisping bacon, right to check and flip the eggs, back and forth. His shoulders move with a definite grace, his arms working with practiced ease, as he switches from one task to the next. Every so often, he looks over his shoulder to make sure that you’re still enraptured with the view, giving you a toothy grin when he sees you watching. The smell of freshly, expertly cooked food wafts towards you, and you’re quickly trying to suppress a sharp pang of hunger, betrayed by the loud growls of your stomach."

rows.original: None too soon, he turns around, pulling your gaze from his rear end to the two stoneware dishes in his hands. Each is filled to the brim with delicious smelling food,
rows.translation: 来得正是时候，他转过身，把你的视线从臀部引向手中的两个炻器盘子。每只盘子都装满了香气诱人的食物，
rows.raw: "\n\nNone too soon, he turns around, pulling your gaze from his rear end to the two stoneware dishes in his hands. Each is filled to the brim with delicious smelling food, "

rows.original: clearly resembling eggs and bacon, even if the ingredients are so unfamiliar to your palate
rows.translation: 尽管食材对你的味蕾而言如此陌生，但显然很像鸡蛋和培根
rows.raw: "clearly resembling eggs and bacon, even if the ingredients are so unfamiliar to your palate"

rows.original: the Uvetan version of eggs and bacon
rows.translation: 这是乌维托版本的鸡蛋与培根
rows.raw: "the Uvetan version of eggs and bacon"

rows.original: . Dreghan shuffles up to the bar, pulling up a seat across from you, thankfully out of the way of the rest of the kitchen staff.
rows.translation: 。德雷甘拖着步子来到吧台，在你对面拉开座位，所幸没有挡住其他厨房人员。
rows.raw: ". Dreghan shuffles up to the bar, pulling up a seat across from you, thankfully out of the way of the rest of the kitchen staff."

rows.original: He pats down his apron and puts a plate in front of you, <i>“
rows.translation: 他拍了拍围裙，把一只盘子放在你面前，<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nHe pats down his apron and puts a plate in front of you, <i>“"

rows.original: Dig in, you don’t want to spend all day in here, do you
rows.translation: 快吃吧，你不想一整天都耗在这里，对吧
rows.raw: "Dig in, you don’t want to spend all day in here, do you"

rows.original: Eat eat, no wanting to spend day here, no
rows.translation: 吃，吃，不想整天待这里，不想
rows.raw: "Eat eat, no wanting to spend day here, no"

rows.original: Needing no further encouragement, the two of you dig in. You find yourself surprised by Dreghan’s skillful cooking. The bacon is a bit gamey but is seasoned to deliciousness and perfectly crispy. The eggs are scrambled and fluffy, the taste surprisingly savory. He can’t help but smile as he watches you eat the yummy food quickly, clearly pleased that you’re enjoying the fruits of his efforts.
rows.translation: 无需更多鼓励，你们俩便大吃起来。德雷甘精湛的厨艺令你惊讶。培根略带野味，却调味得美味无比，而且酥脆得恰到好处。鸡蛋炒得蓬松绵软，滋味出乎意料地鲜美。他看着你迅速吃下可口食物，忍不住露出笑容；看到你享受自己的劳动成果，他显然十分高兴。
rows.raw: "\n\nNeeding no further encouragement, the two of you dig in. You find yourself surprised by Dreghan’s skillful cooking. The bacon is a bit gamey but is seasoned to deliciousness and perfectly crispy. The eggs are scrambled and fluffy, the taste surprisingly savory. He can’t help but smile as he watches you eat the yummy food quickly, clearly pleased that you’re enjoying the fruits of his efforts."

rows.original: The meal passes amicably as you chat and share stories to pass the time between bites.
rows.translation: 你们一边用餐，一边聊天分享故事，在每口食物之间消磨时光，气氛十分融洽。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe meal passes amicably as you chat and share stories to pass the time between bites."

rows.original: You take the opportunity to ask him where he learned to cook, and he excitedly tells you that he had a short fling with a milodan spacer girl quite some time ago, after his mate had passed, and he does not skimp on the details.
rows.translation: 你趁机问他在哪里学会烹饪，他兴奋地告诉你，伴侣去世后，他在相当久以前曾与一名米洛丹太空女郎有过一段短暂情缘，而且讲述细节时完全没有省略。
rows.raw: " You take the opportunity to ask him where he learned to cook, and he excitedly tells you that he had a short fling with a milodan spacer girl quite some time ago, after his mate had passed, and he does not skimp on the details."

rows.original: Dreghan met her while on a hunt for a kor’diiak bear and she was really, really drunk, passed out in the snow during a storm. He explains that he couldn’t just leave her there, and he ended up dragging her into a cave to escape the blizzard. He started a fire to keep them warm, one thing led to another and they ended up having quite the night together. After that, they’d meet up there every few days. They shared meals, and she ended up teaching him the basics of cooking. They also had a lot of sex, he says without shame, a big grin on his face. She wasn’t taking any contraceptives, though he didn’t know it at the time. Inevitably, she got pregnant, told him, and disappeared. He spent days searching the cold wastes for her until he finally came to the conclusion that she had left the planet entirely. He hasn’t seen her since but he knows, somehow, that she and their child are okay.
rows.translation: 德雷甘在猎捕一头科尔迪亚克熊时遇见了她。她喝得非常、非常醉，在暴风雪中昏倒在雪地里。他解释说自己不能把她丢在那里不管，于是最后把她拖进一个山洞躲避暴风雪。他生火为两人取暖，后来一件事引出另一件事，他们共同度过了相当精彩的一夜。此后，他们每隔几天就会在那里见面。他们一起进餐，而她最终教会了他烹饪的基本方法。他毫不害臊地说，他们也做了很多次爱，脸上还挂着灿烂笑容。她没有服用任何避孕药，不过当时他并不知道。她不可避免地怀孕了，告诉他后便消失无踪。他在寒冷荒原里搜寻了数日，最终只能得出她已经彻底离开这颗星球的结论。从那以后，他再也没有见过她，但不知为什么，他确信她和他们的孩子一切安好。
rows.raw: "\n\nDreghan met her while on a hunt for a kor’diiak bear and she was really, really drunk, passed out in the snow during a storm. He explains that he couldn’t just leave her there, and he ended up dragging her into a cave to escape the blizzard. He started a fire to keep them warm, one thing led to another and they ended up having quite the night together. After that, they’d meet up there every few days. They shared meals, and she ended up teaching him the basics of cooking. They also had a lot of sex, he says without shame, a big grin on his face. She wasn’t taking any contraceptives, though he didn’t know it at the time. Inevitably, she got pregnant, told him, and disappeared. He spent days searching the cold wastes for her until he finally came to the conclusion that she had left the planet entirely. He hasn’t seen her since but he knows, somehow, that she and their child are okay."

rows.original: You sit up slowly, with effort, to take a sip. It tastes bitter, with an earthiness akin to dirt, requiring an effort of will to swallow it down. As you drink the elixir, you start to feel revitalized, the lingering aches and chills that plagued you fading away. You’re almost shocked into wakefulness by the draught, leaving your mind clear and focused, undistracted.
rows.translation: 你费力地缓缓坐起身，喝了一口。味道苦涩，还带着泥土般的土腥味，你不得不鼓起意志才能咽下去。饮下这剂药液时，你开始恢复活力，困扰着你的残余酸痛和寒意逐渐消退。这一口药几乎让你猛然清醒，头脑变得清明而专注，不再分心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sit up slowly, with effort, to take a sip. It tastes bitter, with an earthiness akin to dirt, requiring an effort of will to swallow it down. As you drink the elixir, you start to feel revitalized, the lingering aches and chills that plagued you fading away. You’re almost shocked into wakefulness by the draught, leaving your mind clear and focused, undistracted."

rows.translation: 回飞船的路上，你们俩都兴奋得浑身发颤。莱索给了你一份档案，里面是希莉身体完成适应期间未来几周的饮食建议，还有帮助恢复她受损免疫系统的处方。不过眼下，你们俩更在意希莉感受到身体真正属于自己的激动，以及那些她早已学会忍受的小小不适全都消失无踪。唯一让你稍微停顿的，是希莉途中在自动售货机前停下，买了一盒新的绝育灵丸。你们甚至还没走到飞船舷梯，她便吞下一粒药，不愿在关上门后浪费哪怕一刻。 抵达希莉的住舱后，你把她扑倒在床上，与恋人一同翻滚，直到她设法将你压在身下。 “好了，[pc.name]，不管你想做什么都已经赢得资格了，只要你愿意做。”希莉脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。“不用再戴套，什么都不受限制。你来决定吧。”
rows.raw: " The trip back to your ship has you both quivering with excitement. Lessau provides you with a file of some dietary recommendations for Syri for the next few weeks while her body finishes adjusting, as well as prescriptions to help restore her battered immune system. Right now, though, you’re both more focused on the thrill Syri feels at her body truly belonging to her, all the little discomforts she’d learned to live with washed away. The only thing that even makes you pause is Syri stopping at a vending machine along the way to pick up a fresh pack of Sterilex. She pops one of the pills before you even reach the ramp of your ship, not wanting to waste a moment once you’re behind closed doors. You tackle Syri into bed as you arrive at her quarters, rolling over with your lover until she manages to pin you underneath her. “Alright, [pc.name], you’ve earned whatever you wanna do, as long as you wanna do it.” Syri says with a beaming grin on her face. “No more condoms, nothing off-limits. Make the call.” "

rows.original: The chimera behind the desk closes the monitor in front of him as you approach. He’s wearing a Steele Tech standard-issue lab coat, worn open to reveal thick orange fur across his chest and shoulders almost like a mantle, as well as around his wrists, matching the luxurious mane that cascades down the center of his back and is parted at his forehead by a pair of massive black bull-like horns. Below the thicker orange fluff, thinner white fur covers the rest of his upper body, the same shade as the feathers of his rather enormous avian wings. Behind him you can see the signature coils of a naga’s tail, black scales with a white underbelly. As if all that wasn’t enough to make him absolutely monstrous in appearance, now that you’re closer you can also see that he has four arms, three of them resting at the desk even as the fourth is raised in greeting.
rows.translation: 你靠近时，桌后的奇美拉关掉面前的显示器。他身穿斯蒂尔科技配发的标准实验室外套，敞开的衣襟露出胸膛与肩头厚实的橙色毛发，宛如一件斗篷；手腕周围也生着同样的毛发，与从背部中央倾泻而下的华美鬃毛相互呼应，而额前一对巨大的黑色牛角将鬃毛分开。厚实的橙色绒毛下方，较为纤细的白色毛发覆盖着上半身其余部位，色泽与他那对颇为巨大的鸟翼羽毛相同。在他身后，你能看见纳迦尾巴标志性的盘曲轮廓，鳞片漆黑，腹部则呈白色。仿佛这些还不足以让他的外貌显得彻头彻尾如同怪物，如今走近后，你还看出他长着四条手臂，其中三条搁在桌上，第四条则抬起来向你致意。

rows.original: “You didn’t think those microsurgeons that protect you were conjured from thin air, did you? They were created specially for you, twenty years in the making. rows.translation: “你总不会以为，那些保护你的微型外科机器人是凭空变出来的吧？它们是专门为你打造的，研发耗时二十年。这也许是我们第一次见面，斯蒂尔船长，但我们都为彼此成就了伟大的事业。没有你，也没有你的父亲，我今天就不会站在这里。”

This may be the first time we’ve met, Captain Steele, but we have each done great things for the other. Without you, and without your father, I would not be here today.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nThe chimera looks as though he’s about to say more, but shakes his head after a moment."

rows.original: “Well, I imagine you didn’t come in for a reminder of your recent loss. My apologies. Come, take a look. I have quite a number of transformatives that might interest you, if you yearn to become something truly exotic. We can prepare them for you right here.”
rows.translation: “好吧，我想你来这里不是为了重温最近的丧亲之痛。请接受我的歉意。来，看看吧。如果你渴望变成真正充满异域色彩的生物，我这里有不少变形物品或许能引起你的兴趣。我们可以当场为你制备。”

rows.original: “So what’s the head of Steele Tech’s biomedical division doing in a backwater like this?” you ask.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔科技生物医学部门的负责人，为什么会待在这种偏僻落后的地方？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“So what’s the head of Steele Tech’s biomedical division doing in a backwater like this?” you ask."

rows.original: “Ah, yes, that. This planet, as I’m sure you’re aware, is lush with psionically gifted lifeforms owing to the abundant savicite. Other such planets exist, but Uveto is one of the few with such diversity and genetic closeness to the coreworld races. It presents a treasure trove of potential advancements in adapting those gifts to humans or ausar. Such a breakthrough would far surpass any progress that Xenogen has made on that front.”
rows.translation: “啊，对，这件事。相信你也知道，这颗星球由于萨维石资源丰富，充满了具有灵能天赋的生命形态。其他类似星球确实存在，但拥有如此丰富的多样性、在遗传层面又如此接近核心世界种族的，乌维托是少数之一。如何把这些天赋适配给人类或奥萨尔人，其中蕴藏着潜在技术进步的宝库。这样的突破将远远超过异源生物科技在该领域取得的任何进展。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, yes, that. This planet, as I’m sure you’re aware, is lush with psionically gifted lifeforms owing to the abundant savicite. Other such planets exist, but Uveto is one of the few with such diversity and genetic closeness to the coreworld races. It presents a treasure trove of potential advancements in adapting those gifts to humans or ausar. Such a breakthrough would far surpass any progress that Xenogen has made on that front.”"

rows.original: “It also gives us an opportunity to test treatments for environmental adaptation. The local ausar have of course modified themselves to an extent, but there’s potential for far more. Some of the employees have expressed interest in gaining the physical traits of the ice chimeras, not to mention the more humanoid races...” Lessau trails off, noticing he’s begun to ramble.
rows.translation: “这也为我们提供了测试环境适应治疗的机会。本地奥萨尔人自然已经在一定程度上改造了自己，但其中还有大得多的潜力。一些雇员对获得冰原奇美拉的身体特征表现出了兴趣，更不用说那些更接近人形的种族了...”莱索注意到自己已经开始滔滔不绝，声音渐渐低了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It also gives us an opportunity to test treatments for environmental adaptation. The local ausar have of course modified themselves to an extent, but there’s potential for far more. Some of the employees have expressed interest in gaining the physical traits of the ice chimeras, not to mention the more humanoid races...” Lessau trails off, noticing he’s begun to ramble."

rows.original: “In essence, Captain, there’s dozens of reasons to be here. When we’ve unraveled enough of this planet’s mysteries, I’m sure we’ll move on.”
rows.translation: “总而言之，船长，我们有几十个理由留在这里。等到充分解开这颗星球的奥秘后，我相信我们会继续前往别处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In essence, Captain, there’s dozens of reasons to be here. When we’ve unraveled enough of this planet’s mysteries, I’m sure we’ll move on.”"

rows.original: You ask Lessau if he knew your father, a query that prompts the chimera’s ears to flatten and his gaze to shift briefly downward.
rows.translation: 你问莱索是否认识你的父亲。这个问题让奇美拉的双耳贴向脑后，目光也短暂垂了下去。
rows.raw: "You ask Lessau if he knew your father, a query that prompts the chimera’s ears to flatten and his gaze to shift briefly downward."

rows.original: “I knew him quite well, yes, though chiefly in the final decades. I first met him some two centuries ago, when I was a student. He came to see my professor, who like myself studied nanomedicine, to acquire his own microsurgeons. They were experimental, far less refined and far less safe than yours, but he made a convincing argument for testing them on the frontier. I remember feeling a sense of power about him that I’ve not seen since...” Lessau trails off, looking you over. “...Though perhaps I see it now.”
rows.translation: “是的，我和他非常熟悉，不过主要是在最后几十年。我第一次见他是在大约两个世纪前，那时我还是学生。他来拜访我的教授；她和我一样研究纳米医学，他想获得属于自己的微型外科机器人。那些机器人仍是实验产品，远没有你的这批精良，也远没有这么安全，但他为在边疆测试它们提出了令人信服的论据。我记得他身上有一种力量感，自那以后便再也没有见过...”莱索的声音逐渐低下，打量起你。“...不过，也许我现在又看见了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew him quite well, yes, though chiefly in the final decades. I first met him some two centuries ago, when I was a student. He came to see my professor, who like myself studied nanomedicine, to acquire his own microsurgeons. They were experimental, far less refined and far less safe than yours, but he made a convincing argument for testing them on the frontier. I remember feeling a sense of power about him that I’ve not seen since...” Lessau trails off, looking you over. “...Though perhaps I see it now.”"

rows.original: “I didn’t interact with him much at that time, of course, only incidentally. Still, he reached out to me twenty years ago, when it became clear his health was in decline. He wanted a new head of the biotechnology division of Steele Tech, and wanted me to head it.”
rows.translation: “当然，那时我与他没有太多来往，只是偶尔有所接触。尽管如此，二十年前，当他的健康状况明显开始恶化时，他主动联系了我。他想为斯蒂尔科技的生物技术部门找一位新主管，希望由我领导。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t interact with him much at that time, of course, only incidentally. Still, he reached out to me twenty years ago, when it became clear his health was in decline. He wanted a new head of the biotechnology division of Steele Tech, and wanted me to head it.”"

rows.original: You ask why dad reached out to Lessau instead of his mentor, prompting a deep frown from the chimera. “Yes, well, he would have, but she was already acquired by Xenogen. They would not be willing to let her go at any price.”
rows.translation: 你问父亲为什么联系莱索，而不是他的导师；这个问题令奇美拉深深皱起眉头。“是的，这个嘛，他本来会那么做，但她已经被异源生物科技收归旗下。他们无论如何都不肯放她离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask why dad reached out to Lessau instead of his mentor, prompting a deep frown from the chimera. “Yes, well, he would have, but she was already acquired by Xenogen. They would not be willing to let her go at any price.”"

rows.original: “You make it sound like she’s property,” you reply. Lessau fixes you with as serious a look as you’ve ever seen from anyone.
rows.translation: “你说得好像她是件财产，”你回答。莱索注视着你，神情严肃得堪比你见过的任何人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You make it sound like she’s property,” you reply. Lessau fixes you with as serious a look as you’ve ever seen from anyone."

rows.original: <i>“You don’t leave Xenogen, [pc.name]. Not if they find you useful, or if you grow too knowledgeable about what they do behind closed doors.
rows.translation: <i>“人进了异源生物科技就别想离开，[pc.name]。只要他们觉得你有用，或者你对他们在紧闭大门后所做之事了解得太多，就绝无可能。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“You don’t leave Xenogen, [pc.name]. Not if they find you useful, or if you grow too knowledgeable about what they do behind closed doors."

rows.original: I would caution you against doing any more for them than you already have, or you too may find yourself considered an asset too important to let roam free.
rows.translation: 我劝你别再为他们做比已经做过的更多的事，否则你也可能发现，自己被视为一项重要得不能任其自由活动的资产。
rows.raw: " I would caution you against doing any more for them than you already have, or you too may find yourself considered an asset too important to let roam free."

rows.original: Lessau lets the statement hang, seemingly unwilling to go into more lurid detail. The moment eventually passes, and Lessau returns to his story after a moment to collect himself.
rows.translation: 莱索任由这番话悬而未决，似乎不愿讲述更多骇人的细节。这一刻最终过去，莱索稍作整理情绪后，继续讲述自己的故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nLessau lets the statement hang, seemingly unwilling to go into more lurid detail. The moment eventually passes, and Lessau returns to his story after a moment to collect himself."

rows.original: “At the time Steele Tech was mostly a mining company. The biotechnology division was woefully underdeveloped and underfunded, so we began from almost nothing. Between Victor’s generous funding and some fortunate breakthroughs, we’ve managed to develop at a brisk pace since then. We even bought the rights to a terran transformative and improved it. Sadly it did little to help Victor’s condition, but it proved the commercial viability of our department as well. Sales of Humana+ have been brisk... or Terran Treats, as I gather most people call them.” Lessau grumbles a bit at the mention of the more popular name.
rows.translation: “那时斯蒂尔科技主要是一家采矿公司。生物技术部门严重发展不足，资金也极度匮乏，所以我们几乎是从零开始。凭借维克托的慷慨资助和几项幸运的突破，此后我们得以迅速发展。我们甚至买下了一种泰伦变形物品的权利并加以改进。遗憾的是，它对维克托的病情没什么帮助，却也证明了我们部门的商业可行性。Humana+的销量一直很不错...或者说，大多数人似乎都称它为泰伦零食。”提到那个更流行的名字时，莱索略微抱怨了几句。
rows.raw: "\n\n“At the time Steele Tech was mostly a mining company. The biotechnology division was woefully underdeveloped and underfunded, so we began from almost nothing. Between Victor’s generous funding and some fortunate breakthroughs, we’ve managed to develop at a brisk pace since then. We even bought the rights to a terran transformative and improved it. Sadly it did little to help Victor’s condition, but it proved the commercial viability of our department as well. Sales of Humana+ have been brisk... or Terran Treats, as I gather most people call them.” Lessau grumbles a bit at the mention of the more popular name."

rows.original: “The real goal, however, was in a concept I had spent decades drafting and refining, but lacked the funding to develop until Victor’s intervention. With his aid I produced my masterwork: microsurgeons that do more than just protect against known diseases, they adapt, they innovate when faced with the unknown. More importantly, they house within them a full transcript of your original genome from birth. No matter how you alter yourself, no matter what mutations you undergo, you will always be able to return to what you once were.”
rows.translation: “然而，真正的目标是一项我花费数十年构思并完善、却直到维克托介入才有资金开发的概念。在他的帮助下，我创造了自己的杰作：这些微型外科机器人不只防范已知疾病；面对未知事物时，它们还会适应并创新。更重要的是，它们内部保存着一份你出生时原始基因组的完整记录。无论你怎样改造自己，无论经历何种突变，你始终都能回归曾经的模样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The real goal, however, was in a concept I had spent decades drafting and refining, but lacked the funding to develop until Victor’s intervention. With his aid I produced my masterwork: microsurgeons that do more than just protect against known diseases, they adapt, they innovate when faced with the unknown. More importantly, they house within them a full transcript of your original genome from birth. No matter how you alter yourself, no matter what mutations you undergo, you will always be able to return to what you once were.”"

rows.original: “Oh? Oh, yes, all this.” Lessau gestures to himself with one of his hands. “I enjoy switching forms every few months, this has become one of my new favorites. It’s based off the Terran myths of the chimera, though with a few tweaks. The discovery of Mhen’ga and its naleen helped enormously with refining the synthesis, enough so to make this blend reproductively viable. But if you’re asking what I originally am, I was born as a human.”
rows.translation: “哦？哦，对，这一身。”莱索用一只手示意自己的身体。“我喜欢每隔几个月更换一次形态，这副身体已经成了我的新宠之一。它以泰伦神话中的奇美拉为基础，不过做了少许调整。门加及其纳林人的发现极大地帮助了合成技术的完善，足以令这种混合形态具备生殖能力。不过如果你问的是我的原始种族，我生来是个人类。”

rows.original: “And the four arms?” you ask, folding your own. In response Lessau lifts his two left arms, letting you see how the paired shoulders function and move independently.

rows.original: “These are a new addition. I’m testing if the Brundle Limitation can be overcome by forgoing legs. Results so far are promising...” Lessau looks over at his raised arms, which have begun mimicking each other’s actions to his visible annoyance. “...for the most part.”
rows.translation: “这是新增加的部分。我正在测试，舍弃双腿能否克服布伦德尔限制。目前的结果很有希望...”莱索看向抬起的手臂；它们已经开始模仿彼此的动作，显然让他颇为恼火。“...大体上如此。”

My microsurgeons are slightly less refined than yours, but they share the same general set of functions. At present I’m using them as a testbed for developing new features that I hope to be able to pass on to yours someday.”"

rows.original: “In fact, I’ve just recently been working on that rather interesting data you acquired from Bell-Isle Grunmann. It may be ancient technology, but the emergent intelligence properties of those microbots is quite remarkable. Imagine having the Codex and all its data held within your very bloodstream, or having the ability to store your mind as an AI while regrowing your body from the ground up, and perhaps you begin to see the possibilities. All of this will take quite some time before it’s ready to test, but your discovery promises to be a monumental advancement.”
rows.translation: “事实上，我最近一直在研究你从贝尔岛/格伦曼取得的那组颇有意思的数据。这也许是古代技术，但那些微型机器人展现出的涌现智能特性相当出色。试想一下，让CODEX终端及其全部数据存在于你的血液之中，或者拥有将心智保存为AI、同时从头再生身体的能力，也许你就开始看见其中的可能性。这一切还需要相当长的时间才能做好测试准备，但你的发现有望带来一项划时代的进步。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In fact, I’ve just recently been working on that rather interesting data you acquired from Bell-Isle Grunmann. It may be ancient technology, but the emergent intelligence properties of those microbots is quite remarkable. Imagine having the Codex and all its data held within your very bloodstream, or having the ability to store your mind as an AI while regrowing your body from the ground up, and perhaps you begin to see the possibilities. All of this will take quite some time before it’s ready to test, but your discovery promises to be a monumental advancement.”"

rows.original: You can only assume that Dr. Lessau was human at one point, but it’s impossible to tell under the mountain of gene mods he’s undergone, which have turned him into a creature similar to the mythic chimera. From the waist down his lower body is a massive serpent’s tail, normally spiraled into a coil underneath him to keep him at a few inches over six feet. The bulk of the tail’s scales are pitch black, save for a strip of white that runs down the front. His upper body is thickly muscled and covered in a thin layer of white fur that sports a thicker layer of orange around his shoulders and collar. Matching thick orange bands of fur are wrapped around each of his four wrists. Despite the thickness of his muscles, his hands are lean and nimble, the fingers tipped in sharp feline claws. His head is that of a lion, including an orange mane that cascades down his back as hair, but a pair of massive black horns stretch out from underneath the hair, more like a bull’s horns than a goat’s in how they angle up and forward. Adorning his back are a set of white feathered wings.
rows.translation: 你只能猜测莱索医生曾经是个人类，但在他经历的堆积如山的基因改造之下已经无从分辨；这些改造把他变成了类似神话奇美拉的生物。他腰部以下的身体是一条巨大的蛇尾，通常盘绕在身下，让他的身高保持在六英尺出头。尾巴大部分鳞片漆黑如墨，只有正面有一道白色条纹。他的上半身肌肉厚实，覆盖着一层纤细的白色毛发，肩膀和衣领周围则生有更厚的橙色毛发。四只手腕上分别环绕着同样厚实的橙色毛带。尽管肌肉粗壮，他的手却纤细而灵巧，指尖生着锋利的猫科利爪。他的头颅属于狮子，包括一头如长发般倾泻至背后的橙色鬃毛，但一对巨大的黑角从毛发下伸出；以向上、向前的角度来看，它们更像公牛角而非山羊角。他的背上还生有一对白色羽翼。
rows.raw: "You can only assume that Dr. Lessau was human at one point, but it’s impossible to tell under the mountain of gene mods he’s undergone, which have turned him into a creature similar to the mythic chimera. From the waist down his lower body is a massive serpent’s tail, normally spiraled into a coil underneath him to keep him at a few inches over six feet. The bulk of the tail’s scales are pitch black, save for a strip of white that runs down the front. His upper body is thickly muscled and covered in a thin layer of white fur that sports a thicker layer of orange around his shoulders and collar. Matching thick orange bands of fur are wrapped around each of his four wrists. Despite the thickness of his muscles, his hands are lean and nimble, the fingers tipped in sharp feline claws. His head is that of a lion, including an orange mane that cascades down his back as hair, but a pair of massive black horns stretch out from underneath the hair, more like a bull’s horns than a goat’s in how they angle up and forward. Adorning his back are a set of white feathered wings."

It would not be terribly out of my way to help you find your idealized self...” [var1 |“So like the hellhound I saw in the Fuck Dimension.” The doctor nods. “Or anything else Miss Dorna has in mind.” Syri arches her brow. “I mean, I’m pretty happy with myself as I am. Would be a lot happier if I wasn’t taking pills all the time. Although... I guess there’s something to be said for being the big bad wolf [pc.name] wants me to be. At least this way it’s on my terms.” ] “Of course, I’m willing to accommodate whatever you request,” Lessau replies. “However, this is a large favor to ask of me, even with the research data from your current condition as compensation. I will only do such an overhaul once, [pc.name].” [flags.SYRI_HELLHOUND_TALK |Looks like it’s now or never if you want Syri to go hellhound. Which route will you take? ]
rows.translation: [var0 |等你们清理干净后，莱索正式完成了检查。 |你耐心等待莱索正式完成检查。 ]最终，这位医生离开希莉身边，收起设备。 “这是非常复杂的纠缠，但并非无法解决。如果你给我大约一周时间准备，我可以进行一次专门治疗，将两组细胞调整为同一基因组。考虑到这一点...你的第一个选择，是让我直接完成希莉器官的融合。从那以后，她就能正常充分使用自己的身体。第二个选择是，既然我本来就会重写她全身的基因组，也可以顺便整合一些改造。帮助你找到理想中的自我，并不会给我增添太多麻烦...” [var1 |“比如我在性爱维度见过的地狱犬？” 医生点点头。“或者多娜小姐想到的任何其他形态。” 希莉挑起眉毛。“我是说，我对现在的自己挺满意。要是不用一直吃药，我会满意得多。不过...我猜，变成[pc.name]想要的大坏狼也不是没有好处。至少这一次，是按我的条件来。” ] “当然，无论你提出什么要求，我都愿意配合，”莱索答道。“不过，即便拿你目前状况的研究数据作为补偿，这仍是一个很大的人情。我只会做一次这种彻底改造，[pc.name]。” [flags.SYRI_HELLHOUND_TALK |如果你想让希莉变成地狱犬，现在看来只能当机立断了。你会选择哪条路线？ ]
rows.raw: " [var0 |Once you finish cleaning up, Lessau finishes his examination properly. |You wait patiently as Lessau finishes his examination properly. ] Eventually the doctor pulls away from Syri and puts away his equipment. “It’s a very complicated entanglement, but not unsolvable. I can perform a specialized treatment to adjust both sets of cells to the same genome if you’ll give me a week or so to prepare. Now, that in mind... Your first option is that I simply finish the integration of Syri’s organs. She will be properly able to make full use of her body from that point forward. Your second option is that, as I will already be rewriting her entire body’s genome, I can integrate some alterations. It would not be terribly out of my way to help you find your idealized self...” [var1 |“So like the hellhound I saw in the Fuck Dimension.” The doctor nods. “Or anything else Miss Dorna has in mind.” Syri arches her brow. “I mean, I’m pretty happy with myself as I am. Would be a lot happier if I wasn’t taking pills all the time. Although... I guess there’s something to be said for being the big bad wolf [pc.name] wants me to be. At least this way it’s on my terms.” ] “Of course, I’m willing to accommodate whatever you request,” Lessau replies. “However, this is a large favor to ask of me, even with the research data from your current condition as compensation. I will only do such an overhaul once, [pc.name].” [flags.SYRI_HELLHOUND_TALK |Looks like it’s now or never if you want Syri to go hellhound. Which route will you take? ] "

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: “Very well. I’ll send you an email when I’ve finished my preparations.[var0| Syri, I’ll be in touch to determine the specifics of your new body.]” Lessau soon makes his departure to begin the requested work. You figure you’ll be waiting at least a week to hear back from him, so you might as well find something else to do to pass the time.
rows.translation: “很好。准备工作完成后，我会给你发邮件。[var0|希莉，我会与你联系，确定新身体的具体细节。]”莱索很快告辞，开始进行委托的工作。你估计至少得等一周才能收到他的消息，所以不妨找点别的事情打发时间。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t“Very well. I’ll send you an email when I’ve finished my preparations.[var0| Syri, I’ll be in touch to determine the specifics of your new body.]” Lessau soon makes his departure to begin the requested work. You figure you’ll be waiting at least a week to hear back from him, so you might as well find something else to do to pass the time.\n\t\t"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next

rows.raw: "Just Organs"

rows.translation: 只改器官
rows.raw: "Just Organs"

rows.original: No need to change Syri’s body. Just fix her organs.
rows.translation: 无需改变希莉的身体，只要修复她的器官。
rows.raw: "No need to change Syri’s body. Just fix her organs."

rows.original: Go Hellhound
rows.translation: 变成地狱猎犬
rows.raw: "Go Hellhound"

rows.original: Go Hellhound
rows.translation: 变成地狱猎犬
rows.raw: "Go Hellhound"

rows.original: Skom, AveryBirb and MoonKitten
rows.raw: "Skom, AveryBirb and MoonKitten"

rows.original: After dressing the confused deertaur in heavy, insulating clothes and covering her oversized endowments as best you can, you and Amber venture out of your ship and onto Uveto Station. Like a newborn, her curious eyes examine everything, though her good spirits turn into fear once she sees the rows of machine guns lining the walls.
rows.translation: 你为困惑的鹿身人穿上厚重保暖的衣服，尽可能遮住她过于硕大的性器官，随后与安珀离开飞船，踏上乌维托空间站。她好似新生儿一般，好奇地观察一切，但看到墙壁上一排排机关枪时，良好心情便转为恐惧。
rows.raw: "After dressing the confused deertaur in heavy, insulating clothes and covering her oversized endowments as best you can, you and Amber venture out of your ship and onto Uveto Station. Like a newborn, her curious eyes examine everything, though her good spirits turn into fear once she sees the rows of machine guns lining the walls."

rows.original: “Are you sure there’s a scientist in this place?” she asks, uneasy.
rows.translation: “你确定这个地方真有科学家吗？”她不安地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you sure there’s a scientist in this place?” she asks, uneasy."

rows.original: “This here is just the space station,” you explain. “The person I want you to meet is on the planet proper.”
rows.translation: “这里只是空间站，”你解释道。“我想让你见的人在下方星球上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This here is just the space station,” you explain. “The person I want you to meet is on the planet proper.”"

rows.original: Thankfully, it takes only a few minutes for you to leave that area and reach the space elevator, but now the deertaur finds herself faced with a new challenge: the frigid winds of Uveto. The civilized area might be considered warm in comparison with the glacial wastelands that cover most of the planet, but it’s still bitterly cold to someone used to the tropical heat of Mhen’ga.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，你们只花几分钟便离开那个区域，抵达太空电梯，但现在鹿身人面临新的挑战：乌维托凛冽的寒风。与覆盖这颗星球大部分区域的冰川荒原相比，文明区域或许算得上温暖，但对习惯门加热带气候的人而言仍寒冷刺骨。
rows.raw: "\n\nThankfully, it takes only a few minutes for you to leave that area and reach the space elevator, but now the deertaur finds herself faced with a new challenge: the frigid winds of Uveto. The civilized area might be considered warm in comparison with the glacial wastelands that cover most of the planet, but it’s still bitterly cold to someone used to the tropical heat of Mhen’ga."

rows.original: “Is this-ss-s really necess-ssarryy?” she asks, shivering visibly as you go down the space elevator and escort her through the streets.
rows.translation: “这真——的有必——要吗？”你们搭太空电梯下降、穿行街道时，她浑身明显颤抖着问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this-ss-s really necess-ssarryy?” she asks, shivering visibly as you go down the space elevator and escort her through the streets."

rows.original: You reassure her that it’s just a short walk; you’re almost there. Huskar and other dwellers of Uveto cast curious glances her way – it’s not common to see a ‘taur in these parts, never mind one as cute as Amber – but she’s so focused on the cold that she doesn’t even notice the more lustful looks. Good.
rows.translation: 你向她保证只需走一小段路；你们快到了。赫斯卡与乌维托其他居民好奇地看向她，这一带不常见到四足人，更别提安珀这样可爱的四足人，但她太过专注于寒冷，甚至没注意到那些更加淫邪的目光。很好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reassure her that it’s just a short walk; you’re almost there. Huskar and other dwellers of Uveto cast curious glances her way – it’s not common to see a ‘taur in these parts, never mind one as cute as Amber – but she’s so focused on the cold that she doesn’t even notice the more lustful looks. Good."

rows.original: Soon enough, you arrive at Steele Tech’s biomedical division, and the deertaur gives a sigh of relief once the climatized air starts to warm up her reddened cheeks. As you enter Dr. Lessau’s office, the scientist gives you and her a curious look.
rows.translation: 很快，你们抵达斯蒂尔科技生物医学部门，恒温空气开始温暖鹿身人冻红的脸颊，她如释重负地叹了口气。进入莱索医生的办公室时，科学家好奇地看向你和她。
rows.raw: "\n\nSoon enough, you arrive at Steele Tech’s biomedical division, and the deertaur gives a sigh of relief once the climatized air starts to warm up her reddened cheeks. As you enter Dr. Lessau’s office, the scientist gives you and her a curious look."

rows.original: “Captain Steele,” he nods with a warm smile, “and... who might this marvelous lady be?”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔船长，”他带着温暖笑容点头，“而且...这位美妙的女士是谁呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain Steele,” he nods with a warm smile, “and... who might this marvelous lady be?”"

rows.original: “Uhh, hi, I guess! I’m Amber,” she introduces herself a little awkwardly, extending a hand. Dr. Lessau shakes it firmly, though his gaze seems more interested in her tauric half than anything else.
rows.translation: “呃，你好，我想！我叫安珀，”她略显尴尬地自我介绍，同时伸出一只手。莱索医生坚定地握住，但他的目光似乎更关注她的四足下半身。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhh, hi, I guess! I’m Amber,” she introduces herself a little awkwardly, extending a hand. Dr. Lessau shakes it firmly, though his gaze seems more interested in her tauric half than anything else."

rows.original: “I’m Lessau, head of research. Pray, forgive my curiosity, but were you always like this?” he asks, gesturing to her deer body.
rows.translation: “我是莱索，研究主管。请原谅我的好奇，但你一直都是这副模样吗？”他指着她的鹿身问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m Lessau, head of research. Pray, forgive my curiosity, but were you always like this?” he asks, gesturing to her deer body."

rows.original: Amber winces a little. “Oh, that’s kind of a long story. I don’t want to take too much of your time...”
rows.translation: 安珀略微畏缩。“哦，这个故事说来有点长。我不想占用你太多时间...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAmber winces a little. “Oh, that’s kind of a long story. I don’t want to take too much of your time...”"

rows.original: You decide to chime in: “That’s actually why we’re here, so you might as well give him the full version.”
rows.translation: 你决定插话：“这正是我们来这里的原因，所以不妨把完整版本告诉他。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide to chime in: “That’s actually why we’re here, so you might as well give him the full version.”"

rows.original: The deertaur spends a few minutes telling the chimera about her misadventures, how she wound up with her current body and her off the charts libido. Dr. Lessau takes notes at several points, stopping Amber to ask for details about the kinds of transformatives she used – how long the changes took to manifest, whether the people she got the drugs from mentioned anything of relevance, everything from how they looked to how she felt. Amber strains to recall as much as possible, but most of her memories from those times are little more than a haze.
rows.translation: 鹿身人花了几分钟，向奇美拉讲述自己的不幸遭遇，说明她如何变成现在的身体，以及性欲怎样高到爆表。莱索医生多次做笔记，还叫停安珀，询问她使用过哪些变形物品的细节：变化花了多长时间才显现，给她药物的人是否提过相关事项，从外观到感受的一切。安珀竭力回忆尽可能多的内容，但那些时期的大部分记忆都只剩一片朦胧。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe deertaur spends a few minutes telling the chimera about her misadventures, how she wound up with her current body and her off the charts libido. Dr. Lessau takes notes at several points, stopping Amber to ask for details about the kinds of transformatives she used – how long the changes took to manifest, whether the people she got the drugs from mentioned anything of relevance, everything from how they looked to how she felt. Amber strains to recall as much as possible, but most of her memories from those times are little more than a haze."

rows.original: When it becomes apparent that there’s nothing else to be gained from this, you stop the interrogation and explain that you’re looking for a way to cure her condition. Dr. Lessau helped your father before, so surely he might be able to help you...
rows.translation: 事情明显已经无法提供更多信息时，你停止盘问，解释说自己正在寻找治愈她状况的方法。莱索医生以前帮助过你的父亲，所以想必也能帮助你们...
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen it becomes apparent that there’s nothing else to be gained from this, you stop the interrogation and explain that you’re looking for a way to cure her condition. Dr. Lessau helped your father before, so surely he might be able to help you..."

rows.original: “Cure?” the scientist asks with a raised eyebrow. “I’m afraid you’ll have to be a little more specific, Captain. Do you mean turning her back into a human? Selectively undoing some of the changes?”
rows.translation: “治愈？”科学家扬起眉毛问道。“恐怕你得说得更具体些，船长。你是指把她变回人类吗？还是选择性地撤销部分变化？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Cure?” the scientist asks with a raised eyebrow. “I’m afraid you’ll have to be a little more specific, Captain. Do you mean turning her back into a human? Selectively undoing some of the changes?”"

rows.original: You look at Amber. She hesitates, biting her lower lip. Clearly, she wants you to make the big decisions for her, but this time you’re having none of that. After all, it’s her body and mind that we’re talking about. After a moment of awkward silence, she gathers her courage.
rows.translation: 你看向安珀。她迟疑着咬住下唇。显然，她希望由你替自己做出重大决定，但这一次你不打算纵容。毕竟我们谈论的是她的身体和心智。尴尬地沉默片刻后，她鼓起勇气。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at Amber. She hesitates, biting her lower lip. Clearly, she wants you to make the big decisions for her, but this time you’re having none of that. After all, it’s her body and mind that we’re talking about. After a moment of awkward silence, she gathers her courage."

rows.original: “I, uhh, kind of like how my body is now. I wouldn’t mind going back to human if that’s what it takes, but to be honest I just want to... to... have a little more time for myself, you know. Without this,” she blushes, “this constant need to fuck. Like, I just want a few more hours per day to focus on stuff other than sex.”
rows.translation: “我，呃，其实挺喜欢现在的身体。要是非得变回人类才能解决，我也不介意，但老实说，我只想...想...每天多留一点时间给自己，你明白吧。不要一直有这种，”她脸红起来，“这种对性交的持续需求。比如说，我只是想每天多几个小时，专注于性爱以外的事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I, uhh, kind of like how my body is now. I wouldn’t mind going back to human if that’s what it takes, but to be honest I just want to... to... have a little more time for myself, you know. Without this,” she blushes, “this constant need to fuck. Like, I just want a few more hours per day to focus on stuff other than sex.”"

rows.original: The scientist looks at his clock, then nods. “Okay, I’ve got some time before I need to continue my current experiments. Let’s go down to the lab so we can get a proper look at your genes, shall we?”
rows.translation: 科学家看了看时钟，随后点头。“好吧，距离继续当前实验还有些时间。我们去实验室，仔细检查一下你的基因，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe scientist looks at his clock, then nods. “Okay, I’ve got some time before I need to continue my current experiments. Let’s go down to the lab so we can get a proper look at your genes, shall we?”"

rows.original: An hour later...
rows.translation: 一小时后...
rows.raw: "\n\nAn hour later..."

rows.original: Dr. Lessau sighs. “This is a mess. You see, Amber, the mods didn’t just raise your libido to extraordinary levels; they put you in heat permanently. What you think is your heat phase is actually just a cyclic peak in your hormonal curve. A small deviation in the grand scale of things.”
rows.translation: 莱索医生叹了口气。“这是一团乱麻。你看，安珀，这些改造不只是把你的性欲提高到异常水平，还让你永久处于发情期。你以为的发情阶段，其实只是荷尔蒙曲线的周期性峰值。从整体尺度来看，不过是一次微小波动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDr. Lessau sighs. “This is a mess. You see, Amber, the mods didn’t just raise your libido to extraordinary levels; they put you in heat permanently. What you think is your heat phase is actually just a cyclic peak in your hormonal curve. A small deviation in the grand scale of things.”"

rows.original: “How much?” you ask, already feeling the hole in your bank account.
rows.translation: “要花多少？”你已经感觉到银行账户里即将出现一个窟窿，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How much?” you ask, already feeling the hole in your bank account."

rows.original: The chimera waves his hands dismissively. “It’s not just about credits, it’s about manpower and facilities. Steele Tech’s biodivision works on a tight schedule as it is – I can’t afford to divert this lab’s resources, much as I would like to. I was hoping it would be something I could work on as a pet project, but the damage is so extensive that it would take a custom build of nanomachines to achieve anything of significance.”
rows.translation: 奇美拉不以为意地挥了挥手。“这不只是信用点的问题，而是人力和设施问题。斯蒂尔科技生物部门的日程本就十分紧张，尽管我愿意帮忙，却无法抽调这间实验室的资源。我原本希望把它当成个人项目处理，但损伤范围太广，必须定制一套纳米机器才能取得任何显著成果。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe chimera waves his hands dismissively. “It’s not just about credits, it’s about manpower and facilities. Steele Tech’s biodivision works on a tight schedule as it is – I can’t afford to divert this lab’s resources, much as I would like to. I was hoping it would be something I could work on as a pet project, but the damage is so extensive that it would take a custom build of nanomachines to achieve anything of significance.”"

rows.original: Amber looks crestfallen. Even Dr. Lessau seems to feel the sting of her dejection, judging by the look of pity on his face.
rows.translation: 安珀看起来垂头丧气。从莱索医生脸上的怜悯神色来看，就连他也感受到了她失落的刺痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nAmber looks crestfallen. Even Dr. Lessau seems to feel the sting of her dejection, judging by the look of pity on his face."

rows.original: “However, the situation is not without hope,” he amends, trying to raise her spirits. “Since you don’t require any overt changes to your body, it might be achievable in a shorter time frame, and while I cannot allocate this laboratory to your cause, I can share the data I have.”
rows.translation: “不过，情况并非毫无希望，”他补充道，试图鼓舞她的精神。“既然你不需要对身体进行任何明显改变，也许能在较短时间内完成；虽然我无法把这间实验室分配给你，但可以共享我掌握的数据。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“However, the situation is not without hope,” he amends, trying to raise her spirits. “Since you don’t require any overt changes to your body, it might be achievable in a shorter time frame, and while I cannot allocate this laboratory to your cause, I can share the data I have.”"

rows.original: Amber perks up at that, but you give Dr. Lessau a pointed look. “So, you’re telling us to look for someone else.”
rows.translation: 安珀听到这里振作起来，但你意味明确地看了莱索医生一眼。“所以，你是在叫我们找别人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAmber perks up at that, but you give Dr. Lessau a pointed look. “So, you’re telling us to look for someone else.”"

rows.original: “Technically, yes,” the scientist admits with a sigh.
rows.translation: “严格来说，是的，”科学家叹了口气承认。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Technically, yes,” the scientist admits with a sigh."

rows.original: “And do you have any suggestions?” you ask.
rows.translation: “那你有什么建议吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And do you have any suggestions?” you ask."

rows.original: He shakes his head despondently. “No, unfortunately not. You’d want someone unaffiliated with any of the other major corporations, but all of my colleagues have already been taken by the likes of Xenogen, Tamani Corp, and Snugglé.”
rows.translation: 他沮丧地摇了摇头。“没有，遗憾的是没有。你们需要找不隶属于其他大企业的人，但我的同事早已被异源生物科技、塔玛妮公司和舒适乐之类的企业收入旗下。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe shakes his head despondently. “No, unfortunately not. You’d want someone unaffiliated with any of the other major corporations, but all of my colleagues have already been taken by the likes of Xenogen, Tamani Corp, and Snugglé.”"

rows.original: So, basically what Dr. Lessau is suggesting is that you look for an independent scientist, someone without ties to the major corps...
rows.translation: 所以，莱索医生的建议基本上是让你寻找一位独立科学家，也就是与大企业没有联系的人...
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, basically what Dr. Lessau is suggesting is that you look for an independent scientist, someone without ties to the major corps..."

rows.original: Well, you happen to know a certain orange gabilani that fits the bill. Despite her unpredictable antics, you have a feeling she and Amber would get along pretty well. Perhaps a little too well.
rows.translation: 好吧，你恰好认识一名符合条件的橙色加比拉尼人。尽管她的胡闹难以预测，但你感觉她和安珀会相处得相当融洽。也许融洽得有点过头。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you happen to know a certain orange gabilani that fits the bill. Despite her unpredictable antics, you have a feeling she and Amber would get along pretty well. Perhaps a little too well."

rows.original: You have a hunch you might find such an individual on Tarkus, what with all the technological junk lying around. Let’s see...

rows.original: “Sorry, I’m too busy,” you tell her. She looks disappointed for a moment, her tail drooping back behind her. “If you change your mind, my apartment is 127,” she tells you, a bit of hope in her voice. rows.original: According to the email you had received about the second Frostwyrm sighting, around here should be the spot. Before you call for [frostwyrm.name], you survey the area, to see if you can’t spot the Frostwyrm yourself. Frostwyrms aren’t exactly small creatures, but their scales allow them to blend into the environment really well, and with the frequent snow storms and wind gusts, the powdered snow would blow over any tracks or markings something that large and heavy would have left behind. Try as you might, you can’t find any sight of a second Frostwyrm anywhere: no footprints; no packed snow where it might have stopped to rest; no shadows cast across the white plains or the sound of massive wings pushing air with every flap they make. Near as you can tell, you’re totally alone. You reach out to [frostwyrm.name], telling her that you’re at the spot where the ‘second existence,’ as she calls it, was last seen. If she wants to meet it, she should come to you. I am on the hunt. I will arrive shortly, she replies[frostwyrm.andNykke |. Nykke is with me as well. I would not miss this for the world! Nykke chimes in, her voice rattling about in your head with [frostwyrm.name]’s before they both quiet ]. True to her word, her arrival is much faster than normal: a casual flight from the beach to her lair takes about an hour, but she had been fishing in the ocean, close enough that you could see her breach and take to the air off in the horizon[frostwyrm.andNykke |, and you can see Nykke’s dark silhouette and massive wingspan beside her ]. It’s not ten minutes before you’re joined by your draconic wi[frostwyrm.andNykke |ves |fe ]. Despite having just burst from the ocean, the water has already crystallized into ice droplets; when [frostwyrm.andNykke |she |they ] land, [frostwyrm.andNykke |they |she ] gives [frostwyrm.andNykke |their bodies |her body ] a shake, and all of the ice accumulated on [frostwyrm.andNykke |them |her ] flings off in every direction. Now that [frostwyrm.andNykke |they’re |she’s ] here, you ask what happens next. When you were in the lair, [frostwyrm.name] said that ‘her presence will draw them forward.’ It is as I instructed, [frostwyrm.name] replies, keeping her head lifted and her eyes scouring the snowy horizons for any sign of movement. The second existence is close. Their presence is unmistakable.[frostwyrm.andNykke | Nykke, in particular, seems interested in something towards your north. Her gaze is fixated on a larger dune of snow, its crest reaching up higher than your head. “That way, I think,” she says, pointing in the direction she’s facing with both of her right hands. “I think I feel them coming from that way.” ] Only a moment later, and you first hear a loud, deep woosh of noise, as if air were rushing to fill a sudden vacuum. You feel the snow rumble beneath your feet – the snow is too thick for you to be standing on the ground, and the snow shifts and jostles with the weight of something heavy moving on top of it. To the north, [frostwyrm.andNykke |the dune that Nykke was staring at |a tall snow dune, with its crest reaching higher than your head ] begins to shift: snow cascades down its sloped sides in thin sheets, piling up at the dune’s base as something inside it begins to stir. An elongated section of snow shifts and lifts into the air, reminding you almost of a leg with a stout, arrowhead-shaped foot – until you make out telltale horns with snow piling on top of their crooks, framing a long, thin snout beneath them. It seems you’ve found your Frostwyrm. As if to announce itself, its furled wings slowly peel from its body before violently flapping open, flinging snow in a bright, dusty cloud away from it as it shakes its body clean of all the remaining snow still clinging to its scales. With almost belabored and frustrated movements, its six legs lift out from underneath itself, one after the other, stamping into the snow and sinking down to where its ankles would be with each heavy limb. It’s too far away for you to see its eyes, but you can see its head, and you can tell that it’s looking directly at you[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name]. Before it makes its way towards you, you hear a long, deep, bellowing noise coming from what you presume to be its throat – a sort of lyrical sound that starts at one note, then smoothly transitions to a higher note, before ending suddenly on a lower note than it started with. Its massive wings beat against the snowy tundra as it puts one foot in front of the other five, walking, then cantering, then galloping towards you, using its wings to accelerate. You feel a bit exposed, standing in front of a charging Frostwyrm like this. [pc.isAss |But you hold your ground: you had bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat, after all, and you don’t want to appear weak in the face of another Frostwyrm, especially in front of her. |You had beaten [frostwyrm.name] in combat multiple times, but she never approached you with intent like this. A part of you wants to try and at least get out of the way or something – but you feel something in your psyche. Something calming and reassuring; something that straightens your back and heightens your focus. [frostwyrm.name] is with you, and she’d never let anything happen to you. ]
rows.translation: 根据你收到的第二条冰龙目击情报邮件，这里附近应该就是目标地点。 在呼唤[frostwyrm.name]之前，你先观察周围，看看能否亲自发现那条冰龙。冰龙绝不是什么小型生物，但鳞片能让它们很好地融入环境；而频繁的暴风雪与强风又会让粉雪覆盖如此巨大沉重的生物留下的所有足迹或痕迹。无论怎样努力，你都找不到第二条冰龙的任何踪影：没有脚印；没有它可能停下休息时压实的积雪；洁白平原上没有投落的阴影，也听不到巨大双翼每次拍动时推动空气的声响。据你判断，这里完全只有你一个。 你通过意识联系[frostwyrm.name]，告诉她自己已经来到她所谓‘第二存在’最后一次被目击的地点。如果她想与对方见面，就应该到你这里来。 我正在狩猎，很快便会抵达，她回答道[frostwyrm.andNykke |。妮可也和我在一起。 这种事我绝不会错过！妮可插话道；她的声音与[frostwyrm.name]的一同在你脑中震响，随后两者才安静下来 ]。 她确实言出必行，这次到来的速度比平时快得多：从海滩悠闲飞往巢穴大约需要一小时，但她当时正在海中捕鱼，距离近到你能看见她从远方海平面破水而出、飞上天空[frostwyrm.andNykke |，还能看到妮可漆黑的轮廓与巨大翼展就在她身旁 ]。不到十分钟，你的龙族妻[frostwyrm.andNykke |子们 |子 ]便来到身边。 尽管才刚从海中冲出，她们身上的水却已凝结成冰珠；[frostwyrm.andNykke |她 |她们 ]落地时，[frostwyrm.andNykke |她们 |她 ]抖动[frostwyrm.andNykke |各自的身体 |身体 ]，将积在[frostwyrm.andNykke |她们身上 |她身上 ]的冰粒甩向四面八方。 既然[frostwyrm.andNykke |她们已经 |她已经 ]到了，你便询问接下来该怎么做。在巢穴时，[frostwyrm.name]曾说‘她的存在会将对方吸引出来’。 正如我所说，[frostwyrm.name]回答；她高昂着头，双眼扫视白雪覆盖的地平线，寻找任何动静。第二存在就在附近。对方的气息不可能认错。[frostwyrm.andNykke | 妮可似乎尤其留意北方的某个东西。她的目光牢牢锁定一座较大的雪丘，丘顶甚至高过你的头。“我想是那边，”她说道，用右侧两只手一同指向自己面对的方向。“我觉得能感觉到对方正从那里靠近。” ] 只过了一会儿，你首先听见一道低沉响亮的呼啸，仿佛空气正急速涌去填补突然出现的真空。你感觉脚下积雪震动起来 – 雪层太厚，你根本没有踩到地面；某个沉重物体正在上方移动，令积雪随重量摇晃挤动。 北方，[frostwyrm.andNykke |妮可一直盯着的雪丘 |一座丘顶高过你头顶的高大雪丘 ]开始移动：积雪如薄片般从斜坡两侧倾泻，在丘脚堆积，某个藏在其中的东西则开始苏醒。一段细长雪堆移动着升上空中，令你联想到一条末端长有粗短箭头形足掌的腿 – 直到你看出那标志性的长角；积雪堆在弯角上，围住下方又长又细的口鼻。看来你们找到目标冰龙了。 仿佛为了宣告现身，它收拢的双翼缓缓脱离身体，随后猛然张开拍动，将积雪甩成明亮的粉尘云，远远飞散；它抖动身体，清除仍附着在鳞片上的全部残雪。六条腿带着近乎吃力而烦躁的动作，一条接一条从身下抬起，再重重踩入雪中；每条沉重肢体都会陷到脚踝所在的位置。距离太远，你看不清它的眼睛，却能看见头部，也能判断它正直直望着你[frostwyrm.andNykke |、妮可 ]和[frostwyrm.name]。 它还没有朝你们走来，你便听见一道悠长、低沉而洪亮的声音从推测是喉咙的位置传出 – 那声音仿佛一段旋律，以某个音符开始，随后平滑过渡到更高音调，最后又突然结束在比起始音更低的音符上。它迈出一只足，接着是另外五只；从行走变为小跑，再变为朝你们飞奔，同时用巨大双翼拍击雪原，加快速度。 像这样站在一条冲锋的冰龙面前，让你感觉有些毫无遮掩。[pc.isAss |但你守在原地：毕竟你曾在战斗中击败[frostwyrm.name]，而且不想在另一条冰龙面前示弱，尤其不想当着她的面。 |你曾多次在战斗中击败[frostwyrm.name]，可她从未带着这种意图向你逼近。你心里有一部分想至少设法躲开或做点什么 – 但意识中传来了某种感觉。一种平静而令人安心的力量；它让你挺直后背，集中精神。[frostwyrm.name]就在身边，她绝不会让任何事情发生在你身上。 ]

It’s not ten minutes before you’re joined by your draconic wi[frostwyrm.andNykke |ves |fe ]. Despite having just burst from the ocean, the water has already crystallized into ice droplets; when [frostwyrm.andNykke |she |they ] land, [frostwyrm.andNykke |they |she ] gives [frostwyrm.andNykke |their bodies |her body ] a shake, and all of the ice accumulated on [frostwyrm.andNykke |them |her ] flings off in every direction. Now that [frostwyrm.andNykke |they’re |she’s ] here, you ask what happens next. When you were in the lair, [frostwyrm.name] said that ‘her presence will draw them forward.’ It is as I instructed, [frostwyrm.name] replies, keeping her head lifted and her eyes scouring the snowy horizons for any sign of movement. The second existence is close. Their presence is unmistakable.[frostwyrm.andNykke | Nykke, in particular, seems interested in something towards your north. Her gaze is fixated on a larger dune of snow, its crest reaching up higher than your head. “That way, I think,” she says, pointing in the direction she’s facing with both of her right hands. “I think I feel them coming from that way.” ] Only a moment later, and you first hear a loud, deep woosh of noise, as if air were rushing to fill a sudden vacuum. You feel the snow rumble beneath your feet – the snow is too thick for you to be standing on the ground, and the snow shifts and jostles with the weight of something heavy moving on top of it. To the north, [frostwyrm.andNykke |the dune that Nykke was staring at |a tall snow dune, with its crest reaching higher than your head ] begins to shift: snow cascades down its sloped sides in thin sheets, piling up at the dune’s base as something inside it begins to stir. An elongated section of snow shifts and lifts into the air, reminding you almost of a leg with a stout, arrowhead-shaped foot – until you make out telltale horns with snow piling on top of their crooks, framing a long, thin snout beneath them. It seems you’ve found your Frostwyrm. As if to announce itself, its furled wings slowly peel from its body before violently flapping open, flinging snow in a bright, dusty cloud away from it as it shakes its body clean of all the remaining snow still clinging to its scales. With almost belabored and frustrated movements, its six legs lift out from underneath itself, one after the other, stamping into the snow and sinking down to where its ankles would be with each heavy limb. It’s too far away for you to see its eyes, but you can see its head, and you can tell that it’s looking directly at you[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name]. Before it makes its way towards you, you hear a long, deep, bellowing noise coming from what you presume to be its throat – a sort of lyrical sound that starts at one note, then smoothly transitions to a higher note, before ending suddenly on a lower note than it started with. Its massive wings beat against the snowy tundra as it puts one foot in front of the other five, walking, then cantering, then galloping towards you, using its wings to accelerate. You feel a bit exposed, standing in front of a charging Frostwyrm like this. [pc.isAss |But you hold your ground: you had bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat, after all, and you don’t want to appear weak in the face of another Frostwyrm, especially in front of her. |You had beaten [frostwyrm.name] in combat multiple times, but she never approached you with intent like this. A part of you wants to try and at least get out of the way or something – but you feel something in your psyche. Something calming and reassuring; something that straightens your back and heightens your focus. [frostwyrm.name] is with you, and she’d never let anything happen to you. ] "

rows.original: The second Frostwyrm approaches with thunderous stomps, the snow exploding around its feet every time they slam down. Just as you start to think that it’s not going to stop and you brace for impact, it plants four of its six feet into the snow and skids to a halt in front of you [frostwyrm.andNykke |three |two ], kicking up a wave of snow that only just manages to reach your ankles by the time it comes to a full rest. Before you stands a second Frostwyrm, just as you were anticipating. It is, in most ways, somewhat identical to [frostwyrm.name], in the same way that you’d be identical to another [pc.race] with the same color of [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]: white scales cover its upper body, with its softer, more malleable scales darkened to a deeper grey. Each of its six legs are capped with razor-sharp talons that could cut perfect lines through the ice. Its long, thick tail is capped with blunt spikes dotting its tip, better for bludgeoning than for piercing. Blue streaks dress its white scales all over, appearing almost as tattoos. But they’re all subtly different. The spikes on its tail are misshapen: some of them are shorter than others, and one of them is missing entirely. Its scales, particularly along the membranes of its wings, are pockmarked with grey scars, with some of them looking like they’ve been opened more than once. Chinks have been taken out of the talons on its feet, giving them an unnaturally serrated look. And the blue swirls on its body are significantly different from [frostwyrm.name]’s: rather than looking like swirls with stems, they look more like tree branches, with the patterns forking into multiple branches, and not all of them appear symmetrical – although it’s hard to tell if that’s because they’re hidden by scars. Its four red eyes train on [frostwyrm.name] with a familiar kind of intensity: it reminds you of when you and [frostwyrm.name] didn’t know each other, and she approached you with combative intent. Although there’s something different about this one’s posture: where [frostwyrm.name] came at you with wings spread and talons pointed forward, this one approaches with a shimmy in its hind hips and awkward posing in its upper half. Thick, low trills escape its throat occasionally as it regards [frostwyrm.name]. It almost looks like a mating dance. [frostwyrm.name], however, remains nonplussed: she sits on her haunches, her wings folded regally behind herself, watching this second Frostwyrm dance and jiggle in front of her like she was a queen watching a jester underperform in her court. Whatever noise or motion the second Frostwyrm makes, she remains wholly unimpressed and she doesn’t reciprocate any of them. After a moment of this, the second Frostwyrm stops, staring into [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes for a moment. You hear [frostwyrm.name] shift beside you, her head craning downwards to put herself beside you, but her eyes never leave the second Frostwyrm’s[frostwyrm.andNykke |. And, after a moment, she does the same to Nykke, leaning her body closer to yours so she can reach Nykke’s standing form ]. This must be [frostwyrm.name] introducing you[frostwyrm.andNykke | both ]. They will approach you, my Qal, as I had approached you, you hear her say – and she puts a weird amount of emphasis on the word ‘Qal.’ Let them. The second Frostwyrm’s eyes have gone from [frostwyrm.name]’s to yours. At first, it looks at you as though it didn’t notice you were there to begin with... but the change in body language is sudden and distinct. Its four red eyes stay on you, their lids widened, watching you for even the slightest twitch in your body. Its wings flex and strain, locked in a half-furled position, ready to pounce into the air at a moment’s notice. For all the world, it looks like it’s one step away from thrashing at you. [pc.isAss|Let it; you’re not scared. You’ve handled a Frostwyrm before and you’ll do it again.|You’ve handled Frostwyrms in combat before, and you’re ready to do it again... but you’re glad to have [frostwyrm.name] on your side. Beating her in a fight wasn’t exactly easy, after all.] The second Frostwyrm leans forward, its neck outstretched towards you, its pointed face closing the gap until it’s roughly a foot away from you. With an exhale through its flared nostrils, its steamy breath washes over your form, and, just like with [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ], you feel a strange tightness in your head and you see a throbbing in your vision – before everything dissipates and you see as clearly as you had before. Whelp, you hear a voice say – one utterly distinct from [frostwyrm.andNykke |either [frostwyrm.name] or Nykke |[frostwyrm.name] ], echoing in your head and bouncing between your ears. Its voice is low and powerful, while [frostwyrm.name]’s is slightly higher and more sonant. If you were to describe them as instruments, [frostwyrm.name]’s reminds you of an oboe, a smooth but low-pitched wind instrument, while this Frostwyrm’s voice reminds you of a war drum. You have laid claim to– Its voice bursts into a number of syllables consisting of hard consonants and trilling contractions that your mouth could never hope to reproduce. You recognize it as [frostwyrm.name]’s true name – this second Frostwyrm is confirming that you are [frostwyrm.name]’s mate. And you say that you have: you are [frostwyrm.andNykke |Qal not only to [frostwyrm.name], but to Nykke, as well |[frostwyrm.name]’s Qal. A relationship that she initially proposed ]. Its eyes pull away from you to lift back up to [frostwyrm.name]’s. Her posture has returned to the regal stance it was before: on her haunches, her back straightened to the point where she is looking down at it, perhaps deliberately. This is a mockery, it says. A jest. A canard. You, a Qim to... Its eyes go back to you, its snout curling inward so that its scales fold over themselves. It’s very close to bearing its fangs. This. With your mind tethered to this second Frostwyrm, you can feel the emotions flooding from it, unbidden, into your own psyche. There are a number of distinct feelings you can make out, including anger at the revelation and frustration that it had let itself get excited enough to immediately proposition [frostwyrm.name] with a mating dance. But, more than those, you feel... despondence. Despair. Where once there was loneliness and hollowness, there was, for a fleeting moment, hope that shone brightly and fiercely, once it had found another of its kind, only for that flame to instantly be snuffed when it learned that she was spoken for. By you. [pc.ra Frostwyrm |A shallow, insulting mockery of what a proper Frostwyrm ought to be. Not only did you claim the only viable mate on this part of the planet, but you’ve done it by appropriating her very body for yourself |Not even another Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] was driven so desperate for her need of a mate that she would debase herself by taking... whatever the hell it is you even are as a Qal ][frostwyrm.andNykke |. And not only [frostwyrm.name]: you had taken a half-breed into your clutch as well. And [frostwyrm.name] encouraged it! Here you are with two mates, both of them pumping Frostwyrm blood, and it with none ]. The emotions flooding into you change: at first, frustration; then, despair; and now, jealousy and spite. Its four red eyes stare at you with a certain darkness in their difficult-to-see pupils; its lids pull back far enough that you can nearly see the bend of their circumferences in their sockets. That sort of look reminds you not of a crazed animal, but a crazed person, ready to attack. You will calm yourself, [frostwyrm.name] says. A soothing sensation floods your body, starting at your shoulders and working its way down; as soon as she says the words, you feel yourself automatically respond. But the words clearly weren’t meant for you: they were meant for the other Frostwyrm, and the effect her words have are visible, but not nearly as well pronounced. Act as though you are under the eye of the Grand Qim. Hypocrite! the second Frostwyrm barks, lifting its head and opening its jaw to gutturally howl at [frostwyrm.name]. As though the Grand Qim would beseech you take a mongrel for a mate! The Grand Qim would not see us turn on each other in our mutual times of scarcity, [frostwyrm.name] answers, her composure as rock-steady as ever. Quell your frustrations. Our intent was to come to your aid. It has been innumerable Sky Cycles since either of us had seen another of our kind. Allow us to converse before you act. The second Frostwyrm flares its nostrils, its breath coming out ragged as though it had just come in from a heavy sprint. With a long, throaty sigh that starts rough but ends smoothly, it eventually relents, assuming a similar posture to [frostwyrm.name]: sittings on its haunches, its back straight, its wings furled up at its sides. But for all the calmness it’s trying to exude, there is an obvious line of irate impatience flowing from its psionic link into you. Converse, then, it grumbles. A low, echoing growl emanates from its throat. Its snout is pointed towards [frostwyrm.name], but its eyes are focused solely on you. It’s willing to talk, you can tell that that’s sincere – but you can’t be sure it’s willing to be reasoned with.
rows.translation: 第二条霜龙迈着雷鸣般的步伐逼近，每次巨足砸落，周围的积雪都会轰然炸开。就在你开始怀疑它根本不会停下、已经准备承受撞击时，它把六只脚中的四只扎进雪地，在你们[frostwyrm.andNykke |三人 |二人 ]面前滑行停下，掀起一道雪浪；等它完全静止时，那片雪花刚好漫到你的脚踝。 正如预料，站在你面前的是第二条霜龙。它在大多数方面与[frostwyrm.name]颇为相似，就像你会和另一名拥有相同[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]颜色的[pc.race]相似一样：白色鳞片覆盖上半身，较为柔软、富有韧性的鳞片则呈更深的灰色。六条腿都长着剃刀般锋利的爪子，足以在冰面切出完美直线。粗长尾巴末端点缀着钝刺，比起穿刺更适合用来敲打。蓝色条纹遍布白色鳞片，看起来几乎就像文身。 然而各处细节都有所不同。它尾端的尖刺形状不一：有些比其他的短，其中一根甚至完全缺失。它的鳞片，尤其是翼膜附近，布满灰色伤疤，有些看起来不止一次裂开过。脚爪上崩掉了几块，显出不自然的锯齿形状。身体上的蓝色旋纹也与[frostwyrm.name]明显不同：它们不像带柄旋涡，更像树枝，图案分叉出多条枝桠，而且并非全部对称——不过很难判断这是否只是因为部分图案被伤疤遮住。 它的四只红眼睛以一种熟悉的强烈目光盯住[frostwyrm.name]：这让你想起自己与[frostwyrm.name]尚不相识、她怀着战意接近你的时候。不过这条霜龙的姿态有些不同：[frostwyrm.name]当时张开双翼、利爪前伸地向你逼近，而这条霜龙却摇晃着后胯，上半身笨拙地摆出各种姿势。它打量[frostwyrm.name]时，喉中偶尔发出低沉浑厚的颤鸣。看起来几乎像是一支求偶舞。 然而[frostwyrm.name]毫无反应：她后腿坐地，双翼威严地收拢在身后，看着第二条霜龙在面前舞动摇摆，仿佛一位女王正在宫廷里观看小丑拙劣的表演。无论对方发出什么声音、做出什么动作，她都毫不动容，也没有作出任何回应。 片刻后，第二条霜龙停了下来，凝视着[frostwyrm.name]的眼睛。你听见身旁的[frostwyrm.name]挪动身体，低下头与自己并肩，但目光始终没有离开第二条霜龙[frostwyrm.andNykke |。过了一会儿，她也对妮琪做出同样动作，身体靠近你这边，好让脑袋能够抵达站立的妮琪身旁 ]。这一定是[frostwyrm.name]在介绍你们[frostwyrm.andNykke |两人 ]。 它会像我曾经那样接近你，我的Qal，你听见她说道——而且她把“Qal”一词强调得有些奇怪。让它来。 第二条霜龙的目光从[frostwyrm.name]移到了你身上。起初，它看你的样子仿佛此前根本没有注意到你的存在...但肢体语言的变化突然而鲜明。四只红眼睛牢牢锁定你，眼睑大张，监视着你身体哪怕最轻微的抽动。双翼弯曲绷紧，以半收拢姿态僵在那里，随时准备腾空扑击。无论怎么看，它似乎距离暴起攻击只差一步。 [pc.isAss|让它来；你才不怕。以前能对付一条霜龙，现在一样能做到。|你曾在战斗中对付过霜龙，也准备再来一次...不过有[frostwyrm.name]站在身边，你还是感到庆幸。毕竟当初战胜她绝不轻松。] 第二条霜龙俯身向前，脖颈朝你伸展，尖长面孔逐渐逼近，直到距离你大约一英尺。它张开鼻孔呼出一口气，蒸腾吐息掠过你的身体；就像面对[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |和妮琪 ]时一样，你感觉脑中奇怪地紧绷起来，视野也随之搏动——随后一切消散，眼前又恢复先前的清晰。 幼崽，你听见一道声音说道——它与[frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name]和妮琪两者 |[frostwyrm.name] ]都截然不同，在脑海中回响，又在双耳之间反弹。它的声音低沉有力，[frostwyrm.name]的声音则略高一些，更加洪亮悦耳。若把两者比作乐器，[frostwyrm.name]会让你想到双簧管，一种音色平滑而低沉的管乐器；这条霜龙的声音则像战鼓。你已经宣称拥有—— 它的声音猛然化作一连串由坚硬辅音和颤音缩合组成的音节，你的嘴巴永远不可能将其复现。你认出那是[frostwyrm.name]的真名——第二条霜龙是在确认，你就是[frostwyrm.name]的伴侣。你回答的确如此：你不仅是[frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name]的Qal，也是妮琪的Qal |[frostwyrm.name]的Qal。而且这段关系最初是她提出的 ]。 它把目光从你身上移开，重新抬头看向[frostwyrm.name]。她已经恢复先前那副威严姿态：后腿坐地，后背挺得笔直，几乎是在俯视对方，或许还是故意如此。 这是一场闹剧，它说道。一个笑话。一派胡言。你，一名Qim，竟然和...它重新看向你，口鼻向内皱缩，鳞片也彼此叠起，几乎就要露出獠牙。这种东西。 心灵与第二条霜龙相连后，你能感觉到它的情绪不受控制地涌入自己的意识。你可以分辨出许多鲜明感受，包括得知真相后的愤怒，以及因为过于兴奋、刚见面便用求偶舞向[frostwyrm.name]示爱而产生的懊恼。然而比这些更强烈的是...沮丧。绝望。原本只有孤独与空虚；当它发现另一名同族时，希望曾短暂而猛烈地燃烧起来，却又在得知她已有归属的瞬间熄灭。 而她属于你。[pc.ra Frostwyrm |你只是对真正霜龙的浅薄而侮辱性的仿造品。你不只抢走了这颗星球上唯一合适的伴侣，还挪用了她的身体，把自己变成这副模样 |你甚至不是另一条霜龙；[frostwyrm.name]对伴侣的需求已经绝望到不惜贬低自己，让...无论你究竟是什么鬼东西来充当Qal ][frostwyrm.andNykke |。而且不只是[frostwyrm.name]：你甚至还把一个混血种纳入伴侣群体，[frostwyrm.name]居然也鼓励这样做！你拥有两个伴侣，两者体内都流着霜龙血脉，而它却一个都没有 ]。 涌入你的情绪发生了变化：先是懊恼，继而绝望，如今则变成嫉妒与怨恨。它的四只红眼睛盯着你，难以看清的瞳孔中透着某种阴暗；眼睑向后拉得极开，你几乎能看见眼球在眼窝中的弯曲轮廓。那种目光不会让你想到疯狂野兽，而是想到一个疯狂的人，随时准备发动攻击。 冷静下来，[frostwyrm.name]说道。一股安抚感从肩头开始涌遍全身，逐渐向下蔓延；她刚一说出这句话，你就感觉自己下意识作出反应。然而这番话显然不是对你说的，而是说给另一条霜龙听。她的话确实产生了肉眼可见的效果，却远没有在你身上那么明显。就当至高Qim正在注视着你。 伪君子！第二条霜龙吼道，抬起脑袋，张开下颚，朝[frostwyrm.name]发出低沉咆哮。难道至高Qim会恳求你把一个杂种当作伴侣吗！ 在彼此共同面对匮乏的时代，至高Qim绝不会希望我们自相残杀，[frostwyrm.name]回答，镇定依旧如磐石般牢固。平息你的懊恼。我们本想前来帮助你。我们已经度过无数个天穹周期，未曾见到其他同族。请在行动之前，先容我们交谈。 第二条霜龙张开鼻孔，呼吸凌乱，仿佛刚结束一场全力冲刺。它发出一声漫长而低沉的喉音叹息，起初粗粝，末尾却逐渐平稳，最终还是让步，摆出与[frostwyrm.name]相似的姿态：后腿坐地，挺直脊背，双翼收拢在身体两侧。不过尽管它竭力表现平静，一股暴躁不耐的情绪仍沿着心灵连接清晰地流入你的意识。 那就谈吧，它咕哝道，喉中发出低沉回荡的咆哮。口鼻朝向[frostwyrm.name]，眼睛却只盯着你。你能看出它确实愿意交谈——但是否愿意听从道理，就无法确定了。
