Whatever noise or motion the second Frostwyrm makes, she remains wholly unimpressed and she doesn’t reciprocate any of them. After a moment of this, the second Frostwyrm stops, staring into [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes for a moment. You hear [frostwyrm.name] shift beside you, her head craning downwards to put herself beside you, but her eyes never leave the second Frostwyrm’s[frostwyrm.andNykke |. And, after a moment, she does the same to Nykke, leaning her body closer to yours so she can reach Nykke’s standing form ]. This must be [frostwyrm.name] introducing you[frostwyrm.andNykke | both ]. They will approach you, my Qal, as I had approached you, you hear her say – and she puts a weird amount of emphasis on the word ‘Qal.’ Let them. The second Frostwyrm’s eyes have gone from [frostwyrm.name]’s to yours. At first, it looks at you as though it didn’t notice you were there to begin with... but the change in body language is sudden and distinct. Its four red eyes stay on you, their lids widened, watching you for even the slightest twitch in your body. Its wings flex and strain, locked in a half-furled position, ready to pounce into the air at a moment’s notice. For all the world, it looks like it’s one step away from thrashing at you. [pc.isAss|Let it; you’re not scared. You’ve handled a Frostwyrm before and you’ll do it again.|You’ve handled Frostwyrms in combat before, and you’re ready to do it again... but you’re glad to have [frostwyrm.name] on your side. Beating her in a fight wasn’t exactly easy, after all.] The second Frostwyrm leans forward, its neck outstretched towards you, its pointed face closing the gap until it’s roughly a foot away from you. With an exhale through its flared nostrils, its steamy breath washes over your form, and, just like with [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ], you feel a strange tightness in your head and you see a throbbing in your vision – before everything dissipates and you see as clearly as you had before. Whelp, you hear a voice say – one utterly distinct from [frostwyrm.andNykke |either [frostwyrm.name] or Nykke |[frostwyrm.name] ], echoing in your head and bouncing between your ears. Its voice is low and powerful, while [frostwyrm.name]’s is slightly higher and more sonant. If you were to describe them as instruments, [frostwyrm.name]’s reminds you of an oboe, a smooth but low-pitched wind instrument, while this Frostwyrm’s voice reminds you of a war drum. You have laid claim to– Its voice bursts into a number of syllables consisting of hard consonants and trilling contractions that your mouth could never hope to reproduce. You recognize it as [frostwyrm.name]’s true name – this second Frostwyrm is confirming that you are [frostwyrm.name]’s mate. And you say that you have: you are [frostwyrm.andNykke |Qal not only to [frostwyrm.name], but to Nykke, as well |[frostwyrm.name]’s Qal. A relationship that she initially proposed ]. Its eyes pull away from you to lift back up to [frostwyrm.name]’s. Her posture has returned to the regal stance it was before: on her haunches, her back straightened to the point where she is looking down at it, perhaps deliberately. This is a mockery, it says. A jest. A canard. You, a Qim to... Its eyes go back to you, its snout curling inward so that its scales fold over themselves. It’s very close to bearing its fangs. This. With your mind tethered to this second Frostwyrm, you can feel the emotions flooding from it, unbidden, into your own psyche. There are a number of distinct feelings you can make out, including anger at the revelation and frustration that it had let itself get excited enough to immediately proposition [frostwyrm.name] with a mating dance. But, more than those, you feel... despondence. Despair. Where once there was loneliness and hollowness, there was, for a fleeting moment, hope that shone brightly and fiercely, once it had found another of its kind, only for that flame to instantly be snuffed when it learned that she was spoken for. By you. [pc.ra Frostwyrm |A shallow, insulting mockery of what a proper Frostwyrm ought to be. Not only did you claim the only viable mate on this part of the planet, but you’ve done it by appropriating her very body for yourself |Not even another Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] was driven so desperate for her need of a mate that she would debase herself by taking... whatever the hell it is you even are as a Qal ][frostwyrm.andNykke |. And not only [frostwyrm.name]: you had taken a half-breed into your clutch as well. And [frostwyrm.name] encouraged it! Here you are with two mates, both of them pumping Frostwyrm blood, and it with none ]. The emotions flooding into you change: at first, frustration; then, despair; and now, jealousy and spite. Its four red eyes stare at you with a certain darkness in their difficult-to-see pupils; its lids pull back far enough that you can nearly see the bend of their circumferences in their sockets. That sort of look reminds you not of a crazed animal, but a crazed person, ready to attack. You will calm yourself, [frostwyrm.name] says. A soothing sensation floods your body, starting at your shoulders and working its way down; as soon as she says the words, you feel yourself automatically respond. But the words clearly weren’t meant for you: they were meant for the other Frostwyrm, and the effect her words have are visible, but not nearly as well pronounced. Act as though you are under the eye of the Grand Qim. Hypocrite! the second Frostwyrm barks, lifting its head and opening its jaw to gutturally howl at [frostwyrm.name]. As though the Grand Qim would beseech you take a mongrel for a mate! The Grand Qim would not see us turn on each other in our mutual times of scarcity, [frostwyrm.name] answers, her composure as rock-steady as ever. Quell your frustrations. Our intent was to come to your aid. It has been innumerable Sky Cycles since either of us had seen another of our kind. Allow us to converse before you act. The second Frostwyrm flares its nostrils, its breath coming out ragged as though it had just come in from a heavy sprint. With a long, throaty sigh that starts rough but ends smoothly, it eventually relents, assuming a similar posture to [frostwyrm.name]: sittings on its haunches, its back straight, its wings furled up at its sides. But for all the calmness it’s trying to exude, there is an obvious line of irate impatience flowing from its psionic link into you. Converse, then, it grumbles. A low, echoing growl emanates from its throat. Its snout is pointed towards [frostwyrm.name], but its eyes are focused solely on you. It’s willing to talk, you can tell that that’s sincere – but you can’t be sure it’s willing to be reasoned with. "

rows.original: It’s a fact, as unfortunate as it is, that the Frostwyrms are going extinct. It was no small miracle that you had found [frostwyrm.name] at all, and you[frostwyrm.andNykke | three | and her ] only found the second Frostwyrm after hearing rumors that it existed at all. [frostwyrm.name] frequently reminds you that you weren’t her first choice as her mate, and she only chose you because you had proven yourself a viable mate. I already have queries, the Frostwyrm interrupts. Who or what is [frostwyrm.name]? Your mouth can’t pronounce [frostwyrm.name]’s true name – hell, with how you intrinsically understand languages, your brain can hardly do it – so she had resolved to allowing you to give her a name that you could pronounce. And you thought [frostwyrm.name] was a fitting name for her. The Frostwyrm snorts, its nostril crinkling along its muzzle as before, looking for all the world that it had just smelt a rancid pile of shit in front of it. Second, it continues, ‘she’ and ‘her’ – what are these words you insist on using? [frostwyrm.name] answers before you can. The [pc.race] mind, while labyrinthian, can be explored as ours can. Their languages are at once wanting and lacking, yet nuanced and specific, compared and contrasted to our own. If there are words you do not understand, you may explore my Qal’s thoughts for their definitions. Then, with emphasis, she adds, and nothing else. Unbidden, you feel the familiar pressure in your mind as [frostwyrm.name] scours your thoughts for your memories – and then, a second, heavier, and more directionless pressure is added on top of hers, giving you the wholly unpleasant sensation of your brain being too heavy for your skull. The second pressure ‘feels’ different: it’s similar to the different texture between sand and powdered snow, where one is coarser and less free-flowing than the other[frostwyrm.andNykke |. You’ve had more than one Frostwyrm in your head before – and, during sex, the mind-melding can get pretty intense – but both [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke had experience reading your mind up until that point. This second Frostwyrm intrudes into your thoughts the same way a battering ram intrudes into a door |; you remember [frostwyrm.name] not being especially gentle with her mind reading when she first started out, too. Hopefully this one just needs a bit of teaching to get used to it ]. Eventually, after having its fill rummaging through your head for your memories, you feel one of the pressures, [frostwyrm.name]’s, leave your head. The second one takes a moment longer to leave... or, perhaps, [frostwyrm.name] forcefully pulled it out. It is a wonder of the world that kinds like yours exist with such unfocused thoughts, the second Frostwyrm thrums. It lowers its head towards you, its snout bumping into your chest, not cruelly, but in an attempt to size you up. And yet you are the Qal. The duty of the Qal is to pass on the knowledge and teachings of prior generations onto the kips. Despite my misgivings, I assume this is not a mistake. You had said earlier that [frostwyrm.name] chose you because you had proven yourself to be a viable mate. She only came to that conclusion after you had defeated her. Multiple times. In single combat. From the tone in its voice, it doesn’t believe you, but, yes. You did it alone. The second Frostwyrm says nothing. It sits back onto its haunches, mimicking [frostwyrm.name]’s posture once again, and turns its red eyes towards her, looking to her to confirm what it clearly thinks is an absolutely outrageous claim. After all, it is true that [frostwyrm.name] is several times your height, and many multiple times your weight. It is true, she confirms. [pc.name] is much smaller than us. I had reasoned that any [pc.hasCock |virile[pc.isHerm | and fertile ] |fertile ] creature that was capable of downing a being like myself so consistently had a far greater understanding of the world than I possessed, and would therefore make an excellent Qal. A light, trilling thrum emanates from her chest. My conclusion has been correct so far.[frostwyrm.andNykke | The second Frostwyrm turns its gaze towards Nykke, standing notably shorter than [frostwyrm.name][pc.heightRange 0 108 |, although still significantly taller than you ]. And you? it asks, its tone halfway between exasperation and disbelief in the scenario it’s found itself in. Are you the same? Did you challenge this creature to single combat and lose badly enough that you chose to mate with it? Nykke twists her mouth and furrows her brow at its choice in words. “The truth is that I met our Qal in the snowbanks where [frostwyrm.name] was brooding, just like you had,” she answers verbally. “Our kind is dying out. I had the choice of either joining their clutch and becoming a second Qim to our Qal, or to keep wandering the world in the hopes that I’d find another viable mate for myself.” She turns her head to one side and lowers her eyelids. “The same choice you’re facing right now.” Our plights are not the same, it answers, the edges of its scaly mouth curving upward in disdain. “I can tell that you’ve seen a lot of fighting, but from the layers on your horns and talons, you’re not as old as either me or [frostwyrm.name],” Nykke says back. Despite the conviction in her words, she speaks as though she’s working through a lump in her throat. “We’ve been looking for mates longer than you have. We know exactly what you’re going through.” ] The second Frostwyrm turns its eyes to you, then to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |, then to Nykke, then back to [frostwyrm.name] one final time ].[frostwyrm.andNykke | You are suggesting I do what you two have done, it concludes. To join your clutch as a third Qim to this apparent specimen. It is an unusual arrangement, [frostwyrm.name] concedes. There were initial difficulties. Yet the alternative is to continue to weigh your odds against the endless expanse of the world to find a mate for yourself. | What is it you are suggesting, then? it asks, its patience beginning to wear thin in its tone. Unless the purpose of your finding me is to mock me that this neophyte has what I cannot have. [frostwyrm.name] takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, her massive lungs flexing with all of that air inside them. Like it as not, the world is vacant of our kind, she answers. We are not given the luxury of options, nor the fortune of plenty as our bearers once did. Our kind take only one mate, yet... we have been given a challenge, and, by the grace of the Grand Qim or not, we have been given a solution. One that will be initially uncomfortable for us both. The second Frostwyrm tilts its head in confusion at what [frostwyrm.name] could mean... before its eyes suddenly widen in understanding. ] I would be neither Qim nor Qal to my own clutch, the second Frostwyrm says, bereaved. I would all but be given the title of Qer. A scrounger – a parasite, depending on the charity of a kind that has been claimed, and the apparent knowledge of this cross-breeding interloper you have brought before me.[frostwyrm.andNykke | You feel the anger flare from Nykke through your connection to her before you hear her words or see her actions. “You need to shut the fuck up,” Nykke gnashes suddenly, lifting her upper right arm and pointing a finger at the second Frostwyrm. “My own Qal was a ‘cross-breeder,’ too, and if I’m not a Qim to [pc.name], that makes me a Qer, according to you. And I am not a Qer. You’re sitting there, thinking you’re too good for me or [pc.name], but from where we are, you’re the one without a clutch or a mate and you’re the one getting upset at the idea of having anything if it means sharing.” You lift your hand to Nykke’s, gently resting your palm on her raised hand to get her to lower it. The less tensions there are in the air, the better. She lowers her hand – eventually, and slowly. The second Frostwyrm’s posture remains static and difficult to read, but you can at least tell that it’s watching Nykke and listening to her words. “I hunt; I bring food back to the home; I’ve made myself a lair; and I raise the kips that we have reared together. I’m as much a proper Qim as [frostwyrm.name] is. It’s been Sky Cycles since any of us has seen another of our kind; if you want to have any sort of closure in your life, you need to accept that you might never–” Nykke catches herself, unwilling to finish the thought. It’s not a truth that she wants to face, and as soon as the last word hangs in the air, you can feel it from both [frostwyrm.name] and the second Frostwyrm as well: uncomfortable apprehension. Knowing that there’s a truth they must face – a line they must cross – but they’re focusing on anything and everything else to keep from facing it. | Cease with the vile rhetoric! [frostwyrm.name]’s voice bellows in your head. For the first time since you had started, her posture breaks: the hackles of her foremost limbs breach upward and she lowers her head, looking as though she’s readying herself to lunge, if it weren’t for her lowered rump. There is no worthier being in this world than [pc.name] as my Qal. We had come in search of you to offer a respite from the ugly reality of our predicament. It is no small sacrifice on my part to offer you a place in my nest – near our clutch, need I remind you! The barest of compliments you will yield is the respect we are due! ] Everyone’s been taking the conversation in a very roundabout manner so far, so, although you realize the tensions are high and you’re not exactly the second Frostwyrm’s role model, you try to boil down the situation as best as you can: there aren’t a lot of Frostwyrms left on Uveto. You had taken [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke as mates | as a mate ] and you had raised a[var0 | | small ] clutch with [frostwyrm.andNykke |them |her ] before you had realized that there was a second Frostwyrm wandering the plains nearby. You realize that this isn’t how Frostwyrms do things, and that it’s hurt and confused and desperate to have a normal life with a normal family, but the Frostwyrms are facing a harsh reality right now. You[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name] are willing to take it into your family and give it a home. And give it any other accommodations it might require. The second Frostwyrm remains still for a moment before eventually rotating its head to one side. A clutch? it asks. We had spoken of mates, and Qims and Qals, and combat prowess, though this is the first time offspring has been mentioned[frostwyrm.andNykke |. Though I suppose I should have assumed interbreeding was possible, given the third party ]. Its red eyes fixate on you and it leans forward, its snout coming within a foot from your body. All four red eyes focus on you, but on different parts of you, with the eyeballs moving to scan different limbs for any sudden movements. Allow me to see what you know of clutches. You feel the familiar cloying in your mind, of an alien presence trying to force its way into your memories. It’s as unrefined as it was previously: intent, vehement, and without any technique. It’s as uncomfortable as it was before and you can’t help but wince and reach for your head. As soon as you do, though, you feel [frostwyrm.andNykke |both Nykke and ][frostwyrm.name]’s presence alongside it, trying to guide it and refine it so that it’s not nearly as intense. It helps; the presence in your mind becomes more focused and specific, but still without any finesse, trying to force its way through you. Your linguistic skills need improvement, [frostwyrm.name] chastises, but does not try to force the second Frostwyrm out of your head like she had before.
rows.translation: 尽管令人遗憾，但霜龙正在灭绝，这是事实。能找到[frostwyrm.name]本身就是不小的奇迹，而你们[frostwyrm.andNykke |三人 |二人 ]也是在听到它可能存在的传闻后，才找到第二条霜龙。[frostwyrm.name]经常提醒你，你并非她选择伴侣时的首选；她只是因为你证明了自己是合适伴侣，才最终选中你。 我已经有问题了，霜龙打断道。[frostwyrm.name]是谁，或者是什么？ 你的嘴巴无法念出[frostwyrm.name]的真名——见鬼，就算凭着自己对语言的本能理解，大脑也很难处理那些音节——所以她最终允许你给她起一个能够念出的名字。你认为[frostwyrm.name]很适合她。 霜龙哼了一声，鼻孔像之前一样沿着口鼻皱起，那副神情仿佛刚在面前闻到一大堆腐烂粪便。第二，它继续道，“她”和“她的”——你为什么坚持使用这些词？ 你还没来得及回答，[frostwyrm.name]便先开口。[pc.race]的思想虽然如迷宫般复杂，却也能像我们的思想一样受到探索。他们的语言与我们的语言相比，既有匮乏也有缺失，却又细腻而具体。如果遇到不理解的词语，你可以探索我的Qal的思绪，寻找定义。随后，她又加重语气补充道：除此之外，什么都不许看。 熟悉的压力毫无预警地出现在脑海中，[frostwyrm.name]开始翻找你的思绪、搜寻记忆——随后第二股更加沉重、也更加漫无方向的压力叠了上来，令你产生一种大脑对头骨来说过于沉重的难受感觉。第二股压力的“触感”有所不同：就像沙粒与粉雪的质地区别，一个更加粗糙，也不如另一个容易流动[frostwyrm.andNykke |。以前也不止一条霜龙同时进入过你的脑袋——而且在性爱过程中，精神融合可能变得相当激烈——但直到那时，[frostwyrm.name]与妮琪都已经有过读取你思想的经验。这第二条霜龙闯进思想的方式，就像攻城锤撞进一扇门 |；你还记得[frostwyrm.name]刚开始读取思想时也不怎么温柔。希望这条霜龙只需稍加指导便能适应 ]。 它终于在你脑中翻找够了记忆，你感觉其中一股压力，也就是[frostwyrm.name]的压力，离开了脑袋。第二股压力又停留了一会儿...或者说，是[frostwyrm.name]强行把它拉了出去。 你们这种生物思想如此涣散，竟然还能存在于世，真是世界奇迹，第二条霜龙低声颤鸣。它朝你低下脑袋，口鼻撞上胸口，并非出于恶意，只是想估量你的能耐。可你却是Qal。Qal的职责是把先代的知识与教诲传给幼崽。尽管我心存疑虑，但想来这并非错误。 你之前说过，[frostwyrm.name]选择你，是因为你曾经证明自己是合适伴侣。她是在你击败她后才得出这个结论的。而且不止一次。 在单独战斗中。 从它的语气来看，它并不相信你，但事实的确如此。你独自完成了这一切。 第二条霜龙一言不发。它重新以后腿坐下，再次模仿[frostwyrm.name]的姿态，把红眼睛转向她，等她证实这个在它看来完全荒谬的说法。毕竟[frostwyrm.name]的身高确实是你的数倍，体重更是你的许多倍。 这是真的，她确认道。[pc.name]比我们小得多。我当时认为，任何[pc.hasCock |精力旺盛[pc.isHerm |而且富有生育力 ] |富有生育力 ]、又能如此稳定地击倒我这种存在的生物，必然比我更加了解这个世界，因此会成为优秀的Qal。她胸中传出轻柔颤鸣。到目前为止，我的结论一直正确。[frostwyrm.andNykke | 第二条霜龙把目光转向妮琪；她站在[frostwyrm.name]身旁，个子明显更矮[pc.heightRange 0 108 |，不过依然比你高出许多 ]。那你呢？它问道；面对眼下局面，它的语气介于恼火与难以置信之间。你也是一样吗？你向这个生物发起单独挑战，然后输得一败涂地，于是决定与它交配？ 妮琪听见这种措辞后，撇起嘴、皱紧眉头。“事实是，我在[frostwyrm.name]孵蛋的雪原上遇见了我们的Qal，就像你一样，”她用声音回答。“我们的种族正在灭绝。我只有两个选择：加入他们的伴侣群体，成为我们Qal的第二名Qim；或者继续在世间游荡，期待能为自己找到另一个合适伴侣。”她把脑袋转向一侧，垂下眼睑。“也就是你现在面临的选择。” 我们的处境并不相同，它回答，鳞片覆盖的嘴角轻蔑地向上弯起。 “我看得出你经历过许多战斗，但从角与爪的层纹来看，你没有我或[frostwyrm.name]年长，”妮琪回答。尽管话语坚定，她说起话来却仿佛喉中堵着什么。“我们寻找伴侣的时间比你更久。我们完全明白你正在经历什么。” ] 第二条霜龙先看向你，接着看向[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |，再看向妮琪，最后又一次看向[frostwyrm.name] ]。[frostwyrm.andNykke |你们是在建议我照你们的做法去做，它总结道。加入你们的伴侣群体，成为这个所谓优秀样本的第三名Qim。 这是一种不同寻常的安排，[frostwyrm.name]承认道。最初的确遇到了一些困难。但另一个选择，便是继续在无尽世界中权衡自己的机会，寻找属于你的伴侣。 |那么你究竟是在建议什么？它问道，语气里的耐心开始消磨殆尽。除非你找到我的目的，只是嘲笑这个初出茅庐的家伙拥有我无法拥有的东西。 [frostwyrm.name]用鼻子深深叹了一口气，巨大肺部因吸入的空气而膨胀。无论喜欢与否，这个世界都已没有多少我们的同族，她回答。我们没有选择的奢侈，也不像先辈那样拥有众多同族的幸运。我们一生只选择一名伴侣，可是...我们面对着一项挑战，而无论是否出于至高Qim的恩典，我们也得到了一种解决办法。只不过最初会让我们双方都不自在。 第二条霜龙困惑地歪起脑袋，不明白[frostwyrm.name]的意思...随后眼睛骤然睁大，显然已经理解。 ]在自己的伴侣群体里，我既不是Qim，也不是Qal，第二条霜龙悲痛地说道。我几乎只会得到Qer的称号。一个拾荒者——一个寄生者，仰赖已经被人宣称拥有的同族施舍，也仰赖你带到我面前的这个杂交闯入者所谓的知识。[frostwyrm.andNykke | 你先从心灵连接中感到妮琪的怒火，随后才听见她的话、看见她的动作。“你他妈该闭嘴了，”妮琪猛然咬牙说道，抬起右上臂，用手指着第二条霜龙。“我以前的Qal也是‘杂交者’；照你的说法，如果我不是[pc.name]的Qim，那我就是Qer。而我不是Qer。你坐在那里，觉得自己比我或[pc.name]更加高贵；但从我们的角度来看，你才是那个既没有伴侣群体也没有伴侣的人，你才是一想到拥有某种东西就必须与人分享，便大发脾气的家伙。” 你把手抬向妮琪，掌心轻轻放在她举起的手上，示意她放下。空气中的紧张越少越好。她最终缓慢地垂下了手。第二条霜龙的姿态仍旧静止，难以解读，但至少你能看出它正注视妮琪，也在倾听她的话。 “我狩猎，把食物带回家；我建立了自己的巢穴；我还抚养我们共同孕育的幼崽。我和[frostwyrm.name]一样，都是名副其实的Qim。我们已经度过许多个天穹周期，未曾见到其他同族；如果你想让自己的人生得到某种圆满，就必须接受你也许永远不会——” 妮琪及时停住，不愿把那个念头说完。她不想面对这个事实；最后一个词刚刚悬在空气中，你便同时从[frostwyrm.name]和第二条霜龙身上感到同一种不安：它们知道有一个必须面对的事实——一条必须跨越的界线——却专注于其他所有事物，竭力避免真正面对它。 | 停止这种卑劣言辞！[frostwyrm.name]的声音在你脑中轰鸣。自从对话开始以来，她第一次失去威严姿态：最前方肢体上的鬃毛向上竖起，她压低脑袋，若非臀部仍然伏低，看起来简直已经准备扑击。这个世界上，没有任何存在比[pc.name]更有资格成为我的Qal。我们前来寻找你，是为了让你暂时摆脱所处困境的丑陋现实。我愿意让你进入自己的巢穴——而且是在我们的幼崽附近，我必须提醒你——这对我而言绝非微小牺牲！你必须作出的最起码让步，就是给予我们应得的尊重！ ] 到目前为止，所有人都在绕着弯子交谈。因此，尽管你明白气氛相当紧张，而且自己在第二条霜龙眼中绝非榜样，你还是努力尽可能简单地概括现状：乌维托已经没有多少霜龙。你将[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |和妮琪收为伴侣 |收为伴侣 ]，并在意识到附近平原还有第二条霜龙游荡以前，共同养育过一窝[var0 | |规模不大 ]的幼崽；参与养育的是[frostwyrm.andNykke |她们 |她 ]。 你知道霜龙通常不会这样生活，也明白它正因渴望正常生活与正常家庭而受伤、困惑、绝望，但霜龙如今正面对残酷现实。你[frostwyrm.andNykke |、妮琪 ]与[frostwyrm.name]愿意接纳它进入家庭，给它一个家，也愿意提供它可能需要的其他一切安排。 第二条霜龙静止片刻，最终把脑袋转向一旁。一窝幼崽？它问道。我们谈论过伴侣、Qim、Qal和战斗能力，但这是第一次提到后代[frostwyrm.andNykke |。不过既然还有第三方存在，我想自己本该料到跨种族繁殖是可行的 ]。它的红眼睛牢牢盯住你，并向前俯身，口鼻来到距离身体一英尺以内的位置。四只红眼睛全都注视着你，却分别落在不同部位；眼球不断移动，扫描各条肢体，警惕任何突然动作。让我看看你对养育幼崽知道些什么。 脑中再次泛起熟悉的黏滞感，某个异质存在正试图强行闯入记忆。它和先前一样毫无修饰：专注、猛烈，而且完全没有技巧。这种感觉与之前一样难受，你忍不住皱起脸，伸手去捂脑袋。 不过就在你抬手时，你感觉[frostwyrm.andNykke |妮琪和 ][frostwyrm.name]的意识也出现在它旁边，试图引导并打磨对方的方式，使其不再那么强烈。这样确实有效；脑中的存在变得更加集中具体，却仍毫无细腻可言，继续强行在你的思想中穿行。你的语言能力有待提升，[frostwyrm.name]斥责道，却没有像先前那样试图把第二条霜龙赶出你的脑袋。
rows.raw: " It’s a fact, as unfortunate as it is, that the Frostwyrms are going extinct. It was no small miracle that you had found [frostwyrm.name] at all, and you[frostwyrm.andNykke | three | and her ] only found the second Frostwyrm after hearing rumors that it existed at all. [frostwyrm.name] frequently reminds you that you weren’t her first choice as her mate, and she only chose you because you had proven yourself a viable mate. I already have queries, the Frostwyrm interrupts. Who or what is [frostwyrm.name]? Your mouth can’t pronounce [frostwyrm.name]’s true name – hell, with how you intrinsically understand languages, your brain can hardly do it – so she had resolved to allowing you to give her a name that you could pronounce. And you thought [frostwyrm.name] was a fitting name for her. The Frostwyrm snorts, its nostril crinkling along its muzzle as before, looking for all the world that it had just smelt a rancid pile of shit in front of it. Second, it continues, ‘she’ and ‘her’ – what are these words you insist on using? [frostwyrm.name] answers before you can. The [pc.race] mind, while labyrinthian, can be explored as ours can. Their languages are at once wanting and lacking, yet nuanced and specific, compared and contrasted to our own. If there are words you do not understand, you may explore my Qal’s thoughts for their definitions. Then, with emphasis, she adds, and nothing else. Unbidden, you feel the familiar pressure in your mind as [frostwyrm.name] scours your thoughts for your memories – and then, a second, heavier, and more directionless pressure is added on top of hers, giving you the wholly unpleasant sensation of your brain being too heavy for your skull. The second pressure ‘feels’ different: it’s similar to the different texture between sand and powdered snow, where one is coarser and less free-flowing than the other[frostwyrm.andNykke |. You’ve had more than one Frostwyrm in your head before – and, during sex, the mind-melding can get pretty intense – but both [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke had experience reading your mind up until that point. This second Frostwyrm intrudes into your thoughts the same way a battering ram intrudes into a door |; you remember [frostwyrm.name] not being especially gentle with her mind reading when she first started out, too. Hopefully this one just needs a bit of teaching to get used to it ]. Eventually, after having its fill rummaging through your head for your memories, you feel one of the pressures, [frostwyrm.name]’s, leave your head. The second one takes a moment longer to leave... or, perhaps, [frostwyrm.name] forcefully pulled it out. It is a wonder of the world that kinds like yours exist with such unfocused thoughts, the second Frostwyrm thrums. It lowers its head towards you, its snout bumping into your chest, not cruelly, but in an attempt to size you up. And yet you are the Qal. The duty of the Qal is to pass on the knowledge and teachings of prior generations onto the kips. Despite my misgivings, I assume this is not a mistake. You had said earlier that [frostwyrm.name] chose you because you had proven yourself to be a viable mate. She only came to that conclusion after you had defeated her. Multiple times. In single combat. From the tone in its voice, it doesn’t believe you, but, yes. You did it alone. The second Frostwyrm says nothing. It sits back onto its haunches, mimicking [frostwyrm.name]’s posture once again, and turns its red eyes towards her, looking to her to confirm what it clearly thinks is an absolutely outrageous claim. After all, it is true that [frostwyrm.name] is several times your height, and many multiple times your weight. It is true, she confirms. [pc.name] is much smaller than us. I had reasoned that any [pc.hasCock |virile[pc.isHerm | and fertile ] |fertile ] creature that was capable of downing a being like myself so consistently had a far greater understanding of the world than I possessed, and would therefore make an excellent Qal. A light, trilling thrum emanates from her chest. My conclusion has been correct so far.[frostwyrm.andNykke | The second Frostwyrm turns its gaze towards Nykke, standing notably shorter than [frostwyrm.name][pc.heightRange 0 108 |, although still significantly taller than you ]. And you? it asks, its tone halfway between exasperation and disbelief in the scenario it’s found itself in. Are you the same? Did you challenge this creature to single combat and lose badly enough that you chose to mate with it? Nykke twists her mouth and furrows her brow at its choice in words. “The truth is that I met our Qal in the snowbanks where [frostwyrm.name] was brooding, just like you had,” she answers verbally. “Our kind is dying out. I had the choice of either joining their clutch and becoming a second Qim to our Qal, or to keep wandering the world in the hopes that I’d find another viable mate for myself.” She turns her head to one side and lowers her eyelids. “The same choice you’re facing right now.” Our plights are not the same, it answers, the edges of its scaly mouth curving upward in disdain. “I can tell that you’ve seen a lot of fighting, but from the layers on your horns and talons, you’re not as old as either me or [frostwyrm.name],” Nykke says back. Despite the conviction in her words, she speaks as though she’s working through a lump in her throat. “We’ve been looking for mates longer than you have. We know exactly what you’re going through.” ] The second Frostwyrm turns its eyes to you, then to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |, then to Nykke, then back to [frostwyrm.name] one final time ].[frostwyrm.andNykke | You are suggesting I do what you two have done, it concludes. To join your clutch as a third Qim to this apparent specimen. It is an unusual arrangement, [frostwyrm.name] concedes. There were initial difficulties. Yet the alternative is to continue to weigh your odds against the endless expanse of the world to find a mate for yourself. | What is it you are suggesting, then? it asks, its patience beginning to wear thin in its tone. Unless the purpose of your finding me is to mock me that this neophyte has what I cannot have. [frostwyrm.name] takes a long, deep sigh through her nose, her massive lungs flexing with all of that air inside them. Like it as not, the world is vacant of our kind, she answers. We are not given the luxury of options, nor the fortune of plenty as our bearers once did. Our kind take only one mate, yet... we have been given a challenge, and, by the grace of the Grand Qim or not, we have been given a solution. One that will be initially uncomfortable for us both. The second Frostwyrm tilts its head in confusion at what [frostwyrm.name] could mean... before its eyes suddenly widen in understanding. ] I would be neither Qim nor Qal to my own clutch, the second Frostwyrm says, bereaved. I would all but be given the title of Qer. A scrounger – a parasite, depending on the charity of a kind that has been claimed, and the apparent knowledge of this cross-breeding interloper you have brought before me.[frostwyrm.andNykke | You feel the anger flare from Nykke through your connection to her before you hear her words or see her actions. “You need to shut the fuck up,” Nykke gnashes suddenly, lifting her upper right arm and pointing a finger at the second Frostwyrm. “My own Qal was a ‘cross-breeder,’ too, and if I’m not a Qim to [pc.name], that makes me a Qer, according to you. And I am not a Qer. You’re sitting there, thinking you’re too good for me or [pc.name], but from where we are, you’re the one without a clutch or a mate and you’re the one getting upset at the idea of having anything if it means sharing.” You lift your hand to Nykke’s, gently resting your palm on her raised hand to get her to lower it. The less tensions there are in the air, the better. She lowers her hand – eventually, and slowly. The second Frostwyrm’s posture remains static and difficult to read, but you can at least tell that it’s watching Nykke and listening to her words. “I hunt; I bring food back to the home; I’ve made myself a lair; and I raise the kips that we have reared together. I’m as much a proper Qim as [frostwyrm.name] is. It’s been Sky Cycles since any of us has seen another of our kind; if you want to have any sort of closure in your life, you need to accept that you might never–” Nykke catches herself, unwilling to finish the thought. It’s not a truth that she wants to face, and as soon as the last word hangs in the air, you can feel it from both [frostwyrm.name] and the second Frostwyrm as well: uncomfortable apprehension. Knowing that there’s a truth they must face – a line they must cross – but they’re focusing on anything and everything else to keep from facing it. | Cease with the vile rhetoric! [frostwyrm.name]’s voice bellows in your head. For the first time since you had started, her posture breaks: the hackles of her foremost limbs breach upward and she lowers her head, looking as though she’s readying herself to lunge, if it weren’t for her lowered rump. There is no worthier being in this world than [pc.name] as my Qal. We had come in search of you to offer a respite from the ugly reality of our predicament. It is no small sacrifice on my part to offer you a place in my nest – near our clutch, need I remind you! The barest of compliments you will yield is the respect we are due! ] Everyone’s been taking the conversation in a very roundabout manner so far, so, although you realize the tensions are high and you’re not exactly the second Frostwyrm’s role model, you try to boil down the situation as best as you can: there aren’t a lot of Frostwyrms left on Uveto. You had taken [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke as mates | as a mate ] and you had raised a[var0 | | small ] clutch with [frostwyrm.andNykke |them |her ] before you had realized that there was a second Frostwyrm wandering the plains nearby. You realize that this isn’t how Frostwyrms do things, and that it’s hurt and confused and desperate to have a normal life with a normal family, but the Frostwyrms are facing a harsh reality right now. You[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name] are willing to take it into your family and give it a home. And give it any other accommodations it might require. The second Frostwyrm remains still for a moment before eventually rotating its head to one side. A clutch? it asks. We had spoken of mates, and Qims and Qals, and combat prowess, though this is the first time offspring has been mentioned[frostwyrm.andNykke |. Though I suppose I should have assumed interbreeding was possible, given the third party ]. Its red eyes fixate on you and it leans forward, its snout coming within a foot from your body. All four red eyes focus on you, but on different parts of you, with the eyeballs moving to scan different limbs for any sudden movements. Allow me to see what you know of clutches. You feel the familiar cloying in your mind, of an alien presence trying to force its way into your memories. It’s as unrefined as it was previously: intent, vehement, and without any technique. It’s as uncomfortable as it was before and you can’t help but wince and reach for your head. As soon as you do, though, you feel [frostwyrm.andNykke |both Nykke and ][frostwyrm.name]’s presence alongside it, trying to guide it and refine it so that it’s not nearly as intense. It helps; the presence in your mind becomes more focused and specific, but still without any finesse, trying to force its way through you. Your linguistic skills need improvement, [frostwyrm.name] chastises, but does not try to force the second Frostwyrm out of your head like she had before. "

rows.original: The second Frostwyrm probes your mind with some intensity, searching your memories for the clutch you had raised with [frostwyrm.name]. You can’t see what it sees; your interaction with it as it rifles through your head is an alien and somewhat uncomfortable feeling of pressure in some nebulous, undefinable part of your mind. It feels like it’s in the center, yet it has a gravity that pulls on the edges and contracts the surface of your brain towards it. And it does so unevenly, with one probe pressing in on you from the front, and another squeezing in from your right. If [frostwyrm.name] weren’t there to guide it, the experience would go from unpleasant to borderline torturous. A few moments later (which felt significantly longer than that), all of the pressure releases, and your mind is your own again. You look to the second Frostwyrm for its expression, to see if it’s satisfied with what it found – only to see that its head has reared back, with all four of its ruby-red eyes peeled wide. Its nostrils flare as it goes from you to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | to Nykke ] and then back to you. That was your clutch? it asks, as if it had not seen for itself through your own memories. Still, you confirm. And that was your nest? Large enough to hold such a clutch? Again, you confirm – and, in fact, it could hold much, much more. The second Frostwyrm’s voice in your head goes silent. Its body remains tense, each of its muscles wound up as it considers what it has just seen and what you’ve just told it. You turn to [frostwyrm.name] and ask her what a typical clutch is for a Qim and a Qal. You don’t really have a basis for how large it ‘ought’ to be. Two, she answers. Three is uncommon, but not unusual. ... Your clutch is significantly larger than that. Indeed it is.[frostwyrm.andNykke | “For reference, I was an only child,” Nykke adds. ] Why don’t, or, didn’t, Frostwyrms have larger clutches? You’d have gathered that, with how much she enjoys mating, larger Frostwyrm families would have been much more common. There are a multitude of reasons. Anything from food insecurity, to nests not being large enough to sustain more, to the nest being in a precarious location, susceptible to attacks from lesser creatures hoping to poach the kips as they incubate. The location of my nest – in the ocean, away from poachers, in a hollow island, and surrounded by limitless fish to eat – nullifies all concerns. She lowers her snout to you, her throat trilling as she affectionately nuzzles against you. And if I am particularly libidinous, it is because you make me so, my Qal. My kind do not typically mate for the pleasure of it, and yet, with you... I could not ever return to that way of thinking. The second Frostwyrm continues to sit there and stare at you, gobsmacked at everything it’s seen and everything it’s hearing. And, as you consider what [frostwyrm.name] just said, even from a non-Frostwyrm standpoint, she’s making your arrangement sound awfully attractive: food security; a massive nest; no poachers trying to snatch her eggs; and, apparently, all the mind-numbing sex a gigantic, twenty-foot-tall, forty-foot-long dragon could ask for. You take the opportunity to press the point: if there’s anything it doesn’t believe, it’s free to search [frostwyrm.andNykke |the memories between all three of you |your memories, or [frostwyrm.name]’s ]. It’s already seen the size of your clutch and it can infer the size of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair; perhaps it doesn’t believe that the ocean is large enough to feed a massive family of dragons. Maybe it doesn’t know how good sex can feel when it’s not for procreation[frostwyrm.andNykke |. Hell, when it’s all three of you, the sex is so mind-numbingly intense that you barely stay conscious through it, and it’s hard to know when it starts and when it ends ]. If there’s anything it’s unsure about or wants to know more of, you, as the Qal, are the teacher: it’s your job to teach. It takes the second Frostwyrm a long moment to compose itself, and when it finally does find the wherewithal to loosen its body and blink its eyes, it’s with a sort of groggy, disoriented body language that reminds you of someone who’s been asleep for a decade. And you’re offering me a place amongst your clutch? it asks you. You know that it’s not what it had in mind when it set out from its bearers’ home in search of a mate for itself. Circumstances are different and times are difficult for all of the remaining Frostwyrms. But if it can accept that it’d be sharing the duties as Qim with [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ] – hunting for food, raising the kips, and patrolling the perimeters of the territory – then, yes, the offer to join you is there. It’s why you[frostwyrm.andNykke| three | and [frostwyrm.name] ] came out here in the first place. It takes another moment to answer, but you can feel its emotions coming to you via the psionic link. At first, something downtrodden and remorseful; this isn’t what it wanted. It wanted a traditional family: a mate of its own; a lair of its own; not having to share what it has with others. But it also knows you’re right. This is the only chance it’s had in a very, very long time to settle down and have something better than what it has now, and there’s no guarantee that, if it turns you down, it’ll ever find another Frostwyrm to be with. It’s taken so long just to find [frostwyrm.name]. Living with your clutch as another Qim is a better life than wandering the snowy wastes and hoping beyond hope that it’ll get a second chance – and that’s assuming the unlikely scenario that another Frostwyrm isn’t already taken. You soon feel a second set of emotions: this time, something more akin to that light, flighty feeling you get in your upper chest when you start to hope that something good might happen. The opportunity is there – it just has to seize it.[frostwyrm.andNykke | “If it’ll help make up your mind,” Nykke says, putting her lower hands on her hips and giving them a flaunty swish, her tail arcing through the snow and kicking up a line of it. “I get where it is you’re coming from. [frostwyrm.name] found [pc.name] before I did. I was left wandering the world for hundreds of Sky Cycles before I finally found them both. And I was caught wanting the same things you wanted: a normal life. I’m not a pureblood, so I was worried that I wouldn’t make for a good Qal. But my scales also make it so I can’t blend into the environment, meaning I struggled to hunt, so I wouldn’t make a good Qim, either. Being with [pc.name] and [frostwyrm.name] changed my life in so many ways, and all of them for the better.” The second Frostwyrm’s nostrils flare. Its eyes train on Nykke; it’s taking everything she says seriously. The nest is not yours to begin with, it notes. How do you fare with the... arrangement? “I mean, I have everything I could want. A home; kips of my own... I’m smaller than [frostwyrm.name], and that makes me more agile in the water, so I’m a better fisher than she is. But most of all, I have companionship. Something to deal with all of that crushing loneliness. I felt kind of awkward about it at first, but... there’s really nothing more that I could ask for.” Before the Frostwyrm has the chance to further consider its options, Nykke continues. “And the sex – the mating. Good Grand Qim, it is life-changing. I just wanted something to deal with all the heats and the ruts, but what I got....” She steps behind you and wraps her arms around you, hugging you to her – and sinking your head into her cleavage. And you can feel the bulge of her vent pressing up against [pc.heightRange 0 60 84 108 |your head, casting you into shadow |your upper shoulders, near the back of your neck |your lower back, and quickly riding upwards |your butt, sinking into the valley between your cheeks ]. “Trust me when I say that nobody in this world fucks like [pc.ra frostwyrm |[pc.name] can |[pc.race]s can ]. [frostwyrm.name] will agree with me.” It tilts its head in confusion. ‘Fucks?’ it asks. What is this word? You had expected it to dig into your head for its definition, like [frostwyrm.name] likes to do whenever you use a word she doesn’t understand, but [frostwyrm.name] beats you to the punch. Although you don’t understand the exchange, you can tell that they’re communicating – and after a moment, the second Frostwyrm rears back slightly in surprise. I understand. ] It takes a while longer for the Frostwyrm to deliberate with itself whether or not to accept the invitation. Eventually, with a heavy sigh that flares its nostrils, it bows its head. I accept, it says. Given its tone, it had to chew through those two little words – after all, this isn’t the life it wanted, but it’s the one it’s getting. This scenario is unfortunate and unusual for us all, but it is not just me that must accede to the realities of our world. Your offer is munificent and I will not overlook it. In the end, you managed to solve things amicably: you’ve found the second Frostwyrm, and you’ve managed to convince it to join your clutch back in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair.[silly | And all it took was for it to see just how capable you are at making babies with dragons. ]
rows.translation: 第二条霜龙以相当强烈的力度探查你的思想，在记忆中搜寻你与[frostwyrm.name]共同养育的那窝幼崽。你无法看见它所见的内容；当它在脑中翻找时，你与它之间的互动只是一股异质而略显难受的压力，出现在意识里某个模糊、无法定义的部位。它似乎位于中央，却又产生引力，拉扯边缘，让大脑表面向内收缩。而且这股力量并不均匀，一道探查从正面压迫，另一道则从右侧挤压。如果没有[frostwyrm.name]在场引导，这段经历恐怕会从不适变成近乎折磨。 片刻以后（感觉上却远远不止片刻），所有压力全部释放，意识又重新属于你。你看向第二条霜龙，想从神情判断它是否对发现的内容感到满意——却发现它向后仰起脑袋，四只红宝石般的眼睛全部大大睁开。它张开鼻孔，目光从你移到[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |，再移向妮琪 ]，最后又回到你身上。 那就是你们的一窝幼崽？它问道，仿佛没有亲眼通过你的记忆看见。你仍然确认了。那就是你们的巢穴？大到足以容纳如此规模的一窝幼崽？你再次确认——事实上，那里还能容纳多得多的幼崽。 第二条霜龙的声音从脑中消失。它全身依然紧绷，每一块肌肉都绷得如同发条，思考着刚刚看见的景象和你告诉它的事情。 你转向[frostwyrm.name]，问一名Qim与一名Qal通常会养育多少幼崽。你完全不知道“应该”有多少。 两只，她回答。三只并不常见，但也算不上异常。 ...你们那一窝显然大得多。 的确如此。[frostwyrm.andNykke | “作为参考，我是独生女，”妮琪补充道。 ] 为什么霜龙不养育——或者过去不养育——更多幼崽？从她有多么享受交配来看，你原以为规模更大的霜龙家庭会常见得多。 原因有许多。从食物不足，到巢穴太小无法供养更多后代，再到巢穴位置危险，容易遭到企图在幼崽孵化期间偷走它们的弱小生物袭击。我的巢穴位置——处于海中，远离偷猎者，位于一座中空岛屿内部，而且周围有无限鱼类可供食用——消除了所有忧虑。她把口鼻低向你，喉中发出颤鸣，亲昵地蹭着身体。至于我是否格外淫荡，那是因为你让我变成这样，我的Qal。我的同族通常不会为了快感而交配，可是和你在一起...我再也无法回到过去那种想法。 第二条霜龙继续坐在那里盯着你，被眼前所见和耳中所闻惊得目瞪口呆。仔细想想[frostwyrm.name]刚才说的话，就算不从霜龙的角度来看，她也把你们的生活安排描述得极具吸引力：食物有保障；巢穴无比巨大；没有偷猎者试图抢走龙蛋；而且显然还能随意享受一条身高二十英尺、身长四十英尺的巨龙所能要求的一切迷魂性爱。 你趁机进一步劝说：如果有什么不相信的内容，它可以随意搜索[frostwyrm.andNykke |你们三人共同拥有的记忆 |你的记忆，或者[frostwyrm.name]的记忆 ]。它已经看见你们养育了多少幼崽，也能推断[frostwyrm.name]巢穴的规模；也许它不相信海洋大到足以养活一个巨龙大家庭。也许它不知道不为繁衍而进行的性爱能够有多舒服[frostwyrm.andNykke |。见鬼，你们三人一起做爱时，性爱强烈得让人头脑麻木，你几乎全程无法保持清醒，甚至很难分清它从何时开始、又在何时结束 ]。如果它对什么没有把握，或者想了解更多，你身为Qal便是老师：教导正是你的职责。 第二条霜龙花了很长一段时间才恢复镇定。当它终于找回放松身体、眨动眼睛的能力时，那种昏沉迷茫的肢体语言让你想到一个沉睡了十年的人。 而你是在邀请我加入你们的伴侣群体？它向你问道。 你知道这并非它离开双亲的家、出发寻找伴侣时设想的生活。如今情况不同，所有幸存霜龙都处在艰难时代。但如果它能接受与[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |和妮琪 ]共同承担Qim的职责——狩猎食物、抚养幼崽、巡查领地边界——那么没错，加入你们的邀请确实存在。这正是你们[frostwyrm.andNykke|三人 |二人，也就是你与[frostwyrm.name] ]最初来到这里的原因。 它又花了片刻才作出回答，但你能通过心灵连接感受到情绪。起初是一种沮丧与懊悔；这不是它想要的生活。它渴望传统家庭：属于自己的伴侣，属于自己的巢穴，不必与其他人分享拥有的一切。 然而它也知道你说得没错。这是它在非常非常漫长的岁月里，唯一一次获得安定生活、过上更好日子的机会。如果拒绝，谁也无法保证它永远还能找到另一条霜龙作伴。光是找到[frostwyrm.name]便已经耗费如此漫长的时间。 成为另一名Qim，与你们的伴侣群体共同生活，终究好过在冰雪荒原中游荡，不顾一切地祈祷获得第二次机会——而且这还建立在另一条霜龙尚未拥有伴侣这种小概率情形上。你很快感觉到第二组情绪：这一次，更像一种轻盈飘忽的感觉，每当你开始期待好事可能发生时，它就会出现在上胸。机会就摆在面前——它只需伸手抓住。[frostwyrm.andNykke | “如果这样能帮你作出决定，”妮琪说道，把下方双手叉在胯间，故意炫耀般摆动腰臀，尾巴划过雪地，扬起一道雪线。“我明白你在想什么。[frostwyrm.name]比我更早找到[pc.name]。在终于找到他们两个以前，我独自在世间游荡了数百个天穹周期。我和你一样渴望正常生活。因为自己不是纯血种，我担心无法成为优秀的Qal。可是我的鳞片也让我无法融入环境，令狩猎变得困难，所以我同样无法成为优秀的Qim。和[pc.name]、[frostwyrm.name]生活在一起，从许多方面改变了我的人生，而且全都是变得更好。” 第二条霜龙张开鼻孔，眼睛盯住妮琪；它认真对待她说的每一句话。那座巢穴原本并不属于你，它指出。你是如何适应这种...安排的？ “我是说，我已经拥有想要的一切。一个家，属于自己的幼崽...我的体型比[frostwyrm.name]小，因此在水中更加灵活，捕鱼也比她在行。但最重要的是，我拥有陪伴。它帮助我对抗那份压垮一切的孤独。最开始确实感觉有些尴尬，可是...我真的想不到自己还能要求什么。” 霜龙还没来得及进一步考虑，妮琪便继续说了下去。“还有性爱——交配。伟大的至高Qim啊，那真是足以改变一生。我原本只想找个办法熬过一次次发情期，可实际得到的东西....”她来到你身后，伸手把你搂进怀中——也让你的脑袋陷进乳沟。你能感觉她鼓起的泄殖腔贴住[pc.heightRange 0 60 84 108 |你的脑袋，把你笼罩在阴影下 |你的肩膀上部，靠近后颈 |你的后腰，而且正在迅速向上滑动 |你的屁股，陷进两瓣臀肉之间的沟谷 ]。“相信我，这世上没有任何人能像[pc.ra frostwyrm |[pc.name] |[pc.race] ]这样做爱。[frostwyrm.name]也会同意。” 它困惑地歪起脑袋。“做爱？”它问道。这个词是什么意思？ 你原以为它会像[frostwyrm.name]每次听见陌生词汇时那样钻进脑袋寻找定义，但[frostwyrm.name]抢先一步。你虽然无法理解双方的交流，却能看出它们正在沟通——片刻后，第二条霜龙略带惊讶地向后仰起脑袋。我明白了。 ] 霜龙又思考了很久，权衡是否接受邀请。最终，它沉重地叹息，鼻孔随之张开，然后低下脑袋。我接受，它说道。从语气来看，它一定反复咀嚼过这两个简短词语——毕竟这不是它想要的人生，却是它即将得到的人生。这种局面对我们所有人而言都不幸而反常，但不只我必须向世界现实低头。你的提议十分慷慨，我不会将其忽视。 最终，你成功以友善方式解决了问题：你们找到了第二条霜龙，也说服它加入[frostwyrm.name]巢穴里的伴侣群体。[silly | 而你只需要让它看看，自己究竟有多擅长和巨龙生孩子。 ]
rows.raw: " The second Frostwyrm probes your mind with some intensity, searching your memories for the clutch you had raised with [frostwyrm.name]. You can’t see what it sees; your interaction with it as it rifles through your head is an alien and somewhat uncomfortable feeling of pressure in some nebulous, undefinable part of your mind. It feels like it’s in the center, yet it has a gravity that pulls on the edges and contracts the surface of your brain towards it. And it does so unevenly, with one probe pressing in on you from the front, and another squeezing in from your right. If [frostwyrm.name] weren’t there to guide it, the experience would go from unpleasant to borderline torturous. A few moments later (which felt significantly longer than that), all of the pressure releases, and your mind is your own again. You look to the second Frostwyrm for its expression, to see if it’s satisfied with what it found – only to see that its head has reared back, with all four of its ruby-red eyes peeled wide. Its nostrils flare as it goes from you to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | to Nykke ] and then back to you. That was your clutch? it asks, as if it had not seen for itself through your own memories. Still, you confirm. And that was your nest? Large enough to hold such a clutch? Again, you confirm – and, in fact, it could hold much, much more. The second Frostwyrm’s voice in your head goes silent. Its body remains tense, each of its muscles wound up as it considers what it has just seen and what you’ve just told it. You turn to [frostwyrm.name] and ask her what a typical clutch is for a Qim and a Qal. You don’t really have a basis for how large it ‘ought’ to be. Two, she answers. Three is uncommon, but not unusual. ... Your clutch is significantly larger than that. Indeed it is.[frostwyrm.andNykke | “For reference, I was an only child,” Nykke adds. ] Why don’t, or, didn’t, Frostwyrms have larger clutches? You’d have gathered that, with how much she enjoys mating, larger Frostwyrm families would have been much more common. There are a multitude of reasons. Anything from food insecurity, to nests not being large enough to sustain more, to the nest being in a precarious location, susceptible to attacks from lesser creatures hoping to poach the kips as they incubate. The location of my nest – in the ocean, away from poachers, in a hollow island, and surrounded by limitless fish to eat – nullifies all concerns. She lowers her snout to you, her throat trilling as she affectionately nuzzles against you. And if I am particularly libidinous, it is because you make me so, my Qal. My kind do not typically mate for the pleasure of it, and yet, with you... I could not ever return to that way of thinking. The second Frostwyrm continues to sit there and stare at you, gobsmacked at everything it’s seen and everything it’s hearing. And, as you consider what [frostwyrm.name] just said, even from a non-Frostwyrm standpoint, she’s making your arrangement sound awfully attractive: food security; a massive nest; no poachers trying to snatch her eggs; and, apparently, all the mind-numbing sex a gigantic, twenty-foot-tall, forty-foot-long dragon could ask for. You take the opportunity to press the point: if there’s anything it doesn’t believe, it’s free to search [frostwyrm.andNykke |the memories between all three of you |your memories, or [frostwyrm.name]’s ]. It’s already seen the size of your clutch and it can infer the size of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair; perhaps it doesn’t believe that the ocean is large enough to feed a massive family of dragons. Maybe it doesn’t know how good sex can feel when it’s not for procreation[frostwyrm.andNykke |. Hell, when it’s all three of you, the sex is so mind-numbingly intense that you barely stay conscious through it, and it’s hard to know when it starts and when it ends ]. If there’s anything it’s unsure about or wants to know more of, you, as the Qal, are the teacher: it’s your job to teach. It takes the second Frostwyrm a long moment to compose itself, and when it finally does find the wherewithal to loosen its body and blink its eyes, it’s with a sort of groggy, disoriented body language that reminds you of someone who’s been asleep for a decade. And you’re offering me a place amongst your clutch? it asks you. You know that it’s not what it had in mind when it set out from its bearers’ home in search of a mate for itself. Circumstances are different and times are difficult for all of the remaining Frostwyrms. But if it can accept that it’d be sharing the duties as Qim with [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ] – hunting for food, raising the kips, and patrolling the perimeters of the territory – then, yes, the offer to join you is there. It’s why you[frostwyrm.andNykke| three | and [frostwyrm.name] ] came out here in the first place. It takes another moment to answer, but you can feel its emotions coming to you via the psionic link. At first, something downtrodden and remorseful; this isn’t what it wanted. It wanted a traditional family: a mate of its own; a lair of its own; not having to share what it has with others. But it also knows you’re right. This is the only chance it’s had in a very, very long time to settle down and have something better than what it has now, and there’s no guarantee that, if it turns you down, it’ll ever find another Frostwyrm to be with. It’s taken so long just to find [frostwyrm.name]. Living with your clutch as another Qim is a better life than wandering the snowy wastes and hoping beyond hope that it’ll get a second chance – and that’s assuming the unlikely scenario that another Frostwyrm isn’t already taken. You soon feel a second set of emotions: this time, something more akin to that light, flighty feeling you get in your upper chest when you start to hope that something good might happen. The opportunity is there – it just has to seize it.[frostwyrm.andNykke | “If it’ll help make up your mind,” Nykke says, putting her lower hands on her hips and giving them a flaunty swish, her tail arcing through the snow and kicking up a line of it. “I get where it is you’re coming from. [frostwyrm.name] found [pc.name] before I did. I was left wandering the world for hundreds of Sky Cycles before I finally found them both. And I was caught wanting the same things you wanted: a normal life. I’m not a pureblood, so I was worried that I wouldn’t make for a good Qal. But my scales also make it so I can’t blend into the environment, meaning I struggled to hunt, so I wouldn’t make a good Qim, either. Being with [pc.name] and [frostwyrm.name] changed my life in so many ways, and all of them for the better.” The second Frostwyrm’s nostrils flare. Its eyes train on Nykke; it’s taking everything she says seriously. The nest is not yours to begin with, it notes. How do you fare with the... arrangement? “I mean, I have everything I could want. A home; kips of my own... I’m smaller than [frostwyrm.name], and that makes me more agile in the water, so I’m a better fisher than she is. But most of all, I have companionship. Something to deal with all of that crushing loneliness. I felt kind of awkward about it at first, but... there’s really nothing more that I could ask for.” Before the Frostwyrm has the chance to further consider its options, Nykke continues. “And the sex – the mating. Good Grand Qim, it is life-changing. I just wanted something to deal with all the heats and the ruts, but what I got....” She steps behind you and wraps her arms around you, hugging you to her – and sinking your head into her cleavage. And you can feel the bulge of her vent pressing up against [pc.heightRange 0 60 84 108 |your head, casting you into shadow |your upper shoulders, near the back of your neck |your lower back, and quickly riding upwards |your butt, sinking into the valley between your cheeks ]. “Trust me when I say that nobody in this world fucks like [pc.ra frostwyrm |[pc.name] can |[pc.race]s can ]. [frostwyrm.name] will agree with me.” It tilts its head in confusion. ‘Fucks?’ it asks. What is this word? You had expected it to dig into your head for its definition, like [frostwyrm.name] likes to do whenever you use a word she doesn’t understand, but [frostwyrm.name] beats you to the punch. Although you don’t understand the exchange, you can tell that they’re communicating – and after a moment, the second Frostwyrm rears back slightly in surprise. I understand. ] It takes a while longer for the Frostwyrm to deliberate with itself whether or not to accept the invitation. Eventually, with a heavy sigh that flares its nostrils, it bows its head. I accept, it says. Given its tone, it had to chew through those two little words – after all, this isn’t the life it wanted, but it’s the one it’s getting. This scenario is unfortunate and unusual for us all, but it is not just me that must accede to the realities of our world. Your offer is munificent and I will not overlook it. In the end, you managed to solve things amicably: you’ve found the second Frostwyrm, and you’ve managed to convince it to join your clutch back in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair.[silly | And all it took was for it to see just how capable you are at making babies with dragons. ] "

rows.original: The second Frostwyrm probes your mind with some intensity, searching your memories for the clutch you had raised with [frostwyrm.name]. You can’t see what it sees; your interaction with it as it rifles through your head is an alien and somewhat uncomfortable feeling of pressure in some nebulous, undefinable part of your mind. It feels like it’s in the center, yet it has a gravity that pulls on the edges and contracts the surface of your brain towards it. And it does so unevenly, with one probe pressing in on you from the front, and another squeezing in from your right. If [frostwyrm.name] weren’t there to guide it, the experience would go from unpleasant to borderline torturous. A few moments later (which felt significantly longer than that), all of the pressure releases, and you’re left alone in your mind again. You look to the second Frostwyrm for its expression, to see if it’s satisfied with what it found – and it doesn’t look all that impressed. Frostwyrm faces aren’t as expressive as [pc.race]s, but you can tell from its body posture and the tilt of its head that it expected more. Perhaps, by traditional standards, it is an impressive clutch, it admits. Though it is as you say: we live in more trying times. From the stories you had spun, I was expecting a clutch of epic proportions – a clutch to rival the progeny of the Grand Qim. [frostwyrm.name] lets out a long sigh, her body visibly deflating. Our kind are not usually so prone to hyperbole. The second Frostwyrm turns its head, eyeing you with its two red eyes. I have also watched your encounter together, albeit from the point of view of the mongrel. You can see its pupils – as well-blended as they are with the red sclera – are blitzing across your body, watching your every detail, from the contours of your muscles to the reflexive twitches you make when you know you’re being watched. I have been in countless battles myself. Every scar and deformity on my body is a testament to them all, and I have emerged victorious in each and every one. Well, yeah, of course it did. It’d probably be dead if it ever lost. The second Frostwyrm snorts in derision at your observation. Your mate was chosen based on your combat prowess. It stands to reason, then, that the better combatant between us ought to have the right to mate. Wait a minute, nobody said anything about fighting! And what about [frostwyrm.name] – doesn’t she get a say in this? Even if it wins against you– Before you have the chance to finish the thought, the second Frostwyrm spreads its wings with enough force to kick up a blinding white gale of powdered snow, blanketing you[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name]. The high winds, the frigid cold, and the sting of the snow’s dust against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] disorient you; you feel your [pc.feet] lift off the ground and you lose your balance, and then, the second Frostwyrm flaps its wings back down, creating what feels like a snowstorm – a real force of nature. You use your mind to try and reach out to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | or Nykke ], to see if [frostwyrm.andNykke |they |she ] can pinpoint you, but you don’t get any reply. Instead, you feel something akin to a force, or maybe a hand, pressing down on the back of your mind, as if it were trying to stem a flow of water. You’ve been psionically attuned to the second Frostwyrm, and now it’s using that against you! Our battle will be of the same conditions as the battles between you and your mate, the second Frostwyrm’s distinct ‘voice’ says in your head. With another flap of its gargantuan wings, you see its silhouette in the swirling powder: its head lowered slightly, with its wings spread apart from its body but folded somewhat defensively against itself, giving it a larger, more rounded shadow. No mates[frostwyrm.andNykke |, or others, ] to turn the tide of battle. To the victor goes the right to mate. Although your psionic link with [frostwyrm.name] has been blocked, you can still feel every emotion coming from the second Frostwyrm, clear as could be. There’s everything from adrenaline and excitement at the prospect of getting into another fight... but there’s also something else. A type of unease; a sort of desperation that you’d expect from someone who felt like they were at the end of their options. After all, you never knew [frostwyrm.name] to be an unreasonable creature. It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 第二条霜龙以相当强烈的力度探查你的思想，在记忆中搜寻你与[frostwyrm.name]共同养育的那窝幼崽。你无法看见它所见的内容；当它在脑中翻找时，你与它之间的互动只是一股异质而略显难受的压力，出现在意识里某个模糊、无法定义的部位。它似乎位于中央，却又产生引力，拉扯边缘，让大脑表面向内收缩。而且这股力量并不均匀，一道探查从正面压迫，另一道则从右侧挤压。如果没有[frostwyrm.name]在场引导，这段经历恐怕会从不适变成近乎折磨。 片刻以后（感觉上却远远不止片刻），所有压力全部释放，你再次独自留在自己的意识中。你看向第二条霜龙，想从神情判断它是否对发现的内容感到满意——可它看起来并不怎么佩服。霜龙的面孔不像[pc.race]那样富有表情，但从它的身体姿态与脑袋倾斜角度，你能看出它原本期待更多。 也许按照传统标准，那的确是规模可观的一窝幼崽，它承认道。但正如你所说，我们生活在更加艰难的时代。从你编织的故事来看，我原本期待的是一窝规模惊人的后代——一窝足以媲美至高Qim子嗣的幼崽。 [frostwyrm.name]长长叹气，身体明显泄了气。我们的同族通常没有如此喜欢夸大其词。 第二条霜龙转过脑袋，用两只红眼睛审视你。我还看过你们相遇时的情景，尽管是从那个杂种的视角。它的瞳孔虽与红色眼白融合得很好，你仍能看见它们飞快扫视全身，观察每个细节，从肌肉轮廓到发现自己受到注视时下意识产生的抽动。我也经历过无数场战斗。身体上的每一处伤疤与畸形都见证着它们，而且每一场战斗都由我取得胜利。 好吧，那当然。要是它曾经输过，大概早就死了。 第二条霜龙听见你的评价，轻蔑地哼了一声。你的伴侣是根据战斗能力选择的。那么我们之间更优秀的战士，自然应该拥有交配权。 等一下，根本没人说过要战斗！而且[frostwyrm.name]怎么办——难道她没有发言权吗？就算它打赢你—— 你还没来得及说完，第二条霜龙便猛然展开双翼，力道之大，掀起一场令人睁不开眼的白色粉雪狂风，把你[frostwyrm.andNykke |、妮琪 ]与[frostwyrm.name]全部笼罩。狂风、严寒，以及雪尘击打[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]的刺痛令你迷失方向；你感觉[pc.feet]被掀离地面，身体失去平衡，随后，第二条霜龙又把翅膀向下拍落，制造出一场仿佛真正暴风雪般的力量——名副其实的自然伟力。 你试着用心灵接触[frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |或妮琪 ]，想看看[frostwyrm.andNykke |她们 |她 ]能否确定你的位置，却没有得到任何回应。取而代之的是一种仿佛力量、又像一只手的感觉，压在意识背面，仿佛试图截断水流。你已经与第二条霜龙建立心灵感应，而它如今正利用这点来对付你！ 我们的战斗将遵循你和伴侣历次战斗的相同条件，第二条霜龙独特的“声音”在脑中说道。巨大双翼再次拍动，你在飞旋粉雪中看见它的轮廓：脑袋微微压低，翅膀从身体两侧张开，却又以某种防御姿势向内折起，让影子显得更加庞大浑圆。没有伴侣[frostwyrm.andNykke |，也没有其他人 ]可以扭转战局。胜者将得到交配权。 虽然你与[frostwyrm.name]之间的心灵连接遭到阻断，第二条霜龙的每一份情绪却仍清晰无比地传入意识。其中既有肾上腺素，也有即将再次战斗的兴奋...可是还存在其他东西。一种不安；一种近乎绝望的迫切，只有认为自己已经走投无路的人才会拥有。 毕竟，你从不觉得[frostwyrm.name]是个不讲道理的生物。 战斗开始！
rows.raw: " The second Frostwyrm probes your mind with some intensity, searching your memories for the clutch you had raised with [frostwyrm.name]. You can’t see what it sees; your interaction with it as it rifles through your head is an alien and somewhat uncomfortable feeling of pressure in some nebulous, undefinable part of your mind. It feels like it’s in the center, yet it has a gravity that pulls on the edges and contracts the surface of your brain towards it. And it does so unevenly, with one probe pressing in on you from the front, and another squeezing in from your right. If [frostwyrm.name] weren’t there to guide it, the experience would go from unpleasant to borderline torturous. A few moments later (which felt significantly longer than that), all of the pressure releases, and you’re left alone in your mind again. You look to the second Frostwyrm for its expression, to see if it’s satisfied with what it found – and it doesn’t look all that impressed. Frostwyrm faces aren’t as expressive as [pc.race]s, but you can tell from its body posture and the tilt of its head that it expected more. Perhaps, by traditional standards, it is an impressive clutch, it admits. Though it is as you say: we live in more trying times. From the stories you had spun, I was expecting a clutch of epic proportions – a clutch to rival the progeny of the Grand Qim. [frostwyrm.name] lets out a long sigh, her body visibly deflating. Our kind are not usually so prone to hyperbole. The second Frostwyrm turns its head, eyeing you with its two red eyes. I have also watched your encounter together, albeit from the point of view of the mongrel. You can see its pupils – as well-blended as they are with the red sclera – are blitzing across your body, watching your every detail, from the contours of your muscles to the reflexive twitches you make when you know you’re being watched. I have been in countless battles myself. Every scar and deformity on my body is a testament to them all, and I have emerged victorious in each and every one. Well, yeah, of course it did. It’d probably be dead if it ever lost. The second Frostwyrm snorts in derision at your observation. Your mate was chosen based on your combat prowess. It stands to reason, then, that the better combatant between us ought to have the right to mate. Wait a minute, nobody said anything about fighting! And what about [frostwyrm.name] – doesn’t she get a say in this? Even if it wins against you– Before you have the chance to finish the thought, the second Frostwyrm spreads its wings with enough force to kick up a blinding white gale of powdered snow, blanketing you[frostwyrm.andNykke |, Nykke, ] and [frostwyrm.name]. The high winds, the frigid cold, and the sting of the snow’s dust against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] disorient you; you feel your [pc.feet] lift off the ground and you lose your balance, and then, the second Frostwyrm flaps its wings back down, creating what feels like a snowstorm – a real force of nature. You use your mind to try and reach out to [frostwyrm.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | or Nykke ], to see if [frostwyrm.andNykke |they |she ] can pinpoint you, but you don’t get any reply. Instead, you feel something akin to a force, or maybe a hand, pressing down on the back of your mind, as if it were trying to stem a flow of water. You’ve been psionically attuned to the second Frostwyrm, and now it’s using that against you! Our battle will be of the same conditions as the battles between you and your mate, the second Frostwyrm’s distinct ‘voice’ says in your head. With another flap of its gargantuan wings, you see its silhouette in the swirling powder: its head lowered slightly, with its wings spread apart from its body but folded somewhat defensively against itself, giving it a larger, more rounded shadow. No mates[frostwyrm.andNykke |, or others, ] to turn the tide of battle. To the victor goes the right to mate. Although your psionic link with [frostwyrm.name] has been blocked, you can still feel every emotion coming from the second Frostwyrm, clear as could be. There’s everything from adrenaline and excitement at the prospect of getting into another fight... but there’s also something else. A type of unease; a sort of desperation that you’d expect from someone who felt like they were at the end of their options. After all, you never knew [frostwyrm.name] to be an unreasonable creature. It’s a fight! "

rows.raw: "FROSTWYRM"

rows.original: It may have been some time since you last did combat with [frostwyrm.name], but your body remembers all of it. The motions, the techniques, what to watch out for – it’s all very similar. Whatever doubts this second Frostwyrm had about your combat prowess is surely assuaged after that final blow. Yet... for all its strength and combat experience, you can tell that it was holding itself back. When you fought [frostwyrm.name], she fought with intent: you were an intruder in her territory and she fought tooth and claw to keep you out. When this one swiped at you with a claw, it was with less strength than you know it’s capable of; when it snapped its jaw at you, it was more for the spectacle than to land a bite. It lies half-buried in the snow, panting from the pain and the exertion. You’re still psionically attuned with it, and you don’t feel any malice or indignation towards you. In fact, you don’t feel much of anything: a hollow, vacuous space exists in your mind where you expected it to project its emotions. When it catches its breath and rolls itself over to lie on its stomach, you ask why it attacked you. It takes a long, deep sigh, in and out through its nose. Similar to [frostwyrm.name] and her sighs, it lasts nearly a full minute. Pride, it answers simply, with a downward lilt in its voice, like it knew it was defeated... but not necessarily by you. I could not accept that an outsider would have taken[frostwyrm.andNykke | not one, but two viable mates | the only remaining viable mate in this part of the world ]. There is no deeper meaning to my actions. As it speaks, the weather anomaly surrounding you two dissipates. The snowy winds get weaker and weaker, returning visibility to the snowy plains around you – and the next thing you hear is [frostwyrm.andNykke |a pair of wingbeats as your two Qims, quick to find you now that the psionic block is down and the weather is quieting, hurry to your side |a heavy set of wingbeats as your Qim, quick to find you now that the psionic block is down and the weather is quieting, hurries to join your side ]. Despite all the excitement, what you feel from [frostwyrm.name]’s connection with you isn’t panic or anger or anxiety – she’s rather calm and collected. And she’s moving with all the grace and ease of a woman taking a walk through her garden. [frostwyrm.andNykke |They are |She is ] quick to deduce the results of your confrontation. After all, you’re still standing, and it isn’t. You’ve proven your mettle once again over another Frostwyrm. And you feel something else through your link with her: confidence, bordering on smugness. She knew from the beginning what the outcome was going to be. When she lands, she leans her snout towards you, inspecting you with her four ruby-red eyes (just to confirm that you had won as handily as she knew you would) before gently nuzzling into you, a light purr emanating from her throat. There was no doubt in my mind, she trills.[frostwyrm.andNykke | Nykke, however, doesn’t give you a look, knowing that [frostwyrm.name] has you tended to. Instead, the very first thing she does when she sees you and the second Frostwyrm is skid to a stop right next to its face – and then rear her two right fists back, punching it square in the snout, just beneath its left eyes. It flinches and winces, but does not attempt to get away. It knows it deserved that. From the empty feeling you’re getting from it, it might think it deserves more. ] You reciprocate the nuzzling and tell [frostwyrm.name] that you’re fine; you weren’t about to let another Frostwyrm get the best of you like that. After all, you were fighting for the right to keep her as your mate. I would never agree to such a cruel term, she admonishes before resuming her upright, regal posture, sitting on her rear haunches as she looks down upon the defeated Frostwyrm before you. Although it’s already beaten and prostrated in the snow, she pointedly and deliberately lifts her snout at it, forcing herself to look down. And under normal circumstances, neither would you. You are knowingly acting like a fool. The second Frostwyrm sighs again, turning its head to the right and sinking it into the snow. It’s been defeated both physically and emotionally. It knew what it did was wrong and that this wasn’t how Frostwyrms act towards one another. When [frostwyrm.name] called it a fool – and, you note, not a Qer – you felt a pang of deep sadness, the kind where you feel a cold pit in the center of your chest, but it makes no attempt to argue in its defense. You ask [frostwyrm.name] if she intends to rescind the invitation to her lair. It’s her home, after all. It is our home, she corrects. And.... She pauses, standing stock still above the second Frostwyrm, her four red eyes boring into its every scale and watching its every bodily movement. It, in response, pulls itself upward, into a sitting position similar to her own, and with its head upright and level... but still hung lower than hers. Proud and almost defiant... but aware of its place between you [frostwyrm.andNykke |four |three ] all the same. As I said: I had no compunctions on the result of your misbegotten ‘contest.’ [frostwyrm.andNykke |Our Qal |My Qal ] is Qal for a reason. Your actions would turn the Grand Qim away from you and cast you into the world’s shadow for the rest of your life. Its posture doesn’t change, but its own four red eyes break from hers, scanning along the frozen wasteland stretching in every direction around you. Though my judgements aren’t without sympathy, she continues. We are in desperate times. Our way of life is endangered; the ways of our bearers and ancestors before us are no longer viable. Despite my Qal’s capability, [pc.heShe] was not my first choice in mate either. You tell the second Frostwyrm that she likes to repeatedly remind you of that. I do not condone your actions, though I understand them. My first compunctions towards my Qal were also violence. She breaks eye contact – or, more appropriately, she stops staring daggers into the second Frostwyrm – to turn towards you. You had asked if I intend to rescind my invitation. That is not a decision for me to make. It is our home, but you are the Qal. [frostwyrm.name] is leaving the choice of whether you should take this second Frostwyrm into her lair to you. Keeping in mind everything that’s happened so far, from the state of the Frostwyrms to how this one in particular acted towards you (and the remorse it feels for doing so), your choice is–
rows.translation: 距离你上次与[frostwyrm.name]交手或许已经过去了一段时间，但你的身体依然记得一切。动作、技巧、需要提防的招式 – 全都十分相似。第二条霜龙原本对你的战斗实力抱有的任何怀疑，想必都已被最后一击彻底打消。 然而...尽管它拥有强大的力量与丰富的战斗经验，你仍能看出它一直有所保留。你与[frostwyrm.name]交战时，她出手带着明确意图：你是闯入她领地的入侵者，她便以爪牙全力阻止你。当这一条挥爪袭来时，所用的力量远低于它真正能够发挥的程度；当它张嘴咬向你时，也更像是为了制造声势，而非真的咬中你。 它半埋在雪中躺着，因疼痛和劳累而喘息。你依然与它保持着灵能联系，却感觉不到它对你有任何恶意或愤慨。事实上，你几乎什么也感觉不到：原本以为它会将情绪投射进来的地方，在你脑中只剩一片空洞而虚无的空间。等它喘匀气息，翻过身趴伏在地后，你问它为什么袭击你。 它用鼻子缓慢而深沉地吸气、呼气，发出一声长叹。就像[frostwyrm.name]叹气时一样，这一声几乎持续了整整一分钟。骄傲，它简单地回答，语调向下低落，仿佛它知道自己已经败了...却未必认为是败给了你。我无法接受一个外来者竟会夺走[frostwyrm.andNykke |不只一个，而是整整两个合适的伴侣 |这片世界中仅存的唯一合适伴侣 ]。我的行为并没有更深层的含义。 随着它开口，你们周围的异常天气逐渐消散。夹雪的狂风越来越弱，四周雪原重新变得清晰可见 – 接着，你听到的是[frostwyrm.andNykke |两组振翅声；灵能屏障已经消失，天气也平静下来，你的两位Qim很快便找到了你，急忙赶到你身旁 |一阵沉重的振翅声；灵能屏障已经消失，天气也平静下来，你的Qim很快便找到了你，急忙赶到你身旁 ]。尽管刚才发生了那么多事，你通过与[frostwyrm.name]的联系感觉到的却并非恐慌、愤怒或焦虑 – 她反而相当冷静沉着。她的动作优雅而从容，就像一位漫步于自家花园的女士。 [frostwyrm.andNykke |她们 |她 ]很快便判断出你们交锋的结果。毕竟，你仍站着，而它已经倒下。你又一次在另一条霜龙面前证明了自己的勇武。通过与她的联系，你还感觉到了另一种情绪：自信，几乎已接近洋洋自得。她从一开始就知道结局会如何。 她落地后，将口鼻凑向你，用四只红宝石般的眼睛检查你的身体（只是为了确认你确实如她所料，轻而易举地取得了胜利），随后温柔地贴着你磨蹭，喉咙里发出轻柔的呼噜声。我从未有过半点怀疑，她颤声说道。[frostwyrm.andNykke | 然而，妮琪并没有看你，因为她知道[frostwyrm.name]已经在照料你。相反，她看见你和第二条霜龙后做的第一件事，就是急停滑到它脸旁 – 随后把右侧两只拳头向后拉，正正打在它的口鼻上，就在左眼下方。它猛地一缩，因痛苦而皱起脸，却没有试图躲开。它知道自己罪有应得。从你感觉到的那片空虚来看，它或许认为自己理应承受更多。 ] 你也贴着[frostwyrm.name]蹭了蹭，告诉她自己没事；你绝不会让另一条霜龙就这样压过你一头。毕竟，你是在为保住她作为自己伴侣的权利而战。 我绝不会同意如此残酷的条件，她训斥道，随即重新摆出挺直而威严的姿态，后腿蹲坐，俯视着你们面前落败的霜龙。即便对方已经被击败并伏在雪中，她仍刻意而明确地抬起口鼻，迫使自己以居高临下的姿态看着它。正常情况下，你也不会同意。你明知故犯，表现得像个蠢货。 第二条霜龙再次叹息，把头转向右侧，埋入雪中。无论肉体还是精神，它都已经彻底败北。它知道自己做错了，也知道霜龙不该这样对待彼此。当[frostwyrm.name]称它为蠢货 – 而且你注意到，并不是Qer – 你感觉到一阵深切的悲伤，仿佛胸膛正中出现了一个冰冷的深坑，但它并没有试图为自己辩解。 你问[frostwyrm.name]是否打算撤回邀请，不再让它进入自己的巢穴。毕竟，那是她的家。 那是我们的家，她纠正道。而且.... 她停了下来，纹丝不动地站在第二条霜龙上方，四只红眼紧盯着它的每一片鳞片，观察它身体的每一个动作。作为回应，它撑起身体，摆出与她相似的坐姿，脑袋直立而平稳...却依旧低于她。骄傲，几乎带着挑衅...但仍然清楚自己在你们[frostwyrm.andNykke |四个 |三个 ]当中的地位。 正如我所说：你们那场荒谬的“竞赛”无论得出什么结果，我都不在意。[frostwyrm.andNykke |我们的Qal |我的Qal ]能成为Qal，自有其道理。你的行为会让至高Qim弃你而去，将你投入世界的阴影之中，直至生命尽头。 它的姿态没有改变，但自己的四只红眼却避开了她，转而扫视向你们四周延伸到各个方向的冰封荒原。 不过，我的判断并非毫无同情，她继续说道。我们身处绝境。我们的生活方式岌岌可危；我们的生育者与先祖曾经采用的方式已经无法延续。尽管我的Qal能力出众，[pc.heShe]最初也并非我选择伴侣时的首选。 你告诉第二条霜龙，她很喜欢反复提醒你这一点。 我不赞同你的行为，但我能够理解。最初面对我的Qal时，我的第一反应同样是诉诸暴力。她移开目光 – 或者更准确地说，不再用刀锋般的眼神瞪着第二条霜龙 – 转而看向你。你刚才问我是否打算撤回邀请。这并非由我决定。那是我们的家，但你才是Qal。 [frostwyrm.name]把是否应当带第二条霜龙进入她巢穴的选择留给了你。 牢记迄今发生的一切，从霜龙一族的处境，到眼前这一条对你的所作所为（以及它因此感到的悔恨），你的选择是–
