rows.original: There are a dizzying amount of options just for mead alone, but you end up just going with one of the simple, cheap varieties. Can’t get too special with mead - but you can’t go wrong, either. As you tap the screen to make your order, you jealously note that there’s quite a discount for local residents - it might as well be free!
rows.translation: 光是蜂蜜酒就有多得令人眼花缭乱的选择，但你最后只挑了一款简单便宜的品种。蜂蜜酒很难玩出太多花样 - 可也同样很难选错。你轻点屏幕下单时，眼红地注意到当地居民能享受相当大的折扣 - 简直跟白送没什么两样！
rows.raw: "There are a dizzying amount of options just for mead alone, but you end up just going with one of the simple, cheap varieties. Can’t get too special with mead - but you can’t go wrong, either. As you tap the screen to make your order, you jealously note that there’s quite a discount for local residents - it might as well be free!"

rows.original: By the time you look up from your codex again the “busy” barkeep has already placed the pale-golden drink in front of you in a tall glass, complete with a little glass coaster. No sooner are you served, she’s back busily cleaning glasses and paying you little mind again, leaving you with nothing to do but relax and enjoy the smooth, easy going, honey sweet booze. There really is nothing wrong with going for mead.
rows.translation: 等你再次从终端上抬起头时，那位“忙碌”的酒保已经把淡金色的酒放在你面前。酒盛在一只高脚杯里，底下甚至还垫着一枚小巧的玻璃杯垫。刚把酒端上来，她便又忙着清洗杯子，几乎不再理会你；你也无事可做，只能放松下来，享受这杯顺滑温和、甜如蜂蜜的美酒。选择蜂蜜酒果然不会有错。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you look up from your codex again the “busy” barkeep has already placed the pale-golden drink in front of you in a tall glass, complete with a little glass coaster. No sooner are you served, she’s back busily cleaning glasses and paying you little mind again, leaving you with nothing to do but relax and enjoy the smooth, easy going, honey sweet booze. There really is nothing wrong with going for mead."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Flicking through the choices, you come across something particularly eye catching; one of the local flavors, ostentatiously some sort of tourist drink. You’re a tourist here, so why not? Tapping your codex, you immediately hear a dismissive huff from Hana across the bar as she gets to work on it. Must get a lot of tourists, then.
rows.translation: 翻看各项选择时，有一样东西格外引人注目；这是本地风味之一，显然是某种游客饮品。你就是来这里旅游的，何乐而不为？你在宝典上点单后，立刻听见吧台另一边的花不屑地哼了一声，随即开始调制。看来这里的游客一定很多。
rows.raw: "Flicking through the choices, you come across something particularly eye catching; one of the local flavors, ostentatiously some sort of tourist drink. You’re a tourist here, so why not? Tapping your codex, you immediately hear a dismissive huff from Hana across the bar as she gets to work on it. Must get a lot of tourists, then."

rows.original: “It’s nothing special. People hear about all the savicite around and how it has changed some of the creatures living out here, so they want to get in on it. Of course, not many people can actually survive the trip outside.” Hana begins demurely, her tone sounding wooden and rehearsed. “So it’s the ‘psi’ retreatment; it’ll mess with your head for a bit and then you’re perfectly fine. In reality it’s just a mild sedative mixed into the drink.”
rows.translation: “没什么特别的。人们听说这里到处都是萨维石，也听说它改变了生活在外面的某些生物，所以就想亲身体验。当然，真正能活着走完外面那段路的人不多。”花温声开口，语调生硬，像是在照本宣科。“所以这叫‘灵能’再处理；它会暂时搅乱你的脑袋，之后就完全没事。其实不过是在饮料里混了一点温和镇静剂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s nothing special. People hear about all the savicite around and how it has changed some of the creatures living out here, so they want to get in on it. Of course, not many people can actually survive the trip outside.” Hana begins demurely, her tone sounding wooden and rehearsed. “So it’s the ‘psi’ retreatment; it’ll mess with your head for a bit and then you’re perfectly fine. In reality it’s just a mild sedative mixed into the drink.”"

rows.original: Drink might be a bit of an exaggeration; when she sets the glass down it’s little more than a shot, the novelty coaster it rests on feeling entirely unnecessary. Ah well, you’ve already bought it. Down the hatch!
rows.translation: 说这是饮料或许有些夸张；她把杯子放下时，里面充其量只有一小杯，垫在下面的新奇杯垫显得完全多余。算了，反正已经买了。一口闷！
rows.raw: "\n\nDrink might be a bit of an exaggeration; when she sets the glass down it’s little more than a shot, the novelty coaster it rests on feeling entirely unnecessary. Ah well, you’ve already bought it. Down the hatch!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You feel fuzzy for a moment. A kinda weird itch in the back of your head, like you’re forgetting something. The feeling passes, though, and you’re left just sitting there.
rows.translation: 你一时感觉脑袋昏沉。后脑勺深处泛起一种奇怪的痒意，仿佛正在忘记什么。不过感觉很快消退，只剩你坐在那里。
rows.raw: "You feel fuzzy for a moment. A kinda weird itch in the back of your head, like you’re forgetting something. The feeling passes, though, and you’re left just sitting there."

rows.original: Wasn’t something supposed to happen? You don’t really feel any different.
rows.translation: 不是应该发生点什么吗？你并没有觉得自己哪里不同。
rows.raw: "\n\nWasn’t something supposed to happen? You don’t really feel any different."

rows.original: Looking up to Hana with a quizzical expression you’re answered with a quiet, indifferent shrug.
rows.translation: 你疑惑地抬头看向花，得到的回答只是一个安静而冷淡的耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking up to Hana with a quizzical expression you’re answered with a quiet, indifferent shrug."

rows.original: Ugh, what a rip off.
rows.translation: 呃，真是宰人。
rows.raw: "\n\nUgh, what a rip off."

rows.original: For a brief moment you become woozy, your [pc.skin] feeling flush, particularly on your arms.
rows.translation: 你短暂地感到一阵眩晕，[pc.skin]发起热来，手臂尤其明显。
rows.raw: "For a brief moment you become woozy, your [pc.skin] feeling flush, particularly on your arms."

rows.original: Your vision grows hazy, the warm lights of the bar and central fireplace superimposing over one another into a blurry, blinding mess. Shapes swirl in your eyes - no, in your head? You can barely parse it and soon you don’t have to, the swirling mess shifting away into a white, empty void.
rows.translation: 视野逐渐朦胧，酒吧的暖光与中央壁炉在眼前彼此重叠，化作一团模糊刺眼的景象。各种形状在眼中旋转——不，是在脑海里？你几乎无法理解，很快也无需再理解，因为那团旋涡逐渐退去，化作一片空无的白色虚空。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour vision grows hazy, the warm lights of the bar and central fireplace superimposing over one another into a blurry, blinding mess. Shapes swirl in your eyes - no, in your head? You can barely parse it and soon you don’t have to, the swirling mess shifting away into a white, empty void."

rows.original: Did you pass out?
rows.translation: 你昏过去了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDid you pass out?"

rows.original: No, you can still feel the bar beside you and hear the banter of the bar patrons, though both seem somewhat distant. The odd aches of your body gradually disappear until everything is just... muted. It’s there, sure, but you can barely recognize any of the stimuli your senses register.
rows.translation: 不，你仍能感觉到身旁的吧台，也能听见酒客们的谈笑，只是两者似乎都有些遥远。身体各处古怪的酸痛逐渐消失，直到一切都变得...迟钝。它们当然还在，但你几乎无法辨认感官接收到的任何刺激。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, you can still feel the bar beside you and hear the banter of the bar patrons, though both seem somewhat distant. The odd aches of your body gradually disappear until everything is just... muted. It’s there, sure, but you can barely recognize any of the stimuli your senses register."

rows.original: Your mind feels blissfully clear and empty. There’s no concern about the race against your cousin, about the consequences of your adventures, even drive to continue on.
rows.translation: 你的思绪无比清明而空洞。你不再担忧与堂亲的竞赛，不再担忧冒险的后果，甚至连继续前进的动力也消失了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour mind feels blissfully clear and empty. There’s no concern about the race against your cousin, about the consequences of your adventures, even drive to continue on."

rows.original: Not right now.
rows.translation: 现在不行。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot right now."

rows.original: It’s just...
rows.translation: 只是...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s just..."

rows.original: Nothing. It’s nice. It’s also rather terrifying, though you don’t come to that conclusion until the effect starts to wear off.
rows.translation: 什么都没有。这感觉很好。也相当可怕，只不过直到药效开始消退，你才得出这个结论。
rows.raw: "\n\nNothing. It’s nice. It’s also rather terrifying, though you don’t come to that conclusion until the effect starts to wear off."

rows.original: A mixed feeling of both euphoria and nausea starts to overwhelm you, properly pulling you out of that drug assisted reprieve.
rows.translation: 欣快与恶心交织的感觉开始将你淹没，彻底把你从药物带来的短暂安宁中拖了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nA mixed feeling of both euphoria and nausea starts to overwhelm you, properly pulling you out of that drug assisted reprieve."

rows.original: You swallow the urge to retch, at least, and the world comes back into focus. Whoa.
rows.translation: 你至少咽下了呕吐的冲动，世界也重新变得清晰。哇哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou swallow the urge to retch, at least, and the world comes back into focus. Whoa."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Frisky Dingo, huh? You’ve seen some of the ads around - it’s some mainstream brand coming from the ausar homeworlds. It’s popular, so why not?
rows.translation: 骚动野犬酒，是吧？你在附近见过一些广告——这是来自奥萨尔母星地区的主流品牌。既然很受欢迎，为什么不试试？
rows.raw: "Frisky Dingo, huh? You’ve seen some of the ads around - it’s some mainstream brand coming from the ausar homeworlds. It’s popular, so why not?"

rows.original: Tapping it in earns you a faint scoff from Hana just before she spins around on her heels, reaching at something in one of the lower cabinets. It gives you a brief glimpse at her skirt-clad rear. The
rows.translation: 点下它之后，花先是轻轻嗤了一声，随后脚跟一转，伸手去够下层柜子里的某样东西。你得以短暂瞥见她被裙子包裹的后臀。这幅
rows.raw: "\n\nTapping it in earns you a faint scoff from Hana just before she spins around on her heels, reaching at something in one of the lower cabinets. It gives you a brief glimpse at her skirt-clad rear. The"

rows.original: pleasing
rows.translation: 令人愉悦的
rows.raw: " pleasing"

rows.original: view lasts mere seconds before Hana hoists herself back upright, planting the chilled, bottle-sweat glistening order down in front of you with a prominent clink of glass-on-glass.
rows.translation: 景象仅仅持续几秒，花便重新直起身，把冰凉、凝满瓶身水珠的饮品重重放到你面前，玻璃相碰，发出清脆响声。
rows.raw: " view lasts mere seconds before Hana hoists herself back upright, planting the chilled, bottle-sweat glistening order down in front of you with a prominent clink of glass-on-glass."

rows.original: The colorful caricature of a dog greets you on the labeling. Hana is gracious enough to pop off the archaic tin cap with a bottle opener for you before getting back to her barkeeping tasks, leaving you with your drink.
rows.translation: 标签上一只色彩鲜艳的卡通狗向你打招呼。花还算体贴，用开瓶器替你撬开了老式铁皮瓶盖，随后便继续忙自己的酒保工作，把饮料留给你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe colorful caricature of a dog greets you on the labeling. Hana is gracious enough to pop off the archaic tin cap with a bottle opener for you before getting back to her barkeeping tasks, leaving you with your drink."

rows.original: A swig later and the verdict is in. Shitty, painfully mediocre commercial beer. Not that you really expected anything else.
rows.translation: 喝下一口，结论便出来了。糟糕得要命，平庸到令人痛苦的商业啤酒。虽然你原本也没期待别的。
rows.raw: "\n\nA swig later and the verdict is in. Shitty, painfully mediocre commercial beer. Not that you really expected anything else."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: One of the menu options is simply a picture of an empty mug and the listing of ‘the party game,’ with no additional information to speak of. Curious, you give it a tap and look up to Hana, expectantly, taking note of her brief surprise as she gets to work on the order.
rows.translation: 菜单上有个选项只画着一只空酒杯，并标着“派对游戏”，除此之外没有任何说明。出于好奇，你点了下去，满怀期待地抬头看向花，注意到她短暂露出惊讶神色，随即开始准备订单。
rows.raw: "One of the menu options is simply a picture of an empty mug and the listing of ‘the party game,’ with no additional information to speak of. Curious, you give it a tap and look up to Hana, expectantly, taking note of her brief surprise as she gets to work on the order."

rows.original: “Oh, you don’t know? Heh... it’s a local game, each day it’s a different mug filled with four or five different drinks on the menu. If you guess them all correctly and finish your drink you get a little prize. Just some money and fanfare, really. It’s a challenge made for alcoholics.” The woman finishes with a wry smirk, planting a whole, frothing stein down in front of you. It’s... rather alarming. Even merely sitting it down rings out a challenging clunk of glass onto the coaster. The color of the drink is suspect, an off-amber from mixed pale and dark drinks. This might have been a mistake.
rows.translation: “哦，你不知道？呵...这是本地游戏，每天都会用菜单上的四五种不同饮料装满一只酒杯。要是能全部猜对并把酒喝完，就能得到一点奖品。其实也就是一点钱和喝彩。这个挑战是给酒鬼准备的。”女人带着一抹讥讽笑容说完，将一整杯泡沫翻腾的大啤酒杯放到你面前。它看起来...相当吓人。光是放下，玻璃杯落在杯垫上便发出挑战般的沉重声响。酒液颜色很可疑，浅色与深色饮品混合成了暗淡的琥珀色。点这个也许是个错误。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you don’t know? Heh... it’s a local game, each day it’s a different mug filled with four or five different drinks on the menu. If you guess them all correctly and finish your drink you get a little prize. Just some money and fanfare, really. It’s a challenge made for alcoholics.” The woman finishes with a wry smirk, planting a whole, frothing stein down in front of you. It’s... rather alarming. Even merely sitting it down rings out a challenging clunk of glass onto the coaster. The color of the drink is suspect, an off-amber from mixed pale and dark drinks. This might have been a mistake."

rows.original: Tentatively, you take a sip. Muted, mixed flavors all challenge one another for dominance across your taste buds, causing you to wince - and Hana to laugh. Yeah, this is definitely a mistake. It’s made for locals, people who have actually slurped their way through the menu over time. You realize about half way through the stein that some of these flavors are actually pretty strong and it’s hitting you hard. Some form of intrepid spirit keeps you sipping it down, though, and eventually you’re greeted with the bemused expression of Hana, albeit hazy through the bottom of the glass.
rows.translation: 你试探着抿了一口。各种淡薄而混杂的味道在味蕾上争夺主导，令你皱起脸——也让花笑出了声。对，这绝对是个错误。这是给本地人准备的，只有那些长期把菜单挨个喝遍的人才应付得来。喝到大约半杯时，你意识到其中一些味道其实烈得很，酒劲正猛烈冲上脑袋。可某种无畏精神仍让你继续一口口喝下去，最终，透过杯底朦胧的视野，你迎上花忍俊不禁的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nTentatively, you take a sip. Muted, mixed flavors all challenge one another for dominance across your taste buds, causing you to wince - and Hana to laugh. Yeah, this is definitely a mistake. It’s made for locals, people who have actually slurped their way through the menu over time. You realize about half way through the stein that some of these flavors are actually pretty strong and it’s hitting you hard. Some form of intrepid spirit keeps you sipping it down, though, and eventually you’re greeted with the bemused expression of Hana, albeit hazy through the bottom of the glass."

rows.original: “I’m not going to bother quizzing you on what was specifically in there, but can you guess how many drinks there were?” She is looking pretty haughty, though you can’t really say how much what with your head screaming at you already.
rows.translation: “我懒得逐一问你里面具体放了什么，不过你能猜出一共有几种酒吗？”她显得颇为得意，不过你的脑袋已经在尖叫，实在看不太清。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not going to bother quizzing you on what was specifically in there, but can you guess how many drinks there were?” She is looking pretty haughty, though you can’t really say how much what with your head screaming at you already."

rows.original: ... Maybe eight?
rows.translation: ...也许八个？
rows.raw: "\n\n... Maybe eight?"

rows.original: “Just four, heh. Here, have some water. Pace yourself in the future, tourists stumbling around on the ice outside is bad for publicity.”
rows.translation: “只有四种，呵。来，喝点水。以后注意节制，游客在外面的冰面上跌跌撞撞，对宣传形象可不好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just four, heh. Here, have some water. Pace yourself in the future, tourists stumbling around on the ice outside is bad for publicity.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Irestead
rows.translation: 伊尔斯泰德
rows.raw: "Irestead"

rows.original: Irestead

rows.original: “You want to know about the colony?” Hana sounds a bit surprised, arching a brow over her one good eye. When you asked the first time she merely brushed you off, but it only took a bit of pressuring - you are genuinely interested, not just making small talk. Your honest enthusiasm earns you a response in kind from the barkeep, who purses her lips as she collects her thoughts.
rows.translation: “你想了解这座殖民地？”花听起来有些惊讶，完好的那只眼睛上方挑起眉毛。你第一次问时，她只是敷衍过去，但稍微坚持一下便奏效了——你是真心感兴趣，并非只想闲聊。你坦率的热情也换来酒保同等认真的回应；她抿起嘴唇，整理着思绪。
rows.raw: "“You want to know about the colony?” Hana sounds a bit surprised, arching a brow over her one good eye. When you asked the first time she merely brushed you off, but it only took a bit of pressuring - you are genuinely interested, not just making small talk. Your honest enthusiasm earns you a response in kind from the barkeep, who purses her lips as she collects her thoughts."

rows.original: “Honestly, there isn’t too much to say. That’s... not quite true, clearly, but Irestead’s story is the same of a lot of backwater colonies, especially ones just hanging around for research and mining. It’s just cold. This place could be called the ‘capital’ of all of Uveto, but functionally that’s more the station. Still, it’s the heart of the colonial network. But... you could get any of that from a news article, couldn’t you?” The barkeep pauses, looking thoughtful again. Doesn’t look like she plays tourist guide often.
rows.translation: “老实说，没太多可讲的。显然，这...也不完全准确，但艾尔斯泰德的故事和许多偏远殖民地一样，尤其是那些单纯为了科研和采矿而存在的地方。这里只是很冷。这里可以称作整个乌维托的‘首都’，不过从实际功能来说，空间站更像首都。即便如此，这里仍是殖民网络的核心。但...这些东西随便一篇新闻报道都能告诉你，对吧？”酒保停下来，再次露出若有所思的神情。看来她不常充当游客向导。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Honestly, there isn’t too much to say. That’s... not quite true, clearly, but Irestead’s story is the same of a lot of backwater colonies, especially ones just hanging around for research and mining. It’s just cold. This place could be called the ‘capital’ of all of Uveto, but functionally that’s more the station. Still, it’s the heart of the colonial network. But... you could get any of that from a news article, couldn’t you?” The barkeep pauses, looking thoughtful again. Doesn’t look like she plays tourist guide often."

rows.original: “Before Rhenworld got involved this was all just a lackluster research station, really. Once someone found out there was money under the ice, well. Things changed. Suddenly there’s a reason to make sure we’re all cozy, happy and wanting to invite friends. Living conditions got better, the streets got heaters so it wasn’t just ice slabs all the time. It got... well, comfortable isn’t really right, but certainly hospitable. You can actually go outside. Heh, most colonies are just a big, parked freighter loaded with crap and a prayer that it can take off ten years later.”
rows.translation: “在雷恩世界插手之前，这里其实就是一座平平无奇的研究站。后来有人发现冰层下面藏着钱。于是事情变了。突然之间，他们有了理由确保我们过得舒适、开心，还愿意邀请朋友过来。生活条件改善了，街道也装上加热器，不再永远只是几块冰板。这里变得...嗯，说舒适并不准确，但肯定算得上适宜居住。人们真的能走到户外了。呵，大多数殖民地不过是一艘停在地上的大型货船，里面塞满破烂，再祈祷十年后它还能起飞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Before Rhenworld got involved this was all just a lackluster research station, really. Once someone found out there was money under the ice, well. Things changed. Suddenly there’s a reason to make sure we’re all cozy, happy and wanting to invite friends. Living conditions got better, the streets got heaters so it wasn’t just ice slabs all the time. It got... well, comfortable isn’t really right, but certainly hospitable. You can actually go outside. Heh, most colonies are just a big, parked freighter loaded with crap and a prayer that it can take off ten years later.”"

rows.original: “Despite that, it’s... listen, I’m pretty cushy with this bar. I could sell it - or get someone else to run it, anyway - and live in a resort in the core worlds if I really wanted to. Most of the people here are just manual laborers, roped into a job out of some trade school or other. Laborers working beside the machines - or technicians, if they actually came from higher education - trying to make a decent pay cheque. It could be better, sure, this is a rush after all. But it could be a lot worse, too.”
rows.translation: “即便如此，这里还是...听着，我靠这间酒吧过得相当滋润。真想的话，我可以卖掉它——或者让别人经营——然后去核心世界的度假胜地生活。这里大多数人都只是体力劳动者，被某所职业学校安排进工作岗位。工人在机器旁劳作——要是真受过高等教育，那就是技术员——努力挣一份像样薪水。当然，情况还能更好，毕竟这终究是一场淘金热。但也完全可能糟糕得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Despite that, it’s... listen, I’m pretty cushy with this bar. I could sell it - or get someone else to run it, anyway - and live in a resort in the core worlds if I really wanted to. Most of the people here are just manual laborers, roped into a job out of some trade school or other. Laborers working beside the machines - or technicians, if they actually came from higher education - trying to make a decent pay cheque. It could be better, sure, this is a rush after all. But it could be a lot worse, too.”"

rows.original: “Although I could really do without the Stormguards.” Hana grunts, finally finishing and, unceremoniously, going back to her mug cleaning. It doesn’t look like she intends to embellish anymore, particularly about anyone specific.
rows.translation: “不过我是真的很想摆脱那些风暴卫士。”花咕哝一声，终于说完，又毫不客气地继续擦洗酒杯。她看起来不打算再补充什么，尤其不愿谈及具体人物。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Although I could really do without the Stormguards.” Hana grunts, finally finishing and, unceremoniously, going back to her mug cleaning. It doesn’t look like she intends to embellish anymore, particularly about anyone specific."

rows.original: Hana is a pretty big woman nestled deep in a bar of local regulars who would all gladly come to the aid of a friend, no matter the situation. It’s a dangerous prospect, but your curiosity knows no limits; you measure up some volume of tact and, gently, inquire about her eyepatch.
rows.translation: 花是个相当高大的女人，身处一间挤满本地常客的酒吧；无论发生什么，这些人都会乐意帮助朋友。贸然询问很危险，但你的好奇心毫无边界；你斟酌出足够委婉的措辞，轻声问起她的眼罩。
rows.raw: "Hana is a pretty big woman nestled deep in a bar of local regulars who would all gladly come to the aid of a friend, no matter the situation. It’s a dangerous prospect, but your curiosity knows no limits; you measure up some volume of tact and, gently, inquire about her eyepatch."

rows.original: The immediate response puts you on edge; Hana tenses up, the hand wrist-deep in the mug freezing up. Her one eye narrows, the hazel hue becoming a dagger-like squint. It might be your imagination, but you swear some of the rowdy banter between the patrons quiets down, too. But that had to be coincidence, no way they could hear you, could they?
rows.translation: 她立刻作出的反应令你警觉起来；花全身绷紧，原本伸进杯子深处的手也僵住了。她仅剩的一只眼睛眯起，榛色瞳孔化作刀锋般的细线。也许只是错觉，但你发誓酒客间吵闹的谈笑也安静了一些。不过那一定只是巧合，他们不可能听见你说话，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe immediate response puts you on edge; Hana tenses up, the hand wrist-deep in the mug freezing up. Her one eye narrows, the hazel hue becoming a dagger-like squint. It might be your imagination, but you swear some of the rowdy banter between the patrons quiets down, too. But that had to be coincidence, no way they could hear you, could they?"

rows.original: “My eyepatch.” Hana repeated, the tension growing as the woman gently places the mug down on the counter top with a heavy thunk. Maybe this was a bad idea, though with the barkeep leaning forward, both hands firmly on the bar, it is far too late for second thoughts.
rows.translation: “我的眼罩。”花重复道，气氛越发紧张；女人轻轻把杯子放到台面上，却发出一声沉重闷响。也许这不是个好主意，但酒保已经俯身向前，双手牢牢撑在吧台上，现在后悔也太迟了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My eyepatch.” Hana repeated, the tension growing as the woman gently places the mug down on the counter top with a heavy thunk. Maybe this was a bad idea, though with the barkeep leaning forward, both hands firmly on the bar, it is far too late for second thoughts."

I don’t want to talk about it, traveler.” Her tone is gravelly, stern with the unmistakable harsh edge of somebody speaking through gritted teeth. A sore subject, obviously. “I am"

rows.original: Surprisingly, the ausar woman softens pretty quickly afterwards. Her glowering stare shifts into something that looks more... sad. Somber? It sounds like you dredged up a pretty sordid memory, unfortunately, so that isn’t much of a shock. Glumly, Hana snatches the mug back up and you take the cue to leave her in peace for a while, citing an apology as you backpedal right out of the mess you’ve just caused.
rows.translation: 出人意料的是，之后这名奥萨尔女人很快便缓和下来。怒视变成了某种更...悲伤的神情。阴郁？看来你不幸勾起了一段相当不堪的回忆，所以这也不奇怪。花闷闷不乐地重新抓起杯子；你领会暗示，倒退着离开自己刚制造的麻烦，一边道歉，一边让她独自安静一会儿。

rows.original: Come to think of it, who - or what - brought you back to the meadhall in the first place? You’re rather thankful to avoid the whole, you know, freezing to death on some random snowball of a world shtick. And the recuperation, but never mind that.
rows.translation: 仔细想想，当初究竟是谁——或者什么东西——把你带回这座蜜酒厅的？你很庆幸自己躲过了在某颗随处可见的冰雪星球上冻死的老套结局。还有这段康复时间，不过那就不提了。
rows.raw: "Come to think of it, who - or what - brought you back to the meadhall in the first place? You’re rather thankful to avoid the whole, you know, freezing to death on some random snowball of a world shtick. And the recuperation, but never mind that."

rows.original: Hana’s prickly demeanor shatters with your follow up quip as she barks a laugh, lips turning upwards in a wry smile that just screams “you cheeky git.” Still, she doesn’t respond immediately, leaning back to glance around the rather voluminous bar, ostentatiously to point someone out to you - and coming up empty, it seems. Oh well.
rows.translation: 你接着打趣一句，花原本尖刻的神态顿时瓦解；她放声大笑，嘴角扬起一抹讥讽笑容，简直明摆着在说“你这厚脸皮的家伙”。不过她没有立刻回答，而是向后靠去，扫视这间十分宽敞的酒吧，显然想替你指出某个人——可惜似乎没找到。算了。
rows.raw: "\n\nHana’s prickly demeanor shatters with your follow up quip as she barks a laugh, lips turning upwards in a wry smile that just screams “you cheeky git.” Still, she doesn’t respond immediately, leaning back to glance around the rather voluminous bar, ostentatiously to point someone out to you - and coming up empty, it seems. Oh well."

rows.original: “One of the rangers. They’re a group employed by the local authority and, really, make up the core of it. Bunch of lone ‘wolves’ that patrol the colony outskirts to make sure none of the natives wander into town. They also quietly keep track of people wandering out, especially random tourists. It would be pretty bad publicity for our ‘corporate overlords’ if one of our visitors were to freeze to death, after all.”
rows.translation: “是一名巡林员。他们受本地政府雇用，实际上也构成了政府的核心。一群独来独往的‘孤狼’，负责巡查殖民地外围，确保本土生物不会闯进城里。他们也会暗中记录外出的人，尤其是随便乱跑的游客。毕竟，要是哪位访客冻死了，对我们的‘企业领主’来说可是非常糟糕的宣传。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of the rangers. They’re a group employed by the local authority and, really, make up the core of it. Bunch of lone ‘wolves’ that patrol the colony outskirts to make sure none of the natives wander into town. They also quietly keep track of people wandering out, especially random tourists. It would be pretty bad publicity for our ‘corporate overlords’ if one of our visitors were to freeze to death, after all.”"

rows.original: “If you want to give them your well wishes you could try hanging around here for a while- most of them usually like to spend a few hours in here once they get back to town.”
rows.translation: “如果想向他们道谢，可以试着在这里多待一会儿——大多数人回城后通常都喜欢来这里坐上几个小时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you want to give them your well wishes you could try hanging around here for a while- most of them usually like to spend a few hours in here once they get back to town.”"

rows.original: Wait, hey! You haven’t even started yet, not properly! Despite your brief whining the barkeep doesn’t pay you any mind, continuing her work as if you hadn’t said a word.

rows.raw: "\n\nWait, hey! You haven’t even started yet, not properly! Despite your brief whining the barkeep doesn’t pay you any mind, continuing her work as if you hadn’t said a word."

rows.original: “Hey.” You begin, lamely, leaning against the bar. “I can’t help but notice it looked like you enjoyed yourself before, when I was out of it...”
rows.translation: “嘿。”你笨拙地开口，靠在吧台上。“我忍不住注意到，之前我神志不清的时候，你似乎玩得挺开心...”
rows.raw: "“Hey.” You begin, lamely, leaning against the bar. “I can’t help but notice it looked like you enjoyed yourself before, when I was out of it...”"

rows.original: You catch Hana by surprise, her mug-cleaning hand going still as an eyebrow perks upwards, questionably.
rows.translation: 花被你说得措手不及，擦洗酒杯的手停了下来，一边眉毛疑惑地扬起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou catch Hana by surprise, her mug-cleaning hand going still as an eyebrow perks upwards, questionably."

rows.original: “It’s just, you know. Neither of us got off... and that doesn’t seem like much of a returned favor to me, you know?” Rapping your fingers along the bartop, you trail off and simply smile. A smile that, quite quickly, gets mirrored by the prickly barkeep.
rows.translation: “只是，你知道。我们俩都没高潮...而且我觉得这算不上好好回报了人情，明白吗？”你用手指敲着吧台，声音逐渐低下去，只留下一个微笑。很快，尖刻酒保也露出了同样的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s just, you know. Neither of us got off... and that doesn’t seem like much of a returned favor to me, you know?” Rapping your fingers along the bartop, you trail off and simply smile. A smile that, quite quickly, gets mirrored by the prickly barkeep."

rows.original: “All right.” Hana didn’t have to think it over very long, setting her glass and rag down to, instead, lean forward much like you are. Rather close, now!
rows.translation: “好吧。”花根本没考虑多久，便放下玻璃杯和抹布，转而像你一样俯身向前。现在靠得相当近！
rows.raw: "\n\n“All right.” Hana didn’t have to think it over very long, setting her glass and rag down to, instead, lean forward much like you are. Rather close, now!"

rows.original: “And just what do you have in mind, traveler? I’ll be rather cross if it doesn’t involve returning the favor.”

rows.original: The raven haired woman is drying a mug with a thick looking cloth, an expression of thinly veiled dour apathy hanging on her face as you approach. Ouch. It takes her a moment to realize she doesn’t quite recognize you, leading to the two of you giving each other a once over - and allowing you to realize she has an eyepatch, mostly covered up by a dangling bang. Huh. Finally, the cold-acting woman grunts.
rows.translation: 你靠近时，黑发女人正用一块看起来很厚的布擦干酒杯，脸上挂着几乎不加掩饰的阴沉冷漠。好疼。她过了一会儿才意识到自己似乎不认识你，于是你们彼此打量了一遍 - 这也让你发现她戴着眼罩，只是大部分都被垂落的刘海遮住了。嗯。最后，这个举止冷淡的女人哼了一声。

rows.original: “Welcome to the Meadhall, traveler. We’ve got drinks and a fire, but I’m sure you’ve got that figured out for yourself. If there’s something you need, feel free to ask.” Her tone is impressively terse and quick spoken; she isn’t the bubbly, gregarious sort you’ve come to expect from your barkeeps.
rows.translation: “欢迎来到蜜酒大厅，旅行者。我们有酒，也有炉火，不过我想这些你自己已经看明白了。有什么需要就尽管问。”她的语调简短利落得令人印象深刻；她并不是你所熟悉的那种活泼健谈酒保。

rows.original: This sort of feeling is becoming unfortunately familiar, though it’s better than the alternative. You groan weakly, a sense of paradoxically blissful yet uncomfortable heat washing over your body, enough that you can feel the clammy sensation of sweat dotting around your features here and there. Gradually you fight off that looming sense of delirium as you come to, shifting with aching creaks of tensed up muscle. Above all else that’s what you feel; achy, all over. Still, it doesn’t take long for you to recall what had happened, nor where you were yet again. Really, it’s a repeat entirely!

The sort of ache that you just wanted to sprawl out and groan over like a useless lump, not the kind that would have you clutching your side and mewling pathetically for help. 		然而，它和上次一样没有攻击，只是在上空盘旋。它显然焦躁不安：飞得近得令人不适，四只红宝石般的眼睛闪着光，像激光锁定般死死盯住你。但它没有俯冲下来。它正试图警告你离开。

		只要加快脚步，你就能避免与这头野兽正面冲突。或者也可以坚守原地...
rows.raw:
". When you look to the sky, you see the gigantic, draconic Frostwyrm circling the air above you, like a vulture waiting for a target to collapse so it can have its meal.

		Like last time, however, it doesn’t attack. It circles the air above you. It’s clearly agitated: it’s flying uncomfortably close, and you can see the glint of its four ruby-red eyes laser-locked onto you. But it doesn’t dive you. It’s trying to warn you to leave.

		If you hurry your pace, you can avoid a confrontation with the beast. Or you could stand your ground..."

rows.original:
. Again, when you look up, the massive Frostwyrm circles the skies above you.

		Each time you’ve encountered it so far, it’s held its distance but remained incensed, refusing to approach until you postured aggressively back toward it. And again, this is the case... although its body language is noticeably less forthright. It’s willing to fight to protect its territory, something you’re clearly and repeatedly intruding on, but it recognizes you. It doesn’t want to. It knows you’ll probably win.

		You could leave the creature in peace and leave... or you could stand and fight once more.
rows.translation:
。你再次仰头时，那头庞大霜龙正在上空盘旋。

		此前每次遭遇，它都保持距离却怒火中烧，直到你摆出挑衅姿态才肯接近。这次依然如此...不过它的肢体语言明显没那么直截了当。它愿意为了保护领地而战，而你显然一次又一次侵入其中，但它认得你。它并不想打。它知道你很可能会赢。

		你可以让这头生物安静待着，转身离开...也可以再次留下战斗。

rows.original: . When you look up, you see the Frostwyrm in the air above you – but as soon as it recognizes you, it turns its nose downward and begins to dive. It lands on a snowbank nearly fifty feet away from you. And it simply... stares. It sits and watches. Its wings are tucked in and folded defensively around its gargantuan body, but its long, heavy snout lifts above them so it has clear line of sight on you. It snarls, its four red eyes narrowed, but it doesn’t appaorach. From its body language, it’s ready and willing to fight to protect its territory, but at this point, you both know how that’s going to go. The fact that you’re obviously intruding on the Frostwyrm’s territory, and the fact that you’re doing it repeatedly and willingly, comes to mind. You’re the one that’s in the wrong, here. But every time, it only attacks when you threaten it back. It’s always tried to let you leave, and it only fights because it must. It’s intelligent enough to recognize you and your skill compared to it. Every time you’ve beaten it, it lied sprawled in the snow, watching you with fear as you decided what to do with it, but each time, it accepted its fate. You wonder. What would happen if you fought it, but let it win? Would it take advantage of your weakness and kill you immediately? Would it spare you, as you had been sparing it? Is that a risk you’re willing to take? Only one way to find out.
rows.translation: 。你抬头后看见霜龙正在上空飞行 - 但它一认出你，就立刻压低鼻端开始俯冲，最终落在近五十英尺外的一处雪堆上。 随后它只是...盯着你。它坐在那里观察，双翼收拢并防御性地裹住庞大身体，但长而沉重的口鼻从翅膀上方抬起，让它能清楚看见你。它低声咆哮，四只红眼眯成细缝，却没有靠近。从肢体语言来看，它已准备好也愿意为保护领地而战，不过到这一步，你们都知道结果会怎样。 你显然正在侵犯霜龙的领地，而且一次次主动这样做，这个事实浮上脑海。犯错的是你。但每一次，只有当你反过来威胁它时，它才会发动攻击。它总是先让你离开，只因迫不得已才战斗。它足够聪明，能认出你，也明白你的本领远胜于它。每次被击败，它都会摊在雪地里，恐惧地看着你决定如何处置，而每一次，它都接受了自己的命运。 你不禁思考。如果与它战斗，却故意让它获胜，会发生什么？它会利用你的弱点立刻杀死你吗？还是会像你一次次饶过它那样饶过你？你愿意冒这个险吗？ 只有一个办法能知道答案。

It lands on a snowbank nearly fifty feet away from you. And it simply... stares. It sits and watches. Its wings are tucked in and folded defensively around its gargantuan body, but its long, heavy snout lifts above them so it has clear line of sight on you. It snarls, its four red eyes narrowed, but it doesn’t appaorach. From its body language, it’s ready and willing to fight to protect its territory, but at this point, you both know how that’s going to go. The fact that you’re obviously intruding on the Frostwyrm’s territory, and the fact that you’re doing it repeatedly and willingly, comes to mind. You’re the one that’s in the wrong, here. But every time, it only attacks when you threaten it back. It’s always tried to let you leave, and it only fights because it must. It’s intelligent enough to recognize you and your skill compared to it. Every time you’ve beaten it, it lied sprawled in the snow, watching you with fear as you decided what to do with it, but each time, it accepted its fate. You wonder. What would happen if you fought it, but let it win? Would it take advantage of your weakness and kill you immediately? Would it spare you, as you had been sparing it? Is that a risk you’re willing to take? Only one way to find out."

rows.original: B

You hear a familiar, bestial roar overhead. Looking up, you can clearly see the outline of a massive winged creature soaring through the sky, circling you. Oh, shit. You get your [pc.mainWeapon] ready as the draconic frostwyrm does a barrel roll and dives down, slamming into the snow just a short ways ahead of you. It lets out a fearsome battle roar and stalks towards you, a dark shape through the haze of billowing snow.
rows.translation: 你听见头顶传来熟悉的野兽咆哮。抬头后，你清楚看见一头巨大有翼生物的轮廓正在空中翱翔盘旋。哦，操。你握紧[pc.mainWeapon]准备战斗；龙形霜龙在空中做了个桶滚后俯冲下来，重重砸进不远处的雪地。它发出骇人的战吼，透过翻涌雪雾化作一道黑影，朝你步步逼近。
rows.raw: "You hear a familiar, bestial roar overhead. Looking up, you can clearly see the outline of a massive winged creature soaring through the sky, circling you. Oh, shit. You get your [pc.mainWeapon] ready as the draconic frostwyrm does a barrel roll and dives down, slamming into the snow just a short ways ahead of you. It lets out a fearsome battle roar and stalks towards you, a dark shape through the haze of billowing snow."

rows.raw: "Neoptolemus"

rows.original: You’ve gone toe to toe with some terrifying foes in your time. But there’s no way you’re going to fight that. Instead, adrenaline pumping, you break into a desperate sprint away from the gigantic lizard behind you. When you hazard a glance back over your shoulder the frostwyrm doesn’t seem to have given chase at all, although those four draconic eyes are still fixed on you.
rows.translation: 你一路走来曾与一些骇人的敌人正面交锋，但你绝不可能去对付那个。于是肾上腺素狂涌，你开始拼命冲刺，逃离身后那头巨大蜥蜴。冒险回头一瞥时，霜龙似乎根本没有追赶，不过四只龙眼依然牢牢盯着你。
rows.raw: "You’ve gone toe to toe with some terrifying foes in your time. But there’s no way you’re going to fight that. Instead, adrenaline pumping, you break into a desperate sprint away from the gigantic lizard behind you. When you hazard a glance back over your shoulder the frostwyrm doesn’t seem to have given chase at all, although those four draconic eyes are still fixed on you."

rows.original: What feels like an eternity latter, the wyrm beats its wings and takes off again, flying back the way it came. You take a few minutes to recover your breath, by then the beast is completely out of sight.
rows.translation: 感觉仿佛过了永恒那么久之后，霜龙终于拍动翅膀再次起飞，沿来路飞走。你花了几分钟恢复呼吸，此时那头野兽已经完全消失在视野中。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat feels like an eternity latter, the wyrm beats its wings and takes off again, flying back the way it came. You take a few minutes to recover your breath, by then the beast is completely out of sight."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: With a pathetic groan, the beast finally collapses. It topples onto its side, surrounded by a billow of snow that spews into the air. Its tail thrashes, wings beating weakly as it slips out of consciousness.
rows.translation: 随着一声可怜呻吟，野兽终于倒下。它侧身倾倒，周围喷起一大片飞扬雪雾。它尾巴疯狂抽动，双翼无力拍打，逐渐失去意识。
rows.raw: "With a pathetic groan, the beast finally collapses. It topples onto its side, surrounded by a billow of snow that spews into the air. Its tail thrashes, wings beating weakly as it slips out of consciousness."

rows.original: Tentatively, wary of a trap, you approach the defeated creature with weapon at the ready. Waving snow out of your face, you manage to lock gaze with a quartet of glowing red eyes, looking up at you with what you can only imagine is fear.
rows.translation: 你警惕着陷阱，举好武器，小心翼翼地接近落败生物。挥开面前雪花后，你终于与四只发光红眼对上目光；它仰望着你，其中流露的情绪只能被你理解为恐惧。
rows.raw: "\n\nTentatively, wary of a trap, you approach the defeated creature with weapon at the ready. Waving snow out of your face, you manage to lock gaze with a quartet of glowing red eyes, looking up at you with what you can only imagine is fear. "

rows.original: It’s afraid!
rows.translation: 它害怕了！
rows.raw: "It’s afraid!"

rows.original: The creature knows it has lost, and is utterly at your mercy.
rows.translation: 这头生物知道自己已经落败，完全任你宰割。
rows.raw: "The creature knows it has lost, and is utterly at your mercy."

rows.original: What do you do?
rows.translation: 你要怎么做？
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat do you do?"

rows.original: FROSTWYRM_VICTORY_COUNT
rows.raw: "FROSTWYRM_VICTORY_COUNT"

rows.original: Kill It
rows.translation: 杀死它
rows.raw: "Kill It"

rows.original: Kill It
rows.translation: 杀死它
rows.raw: "Kill It"

rows.original: This creature will only threaten you again. Kill it now, and save yourself from future battles.
rows.translation: 这头生物只会再次威胁你。现在杀了它，免去将来的战斗。
rows.raw: "This creature will only threaten you again. Kill it now, and save yourself from future battles."

rows.original: Leave It
rows.translation: 别管它
rows.raw: "Leave It"

rows.original: Frostwyrm Scales
rows.raw: "Frostwyrm Scales"

rows.original: You will not be threatened by this creature again. You bring your weapon to bear and finish it quickly. The frostwyrm dies with a pathetic screech, and then falls still and silent.
rows.translation: 你不会再受到这头生物的威胁。你举起武器，迅速结束了它的生命。霜龙发出一声可怜尖啸，随后一动不动地归于寂静。
rows.raw: "You will not be threatened by this creature again. You bring your weapon to bear and finish it quickly. The frostwyrm dies with a pathetic screech, and then falls still and silent."

rows.original: Once it’s gone, you spend a few minutes harvesting some of its scales and leather -- you could probably get something cool made out of it.
rows.translation: 它死后，你花了几分钟采集鳞片与皮革 -- 大概能用这些做出某件很酷的东西。
rows.raw: " Once it’s gone, you spend a few minutes harvesting some of its scales and leather -- you could probably get something cool made out of it.\n\n"

rows.original: You turn away from the creature and head back into the snow-blasted glacier, leaving it to its fate. A few moments later, you hear a roar behind you and the sound of the great beast taking flight.
rows.translation: 你转身离开那头生物，重新走进风雪肆虐的冰川，把它留给自己的命运。片刻后，身后传来咆哮声，以及巨兽振翅起飞的动静。
rows.raw: "You turn away from the creature and head back into the snow-blasted glacier, leaving it to its fate. A few moments later, you hear a roar behind you and the sound of the great beast taking flight."

rows.original: Something tells you you’ll see it again, once it’s had time to lick its wounds.
rows.translation: 某种直觉告诉你，等它有时间舔舐伤口后，你还会再次见到它。
rows.raw:
"

Something tells you you’ll see it again, once it’s had time to lick its wounds.

"

rows.original: B
With a final gasp, you crumple to the ground, utterly defeated. Your gaze is cast down to the ice and snow beneath you as you pant
rows.translation: 你发出最后一声喘息，彻底落败地瘫倒在地。你喘息着，目光垂向身下的冰雪
rows.raw: "With a final gasp, you crumple to the ground, utterly defeated. Your gaze is cast down to the ice and snow beneath you as you pant"

rows.original: in lust
rows.translation: ，欲火中烧
rows.raw: " in lust"

rows.original: , then, as you hear the rumblings of the giant Frostwyrm pace before you, you muster the nerve and the strength to stare it in the eye.
rows.translation: ；随后听见巨大霜龙在面前踱步的低沉动静，你鼓起勇气与力气，直视它的双眼。
rows.raw: ", then, as you hear the rumblings of the giant Frostwyrm pace before you, you muster the nerve and the strength to stare it in the eye."

rows.original: The creature’s scaly skin is pockmarked by scars and nicks in its otherwise smooth frame, evidence of not only your past encounters of it, but your victories. Now that the situation’s been reversed
rows.translation: 这头生物光滑躯体上的鳞片遍布疤痕与缺口，既是你们过去多次遭遇的证据，也是你一次次获胜的见证。如今局势已经逆转
rows.raw: "\n\nThe creature’s scaly skin is pockmarked by scars and nicks in its otherwise smooth frame, evidence of not only your past encounters of it, but your victories. Now that the situation’s been reversed"

rows.original: a second time
rows.translation: 第二次
rows.raw: " a second time"

rows.original: , you hope beyond hope that the creature is compassionate enough to realize that you’ve spared it every time already, and that it’ll extend the same mercy to you.
rows.translation: ，你只能拼命祈祷这生物足够仁慈，能意识到你先前每次都饶了它，并对你展现同样的慈悲。
rows.raw: ", you hope beyond hope that the creature is compassionate enough to realize that you’ve spared it every time already, and that it’ll extend the same mercy to you."

rows.original: The Frostwyrm bends its long neck towards you, its enormous maw open and its hot breath washing over your prone
rows.translation: 霜龙将长颈探向你，巨口大张，滚烫吐息冲刷着你倒地不起的
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Frostwyrm bends its long neck towards you, its enormous maw open and its hot breath washing over your prone"

rows.original: and beaten
rows.translation: 且伤痕累累的
rows.raw: " and beaten"

rows.original: form. Its four flame-red eyes bore into you, studying you – it paces indecisively before you, wary and cautious, clearly familiar with you and your previous victories. That it hasn’t yet eaten you, you take as a good sign.
rows.translation: 身躯。四只火红眼睛死死盯着你，仔细审视；它在你面前迟疑地来回踱步，警惕而谨慎，显然认出了你，也记得你先前的胜利。它还没吃掉你，你姑且将此视为好兆头。
rows.raw: " form. Its four flame-red eyes bore into you, studying you – it paces indecisively before you, wary and cautious, clearly familiar with you and your previous victories. That it hasn’t yet eaten you, you take as a good sign."

rows.original: You haven’t forgotten its warning the last time it defeated you.
rows.translation: 你并未忘记上次被它击败时收到的警告。
rows.raw: " You haven’t forgotten its warning the last time it defeated you."

rows.original: It leans forward and, with a flair of the nostrils and a huff from its massive lungs, it snorts in your face. You suddenly feel a sensation in the back of your head.
rows.translation: 它向前俯身，鼻孔一张，从巨大肺腑中喷出一口气，正吹在你脸上。你突然感觉后脑传来一阵异样。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt leans forward and, with a flair of the nostrils and a huff from its massive lungs, it snorts in your face. You suddenly feel a sensation in the back of your head."

rows.original: You brace for the sharp pain that came last time this happened, but this time is different.
rows.translation: 你做好准备承受上次同样情况时袭来的尖锐疼痛，但这次有所不同。
rows.raw: " You brace for the sharp pain that came last time this happened, but this time is different."

rows.original: It’s a light pressure that you can only describe as insistent, but not forceful, urging you to something. The edges of your vision grow clouded, yet you see the Frostwyrm before you with a sudden, sharp clarity, undistracted by the pangs of your most recent loss.
rows.translation: 那只是一股轻微压力，你只能将其形容为执拗，却并不强硬，催促你去做某件事。视野边缘逐渐模糊，眼前的霜龙却骤然变得无比清晰，不再受到刚刚败北所带来的痛楚干扰。
rows.raw: " It’s a light pressure that you can only describe as insistent, but not forceful, urging you to something. The edges of your vision grow clouded, yet you see the Frostwyrm before you with a sudden, sharp clarity, undistracted by the pangs of your most recent loss."

rows.original: A voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. Why do you haunt me? it asks slowly. Each time we’ve met, we’ve done combat, and every time but now, you’ve bested me. You do not seek the thrill of the kill. You do not hunt for my lair. What is your goal?
rows.translation: 一个声音在双耳之间重重回响，野兽般低沉粗哑，却又轻如耳语。你为何纠缠于我？它缓缓问道。我们每次相遇都会交战，除去今日，每次都是你胜过我。你并不追求杀戮的刺激，也没有寻找我的巢穴。你究竟有何目的？
rows.raw: "\n\nA voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. Why do you haunt me? it asks slowly. Each time we’ve met, we’ve done combat, and every time but now, you’ve bested me. You do not seek the thrill of the kill. You do not hunt for my lair. What is your goal?"

rows.original: The Frostwyrm sits on its haunches, awaiting your reply. You hesitate, wondering if it’s an actual question, and then, honestly, you struggle to think of any single, reasonable answer. What possessed you to explore the frozen, restricting wastes of Uveto and scour its eastern coastline, knowing that a Frostwyrm claimed it as its territory?
rows.translation: 霜龙以后腿坐下，等待你的回答。你迟疑片刻，不确定这是否真是个问题；老实说，你甚至想不出一个合理的答案。明知霜龙已将此处划为领地，究竟是什么驱使你探索乌维托冰封而闭塞的荒原，搜遍东部海岸？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Frostwyrm sits on its haunches, awaiting your reply. You hesitate, wondering if it’s an actual question, and then, honestly, you struggle to think of any single, reasonable answer. What possessed you to explore the frozen, restricting wastes of Uveto and scour its eastern coastline, knowing that a Frostwyrm claimed it as its territory?"

rows.original: To be honest, there’s only one reason that immediately pops into your head. You’re... sexually-minded a lot of the time, and, like, there aren’t a lot of creatures that are as big, like, physically, in the universe. Imagine the cheers you’d get if you told everyone that you tamed a Frostwyrm to the point of it allowing you to fuck it!
rows.translation: 老实说，你脑中立刻冒出的理由只有一个。你...很多时候满脑子都是性，而且，像这样在体型上如此庞大的生物，整个宇宙里也没有多少。想象一下，要是你告诉所有人，自己驯服了一条霜龙，甚至让它同意与你交配，会得到怎样的欢呼！
rows.raw: " To be honest, there’s only one reason that immediately pops into your head. You’re... sexually-minded a lot of the time, and, like, there aren’t a lot of creatures that are as big, like, physically, in the universe. Imagine the cheers you’d get if you told everyone that you tamed a Frostwyrm to the point of it allowing you to fuck it!"

rows.original: You answer that you’ve never put much thought into the why, other than because... it exists. The satisfaction of asserting your superiority over a creature as glorious and mythical as a Frostwyrm is one that you’ve never heard another person rightfully boast.
rows.translation: 你回答说，自己从没认真思考过为什么，只是因为...它就在那里。征服霜龙这般辉煌而神秘的生物所带来的满足感，你从未听说还有谁能名正言顺地夸耀。
rows.raw: " You answer that you’ve never put much thought into the why, other than because... it exists. The satisfaction of asserting your superiority over a creature as glorious and mythical as a Frostwyrm is one that you’ve never heard another person rightfully boast."

rows.original: The creature huffs once in frustration, its four eyes narrowing on yours. How cruel, it says. My kind are so few now. You would play with extinguishing a species so that you can crow about it to others of your
rows.translation: 这生物沮丧地喷了口气，四只眼睛眯起，紧盯着你。何其残忍，它说道。如今我的族类已如此稀少。你竟为了向其他与你
rows.raw: "\n\nThe creature huffs once in frustration, its four eyes narrowing on yours. How cruel, it says. My kind are so few now. You would play with extinguishing a species so that you can crow about it to others of your "

rows.original: -kind. All I wish is to protect my domain.
rows.translation: 同族之人炫耀，拿一个物种的灭绝取乐。我所求不过是守护自己的领地。
rows.raw: "-kind. All I wish is to protect my domain."

rows.original: You remain silent as the beast criticizes you and your brash way of thinking. That said, it continues, a heavy sigh flaring its nostrils once again, you have proven yourself quite capable. I have existed for many Sky Cycles, and I have battled many peoples and creatures before you. You are the first to not only best me, but to do so consistently. Consider your ‘superiority’ asserted,
rows.translation: 野兽批评着你和你莽撞的思维方式，你始终沉默。话虽如此，它继续说道，沉重叹息再次撑开鼻孔，你已经充分证明了自己的能力。我已经存世许多个天空周期，在你之前也与众多族群和生物交战。你不仅是第一个胜过我的，也是第一个能一再做到这一点的。就当你的“优越性”已经得到证明吧，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou remain silent as the beast criticizes you and your brash way of thinking. That said, it continues, a heavy sigh flaring its nostrils once again, you have proven yourself quite capable. I have existed for many Sky Cycles, and I have battled many peoples and creatures before you. You are the first to not only best me, but to do so consistently. Consider your ‘superiority’ asserted, "

rows.original: : you are an exemplary specimen.
rows.translation: ：你是一具堪称典范的个体。
rows.raw: ": you are an exemplary specimen."

rows.original: Your earlier aches from the battle quickly fade at the Frostwyrm’s praise
rows.translation: 霜龙的赞扬让先前战斗留下的疼痛迅速消退
rows.raw: "\n\nYour earlier aches from the battle quickly fade at the Frostwyrm’s praise"

rows.original: though all it does for your crotch is make you
rows.translation: ，但这番话对胯间的唯一作用，就是令你更加
rows.raw: " though all it does for your crotch is make you"

rows.original: harder
rows.translation: 更加坚硬
rows.raw: " harder"

rows.original: and
rows.translation: 且
rows.raw: " and"

rows.original: wetter
rows.translation: 更加湿润
rows.raw: " wetter"

rows.original: . A dragon is admitting that you’re better than it! If that doesn’t make you eligible, then nothing does.
rows.translation: 。一条龙亲口承认你比它更优秀！如果这还不算合格，那就没有什么算了。
rows.raw: ". A dragon is admitting that you’re better than it! If that doesn’t make you eligible, then nothing does."

rows.original: This encounter between us is different, it continues, pressing one of its six enormous feet into the ice before you. The snow and ice crunch and crack beneath its weight, to prove its point. I could crush you now. I could break you and save you for dinner later. I will not do these things.
rows.translation: 我们这次相遇与以往不同，它继续说道，将六只巨足之一压在你面前的冰面上。积雪与坚冰在它的重量下嘎吱碎裂，证明了它的话。我现在可以碾碎你，可以打断你的骨头，将你留作稍后的晚餐。但我不会这样做。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis encounter between us is different, it continues, pressing one of its six enormous feet into the ice before you. The snow and ice crunch and crack beneath its weight, to prove its point. I could crush you now. I could break you and save you for dinner later. I will not do these things."

rows.original: You gulp audibly as it flexes its massive form and draconian muscles, reminding you exactly where you are.
rows.translation: 它绷紧庞大身躯与龙族肌肉，提醒你究竟身在何处；你不由自主地大声咽了口唾沫。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gulp audibly as it flexes its massive form and draconian muscles, reminding you exactly where you are."

rows.original: I require something of you, which I claim by right of victory, the Frostwyrm says suddenly. You wonder to yourself what you could possibly offer it. I require your willing
rows.translation: 我要求你给予一样东西，这是我凭胜利之权索取的，霜龙突然说道。你暗自思索，自己究竟能为它提供什么。我需要你自愿献出
rows.raw: "\n\nI require something of you, which I claim by right of victory, the Frostwyrm says suddenly. You wonder to yourself what you could possibly offer it. I require your willing "

rows.original: seed
rows.translation: 精种
rows.raw: "seed "

rows.original: womb
rows.translation: 子宫
rows.raw: "womb "

rows.original: body
rows.translation: 身体
rows.raw: "body "

rows.original: to ensure the future of my species. I have been unable to find a proper mate these many Sky Cycles; a strong, cunning, exemplary, superior
rows.translation: 来确保我族的未来。许多个天空周期以来，我始终无法找到合适的配偶；像你这样强大、狡猾、堪称典范且优越的
rows.raw: "to ensure the future of my species. I have been unable to find a proper mate these many Sky Cycles; a strong, cunning, exemplary, superior "

rows.original: such as yourself will do nicely.
rows.translation: 个体正合我意。
rows.raw: " such as yourself will do nicely."

rows.original: Your cheeks flush suddenly. The Frostwyrm... wants to fuck you? And make little Frostwyrm half-breeds?
rows.translation: 你的双颊突然发烫。霜龙...想要操你？还要生下一群霜龙混血幼崽？
rows.raw: "\n\nYour cheeks flush suddenly. The Frostwyrm... wants to fuck you? And make little Frostwyrm half-breeds?"

rows.original: It all almost sounds too good to be true!
rows.translation: 这一切简直好得不像真的！
rows.raw: "It all almost sounds too good to be true!"

rows.original: Your first impulse isn’t to say no; it’s to ask the creature if it’s even possible. Six tales of my kind mating with others have reached me, and yet more may exist. The resulting kip would inherit the strongest, most definitive traits of us both. In my tireless search for a proper mate, perhaps it was never meant to be one of my own species. You feel a pleasant, tingling sensation down your spine; a pleasurable shock that works to your groin and arouses you
rows.translation: 你的第一反应并不是拒绝，而是询问这生物是否真的可行。我曾听闻六则族人与异族交配的故事，或许还有更多。诞生的幼崽会继承我们双方最强大、最鲜明的特征。在我不知疲倦地寻找合适配偶时，或许命中注定的对象本就不是我的同族。一阵愉悦的酥麻沿脊柱而下，化作快感冲向胯间，令你
rows.raw: "\n\nYour first impulse isn’t to say no; it’s to ask the creature if it’s even possible. Six tales of my kind mating with others have reached me, and yet more may exist. The resulting kip would inherit the strongest, most definitive traits of us both. In my tireless search for a proper mate, perhaps it was never meant to be one of my own species. You feel a pleasant, tingling sensation down your spine; a pleasurable shock that works to your groin and arouses you"

rows.original: even further
rows.translation: 更加
rows.raw: " even further"

rows.original: . And, I am sure, the feat of defeating a creature as glorious and mythical as myself would pale in comparison to breeding with one. The promise of it being a good time is not lost on you.
rows.translation: 兴奋。而且我确信，比起与我这样辉煌而神秘的生物交配，击败我的壮举也会黯然失色。你当然明白，这保证会是一段美妙时光。
rows.raw: ". And, I am sure, the feat of defeating a creature as glorious and mythical as myself would pale in comparison to breeding with one. The promise of it being a good time is not lost on you."

rows.original: What if you refuse? Then I would extend the same mercy as you have to me. This would be the last of our encounters together. I will not risk my health for your selfish satisfaction any longer.
rows.translation: 如果你拒绝呢？那么，我会像你宽恕我一样宽恕你。这将是我们最后一次相遇。我不会再为了满足你的自私欲望而拿自己的健康冒险。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat if you refuse? Then I would extend the same mercy as you have to me. This would be the last of our encounters together. I will not risk my health for your selfish satisfaction any longer."

rows.original: This was definitely not the result you had expected when you lost your battle against the Frostwyrm, but now, you’ve been given a unique opportunity. Do you willingly breed with the Frostwyrm and work with it to ensure the survival of its species? Or do you refuse its invitation and part ways with it forever?
rows.translation: 这绝不是你在败给霜龙时预想的结果，但现在，一个独一无二的机会已经摆在面前。你愿意与霜龙交配，同它一起确保其族群延续吗？还是拒绝邀请，与它永远分道扬镳？
rows.raw: "\n\nThis was definitely not the result you had expected when you lost your battle against the Frostwyrm, but now, you’ve been given a unique opportunity. Do you willingly breed with the Frostwyrm and work with it to ensure the survival of its species? Or do you refuse its invitation and part ways with it forever?"

rows.original: Accept
rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.original: Accept
rows.translation: 接受
rows.raw: "Accept"

rows.original: Willingly breed with the Frostwyrm and work with it to ensure the survival of its species.
rows.translation: 自愿与霜龙交配，同它一起确保其族群延续。
rows.raw: "Willingly breed with the Frostwyrm and work with it to ensure the survival of its species."

rows.original: Refuse
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Refuse"

rows.original: Refuse
rows.translation: 拒绝
rows.raw: "Refuse"

rows.original: Refuse its invitation and part ways with it forever.
rows.translation: 拒绝它的邀请，与它永远分道扬镳。
rows.raw: "Refuse its invitation and part ways with it forever."

rows.original: With a final gasp, you crumple to the ground, utterly defeated. Your life, short that it’s been, flashes before your eyes as the behemoth of frost and scales lumbers toward you, fangs bared and slavering with bestial hunger.
rows.translation: 随着最后一声喘息，你瘫倒在地，彻底落败。短暂一生如走马灯般在眼前闪过，冰霜与鳞片构成的庞然巨兽迈步逼近，露出獠牙，因野兽般饥饿而垂涎欲滴。
rows.raw: "With a final gasp, you crumple to the ground, utterly defeated. Your life, short that it’s been, flashes before your eyes as the behemoth of frost and scales lumbers toward you, fangs bared and slavering with bestial hunger."

rows.original: You scramble back, but a single stride of the creature’s six huge legs brings it so close that you can feel its breath hot against your [pc.face]. It growls, regarding you with its four red eyes. Rather than open wide to devour you, though, the creature snorts in your face, and you feel a sudden pressure on the back of your head. Your vision swims as an unwelcome force burrows into your mind.
rows.translation: 你慌忙后退，但这生物六条巨腿只跨出一步便来到近前，滚烫吐息扑在你的[pc.face]上。它低声咆哮，四只红眼审视着你。然而它并未张开巨口将你吞噬，而是朝你脸上喷了口气；你顿觉后脑遭到一股压力。视野摇晃，一股不受欢迎的力量钻入你的心智。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scramble back, but a single stride of the creature’s six huge legs brings it so close that you can feel its breath hot against your [pc.face]. It growls, regarding you with its four red eyes. Rather than open wide to devour you, though, the creature snorts in your face, and you feel a sudden pressure on the back of your head. Your vision swims as an unwelcome force burrows into your mind."

rows.original: A pounding pain thunders through your mind, feeling like your head is about to be rend apart. You wrap your hands around your head, a feeble effort to ward off the psychic assault drilling through your consciousness. Your attempts are futile, utterly insufficient in your state of
rows.translation: 一阵雷鸣般的剧痛轰击脑海，仿佛头颅即将被撕裂。你双手抱头，徒劳试图抵挡钻入意识的灵能猛攻。以你现在
rows.raw: "\n\nA pounding pain thunders through your mind, feeling like your head is about to be rend apart. You wrap your hands around your head, a feeble effort to ward off the psychic assault drilling through your consciousness. Your attempts are futile, utterly insufficient in your state of "

rows.original: physical defeat.
rows.translation: 肉体落败的状态
rows.raw: "physical defeat."

rows.original: overwhelming sexual arousal.
rows.translation: 性欲高涨到无法自持的状态
rows.raw: "overwhelming sexual arousal."

rows.original: Your defenses are compromised, and you can feel them slowly peeled apart, stripped layer by layer like an onion until you’re suddenly aware of another presence in your mind, a worming coldness squirming through your brain.
rows.translation: ，这种抵抗完全无济于事。你的防线已经破损，能感觉它们缓缓剥落，像洋葱般一层层被揭去，直到你突然意识到心中多出另一个存在，一股蠕动的寒意正钻过你的大脑。
rows.raw: " Your defenses are compromised, and you can feel them slowly peeled apart, stripped layer by layer like an onion until you’re suddenly aware of another presence in your mind, a worming coldness squirming through your brain."

rows.original: A voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. You did not run, it says, as the frostwyrm snorts a frigid breath across your face. Most run.
rows.translation: 一个声音在双耳之间重重回响，野兽般低沉粗哑，却又轻如耳语。你没有逃跑，它说道，霜龙冰冷吐息掠过你的脸。大多数都会逃。
rows.raw: "\n\nA voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. You did not run, it says, as the frostwyrm snorts a frigid breath across your face. Most run."

rows.original: “W-what?” you groan, not sure if you’re speaking aloud or just thinking back at the voice burrowing in your brain.
rows.translation: “什、什么？”你呻吟道，不确定自己究竟真的说出了口，还是只在意识里回应那个钻入脑海的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-what?” you groan, not sure if you’re speaking aloud or just thinking back at the voice burrowing in your brain."

rows.original: Are you brave, or foolish, I wonder? the voice says. Your kind come to slay me with their great machines of fire and war... and yet here you stand alone. Ah, a word in your language: hubris.
rows.translation: 我在想，你是勇敢，还是愚蠢？那个声音说道。你的族类带着烈火与战争的庞大机器前来杀我...而你却孤身站在这里。啊，用你们语言里的一个词来说：傲慢。
rows.raw: "\n\nAre you brave, or foolish, I wonder? the voice says. Your kind come to slay me with their great machines of fire and war... and yet here you stand alone. Ah, a word in your language: hubris."

rows.original: The creature snorts again and withdraws, rising to its full and terrifying height. With an ear-piercing bellow, the wyrm turns away from you, looking back across the misty sea to the east. Never again come to my domain, creature. Keep your distance from the coastlands. I will not be so forgiving a second time.
rows.translation: 这生物再次喷气，随后退开，挺起那高大而骇人的身躯。霜龙发出刺耳咆哮，转身背对你，遥望东方雾气弥漫的海面。永远不要再踏入我的领地，生物。离海岸地区远些。若有第二次，我不会如此宽容。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe creature snorts again and withdraws, rising to its full and terrifying height. With an ear-piercing bellow, the wyrm turns away from you, looking back across the misty sea to the east. Never again come to my domain, creature. Keep your distance from the coastlands. I will not be so forgiving a second time."

rows.original: Glancing at you over its shoulder, the wyrm takes wing and dives beneath the glacial cliff and out of sight.
rows.translation: 霜龙越过肩头瞥你一眼，随后振翅而起，俯冲至冰川悬崖下方，消失在视野中。
rows.raw: "\n\nGlancing at you over its shoulder, the wyrm takes wing and dives beneath the glacial cliff and out of sight."

rows.original: Note: Make sure you have defeated the frostwyrm in combat at least three times (your victory count:
rows.translation: 注意：请确保你已经在战斗中击败霜龙至少三次（当前胜利次数：
rows.raw: "\n\nNote: Make sure you have defeated the frostwyrm in combat at least three times (your victory count: "

rows.translation: ），并且在再次败给它之前能够使其受孕或被其受孕，否则将会产生后果！
rows.raw: ") and can breed or be bred before losing to it again, otherwise there will be consequences!"

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 一阵雷鸣般的剧痛轰击脑海，仿佛头颅即将被撕裂。你双手抱头，徒劳试图抵挡钻入意识的灵能猛攻。以你现在

rows.translation: ，这种抵抗完全无济于事。你的防线已经破损，能感觉它们缓缓剥落，像洋葱般一层层被揭去，直到你突然意识到心中多出另一个存在，一股蠕动的寒意正钻过你的大脑。
rows.raw: " Your defenses are compromised, and you can feel them slowly peeled apart, stripped layer by layer like an onion until you’re suddenly aware of another presence in your mind, a worming coldness squirming through your brain."

rows.original: A voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. You did not run, it says, an echo of your prior defeat. I warned you once to never again darken my door. Yet not only do I find you here again, but you lack the sense to flee when confronted.
rows.translation: 一个声音在双耳之间重重回响，野兽般低沉粗哑，却又轻如耳语。你没有逃跑，它说道，仿佛呼应着你上次的败北。我曾警告过你，永远不要再次踏上我的门槛。可我不仅又在这里发现了你，你在与我对峙时甚至还不懂得逃走。
rows.raw: "\n\nA voice pounds between your ears, bestial and guttural, yet soft as a whisper. You did not run, it says, an echo of your prior defeat. I warned you once to never again darken my door. Yet not only do I find you here again, but you lack the sense to flee when confronted."

rows.original: The frostwyrm looms down on you, billowing icy breath across your face. You shiver, scrabbling back away from it... until one of its huge, bestial claws reaches out and grabs you around the waist, pinning you to the ice.
rows.translation: 霜龙居高临下俯视着你，将冰冷吐息喷在你脸上。你浑身发抖，手脚并用地向后退去...直到一只野兽般的巨爪伸来，抓住你的腰，将你压在冰面上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe frostwyrm looms down on you, billowing icy breath across your face. You shiver, scrabbling back away from it... until one of its huge, bestial claws reaches out and grabs you around the waist, pinning you to the ice."

rows.original: The beast seems to consider you for a moment, its draconic eyes drilling into you before it exudes a long breath and clutches its claws around you.
