rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] begins to purr, and you relax against her, letting the vibrations soothe you. You let the moment settle before asking for more information on what you should expect from the pregnancy. There will be approximately two rotations of the Orb between the kip’s conception to when it is laid. Another two will pass before the young kip is strong enough to hatch from its shell; and another two will pass before it is prepared to hunt, mate, and leave the lair. It will be one Sky Cycle until the kip is fully matured.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]开始发出咕噜声，你靠着她放松下来，让震动抚慰身心。你静静体会片刻，随后询问这次怀孕还会经历些什么。从幼崽受孕到产下，大约会经过天空之球的两次轮转。再经过两次轮转，幼崽才会强壮到足以破壳；又过两次，它便准备好狩猎、交配并离开巢穴。一个天空周期后，幼崽就会完全成熟。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] begins to purr, and you relax against her, letting the vibrations soothe you. You let the moment settle before asking for more information on what you should expect from the pregnancy. There will be approximately two rotations of the Orb between the kip’s conception to when it is laid. Another two will pass before the young kip is strong enough to hatch from its shell; and another two will pass before it is prepared to hunt, mate, and leave the lair. It will be one Sky Cycle until the kip is fully matured."

rows.original: You ask her if she can translate any of those times to measurements you understand. After she prods at your mind for a moment, she responds: four of what your kind calls a ‘month’ for each of the kip’s growth stage, and one ‘year’ until it is fully mature.
rows.translation: 你问她能否把这些时间换算成自己熟悉的单位。她在你的思维中探查片刻，回答道：幼崽成长的每个阶段，相当于你们种族所谓的“四个月”；等到完全成熟，则需要“一年”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if she can translate any of those times to measurements you understand. After she prods at your mind for a moment, she responds: four of what your kind calls a ‘month’ for each of the kip’s growth stage, and one ‘year’ until it is fully mature."

rows.original: There is one matter yet, my mate, [frostwyrm.name] cautions. Your attention is undivided on her. Though our mating has taken, and we shall lay our progeny as I had described, its bearing will not hatch without the knowing watch and attunement of its sires. Both of the kip’s bearers must be present, else they will never hatch.
rows.translation: 还有一件事，我的伴侣，[frostwyrm.name]提醒道。你全神贯注地听着。尽管我们的交配已经成功，也会如我所述产下后代，但若没有双亲清醒的守望与协调，所孕育的幼崽便无法孵化。幼崽的两位孕育者都必须在场，否则它永远不会破壳。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is one matter yet, my mate, [frostwyrm.name] cautions. Your attention is undivided on her. Though our mating has taken, and we shall lay our progeny as I had described, its bearing will not hatch without the knowing watch and attunement of its sires. Both of the kip’s bearers must be present, else they will never hatch."

rows.original: You ask her how that works. How can the kip tell if the parents are or aren’t there? The ‘skill’ that you refer to as ‘psionics’ are an integral part of a kip’s development, and a strong familial bond is tantamount. A kip bonding with its Qim and Qal whilst in its shell is necessary; else, without the bonds of its sires, it would simply not grow.
rows.translation: 你问她这是如何运作的。幼崽怎么知道父母是否在场？你所谓的“灵能”是幼崽发育不可或缺的一部分，而牢固的亲缘纽带至关重要。幼崽在壳中与Qim和Qal建立联系是必要的；否则，没有双亲的纽带，它便根本无法成长。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how that works. How can the kip tell if the parents are or aren’t there? The ‘skill’ that you refer to as ‘psionics’ are an integral part of a kip’s development, and a strong familial bond is tantamount. A kip bonding with its Qim and Qal whilst in its shell is necessary; else, without the bonds of its sires, it would simply not grow."

rows.original: You ask if that presents any significant danger to your kids – say, for example, if you needed to leave, and the egg won’t hatch unless you’re there, would they eventually, uh, ‘expire’ in the egg if you took too long? There is a risk of overdue hatching causing our kip’s growth to stunt, though otherwise, there is no risk of it perishing within the shell.
rows.translation: 你问这是否会给孩子带来重大危险——比如你必须离开，而蛋在你不在时不会孵化；若耽搁太久，它们最终会不会在蛋里，呃，“过期”？孵化延误确实可能阻碍幼崽成长，但除此之外，它不会有死在壳内的风险。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if that presents any significant danger to your kids – say, for example, if you needed to leave, and the egg won’t hatch unless you’re there, would they eventually, uh, ‘expire’ in the egg if you took too long? There is a risk of overdue hatching causing our kip’s growth to stunt, though otherwise, there is no risk of it perishing within the shell."

rows.original: I, [frostwyrm.name] says lowly, taken off-guard by your words and at a loss for her own. I am not educated in the necessities of your kind’s needs and cultures, [pc.name]. But I will trust you. You will know when is right to return to your mate. She nudges you gently, her nose against your scalp. Distance will not separate us. Should you need my guidance, focus upon me. I will answer your summons.
rows.translation: 我，[frostwyrm.name]低声说道。你的话令她猝不及防，一时间也不知该如何回应。我不了解你族生活与文化上的各种需求，[pc.name]。但我会信任你。你会知道何时该回到伴侣身边。她用鼻子轻轻碰了碰你的头皮。距离无法将我们分开。若你需要我的指引，就将注意力集中在我身上。我会回应你的呼唤。
rows.raw: "I, [frostwyrm.name] says lowly, taken off-guard by your words and at a loss for her own. I am not educated in the necessities of your kind’s needs and cultures, [pc.name]. But I will trust you. You will know when is right to return to your mate. She nudges you gently, her nose against your scalp. Distance will not separate us. Should you need my guidance, focus upon me. I will answer your summons."

rows.original: Your daughter pouts loudly, disappointed at the news, but [frostwyrm.name] hushes her.

rows.raw: "Your daughter pouts loudly, disappointed at the news, but [frostwyrm.name] hushes her."

rows.raw: "Your daughters each pout loudly, disappointed at the news, but [frostwyrm.name] hushes them."

rows.original: I understand that you have other necessities in your life as well. Your kind are not as long-lived as mine; you have my blessing to do what you require, when you require it. You will know when to return to your Qim. She nudges gently at your scalp with her nose. Do not forget that distance will not separate us, and if you need of my guidance, I will respond.
rows.translation: 我明白，你的生活也有其他必需之事。你族不像我族这般长寿；无论你需要做什么，又需要何时去做，都有我的准许。你会知道何时该回到自己的Qim身边。她用鼻子轻轻碰了碰你的头皮。别忘了，距离无法将我们分开；若你需要我的指引，我会作出回应。
rows.raw: " I understand that you have other necessities in your life as well. Your kind are not as long-lived as mine; you have my blessing to do what you require, when you require it. rows.original: The first four months go by in a flash: you’re [frostwyrm.name]’s extended guest and attentive mate, and she is far more hospitable than you expected a dragon could be. She provided food when you were hungry; she kept you warm at night; and she’s an excellent conversationalist, providing you with entertainment and enlightenment throughout the four months.
rows.translation: 头四个月转瞬即逝：你作为[frostwyrm.name]的长期客人兼体贴伴侣住了下来，而她展现出的好客远超你对一条龙的预期。你饿时她会提供食物；夜晚她会为你保暖；她还是一位出色的交谈者，在这四个月中不断为你带来消遣与启迪。
rows.raw: "The first four months go by in a flash: you’re [frostwyrm.name]’s extended guest and attentive mate, and she is far more hospitable than you expected a dragon could be. She provided food when you were hungry; she kept you warm at night; and she’s an excellent conversationalist, providing you with entertainment and enlightenment throughout the four months."

rows.original: The whole time, your belly was slowly growing more and more gravid; it grew harder to walk with each passing day and the weight on your spine became increasingly unbearable. By the time the fourth month rolled around, you were as large as any nine-month-pregnant woman of your kind.
rows.translation: 在此期间，你的腹部逐渐因怀孕而越来越大；每过一天，行走就更困难一些，脊柱承受的重量也越来越难以忍受。到了第四个月，你已经和族中怀孕九个月的女性一样大了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe whole time, your belly was slowly growing more and more gravid; it grew harder to walk with each passing day and the weight on your spine became increasingly unbearable. By the time the fourth month rolled around, you were as large as any nine-month-pregnant woman of your kind."

rows.original: By the end of month one, you had started to experience mood swings, but they were different from what you had expected from your sexual education classes. You weren’t experiencing joy, or anger, or sadness – not in the traditional sense. What you felt was more primeval, more unfocused. Raw. You had come to understand that they were the emotions your kip was feeling: as it developed inside you, its psionic powers grew, but it was too young yet to understand anything other than pure emotion.
rows.translation: 第一个月末，你开始出现情绪波动，但与性教育课中预想的情形不同。你感受到的并非传统意义上的喜悦、愤怒或悲伤，而是更原始、更模糊的东西。纯粹而直接。你逐渐明白，那是幼崽的情绪：随着它在体内发育，灵能力量也在增强，但它还太年幼，只能理解纯粹的情绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the end of month one, you had started to experience mood swings, but they were different from what you had expected from your sexual education classes. You weren’t experiencing joy, or anger, or sadness – not in the traditional sense. What you felt was more primeval, more unfocused. Raw. You had come to understand that they were the emotions your kip was feeling: as it developed inside you, its psionic powers grew, but it was too young yet to understand anything other than pure emotion."

rows.original: Halfway through the third month, you began hearing sounds. They reminded you of baby speech, but since your kip wasn’t talking to you with a mouth or with lungs, the sounds were constant and melodic, transitioning from one sound to another seamlessly, almost like an instrument. Still, they were unnerving at first, and they kept you up at night, so [frostwyrm.name] graciously blocked them from your mind until you asked to hear them again.
rows.translation: 第三个月过半时，你开始听见声音。它们让你想起婴儿牙牙学语，但幼崽并非用嘴或肺与你说话，因此声音持续而富有旋律，从一种无缝过渡到另一种，几乎像乐器。起初它们仍让你不安，也害得你夜不能寐，于是[frostwyrm.name]体贴地将其隔绝在你的意识之外，直到你主动要求再次聆听。
rows.raw: "\n\nHalfway through the third month, you began hearing sounds. They reminded you of baby speech, but since your kip wasn’t talking to you with a mouth or with lungs, the sounds were constant and melodic, transitioning from one sound to another seamlessly, almost like an instrument. Still, they were unnerving at first, and they kept you up at night, so [frostwyrm.name] graciously blocked them from your mind until you asked to hear them again."

rows.original: In month four, the ‘laying,’ as [frostwyrm.name] constantly referred it, was much easier than you anticipated. The egg inside you had grown to the size of a normal, healthy, [pc.originalRace] child, and the shell’s smooth surface made the whole ordeal go by without complications. You didn’t even feel any pain; [frostwyrm.name] blocked the sensation from your mind as the egg came.
rows.translation: 到了第四个月，[frostwyrm.name]一直所说的“产卵”比你预想中轻松得多。你体内的蛋已经长到一个正常健康的[pc.originalRace]孩子那般大小，而蛋壳表面光滑，使整个过程顺利无碍。你甚至没有感到疼痛；蛋产出时，[frostwyrm.name]将那种感觉隔绝在你的意识之外。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn month four, the ‘laying,’ as [frostwyrm.name] constantly referred it, was much easier than you anticipated. The egg inside you had grown to the size of a normal, healthy, [pc.originalRace] child, and the shell’s smooth surface made the whole ordeal go by without complications. You didn’t even feel any pain; [frostwyrm.name] blocked the sensation from your mind as the egg came."

rows.original: When all is said and done, you’re in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, resting against your draconian mate, and now you have a fresh egg to cuddle against.
rows.translation: 一切结束后，你躺在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴里，倚着自己的龙族伴侣休息，怀中则依偎着一枚刚产下的蛋。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen all is said and done, you’re in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, resting against your draconian mate, and now you have a fresh egg to cuddle against."

rows.original: The whole time, your belly was slowly growing more and more gravid; it grew harder to walk with each passing day and the weight on your spine became increasingly unbearable. By the time the fourth month rolled around, you were as large as any nine-month-pregnant woman of your kind. Meanwhile, [frostwyrm.name]’s outward appearance doesn’t change much during her gestation; her belly grows firmer and her scales grow more resilient, making it less comfy to snuggle against her, but she otherwise does not pack on any noticeable weight and her walking stature does not change.
rows.translation: 在此期间，你的腹部逐渐因怀孕而越来越大；每过一天，行走就更困难一些，脊柱承受的重量也越来越难以忍受。到了第四个月，你已经和族中怀孕九个月的女性一样大了。与此同时，[frostwyrm.name]孕期的外在变化并不明显；她的腹部变得更紧实，鳞片也更加坚韧，依偎起来不再那么舒服，但除此之外，她并未明显增重，走路的姿态也没有变化。

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] kept you up-to-date on every little change to your kip: when the baby’s psionic powers grew stronger within her womb, she told you about how she felt its emotions, and how its thoughts eventually became melodic sounds that would eventually evolve into the same sort of speech she uses to communicate with you. It was difficult to understand the way she described what the kip was doing, since you didn’t have psionic powers of your own.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]会随时告诉你幼崽的每一点变化：宝宝在她子宫内的灵能力量何时增强，她如何感受到它的情绪，以及它的思想最终如何化作富有旋律的声音，并逐渐发展成她与你交流时所用的同类语言。由于你没有自己的灵能力量，很难理解她对幼崽行为的描述。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] kept you up-to-date on every little change to your kip: when the baby’s psionic powers grew stronger within her womb, she told you about how she felt its emotions, and how its thoughts eventually became melodic sounds that would eventually evolve into the same sort of speech she uses to communicate with you. It was difficult to understand the way she described what the kip was doing, since you didn’t have psionic powers of your own."

rows.original: You did your part as an attentive and loving mate – which amounted to little more than emotional and sexual support, trapped as you were on the island that housed her lair. Still, by the time the fourth month rolled around, you were there for every little step of [frostwyrm.name] ‘laying,’ as she constantly referred it.
rows.translation: 你尽到了体贴而深爱伴侣的责任 – 而受困于这座巢穴所在的岛上，这其实无非是给予情感和性方面的支持。即便如此，到了第四个月，你还是见证了[frostwyrm.name]一直所说的“产卵”过程中的每一个细微阶段。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou did your part as an attentive and loving mate – which amounted to little more than emotional and sexual support, trapped as you were on the island that housed her lair. Still, by the time the fourth month rolled around, you were there for every little step of [frostwyrm.name] ‘laying,’ as she constantly referred it."

rows.original: The egg was no larger than an average, healthy [pc.originalRace] newborn baby. When all was said and done, you snuggle up against [frostwyrm.name] once more, sharing the space with her freshly-laid egg.

rows.raw: "\n\nThe egg was no larger than an average, healthy [pc.originalRace] newborn baby. Its shell was smooth and sturdy all around; you doubt you’d be able to crack it open even if you wanted to. When all was said and done, you snuggle up against [frostwyrm.name] once more, sharing the space with her freshly-laid egg."

rows.original: You finally get an answer to the question you had been wondering ever since its conception: what would it look like? What you see is a seven-foot tall, bipedal dragon; it has icy-white scales all along its body, with layered, sky-blue, armored scales along its front, from neck to crotch. Like Nykke, it has a humanoid face, with two piercing red eyes. It has massive wings, their bones reaching higher than its head and all the way down to its ankles, and with a wingspan as wide as they are tall. It has two legs, yet four arms; and, as of yet, it lacks any sort of sexual characteristic. Surely those will develop later.
rows.translation: 你终于得到了自它受孕以来一直想知道的那个问题的答案：它会长什么样？眼前是一条七英尺高、双足站立的龙；全身覆盖冰白色鳞片，正面从脖颈到胯部则覆着层叠的天蓝色甲鳞。它和妮凯一样有着人形面孔与一双锐利的红眼。它的翅膀极其巨大，翼骨高过头顶，一直延伸至脚踝，翼展也与身高相当。它有两条腿，却有四条手臂；而且目前还没有任何性征。想必那些会在日后发育出来。

Like Nykke, it has a humanoid face, with two piercing red eyes. It has massive wings, their bones reaching higher than its head and all the way down to its ankles, and with a wingspan as wide as they are tall. It has two legs, yet four arms; and, as of yet, it lacks any sort of sexual characteristic. Surely those will develop later."

rows.original: You finally get an answer to the question you had been wondering ever since their conception: what would they look like? What you see are seven-foot tall, bipedal dragons; they have icy-white scales all along their bodies, with layered, sky-blue, armored scales along their front, from neck to crotch. Like Nykke, they have humanoid faces, with two piercing red eyes. They have massive wings, their bones reaching higher than their heads and all the way down to their ankles, and with a wingspan as wide as they are tall. They each have two legs, yet four arms; and, as of yet, they lack any sort of sexual characteristic. Surely those will develop later.
rows.translation: 你终于得到了自它们受孕以来一直想知道的那个问题的答案：它们会长什么样？眼前是数条七英尺高、双足站立的龙；全身覆盖冰白色鳞片，正面从脖颈到胯部则覆着层叠的天蓝色甲鳞。它们和妮凯一样有着人形面孔与一双锐利的红眼。它们的翅膀极其巨大，翼骨高过头顶，一直延伸至脚踝，翼展也与身高相当。它们各有两条腿，却有四条手臂；而且目前还没有任何性征。想必那些会在日后发育出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finally get an answer to the question you had been wondering ever since their conception: what would they look like? What you see are seven-foot tall, bipedal dragons; they have icy-white scales all along their bodies, with layered, sky-blue, armored scales along their front, from neck to crotch. Like Nykke, they have humanoid faces, with two piercing red eyes. They have massive wings, their bones reaching higher than their heads and all the way down to their ankles, and with a wingspan as wide as they are tall. They each have two legs, yet four arms; and, as of yet, they lack any sort of sexual characteristic. Surely those will develop later."

rows.original: Your kip is exhausted; it took all its strength to break free, and the first thing it wants to do is rest. It doesn’t know how to walk, and when it tries, it immediately falls onto its face. You, [frostwyrm.name], and Nykke are on it quickly; looks like any other plans you had for the day have been changed.
rows.translation: 你的幼崽筋疲力尽；挣脱卵壳耗尽了它的全部力气，现在最想做的就是休息。它还不会走路，刚一尝试便立刻摔了个脸着地。你、[frostwyrm.name]和妮凯迅速围到它身边；看来你今天原有的其他安排都得改变了。

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] wraps you, Nykke, and your kip into a huddle, sharing her body warmth and allowing it to rest. It clutches and squeezes at various body parts between you three; when it goes for you, [frostwyrm.name] introduces you as it’s Qal; when it goes for either [frostwyrm.name] or Nykke, they’re both introduced as it’s Qim. You know it’s unusual for a kip to have two Qims, and you can’t imagine it’s particularly instinctual for your two mates to both introduce themselves as a single kip’s Qim, but, to your delight, neither of them have any trouble willingly taking and sharing the title. Becoming a single family unit is more natural to them than being conflicted over a title.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]用身体将你、妮凯和幼崽一同围住，分享她的体温，让它安然休息。它抓住并轻轻捏弄你们三人的各处身体；当它伸向你时，[frostwyrm.name]便介绍你是它的Qal；当它伸向[frostwyrm.name]或妮凯时，她们则都被介绍为它的Qim。你知道一只幼崽拥有两位Qim并不寻常，也无法想象你的两位伴侣同时自称同一只幼崽的Qim会是多么本能的事；但令你欣喜的是，她们都毫不介意自愿接受并共享这个称谓。对她们而言，组成一个完整家庭远比为称谓发生冲突更加自然。

What you see are seven-foot tall, bipedal dragons; one of them, younger by just a few seconds, has white scales all along its body, with layered, sky-blue, armored scales along its front, from neck to crotch, while its older sibling looks identical. Unlike [frostwyrm.name], they have humanoid faces, with two piercing red eyes. They have massive wings, their bones reaching higher than their head and all the way down to their ankles, and with a wingspan as wide as they are tall. They each have two legs, yet four arms; and, as of yet, they lack any sort of sexual characteristic. Surely those will develop later."

rows.original: Your kips are exhausted; it took all their strength to break free, and the first thing they want to do is rest. They don’t know how to walk, and when they try, they immediately fall onto their faces. You and [frostwyrm.name] are on them quickly; looks like any other plans you had for the day have been changed.
rows.translation: 你的幼崽们筋疲力尽；挣脱卵壳耗尽了它们的全部力气，现在最想做的就是休息。它们还不会走路，刚一尝试便立刻摔了个脸着地。你和[frostwyrm.name]迅速围到它们身边；看来你今天原有的其他安排都得改变了。

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] wraps you and your kips into a huddle, sharing her body warmth and allowing them to rest. They clutch and squeeze at various body parts between you both; when one goes for [frostwyrm.name], she introduces herself as their Qim. When one reaches for you, [frostwyrm.name] introduces you as their Qal.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]用身体将你和幼崽们一同围住，分享她的体温，让它们安然休息。它们抓住并轻轻捏弄你们两人的各处身体；当其中一个伸向[frostwyrm.name]时，她自称是它们的Qim。当另一个伸向你时，[frostwyrm.name]则介绍你是它们的Qal。

rows.original: With the introductions out of the way, you broach the obvious topic hanging in the air between you two: your firstborn kip has black scales, whereas [frostwyrm.name]’s are snow-white. You ask her if this is a common thing, and that its scales will bleach over time.
rows.translation: 介绍完毕后，你提起横亘在你们之间那个显而易见的话题：你们的长女有黑色鳞片，而[frostwyrm.name]的鳞片却雪白。你问她这种情况是否常见，它的鳞片会不会随时间逐渐褪白。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the introductions out of the way, you broach the obvious topic hanging in the air between you two: your firstborn kip has black scales, whereas [frostwyrm.name]’s are snow-white. You ask her if this is a common thing, and that its scales will bleach over time."

rows.original: “No,” she answers. You feel a number of conflicting emotions seep through the psionic link between you two – parental love; unconditional affection; and total relief... but, also, hesitation. “I had told you before that our resultant kip would inherit the strongest traits of us both, but... I had never been privy to an abnormality such as this.”
rows.translation: “不，”她回答。你感觉许多相互冲突的情绪透过你们之间的心灵连接渗来——父母之爱；无条件的疼爱；彻底的宽慰...但也夹杂着迟疑。“我以前告诉过你，我们孕育出的幼崽会继承双方最强大的特征，可是...我从未见过这样的异常。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” she answers. You feel a number of conflicting emotions seep through the psionic link between you two – parental love; unconditional affection; and total relief... but, also, hesitation. “I had told you before that our resultant kip would inherit the strongest traits of us both, but... I had never been privy to an abnormality such as this.”"

rows.original: Should you two be worried?
rows.translation: 你们两个该担心吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nShould you two be worried?"

rows.original: “Without a form to disappear into the Wet Dust, our kip may have difficulty hunting when it matures. It is without an important element of the hunt to aid it.” While her words are sobering, her parental instincts and emotions do not stop their flood over the link between you. “Our kip is born healthy, my Qal, and, for the moment, that is all I care to know.”
rows.translation: “没有能够消失在湿尘中的形态，我们的幼崽成年后可能很难狩猎。它缺少了帮助自己狩猎的一项重要要素。”她的话虽令人清醒，但母性的本能与情感仍源源不断地通过你们之间的连接涌来。“我们的幼崽健康地出生了，我的Qal，而眼下这就是我唯一在意的事。”

TIME CHEAT IS ON
rows.translation: 时间作弊已开启
rows.raw: 'TIME CHEAT IS ON\n\n'

rows.original: The final four months of your child-rearing are definitely the most interesting and educational.
rows.translation: 养育孩子的最后四个月，无疑最有趣，也最具教育意义。
rows.raw: "The final four months of your child-rearing are definitely the most interesting and educational."

rows.original: Your kips have gargantuan and imposing forms, even though they’re so young; they appear as though they should be capable of walking and lifting and hunting right away, but their muscles, while strong enough to carry themselves, are good for only that. They require proper nursing before they’re strong enough and smart enough to fend for themselves.
rows.translation: 你的幼崽们身形庞大而威严，哪怕还如此年幼；看起来明明应该已经能够行走、抬起任何东西，可它们却像婴儿般笨拙。
rows.raw: " Your kips have gargantuan and imposing forms, even though they’re so young; they appear as though they should be capable of walking and lifting and hunting right away, but their muscles, while strong enough to carry themselves, are good for only that. They require proper nursing before they’re strong enough and smart enough to fend for themselves."

rows.original: Luckily, that doesn’t last long. The ninth month is you, your two mates, and your kips bonding with each other and familiarizing yourselves with each other’s forms and titles. They quickly learn that you’re their Qal and to address you as one; it takes them a bit longer to learn to address both [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke as their Qim, rather than one or the other, but they figure it out. You and Nykke, sharing a similar form as your kips, teach them to walk, while [frostwyrm.name] teaches them to fly. You teach them language, and their biology allows them to speak verbally and not purely through psionics, while [frostwyrm.name] teaches them how to hunt and how to use their psionic strength similarly to herself. And while Nykke might not have been the most accomplished hunter, it was only because her scales made her impossible to camouflage – she had mastered multiple techniques in how to move, sneak, and kill her prey in order to survive, and she was all too happy to pass on what she knew to her clutch, fulfilling her duty as a real, earnest Qim to a family.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，这种状况没有持续多久。第九个月，你、两位伴侣和幼崽们彼此亲近，熟悉彼此的形态与称谓。它们很快明白你是它们的Qal，也学会如此称呼你；要学会同时把[frostwyrm.name]和妮凯称为Qim，而不是只称其中一个，则多花了一点时间，但它们最终掌握了。你和妮凯的形态与幼崽们相似，便教它们走路，而[frostwyrm.name]教它们飞行。你教它们语言；它们的生理构造让它们不仅能凭心灵感应，还能开口说话，而[frostwyrm.name]则教它们狩猎，以及像她一样运用心灵力量。妮凯或许不是最成功的猎手，但那只是因为她的鳞片令她根本无法伪装——为了生存，她已经精通多种移动、潜行和猎杀猎物的技巧，也非常乐意把所知传给这一窝孩子，履行自己作为这个家庭真正而诚挚的Qim的职责。

And while Nykke might not have been the most accomplished hunter, it was only because her scales made her impossible to camouflage – she had mastered multiple techniques in how to move, sneak, and kill her prey in order to survive, and she was all too happy to pass on what she knew to her clutch, fulfilling her duty as a real, earnest Qim to a family."

rows.original: Through month ten and eleven, your kips spend most of their time with their two Qims; [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke spend much of their time communicating with the clutch’s newest family members, enlightening them to the strengths and utilities of the psionic powers unique to their Frostwyrm lineage. Through [frostwyrm.name], your kips are taught how to act; how to speak; and how to address their parents; and through Nykke, they’re taught certain truths of the world, and how best to survive in such an unforgiving climate, especially with a biology like hers – not being a pureblood Frostwyrm has its disadvantages, but, thankfully, your newest kips have pure-white scales, and they’ll never know the difficulties Nykke had to put up with her whole life.
rows.translation: 第十和第十一个月里，幼崽们大多与两位Qim待在一起；[frostwyrm.name]和妮凯花大量时间与这一窝最新的家庭成员交流，引导它们认识霜龙血脉独有心灵力量的强项和用途。通过[frostwyrm.name]，幼崽们学会如何举止、如何说话，以及如何称呼双亲；通过妮凯，它们则学到世界的某些真相，以及如何在如此严酷的气候中尽可能生存，尤其是拥有与她相似生理特征时——并非纯血霜龙确有劣势，但幸好你最新的幼崽们拥有纯白鳞片，永远不必体会妮凯一生忍受的那些困难。

rows.original: With their emotional growth comes a real sense of maturity, and with that, a sense of identity: taking after their Qims, they almost instinctively chooses to be referred to by female pronouns.
rows.translation: 随着情感成长，它们也真正显露成熟，并由此萌发自我认同：效仿自己的Qim，它们几乎本能地把自己视为女性。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith their emotional growth comes a real sense of maturity, and with that, a sense of identity: taking after their Qims, they almost instinctively chooses to be referred to by female pronouns."

rows.original: Your girls are naturally inquisitive, asking you why you and Nykke look so different from [frostwyrm.name] and what the differences between you three are. They ask you how you met them both, which, naturally, was followed-up by asking how you came to be the Qal to two Qims, and where they, as your kips, belongs in this world.
rows.translation: 你的女儿们天生好奇，会问你为什么你和妮凯与[frostwyrm.name]长得如此不同，以及你们之间有何差异。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour girls are naturally inquisitive, asking you why you and Nykke look so different from [frostwyrm.name] and what the differences between you three are. They ask you how you met them both, which, naturally, was followed-up by asking how you came to be the Qal to two Qims, and where they, as your kips, belongs in this world."

And while Nykke might not have been the most accomplished hunter, it was only because her scales made her impossible to camouflage – she had mastered multiple techniques in how to move, sneak, and kill her prey in order to survive, and she was all too happy to pass on what she knew to her clutch, fulfilling her duty as a real, earnest Qim to a family."

rows.original: Through month ten and eleven, your kip spends most of its time with its two Qims; [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke spend much of their time communicating with the clutch’s newest family member, enlightening it to the strengths and utilities of the psionic powers unique to their Frostwyrm lineage. Through [frostwyrm.name], your kip is taught how to act; how to speak; and how to address its parents; and through Nykke, it’s taught certain truths of the world, and how best to survive in such an unforgiving climate, especially with a biology like hers – not being a pureblood Frostwyrm has its disadvantages, but, thankfully, your newest kip has pure-white scales, and it’ll never know the difficulties Nykke had to put up with her whole life.
rows.translation: 第十和第十一个月里，幼崽大多与两位Qim待在一起；[frostwyrm.name]和妮凯花大量时间与这一窝最新的家庭成员交流，引导它认识霜龙血脉独有心灵力量的强项和用途。通过[frostwyrm.name]，幼崽学会如何举止、如何说话，以及如何称呼双亲；通过妮凯，它则学到世界的某些真相，以及如何在如此严酷的气候中尽可能生存，尤其是拥有与她相似生理特征时——并非纯血霜龙确有劣势，但幸好你最新的幼崽拥有纯白鳞片，永远不必体会妮凯一生忍受的那些困难。
rows.raw: "\n\nThrough month ten and eleven, your kip spends most of its time with its two Qims; [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke spend much of their time communicating with the clutch’s newest family member, enlightening it to the strengths and utilities of the psionic powers unique to their Frostwyrm lineage. Through [frostwyrm.name], your kip is taught how to act; how to speak; and how to address its parents; and through Nykke, it’s taught certain truths of the world, and how best to survive in such an unforgiving climate, especially with a biology like hers – not being a pureblood Frostwyrm has its disadvantages, but, thankfully, your newest kip has pure-white scales, and it’ll never know the difficulties Nykke had to put up with her whole life."

rows.original: With its emotional growth comes a real sense of maturity, and with that, a sense of identity: taking after its Qims, it almost instinctively chooses to be referred to by female pronouns.
rows.translation: 随着情感成长，它也真正显露成熟，并由此萌发自我认同：效仿自己的Qim，它几乎本能地把自己视为女性。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith its emotional growth comes a real sense of maturity, and with that, a sense of identity: taking after its Qims, it almost instinctively chooses to be referred to by female pronouns."

rows.original: Your girl is naturally inquisitive, asking you why you and Nykke look so different from [frostwyrm.name] and what the differences between you three are. She asks you how you met them both, which, naturally, was followed-up by asking how you came to be the Qal to two Qims, and where she, as your kip, belongs in this world.
rows.translation: 你的女儿天生好奇，会问你为什么你和妮凯与[frostwyrm.name]长得如此不同，以及你们之间有何差异。

rows.original: You answer each of her questions dutifully and truthfully, explaining the differences in biology between you, Nykke, and [frostwyrm.name] in the clearest, simplest ways you can. Questions that are answered are beget with more questions, which you encourage.
rows.translation: 你尽职而诚实地回答她的每一个问题，解释你、妮凯和[frostwyrm.name]在生理上的差异。

rows.original: The final four months of your child-rearing are definitely the most interesting and educational.
rows.translation: 养育孩子的最后四个月，无疑最有趣，也最具教育意义。
rows.raw: "The final four months of your child-rearing are definitely the most interesting and educational."

rows.original: Your kips have gargantuan and imposing forms, even though they’re so young; they appear as though they should be capable of walking and lifting and hunting right away, but their muscles, while strong enough to carry themselves, are good for only that. They require proper nursing before they’re strong enough and smart enough to fend for themselves.

rows.translation: 你的飞船自动接通了通话，画面中出现驾驶舱，但那里没有人回应。你解释说，这是你的飞船，你用它以极高速度跨越遥远距离——几乎就像一对翅膀。
rows.raw: "your call is automatically answered by your ship, and you’re given a view of the cockpit, but there’s nobody there to answer. You explain that this is your ship, and you use it to travel vast distances at high speeds – almost like a set of wings. "

rows.raw: "Nykke"

rows.original: Your kip
rows.translation: 你的幼崽
rows.raw: "Your kip"

rows.original: scrunches her nose as she studies the Codex, and she looks around the metal box, trying to see more into the ship. She presses her nose against the glass, trying to go through it to get into the ship, but she’s stopped by the glass screen.
rows.translation: 皱起鼻子研究终端，又从各个角度观察这个金属盒子，试图看清飞船内部更多地方。她把鼻子抵在玻璃上，想穿过屏幕进入飞船，却被玻璃屏幕挡住。

rows.original: This is just a minor example of the technology your species is capable of – so minor, in fact, that this is considered fairly mundane and typical of its usual standards. Advancements include traveling at speeds many times faster than any Frostwyrm is capable of; medicine capable of curing any disease; transformatives that can change the physical makeup of any person to turn them into whatever they want; there are almost no limits anymore.
rows.translation: 这只是你们种族科技的一个微不足道的例子——事实上，它普通到按照你们的一贯标准，只能算相当平常的东西。你们的进步包括以任何霜龙都无法企及的数倍速度航行；能够治愈任何疾病的医疗技术；能改变任何人身体构造、让其变成自己想要模样的变形物；如今几乎已经没有什么限制。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis is just a minor example of the technology your species is capable of – so minor, in fact, that this is considered fairly mundane and typical of its usual standards. Advancements include traveling at speeds many times faster than any Frostwyrm is capable of; medicine capable of curing any disease; transformatives that can change the physical makeup of any person to turn them into whatever they want; there are almost no limits anymore."

rows.original: You flip through various channels on your Codex, explaining the different things you find. When you find clothing, you explain their purpose and appeal; when you find weapons, you explain their necessities and their dangers. When you find television programs, you explain they’re use as information relays and entertainment–
rows.translation: 你在终端上切换不同频道，解释自己找到的各种内容。看到服装时，你说明它们的用途与魅力；看到武器时，你解释它们存在的必要性与危险。看到电视节目时，你说明它们可用于传递信息和娱乐——
rows.raw: "\n\nYou flip through various channels on your Codex, explaining the different things you find. When you find clothing, you explain their purpose and appeal; when you find weapons, you explain their necessities and their dangers. When you find television programs, you explain they’re use as information relays and entertainment–"

rows.original: “Go back to that last one,” she asks you, and you do so. It’s an episode of Steph Irson’s Galactic Huntress. From the looks of it, it’s getting close to the end of the episode, judging from how she’s gotten herself in another gangbang with some planet’s indigenous species. It looks like the Zil from Mhen’ga this time.
rows.translation: “回到刚才那个，”她请求道，于是你切了回去。那是史蒂芬·艾尔森的银河女猎手。从画面来看，这一集似乎快结束了，因为她又一次跟某颗星球的原生种族陷入群交。这次看起来是门加的泽尔人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go back to that last one,” she asks you, and you do so. It’s an episode of Steph Irson’s Galactic Huntress. From the looks of it, it’s getting close to the end of the episode, judging from how she’s gotten herself in another gangbang with some planet’s indigenous species. It looks like the Zil from Mhen’ga this time."

rows.translation: 妮凯
rows.raw: "Nykke"

rows.original: Your kip
rows.translation: 你的幼崽
rows.raw: "Your kip"

rows.original: watches, enraptured. She’s totally taken in by the programming going on in front of her. “What’s going on here?” she asks you innocently, and you explain who Steph is and what her goal is – or, rather, what it’s supposed to be, but more often than not, it always devolves into... exactly what’s happening right now. Her audience tends to prefer it this way.
rows.translation: 看得入了迷，完全被眼前播放的节目吸引。“这里在发生什么？”她天真地问。你解释史蒂芬是谁，以及她的目标是什么——或者更确切地说，本来应该是什么；但多数时候，剧情总会演变成...眼下正在发生的事情。她的观众通常更喜欢这样。

She’s totally taken in by the programming going on in front of her. “What’s going on here?” she asks you innocently, and you explain who Steph is and what her goal is – or, rather, what it’s supposed to be, but more often than not, it always devolves into... exactly what’s happening right now. Her audience tends to prefer it this way."

rows.original: probes your mind once again. “You mean there are individuals that enjoy watching others mate for their entertainment?” You answer that yes, that’s about the long and short of it. “Wow.”
rows.translation: 又一次探查你的思维。“你是说，有些人会把观看别人交配当作娱乐？”你回答说，是的，简单来说就是如此。“哇。”
rows.raw: " probes your mind once again. “You mean there are individuals that enjoy watching others mate for their entertainment?” You answer that yes, that’s about the long and short of it. “Wow.”"

rows.original: She sits in almost stunned silence for a moment as she watches Steph get absolutely railed by two male, and one female, Zil.
rows.translation: 她几乎目瞪口呆地沉默着，看史蒂芬被两个雄性泽尔和一个雌性泽尔狠狠操弄。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sits in almost stunned silence for a moment as she watches Steph get absolutely railed by two male, and one female, Zil."

rows.original: “I wonder if-” she begins, but then stops herself, her eyes flitting towards yours for a split second. “Never mind, it’s not important.”
rows.translation: “我在想，要是——”她开口，却又停了下来，目光飞快地瞥向你的眼睛。“没事，不重要。”
rows.raw: " “I wonder if-” she begins, but then stops herself, her eyes flitting towards yours for a split second. “Never mind, it’s not important.”"

rows.original: When you switch the programming to something else, she pouts, but ultimately respects your decision as her Qal.
rows.translation: 当你把节目换成别的内容时，她噘起嘴，但最终还是尊重身为Qal的你的决定。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you switch the programming to something else, she pouts, but ultimately respects your decision as her Qal."

rows.original: what she thinks of the standards and traditions that are upheld here in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. “I don’t think I understand the question,” she says, so you elaborate, one step at a time: what does she think about mating with you and [frostwyrm.name]?
rows.translation: ，她如何看待[frostwyrm.name]巢穴里奉行的规范和传统。“我好像没听懂这个问题，”她说，于是你循序渐进地详细说明：她怎么看待与你及[frostwyrm.name]交配？
rows.raw: " what she thinks of the standards and traditions that are upheld here in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. “I don’t think I understand the question,” she says, so you elaborate, one step at a time: what does she think about mating with you and [frostwyrm.name]?"

rows.original: “It’s the natural way of our kind, of course,” she says matter-of-factly, proud of her learned knowledge of her kind. “We remain with our Qim and Qal to have our every need met until you two are summoned by the Grand Qim. That includes food, shelter, and any needs regarding mating
rows.translation: “这当然是我们种族的自然之道，”她理所当然地说，为自己学到的种族知识感到自豪。“我们会留在Qim和Qal身边，由你们满足我们的一切需求，直到你们被至尊Qim召走。这包括食物、住所，还有任何与交配有关的需求
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s the natural way of our kind, of course,” she says matter-of-factly, proud of her learned knowledge of her kind. “We remain with our Qim and Qal to have our every need met until you two are summoned by the Grand Qim. That includes food, shelter, and any needs regarding mating"

rows.original: You tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] aren’t exactly of the same race. “Well, I gathered that much, silly,” she laughs, nuzzling your nose with hers. “I think it’s incredible that the Grand Qim managed to put you two together, despite your differences.”
rows.translation: 你告诉她，你和[frostwyrm.name]并不完全属于同一种族。“好吧，这点我还是看得出来的，傻瓜，”她笑着用鼻子蹭你的鼻子。“尽管你们有这么多差异，至尊Qim仍设法让你们走到一起，我觉得太不可思议了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] aren’t exactly of the same race. “Well, I gathered that much, silly,” she laughs, nuzzling your nose with hers. “I think it’s incredible that the Grand Qim managed to put you two together, despite your differences.”"

rows.original: What you mean is that, where you come from, there is no such thing as ‘inner circle coupling,’ and that children – or, kips – from your kind do not mate with their parents, and leave the home once they reach a certain age.
rows.translation: 你的意思是，在你的故乡，并不存在“内圈交配”；你们种族的孩子——或者说幼崽——不会与父母交配，并且会在达到一定年龄后离开家。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you mean is that, where you come from, there is no such thing as ‘inner circle coupling,’ and that children – or, kips – from your kind do not mate with their parents, and leave the home once they reach a certain age."

rows.original: “Why would they want to do any of that?” she asks. You reply that there’s a specific word for ‘inner circle coupling,’ and it’s considered a taboo act. Not everyone appreciates the idea of mating with their parents. “Why wouldn’t they? My Qim is the biggest of her kind, and my Qal is the smartest and the strongest. I can’t imagine mating with anyone else. Isn’t that the same with everyone?”
rows.translation: “他们为什么会想做任何这种事？”她问。你回答说，“内圈交配”有一个专门的词，而且被视为禁忌行为。并非所有人都能接受与父母交配。“为什么不能？我的Qim是族群中最庞大的，而我的Qal最聪明也最强壮。我根本无法想象与其他任何人交配。大家不都是这样吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why would they want to do any of that?” she asks. You reply that there’s a specific word for ‘inner circle coupling,’ and it’s considered a taboo act. Not everyone appreciates the idea of mating with their parents. “Why wouldn’t they? My Qim is the biggest of her kind, and my Qal is the smartest and the strongest. I can’t imagine mating with anyone else. Isn’t that the same with everyone?”"

rows.original: You appreciate the compliment, but no, not everyone thinks the same way as the Frostwyrms. Everyone has a different approach to mating, but some laws and concerns are universal: society, which is another word to describe the way a civilization thinks and acts, looks down on ‘inner circle coupling’ as a serious crime.
rows.translation: 你接受了这番恭维，但告诉她，不是所有人都像霜龙一样思考。每个人看待交配的方式各不相同，但有些法律和顾虑是普遍存在的：社会——也就是描述一个文明如何思考和行动的另一个词——会把“内圈交配”视为严重罪行。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou appreciate the compliment, but no, not everyone thinks the same way as the Frostwyrms. Everyone has a different approach to mating, but some laws and concerns are universal: society, which is another word to describe the way a civilization thinks and acts, looks down on ‘inner circle coupling’ as a serious crime."

rows.original: “Is it society that’s wrong, then? Who does it hurt to mate with who you want?” You tell her that that’s a very dangerous line of thinking – she can’t just ‘mate with who she wants.’ Her partner needs to be aware and willing to mate with her, and if they aren’t, that’s an even more serious crime. “It sounds to me like your ‘society’ is a boring, hard place to be. There are a lot of rules to keep in mind.” You don’t budge, and you force your kip to promise that she won’t mate with anyone or anything without their consent. “Okay, fine! I promise.”
rows.translation: “那错的是社会吗？和自己想要的人交配，会伤害谁？”你告诉她，这种想法非常危险——她不能只是“和自己想要的人交配”。她的伴侣必须知情并自愿与她交配；如果对方不愿意，那就是更加严重的罪行。“听起来，你的‘社会’既无聊又难熬，要记住的规矩太多了。”你毫不让步，逼幼崽承诺，未经同意绝不会与任何人或任何东西交配。“好吧，好吧！我保证。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is it society that’s wrong, then? Who does it hurt to mate with who you want?” You tell her that that’s a very dangerous line of thinking – she can’t just ‘mate with who she wants.’ Her partner needs to be aware and willing to mate with her, and if they aren’t, that’s an even more serious crime. “It sounds to me like your ‘society’ is a boring, hard place to be. There are a lot of rules to keep in mind.” You don’t budge, and you force your kip to promise that she won’t mate with anyone or anything without their consent. “Okay, fine! I promise.”"

rows.original: With that squared away, you relax.
rows.translation: 解决了这件事后，你放松下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that squared away, you relax."

rows.original: “Does this mean you aren’t okay with us celebrating our inner circle coupling with our Qim?” she asks, her eyes wide with concern. “I mean, you’re not from our Qim’s kind, and your kind doesn’t like the idea of a parent mating with their child.”
rows.translation: “这是不是说，你不赞成我们和Qim一起庆祝内圈交配？”她担忧地睁大眼睛问。“我的意思是，你和我们Qim不是同族，而你的种族不喜欢父母与孩子交配。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Does this mean you aren’t okay with us celebrating our inner circle coupling with our Qim?” she asks, her eyes wide with concern. “I mean, you’re not from our Qim’s kind, and your kind doesn’t like the idea of a parent mating with their child.”"

rows.original: You tell her that you’ve come to accept that it’s a part of Frostwyrm culture, and you couldn’t ask [frostwyrm.name] to be something she’s not, in her own home, for your sake. You don’t mind if she satiates the sexual needs of your kips, and it’s enough for you to know that she and your kips all respect your decision as their Qal to not participate.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，你已经接受这是霜龙文化的一部分；你不能为了自己，要求[frostwyrm.name]在她自己的家中变成并非本性的模样。你不介意她满足幼崽们的性需求；只要知道她和所有幼崽都尊重你身为Qal而选择不参与的决定，对你来说就已经足够。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ve come to accept that it’s a part of Frostwyrm culture, and you couldn’t ask [frostwyrm.name] to be something she’s not, in her own home, for your sake. You don’t mind if she satiates the sexual needs of your kips, and it’s enough for you to know that she and your kips all respect your decision as their Qal to not participate."

rows.original: “Okay,” she says, snuggling in closer to you and burying her nose into the crease of your neck affectionately. “I hope I’m as understanding as you are with my own mate, my Qal.”
rows.translation: “好，”她说着，贴得更紧，亲昵地把鼻子埋进你的颈窝。“希望我对自己的伴侣也能像你这样善解人意，我的Qal。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay,” she says, snuggling in closer to you and burying her nose into the crease of your neck affectionately. “I hope I’m as understanding as you are with my own mate, my Qal.”"

rows.original: And, that said, it’s not like [pc.originalRace] societies and cultures are all that different from Frostwyrm ideals. For example, your kind enjoys the concept of mating for life. Although, they don’t call it ‘mating,’ even though that’s what you do; they call it ‘marriage.’
rows.translation: 话虽如此，[pc.originalRace]的社会与文化其实也并非与霜龙的观念那么不同。例如，你的种族喜欢终身相伴的概念。只不过他们不把它叫作“交配”，尽管实际做的正是如此；他们称之为“婚姻”。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, that said, it’s not like [pc.originalRace] societies and cultures are all that different from Frostwyrm ideals. For example, your kind enjoys the concept of mating for life. Although, they don’t call it ‘mating,’ even though that’s what you do; they call it ‘marriage.’"

rows.original: “What’s the difference?” she asks, and you tell her that there isn’t really one; it’s just a fancy label that your kind apply to mates to tell others that they aren’t available. “Why would you need a label for that? Shouldn’t their scent markings be enough?” You smile. That’s a kinky thought, but most people try to be as un-smelly as possible.
rows.translation: “有什么区别？”她问。你告诉她，其实没有真正的区别；那只是你们种族给伴侣冠上的花哨称谓，用来告诉别人他们已经名花有主。“为什么需要称谓？他们身上的气味标记还不够吗？”你笑了。这个想法挺色情，但大多数人都尽量让自己没有异味。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s the difference?” she asks, and you tell her that there isn’t really one; it’s just a fancy label that your kind apply to mates to tell others that they aren’t available. “Why would you need a label for that? Shouldn’t their scent markings be enough?” You smile. That’s a kinky thought, but most people try to be as un-smelly as possible."

rows.original: “So marriage just means that you don’t mate with anyone except your mate?” That’s about the short of it, you confirm.
rows.translation: “所以结婚就意味着，除了自己的伴侣以外，不跟任何人交配？”差不多就是这么回事，你确认道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So marriage just means that you don’t mate with anyone except your mate?” That’s about the short of it, you confirm."

rows.original: “Does that mean we’re married to our Qim?” Well – suddenly, you’ve gotten yourself in a bit of a situation. You want to tell her that, if she’s married to anyone in the lair, it would be you, but you just said that two married people only mate with their mates. So... in a sense, yes, you suppose, [frostwyrm.name] is married to your kip
rows.translation: “那这是不是说，我们都和Qim结婚了？”好吧——你突然把自己绕进了困境。你想告诉她，如果她与巢穴里的谁结了婚，那应该是你；可你刚刚又说，两个已婚之人只会与自己的伴侣交配。所以...从某种意义上来说，是的，你想，[frostwyrm.name]确实和你的幼崽结婚了

You want to tell her that, if she’s married to anyone in the lair, it would be you, but you just said that two married people only mate with their mates. So... in a sense, yes, you suppose, [frostwyrm.name] is married to your kip"

rows.original:
hybrids is only beginning.
 
		Your [frostwyrm.andNykke|three|two] Qims love you with all their heart; you don’t need psionics to know that. And your kips are all highly devoted to you; their love toward their Qims and their Qal isn’t something you’d ever question. rows.translation: 你费了些力气才从长女身边抽身——她很舍不得放开你——接着离开[frostwyrm.name]，站到巢穴前方、霜龙幼体村落中的一处高台上。族群中的喧闹逐渐平息，每个女儿的红宝石双眼都转向了你；通过与你内嵌的灵能联系，她们全都感觉到你有件严肃的事要宣布，而你知道，出于尊重，她们并未读取你的思想——当你有话要说时，自会亲口说出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pull yourself away from your eldest daughter (with some effort; she was reluctant to let you go), and you peel from [frostwyrm.name], standing before the lair and on an elevated level of your Frostwyrmling village. The bustle of the clutch slowly begins to fade as the ruby-red eyes of each and every daughter fall to you; through their embedded psionic connection with you, they all feel that you have a serious announcement to make, and you know that, out of respect, they are not reading your mind – when you have something to say, you will say it."

rows.original: The lair falls entirely silent as they wait, excited for your words. [frostwyrm.name] watches you, her Qal and her mate, intensely, curious for what you intend to say. Nykke soon withdraws from her own, smaller cave, standing as a black beacon among the village of Frostwyrmlings, her own curiosity peaked at your announcement. You have the undivided attention of the lair.
rows.translation: 巢穴彻底安静下来，她们兴奋地等待你发言。[frostwyrm.name]目不转睛地注视着自己的Qal与伴侣，好奇你打算说什么。妮凯很快也从自己那座较小的洞穴中走出，如同一道黑色信标般立于霜龙幼体村落之间，你的宣告同样勾起了她的好奇。整座巢穴都在全神贯注地听你说话。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lair falls entirely silent as they wait, excited for your words. [frostwyrm.name] watches you, her Qal and her mate, intensely, curious for what you intend to say. Nykke soon withdraws from her own, smaller cave, standing as a black beacon among the village of Frostwyrmlings, her own curiosity peaked at your announcement. You have the undivided attention of the lair."

rows.original: You open your mouth, and you say the words that will change your life, and the course of Uveto, forever....
rows.translation: 你张开嘴，说出了将永远改变你的人生、也改变乌维托命运的话....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open your mouth, and you say the words that will change your life, and the course of Uveto, forever...."

rows.original: It might just be age creeping up on you, but you feel a sense of belonging that you can’t rightly explain, here in the lair. You’ve been with [frostwyrm.name] for so many years and you’ve had so many kips with her that you can’t shake the feeling that this is... where you belong. Here, as the Qal to your new, invigorated race of Frostwyrm hybrids; where you should stay until you and [frostwyrm.name] are summoned by the Grand Qim and your daughters leave to spread their genes, just as you have, throughout all of Uveto. Possibly further.
rows.translation: 或许只是年岁渐长，但待在巢穴里时，你感受到一种无法准确解释的归属感。你和[frostwyrm.name]相伴多年，也与她育有如此多的幼崽，因而再也无法摆脱这种感觉：这里...才是你的归宿。留在这里，作为这个重新焕发生机的霜龙混血种族的Qal；你应该一直留在这里，直到你和[frostwyrm.name]都被大Qim召唤，而你的女儿们则像你一样离开家园，把自己的基因传播到乌维托各地，甚至更加遥远的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt might just be age creeping up on you, but you feel a sense of belonging that you can’t rightly explain, here in the lair. You’ve been with [frostwyrm.name] for so many years and you’ve had so many kips with her that you can’t shake the feeling that this is... where you belong. Here, as the Qal to your new, invigorated race of Frostwyrm hybrids; where you should stay until you and [frostwyrm.name] are summoned by the Grand Qim and your daughters leave to spread their genes, just as you have, throughout all of Uveto. Possibly further."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: B

You didn’t simply leave the lair and start ransacking the planetoid that night; you spent many weeks afterward preparing and planning your methodical strikes at various points along the planet. You’d need to be swift and powerful, and you’d prefer to establish your kingdom with as little bloodshed as possible. The civilized peoples on Uveto aren’t fighters – they’d probably surrender peacefully, and if they don’t, it wouldn’t be difficult to put them on the next shuttle out of orbit. Each and every member of your clutch was on board with the plan. If it meant their Qal would stay with them forever, and if it made their Qal happy, they were all for it, every single one of them. They were giddy and excited, yet attentive and serious when you briefed them on your strategies and plans They wanted this to succeed as badly as you did, but none as much as [frostwyrm.name]; of everyone in the lair, the idea of retaking her world for her kind, with her Qal at the helm, was like a fantasy come true. [frostwyrm.andNykke|Nykke shared a similar sentiment, although she confided in you privately that what she was most excited for was a lair of her own, which would be easy to find once the entire planetoid became her grounds. ]And [flurry.name], while sharing [frostwyrm.name]’s excitement, was first and foremost interested in scouring the world for more pureblood Frostwyrms like himself: while he was fully dedicated to you
rows.translation: 那天夜里，你并未直接离开巢穴、开始洗劫整颗小行星；之后的许多个星期里，你一直在准备并筹划对行星各处发动有条不紊的袭击。行动必须迅速而有力，而且你希望尽可能少流血地建立王国。乌维托的文明居民并非战士——他们很可能会和平投降；即使不肯，把他们送上下一班离开轨道的穿梭机也并不困难。 族群中的每一名成员都赞同这项计划。如果这意味着她们的Qal会永远留在身边，而且能让Qal开心，那她们每一个都全力支持。你向她们说明战略和计划时，她们既兴奋雀跃，又专注严肃。 她们和你一样渴望成功，但谁也比不上[frostwyrm.name]；在巢穴所有成员中，由Qal掌舵、为自己的种族夺回故乡，对她而言宛如梦想成真。[frostwyrm.andNykke|妮凯也有类似感受，不过她私下向你坦言，自己最期待的其实是拥有一座专属巢穴；整颗小行星都成为她的领地后，这很容易找到。]至于[flurry.name]，虽然也和[frostwyrm.name]一样兴奋，却首先想搜遍世界，寻找更多像自己一样的纯血霜龙：尽管他完全忠于你

rows.translation: ，而且他是自己与[frostwyrm.name]所生纯血后代忠诚的Qim
rows.raw: ", and he was a devoted Qim to the purebloods he and [frostwyrm.name] had produced"

rows.original: kinda went out the window as soon as an intrepid few from your clutch had a better idea: rather than flex some muscle or make some threats or try and talk your way into sub... subju... ruling all of Uveto, why not just fuck your way there? It was a simple trade: all those lonely, pent-up and frustrated scientists got all the sex they could have asked for from your Frostwyrmling hunnies, and all they had to do was promise to do what you said. Man or woman, gay or straight, it didn’t matter; each of your daughters had something for everyone. You dunno how long it took, but when all was said and done, there weren’t any more stations to take over. And although not a drop of blood was spilt, the same could not be said for a handful of other bodily fluids
rows.translation: 很快就被族群中几名大胆成员提出的好主意抛到脑后：与其展示肌肉、发出威胁，或者试图靠谈判征...征服...统治整个乌维托，为什么不一路操过去呢？交易很简单：那些孤独、压抑又性欲难耐的科学家，可以从你的霜龙幼体甜心们那里得到想要的一切性爱，只需答应服从你的命令。男人女人、同性恋异性恋都无所谓；你的每个女儿都能满足所有人。你不知道花了多久，但尘埃落定时，再也没有需要接管的站点。虽然一滴血都没流，却不能说其他几种体液也一样

It was a simple trade: all those lonely, pent-up and frustrated scientists got all the sex they could have asked for from your Frostwyrmling hunnies, and all they had to do was promise to do what you said. Man or woman, gay or straight, it didn’t matter; each of your daughters had something for everyone. You dunno how long it took, but when all was said and done, there weren’t any more stations to take over. And although not a drop of blood was spilt, the same could not be said for a handful of other bodily fluids"

rows.original: was a diplomatic disaster. You wanted no bloodshed, but your coordination was nonexistent; your attack plan, if it could even be called that, was sloppy; and you couldn’t even find the stations you had mapped out to strike in order. Your attack was confused and haphazard, with little communication between you and the kips, and rather than try to subjugate Uveto through a bit of flexing and diplomacy, it ultimately devolved into violence. You aren’t sure who threw the first punch, but, when all was said and done, you sure as hell finished the fight
rows.translation: 计划成了一场外交灾难。你本不希望流血，可你们毫无协调；袭击方案——如果那玩意儿还能称作方案——粗陋不堪，甚至找不到地图上标出、准备依次打击的站点。袭击混乱而草率，你与幼崽间几乎没有沟通；原本想靠展示力量和外交手段征服乌维托，最终却演变成了暴力。你不知道是谁先动手，但尘埃落定时，结束战斗的肯定是你们

You aren’t sure who threw the first punch, but, when all was said and done, you sure as hell finished the fight"

rows.original: was executed with the occasional hiccup, and you can’t say it was completely bloodless. The clutch stayed together, and you took the planetoid one station at a time; some of them fell easily and without resistance, while others were a little more... animated, refusing their subjugation. When a station couldn’t be reasoned with, you had to make some demonstrations and examples. It wasn’t the fault of anyone in your clutch, but you couldn’t help but feel responsible for the few diplomatic losses you had to endure
rows.translation: 计划执行时偶有波折，你也不能说它完全没有流血。族群始终团结在一起，一座站点接一座站点地拿下这颗小行星；有些轻易陷落、毫无抵抗，另一些则更加...激烈，拒绝遭到征服。当某座站点无法讲通道理时，你们只能展示力量、杀鸡儆猴。这并非族群任何成员的过错，但你仍忍不住为不得不承受的少数外交损失感到内疚
rows.raw: "was executed with the occasional hiccup, and you can’t say it was completely bloodless. The clutch stayed together, and you took the planetoid one station at a time; some of them fell easily and without resistance, while others were a little more... animated, refusing their subjugation. When a station couldn’t be reasoned with, you had to make some demonstrations and examples. It wasn’t the fault of anyone in your clutch, but you couldn’t help but feel responsible for the few diplomatic losses you had to endure"

rows.original: was executed flawlessly. Your clutch struck with strength and precision, hitting each station in order exactly as you had planned, and you had subjugated them one after the other without so much as a hitch. Like you had surmised, most of the civilized life on the planetoid were humble scientists, and they generally didn’t need convincing. The few that did bent with just a little flex of the power of your Frostwyrms, and when all was said and done, each and every station on Uveto was under your control, and not a drop of blood was spilled. You couldn’t have been prouder of your clutch and their discipline
rows.translation: 计划执行得天衣无缝。你的族群以力量和精准发动打击，完全按照计划依次攻下每座站点，一个接一个将其征服，没有遇到丝毫阻碍。正如你所料，小行星上的文明生命大多只是谦和的科学家，通常无须劝服。少数顽固者也在霜龙稍稍展示力量后屈服；尘埃落定时，乌维托的每座站点都已处于你的控制之下，滴血未流。你从未如此为族群及其纪律感到骄傲

rows.original:
.

		Of course, the total annexation of an entire planet did not go unnoticed on the interplanetary scale: there were many factions and businesses that had a vested interest in keeping Uveto the way it was, free of the ‘tyranny’ of an army of Frostwyrms having assumed control. Luckily, orbital strikes were out of the question – civilian casualties would be enormous; trade would halt for decades as rebuilding efforts would take place; and there’s no telling what explosive events like that would do to Uveto’s glacier surface. That was when it was time for a more diplomatic approach.

		In truth, while you and your Frostwyrm family commanded the Uvetan surface, you and your ilk had no interest in interfering with the businesses of others. You made no attempt to stop the mining of Uveto’s minerals; you did not interfere in the practices and studies of the scientists and workers living there; and you had no plans or means to continue your conquest beyond Uveto. What you wanted was for your family to have more living space than a dome in the ocean, and for the opportunity to expand your search for other purebred Frostwyrms.

		Your position as monarch of Uveto was tenuous, to say the least, with other factions interested in maintaining Uveto’s predetermined order. You suspected for years that non-Uvetans did not respect your title as Uveto’s ruler. But, simultaneously, they did not attempt to overthrow you or usurp you: as long as you made no effort to halt the common trade and business on Uveto – and, as you’re sure it played no small part in maintaining the peace, as long as you kept surrounding yourself with dragons – your position as Uveto’s ruler was not challenged.
rows.translation:
。

		当然，吞并整颗行星的行为并未逃过星际社会的注意：许多派系和企业都对维持乌维托原状有切身利益，不愿让它落入一支霜龙军队的“暴政”之下。幸运的是，轨道轰炸绝不可行——平民伤亡会极其惨重；重建将令贸易停滞数十年；而且没人知道这类爆炸会给乌维托的冰川表面造成什么影响。于是，该采取更加外交的手段了。

		事实上，尽管你和霜龙家族控制了乌维托地表，你们却无意干涉他人的生意。你没有试图阻止开采乌维托的矿物，也未干预当地科学家和工人的实践与研究，更没有计划或能力把征服扩展到乌维托之外。你只希望家人能拥有比海中穹顶更广阔的生活空间，并获得扩大搜索、寻找其他纯血霜龙的机会。

		至少可以说，你身为乌维托君主的地位并不稳固，因为其他派系仍想维护乌维托预定的秩序。多年来，你一直怀疑非乌维托人并不认可你作为统治者的头衔。但与此同时，他们也没有试图推翻或篡夺你：只要你不妨碍乌维托常规的贸易与商业——而且你确信，始终让龙群环绕自己也对维持和平功不可没——你身为乌维托统治者的地位便无人挑战。

rows.raw: "\n\nEach and every member of your clutch was on board with the plan. If it meant their Qal would stay with them forever, and if it made their Qal happy, they were all for it, every single one of them. They were giddy and excited, yet attentive and serious when you briefed them on your strategies and plans."

rows.original: They wanted this to succeed as badly as you did, but none as much as [frostwyrm.name]; of everyone in the lair, the idea of retaking her world for her kind, with her Qal at the helm, was like a fantasy come true. Nykke shared a similar sentiment, although she confided in you (in private) that what she was most excited for was a lair of her own, which would be easy to find once the entire planetoid became her grounds.
rows.translation: 她们和你一样渴望成功，但谁也比不上[frostwyrm.name]；在巢穴所有成员中，由Qal掌舵、为自己的种族夺回故乡，对她而言宛如梦想成真。妮凯也有类似感受，不过她私下向你坦言，自己最期待的其实是拥有一座专属巢穴；整颗小行星都成为她的领地后，这很容易找到。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey wanted this to succeed as badly as you did, but none as much as [frostwyrm.name]; of everyone in the lair, the idea of retaking her world for her kind, with her Qal at the helm, was like a fantasy come true. Nykke shared a similar sentiment, although she confided in you (in private) that what she was most excited for was a lair of her own, which would be easy to find once the entire planetoid became her grounds."

rows.raw: "\n\nThe day you began your strike – the day [frostwyrm.name] lovingly referred to as ‘Light’s Beginning’ – "

rows.original: kinda went out the window as soon as an intrepid few from your clutch had a better idea: rather than flex some muscle or make some threats or try and talk your way into sub... subju... ruling all of Uveto, why not just fuck your way there? It was a simple trade: all those lonely, pent-up and frustrated scientists got all the sex they could have asked for from your Frostwyrmling hunnies, and all they had to do was promise to do what you said. Man or woman, gay or straight, it didn’t matter; each of your daughters had something for anyone. You dunno how long it took, but when all was said and done, there weren’t any more stations to take over. And although not a drop of blood was spilt, the same could not be said for a handful of other bodily fluids.
rows.translation: 很快就被族群中几名大胆成员提出的好主意抛到脑后：与其展示肌肉、发出威胁，或者试图靠谈判征...征服...统治整个乌维托，为什么不一路操过去呢？交易很简单：那些孤独、压抑又性欲难耐的科学家，可以从你的霜龙幼体甜心们那里得到想要的一切性爱，只需答应服从你的命令。男人女人、同性恋异性恋都无所谓；你的每个女儿都能满足所有人。你不知道花了多久，但尘埃落定时，再也没有需要接管的站点。虽然一滴血都没流，却不能说其他几种体液也一样。
rows.raw: " kinda went out the window as soon as an intrepid few from your clutch had a better idea: rather than flex some muscle or make some threats or try and talk your way into sub... subju... ruling all of Uveto, why not just fuck your way there? It was a simple trade: all those lonely, pent-up and frustrated scientists got all the sex they could have asked for from your Frostwyrmling hunnies, and all they had to do was promise to do what you said. Man or woman, gay or straight, it didn’t matter; each of your daughters had something for anyone. You dunno how long it took, but when all was said and done, there weren’t any more stations to take over. And although not a drop of blood was spilt, the same could not be said for a handful of other bodily fluids."

rows.original: was executed flawlessly. Your clutch struck with strength and precision, hitting each station in order exactly as you had planned, and you had subjugated them one after the other without so much as a hitch. Like you had surmised, most of the civilized life on the planetoid were humble scientists, and they generally didn’t need convincing. The few that did bent with just a little flex of the power of your Frostwyrms, and when all was said and done, each and every station on Uveto was under your control, and not a drop of blood was spilled. You couldn’t have been prouder of your clutch and their discipline.
rows.translation: 计划执行得天衣无缝。你的族群以力量和精准发动打击，完全按照计划依次攻下每座站点，一个接一个将其征服，没有遇到丝毫阻碍。正如你所料，小行星上的文明生命大多只是谦和的科学家，通常无须劝服。少数顽固者也在霜龙稍稍展示力量后屈服；尘埃落定时，乌维托的每座站点都已处于你的控制之下，滴血未流。你从未如此为族群及其纪律感到骄傲。
rows.raw: "\n\nwas executed flawlessly. Your clutch struck with strength and precision, hitting each station in order exactly as you had planned, and you had subjugated them one after the other without so much as a hitch. Like you had surmised, most of the civilized life on the planetoid were humble scientists, and they generally didn’t need convincing. The few that did bent with just a little flex of the power of your Frostwyrms, and when all was said and done, each and every station on Uveto was under your control, and not a drop of blood was spilled. You couldn’t have been prouder of your clutch and their discipline."

rows.original: was executed with the occasional hiccup, and you can’t say it was completely bloodless. The clutch stayed together, and you took the planetoid one station at a time; some of them fell easily and without resistance, while others were a little more... animated, refusing their subjugation. When a station couldn’t be reasoned with, you had to make some demonstrations and examples. It wasn’t the fault of anyone in your clutch, but you couldn’t help but feel responsible for the few diplomatic losses you had to endure.
rows.translation: 计划执行时偶有波折，你也不能说它完全没有流血。族群始终团结在一起，一座站点接一座站点地拿下这颗小行星；有些轻易陷落、毫无抵抗，另一些则更加...激烈，拒绝遭到征服。当某座站点无法讲通道理时，你们只能展示力量、杀鸡儆猴。这并非族群任何成员的过错，但你仍忍不住为不得不承受的少数外交损失感到内疚。
rows.raw: " was executed with the occasional hiccup, and you can’t say it was completely bloodless. The clutch stayed together, and you took the planetoid one station at a time; some of them fell easily and without resistance, while others were a little more... animated, refusing their subjugation. When a station couldn’t be reasoned with, you had to make some demonstrations and examples. It wasn’t the fault of anyone in your clutch, but you couldn’t help but feel responsible for the few diplomatic losses you had to endure."

rows.original: was a diplomatic disaster. You wanted no bloodshed, but your coordination was nonexistent; your attack plan, if it could even be called that, was sloppy; and you couldn’t even find the stations you had mapped out to strike in order. Your attack was confused and haphazard, with little communication between you and the kips, and rather than try to subjugate Uveto through a bit of flexing and diplomacy, it ultimately devolved into violence. You aren’t sure who threw the first punch, but, when all was said and done, you sure as hell finished the fight.
rows.translation: 计划成了一场外交灾难。你本不希望流血，可你们毫无协调；袭击方案——如果那玩意儿还能称作方案——粗陋不堪，甚至找不到地图上标出、准备依次打击的站点。袭击混乱而草率，你与幼崽间几乎没有沟通；原本想靠展示力量和外交手段征服乌维托，最终却演变成了暴力。你不知道是谁先动手，但尘埃落定时，结束战斗的肯定是你们。
rows.raw: " was a diplomatic disaster. You wanted no bloodshed, but your coordination was nonexistent; your attack plan, if it could even be called that, was sloppy; and you couldn’t even find the stations you had mapped out to strike in order. Your attack was confused and haphazard, with little communication between you and the kips, and rather than try to subjugate Uveto through a bit of flexing and diplomacy, it ultimately devolved into violence. You aren’t sure who threw the first punch, but, when all was said and done, you sure as hell finished the fight."

rows.original: Of course, the total annexation of an entire planet did not go unnoticed on the interplanetary scale: there were many factions and businesses that had a vested interest in keeping Uveto the way it was, free of the ‘tyranny’ of an army of Frostwyrms having assumed control. Luckily, orbital strikes were out of the question – civilian casualties would be enormous; trade would halt for decades as rebuilding efforts would take place; and there’s no telling what explosive events like that would do to Uveto’s glacier surface. That was when it was time for a more diplomatic approach.
rows.translation: 当然，吞并整颗行星的行为并未逃过星际社会的注意：许多派系和企业都对维持乌维托原状有切身利益，不愿让它落入一支霜龙军队的“暴政”之下。幸运的是，轨道轰炸绝不可行——平民伤亡会极其惨重；重建将令贸易停滞数十年；而且没人知道这类爆炸会给乌维托的冰川表面造成什么影响。于是，该采取更加外交的手段了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, the total annexation of an entire planet did not go unnoticed on the interplanetary scale: there were many factions and businesses that had a vested interest in keeping Uveto the way it was, free of the ‘tyranny’ of an army of Frostwyrms having assumed control. Luckily, orbital strikes were out of the question – civilian casualties would be enormous; trade would halt for decades as rebuilding efforts would take place; and there’s no telling what explosive events like that would do to Uveto’s glacier surface. That was when it was time for a more diplomatic approach."

rows.original: In truth, while you and your Frostwyrm family commanded the Uvetan surface, you and your ilk had no interest in interfering with the businesses of others. You made no attempt to stop the mining of Uveto’s minerals; you did not interfere in the practices and studies of the scientists and workers living there; and you had no plans or means to continue your conquest beyond Uveto. What you wanted was for your family to have more living space than a small dome in the ocean, and for the opportunity to expand your search for other purebred Frostwyrms.
rows.translation: 事实上，尽管你和霜龙家族控制了乌维托地表，你们却无意干涉他人的生意。你没有试图阻止开采乌维托的矿物，也未干预当地科学家和工人的实践与研究，更没有计划或能力把征服扩展到乌维托之外。你只希望家人能拥有比海中小穹顶更广阔的生活空间，并获得扩大搜索、寻找其他纯血霜龙的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn truth, while you and your Frostwyrm family commanded the Uvetan surface, you and your ilk had no interest in interfering with the businesses of others. You made no attempt to stop the mining of Uveto’s minerals; you did not interfere in the practices and studies of the scientists and workers living there; and you had no plans or means to continue your conquest beyond Uveto. What you wanted was for your family to have more living space than a small dome in the ocean, and for the opportunity to expand your search for other purebred Frostwyrms."

rows.original: Your position as monarch of Uveto was tenuous, to say the least, with other factions interested in maintaining Uveto’s predetermined order. You suspected for years that non-Uvetans did not respect your title as Uveto’s ruler. But, simultaneously, they did not attempt to overthrow you or usurp you: as long as you made no effort to halt the common trade and business on Uveto – and, as you’re sure it played no small part in maintaining the peace, as long as you kept surrounding yourself with dragons – your position as Uveto’s ruler was not challenged.
rows.translation: 至少可以说，你身为乌维托君主的地位并不稳固，因为其他派系仍想维护乌维托预定的秩序。多年来，你一直怀疑非乌维托人并不认可你作为统治者的头衔。但与此同时，他们也没有试图推翻或篡夺你：只要你不妨碍乌维托常规的贸易与商业——而且你确信，始终让龙群环绕自己也对维持和平功不可没——你身为乌维托统治者的地位便无人挑战。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour position as monarch of Uveto was tenuous, to say the least, with other factions interested in maintaining Uveto’s predetermined order. You suspected for years that non-Uvetans did not respect your title as Uveto’s ruler. But, simultaneously, they did not attempt to overthrow you or usurp you: as long as you made no effort to halt the common trade and business on Uveto – and, as you’re sure it played no small part in maintaining the peace, as long as you kept surrounding yourself with dragons – your position as Uveto’s ruler was not challenged."

rows.original: You didn’t simply leave the lair and start ransacking the planetoid that night; you spent many weeks afterward preparing and planning your methodological strikes at various points along the planet. You’d need to be swift and powerful, and you’d prefer to establish your kingdom with as little bloodshed as possible. The civilized peoples on Uveto aren’t fighters – they’d probably surrender peacefully, and if they don’t, it wouldn’t be difficult to put them on the next shuttle out of orbit.
rows.translation: 那天夜里，你并未直接离开巢穴、开始洗劫整颗小行星；之后的许多个星期里，你一直在准备并筹划对行星各处发动有条不紊的袭击。行动必须迅速而有力，而且你希望尽可能少流血地建立王国。乌维托的文明居民并非战士——他们很可能会和平投降；即使不肯，把他们送上下一班离开轨道的穿梭机也并不困难。

rows.original: Once you had taken complete control of Uveto and the Frostwyrm population began to boom (albeit through hybrids), you quickly found other, surviving individual purebred Frostwyrms – you had found more of [frostwyrm.name]’s kind. [frostwyrm.name] was overjoyed, of course, but she showed no interest in any of her kind, sexually or emotionally. How could she? She had the greatest Qal in history as a mate, and her every emotional and sexual need was fulfilled by her loyal clutch. She was devoted to you and to the clutch, body and soul, until the end of time.
rows.translation: 当你彻底控制乌维托、霜龙种群开始迅速增长之后（尽管增长的是混血后代），你很快便发现了其他幸存的纯血霜龙个体——你找到了更多[frostwyrm.name]的同族。[frostwyrm.name]自然欣喜若狂，但无论在性欲还是感情上，她都没有对任何同族表现出兴趣。她怎么可能有兴趣呢？她拥有历史上最伟大的Qal作为伴侣，忠诚的巢群也满足了她的一切情感和性需求。她全身心地忠于你和巢群，直到时间的尽头。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you had taken complete control of Uveto and the Frostwyrm population began to boom (albeit through hybrids), you quickly found other, surviving individual purebred Frostwyrms – you had found more of [frostwyrm.name]’s kind. [frostwyrm.name] was overjoyed, of course, but she showed no interest in any of her kind, sexually or emotionally. How could she? She had the greatest Qal in history as a mate, and her every emotional and sexual need was fulfilled by her loyal clutch. She was devoted to you and to the clutch, body and soul, until the end of time."

rows.original: Today, you’re sitting on your favorite chair: what was once the Irestead lead director’s chair, which was surprisingly regal and fancy for who everyone was assumed was a mere scientist. You had relocated it to the lower floor of the station, so that you could be closer to [frostwyrm.name] and your numerous, doting daughters at all times. You had the station remodeled slightly to allow for [frostwyrm.name] to comfortably enter and leave the lowest floor, and since then, you’ve rarely left Irestead for anything - save for when you, as Qal of the clutch, want to spend some quality, personal time with your Qim.
rows.translation: 今天，你坐在自己最喜欢的椅子上：它曾是艾尔斯泰德首席主管的座椅，对一个被所有人认为只是普通科学家的人而言，这椅子出乎意料地华贵而气派。你将它搬到了空间站的下层，好让自己时刻贴近[frostwyrm.name]和众多殷勤体贴的女儿。你还稍微改造了空间站，让[frostwyrm.name]可以舒适地进出最底层；从那以后，你几乎从不因任何事情离开艾尔斯泰德——除非身为巢群Qal的你想与你的Qim单独享受一段亲密时光。
rows.raw: "\n\nToday, you’re sitting on your favorite chair: what was once the Irestead lead director’s chair, which was surprisingly regal and fancy for who everyone was assumed was a mere scientist. You had relocated it to the lower floor of the station, so that you could be closer to [frostwyrm.name] and your numerous, doting daughters at all times. You had the station remodeled slightly to allow for [frostwyrm.name] to comfortably enter and leave the lowest floor, and since then, you’ve rarely left Irestead for anything - save for when you, as Qal of the clutch, want to spend some quality, personal time with your Qim."

rows.original: One of your kips approaches you, holding out a hologram of the latest in the universe’s news and happenings. rows.original: A low rumbling emanates from her chest, where you’re pressed against, as she enjoys the contentment of being with her Qal in her lair. What troubles you? she asks, shuffling her legs a bit to nudge you closer to her. Speak your mind to me. As ever, your mate is here for you.
rows.translation: 你紧贴着她的胸膛，那里传出低沉的隆隆声；她正享受着与自己的Qal同处巢穴的满足。什么事情困扰着你？她问道，稍稍挪动双腿，将你推得更贴近她。把心事告诉我。一如既往，你的伴侣会陪在你身边。

rows.original: At her insistence, you say that it isn’t anything upsetting or concerning. I am relieved to hear that, she says, in an expectant, yet loving, tone – the sort of tone that sounds like she’s enamored with the sound of your voice and just wants to hear more.
rows.translation: 在她的坚持下，你说这并不是什么令人难过或担忧的事。听你这么说，我就放心了，她以满怀期待却又充满爱意的语调说道——那语气仿佛她迷恋着你的声音，只想听你继续说下去。

rows.original: You tell her that, at around this time of the Sky Cycle, your kind has a tradition that you all celebrate. What you call it and how you celebrate it are different depending on the individual and their culture, but they all have similar themes: it’s a time that emphasizes togetherness; joy and merriment; and family. It’s a time when families get together and enjoy each other’s company.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，在天空周期的这个时节，你的族人会庆祝一项传统。不同个体与文化对它的称呼和庆祝方式各不相同，但都有相似的主题：这是强调团聚、欢乐和家庭的时节；家人会相聚一堂，享受彼此的陪伴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that, at around this time of the Sky Cycle, your kind has a tradition that you all celebrate. What you call it and how you celebrate it are different depending on the individual and their culture, but they all have similar themes: it’s a time that emphasizes togetherness; joy and merriment; and family. It’s a time when families get together and enjoy each other’s company."

rows.original: Is that not what we do all Sky Cycle? she asks, and you respond that it is – but what you two share is, in a word, atypical of your kind. Families in your species don’t always stay together until their parents pass away, and everyone in a ‘clutch’ makes a conscious effort to gather together during this time of the Sky Cycle.
rows.translation: 我们不是整个天空周期都在这样做吗？她问道。你回答说确实如此——但你们之间的生活，用一个词来说，对你的族人而言并不寻常。你的种族中，家庭成员并不总会相伴到父母离世，而“巢群”中的每个人都会在天空周期的这个时节有意识地团聚起来。

rows.original: B

There’s one thing you and your kind liked to do during times like these. Here on Uveto, snow and ice is everywhere and it’s something that everyone, including its natives like the Frostwyrms, take for granted; but where you come from, snow is something that only happens during very specific times of the Sky Cycle. You and your kind have learned to make the most out of the little window you’re given to do fun stuff with it.
rows.translation: 在这样的时节里，你和你的同族过去总爱做一件事。乌维托到处都是冰雪，所有人——包括霜龙这样的本地生物——都对此习以为常；但在你的故乡，只有天空周期中特定的时节才会下雪。你和你的同族早已学会充分利用这段短暂时光，在雪中尽情玩乐。
rows.raw: "There’s one thing you and your kind liked to do during times like these. Here on Uveto, snow and ice is everywhere and it’s something that everyone, including its natives like the Frostwyrms, take for granted; but where you come from, snow is something that only happens during very specific times of the Sky Cycle. You and your kind have learned to make the most out of the little window you’re given to do fun stuff with it."

rows.original: Give me a moment, [frostwyrm.name] says determinedly, her eyes narrowing as she scrutinizes the puzzle she had made for herself. She opens her massive jaw and considers biting into them, but reconsiders; she wraps her long neck around one to try and lift that way, but she couldn’t get halfway around the ball.
rows.translation: 给我一点时间，[frostwyrm.name]坚定地说道。她眯起眼睛，仔细审视自己给自己出的难题。她张开巨口，考虑要不要咬住雪球，却又打消了念头；她又试着用长颈环住其中一颗将其抬起，但连雪球的一半都绕不过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nGive me a moment, [frostwyrm.name] says determinedly, her eyes narrowing as she scrutinizes the puzzle she had made for herself. She opens her massive jaw and considers biting into them, but reconsiders; she wraps her long neck around one to try and lift that way, but she couldn’t get halfway around the ball."

rows.original: After a moment, she turns to one side and jams the tip of her wing underneath one heavy orb; with a grunt and a flex of her powerful wing, she manages to lift it up, where it then rolls onto her back, until she gets into position and rolls it back off. The third ball is much harder, since her snowman is so tall, but, with determination and no grace, she manages to make herself a bonafide, if absolutely massive, snowman.
rows.translation: 片刻之后，她侧过身，把翼尖猛地插到一颗沉重的雪球底下；伴随着一声闷哼和强健翅膀的发力，她成功将它抬起。雪球随即滚到她背上，直到她站好位置，再让它从背上滚下去。第三颗雪球要困难得多，因为她的雪人实在太高了；不过，凭借坚定的意志和毫无优雅可言的动作，她还是成功堆出了一个货真价实、但大得吓人的雪人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment, she turns to one side and jams the tip of her wing underneath one heavy orb; with a grunt and a flex of her powerful wing, she manages to lift it up, where it then rolls onto her back, until she gets into position and rolls it back off.
