rows.original: But that’s not all. Here’s the best part: you get to decorate the snowman. You start digging into the snow, looking for the rocky surface of Uveto, and you find it: the island is covered in smooth, black pebbles, frozen together in clumps of three and four, underneath the ice. You break them apart and put two on the topmost snowball – now he has eyes!
rows.translation: 不过还没有结束。接下来才是最好玩的部分：你们可以装饰雪人。你开始挖开积雪，寻找乌维托的岩石地表，并且很快找到了：冰层之下，整座岛都覆盖着光滑的黑色卵石，每三四块冻结成一团。你把它们敲开，将两块放到最顶端的雪球上——现在他有眼睛了！

rows.translation: 。她们开始交流点子，再稍加增补或改动——每个人都笑得无比灿烂，享受着彼此相处、增进感情的时光。
rows.raw: ". They begin sharing ideas and adding or changing them just slightly – and they each have the widest of smiles, loving the bonding time they’re sharing with each other."

rows.original: She starts with doing exactly as you had done by putting two rocks where the eyes would be. Then, she puts in several more, in a line going straight down the middle snowball. Then, out of ideas, she drills small holes into the snowman’s body with her claws, digging the stones in deep so that only the tips remain – she gave her snowman scales, like her own body !
rows.translation: 她先完全照着你的做法，把两块石头放在眼睛的位置。接着，她又沿着中间雪球的正中央摆下一整排石头。然后，她想不出别的点子了，便用爪子在雪人身体上钻出许多小孔，把石头深深嵌进去，只露出尖端——她给雪人添上了与自己身体一样的鳞片 ！
rows.raw: "She starts with doing exactly as you had done by putting two rocks where the eyes would be. Then, she puts in several more, in a line going straight down the middle snowball. Then, out of ideas, she drills small holes into the snowman’s body with her claws, digging the stones in deep so that only the tips remain – she gave her snowman scales, like her own body !"

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] concentrates on her snowman, unsure of how to go about personalizing it. She twists her head from side to side, trying to imagine how it would look with any number of changes or accessories. Then, suddenly, she’s struck with inspiration, and disappears into the lair for a moment.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]专注地盯着自己的雪人，不知道该怎样赋予它独特之处。她把头从一边歪到另一边，细细考虑，随后忽然想到什么，转身跑回巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] concentrates on her snowman, unsure of how to go about personalizing it. She twists her head from side to side, trying to imagine how it would look with any number of changes or accessories. Then, suddenly, she’s struck with inspiration, and disappears into the lair for a moment."

rows.original: When she returns, she has two large icicles, pulled from the roof of her lair, in her mouth. She drops one, then carefully aligns the sharp end of the other against the side of her middle snowball, tilted upwards, and drives it in. Satisfied that it’ll remain in place, she picks up the other and does the same thing on the other side.
rows.translation: 她回来时，嘴里叼着两根从巢穴屋顶取下的大冰柱。她放下一根，然后小心地把另一根的尖端对准中间雪球的侧面，略微向上倾斜，再将它插进去。确认它不会掉落后，她捡起另一根，在另一侧重复了同样的做法。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she returns, she has two large icicles, pulled from the roof of her lair, in her mouth. She drops one, then carefully aligns the sharp end of the other against the side of her middle snowball, tilted upwards, and drives it in. Satisfied that it’ll remain in place, she picks up the other and does the same thing on the other side."

rows.original: My Snowing Man has been completed, [frostwyrm.name] announces proudly, stepping back and sitting on her haunches to appreciate her work. You take your position beside her to properly enjoy it: massive, craggy, misshapen and crooked, and aside from the icicle arms, it’s completely bare. You tell her that it’s absolutely beautiful.
rows.translation: 我的落雪之人已经完成了，[frostwyrm.name]骄傲地宣布，退后一步坐在后腿上欣赏自己的作品。你来到她身旁，好好端详起来：它巨大、粗粝、歪歪斜斜，形状也不规整；除了一双冰柱手臂外，身上什么装饰都没有。你告诉她，它美极了。
rows.raw: "\n\nMy Snowing Man has been completed, [frostwyrm.name] announces proudly, stepping back and sitting on her haunches to appreciate her work. You take your position beside her to properly enjoy it: massive, craggy, misshapen and crooked, and aside from the icicle arms, it’s completely bare. You tell her that it’s absolutely beautiful."

rows.original: You feel her probe your mind, likely for the definition of the word ‘beautiful.’ I should hope so, my mate, she says, craning her neck down to nuzzle you. It is modeled after you. You look at her towering behemoth of a snowman again. Frostwyrms don’t have arms.
rows.translation: 你感觉她探入你的思绪，大概是在寻找“美丽”一词的含义。我当然希望如此，我的伴侣，她说道，弯下脖颈亲昵地蹭着你。它是照着你的模样做的。你再次看向她那座高耸庞大的雪人。霜龙根本没有手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel her probe your mind, likely for the definition of the word ‘beautiful.’ I should hope so, my mate, she says, craning her neck down to nuzzle you. It is modeled after you. You look at her towering behemoth of a snowman again. Frostwyrms don’t have arms."

rows.raw: "completed together. With the constant subzero temperatures of Uveto, your snowmen will survive for as long as the weather is decent. You wonder if you should give your own snowman some wings or something, to return the notion."

You have no doubt that she’d love to give it a try, if for no other reason than to be a part of your life, but you just can’t wrap your head around how it could possibly look in the snow. There is, of course, only one way to know for sure.
rows.translation: 你抬头望向[frostwyrm.name]，脑中浮现出雪地天使的主意。你毫不怀疑她会愿意尝试，哪怕只是为了参与到你的生活中；可你实在想象不出她在雪里做出的图案会是什么样子。当然，只有一种办法能够确定。

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name], try as she might, just can’t wrap her head around how the silhouette is supposed to look: the creature you’ve drawn in the snow has no ‘arms’ or even legs, and it has no weight or body to it. Her imagination draws nothing as she tries again and again to see it, from different angles. You offer to make another one. More examples would not assist me, though I appreciate the offer, my Qal, she says, her eyes narrowing on the pit in the snow. I will deduce this with what you’ve provided me now.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]无论怎么努力，也始终无法理解那道轮廓本该是什么模样：你画在雪里的生物没有“手臂”，甚至没有腿，也没有重量或实体。她换着角度反复观察，想象中却仍旧一片空白。你提出可以再做一个。更多示例也无法帮助我，不过我感谢你的提议，我的Qal，她眯起眼睛盯着雪坑说道。我会根据你现在提供的东西推断出来。
rows.raw: "[frostwyrm.name], try as she might, just can’t wrap her head around how the silhouette is supposed to look: the creature you’ve drawn in the snow has no ‘arms’ or even legs, and it has no weight or body to it. More examples would not assist me, though I appreciate the offer, my Qal, she says, her eyes narrowing on the pit in the snow. I will deduce this with what you’ve provided me now."

rows.original: Your daughter, meanwhile, has already taken to making herself a small cadre of snow angels: as soon as she’s wrapped her head around the concept, she finds a blank spot in the snow, spreads her arms and wings, and falls backward with a giggle, the snow billowing up and around her when she flops into it. Where she puts her next angel is usually pretty random – with the exception of three in particular, aligned in such a way that their wings overlap just slightly.
rows.translation: 与此同时，你的女儿已经开始给自己做出一小群雪天使：她一理解这个概念，就找了片没被踩过的雪地躺下，照着你的动作挥舞四肢。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour daughter, meanwhile, has already taken to making herself a small cadre of snow angels: as soon as she’s wrapped her head around the concept, she finds a blank spot in the snow, spreads her arms and wings, and falls backward with a giggle, the snow billowing up and around her when she flops into it. Where she puts her next angel is usually pretty random – with the exception of three in particular, aligned in such a way that their wings overlap just slightly."

rows.original: The moments tick by as [frostwyrm.name] scrutinizes your angel. You’re on the verge of telling her that you can do something else – you’re worried that the snow angel might be souring her mood – when, suddenly, she looks up and scours the island for an untainted bit of snow, large enough for her. When she finds one, she turns to one side, folds her wings against her body, and tips over, rolling across the snow until she’s on her back.
rows.translation: 时间一点点过去，[frostwyrm.name]仔细审视着你的天使。你正准备告诉她可以换个活动——你担心雪地里的形象实在让她难以理解——她却忽然下定了决心。

When she finds one, she turns to one side, folds her wings against her body, and tips over, rolling across the snow until she’s on her back."

rows.original: Her motions are similar to a... well, to a giant lizard that’s fallen onto its back. [frostwyrm.name] writhes her spine back and forth, twisting her body and flapping her wings in her attempt to mimic your actions earlier. The snow crunches underneath her weight, and the air vibrates every time her bodily thrusting lifts her off the ground. You stay clear of her; her wings and her thrashing tail are larger than she might realize.
rows.translation: 她的动作看起来就像……嗯，一只摔了个四脚朝天的巨型蜥蜴。[frostwyrm.name]左右扭动脊背，转动身体，同时挥舞四肢，竭力在雪中刻出想要的轮廓。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer motions are similar to a... well, to a giant lizard that’s fallen onto its back. rows.translation: 雪块随着她的动作粘在身上。值得肯定的是，她的动作相当有规律：尽管看上去有些滑稽，却并非毫无章法地乱动。

My Snowing Angel had come out better than I had imagined, she says to you "

rows.original: and her clutch
rows.translation: 她的孩子们也
rows.raw: "and her clutch "

rows.original: proudly.
rows.translation: 满怀自豪。
rows.raw: "proudly."

rows.original: It’s difficult to make out any particular shape in the snow from your angle – it just looks like a giant, flattened bit of snow (not that you’d ever say that to her). Still, from what you can tell, some parts of her angel appear rather specific, particularly around the wings and tail.
rows.translation: 从你的角度很难看出雪地里有什么明确形状——它看起来只像一大片被压平的雪（当然，你绝不会对她这么说）。不过，她显然对自己的成果很满意。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s difficult to make out any particular shape in the snow from your angle – it just looks like a giant, flattened bit of snow (not that you’d ever say that to her). Still, from what you can tell, some parts of her angel appear rather specific, particularly around the wings and tail."

rows.original: ‘Angels’ represent what is good in our world, correct? [frostwyrm.name] asks you, and you confirm. My kind do not have ‘angels,’ but we do have the Grand Qim. [frostwyrm.name] makes a wide circle around her creation, until she gets to the wings. These are the Grand Qim’s wide, spectacular wings; large enough, as the stories go, to blot out the Orb and protect the kips from a raging storm.
rows.translation: “天使”代表你们世界中的善，对吗？[frostwyrm.name]问道，你予以确认。我的种族没有“天使”，但我们确实有大Qim。[frostwyrm.name]绕着自己的作品走了一大圈，来到翅膀旁。这些是大Qim宽阔而壮丽的翅膀；据传说，它们大得足以遮蔽天球，保护幼崽免受狂暴风暴侵袭。
rows.raw: "\n\n‘Angels’ represent what is good in our world, correct? [frostwyrm.name] asks you, and you confirm. My kind do not have ‘angels,’ but we do have the Grand Qim. [frostwyrm.name] makes a wide circle around her creation, until she gets to the wings. These are the Grand Qim’s wide, spectacular wings; large enough, as the stories go, to blot out the Orb and protect the kips from a raging storm."

rows.original: She rounds around to the front, where her head was. The Grand Qim’s breath was warm enough to bring an end to the Evercold and foster forth the next generation. She continues on, towards the tail. The Grand Qim’s tail, so say the stories, was large enough to wrap around the world; with a beat of the wings, the Grand Qim could carry the lair, and the world, anywhere.
rows.translation: 她绕到轮廓前方，也就是头部所在的位置。大Qim的吐息温暖得足以终结永寒，并孕育出下一代。她继续走向尾部。据传说，大Qim的尾巴长得足以环绕世界；只需振翅，大Qim便能将巢穴乃至整个世界带往任何地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rounds around to the front, where her head was. The Grand Qim’s breath was warm enough to bring an end to the Evercold and foster forth the next generation. She continues on, towards the tail. The Grand Qim’s tail, so say the stories, was large enough to wrap around the world; with a beat of the wings, the Grand Qim could carry the lair, and the world, anywhere."

rows.original: You ask if that’s what the Grand Qim is doing right now; the head, wings, and tail are detailed enough, but the center of the silhouette is a giant, flat picture. Either that, or the Grand Qim is... particularly fertile and will lay an excessive clutch, [frostwyrm.name] says, her lungs heaving in a crude mimicry of laughter. I would not disbelieve either theory.
rows.translation: 你问她，眼下这幅图表现的就是大Qim吗；头部、翅膀和尾巴都足够细致，但轮廓中央却是一大片扁平的图案。要么如此，要么大Qim……格外多产，会生下数量惊人的一窝蛋，[frostwyrm.name]说道，肺部起伏，粗略模仿着笑声。两种说法我都不会怀疑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if that’s what the Grand Qim is doing right now; the head, wings, and tail are detailed enough, but the center of the silhouette is a giant, flat picture. Either that, or the Grand Qim is... particularly fertile and will lay an excessive clutch, [frostwyrm.name] says, her lungs heaving in a crude mimicry of laughter. I would not disbelieve either theory."

rows.original: You take your position beside [frostwyrm.name], admiring her work in the snow. From the way she was moving about earlier, you hadn’t expected that she had such an artistic interpretation in mind for something as simple as a snow angel.
rows.translation: 你来到[frostwyrm.name]身旁，与她一同欣赏雪地里的作品。看她方才那样翻滚，你还真没想到她竟能留下如此细致的图案。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take your position beside [frostwyrm.name], admiring her work in the snow. From the way she was moving about earlier, you hadn’t expected that she had such an artistic interpretation in mind for something as simple as a snow angel."

rows.original: Your
rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: " Your "

rows.original: daughters all admire
rows.translation: 女儿们也都欣赏着
rows.raw: "daughters all admire"

rows.original: daughter admires
rows.translation: 女儿也欣赏着
rows.raw: "daughter admires"

rows.original: the picture as well, standing clear of the snow angel to take in its imagery without disturbing the effort
rows.translation: 这幅图，站在雪天使外侧端详其中的意象，以免破坏
rows.raw: " the picture as well, standing clear of the snow angel to take in its imagery without disturbing the effort "

rows.original: their
rows.translation: 她们的
rows.raw: "their"

rows.original: her
rows.translation: 她的
rows.raw: "her"

rows.original: Qim had put into creating it.
rows.translation: Qim为创作它付出的心血。
rows.raw: " Qim had put into creating it."

rows.original: They chat amongst themselves, admiring some of the finer details and how learned their Qim is about the legends and stories of their kind; you even catch one of them saying how envious they were of [frostwyrm.name]’s artistic skill.
rows.translation: 她们彼此交谈，赞叹其中一些精巧细节，也称颂自己的Qim对本族传说和故事的渊博了解；你甚至听见其中一个孩子说，自己多么羡慕[frostwyrm.name]的艺术才能。
rows.raw: " They chat amongst themselves, admiring some of the finer details and how learned their Qim is about the legends and stories of their kind; you even catch one of them saying how envious they were of [frostwyrm.name]’s artistic skill."

rows.original: What other activities does your kind’s tradition include, my Qal? [frostwyrm.name] asks.
rows.translation: 你们种族的传统还包括哪些活动，我的Qal？[frostwyrm.name]问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat other activities does your kind’s tradition include, my Qal? [frostwyrm.name] asks."

rows.original: B

One of the ways your kind celebrates togetherness and bonds between friends and family is through gifts. Usually something material, although what’s most important is the thought that goes into the gift, and that could be anything at all. Something that tells the recipient that they’re on the giver’s mind and that they’ve put some thought into their wants and needs.
rows.translation: 你们种族庆祝友谊与亲情纽带的一种方式就是互赠礼物。通常是某种物质物品，不过最重要的还是礼物背后的心意：它表明赠送者了解并关心对方。
rows.raw: "One of the ways your kind celebrates togetherness and bonds between friends and family is through gifts. Usually something material, although what’s most important is the thought that goes into the gift, and that could be anything at all. Something that tells the recipient that they’re on the giver’s mind and that they’ve put some thought into their wants and needs."

rows.original: Immediately, though, you’re at a loss as to what you give to [frostwyrm.name] – she’s a Frostwyrm. You can think of a few wants and needs that she has, but
rows.translation: 不过，你立刻就不知道该送[frostwyrm.name]什么——她毕竟是霜龙。你能想到她的一些愿望和需求，可
rows.raw: "Immediately, though, you’re at a loss as to what you give to [frostwyrm.name] – she’s a Frostwyrm. You can think of a few wants and needs that she has, but "

rows.original: you’ve already given her what she wants. Sure, you two could ‘make’ some more, and you’ll have a ton of fun doing it, but you think ‘more kips’ would be a lazy, uninitiated gift to give her
rows.translation: 你已经给过她想要的东西了。当然，你们还可以再“制造”一些，而且过程肯定会非常愉快，但你觉得把“更多幼崽”当作礼物既偷懒又欠考虑；
rows.raw: "you’ve already given her what she wants. Sure, you two could ‘make’ some more, and you’ll have a ton of fun doing it, but you think ‘more kips’ would be a lazy, uninitiated gift to give her"

rows.original: you’re working on one of them right now, and it’s not something that’s going to be ‘done’ in time for the holidays
rows.translation: 你们眼下就正在努力孕育其中一个，而且这也不可能赶在节日前“完成”
rows.raw: "you’re working on one of them right now, and it’s not something that’s going to be ‘done’ in time for the holidays"

rows.original: . What sort of gifts would Frostwyrms appreciate, and can you even make one from this island? Food, baths, and sex are the obvious choices....
rows.translation: 。霜龙会喜欢什么样的礼物？你甚至能在这座岛上做出一件吗？食物、沐浴和性爱显然都是选择....
rows.raw: ". What sort of gifts would Frostwyrms appreciate, and can you even make one from this island? Food, baths, and sex are the obvious choices...."

rows.original: While you mull the decision over, you fill [frostwyrm.name] on the tradition of gift-giving between individuals during these times, and you explain what usually goes into the thought process of getting a gift for another. This is a simple matter, my mate, she says unsubtly. The greatest gift you could give your Qim is additional kips to further our lineage. You answer that, yes, that was one of the first thoughts you had, but procreation is something that you two do regardless of the time of year. This is an opportunity for you both to show your appreciation in a way you otherwise wouldn’t.
rows.translation: 在思索该如何决定时，你向[frostwyrm.name]讲述了这个时节人们互赠礼物的传统，也解释了为别人挑选礼物时通常会如何思考。这很简单，我的伴侣，她毫不含蓄地说道。你能送给Qim最好的礼物，就是更多延续我们血脉的幼崽。你回答说，没错，这确实是你最先想到的事情之一，但繁衍后代是你们无论什么季节都会做的事。这是一个用平时不会采用的方式表达彼此珍视的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you mull the decision over, you fill [frostwyrm.name] on the tradition of gift-giving between individuals during these times, and you explain what usually goes into the thought process of getting a gift for another. This is a simple matter, my mate, she says unsubtly. The greatest gift you could give your Qim is additional kips to further our lineage. You answer that, yes, that was one of the first thoughts you had, but procreation is something that you two do regardless of the time of year. This is an opportunity for you both to show your appreciation in a way you otherwise wouldn’t."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] bends her head downward contemplatively. Perhaps you are right. Every moment together with you is itself a gift, my Qal, yet I fear that our moments would lose their luster as they become routine. Her four red eyes lock onto yours attentively. What would you desire of your Qim in this occasion, my Qal?
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]若有所思地低下头。也许你说得对。与你共度的每一刻本身就是礼物，我的Qal，但我担心这些时刻成为日常后会失去光彩。她的四只红眼专注地盯着你。这次你想从Qim那里得到什么，我的Qal？
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] bends her head downward contemplatively. Perhaps you are right. Every moment together with you is itself a gift, my Qal, yet I fear that our moments would lose their luster as they become routine. Her four red eyes lock onto yours attentively. What would you desire of your Qim in this occasion, my Qal?"

rows.original: Telling her what you want would ruin the surprise, though – and the message. The point of the gift is that you’re supposed to be paying enough attention to the recipient that they don’t need to tell you what they want, and that you should just know. For that reason, you aren’t going to ask her what she wants, either.
rows.translation: 不过，直接告诉她你想要什么会毁掉惊喜——也会破坏其中的心意。送礼的重点，本就是平时要足够关注接受礼物的人，让对方不必告诉你想要什么，而你理应直接知道。基于同样理由，你也不会询问她想要什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nTelling her what you want would ruin the surprise, though – and the message. The point of the gift is that you’re supposed to be paying enough attention to the recipient that they don’t need to tell you what they want, and that you should just know. For that reason, you aren’t going to ask her what she wants, either."

rows.original: Her breath comes out as a low, thoughtful growl. This may prove difficult, she says. That’s the spirit!
rows.translation: 她低沉而若有所思地咆哮着吐出一口气。这或许会很困难，她说道。要的就是这种精神！
rows.raw: "\n\nHer breath comes out as a low, thoughtful growl. This may prove difficult, she says. That’s the spirit!"

rows.original: You ask [frostwyrm.name] if she wouldn’t mind giving you a lift to Irestead, along the coast where you two usually meet. It’s a long flight, but the time will give you both the opportunity to think on what it is you can get each other. She agrees, and in a moment, you and [frostwyrm.name] take to the sky
rows.translation: 你问[frostwyrm.name]是否介意载你去沿岸的艾尔斯泰德，也就是你们平时见面的地方。路途很远，但这段时间也能让你们思考该送彼此什么。她答应下来，片刻后，你和[frostwyrm.name]便飞上天空
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask [frostwyrm.name] if she wouldn’t mind giving you a lift to Irestead, along the coast where you two usually meet. It’s a long flight, but the time will give you both the opportunity to think on what it is you can get each other. She agrees, and in a moment, you and [frostwyrm.name] take to the sky"

rows.original: , your daughter flying alongside you both
rows.translation: ，你的女儿也一路飞在你们身旁
rows.raw: ", your daughter flying alongside you both"

rows.original: , your daughters taking their place on either side of their Qim in the air
rows.translation: ，你的女儿们在空中分别飞到Qim的两侧
rows.raw: ", your daughters taking their place on either side of their Qim in the air"

rows.original: , flying in a tight V behind her
rows.translation: ，紧紧排成V字跟在她身后
rows.raw: ", flying in a tight V behind her"

rows.original: , on your way to Irestead.
rows.translation: ，一路前往艾尔斯泰德。
rows.raw: ", on your way to Irestead."

rows.original: You promised to call out to her within, uh... well before Light’s Fall, whether or not your trip is successful. When you hit the mainland, you go your separate ways. The flight lasted an hour, and you still don’t have the first idea what to get her. But, you’ll have an easier time thinking about it when you’re in your own element, or so you tell yourself.
rows.translation: 你答应会在……呃，至少在光陨节前从心中呼唤她，无论这趟行程是否顺利。抵达大陆后，你们各自分头寻找礼物。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou promised to call out to her within, uh... well before Light’s Fall, whether or not your trip is successful. When you hit the mainland, you go your separate ways. The flight lasted an hour, and you still don’t have the first idea what to get her. But, you’ll have an easier time thinking about it when you’re in your own element, or so you tell yourself."

rows.original: There aren’t a lot of material goods or stores to buy things from in Irestead. It’s a weather station that doubles as a landing point for interplanetary visitors; there are weather-measuring instruments and lots of alcohol, but nothing a Frostwyrm would be interested in. Although, to be fair to yourself, you’re sure [frostwyrm.name]’s never had any alcohol – you don’t know if she wouldn’t like it. And you’re sure an inebriated Frostwyrm would be a sight to see.
rows.translation: 艾尔斯泰德并没有多少物资或商店可供采购。这里是一座气象站，同时也是星际访客的登陆点；这里有气象测量仪器和大量酒水，却没有霜龙会感兴趣的东西。不过，公平地说，你确信[frostwyrm.name]从未喝过酒——你也不知道她是否会不喜欢。而且，醉醺醺的霜龙肯定相当值得一看。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere aren’t a lot of material goods or stores to buy things from in Irestead. It’s a weather station that doubles as a landing point for interplanetary visitors; there are weather-measuring instruments and lots of alcohol, but nothing a Frostwyrm would be interested in. Although, to be fair to yourself, you’re sure [frostwyrm.name]’s never had any alcohol – you don’t know if she wouldn’t like it. And you’re sure an inebriated Frostwyrm would be a sight to see."

rows.original: That said, Irestead is much more festive than you had expected, coming into it. The local scientists and explorers are taking whatever time they can off their busy schedules to celebrate their own holidays, including putting up decorations. You even catch a whiff of some baked goods coming from their mess hall. It’s as good a place to start, you figure.
rows.translation: 话虽如此，抵达之后你才发现，艾尔斯泰德的节日气氛远比预想中浓厚。当地科学家和探险者正尽可能从工作中抽出时间，一起庆祝。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat said, Irestead is much more festive than you had expected, coming into it. The local scientists and explorers are taking whatever time they can off their busy schedules to celebrate their own holidays, including putting up decorations. You even catch a whiff of some baked goods coming from their mess hall. It’s as good a place to start, you figure."

rows.original: You’re greeted with the sight of enough baked cookies and cakes to give everyone on the station at least one of each. You ask the baker, a stout and jolly man, if he could spare enough to feed a Frostwyrm
rows.translation: 映入眼帘的是堆积如山的烤饼干和蛋糕，足够让站内每个人都至少各拿一份。你向面包师询问，他是个敦实而开朗的男人
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re greeted with the sight of enough baked cookies and cakes to give everyone on the station at least one of each. You ask the baker, a stout and jolly man, if he could spare enough to feed a Frostwyrm"

rows.original: and its family
rows.translation: 以及它的家人
rows.raw: " and its family"

rows.original: , you were given a fairly curt ‘no’ – the dough is used in too many different pastries to possibly spare that many. But, you’re instead given three large packs of frosting: red, green, and white. There aren’t nearly enough uses for them and they’re going to go bad well before the holidays are over, so you’re welcome to them. It’s, uh, a start, you suppose.
rows.translation: ，却得到颇为干脆的一声“不行”——面团还要用来制作太多不同糕点，根本腾不出那么多。不过，对方转而给了你三大包调味料。
rows.raw: ", you were given a fairly curt ‘no’ – the dough is used in too many different pastries to possibly spare that many. But, you’re instead given three large packs of frosting: red, green, and white. There aren’t nearly enough uses for them and they’re going to go bad well before the holidays are over, so you’re welcome to them. It’s, uh, a start, you suppose."

rows.original: You wander Irestead aimlessly, wracking your mind for something that [frostwyrm.name] would enjoy, and you doubt three big packs of food flavoring is really going to cut it. You glance out the windows to the frozen expanse of Uveto and try to think of something she, as a Frostwyrm, might appreciate, but every time you think of something, you just remind yourself that there’s nothing out there that she can’t just get herself.
rows.translation: 你漫无目的地在艾尔斯泰德闲逛，绞尽脑汁思考[frostwyrm.name]会喜欢什么。你很怀疑三大包食物调味料能算得上真正的好礼物。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wander Irestead aimlessly, wracking your mind for something that [frostwyrm.name] would enjoy, and you doubt three big packs of food flavoring is really going to cut it. You glance out the windows to the frozen expanse of Uveto and try to think of something she, as a Frostwyrm, might appreciate, but every time you think of something, you just remind yourself that there’s nothing out there that she can’t just get herself."

rows.original: As time grows short, you start exploring the more practical shops of Uveto, and you happen to come across a thermal jacket, on the rack for a modest price. It’s lined with fur and it doesn’t look thick enough to provide a lot of protection in the coldest of colds, but it would nonetheless provide something. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t have any fur at all and she’s out there, bearing Uveto’s climate with just her scales. Maybe she’d appreciate something a little warm?
rows.translation: 随着时间越来越紧，你开始查看乌维托那些更实用的商店，碰巧看到货架上一件价格适中的保暖夹克。它内衬毛皮，看起来并不足以在最极端的严寒中提供太多防护，但至少能起到一些作用。[frostwyrm.name]身上一点毛皮都没有，只靠鳞片承受乌维托的气候。也许她会喜欢一点温暖？
rows.raw: "\n\nAs time grows short, you start exploring the more practical shops of Uveto, and you happen to come across a thermal jacket, on the rack for a modest price. It’s lined with fur and it doesn’t look thick enough to provide a lot of protection in the coldest of colds, but it would nonetheless provide something. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t have any fur at all and she’s out there, bearing Uveto’s climate with just her scales. Maybe she’d appreciate something a little warm?"

rows.original: The jacket was on a holiday sale
rows.translation: 这件夹克正值节日促销
rows.raw: "\n\nThe jacket was on a holiday sale"

rows.original: , thank the Gods
rows.translation: ，感谢诸神
rows.raw: ", thank the Gods"

rows.original: , and you have your gift to [frostwyrm.name]. Naturally, the whole thing isn’t going to fit a Frostwyrm, so you make some modifications – namely, once you’re out of the store and somewhere relatively private, you rip off the sleeves. Now, your gift is ready.
rows.translation: ，于是你总算有了送给[frostwyrm.name]的礼物。当然，整件衣服不可能套在霜龙身上，所以你做了一些改造——更确切地说，离开商店后，你拆下了衣袖并重新调整。
rows.raw: ", and you have your gift to [frostwyrm.name]. Naturally, the whole thing isn’t going to fit a Frostwyrm, so you make some modifications – namely, once you’re out of the store and somewhere relatively private, you rip off the sleeves. Now, your gift is ready."

rows.original: The trek back to the Uveto coast is long and cold, but you’re fuelled by your excitement at meeting [frostwyrm.name] again and giving her the gift you’ve picked out. You call to her and say that you’re ready to return. At once, my Qal, she replies, and in another moment, she’s by your side and you’re on your way back.
rows.translation: 返回乌维托海岸的路途漫长而寒冷，但想到即将再次见到[frostwyrm.name]并送出精心挑选的礼物，你便充满了动力。你呼唤她，告诉她自己已经准备好返回。马上就来，我的Qal，她回应道；片刻后，她便来到你身旁，与你一起踏上归途。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe trek back to the Uveto coast is long and cold, but you’re fuelled by your excitement at meeting [frostwyrm.name] again and giving her the gift you’ve picked out. You call to her and say that you’re ready to return. At once, my Qal, she replies, and in another moment, she’s by your side and you’re on your way back."

rows.original: You notice that her scales appear slightly different – a little bluer in shade, across most of her body. Normally, she’s rather resilient to the cold, but it appears now that her body’s been slightly frosted over.
rows.translation: 你注意到她的鳞片似乎略有变化——身体大部分区域都带上了更蓝的色调。她平时颇能抵抗寒冷，但眼下似乎还是感受到了低温。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice that her scales appear slightly different – a little bluer in shade, across most of her body. Normally, she’s rather resilient to the cold, but it appears now that her body’s been slightly frosted over."

rows.original: Were you successful in your search, my mate? [frostwyrm.name] asks you as she flies back. You tell her that you... think you did, but you can’t be certain that she’ll appreciate it. As you taught me, it is not the gift that is essential. It is the intention behind it. I trust that my Qal has only the best of intentions in mind.
rows.translation: 你找到合适的东西了吗，我的伴侣？[frostwyrm.name]返程飞行时问道。你告诉她……应该找到了，但无法确定她究竟会不会喜欢。正如你教我的，重要的不是礼物，而是背后的心意。我相信自己的Qal心中只有最美好的用意。
rows.raw: "\n\nWere you successful in your search, my mate? [frostwyrm.name] asks you as she flies back. You tell her that you... think you did, but you can’t be certain that she’ll appreciate it. As you taught me, it is not the gift that is essential. It is the intention behind it. I trust that my Qal has only the best of intentions in mind."

rows.original: The flight back is chilly and long
rows.translation: 返程的飞行寒冷而漫长
rows.raw: "\n\nThe flight back is chilly and long"

rows.original: , made warmer by your clutch keeping you company the entire way
rows.translation: ，但有你的孩子们全程陪伴，便温暖了许多
rows.raw: ", made warmer by your clutch keeping you company the entire way"

rows.original: . The entire flight, you feel what seems to be apprehension from [frostwyrm.name]; if you had to guess, she’s just as concerned and nervous that you’ll enjoy whatever gift she had picked out for you. The suspense is usually one of the harder parts of the holidays.
rows.translation: 。整段飞行中，你都能感觉到[frostwyrm.name]似乎有些忐忑；如果要猜，她大概也同样担心你是否会喜欢她准备的东西。
rows.raw: ". The entire flight, you feel what seems to be apprehension from [frostwyrm.name]; if you had to guess, she’s just as concerned and nervous that you’ll enjoy whatever gift she had picked out for you. The suspense is usually one of the harder parts of the holidays."

rows.original: After another hour, [frostwyrm.name]’s lair appears on the horizon, and you make a graceful landing back onto the snow of the island. Is this when we present each other our gifts? [frostwyrm.name] asks you, her body shuffling to block you from the entrance of the lair.
rows.translation: 又过了一个小时，[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴出现在地平线上，你们优雅地降落在岛上的雪地中。现在就是我们交换礼物的时候吗？[frostwyrm.name]问道，同时挪动身体挡住巢穴入口。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter another hour, [frostwyrm.name]’s lair appears on the horizon, and you make a graceful landing back onto the snow of the island. Is this when we present each other our gifts? [frostwyrm.name] asks you, her body shuffling to block you from the entrance of the lair."

rows.original: Your
rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: " Your "

rows.original: daughters move
rows.translation: 女儿们跟着她移动
rows.raw: "daughters move"

rows.original: daughter moves
rows.translation: 女儿跟着她移动
rows.raw: "daughter moves"

rows.original: with her, attempting to nonchalantly prevent your eyes from peeping at something in the lair’s direction. They aren’t being especially subtle about it, but you play along for now.
rows.translation: ，故作自然地挡住你的视线，不让你偷看巢穴方向的某样东西。她们的动作并不算隐蔽，但你还是配合着移开目光。
rows.raw: " with her, attempting to nonchalantly prevent your eyes from peeping at something in the lair’s direction. They aren’t being especially subtle about it, but you play along for now."

rows.original: You respond affirmatively, and you reach for your gift to her: a torn thermal jacket, and its two sleeves. [frostwyrm.name] studies them curiously: flimsy fabrics that would barely fit around her leg, much less her entire body, but you respond that that’s the idea. Unfortunately, Irestead had lots to offer for kinds and individuals like yours, but not a lot to provide for Frostwyrms, so you had to get a little creative.
rows.translation: 你给出肯定答复，随后取出送她的礼物：一件拆开的保暖夹克和它的两只衣袖。[frostwyrm.name]好奇地端详着这些轻薄布料，显然不明白它们能有什么用途。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond affirmatively, and you reach for your gift to her: a torn thermal jacket, and its two sleeves. [frostwyrm.name] studies them curiously: flimsy fabrics that would barely fit around her leg, much less her entire body, but you respond that that’s the idea. Unfortunately, Irestead had lots to offer for kinds and individuals like yours, but not a lot to provide for Frostwyrms, so you had to get a little creative."

rows.original: You ask [frostwyrm.name] to bend her neck down so that you can get to her horns, and she does so. You explain that you can’t really survive in the cold the same way she can, and that you need help to keep warm in the colder climates. Then, you thought, your Qim probably didn’t enjoy the cold all that much, so maybe – just maybe – she would appreciate trying to keep warm. To that end, you slip the sleeves over her horns, and once those are in place, you wrap the body of the jacket around her foremost left leg and zip it up, giving her a warm, fluffy cufflink.
rows.translation: 你请[frostwyrm.name]低下脖子，好让自己够到她的角，她照做了。你解释说，自己不像她那样能在严寒中生存，因此保暖衣物能够保护身体；而你希望这份礼物也能以同样方式保护她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask [frostwyrm.name] to bend her neck down so that you can get to her horns, and she does so. You explain that you can’t really survive in the cold the same way she can, and that you need help to keep warm in the colder climates. Then, you thought, your Qim probably didn’t enjoy the cold all that much, so maybe – just maybe – she would appreciate trying to keep warm. To that end, you slip the sleeves over her horns, and once those are in place, you wrap the body of the jacket around her foremost left leg and zip it up, giving her a warm, fluffy cufflink."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] regards the jacket zipped up against her, studying it with two red eyes, then turning her head to see it with the other two. You realize that it isn’t much, and it’s not going to keep most of her warm.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]端详着拉合在身上的夹克，用两只红眼观察，又转过头换另外两只看。你这才意识到，它贴在她身上的样子多少有些滑稽。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] regards the jacket zipped up against her, studying it with two red eyes, then turning her head to see it with the other two. You realize that it isn’t much, and it’s not going to keep most of her warm."

rows.original: [pc.name], she begins, placing her foot in the snow and watching the jacket protect her from the snow, I... I had never considered that there could be methods to prevent the elements from coating my form. Every journey into the Evercold was a tasking, unforgiving event that no one individual of my kind ever enjoyed. She steps forward, her long tongue snaking out and giving you a warm, loving lick across most of your body. I can only hope my gift to you is half as considerate, my mate and my Qal.
rows.translation: [pc.name]，她开口说道，将脚踩进雪中，看着夹克替她隔开冰雪，我...我从未想过，竟有办法阻止自然环境覆盖我的身体。每次进入永寒之地，都是艰苦而无情的经历，没有任何一个同族会喜欢。她向前一步，长舌蜿蜒伸出，温暖而爱怜地舔过你大半身体。我只希望自己送你的礼物能有这份体贴的一半，我的伴侣、我的Qal。
rows.raw: "\n\n[pc.name], she begins, placing her foot in the snow and watching the jacket protect her from the snow, I... I had never considered that there could be methods to prevent the elements from coating my form. Every journey into the Evercold was a tasking, unforgiving event that no one individual of my kind ever enjoyed. She steps forward, her long tongue snaking out and giving you a warm, loving lick across most of your body. I can only hope my gift to you is half as considerate, my mate and my Qal."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] looks over her flank, communicating with your daughters to retrieve the gift they had made for their Qal. Eager, they disappear into the lair, and only a moment later, they return with their gift to you: a set of scales, woven to link together, the suit a slightly darker shade of blue than [frostwyrm.name]’s body. It’s about tailored to the size of your torso.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]转头看向侧腹，与女儿们交流，让她们取来为Qal制作的礼物。孩子们兴奋地消失在巢穴中，片刻后便带着礼物回来：一套彼此编接的鳞片，颜色比[frostwyrm.name]的身体略深，尺寸大致依照你的躯干裁制。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] looks over her flank, communicating with your daughters to retrieve the gift they had made for their Qal. Eager, they disappear into the lair, and only a moment later, they return with their gift to you: a set of scales, woven to link together, the suit a slightly darker shade of blue than [frostwyrm.name]’s body. It’s about tailored to the size of your torso."

rows.original: We, as your clutch, understand that you have responsibilities to your culture that do not include us. There are times when your kind must summon you away from us, and to the dangers of the world around us. Your oldest daughter lays the small sheet of Frostwyrm scales along both her hands, presenting it to you as a gift. The sheet consists of two layers: the top layer is covered with smaller scales, interlinked with each other inseparably, and the lower layer includes a single, massive scale underneath. Your clutch and I have woven this small protective layer for you, our Qal.
rows.translation: 身为你的孩子，我们明白，你对自己的文化负有一些与我们无关的责任。有时，你的种族会召唤你离开我们，前往周遭世界的危险之中。你最年长的女儿双手托着那张霜龙鳞片，将其作为礼物呈给你。它分为两层：上层覆盖着彼此牢牢编接的小鳞片，下层则是一片巨大的完整鳞片。你的孩子们与我共同为你编织了这层小小的防护，我们的Qal。
rows.raw: "\n\nWe, as your clutch, understand that you have responsibilities to your culture that do not include us. There are times when your kind must summon you away from us, and to the dangers of the world around us. Your oldest daughter lays the small sheet of Frostwyrm scales along both her hands, presenting it to you as a gift. The sheet consists of two layers: the top layer is covered with smaller scales, interlinked with each other inseparably, and the lower layer includes a single, massive scale underneath. Your clutch and I have woven this small protective layer for you, our Qal. "

rows.original: Though your body has its own protection, it is not of the same temperament as my kind.
rows.translation: 尽管你的身体自有保护，却不具备我们种族那样的性质。
rows.raw: "Though your body has its own protection, it is not of the same temperament as my kind."

rows.original: As your own body is unprotected and exposed, this will provide you with the protection of my kind.
rows.translation: 你的身体毫无保护、暴露在外，而这件东西会赋予你属于我们种族的防护。
rows.raw: "As your own body is unprotected and exposed, this will provide you with the protection of my kind."

rows.original: Our intent is to protect our Qal, no matter the distance – and to remind you of your clutch, wherever you go.
rows.translation: 我们的意图是保护自己的Qal，无论相隔多远——也让你无论去往何处，都能记得自己的孩子们。
rows.raw: " Our intent is to protect our Qal, no matter the distance – and to remind you of your clutch, wherever you go."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] turns on the spot, her tail digging through the snow until she feels it clank against something she had hidden in it. Using her claws, she unearths it and presents it to you: one of her scales, a slightly deeper shade of blue than the rest of her. Her one scale is about the size of your torso, and it’s hard as rocks, if not harder.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]原地转身，尾巴扫过积雪，直到碰响某样藏在其中的东西。她用爪子将其挖出，露出精心准备的礼物。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] turns on the spot, her tail digging through the snow until she feels it clank against something she had hidden in it. Using her claws, she unearths it and presents it to you: one of her scales, a slightly deeper shade of blue than the rest of her. Her one scale is about the size of your torso, and it’s hard as rocks, if not harder."

rows.original: I understand that, as you are not of my kind, you have other responsibilities and demands that your culture makes of you. You cannot spend all your time with your clutch, as much as I desire it so. She nudges her scale to you, pressing it into your hands. This scale of mine has been tempered in the cold, heavy waters beneath the ocean’s surface. It is stronger and more resilient than my natural form.
rows.translation: 我明白，你并非我的同族，因此还有其他责任，也要回应自身文化对你的要求。尽管我希望如此，你也无法把全部时间都与你的孩子们共度。她把自己的鳞片推向你，压进你手中。我的这片鳞经过海面之下冰冷沉重的海水淬炼。它比我天然的身体更坚固、更有韧性。
rows.raw: "\n\nI understand that, as you are not of my kind, you have other responsibilities and demands that your culture makes of you. You cannot spend all your time with your clutch, as much as I desire it so. She nudges her scale to you, pressing it into your hands. This scale of mine has been tempered in the cold, heavy waters beneath the ocean’s surface. It is stronger and more resilient than my natural form. "

rows.original: You have fine scales of your own, my Qal, but they do not have the same temperament or provide the same defense as my own.
rows.translation: 你拥有自己精美的鳞片，我的Qal，但它们不具备与我的鳞片相同的性质，也无法提供同等防护。
rows.raw: "You have fine scales of your own, my Qal, but they do not have the same temperament or provide the same defense as my own."

rows.original: You do not possess scales of your own, my Qal; your body is frail and exposed to the world.
rows.translation: 你没有自己的鳞片，我的Qal；你的身体脆弱，毫无遮蔽地暴露在世间。
rows.raw: "You do not possess scales of your own, my Qal; your body is frail and exposed to the world."

rows.original: My intent is to give you a part of myself so that you may protect yourself from the dangers of the world.
rows.translation: 我的用意，是将自己的一部分赠予你，让你能够保护自己，免受世间危险的伤害。
rows.raw: " My intent is to give you a part of myself so that you may protect yourself from the dangers of the world."

rows.original: You humbly take the
rows.translation: 你谦恭地将这件
rows.raw: "\n\nYou humbly take the "

rows.original: suit of scales
rows.translation: 鳞甲
rows.raw: "suit of scales"

rows.original: scale
rows.translation: 鳞片
rows.raw: "scale"

rows.original: into your arms. It’s lightweight; totally opaque; and you can already tell it’s sturdy as could possibly be. You run your hand along the surface,
rows.translation: 抱进怀里。它轻盈无比，完全不透光，而且一眼便能看出它坚固到了极点。你用手沿表面抚过，
rows.raw: " into your arms. It’s lightweight; totally opaque; and you can already tell it’s sturdy as could possibly be. You run your hand along the surface, "

rows.translation: 指尖轻轻掠过每一片彼此交叠的鳞片，让它们互相碰撞，发出清脆声响
rows.raw: "your fingers tickling along all the interlocking scales, making them each clink against each other"

rows.original: running your fingers along the smoothness of [frostwyrm.name]’s scale
rows.translation: 手指沿着[frostwyrm.name]鳞片的光滑表面划过
rows.raw: "running your fingers along the smoothness of [frostwyrm.name]’s scale"

rows.original: . Your
rows.translation: 。你的
rows.raw: ". Your "

rows.original: clutch
rows.translation: 孩子们
rows.raw: "clutch"

rows.original: Qim
rows.translation: Qim
rows.raw: "Qim"

rows.original: had done this... for you. To make sure you’d always have something to remind you of
rows.translation: 做了这件事...是为了你。为了确保你永远都有一件东西，能让你想起
rows.raw: " had done this... for you. To make sure you’d always have something to remind you of "

rows.original: them
rows.translation: 她们
rows.raw: "them"

rows.original: her
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "her"

rows.original: You tell [frostwyrm.name] that it’s easily one of the most thoughtful gifts you had ever received. She’s right: it’s dangerous out there, adventuring in the world. There are a lot of things that could hurt you, and sometimes, you can get a little homesick when you’re away from the lair for too long. With this, you’ll have the power of the Frostwyrms on your side. You won’t have any reason to fear anything with this as your armor.
rows.translation: 你告诉[frostwyrm.name]，这无疑是你收到过的最贴心的礼物之一。她说得没错：在外面的世界冒险十分危险。那里有许多东西能够伤害你，而且离开巢穴太久时，你偶尔也会有些想家。有了它，霜龙的力量便会与你同在。穿着这件护甲，你无需畏惧任何事物。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell [frostwyrm.name] that it’s easily one of the most thoughtful gifts you had ever received. She’s right: it’s dangerous out there, adventuring in the world. There are a lot of things that could hurt you, and sometimes, you can get a little homesick when you’re away from the lair for too long. With this, you’ll have the power of the Frostwyrms on your side. You won’t have any reason to fear anything with this as your armor."

rows.original: It is a privilege to hear you say those words, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says, craning her long neck down to nuzzle against you.
rows.translation: 能听你说出这番话，是我的荣幸，我的Qal，[frostwyrm.name]说着，俯下修长的脖颈，亲昵地蹭了蹭你。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt is a privilege to hear you say those words, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says, craning her long neck down to nuzzle against you."

rows.original: What other activities does your kind’s tradition include, my Qal? [frostwyrm.name] asks.
rows.translation: 你们族群的传统还包括哪些活动，我的Qal？[frostwyrm.name]问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat other activities does your kind’s tradition include, my Qal? [frostwyrm.name] asks."

rows.original: B

A common but uncommonly-practiced event that goes on during the holiday seasons is caroling – going around your neighborhood and singing to your neighbors in order to spread the cheer. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t make very many noises at all, but you’re curious if she and her kind knows how to sing, and if she knows any songs.
rows.translation: 节日期间有一项常见却不常有人实践的活动，叫作唱颂歌——走遍住处周围，为邻居歌唱，向他们传递喜悦。[frostwyrm.name]平时几乎不发出什么声音，但你很好奇她和她的族人是否懂得唱歌，也想知道她会不会什么歌曲。
rows.raw: "A common but uncommonly-practiced event that goes on during the holiday seasons is caroling – going around your neighborhood and singing to your neighbors in order to spread the cheer. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t make very many noises at all, but you’re curious if she and her kind knows how to sing, and if she knows any songs."

rows.original: You pass the idea onto her, and she hesitates on her response. My kind typically communicate via the mind, but we must know the individual we are communicating with first. And to do this, we must find each other, and this is most easily accomplished by calling to the winds.
rows.translation: 你把这个主意告诉她，她却迟疑着没有立刻回答。我的族人通常通过心灵交流，但我们必须先认识交流的对象。为此，我们必须先找到彼此，而最简单的办法，就是向风中呼唤。
rows.raw: "You pass the idea onto her, and she hesitates on her response. My kind typically communicate via the mind, but we must know the individual we are communicating with first. And to do this, we must find each other, and this is most easily accomplished by calling to the winds."

rows.original: So, she knows how to sing? That is not the word that we use to describe it, but, yes. What you call ‘singing’ is similar in concept to how my kind introduce each other. Perfect! You ask her if she’d be willing to share any songs that she know.
rows.translation: 所以，她会唱歌？我们不会用这个词来形容那种行为，不过，是的。你所谓的“歌唱”，在概念上类似于我的族人彼此介绍自己的方式。太好了！你问她是否愿意分享一些她会的歌。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, she knows how to sing? That is not the word that we use to describe it, but, yes. What you call ‘singing’ is similar in concept to how my kind introduce each other. Perfect! You ask her if she’d be willing to share any songs that she know. "

rows.original: Your
rows.translation: 你的
rows.raw: "Your "

rows.original: daughters agree
rows.translation: 女儿们纷纷赞同
rows.raw: "daughters agree"

rows.original: daughter agrees
rows.translation: 女儿也表示赞同
rows.raw: "daughter agrees"

rows.original: encouragingly, wanting to hear their Qim teach them how to sing.
rows.translation: ，她们想听自己的Qim教她们唱歌。
rows.raw: " encouragingly, wanting to hear their Qim teach them how to sing. "

rows.original: You may find yourself disappointed, my Qal. You assure her that you would never be disappointed in anything she does or says.
rows.translation: 你或许会失望，我的Qal。你向她保证，无论她做什么或说什么，你都绝不会失望。
rows.raw: "You may find yourself disappointed, my Qal. You assure her that you would never be disappointed in anything she does or says."

rows.original: Inspired by your words, [frostwyrm.name] looks to the horizon. Your island is surrounded on all sides by the vast Uveto ocean; you
rows.translation: 受到你这番话的鼓舞，[frostwyrm.name]望向地平线。你的小岛四面都被乌维托的浩瀚海洋包围；你
rows.raw: "\n\nInspired by your words, [frostwyrm.name] looks to the horizon. Your island is surrounded on all sides by the vast Uveto ocean; you "

rows.original: and your clutch
rows.translation: 和你的孩子们
rows.raw: "and your clutch "

rows.original: are the only
rows.translation: 是方圆数英里内
rows.raw: "are the only "

rows.original: ones
rows.translation: 唯独能听到她歌声的人
rows.raw: "ones "

rows.original: one
rows.translation: 唯独能听到她歌声的人
rows.raw: "one"

rows.original: within miles and miles to hear her. As you wish, she says. She paces a bit and shuffles on the spot, unsure and apprehensive – is she nervous about singing in front of you?
rows.translation: 。如你所愿，她说道。她来回踱了几步，又在原地挪动着身体，显得迟疑而忐忑——她是在为当着你的面唱歌而紧张吗？
rows.raw: " within miles and miles to hear her. As you wish, she says. She paces a bit and shuffles on the spot, unsure and apprehensive – is she nervous about singing in front of you?"

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] takes a deep breath (a much deeper one than you could make!), and from her throat vibrates a constant, baritone hum that reverberates out into the water. Her throat visibly flexes as her voice shifts and makes different notes. It’s a lyric-less song, of course, and it doesn’t follow any sort of pentameter that you’ve ever heard before, but there is nonetheless a certain rhythm to it; the way her highs blend with other highs before sinking to lows and starting again.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]深吸了一口气（远比你能吸入的更深！），低沉而连绵的嗡鸣从她喉中震荡而出，向海面远远传开。她的喉咙明显地屈伸着，嗓音随之转变，发出不同的音调。这当然是一首没有歌词的歌，也不符合你听过的任何格律，但其中仍然存在某种鲜明的节奏；她的高音与另一些高音交融，随后沉入低音，再重新开始。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] takes a deep breath (a much deeper one than you could make!), and from her throat vibrates a constant, baritone hum that reverberates out into the water. Her throat visibly flexes as her voice shifts and makes different notes. It’s a lyric-less song, of course, and it doesn’t follow any sort of pentameter that you’ve ever heard before, but there is nonetheless a certain rhythm to it; the way her highs blend with other highs before sinking to lows and starting again."

rows.original: It doesn’t sound at all like you had expected a dragon’s song to sound. Worst-case, you had expected something grating and off-key; best-case, you had expected something kind of whiny and shrill. Her ‘voice’ is very deep, matching her size and stature, and it hits just the right resonance to relax your body and tickle you in the chest. Your body leans subconsciously towards [frostwyrm.name] and your ears perk whenever she hits a new high-note. You find yourself... not entranced, per se, but intrigued by [frostwyrm.name] and the song that she’s singing. If you weren’t already deeply acquainted with her, you’d have sought her out with your ears leading the way.
rows.translation: 这完全不像你想象中的龙吟。最坏的情况下，你原以为它会刺耳而走调；最好的情况下，你也只期待它有些哀婉而尖细。她的“嗓音”极其低沉，与她的体型和身姿相称，恰到好处的共鸣令你的身体放松，也让胸口泛起酥痒。你的身体下意识地朝[frostwyrm.name]倾去，每当她唱出一个新的高音，你的耳朵便会竖起。你发现自己...倒不能说被迷住了，但确实对[frostwyrm.name]和她吟唱的歌产生了浓厚兴趣。如果你还没有与她如此熟悉，恐怕早已任由双耳引路，循着歌声去寻找她。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t sound at all like you had expected a dragon’s song to sound. Worst-case, you had expected something grating and off-key; best-case, you had expected something kind of whiny and shrill. Her ‘voice’ is very deep, matching her size and stature, and it hits just the right resonance to relax your body and tickle you in the chest. Your body leans subconsciously towards [frostwyrm.name] and your ears perk whenever she hits a new high-note. You find yourself... not entranced, per se, but intrigued by [frostwyrm.name] and the song that she’s singing. If you weren’t already deeply acquainted with her, you’d have sought her out with your ears leading the way."

rows.original: Your daughters are uniformly still, which is unusual for them, enthralled as they are to their Qim’s song. They take their seats at [frostwyrm.name]’s haunches, their bodies rocking in gentle waves back and forth in time with the rhythms of their Qim’s breathing. Whatever the song is, it may be appealing to their Frostwyrm genetics, enticing them to sit still and listen.
rows.translation: 你的女儿们一动不动——这对她们而言十分反常，显然已经完全沉醉于Qim的歌声。她们在[frostwyrm.name]的后腿旁坐下，身体随着Qim呼吸的节奏，轻柔地前后摇摆。不论这是什么歌，它似乎都在呼唤她们体内的霜龙血脉，诱使她们安静坐着，专心聆听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour daughters are uniformly still, which is unusual for them, enthralled as they are to their Qim’s song. They take their seats at [frostwyrm.name]’s haunches, their bodies rocking in gentle waves back and forth in time with the rhythms of their Qim’s breathing. Whatever the song is, it may be appealing to their Frostwyrm genetics, enticing them to sit still and listen."

rows.original: Your daughter is likewise enthralled by [frostwyrm.name]’s song, but doesn’t hesitate to introduce herself into her Qim’s space and sits herself at [frostwyrm.name]’s haunches, her body gently swaying back and forth to the tune of her Qim’s breathing and rhythms. Her eyes close and her body is otherwise still; the song may be reaching to her on some instinctual level, appealing to her Frostwyrm genetics.
rows.translation: 你的女儿同样沉醉于[frostwyrm.name]的歌声，却毫不犹豫地闯进Qim身边，在[frostwyrm.name]的后腿旁坐下，身体随着Qim呼吸的旋律和节奏轻柔地前后摇摆。她闭上双眼，身体其余部分纹丝不动；这首歌似乎在某种本能层面触动了她，呼唤着她的霜龙血脉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour daughter is likewise enthralled by [frostwyrm.name]’s song, but doesn’t hesitate to introduce herself into her Qim’s space and sits herself at [frostwyrm.name]’s haunches, her body gently swaying back and forth to the tune of her Qim’s breathing and rhythms. Her eyes close and her body is otherwise still; the song may be reaching to her on some instinctual level, appealing to her Frostwyrm genetics."

rows.original: The minutes tick by, and eventually, [frostwyrm.name]’s song ends, and your body is gently let off the cloud it’s been put on. You ask [frostwyrm.name] what she had just sang. In terms you understand, it is what your kind would call a ‘lullaby.’ It is a song a Qim or Qal sing to each other, or to their clutch, particularly during times of plenty.
rows.translation: 时间一分一秒地过去，最终，[frostwyrm.name]的歌声结束，你的身体也从那片托举着自己的云端被轻柔地放下。你问[frostwyrm.name]刚才唱的是什么。用你能够理解的说法，那便是你们族群所谓的“摇篮曲”。这是Qim与Qal唱给彼此，或唱给孩子们的歌，尤其会在丰足的时节吟唱。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe minutes tick by, and eventually, [frostwyrm.name]’s song ends, and your body is gently let off the cloud it’s been put on. You ask [frostwyrm.name] what she had just sang. In terms you understand, it is what your kind would call a ‘lullaby.’ It is a song a Qim or Qal sing to each other, or to their clutch, particularly during times of plenty."

rows.original: You ask her if the song means anything. I do not understand the question, she says, and you clarify: you ask if there are any definitions to the noises she just made. Songs by your kind usually have words, or ‘lyrics,’ that accompany the music. No, there is no ‘definition’ to what I had just done. My kind communicate via emotion, [pc.name], not by words, and our songs are no different.
rows.translation: 你问她，这首歌是否有什么含义。我不明白你的问题，她说，于是你进一步解释：你想知道她刚才发出的那些声音是否各自具有某种定义。你们族群的歌曲通常都有文字，或者说“歌词”，与旋律相伴。不，我刚才所做的事情没有什么“定义”。我的族人通过情感交流，[pc.name]，而不是语言，我们的歌也没有区别。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if the song means anything. I do not understand the question, she says, and you clarify: you ask if there are any definitions to the noises she just made. Songs by your kind usually have words, or ‘lyrics,’ that accompany the music. No, there is no ‘definition’ to what I had just done. My kind communicate via emotion, [pc.name], not by words, and our songs are no different."

rows.original: You suppose that makes sense. Frostwyrms don’t speak like you do, after all. It is your turn, [frostwyrm.name] says, craning her long neck towards you to playfully nudge you with her nose. I have fulfilled my role in the tradition of your kind. You must now do the same.
rows.translation: 你觉得这倒也说得通。毕竟，霜龙不像你一样用语言说话。轮到你了，[frostwyrm.name]说着，将修长的脖颈伸向你，用鼻子顽皮地顶了顶你。我已经履行了自己在你们族群传统中的职责。现在，你也必须如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose that makes sense. Frostwyrms don’t speak like you do, after all. It is your turn, [frostwyrm.name] says, craning her long neck towards you to playfully nudge you with her nose. I have fulfilled my role in the tradition of your kind. You must now do the same. "

rows.original: You don’t know a ton of holiday songs off the top of your head, so you default to something you learned back when you were a child. It’s a song about

rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t know a ton of holiday songs off the top of your head, so you default to something you learned back when you were a child. It’s a song about "

rows.original: borderline unrequited love, sung by a male performer, espousing the virtues of being a good lover and insisting that he’s above the others by pouring out his feelings. To further the point, he makes a bunch of promises about his loyalty and dependability, and halfway through the song he starts singing about how he knows his love feels the same way. You don’t know if you’d call it a festive holiday song, but it was nonetheless fairly popular back in the day.
rows.translation: 一段几乎没有回应的单恋，由一名男性歌手演唱。他大谈成为优秀恋人的美德，坚持声称自己胜过其他人，并倾吐出全部感情来证明这一点。为了进一步说明，他许下许多关于忠诚可靠的承诺，唱到一半时，又开始宣称自己知道爱人也有同样的感受。你不确定自己是否会把它称为喜庆的节日歌曲，但它当年确实相当流行。
rows.raw: "borderline unrequited love, sung by a male performer, espousing the virtues of being a good lover and insisting that he’s above the others by pouring out his feelings. You don’t know if you’d call it a festive holiday song, but it was nonetheless fairly popular back in the day."

rows.original: decorating the halls with a number of shiny baubles and piles of minty plants to spruce up the home; something about putting on happy clothing (you never really understood that part; you just knew the words); and urging others through the lyrics to join in through the song and start again. It’s a staple holiday song, at least.
rows.translation: 用许多闪亮饰品和成堆芬芳的植物装点厅堂，好让家里焕然一新；还提到要穿上快乐的衣服（你始终没真正理解那部分，只是记得歌词）；并在歌词中鼓励其他人加入歌唱，再从头唱起。至少，它算是一首节日必唱曲目。

It’s a staple holiday song, at least."

rows.original: sneaking downstairs during the height of the holiday season, to hopefully get a head-start on opening some presents, before catching your own mother kissing a larger man that you didn’t recognize. The song included something about a white beard, and your mother being unusually hands-y with the whole encounter. It’s... well, it was the first thing that came to mind.
rows.translation: 在节日气氛最浓的时候偷偷溜下楼，想抢先拆开几件礼物，却撞见自己的母亲正在亲吻一个你不认识的高大男人。歌里还提到一把白胡子，而你的母亲在整场邂逅中也显得格外手脚不规矩。它...好吧，这是你最先想到的一首歌。

rows.original: one of your older relatives getting really drunk and then getting mauled to death by a reindeer. It’s a pretty sobering song about... a lot of life lessons, really: know what your limit is; don’t forget your medication; don’t try to walk through a blizzard while three sheets to the wind; just to name a few. It’s a pretty festive sounding song, and its rhythm really stuck with you, but you never understood why it was a holiday song.
rows.translation: 你的一位年长亲戚喝得酩酊大醉，随后被一头驯鹿活活撞死。这是一首颇能让人清醒的歌，讲了...许多人生教训，真的：清楚自己的酒量；别忘了服药；别在醉得东倒西歪时穿过暴风雪；诸如此类。它听起来倒是很有节日气氛，节奏也让你印象深刻，可你始终不明白它为什么会是一首节日歌曲。

rows.original: You ask her if she thinks your language’s songs have a chance of instilling the same emotions in their audience as hers does. That would be a matter of who is performing, my Qal, she answers simply, her big nose nuzzling up against you once more, making her message as clear as she can without being overt.
rows.translation: 你问她，你们语言中的歌曲是否有机会像她的歌一样，在听众心中唤起同样的情感。那要看演唱者是谁，我的Qal，她简单地回答，硕大的鼻尖再次亲昵地蹭着你，在不直说的情况下尽可能清楚地传达自己的意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if she thinks your language’s songs have a chance of instilling the same emotions in their audience as hers does. rows.original: B

The holidays wouldn’t be complete without one last thing. They’re always accompanied by a ton of decorating, whether it’s the house or some symbol. But you’re at a bit of a loss – you look around the island for a moment and notice how it’s completely, absolutely bare. Aside from the snow, there isn’t so much as an icicle for you to decorate, and even if there was, what would you decorate it with?
rows.translation: 少了最后一件事，节日便算不上完整。节日总伴随着大量装饰，无论装点的是房屋还是某种象征物。可你现在却有些犯难——你环顾小岛片刻，发现这里彻底、绝对地空空如也。除了积雪之外，这里连一根可供装饰的冰柱都没有；即使真有，你又能拿什么去装饰呢？
rows.raw: "The holidays wouldn’t be complete without one last thing. They’re always accompanied by a ton of decorating, whether it’s the house or some symbol. But you’re at a bit of a loss – you look around the island for a moment and notice how it’s completely, absolutely bare. Aside from the snow, there isn’t so much as an icicle for you to decorate, and even if there was, what would you decorate it with?"
