rows.original: I love you, my Qal, she says. Inspired by the message, each of your kips parrot it, saying it one after the other, some of them saying it twice. Each of them cuddle up just a little closer to their siblings, and to you, bringing themselves just a little bit closer to their Qal.
rows.translation: 我爱你，我的Qal，她说道。受这句话感染，每个孩子都跟着重复起来，一个接一个地说出口，有些甚至说了两遍。她们各自又向姐妹和你依偎得更紧了一点，让自己离Qal再近一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nI love you, my Qal, she says. Inspired by the message, each of your kips parrot it, saying it one after the other, some of them saying it twice. Each of them cuddle up just a little closer to their siblings, and to you, bringing themselves just a little bit closer to their Qal."

rows.original: You give Nykke another, quick kiss on the nose, and tell her, and each of them, that you love them, too. Then, you lay your head down – it’s time to recuperate.
rows.translation: 你又在妮凯鼻尖上轻轻亲了一口，告诉她，也告诉所有孩子，你同样爱她们。随后你躺下脑袋，是时候恢复体力了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Nykke another, quick kiss on the nose, and tell her, and each of them, that you love them, too. Then, you lay your head down – it’s time to recuperate."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: B

Guilt starts to creep up on you as you lay in [frostwyrm.name]’s embrace in the safety of her lair in the middle of the ocean. She had taken you as her mate; given you shelter, food, and protection; and you two even had a beautiful
rows.translation: 当你躺在海洋中央安全巢穴中、依偎在[frostwyrm.name]怀里时，愧疚开始悄悄爬上心头。她接纳你作为伴侣，为你提供住处、食物和保护；你们甚至还有了美丽的
rows.raw: "Guilt starts to creep up on you as you lay in [frostwyrm.name]’s embrace in the safety of her lair in the middle of the ocean. She had taken you as her mate; given you shelter, food, and protection; and you two even had a beautiful "

rows.original: clutch
rows.translation: 一窝孩子
rows.raw: "clutch"

rows.original: kip
rows.translation: 幼崽
rows.raw: "kip"

rows.original: together – and then you had sex with Nykke on [frostwyrm.name]’s old territory. It’s less that you aren’t ‘faithful’ to [frostwyrm.name], since she’s aware that you aren’t strictly monogamous and you have sex with others when you aren’t with her; it’s more that you know that she is, and the fact that you had sex with another Frostwyrm, even if she was a half-breed, is what’s making the guilt set in on you.
rows.translation: 在一起 – 然后你又在[frostwyrm.name]的旧领地上和妮凯发生了关系。问题倒不在于你对[frostwyrm.name]不够“忠贞”，毕竟她知道你并非严格奉行一夫一妻制，也知道你不和她在一起时会与别人发生关系；更多是因为你知道她确实对你忠贞，而你却和另一条霜龙发生了关系，哪怕对方只是混血，这一点让愧疚感涌上了心头。
rows.raw: " together – and then you had sex with Nykke on [frostwyrm.name]’s old territory. It’s less that you aren’t ‘faithful’ to [frostwyrm.name], since she’s aware that you aren’t strictly monogamous and you have sex with others when you aren’t with her; it’s more that you know that she is, and the fact that you had sex with another Frostwyrm, even if she was a half-breed, is what’s making the guilt set in on you."

rows.original: You get the feeling that [frostwyrm.name] knows, too, and she just hasn’t said anything about it. You aren’t sure how strong a Frostwyrm’s nose is, but if it’s as strong as
rows.translation: 你感觉[frostwyrm.name]其实也知道，只是一直没有提起。你不清楚霜龙的嗅觉有多灵敏，但如果能和
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the feeling that [frostwyrm.name] knows, too, and she just hasn’t said anything about it. You aren’t sure how strong a Frostwyrm’s nose is, but if it’s as strong as "

rows.original: , then she could probably smell Nykke on you as soon as she picked you up at the coast.
rows.translation: 一样敏锐，那么她在海岸接到你时，很可能立刻就闻出了你身上妮凯的气味。
rows.raw: ", then she could probably smell Nykke on you as soon as she picked you up at the coast."

rows.original: You know that it’d be best if you came clean and up-front with [frostwyrm.name]. Her mood would be calmest here, in her lair, with her mate and her clutch... but if she gets mad, you also don’t exactly have a lot of places to run to. That’s a risk you’ll have to take.
rows.translation: 你知道，最好还是向[frostwyrm.name]坦白，对她直言不讳。此刻她就在自己的巢穴里，伴侣和一窝幼崽都陪在身边，心情应该最为平静...可要是她真的发怒了，你也确实没多少地方可逃。这个险，你只能冒。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou know that it’d be best if you came clean and up-front with [frostwyrm.name]. Her mood would be calmest here, in her lair, with her mate and her clutch... but if she gets mad, you also don’t exactly have a lot of places to run to. That’s a risk you’ll have to take."

rows.original: I can feel your tension, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says to you over your psionic link. Her long neck hooks toward you, her four ruby-red eyes watching you with a certain serenity that only a person in the total comfort of their house could achieve. If there is anything your Qim can do, then bid it, and I will see it done.
rows.translation: 我能感觉到你的紧张，我的Qal，[frostwyrm.name]通过灵能链接对你说道。她修长的脖颈弯向你，四只红宝石般的眼睛注视着你，流露出一种唯有完全安居家中之人才会有的宁静。若有任何事是你的Qim能为你做的，尽管吩咐，我会替你办妥。
rows.raw: "\n\nI can feel your tension, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says to you over your psionic link. Her long neck hooks toward you, her four ruby-red eyes watching you with a certain serenity that only a person in the total comfort of their house could achieve. If there is anything your Qim can do, then bid it, and I will see it done."

rows.original: It’s not that you need something done. In fact, it’s because that something was ‘done’ that you’re tense in the first place. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t press, and waits patiently for you to continue.
rows.translation: 倒不是你需要她做什么。事实上，恰恰是因为某件事已经“做过”了，你才会如此紧张。[frostwyrm.name]没有催促，只是耐心等你继续说下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not that you need something done. In fact, it’s because that something was ‘done’ that you’re tense in the first place. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t press, and waits patiently for you to continue."

rows.original: You ask [frostwyrm.name] if she realizes that there’s another half-breed Frostwyrm wandering the coast, where she made her old stomping grounds. It looks exactly like your own kip, but with a number of scars over her body, having built up over the many years... and with pitch-black scales.
rows.translation: 你问[frostwyrm.name]，她是否知道还有另一条混血霜龙在她过去盘踞的海岸一带游荡。对方和你们自己的幼崽长得一模一样，只是经年累月下来，身上添了许多伤疤...还有一身漆黑如墨的鳞片。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask [frostwyrm.name] if she realizes that there’s another half-breed Frostwyrm wandering the coast, where she made her old stomping grounds. It looks exactly like your own kip, but with a number of scars over her body, having built up over the many years... and with pitch-black scales."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] seems to consider the question for a moment, which takes you by surprise. You’d have thought she would be far more energetic; either with joy that there was another Frostwyrm, and so close by, or with fury, that another Frostwyrm would wander so brazenly into her territory.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]似乎思索了片刻，这让你颇为意外。你原以为她的反应会激烈得多：要么为附近还有另一条霜龙而欣喜若狂，要么因另一条霜龙竟敢如此明目张胆地闯入她的领地而勃然大怒。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] seems to consider the question for a moment, which takes you by surprise. You’d have thought she would be far more energetic; either with joy that there was another Frostwyrm, and so close by, or with fury, that another Frostwyrm would wander so brazenly into her territory."

rows.original: The way you phrase your question is curious, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says after a time, her eyes wandering the icy walls of her lair. Of course I am ‘aware’ that another Frostwyrm is in my territory. I have heard its songs and I have smelt its presence. Her head turns back to you, and her red eyes fall to yours, capturing you like a fly on a spider’s web. It seems you are... acquainted with its smell yourself, my Qal.
rows.translation: 你提出这个问题的方式很耐人寻味，我的Qal，过了一会儿，[frostwyrm.name]说道，目光游移在巢穴冰冷的墙壁上。我当然“知道”自己的领地里有另一条霜龙。我听见过它的歌声，也闻到过它的气息。她把头转回你这边，赤红的目光落入你的眼中，像蛛网捕住苍蝇般牢牢攫住了你。看来，你自己也...很熟悉它的气味，我的Qal。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe way you phrase your question is curious, my Qal, [frostwyrm.name] says after a time, her eyes wandering the icy walls of her lair. Of course I am ‘aware’ that another Frostwyrm is in my territory. I have heard its songs and I have smelt its presence. Her head turns back to you, and her red eyes fall to yours, capturing you like a fly on a spider’s web. It seems you are... acquainted with its smell yourself, my Qal."

rows.original: The tension that [frostwyrm.name] mentioned before begins to flare. You were worried that she could tell. You aren’t sure if you should apologize, or defend yourself, or ask for forgiveness–
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]先前提到的那股紧张感顿时高涨起来。你一直担心她能察觉。你不知道自己是该道歉、为自己辩解，还是请求原谅–
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tension that [frostwyrm.name] mentioned before begins to flare. You were worried that she could tell. You aren’t sure if you should apologize, or defend yourself, or ask for forgiveness–"

rows.original: Be calm, [frostwyrm.name] says. Her ‘voice’ thrums in your head gently, and with a calm tone, tickling at your mind to get you to relax – it sort of reminds you of a mother singing to her baby in a rocking chair. Just those two words, and you can feel the ease start to set in your limbs and down your spine.
rows.translation: 冷静下来，[frostwyrm.name]说道。她的“声音”在你脑海中轻柔震颤，语调平静，轻抚着你的心神，催你放松 – 感觉有些像母亲坐在摇椅上为婴儿哼唱。仅仅两个词，你便感到四肢和脊背渐渐舒缓下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nBe calm, [frostwyrm.name] says. Her ‘voice’ thrums in your head gently, and with a calm tone, tickling at your mind to get you to relax – it sort of reminds you of a mother singing to her baby in a rocking chair. Just those two words, and you can feel the ease start to set in your limbs and down your spine."

rows.original: Your kind do not communicate as mine do, my Qal, she continues. That presented a... unique challenge to me. It was obvious that you had lain with this half-breed, but when you said nothing about it, I was unsure whether I should or not. I understand that you and your kind do not have the same... restrictions as my own, and that your kind do not mate monogamously. I had thought nothing about it until I could smell another of my kind on you.
rows.translation: 你的种族并不像我的种族那样交流，我的Qal，她继续说道。这给我带来了一个...独特的难题。很明显，你曾与这条混血霜龙交合，可你对此只字未提，我便不知道自己是否该开口。我明白你和你的种族不像我们一样受到...限制，也不会只与一名伴侣交配。在闻到你身上另一名同族的气味之前，我从未对此多想。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour kind do not communicate as mine do, my Qal, she continues. That presented a... unique challenge to me. It was obvious that you had lain with this half-breed, but when you said nothing about it, I was unsure whether I should or not. I understand that you and your kind do not have the same... restrictions as my own, and that your kind do not mate monogamously. I had thought nothing about it until I could smell another of my kind on you."

rows.original: You say nothing for the time. You’ll have your invitation to tell your side of the story when [frostwyrm.name] gives it to you.
rows.translation: 你暂时没有说话。等[frostwyrm.name]给你机会时，你再讲述自己这边的经过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou say nothing for the time. You’ll have your invitation to tell your side of the story when [frostwyrm.name] gives it to you."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] sighs – a deep, long sigh, lasting several moments, with lungs as large as hers. Her psionic voice doesn’t sound in your mind for a short time as she considers her next words. Frostwyrms communicate primarily through emotions, not words, and she’s having a difficult time putting her emotions to words.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]叹了口气 – 以她那般巨大的肺腑，这声叹息低沉而漫长，持续了好一阵子。她斟酌着接下来该说什么，灵能之声一时没有在你脑中响起。霜龙主要以情感而非语言交流，她很难把自己的情绪化作言语。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] sighs – a deep, long sigh, lasting several moments, with lungs as large as hers. Her psionic voice doesn’t sound in your mind for a short time as she considers her next words. Frostwyrms communicate primarily through emotions, not words, and she’s having a difficult time putting her emotions to words."

rows.original: I do not know why I ignored the songs of this other of my kind, she says. Perhaps because I had found my own mate, and had no inclinations for another
rows.translation: 我不知道自己为何无视了这名同族的歌声，她说道。也许是因为我已经找到了自己的伴侣，无意再寻求另一个
rows.raw: "\n\nI do not know why I ignored the songs of this other of my kind, she says. Perhaps because I had found my own mate, and had no inclinations for another"

joinAfter.expression:
window.nykkeFrostwyrmTF()
                ? ""
                : ", no matter if they were of my own kind or not"

rows.original: , no matter if they were of my own kind or not
rows.translation: ，无论对方是不是我的同族
rows.raw: ", no matter if they were of my own kind or not"

rows.original: . I will admit..., she says, then pauses again for a time. Her head tilts back, and her eyes watch the icy stalactites of her lair above her. I feel... lost. My emotions are more labyrinthine to me now than they ever had been before. I do not know what to feel.
rows.translation: 。我承认...,她说道，随后又停顿了一会儿。她向后仰起头，望着巢穴上方冰冷的钟乳石。我感觉...迷失了。如今，我自己的情感比以往任何时候都更像一座迷宫。我不知道自己该有什么感受。
rows.raw: ". I will admit..., she says, then pauses again for a time. Her head tilts back, and her eyes watch the icy stalactites of her lair above her. I feel... lost. My emotions are more labyrinthine to me now than they ever had been before. I do not know what to feel."

rows.original: True to her words, you can feel a myriad of emotions leaking through your psionic link with her, and it’s enough to overwhelm you: you feel unease; you feel a bit of joy; you feel a bit of sadness and anger; most distinctly, but not more powerfully than any other, you feel what can only be described as a pit in your chest – the type of pit that comes from finding out that your lover had sex with someone else. Like [frostwyrm.name] had said, you aren’t sure which emotion to feel most of.
rows.translation: 正如她所说，你能感觉到无数情绪透过彼此的灵能链接渗来，几乎要将你淹没：你感到不安；感到些许喜悦；也感到些许悲伤与愤怒；最为清晰、却又不比其他情绪更强烈的，是一种只能形容为胸口陷落的空洞感 – 那是得知爱人与别人发生关系时才会出现的空洞感。就像[frostwyrm.name]说的那样，你也不知道该以哪一种情绪为主。
rows.raw: "\n\nTrue to her words, you can feel a myriad of emotions leaking through your psionic link with her, and it’s enough to overwhelm you: you feel unease; you feel a bit of joy; you feel a bit of sadness and anger; most distinctly, but not more powerfully than any other, you feel what can only be described as a pit in your chest – the type of pit that comes from finding out that your lover had sex with someone else. Like [frostwyrm.name] had said, you aren’t sure which emotion to feel most of."

rows.original: Earlier, [frostwyrm.name] had told you that, if you needed something done, you could just ask her for it, and she’d do it. It would be wrong of you, as her mate, to not offer the same to her: if she needed you to apologize, or to never meet with the half-breed again, then you’d do it. You tell her that she is your mate, and the last thing you’d ever want is to hurt her and make her feel these feelings.
rows.translation: 先前，[frostwyrm.name]曾告诉你，若有什么事需要办，只要开口，她就会替你完成。身为她的伴侣，若不向她作出同样的承诺，那便是你的不对：如果她需要你道歉，或需要你再也不去见那条混血霜龙，你都会照做。你告诉她，她是你的伴侣，而你最不愿做的事，就是伤害她，让她承受这些感受。
rows.raw: "\n\nEarlier, [frostwyrm.name] had told you that, if you needed something done, you could just ask her for it, and she’d do it. It would be wrong of you, as her mate, to not offer the same to her: if she needed you to apologize, or to never meet with the half-breed again, then you’d do it. You tell her that she is your mate, and the last thing you’d ever want is to hurt her and make her feel these feelings."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name]’s head cranes down towards you, and she rests her right, scaly cheek against your body, nuzzling against you. It is right of you to say that, my Qal, she says, and you can feel the maelstrom of emotions seeping through her psionic link with you begin to ease slightly.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]把头探向你，将右侧覆着鳞片的脸颊贴上你的身体，亲昵地蹭着你。你能这么说是对的，我的Qal，她说道。你能感觉到，从她与你的灵能链接中渗来的情感漩涡开始稍稍平息。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name]’s head cranes down towards you, and she rests her right, scaly cheek against your body, nuzzling against you. It is right of you to say that, my Qal, she says, and you can feel the maelstrom of emotions seeping through her psionic link with you begin to ease slightly."

rows.original: You tell [frostwyrm.name] that, sometimes, when one of your kind feels so lost and confused within their own heart, it can help to talk it through. Maybe, if there’s more information between you two, she can come to an understanding with her own emotions, and what she needs from you will be clearer to you both.
rows.translation: 你告诉[frostwyrm.name]，有时，当你的同族在自己心中如此迷茫困惑时，把事情说开会有所帮助。也许，只要你们彼此多了解一些，她就能弄清自己的情绪，而她需要你做什么，你们双方也都会看得更明白。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell [frostwyrm.name] that, sometimes, when one of your kind feels so lost and confused within their own heart, it can help to talk it through. Maybe, if there’s more information between you two, she can come to an understanding with her own emotions, and what she needs from you will be clearer to you both."

rows.original: A low, quiet purr emanates from her throat as she nuzzles against you once more. I would like to try this with you, my Qal, she says.
rows.translation: 她再次蹭了蹭你，喉咙里发出低沉而轻柔的呼噜声。我愿意和你试试，我的Qal，她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nA low, quiet purr emanates from her throat as she nuzzles against you once more. I would like to try this with you, my Qal, she says."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: B

[frostwyrm.name] pulls her head away from you and relaxes her body, lowering her head to bring it level to you, so you aren’t looking up at her all the time. <i>Tell me more of this other Frostwyrm. You say it bears countenance to our own kip
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]把头从你身旁移开，放松身体，将头低到与你齐平的位置，好让你不必一直仰头看她。<i>再多告诉我一些关于那条霜龙的事。你说它与我们自己的幼崽相貌相似
rows.raw: "[frostwyrm.name] pulls her head away from you and relaxes her body, lowering her head to bring it level to you, so you aren’t looking up at her all the time. <i>Tell me more of this other Frostwyrm. You say it bears countenance to our own kip"

rows.original: s
, yet its scales are different. I would like to know more.
rows.translation: ，但它的鳞片却不一样。我想知道更多。
rows.raw: ", yet its scales are different. I would like to know more."

rows.original: You answer [frostwyrm.name] as best as you can. You tell her that the half-breed calls herself Nykke, and she’s around [frostwyrm.name]’s age, being about two-hundred Sky Cycles old. Like with [frostwyrm.name] herself, she hadn’t found a mate in all that time, and she was... well, you and Nykke never fought, but she was just as ‘forward’ about mating as [frostwyrm.name] was as soon as she decided you were an ideal mate. As soon as Nykke realized that you were the mate to another Frostwyrm, she tried to mate with you right there, on the spot.
rows.translation: 你尽己所能回答[frostwyrm.name]。你告诉她，那个混血儿自称妮凯，年龄与[frostwyrm.name]相仿，大约活了两百个天空周期。和[frostwyrm.name]本人一样，她这么久以来也一直没能找到配偶，而且她...好吧，你和妮凯并没有打过一架，但她一认定你是理想的配偶，在交配这件事上就和当初的[frostwyrm.name]一样“主动”。妮凯一发现你已经是另一条霜龙的配偶，就试图当场与你交配。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer [frostwyrm.name] as best as you can. You tell her that the half-breed calls herself Nykke, and she’s around [frostwyrm.name]’s age, being about two-hundred Sky Cycles old. Like with [frostwyrm.name] herself, she hadn’t found a mate in all that time, and she was... well, you and Nykke never fought, but she was just as ‘forward’ about mating as [frostwyrm.name] was as soon as she decided you were an ideal mate. As soon as Nykke realized that you were the mate to another Frostwyrm, she tried to mate with you right there, on the spot."

rows.original: To continue, you tell [frostwyrm.name] that Nykke has a unique condition that your kind calls ‘melanism.’ Anyone with the affliction has their skin – or, in Nykke’s case, her scales – turned pitch-black in color. She stands out among the snow like a sore thumb: it’s impossible to miss her.

rows.translation: 靠在[frostwyrm.name]庞大的身躯上休息时，你忽然想起自己最近听到了一个相当有趣的消息，毫无疑问，她一定很想知道。然而，还没等你开口，你便感到脑中传来一股极轻微的压力，仿佛有什么正挤压着你的大脑，要把里面的信息拧出来——随后又骤然松开。说出你的消息吧，我的Qal，她低鸣道。 可她刚才不是已经知道那是什么了吗？ 我方才搜寻了你的词汇，以了解你所谓“消息”的定义，她回答。我也注意到，你对把这个“消息”告诉我怀有几分期待。我不会破坏属于你的时刻。 噢。好吧：你最近去过艾尔斯特德——那个位于海洋彼岸、更深入内陆的文明——并在那里无意间听说，附近或许还有第二条霜龙。 话音刚落，[frostwyrm.name]便猛地抬起头，颈部伸长绷紧，以便全神贯注地看着你。四只宝石红的眼睛齐齐锁定在你身上，迫切地等着你继续说下去。你觉得她甚至屏住了巨大肺脏里的呼吸。[frostwyrm.andNykke | 第二条？她问道，你脑中的“声音”略微上扬。是像我一样的纯血，还是像妮凯一样的混血？ 你也只是转述听来的消息；对方说那是一只“巨大的龙形六足生物”。六足这个词，就是“六条腿”的意思。妮凯只有两条。 ] 不过，确实也没有更多可说的了：你只知道有人曾在“一天中的大部分时间里，看见它在海岸以北稍远、偏向内陆的天空中盘旋”。你还没亲自去寻找它；你觉得在做出任何冒失之举前，应该先把这件事告诉身为你Qim的她[frostwyrm.andNykke |，尤其是你之前在妮凯的事情上操之过急，伤害了她的感情，后来才把事情解决 ]。 [frostwyrm.name]纹丝不动，双眼一眨不眨地盯着你。她是个聪慧的生物[pc.intelligenceRange 0 33 |，远远比你聪明 ]，像这样完全陷入空白，对她来说极不寻常。仿佛你让她陷进了某种逻辑循环，而她正试图解析某件彻底无法理解的事情。 你们之间流动的情绪也异常紊乱。你能感受到从困惑、冷漠，到一种比其他情绪更尖锐、更鲜明的感受——希望。它并没有强烈到压过其他情绪，但当你对某样事物的渴望胜过一切，而得到它的可能性又真实可触时，胸中那阵突如其来的震动，比任何其他感受都更容易辨认。 [frostwyrm.name]花了一会儿才组织出一个连贯的念头。这对她而言又是一个异常：她平时与你交流时总是无比准确而审慎。 我很矛盾，她终于承认。 这不是你预料中的反应。你原以为，得知自己的同类——一条纯血霜龙——不仅还活着，而且就在如此近的地方，她一定会欣喜若狂。 欣喜确实是我此刻万千状态之一，她回答。在与你交谈的整个过程中，她的身体始终一动不动：头仍高高抬着，肺中的呼吸也依旧屏住。[frostwyrm.name]擅长游泳；她能长时间屏息。然而.... 她迟疑了，无法将思绪妥善整理，以便有效地传达给你。你从未见过她这样。[pc.race]的大脑在任何时刻都有数不清的念头，而霜龙这种天生具备灵能的物种，却习惯于每次只拥有——或者至少只“广播”——一个念头。她无法像平常那样组织思想，只可能意味着她的思绪已经彻底陷入混乱。 倘若我在与你相遇之前便得知了第二个存在，这个“消息”对我而言，便会像伟大Qim赐下的礼物，她终于说道，但话语断断续续，十分生硬，仿佛她仍不确定自己所说的内容，因此谨慎地挑选着每一个词。如今我知道，若选择除你之外的任何Qal，我都会失去更多，[pc.name]。 尽管你很感激这份情意，也同样以真心回应她，但她没必要这样奉承你——这关系到她和她的种族。外面还有整整一条霜龙；既然有一条，就一定还会有更多！她的物种有可能得救！ 这恰恰就是我觉得自己必须确认你对我的意义、你之于我究竟是什么的原因。自从你告诉她这个消息以来，[frostwyrm.name]颈部的肌肉第一次放松下来，头也朝你低下。我的需求已经得到满足。我有伴侣、有家、有一窝孩子。食物也很充足。其余一切都只是附属。若我与第二个存在相遇，对方很可能正在承受我曾经承受的痛苦——没有伴侣，并为寻求伴侣而绝望。 ...她是在暗示，第二条霜龙会想要与她交配。你问她是不是这个意思。 对方很可能像曾经的我一样迷失而孤独，祈求伟大Qim赐予洞见，好让其明白我们的同类究竟遭遇了什么，她拐弯抹角地回答。若我与第二个存在见面，那将近乎残忍：我的整个存在都已许配给你，[pc.name]。我不能拥有第二位伴侣。 然而，任由对方独自在冰原上游荡，没有同类陪伴，也完全不知道自己的物种遭遇了什么，同样近乎残忍。 这便是我的矛盾所在。她呼出肺中所有滞留的空气，鼻中发出一声持续了将近一分钟的叹息。与第二个存在见面，却拒绝伟大Qim为其指定的机会，是恶意之举；拒绝与对方相见，将其判处终生独自在世间游荡、疑惑，也同样恶毒。此事没有答案。 [frostwyrm.andNykke |你并不认为真是如此——毕竟，她和妮凯最终就找到了相处之道。她和这第二条霜龙真的完全不可能达成某种共识吗？ 或许并非不可能，[frostwyrm.name]承认，但你要明白，我们与妮凯建立的这种...安排本身就已经足够反常。我的同类只会选择一位伴侣。要把另一个成员纳入我们这一窝，需要的远不只是你我之间的同理心，我的Qal；妮凯也必须抱有同样的理解。她从鼻中哼了一声，近乎不耐烦。若我们继续往这一窝里增加Qim，就不会有足够的同理心维系这个家庭。 也许你的确正在把许多陌生人带进[frostwyrm.name]的家，带进你们这一窝。你明白，这对霜龙而言是极不寻常的行为，也能透过与她的灵能连接感受到那份担忧和迟疑。 ]你告诉她，自己不会逼她做任何令她不舒服的事。你们都不必决定把更多陌生人带进巢穴，无论这里有多么宽敞。也没人需要立刻做出如此重大、影响深远的决定。 但她至少仍该去见见另一条霜龙。倘若迷失在雪原上、不知疲倦地寻找同类的是她，那么即使遇到的霜龙已经有了伴侣，她也一定会庆幸自己并非种族仅存的唯一幸存者。与另一条霜龙见面，至少能让你们双方得到一个了结。 你感到脑中短暂地收紧——她大概是在查找你对“了结”一词的定义。这对我们双方而言都会是一场艰难的会面，她说道。她闭上眼睛，鼻孔翕张，试图想象自己与另一条霜龙见面时会发生什么。但你说得对，而且不止一方面如此。让对方知道自己并非世上仅存的同类，将会是一份礼物——我不该将它独占。 为了确保你们之间没有误解：她具体是什么意思？在不知道该向另一条霜龙提出什么之前，你可不想贸然接近对方。 [frostwyrm.andNykke |简而言之，尽管这令我十分迟疑，我们会向对方提供与妮凯相同的条件，她说道，目光移向妮凯在巢穴墙壁上挖出的洞。在这一窝中给其一席之地；若其是一名合格的猎手，便授予Qim之名——成为我们家庭的第三位成员。尽管这与我族典型的家庭相去甚远，但情况早已不同于我还是幼崽的时候。我们都必须适应。 她转头看向你；当四只宝石红的眼睛都将你纳入视野时，肺脏再次起伏，发出她那奇怪的仿笑声。你将有三位Qim需要照料，我的Qal。你和你的族类或许永远欲求不满，但或许就连你也会发现，我们共同旅途的下一步颇具挑战。 [pc.libidoRange 0 50 |那就只能到时候再看了。 |噢，你对此深表怀疑。既然现在有了三个，也许终于算得上势均力敌。 ] |若第二个存在与我们初遇时的我有任何相似之处——以我对自己同类的了解，多半如此——那么对方一定既孤独，又...焦躁。两方面都需要宣泄的出口。她抬起头，吻部指向地下冰穴圆润光滑的墙壁。巢穴十分宽敞：不仅足以容纳第二位同类，也足以容纳我们所能想象的最大规模的一窝。只要对方接受，孤独便不会成为问题。 那“焦躁”呢？ [frostwyrm.name]的肺脏起伏，发出她那粗糙的仿笑声。你是Qal。你将要照料两位耽误了一生繁衍需求的Qim。那将是你必须承受的任务。 好吧，倘若你对自己的能力没有信心，当初大概也不会那么快接受[frostwyrm.name]成为她伴侣的提议。 她肺中的起伏渐渐平息，神情惆怅地凝望巢穴远处，目光没有落在任何特定事物上。这一切都取决于对方是否接受我们的提议，她指出。而对方未必愿意接受。我会坦率承认，按照我族的标准，我们所拥有的一切，[pc.name]，并不正常。我曾经极度渴望正常的生活。一个正常的伴侣，以及属于自己的一窝孩子。第二个存在或许会...抗拒这样的想法：不仅无法拥有专属于自己的伴侣，不仅要像我一样与异族交配，而且还不能成为这一窝中唯一的Qim。光是这个念头，就连我自己的鬃毛都因困惑而竖起。 她叹了口气，整个动作持续了大约一分钟。不过，那是对方要做的决定。不是我们。 ] 她将巨大的脖颈向前探来，把头凑到你身上，用鼻梁蹭着你的整个躯干。下次你踏上苔原时，去你所听说的第二个存在栖居之地，然后召唤我。我的出现会将对方引出来。
rows.raw: " While reclining against [frostwyrm.name]’s larger body, you suddenly recall that you had received some rather interesting news that you have no doubt she’d love to hear. Before you start telling her, though, you feel a very slight pressure inside your head, feeling like it’s squeezing on your brain and wringing it for its information – before it suddenly releases. Speak your news, my Qal, she thrums. Didn’t she just learn what it was, though? I had scoured your vocabulary for the definition of what you call ‘news,’ she answers. I noticed as well that you bore some anticipation to telling me whatever this ‘news’ is. I would not spoil your moment. Oh. Well: when you recently went to Irestead – the civilization deeper inland, across the ocean – you had overheard news that there might be a second Frostwyrm nearby. As soon as the words leave your mouth, [frostwyrm.name]’s head jolts upward, her neck elongating and straining to keep her undivided attention on you. All four of her ruby-red eyes train directly on you, eager to hear more. You think she’s even holding her breath in her massive lungs.[frostwyrm.andNykke | A second? she asks, the ‘voice’ in your head lilting upward slightly. A pureblood, as myself? Or a halfling, as Nykke? You’re only going by what you were told, and you were told that it was a ‘large draconic hexapod.’ That word, hexapod, means ‘six legs.’ Nykke only has two. ] There’s admittedly not much more to tell, though: the only thing you know is that it was spotted ‘circling the skies slightly further north and inland from the coast during most hours of the day.’ You haven’t gone looking for it yourself; you figured that she, your Qim, should know about it before you did anything brash[frostwyrm.andNykke |, especially after you jumped the gun with Nykke and you had hurt her feelings before working things out ]. [frostwyrm.name] is totally motionless, her eyes unblinking on yours. She’s an intelligent creature[pc.intelligenceRange 0 33 |, way more than you are ], and to see her totally blanking like this is unusual for her. It’s like you’ve trapped her in some sort of logic loop and she’s trying to parse something utterly incomprehensible. The flow of emotions between you two is also abnormally turbulent. You can feel everything from confusion, to apathy, to something sharper and more pronounced than the others – hope. It’s not so emphasized that it overpowers the other emotions, but that specific, sudden shock of a feeling in your chest when you want something more than anything, and the possibility of having it is real and tangible, is much easier to pinpoint than anything else. It takes [frostwyrm.name] a moment to form a single coherent thought. Another anomaly for her: she’s normally so specific and deliberate with her communications with you. I am conflicted, she eventually admits. That’s not the response that you were expecting. You thought she would have been elated to learn that one of her kind – a pureblood Frostwyrm – was not only alive, but so close by. Elation is among the myriad of states of my being, yes, she replies. The entire time she speaks with you, her body remains stock still: her head is still craned upward and her breath is still held in her lungs. [frostwyrm.name] is a fine swimmer; she can hold her breath for a long time. And yet.... She hesitates, unable to properly put her thoughts in order so she can effectively communicate them to you. You’ve never seen her like this before. The [pc.race] brain has a million-and-one thoughts at any given time, and Frostwyrms, an inherently psionic species, are attuned to only having – or, at least, ‘broadcasting’ – just one at a time. For her to be unable to phrase her thoughts like she normally does can only mean that her thoughts are positively chaotic. Had I learned of this second existence before you and I had met, this ‘news’ would have come to me as though it were a gift from the Grand Qim, she eventually says, although her words come out halted and stilted, as if she still isn’t sure about what she’s saying and she’s being careful to choose them. I know now I would be poorer for choosing any Qal besides yourself, [pc.name]. As much as you appreciate, and reciprocate, the sentiment, you don’t need to be buttered up like that – this is about her and her species. There’s a whole other Frostwyrm out there, and if there’s one, there’s bound to be more! There’s a chance that her species can be saved! That is precisely why I feel I must affirm what you are to me. What you mean to me. For the first time since you broke the news to her, the muscles in [frostwyrm.name]’s neck relax, and her head lowers towards you. My needs are satisfied. I have a mate. A home. A clutch. Food is plentiful. All else is ancillary. Were I to meet this second existence, they are likely suffering as I had suffered – without a mate, desperate in their pursuit of one. ... She’s suggesting that this second Frostwyrm would want to mate with her. You ask her if that’s correct. They are likely as lost and forlorn as I was, wishing to the Grand Qim for the hindsight into what had happened to our kind, she answers in a roundabout way. If I were to meet with this second existence, it would be nothing short of cruel: the whole of my being is betrothed to you, [pc.name]. I cannot take a second mate. And yet, leaving them to wander the icy plains, alone, without the company of another one of their kind and without any sort of idea on what had happened to their species, would be nothing short of cruel as well. Hence my confliction. She exhales, all that stale air in her lungs letting out through her nose in a sigh that lasts nearly a minute. To meet with the second existence and deny it the opportunities the Grand Qim had bade it would be malicious; to deny them our meeting and consign them to a lifetime of wandering and wondering, alone in the world, would be malignant. There is no answer. [frostwyrm.andNykke |You’re not convinced that that’s the case – after all, she and Nykke managed to work something out. Is it really out of the question that she and this second Frostwyrm could come to an understanding as well? Perhaps not, [frostwyrm.name] admits, though, understand that the... arrangement that we have established with Nykke is anomalous enough. My kind take only one mate. Adding another to our clutch required no short amount of empathy between not just us, my Qal, but from Nykke as well. She snorts through her nose, almost impatiently. There will not be enough empathy to sustain our clutch if we continue with adding Qims to it. Maybe it’s true that you’re introducing a lot of strangers into [frostwyrm.name]’s home and into your clutch. You understand that this is highly unusual behavior for Frostwyrms and you can feel the apprehension and hesitancy through the psionic link you have with her. ]You tell her that you’re not going to push her to do anything she’s uncomfortable with. Neither of you need to decide to bring any more strangers into the lair, no matter how large it is. Nobody needs to make any big, sweeping decisions like that right away. But she should still at least go see this other Frostwyrm. If she were the one that was lost out in the snow, searching tirelessly for another of her kind, she’d appreciate knowing that she’s not the only survivor of her race remaining, even if the Frostwyrm she met was already spoken for. Meeting with this other Frostwyrm will at least give you both some closure. You feel the tightening in your mind for a brief moment – she’s probably looking up your definition of the word ‘closure.’ It will be a difficult meeting for us both, she says. Her eyes close and her nostrils flare as she tries to envision how the meeting between her and this other Frostwyrm might go. But you are correct in more manners than one. Knowing that they are not the only surviving kind left in the world would be a gift – one that I ought not to hoard for myself. Just so there’s no confusion between you two: what does she mean by that, exactly? You wouldn’t want to approach another Frostwyrm without knowing exactly what to offer. [frostwyrm.andNykke |In short, and as much pause as it gives me, we offer it the same accommodations that we offered Nykke, she says, her eyes going to the hole that Nykke’s bored into the wall of her lair. A place within the clutch, and if it is a viable hunter, the title of Qim – a third to add to our family. Although it is a far departure from a typical clutch within my kind, circumstances are not the same when I was a kip. We will all need to adjust. She turns her head towards you; when she has you in all four of her ruby-red eyes, her lungs heave in that weird mimicry of laughter that she has. You will have three Qims to tend to, my Qal. You and your kind may be endlessly libidinous, but perhaps even you will find this next step in our journey together challenging. [pc.libidoRange 0 50 |We’ll just have to see about that. |Oh, you sincerely doubt that. Now that there’s three of them, maybe it’ll be a fair match. ] |If this second existence is anything like I was when we first met – and, knowing my kind, it likely is – then it will be both lonesome and... frustrated. It will need outlets for both. She lifts her head, her snout pointing at the rounded, smoothened walls of her icy underground lair. The lair is significant in size: there is room enough not only for a second of my kind, but for as large a clutch as we could fathom. Loneliness will not be an issue, provided it accepts. And the ‘frustrations?’ [frostwyrm.name]’s lungs heave in that crude mimicry of laughter of hers. You are the Qal. You would be tending to two Qims that are overdue a lifetime of breeding. That will be a task for you to endure. Well, if you weren’t confident in your own abilities, you probably wouldn’t have been so quick to accept [frostwyrm.name]’s proposal to be mates with her. The heaving in her lungs dies down, and she stares forlornly off into the distance of her lair, focused on nothing in particular. This is all contingent on it accepting our offer, she notes. Which it may not be inclined to. I will openly admit that what we have, [pc.name], is abnormal by the standards of my kind. I was desperate for normalcy. A normal mate and a clutch of my own. This second existence may... bristle at the idea of not only having its own mate, and not only of mating outside of our species as I have, but not being the only Qim to a clutch. The very notion makes even my own hackles rise in confusion. She sighs, the action lasting roughly a minute. That, however, is for it to decide. Not us. ] She leans her massive neck forward, bringing her head to your body so that she can nuzzle into you, rubbing the bridge of her snout against your whole torso. When next you take to the tundra, go to where you have been told of this second existence’s brooding grounds and summon me. My presence will draw them forward. "

And what about Nykke? Should she be included? [frostwyrm.name] rears backward, taken aback slightly by the question. Of course, she responds. Nykke is one of our own now, and she had suffered the same difficulties I had and this second existence is suffering. Excluding her would be as to say she has not suffered and is not one of us. She lifts her head, her eyes facing the hole that Nykke’s clawed into the side of her lair. I will inform her now. Just as you think that that makes sense – [frostwyrm.name]’s psionic communications can speak with Nykke much faster than your mouth can – you hear the hurried stomping of Nykke’s feet against the ice as she runs out of the mouth of her lair-within-a-lair. When she emerges, her eyes are wide with excitement, and as soon as she’s in the wider expanse of the proper lair, her wings unfurl with some force. “There’s a what, and it’s where?!” she asks loudly, her lips curling upward at the news. It’s interesting to you that there’s such a wild difference between Nykke’s reaction to there being a second Frostwyrm, and [frostwyrm.name]’s. Nykke almost looks like she’s about to jump out there and search for it herself. It is understandable, [frostwyrm.name] offers. Nykke is our mate, and she shares in our lair and in our groupings, but her position in the clutch is indistinct. There being a potential mate would beget a fervent response. “Fuck that,” Nykke says, waving her hand dismissively at [frostwyrm.name]’s supposition. “Think of all the sex! [pc.name] already has the drive to satisfy both of us, [frostwyrm.name]; imagine another one!” [frostwyrm.name] says nothing in turn... although her head lowers slightly and she averts your eyes. And, as much as she tries to withhold it, you can feel the lust seeping into you from your psionic link with her. The idea of adding another to your ‘party’ was never lost on her. “Don’t try to pretend that that isn’t a factor,” Nykke continues, her legs splayed slightly to make room for the growing bulge in her penile vent. It wouldn’t take much prodding for her to start dealing with the excess lust right then and there. “Before we met [pc.name], mating was just a means to make a clutch. And that’s great and fantastic and amazing, don’t get me wrong, but now that we know how good it can feel – by the Grand Qim, can you imagine? If two feels good, and three feels great, then how amazing must four be?” [frostwyrm.name] hesitates in her response. It is true, she eventually admits. The lust you felt early gets significantly more intense, but only for a moment, before she recollects herself. I had never anticipated such pleasures before you, my Qal. Your kind are so... creative and imaginative with procreation. Every time the topic of there being so few Frostwyrms left on Uveto has come up, [frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name], Nykke, and [flurry.name] |[frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] ] have done everything from deny the possibility to deflect to another topic. It’s clear to you that it’s a difficult conversation for them to have, and it’s not hard to understand why: the idea that you may be among the last of your kind is a hard one to even process, much less entertain. But... it’s reality. Frostwyrms are going extinct. [frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name], Nykke, and [flurry.name] have all bemoaned |[frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] both bemoaned ] that it was you that [frostwyrm.name] mated with first: she continually says that you weren’t her first choice, and that she wanted a mate that was more ‘proper’ for her to raise a typical clutch with. Now, though, she insists that you’re the perfect mate, and that she can’t imagine having anyone else... ... but you’re still not a pureblood Frostwyrm[pc.ra frostwyrm |, no matter how hard you try ]. Things have changed, though. Not only did [frostwyrm.name] take you as her mate – already a highly unusual thing for Frostwyrms, let alone [pc.ra frostwyrm |your own society |[pc.race]s ] – but now, you’re the Qal to two[frostwyrm.andNykke | purebloods, and a halfblood ]. [flurry.name] was just as hesitant and resistant to the idea of mating outside of his species as [frostwyrm.name] has, but over time, he’s come to appreciate you the same way [frostwyrm.name] does: it’s not just that you can sexually please them, but you’re an accomplished mate to them both, and you’ve raised multiple children between them. You’re as accomplished as any pureblood Qal and when they say that they’re lucky to have known you, they each mean it. This train of thought, though, leads you back to your initial concern: Uveto is running out of pureblood Frostwyrms. There’s a solution to that. There are two viable pureblood Frostwyrms in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair right now. But it means for [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] to mate with each other – and not with you. Even ignoring the sort of stigma something like that might have in the societies you come from, there’s no telling whether [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] would even be capable of it, traditionally: Frostwyrms don’t experience sex like you do, and since they aren’t each other’s mates, there might be some form of psionic block that could prevent it from happening altogether. Frostwyrms can choose whether to get pregnant or not during sex, but they also don’t do it for recreation before you came along. There’s only one way to truly find out, though. You’re having this conversation with yourself when it really ought to involve two others. Are you okay with that? Are you okay with the idea of [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] having sex with each other to produce a pureblood Frostwyrm?
rows.translation: 每当谈到乌维托仅存的霜龙如此稀少时，[frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name]、妮凯和[flurry.name] |[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name] ]不是否认这种可能，就是把话题岔开。你看得出，这场谈话对他们而言很艰难，原因也不难理解：自己或许是族群最后的成员之一，这种想法仅仅是理解都很困难，更不用说认真考虑了。 但是...这就是现实。霜龙正在灭绝。[frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name]、妮凯和[flurry.name]全都曾哀叹 |[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]都曾哀叹 ]，[frostwyrm.name]最先交配的对象竟然是你：她一再表示，你并非她的首选，她原本想找一个更‘合适’的伴侣，与之养育一窝寻常的幼崽。可现在，她坚称你是完美的伴侣，无法想象自己还能与其他任何人在一起... ...但你仍不是纯血霜龙[pc.ra frostwyrm |，无论你如何努力 ]。 不过，情况已经改变了。[frostwyrm.name]不仅选择你作为她的伴侣 – 对霜龙而言，这本就极不寻常，更不用说[pc.ra frostwyrm |你自己的社会 |[pc.race]们 ]了 – 如今，你还是两名Qim的Qal[frostwyrm.andNykke |，其中有两名纯血，还有一名混血 ]。[flurry.name]最初与[frostwyrm.name]一样，对于和异族交配既犹豫又抗拒；然而随着时间推移，他也像[frostwyrm.name]一样逐渐懂得欣赏你：不只是因为你能在性方面取悦他们，更因为你是他们两者称职的伴侣，也为他们养育了多个孩子。你和任何纯血Qal一样出色；他们说自己很幸运能够认识你时，每一个都是真心实意的。 然而这番思绪又把你带回最初的忧虑：乌维托的纯血霜龙正变得越来越少。 这个问题有一个解决办法。此刻，[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴里就有两条具备繁殖能力的纯血霜龙。 但这意味着[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]必须彼此交配 – 而不是与你交配。即使不考虑这种事在你出身的社会里可能招致怎样的非议，也无法确定[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]是否真能以传统方式做到：霜龙对性的体验不同于你；既然他们不是彼此的伴侣，某种灵能障碍或许会彻底阻止此事发生。霜龙可以在性交时选择是否怀孕，但在你出现之前，他们也从不会为了消遣而性交。 不过，真正弄清答案的办法只有一个。你现在是在独自思考这件事，可这场谈话本该让另外两人参与。 你能接受吗？你能接受[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]彼此性交，以孕育一条纯血霜龙吗？

You summon [flurry.name] to the central chamber of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, where you and [frostwyrm.name] reside. Only a few seconds later, the sound of his heavy footsteps starts echoing off the smooth, icy walls, and you can feel the tremors of his footfalls as he makes his way towards the two of you. Another moment later and you see his body reflecting off the glassy ice before he rounds the final corner. His head is tilted to one side as he approaches. How can I assist, my Qal? he asks. [frostwyrm.name]’s head rises from her sitting position beside you, eyeing [flurry.name] as he approaches. When he nears the foot of the dais you two are on, he sits on his haunches, awaiting your further instruction; she, likewise, twists her long neck to face you patiently. You had summoned him to the central chamber; whatever it is you wanted clearly involves them both. There’s no easy way to lead into it: you tell them both that there’s a serious matter you need to address, and insisting that it’s not a problem is only going to make it worse. The world is running out of pureblood Frostwyrms. As soon as the words leave your mouth, you feel a deep, cold pit form in your chest. It’s not your sensation: it’s [frostwyrm.name]’s and [flurry.name]’s. It’s a reality that they had both been trying to ignore since you first met them – when the topic came up, they would instead try to focus on the better things they had in life, such as finally have a mate of their own, but it’s time you three stopped kicking the can down the road, as it were. This is no easy topic to discuss, [frostwyrm.name] warns. Her tone is unusually low and stern, as if she were trying to intimidate you into stopping – but her words come to you shakily. Her conviction is shot: she knows that you’re right, but she’s still trying to fight it. You are our Qal, [pc.name], yet your origin is with a kind that has never known the struggles that [flurry.name] and I face. You cannot understand the difficulties it is that we endure. That’s exactly why you three need to have this conversation. [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] have one particular thing in common: they only took you as their mate because they were desperate. In another life, if they had waited just a little longer, they would have found each other, and you three wouldn’t be in this predicament. I do not regret my choice, [frostwyrm.name] insists. Nor I, [flurry.name] continues. That you are not of our kind, our Qal, is no longer a concern to either of us. Yes, you know that, but that’s not the point you’re trying to make. They are both viable, pureblood Frostwyrms. No matter how many kips you give to either of them, you’re simply not a Frostwyrm yourself[pc.ra frostwyrm | – not pureblood, anyway ]. It’s beautiful and rewarding and wholesome for them to say that they’re so enamored with you and that you’ve been a good Qal to them, but... given that the Frostwyrms are dying out, they have to make a decision that they may not be comfortable with. One that stretches how they feel about wanting a ‘typical clutch’ even further. You are suggesting that [flurry.name] and I mate, [frostwyrm.name] says flatly, cutting through all the fluff you’ve been setting up between them. ... Yes, that’s what you’ve been working towards. [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes close, and she takes a long, deep sigh through her nose. Given her size, it lasts nearly a full minute. What you are asking is not impossible, she eventually relents. Her eyes remain closed. Though... it is not so simple a matter as one of us mounting the other. Isn’t it? Our situation is atypical, our Qal, [flurry.name] answers for her. [frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name], Nykke, and I |[frostwyrm.name] and I ] entered into a clutch with more than one Qim out of necessity. A Qal and a Qim mating with each other is not merely a matter of copulation: it is about choosing your partner and remaining with them until you are summoned by the Grand Qim. Our clutch is already atypical and includes multiple Qims, but the idea that a Qim would mate with another Qim is... implausible. You don’t want to seem like you’re insensitive or ignorant, but you don’t understand the issue. You won’t deny that there’s an emotional aspect to it, but the way [flurry.name] describes it, it’s almost like he’s saying it physically can’t be done. It may not be, he replies. It is you that has taken the role of Qal, [pc.name]. [frostwyrm.name] and I – our kind[frostwyrm.andNykke |, and Nykke as well ] – we do not mate for recreation. Like your kind, we require tactile feedback to ejaculate, but we cannot experience that feedback without a mate. And if we cannot ejaculate, we cannot procreate. ... And since he and [frostwyrm.name] aren’t mates, he’s suggesting that they wouldn’t feel pleasure if they mated with each other? Were a Qim, for example, to be summoned by the Grand Qim before their Qal, the widowed Qal could not take a new Qim for this same reason. It goes against our... understanding of what a clutch is meant to be. More for your own curiosity than you trying to think of ways [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] could have sex with each other, you ask if they couldn’t they just... pretend? Couldn’t [frostwyrm.name] take on the role of the Qal for a little bit or something? That is impossible, [flurry.name] responds. It is you that is the Qal. [frostwyrm.name]’s been quiet for a little while since you had started, and when you look to her, you see that her eyes have been cast down towards the icy floor. Her breathing is shallow to the point of being nearly indistinct: it’s like she’s trying to hide from you. You ask her if she’s okay. She takes a long moment to herself before answering. You have been asking questions about the plausibility of the act, my Qal, she answers slowly. You feel a cold pit in your chest as she speaks, but you didn’t need to feel that to know that she’s upset. I will not chastise you for your misunderstandings and your efforts to right them, but there is an emotive aspect to this that we are each neglecting, even if it were possible for me to assume the role of Qal temporarily. She rotates her head and lifts her snout so that her two ruby-red eyes look into yours. You are my Qal. [flurry.name] is not my Qal. And I cannot, and would not, assume the role of Qal. The air hangs heavy, her words lingering between you and [flurry.name]. You are the Qal to [frostwyrm.andNykke |three |two ] dragons, and all that entails: as Qal, you are the teacher to your offspring, meant to pass on the knowledge and traditions of earlier generations to the next – but you are also the mate to your Qim. Having to share you isn’t easy for her, just as it hasn’t been easy for [flurry.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ]. Our Qal speaks the truth, [flurry.name] says, before his voice erupts in a series of impossible vowels and consonants that you recognize as [frostwyrm.name]’s true name. Our kind is in peril. We cannot continue to ignore this. I know, she answers. To not do what our Qal suggests would consign our kind to its fate. I know! she barks, her head lunging upward and her jaw snapping shut in [flurry.name]’s direction. Our Qal and I had this very discussion before we chose to seek you out, she says before her own voice spouts a bunch of gibberish that you recognize as [flurry.name]’s true name. Every time I look at you, I am reminded of the reality that we face: that you and I may well be the last of our kind in this world! At that, you feel a second, stronger, colder pit in your chest – this time, coming from [flurry.name]. It’s not that her words have cut into him: it’s that he feels the same way. No matter how much they adore you as their Qal, the fact remains that, through circumstances neither of them could control, their species is dying and they had both missed an opportunity to not only try and fix that, but to live normal lives and have a normal Frostwyrm family – something they both coveted before they met you. Your hand goes to [frostwyrm.name]’s chest; as soon as she feels your palm rest against her scales, she calms down and lowers her head back to the ice. If she doesn’t want to do this, then she doesn’t want to do this. That’s the end of the discussion. As with all things, it is not that simple, she says, letting out a long, deep sigh – her vocal chords vibrate as she does, and it comes out as a low-pitched whine. There is nothing I desire more than to conserve my kind, our Qal. I am willing to do whatever it takes. I am willing to do anything, but this simply is not a matter of willpower. Her eyes go to [flurry.name], then to yours. It is not right, she continues, her voice lilting in your head. It is not right that we are put into this scenario. It is a cost that the Grand Qim has deigned we remunerate for the gifts we have been given. Again, the air hangs silent for a long moment. [flurry.name], growing emotionally weary from the discussion, stands; takes a step backward; and then lies on his stomach, his snout only about a foot away from [frostwyrm.name]’s. This is a difficult discussion for them both and you don’t want to make light of the scenario by suggesting that sex is the answer... but they have two options: they can accept that there’s nothing that can be done, and [flurry.name] returns to his corner of the lair, and you all go back to the way things were before you had this discussion... ... or, if they’re serious about wanting to conserve their species before it risks going extinct, they mate with each other – and you get involved. That ought to at least solve the issue about them not being able to experience the ‘tactile feedback’ they need to actually get the gears turning, so to speak. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t immediately respond to your suggestion. When she does, she turns her eyes to you without lifting her head. What are you suggesting? she asks. Well, you’re the Qal, right? They’ll only get the feedback they need if you’re involved. What you three could do is, [pc.hasCock |[frostwyrm.name] mounts [flurry.name], and you mount [frostwyrm.name] on top of them both[pc.hasVagina |. Or, if they’d rather, ] ][pc.hasVagina |[flurry.name] mounts [frostwyrm.name], and [frostwyrm.name] mounts you on the bottom ]; that way, since you’re involved, they’d both get the feedback they’d need, and [frostwyrm.name] still gets to mate with her Qal. And, on top of that, [pc.hasCock |[frostwyrm.name] would get another kip of her own with you as well[pc.hasVagina |, or, if you’re on bottom, ] ][pc.hasVagina |you’d get another kip with [frostwyrm.name][pc.isPregnant |, at least once you pass the kid you’re incubating right now, ] ] to add to your growing clutch. It’s not a perfect solution... but if you three want to do anything about Frostwyrms being endangered, they’ll all just have to accept that no ‘perfect solution’ exists. Both [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] remain silent as they consider your words. Both of them look to you, and, after a moment, their eyes turn to each other. [flurry.name] raises his head off the ice slightly, slowly becoming animated the longer he considers the idea. This would solve the feedback concern, he admits. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t respond, but from the way she’s looking up at [flurry.name], it’s clear that she isn’t terribly opposed to the idea. Like you said, it’s not a perfect solution, but your involvement would, at the very least, make things a bit easier. I am willing to try, she says eventually. For the sake of the conservation of our kind... I am willing to try. [flurry.name] doesn’t object either. It’s worth a shot.
rows.translation: 你将[flurry.name]召唤到[frostwyrm.name]巢穴的中央大厅，也就是你和[frostwyrm.name]居住的地方。 仅仅几秒后，他沉重的脚步声便开始在光滑的冰墙间回荡；随着他朝你们两人走来，你甚至能感受到每一步引发的震颤。又过片刻，你先看见他的身影映在玻璃般的冰面上，随后他才绕过最后一道拐角。他走近时，脑袋略微歪向一侧。有什么是我能效劳的吗，我的Qal？他问道。 [frostwyrm.name]原本坐在你身旁，此时抬起头，注视着走近的[flurry.name]。来到你们所在高台的台阶下后，他以后腿蹲坐下来，等待你进一步吩咐；她也同样扭过长颈，耐心地面向你。是你把他召到中央大厅的；无论你想做什么，显然都与他们两个有关。 这件事没法轻松地开口：你告诉他们，有一件严肃的事情必须面对；一味坚持说这不是问题，只会令情况恶化。纯血霜龙正在走向灭绝。 话音刚落，你便感到胸口形成了一个幽深冰冷的空洞。那并非你的感觉，而是[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]的。自你初次见到他们以来，他们便一直试图忽视这个现实——每当谈起此事，他们总会转而关注生活中那些更美好的部分，例如终于拥有了自己的伴侣；但现在，你们三个不能再继续拖延下去了。 这不是一个容易讨论的话题，[frostwyrm.name]警告道。她的语调异常低沉严厉，仿佛想以威势逼你住口——可传入你脑海的话语却微微发颤。她的信念已经动摇：她知道你说得没错，却仍在试图抗拒。你是我们的Qal，[pc.name]，可你出身于一个从未经历过我与[flurry.name]所面临困境的种族。你无法理解我们承受的艰难。 正因如此，你们三个才更有必要谈一谈。[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]有一个共同点：他们当初都只因走投无路，才会选择你作为伴侣。若是在另一种人生里，只要他们多等一阵子，便会找到彼此，你们三个也就不会陷入如今的困境。 我不后悔自己的选择，[frostwyrm.name]坚持道。 我也不后悔，[flurry.name]接着说。我们的Qal，你并非我族一员这件事，对我们中的任何一个而言都已不再是顾虑。 是的，你知道，但这并不是你想表达的重点。他们都是拥有生育能力的纯血霜龙。无论你让他们中的任何一个孕育多少幼崽，你自己终究不是霜龙[pc.ra frostwyrm |——至少不是纯血霜龙 ]。他们说自己如此倾心于你，说你一直是个称职的Qal，这些话既美好、令人欣慰又温暖人心；可是...鉴于霜龙正在灭绝，他们必须做出一个或许会令自己不适的决定。这个决定会进一步挑战他们对于拥有“一窝典型幼崽”的看法。 你是在建议我和[flurry.name]交配，[frostwyrm.name]直截了当地说道，戳破了你为他们铺垫的所有委婉说辞。 ...是的，你刚才一直在把话题引向这里。 [frostwyrm.name]闭上双眼，用鼻子深深地长叹一口气。以她的体型，这口气持续了将近整整一分钟。 你要求的事并非不可能，她最终让步道，双眼仍然闭着。不过...这并不像我们中的一个骑上另一个那么简单。 难道不是吗？ 我们的情况并不寻常，我们的Qal，[flurry.name]代她回答。[frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name]、妮凯和我 |[frostwyrm.name]和我 ]是迫于无奈，才与不止一名Qim组成了一窝。Qal与Qim交配，绝不只是肉体上的结合：那代表着选择自己的伴侣，并与其相守，直至受到至尊Qim的召唤。我们这一窝本就不同寻常，包含多名Qim，可让一名Qim与另一名Qim交配的想法...并不现实。 你不想显得迟钝或无知，可你确实不明白问题出在哪里。你不否认其中有情感层面的因素，但照[flurry.name]的说法听来，他几乎是在声称这件事从生理上就做不到。 或许的确做不到，他回答。承担Qal之位的是你，[pc.name]。[frostwyrm.name]和我——我们这个种族[frostwyrm.andNykke |，妮凯也一样 ]——并不会为了消遣而交配。与贵族相同，我们需要触觉反馈才能射精，但若没有伴侣，我们就无法感受到这种反馈。而无法射精，我们就无法繁衍。 ...所以，因为他与[frostwyrm.name]不是伴侣，他是在说，即便他们彼此交配，也不会感受到快感？ 举例而言，若一名Qim先于其Qal受到至尊Qim的召唤，丧偶的Qal也无法另觅新的Qim，原因亦是如此。那有悖于我们对...一窝伴侣应有模样的认知。 与其说你是在设法让[frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]彼此发生关系，不如说这更多只是出于你自己的好奇；你问他们难道不能...假装一下吗？[frostwyrm.name]不能暂时扮演一会儿Qal之类的角色吗？ 那不可能，[flurry.name]回答。Qal是你。 从你开始谈起这件事以来，[frostwyrm.name]已经沉默了一阵子。你看向她时，发现她的目光一直垂向冰面。她的呼吸浅得几乎难以察觉，仿佛正试图躲开你。你问她是否还好。 她独自沉默了许久才作答。我的Qal，你一直在询问这种行为是否可行，她缓缓回答。她说话时，你感到胸中出现了一个冰冷的空洞，但即使没有这种感觉，你也知道她很难过。我不会因为你的误解，以及你试图纠正误解的努力而责备你；但这件事还有一个我们所有人都在忽略的情感层面，即便我真的可以暂时承担Qal的角色也一样。她转过头、扬起吻部，让那双红宝石般的眼睛望进你的双眼。你是我的Qal。[flurry.name]不是我的Qal。而我不能，也不愿承担Qal的角色。 空气变得无比沉重，她的话语久久萦绕在你与[flurry.name]之间。你是[frostwyrm.andNykke |三 |两 ]条龙的Qal，也承担着这个身份所包含的一切：身为Qal，你是后代的老师，负责把先辈的知识与传统传给下一代——但你同样也是你的Qim的伴侣。对她而言，必须与别人分享你并不容易；对[flurry.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |和妮凯 ]而言，也同样如此。 我们的Qal说出了事实，[flurry.name]说道，随后他的声音爆发出一串不可能发出的元音与辅音，你认出那是[frostwyrm.name]的真名。我族正身处危难。我们不能继续对此视而不见。 我知道，她回答。 若不按我们的Qal所言行事，便是任由我族走向既定的命运。 我知道！她厉声吼道，猛然抬头，朝[flurry.name]的方向“咔”地闭拢双颚。早在我们决定出发寻找你之前，我与我们的Qal就讨论过同一件事，她说完，自己的声音也吐出一串你听来毫无意义、却能认出是[flurry.name]真名的音节。每次看见你，我都会想起我们面临的现实：你与我很可能就是这个世界上最后的同族！ 话音落下，你感到胸口出现了第二个更加剧烈、更加寒冷的空洞——这一次来自[flurry.name]。并非她的话伤到了他，而是因为他也有着同样的感受。无论他们多么爱戴作为Qal的你，事实依旧不变：由于他们都无法控制的境遇，他们的种族正在走向灭亡；他们两人不仅错过了一次尝试扭转局面的机会，也错过了过上正常生活、建立普通霜龙家庭的机会——在遇见你之前，那都是他们共同渴望的生活。 你把手放到[frostwyrm.name]的胸口；感受到你的掌心贴上鳞片，她立刻平静下来，把头重新低到冰面。 如果她不愿意这么做，那就不做。讨论到此为止。 如同所有事情一样，没那么简单，她说道，发出一声深长的叹息——叹气时，她的声带也随之振动，听来像一声低沉的呜咽。我们的Qal，我最渴望的莫过于延续自己的种族。我愿意付出任何代价。我愿意做任何事，但这根本不是凭意志力就能解决的问题。 她先看向[flurry.name]，随后又看向你。 这不公平，她继续说道，声音在你的脑海中起伏。我们被置于这样的境地是不公平的。这是至尊Qim命定要我们为所得恩赐偿付的代价。 空气再度陷入漫长的沉寂。讨论令[flurry.name]感到心力交瘁，他站起身，后退一步，随后腹部贴地趴下，吻部距[frostwyrm.name]的吻部只有约一英尺。 这场谈话对他们两人而言都很艰难，你不愿以“发生关系就是答案”这种说法轻率对待眼前的困境...但他们只有两个选择：他们可以接受无能为力的事实，让[flurry.name]回到巢穴属于他的角落，然后你们所有人都恢复到这场谈话之前的生活状态... ...或者，如果他们真的想在种族面临灭绝风险之前将其延续下去，他们就彼此交配——而你也参与其中。这样一来，至少能解决他们无法获得真正让身体运转起来所需的“触觉反馈”这一问题。 [frostwyrm.name]没有立刻回应你的提议。等到她终于开口时，她没有抬头，只是转眼看向你。你在建议什么？她问道。 这个嘛，你是Qal，对吧？只有你参与，他们才能获得所需的反馈。你们三个可以这样做：[pc.hasCock |让[frostwyrm.name]骑上[flurry.name]，然后你再骑到[frostwyrm.name]身上，叠在他们两个上方[pc.hasVagina |。或者，如果他们更愿意， ] ][pc.hasVagina |让[flurry.name]骑上[frostwyrm.name]，再让[frostwyrm.name]骑到位于最下方的你身上 ]；这样一来，因为你参与其中，他们两个都能获得所需的反馈，同时[frostwyrm.name]依然是在与她的Qal交配。除此之外，[pc.hasCock |[frostwyrm.name]也会与你再孕育一只属于她自己的幼崽[pc.hasVagina |；或者，如果你在最下方， ] ][pc.hasVagina |你会与[frostwyrm.name]再孕育一只幼崽[pc.isPregnant |——至少得等你生下现在正孕育的孩子， ] ]，为不断壮大的家庭再添一员。 这并不是完美的解决办法...但若你们三个真想为濒危的霜龙做些什么，那所有人都必须接受根本不存在“完美解决办法”这一事实。 [frostwyrm.name]和[flurry.name]都沉默不语，思考着你说的话。他们都看向你，过了一会儿，视线又转向彼此。[flurry.name]将头稍稍抬离冰面；这个念头在他脑海中盘旋得越久，他就逐渐显得越有精神。 这确实能解决反馈的问题，他承认道。 [frostwyrm.name]没有作答，但从她仰望[flurry.name]的神态来看，她显然并不十分反对这个主意。正如你所说，这不是完美的办法，可至少你的参与能让事情容易一些。 我愿意试试，她最终说道。为了延续我们的种族...我愿意试试。 [flurry.name]也没有反对。 值得一试。
rows.raw: " You summon [flurry.name] to the central chamber of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, where you and [frostwyrm.name] reside. Only a few seconds later, the sound of his heavy footsteps starts echoing off the smooth, icy walls, and you can feel the tremors of his footfalls as he makes his way towards the two of you. Another moment later and you see his body reflecting off the glassy ice before he rounds the final corner. His head is tilted to one side as he approaches. How can I assist, my Qal? he asks. [frostwyrm.name]’s head rises from her sitting position beside you, eyeing [flurry.name] as he approaches. When he nears the foot of the dais you two are on, he sits on his haunches, awaiting your further instruction; she, likewise, twists her long neck to face you patiently. You had summoned him to the central chamber; whatever it is you wanted clearly involves them both. There’s no easy way to lead into it: you tell them both that there’s a serious matter you need to address, and insisting that it’s not a problem is only going to make it worse. The world is running out of pureblood Frostwyrms. As soon as the words leave your mouth, you feel a deep, cold pit form in your chest. It’s not your sensation: it’s [frostwyrm.name]’s and [flurry.name]’s. It’s a reality that they had both been trying to ignore since you first met them – when the topic came up, they would instead try to focus on the better things they had in life, such as finally have a mate of their own, but it’s time you three stopped kicking the can down the road, as it were. This is no easy topic to discuss, [frostwyrm.name] warns. Her tone is unusually low and stern, as if she were trying to intimidate you into stopping – but her words come to you shakily. Her conviction is shot: she knows that you’re right, but she’s still trying to fight it. You are our Qal, [pc.name], yet your origin is with a kind that has never known the struggles that [flurry.name] and I face. You cannot understand the difficulties it is that we endure. That’s exactly why you three need to have this conversation. [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] have one particular thing in common: they only took you as their mate because they were desperate. In another life, if they had waited just a little longer, they would have found each other, and you three wouldn’t be in this predicament. I do not regret my choice, [frostwyrm.name] insists. Nor I, [flurry.name] continues. That you are not of our kind, our Qal, is no longer a concern to either of us. Yes, you know that, but that’s not the point you’re trying to make. They are both viable, pureblood Frostwyrms. No matter how many kips you give to either of them, you’re simply not a Frostwyrm yourself[pc.ra frostwyrm | – not pureblood, anyway ]. It’s beautiful and rewarding and wholesome for them to say that they’re so enamored with you and that you’ve been a good Qal to them, but... given that the Frostwyrms are dying out, they have to make a decision that they may not be comfortable with. One that stretches how they feel about wanting a ‘typical clutch’ even further. You are suggesting that [flurry.name] and I mate, [frostwyrm.name] says flatly, cutting through all the fluff you’ve been setting up between them. ... Yes, that’s what you’ve been working towards. [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes close, and she takes a long, deep sigh through her nose. Given her size, it lasts nearly a full minute. What you are asking is not impossible, she eventually relents. Her eyes remain closed. Though... it is not so simple a matter as one of us mounting the other. Isn’t it? Our situation is atypical, our Qal, [flurry.name] answers for her. [frostwyrm.andNykke |[frostwyrm.name], Nykke, and I |[frostwyrm.name] and I ] entered into a clutch with more than one Qim out of necessity. A Qal and a Qim mating with each other is not merely a matter of copulation: it is about choosing your partner and remaining with them until you are summoned by the Grand Qim. Our clutch is already atypical and includes multiple Qims, but the idea that a Qim would mate with another Qim is... implausible. You don’t want to seem like you’re insensitive or ignorant, but you don’t understand the issue. You won’t deny that there’s an emotional aspect to it, but the way [flurry.name] describes it, it’s almost like he’s saying it physically can’t be done. It may not be, he replies. It is you that has taken the role of Qal, [pc.name]. [frostwyrm.name] and I – our kind[frostwyrm.andNykke |, and Nykke as well ] – we do not mate for recreation. Like your kind, we require tactile feedback to ejaculate, but we cannot experience that feedback without a mate. And if we cannot ejaculate, we cannot procreate. ... And since he and [frostwyrm.name] aren’t mates, he’s suggesting that they wouldn’t feel pleasure if they mated with each other? Were a Qim, for example, to be summoned by the Grand Qim before their Qal, the widowed Qal could not take a new Qim for this same reason. It goes against our... understanding of what a clutch is meant to be. More for your own curiosity than you trying to think of ways [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] could have sex with each other, you ask if they couldn’t they just... pretend? Couldn’t [frostwyrm.name] take on the role of the Qal for a little bit or something? That is impossible, [flurry.name] responds. It is you that is the Qal. [frostwyrm.name]’s been quiet for a little while since you had started, and when you look to her, you see that her eyes have been cast down towards the icy floor. Her breathing is shallow to the point of being nearly indistinct: it’s like she’s trying to hide from you. You ask her if she’s okay. She takes a long moment to herself before answering. You have been asking questions about the plausibility of the act, my Qal, she answers slowly. You feel a cold pit in your chest as she speaks, but you didn’t need to feel that to know that she’s upset. I will not chastise you for your misunderstandings and your efforts to right them, but there is an emotive aspect to this that we are each neglecting, even if it were possible for me to assume the role of Qal temporarily. She rotates her head and lifts her snout so that her two ruby-red eyes look into yours. You are my Qal. [flurry.name] is not my Qal. And I cannot, and would not, assume the role of Qal. The air hangs heavy, her words lingering between you and [flurry.name]. You are the Qal to [frostwyrm.andNykke |three |two ] dragons, and all that entails: as Qal, you are the teacher to your offspring, meant to pass on the knowledge and traditions of earlier generations to the next – but you are also the mate to your Qim. Having to share you isn’t easy for her, just as it hasn’t been easy for [flurry.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ]. Our Qal speaks the truth, [flurry.name] says, before his voice erupts in a series of impossible vowels and consonants that you recognize as [frostwyrm.name]’s true name. Our kind is in peril. We cannot continue to ignore this. I know, she answers. To not do what our Qal suggests would consign our kind to its fate. I know! she barks, her head lunging upward and her jaw snapping shut in [flurry.name]’s direction. Our Qal and I had this very discussion before we chose to seek you out, she says before her own voice spouts a bunch of gibberish that you recognize as [flurry.name]’s true name. Every time I look at you, I am reminded of the reality that we face: that you and I may well be the last of our kind in this world! At that, you feel a second, stronger, colder pit in your chest – this time, coming from [flurry.name]. It’s not that her words have cut into him: it’s that he feels the same way. No matter how much they adore you as their Qal, the fact remains that, through circumstances neither of them could control, their species is dying and they had both missed an opportunity to not only try and fix that, but to live normal lives and have a normal Frostwyrm family – something they both coveted before they met you. Your hand goes to [frostwyrm.name]’s chest; as soon as she feels your palm rest against her scales, she calms down and lowers her head back to the ice. If she doesn’t want to do this, then she doesn’t want to do this. That’s the end of the discussion. As with all things, it is not that simple, she says, letting out a long, deep sigh – her vocal chords vibrate as she does, and it comes out as a low-pitched whine. There is nothing I desire more than to conserve my kind, our Qal. I am willing to do whatever it takes. I am willing to do anything, but this simply is not a matter of willpower. Her eyes go to [flurry.name], then to yours. It is not right, she continues, her voice lilting in your head. It is not right that we are put into this scenario. It is a cost that the Grand Qim has deigned we remunerate for the gifts we have been given. Again, the air hangs silent for a long moment. [flurry.name], growing emotionally weary from the discussion, stands; takes a step backward; and then lies on his stomach, his snout only about a foot away from [frostwyrm.name]’s. This is a difficult discussion for them both and you don’t want to make light of the scenario by suggesting that sex is the answer... but they have two options: they can accept that there’s nothing that can be done, and [flurry.name] returns to his corner of the lair, and you all go back to the way things were before you had this discussion... ... or, if they’re serious about wanting to conserve their species before it risks going extinct, they mate with each other – and you get involved. That ought to at least solve the issue about them not being able to experience the ‘tactile feedback’ they need to actually get the gears turning, so to speak. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t immediately respond to your suggestion. When she does, she turns her eyes to you without lifting her head. What are you suggesting? she asks. Well, you’re the Qal, right? They’ll only get the feedback they need if you’re involved. What you three could do is, [pc.hasCock |[frostwyrm.name] mounts [flurry.name], and you mount [frostwyrm.name] on top of them both[pc.hasVagina |. Or, if they’d rather, ] ][pc.hasVagina |[flurry.name] mounts [frostwyrm.name], and [frostwyrm.name] mounts you on the bottom ]; that way, since you’re involved, they’d both get the feedback they’d need, and [frostwyrm.name] still gets to mate with her Qal. And, on top of that, [pc.hasCock |[frostwyrm.name] would get another kip of her own with you as well[pc.hasVagina |, or, if you’re on bottom, ] ][pc.hasVagina |you’d get another kip with [frostwyrm.name][pc.isPregnant |, at least once you pass the kid you’re incubating right now, ] ] to add to your growing clutch. It’s not a perfect solution... but if you three want to do anything about Frostwyrms being endangered, they’ll all just have to accept that no ‘perfect solution’ exists. Both [frostwyrm.name] and [flurry.name] remain silent as they consider your words. Both of them look to you, and, after a moment, their eyes turn to each other. [flurry.name] raises his head off the ice slightly, slowly becoming animated the longer he considers the idea. This would solve the feedback concern, he admits. [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t respond, but from the way she’s looking up at [flurry.name], it’s clear that she isn’t terribly opposed to the idea. Like you said, it’s not a perfect solution, but your involvement would, at the very least, make things a bit easier. I am willing to try, she says eventually. For the sake of the conservation of our kind... I am willing to try. [flurry.name] doesn’t object either. It’s worth a shot. "

rows.original: B

Before you get started, though, you ask [flurry.name] to return to his section of the lair for a moment. You have something you’d like to discuss with [frostwyrm.name], and you’d prefer it if he was out of earshot for it – and you ask [frostwyrm.name] to block your psionic link with him for privacy. As you say, our Qal, he says, pulling himself to his six legs and heading off towards the rear of the lair. He’s out of eyesight soon enough, but you wait until you stop feeling the vibrations of his feet and you stop hearing the thundering echoes of his footsteps before you start. Once you’re confident that you and [frostwyrm.name] are alone, you reposition yourself so that you’re closer to her neck. She curls her long head towards you, her four eyes trained tightly on you, giving you her undivided attention. You ask her plainly: was it wrong to bring him into the clutch as another Qim[frostwyrm.andNykke |? Was it wrong to bring in Nykke ]? Would she have preferred that she was the only Qim in the clutch? The question seems to have caught her off-guard: she rears her head back, her eyes widening, and she doesn’t immediately respond. Her eyes remain solely on yours, laser-locked and unshakeable as she seriously considers her answer. What feels like a minute passes before she exhales, and her focus on you is broken with a long, slow blink. Yes, she eventually answers. Just as you are my only Qal, I would have preferred that I was your only Qim. But, she continues before you can respond, it was not wrong to bring in [flurry.name][frostwyrm.andNykke | and Nykke ]. These two thoughts are not exclusive to each other. [frostwyrm.andNykke |They were |He was ] hurting as I had been hurting: our scenario is unusual and desperate, and we must all make desperate decisions to adapt. If you were to ask [flurry.name] the same question, there is no doubt that he would respond likewise. She leans her gigantic head towards you; the side of her snout gently rubs against your body, nuzzling you affectionately. It is kind of you to consider my emotions as you have, she continues. I am, as of yet, uncertain of how our attempts to mate me with [flurry.name] will transpire, but no matter what, it is comforting to know that I will have my Qal before, during, and after the attempt. You’re certainly not going anywhere. Qims and Qals mate for life, after all.
rows.translation: 不过，在开始之前，你请[flurry.name]暂时回到巢穴中属于他的区域。你有些事情想和[frostwyrm.name]商量，而且希望他听不到你们的谈话 – 你还请[frostwyrm.name]为了保密而切断你和他之间的灵能链接。 如你所愿，我们的Qal，他说着，用六条腿撑起身体，朝巢穴后方走去。没过多久，他便离开了视线，但你一直等到再也感觉不到他脚步的震动，也听不见那雷鸣般的脚步回声，才开始说话。 确定这里只剩下你和[frostwyrm.name]后，你挪动身体，靠近她的脖颈。她把修长的头颅弯向你，四只眼睛紧紧盯着你，将全部注意力都放在你身上。 你直截了当地问她：把他作为另一位Qim带进巢群，是否做错了[frostwyrm.andNykke |？把妮凯带进来是否做错了 ]？她是否更希望自己是巢群中唯一的Qim？ 这个问题似乎让她猝不及防：她向后仰起头，双眼睁大，没有立刻回答。她的目光始终只落在你身上，像激光般牢牢锁定、毫不动摇，认真思索着自己的答案。 仿佛过了一分钟，她才呼出一口气，缓慢而长久地眨了眨眼，终于不再那样专注地凝视你。 是的，她终于答道。正如你是我唯一的Qal，我也更希望自己是你唯一的Qim。 但是，没等你回应，她便继续说道，让[flurry.name][frostwyrm.andNykke |和妮凯 ]加入进来并没有错。这两种想法并不相互排斥。[frostwyrm.andNykke |他们曾经 |他曾经 ]和我一样痛苦：我们的处境异乎寻常而又绝望，我们都必须作出孤注一掷的决定来适应它。如果你问[flurry.name]同样的问题，毫无疑问，他也会作出相同的回答。 她把硕大的头颅凑向你，用吻部侧面轻轻蹭着你的身体，亲昵地依偎着你。你能这样顾及我的感受，实在体贴，她继续说道。我暂时还不知道让[flurry.name]与我交配的尝试会如何发展，但无论结果怎样，知道在尝试之前、期间和之后，我的Qal都会陪着我，这令人安心。 你当然不会离开。 毕竟，Qim与Qal会终生相伴。

rows.original: You lack a lot of conscious input in the entire procedure; your body knows what it needs to do and you don’t try to hold yourself back just because you’re not in a hospital or a nursery. Although the situation is no less urgent than any other pregnancy, the whole ordeal is otherwise quite smooth and it’s not nearly as painful as you were expecting – mostly because you’re not pushing out a very small Frostwyrm, but because you’re pushing out an egg the size of [pc.aRace] baby.
rows.translation: 整个过程中，你几乎无法有意识地控制自己；你的身体知道该做什么，而你不会仅仅因为自己不在医院或育婴室里就强行抑制它。尽管情况与其他任何一次分娩同样紧迫，整个过程却相当顺利，也远没有你预想的那么痛苦 – 主要是因为你产下的不是一条很小的霜龙，而是一枚只有[pc.aRace]婴儿那么大的蛋。

Although the situation is no less urgent than any other pregnancy, the whole ordeal is otherwise quite smooth and it’s not nearly as painful as you were expecting – mostly because you’re not pushing out a very small Frostwyrm, but because you’re pushing out an egg the size of [pc.aRace] baby."

rows.original: When the scenario is over, you aren’t left with a kicking, screaming, breathing bundle of joy, but a very large, sturdy egg. It’s pure white all over, with no distinguishing markings around it. In a way, you’re a bit disappointed – you wanted to know what it looked like, what gender it was, and if it came out healthy. The last concern is answered when you hear the telltale melodic sounds, still in your head: despite being physically separated from you, the kip inside is still psionically bonded with you enough to communicate in its wordless way.
rows.translation: 一切结束后，留在你身边的并不是一个会踢蹬、尖叫、呼吸的喜悦结晶，而是一枚非常硕大而坚固的蛋。蛋壳通体纯白，表面没有任何醒目的斑纹。从某种意义上说，你有些失望 – 你原本想知道幼崽长什么样、是什么性别，以及是否健康。最后一个疑问很快有了答案：你听见了那熟悉的、富有旋律的声音，它依旧回荡在脑海里。尽管已经和你在肉体上分离，蛋里的幼崽仍与你维持着足够强的灵能联结，能以那种无言的方式与你交流。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen the scenario is over, you aren’t left with a kicking, screaming, breathing bundle of joy, but a very large, sturdy egg. It’s pure white all over, with no distinguishing markings around it. In a way, you’re a bit disappointed – you wanted to know what it looked like, what gender it was, and if it came out healthy. The last concern is answered when you hear the telltale melodic sounds, still in your head: despite being physically separated from you, the kip inside is still psionically bonded with you enough to communicate in its wordless way."

rows.original: You call for a transit ship to take the egg to Uveto, and program in the coordinates for the shoreline rather than the landing dock. Your thoughts turn to [frostwyrm.name]; you wonder if you should take the egg there yourself, so that you could call for her and have her take the egg from you personally.
rows.translation: 你叫来一艘运输船，把蛋送往乌维托，并把目的地设为海岸线，而不是着陆码头。你的思绪转向[frostwyrm.name]；你不知道自己是否应该亲自把蛋带过去，好呼唤她前来，让她亲手从你这里接走这枚蛋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou call for a transit ship to take the egg to Uveto, and program in the coordinates for the shoreline rather than the landing dock. Your thoughts turn to [frostwyrm.name]; you wonder if you should take the egg there yourself, so that you could call for her and have her take the egg from you personally."

rows.original: Distance will not separate us, you hear [frostwyrm.name] say suddenly, startling you. You briefly glance around your surroundings for her, confused. Inform me when to expect our kip, and I will retrieve her upon our shoreline.
rows.translation: 距离无法将我们分开，你突然听见[frostwyrm.name]说道，吓了你一跳。你困惑地短暂扫视四周，寻找她的身影。告诉我我们的幼崽何时抵达，我会到我们的海岸接她。
rows.raw: "\n\nDistance will not separate us, you hear [frostwyrm.name] say suddenly, startling you. You briefly glance around your surroundings for her, confused. Inform me when to expect our kip, and I will retrieve her upon our shoreline."
