rows.original: A distant beeping rings in your frozen ears. It seems so far and so weak but it prevents you from completely dozing off. Stars, everything feels so cold, as if all heat left your body! Your eyes feel so heavy, so tired. Suddenly, loud turbines and flashing lights feel the arctic void. Hot winds batter your face as a white vessel with lightning patterns lands a few feet away from you. The rear panel opens a moment later, followed by a long, chromed ramp. “The signal’s coming from here. [pc.HeShe] must be close,” a rough, deep voice blares. Smaller flashlights scour the snow near you. “Here! I see something!” a more feminine ranger shouts. “Grimald! Keep the engines hot and ready the hardlight barrow!” Big, fuzzy hands dig the snow around you. They gently pass on your [pc.skinFurScales], wiping the icy flakes from your face before taking your pulse. “Don’t worry [pc.mf |buddy |missy ], we’ve got you. Erda! I need a thermal pack — quickly! Grimald, Orvil, help me carry [pc.himHer] to the ship!” The tender hands strap something to your chest. Suddenly, a miraculous warmth spreads through your frozen bones. You start shivering again — you still feel numb but you can feel your muscles and extremities again. It’s not enough to repel the cold but it’s enough to push back the dark torpor snaking around you. You blink. Your frosted eyelids feel so heavy. Everything looks so blurry but you recognize Grimald’s orange feathers and augmented hands looming over you. He examines you slowly, checking on your fingertips, [pc.isNaga |coils |[pc.feet] ], and chest before telling something to the big, burly dude. The stormguards lift you up a second later. They place you on a glowing stretcher, wrapping you tightly in a metallic blanket before carrying you inside the emergency shuttle. “Does [pc.heShe] need oxygen?” the deer woman asks. “No, [pc.heShe]’s breathing fine,” Grimald replies. “No frostbite or necrosis either, but we can’t be sure until we give [pc.himHer] a proper scan.” [flags.RESCUE_BEACON |“Grimmie, are you su-” “I’ve got this Uther. Take care of [pc.himHer] while I drive us back home. I’m counting on you guys.” |“Grimmie, do you know [pc.himHer]?” The half-anat nods. “Maybe it’s best if I pil-” “NO! No... I’ve got it, don’t worry Uther. Just watch over [pc.name] while I drive us back home. I’m not gonna lose her because someone else flew us too slowly across the tundra.” ] The fuzzy milodan shakes his head. “Alright, let’s go! Erda, Orvil, [silly |10cc of firewater!” “For [pc.himHer]?” his subordinate asks. “No, for me! Then prepare an ironheart infusion for this poor [pc.mf |guy |girl ]! |prepare some ironheart infusion for our patient! ]” he groans. “It’s two green pills and one yellow before ironheart infusion,” Grimald shouts from the driver’s seat. “Check [pc.hisHer] pulse before administering the yellow pill. If it’s over 80 bpm, skip the pill and give [pc.himHer] the infusion.” “Don’t worry, you’re in good hands,” Erda says.
rows.translation: 一阵遥远的哔哔声传入你冻僵的耳朵。声音似乎无比遥远、微弱不堪，却让你无法彻底昏睡过去。星辰在上，一切都是如此寒冷，仿佛身体里的热量全都流失了！你的眼皮无比沉重，疲惫至极。 突然，轰鸣的涡轮与闪烁的灯光充斥了极地的虚空。灼热的风拍打着你的脸，一艘带有闪电纹样的白色飞船在离你几英尺远的地方着陆。片刻后，尾部舱板开启，紧接着伸出一条长长的镀铬坡道。 “信号就是从这里发出的。[pc.HeShe]肯定就在附近，”一个粗犷低沉的声音响起。 几束较小的手电光扫过你附近的积雪。“这里！我看到东西了！”一名嗓音更为女性化的巡林员喊道。 “格里马尔德！让引擎保持热机状态，准备好硬光担架车！” 一双毛茸茸的大手刨开你周围的积雪。它们轻柔地拂过你的[pc.skinFurScales]，擦去你脸上的冰屑，随后探了探你的脉搏。“别担心，[pc.mf |老兄 |姑娘 ]，我们来救你了。埃尔达！我需要一个保温包——快！格里马尔德、奥维尔，帮我把[pc.himHer]抬到船上！” 那双温柔的手把某样东西绑在你的胸前。顿时，一股奇迹般的暖意蔓延进你冰封的骨头。你再次颤抖起来——身体依然麻木，但已经重新感觉到了肌肉和四肢。这样的热量还不足以驱散寒冷，却足以逼退正缠绕着你的黑暗昏沉。 你眨了眨眼。结霜的眼皮沉重不堪。视野中的一切都很模糊，但你还是认出了俯身在你上方的格里马尔德：橙色羽毛和经过强化的双手。他慢慢检查着你，查看你的指尖、[pc.isNaga |蛇躯 |[pc.feet] ]和胸口，随后对那个高大魁梧的家伙说了些什么。一秒后，风暴卫士们将你抬起。他们把你放到一副发光的担架上，用金属毯将你紧紧裹住，然后抬进紧急救援穿梭机。 “[pc.heShe]需要吸氧吗？”鹿女问道。 “不用，[pc.heShe]呼吸正常，”格里马尔德答道。“也没有冻伤或坏死，不过在给[pc.himHer]做完整扫描前还不能确定。” [flags.RESCUE_BEACON |“格里米，你确-” “我能处理，乌瑟。你们照顾好[pc.himHer]，我开船带大家回家。全靠你们了。” |“格里米，你认识[pc.himHer]吗？” 半安纳泰人点了点头。 “也许最好由我来驾-” “不！不...我来，别担心，乌瑟。我开船带大家回家时，你只管照看好[pc.name]。我不会因为别人飞过苔原的速度太慢而失去她。” ] 毛茸茸的米洛丹人摇了摇头。“好，我们走！埃尔达、奥维尔，[silly |给我来10毫升烈酒！” “给[pc.himHer]吗？”他的下属问道。 “不，给我！然后为这个可怜的[pc.mf |小伙子 |姑娘 ]准备铁心输液！ |给我们的病人准备铁心输液！ ]”他呻吟道。 “铁心输液前要服两颗绿色药丸和一颗黄色药丸，”格里马尔德从驾驶座喊道。“使用黄色药丸前检查[pc.hisHer]的脉搏。如果超过每分钟80次，就跳过药丸，直接给[pc.himHer]输液。” “别担心，你会得到妥善照顾的，”埃尔达说道。

rows.original: , cleans you up, slowly and methodically, scrubbing you down and helping to work feeling back into your limbs. When you finally regain some control of your still jelly-like arms, you return the favor, helping to wash all of her hard to reach places.
rows.translation: , 缓慢而有条不紊地为你清洗，擦净身体并帮四肢逐渐恢复知觉。当你终于重新获得对依旧软得像果冻般的手臂的些许控制时，也投桃报李，帮她清洗所有难以触及的位置。
rows.raw: ", cleans you up, slowly and methodically, scrubbing you down and helping to work feeling back into your limbs. When you finally regain some control of your still jelly-like arms, you return the favor, helping to wash all of her hard to reach places."

rows.original: Eventually though she turns the steamy water off and directs you out of her shower.
rows.translation: 不过最终，她还是关掉了热气腾腾的水流，示意你离开她的淋浴间。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually though she turns the steamy water off and directs you out of her shower."

rows.original: She points you to her packs and you make with retrieving all of your gear. Tucked under your stuff is a little parcel intended for you, PET simply written across the top of it. Inside is a modified version of the harness you’ve become intimately familiar with whilst under the taur; each of the magnetic clasps has a tiny status light hidden on the corner, all of them dim. You slip it on automatically and you realize it’s sized perfectly for you, your suspicions about the clasps confirmed when you bend your arm double but the tell-tale smack of the clasps locking together is absent.
rows.translation: 她指了指自己的行囊，你便去取回全部装备。你的东西下面塞着一个给你的小包裹，顶部只写着“宠物”二字。里面是一件改装过的束具，正是你在这位牛兽身下时已经无比熟悉的款式；每个磁力扣角落里都藏着一盏微小的状态灯，此刻全都暗着。你下意识地穿上它，发现尺寸与你完美贴合；当你把手臂彻底折起，却没有听见锁扣合拢时那声标志性的轻响，这也证实了你对这些扣子的猜测。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points you to her packs and you make with retrieving all of your gear. Tucked under your stuff is a little parcel intended for you, PET simply written across the top of it. Inside is a modified version of the harness you’ve become intimately familiar with whilst under the taur; each of the magnetic clasps has a tiny status light hidden on the corner, all of them dim. You slip it on automatically and you realize it’s sized perfectly for you, your suspicions about the clasps confirmed when you bend your arm double but the tell-tale smack of the clasps locking together is absent."

rows.original: You slip the garment back off for later and don the rest of your gear.
rows.translation: 你把这件衣物脱下来留待以后使用，然后穿好其余装备。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slip the garment back off for later and don the rest of your gear. "

rows.original: She points you to her packs and you make with retrieving all of your gear, suiting back up and getting ready to return to your travels.
rows.translation: 她指了指自己的行囊，你便取回全部装备，重新穿戴整齐，准备继续旅程。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points you to her packs and you make with retrieving all of your gear, suiting back up and getting ready to return to your travels."

rows.translation: ，你返回伊尔斯泰德冰冷彻骨的街道，身体仍有些酸痛，却庆幸自己安然无恙。

rows.original: Jerynn grabs the leash and wraps it tightly around her hand, keeping you close to her side. She leads you out of the bathroom and back into the main room of her apartment, everything in here sized appropriately for a near nine foot tall draconic-taur. The middle of the room sports a giant, sunken pit, stuffed full of pillows and blankets. Its bottom is a giant mattress filling the entire recess as the taur steps down into it, the fabric puffing out around her foot paw as she does. You feel tiny by comparison, a sense that only grows stronger when you hop down into the pillow-stuffed pit.
rows.translation: 杰琳抓起牵绳，紧紧缠在手上，让你贴在她身边。她领着你走出浴室，回到公寓的主厅；这里的一切都是按一名近九英尺高的龙形牛兽设计的。房间中央有一处巨大的下沉坑，里面塞满枕头和毯子。坑底是一张铺满整个凹处的巨型床垫；牛兽迈进去时，织物从她的足爪四周鼓起。相比之下，你显得无比渺小；当你跳进这座堆满枕头的坑里时，这种感觉只变得更加强烈。
rows.raw: " Jerynn grabs the leash and wraps it tightly around her hand, keeping you close to her side. She leads you out of the bathroom and back into the main room of her apartment, everything in here sized appropriately for a near nine foot tall draconic-taur. The middle of the room sports a giant, sunken pit, stuffed full of pillows and blankets. Its bottom is a giant mattress filling the entire recess as the taur steps down into it, the fabric puffing out around her foot paw as she does. You feel tiny by comparison, a sense that only grows stronger when you hop down into the pillow-stuffed pit."

rows.original: Jerynn props her upper body up in one of the corners, easily tall enough to lean on the outside edge of it. She pats the mattress in front of her and you take that as an order, struggling to get your limbs under you on the soft surface; you make it, with something of a struggle that the taur finds hilarious, laughing to herself at your misfortune.
rows.translation: 杰琳在一个角落里支起上身，她高得足以倚靠凹坑外沿。她拍了拍面前的床垫，你把这当成命令，在柔软的表面上费力撑起四肢；虽然颇费了一番力气，你还是成功了，而这位牛兽却觉得你的窘境十分好笑，幸灾乐祸地低声笑着。
rows.raw: "\n\nJerynn props her upper body up in one of the corners, easily tall enough to lean on the outside edge of it. She pats the mattress in front of her and you take that as an order, struggling to get your limbs under you on the soft surface; you make it, with something of a struggle that the taur finds hilarious, laughing to herself at your misfortune."

rows.original: “Good [pc.boy],” she praises, and you beam in response. Even [pc.barkMeow].
rows.translation: “好[pc.boy]，”她夸奖道，你顿时喜形于色，甚至还[pc.barkMeow]了一声。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good [pc.boy],” she praises, and you beam in response. Even [pc.barkMeow]."

rows.original: “No more talkin’, I’m tired, you’re tired, long day. Come on,” she suggests, a hand rubbing against her flank as an invitation.
rows.translation: “别再说话了，我累了，你也累了，今天够漫长的。过来，”她提议道，一只手摩挲着自己的侧腹，示意你靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No more talkin’, I’m tired, you’re tired, long day. Come on,” she suggests, a hand rubbing against her flank as an invitation."

rows.original: You hadn’t noticed but your body does feel exhausted. You’re curled up under Mistress’s underbelly before you’ve even had chance to think, her thick tail lazily curling all around you.
rows.translation: 你之前没有注意到，但身体确实已经疲惫不堪。你还来不及思考，便蜷缩到了女主人的腹部下方，她粗壮的尾巴懒洋洋地盘绕在你四周。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hadn’t noticed but your body does feel exhausted. You’re curled up under Mistress’s underbelly before you’ve even had chance to think, her thick tail lazily curling all around you."

rows.original: The leash comes unclipped from your collar and left on the high-ground, out of your reach. She leans a bit further and a dataslate returns in her grasp, a few seconds of idle taps against it and a large screen bursts into life, almost entirely filling the wall facing her. Various shows are indexed down the side, but the main view is full of galnet browsers; she’s flipping through them and pulls out one for a food delivery service here in Irestead. The others, though, really capture your attention. A few pharmaceutical companies, all of them specializing in transformatives... some clothing outlets, mostly specializing in garments fit for the tauricly-abled.... One window really catches your eye though; a forum dedicated to pet-play fetishism. Not surprising, really.
rows.translation: 牵绳从你的项圈上解下，被留在高处，远远超出你的触及范围。她又探身过去，拿回一块数据板，随意点按几下后，一面几乎占满她对面整堵墙的大屏幕骤然亮起。侧边列着各种节目，但主画面满是银河网浏览器；她逐一翻看，调出伊尔斯泰德本地的一家送餐服务。可真正吸引你注意的却是其他窗口。几家制药公司，全都专攻变形药物...还有一些服装商店，大多专门销售适合牛兽体型的衣服....不过，其中一个窗口格外引人注目；那是一个专门讨论宠物扮演癖好的论坛。其实也并不意外。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe leash comes unclipped from your collar and left on the high-ground, out of your reach. She leans a bit further and a dataslate returns in her grasp, a few seconds of idle taps against it and a large screen bursts into life, almost entirely filling the wall facing her. Various shows are indexed down the side, but the main view is full of galnet browsers; she’s flipping through them and pulls out one for a food delivery service here in Irestead. The others, though, really capture your attention. A few pharmaceutical companies, all of them specializing in transformatives... some clothing outlets, mostly specializing in garments fit for the tauricly-abled.... One window really catches your eye though; a forum dedicated to pet-play fetishism. Not surprising, really."

rows.original: What does draw your attention though are the few child windows connected to it; things Mistress is obviously keeping a close eye on. There’s one specifically about training tips. Another focuses on physical modifications and equipment. The one at the top of the list really stands out though, discussing the legalities of owning a sapient pet.
rows.translation: 真正引起你注意的，是与之关联的几个子窗口；显然都是女主人密切关注的内容。其中一个专门讨论训练技巧，另一个聚焦身体改造与装备。列表最上面的那个尤其醒目，讨论的是拥有一只智慧宠物的法律问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat does draw your attention though are the few child windows connected to it; things Mistress is obviously keeping a close eye on. There’s one specifically about training tips. Another focuses on physical modifications and equipment. The one at the top of the list really stands out though, discussing the legalities of owning a sapient pet."

rows.original: The screen chimes a happy little jingle, breaking you from your concentration. The window she was tapping away at now filled with a giant ‘Thank you for your order!’ message and a delivery eta. No longer focused on the food order, she spots just what it is you’re looking at and laughs to herself.
rows.translation: 屏幕响起一段欢快的小曲，把你从专注中惊醒。她刚才不断点按的窗口里，如今显示着巨大的“感谢您的订单！”信息和预计送达时间。不再关注餐点订单后，她发现了你正在看的内容，忍不住笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe screen chimes a happy little jingle, breaking you from your concentration. The window she was tapping away at now filled with a giant ‘Thank you for your order!’ message and a delivery eta. No longer focused on the food order, she spots just what it is you’re looking at and laughs to herself."

rows.original: “What do you think? You like being a pet? You can speak normally,” she says.
rows.translation: “你觉得怎么样？喜欢当宠物吗？现在可以正常说话，”她说道。

rows.raw: "“Not particularly,” you reply. “I just like a good fuck, but I have my own life to live. Your desires align with mine from time to time, so why not indulge a little?”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, your desires Mistress.” you correct. “It’s nice being able to hang it all up for a while and take a break, but I have my own worries, my own commitments to live up to.”"

rows.translation: “不过你肯定能体会其中的讽刺吧？选择被夺走，竟然反而成了所能想象到的最自由的事情？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Surely you can appreciate the irony though? To have choice taken away somehow being the most liberating thing imaginable?”"

The other has seen some extensive medical work though, their arms and legs having been replaced entirely with robotic facsimiles of

rows.raw: "\n\nTwo images of petgirls blow up to fill the screen side-by-side. The one on the left is wrapped up tightly in a shiny layer of latex, the arms and legs of the occupant obviously doubled up similar to the harness you’ve been wearing, albeit with much more material covering the rest of the body. The other has seen some extensive medical work though, their arms and legs having been replaced entirely with robotic facsimiles of "

rows.original: feline
rows.translation: 猫类型
rows.raw: "feline"

rows.original: canine
rows.translation: 犬类型
rows.raw: "canine"

rows.original: limbs, effectively adapting their body to a life permanently spent as a quadruped.
rows.translation: 肢体的机械复制品，实际上让她的身体适应了永久以四足姿态生活。
rows.raw: " limbs, effectively adapting their body to a life permanently spent as a quadruped."

rows.original: “I’m interested to see your point of view on these kinds of adaptations, pet. What do you think would be most appropriate?”
rows.translation: “我很想听听你对这类改造的看法，宠物。你觉得哪一种最合适？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m interested to see your point of view on these kinds of adaptations, pet. What do you think would be most appropriate?”"

rows.original: Bitchsuit
rows.translation: 母犬服
rows.raw: "Bitchsuit"

rows.original: Cybernetics
rows.translation: 义体改造
rows.raw: "Cybernetics"

rows.original: Owner
rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Owner"

rows.original: “The harness would be the better of the two, I think,” you answer after a moment’s consideration. “At least that way, no matter what, they would always have the ability to rely on themselves, Mistress, no matter what happened.”
rows.translation: “我觉得两者之中束具更好，”你思考片刻后回答。“至少这样，无论发生什么，它们永远都有依靠自己的能力，女主人。”
rows.raw: "“The harness would be the better of the two, I think,” you answer after a moment’s consideration. “At least that way, no matter what, they would always have the ability to rely on themselves, Mistress, no matter what happened.”"

rows.original: “The cybernetics would be the better of the two, I think,” you answer after a moment’s consideration. “As... drastic a change as replacement may be, they look like they would allow for a lot more movement than the harness.”
rows.translation: “我觉得两者之中义体更好，”你思考片刻后回答。“虽然替换肢体是种...剧烈的改变，但它们看起来能提供比束具大得多的活动能力。”
rows.raw: "“The cybernetics would be the better of the two, I think,” you answer after a moment’s consideration. “As... drastic a change as replacement may be, they look like they would allow for a lot more movement than the harness.”"

rows.original: “Fundamentally Mistress, I think it would be down to the whims of the owner and what they expect of their pet,” you answer after a moment’s consideration.
rows.translation: “归根结底，女主人，我认为这取决于主人的意愿，以及主人对宠物有什么期待，”你思考片刻后回答。
rows.raw: "“Fundamentally Mistress, I think it would be down to the whims of the owner and what they expect of their pet,” you answer after a moment’s consideration."

rows.original: Jerynn hmms under her breath, thinking for a moment herself.
rows.translation: 杰琳在喉咙里轻轻哼了一声，自己也思考了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nJerynn hmms under her breath, thinking for a moment herself."

rows.original: “I have to say I’ve been partial to the cybernetics option myself. The suit is much cheaper, but you’ve seen how difficult it is to get around on your own. Can’t wear them constantly either, causes problems with the limbs to stay bent like that for too long.”
rows.translation: “我得说，我自己一直更偏爱义体方案。束具便宜得多，可你也亲身体会过，穿着它独自行动有多困难。也不能一直穿着；四肢长时间那样弯着会出问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have to say I’ve been partial to the cybernetics option myself. The suit is much cheaper, but you’ve seen how difficult it is to get around on your own. Can’t wear them constantly either, causes problems with the limbs to stay bent like that for too long.”"

rows.original: Now that she mentions it, your hands do feel a little weird.
rows.translation: 经她这么一说，你的双手确实感觉有些怪异。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that she mentions it, your hands do feel a little weird."

rows.original: “Something to be said for the routine, though. Daily personal preparation of your pet, making sure they’re healthy whilst you slip ‘em into the suit,” she continues, obviously having spent a huge amount of time considering the two options herself.
rows.translation: “不过那套日常流程也有可取之处。每天亲手给宠物做准备，在把它们塞进束具时确认它们健康无恙，”她继续说道；显然，她自己早已花大量时间权衡过这两种选择。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something to be said for the routine, though. Daily personal preparation of your pet, making sure they’re healthy whilst you slip ‘em into the suit,” she continues, obviously having spent a huge amount of time considering the two options herself."

rows.original: She goes back to tapping away at the tablet again as she continues. “The cybernetics though, now that’s where the fun is. Limbs that actually work like the pet needs ‘em to work and none of the health issues. The part I like the most though is it’s a one way trip; can’t easily graft flesh and blood back to implants. Gotta stick to wetware for the rest of your days after that.”
rows.translation: 她再次点按平板，同时继续说道。“但义体嘛，那才是真正有趣的地方。肢体能按宠物需要的方式正常运作，也没有那些健康问题。我最喜欢的地方，是这趟旅程有去无回；植入义体后，可没法轻易把血肉重新接回去。往后余生都得坚持使用湿件了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe goes back to tapping away at the tablet again as she continues. “The cybernetics though, now that’s where the fun is. Limbs that actually work like the pet needs ‘em to work and none of the health issues. The part I like the most though is it’s a one way trip; can’t easily graft flesh and blood back to implants. Gotta stick to wetware for the rest of your days after that.”"

rows.original: The two windows slide back to their minimized state, replaced with only a single view this time. A grid of marketing images for a variety of transformative products, each spinning around independently and highlighting various features. Three of them are surrounded by a colorful border, probably indicating that they’ve been viewed in the past.
rows.translation: 两个窗口滑回最小化状态，这次只被一幅画面取代。那是各种变形产品宣传图组成的网格，每件产品都独立旋转，突出展示不同特征。其中三件被彩色边框圈住，大概表示以前浏览过。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two windows slide back to their minimized state, replaced with only a single view this time. A grid of marketing images for a variety of transformative products, each spinning around independently and highlighting various features. Three of them are surrounded by a colorful border, probably indicating that they’ve been viewed in the past."

rows.original: The first is skin, pretty much. The model flips through some options like pigmentation, thicknesses and such, but pretty much just plain old human skin.
rows.translation: 第一种基本上就是皮肤。模型轮换展示色素、厚度之类的选项，但总体而言，就是普通的人类皮肤。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe first is skin, pretty much. The model flips through some options like pigmentation, thicknesses and such, but pretty much just plain old human skin."

rows.original: The next is more interesting and offers far more options. Various lengths and shades of fur, and dozens of other connected options. Patterns, textures, even down to variations in the length based on body area.
rows.translation: 第二种更有意思，也提供了丰富得多的选择。各种长度与色调的毛发，以及几十项相关选项。花纹、质地，甚至细化到身体不同部位的毛长差异。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next is more interesting and offers far more options. Various lengths and shades of fur, and dozens of other connected options. Patterns, textures, even down to variations in the length based on body area."

rows.original: The final one offers almost as many options again, this time for scales. Pigmentation, patterns, sub-patterns, thicknesses, roughness, even down to the shape of the scales on different parts of the body.
rows.translation: 最后一种再次提供了几乎同样丰富的选项，这次针对的是鳞片。色素、花纹、次级花纹、厚度、粗糙度，甚至细化到身体不同部位鳞片的形状。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe final one offers almost as many options again, this time for scales. Pigmentation, patterns, sub-patterns, thicknesses, roughness, even down to the shape of the scales on different parts of the body."

rows.original: “Similar theme, pet. Interesting to see what you can make of each,” she asks.
rows.translation: “还是相似的主题，宠物。我想看看你能如何评价每一种，”她问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Similar theme, pet. Interesting to see what you can make of each,” she asks."

rows.original: Skin
rows.translation: 皮肤
rows.raw: "Skin"

rows.original: Fur
rows.translation: 毛发
rows.raw: "Fur"

rows.original: Scales
rows.translation: 鳞片
rows.raw: "Scales"

rows.original: Owner
rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Owner"

rows.original: It takes a while but you finally settle on an argument for a favorite.
rows.translation: 你花了好一阵子，最终才为自己最喜欢的选项整理出一套理由。
rows.raw: "It takes a while but you finally settle on an argument for a favorite."

rows.original: “Skin would be most appropriate, Mistress. Fur would be so difficult to wash and dry, and scales I imagine get caught on things,” you answer, finally.
rows.translation: “皮肤最合适，女主人。毛发清洗和吹干太麻烦了，而且我想鳞片容易勾住东西，”你终于回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Skin would be most appropriate, Mistress. Fur would be so difficult to wash and dry, and scales I imagine get caught on things,” you answer, finally."

rows.original: “Fur would be most appropriate, Mistress. Soft and fluffy suits a pet much better than skin or scale,” you answer, finally.
rows.translation: “毛发最合适，女主人。柔软又蓬松，比皮肤或鳞片更符合宠物的形象，”你终于回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fur would be most appropriate, Mistress. Soft and fluffy suits a pet much better than skin or scale,” you answer, finally."

rows.original: “Scales would be most appropriate, Mistress. Fur would be so difficult to wash and dry, and skin just seems too... pedestrian,” you answer, finally.
rows.translation: “鳞片最合适，女主人。毛发清洗和吹干太麻烦了，而皮肤又显得太...平庸，”你终于回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Scales would be most appropriate, Mistress. Fur would be so difficult to wash and dry, and skin just seems too... pedestrian,” you answer, finally."

rows.original: “They all have benefits I think, Mistress. Only really the owner would know which would suit their pet the best, as the owner is the only person who can answer how they wish to care for their pet,” you answer, finally.
rows.translation: “我觉得每一种都有优点，女主人。只有主人才真正知道哪一种最适合自己的宠物，因为只有主人能回答自己希望如何照顾宠物，”你终于回答道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“They all have benefits I think, Mistress. Only really the owner would know which would suit their pet the best, as the owner is the only person who can answer how they wish to care for their pet,” you answer, finally."

rows.original: “Scales. Definitely scales,” she retorts quickly. “Fur’s too ticklish against mine, makes it really hard to enjoy a snuggle with your pet. Skin is pretty fragile in my experience. Yeah, it makes it real easy to figure out when your
rows.translation: “鳞片。绝对是鳞片，”她立刻反驳。“毛发蹭着我的鳞片太痒了，想好好抱抱宠物都变得很困难。依我的经验，皮肤相当脆弱。没错，要是你的
rows.raw: "\n\n“Scales. Definitely scales,” she retorts quickly. “Fur’s too ticklish against mine, makes it really hard to enjoy a snuggle with your pet. Skin is pretty fragile in my experience. Yeah, it makes it real easy to figure out when your "

rows.translation: 小猫

rows.original: tripped over their own feet and landed face first on the floor when the bruise shows up, but there’ll be nothing actually wrong beyond the bruise.”
rows.translation: 被自己的脚绊倒，一头栽在地板上，瘀青一出现就很容易看出来，但除了瘀青之外其实不会有什么问题。”
rows.raw: " tripped over their own feet and landed face first on the floor when the bruise shows up, but there’ll be nothing actually wrong beyond the bruise.”"

rows.original: You find yourself nodding in agreement.
rows.translation: 你发现自己赞同地点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find yourself nodding in agreement."

rows.original: “Scales though, scales are pretty tough. Take it from me. And the modders are real up on their stuff when it comes to getting exactly what you want.”
rows.translation: “但鳞片嘛，鳞片相当坚韧。相信我。而且改造师在精确实现客户需求这方面非常在行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Scales though, scales are pretty tough. Take it from me. And the modders are real up on their stuff when it comes to getting exactly what you want.”"

rows.original: The model definitely seemed to agree with the sentiment; far more color options and combinations. Mixed-color designs would probably be a lot easier to get right too compared to fur.
rows.translation: 模型显然也赞同这种看法；它提供的颜色选项与组合远为丰富。与毛发相比，混色设计大概也更容易准确实现。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe model definitely seemed to agree with the sentiment; far more color options and combinations. Mixed-color designs would probably be a lot easier to get right too compared to fur."

rows.original: She goes back to the tablet again, but before the screen can change again a chime from the apartment door interrupts. “Don’t go anywhere, pet,” she chuckles to herself, rolling to her feet and walking off to answer. The mattress is soon weighed down by her frame again, an exceedingly large bag in one hand, the bowl you’d so dutifully cleaned earlier in the other. Delicious, rich wafts of odor escape the bag and your stomach rumbles angrily, the thirst from earlier returned as hunger with just as pressing a need to sate it.
rows.translation: 她再次低头操作平板，可屏幕还没来得及变化，公寓门口的提示音便打断了她。“别乱跑，宠物，”她轻笑着站起身，走去应门。不久，她的身躯再次压上床垫，一只手提着一个大得夸张的袋子，另一只手拿着你先前尽职舔净的碗。袋子里飘出阵阵浓郁诱人的香气，你的胃愤怒地咕咕叫起来；先前的口渴如今化作饥饿，同样迫切地需要满足。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe goes back to the tablet again, but before the screen can change again a chime from the apartment door interrupts. “Don’t go anywhere, pet,” she chuckles to herself, rolling to her feet and walking off to answer. The mattress is soon weighed down by her frame again, an exceedingly large bag in one hand, the bowl you’d so dutifully cleaned earlier in the other. Delicious, rich wafts of odor escape the bag and your stomach rumbles angrily, the thirst from earlier returned as hunger with just as pressing a need to sate it."

rows.original: She digs through the contents of the bag for a minute, judging your reaction to a dozen different foodstuffs in the bag. Whichever she deems you had the strongest reaction to ends up partially scooped out into your bowl, carefully positioned where Mistress can keep an eye on you whilst she eats her fill. She eats messily with her hands, offering you bits and pieces of the other trays as she devours her way through the majority, every bit delicious, and every time you end up licking her fingers clean.
rows.translation: 她花了一分钟翻找袋中内容，一边观察你对袋里十几种食物的反应。她认为最能让你兴奋的那一种，被舀出一部分放进你的碗里，并被仔细摆在女主人用餐时也能看着你的位置。她直接用手狼吞虎咽，吃相凌乱；在消灭大部分食物的过程中，她还会递给你其他餐盒里的零碎。每一口都美味无比，而你每次最后都会把她的手指舔干净。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe digs through the contents of the bag for a minute, judging your reaction to a dozen different foodstuffs in the bag. Whichever she deems you had the strongest reaction to ends up partially scooped out into your bowl, carefully positioned where Mistress can keep an eye on you whilst she eats her fill. She eats messily with her hands, offering you bits and pieces of the other trays as she devours her way through the majority, every bit delicious, and every time you end up licking her fingers clean."

rows.original: “So,” she starts between bites, “what do you think of a pet that can’t physically talk anymore?” She quickly sucks a few bits of sauce off a finger, just enough to poke at the tablet without covering it in food in the process. Three windows pop up on the screen, three different options.
rows.translation: “那么，”她在咀嚼间隙开口，“你觉得一只生理上再也无法说话的宠物怎么样？”她迅速吮去手指上的少许酱汁，刚好清理到可以点按平板、又不会把食物涂满屏幕的程度。屏幕上弹出三个窗口，展示三种不同选项。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So,” she starts between bites, “what do you think of a pet that can’t physically talk anymore?” She quickly sucks a few bits of sauce off a finger, just enough to poke at the tablet without covering it in food in the process. Three windows pop up on the screen, three different options."

rows.original: The first is a company that produces high-tech communication devices. They seem to specialize in sub-vocal equipment, the kind of stuff that doesn’t actually needs you to make a noise to transmit speech, relying on a series of sensors around the neck- almost like a collar. One of the items states that it actually suppresses vocalizations entirely in the process, allowing speech to be sent without making a sound louder than an exhaled breath in the process. The only noises it wouldn’t suppress are noises it doesn’t detect as speech.
rows.translation: 第一个来自一家制造高科技通讯设备的公司。它们似乎专攻次声发声设备，也就是无需真正发出声音便能传递话语的那类东西，依靠环绕颈部的一系列传感器——几乎就像项圈。其中一件产品声称，它甚至能在传输过程中彻底抑制发声，让使用者在发送话语时，声音不会大过呼出的一口气。唯一不会被抑制的，是设备没有识别为语言的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe first is a company that produces high-tech communication devices. They seem to specialize in sub-vocal equipment, the kind of stuff that doesn’t actually needs you to make a noise to transmit speech, relying on a series of sensors around the neck- almost like a collar. One of the items states that it actually suppresses vocalizations entirely in the process, allowing speech to be sent without making a sound louder than an exhaled breath in the process. The only noises it wouldn’t suppress are noises it doesn’t detect as speech."

rows.original: One seems much more extreme, another transformative company. The page is mostly full of enhancements for singers and the like, offering larger potential ranges, higher notes, that kind of thing. Some offer to allow a consumer to emulate various fantastical beasts- at a cost, though. Generally removing the ability for normal speech in the process.
rows.translation: 另一项则极端得多，来自另一家变形公司。页面大部分内容都是为歌手之类的人提供的增强改造，能扩大潜在音域、唱出更高音调，诸如此类。有些产品能让消费者模仿各种幻想生物——但也要付出代价，通常会在过程中失去正常说话的能力。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne seems much more extreme, another transformative company. The page is mostly full of enhancements for singers and the like, offering larger potential ranges, higher notes, that kind of thing. Some offer to allow a consumer to emulate various fantastical beasts- at a cost, though. Generally removing the ability for normal speech in the process."

rows.original: The final window is just another thread from the petplay forum you spotted earlier, extolling the idea that it’s best not to force a prospective pet into losing their voice, and instead placing emphasis on it being the only choice they have to make on a regular basis. Knowing that they could speak, but that they don’t... unless allowed.
rows.translation: 最后一个窗口只是你先前看到的宠物扮演论坛里的另一篇讨论帖，极力主张最好不要强迫潜在宠物失去声音，而应强调这是它们日常唯一需要主动做出的选择。明知道自己可以说话，却选择保持沉默...除非得到允许。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe final window is just another thread from the petplay forum you spotted earlier, extolling the idea that it’s best not to force a prospective pet into losing their voice, and instead placing emphasis on it being the only choice they have to make on a regular basis. Knowing that they could speak, but that they don’t... unless allowed."

rows.raw: "Collar"

rows.original: Mods
rows.translation: 身体模组
rows.raw: "Mods"

rows.original: Choice
rows.translation: 选择
rows.raw: "Choice"

rows.original: Owner
rows.translation: 主人
rows.raw: "Owner"

rows.original: “The collar is interesting, I think. It takes choice away but I guess you could always listen in if the need arose,” you answer.
rows.translation: “我觉得项圈很有意思。它会剥夺选择，但我想有需要时总能进行监听，”你回答道。
rows.raw: "“The collar is interesting, I think. It takes choice away but I guess you could always listen in if the need arose,” you answer."

rows.original: “The mods are interesting, I think. There’s a sense of... permanence to them, of finality,” you answer. “At least as permanent as a mod goes these days.”
rows.translation: “我觉得改造很有意思。它们有一种...永久性，一种尘埃落定的感觉，”你回答道。“至少以如今的改造标准而言，算得上永久。”
rows.raw: "“The mods are interesting, I think. There’s a sense of... permanence to them, of finality,” you answer. “At least as permanent as a mod goes these days.”"

rows.original: “I think leaving it up to the pet is most interesting. To be given some power over their lifestyle is important, at least as far as demonstrating their commitment to their owner on a regular basis,” you answer.
rows.translation: “我觉得把决定权留给宠物最有意思。让宠物对自己的生活方式保留一点权力很重要，至少能够让它定期证明自己对主人的忠诚，”你回答道。
rows.raw: "“I think leaving it up to the pet is most interesting. To be given some power over their lifestyle is important, at least as far as demonstrating their commitment to their owner on a regular basis,” you answer."

rows.original: “Only the owner can really decide, I think. The best choice would depend entirely on how much time they were willing to dedicate, and how well they understood their pet,” you answer.
rows.translation: “我觉得只有主人才能真正做决定。最佳选择完全取决于主人愿意投入多少时间，以及他们有多了解自己的宠物，”你回答道。
rows.raw: "“Only the owner can really decide, I think. The best choice would depend entirely on how much time they were willing to dedicate, and how well they understood their pet,” you answer."

rows.raw: " I lean towards the collars I think. Gives both the pet and the owner a viable connection so I wouldn’t have to keep such a close eye all the time, ya know? Give the freedom to be out without having to worry what mischief your little "

rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been looking forward to this for a while,” she says with a smirk. The ever-so-slight tent in her jeans assures you she very much so has been."

rows.original: You grab a handful of half-ausar ass as Kaede hops out of her chair, making her auburn tail jump and wiggle over your arm. She blushes, and the two of you quickly make your way out of the cafe and out towards the lengthy docking arm once again. As you’re walking, Kaede’s hand slips down to yours, lacing her fingers through yours. She nestles into your shoulder and follows your lead back to where you met, where your ship and hers are parked just a stone’s throw apart.
rows.translation: 枫抓了一把半奥萨人的屁股，她从椅子上跳起来，栗色尾巴随之弹起，在你的手臂上扭动。她红着脸，和你迅速离开咖啡馆，再次朝长长的对接臂走去。走着走着，枫的手滑下来牵住你，十指与你相扣。她依偎在你肩头，由你领着回到初遇之处；你和她的飞船都停在那里，相距不过咫尺。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grab a handful of half-ausar ass as Kaede hops out of her chair, making her auburn tail jump and wiggle over your arm. She blushes, and the two of you quickly make your way out of the cafe and out towards the lengthy docking arm once again. As you’re walking, Kaede’s hand slips down to yours, lacing her fingers through yours. She nestles into your shoulder and follows your lead back to where you met, where your ship and hers are parked just a stone’s throw apart."

rows.original: Glancing out the docking viewport, you’re treated to a view of Kaede’s vessel in all its beat-up glory. She’s an old Casstech Lancer, covered in a racer-like paintjob of red and white. A meaty looking laser turret sits under the cabin, considerably bigger than your average stock freighter ought to be packing. The words “Talon Rogue” are written in bold white letters on the long neck between the cabin and the main hold. Kaede flips a keychain out of her pocket and swipes it over a keypad next to the airlock. The ship beeps at you, and the station’s security doors slide open.
rows.translation: 透过对接口舷窗望去，枫那艘饱经风霜的飞船尽收眼底。那是一艘老旧的卡斯科技枪骑兵级，表面涂着赛车风格的红白涂装。驾驶舱下方装着一座颇为粗壮的激光炮塔，比普通原装货船该配备的大得多。驾驶舱与主货舱之间的长颈上，以粗体白字写着“利爪浪客号”。枫从口袋里掏出一串钥匙，在气闸旁的键盘上刷过。飞船朝你们响了一声，空间站的安全门随之滑开。
rows.raw: "\n\nGlancing out the docking viewport, you’re treated to a view of Kaede’s vessel in all its beat-up glory. She’s an old Casstech Lancer, covered in a racer-like paintjob of red and white. A meaty looking laser turret sits under the cabin, considerably bigger than your average stock freighter ought to be packing. The words “Talon Rogue” are written in bold white letters on the long neck between the cabin and the main hold. Kaede flips a keychain out of her pocket and swipes it over a keypad next to the airlock. The ship beeps at you, and the station’s security doors slide open."

rows.original: “After you, Captain,” your companion smiles, sweeping one of her arms ahead like an old-Earth valet. You
rows.translation: “您先请，船长。”同伴微笑着说，像旧地球的侍者一样将一条手臂向前一挥。你
rows.raw: "\n\n“After you, Captain,” your companion smiles, sweeping one of her arms ahead like an old-Earth valet. You"

rows.original: give her a mock
rows.translation: 装模作样地向她
rows.raw: " give her a mock "

rows.original: bow
rows.translation: 鞠躬
rows.raw: "bow"

rows.original: curtsy
rows.translation: 行屈膝礼
rows.raw: "curtsy"

rows.original: and
rows.translation: ，然后
rows.raw: " and"

rows.original: step aboard.
rows.translation: 登上飞船。
rows.raw: " step aboard."

rows.original: The interior of Talon Rogue is delightfully comfortable looking, the very definition of a bachelor pad. A circular couch surrounds a big holo projector, wired up to several game controllers lying atop a sea of holovid and game cases. A half-eaten box of Ausari stir-fry has been lazily left on top of the projector, making the glowing blue lights flicker oddly over the ceiling.
rows.translation: 利爪浪客号的内部看起来舒适宜人，堪称单身汉公寓的典范。一张环形沙发围着大型全息投影仪，投影仪接着好几个游戏控制器，散落在一大片全息影碟和游戏盒上。一盒没吃完的奥萨炒菜被懒洋洋地扔在投影仪顶上，让闪烁的蓝光在天花板上投出古怪的光影。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe interior of Talon Rogue is delightfully comfortable looking, the very definition of a bachelor pad. A circular couch surrounds a big holo projector, wired up to several game controllers lying atop a sea of holovid and game cases. A half-eaten box of Ausari stir-fry has been lazily left on top of the projector, making the glowing blue lights flicker oddly over the ceiling."

rows.original: “Sorry about the mess,” Kaede laughs, grabbing the food off her projector-turned-table and throwing it into a mini-fridge up against the far wall. She squirms out of her tight leather jacket and hangs it up next to the airlock, following it with a loaded gunbelt you hadn’t even noticed. Once she’s down to jeans and her T-shirt, she starts heading for her cabin, pausing just long enough to ask, “I’m going to go slip into something more... comfortable. Want me to bring back a little social lubrication; or just the fun kind?”
rows.translation: “抱歉，这里有点乱。”枫笑着把食物从兼作桌子的投影仪上拿起来，扔进远墙边的小冰箱。她扭着身子脱下紧身皮夹克，挂到气闸旁，随后又解下你之前甚至没注意到的实弹枪带。等身上只剩牛仔裤和T恤，她便朝自己的舱室走去，临走前停下来问道：“我要去换一身更...舒服的衣服。要我带点社交润滑剂回来，还是只带好玩的那种？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry about the mess,” Kaede laughs, grabbing the food off her projector-turned-table and throwing it into a mini-fridge up against the far wall. She squirms out of her tight leather jacket and hangs it up next to the airlock, following it with a loaded gunbelt you hadn’t even noticed. Once she’s down to jeans and her T-shirt, she starts heading for her cabin, pausing just long enough to ask, “I’m going to go slip into something more... comfortable. Want me to bring back a little social lubrication; or just the fun kind?”"

rows.original: You nod, and let Kaede slip away through a hatch into a side chamber near the back of the ship. You flop down onto the couch while you wait, slipping your arms around the back of the seat
rows.translation: 你点点头，让枫穿过舱门，走进飞船后部附近的侧舱。等待期间，你一屁股坐到沙发上，双臂搭在椅背上
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and let Kaede slip away through a hatch into a side chamber near the back of the ship. You flop down onto the couch while you wait, slipping your arms around the back of the seat"

rows.original: and kicking your feet up onto the projector’s face
rows.translation: ，双脚翘到投影仪表面
rows.raw: " and kicking your feet up onto the projector’s face"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A boisterous chortle rings through the interior of the bar.
rows.translation: 一阵豪爽的大笑响彻酒吧内部。
rows.raw: "\n\nA boisterous chortle rings through the interior of the bar."

rows.original: It could only be Jerynn and a quick glance around confirms it;
rows.translation: 这只可能是杰琳；飞快扫视一圈，果然证实了这一点；
rows.raw: " It could only be Jerynn and a quick glance around confirms it;"

rows.original: A quick look around the interior of the bar reveals a taur-like woman stood amongst her cohorts;
rows.translation: 飞快扫视一圈酒吧内部，你看见一名半人马般的女人站在同伴之中；
rows.raw: " A quick look around the interior of the bar reveals a taur-like woman stood amongst her cohorts;"

rows.original: she’s stood directly under one of the bar’s dingy little lights, the illumination only serving to better illustrate her imperious stature... and from this angle, an ass that looks like it could crush granite.
rows.translation: 她正站在酒吧一盏昏暗小灯下，灯光只让她威严的身材显得更加醒目...从这个角度看，她那屁股仿佛连花岗岩都能压碎。
rows.raw: " she’s stood directly under one of the bar’s dingy little lights, the illumination only serving to better illustrate her imperious stature... and from this angle, an ass that looks like it could crush granite."

rows.original: Jerynn
rows.translation: 杰琳
rows.raw: "Jerynn"

rows.original: Tauress
rows.translation: 半人马女
rows.raw: "Tauress"

rows.original: Jerynn
rows.translation: 杰琳
rows.raw: "Jerynn"

rows.original: Taur Woman
rows.translation: 半人马般的女人
rows.raw: "Taur Woman"

rows.original: Steal a few more glances at
rows.translation: 再偷瞄几眼
rows.raw: "Steal a few more glances at "

rows.original: Jerynn.
rows.translation: 杰琳。
rows.raw: "Jerynn."

rows.original: the taur-like woman.
rows.translation: 那个半人马般的女人。
rows.raw: "the taur-like woman."

rows.original: A loud crinkling noise draws you back from the brink, a regular rustle akin to a metronome tapping on the side of your near-unconsciousness. You feel yourself shift in time with the noise, your limbs flopping helplessly around to the tune.
rows.translation: 响亮的窸窣声将你从昏迷边缘拉了回来，那规律的沙沙声仿佛节拍器敲击着你近乎失去意识的边界。你感觉自己的身体随声晃动，四肢无力地随着节奏摆荡。
rows.raw: "A loud crinkling noise draws you back from the brink, a regular rustle akin to a metronome tapping on the side of your near-unconsciousness. You feel yourself shift in time with the noise, your limbs flopping helplessly around to the tune."

rows.original: It’s a struggle to peel open your eyes, the endless freezing winds having battered any exposed [pc.skinFurScales] so completely your [pc.face] is covered in outcroppings of icicles hanging from your features. You have to work your face a little, stretching and tugging against the icy buildup, as sensation slowly creeps back in - bringing with it the deep, throbbing pain of penetrating cold having set into the core of your body - before you can open them.
rows.translation: 你费力地睁开眼睛。无休止的冰冷狂风已将所有暴露在外的[pc.skinFurScales]吹打得彻底麻木，[pc.face]上也挂满了从五官垂下的冰凌。你不得不活动脸部，拉扯、绷动结冰的表面；知觉逐渐恢复，随之而来的是刺骨寒意侵入身体核心后产生的深沉抽痛——直到这时，你才能真正睁眼。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a struggle to peel open your eyes, the endless freezing winds having battered any exposed [pc.skinFurScales] so completely your [pc.face] is covered in outcroppings of icicles hanging from your features. You have to work your face a little, stretching and tugging against the icy buildup, as sensation slowly creeps back in - bringing with it the deep, throbbing pain of penetrating cold having set into the core of your body - before you can open them."

rows.original: You’re looking down at the floor, slumped over something. Dangling, helplessly, on top of whatever it is as it moves. Streaks of a different shade of blue clash with the color of the surrounding ice as the distinct shape of a person comes into focus. A person with a large, taur-like body that you happened to be bundled over the top of as they take difficult, lumbering steps, fighting against the ice and snow.
rows.translation: 你低头望着地面，整个人瘫伏在某样东西上，随着它移动而无助地悬在上面。周围冰面的色彩中掠过几道不同深浅的蓝色，一个清晰的人形逐渐映入眼帘。那人有着庞大的半人马式身躯，而你正被捆在其背上；对方迈着艰难而沉重的步伐，与冰雪抗争。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re looking down at the floor, slumped over something. Dangling, helplessly, on top of whatever it is as it moves. Streaks of a different shade of blue clash with the color of the surrounding ice as the distinct shape of a person comes into focus. A person with a large, taur-like body that you happened to be bundled over the top of as they take difficult, lumbering steps, fighting against the ice and snow."

rows.original: You suck down an icy cold breath of air before trying to attract your rescuers attention, only to be rewarded with a lightning bolt of pain as your lungs complain - as more warmth seeps back into your body, the less numb everything feels... and the more pain seeps through.
rows.translation: 你吸入一口冰冷刺骨的空气，试图引起救命恩人的注意，却只换来一道闪电般的剧痛，仿佛肺部在发出抗议——随着更多暖意渗回体内，一切都不再那么麻木...疼痛也愈发清晰。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suck down an icy cold breath of air before trying to attract your rescuers attention, only to be rewarded with a lightning bolt of pain as your lungs complain - as more warmth seeps back into your body, the less numb everything feels... and the more pain seeps through."

rows.original: You let your eyes drift closed, falling back into fitful slumber amidst the frozen tundra....
rows.translation: 你任由眼皮合上，在冰封荒原中再次陷入不安稳的睡眠....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let your eyes drift closed, falling back into fitful slumber amidst the frozen tundra...."

rows.original: UVETO_JERYNN_RESCUES
rows.raw: "UVETO_JERYNN_RESCUES"

rows.original: You can barely make out somebody shouting... something off in the distance. It’s a strain to make out what, exactly, it is, but it’s clearly words.
rows.translation: 你勉强能听见有人在喊...声音来自远处，具体喊的是什么很难分辨，但显然是话语。
rows.raw: "You can barely make out somebody shouting... something off in the distance. It’s a strain to make out what, exactly, it is, but it’s clearly words."

rows.original: Again and again, the noise comes, every time the source closer than the last... until finally, they come into stark relief against the howling winds of the tundra.
rows.translation: 那声音一次又一次响起，每次都比上次更近...直到来者终于在冻原呼啸的狂风中显露出清晰轮廓。
rows.raw: "\n\nAgain and again, the noise comes, every time the source closer than the last... until finally, they come into stark relief against the howling winds of the tundra."

rows.original: Suddenly they’re right on top of you! Inches away almost.
rows.translation: 对方突然来到你面前！几乎近在咫尺。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly they’re right on top of you! Inches away almost."

rows.original: “Hey, wake the fuck up, friend.”
rows.translation: “嘿，醒醒，朋友，别他妈睡了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, wake the fuck up, friend.”"

rows.original: You try to respond, but you can barely manage to breathe let alone produce an intelligible noise. The bitter cold has even robbed you of the ability to flop your limbs about... but the twitches and signs of awareness are there.
rows.translation: 你试图回应，可你连呼吸都十分勉强，更别提发出能听懂的声音。刺骨严寒甚至夺走了你挥动四肢的能力...但细微的抽动和恢复意识的迹象依然存在。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to respond, but you can barely manage to breathe let alone produce an intelligible noise. The bitter cold has even robbed you of the ability to flop your limbs about... but the twitches and signs of awareness are there."

rows.original: “That’s it, no freezing to death in the snow today, thanks. I didn’t drag myself halfway across this fucking moon to drag a fucking popsicle back to town.”
rows.translation: “行了，今天可不能冻死在雪地里，谢谢。我他妈大老远跑了半个月球，可不是为了把一根他妈的冰棍拖回城里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s it, no freezing to death in the snow today, thanks. I didn’t drag myself halfway across this fucking moon to drag a fucking popsicle back to town.”"

rows.original: A crinkly thermal blanket quickly gets wrapped around your body, pain lancing through your muscles as you’re manhandled into position before you settle into the welcoming respite from the biting winds.
rows.translation: 一张窸窣作响的保温毯迅速裹住你的身体。对方摆弄着你调整姿势，疼痛如长矛般刺入肌肉；随后，你终于安稳下来，躲进这处隔绝刺骨寒风的温暖庇护。
rows.raw: "\n\nA crinkly thermal blanket quickly gets wrapped around your body, pain lancing through your muscles as you’re manhandled into position before you settle into the welcoming respite from the biting winds."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You step out of your ship and into the cold, sterile air of Uveto Station. The long arm of the docking limb stretches far ahead of you, somewhat cluttered with crates of mining equipment and food supplies. A handful of other spacers are milling around, trying to ignore the ever-present eye of security cameras and assault drones peering down from on-high.
rows.translation: 你走出飞船，进入乌维托空间站冰冷而无菌的空气。对接臂的长廊向前方延伸，沿途有些杂乱地堆着采矿设备箱和食物补给。少数太空旅客在附近走动，尽力无视无处不在的安全摄像头，以及从高处俯视众人的突击无人机。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou step out of your ship and into the cold, sterile air of Uveto Station. The long arm of the docking limb stretches far ahead of you, somewhat cluttered with crates of mining equipment and food supplies. A handful of other spacers are milling around, trying to ignore the ever-present eye of security cameras and assault drones peering down from on-high."

rows.original: Just as you’re starting to head down to the corridor, you hear your name being called from behind. You turn, just in time to see a familiar ginger half-ausar bounding towards you down the corridor. You swing your arms around her, pulling Kaede into a tight hug. Her orange tail swishes excitedly behind her as she nuzzles her cheek into your [pc.chest].
rows.translation: 你刚要走向走廊，便听见身后有人呼喊你的名字。你转过身，恰好看见熟悉的姜黄色半奥萨人沿走廊朝你奔来。你张开双臂，将枫紧紧抱住。她橙色的尾巴在身后兴奋地摇摆，脸颊则依偎着你的[pc.chest]。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re starting to head down to the corridor, you hear your name being called from behind. You turn, just in time to see a familiar ginger half-ausar bounding towards you down the corridor. You swing your arms around her, pulling Kaede into a tight hug. Her orange tail swishes excitedly behind her as she nuzzles her cheek into your [pc.chest]."

rows.original: After a few moments of tight embrace, Kaede pulls back with a big smile. “[pc.name]! What are you doing here?”
rows.translation: 紧紧拥抱了片刻，枫退开一些，露出灿烂笑容。“[pc.name]！你怎么会在这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments of tight embrace, Kaede pulls back with a big smile. “[pc.name]! What are you doing here?”"

rows.original: You explain what brought you all the way into the core, then pose the same question back at her: doesn’t Kaede usually operate out of Tavros?
rows.translation: 你解释了自己为何会一路来到核心区域，接着反问她同样的问题：枫通常不是在塔弗罗斯一带活动吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain what brought you all the way into the core, then pose the same question back at her: doesn’t Kaede usually operate out of Tavros?"

rows.original: She points back the way she came, to a pair of leithans in purple and silver uniforms who are guiding a hover-platform off of Talon Rogue, laden with cargo containers marked for RhenWorld Stellar Excavations.
rows.translation: 她指向来路。两个穿紫银制服的莱坦人正引导一座悬浮平台离开利爪浪客号，平台上堆满标有伦世恒星采掘公司字样的货运箱。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe points back the way she came, to a pair of leithans in purple and silver uniforms who are guiding a hover-platform off of Talon Rogue, laden with cargo containers marked for RhenWorld Stellar Excavations."

rows.original: “I’ve still got a pretty sweet gig for RhenWorld going. The daughter of their C.E.O. and I are, uh, pretty close so... whenever I don’t have a contract going, I just get myself on RhenWorld’s Uveto-Krovak supply run. Safe, boring, and lucrative - just the way I like ‘em!” Kaede chuckles.
rows.translation: “我还在替伦世干一份相当不错的差事。他们首席执行官的女儿和我，呃，关系很亲密，所以...每当手头没有合约，我就会加入伦世的乌维托—克罗瓦克补给航线。安全、无聊，又赚钱——正是我喜欢的样子！”枫轻笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve still got a pretty sweet gig for RhenWorld going. The daughter of their C.E.O. and I are, uh, pretty close so... whenever I don’t have a contract going, I just get myself on RhenWorld’s Uveto-Krovak supply run. Safe, boring, and lucrative - just the way I like ‘em!” Kaede chuckles."

rows.original: Well, that is a sweet deal she’s got going for herself. Speaking of sweet, you notice that the normally plain-jane girl’s dolled herself up a little for once: her slim lips are glistening with blue lipstick, and she’s definitely got at least a little eyeshadow on, though she’s still wearing her weathered old jacket and tore-up jeans.
rows.translation: 嗯，她给自己找的确实是份美差。说到甜美，你注意到这个平时朴素无华的女孩难得稍微打扮了一番：纤薄的嘴唇涂着闪亮的蓝色唇膏，眼睛上也肯定抹了些眼影，尽管她依然穿着那件饱经风霜的旧夹克和破牛仔裤。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that is a sweet deal she’s got going for herself. Speaking of sweet, you notice that the normally plain-jane girl’s dolled herself up a little for once: her slim lips are glistening with blue lipstick, and she’s definitely got at least a little eyeshadow on, though she’s still wearing her weathered old jacket and tore-up jeans."

rows.original: The halfbreed blushes when she catches you looking. “What?” she pouts, still wagging her tail. “A girl can decide to look pretty once in a while. Especially when she’s gonna be meeting her leithan patron’s half-sister here on business. Though not for a couple hours, actually. Hey! There’s a little cafe here on the station that makes the best steaks. How ‘bout I buy you lunch? I’d love to have someone to while away the time with.”
rows.translation: 发现你在打量自己，混血姑娘红了脸。“干嘛？”她撅嘴问道，尾巴依旧摇个不停。“女孩子偶尔也可以想打扮得漂亮一点嘛。尤其是她要在这里谈生意，见见她那位莱坦资助人的同父异母妹妹。不过还要等好几个小时。嘿！空间站上有家小咖啡馆，做的牛排是最棒的。我请你吃午饭怎么样？有人陪我消磨时间，我会很开心的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe halfbreed blushes when she catches you looking. “What?” she pouts, still wagging her tail. “A girl can decide to look pretty once in a while. Especially when she’s gonna be meeting her leithan patron’s half-sister here on business. Though not for a couple hours, actually. Hey! rows.translation: “修店的时候，琪奥娜做了东西感谢外星人。希望外星人喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiona make something for alien in thanks while fixings shop. Hopings alien like.” "

rows.original: “Also, I’ve been meaning to say that I’m really sorry for the way I acted towards you before... I made a complete ass of myself over something trivial and took it out on you.” She blushes, constantly stuttering over her words. “I, um... I made you something for you in the event that you dropped by. Hopefully this can help make up for things.”
rows.translation: “另外，我一直想说，我真的很抱歉之前那样对你... 我为了一件小事把自己变成了十足的蠢货，还把气撒在你身上。”她脸颊泛红，说话时不断结巴。“我，呃... 我想着万一你顺道来访，就给你做了点东西。希望这能稍微补偿一下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Also, I’ve been meaning to say that I’m really sorry for the way I acted towards you before... I made a complete ass of myself over something trivial and took it out on you.” She blushes, constantly stuttering over her words. “I, um... I made you something for you in the event that you dropped by. Hopefully this can help make up for things.” "

rows.original: “Also, meanings to say am sorry for way of actings to alien... Kiona make butt of self over small thing and take out on alien.” She blushes, constantly stuttering over her words. “Uh, uhm... Kiona makings thing for alien in happening that alien drop by. Hopings it help make up for things.”
rows.translation: “还有，一直想说很抱歉之前那样对外星人... 琪奥娜为小事出丑，还把气撒在外星人身上。”她脸颊泛红，说话时不断结巴。“呃，嗯... 琪奥娜做了东西，想着外星人或许会来。希望这能补偿一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Also, meanings to say am sorry for way of actings to alien... Kiona make butt of self over small thing and take out on alien.” She blushes, constantly stuttering over her words. “Uh, uhm... Kiona makings thing for alien in happening that alien drop by. Hopings it help make up for things.” "

rows.original: Kiona lets go of your arm and rushes past the backroom curtains. After a few moments of waiting, she reemerges with a decent sized bundle in her arms.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜松开你的手臂，冲进后屋的帘子后面。等了片刻，她重新出现，双臂抱着一个大小可观的包裹。
rows.raw: "Kiona lets go of your arm and rushes past the backroom curtains. After a few moments of waiting, she reemerges with a decent sized bundle in her arms."

rows.original: “Go on, open it! It’s for you!”
rows.translation: “快，打开看看！这是给你的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go on, open it! It’s for you!”"

rows.original: “Go go, open! It for alien!”
rows.translation: “快快，打开！这是给外星人的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go go, open! It for alien!”"

rows.original: the korgonne thrusts the package into your arms. At her insistence, you carefully peel off the wrapping, revealing an arranged assortment of jewels and cloth. From the top, you unfurl the garb and spread it out over the counter; it’s an outfit made entirely of transparent fabric and gems! Kiona grins from ear to ear while you admire the handiwork.
rows.translation: 这名科尔贡把包裹塞进你怀里。在她的催促下，你小心剥开包装，露出精心排列的珠宝与布料。你从上方将衣物展开，平铺在柜台上；这是一套完全由透明布料和宝石制成的服装！当你欣赏这件手工作品时，琪奥娜笑得合不拢嘴。
rows.raw: " the korgonne thrusts the package into your arms. At her insistence, you carefully peel off the wrapping, revealing an arranged assortment of jewels and cloth. From the top, you unfurl the garb and spread it out over the counter; it’s an outfit made entirely of transparent fabric and gems! Kiona grins from ear to ear while you admire the handiwork."

rows.original: “Probably one of my most inspired pieces yet!” Kiona waves a paw towards her packed shelves. “The whole milodan war wasn’t all bad... certainly not the spoils that came from it anyways. Thanks to that ordeal, I have more stock than I know what to do with. If you’re interested in piercings or anything, I have them in abundance! I just hope that my jewelry and my gift will prove useful for you. We korgonne still owe you so much...”
rows.translation: “这大概是我至今最有灵感的作品之一！”琪奥娜朝塞得满满的货架挥了挥爪。“整场米洛丹战争也不全是坏事... 至少伴随而来的战利品绝对不坏。多亏那场磨难，我的库存多到都不知道该怎么办。如果你对穿孔饰品之类感兴趣，我这里多得很！只希望我的珠宝和礼物能对你有用。我们科尔贡仍欠你太多...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably one of my most inspired pieces yet!” Kiona waves a paw towards her packed shelves. “The whole milodan war wasn’t all bad... certainly not the spoils that came from it anyways. Thanks to that ordeal, I have more stock than I know what to do with. If you’re interested in piercings or anything, I have them in abundance! I just hope that my jewelry and my gift will prove useful for you. We korgonne still owe you so much...”"

rows.original: “Maybe one of most complicated work yet!” Kiona waves a paw towards her packed shelves. “The fighting not all bad... for sure not loot that come with anyway. Thankings to that mess, Kiona havings more stuff than know what doing with. If interest in body sparkles or anything, Kiona have in lots! Just hopings sparkles and gift provings useful to alien. Still feel korgonne owe much more...”
rows.translation: “也许是至今最复杂的作品之一！”琪奥娜朝塞满的货架挥了挥爪。“打仗也不全是坏事... 至少随之而来的战利品绝对不坏。多亏那场混乱，琪奥娜的东西多到不知道怎么办。要是对身体闪亮饰物之类感兴趣，琪奥娜有很多！只希望闪亮饰物和礼物能帮到外星人。还是觉得科尔贡欠得更多...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe one of most complicated work yet!” Kiona waves a paw towards her packed shelves. “The fighting not all bad... for sure not loot that come with anyway. Thankings to that mess, Kiona havings more stuff than know what doing with. If interest in body sparkles or anything, Kiona have in lots! Just hopings sparkles and gift provings useful to alien. Still feel korgonne owe much more...”"

rows.original: You reach over and give Kiona a light hug in appreciation, causing her tail to wag so fast that it almost whirrs. When the two of you finally separate, she retreats behind the counter and readjusts her jewelry so that she looks presentable.
rows.translation: 你伸手轻轻拥抱琪奥娜表示感谢，让她的尾巴摇得如此之快，几乎发出嗡嗡声。你们终于分开后，她退回柜台后，重新整理珠宝，好让自己看起来体面些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach over and give Kiona a light hug in appreciation, causing her tail to wag so fast that it almost whirrs. When the two of you finally separate, she retreats behind the counter and readjusts her jewelry so that she looks presentable."

rows.original: “With that in mind, is there anything else I can do for you, Kerborus?”
rows.translation: “既然如此，刻耳柏洛斯，还有什么是我能为你做的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“With that in mind, is there anything else I can do for you, Kerborus?”"

rows.original: “That in mind, anything Kiona can do, Kerborus?”
rows.translation: “既然这样，琪奥娜还能做什么，刻耳柏洛斯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That in mind, anything Kiona can do, Kerborus?”"

rows.original: There is no room in your inventory for the Jeweled Outfit. Come back later when you have room.
rows.translation: 你的物品栏没有空间放置珠宝服装。等有空间时再回来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere is no room in your inventory for the Jeweled Outfit. Come back later when you have room."

rows.original: You approach the counter, surveying the korgonne-crafted jewelry and accessories on display along the way. Several pieces glow a bright green, despite the somewhat dim lighting of this shop. There’s a very scarce selection from what you can see; only a few scattered necklaces, bracelets, and chains are visible.
rows.translation: 你走向柜台，沿途打量着陈列的科尔贡手工珠宝与饰品。尽管店内光线有些昏暗，好几件饰品仍泛着明亮的绿光。就你所见，选择非常有限；只有零散的几条项链、手镯和链饰。
rows.raw: "You approach the counter, surveying the korgonne-crafted jewelry and accessories on display along the way. Several pieces glow a bright green, despite the somewhat dim lighting of this shop. There’s a very scarce selection from what you can see; only a few scattered necklaces, bracelets, and chains are visible."

rows.original: The korgonne working on the polishing wheel in the back of the shop doesn’t immediately turn her attention to you, even after you clear your throat a few times. It takes a sharp “Hello!” from you to finally cause a reaction; with a slight jump, the busy shopkeeper straightens up, nearly dropping the hunk of savicite she was working on. She quickly stumbles over to the counter, nearly tripping over herself along the way.
rows.translation: 店铺后方正在抛光轮前工作的科尔贡没有立刻理会你，哪怕你清了几次嗓子也一样。直到你尖声喊出“你好！”，她才终于有所反应；忙碌的店主微微一跳，猛然直起身，差点把正在加工的那块萨维晶石掉在地上。她连忙跌跌撞撞地走向柜台，途中差点把自己绊倒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne working on the polishing wheel in the back of the shop doesn’t immediately turn her attention to you, even after you clear your throat a few times. It takes a sharp “Hello!” from you to finally cause a reaction; with a slight jump, the busy shopkeeper straightens up, nearly dropping the hunk of savicite she was working on. She quickly stumbles over to the counter, nearly tripping over herself along the way."

rows.original: “Ah! Welcome to Kiona’s Kiosk! I’m out of piercings at the moment, but how may I help-”
rows.translation: “啊！欢迎来到琪奥娜小铺！我现在没有穿孔饰品了，不过有什么能帮你——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Welcome to Kiona’s Kiosk! I’m out of piercings at the moment, but how may I help-”"

rows.original: “Ah! Welcomes to Kiona’s Kiosk! Out of piercings at moment, but how can help-”
rows.translation: “啊！欢迎来琪奥娜小铺！现在穿孔饰品卖光啦，不过能帮什么——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Welcomes to Kiona’s Kiosk! Out of piercings at moment, but how can help-”"

rows.original: The jewel-clad korgonne cocks her head backwards in surprise, eyes widening in realization at first, then narrowing in suspicion.
rows.translation: 戴满珠宝的科尔贡惊讶地把头向后仰，双眼先因恍然大悟而睁大，随后又因怀疑眯起。
rows.raw: " The jewel-clad korgonne cocks her head backwards in surprise, eyes widening in realization at first, then narrowing in suspicion."

rows.original: korgonne
rows.raw: "korgonne"

rows.original: “You don’t smell like you’re from around here... Are you from another hold?”
rows.translation: “你闻起来不像本地人... 你来自另一个据点吗？”
rows.raw: " “You don’t smell like you’re from around here... Are you from another hold?”"

rows.original: “You not smell like from here... From other hold?”
rows.translation: “闻起来不像这里的... 来自其他据点？”
rows.raw: " “You not smell like from here... From other hold?”"

rows.original: She keeps her distance, taking multiple short whiffs of the air around you. When finished, the corners of her lips stretch wide into a scowl.
rows.translation: 她保持距离，接连短促地嗅着你周围的空气。嗅完后，她的嘴角大幅向两侧拉开，化作怒容。
rows.raw: " She keeps her distance, taking multiple short whiffs of the air around you. When finished, the corners of her lips stretch wide into a scowl."

rows.original: <i>“No... the off-worlder scent is too strong for that.
rows.translation: <i>“不... 外世界人的气味太浓了，不可能。
rows.raw: " <i>“No... the off-worlder scent is too strong for that. "

rows.original: <i>“No... alien smell too strong for that.
rows.translation: <i>“不... 外星人的气味太浓，不是。
rows.raw: " <i>“No... alien smell too strong for that. "

rows.original: Urgh, you must be the one Ula let in here. She’s too trusting of outsiders...
rows.translation: 呃，你肯定就是乌拉放进来的那个人。她实在太容易相信外人了...
rows.raw: "Urgh, you must be the one Ula let in here. She’s too trusting of outsiders..."

rows.original: Urgh... Must be alien Ula let in. Too trustings in outsiders...
rows.translation: 呃... 肯定是乌拉放进来的外星人。太相信外人了...
rows.raw: "Urgh... Must be alien Ula let in. Too trustings in outsiders..."

rows.original: The furry doggirl sighs out of impatience, sharply rapping her clawed fingers against the stone display table.
rows.translation: 毛茸茸的犬女不耐烦地叹了口气，用带爪的手指急促敲打石制展示台。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe furry doggirl sighs out of impatience, sharply rapping her clawed fingers against the stone display table."

rows.original: “Well, what do you want? You want to buy something, or are you just looking to pillage the rest? I bet it’ll come down to that sooner or later.”
rows.translation: “所以呢，你想要什么？想买东西，还是只想来洗劫剩下的货？我敢说迟早会变成那样。”
rows.raw: " “Well, what do you want? You want to buy something, or are you just looking to pillage the rest? I bet it’ll come down to that sooner or later.”"

rows.original: “Well? What want? Wanting to buy, or lookings to take rest of gemstock? Will come to that soon, Kiona bet.”
rows.translation: “所以？想要什么？想买，还是想把剩下的宝石库存拿走？琪奥娜敢说很快就会这样。”
rows.raw: " “Well? What want? Wanting to buy, or lookings to take rest of gemstock? Will come to that soon, Kiona bet.”"

rows.original: Someone’s clearly not happy to see you...
rows.translation: 显然有人不高兴见到你...
rows.raw: " Someone’s clearly not happy to see you..."

rows.original: “That’s it? Alright. What else do you want?”
rows.translation: “就这些？好吧。你还想要什么？”
rows.raw: "“That’s it? Alright. What else do you want?”"

rows.original: “That it? Alright. What else alien want?”
rows.translation: “就这些？好吧。外星人还想要什么？”
rows.raw: "“That it? Alright. What else alien want?”"

rows.original: You approach the counter to Kiona’s Kiosk, greeted by the warm, glowing gems and jewels on display. Kiona herself has her back turned to you, her long ponytail blocking most of her backside from view. With a shrill whistle, you snag her attention. The busy korg nearly jumps out of her fur, yipping loudly in surprise, and drops the jewel she had in her hands with a soft clatter against the stone floor.
rows.translation: 你走向琪奥娜小铺的柜台，陈列品中温暖发光的宝石与珠宝映入眼帘。琪奥娜本人背对着你，长长的马尾遮住了大半背影。你吹出一声尖锐口哨，引起她的注意。忙碌的科尔贡吓得几乎从毛皮里跳出来，惊讶地大声尖叫，手中的珠宝也随一声轻响掉在石地上。
rows.raw: "You approach the counter to Kiona’s Kiosk, greeted by the warm, glowing gems and jewels on display. Kiona herself has her back turned to you, her long ponytail blocking most of her backside from view. With a shrill whistle, you snag her attention. The busy korg nearly jumps out of her fur, yipping loudly in surprise, and drops the jewel she had in her hands with a soft clatter against the stone floor."

rows.original: “Ack! Fuck, okay! I’m coming! Hold your nog’wich...”
rows.translation: “啊！操，好吧！我来了！别急着吃你的诺格维奇...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ack! Fuck, okay! I’m coming! Hold your nog’wich...”"

rows.original: “Ack! Frick, okay! Kiona coming! Hold nog’wich...”
rows.translation: “啊！该死，好吧！琪奥娜来了！先拿稳诺格维奇...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ack! Frick, okay! Kiona coming! Hold nog’wich...”"

rows.original: Kiona huffs, picking the gem up from the ground before rushing over to you.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜气呼呼地从地上捡起宝石，随后朝你冲来。
rows.raw: " Kiona huffs, picking the gem up from the ground before rushing over to you."

rows.original: When she reaches the counter, she lets out a gasp before bowing her head, barely missing the counter with it.
rows.translation: 到达柜台时，她倒吸一口气，随后低头鞠躬，脑袋险些撞上柜台。
rows.raw: " When she reaches the counter, she lets out a gasp before bowing her head, barely missing the counter with it."

rows.original: When she reaches the counter, she gives you a nonchalant wave.
rows.translation: 到达柜台时，她漫不经心地朝你挥了挥爪。
rows.raw: " When she reaches the counter, she gives you a nonchalant wave."

rows.original: When she reaches the counter, her expression softens slightly, regarding you with tired but expectant eyes.
rows.translation: 到达柜台时，她的表情稍稍柔和，以疲惫却期待的目光望向你。
rows.raw: " When she reaches the counter, her expression softens slightly, regarding you with tired but expectant eyes."

rows.original: She nearly stumbles over her feet before she reaches the counter. Small specks of savicite flake off her with a dog-like shake of her body.
rows.translation: 她到达柜台前差点被自己的脚绊倒。她像狗一样抖了抖身体，小片萨维晶石屑从身上剥落。
rows.raw: " She nearly stumbles over her feet before she reaches the counter. Small specks of savicite flake off her with a dog-like shake of her body."

rows.original: When she reaches the counter, her expression darkens. Her eyes narrow, regarding you with scorn rather than annoyance.
rows.translation: 到达柜台时，她的表情阴沉下来。她眯起双眼，投向你的不再是烦躁，而是鄙夷。
rows.raw: " When she reaches the counter, her expression darkens. Her eyes narrow, regarding you with scorn rather than annoyance."

rows.original: “Ah! Welcome back, Kerborus! Hopefully there’s something here to your liking!”
rows.translation: “啊！欢迎回来，刻耳柏洛斯！希望这里有你喜欢的东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Welcome back, Kerborus! Hopefully there’s something here to your liking!”"

rows.original: “Ah, welcomings Kerborus! Hopings there’s something to Kerborus’ likings!”
rows.translation: “啊，欢迎刻耳柏洛斯！希望有刻耳柏洛斯喜欢的东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, welcomings Kerborus! Hopings there’s something to Kerborus’ likings!”"

rows.original: “Oh... it’s you again. Did you manage to get that blue ore yet?”
rows.translation: “哦... 又是你。你弄到那种蓝色矿石了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... it’s you again. Did you manage to get that blue ore yet?”"

rows.original: “Oh... alien again. Manage to get blue rock?”
rows.translation: “哦... 又是外星人。拿到蓝色石头了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... alien again. Manage to get blue rock?”"

rows.original: “Ah, it’s you. Do you need anything? I actually have some time to talk, now that a lot of my orders are done. Many thanks to you.”
rows.translation: “啊，是你。需要什么吗？我的许多订单都做完了，现在确实有时间聊聊了。非常感谢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, it’s you. Do you need anything? I actually have some time to talk, now that a lot of my orders are done. Many thanks to you.”"

rows.original: “Ah, alien. Needings something? Finally havings time for talk since lots of orders done now. Many thankings.”
rows.translation: “啊，外星人。需要什么？好多订单现在终于完成，有时间聊天了。非常感谢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, alien. Needings something? Finally havings time for talk since lots of orders done now. Many thankings.”"

rows.original: “Oh, you again. What do you want this time?”
rows.translation: “哦，又是你。这次想要什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, you again. What do you want this time?”"

rows.original: “Oh, alien again. What wantings this time?”
rows.translation: “哦，又是外星人。这次想要什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, alien again. What wantings this time?”"

rows.original: “Oh... you again. It’s the same as before; buy something or go on your way. I’m too busy to deal with window-shoppers.”
rows.translation: “哦... 又是你。还是和之前一样；买东西，或者走你的路。我忙得没空应付只看不买的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... you again. It’s the same as before; buy something or go on your way. I’m too busy to deal with window-shoppers.”"

rows.original: “Alien again... Same before; buy or leave. Kiona too busy for look-shoppers.”
rows.translation: “又是外星人... 和以前一样；买或者离开。琪奥娜太忙，没空理只看的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alien again... Same before; buy or leave. Kiona too busy for look-shoppers.”"

rows.original: There’s a subtle undertone to her words that suggests a deeper meaning to them.
rows.translation: 她的话里有一丝不易察觉的弦外之音。
rows.raw: " There’s a subtle undertone to her words that suggests a deeper meaning to them."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Take a gander at the cute doggy!
rows.translation: 看看这只可爱的狗狗！
rows.raw: "Take a gander at the cute doggy!"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Take a gander at the cute doggy!
rows.translation: 看看这只可爱的狗狗！
rows.raw: "Take a gander at the cute doggy!"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: You don’t think it would be a good idea to try sneaking a thorough look again....while she’s in a bad mood.
rows.translation: 你觉得在她心情不好的时候，再偷偷仔细打量她....不是个好主意。
rows.raw: "You don’t think it would be a good idea to try sneaking a thorough look again....while she’s in a bad mood."

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Talk?
rows.translation: 交谈？
rows.raw: "Talk?"

rows.original: Talk?
rows.translation: 交谈？
rows.raw: "Talk?"

rows.original: If might be best to talk to her when she’s less busy...
rows.translation: 或许最好等她不那么忙时再和她交谈...
rows.raw: "If might be best to talk to her when she’s less busy..."

rows.original: Talk?
rows.translation: 交谈？
rows.raw: "Talk?"

rows.original: Talk?
rows.translation: 交谈？
rows.raw: "Talk?"

rows.original: Maybe she might be more in a mood for talking, now that you’ve helped her expand her inventory a bit more?
rows.translation: 既然你帮她扩大了一些库存，也许她现在更有心情聊天？
rows.raw: "Maybe she might be more in a mood for talking, now that you’ve helped her expand her inventory a bit more?"

rows.original: Kiona smirks, letting you soak in her form.

rows.original: “What do you want now, I’m telling you, I’m not for sale.”

rows.original: “What want now. Telling alien Kiona not for sale.”
