rows.raw: "“What want now. Telling alien Kiona not for sale.”"

rows.original: Kiona mumbles, shifting in place uncomfortably, though she doesn’t seem to be opposing your gaze this time around.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜嘟囔着，不自在地挪动身体，不过这次似乎并不反对你的注视。
rows.raw: " Kiona mumbles, shifting in place uncomfortably, though she doesn’t seem to be opposing your gaze this time around."

rows.original: Kiona is an expectedly diminutive 4' 10" korgonne. While the majority of korgs you’ve seen are stocky when it comes to their builds, this one is a fair bit thinner in comparison. Despite her initially rough personality, she’s gorgeous, for korgonne standards. With all of the jewelry adorning her figure, she could rival Ula’s beauty. A tight red handkerchief wraps around her right biceps, and another on the opposite thigh. In concert with those accessories, she wears an alluring ensemble of lucinite bracelets, anklets, and even several tail rings that sparkle in the dim lighting of the cave. Most notably, several intricately-carved savicite accessories dangle freely around her ears, belly, and tongue. It definitely shows that she a master of her craft.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜是一名意料之中娇小的科尔贡，身高4英尺10英寸。你见过的大多数科尔贡都体格敦实，而她相比之下瘦削不少。尽管最初性格粗鲁，但以科尔贡的标准而言，她相当美丽。浑身佩戴的珠宝让她足以与乌拉媲美。一条紧绷的红色手帕缠在她右侧肱二头肌上，另一条则缠在对侧大腿。与这些配饰相衬，她还佩戴着一套诱人的露西矿手镯、脚镯，甚至有好几个尾环，在洞穴昏暗的光线下闪闪发亮。最引人注目的是，好几件雕刻精细的萨维晶石饰品自由垂挂在她的耳朵、腹部和舌头周围。显然，她的确是个手艺大师。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona is an expectedly diminutive 4' 10\" korgonne. While the majority of korgs you’ve seen are stocky when it comes to their builds, this one is a fair bit thinner in comparison. Despite her initially rough personality, she’s gorgeous, for korgonne standards. With all of the jewelry adorning her figure, she could rival Ula’s beauty. A tight red handkerchief wraps around her right biceps, and another on the opposite thigh. In concert with those accessories, she wears an alluring ensemble of lucinite bracelets, anklets, and even several tail rings that sparkle in the dim lighting of the cave. Most notably, several intricately-carved savicite accessories dangle freely around her ears, belly, and tongue. It definitely shows that she a master of her craft."

rows.original: Kiona has oddly-shaped, bright hazel eyes that wander towards you on occasion, sneaking peeks to take in your otherworldly appearance. Thin pink lips glisten against the forge fire. Most of her white lower-back-length hair is done up in a ponytail, which cascades behind her elegantly. A fluffy coat of pale brown covers most of her form, broken only by the white of her front side. Her accessory-clad tail wags slowly behind her, tipped with the same shade of white as her hair.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜那双形状奇特的明亮淡褐色眼睛偶尔会游移到你身上，偷瞄着端详你来自异世界的外貌。薄薄的粉色嘴唇在锻炉火光下闪闪发亮。她大部分长及下背的白发扎成马尾，优雅地垂落身后。浅棕色的蓬松毛皮覆盖了身体的大部分区域，只有身体正面的白色将其打断。饰品缠绕的尾巴在身后缓缓摇动，尾尖和头发一样洁白。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona has oddly-shaped, bright hazel eyes that wander towards you on occasion, sneaking peeks to take in your otherworldly appearance. Thin pink lips glisten against the forge fire. Most of her white lower-back-length hair is done up in a ponytail, which cascades behind her elegantly. A fluffy coat of pale brown covers most of her form, broken only by the white of her front side. Her accessory-clad tail wags slowly behind her, tipped with the same shade of white as her hair."

rows.original: Kiona’s body is more slender than most of the other korgonne you’ve seen, though she does still have fairly wide hips, bigger-than-average breasts, and a sizable derriere. Tight bandages wrap around her
rows.translation: 琪奥娜的身体比你见过的大多数科尔贡更加纤细，不过她依然有相当宽阔的臀胯、大于平均尺寸的乳房，以及颇为丰满的臀部。紧绷的绷带裹住她那对
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona’s body is more slender than most of the other korgonne you’ve seen, though she does still have fairly wide hips, bigger-than-average breasts, and a sizable derriere. Tight bandages wrap around her "

rows.original: pierced DD-cup
rows.translation: 带穿孔的DD罩杯
rows.raw: "pierced DD-cup "

rows.original: breasts, held up by an impressive looking neck brooch made of the same teal material. Kiona doesn’t appear to have nearly the same amount of fat that most lady korgonne have, likely from years of hard work and labor. She is still respectably thick at the thighs despite this, however.
rows.translation: 乳房，并由一枚用同种青绿色材料制成、看起来十分华丽的颈饰托住。琪奥娜的脂肪似乎远少于大多数科尔贡女性，这大概是多年辛勤劳动的结果。尽管如此，她的大腿依然厚实得体。
rows.raw: "breasts, held up by an impressive looking neck brooch made of the same teal material. Kiona doesn’t appear to have nearly the same amount of fat that most lady korgonne have, likely from years of hard work and labor. She is still respectably thick at the thighs despite this, however."

rows.original: A modest light-blue loincloth covers her most private of parts.
rows.translation: 一条端庄的浅蓝色缠腰布遮住她最私密的部位。
rows.raw: "\n\nA modest light-blue loincloth covers her most private of parts."

rows.original: From your previous trysts with her, you know she has a moist snatch that emits the most wonderful pheromonal aroma of mint. Her tight pucker rests behind and just above it where it belongs.
rows.translation: 根据以前和她的云雨经历，你知道她有一条湿润的肉缝，会散发最美妙的薄荷信息素香气。紧窄的菊穴位于其后方稍高处，正是应在的位置。
rows.raw: " From your previous trysts with her, you know she has a moist snatch that emits the most wonderful pheromonal aroma of mint. Her tight pucker rests behind and just above it where it belongs."

rows.original: It’s kind of difficult to tell what she’s packing underneath, but there isn’t a visible bulge, and a faint scent of mint wafts from her. She closes her legs suddenly when she notices you staring,
rows.translation: 很难看清她在下面藏着什么，不过没有明显的隆起，一缕淡淡的薄荷香飘来。当她发现你正盯着看时，突然合拢双腿，
rows.raw: " It’s kind of difficult to tell what she’s packing underneath, but there isn’t a visible bulge, and a faint scent of mint wafts from her. She closes her legs suddenly when she notices you staring,"

rows.original: blushing while murmuring, “H-hey... No staring.”
rows.translation: 红着脸低声说道：“嘿——嘿... 别盯着看。”
rows.raw: " blushing while murmuring, “H-hey... No staring.”"

rows.original: blushing while murmuring, “H-hey... No stare.”
rows.translation: 红着脸低声说道：“嘿——嘿... 不许看。”
rows.raw: " blushing while murmuring, “H-hey... No stare.”"

rows.original: growling and muttering various obscenities under her breath.
rows.translation: 一边低吼，一边压低声音咕哝着各种脏话。
rows.raw: " growling and muttering various obscenities under her breath."

rows.original: You attempt to take a good look at the short corgi-girl working the store, only to have her rap loudly against the counter, causing you to flinch in surprise.
rows.translation: 你试图仔细打量正在店里工作的矮小柯基女孩，她却用力敲响柜台，吓得你猛然一缩。
rows.raw: "You attempt to take a good look at the short corgi-girl working the store, only to have her rap loudly against the counter, causing you to flinch in surprise."

rows.original: “Hey! There’s no eye-candy here! And no, I’m not for sale.”
rows.translation: “嘿！这里可没有让你大饱眼福的东西！而且不，我是非卖品。”
rows.raw: " “Hey! There’s no eye-candy here! And no, I’m not for sale.”"

rows.original: “Hey! No eye-sweets! No, Kiona not for sellings.”
rows.translation: “嘿！没有养眼甜点！不，琪奥娜不卖。”
rows.raw: " “Hey! No eye-sweets! No, Kiona not for sellings.”"

rows.original: She huffs, clearly growing more impatient with you with each passing moment. Looks like you’ll need to get her on friendlier grounds in order to have her not be so antsy around you.
rows.translation: 她气呼呼地喘着气，显然每过一刻都对你更加不耐烦。看来你得先和她建立更友好的关系，才能让她在你身边不再如此紧张。
rows.raw: " She huffs, clearly growing more impatient with you with each passing moment. Looks like you’ll need to get her on friendlier grounds in order to have her not be so antsy around you."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: You’re already doing this!
rows.translation: 你已经在做这件事了！
rows.raw: "You’re already doing this!"

rows.original: Before you can ask Kiona if there was anything she wants to talk to you about, she quickly holds a paw to your face and shakes her head.
rows.translation: 还没等你问琪欧娜有没有什么想和你聊的，她便迅速抬起一只爪子挡在你面前，摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "Before you can ask Kiona if there was anything she wants to talk to you about, she quickly holds a paw to your face and shakes her head."

rows.original: “No. You’re a selfish outsider like the rest. You said no to helping me, and yet you still insist on talking? Well, sorry, I’m behind on orders, so I’m still too busy for you. That is... unless you changed your mind? My request is still open, if you’re still considering... Forge knows I could use the help.”
rows.translation: “不行。你和其他人一样，都是个自私的外来者。你拒绝帮我，却还坚持要聊天？抱歉，我的订单已经积压了，所以还是没空理你。除非...你改变主意了？如果你还在考虑，我的请求仍然有效...锻炉在上，我确实需要帮忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. You’re a selfish outsider like the rest. You said no to helping me, and yet you still insist on talking? Well, sorry, I’m behind on orders, so I’m still too busy for you. That is... unless you changed your mind? My request is still open, if you’re still considering... Forge knows I could use the help.”"

rows.original: “No. Selfish alien like rest. Alien say no to helpings, and still want talkings? Sorry. Still behind. Still busy for alien. Unless change mind? Still can gettings blue sparkle rock if wants... Forge know Kiona need helpings.”
rows.translation: “不行。自私外星人和其他一样。外星人不肯帮忙，还想聊天？抱歉。还是落后。还是没空理外星人。除非改变主意？如果想要...还是可以去拿蓝色闪亮石头。锻炉知道琪欧娜需要帮忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No. Selfish alien like rest. Alien say no to helpings, and still want talkings? Sorry. Still behind. Still busy for alien. Unless change mind? Still can gettings blue sparkle rock if wants... Forge know Kiona need helpings.”"

rows.original: The korgonne sighs, wiping a brow in exasperation. From the sullen bags under eyes, she seems like she’s had a rough time, and could use a break from her stresses. You could lend a helping hand for the woebegone korgi-girl if you wanted. She would likely appreciate the help.
rows.translation: 这名科尔贡叹了口气，懊恼地擦着额头。从眼下阴沉的眼袋来看，她近来过得很辛苦，需要暂时摆脱压力休息一下。只要你愿意，完全可以向这位愁苦的科尔贡姑娘伸出援手。她多半会感激你的帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne sighs, wiping a brow in exasperation. From the sullen bags under eyes, she seems like she’s had a rough time, and could use a break from her stresses. You could lend a helping hand for the woebegone korgi-girl if you wanted. She would likely appreciate the help."

rows.original: You ask the korgonne shopkeeper if there was anything that she could tell you about herself, though all this earns is an eye-roll and a frown.
rows.translation: 你问这名科尔贡店主有没有什么关于她自己的事可以告诉你，换来的却只有一个白眼和一张皱起的脸。
rows.raw: "You ask the korgonne shopkeeper if there was anything that she could tell you about herself, though all this earns is an eye-roll and a frown."

rows.original: “Look... I’m a busy korgonne. I’m still backed up on orders as it is. I just don’t have any time for idle conversation. If that’s all you needed, then I need to go back to work.”
rows.translation: “听着...我是个很忙的科尔贡。订单到现在还积压着。我实在没时间闲聊。如果你只想说这些，那我得回去干活了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look... I’m a busy korgonne. I’m still backed up on orders as it is. I just don’t have any time for idle conversation. If that’s all you needed, then I need to go back to work.”"

rows.original: “Look... This busy korgonne. Am still backed up in orders. No time for no-meanings chit-chats. If that all, need to work again.”
rows.translation: “听着...这个科尔贡很忙。订单还积压。没时间没意义闲聊。如果就这些，得继续干活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look... This busy korgonne. Am still backed up in orders. No time for no-meanings chit-chats. If that all, need to work again.”"

rows.original: Kiona sighs and turns towards the forge, walking sluggishly towards it.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜叹了口气，转身朝锻炉走去，脚步有气无力。
rows.raw: " Kiona sighs and turns towards the forge, walking sluggishly towards it."

rows.original: You stare at her incredulously,
rows.translation: 你难以置信地盯着她，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stare at her incredulously,"

rows.original: speechless from the rude gesture. You were just trying to strike up a conversation.
rows.translation: 被这个粗鲁举动弄得哑口无言。你不过是想和她聊聊天而已。
rows.raw: " speechless from the rude gesture. You were just trying to strike up a conversation."

rows.original: unable to come up with any witty remark to say to her in retaliation. Well, if she’s going to turn her back on you... you’ll just help yourself to an eyeful of ass.
rows.translation: 一时想不出任何机智的话来回敬她。好吧，既然她要背对着你...你就不客气地饱览一番她的屁股。
rows.raw: " unable to come up with any witty remark to say to her in retaliation. Well, if she’s going to turn her back on you... you’ll just help yourself to an eyeful of ass."

rows.original: your mind racing with the hundreds of ways you want to tell her off with how rude she is being to someone who just helped her.
rows.translation: 脑海中飞速掠过上百种训斥她的方式，想让她明白这样对待刚帮过自己的人有多失礼。
rows.raw: " your mind racing with the hundreds of ways you want to tell her off with how rude she is being to someone who just helped her."

rows.original: Feeling the heat of your gaze, she eventually pauses mid-stride and stands there for a few seconds before turning to you again. Her expression is still deadly serious, though you can see the telltale signs of fatigue. After a brief stare-down, she finally resigns, dropping her usual cold demeanor with a tired sigh and trudges over to you again.
rows.translation: 感受到你灼热的视线，她终于在半路停下，站了几秒才再次转向你。她仍然一脸严肃，不过你看得出明显的疲惫迹象。短暂对视后，她终于认输，疲惫地叹了口气，放下平时冷淡的架子，拖着脚步重新走向你。
rows.raw: " Feeling the heat of your gaze, she eventually pauses mid-stride and stands there for a few seconds before turning to you again. Her expression is still deadly serious, though you can see the telltale signs of fatigue. After a brief stare-down, she finally resigns, dropping her usual cold demeanor with a tired sigh and trudges over to you again."

rows.original: “L-listen. I don’t exactly trust you off-worlders at all, but... at the moment, I’m getting desperate. If you’re this persistent in getting to know me, then... can you help me out once more?”
rows.translation: “听、听着。我确实一点都不信任你们这些外星人，但...现在我真的快没办法了。既然你这么坚持想了解我，那...能再帮我一次吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-listen. I don’t exactly trust you off-worlders at all, but... at the moment, I’m getting desperate. If you’re this persistent in getting to know me, then... can you help me out once more?”"

rows.original: “L-listen. No trusting aliens, but... am growings desperate. If alien persistent in knowing korgonne, then... help once more?”
rows.translation: “听、听着。不信任外星人，但...越来越没办法。如果外星人坚持了解科尔贡，那...再帮一次？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“L-listen. No trusting aliens, but... am growings desperate. If alien persistent in knowing korgonne, then... help once more?”"

rows.original: Kiona’s downcast eyes sneak a glance at you, which quickly look away again once she makes eye contact.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜低垂的双眼偷偷瞥了你一下，刚与你对上视线便迅速移开。
rows.raw: " Kiona’s downcast eyes sneak a glance at you, which quickly look away again once she makes eye contact."

rows.original: “You don’t seem like one of the bad ones, and I’m also kinda curious about you. I want to find out if you’re as strong as you seem to be kind. I hate asking for help, but I really need it.”
rows.translation: “你看起来不像那些坏家伙，而且我也有点好奇你。我想知道你是不是和表现出来的一样，既强大又善良。我讨厌求人，但真的需要帮助。”
rows.raw: " “You don’t seem like one of the bad ones, and I’m also kinda curious about you. I want to find out if you’re as strong as you seem to be kind. I hate asking for help, but I really need it.”"

rows.original: “Alien not seem bad like others, but Kiona also curious about this alien. Wantings to see if strong as alien seems kind. Hate askings, but really need it.”
rows.translation: “外星人不像其他坏家伙，琪欧娜也好奇这个外星人。想看是不是像善良一样强大。讨厌求助，但真的需要。”
rows.raw: " “Alien not seem bad like others, but Kiona also curious about this alien. Wantings to see if strong as alien seems kind. Hate askings, but really need it.”"

rows.original: The korgonne pleads. You can’t help but melt when she looks at you again with those exhausted eyes of hers.
rows.translation: 这名科尔贡恳求道。她再次用那双疲惫的眼睛望着你时，你忍不住心软了。
rows.raw: " The korgonne pleads. You can’t help but melt when she looks at you again with those exhausted eyes of hers."

rows.original: “Okay, I’ll listen at least, if it means l can get you to ease up a little.”
rows.translation: “好吧，我至少会听听，这样也许能让你稍微放松点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, I’ll listen at least, if it means l can get you to ease up a little.”"

rows.original: “Alright. I’ll listen, for now.”
rows.translation: “好吧。我会听，暂时。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright. I’ll listen, for now.”"

rows.original: You lean over the counter attentively, waiting for her request. The vendor shifts in place for a short while before continuing.
rows.translation: 你专注地俯身靠在柜台上，等着听她的请求。商贩在原地不安地挪动了一会儿，才继续说下去。
rows.raw: " You lean over the counter attentively, waiting for her request. The vendor shifts in place for a short while before continuing."

rows.original: “I need one of those blue shiny rocks, kinda like the one on my necklace. They’re mainly found near the frostwyrm territory to the far east. I tried asking others to help me look, but the other korgonne hunters are too scared of getting eaten. I’m not stupid enough to go by myself either. I’m not strong enough,”
rows.translation: “我需要一块那种蓝色发亮的石头，有点像我项链上的这块。它们主要出现在遥远东方的霜龙领地附近。我试过请别人帮忙找，可其他科尔贡猎人都害怕被吃掉。我也没蠢到要独自过去。我不够强，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I need one of those blue shiny rocks, kinda like the one on my necklace. They’re mainly found near the frostwyrm territory to the far east. I tried asking others to help me look, but the other korgonne hunters are too scared of getting eaten. I’m not stupid enough to go by myself either. I’m not strong enough,”"

rows.original: “Needings blue rock sparkle like on necklace. Only find near white-wyrm land far east. Ask others before alien, but other korgonne scared to be eaten. Not stupid to go by self too. Not strong enough.”
rows.translation: “需要蓝色闪亮石头，像项链上的。只能在遥远东方白龙土地附近找到。在外星人之前问过别人，但其他科尔贡怕被吃。不笨，不会自己去。还不够强。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Needings blue rock sparkle like on necklace. Only find near white-wyrm land far east. Ask others before alien, but other korgonne scared to be eaten. Not stupid to go by self too. Not strong enough.”"

rows.original: Kiona growls out the last words. Her hands curl into fists, and a grimace forms on her muzzle.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜咬牙吐出最后几个字。她双手握成拳头，口鼻处浮现一抹痛苦的表情。
rows.raw: " Kiona growls out the last words. Her hands curl into fists, and a grimace forms on her muzzle."

rows.original: “You... might be strong enough. Maybe you might have better luck than me?”
rows.translation: “你...也许够强。也许你的运气会比我好？”
rows.raw: " “You... might be strong enough. Maybe you might have better luck than me?”"

rows.original: “You... maybe strong. Maybe better luck?”
rows.translation: “你...也许很强。也许运气更好？”
rows.raw: " “You... maybe strong. Maybe better luck?”"

rows.original: The korgonne asks, fully avoiding eye-contact with you as if expecting you to reject the offer.
rows.translation: 这名科尔贡问道，完全避开与你对视，仿佛早已料定你会拒绝。
rows.raw: " The korgonne asks, fully avoiding eye-contact with you as if expecting you to reject the offer."

rows.original: The prospect of potentially facing down a real motherfucking dragon seems downright suicidal. On the plus side, you won’t necessarily have to fight it off; just hopefully not encounter it in its territory.
rows.translation: 想到可能要正面对上一条货真价实的他妈巨龙，简直和自杀没什么两样。好的一面是，你未必非得击退它；只要希望别在它的领地里遇上就好。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe prospect of potentially facing down a real motherfucking dragon seems downright suicidal. On the plus side, you won’t necessarily have to fight it off; just hopefully not encounter it in its territory."

rows.original: Fortunately for you, you managed to mate with her, so getting her jewel shouldn’t be much of an issue for you, barring the occasional hostile encounter along the way and inclement weather. Telling Kiona about your pairing would likely lead to confusion, so withholding that information from her would be best for now. Still, it should be an easy enough task.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，你已经成功和她交配过，所以拿到她的宝石应该没什么问题，顶多是沿途偶尔遇到敌袭和恶劣天气。把你们配对的事告诉琪欧娜很可能只会让她困惑，因此目前最好还是瞒着她。不过，这项任务应该足够简单。
rows.raw: "\n\nFortunately for you, you managed to mate with her, so getting her jewel shouldn’t be much of an issue for you, barring the occasional hostile encounter along the way and inclement weather. Telling Kiona about your pairing would likely lead to confusion, so withholding that information from her would be best for now. Still, it should be an easy enough task."

rows.original: From your last encounter with the frostwyrm, you won and took it out for good. Venturing deep into the deep parts of the glacial rift will be easier with that beast out of the picture, making this a menial task... supposing there isn’t more of its kind out there.
rows.translation: 上次遭遇霜龙时，你赢了，并彻底解决了它。如今那头野兽已经不在，深入冰川裂谷深处会轻松许多，这让任务变成了件小事...前提是外面没有更多同类。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom your last encounter with the frostwyrm, you won and took it out for good. Venturing deep into the deep parts of the glacial rift will be easier with that beast out of the picture, making this a menial task... supposing there isn’t more of its kind out there."

rows.original: After your last encounter with the frostwyrm, it is gone for good. Venturing deep into the deep parts of the glacial rift will be easier with that beast out of the picture, making this a menial task... supposing there isn’t more of its kind out there.
rows.translation: 上次遭遇霜龙之后，它已经永远消失了。如今那头野兽已经不在，深入冰川裂谷深处会轻松许多，这让任务变成了件小事...前提是外面没有更多同类。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter your last encounter with the frostwyrm, it is gone for good. Venturing deep into the deep parts of the glacial rift will be easier with that beast out of the picture, making this a menial task... supposing there isn’t more of its kind out there."

rows.original: It didn’t seem interested in chasing after you during your last run-in. Just a simple find and grab errand. It should be easy enough... right?
rows.translation: 上次碰面时，它似乎没兴趣追赶你。只是个找到东西再带回来的简单差事。应该足够轻松...对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt didn’t seem interested in chasing after you during your last run-in. Just a simple find and grab errand. It should be easy enough... right?"

rows.original: Your last encounter with the frostwyrm didn’t go very well, and you’re thankful that you were still able to make it out in one piece. Another fight with it could very well spell the end for you, but maybe you’ll luck out and not run into it this time.
rows.translation: 你上次遭遇霜龙的结果并不好，很庆幸自己还能完整逃出来。再和它打一场很可能会让你送命，不过这次也许能走运，不会碰见它。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour last encounter with the frostwyrm didn’t go very well, and you’re thankful that you were still able to make it out in one piece. Another fight with it could very well spell the end for you, but maybe you’ll luck out and not run into it this time."

rows.original: Strong enough indeed. You were able to fend the frostwyrm the last time you encountered it. With proper preparation, you could likely beat it off again should you run into it... that is if you want to go through the trouble for Kiona.
rows.translation: 确实足够强。上次遇到霜龙时，你成功击退了它。只要准备充分，再碰上时你多半也能再次赶走它...当然，前提是你愿意为琪欧娜费这番工夫。
rows.raw: "\n\nStrong enough indeed. You were able to fend the frostwyrm the last time you encountered it. With proper preparation, you could likely beat it off again should you run into it... that is if you want to go through the trouble for Kiona."

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Sure, why not?
rows.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？
rows.raw: "Sure, why not?"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Heeeell naw.
rows.translation: 绝——对不行。
rows.raw: "Heeeell naw."

rows.original: You agree to help, though you emphasize that you won’t make any promises, and might have to renege should things get too dangerous.
rows.translation: 你答应帮忙，不过也强调不会作出任何保证；如果事情变得太危险，你可能不得不反悔。
rows.raw: "You agree to help, though you emphasize that you won’t make any promises, and might have to renege should things get too dangerous."

rows.original: “That’s fair. If you do this for me though, I’d be extremely thankful. I’ll have the last of my backed-up orders done, and maybe more time to myself since I’ll have more supplies! Until then, I just don’t have time to talk. Gotta keep working.”
rows.translation: “这很公平。不过，如果你真能帮我办到，我会非常感激。积压的最后一批订单就能完成，有了更多材料，我或许也能多些自己的时间！在那之前，我确实没空聊天。必须继续工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s fair. If you do this for me though, I’d be extremely thankful. I’ll have the last of my backed-up orders done, and maybe more time to myself since I’ll have more supplies! Until then, I just don’t have time to talk. Gotta keep working.”"

rows.original: “Is fair. If alien does it, Kiona will be many thanks. Will have last back-orders done, more time for talkings with more supply! Until then, can’t talk. Must work.”
rows.translation: “很公平。如果外星人做到，琪欧娜会非常感谢。最后积压订单能完成，有更多材料就有更多时间聊天！在那之前，不能聊。必须工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is fair. If alien does it, Kiona will be many thanks. Will have last back-orders done, more time for talkings with more supply! Until then, can’t talk. Must work.”"

rows.original: The shopkeeper sweeps a few errant strands of hair from her face with a paw before regaining her normal composure.
rows.translation: 店主用爪子拨开脸旁几缕散乱的头发，重新恢复了平常的仪态。
rows.raw: " The shopkeeper sweeps a few errant strands of hair from her face with a paw before regaining her normal composure."

rows.original: “Now, are you going to buy something, or was that all?”
rows.translation: “现在，你要买点东西，还是就这些？”
rows.raw: " “Now, are you going to buy something, or was that all?”"

rows.original: “Now, alien buy, or is it all?”
rows.translation: “现在，外星人买东西，还是就这些？”
rows.raw: " “Now, alien buy, or is it all?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You shake your head, not wanting to go through with her difficult request. Kiona grunts in frustration, her mouth widening into a scowl as she crosses her arms across her bosom.
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，不想接受她这项艰难的请求。琪欧娜沮丧地哼了一声，双臂抱在胸前，嘴巴咧成一道怒容。
rows.raw: "You shake your head, not wanting to go through with her difficult request. Kiona grunts in frustration, her mouth widening into a scowl as she crosses her arms across her bosom."

rows.original: “Figures. I would have thought you’d love the challenge, but all you off-worlders are good for are picking on things weaker than yourselves. If you’re not wanting to help me, then you’re wasting my time.”
rows.translation: “果然如此。我还以为你会喜欢这种挑战，可你们这些外星人只会欺负比自己弱小的东西。既然不想帮我，那就是在浪费我的时间。”
rows.raw: " “Figures. I would have thought you’d love the challenge, but all you off-worlders are good for are picking on things weaker than yourselves. If you’re not wanting to help me, then you’re wasting my time.”"

rows.original: “Figures. Thinkings love challenge, but all aliens good for only pick on things weaker than them. If no wantings to help, then wastings time.”
rows.translation: “果然。还以为喜欢挑战，但外星人只会欺负比自己弱的东西。如果不想帮忙，就是浪费时间。”
rows.raw: " “Figures. Thinkings love challenge, but all aliens good for only pick on things weaker than them. If no wantings to help, then wastings time.”"

rows.original: With a huff, Kiona shuffles back over to the forge and continues where she left off with her work.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜气呼呼地拖着脚步回到锻炉旁，从刚才停下的地方继续工作。
rows.raw: " With a huff, Kiona shuffles back over to the forge and continues where she left off with her work."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: KORGII V24
rows.raw: "KORGII V24"

rows.original: “Oh? Yeah, sure! What did you want to talk about?”
rows.translation: “哦？好啊，当然！你想聊什么？”
rows.raw: "“Oh? Yeah, sure! What did you want to talk about?”"

rows.original: “Oh? Sure! What alien want talkings about?”
rows.translation: “哦？当然！外星人想聊什么？”
rows.raw: "“Oh? Sure! What alien want talkings about?”"

rows.original: Kiona
rows.translation: 琪奥娜
rows.raw: "Kiona"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You"

rows.original: Aliens
rows.translation: 外星人
rows.raw: "Aliens"

rows.original: Jewelcraft
rows.translation: 珠宝工艺
rows.raw: "Jewelcraft"

rows.original: Hunting
rows.translation: 狩猎
rows.raw: "Hunting"

rows.original: Rescuer
rows.translation: 救援者
rows.raw: "Rescuer"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “O-oh, me? The Kerborus want to know about...” Kiona trails off, visibly caught off guard. “Eh... to tell the truth, I’m not sure what I can tell you about me that might be interesting compared to what you do.”
rows.translation: “哦、哦，我？刻耳柏洛斯想了解...”琪欧娜的话音渐渐消失，显然有些措手不及。“呃...说实话，和你做的那些事相比，我不知道自己有什么值得一提的趣事。”
rows.raw: "“O-oh, me? The Kerborus want to know about...” Kiona trails off, visibly caught off guard. “Eh... to tell the truth, I’m not sure what I can tell you about me that might be interesting compared to what you do.”"

rows.original: After a bit of persuasion on your part, Kiona finally manages to start. “Well... there’s not much to say about me really. I am a jewelcrafter here, which pretty much means I shape rocks and gems into wearable accessories and stuff... simple work really for us korgonne.” Kiona pauses, shuffling her feet during the awkward silence before clearing her throat and continuing. “I like to say I’m good enough at it that even the elders often look to me for some of my works.” She smiles slightly. Judging from what is on display on the counter and comparing the jewelry to what you’ve seen on Ula, you don’t think she’s exactly fibbing.
rows.translation: 在你的劝说下，琪欧娜终于开了口。“嗯...其实我没什么好说的。我是这里的珠宝匠，基本就是把石头和宝石加工成可以佩戴的饰品之类...对我们科尔贡来说，这工作真的很简单。”尴尬的沉默中，琪欧娜挪了挪脚，随后清清嗓子继续说道。“我敢说自己的手艺足够好，就连长老们也常来找我做东西。”她微微一笑。从柜台上的展品来看，再和你在乌拉身上见过的首饰比较，你觉得她确实没有吹牛。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a bit of persuasion on your part, Kiona finally manages to start. “Well... there’s not much to say about me really. I am a jewelcrafter here, which pretty much means I shape rocks and gems into wearable accessories and stuff... simple work really for us korgonne.” Kiona pauses, shuffling her feet during the awkward silence before clearing her throat and continuing. “I like to say I’m good enough at it that even the elders often look to me for some of my works.” She smiles slightly. Judging from what is on display on the counter and comparing the jewelry to what you’ve seen on Ula, you don’t think she’s exactly fibbing."

rows.original: Relieved that she’s opening up more, you ask if there’s anything more she can tell you outside of her jewelcrafting. Kiona shakes her head slightly. “Not really... I don’t get to go out much, so my life is fairly simple. Pretty much exercise at dawn, work on jewels the rest of the day, then sleep. Occasionally I help the hunters of the hold with their trinkets, but that’s about it.” She shrugs nonchalantly.
rows.translation: 见她愿意多说一些，你便问她除了珠宝手艺之外还有没有别的事可以讲。琪欧娜轻轻摇头。“没有了...我不怎么出门，所以生活很简单。基本就是黎明时锻炼，余下时间加工珠宝，然后睡觉。偶尔也会帮据点里的猎人做些小饰物，不过也就这样。”她若无其事地耸耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\nRelieved that she’s opening up more, you ask if there’s anything more she can tell you outside of her jewelcrafting. Kiona shakes her head slightly. “Not really... I don’t get to go out much, so my life is fairly simple. Pretty much exercise at dawn, work on jewels the rest of the day, then sleep. Occasionally I help the hunters of the hold with their trinkets, but that’s about it.” She shrugs nonchalantly."

rows.original: “But uh... that’s enough about boring ol’ me... I’d much rather hear about our resident star-flier here!” Kiona leans in slightly in expectancy.
rows.translation: “不过，呃...无聊的我就说到这里吧...我更想听听我们这位星际飞行者的故事！”琪欧娜满怀期待地微微靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But uh... that’s enough about boring ol’ me... I’d much rather hear about our resident star-flier here!” Kiona leans in slightly in expectancy."

rows.original: “O-oh... Kerborus wantings know about...” Kiona trails off, visibly caught off guard. “Eh... tellings truth, Kiona not sure what can tell that interestings compare to Kerborus.”
rows.translation: “哦、哦...刻耳柏洛斯想了解...”琪欧娜的话音渐渐消失，显然有些措手不及。“呃...说实话，琪欧娜不知道能说什么，会比刻耳柏洛斯更有趣。”
rows.raw: "“O-oh... Kerborus wantings know about...” Kiona trails off, visibly caught off guard. “Eh... tellings truth, Kiona not sure what can tell that interestings compare to Kerborus.”"

rows.original: After a bit of persuasion on your part, Kiona finally manages to start. “Well... not much sayings about Kiona really. Am a sparklecrafter, which mean shape rocks and sparkle rocks into body sparkles and stuff... easy workings for korgonne.”
rows.translation: 在你的劝说下，琪欧娜终于开了口。“嗯...琪欧娜真的没什么好说。是闪亮工匠，就是把石头和闪亮石头做成身体闪亮饰品之类...对科尔贡来说是简单工作。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a bit of persuasion on your part, Kiona finally manages to start. “Well... not much sayings about Kiona really. Am a sparklecrafter, which mean shape rocks and sparkle rocks into body sparkles and stuff... easy workings for korgonne.”"

Judging from what is on display on the counter and comparing the jewelry to what you’ve seen on Ula, you don’t think she’s exactly fibbing.

Judging from what is on display on the counter and comparing the jewelry to what you’ve seen on Ula, you don’t think she’s exactly fibbing."

No gettings out much, so life simple. Just work out in day startings, work on sparkles rest of day, then sleep. Kiona sometimes help hunters of hold with trinkets, but that it.” She shrugs nonchalantly.
rows.translation: 见她愿意多说一些，你便问她除了珠宝手艺之外还有没有别的事可以讲。琪欧娜轻轻摇头。“没有...不怎么出门，所以生活简单。就是一天开始时锻炼，余下时间做闪亮东西，然后睡觉。琪欧娜有时帮据点猎人做小饰物，不过就这样。”她若无其事地耸耸肩。

No gettings out much, so life simple. Just work out in day startings, work on sparkles rest of day, then sleep. Kiona sometimes help hunters of hold with trinkets, but that it.” She shrugs nonchalantly."

rows.original: “Uh... that enough about boring Kiona... Would rather hear about alien star travelings!” Kiona leans in slightly in expectancy.
rows.translation: “呃...无聊琪欧娜就说到这里...更想听外星人的星际旅行！”琪欧娜满怀期待地微微靠近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... that enough about boring Kiona... Would rather hear about alien star travelings!” Kiona leans in slightly in expectancy."

rows.original: You strike up a conversation with her once more, now that she seems less strung up from her work orders. Kiona gives you a deadpan look.
rows.translation: 如今她不再因为订单而那么紧张，你再次找她聊了起来。琪欧娜面无表情地看着你。
rows.raw: "You strike up a conversation with her once more, now that she seems less strung up from her work orders. Kiona gives you a deadpan look."

rows.original: “Really? Even after all the crap I gave you about my jewels being stolen? Even after asking you to go all that way to get me this lucinite? You just come from that dragon’s lair, and you still want to know about me after all that?”
rows.translation: “真的？就算我因为珠宝被偷的事对你说了那么多混账话？就算我让你跑那么远替我找这块路西尼特？你才刚从那条龙的巢穴回来，经历这一切后还想了解我？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? Even after all the crap I gave you about my jewels being stolen? Even after asking you to go all that way to get me this lucinite? You just come from that dragon’s lair, and you still want to know about me after all that?”"

rows.original: Kiona snorts, breaking her neutral expression with a smirk.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜哼了一声，冷淡的表情化作一抹坏笑。
rows.raw: " Kiona snorts, breaking her neutral expression with a smirk."

rows.original: “You’re weird. You’re definitely not like other off-worlders. I would have thought you’d kill me after the way I treated you.”
rows.translation: “你真奇怪。你绝对和其他外星人不同。照我之前那样对你，我还以为你会杀了我。”
rows.raw: " “You’re weird. You’re definitely not like other off-worlders. I would have thought you’d kill me after the way I treated you.”"

rows.original: The korgonne stifles a laugh when she sees your serious expression.
rows.translation: 见你一脸严肃，这名科尔贡忍住笑声。
rows.raw: " The korgonne stifles a laugh when she sees your serious expression. "

rows.original: “You’re funny. I’m starting to like you a little. Fine, I’ll play.” She leans against the counter, nearly letting her assets spill free from their meager confines.
rows.translation: “你真有趣。我开始有点喜欢你了。好吧，我陪你聊。”她靠在柜台上，丰满的身体几乎要从那少得可怜的束缚中溢出来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re funny. I’m starting to like you a little. Fine, I’ll play.” She leans against the counter, nearly letting her assets spill free from their meager confines."

rows.original: “As you probably figured, I sell jewelry. I also craft them into wearable accessories to wear.” Then there’s an uncomfortable silence. Kiona takes the moment to adjust her neck brooch and chest wrappings.
rows.translation: “你大概已经猜到了，我卖珠宝，也会把它们做成可以佩戴的饰品。”随后是一阵令人不适的沉默。琪欧娜趁机调整了一下颈部胸针和胸前裹布。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As you probably figured, I sell jewelry. I also craft them into wearable accessories to wear.” Then there’s an uncomfortable silence. Kiona takes the moment to adjust her neck brooch and chest wrappings."

rows.original: “That’s... it?” you ask her, disappointment clear in your voice. To that question, Kiona can barely contain herself anymore. She bursts out laughing, yipping loud enough for the entire hallway to hear.
rows.translation: “就...这样？”你问道，声音里的失望毫不掩饰。听到这个问题，琪欧娜终于再也忍不住了。她放声大笑，欢叫声响得整条走廊都能听见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s... it?” you ask her, disappointment clear in your voice. To that question, Kiona can barely contain herself anymore. She bursts out laughing, yipping loud enough for the entire hallway to hear."

rows.original: “What did you expect? The life of a korgonne is pretty simple. Boring, too.. Well... until you off-landers showed up anyways. Now life is getting harsher. You’re the first one that doesn’t seem totally selfish... Still, I don’t know if you’re here for an ulterior motive or not, so don’t blame me for being wary.”
rows.translation: “你还期待什么？科尔贡的生活很简单，也很无聊..好吧...至少在你们这些外来者出现之前如此。现在生活越来越艰难了。你是第一个看起来不那么自私的人...不过，我还是不知道你有没有别的企图，所以别怪我保持警惕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did you expect? The life of a korgonne is pretty simple. Boring, too.. Well... until you off-landers showed up anyways. Now life is getting harsher. You’re the first one that doesn’t seem totally selfish... Still, I don’t know if you’re here for an ulterior motive or not, so don’t blame me for being wary.”"

rows.original: “Really? Even after givings crap about lost sparkles? Even after askings alien for hard task in gettings get blue sparkle rock from dragon lair? Alien comings back and still askings about Kiona?”
rows.translation: “真的？就算因为丢失闪亮东西对外星人说混账话？就算叫外星人做困难任务，去龙巢拿蓝色闪亮石头？外星人回来以后还想了解琪欧娜？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? Even after givings crap about lost sparkles? Even after askings alien for hard task in gettings get blue sparkle rock from dragon lair? Alien comings back and still askings about Kiona?”"

rows.original: Kiona snorts, breaking her neutral expression with a smirk.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜哼了一声，冷淡的表情化作一抹坏笑。
rows.raw: " Kiona snorts, breaking her neutral expression with a smirk."

rows.original: “Alien weird. Definitely not like others. Thinkings would kill Kiona after way treated alien...”
rows.translation: “外星人奇怪。绝对和其他不同。还以为照琪欧娜对待外星人的方式，外星人会杀掉琪欧娜...”
rows.raw: " “Alien weird. Definitely not like others. Thinkings would kill Kiona after way treated alien...”"

rows.original: The korgonne stifles a laugh when she sees your serious expression.
rows.translation: 见你一脸严肃，这名科尔贡忍住笑声。
rows.raw: " The korgonne stifles a laugh when she sees your serious expression."

rows.original: “Alien funny. Startings to like alien a little. Fine, Kiona play.” She leans against the counter, nearly letting her assets spill free from their meager confines.
rows.translation: “外星人有趣。开始有点喜欢外星人。好吧，琪欧娜陪你聊。”她靠在柜台上，丰满的身体几乎要从那少得可怜的束缚中溢出来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alien funny. Startings to like alien a little. Fine, Kiona play.” She leans against the counter, nearly letting her assets spill free from their meager confines."

rows.original: “As alien figure, Kiona am dealings with sparkles. Craft them into pretty sparkles to wear.” Then there’s an uncomfortable silence. Kiona takes the moment to adjust her neck brooch and chest wrappings.
rows.translation: “就像外星人猜的，琪欧娜做闪亮东西生意。把它们做成可以佩戴的漂亮闪亮东西。”随后是一阵令人不适的沉默。琪欧娜趁机调整了一下颈部胸针和胸前裹布。

rows.original: “What alien expect? Korgonne life simple. Boring, too. Well... until aliens show. Now it more trouble... You first one not seemings selfish. Still... Not knowings if here for other reasons or no, no blame Kiona if wary.”
rows.translation: “外星人期待什么？科尔贡生活简单。也无聊。好吧...直到外星人出现。现在更麻烦...你是第一个看起来不自私的。还是...不知道来这里有没有其他原因，如果琪欧娜警惕，不要责怪。”

rows.original: Jewelcraft
rows.translation: 珠宝工艺
rows.raw: "Jewelcraft"

rows.original: Hunting
rows.translation: 狩猎
rows.raw: "Hunting"

rows.original: “You know... before this, I wouldn’t have given a care about what you off-worlders do, especially after what I’ve heard from other hunters, but you... you’re clearly different.” Kiona smirks, giving you a once-over before continuing. “I’m curious to know if you go around world to world nosing into local affairs for a living?”
rows.translation: “你知道...在此之前，我根本不会在意你们这些外星人做什么，尤其是听过其他猎人的说法以后。不过你...你显然不一样。”琪欧娜坏笑着上下打量你一番，才继续说道。“我很好奇，你是不是靠一个世界接一个世界地四处插手当地事务谋生？”
rows.raw: "“You know... before this, I wouldn’t have given a care about what you off-worlders do, especially after what I’ve heard from other hunters, but you... you’re clearly different.” Kiona smirks, giving you a once-over before continuing. “I’m curious to know if you go around world to world nosing into local affairs for a living?”"

rows.original: Judging by the disarming smile she is wearing, it’s likely that doesn’t mean what she said in any harm. You take the opportunity to tell Kiona about your quest to find your late father’s probes, and your adventures along the way. Naturally, she struggles to understand many basic concepts of space travel, stopping you frequently to ask a question. Whenever you answer her, she slowly nods her head with a small “Ah, okay” before letting you continue. Her eyes hyper-focus onto you, her attention never wavering the entire time that you talk.
rows.translation: 看她脸上那毫无敌意的笑容，这句话多半并没有恶意。你借机告诉琪欧娜，自己正在寻找已故父亲留下的探针，以及一路上的冒险。她自然很难理解许多太空旅行的基本概念，不时打断你提出问题。每当你回答，她都会缓慢点头，小声说句“啊，明白了”，再让你继续。她的眼睛始终紧紧盯着你，在你讲述的整个过程中从未分心。

You take the opportunity to tell Kiona about your quest to find your late father’s probes, and your adventures along the way. Naturally, she struggles to understand many basic concepts of space travel, stopping you frequently to ask a question. Whenever you answer her, she slowly nods her head with a small “Ah, okay” before letting you continue. Her eyes hyper-focus onto you, her attention never wavering the entire time that you talk."

rows.original: When you finally finish explaining how a starship works to Kiona, she scratches her head in thought.
rows.translation: 等你终于向琪欧娜解释完星舰如何运作，她若有所思地挠了挠头。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you finally finish explaining how a starship works to Kiona, she scratches her head in thought."

rows.original: “Yeesh... space is... big. Complicated. It’s a lot for this korgonne to wrap her head around in one sitting.” Kiona laughs sheepishly “To be honest, being in that many different places with that many different aliens at once is kind of overwhelming... I think I’ll just stick to just getting to know the one in front of me for now.”
rows.translation: “天啊...太空...真大。也很复杂。这么多东西，科尔贡一次根本理解不了。”琪欧娜不好意思地笑了笑。“说实话，同时待在那么多不同地方，面对那么多不同外星人，感觉有点喘不过气...我想自己暂时还是先了解眼前这一个就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeesh... space is... big. Complicated. It’s a lot for this korgonne to wrap her head around in one sitting.” Kiona laughs sheepishly “To be honest, being in that many different places with that many different aliens at once is kind of overwhelming... I think I’ll just stick to just getting to know the one in front of me for now.”"

rows.original: “By the way, I never got your name. What should I call you?”
rows.translation: “对了，我还不知道你的名字。该怎么称呼你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“By the way, I never got your name. What should I call you?”"

rows.original: “My name is [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “我叫[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My name is [pc.name].”"

rows.original: “The name’s [pc.name]. [pc.name] Steele.” You put on your best suave impression, which only earns a raised eyebrow in confusion from her.
rows.translation: “名字是[pc.name]。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”你摆出自己最潇洒的模样，却只换来她困惑地挑起眉毛。

rows.original: You begrudgingly bring up your initial encounter, asking why she gave you the rough treatment despite being welcome into the hold. Kiona’s ears droop and her eyes avoid yours, looking away in embarrassment.
rows.translation: 你不情愿地提起初次见面的事，问她为什么明明你获准进入据点，她却还是粗暴地对待你。琪欧娜双耳垂下，尴尬地移开目光，不敢看你。
rows.raw: "You begrudgingly bring up your initial encounter, asking why she gave you the rough treatment despite being welcome into the hold. Kiona’s ears droop and her eyes avoid yours, looking away in embarrassment."

rows.original: “Oh... yeah. I’m sorry. Try not to take it too personally. I was just, um... I wanted you out of my shop and out of my hair. I was angry, a-and that wasn’t cool of me. Again, you don’t seem like a bad off-worlder compared to what I’ve heard from the other hunters here.” Kiona shuffles in place for a few moments before turning to you.
rows.translation: “哦...对。对不起。尽量别太往心里去。我只是，呃...想让你离开店里，别再来烦我。当时我很生气，而、而且那样做确实不对。再说一次，和我从这里其他猎人那里听说的相比，你看起来不是个坏外星人。”琪欧娜在原地不安地挪动了一会儿，才转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... yeah. I’m sorry. Try not to take it too personally. I was just, um... I wanted you out of my shop and out of my hair. I was angry, a-and that wasn’t cool of me. Again, you don’t seem like a bad off-worlder compared to what I’ve heard from the other hunters here.” Kiona shuffles in place for a few moments before turning to you."

rows.original: “You really did help me out a ton though... You helped me restock my shop, and even went out of your way to get me some lucinite. Hell, even the other korgs here don’t seem to be as brave as you seem to be for going out so far to get this stuff for me. Don’t tell the others I said this though.” The korgonne winks slyly at you.
rows.translation: “不过，你确实帮了我大忙...你帮我补充店里的货物，甚至还特意替我找来一些路西尼特。见鬼，就连这里其他科尔贡似乎都没你这么勇敢，愿意跑那么远替我拿这些东西。不过别告诉别人是我说的。”这名科尔贡狡黠地向你眨眨眼。

rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个！
rows.raw: "You just talked about this!"

rows.raw: "Aliens"

rows.translation: 珠宝工艺
rows.raw: "Jewelcraft"

rows.original: Hunting
rows.translation: 狩猎
rows.raw: "Hunting"

rows.original: Out of curiosity, you ask Kiona to elaborate on what she heard from her fellow korg mates about off-worlders.
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你让琪欧娜详细说说同族伙伴提到的那些外星人传闻。
rows.raw: "Out of curiosity, you ask Kiona to elaborate on what she heard from her fellow korg mates about off-worlders."

rows.original: “Ah... I don’t know... just, things.” The korgonne stammers bringing a paw to her muzzle while looking to the side nervously. “I... I mean, did you see how Tuuva and Maja turned out from their run-ins with you off-worlders and your weird things?”
rows.translation: “啊... 我不知道... 就是，一些事。”科尔贡人结结巴巴地说着，一只爪子抬到口鼻旁，紧张地望向一边。“我... 我是说，你没看到图瓦和玛雅遇上你们外星人和那些怪东西以后变成什么样了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... I don’t know... just, things.” The korgonne stammers bringing a paw to her muzzle while looking to the side nervously. “I... I mean, did you see how Tuuva and Maja turned out from their run-ins with you off-worlders and your weird things?”"

rows.original: “Ah... Kiona not know... just, stuffs.” The korgonne stammers bringing a paw to her muzzle while looking to the side nervously. “Kiona mean... Did alien see how Tuuva and Maja turn from meetings aliens and weird things?”
rows.translation: “啊... 琪欧娜不知道... 就是，一些事。”科尔贡人结结巴巴地说着，一只爪子抬到口鼻旁，紧张地望向一边。“琪欧娜是说... 外星人没看到图瓦和玛雅遇到外星人与怪东西后变成什么样吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah... Kiona not know... just, stuffs.” The korgonne stammers bringing a paw to her muzzle while looking to the side nervously. “Kiona mean... Did alien see how Tuuva and Maja turn from meetings aliens and weird things?”"

rows.original: Now that she mentions it, the korgonne in question did have some unexpected ‘effects’ from running into foreign technology.
rows.translation: 经她这么一说，那两名科尔贡人接触外来科技之后，确实出现了一些意想不到的“变化”。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that she mentions it, the korgonne in question did have some unexpected ‘effects’ from running into foreign technology."

rows.original: “You see? Now you can understand why I’m kinda paranoid about your kind. I know they’re dealing with their ‘changes’ but I don’t want to risk that myself. I like my body just the way it is, and I worked hard keeping it this way! I don’t need you off-worlders screwing that up!”
rows.translation: “明白了吧？现在你该知道我为什么对你们这么多疑了。我知道她们正在适应那些‘变化’，可我不想让自己也冒这个险。我喜欢自己现在的身体，而且为了保持这样付出了很多努力！我可不需要你们外星人把它搞砸！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You see? Now you can understand why I’m kinda paranoid about your kind. I know they’re dealing with their ‘changes’ but I don’t want to risk that myself. I like my body just the way it is, and I worked hard keeping it this way! I don’t need you off-worlders screwing that up!”"

rows.original: “Alien see? Can understandings why Kiona wary of outsiders. Kiona know they dealings with ‘new parts’ but no want to risk it. Kiona like body way it is, work hard to keep! No needings aliens messing body up.”
rows.translation: “外星人明白了？现在能理解琪欧娜为什么提防外来者。琪欧娜知道她们正在适应‘新部位’，但不想冒险。琪欧娜喜欢现在的身体，也努力保持！不需要外星人把身体搞坏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alien see? Can understandings why Kiona wary of outsiders. Kiona know they dealings with ‘new parts’ but no want to risk it. Kiona like body way it is, work hard to keep! No needings aliens messing body up.”"

rows.original: You shake your head, eager to know what befell of the korgonne that she mentioned.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，急切地想知道她提到的那两名科尔贡人究竟遭遇了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head, eager to know what befell of the korgonne that she mentioned."

rows.original: “Well... if you meet them, you’ll see. I won’t be the one to tell you what happened, but ever since hearing from them, I’m not too keen on having the same thing happen to me. You’ll understand why I’m so wary.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 如果你见到她们，自然就会明白。我不会告诉你究竟发生了什么，但听她们说过以后，我一点也不想让同样的事发生在自己身上。你会明白我为何这么警惕的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... if you meet them, you’ll see. I won’t be the one to tell you what happened, but ever since hearing from them, I’m not too keen on having the same thing happen to me. You’ll understand why I’m so wary.”"

rows.original: “Well... alien see if meet them. Kiona won’t be one to tell what happen, but since hearings from them, Kiona no want to have same happen to her. Alien will understand why Kiona so wary.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 外星人见到她们就会明白。琪欧娜不会说发生了什么，但听她们说过以后，琪欧娜不想让同样的事发生在自己身上。外星人会明白琪欧娜为什么警惕。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... alien see if meet them. Kiona won’t be one to tell what happen, but since hearings from them, Kiona no want to have same happen to her. Alien will understand why Kiona so wary.”"

rows.original: With your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. You barely have a chance to start before being tackled by the small ball of fluff, nearly knocking you over. She looks up to you and regards you with a pleasant smile on her face.
rows.translation: 你尽力向琪欧娜保证，自己和其他外星人并不一样，也不认同那些给科尔贡人带来负面影响的家伙。你才刚开口，就被这团小毛球扑了个满怀，险些摔倒。她抬头望着你，脸上挂着愉快的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. You barely have a chance to start before being tackled by the small ball of fluff, nearly knocking you over. She looks up to you and regards you with a pleasant smile on her face."

rows.original: “I already know you’re one of the good ones, [pc.name]! After saving me during that milodan invasion, I think you’ve more than proved to me that you mean well. I trust you.” Kiona nuzzles into your [pc.chest], sighing in comfort. Winning over her trust definitely has its benefits!
rows.translation: “我已经知道你是好人了，[pc.name]！你在米洛丹入侵时救了我，已经充分证明你没有恶意。我信任你。”琪欧娜依偎着你的[pc.chest]，惬意地叹了口气。赢得她的信任显然好处不少！
rows.raw: "\n\n“I already know you’re one of the good ones, [pc.name]! After saving me during that milodan invasion, I think you’ve more than proved to me that you mean well. I trust you.” Kiona nuzzles into your [pc.chest], sighing in comfort. Winning over her trust definitely has its benefits!"

rows.original: “Kiona know [pc.name] good alien! After savings Kiona during fang-cat raid, [pc.name] more than provings that [pc.name] mean well. Kiona trust [pc.name].” Kiona nuzzles into your [pc.chest], sighing in comfort. Winning over her trust definitely has its benefits!
rows.translation: “琪欧娜知道[pc.name]是好外星人！尖牙猫袭击时救了琪欧娜，[pc.name]已经充分证明[pc.name]没有恶意。琪欧娜信任[pc.name]。”琪欧娜依偎着你的[pc.chest]，惬意地叹了口气。赢得她的信任显然好处不少！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiona know [pc.name] good alien! After savings Kiona during fang-cat raid, [pc.name] more than provings that [pc.name] mean well. Kiona trust [pc.name].” Kiona nuzzles into your [pc.chest], sighing in comfort. Winning over her trust definitely has its benefits!"

rows.original: With your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. Throughout appealing your case, you notice that Kiona’s tail wags progressively faster behind her, and her brow furrows in deep thought. She raises a paw to her snout when you finish talking.
rows.translation: 你尽力向琪欧娜保证，自己和其他外星人并不一样，也不认同那些给科尔贡人带来负面影响的家伙。听你陈述时，琪欧娜身后的尾巴越摇越快，眉头也因沉思而紧锁。你说完后，她抬起一只爪子抵在口鼻旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. Throughout appealing your case, you notice that Kiona’s tail wags progressively faster behind her, and her brow furrows in deep thought. She raises a paw to her snout when you finish talking."

rows.original: “I think I’m now starting to realize, you were actually the one that helped us repel that milodan attack not long ago. I wish I realized that sooner instead of being stuck in my own worries. I heard about what you did for us, and I think I can trust you.”
rows.translation: “我现在才开始意识到，不久前帮我们击退米洛丹袭击的人其实就是你。真希望自己能早点明白，而不是一直困在那些忧虑里。我听说了你为我们做的事，觉得自己可以信任你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think I’m now starting to realize, you were actually the one that helped us repel that milodan attack not long ago. I wish I realized that sooner instead of being stuck in my own worries. I heard about what you did for us, and I think I can trust you.”"

rows.original: You stretch out your arm to shake on it, to which Kiona accepts it, wrapping her warm paw around your [pc.hand].
rows.translation: 你伸出手想与她握手，琪欧娜欣然接受，用温暖的爪子握住你的[pc.hand]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stretch out your arm to shake on it, to which Kiona accepts it, wrapping her warm paw around your [pc.hand]."

rows.original: “Thank you again for saving us.”
rows.translation: “再次感谢你救了我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you again for saving us.”"

rows.original: “Thinkings Kiona realize, [pc.name] was one that help beat up fang-cats in Korg’ii Hold attack not long ago. Wishings Kiona realize sooner instead being stuck in own problems. Kiona hear what [pc.name] do for korgonne, and believe can trustings [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “琪欧娜现在才明白，不久前科尔吉堡遭袭时，帮忙打跑尖牙猫的是[pc.name]。真希望琪欧娜早点明白，而不是只顾自己的烦恼。琪欧娜听说了[pc.name]为科尔贡人做的事，相信可以信任[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thinkings Kiona realize, [pc.name] was one that help beat up fang-cats in Korg’ii Hold attack not long ago. Wishings Kiona realize sooner instead being stuck in own problems. Kiona hear what [pc.name] do for korgonne, and believe can trustings [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You stretch out your arm to shake on it, to which Kiona accepts it, wrapping her warm paw around your [pc.hand].
rows.translation: 你伸出手想与她握手，琪欧娜欣然接受，用温暖的爪子握住你的[pc.hand]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stretch out your arm to shake on it, to which Kiona accepts it, wrapping her warm paw around your [pc.hand]."

rows.original: “Many thankings again for saving korgonne.”
rows.translation: “再次万分感谢你救了科尔贡人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Many thankings again for saving korgonne.”"

rows.original: With your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. Throughout appealing your case, you notice that she has her tail tucked low between her legs, and she repeatedly adjusts her accessories in nervousness.
rows.translation: 你尽力向琪欧娜保证，自己和其他外星人并不一样，也不认同那些给科尔贡人带来负面影响的家伙。听你陈述时，她始终把尾巴低低夹在双腿之间，还因紧张而反复摆弄身上的饰品。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your best effort, you assert to Kiona that you aren’t like the other off-worlders, and do not condone the ones that have had an overall negative impact on the korgonne. Throughout appealing your case, you notice that she has her tail tucked low between her legs, and she repeatedly adjusts her accessories in nervousness. "

rows.original: “Sorry... You seem nice and all, but I still don’t trust you that much yet.”
rows.translation: “对不起... 你看起来人很好，但我还没有那么信任你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry... You seem nice and all, but I still don’t trust you that much yet.”"

rows.original: “Sorries... Alien seem nice, but still no trustings much yet.”
rows.translation: “对不起... 外星人看起来很好，但琪欧娜还没有那么信任。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorries... Alien seem nice, but still no trustings much yet.”"

rows.original: she murmurs softly. You figure it might take some time for her to trust you to that level. For now, leave the subject be.
rows.translation: 她轻声嘟囔。看来要让她信任你到那种程度还需要一些时间。现在先别再谈这个话题。
rows.raw: " she murmurs softly. You figure it might take some time for her to trust you to that level. For now, leave the subject be."

rows.original: Aliens
rows.translation: 外星人
rows.raw: "Aliens"

rows.original: Aliens
rows.translation: 外星人
rows.raw: "Aliens"

rows.original: You just talked about this!
rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个！
rows.raw: "You just talked about this!"

rows.original: You ask Kiona if there’s anything else she can tell you about her jewelcrafting profession, since she didn’t give you much to go on initially.
rows.translation: 你问琪欧娜，她能否再讲讲自己的珠宝工艺；毕竟她起初并没透露多少。
rows.raw: "You ask Kiona if there’s anything else she can tell you about her jewelcrafting profession, since she didn’t give you much to go on initially."

rows.original: “Meh, you’re asking me a boring question... Fine, I’ll tell you.” She harrumphs, crossing her arms across her chest, which inadvertently accentuates her cleavage.
rows.translation: “唉，你问了个好无聊的问题... 好吧，我告诉你。”她哼了一声，双臂抱在胸前，无意间让乳沟更加醒目。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Meh, you’re asking me a boring question... Fine, I’ll tell you.” She harrumphs, crossing her arms across her chest, which inadvertently accentuates her cleavage."

rows.original: “I pretty much inherited this shop and this trade from my mother. She basically taught me all I know about how to cut a gem to its finest detail and how to shape and mold metals to a perfect shape. It took me a few years to make my first batch of savicite jewelry that was acceptable enough...” Kiona turns around and waves her arm towards her working forge. Splayed in front of it is an array of outdated tools used to hammer, mold, grind, and shape jewels and metals.
rows.translation: “这间店和这门手艺基本都是我从母亲那里继承的。她教会了我如何把宝石精细切割，以及怎样将金属塑造成完美形状。我花了好几年，才做出第一批勉强合格的萨维石首饰...”琪欧娜转过身，挥手指向自己的锻炉。炉前散放着一系列老旧工具，用于锤打、塑形、研磨并加工宝石和金属。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I pretty much inherited this shop and this trade from my mother. She basically taught me all I know about how to cut a gem to its finest detail and how to shape and mold metals to a perfect shape. It took me a few years to make my first batch of savicite jewelry that was acceptable enough...” Kiona turns around and waves her arm towards her working forge. Splayed in front of it is an array of outdated tools used to hammer, mold, grind, and shape jewels and metals."

rows.original: “It’s pretty hard stuff considering the equipment I have is ‘primitive’ at best, and I bet you spacers have better tools out there. Hell, I wouldn’t be surprised if you have the stuff automatically made with whatever weird contraption you people have.” She turns back to you with a frown her face. “That said, I’ve done well enough with what I have, but I feel like I’d make a lot better jewelry if I had better equipment to work with...” Kiona laments.
rows.translation: “这活儿相当难，毕竟我的设备充其量只能算‘原始’，我敢说你们太空人肯定有更好的工具。见鬼，就算你们能用什么古怪装置自动做出这些东西，我也不会意外。”她转回来看着你，脸上带着不悦。“话虽如此，靠现有工具我也做得不错；但如果能有更好的设备，肯定可以做出优秀得多的首饰...”琪欧娜惋惜地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s pretty hard stuff considering the equipment I have is ‘primitive’ at best, and I bet you spacers have better tools out there. Hell, I wouldn’t be surprised if you have the stuff automatically made with whatever weird contraption you people have.” She turns back to you with a frown her face. “That said, I’ve done well enough with what I have, but I feel like I’d make a lot better jewelry if I had better equipment to work with...” Kiona laments."

rows.original: You take a moment to take stock of her inventory. She certainly has a lot of surprisingly high-quality jewelry on display, and a wide variety of them as well! On one display rack are a number of studs, rings, hoops, and other small bits and baubles that shine brilliantly in the dim lighting of the store. In another shelf further away are an assortment of large bracelets, anklets, and necklaces that would rival the quality of even the more well-known jewelcrafters in the galaxy. She’s likely doesn’t realize that she could very well be the best jewelsmith in the whole universe, especially if she gets her paws on some modern equipment.
rows.translation: 你花了点时间清点她的库存。展示出来的首饰不仅品质出奇地高，种类也极其丰富！一只陈列架上摆着许多钉饰、戒指、环饰和其他小饰品，在店内昏暗的光线下熠熠生辉。远处另一层架子则陈列着各种大号手镯、脚镯与项链，品质足以媲美银河中那些声名显赫的珠宝匠。她恐怕没有意识到，自己很可能就是全宇宙最优秀的珠宝匠，尤其是在获得现代设备之后。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to take stock of her inventory. She certainly has a lot of surprisingly high-quality jewelry on display, and a wide variety of them as well! On one display rack are a number of studs, rings, hoops, and other small bits and baubles that shine brilliantly in the dim lighting of the store. In another shelf further away are an assortment of large bracelets, anklets, and necklaces that would rival the quality of even the more well-known jewelcrafters in the galaxy. She’s likely doesn’t realize that she could very well be the best jewelsmith in the whole universe, especially if she gets her paws on some modern equipment."

rows.original: A soft thump brings your attentions back to Kiona, who is showcasing a small box with a number of small bars of varying material.
rows.translation: 一声轻响把你的注意力拉回琪欧娜身上；她正展示一个小盒子，里面装着数根由不同材料制成的小条。
rows.raw: "\n\nA soft thump brings your attentions back to Kiona, who is showcasing a small box with a number of small bars of varying material."

rows.original: “I can even do piercings myself at this point! It took a bit of help from Nenne to be able to make a numbing agent strong enough for it to be virtually painless, but if you ever need a piece added or removed that you can’t do yourself, I’m your jeweler!” Kiona bleps cutely for emphasis.
rows.translation: “我现在甚至可以亲自做穿孔！多亏内内帮忙，我才调制出足够强效的麻醉剂，让过程几乎完全无痛。如果你以后有自己无法安装或取下的饰品，我就是你的珠宝匠！”琪欧娜可爱地吐了吐舌头以示强调。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can even do piercings myself at this point! It took a bit of help from Nenne to be able to make a numbing agent strong enough for it to be virtually painless, but if you ever need a piece added or removed that you can’t do yourself, I’m your jeweler!” Kiona bleps cutely for emphasis."

rows.original: You make a mental note to make good on that offer when you need it, though something else niggles at your brain; what was so special about the lucinite that she wanted so badly?
rows.translation: 你暗自记下，今后有需要时一定要接受她的服务；不过另一件事仍萦绕在脑海里：她如此渴望的露西矿究竟有什么特别之处？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make a mental note to make good on that offer when you need it, though something else niggles at your brain; what was so special about the lucinite that she wanted so badly?"

rows.original: “Oh, those? Yeah! I love those blue rocks!” Kiona lights up excitedly, proudly showing off her lucinite brooch. “Basically, I’ve found that they help with calming the mind somehow. It makes for a great trinket for a hunter to carry with them to block out unnecessary thoughts. Only just discovered that myself recently, but ever since I’ve shown the other hunters in the hold what it can do, I’ve been getting more and more orders to make lucinite trinkets. They’re eh... starting to get a bit more popular than I initially realized. Thanks again for replenishing my supply, [pc.name].” She smiles sheepishly.
rows.translation: “噢，那些吗？当然！我可喜欢那些蓝色石头了！”琪欧娜兴奋起来，骄傲地展示着自己的露西矿胸针。“基本上，我发现它们似乎能让心神平静。猎人带上这种小饰物，就能排除不必要的杂念。我自己也是最近才发现，可自从向堡里的其他猎人展示了它的效果，找我定制露西矿饰品的人就越来越多。它们呃... 比我原先想象的还要受欢迎。再次感谢你补充了我的库存，[pc.name]。”她腼腆地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, those? Yeah! I love those blue rocks!” Kiona lights up excitedly, proudly showing off her lucinite brooch. “Basically, I’ve found that they help with calming the mind somehow. It makes for a great trinket for a hunter to carry with them to block out unnecessary thoughts. Only just discovered that myself recently, but ever since I’ve shown the other hunters in the hold what it can do, I’ve been getting more and more orders to make lucinite trinkets. They’re eh... starting to get a bit more popular than I initially realized. Thanks again for replenishing my supply, [pc.name].” She smiles sheepishly."

rows.original: You tell Kiona that your first experience touching the metallic ore had a profoundly different effect on you than she described for herself. Her brow furrows in confusion as you tell her about how it felt when you picked it up.
rows.translation: 你告诉琪欧娜，自己第一次触碰这种金属矿石时，感受到的效果与她描述的截然不同。听你讲述拾起它时的感受，她困惑地皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Kiona that your first experience touching the metallic ore had a profoundly different effect on you than she described for herself. Her brow furrows in confusion as you tell her about how it felt when you picked it up."

rows.original: “Huh. I can’t say that I can explain that one for you.” She shrugs dismissively, which sets off her adorning jewelry to jingle pleasantly. “My guess is, it affects korgonne differently than it does any other race. Case in point, I heard that savicite makes pretty much any other race go crazy with lust... Hell, even milodan use it as a fertility aid like some sort of baby-making idol. Makes me curious how the lucinite and savicite together would react when worn by an off-worlder like you.” Kiona eyes you curiously, giving you the impression that you’re suddenly under a lab microscope.
rows.translation: “嗯。这我可解释不了。”她不以为意地耸耸肩，带得身上的首饰悦耳作响。“我猜，它对科尔贡人的作用和其他种族不一样。比如，我听说萨维石会让几乎所有其他种族欲火焚身... 见鬼，就连米洛丹人都会拿它当助孕物，像某种生育神像一样。我倒很好奇，露西矿和萨维石一起戴在你这样的外星人身上会有什么反应。”琪欧娜好奇地打量着你，让你感觉自己忽然被放到了实验室显微镜下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Huh. I can’t say that I can explain that one for you.” She shrugs dismissively, which sets off her adorning jewelry to jingle pleasantly. “My guess is, it affects korgonne differently than it does any other race. Case in point, I heard that savicite makes pretty much any other race go crazy with lust... Hell, even milodan use it as a fertility aid like some sort of baby-making idol. Makes me curious how the lucinite and savicite together would react when worn by an off-worlder like you.” Kiona eyes you curiously, giving you the impression that you’re suddenly under a lab microscope."

rows.original: You wonder about what her opinion on savicite is, since the majority of korgonne you’ve seen around the hold so far prefer to wear that jewel instead.
rows.translation: 你想知道她如何看待萨维石；毕竟你在堡里见过的大多数科尔贡人都更喜欢佩戴这种宝石。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder about what her opinion on savicite is, since the majority of korgonne you’ve seen around the hold so far prefer to wear that jewel instead."

rows.original: “It’s definitely a pretty green gem for sure,” the jewelcrafter chirps brightly. Her tail grows animated as she talks about the green psionic gem. “Us korgonne are resistant to the apparent effects they have, so it’s not any real issue wearing the stuff for us. I do like to think that it does keep the warmth of the spire close to us always, and to pierce them into our very being is to, in a way, become one with the Great Forge. That’s my take on it anyways! Besides, lucinite is much harder to get, and less abundant. It’s rarity makes it that much more valuable as a whole, and not too many of us has access to get some, let alone use it.”
rows.translation: “它当然是一种很漂亮的绿色宝石。”珠宝匠欢快地说道。谈起这种绿色灵能宝石时，她的尾巴活泼地摆动起来。“我们科尔贡人能抵抗它显而易见的影响，所以佩戴它根本不是问题。我愿意相信，它能让尖塔的温暖永远陪伴我们；而将它穿入身体，从某种意义上说，就是与伟大熔炉融为一体。反正我是这么理解的！况且露西矿更难取得，也更加稀少。稀有使它整体上更加珍贵，能弄到它的族人不多，更别说使用了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s definitely a pretty green gem for sure,” the jewelcrafter chirps brightly. Her tail grows animated as she talks about the green psionic gem. “Us korgonne are resistant to the apparent effects they have, so it’s not any real issue wearing the stuff for us. I do like to think that it does keep the warmth of the spire close to us always, and to pierce them into our very being is to, in a way, become one with the Great Forge. That’s my take on it anyways! Besides, lucinite is much harder to get, and less abundant. It’s rarity makes it that much more valuable as a whole, and not too many of us has access to get some, let alone use it.”"

rows.original: “Guh, alien askings boring question... Fine, Kiona tell.” She harrumphs, crossing her arms across her chest, which inadvertently accentuates her cleavage.
rows.translation: “呃，外星人问了个无聊问题... 好吧，琪欧娜告诉你。”她哼了一声，双臂抱在胸前，无意间让乳沟更加醒目。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Guh, alien askings boring question... Fine, Kiona tell.” She harrumphs, crossing her arms across her chest, which inadvertently accentuates her cleavage."

rows.original: “Kiona pretty much inherit shop and craft from mother. Teach all Kiona know about gem cuttings to fine detail and shapings metal to perfect shape. Took Kiona few years to make first savicite batch that was good.” Kiona turns around and waves her arm towards her working forge. Splayed in front of it is an array of outdated tools used to hammer, mold, grind, and shape jewels and metals.
rows.translation: “琪欧娜基本从母亲那里继承店铺和手艺。她教会琪欧娜如何精细切割宝石，也教会琪欧娜把金属塑成完美形状。琪欧娜花了几年，才做出第一批合格的萨维石首饰。”琪欧娜转过身，挥手指向自己的锻炉。炉前散放着一系列老旧工具，用于锤打、塑形、研磨并加工宝石和金属。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiona pretty much inherit shop and craft from mother. Teach all Kiona know about gem cuttings to fine detail and shapings metal to perfect shape. Took Kiona few years to make first savicite batch that was good.” Kiona turns around and waves her arm towards her working forge. Splayed in front of it is an array of outdated tools used to hammer, mold, grind, and shape jewels and metals."

rows.original: “It hard since equipment very old at best, and Kiona bet aliens having better stuffs. Not surprise Kiona betting aliens having sparkles auto make with some weird thingy.” She turns back to you with a frown her face. “That said, Kiona do well with what Kiona havings, but am feeling Kiona would make better sparkles if havings better tools to work.” Kiona laments.
rows.translation: “这活很难，因为设备最多只算非常老旧；琪欧娜敢说外星人有更好的东西。要是外星人能用什么怪东西自动做出闪亮饰品，琪欧娜也不意外。”她转回来看着你，脸上带着不悦。“话虽如此，琪欧娜靠现有东西也做得不错，但觉得有更好的工具，就能做出更好的闪亮饰品。”琪欧娜惋惜地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It hard since equipment very old at best, and Kiona bet aliens having better stuffs. Not surprise Kiona betting aliens having sparkles auto make with some weird thingy.” She turns back to you with a frown her face. “That said, Kiona do well with what Kiona havings, but am feeling Kiona would make better sparkles if havings better tools to work.” Kiona laments."

rows.original: You take a moment to take stock of her inventory. She certainly has a lot of surprisingly high-quality jewelry on display, and a wide variety of them as well! On one display rack are a number of studs, rings, hoops, and other small bits and baubles that shine brilliantly in the dim lighting of the store. In another shelf further away are an assortment of large bracelets, anklets, and necklaces that would rival the quality of even the more well-known jewelcrafters in the galaxy. She’s likely doesn’t realize that she could very well be the best jewelsmith in the whole universe, especially if she gets her paws on some modern equipment.
rows.translation: 你花了点时间清点她的库存。展示出来的首饰不仅品质出奇地高，种类也极其丰富！一只陈列架上摆着许多钉饰、戒指、环饰和其他小饰品，在店内昏暗的光线下熠熠生辉。远处另一层架子则陈列着各种大号手镯、脚镯与项链，品质足以媲美银河中那些声名显赫的珠宝匠。她恐怕没有意识到，自己很可能就是全宇宙最优秀的珠宝匠，尤其是在获得现代设备之后。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to take stock of her inventory. She certainly has a lot of surprisingly high-quality jewelry on display, and a wide variety of them as well! On one display rack are a number of studs, rings, hoops, and other small bits and baubles that shine brilliantly in the dim lighting of the store. In another shelf further away are an assortment of large bracelets, anklets, and necklaces that would rival the quality of even the more well-known jewelcrafters in the galaxy. She’s likely doesn’t realize that she could very well be the best jewelsmith in the whole universe, especially if she gets her paws on some modern equipment."

rows.original: A soft thump brings your attentions back to Kiona, who is showcasing a small box with a number of small bars of varying material.
rows.translation: 一声轻响把你的注意力拉回琪欧娜身上；她正展示一个小盒子，里面装着数根由不同材料制成的小条。
rows.raw: "\n\nA soft thump brings your attentions back to Kiona, who is showcasing a small box with a number of small bars of varying material."

rows.original: “Kiona do piercings as well! Take help from Nenne in makings numbing potion for no hurtings, but if needings piercings take or give, Kiona alien’s jeweler!” Kiona bleps cutely for emphasis.
rows.translation: “琪欧娜也会做穿孔！多亏内内帮忙制作麻醉药水，过程才不会疼；如果外星人需要安装或取下穿孔饰品，琪欧娜就是外星人的珠宝匠！”琪欧娜可爱地吐了吐舌头以示强调。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiona do piercings as well! Take help from Nenne in makings numbing potion for no hurtings, but if needings piercings take or give, Kiona alien’s jeweler!” Kiona bleps cutely for emphasis."

rows.original: You make a mental note to make good on that offer when you need it, though something else niggles at your brain; what was so special about the lucinite that she wanted so badly?
rows.translation: 你暗自记下，今后有需要时一定要接受她的服务；不过另一件事仍萦绕在脑海里：她如此渴望的露西矿究竟有什么特别之处？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make a mental note to make good on that offer when you need it, though something else niggles at your brain; what was so special about the lucinite that she wanted so badly?"

rows.original: “Oh, them? Yes! Kiona love blue rock sparkles!” Kiona lights up excitedly, proudly showing off her lucinite brooch. “Findings that they calm mind somehow. Make for great trinket for hunter to hold for keepings out junk thoughts. Only discover myself recently, but since showings other hunters blue rock, Kiona get more and more orders to make. They eh... start gettings popular, more than Kiona thinkings. Thankings [pc.name] for givings more supply!” She smiles sheepishly.
rows.translation: “噢，那些？对！琪欧娜喜欢蓝色闪光石！”琪欧娜兴奋起来，骄傲地展示着自己的露西矿胸针。“琪欧娜发现，它们似乎能让心神平静。猎人带着这种小饰物，就能赶走无用的杂念。琪欧娜自己也是最近才发现，但自从给其他猎人看过蓝色石头后，找琪欧娜定做的人越来越多。它们呃... 开始变得很受欢迎，比琪欧娜想的还受欢迎。谢谢[pc.name]补充库存！”她腼腆地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, them? Yes! Kiona love blue rock sparkles!” Kiona lights up excitedly, proudly showing off her lucinite brooch. “Findings that they calm mind somehow. Make for great trinket for hunter to hold for keepings out junk thoughts. Only discover myself recently, but since showings other hunters blue rock, Kiona get more and more orders to make. They eh... start gettings popular, more than Kiona thinkings. Thankings [pc.name] for givings more supply!” She smiles sheepishly."

rows.original: You tell Kiona that your first experience touching the metallic ore had a profoundly different effect on you than she described for herself. Her brow furrows in confusion as you tell her about how it felt when you picked it up.
rows.translation: 你告诉琪欧娜，自己第一次触碰这种金属矿石时，感受到的效果与她描述的截然不同。听你讲述拾起它时的感受，她困惑地皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Kiona that your first experience touching the metallic ore had a profoundly different effect on you than she described for herself. Her brow furrows in confusion as you tell her about how it felt when you picked it up."

rows.original: “Huh. Don’t think can explain that one to [pc.name].” She shrugs dismissively, which sets off her adorning jewelry to jingle pleasantly. “Kiona guessing it affect korgonne different than not korgonne. As point, hearings that green sparkle make other race go crazy horny... Heck, cat-people use for breeding aid like it a pup-giving idol. Makes Kiona curious how blue rock and green sparkle work on alien like [pc.name].” Kiona eyes you curiously, giving you the impression that you’re suddenly under a lab microscope.
rows.translation: “嗯。琪欧娜觉得没法向[pc.name]解释。”她不以为意地耸耸肩，带得身上的首饰悦耳作响。“琪欧娜猜，它对科尔贡人和非科尔贡人的作用不同。比如，听说绿色闪光石会让其他种族欲火焚身... 哎呀，猫人还把它当成繁育辅助品，像某种赐崽神像。琪欧娜很好奇，蓝色石头和绿色闪光石会怎样影响[pc.name]这样的外星人。”琪欧娜好奇地打量着你，让你感觉自己忽然被放到了实验室显微镜下。

Don’t think can explain that one to [pc.name].” She shrugs dismissively, which sets off her adorning jewelry to jingle pleasantly. “Kiona guessing it affect korgonne different than not korgonne. As point, hearings that green sparkle make other race go crazy horny... Heck, cat-people use for breeding aid like it a pup-giving idol. Makes Kiona curious how blue rock and green sparkle work on alien like [pc.name].” Kiona eyes you curiously, giving you the impression that you’re suddenly under a lab microscope."

rows.translation: 你想知道她如何看待萨维石；毕竟你在堡里见过的大多数科尔贡人都更喜欢佩戴这种宝石。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wonder about what her opinion on savicite is, since the majority of korgonne you’ve seen around the hold so far prefer to wear that jewel instead."

Her tail grows animated as she talks about the green psionic gem. “Havings no effects, so no issues in wearings for korgonne. Kiona like thinkings it keep warmth of spire close always, and etching into us is help to become one with Great Forge. That Kiona take on it! Beside, blue rock sparkle hard to get. Less of them too. It rarity making is worth lots, and not many korgonne can get, or use it.”
