Her tail grows animated as she talks about the green psionic gem. “Havings no effects, so no issues in wearings for korgonne. Kiona like thinkings it keep warmth of spire close always, and etching into us is help to become one with Great Forge. That Kiona take on it! Beside, blue rock sparkle hard to get. Less of them too. It rarity making is worth lots, and not many korgonne can get, or use it.”"

rows.original: Jewelcraft
rows.translation: 珠宝工艺
rows.raw: "Jewelcraft"

rows.original: Jewelcraft
rows.translation: 珠宝工艺
rows.raw: "Jewelcraft"

rows.original: You just talked about this!
rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个！
rows.raw: "You just talked about this!"

rows.original: Kiona’s mentioned her efforts to help the hunters of the hold several times throughout your talks. You ask if she has any sort of special connection to them. Kiona’s tail wags increasingly faster at the question, her jewel-laden accessories on it jingling quietly in concert.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜在交谈中多次提到自己为堡里的猎人提供帮助。你问她是否和他们有什么特殊联系。听到这个问题，她的尾巴越摇越快，上面镶满珠宝的饰物也随之轻声叮当作响。
rows.raw: "Kiona’s mentioned her efforts to help the hunters of the hold several times throughout your talks. You ask if she has any sort of special connection to them. Kiona’s tail wags increasingly faster at the question, her jewel-laden accessories on it jingling quietly in concert."

rows.original: “Oh, yes! In fact, I’m actually a hunter myself as well!” Kiona points a padded thumb towards a corner of the room where a weathered coat and yappi strap lie against the wall, among other hunting equipment. “I haven’t been doing it as long as I have jewelcrafting, but I’d like to think I’m pretty competent at it!”
rows.translation: “噢，当然！其实我自己也是猎人！”琪欧娜用带肉垫的拇指指向房间一角，那里靠墙放着一件风化的外套、一条亚皮带和其他狩猎装备。“我当猎人的时间没有做珠宝那么久，但自认为还挺有本事的！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, yes! In fact, I’m actually a hunter myself as well!” Kiona points a padded thumb towards a corner of the room where a weathered coat and yappi strap lie against the wall, among other hunting equipment. “I haven’t been doing it as long as I have jewelcrafting, but I’d like to think I’m pretty competent at it!”"

rows.original: “Oh? Do you hunt anything in particular, or...?” you ask out of curiosity.
rows.translation: “哦？你通常猎些什么，还是说...？”你好奇地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh? Do you hunt anything in particular, or...?” you ask out of curiosity."

rows.original: “Depends. I’m not among the best hunters yet, so I’m mostly stuck doing scouting or patrol, usually with a small party of other korgonne. I don’t usually see action. Kinda boring really.” Kiona pouts, glancing off to the side irritably. “On one hand, it’s a little bit of a relief, but on the other hand, I do want to have more fighting experience and get stronger from it.”
rows.translation: “视情况而定。我还算不上最优秀的猎人，所以大多只能负责侦察或巡逻，通常还要和一小队其他科尔贡人同行。我很少真正遇上战斗。其实挺无聊的。”琪欧娜撅起嘴，烦躁地瞥向一旁。“一方面我有点庆幸，但另一方面，我确实想积累更多战斗经验，让自己变得更强。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Depends. I’m not among the best hunters yet, so I’m mostly stuck doing scouting or patrol, usually with a small party of other korgonne. I don’t usually see action. Kinda boring really.” Kiona pouts, glancing off to the side irritably. “On one hand, it’s a little bit of a relief, but on the other hand, I do want to have more fighting experience and get stronger from it.”"

rows.original: The korgonne pauses for an uncomfortable length of time. Her expression darkens rapidly, and her tail stops wagging. “I did have a close shave once while our scout group was out salvaging though. Narrowly made it out of there with my fur intact, but that isn’t to say I’d never want to face a challenge like that again.”
rows.translation: 科尔贡人陷入一阵令人不适的沉默。她的脸色迅速阴沉，尾巴也停止摆动。“不过，有一次我们侦察小队外出拾荒时，我确实险些丧命。勉强保住一身毛活了下来，但这并不代表我再也不想面对那样的挑战。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne pauses for an uncomfortable length of time. Her expression darkens rapidly, and her tail stops wagging. “I did have a close shave once while our scout group was out salvaging though. Narrowly made it out of there with my fur intact, but that isn’t to say I’d never want to face a challenge like that again.”"

rows.original: You ask what happened during her ‘close shave’ while out salvaging. Kiona’s tail stops completely, her ears tucking back into her long hair. She furrows her brow while recalling the incident.
rows.translation: 你问她外出拾荒时那次“死里逃生”究竟发生了什么。琪欧娜的尾巴完全停住，耳朵缩进长发之中。回忆起那件事时，她紧紧皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what happened during her ‘close shave’ while out salvaging. Kiona’s tail stops completely, her ears tucking back into her long hair. She furrows her brow while recalling the incident."

rows.original: “W-well... it happened about a year ago. Our four-korgonne scouting group came across a off-worlder pod of some sort, and we went over to check it out. It was supposed to be simple enough; a few moments to check around if any valuables could be taken for the hold. There was a decent amount of alien tech we could take back for the specialists to look over.” Kiona frowns while twirling a lock of hair around a clawed finger.
rows.translation: “那、那个... 大约发生在一年前。我们四人侦察小队发现了某种外星逃生舱，于是过去查看。本来应该很简单，只要花点时间看看有没有什么值钱东西能带回堡里。那里确实有不少外星科技，可以带回去交给专家研究。”琪欧娜皱着眉，用利爪手指卷弄一缕头发。
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... it happened about a year ago. Our four-korgonne scouting group came across a off-worlder pod of some sort, and we went over to check it out. It was supposed to be simple enough; a few moments to check around if any valuables could be taken for the hold. There was a decent amount of alien tech we could take back for the specialists to look over.” Kiona frowns while twirling a lock of hair around a clawed finger."

rows.original: “Just about as soon as we were about to finish up and leave, a group of filthy milodan showed up, with their eyes on our prize,” she growls, her fur beginning to stand on end. “Let’s just say, we korgonne don’t really get along with milodan at all. It was an even number of us, so... yeah. It quickly turned into a skirmish over the salvage.” Kiona shrugs.
rows.translation: “就在我们快收拾完准备离开时，一群肮脏的米洛丹人出现了，也盯上了我们的战利品。”她低吼着，全身毛发开始竖起。“简单说吧，我们科尔贡人和米洛丹人完全合不来。双方人数相同，所以... 没错，很快就为那些拾荒物打了起来。”琪欧娜耸耸肩。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just about as soon as we were about to finish up and leave, a group of filthy milodan showed up, with their eyes on our prize,” she growls, her fur beginning to stand on end. “Let’s just say, we korgonne don’t really get along with milodan at all. It was an even number of us, so... yeah. It quickly turned into a skirmish over the salvage.” Kiona shrugs."

rows.original: “I remember being excited for my first chance to have a real scrap. Usually, we use ambushing techniques and having the element of surprise on our side, so there’s rarely an opportunity that we just fight outright.” The korg-girl wrings her paws together while grimacing. “Oh man... if I knew back then that it’s not all that it’s cracked up to be... especially considering how fresh I was.” She takes a brief moment before resuming her story.
rows.translation: “我记得自己当时很兴奋，终于有机会真正打一场。我们通常会采用伏击战术，利用出其不意的优势，所以很少有机会正面交锋。”科尔贡姑娘苦着脸绞动双爪。“天啊... 如果那时就知道真正的战斗根本没那么美好就好了... 尤其我还是个新手。”她稍稍停顿，随后继续讲述。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I remember being excited for my first chance to have a real scrap. Usually, we use ambushing techniques and having the element of surprise on our side, so there’s rarely an opportunity that we just fight outright.” The korg-girl wrings her paws together while grimacing. “Oh man... if I knew back then that it’s not all that it’s cracked up to be... especially considering how fresh I was.” She takes a brief moment before resuming her story."

rows.original: “The fight started out well enough. We fought in pairs to split them up; one of us to hold off the opposing pair while the other of us attacks from their blind side. We did what we could to disorient our targets one at a time so that it could maximize our chances of making it through unharmed.” Kiona crosses her arms over her bosom. Her hands subconsciously tug at the ornaments on her shoulders. “Of our pair, I was the one to make the flanking strikes. My partner did well enough holding the other milodans’ attention, and I even held my own fighting from range... at least if only for a little while.” Her teeth grind together as she holds herself tighter.
rows.translation: “战斗一开始还算顺利。我们两人一组把他们分开；一人牵制对方两人，另一人则从视野盲区发动攻击。我们尽力逐个干扰目标，争取让大家都毫发无伤地撑过去。”琪欧娜双臂抱住胸部，双手下意识地拉扯肩上的饰物。“我们这一组里，我负责从侧翼攻击。搭档成功吸引了另外两名米洛丹人的注意，而我远距离作战也还应付得来... 至少有一小会儿是这样。”她紧咬牙齿，把自己抱得更紧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The fight started out well enough. We fought in pairs to split them up; one of us to hold off the opposing pair while the other of us attacks from their blind side. We did what we could to disorient our targets one at a time so that it could maximize our chances of making it through unharmed.” Kiona crosses her arms over her bosom. Her hands subconsciously tug at the ornaments on her shoulders. “Of our pair, I was the one to make the flanking strikes. My partner did well enough holding the other milodans’ attention, and I even held my own fighting from range... at least if only for a little while.” Her teeth grind together as she holds herself tighter."

rows.original: You gently ask Kiona what happened next. Somberly, she shakes her head.
rows.translation: 你温和地问琪欧娜后来发生了什么。她神情阴郁地摇了摇头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gently ask Kiona what happened next. Somberly, she shakes her head."

rows.original: “Well... one of the milodan from the other pair our group was fighting had their back completely turned to me, so I thought I could well... knock him out with a quick whack to the head while my partner had our pair’s attention.” Kiona sighs dejectedly. “When I went for it, I lashed out at him with my yappi strap. The damn guy didn’t even so much as flinch when I nailed him. Before I could get my weapon wound back up, I got blindsided by one of the milodan we were originally fighting.” Kiona smashes a balled fist onto the stone counter, shaking the jewelry on top of it.
rows.translation: “嗯... 我们另一组正在对付的一个米洛丹人完全背对着我，所以我以为自己可以趁搭档吸引那两人时... 迅速敲中他的脑袋，把他打昏。”琪欧娜沮丧地叹了口气。“我冲过去，用亚皮带抽中了他。可那混蛋挨了一下甚至都没晃一晃。还没来得及重新收好武器，我就被原本和我们交手的一名米洛丹人从侧面偷袭了。”琪欧娜一拳砸在石柜台上，震得上面的首饰不断颤动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well... one of the milodan from the other pair our group was fighting had their back completely turned to me, so I thought I could well... knock him out with a quick whack to the head while my partner had our pair’s attention.” Kiona sighs dejectedly. “When I went for it, I lashed out at him with my yappi strap. The damn guy didn’t even so much as flinch when I nailed him. Before I could get my weapon wound back up, I got blindsided by one of the milodan we were originally fighting.” Kiona smashes a balled fist onto the stone counter, shaking the jewelry on top of it."

rows.original: “I feel stupid making a dumb mistake like that in the first place, not being able to knock that milodan out, and being the first to go down out of all of us. Because of me, my partner didn’t take long to go down himself, and then it was just two of us left against the rest. I was helpless since the one milodan hit me so hard, I was on the verge of passing out” The korg-girl growls under her breath. Considering she’s alive and well, you wonder how she managed to get out of the mess that she got in.
rows.translation: “我觉得自己太蠢了，居然犯下那种错误；不仅没能打昏那个米洛丹人，还是我们中第一个倒下的。因为我，搭档没过多久也倒下了，只剩下另外两人对付所有敌人。那个米洛丹人下手太重，我当时都快昏过去了，根本无力反抗。”科尔贡姑娘低声咆哮。既然她现在还活得好好的，你不禁想知道她是怎么逃出那场灾难的。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I feel stupid making a dumb mistake like that in the first place, not being able to knock that milodan out, and being the first to go down out of all of us. Because of me, my partner didn’t take long to go down himself, and then it was just two of us left against the rest. I was helpless since the one milodan hit me so hard, I was on the verge of passing out” The korg-girl growls under her breath. Considering she’s alive and well, you wonder how she managed to get out of the mess that she got in."

rows.original: “W-well... I don’t remember much beyond that point, but...” Kiona places a pawed hand over her face, concentrating hard. “All I recall was feeling cold, dizzy, disoriented... and honestly scared witless. I heard some loud growling and snarling that... didn’t sound like anything I recognised. I tried looking to see what it was, but I was too weak to lift my head. All I catch were glimpses of a blue-grey blur. Before I passed out, I saw a huge korgonne - definitely not from our scouting group - walk over to me... and such a big paw too. Next thing I remember, I woke up in my bed with Nenne overlooking me.”
rows.translation: “那、那个... 后来的事我记不太清了，不过...”琪欧娜用一只爪手捂住脸，努力集中精神。“我只记得自己很冷、很晕、意识混乱... 而且说真的，吓坏了。我听到很响的低吼和咆哮... 完全不像任何我认识的生物。我想抬头看看，却虚弱得连脑袋都抬不起来。只能偶尔瞥见一道蓝灰色的模糊身影。昏过去之前，我看到一个巨大的科尔贡人——肯定不是我们侦察小队的人——向我走来... 还有一只好大的爪子。再醒来时，我已经躺在床上，内内正在照看我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“W-well... I don’t remember much beyond that point, but...” Kiona places a pawed hand over her face, concentrating hard. “All I recall was feeling cold, dizzy, disoriented... and honestly scared witless. I heard some loud growling and snarling that... didn’t sound like anything I recognised. I tried looking to see what it was, but I was too weak to lift my head. All I catch were glimpses of a blue-grey blur. Before I passed out, I saw a huge korgonne - definitely not from our scouting group - walk over to me... and such a big paw too. Next thing I remember, I woke up in my bed with Nenne overlooking me.”"

rows.original: “Are you okay after all that? That sounded like quite a trial to go through,” you remark. Kiona smiles brightly to your surprise.
rows.translation: “经历了那些以后，你还好吗？听起来真是一场严峻的考验。”你评论道。出乎意料的是，琪欧娜灿烂地笑了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you okay after all that? That sounded like quite a trial to go through,” you remark. Kiona smiles brightly to your surprise."

rows.original: “Pff, of course! I mean yeah, it was scary, but I believe what doesn’t kill you only makes you stronger! Ever since then, I’ve been training my ass off so that same thing never has to happen again. Those mangy, long-tooth hairballs had better watch out next time.” Kiona pumps a triumphant fist in your direction.
rows.translation: “噗，当然！我是说，确实很吓人，可我相信杀不死你的只会让你更强大！从那以后，我一直拼命训练，绝不让同样的事再发生。那些肮脏的长牙毛球下次最好小心点。”琪欧娜朝你挥起胜利的拳头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Pff, of course! I mean yeah, it was scary, but I believe what doesn’t kill you only makes you stronger! Ever since then, I’ve been training my ass off so that same thing never has to happen again. Those mangy, long-tooth hairballs had better watch out next time.” Kiona pumps a triumphant fist in your direction."

rows.original: “Yes! Actually, Kiona is hunter herself!” Kiona points a padded thumb towards a corner of the room where a weathered coat and yappi strap lie against the wall, among other hunting equipment. “Haven’t done long as gem craft, but thinkings am good at hunting!”
rows.translation: “对！其实琪欧娜自己也是猎人！”琪欧娜用带肉垫的拇指指向房间一角，那里靠墙放着一件风化的外套、一条亚皮带和其他狩猎装备。“当猎人的时间没有做宝石工艺那么久，但琪欧娜觉得自己很会狩猎！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes! Actually, Kiona is hunter herself!” Kiona points a padded thumb towards a corner of the room where a weathered coat and yappi strap lie against the wall, among other hunting equipment. “Haven’t done long as gem craft, but thinkings am good at hunting!”"

rows.original: “Oh? Do you hunt anything in particular, or...?” you ask out of curiosity.
rows.translation: “哦？你通常猎些什么，还是说...？”你好奇地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh? Do you hunt anything in particular, or...?” you ask out of curiosity."

rows.original: “Depend. Kiona not one of best hunters yet, so stuck scoutings or patrollings, usually with few korgonne. No seeings much action. Is boring, kind of.” Kiona pouts, glancing off to the side irritably. “One hand, is relief. On other, Kiona want fightings more; gettings stronger from it!”
rows.translation: “看情况。琪欧娜还不是最好的猎人，所以只能侦察或巡逻，通常和几个科尔贡人一起。很少遇到战斗。有点无聊。”琪欧娜撅起嘴，烦躁地瞥向一旁。“一方面让琪欧娜放心。另一方面，琪欧娜想打更多架；从中变得更强！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Depend. Kiona not one of best hunters yet, so stuck scoutings or patrollings, usually with few korgonne. No seeings much action. Is boring, kind of.” Kiona pouts, glancing off to the side irritably. “One hand, is relief. On other, Kiona want fightings more; gettings stronger from it!”"

rows.original: The korgonne pauses for an uncomfortable length of time. Her expression darkens rapidly, and her tail stops wagging. “Did have close call when out scoutings with small band. Was salvagings. Almost not make it with fur still on body, not sayings Kiona not want to face challenge again though.”
rows.translation: 科尔贡人陷入一阵令人不适的沉默。她的脸色迅速阴沉，尾巴也停止摆动。“有一次跟小队外出侦察时差点没命。那时正在拾荒。琪欧娜险些没能带着一身毛活下来，但不是说琪欧娜再也不想面对挑战。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe korgonne pauses for an uncomfortable length of time. Her expression darkens rapidly, and her tail stops wagging. “Did have close call when out scoutings with small band. Was salvagings. Almost not make it with fur still on body, not sayings Kiona not want to face challenge again though.”"

rows.original: You ask what happened during her ‘close shave’ while out salvaging. Kiona’s tail stops completely, her ears tucking back into her long hair. She furrows her brow while recalling the incident.
rows.translation: 你问她外出拾荒时那次“死里逃生”究竟发生了什么。琪欧娜的尾巴完全停住，耳朵缩进长发之中。回忆起那件事时，她紧紧皱起眉头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what happened during her ‘close shave’ while out salvaging. Kiona’s tail stops completely, her ears tucking back into her long hair. She furrows her brow while recalling the incident."

rows.original: “W-well... It happen one year past. Had four korgonne scout group come to alien pod or something and see what can take. Was suppose to be simple; few moment to check and take things back to hold. Good amount of alien tech to takings back to core wizard.” Kiona frowns while twirling a lock of hair around a clawed finger.
rows.translation: “那、那个... 是一年前发生的。四名科尔贡人组成的侦察队发现了外星逃生舱之类的东西，就过去看看能拿走什么。本该很简单；花点时间检查，再把东西带回堡里。那里有不少外星科技，可以带回去交给核心法师。”琪欧娜皱着眉，用利爪手指卷弄一缕头发。

rows.original: “When we finishing up and leavings, group of dirty cat-people show up tryings to take our prize.” she growls, her fur beginning to stand on end. “Let’s say, us korgonne no gettings along with cat-people at all. Was even amount of korgonne, so... yeah. It turn to small fight over alien scraps.” Kiona shrugs.
rows.translation: “就在我们收拾完准备离开时，一群肮脏猫人出现，想抢走战利品。”她低吼着，全身毛发开始竖起。“简单说，科尔贡人和猫人完全合不来。双方人数一样，所以... 没错，很快就为外星废料打了起来。”琪欧娜耸耸肩。

rows.original: You ask Kiona if she ever got to meet the korgonne that rescued her from the milodan ambush on her scouting group.
rows.translation: 你问琪欧娜，后来是否见到了那个从米洛丹人伏击中救下她的科尔贡人。
rows.raw: "You ask Kiona if she ever got to meet the korgonne that rescued her from the milodan ambush on her scouting group."

rows.original: “Mmhmm, yup.” The jeweler nods, though she doesn’t sound all too happy about it. “I met him alright. Every bit as hunky and strong of a korgonne anyone could ever dream of, if kinda... old. His name is Dreghan. Kinda a big ol’ softie... a little too soft.” Kiona frowns and looks away, her expression darkening rapidly. “Let’s just say... we didn’t exactly see eye to eye on our views of off-worlders.”
rows.translation: “嗯哼，见过。”珠宝匠点点头，听起来却不怎么高兴。“我确实见到他了。强壮又英俊，完全是任何人梦想中的科尔贡人，只是有点... 老。他叫德雷甘。是个大块头老好人... 心肠有点太软了。”琪欧娜皱着眉移开视线，脸色迅速阴沉。“这么说吧... 我们对外星人的看法并不完全一致。”

Kinda a big ol’ softie... a little too soft.” Kiona frowns and looks away, her expression darkening rapidly. “Let’s just say... we didn’t exactly see eye to eye on our views of off-worlders.”"

rows.original: In a sudden realization, she quickly turns back to you with an apologetic look on her face and waves her hands in front of her frantically. “I mean... with you, I suppose that now I can see where he’s coming from...”
rows.translation: 她忽然意识到什么，立刻满脸歉意地转回你这边，慌张地在身前摆动双手。“我是说... 至于你，我想现在多少能理解他的立场了...”
rows.raw: "\n\nIn a sudden realization, she quickly turns back to you with an apologetic look on her face and waves her hands in front of her frantically. “I mean... with you, I suppose that now I can see where he’s coming from...”"

rows.original: Kiona sighs dejectedly, twiddling a loose strand of hair in a furred finger. “Maybe I should go over to his den sometime and apologise. The whole argument we had was kind of stupid in hindsight, that and... I really would like to learn more from him. If he’s strong enough to fend off a pack of milodan himself, I’d really love to know his methods!” A glint of excitement flashes across her face as she ponders the eventuality of meeting up with her rescuer again.
rows.translation: 琪欧娜沮丧地叹了口气，用毛茸茸的手指卷弄一缕散发。“或许我该找时间去他的巢穴道歉。现在回想起来，我们那场争论确实挺蠢的，而且... 我真的很想多向他学习。如果他强大到能独自击退一群米洛丹人，我真想知道他是怎么做到的！”想到最终会再次见到自己的救命恩人，她脸上闪过兴奋的光芒。

rows.original: From the sound of things, she herself seems to have a soft spot for this hulking korgonne. Maybe you can put in a good word for Kiona if you end up meeting him beforehand.
rows.translation: 听起来，她自己似乎也对这个魁梧的科尔贡人颇有好感。如果你先见到他，或许可以替琪欧娜美言几句。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the sound of things, she herself seems to have a soft spot for this hulking korgonne. Maybe you can put in a good word for Kiona if you end up meeting him beforehand."

rows.translation: 救援者

rows.original: Rescuer
rows.translation: 救援者
rows.raw: "Rescuer"

rows.original: You just talked about this!
rows.translation: 你刚聊过这个！
rows.raw: "You just talked about this!"

rows.original: You tell Kiona that you’ve received approval from Ula to be able to use your credits in exchange for the goods sold at her shop. She scoffs in response, rolling her eyes and muttering under her breath.
rows.translation: 你告诉琪欧娜，乌拉已经批准她用信用点交换店里出售的商品。她闻言嗤了一声，翻着白眼低声嘟囔。
rows.raw: "You tell Kiona that you’ve received approval from Ula to be able to use your credits in exchange for the goods sold at her shop. She scoffs in response, rolling her eyes and muttering under her breath."

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah, I heard Ula talking about it only recently... Fine, I’ll do it. These ‘credits’ had better be worth something at least, or I’ll have a serious talk with the elders.” Kiona huffs, visibly sore about having to make transactions with a new and unfamiliar currency.
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧，我最近才听乌拉说起这事... 行，我会照办。这些‘信用点’最好真有点价值，否则我可要认真找长老们谈谈。”琪欧娜哼了一声，显然很不情愿接受这种陌生的新货币。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah, I heard Ula talking about it only recently... Fine, I’ll do it. These ‘credits’ had better be worth something at least, or I’ll have a serious talk with the elders.” Kiona huffs, visibly sore about having to make transactions with a new and unfamiliar currency."

rows.original: “Now, obviously I don’t have any of these ‘credits’ you off-worlders deal with to start, so if I have none to offer you for selling me a piece I want, then I’ll just credit the amount towards whatever you want to buy from my shop... at least that’s how I understand how something like this works, right?” she asks, her hand scratching behind one of her crooked ears in concentration. You nod in confirmation.
rows.translation: “显然，我一开始根本没有你们外星人使用的这些‘信用点’。所以，如果你卖给我一件想要的东西，而我没有信用点可以付你，那我就把这笔金额记到你想从店里购买的商品上... 这类交易应该就是这么运作的，对吧？”她一边问，一边专注地挠着一只弯曲耳朵的后方。你点头确认。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, obviously I don’t have any of these ‘credits’ you off-worlders deal with to start, so if I have none to offer you for selling me a piece I want, then I’ll just credit the amount towards whatever you want to buy from my shop... at least that’s how I understand how something like this works, right?” she asks, her hand scratching behind one of her crooked ears in concentration. You nod in confirmation."

rows.original: “Still much simpler just trading jewels in my opinion...” Kiona rolls her eyes and lays her hands on her hips.
rows.translation: “我还是觉得直接用珠宝交换简单多了...”琪欧娜翻了个白眼，双手叉腰。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still much simpler just trading jewels in my opinion...” Kiona rolls her eyes and lays her hands on her hips."

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah. Hearing Ula talkings about it earlier. Fine. ‘Credits’ better be worth something, or have talkings with elders.” Kiona huffs, visibly sore about having to make transactions with a new and unfamiliar currency.
rows.translation: “好啦，好啦。之前听乌拉说过这事。行吧。那些‘信用点’最好真能换到东西，不然琪奥娜会气到在谁的屁股上打洞。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah. Hearing Ula talkings about it earlier. Fine. ‘Credits’ better be worth something, or have talkings with elders.” Kiona huffs, visibly sore about having to make transactions with a new and unfamiliar currency."

rows.original: “Now, knowing Kiona havings no ‘credit’ aliens deal with for starts, so if Kiona have none to give to alien for selling sparkle Kiona want, then Kiona credit amount to what alien want from shop... least that how Kiona understand how this working, right?” she asks, her hand scratching behind one of her crooked ears in concentration. You nod in confirmation.
rows.translation: “现在，琪奥娜一开始没有‘信用点’给外星人用，所以外星人没有的话，就先给琪奥娜萨维石或卢西石来换取‘信用点’。琪奥娜会给最好的价，不骗人。然后外星人就能用信用点买东西，不必每次都带闪亮石头来。简单，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now, knowing Kiona havings no ‘credit’ aliens deal with for starts, so if Kiona have none to give to alien for selling sparkle Kiona want, then Kiona credit amount to what alien want from shop... least that how Kiona understand how this working, right?” she asks, her hand scratching behind one of her crooked ears in concentration. You nod in confirmation."

rows.original: “Still simpler trading sparkles in Kiona opinion...” Kiona rolls her eyes and lays her hands on her hips.
rows.translation: “不过琪奥娜觉得直接拿闪亮石头交易还是更简单...” 琪奥娜翻了个白眼，把手放回柜台上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still simpler trading sparkles in Kiona opinion...” Kiona rolls her eyes and lays her hands on her hips."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: When you ask the jewel-clad korgonne about the wares that she has available, she scoffs heatedly, giving you a disdainful look.
rows.translation: 当你询问这位珠宝满身的科尔贡人目前有什么商品时，她恼火地嗤了一声，投来锐利的目光。
rows.raw: "When you ask the jewel-clad korgonne about the wares that she has available, she scoffs heatedly, giving you a disdainful look."

rows.original: “Wouldn’t you like to know? Thanks to you outsiders, I barely even have shit to sell! My last haul of jewels that I had gathered while outside of the hold was stolen, and I know it was one of you stupid off-worlders that took it, because no native creature around here has strange footprints like the ones I saw where I put the gems!” Kiona huffs, her lips curling into a snarl.
rows.translation: “你当然想知道吧？拜你们这些外来者所赐，我几乎已经没什么鬼东西可卖了！我上次外出时收集的那批珠宝被偷了，而且我知道就是你们这些愚蠢外来者中的一个干的，因为本地没有哪种生物会留下我存放宝石处那种古怪脚印！” 琪奥娜哼了一声，嘴唇扭成怒容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wouldn’t you like to know? Thanks to you outsiders, I barely even have shit to sell! My last haul of jewels that I had gathered while outside of the hold was stolen, and I know it was one of you stupid off-worlders that took it, because no native creature around here has strange footprints like the ones I saw where I put the gems!” Kiona huffs, her lips curling into a snarl."

rows.original: “Wouldn’t alien like knowings? Thanks to aliens, Kiona have barely have crap to sell. Last stash of sparkles Kiona gather while outside hold stolen, and knowings it was one of stupid aliens that takings, cause no home creature here have weird feetprints like one Kiona see where I put sparkles.” Kiona huffs, her lips curling into a snarl.
rows.translation: “外星人当然想知道？都怪外星人们，琪奥娜几乎没什么破东西可以卖！琪奥娜上次在据点外收集的闪亮物被偷，琪奥娜知道是你们蠢外星人中的一个拿走，因为这里的本地生物不会在琪奥娜放闪亮物的地方留下那种怪脚印！” 琪奥娜气呼呼地哼着，嘴唇扭成怒容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wouldn’t alien like knowings? Thanks to aliens, Kiona have barely have crap to sell. Last stash of sparkles Kiona gather while outside hold stolen, and knowings it was one of stupid aliens that takings, cause no home creature here have weird feetprints like one Kiona see where I put sparkles.” Kiona huffs, her lips curling into a snarl."

rows.original: After thinking about it, you conclude that you definitely don’t remember coming across any random jewel piles, especially nearby the hold.
rows.translation: 仔细想想，你确定自己一路上根本没碰见什么散落的首饰，更别说属于琪奥娜的货物了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter thinking about it, you conclude that you definitely don’t remember coming across any random jewel piles, especially nearby the hold."

rows.original: “Er... I think there’s been a bit of a misunderstanding. I can’t speak for any other off-worlder, but personally I haven’t ever seen your jewel pile before. Even if I did find one nearby here, if I knew it was Korg’ii Hold property, I wouldn’t want to get on Ula’s bad side by stealing it.”
rows.translation: “呃... 我想这里有点误会。我不能替其他外来者说话，但我肯定没从你这里偷过东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Er... I think there’s been a bit of a misunderstanding. I can’t speak for any other off-worlder, but personally I haven’t ever seen your jewel pile before. Even if I did find one nearby here, if I knew it was Korg’ii Hold property, I wouldn’t want to get on Ula’s bad side by stealing it.”"

rows.original: “Look, lady. I’m pretty sure that this is a small misunderstanding. I’m not like a certain greedy off-worlder that likely took it. I can’t take what I’ve never seen before. That and if I did find your pile near here, if I knew it was Korg’ii Hold property, it’d be a crime to make the pretty princess mad... and a pretty jeweler on top of that.”
rows.translation: “听着，女士。我很确定这只是个小误会。我不像某个绿色小混蛋那样，会顺手拿走不属于自己的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look, lady. I’m pretty sure that this is a small misunderstanding. I’m not like a certain greedy off-worlder that likely took it. I can’t take what I’ve never seen before. That and if I did find your pile near here, if I knew it was Korg’ii Hold property, it’d be a crime to make the pretty princess mad... and a pretty jeweler on top of that.”"

rows.original: “Hey. Why am I to blame for something someone else did? Some other off-worlder probably took it, not me. I never saw your gem pile at all, for sure. Even if I did and I knew it belonged to the hold, I’m not stupid enough to get myself kicked out as soon as I was let in. Come on, think about it.”
rows.translation: “嘿。别人干的事凭什么怪我？大概是另一个外来者拿走了。你不能因为我们都来自星球外面，就认定我们是一伙的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey. Why am I to blame for something someone else did? Some other off-worlder probably took it, not me. I never saw your gem pile at all, for sure. Even if I did and I knew it belonged to the hold, I’m not stupid enough to get myself kicked out as soon as I was let in. Come on, think about it.”"

rows.original: Despite your best explanation, Kiona doesn’t look in the least bit convinced at all, crossing her arms in defiance.
rows.translation: 尽管你已经尽力解释，琪奥娜看起来仍完全不信，抱着双臂怀疑地盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite your best explanation, Kiona doesn’t look in the least bit convinced at all, crossing her arms in defiance."

rows.original: “Either way, I’ve only got some sex toys in stock, but you’re shit out of luck for piercings until I have my supplies replenished... somehow.” Kiona emphasises the last word heavily, glaring daggers at you all the while.
rows.translation: “不管怎样，我现在只有些性爱玩具有货；至于穿孔饰品，在原料通过... 某种办法补回来前，你只能自认倒霉。” 琪奥娜重重强调最后几个字，同时一直恶狠狠地瞪着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Either way, I’ve only got some sex toys in stock, but you’re shit out of luck for piercings until I have my supplies replenished... somehow.” Kiona emphasises the last word heavily, glaring daggers at you all the while."

rows.original: “Anyways, Kiona only have sexing toys for sellings, but crap out of luck with body sparkles until gettings more supply... somehow.” Kiona emphasises the last word heavily, glaring daggers at you all the while.
rows.translation: “总之，琪奥娜只有性爱玩具能卖，身体闪亮物在补充更多原料前没有，得通过... 某种办法。” 琪奥娜重重强调最后几个字，同时一直恶狠狠地瞪着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyways, Kiona only have sexing toys for sellings, but crap out of luck with body sparkles until gettings more supply... somehow.” Kiona emphasises the last word heavily, glaring daggers at you all the while."

rows.original: You don’t think that words alone aren’t going to help with Kiona’s enmity towards you. Sighing in defeat, you offer to her a deal: If you can find her missing stash or some replacement jewels that she could use to restock her wares, then she’ll stop accusing you of being a thief in return.
rows.translation: 看来光靠言语无法消除琪奥娜对你的敌意。你无奈地叹了口气，决定帮她找回一些失窃的材料。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t think that words alone aren’t going to help with Kiona’s enmity towards you. Sighing in defeat, you offer to her a deal: If you can find her missing stash or some replacement jewels that she could use to restock her wares, then she’ll stop accusing you of being a thief in return."

rows.original: “Mmm... that’s a start. If I get back as much as was stolen, I should at least be able to finish a sizable chunk of my orders and have some extra savicite piercings to sell to boot. For now, all you get is what I have left.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 这算个开始。如果能拿回和失窃数量差不多的原料，我至少能完成相当一部分订单。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm... that’s a start. If I get back as much as was stolen, I should at least be able to finish a sizable chunk of my orders and have some extra savicite piercings to sell to boot. For now, all you get is what I have left.”"

rows.original: “Mmm... that a start. If get back what was stolen, Kiona can finish good bit of orders and having extra green body sparkles too. For now, all alien get is what having left.”
rows.translation: “嗯... 这是开始。如果拿回被偷的那些，琪奥娜能完成不少订单，也能再有身体闪亮物卖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm... that a start. If get back what was stolen, Kiona can finish good bit of orders and having extra green body sparkles too. For now, all alien get is what having left.”"

rows.original: You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of savicite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. Her eyebrows raise slightly, though her glowering expression otherwise remains unchanged.
rows.translation: 你小心地在库存里翻找片刻，随后取出一块未经加工的萨维石，把它放在柜台上。
rows.raw: "You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of savicite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. Her eyebrows raise slightly, though her glowering expression otherwise remains unchanged."

rows.original: “Here. This probably isn’t all from what was stolen from you, but it’s something.”
rows.translation: “给你。这大概不是你被偷走的全部，但总比没有好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here. This probably isn’t all from what was stolen from you, but it’s something.”"

rows.original: Kiona picks up the jewel, turning it over and around. The corners of her mouth crook as she thoroughly inspects the ore. Finally, she places the jewel in a hidden compartment under her stall and nods her head slightly.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜拿起宝石，翻来覆去地端详。她仔细检查这块原石时，嘴角微微翘起。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona picks up the jewel, turning it over and around. The corners of her mouth crook as she thoroughly inspects the ore. Finally, she places the jewel in a hidden compartment under her stall and nods her head slightly."

rows.original: “Yeah... That was a fine piece you brought me. It’s enough to get some orders done.” The korgonne tersely remarks. After a few moments in awkward silence, you ask her just how much was stolen from her.
rows.translation: “嗯... 你带来的这块品质不错，足够我完成一些订单了。” 科尔贡女人满意地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah... That was a fine piece you brought me. It’s enough to get some orders done.” The korgonne tersely remarks. After a few moments in awkward silence, you ask her just how much was stolen from her."

rows.original: “Yes... That was good sparkle you bring Kiona. Enough to get few order done.” The korgonne tersely remarks. After a few moments in awkward silence, you ask her just how much was stolen from her.
rows.translation: “对... 外星人带来的闪亮石头很好。足够完成几个订单。” 科尔贡女人满意地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes... That was good sparkle you bring Kiona. Enough to get few order done.” The korgonne tersely remarks. After a few moments in awkward silence, you ask her just how much was stolen from her."

rows.original: “I believe I had a few more pieces that were about that size. Thankfully, I’m really efficient with processing these ores, so I don’t need much of it to make a decent amount of jewelry. I’d say about four more of those should make us even.”
rows.translation: “我记得还有几块差不多大小的。幸好我很擅长充分利用原料，所以再找回几块就能派上很大用场。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I believe I had a few more pieces that were about that size. Thankfully, I’m really efficient with processing these ores, so I don’t need much of it to make a decent amount of jewelry. I’d say about four more of those should make us even.”"

rows.original: “Kiona believe havings few more sparkles about same size. Thankful Kiona very good with using sparkle rocks so not needings much to make lots of body sparkles. Sayings about four more make even.”
rows.translation: “琪奥娜记得还有几块差不多大小的闪亮石头。幸好琪奥娜很会充分利用闪亮石头，所以再找回几块就很有用。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiona believe havings few more sparkles about same size. Thankful Kiona very good with using sparkle rocks so not needings much to make lots of body sparkles. Sayings about four more make even.”"

rows.original: Resisting the growing urge to claim your innocence and argue with the korgonne again, you decide to simply drop the subject entirely for the time being.
rows.translation: 你压下再次声明清白、同琪奥娜争辩的冲动，决定继续寻找失窃的材料。
rows.raw: "\n\nResisting the growing urge to claim your innocence and argue with the korgonne again, you decide to simply drop the subject entirely for the time being."

rows.original: “Hm... good. I can at least say you’re turning out more honorable than I initially figured you to be. Keep it up and I should have a good amount to fully replenish my stock.”

rows.raw: "You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of savicite and placing it on the counter in front of Kiona. Her eyebrows rise in response; she actually looks quite impressed this time around."

rows.original: Kiona picks up the jewel, turning it over and around, her mouth crooking in delight as she thoroughly inspects the ore. Finally, she places the jewel in a hidden compartment under her stall and nods her head in satisfaction.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜拿起宝石，翻来覆去地端详；仔细检查这块原石时，她欣喜地扬起嘴角。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona picks up the jewel, turning it over and around, her mouth crooking in delight as she thoroughly inspects the ore. Finally, she places the jewel in a hidden compartment under her stall and nods her head in satisfaction."

rows.original: “Well, prove me wrong. You actually returned pretty much what was stolen from me! I should be able to finish a majority of my orders right now, with some extras to boot. You’ll have to come back tomorrow for those piercings to be done. I’m gonna close down the shop for today to get them done and those piercings made. Excuse me.”
rows.translation: “好吧，算你证明我错了。你居然把被偷的东西差不多都还回来了！我应该能完成绝大多数订单，还能重新摆些穿孔饰品出售。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, prove me wrong. You actually returned pretty much what was stolen from me! I should be able to finish a majority of my orders right now, with some extras to boot. You’ll have to come back tomorrow for those piercings to be done. I’m gonna close down the shop for today to get them done and those piercings made. Excuse me.”"

rows.original: “Well, provings Kiona wrong. Alien actually return stolen sparkles! Should finishings most of orders right now, with extra on top. Alien havings to come tomorrow for body sparkles to finish. Gonna close shop for today, gettings orders done and body sparkles made. Excuse Kiona.”
rows.translation: “好吧，证明琪奥娜错了。外星人真的把被偷的闪亮石头还回来了！应该能完成大部分订单，也能再卖身体闪亮物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, provings Kiona wrong. Alien actually return stolen sparkles! Should finishings most of orders right now, with extra on top. Alien havings to come tomorrow for body sparkles to finish. Gonna close shop for today, gettings orders done and body sparkles made. Excuse Kiona.”"

rows.original: Kiona turns the open/closed sign on the front shelf and trots over towards a hidden room behind a fur curtain. Just as you turn around, you faintly hear a “thank you” from behind. When you whip around to confirm if Kiona said this, all you see is a flick of her jewel-laden tail before it disappears behind the furry sheet.
rows.translation: 琪奥娜翻转前台的营业牌，随后小跑向毛皮帘幕后方的一间隐蔽房间。就在你转身时，隐约听见身后传来一句“谢谢”。你猛然回头，想确认那是不是琪奥娜说的，却只看见她挂满珠宝的尾巴一闪，消失在毛皮帘幕后。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiona turns the open/closed sign on the front shelf and trots over towards a hidden room behind a fur curtain. Just as you turn around, you faintly hear a “thank you” from behind. When you whip around to confirm if Kiona said this, all you see is a flick of her jewel-laden tail before it disappears behind the furry sheet."

rows.original: You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of savicite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. One of her eyebrows rises in confusion.

rows.raw: "You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of savicite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. One of her eyebrows rises in confusion."

rows.original: “Oh... wow, is this for me? I know I was being a pain in the ass before, but now you’re kind of making me feel even worse about it. Well, how about a small token of my own gratitude? I’ll get you a free piercing for your trouble. It’s the least I could do to make things up to you. Really, thank you so much for helping me supply up.”
rows.translation: “噢... 哇，这是给我的？我知道之前挺招人烦的，可你现在都快让我觉得不好意思了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... wow, is this for me? I know I was being a pain in the ass before, but now you’re kind of making me feel even worse about it. Well, how about a small token of my own gratitude? I’ll get you a free piercing for your trouble. It’s the least I could do to make things up to you. Really, thank you so much for helping me supply up.”"

rows.original: “Oh... wow, this for Kiona? Knowings Kiona was pain in butt before, but now alien kind of makings Kiona feel worse. Well... how about small token of gratitude? Kiona givings free body-sparkle for trouble. It least Kiona can do to make up. Really, thankings alien very much for help supply up.”
rows.translation: “噢... 哇，这是给琪奥娜？知道琪奥娜之前很烦人，可外星人现在让琪奥娜有点不好意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... wow, this for Kiona? Knowings Kiona was pain in butt before, but now alien kind of makings Kiona feel worse. Well... how about small token of gratitude? Kiona givings free body-sparkle for trouble. It least Kiona can do to make up. Really, thankings alien very much for help supply up.”"

rows.original: “Um... I mean, I already have all that I need so far but... I won’t say no to more. Just... I kinda hate feeling like I have to owe anyone anything, so I’ll just give you a free piercing to call us even. Thank you for this, really.”
rows.translation: “呃... 我的意思是，目前需要的原料已经够了，不过... 更多我也不会拒绝。只是... 我不喜欢欠别人人情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um... I mean, I already have all that I need so far but... I won’t say no to more. Just... I kinda hate feeling like I have to owe anyone anything, so I’ll just give you a free piercing to call us even. Thank you for this, really.”"

rows.original: “Uh... Already have all Kiona need so far, but... won’t say no to more. Hatings feel like owing anything so Kiona give free body-sparkle to call even. Thankings alien for this, really.”
rows.translation: “呃... 琪奥娜目前已经有需要的全部东西，但... 更多也不会拒绝。只是... 讨厌感觉欠外星人人情。”

rows.raw: "KIONA_SAVICITE"

rows.original: You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of lucinite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. She looks positively gobsmacked when she realizes that you’re giving her another chunk of the rare teal-blue ore.
rows.translation: 你小心地在库存里翻找片刻，随后取出一块未经加工的卢西石，把它放在柜台上。
rows.raw: "You gingerly poke through your inventory for a moment before pulling out a raw chunk of lucinite and place it on the counter in front of Kiona. She looks positively gobsmacked when she realizes that you’re giving her another chunk of the rare teal-blue ore."

rows.original: “I... You’re seriously just gonna give this to me? I’m not sure what to say honestly, but you’ve definitely just made my day with this.” Kiona strokes the metallic rock along her cheek, smiling gleefully. “I... I won’t question how you managed to procure this, but you must be seriously strong to get that much of this. I can’t wait to make more accessories out of this stuff! Thank you so much! Please, take a lucinite piercing in return, I insist!”
rows.translation: “我... 你真打算直接把这个给我？老实说，我不知道该说什么，但这绝对让我开心了一整天。” 琪奥娜把金属般的矿石贴在脸颊上摩挲，欣喜地笑着。“我... 我不会追问你是怎么弄到它的，但能得到这么多，你一定强得惊人。我等不及要用这种材料制作更多饰品了！太感谢你了！请收下一件卢西石穿孔饰品作为回礼，我坚持！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... You’re seriously just gonna give this to me? I’m not sure what to say honestly, but you’ve definitely just made my day with this.” Kiona strokes the metallic rock along her cheek, smiling gleefully. “I... I won’t question how you managed to procure this, but you must be seriously strong to get that much of this. I can’t wait to make more accessories out of this stuff! Thank you so much! Please, take a lucinite piercing in return, I insist!”"

rows.original: “Uh... uhm... Alien seriously givings blue sparkle rock to Kiona. Not knowings what to say in honest, but for sure makings Kiona’s day.” Kiona strokes the metallic rock along her cheek, smiling gleefully. “Won’t question how alien get sparkle rock, but must be super strong to get this much. Kiona can’t wait to make more sparkle rock jewels out of this. Many thankings to alien! Please takings blue sparkle body jewel in return, Kiona insist!”
rows.translation: “呃... 嗯... 外星人真的把蓝色闪亮石头给琪奥娜。老实说不知道该说什么，但肯定让琪奥娜开心一整天。” 琪奥娜把金属般的矿石贴在脸颊上摩挲，欣喜地笑着。“不问外星人怎么弄到闪亮石头，但能弄到这么多，一定超级强。琪奥娜等不及用它做更多闪亮珠宝。非常感谢外星人！请收下蓝色闪亮身体珠宝作为回礼，琪奥娜坚持！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... uhm... Alien seriously givings blue sparkle rock to Kiona. Not knowings what to say in honest, but for sure makings Kiona’s day.” Kiona strokes the metallic rock along her cheek, smiling gleefully. “Won’t question how alien get sparkle rock, but must be super strong to get this much. Kiona can’t wait to make more sparkle rock jewels out of this. Many thankings to alien! Please takings blue sparkle body jewel in return, Kiona insist!”"

rows.original: KIONA_LUCINITE
rows.raw: "KIONA_LUCINITE"

rows.original: You briefly rummage through your inventory, and place a chunk of lucinite on the shop counter. Kiona’s eyes light up and a gasp escapes her when she realizes what she is looking at. She snatches the ore chunk up and hurries into the back room. A few moments later, she pops back out through the fur sheets with the first smile you’ve seen from her.
rows.translation: 你简单翻了翻库存，把一块卢西石放在商店柜台上。琪奥娜的眼睛立刻睁大了。
rows.raw: "You briefly rummage through your inventory, and place a chunk of lucinite on the shop counter. Kiona’s eyes light up and a gasp escapes her when she realizes what she is looking at. She snatches the ore chunk up and hurries into the back room. A few moments later, she pops back out through the fur sheets with the first smile you’ve seen from her."

rows.original: “Yes! Yes! This is the stuff! I actually can’t believe you managed to get your hands on this! You... must be very strong in order to get this, to brave the frostwyrm territory. And... this is for me?” the korgonne asks, eyes full of hope. When you nod your head, Kiona yips in glee, holding the ore to her chest.
rows.translation: “对！对！就是这种东西！真不敢相信你居然能弄到它！你... 一定非常强，才能闯进霜龙的领地拿到它。而且... 这是给我的？” 科尔贡女人满怀希望地问道。你点头后，琪奥娜欣喜地叫了一声，把矿石抱在胸前。

rows.original: The spinarran shopkeeper stands tall for a woman, an inch or two over six feet tall. From her build you can tell she’s no pushover either. Six eyes look back at you from behind polarized goggles. Under her outfit, her entire body is covered head to toe in hard, shiny carapace of polished-looking coppery metal. Long locks of chitinous ‘hair’ flow down her back from her crested head, each tendril as thick as a finger, segmented and looking like bundles of wrapped copper cable. Standing out from her chest is the rise of her bust, what you guess to be C-cups, perfectly suited to her frame. Her strong waist flares into wide, egg bearing hips, thick thighs and a round ass.
rows.translation: 这名斯皮纳兰店主以女性而言相当高挑，足有六英尺多几英寸。从体格也看得出她绝非好惹之辈。六只眼睛隔着偏光护目镜回望着你。她的衣装之下，从头到脚都覆盖着坚硬而闪亮的甲壳，宛如精心抛光的铜色金属。长长的几丁质“发丝”从头顶冠脊一路垂过背部，每根触须都有手指粗细，呈分节状，看起来就像一束束缠绕的铜缆。胸前隆起一对你估摸有C罩杯的乳房，与她的身材十分相称。强健的腰肢向下展开成适合产卵的宽胯、粗壮大腿和浑圆臀部。

rows.original: “True enough. Spinarrans are not a commonly seen species. If you wanted to know about us, you could look us up on the extranet. Our people have been a part of the UGC for a century now. Plenty of information on us is publicly available, but I suppose firsthand knowledge is always better. What would you like to talk about; about spinarrans, myself, or if you’re tired of talking you could always peruse our wares.”
rows.translation: “确实如此。斯皮纳兰人并不是常见的种族。如果你想了解我们，可以上外联网查一查。我们的人民加入联合银河邦联已经有一个世纪了，关于我们的公开资料多得很，不过第一手了解当然总是更好。你想聊什么；斯皮纳兰人、我自己，还是说你不想聊了，也可以看看我们的商品。”

rows.original: “We like to live deep underground, you see. Many of our kin go their whole lives without seeing the sky or even the surface of a planet. Our eyes don’t see very well in bright light,” the copper-plated alien says as she taps a clawed finger against the polarised surface of her goggles. “Spinarrans need protective lenses to keep our eyes safe on the surface or in alien cities, we would be almost blinded by even the lights most beings need to see.”
rows.translation: “你瞧，我们喜欢住在地下深处。许多同胞一辈子都不曾见过天空，甚至没见过行星表面。我们的眼睛在强光下看不清东西，”覆着铜甲的外星人一边说，一边用带爪的手指敲了敲护目镜的偏光镜面。“斯皮纳兰人在地表或外星城市里必须戴防护镜片保护眼睛；哪怕只是大多数生物视物所需的灯光，也几乎能让我们失明。”
rows.raw: "“We like to live deep underground, you see. Many of our kin go their whole lives without seeing the sky or even the surface of a planet. Our eyes don’t see very well in bright light,” the copper-plated alien says as she taps a clawed finger against the polarised surface of her goggles. “Spinarrans need protective lenses to keep our eyes safe on the surface or in alien cities, we would be almost blinded by even the lights most beings need to see.”"

rows.original: “On the plus side, we see in infrared and ultraviolet. We are very well adapted to living in near or total darkness,” the drider says, adding to the topic at hand. “With our sight, smell, and our antennae, we can even sense all the different types of rock and minerals in the walls and ground around us.”
rows.translation: “好处是，我们能看见红外线和紫外线，非常适应近乎全黑或彻底黑暗的环境，”这名蛛身人继续补充道。“凭借视觉、嗅觉和触角，我们甚至能感知周围墙壁与地面中各种不同的岩石和矿物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“On the plus side, we see in infrared and ultraviolet. We are very well adapted to living in near or total darkness,” the drider says, adding to the topic at hand. “With our sight, smell, and our antennae, we can even sense all the different types of rock and minerals in the walls and ground around us.”"

rows.original: You look at their covered eyes before gazing around the store. It’s hard to imagine seeing things like that all at once. You have no idea what it would be like to just sense minerals like that. “Hard to imagine seeing all those different things at once,” you say, voicing your thoughts.
rows.translation: 你看了看她被遮住的眼睛，又环顾店铺。很难想象同时以那种方式看见一切，你根本不知道直接感知矿物是什么体验。“很难想象同时看见那么多不同的东西，”你把心里的想法说了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at their covered eyes before gazing around the store. It’s hard to imagine seeing things like that all at once. You have no idea what it would be like to just sense minerals like that. “Hard to imagine seeing all those different things at once,” you say, voicing your thoughts."

rows.original: Her antennae shudder with amusement and she smiles. “To others, yes. To us, it’s beautiful. We see a world of patterns and twilight. People look like fire of all shades, cold lends notes of shadowy twilight. UV adds detail to your blazing form.” Her antennae twitch several times, and you can hear her sniffing. “If you had been down in the mines I would even be able to smell the minerals in the dust on your clothing.”
rows.translation: 她的触角因愉悦而颤动，脸上露出笑容。“对别人而言，是这样。对我们来说，那很美。我们看见的是由纹理与暮色组成的世界。人们如同各种色调的火焰，寒冷则带来幽暗暮色般的阴影，紫外线为你燃烧般的形体增添细节。”她的触角抽动了几次，你还听见她在嗅闻。“如果你去过矿井，我甚至能闻出沾在你衣服灰尘里的矿物。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer antennae shudder with amusement and she smiles. “To others, yes. To us, it’s beautiful. We see a world of patterns and twilight. People look like fire of all shades, cold lends notes of shadowy twilight. UV adds detail to your blazing form.” Her antennae twitch several times, and you can hear her sniffing. “If you had been down in the mines I would even be able to smell the minerals in the dust on your clothing.”"

rows.original: “That’s pretty cool. It must be nice being able to see in complete darkness,” you say as you get comfortable at the counter.
rows.translation: “真酷。能在彻底的黑暗中看清东西一定很方便，”你一边说，一边在柜台边找了个舒服的姿势。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s pretty cool. It must be nice being able to see in complete darkness,” you say as you get comfortable at the counter."

rows.original: “It is I suppose. It’s normal to us. It does come with a price; we can’t stand daylight at all, and alien cities are... intense for us. Some places have so much neon that it may as well be daylight. Got to wear our goggles all the time just to be able to see. Give me a nice dark spinarran city any day.” The chitinous alien looks at you apologetically. “No offence to you, honestly. Biological differences, that’s all. It’s just a lot more comfortable for us. And most aliens don’t like UV light, so we can’t make full use of our antennae.”
rows.translation: “我想是吧。对我们而言很正常。当然也有代价；我们完全受不了日光，而外星城市对我们来说也...太刺激了。有些地方的霓虹灯多得简直和白昼一样。我们必须一直戴着护目镜才能看清。要我说，任何时候都不如一座舒适昏暗的斯皮纳兰城市。”这名几丁质外星人歉意地看着你。“不是有意冒犯你，真的，只是生理差异而已。那样对我们舒服得多。而且大多数外星人都不喜欢紫外线，所以我们也无法充分运用触角。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is I suppose. It’s normal to us. It does come with a price; we can’t stand daylight at all, and alien cities are... intense for us. Some places have so much neon that it may as well be daylight. Got to wear our goggles all the time just to be able to see. Give me a nice dark spinarran city any day.” The chitinous alien looks at you apologetically. “No offence to you, honestly. Biological differences, that’s all. It’s just a lot more comfortable for us. And most aliens don’t like UV light, so we can’t make full use of our antennae.”"

rows.original: Your eyes look up to the occasionally twitching feelers. “You can’t?”
rows.translation: 你的目光抬向那对偶尔抽动的触须。“不能吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes look up to the occasionally twitching feelers. “You can’t?”"

rows.original: Kirila shakes her head. “No, we can’t, or, well, we choose not too. We can make them glow with ultraviolet light so we can see better in the dark, and most aliens don’t handle UV rays very well. In fact I could probably give you a bad sunburn or cause permanent eye damage if I were to make them glow. So we don’t unless we are alone, or when It’s just spinarrans anyway.”
rows.translation: 基里拉摇摇头。“不能，或者说，嗯，是我们选择不用。我们可以让触角发出紫外线，在黑暗中看得更清楚，但大多数外星人都承受不了紫外线。事实上，要是让它们发光，我大概能把你严重晒伤，甚至永久损伤你的眼睛。所以除非独处，或者周围全是斯皮纳兰人，否则我们不会这么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila shakes her head. “No, we can’t, or, well, we choose not too. We can make them glow with ultraviolet light so we can see better in the dark, and most aliens don’t handle UV rays very well. In fact I could probably give you a bad sunburn or cause permanent eye damage if I were to make them glow. So we don’t unless we are alone, or when It’s just spinarrans anyway.”"

rows.original: Yeah, you could do without getting a sunburn indoors. “I see. Well it’s thoughtful of you to keep them unlit around aliens.”
rows.translation: 是啊，你可不想待在室内还被晒伤。“明白了。你们在外星人身边让它们保持熄灭，确实很体贴。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, you could do without getting a sunburn indoors. “I see. Well it’s thoughtful of you to keep them unlit around aliens.”"

rows.original: She nods. “We try, not all aliens adapt to galactic life easily. The UV sight isn’t just for not bumping into stuff, you don’t see it on us, but we are covered in patterns and markings that are only visible in the ultraviolet spectrum. Helps us tell each other apart and warn creatures we are dangerous, as if being covered head to toe in metal, having claws, pick arms, and strong jaws weren’t enough to give that away,” the arachnid says, jabbing the air with one of her pickaxe-like secondary limbs for emphasis.
rows.translation: 她点点头。“我们会尽量这么做，不是所有外星人都能轻松适应银河生活。紫外视觉不只是为了避免撞上东西；你看不出来，但我们全身都覆盖着只有在紫外光谱下才能看见的纹路与斑纹。这有助于我们辨认彼此，也能警告其他生物我们很危险——仿佛从头到脚覆着金属、长着爪子、镐状副肢和强健颚部，还不足以说明这一点似的，”这名蛛形生物说道，并用一条宛如十字镐的副肢戳了戳空气以加强语气。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “We try, not all aliens adapt to galactic life easily. The UV sight isn’t just for not bumping into stuff, you don’t see it on us, but we are covered in patterns and markings that are only visible in the ultraviolet spectrum. Helps us tell each other apart and warn creatures we are dangerous, as if being covered head to toe in metal, having claws, pick arms, and strong jaws weren’t enough to give that away,” the arachnid says, jabbing the air with one of her pickaxe-like secondary limbs for emphasis."

rows.original: Kinathis
rows.raw: "Kinathis"

rows.original: You look down at the bowl filled with bluish rocks and pick one up. “These looks like rocks, but I saw you eat one earlier. Are they really rocks?” you ask, playing with the little bluish rock in your hand.
rows.translation: 你低头看向装满蓝色石块的碗，拿起一块。“这些看起来像石头，但我刚才看到你吃了一块。它们真是石头吗？”你一边问，一边摆弄手中的蓝色小石块。
rows.raw: "You look down at the bowl filled with bluish rocks and pick one up. “These looks like rocks, but I saw you eat one earlier. Are they really rocks?” you ask, playing with the little bluish rock in your hand."

rows.original: She nods. “Of course, what else would they be?”
rows.translation: 她点点头。“当然，不然还能是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “Of course, what else would they be?”"

rows.original: “You seriously do eat rocks?” you question, eyes drifting down to the bowl of small rocks on the counter. You know you saw her eat one.
rows.translation: “你们真的会吃石头？”你追问道，目光落向柜台上那碗小石块。你很确定刚才看见她吃了一块。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You seriously do eat rocks?” you question, eyes drifting down to the bowl of small rocks on the counter. You know you saw her eat one."

rows.original: Kirila smiles, showing the many sharp and crushing teeth. The pearlescent rock breakers almost seem to sparkle like crystal. “Indeed I do, and yes, they are real rocks. Rocks impregnated with copper ore to be exact. I snack on them often. Got to keep up my lovely exoskeleton!” she says, running a hand back over her head and through her copper tresses.
rows.translation: 基里拉露齿微笑，显出许多尖锐、适于碾碎东西的牙齿。那些珠光闪烁的碎岩齿看起来几乎像水晶般熠熠生辉。“当然会，而且没错，它们是真石头，确切说是富含铜矿的岩石。我经常拿来当零食。必须维护好我漂亮的外骨骼嘛！”她说着，一只手从头顶向后划过铜色发丝。
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila smiles, showing the many sharp and crushing teeth. The pearlescent rock breakers almost seem to sparkle like crystal. “Indeed I do, and yes, they are real rocks. Rocks impregnated with copper ore to be exact. I snack on them often. Got to keep up my lovely exoskeleton!” she says, running a hand back over her head and through her copper tresses."

rows.original: So, like, your hair is actual copper? Like the metal. Coooool
rows.translation: 所以说，你的头发真的是铜？就是那种金属。酷——毙了
rows.raw: "So, like, your hair is actual copper? Like the metal. Coooool"

rows.original: They talk about people having hair like spun copper, but for you it’s literal, your ski-chitin and uhh... hair, it’s all copper?
rows.translation: 人们总说谁的头发像铜丝，可你这是字面意义上的；你的皮肤——几丁质，还有呃...头发，全都是铜？
rows.raw: "They talk about people having hair like spun copper, but for you it’s literal, your ski-chitin and uhh... hair, it’s all copper?"

rows.original: The spinarran nods. “Mmhmm, it’s all metal, well, almost all. There is a little bit of organic matter laced throughout, but for the most part I am covered head to toe in a lovely alloy of nearly 90% copper plus a bunch of other stuff.” She lifts her chin and smiles, clearly proud of her chitin.
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰人点点头。“嗯哼，都是金属，嗯，几乎都是。里面交织着少量有机物，但我从头到脚覆盖的基本是一种含铜近90%、外加许多其他成分的漂亮合金。”她抬起下巴微笑，显然对自己的甲壳十分自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe spinarran nods. “Mmhmm, it’s all metal, well, almost all. There is a little bit of organic matter laced throughout, but for the most part I am covered head to toe in a lovely alloy of nearly 90% copper plus a bunch of other stuff.” She lifts her chin and smiles, clearly proud of her chitin."

rows.original: Oh it’s, like, sooo shiny! You must take such amazing care of it!
rows.translation: 噢，真的，太——闪亮了！你一定把它保养得特别好！
rows.raw: "Oh it’s, like, sooo shiny! You must take such amazing care of it!"

rows.original: Well it’s very shiny, looks like you take good care of it,
rows.translation: 嗯，真的很闪亮，看起来你保养得很好，
rows.raw: "Well it’s very shiny, looks like you take good care of it,"

rows.original: ” you muse aloud while looking at your reflection in her metal plates.
rows.translation: ”你望着金属甲片里自己的倒影，大声感叹道。
rows.raw: "” you muse aloud while looking at your reflection in her metal plates."

rows.original: Her antenna rattle, and she plays with one of the long locks of copper. “Why thank you, I take good care of it. I make sure to get an acid bath every other week and polish it every few days after. Makes it oh so shiny, like a mirror.”
rows.translation: 她的触角沙沙作响，同时把玩着一缕长长的铜发。“谢谢夸奖，我确实很用心保养。每隔一周都会泡一次酸浴，每隔几天还会抛光。这样它就会非常闪亮，像镜子一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer antenna rattle, and she plays with one of the long locks of copper. “Why thank you, I take good care of it. I make sure to get an acid bath every other week and polish it every few days after. Makes it oh so shiny, like a mirror.”"

rows.original: The copper clad spinarran smiles, showing off her teeth again. “While we can eat just about anything, our primary diet is rock and minerals. Metallic ore in particular is considered highly nutritious, and volcanic ore is, like, the best tasting thing ever. Though you probably don’t quite understand, I’m sure you have something that you really enjoy eating. To us the freshly formed rock and metal is amazingly delicious.” She taps a finger on the plate of her forearm. “We use the minerals to make our exoskeletons and keep our bodies running. Biologically speaking, we are quite a bit different from many other species. Heh, if we were more aggressive or feral, I suspect our race would be a scourge: physically strong, tough, quick to breed, eat resources many races use. If all we did was eat as much as we could and breed as much as we could, we could multiply uncontrollably and eat whole worlds...” She lets that grim idea linger for a moment before grinning. “But that’s not the case thankfully. It’s not just eating and fucking.”
rows.translation: 这名覆铜的斯皮纳兰人微笑着，再次露出牙齿。“虽然我们几乎什么都能吃，但主食还是岩石和矿物。尤其是金属矿石，营养价值很高，而火山矿石简直是世上最好吃的东西。不过你大概不太能理解，我相信你也有自己特别爱吃的食物。对我们而言，刚形成的岩石和金属美味得不可思议。”她用一根手指敲了敲前臂的甲片。“我们用矿物生成外骨骼，并维持身体运转。从生物学角度说，我们与许多其他种族差异很大。呵，要是我们的性情更具侵略性或更野蛮，我怀疑斯皮纳兰一族会成为一场灾祸：体格强壮、身体坚韧、繁殖迅速，还以许多种族赖以利用的资源为食。如果我们只顾着尽可能多吃、尽可能多繁殖，就可能失控般增殖，把整个世界都吃光...”她让这个阴森的设想停留片刻，随后咧嘴一笑。“不过幸好事实并非如此。生活可不只是吃东西和交配。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe copper clad spinarran smiles, showing off her teeth again. “While we can eat just about anything, our primary diet is rock and minerals. Metallic ore in particular is considered highly nutritious, and volcanic ore is, like, the best tasting thing ever. Though you probably don’t quite understand, I’m sure you have something that you really enjoy eating. To us the freshly formed rock and metal is amazingly delicious.” She taps a finger on the plate of her forearm. “We use the minerals to make our exoskeletons and keep our bodies running. Biologically speaking, we are quite a bit different from many other species. Heh, if we were more aggressive or feral, I suspect our race would be a scourge: physically strong, tough, quick to breed, eat resources many races use. If all we did was eat as much as we could and breed as much as we could, we could multiply uncontrollably and eat whole worlds...” She lets that grim idea linger for a moment before grinning. “But that’s not the case thankfully. It’s not just eating and fucking.”"

rows.original: Kirila coughs. “But umm. I think we got a little off track.”
rows.translation: 基里拉咳了一声。“不过，呃，我觉得我们有点跑题了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila coughs. “But umm. I think we got a little off track.”"

rows.original: You nod your head. “Just a little bit.”
rows.translation: 你点点头。“是跑了一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your head. “Just a little bit.”"

rows.original: “Anyway. So yeah, we eat rock and minerals. What we eat is reflected in our carapace.” She points to herself. “I like to eat copper, and thus I’m copper colored. My sister Koritha is a big silver drider; she eats a lot of different metals, most of them silvery. She maintains a very strict diet though due to her job.”
rows.translation: “总之，没错，我们吃岩石和矿物，吃的东西会反映在甲壳上。”她指向自己。“我喜欢吃铜，所以是铜色的。我姐姐科莉莎是一只银色的大型蛛身人；她会吃许多不同金属，其中大多呈银色。不过因为工作的关系，她严格控制饮食。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyway. So yeah, we eat rock and minerals. What we eat is reflected in our carapace.” She points to herself. “I like to eat copper, and thus I’m copper colored. My sister Koritha is a big silver drider; she eats a lot of different metals, most of them silvery. She maintains a very strict diet though due to her job.”"

rows.original: “You must be quite strong to carry all that weight around with you. Just the exoskeleton alone must weigh... what 36 kilos?”
rows.translation: “带着这么重的身体到处走，你们一定很强壮。光外骨骼就得有...多少，36公斤？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You must be quite strong to carry all that weight around with you. Just the exoskeleton alone must weigh... what 36 kilos?”"

rows.original: She smiles and nods. “Something like that. Spinarrans are quite physically strong, we must be to carry our carapace and smash and dig through rock. I’m fairly average now. In the past I was a soldier, and warriors are more formidable.” Her voice is rich with pride. Her pride soon deflates, however. “Despite that, rockworms are still a menace back home.” Kirila explains before you can ask, “Rockworms are a native species on Spinarra. They start off as worms about as large as a car, and can grow to be as large as a small apartment tower. Like us, they eat rock, but also spinarrans. We take great pains to keep track of the giant ones, but from time to time, small communities can just... disappear, swallowed up by them. Thankfully they are slow, and they don’t need to eat as often as us. We are just as happy to chow down on them as well. Young rockworm meat is quite tasty. A hot, thick slab of rockworm meat, crusted in rock salt and sand, with a freshly kilned clay bun, baked just enough so it’s still soft inside but crunchy on the outside, yum,” Kirila finishes with a sigh. You’re pretty sure she’s drooling a little bit.
rows.translation: 她笑着点点头。“差不多吧。斯皮纳兰人的体力相当强，必须如此才能背负甲壳、击碎并挖穿岩石。我现在算是普通水平，过去当兵时，战士们还要厉害得多。”她的声音充满自豪，不过很快又泄了气。“即便如此，岩虫在故乡仍然是个祸害。”没等你开口，基里拉便解释道：“岩虫是斯皮纳拉的本土物种。幼年时就是像汽车那么大的虫子，成年后能长到小型公寓楼那么大。它们和我们一样吃岩石，但也吃斯皮纳兰人。我们费尽心力追踪那些巨型个体，可有时候小型聚落还是会就这么...消失，被它们一口吞掉。幸好它们行动缓慢，而且不必像我们一样频繁进食。当然，我们也很乐意吃掉它们。幼年岩虫的肉非常美味。一大块滚烫厚实的岩虫肉，裹着岩盐和沙子，再夹进刚出窑的黏土面包里，烤到里面仍然柔软、外面却酥脆，真香，”基里拉叹息着说完。你很确定她都快流口水了。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles and nods. “Something like that. Spinarrans are quite physically strong, we must be to carry our carapace and smash and dig through rock. I’m fairly average now. In the past I was a soldier, and warriors are more formidable.” Her voice is rich with pride. Her pride soon deflates, however. “Despite that, rockworms are still a menace back home.” Kirila explains before you can ask, “Rockworms are a native species on Spinarra. They start off as worms about as large as a car, and can grow to be as large as a small apartment tower. Like us, they eat rock, but also spinarrans. We take great pains to keep track of the giant ones, but from time to time, small communities can just... disappear, swallowed up by them. Thankfully they are slow, and they don’t need to eat as often as us. We are just as happy to chow down on them as well. Young rockworm meat is quite tasty. A hot, thick slab of rockworm meat, crusted in rock salt and sand, with a freshly kilned clay bun, baked just enough so it’s still soft inside but crunchy on the outside, yum,” Kirila finishes with a sigh. You’re pretty sure she’s drooling a little bit."

rows.original: Well the way she put it, it did sound tasty.... Well maybe not the bun made of searing hot clay, but a big steak sounds good. The idea is whimsical enough to earn a chuckle.“Well I’m not sure about the bun, but I wonder what rockworm tastes like.”
rows.translation: 照她的说法，听起来确实挺好吃的.... 好吧，用滚烫黏土做的面包也许不怎么样，但一大块肉排还是很诱人。这个奇妙想法让你轻笑一声。“面包我不确定，不过真想知道岩虫是什么味道。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWell the way she put it, it did sound tasty.... Well maybe not the bun made of searing hot clay, but a big steak sounds good. The idea is whimsical enough to earn a chuckle.“Well I’m not sure about the bun, but I wonder what rockworm tastes like.”"

rows.original: Kirila gives you a sidelong glance. “Probably not at all like meat you’re used to. Your... uhh... what was it...cows? They don’t chow down on boulders and veins of metallic ore. Probably wouldn’t taste too good to you. It’d be too...” She pauses, trying to decide how to describe rockworm meat to a non-spinarran. “Mineraly?” She shrugs. “Not sure how else to describe it.” The shopkeeper reaches down to her rocks and plucks one up before popping it into her mouth, then offers you one.
rows.translation: 基里拉斜眼看你。“大概完全不像你习惯的肉。你们的...呃...叫什么来着...牛？它们可不会大嚼巨石和金属矿脉。你多半不会觉得好吃。那味道太...”她停下来，思考该怎样向非斯皮纳兰人描述岩虫肉。“矿物味？”她耸耸肩。“我也不知道还能怎么形容。”店主伸手从石碗里捻起一块丢入口中，随后又递给你一块。
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila gives you a sidelong glance. “Probably not at all like meat you’re used to. Your... uhh... what was it...cows? They don’t chow down on boulders and veins of metallic ore. Probably wouldn’t taste too good to you. It’d be too...” She pauses, trying to decide how to describe rockworm meat to a non-spinarran. “Mineraly?” She shrugs. “Not sure how else to describe it.” The shopkeeper reaches down to her rocks and plucks one up before popping it into her mouth, then offers you one."

rows.original: You give her a flat look.
rows.translation: 你面无表情地看着她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a flat look."

rows.original: She grins and chews her rock, cracking and popping and grinding it down before swallowing. “Perhaps it would taste like really nice dirt.”
rows.translation: 她咧嘴一笑，咔嚓作响地咀嚼、碾碎石头，随后吞了下去。“也许尝起来就像特别好吃的泥土。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins and chews her rock, cracking and popping and grinding it down before swallowing. “Perhaps it would taste like really nice dirt.”"

rows.original: Weird rock eating bugs.
rows.translation: 真是群吃石头的怪虫子。
rows.raw: "\n\nWeird rock eating bugs."

rows.original: “Eating is very important for us actually, well, I mean, obviously it’s important, but aside from the standard reasons. Our teeth are constantly growing, and while they are like diamonds, chewing on rocks grinds them down to keep them under control. While a spinarran can live off just eating yummy m-jelly, it would be bad since their teeth would get huge or they would have to file em down manually.”
rows.translation: “实际上，进食对我们非常重要；嗯，我是说，显然进食本来就很重要，但还有常规理由之外的原因。我们的牙齿会不断生长；虽然它们像钻石一样坚硬，咀嚼岩石却能把它们磨短，防止失控。斯皮纳兰人只吃美味的金属冻也能活下去，但那样不好，因为牙齿会长得巨大，或者必须手动锉短。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eating is very important for us actually, well, I mean, obviously it’s important, but aside from the standard reasons. Our teeth are constantly growing, and while they are like diamonds, chewing on rocks grinds them down to keep them under control. While a spinarran can live off just eating yummy m-jelly, it would be bad since their teeth would get huge or they would have to file em down manually.”"

rows.original: “I can’t imagine that would be very enjoyable. Grinding your teeth down.” You shudder and grimace.
rows.translation: “我想象不出那会有多愉快，把自己的牙齿磨短。”你打了个寒颤，皱起脸。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I can’t imagine that would be very enjoyable. Grinding your teeth down.” You shudder and grimace."

rows.original: The spinarran shrugs. “Ehh, it’s fine I guess. It’s normal for us so it’s not really uncomfortable. Doing it manually is just boring I guess, like a human clipping their nails.”
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰人耸耸肩。“呃，我觉得还好。对我们来说很正常，所以并不会真的不舒服。手动处理大概只是很无聊，就像人类剪指甲一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe spinarran shrugs. “Ehh, it’s fine I guess. It’s normal for us so it’s not really uncomfortable. Doing it manually is just boring I guess, like a human clipping their nails.”"

rows.original: “So what is m-jelly, some kind of nutrient paste?”
rows.translation: “那么金属冻是什么，某种营养糊吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what is m-jelly, some kind of nutrient paste?”"

rows.original: The spinarran looks at you for a moment before smiling. “Yeah, something like that.”
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰人看了你片刻，随后微笑。“对，差不多就是那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe spinarran looks at you for a moment before smiling. “Yeah, something like that.”"

rows.original: “Something like that?” That’s an odd response.
rows.translation: “差不多？”这个回答有点奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that?” That’s an odd response."

rows.original: “M-Jelly is basically a jelly that is made of suspended metallic grains and minerals. Our bodies store it as excess nutrients. It’s kind of like... milk from a Terran cow, or I guess more accurately a New Texan cowgirl, or maybe honey would be a closer example.”
rows.translation: “金属冻基本上是一种悬浮着金属颗粒和矿物的果冻。我们的身体会把它作为多余养分储存起来。有点像...泰兰奶牛的乳汁，或者更准确地说，像新德州奶牛姑娘的乳汁；也许蜂蜜才是更接近的例子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“M-Jelly is basically a jelly that is made of suspended metallic grains and minerals. Our bodies store it as excess nutrients. It’s kind of like... milk from a Terran cow, or I guess more accurately a New Texan cowgirl, or maybe honey would be a closer example.”"

rows.original: You look at her, or more specifically, the rise of her chest. “Is that sooo...”
rows.translation: 你看向她，更准确地说，是看向她隆起的胸脯。“所以说...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at her, or more specifically, the rise of her chest. “Is that sooo...”"

rows.original: She notice your looks. “Well it’s not quite like that, but you’re sort of on the right track. Let’s just say that driders make it and some are even paid to maintain a steady diet and get milked for others to eat. It’s kind of neat-looking actually, like your average fruit jam but shiny and metallic in color, like liquid chrome in a lot of cases.”
rows.translation: 她注意到你的视线。“嗯，倒不完全是那样，不过你的方向差不多对了。简单说，蛛身人会制造金属冻，其中有些甚至受雇维持稳定饮食，再定期被挤取供别人食用。它看起来其实挺漂亮的，就像普通果酱，却闪着金属光泽；许多时候像液态铬一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe notice your looks. “Well it’s not quite like that, but you’re sort of on the right track. Let’s just say that driders make it and some are even paid to maintain a steady diet and get milked for others to eat. It’s kind of neat-looking actually, like your average fruit jam but shiny and metallic in color, like liquid chrome in a lot of cases.”"

rows.original: You think about that for a few minutes, and decide it’s either gross or kind of kinky.
rows.translation: 你思考了几分钟，最后觉得这要么很恶心，要么有点淫靡。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think about that for a few minutes, and decide it’s either gross or kind of kinky."

rows.original: Kinathis
rows.raw: "Kinathis"

rows.original: In a bout of curiosity, you wonder about the business here. How long has this spinarran been here? “So how long have you been running this place?”
rows.translation: 一时好奇之下，你想起这里的生意。这名斯皮纳兰人来了多久？“所以，你经营这家店多久了？”
rows.raw: "In a bout of curiosity, you wonder about the business here. How long has this spinarran been here? “So how long have you been running this place?”"

rows.original: “Hmm?” Kirila perks up and twitches her antennae. “How long? Oh, well, five or so years now. Used to be in the military before I started this business.”
rows.translation: “嗯？”基里拉打起精神，触角抽了抽。“多久？噢，到现在大约五年了。开始做生意以前，我在军队服役。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm?” Kirila perks up and twitches her antennae. “How long? Oh, well, five or so years now. Used to be in the military before I started this business.”"

rows.original: “The military, huh? What was that like?” you ask, settling in for what could be a long story.
rows.translation: “军队啊？那是什么样的？”你问道，并做好听一个长故事的准备。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The military, huh? What was that like?” you ask, settling in for what could be a long story."

rows.original: The copper-skinned spinarran just shrugs. “It’s probably just like any other military force out there, though spinarrans do make for some scary shock troops. Tall, strong, covered head to toe in hardened metal plates, and there are a lot of us. Then there is the military body armor and shields to boot. But we don’t like to fight on the surface, unless it’s night. Then it’s alright. So night strikes and digging tunnels behind enemy lines is what we excel at. I don’t think any spinarrans have ever fought in space before. Probably for the best. We don’t handle the sheer vast openness of space very well. You will never see a spinarran with claustrophobia, but plenty have agoraphobia. Some can’t even look out a window in space without getting totally freaked out. We’re just not really made for it. I myself was a member of my legion’s 3rd sapper cohort. Now, in most militaries, sappers are engineers. They build stuff and break stuff. Spinarrans however, when we break stuff, we get in under you and fuck you up...” Kirila sighs “I’ll tell you one thing, we are dedicated. Peace is as prevalent as it seems, but military and civil protection are constantly performing training exercises to stay in top condition and ready for action. Most soldiers come from families that have a long tradition of service, all of them career soldiers.”
rows.translation: 覆着铜甲的斯皮纳兰人只是耸耸肩。“大概和其他军队差不多，不过斯皮纳兰人确实能成为很吓人的突击兵。高大、强壮、从头到脚覆着硬化金属甲片，而且数量众多，更不用说军用动力甲和护盾了。不过我们不喜欢在地表作战，除非是在夜间，那样就没问题。所以夜袭和挖隧道绕到敌后正是我们的强项。我觉得斯皮纳兰人还从未在太空作战过。这样也许最好，我们不太能应付太空那种无边无际的开阔感。你绝不会见到患幽闭恐惧症的斯皮纳兰人，却有很多人患广场恐惧症。有些人甚至无法透过太空中的舷窗向外看，否则就会彻底崩溃。我们天生就不适合那种环境。我曾是自己军团第三工兵大队的一员。大多数军队里的工兵都是工程师，负责建造和爆破；但斯皮纳兰人搞破坏时，会从你脚底钻出来，把你狠狠干翻...”基里拉叹了口气。“有一点我敢肯定，我们非常敬业。和平确实像表面看起来那样普遍，但军队和民防部队一直进行训练演习，保持最佳状态并随时准备行动。大多数士兵来自拥有悠久服役传统的家族，而且全都是职业军人。”

Spinarrans however, when we break stuff, we get in under you and fuck you up...” Kirila sighs “I’ll tell you one thing, we are dedicated. Peace is as prevalent as it seems, but military and civil protection are constantly performing training exercises to stay in top condition and ready for action. Most soldiers come from families that have a long tradition of service, all of them career soldiers.”"

rows.original: “For me, it was a lot of digging - strategic digging, using seismic scanners to map ‘enemy’ encampments and then finding the best place to come on up. Bam! Flood in through the new beachhead in the enemy lines and attack from within, or boom! Collapse fortified positions or identified artillery. Well that’s against surface threats. If they got dug-in hardpoints, it’s even better, we just smash or melt our way inside and flood in through the basements. And before you ask, we can dig really fast, what do you think these extra limbs are for?”
rows.translation: “对我来说，大部分工作就是挖掘——战略性挖掘，用地震扫描仪绘制‘敌方’营地，再找出最佳的破土位置。砰！从敌军阵线中新开的滩头阵地涌进去，由内部发动攻击；或者轰！让强化阵地或已经锁定的炮兵阵地坍塌。当然，那是针对地表威胁。要是他们有挖好的坚固据点，那就更方便了，我们只管砸穿或熔穿进去，从地下室蜂拥而入。免得你问，我们挖得非常快；你以为这些额外肢体是干什么用的？”
