Flood in through the new beachhead in the enemy lines and attack from within, or boom! Collapse fortified positions or identified artillery. Well that’s against surface threats. If they got dug-in hardpoints, it’s even better, we just smash or melt our way inside and flood in through the basements. And before you ask, we can dig really fast, what do you think these extra limbs are for?”"

rows.original: “Right, well, have you ever seen real combat?” you ask, curious about her service.
rows.translation: “好吧，那么你经历过真正的战斗吗？”你好奇地询问她的服役经历。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right, well, have you ever seen real combat?” you ask, curious about her service."

rows.original: “Yeah, once or twice. Some groups don’t think the peaceful arrangement that The Empress got with the other races is good. You know the usual species superiority types. They think spinarrans are better, higher forms of life. Sometimes they get a bit too rowdy... one time intelligence sniffed out that one of these groups had all gotten together and relocated to one our colonies. They were planning on breeding up an army. That was no good for sure. They were probably going to come back home and try to off The Empress and take over then pull some ‘manifest destiny’ stuff. That was one of the times I got into a real fight. Now the other time was a lot more interesting. World called Rakshasis. Nice place. All twilight, sand and mountains. All in all, not bad for my kind, even on the surface. Not too bright. Get hungry, and all you have to do is lean down and scoop up a handful of sand. Not very nutritious, but it gets the job done. It’s one of our few colonies. We don’t spread out much since we can make use of vastly more of a planet’s mass than non-lithophages can. Anyway, back to the story. This happened when it was a new place. Our settlements were still small. Tunnels were being dug around the clock to dig in as we do. The colony’s garrison was still on the way to the planet, so it had nothing but some local militia to stand up to the incoming attack”
rows.translation: “有，一两次吧。有些团体认为女皇与其他种族达成的和平安排并不好。你知道，就是常见的种族优越主义者。他们觉得斯皮纳兰人更优秀，是更高等的生命。有时他们会闹得太过火...有一次，情报部门发现其中一个团体全员集合，迁往了我们的一处殖民地。他们计划繁殖出一支军队。那当然不行。他们大概打算返回母星，杀掉女皇夺取政权，再搞一套‘昭昭天命’之类的东西。那是我真正参加战斗的经历之一。另一次就有意思多了。那个世界叫拉克沙西斯，是个好地方，遍布暮色、沙地和山脉。总的来说很适合我们，即便在地表也不错，光线不太强。饿了只要弯腰抓一把沙子，虽然没多少营养，却足以填肚子。那是我们为数不多的殖民地之一。我们不怎么向外扩张，因为相较不食岩的种族，我们能利用行星质量中大得多的部分。总之，回到故事。事情发生在殖民地刚建立时，聚落规模还很小；为了像往常一样扎根地下，隧道昼夜不停地开挖。殖民地守军仍在前往行星的路上，所以面对即将来袭的敌人，只有当地民兵能站出来抵抗。”

They think spinarrans are better, higher forms of life. Sometimes they get a bit too rowdy... one time intelligence sniffed out that one of these groups had all gotten together and relocated to one our colonies. They were planning on breeding up an army. That was no good for sure. They were probably going to come back home and try to off The Empress and take over then pull some ‘manifest destiny’ stuff. That was one of the times I got into a real fight. Now the other time was a lot more interesting. World called Rakshasis. Nice place. All twilight, sand and mountains. All in all, not bad for my kind, even on the surface. Not too bright. Get hungry, and all you have to do is lean down and scoop up a handful of sand. Not very nutritious, but it gets the job done. It’s one of our few colonies. We don’t spread out much since we can make use of vastly more of a planet’s mass than non-lithophages can. Anyway, back to the story. This happened when it was a new place. Our settlements were still small. Tunnels were being dug around the clock to dig in as we do. The colony’s garrison was still on the way to the planet, so it had nothing but some local militia to stand up to the incoming attack”"

rows.original: You grimace at that. Either pirates or slavers, a new and still undefended colony was a golden opportunity for loot, equipment, or slaves.
rows.translation: 你听得皱起脸。不论是海盗还是奴隶贩子，一个尚无防御的新殖民地都是掠夺战利品、设备或奴隶的绝佳机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grimace at that. Either pirates or slavers, a new and still undefended colony was a golden opportunity for loot, equipment, or slaves."

rows.original: “We make for good heavy labor, can work in hazardous environments, and don’t really need to be fed, plus driders can have their fangs milked for their venom. It’s a potent and highly addictive aphrodisiac. We make for fairly valuable slaves,” Kirila says as if sensing your train of thought.
rows.translation: “我们很适合做重体力劳动，能在危险环境中工作，基本不需要别人喂养；而且还能从蛛身人的毒牙中采集毒液，那是一种效力强大、极易成瘾的催情剂。我们算是相当值钱的奴隶，”基里拉仿佛看透了你的思路般说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We make for good heavy labor, can work in hazardous environments, and don’t really need to be fed, plus driders can have their fangs milked for their venom. It’s a potent and highly addictive aphrodisiac. We make for fairly valuable slaves,” Kirila says as if sensing your train of thought."

rows.original: She shakes her head. “It was naive of us to not send a full military detachment with the colony. They could have warded it from a raid, and the engineering cohorts could’ve helped dig in and set up the infrastructure.” She shows a small smile. “I didn’t think they expected us to get there as soon as we did. Our ships might not be nearly as fast as everyone else’s, but like the people that built them, they are hardy as hell, tanks every one of them, and we got plasma cannons. They also have these things that are technically supposed to be used to cut apart asteroids, but they also work on ships if you can get close enough. I do wish we would catch up with the more established races though. Imagine a ship with our armor and weapons carrying ausar shields and terran engines.” She sighs wistfully.
rows.translation: 她摇摇头。“我们当初没有随殖民队派遣完整军事分遣队，实在太天真了。他们本可以抵御劫掠，工程大队也能协助挖掘、建设基础设施。”她露出一丝微笑。“我想他们没料到我们这么快就会赶到。我们的船也许远没有其他人的快，但就像建造它们的人民一样，它们硬得要命，每一艘都是坦克，而且还装备了等离子炮。船上还有些设备，严格说来本应拿来切割小行星，但只要靠得够近，对付飞船同样有效。不过我真希望我们能赶上那些发展更久的种族。想象一下，一艘拥有我们的装甲和武器、同时搭载奥萨护盾与泰兰引擎的船。”她向往地叹了口气。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head. “It was naive of us to not send a full military detachment with the colony. They could have warded it from a raid, and the engineering cohorts could’ve helped dig in and set up the infrastructure.” She shows a small smile. “I didn’t think they expected us to get there as soon as we did. Our ships might not be nearly as fast as everyone else’s, but like the people that built them, they are hardy as hell, tanks every one of them, and we got plasma cannons. They also have these things that are technically supposed to be used to cut apart asteroids, but they also work on ships if you can get close enough. I do wish we would catch up with the more established races though. Imagine a ship with our armor and weapons carrying ausar shields and terran engines.” She sighs wistfully."

rows.original: The copper-skinned alien waves her daydream away before returning to her story. “We took their hits and got in close before pounding their ships with plasma lances and lasers. We made them fall back around to the dark side of the planet. Several ships in the flotilla gave a slow chase, some curved around to head them off. The rest of us, the transports, made their way down to the planet’s surface. Our colony was still small, only about a thousand spinarrans, but enough to get things started. The raiders, several hundred, were well armed. Our force was better armed: five hundred combat trained, armed soldiers and another hundred support personnel. Just a small army, barely even a cohort’s worth.”
rows.translation: 覆着铜甲的外星人挥散幻想，继续讲述。“我们顶着他们的炮火逼近，然后用等离子长矛和激光猛轰敌舰，把他们逼退到行星背面。舰队里的几艘船缓慢追击，另一些则绕过去堵截。剩下的运输舰载着我们前往行星表面。殖民地规模仍然很小，只有大约一千名斯皮纳兰人，但也足够起步了。劫掠者有数百人，装备精良；我们的装备更好：五百名受过战斗训练、全副武装的士兵，另有一百名支援人员。只是一支小部队，甚至还凑不满一个大队。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe copper-skinned alien waves her daydream away before returning to her story. “We took their hits and got in close before pounding their ships with plasma lances and lasers. We made them fall back around to the dark side of the planet. Several ships in the flotilla gave a slow chase, some curved around to head them off. The rest of us, the transports, made their way down to the planet’s surface. Our colony was still small, only about a thousand spinarrans, but enough to get things started. The raiders, several hundred, were well armed. Our force was better armed: five hundred combat trained, armed soldiers and another hundred support personnel. Just a small army, barely even a cohort’s worth.”"

rows.original: “All colonies set up prefab structures to start. It’s easy even for us dark-dwellers to use them until we can get a proper space dug underground for a settlement. It was set up in a valley at the base of a huge mountain range - perfect terrain to build up and down inside the mountain. They had landed a craft just on the outskirts of town. Our transports buzzed the prefab town with the doors open, driders jumping out of the back doors, arachne repelling down cables. If you think Spinarrans are hardy already, then a warrior in full armor with shields is a monster. I saw a drider go leaping full speed and come down on a concrete wall. Both her pedipalps slammed into it and just plowed through the wall to crush the raider behind it.”
rows.translation: “所有殖民地起步时都会搭建预制建筑。在我们挖出适合建造正式聚落的地下空间之前，即便是我们这些地下居民，也能轻松使用它们。聚落位于巨大山脉脚下的一处山谷里——非常适合向山体内部和地下扩建。他们在城镇边缘降落了一艘飞船。我们的运输舰敞着舱门掠过预制小镇，蛛身人从后舱门跃下，蛛形人则沿绳索速降。要是你已经觉得斯皮纳兰人很强悍，那么身穿全套护甲、带着护盾的战士简直就是怪物。我亲眼看见一名蛛身人全速跃起，砸向一堵混凝土墙。她两条须肢同时撞上去，直接轰穿墙壁，把后面的劫掠者压成了肉泥。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All colonies set up prefab structures to start. It’s easy even for us dark-dwellers to use them until we can get a proper space dug underground for a settlement. It was set up in a valley at the base of a huge mountain range - perfect terrain to build up and down inside the mountain. They had landed a craft just on the outskirts of town. Our transports buzzed the prefab town with the doors open, driders jumping out of the back doors, arachne repelling down cables. If you think Spinarrans are hardy already, then a warrior in full armor with shields is a monster. I saw a drider go leaping full speed and come down on a concrete wall. Both her pedipalps slammed into it and just plowed through the wall to crush the raider behind it.”"

rows.original: “We swarmed over the town. Every non-spinarran was either subdued or killed. There was a bit of a hostage crisis though. Some of the raiders took prisoners into the tunnels we were building. I guess they were desperate, going into those pitch black tunnels. They didn’t know that the militia had taken a bunch of the colonists into the caves. They took shots from behind, then the last of the free raiders in the town were dead. We had a few wounded. One drider got unlucky. A shot got through her visor and into her eye. It was a noble death. We heard that once the raiders lost contact from the ground attack, the ships above hauled ass away from the planet. The one that got crippled in the opening salvo was boarded, most of the pirates were arrested, and anyone that fought back was put down. We weren’t yet set up to handle them, so we sent them off with an escort up the chain of command; let them handle it.”
rows.translation: “我们蜂拥着席卷城镇。所有非斯皮纳兰人不是被制服，就是被杀死。不过期间发生了一场人质危机；一些劫掠者挟持俘虏躲进我们正在开挖的隧道。跑进那些漆黑的隧道，想必他们已经绝望了。他们不知道民兵也把许多殖民者带进了洞穴。劫掠者从背后遭到射击，随后城里最后一批仍能自由行动的敌人也死了。我们有几人受伤，一名蛛身人运气不好，一发子弹穿过面罩打进眼睛。她死得很高尚。后来我们听说，轨道上的劫掠者与地面进攻部队失去联系后，立刻逃离了行星。开场齐射中被打残的那艘船遭到登舰，大多数海盗被捕，凡是反抗的都被击毙。我们当时还没有关押他们的条件，于是派护卫把他们逐级押送上去，交给上级处理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We swarmed over the town. Every non-spinarran was either subdued or killed. There was a bit of a hostage crisis though. Some of the raiders took prisoners into the tunnels we were building. I guess they were desperate, going into those pitch black tunnels. They didn’t know that the militia had taken a bunch of the colonists into the caves. They took shots from behind, then the last of the free raiders in the town were dead. We had a few wounded. One drider got unlucky. A shot got through her visor and into her eye. It was a noble death. We heard that once the raiders lost contact from the ground attack, the ships above hauled ass away from the planet. The one that got crippled in the opening salvo was boarded, most of the pirates were arrested, and anyone that fought back was put down. We weren’t yet set up to handle them, so we sent them off with an escort up the chain of command; let them handle it.”"

rows.original: “Probably got sent off to some penal colony after that,” you hazard a guess.
rows.translation: “大概被送去某个流放殖民地了吧，”你猜测道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably got sent off to some penal colony after that,” you hazard a guess."

rows.original: “Yeah, it was either that or just kill all of them. I mean, we didn’t have the food to keep them locked up on planet. I mean no food at all. All we had were the huge tanks of M-Jelly to eat and, you know, all the rock everywhere.”
rows.translation: “是啊，不然就只能把他们全杀了。我是说，我们没有食物能把他们关在行星上养着，真的一点食物都没有。我们只有装在巨大储罐里的金属冻可以吃，还有，你知道，遍地的岩石。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, it was either that or just kill all of them. I mean, we didn’t have the food to keep them locked up on planet. I mean no food at all. All we had were the huge tanks of M-Jelly to eat and, you know, all the rock everywhere.”"

rows.original: Kinathis
rows.raw: "Kinathis"

rows.original: The spinarran behind the counter looks at you with curiosity. “So how is the ‘verse treating ya? Been out to see any of the new systems and planets that just opened up?”
rows.translation: 柜台后的斯皮纳兰人好奇地看着你。“最近宇宙待你怎么样？去看过那些刚开放的新星系和行星吗？”
rows.raw: "The spinarran behind the counter looks at you with curiosity. “So how is the ‘verse treating ya? Been out to see any of the new systems and planets that just opened up?”"

rows.original: You nod your head and affirm your status as a brave, adventurous rusher. “Yeah I’ve been out there, seen a lot of cool stuff, a lot of new alien races.” Kirila leans in, resting her cheek in her palm, watching you closely and listening intently to your tales.
rows.translation: 你点头确认自己确实是一名勇敢而富有冒险精神的行星探险者。“是啊，我去过外面，见识了很多酷东西，还有许多新的外星种族。”基里拉俯身靠近，一手托腮，专注地注视着你，认真聆听你的故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your head and affirm your status as a brave, adventurous rusher. “Yeah I’ve been out there, seen a lot of cool stuff, a lot of new alien races.” Kirila leans in, resting her cheek in her palm, watching you closely and listening intently to your tales."

rows.original: “On one planet I encountered the zil, this whole primitive race of aliens that are a lot like Terran bees. They even buzz and make all this sweet tasting honey. There was also the vanae, this all female-looking hunter race with all these wiggling tentacles around their waists.” You wiggle your fingers emphasis, and the spinarran smiles.
rows.translation: “我在一颗行星上遇见了泽尔，那是一整个类似泰兰蜜蜂的原始外星种族。他们甚至会嗡嗡叫，还能制造味道甜美的蜂蜜。那里还有瓦奈，一种外表全是女性的猎手种族，腰间生着许多扭动的触手。”你晃动手指加强说明，斯皮纳兰人笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“On one planet I encountered the zil, this whole primitive race of aliens that are a lot like Terran bees. They even buzz and make all this sweet tasting honey. There was also the vanae, this all female-looking hunter race with all these wiggling tentacles around their waists.” You wiggle your fingers emphasis, and the spinarran smiles."

rows.original: “My my, sounds exciting, it’s a shame they are so primitive though. It will be so long before they are ready to join everyone else, I may never get too see them. Oh, maybe I can try and get a ship to take me there someday, like a vacation. I would love to see those zil. Oh! I bet those vanae give great hugs.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，听起来真刺激。可惜他们那么原始，要等很久才能准备好加入其他种族，我也许一辈子都没机会见到他们。噢，也许哪天能找艘船载我过去度假。我很想见见那些泽尔。噢！我敢说那些瓦奈一定特别会拥抱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My my, sounds exciting, it’s a shame they are so primitive though. It will be so long before they are ready to join everyone else, I may never get too see them. Oh, maybe I can try and get a ship to take me there someday, like a vacation. I would love to see those zil. Oh! I bet those vanae give great hugs.”"

rows.original: You grin. Mhen’ga isn’t the best vacation spot, but maybe in a few years something would be possible. Then again, not many things could possibly bring down one of these spinarrans.
rows.translation: 你咧嘴一笑。门加并非最佳度假胜地，不过再过几年也许就有可能。话说回来，能放倒斯皮纳兰人的东西恐怕也不多。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grin. Mhen’ga isn’t the best vacation spot, but maybe in a few years something would be possible. Then again, not many things could possibly bring down one of these spinarrans."

rows.original: “There was this one place, Tarkus. It was a planet covered in junk, like, fields of broken tech and rusted out ships. There was even this old old Terran colony ship - one of those slow boats that were launched before the Ausar hooked the galaxy up with their warp gate technology. There were a bunch of races in that planet, though I don’t think your people would like it too much,” you say as you look over Kirila’s metal exoskeletons.
rows.translation: “还有一个地方叫塔克斯，整颗行星都被垃圾覆盖，到处是损坏的科技设备和锈蚀飞船。那里甚至还有一艘古老的泰兰殖民船——就是奥萨用跃迁门技术连接银河以前发射的那种慢船。那颗行星上生活着许多种族，不过我觉得你们的人不会太喜欢那里，”你说着，目光扫过基里拉的金属外骨骼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“There was this one place, Tarkus. It was a planet covered in junk, like, fields of broken tech and rusted out ships. There was even this old old Terran colony ship - one of those slow boats that were launched before the Ausar hooked the galaxy up with their warp gate technology. There were a bunch of races in that planet, though I don’t think your people would like it too much,” you say as you look over Kirila’s metal exoskeletons."

rows.original: “Oh? Why’s that?” the copper clad spinarran asks, giving you a curious look.
rows.translation: “哦？为什么？”覆着铜甲的斯皮纳兰人好奇地看着你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh? Why’s that?” the copper clad spinarran asks, giving you a curious look."

rows.original: “Well, one of the races there, the sydians. They are... well, they’re a lot like you actually: buggy, exoskeleton covering their whole body. They even have a metallic diet like your people,” you explain to her, just about to get to the part she won’t like. “This is going to be a bit umm... horrific, I suppose is the word. You guys are lithophages, you eat rock and minerals, the sidians however are ferrovores, they corrode and eat refined metal. You spinarrans are kind of made of it; probably a place you wouldn’t like to go to.”
rows.translation: “嗯，那里有一个种族叫西迪安。他们...其实和你很像：有虫类特征，外骨骼覆盖全身，甚至也像你们一样以金属为食，”你向她解释，准备说出她不会喜欢的部分。“接下来的内容有点，呃...恐怖，我想这个词最合适。你们是食岩生物，以岩石和矿物为食；但西迪安是食铁生物，会腐蚀并吞食精炼金属。你们斯皮纳兰人的身体恰好由金属构成；那里大概不是你会喜欢的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, one of the races there, the sydians. They are... well, they’re a lot like you actually: buggy, exoskeleton covering their whole body. They even have a metallic diet like your people,” you explain to her, just about to get to the part she won’t like. “This is going to be a bit umm... horrific, I suppose is the word. You guys are lithophages, you eat rock and minerals, the sidians however are ferrovores, they corrode and eat refined metal. You spinarrans are kind of made of it; probably a place you wouldn’t like to go to.”"

rows.original: Kirila grimaces and shudders at what you say, obviously disturbed by this information. “Oh... Well, I can see why I would not like that place. I can’t even... Eat us alive...” She shudders again.
rows.translation: 基里拉听后皱起脸，打了个寒颤，显然被这个消息吓到了。“噢...好吧，我明白自己为什么不会喜欢那里了。我根本无法...活生生吃掉我们...”她再次发抖。
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila grimaces and shudders at what you say, obviously disturbed by this information. “Oh... Well, I can see why I would not like that place. I can’t even... Eat us alive...” She shudders again."

rows.original: “But not everything there is like that, the raskvel that live there are pretty cute little guys, real short and excitable. They love to fix things; I’m pretty sure they get off on fixing machines. There are also all these silvery nano-goos around. They are very amorous but not actually threatening.”
rows.translation: “不过那里并非所有东西都这样。居住在那里的拉斯克维尔是群很可爱的小家伙，个子特别矮，又容易兴奋。他们热爱修理东西；我很确定修好机器会让他们兴奋。那里还有许多银色纳米黏液，她们非常多情，实际上却没有威胁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But not everything there is like that, the raskvel that live there are pretty cute little guys, real short and excitable. They love to fix things; I’m pretty sure they get off on fixing machines. There are also all these silvery nano-goos around. They are very amorous but not actually threatening.”"

rows.original: Still reeling from the talk of sydians she nods. “Well, it’s good to know not everything there is horrific. Those sydians are going to have some problems with spinarrans if they get out - probably wouldn’t be allowed on any spinarran settlement or world.”
rows.translation: 她仍未从西迪安的话题中缓过来，只是点点头。“好吧，至少知道那里不是所有东西都那么恐怖。要是那些西迪安离开那里，肯定会和斯皮纳兰人产生麻烦——大概任何斯皮纳兰聚落或世界都不会允许他们进入。”
rows.raw: "\n\nStill reeling from the talk of sydians she nods. “Well, it’s good to know not everything there is horrific. Those sydians are going to have some problems with spinarrans if they get out - probably wouldn’t be allowed on any spinarran settlement or world.”"

rows.original: You can kind of understand that. You wouldn’t want an alien that would eat your skin around you either.
rows.translation: 你多少能理解。你也不会希望身边有个能吃掉自己皮肤的外星人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can kind of understand that. You wouldn’t want an alien that would eat your skin around you either."

rows.original: Kirila looks particularly perky, as if she got some good news.
rows.translation: 基里拉显得格外精神，仿佛收到了什么好消息。
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila looks particularly perky, as if she got some good news."

rows.original: You lean on the counter and ask what’s up. Why does she looks so pleased?
rows.translation: 你靠在柜台上，问她发生了什么。她为什么看起来这么高兴？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean on the counter and ask what’s up. Why does she looks so pleased?"

rows.original: She claps her chitinous hands together and beams a pearly grin at you. “I was browsing the news on the Planet Rush and there was a report on a place called Myrellion. A new planet in the Rush that’s full of insect-like aliens, and I heard a bunch of them like to live underground too. It would be nice to get some fellow dark-dwellers to talk to, relate ya know.” She quivers in seeming anticipation. “Oh, I hope things go well with them. I want to have these myr and nyrea around.”
rows.translation: 她拍了拍几丁质双手，朝你露出一口珍珠般的灿烂笑容。“我浏览行星大开发的新闻时，看到了一篇关于一个叫米瑞利昂的地方的报道。那是大开发中新发现的一颗行星，遍布昆虫般的外星人，而且我听说其中许多人也喜欢住在地下。要是能找些同样住在黑暗里的伙伴聊聊天、互相交流，应该会很不错，你懂吧。”她似乎因期待而微微颤抖。“噢，我希望他们一切顺利。我真想让这些米尔人和尼瑞娅人留在身边。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe claps her chitinous hands together and beams a pearly grin at you. “I was browsing the news on the Planet Rush and there was a report on a place called Myrellion. A new planet in the Rush that’s full of insect-like aliens, and I heard a bunch of them like to live underground too. It would be nice to get some fellow dark-dwellers to talk to, relate ya know.” She quivers in seeming anticipation. “Oh, I hope things go well with them. I want to have these myr and nyrea around.”"

rows.original: Kirila looks sad, her copper plated face is set in a perpetual pout of disappointment. Her arms are crossed and she sighs before looking up at you. “Oh hello there, what can I do for you today?”
rows.translation: 琪莉拉看起来很难过，覆着铜色甲壳的脸上始终挂着失望的噘嘴神情。她双臂交叉，叹了口气后才抬头看向你。“噢，你好啊，今天需要我为你做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila looks sad, her copper plated face is set in a perpetual pout of disappointment. Her arms are crossed and she sighs before looking up at you. “Oh hello there, what can I do for you today?”"

rows.original: You give her a look. “What’s up with you, you look awfully unhappy.”
rows.translation: 你看了她一眼。“你怎么了？看起来很不开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a look. “What’s up with you, you look awfully unhappy.”"

rows.original: She sighs again. “I was checking the news and there was a report on a planet in the Rush, Myrellion.”
rows.translation: 她又叹了口气。“我刚才在看新闻，里面有一篇关于大开发中一颗行星的报道，米瑞利昂。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs again. “I was checking the news and there was a report on a planet in the Rush, Myrellion.”"

rows.original: You can see where this is going.
rows.translation: 你已经猜到她接下来要说什么了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see where this is going."

rows.original: “A new planet in the Rush that’s... was full of insectoid aliens, ones that liked to live underground too. Apparently they have been pretty warlike and resorted to nuclear weapons, the UGC blew them all back into the Stone Age with orbital weapons.” She gets a sour face again and clenches a hand on the counter, her claws peeling thin ribbons of metal off the top. “It would have been so nice to get some other aliens that like the darkness and living underground. But I mean, was blowing them up the thing to do? I bet the empress is real mad. She would have pushed for occupation by spinarran legions, let us get down there and choke hold em. We would have been perfect for it. Literally bred by nature to fight underground. Maybe if a race more like them was talking them down, maybe they would have listened. It’s all just such a waste. Maybe my people can get the green light on some aid for them. Help them get back on their feet.”
rows.translation: “大开发中新发现的一颗行星，那里...曾经遍布昆虫般的外星人，他们也喜欢住在地下。听说他们相当好战，甚至动用了核武器，结果联合银河邦联用轨道武器把他们全都轰回了石器时代。”她的脸色再次变得难看，一只手紧紧抓住柜台，利爪从台面上刨下一条条薄薄的金属卷。“要是能遇到其他同样喜欢黑暗和地下生活的外星人，该有多好。可我是说，把他们炸成那样真的是正确做法吗？女皇肯定气坏了。她大概会主张让斯皮纳兰军团占领那里，让我们下去牢牢控制住他们。我们简直再适合不过了，天生就是为了地下作战而生。也许要是由一个更像他们的种族去劝说，他们可能会听进去。这一切实在太浪费了。也许我的族人能获准向他们提供援助，帮他们重新站起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A new planet in the Rush that’s... was full of insectoid aliens, ones that liked to live underground too. Apparently they have been pretty warlike and resorted to nuclear weapons, the UGC blew them all back into the Stone Age with orbital weapons.” She gets a sour face again and clenches a hand on the counter, her claws peeling thin ribbons of metal off the top. “It would have been so nice to get some other aliens that like the darkness and living underground. But I mean, was blowing them up the thing to do? I bet the empress is real mad. She would have pushed for occupation by spinarran legions, let us get down there and choke hold em. We would have been perfect for it. Literally bred by nature to fight underground. Maybe if a race more like them was talking them down, maybe they would have listened. It’s all just such a waste. Maybe my people can get the green light on some aid for them. Help them get back on their feet.”"

rows.original: She looks at her counter and hisses in displeasure. “Aww damnit, I fucked up my countertop.”
rows.translation: 她看向自己的柜台，不悦地嘶了一声。“啊，该死，我把柜台弄坏了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks at her counter and hisses in displeasure. “Aww damnit, I fucked up my countertop.”"

rows.original: The copper spinarran sighs and puts her chin in her hand. “No offence, but there is an overwhelming number of aliens that like the surface and a scant few that like to live in the underground.”
rows.translation: 这名铜色斯皮纳兰人叹了口气，用手托住下巴。“无意冒犯，但喜欢地表生活的外星人多得惊人，喜欢住在地下的却寥寥无几。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe copper spinarran sighs and puts her chin in her hand. “No offence, but there is an overwhelming number of aliens that like the surface and a scant few that like to live in the underground.”"

rows.original: You think about it for a moment, and you have to agree. It must be a bit lonely for spinarrans, being so adapted to an environment that would be uncomfortable to most others. Your eyes flick to the goggles she wears over their eyes. It would be hard to have to wear protective equipment everywhere you go just to keep yourself from going blind. “Well here’s hoping that something can be made of this.”
rows.translation: 你想了一会儿，不得不同意。对于斯皮纳兰人来说，适应了一个让大多数其他种族都感到不适的环境，想必会有些孤独。你的目光掠过她戴在六只眼睛外的护目镜。无论去哪里都必须佩戴防护装备，才能避免自己失明，肯定很难受。“那么，希望这件事最后能有个好结果吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think about it for a moment, and you have to agree. It must be a bit lonely for spinarrans, being so adapted to an environment that would be uncomfortable to most others. Your eyes flick to the goggles she wears over their eyes. It would be hard to have to wear protective equipment everywhere you go just to keep yourself from going blind. “Well here’s hoping that something can be made of this.”"

rows.original: Kirila smiles. “Thank you, I hope so too.”
rows.translation: 琪莉拉微笑起来。“谢谢你，我也希望如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKirila smiles. “Thank you, I hope so too.”"

rows.original: “Steel please,” you say as you look at the racks of various weapons and armor on display. “Alrighty, one minute!” she says before ducking down under the counter. Out of curiosity, you lean over, look down and catch sight of a pair of round, mirror-polished asscheeks as the shopkeep changes clothes. You cover your mouth at her sudden desire to strip; does she do this every time? Not that you’re complaining. The alien woman has a very nice body, looking fit with wide hips and a round butt. You really get to appreciate how polished her exoskeleton is. Every plate is like a copper mirror. After a moment, the copper spinarran appears again, this time wearing a coat made of synth-leather, ballistic padding, and tightly woven silvery mesh. She takes a moment to smooth out her new outfit before grinning and showing off rows of sharp pearlescent teeth. “Please, take a look around and let me know if you want to see something in particular. Much of it is registered military surplus.”
rows.translation: “请给我看看钢铁货品。”你望着陈列架上各式各样的武器和护甲说道。 “好嘞，稍等一下！”她说完便钻到柜台下面。出于好奇，你俯身向下看去，正好瞧见店主换衣服时那对圆润、打磨得如镜面般光亮的臀瓣。她突然脱起衣服，让你不由得捂住嘴；她每次都这么做吗？不过你也没什么可抱怨的。这名外星女子身材非常不错，体态健美、胯部宽阔，臀部也很圆润。你更得以欣赏她的外骨骼被抛光得有多么漂亮，每一块甲片都像一面铜镜。 片刻之后，铜色斯皮纳兰人再次现身，这次穿上了一件由合成皮革、防弹衬垫和紧密编织的银色网甲制成的外套。她花了点时间抚平新装，随后咧嘴露出一排排锋利的珍珠色牙齿。“请随意看看，要是特别想看什么就告诉我。这里许多东西都是登记在册的军用剩余物资。”
rows.raw: "“Steel please,” you say as you look at the racks of various weapons and armor on display. “Alrighty, one minute!” she says before ducking down under the counter. Out of curiosity, you lean over, look down and catch sight of a pair of round, mirror-polished asscheeks as the shopkeep changes clothes. You cover your mouth at her sudden desire to strip; does she do this every time? Not that you’re complaining. The alien woman has a very nice body, looking fit with wide hips and a round butt. You really get to appreciate how polished her exoskeleton is. Every plate is like a copper mirror. After a moment, the copper spinarran appears again, this time wearing a coat made of synth-leather, ballistic padding, and tightly woven silvery mesh. She takes a moment to smooth out her new outfit before grinning and showing off rows of sharp pearlescent teeth. “Please, take a look around and let me know if you want to see something in particular. Much of it is registered military surplus.” "

rows.original: You gesture to the armor on display and ask about it. The spinarran behind the counter nods her head and fingers her outfit again. “Ahh, alright. I hope you like what we have. All of it is of the highest quality I assure you. My clutchmate makes all the armor herself from her own weave. I guarantee that it will offer very good protection, though it won’t help against the cold outside.”
rows.translation: 你指了指陈列的护甲，向她询问。柜台后的斯皮纳兰人点点头，又用手指摩挲起自己的衣服。 “啊，好吧。希望你会喜欢我们的货品。我向你保证，它们全都是最高品质。我的同巢姐妹亲手用她自己的织丝制作了所有护甲。我保证它们能提供非常不错的防护，不过对外面的严寒可没什么帮助。”
rows.raw: "You gesture to the armor on display and ask about it. The spinarran behind the counter nods her head and fingers her outfit again. “Ahh, alright. I hope you like what we have. All of it is of the highest quality I assure you. My clutchmate makes all the armor herself from her own weave. I guarantee that it will offer very good protection, though it won’t help against the cold outside.” "

rows.original: “Silk please,” you say as you look at the racks of clothing on display. “Alrighty, one minute!” she says before ducking down under the counter. Out of curiosity, you lean over, look down, and catch sight of a pair of round, mirror-polished asscheeks as the shopkeep changes clothes. You cover your mouth at her sudden desire to strip. Does she do this every time? Not that you’re complaining, the alien woman has a very nice body, fit with wide hips and round butt. You really get to see how polished her exoskeleton is, every plate is like a copper mirror. After a moment the copper spinarran appears again, this time wearing a frilly gothic dress. The girly outfit is covered in lace, frills, and looks to be made of silk or satin. She takes a moment to smooth out her new outfit before grinning and showing off rows of sharp pearlescent teeth. “Please, take a look around and let me know if you want to see something in particular.”

rows.original: You look through the racks of protective clothing and pull out one of the thick shirts that’s a little long in both the sleeves and overall length than your basic shirt, but the material is clearly what makes this thick garment special. The armor comes in a few different styles, and you pull one out before bringing it over to the counter to ask about it.
rows.translation: 你翻看着一排排防护服，从中抽出一件厚实的衬衫。它的袖子和整体长度都比普通衬衫稍长一些，但显然是材质让这件厚重衣物显得与众不同。这种护甲有好几种不同款式，你取出一件，拿到柜台前询问。
rows.raw: "You look through the racks of protective clothing and pull out one of the thick shirts that’s a little long in both the sleeves and overall length than your basic shirt, but the material is clearly what makes this thick garment special. The armor comes in a few different styles, and you pull one out before bringing it over to the counter to ask about it."

rows.original: “Ahh, alright. This is our basic weavemail shirt: decent protection, light enough to wear under your clothes if you want to be discrete. Spinarran weavemail resists solid projectiles very well and distributes heat quite efficiently. While normal ballistic jackets or armor are good against bullets but not so good against being stabbed, weavemail will stop most blades as well. We make it in a few different styles here depending on how obvious you want to be about the armor.”
rows.translation: “啊，好吧。这是我们的基础织甲衬衫：防护性能不错，而且足够轻便，想低调些的话还可以穿在衣服里面。斯皮纳兰织甲非常擅长抵御实体弹丸，也能相当有效地分散热量。普通防弹夹克或护甲虽然能挡子弹，却不太能防刺，而织甲同样能挡住大多数刀刃。我们这里有几种不同款式，取决于你想让这件护甲显眼到什么程度。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ahh, alright. This is our basic weavemail shirt: decent protection, light enough to wear under your clothes if you want to be discrete. Spinarran weavemail resists solid projectiles very well and distributes heat quite efficiently. While normal ballistic jackets or armor are good against bullets but not so good against being stabbed, weavemail will stop most blades as well. We make it in a few different styles here depending on how obvious you want to be about the armor.”"

rows.original: You look through the racks of protective clothing and pull out one of the long duster-like trench coats. Covered in supple synth-leather on the outside, you flip up the coat’s mantle to find a fine woven mesh of metal mail. You can feel the many layers of ballistic fiber and spinarran mail under the leather of the coat. The outfit is long, reaching down a little ways past your knees, it would provide a wide area of protection from your body. The armor comes in a few different styles, some showing off the protective spinarran mail more than the others, and you pull one out before bringing it over to the counter to ask about it.
rows.translation: 你翻看着一排排防护服，从中抽出一件形似长风衣的长外套。外层覆着柔软的合成皮革，你掀起外套肩披，看到一层精细编织的金属网甲。你能感觉到皮革下面层层叠叠的防弹纤维和斯皮纳兰网甲。这套衣服很长，一直垂到膝盖下方不远，足以为身体的大部分区域提供保护。这种护甲有好几种不同款式，有些比其他款式更明显地露出防护用斯皮纳兰网甲；你取出一件，拿到柜台前询问。

The outfit is long, reaching down a little ways past your knees, it would provide a wide area of protection from your body. The armor comes in a few different styles, some showing off the protective spinarran mail more than the others, and you pull one out before bringing it over to the counter to ask about it."

rows.original: The Spinarran smiles at the sight of the armor, her jagged pearlescent teeth showing. “Oooo... a good choice, one of my favorites.” She plucks a fingertip against her own outfit. “Weavemail coats like these are as close to military grade protection as you can get. Made by a close personal friend of mine. It’ll stop bullets just as well as blades, heat based weapons such as lasers and plasma will be damped by the many layers and by the heat-spreading properties of the weave. We make it in a few different styles here depending on how obvious you want to be about the armor. And for an additional charge, we can install secondary shield emitters for extra protection.”
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰人看到这件护甲便笑了起来，露出锯齿般的珍珠色牙齿。“噢噢...选得不错，这是我最喜欢的款式之一。”她用指尖弹了弹自己身上的衣服。“这种织甲外套几乎就是你能买到的最接近军用级的防护装备，由我的一位亲密好友制作。它挡刀刃和挡子弹一样有效；激光和等离子之类的热能武器也会被层层材料以及织物分散热量的特性削弱。我们这里有几种不同款式，取决于你想让这件护甲显眼到什么程度。另外，只要加收费用，我们还可以安装辅助护盾发射器，提供额外保护。”

While they don’t show off a lot of skin, they are elegantly styled with satin, lace, and shiny mail. They will provide near military grade protection for you as well. It’s a bit more bulky than normal dresses, but if you’re looking to look good and be able to stop gunfire, you can’t really beat it.”
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰人看到这件护甲便微笑着拍起手来，露出锯齿般的珍珠色牙齿。“噢噢...选得不错。我姐妹特别喜欢制作这种衣服。虽然它们不会露出太多肌肤，却以缎子、蕾丝和闪亮网甲打造出优雅风格，同时还能为你提供近乎军用级的防护。它比普通连衣裙稍显厚重，但如果既想穿得漂亮又想挡住枪火，那基本没有比它更好的选择了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe spinarran smiles and claps her hands at the sight of the armor, her jagged pearlescent teeth showing. “Oooo... A good choice. My sister absolutely loves making these. While they don’t show off a lot of skin, they are elegantly styled with satin, lace, and shiny mail. They will provide near military grade protection for you as well. It’s a bit more bulky than normal dresses, but if you’re looking to look good and be able to stop gunfire, you can’t really beat it.”"

rows.original: You look over several of the silky garments, your eyes falling onto a long dress. It’s simple but elegant, the kind of dress you’d see on wealthy debutantes at a formal party. That said, it looks like it wouldn’t restrict your movement that much, so wearing it casually wouldn’t be problematic.
rows.translation: 你的目光掠过几件丝质服装，最后落在一条长裙上。它简洁而优雅，像是富家初次参加社交活动的少女会在正式宴会上穿的款式。不过，它看起来不会过分限制行动，所以平时穿着应该也没问题。
rows.raw: "You look over several of the silky garments, your eyes falling onto a long dress. It’s simple but elegant, the kind of dress you’d see on wealthy debutantes at a formal party. That said, it looks like it wouldn’t restrict your movement that much, so wearing it casually wouldn’t be problematic."

rows.original: “Ah, good eye,” the shopkeeper says. “That dress is made from various alien silks. Well, alien to us.” She gives a small laugh. “I suppose to you it’s more conventional. I assume you’ve heard of chameleon silk? Our dresses weave that and traditional silks to create these beauties. Waterproof with completely customizable colors. It’s the whole package.”
rows.translation: “啊，好眼光。”店主说道。“那条裙子由各种外星丝绸制成。嗯，对我们而言是外星的。”她轻笑一声。“对你来说大概更加常见。我猜你听说过变色龙丝吧？我们的连衣裙把那种丝和传统丝绸织在一起，才制成这些精品。既防水，颜色又完全可以自定义，样样俱全。”

I assume you’ve heard of chameleon silk? Our dresses weave that and traditional silks to create these beauties. Waterproof with completely customizable colors. It’s the whole package.”"

rows.original: Hanging on many of the racks along the walls are several classic suits popular among the rich and powerful of Earth. Each suit is crisp and clean, and consists of a jacket, button-up shirt, tie, and trousers. Despite fashion changing every other week or so, the classic suit never goes out of style it seems.
rows.translation: 墙边许多衣架上挂着数套地球富豪权贵钟爱的经典西装。每套西装都干净笔挺，包括外套、纽扣衬衫、领带和长裤。尽管潮流似乎每隔一周就会改变一次，经典西装却永远不会过时。
rows.raw: "Hanging on many of the racks along the walls are several classic suits popular among the rich and powerful of Earth. Each suit is crisp and clean, and consists of a jacket, button-up shirt, tie, and trousers. Despite fashion changing every other week or so, the classic suit never goes out of style it seems."

rows.original: The shopkeeper’s eyes fall on you and she smiles, “Oh yes, those are popular among the businessmen. Earth seems to have a way of creating timeless fashion. The tailor assures us that they are completely waterproof, stain proof, and will adjust to fit any wearer. Something about each being a ‘bespoke’ suit.”
rows.translation: 店主的目光落到你身上，微笑道：“噢，是的，那些很受商人欢迎。地球似乎很擅长创造永不过时的时装。裁缝向我们保证，它们完全防水、防污，而且会自动调整到适合任何穿戴者的尺寸。好像是因为每一套都是所谓的‘定制’西装。”

The tailor assures us that they are completely waterproof, stain proof, and will adjust to fit any wearer. Something about each being a ‘bespoke’ suit.”"

rows.original: Hanging from a rack in a tucked away corner of the store are several black and white maid outfits. Frills and lace adorn the various hems, and it feels silky smooth to the touch. The frilled dress would barely drop past the top of the thigh on its wearer. You’re certain it wouldn’t hide a thing if its owner bent over. Maybe that’s the point. Combined with the thigh-high stockings, the entire thing just oozes feminine sensuality.
rows.translation: 商店一个隐蔽角落的衣架上挂着几套黑白女仆装。各处衣摆都饰有褶边和蕾丝，摸起来丝滑柔顺。这条褶边短裙穿在身上时，恐怕只能勉强盖过大腿根部。你敢肯定，只要主人弯下腰，它什么也遮不住。也许这正是设计目的。再搭配过膝长袜，整套服装都散发着女性的性感魅力。
rows.raw: "Hanging from a rack in a tucked away corner of the store are several black and white maid outfits. Frills and lace adorn the various hems, and it feels silky smooth to the touch. The frilled dress would barely drop past the top of the thigh on its wearer. You’re certain it wouldn’t hide a thing if its owner bent over. Maybe that’s the point. Combined with the thigh-high stockings, the entire thing just oozes feminine sensuality."

rows.original: “Oh.” The shopkeeper sees your interest and drops her head slightly. If she could blush, you think she’d be a bright crimson. “I thought I’d only ordered one for... personal reasons. Turns out we got a full shipment. So if you’d like to take one off our hands and save me the embarrassment, I would greatly appreciate it.”
rows.translation: “噢。”店主注意到你的兴趣，微微低下头。要是她能脸红，你觉得她现在一定已经红得发亮。“我本来以为自己只订了一套，用于...私人用途。结果送来了一整批。所以，如果你愿意替我们带走一套，让我少丢点脸，我会非常感激。”

rows.original: Sandwiched between the fluffy parkas and the more traditional clothing is an odd bodysuit. You hold it up, noting how relatively thin it is. It looks like it would cling to your body fairly tightly. You poke at the material. Seems like it’s fairly stretchy, so it wouldn’t restrict your movements very much. In fact, it’d probably feel more like a second skin to you than anything. Several vital areas, including the spinal area and knees have extra padding. It’s not quite armor, but tougher plated sections that are still fairly flexible in their own right.
rows.translation: 蓬松派克大衣与传统服装之间夹着一件奇特的紧身衣。你把它举起来，发现它相当轻薄，看起来会非常贴合身体。你戳了戳这种材料，似乎颇有弹性，不会过多限制动作。事实上，它穿起来大概更像第二层皮肤。脊柱和膝盖等几个要害部位都有额外衬垫。它还算不上护甲，不过这些较为坚韧的板状区域本身依旧相当柔韧。
rows.raw: "Sandwiched between the fluffy parkas and the more traditional clothing is an odd bodysuit. You hold it up, noting how relatively thin it is. It looks like it would cling to your body fairly tightly. You poke at the material. Seems like it’s fairly stretchy, so it wouldn’t restrict your movements very much. In fact, it’d probably feel more like a second skin to you than anything. Several vital areas, including the spinal area and knees have extra padding. It’s not quite armor, but tougher plated sections that are still fairly flexible in their own right."

rows.original: “Ah yeah, the thermal bodysuit,” says the spinarran shopkeeper. “It’s quite comfortable, or so I’m told. Reinforced with an insulating layer of aerogel, you won’t find a better way to beat the frozen wastes. In fact, it’ll even protect you from extreme heat. The outer material is fire retardant, and the aerogel ensures that you’ll remain unaffected by the heat.” she laughs jokingly. “Oh, I do have to tell you that despite the insulating power of the bodysuit, you should still get a heat belt system, just to make sure you will be all right. Although, you might be alright as well if you combine the bodysuit with the winter gear we have in stock.”
rows.translation: “啊，对，保温紧身衣。”斯皮纳兰店主说道。“听说它穿起来很舒服。里面有一层隔热气凝胶加固，你找不到比它更适合抵御冰封荒野的东西了。事实上，它甚至还能保护你免受极端高温伤害。外层材料阻燃，而气凝胶能确保热量不会影响到你。”她开玩笑般笑了笑。“噢，我还得告诉你，尽管这件紧身衣隔热能力很强，你仍然应该配上一套热能腰带系统，以确保万无一失。不过，要是把紧身衣和我们库存里的冬季装备搭配使用，可能也不会有问题。”

The outer material is fire retardant, and the aerogel ensures that you’ll remain unaffected by the heat.” she laughs jokingly. “Oh, I do have to tell you that despite the insulating power of the bodysuit, you should still get a heat belt system, just to make sure you will be all right. Although, you might be alright as well if you combine the bodysuit with the winter gear we have in stock.”"

rows.original: Your eyes wander over to several displays of wintery gear. The store seems to have a majority of its space dedicated to these outfits, and it’s no surprise why. Cold weather can be the death of most species. The outfit consists of a large parka jacket with hood, full length trousers, and large boots. Surprisingly, the inner lining of each consists of a fine, ultra-soft downy fur. It almost feels as though your hand is gliding over a cloud as you stroke the insides of the jacket. A warm, fuzzy cloud.
rows.translation: 你的目光转向几处冬季装备陈列区。店内大部分空间似乎都留给了这类服装，原因并不难理解：寒冷天气对大多数种族而言都可能致命。整套服装包括一件带兜帽的大型派克大衣、一条全长长裤和一双大靴子。令人惊讶的是，每件衣物内衬都铺着精细而异常柔软的绒毛。你抚摸大衣内侧时，手掌仿佛正从云朵上滑过，一朵温暖而毛茸茸的云。

Cold weather can be the death of most species. The outfit consists of a large parka jacket with hood, full length trousers, and large boots. Surprisingly, the inner lining of each consists of a fine, ultra-soft downy fur. It almost feels as though your hand is gliding over a cloud as you stroke the insides of the jacket. A warm, fuzzy cloud."

rows.original: “Yes, yes,” says the shopkeeper. “Our standard winter gear. Can’t get by without it on Uveto. The jacket, pants, and boots are each fitted with insulating fibers, synthetic fur, and heating pads that react to your core body temperature. They’ll help you survive a jaunt into the frigid wastes, though I’m required by law to say that it’s no substitute for a complete survival package if you intend to remain outside for extended periods.”
rows.translation: “对，对。”店主说道。“我们的标准冬季装备。在乌维托没有它可过不下去。夹克、长裤和靴子都装有隔热纤维、合成毛皮，以及会根据核心体温作出反应的加热垫。它们能帮助你在严寒荒野中短途活动，不过法律要求我说明：如果打算长时间待在户外，它不能代替完整的生存套装。”

rows.original: You point at one the small arms under the front display counter: a straight, sleek looking gun almost as long as a human’s forearm with a long rectangular barrel on a rotating joint. On either side of the barrel are three targeting lasers. “That is a respectable weapon right there. The V36 thermal scalpel is the sidearm of every spinarran soldier. It’s durable, reliable, and easy to reload. Its plasma blade can slice clean through an arm or leg as easy as it can shear through rock. A body shot can cook your insides, and it’s tough enough that you can club someone over the head or punch someone in the face with it. Everyone loves these, and they double as small mining tools as well, slicing rocks into pieces.”
rows.translation: 你指向前方展示柜下的一件小型武器：一把笔直流畅、长度几乎相当于人类前臂的枪械，长方形枪管安装在旋转接头上，枪管两侧各有三道瞄准激光。“这可是一件值得信赖的武器。V36热能手术刀是每名斯皮纳兰士兵的随身武器，坚固、可靠，而且容易装填。它的等离子刃切断手臂或腿，就像切开岩石一样轻松。击中躯干能把内脏烤熟，而且它足够结实，既能抡起来砸人脑袋，也能用来揍人脸。人人都喜欢它，它还能兼作小型采矿工具，把岩石切成碎块。”

rows.original: Looking at the heavier weapons on the walls, you point to one of several heavy, two handed weapons. A big, mean looking thing, it’s clearly made to be used with two hands. You bet it packs one hell of a punch. “Mmmm... a beauty.” The girl behind the counter sighs as she pulls one down from the case with ease and lays the heavy weapon down on the counter for you. “This is a SS-M XIII plasma bore. It is a beautiful piece of spinarran weaponry. The plasma bore is the workhorse of spinarran weapons tech, packs a hell of a punch at short and medium ranges, melts rock and metal, vaporizes flesh and bone. Tough, reliable, not too heavy, well for spinarrans or leithans anyway. Might be a bit heavy for a human or an ausar. The power pack for it is good for about 80 shots, not as many as a modern laser rifle, but like I said, hell of a punch, just, you know, keep your hands away from the emitters.”
rows.translation: 你看向墙上的重型武器，指着其中一件沉重的双手武器。那东西外形凶悍，显然必须双手使用，你敢说它的威力肯定惊人。“嗯...真是个美人。”柜台后的姑娘叹息着，轻松地把武器从柜中取下，将沉重的枪械放在你面前。“这是SS-M XIII型等离子钻膛枪，是一件精美的斯皮纳兰武器。等离子钻膛枪是斯皮纳兰武器技术的主力，近距离和中距离威力惊人，能熔化岩石与金属、汽化血肉与骨骼。它坚固可靠，也不算太重，嗯，至少对斯皮纳兰人或莱坦人来说如此。对人类或奥萨人可能有点重。它的能量包大约能射击八十次，虽不如现代激光步枪那么多，但就像我说的，威力非常惊人。只是，你知道的，手别靠近发射器。”

rows.original: Looking at the heavier weapons on the walls, you point to one of several heavy, two handed weapons. A big, mean looking thing, with two handles curved plates, what looks like a rotatory barrel. “Mmmm... a beauty.” The girl behind the counter sighs as she pulls one down from the case with ease and lays the heavy weapon down on the counter for you. “This is a plasma bore sunfire variant. It is a beautiful piece of spinarran weaponry. While each shot doesn’t hit as hard as the standard version, the rotating barrel and expanded fuelcell means one of the shots is bound to land. What’s more all that heat might set your foes ablaze! Tough, reliable, not too heavy, well for spinarrans or leithans anyway. Might be a bit heavy for a human or an ausar.”

rows.original: Among the heavy spinarran plasma weapons is a rifle of matte black and silver metal plates and highlights. You point out the sleek, glossy weapon and ask to see it. Kirila nods and brings it down for you. “Like the plasma bore, this is another mainstay of spinarran weapons tech - one of the first weapons made once we hooked up the UGC. As a change from our plasma weapons, this is a laser rifle. It’s sleek, light, accurate, and its ultraviolet beams packs a punch civilian weapons won’t. Even comes with a high tech pop up scope for making sure those shots hit!”
rows.translation: 斯皮纳兰重型等离子武器之间摆着一把由哑光黑色与银色金属板构成、饰有银色细节的步枪。你指着这把流畅光洁的武器，提出想看看。琪莉拉点点头，把它取下来交给你。“和等离子钻膛枪一样，这也是斯皮纳兰武器技术的中流砥柱，是我们加入联合银河邦联后最早制造的武器之一。不同于我们的等离子武器，这是一把激光步枪。它造型流畅、重量轻、精度高，发射的紫外线光束比民用武器更有威力！它甚至还配有高科技弹出式瞄准镜，确保射击能够命中！”

rows.original: You look down into the front display and admire the swords set out, every one of them looks pristine, gleaming silver in their case. “Ahh, a fine eye you have there. Those are some nice sabers.” She reaches under and pulls one out before laying it down. “Now, no touching alright, these are pretty dangerous. These here are spinarran infantry sabers. My kind are used to and well adapted to close range combat, so every soldier gets a weapon for use in melee. They are made of densely compressed and highly refined alloys of titanium and tungsten with an internal skeleton of spinarran filament silk, very durable and keeps its edge well. To help with cutting, the very edge is lined with a mono filament wire that lets the blade slide through resistance. Very dangerous. And if that wasn’t enough, it has a built in vibrational core to make the blade vibrate at ultra high frequencies.”

They are made of densely compressed and highly refined alloys of titanium and tungsten with an internal skeleton of spinarran filament silk, very durable and keeps its edge well. To help with cutting, the very edge is lined with a mono filament wire that lets the blade slide through resistance. Very dangerous. And if that wasn’t enough, it has a built in vibrational core to make the blade vibrate at ultra high frequencies.”"

rows.original: Your gut cramps in a second contraction, and your pained face attracts the attention of some passers-by. After some confusion and dithering, they help you to a medical aid station and leave you in the capable hands of the staff... and luckily, their painkillers.
rows.translation: 第二次宫缩令腹部绞痛，你痛苦的表情引起了几名路人的注意。经过一阵困惑与犹豫，他们把你送到一处医疗救助站，将你交给工作人员可靠的双手……幸运的是，这里还有止痛药。

rows.original: Oh, god... the timing couldn’t be worse. You look around furtively for help, but of course there’s no one out here but you. You strip your gear and arrange it to try and keep the baby off of the ground, planning to cope as best you can....
rows.translation: 噢，天啊……时机糟得不能再糟。你偷偷环顾四周寻求帮助，可这里当然只有你自己。你脱下装备，把它们铺好，尽量不让宝宝接触地面，打算竭尽所能独自应付……
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, god... the timing couldn’t be worse. You look around furtively for help, but of course there’s no one out here but you. You strip your gear and arrange it to try and keep the baby off of the ground, planning to cope as best you can...."

rows.original: You call back your name, saying that you’re an explorer of sorts. If she wasn’t expecting you, you sure weren’t expecting to find a fortified base out here in the middle of nowhere.

rows.original: She lowers her spear after a moment, A head of blond hair whips in the wind, shaved on one side and swept over near her shoulder on the other, revealing an ear full of glistening holo-rings and a pierced nostril. She pushes a pair of blue-tinted goggles, matching blue eyes, up on her forehead. “Fair enough. This is a Stormguard outpost. We keep it safe for Iresteaders that wander too far afield, or scientists coming through to study the Rift. ‘Course, they all pay a premium to use the place. You, though...”
rows.translation: 片刻后，她放低长矛。一头金发在风中飞扬，一侧剃短，另一侧垂到肩旁，露出戴满闪亮全息环的耳朵和穿孔的鼻翼。她把蓝色护目镜推到额头上，露出与镜片同色的眼睛。“行吧。这里是风暴卫士前哨站。我们会保护那些走得太远的艾尔斯泰德人，或前来研究裂隙的科学家。当然，他们使用这里都得付一大笔钱。不过你嘛……”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers her spear after a moment, A head of blond hair whips in the wind, shaved on one side and swept over near her shoulder on the other, revealing an ear full of glistening holo-rings and a pierced nostril. She pushes a pair of blue-tinted goggles, matching blue eyes, up on her forehead. “Fair enough. This is a Stormguard outpost. We keep it safe for Iresteaders that wander too far afield, or scientists coming through to study the Rift. ‘Course, they all pay a premium to use the place. You, though...”"

rows.original: The woman taps a button on a wrist-mounted device and waves her arm in your direction. “You’re lucky you’re loaded down with nanomachines. Otherwise the turrets woulda ripped you a new one when you got inside a hundred meters. But, you’re still not supposed to be here. So.”
rows.translation: 女人按下腕戴装置上的一个按钮，朝你挥了挥手臂。“你没有携带任何已知犯罪组织的身份信号……好吧。放松点，我不会伤害你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman taps a button on a wrist-mounted device and waves her arm in your direction. “You’re lucky you’re loaded down with nanomachines. Otherwise the turrets woulda ripped you a new one when you got inside a hundred meters. But, you’re still not supposed to be here. So.”"

rows.original: So. “Who’re you?”
rows.translation: 那么。“你是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSo. “Who’re you?”"

rows.original: She chuckles, switching the spear from one hand to the other. “Krymhilde Weissman. Storm Lancer. Can call me Krym if you want. I’m responsible for security and maintenance here. Make sure the right people can come and go, safe and sound. Since you’re not Stormguard or someone paying us, if you want to use the transport beacon or catch some shuteye in the safety of my gun-net, gonna have to make it worth my while. Otherwise, kindly take a hike.”
rows.translation: 她轻笑一声，把长矛从一只手换到另一只手。“克里姆希尔德·魏斯曼。风暴枪骑兵，隶属风暴卫士。你可以叫我克里姆。我的任务是在这一带巡逻，保护这里不受海盗和野兽侵扰。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles, switching the spear from one hand to the other. “Krymhilde Weissman. Storm Lancer. Can call me Krym if you want. I’m responsible for security and maintenance here. Make sure the right people can come and go, safe and sound. Since you’re not Stormguard or someone paying us, if you want to use the transport beacon or catch some shuteye in the safety of my gun-net, gonna have to make it worth my while. Otherwise, kindly take a hike.”"

The essyra gives you a gentle, almost pleading tug in the direction of... whatever it is she wants.
rows.translation: 你缓缓转过身准备离开——却感觉她带爪的双手抓住了你的肩膀。有那么一瞬间，你惊慌起来，以为自己遭到了袭击。但片刻之后，当她那裹着毛皮的身体贴上你的后背，外套下那对挺翘的乳丘也随之蹭上来时，恐惧便消散了。她发出悲伤而无言的呜咽，绝望地紧紧抓住你。你设法在她笨拙的拥抱中扭过身来面对她，同时将她那双大大的、惹人怜爱的眼睛看得一清二楚。这名艾希拉轻轻拉了你一下，几乎带着恳求，想把你带向...无论她究竟想要什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly, you start to turn around to depart - only to feel her clawed hands grab at your shoulders. For a second, you panic, thinking you’re under attack. The fear passes a moment later when you feel her fur-clad body press into your back, feeling the perky mounds of a pair of breasts under the coat rubbing against you. She makes a sad, wordless whining sound, clutching desperately at you. You manage to squirm around in her awkward embrace that you face her, getting a good look at her big, puppy-dog eyes in the process. The essyra gives you a gentle, almost pleading tug in the direction of... whatever it is she wants."

rows.original: She looks pretty desperate for you to come with her now, whining and tugging at you like she is. Maybe you should go with her?
rows.translation: 看她这样一边呜咽一边拉扯你，她现在似乎非常迫切地想让你跟她走。也许你应该跟她去？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks pretty desperate for you to come with her now, whining and tugging at you like she is. Maybe you should go with her?"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: The strange pink-haired essyra seems intent on taking you somewhere. Let’s see where this goes...
rows.translation: 这个粉红头发的古怪艾希拉似乎执意要带你去某个地方。看看接下来会发生什么...
rows.raw: "The strange pink-haired essyra seems intent on taking you somewhere. Let’s see where this goes..."

rows.original: Definitely Not!
rows.translation: 绝对不去！
rows.raw: "Definitely Not!"

rows.original: Definitely Not!
rows.translation: 绝对不去！
rows.raw: "Definitely Not!"

rows.original: Nope. Not falling for it.
rows.translation: 不。你才不会上当。
rows.raw: "Nope. Not falling for it."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You step backwards, away from the marionette. She only sighs and turns away, walking back into the snow. Seems that this one at least knows how to take “No” for an answer...
rows.translation: 你向后退开，远离这个提线木偶般的女孩。她只是叹了口气，转身走回雪地。看来这个至少还知道在别人说“不”之后收手...
rows.raw: "You step backwards, away from the marionette. She only sighs and turns away, walking back into the snow. Seems that this one at least knows how to take “No” for an answer..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You wrest yourself out of the essyra’s grasp and
rows.translation: 你挣脱艾希拉的抓握，并
rows.raw: "You wrest yourself out of the essyra’s grasp and "

rows.original: gently
rows.translation: 温和地
rows.raw: "gently"

rows.original: mockingly
rows.translation: 嘲弄地
rows.raw: "mockingly"

rows.original: forcefully
rows.translation: 强硬地
rows.raw: "forcefully"

rows.original: tell her that you’re not going with her. Not that she understands you, anyway.
rows.translation: 告诉她你不会跟她走。反正她也听不懂你的话。
rows.raw: " tell her that you’re not going with her. Not that she understands you, anyway."

rows.original: By the time you manage to turn away and put some distance between you, you’re half sure you can see tears welling up in her eyes when you look over your shoulder. What the hell? You sigh and turn away, starting to resume your trudge through the snowy wastes.
rows.translation: 等你终于转身并拉开一段距离后，回头望去时，你几乎确信自己看见她眼里涌出了泪水。搞什么鬼？你叹了口气，再次转身，准备继续艰难跋涉于这片冰雪荒原。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you manage to turn away and put some distance between you, you’re half sure you can see tears welling up in her eyes when you look over your shoulder. What the hell? You sigh and turn away, starting to resume your trudge through the snowy wastes."

rows.original: You shake your head and tell her no, you aren’t going to follow her. You earn a pout and huff from the foxy native, but she doesn’t move to stop you from walking away.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，告诉她不行，你不会跟她走。这个狐狸般的本地女孩噘嘴哼了一声，却没有再阻止你离开。
rows.raw: "You shake your head and tell her no, you aren’t going to follow her. You earn a pout and huff from the foxy native, but she doesn’t move to stop you from walking away."

rows.original: After about fifty paces, you feel something heavy and cold hit you in the back, exploding in a hail of white dust. You stumble, more from surprise than anything, and watch as a second snowball goes careening over your head! Spinning around, you see the same, persistent essyra standing atop a nearby snowbank with another snowball in her hands, giggling as she hucks it at you.
rows.translation: 走出大约五十步后，一个又重又冷的东西砸中你的后背，在一阵白色粉尘中炸开。你踉跄了一下，更多是出于惊讶而非疼痛，紧接着看见第二颗雪球从头顶呼啸飞过！你猛地转身，只见那个执着的艾希拉正站在附近一处雪堤顶上，手里还捧着一颗雪球；她咯咯笑着，将它朝你掷来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter about fifty paces, you feel something heavy and cold hit you in the back, exploding in a hail of white dust. You stumble, more from surprise than anything, and watch as a second snowball goes careening over your head! Spinning around, you see the same, persistent essyra standing atop a nearby snowbank with another snowball in her hands, giggling as she hucks it at you."

rows.original: Fight Back!
rows.translation: 还击！
rows.raw: "Fight Back!"

rows.original: Fight Back!
rows.translation: 还击！
rows.raw: "Fight Back!"

rows.original: Well, you can’t let that go unanswered. Hit her back with a snowball!
rows.translation: 这可不能不还手。拿雪球砸回去！
rows.raw: "Well, you can’t let that go unanswered. Hit her back with a snowball!"

rows.original: Go Away!
rows.translation: 走开！
rows.raw: "Go Away!"

rows.original: Go Away!
rows.translation: 走开！
rows.raw: "Go Away!"

rows.original: No, seriously, go away!
rows.translation: 不，说真的，走开！
rows.raw: "No, seriously, go away!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Hey!” you shout, ducking a third snowball that comes hurling at you. “I said no!”
rows.translation: “喂！”你大喊一声，低头躲过迎面飞来的第三颗雪球。“我说了不！”
rows.raw: "“Hey!” you shout, ducking a third snowball that comes hurling at you. “I said no!”"

rows.original: She giggles and leans over, grabbing more snow. Dammit, that’s it! You do the same, grabbing a fistful of snow and letting fly right at her big, dumb, pink head. The girl squeals when the snowball impacts her, turning into an uproarious laugh as she throws another that hits you right in the [pc.chest]. A running start and a hard overhead throw like a grenade gives her another taste of her own medicine, beaning her in the leg, apparently hard enough to make her tumble over. She yelps, planting her ass in the snow as the bank she’s standing on rumbles behind her, and starts to shift.
rows.translation: 她咯咯笑着弯下腰，又抓起一把雪。该死，够了！你也照做，抓起一捧雪，朝她那颗又大又蠢的粉红脑袋用力掷去。雪球击中她时，女孩尖叫一声，旋即爆发出放肆的大笑，又扔来一颗雪球，正中你的[pc.chest]。你助跑几步，像扔手榴弹一样使劲从头顶掷出，让她也再次尝到自己的手段；雪球砸中她的腿，力道似乎大得足以让她摔倒。她惊叫着一屁股坐进雪里，身后的雪堤也随之隆隆作响，开始滑动。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe giggles and leans over, grabbing more snow. Dammit, that’s it! You do the same, grabbing a fistful of snow and letting fly right at her big, dumb, pink head. The girl squeals when the snowball impacts her, turning into an uproarious laugh as she throws another that hits you right in the [pc.chest]. A running start and a hard overhead throw like a grenade gives her another taste of her own medicine, beaning her in the leg, apparently hard enough to make her tumble over. She yelps, planting her ass in the snow as the bank she’s standing on rumbles behind her, and starts to shift."

rows.original: Oh, shit. You have just enough time to turn around and take a desperate step before the essyra’s ass-plant sends the side of the hill tumbling down in a great wave of crashing snow. You scream in surprise as the miniature avalanche slams into your back, barreling you over. Darkness takes hold for a moment, until you manage to flail your limbs enough to fight your way to the surface - and right into another snowball. The essyra, now all of two feet away and sitting dazed beside you, laughs reaches for more snow.
rows.translation: 噢，糟了。你只来得及转身，拼命迈出一步，艾希拉一屁股坐下所造成的冲击便让山坡侧面轰然坍塌，化作一股奔涌的雪浪。小型雪崩撞上你的后背，将你掀翻在地，你惊叫出声。黑暗笼罩了你片刻，直到你拼命挥动四肢，总算挣扎着钻出雪面——然后迎头又挨了一颗雪球。艾希拉此刻就在两英尺外，晕乎乎地坐在你身旁，一边大笑，一边伸手去抓更多的雪。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, shit. You have just enough time to turn around and take a desperate step before the essyra’s ass-plant sends the side of the hill tumbling down in a great wave of crashing snow. You scream in surprise as the miniature avalanche slams into your back, barreling you over. Darkness takes hold for a moment, until you manage to flail your limbs enough to fight your way to the surface - and right into another snowball. The essyra, now all of two feet away and sitting dazed beside you, laughs reaches for more snow."

rows.original: You reach up and grab her arm, pulling her down. She just laughs and rolls with it, happily letting you restrain her as you pull yourself out of the snow. The moment you’re out, though, you feel a pull on you in turn, sending you right back into the ground beside the essyra, who’s got her arms around your waist and her legs straddling yours.
rows.translation: 你伸手抓住她的胳膊，将她拽倒。她只是笑着顺势翻滚，任由你把她制住，同时你也从雪里撑起身子。然而你才刚刚脱身，反过来便有一股力量拉住了你，把你再次扯倒在艾希拉身旁；她双臂环着你的腰，双腿跨在你的腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach up and grab her arm, pulling her down. She just laughs and rolls with it, happily letting you restrain her as you pull yourself out of the snow. The moment you’re out, though, you feel a pull on you in turn, sending you right back into the ground beside the essyra, who’s got her arms around your waist and her legs straddling yours."

rows.original: She laughs and smiles, leaning in so close that you can feel her hot, sweet breath on your [pc.face]. Before you can react, she leans down and plants a lightning-fast kiss on your [pc.lips], sending an electric current of surprise and stimulation through your snow-logged body. But she doesn’t press the issue further, at least not now. She gives you a much more sensual, inviting smile, and nods towards the south.
rows.translation: 她笑容灿烂地凑近，近得让你能感觉到她甜美而炽热的呼吸拂过[pc.face]。你还来不及反应，她便低下头，在你的[pc.lips]上飞快印下一吻，惊讶与刺激仿佛电流般窜过你那沾满积雪的身体。但她没有继续强求，至少现在没有。她向你露出一个更加撩人、充满邀请意味的微笑，然后朝南方点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs and smiles, leaning in so close that you can feel her hot, sweet breath on your [pc.face]. Before you can react, she leans down and plants a lightning-fast kiss on your [pc.lips], sending an electric current of surprise and stimulation through your snow-logged body. But she doesn’t press the issue further, at least not now. She gives you a much more sensual, inviting smile, and nods towards the south."

rows.original: Suddenly, you think you realize what she’s wanted all along...
rows.translation: 突然间，你觉得自己终于明白她一直想要什么了...
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, you think you realize what she’s wanted all along..."

rows.original: Go for it!
rows.translation: 来吧！
rows.raw: "Go for it!"

rows.original: Go for it!
rows.translation: 来吧！
rows.raw: "Go for it!"

rows.original: Alright, alright. She’s made her point. Go along with the pretty pink fox-girl.
rows.translation: 好吧，好吧。她已经表达得够清楚了。跟这个漂亮的粉红狐狸女孩一起走。
rows.raw: "Alright, alright. She’s made her point. Go along with the pretty pink fox-girl."

rows.original: Seriously, No!
rows.translation: 说真的，不去！
rows.raw: "Seriously, No!"

rows.original: Seriously, No!
rows.translation: 说真的，不去！
rows.raw: "Seriously, No!"

rows.original: You don’t want what the pink-haired slut’s offering.
rows.translation: 你不想要这个粉红头发的荡妇所提供的东西。
rows.raw: "You don’t want what the pink-haired slut’s offering."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You take out your [pc.rangedWeapon] and pop a shot off at her feet, making the snowbank under her explode in a white flurry of disturbed ice. She yelps and goes sliding down out of sight as the false hill collapses.
rows.translation: 你取出[pc.rangedWeapon]，朝她脚边开了一枪，让她身下的雪堤在飞散的白色冰屑中炸开。她惊叫着滑落，在假山丘坍塌时消失于视野之中。
rows.raw: "You take out your [pc.rangedWeapon] and pop a shot off at her feet, making the snowbank under her explode in a white flurry of disturbed ice. She yelps and goes sliding down out of sight as the false hill collapses."

rows.original: “Fuck off!” you yell after her, [pc.holstering] your weapon. God damn barbarians.
rows.translation: “滚开！”你朝她消失的方向大喊，同时[pc.holstering]武器。该死的野蛮人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck off!” you yell after her, [pc.holstering] your weapon. God damn barbarians."

rows.original: God dammit! You scream some profanities at her before you take off as fast as you can, hoping she’ll take the hint. A few silent minutes later, and you’re fairly convinced she has. Shaking your head, you look to resume your travel.
rows.translation: 真他妈该死！你冲她骂了几句脏话，随后以最快速度离开，希望她能明白你的意思。几分钟寂静过去，你相当确信她终于懂了。你摇摇头，准备继续赶路。
rows.raw: "God dammit! You scream some profanities at her before you take off as fast as you can, hoping she’ll take the hint. A few silent minutes later, and you’re fairly convinced she has. Shaking your head, you look to resume your travel."

rows.original: You give her one last, fierce scowl and shake your head. The essyra’s chest gives a sad little heave, and she stands up, releasing her hold on you. She pouts, but this time doesn’t try and stop you from leaving.
rows.translation: 你最后狠狠瞪了她一眼，摇了摇头。艾希拉的胸口难过地轻轻起伏了一下，随后她站起身，放开了你。她噘着嘴，但这一次没有再试图阻止你离开。
rows.raw: "You give her one last, fierce scowl and shake your head. The essyra’s chest gives a sad little heave, and she stands up, releasing her hold on you. She pouts, but this time doesn’t try and stop you from leaving."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Curiosity takes the better of you, and you decide to see what exactly this silent pink vixen wants to show you. You give her a nod and let her take your hand, drawing you southwards into the winding white wasteland of the Uvetan wilderness. You wonder where she’s taking you...
rows.translation: 好奇心占了上风，你决定看看这个沉默的粉红狐狸女究竟想给你看什么。你朝她点点头，任由她牵起你的手，带着你向南进入乌维托荒野蜿蜒的白色冰原。你不禁好奇她要带你去哪里...
rows.raw: "Curiosity takes the better of you, and you decide to see what exactly this silent pink vixen wants to show you. You give her a nod and let her take your hand, drawing you southwards into the winding white wasteland of the Uvetan wilderness. You wonder where she’s taking you..."

rows.original: “Alright, alright,” you laugh, grabbing the girl’s hips and giving her a wink. Her big, blue smile returns with gusto, followed through by a delighted squeal. She slips down and gives you a big, warm hug, enveloping you in heavy, soft furs. You laugh as the two of you get up, her hand locked firmly around your own, and she pulls you towards the snow-wracked wastes of the south. You wonder where she’s taking you...
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧，”你笑着抓住女孩的臀部，朝她眨了眨眼。她灿烂的蓝色笑容立刻全然恢复，随后还发出一声欢喜的尖叫。她滑下来，给了你一个温暖的大大拥抱，让厚重而柔软的毛皮将你包裹其中。你笑着和她一起站起身，她的手牢牢牵住你的手，将你拉向南方风雪肆虐的荒野。你不禁好奇她要带你去哪里...
rows.raw: "“Alright, alright,” you laugh, grabbing the girl’s hips and giving her a wink. Her big, blue smile returns with gusto, followed through by a delighted squeal. She slips down and gives you a big, warm hug, enveloping you in heavy, soft furs. You laugh as the two of you get up, her hand locked firmly around your own, and she pulls you towards the snow-wracked wastes of the south. You wonder where she’s taking you..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The essyra leads you by the hand through the whipping winds and vast snowdrifts. She stays close to you, letting you feel the heat and softness of her heavy cloak. Her tail whips against your [pc.leg] with every step, a show of obvious and unabashed excitement as she leads you to
rows.translation: 艾希拉牵着你的手，带你穿过呼啸的狂风与大片雪堆。她始终紧贴着你，让你感受到厚重斗篷的温暖与柔软。每迈出一步，她的尾巴都会拍打你的[pc.leg]；那份毫不掩饰的兴奋显而易见，而她正带着你走向
rows.raw: "The essyra leads you by the hand through the whipping winds and vast snowdrifts. She stays close to you, letting you feel the heat and softness of her heavy cloak. Her tail whips against your [pc.leg] with every step, a show of obvious and unabashed excitement as she leads you to "

rows.original: your fate
rows.translation: 你的命运
rows.raw: "your fate"

rows.original: her home
rows.translation: 她的家
rows.raw: "her home"

rows.original: . A few short minutes pass without a word said between you. Your pink-maned companion seems content, as ever, to remain wordless - if she even can speak. Still, with her hand on yours and her warm body pressed constantly against your own there’s little need for words, and you follow her soothing presence through the bleak Uvetan chill.
rows.translation: 。短短几分钟过去，你们之间一句话也没有说。你那粉红鬃发的同伴似乎一如既往地满足于保持沉默——如果她真的会说话的话。不过，她的手牵着你，温暖的身体又始终贴着你，言语也就没那么必要了；你跟随她令人安心的身影，穿过乌维托凄冷的寒意。
rows.raw: ". A few short minutes pass without a word said between you. Your pink-maned companion seems content, as ever, to remain wordless - if she even can speak. Still, with her hand on yours and her warm body pressed constantly against your own there’s little need for words, and you follow her soothing presence through the bleak Uvetan chill."

rows.original: Her meandering path soon leads you to a towering hill of snow and ice, flanked by the pillars of obsidian-like growths that form from the planet’s frigid surface. A dark, slender opening sits at the base of the snow-mound, obviously dug out by living hands - although it’s incredibly smooth, almost a perfect half-circle stretching up from the flat ice below it. Your essyra guide gives you a smile over her shoulder and slinks down onto her hands and knees, crawling through the opening and into the dark, out of sight. You shiver at the sudden return of the ceaseless cold, now deprived of her warm presence, and move quickly to follow her
rows.translation: 她迂回曲折的路线很快将你带到一座高耸的冰雪丘陵前，两侧矗立着黑曜石般的柱状生长物，它们从这颗行星冰冷的地表上形成。一道黑暗而狭窄的入口位于雪丘底部，显然是由活物的双手挖掘出来的——不过它光滑得不可思议，几乎形成一个从下方平坦冰面向上延伸的完美半圆。你的艾希拉向导回头朝你微笑，随后伏下身，以手膝着地，爬过入口进入黑暗，消失在视野中。失去她温暖的陪伴后，无休无止的寒意骤然回归，让你打了个寒战；你赶紧跟了上去
rows.raw: "\n\nHer meandering path soon leads you to a towering hill of snow and ice, flanked by the pillars of obsidian-like growths that form from the planet’s frigid surface. A dark, slender opening sits at the base of the snow-mound, obviously dug out by living hands - although it’s incredibly smooth, almost a perfect half-circle stretching up from the flat ice below it. Your essyra guide gives you a smile over her shoulder and slinks down onto her hands and knees, crawling through the opening and into the dark, out of sight. You shiver at the sudden return of the ceaseless cold, now deprived of her warm presence, and move quickly to follow her"

rows.original: - though your struggle somewhat due to your
rows.translation: - 不过，由于你的
rows.raw: "- though your struggle somewhat due to your "

rows.original: size
rows.translation: 体型
rows.raw: "size"

rows.original: and
rows.translation: 和
rows.raw: " and "

rows.original: shape
rows.translation: 轮廓
rows.raw: "shape"

rows.original: to fit through the passage
rows.translation: ，你费了些力气才穿过通道
rows.raw: " to fit through the passage"

rows.original: When you finally emerge from the tunnel’s end, you’re greeted by a welcome sight indeed: a hemispherical chamber has been dug out of the hillside, with smooth packed-in walls and a floor of perfect ice, covered with plush fur rugs that surround a circle of obsidian stones and wood. Apparently the ring is a fire pit - one that your companion is already lighting, allowing much-needed warmth to spread through the chamber. A chill still hangs in the air here, but it’s nothing like the seeping, gut-clenching freeze of the outside world. What’s left inside is a calm, almost relaxing chill - just enough to make you thankful for the heat of the fire

Another Essyra... and very likely a lureling’s marion at that."

rows.original: You find your hand settling on your [pc.weapon] as she draws closer, and indeed, she stops some thirty feet ahead of you and puts her hands up in a gesture of peace. Though as wordless as the last of her kin, she uses her mittened hands to make clear gestures at you: “Don’t hurt me. You can follow me if you like.”
rows.translation: 她靠近时，你的手不由得搭上[pc.weapon]；果然，她在你前方约三十英尺处停下，举起双手示意和平。她和上一个同族一样一言不发，却用戴着连指手套的双手向你做出清晰手势：“别伤害我。如果你愿意，可以跟我来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou find your hand settling on your [pc.weapon] as she draws closer, and indeed, she stops some thirty feet ahead of you and puts her hands up in a gesture of peace. Though as wordless as the last of her kin, she uses her mittened hands to make clear gestures at you: “Don’t hurt me. You can follow me if you like.”"

rows.original: Seems like she, too, intends to honeypot you. But if you can stomach knowing what lurks under the ice... would that be so bad?
rows.translation: 看来她也打算用美色诱你上钩。不过，如果你能接受冰层下潜伏着什么...那又有什么不好？
rows.raw: "\n\nSeems like she, too, intends to honeypot you. But if you can stomach knowing what lurks under the ice... would that be so bad?"

rows.raw: "You trudge through the perpetual ice and cold of the Uvetan wasteland"

rows.translation: ，双臂抱紧身体，疯狂打着寒颤，只盼能在冻倒前找到避难所
rows.raw: ", holding your arms around yourself and shivering like mad, hoping beyond hope to find shelter before you collapse from the cold"

rows.original: as you try to brave the elements on this inhospitable world

rows.raw: " as you try to brave the elements on this inhospitable world"

rows.original: . The snow-paths around you seem vast and endless, stretching off in featureless expanses of white as far as the eye can see. White, save for a pillar of obsidian darkness moving on the horizon in your direction.
rows.translation: 。周围雪道辽阔无尽，目力所及尽是毫无特征的白色荒原。除了地平线上一道正朝你移动的黑曜石般漆黑身影。
rows.raw: ". The snow-paths around you seem vast and endless, stretching off in featureless expanses of white as far as the eye can see. White, save for a pillar of obsidian darkness moving on the horizon in your direction."

rows.original: You squint, trying to see a bit clearer through the biting wind. As your path and the figure’s draw ever close together, the dark shape resolves into that of a humanoid, wrapped in heavy furs that billow in the wind. One of the natives, maybe?
rows.translation: 你眯起眼，试图透过刺骨寒风看得更清楚。随着你和那个身影走的路线越来越近，那团暗影逐渐显出一个裹着厚重毛皮的人形轮廓，毛皮在风中翻飞。或许是当地人？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squint, trying to see a bit clearer through the biting wind. As your path and the figure’s draw ever close together, the dark shape resolves into that of a humanoid, wrapped in heavy furs that billow in the wind. One of the natives, maybe? "

rows.translation: 谢天谢地！也许她能帮你找到避难所
rows.raw: "Thank God! Maybe they can help you find shelter"

rows.original: ... or some other way to warm up...
rows.translation: ...或者别的取暖办法...
rows.raw: " ... or some other way to warm up..."

rows.original: Hopefully not hostile, though you have to admit: getting the blood pumping like in a good fight would really help against the pervasive chill. Not to mention what comes after....
rows.translation: 希望她没有敌意，不过你不得不承认，像痛快打一架那样让血液沸腾，确实很有助于抵御无处不在的寒意。更别提之后的事了....
rows.raw: "Hopefully not hostile, though you have to admit: getting the blood pumping like in a good fight would really help against the pervasive chill. Not to mention what comes after...."

rows.original: Either way, the two of you are headed right for each other. You raise a wary hand to the cloaked figure as it draws near and to your relief, you see it wave back. No more than twenty paces away now, it pulls down its fur-lined hood to reveal a head of brilliant bright-pink hair flooding down to its owner’s shoulders in silken curls, framing a pale, feminine face. A pair of perky, fox-like ears - much too small to be those of an ausar, and filled with a lush blue-white fluff - poke out from her scalp, twitching in your direction. The woman’s - and that’s most certainly what she is - lips are full and dark blue, forming an enchanting smile.
rows.translation: 无论如何，你们正迎面走向彼此。披斗篷的身影靠近时，你警惕地抬手示意，令你松了口气的是，她也挥手回应。此刻相距不过二十步，她拉下毛皮衬里的兜帽，露出一头亮丽的粉红长发，丝绸般卷曲着垂至肩头，衬托着苍白而女性化的脸庞。一对俏立的狐耳从头顶探出，尺寸远小于奥萨人的耳朵，内部覆满浓密的蓝白绒毛，正朝你的方向轻轻抽动。这个女人，毫无疑问是女人，有着丰满的深蓝色嘴唇，勾勒出迷人的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nEither way, the two of you are headed right for each other. You raise a wary hand to the cloaked figure as it draws near and to your relief, you see it wave back. No more than twenty paces away now, it pulls down its fur-lined hood to reveal a head of brilliant bright-pink hair flooding down to its owner’s shoulders in silken curls, framing a pale, feminine face. A pair of perky, fox-like ears - much too small to be those of an ausar, and filled with a lush blue-white fluff - poke out from her scalp, twitching in your direction. The woman’s - and that’s most certainly what she is - lips are full and dark blue, forming an enchanting smile. "
