rows.raw: "Essyras"

rows.original: You recognize her for one of the fox-like essyra, a thankfully friendly race!
rows.translation: 你认出她是狐形埃希拉的一员，幸好这是个友善的种族！
rows.raw: "You recognize her for one of the fox-like essyra, a thankfully friendly race!"

rows.original: Your Codex chirps, just barely audible over the howl of the wind, that this is an essyra, one of the native species here on Uveto. One that is, generally, friendly to off-worlders like you.
rows.translation: 你的法典发出提示音，在风的呼啸中几乎听不清，告诉你这是埃希拉，是乌维托的原生种族之一。总体而言，她们对你这样的外星人颇为友善。
rows.raw: "Your Codex chirps, just barely audible over the howl of the wind, that this is an essyra, one of the native species here on Uveto. One that is, generally, friendly to off-worlders like you."

rows.original: You give a sigh of relief as you see the friendly smile on the girl’s face. She instantly seems to recognize that you’re freezing where you stand, slowly turning into [pc.aRace] icicle. Her smile, the warmest thing out here, wavers with concern, and a cream-pale hand darts out from under her hide cloak to grasp yours, locking her fingers around your hand and giving you an urgent tug towards the south. In your condition, you don’t even think about refusing the silent woman’s saving graces. Any promise of salvation from this lethal cold is good enough, especially when she pulls you in against herself, wrapping part of her heavy cloak around you to share in the warmth of it - and her body.
rows.translation: 看到女孩脸上友善的笑容，你松了口气。她立刻察觉你正站在原地冻僵，慢慢变成一根[pc.aRace]冰柱。她的笑容是这片冰天雪地里最温暖的事物，此刻却因担忧而动摇。一只奶油般苍白的手从兽皮斗篷下迅速伸出，握住你的手，手指紧扣，并急切地把你向南方拉去。以你现在的状况，根本不会考虑拒绝这个沉默女人的救命善意。只要有希望逃离致命严寒就足够了，尤其是当她把你拉进怀里，用部分厚重斗篷将你裹住，与你分享斗篷和她身体的温暖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give a sigh of relief as you see the friendly smile on the girl’s face. She instantly seems to recognize that you’re freezing where you stand, slowly turning into [pc.aRace] icicle. Her smile, the warmest thing out here, wavers with concern, and a cream-pale hand darts out from under her hide cloak to grasp yours, locking her fingers around your hand and giving you an urgent tug towards the south. In your condition, you don’t even think about refusing the silent woman’s saving graces. Any promise of salvation from this lethal cold is good enough, especially when she pulls you in against herself, wrapping part of her heavy cloak around you to share in the warmth of it - and her body."

rows.original: A moment passes in silence, her warm smile and bright eyes locked on you. You can see the hint of a glistening pink tail swishing eagerly under her coat, and heavily-clad arms moving at her side. The moment goes past, and a hint of the tension of meeting a stranger in the wilds passes: neither of you seem eager to attack the other, yet the girl isn’t speaking. You suppose you need to take the initiative, and so you introduce yourself.
rows.translation: 沉默中片刻过去，她温暖的笑容与明亮双眼始终落在你身上。你能看见一条闪亮粉尾在她外套下热切摆动，厚实衣物包裹的双臂则垂在身侧。又过了一会儿，荒野中与陌生人相遇的紧张感消散些许：你们似乎都无意攻击对方，可女孩仍不开口。你觉得该主动一些，于是做了自我介绍。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment passes in silence, her warm smile and bright eyes locked on you. You can see the hint of a glistening pink tail swishing eagerly under her coat, and heavily-clad arms moving at her side. The moment goes past, and a hint of the tension of meeting a stranger in the wilds passes: neither of you seem eager to attack the other, yet the girl isn’t speaking. You suppose you need to take the initiative, and so you introduce yourself."

rows.original: The essyra smiles a little broader when you speak, but she makes no motion that she understood you. You blink in confusion, not really used to that happening, and tap your Codex through your pack. It beeps at you, letting you know it’s still awake and functioning as your personal translator. Huh. Approaching the problem from a different angle, you point your hands at yourself and say, “[pc.name].”
rows.translation: 你开口时，埃希拉笑得更灿烂了些，却没有表现出听懂的迹象。你困惑地眨眨眼，不太习惯这种情况，隔着背包轻敲法典。它向你发出提示音，表明仍在工作并履行私人翻译器的职责。嗯。你换了个思路，双手指向自己，说道：“[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe essyra smiles a little broader when you speak, but she makes no motion that she understood you. You blink in confusion, not really used to that happening, and tap your Codex through your pack. It beeps at you, letting you know it’s still awake and functioning as your personal translator. Huh. Approaching the problem from a different angle, you point your hands at yourself and say, “[pc.name].”"

Her hands are bare, with cream-pale flesh ending in tiny, sharp little claws. They rake gently against your

rows.original: To hell with this, you’re getting out of here! You fight back just enough to push the snarling beast back, giving yourself the room you need to dive for the narrow entrance to the hidden den. You’ve barely wedged yourself into the snowy tunnel when you hear a horrible, croaking sound from behind you. What sounds at first like a roar or a growl steadily resolves into what can only be a hoarse but rhythmic laugh.
rows.translation: 去他的，你要离开这里！你奋力反击，刚好把咆哮的野兽推退，为自己争取到扑向隐蔽巢穴狭窄入口的空间。你才刚挤进积雪隧道，就听见身后传来一阵可怕的嘶哑声。起初像是怒吼或低咆，随后却逐渐变成一种沙哑而富有节奏的笑声。
rows.raw: "To hell with this, you’re getting out of here! You fight back just enough to push the snarling beast back, giving yourself the room you need to dive for the narrow entrance to the hidden den. You’ve barely wedged yourself into the snowy tunnel when you hear a horrible, croaking sound from behind you. What sounds at first like a roar or a growl steadily resolves into what can only be a hoarse but rhythmic laugh."

rows.original: You expect the final pen to extend into an even deeper cavern, given the trend of the last three, but you find it to be no larger than the waiting room where Maja keeps her desk. Inside, a gaggle of awkward looking lizard-like creatures mill about in the enclosed space. Eyes like saucers flit around, settling on you for a half second before moving on. One of the creatures makes a move to approach the fence, but trips on its own legs and falls with a thunk. Three others surrounding it bounce five feet straight into the air, landing with unbelievable grace to face their fallen companion.
rows.translation: 照前三座围栏越来越大的趋势，你原以为最后一座会延伸进更深的洞窟，然而它甚至不比玛雅摆放桌子的候客室大。围栏里，一群模样笨拙的蜥蜴状生物来回游荡。碟子般的大眼睛四处乱转，在你身上停留不到半秒便移开。一只生物试图靠近围栏，却被自己的腿绊倒，砰地摔在地上。周围另外三只顿时垂直弹起足足五英尺，又以难以置信的优雅姿态落地，齐齐面向倒下的同伴。

rows.original: Grunch arent the smartest things, but they try. They hurt themselves if they have too much space to move around and no one to look after them. The little ones can spit acid from their mouths if you point them at something you need melted. We still have to take care of them after they grow up though. They get attached to the miners they grew up with, and they taste like garbage, so we can’t cook them.
rows.translation: 格伦奇并不是最聪明的生物，但它们确实很努力。要是活动空间太大又没人照料，它们会把自己弄伤。只要把幼崽对准需要熔化的东西，它们就能从嘴里喷出酸液。不过它们长大后我们仍得继续照料。它们会依恋陪伴自己长大的矿工，而且肉难吃得像垃圾，所以也不能拿来烹饪。
rows.raw: "Grunch arent the smartest things, but they try. They hurt themselves if they have too much space to move around and no one to look after them. The little ones can spit acid from their mouths if you point them at something you need melted. We still have to take care of them after they grow up though. They get attached to the miners they grew up with, and they taste like garbage, so we can’t cook them."

A minute later she comes back, leading one of the hulking bear-like creatures by a thick-roped collar. It huffs inquisitively in your direction, and Maja transfers the leash to your hands."

rows.original: “Here you are, this big guy ought to protect you out on the ice. Or anywhere cold really. He’s helped a lot of korgonne get back safe from hunts. He’ll have your back, so you make sure to have his.”
rows.translation: “给你。这大家伙会在冰原上保护你——其实任何寒冷地方都行。他曾帮助许多科尔贡平安结束狩猎。你可得确保他也平安回来。”
rows.raw: "“Here you are, this big guy ought to protect you out on the ice. Or anywhere cold really. He’s helped a lot of korgonne get back safe from hunts. He’ll have your back, so you make sure to have his.”"

rows.original: “Here go! Kor’diiak will do a protect. Big scary to bad guys. He make sure many get home safe, so you make sure he get home safe.”
rows.translation: “给你！科尔迪亚克会保护。坏家伙见了会害怕。他让很多人安全回家，所以你也要让他安全回家。”
rows.raw: "“Here go! Kor’diiak will do a protect. Big scary to bad guys. He make sure many get home safe, so you make sure he get home safe.”"

rows.original: “Tell him this is [pc.name] Steele, requesting a miniature giant baby kor’diiak delivered to this location.” Maja nods curtly, spinning around on her stool and opening a small door in the stone wall. She pulls out a corded telephone, speaking a phrase into the receiver. The cave begins to shake, and a massive korgonne fist smashes through the ceiling, bathed in rays of shadowy light. You hold out your hands, and the fist drops a basketball sized kor’diiak into your hands. It yips playfully, poking at your fingers with its tiny horn. When you look away you find Maja sitting at her desk, with no sign of the damage caused to the cave. What could have come over you?
rows.translation: “告诉他，我是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，要求把一只微型巨型科尔迪亚克宝宝送到这里。”玛雅简短地点点头，在凳子上转过身，打开石墙上的一扇小门。她从中取出一部有线电话，对着听筒说了一句话。洞穴开始震动，一只巨大的科尔贡拳头猛然砸穿天花板，沐浴在幽暗的光束中。你伸出双手，那只拳头便把一只篮球大小的科尔迪亚克放进你怀里。它欢快地嗷嗷叫着，用小角戳弄你的手指。等你移开视线时，却发现玛雅正坐在桌前，洞穴里完全看不出方才遭到破坏的痕迹。你刚才究竟是怎么了？
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell him this is [pc.name] Steele, requesting a miniature giant baby kor’diiak delivered to this location.” Maja nods curtly, spinning around on her stool and opening a small door in the stone wall. She pulls out a corded telephone, speaking a phrase into the receiver. The cave begins to shake, and a massive korgonne fist smashes through the ceiling, bathed in rays of shadowy light. You hold out your hands, and the fist drops a basketball sized kor’diiak into your hands. It yips playfully, poking at your fingers with its tiny horn. When you look away you find Maja sitting at her desk, with no sign of the damage caused to the cave. What could have come over you?"

rows.original: “I want to trust you. I don’t meet many outsiders. The rare occasions I do see them are when I’m out taming new animals. The last group I saw looked pretty weak, so I decided to ambush them. I got my ass kicked, but I’d heard stories of aliens who prefer to just mate after a good fight instead of doing nastier things, so I wasn’t too sad about it. rows.original: She stares up at you with big, doe-like blue eyes while you introduce yourself. A messy lock of flaxen hair falls from under her hood, long enough to brush her unadorned lips before she tucks it back behind an ear -- a human ear, you notice. Your question dies in your throat before you have a chance to speak it. The last time you saw Steph, she was mutated with cat-parts and silver eyes and more... though now that you’re next to her, this woman still definitely strikes an uncanny resemblance.

rows.original: for the intrusion. Honestly, considering what you saw on the most recent episode of her sister’s show, you’re not sure how you could have made the mistake. She might look just like her sister did last season, but now, after all those mutations...
rows.translation: 为自己的打扰致歉。说实话，考虑到你在她姐姐最新一集节目里看到的内容，你也不明白自己怎么会认错。她的确和姐姐上一季时长得一模一样，但经历了那些突变后，如今的斯蒂芬...
rows.raw: " for the intrusion. Honestly, considering what you saw on the most recent episode of her sister’s show, you’re not sure how you could have made the mistake. She might look just like her sister did last season, but now, after all those mutations..."

rows.original: Nat blushes all of a sudden, blood red. “Y-you’ve seen those awful new episodes? Oh-oh no!”
rows.translation: 娜特的脸忽然涨得血红。“你、你看过那些糟透了的新节目？哦、哦不！”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat blushes all of a sudden, blood red. “Y-you’ve seen those awful new episodes? Oh-oh no!”"

rows.original: “What’s wrong?” you ask, taking a sip of your drink.
rows.translation: “怎么了？”你喝了一口饮料，问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s wrong?” you ask, taking a sip of your drink."

rows.original: The woman across from you squirms, hiding most of her face under her hood and in her drink. “Those new episodes, the stuff she gets into; lets people see... God, half the galaxy’s seen me naked!”
rows.translation: 坐在对面的女人不安地扭动着，把大半张脸藏进兜帽和杯子里。“那些新节目，还有她做的那些事；让别人看见...天啊，半个银河系都看过我的裸体了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman across from you squirms, hiding most of her face under her hood and in her drink. “Those new episodes, the stuff she gets into; lets people see... God, half the galaxy’s seen me naked!”"

rows.original: Naked? What... oh, right. Twins.
rows.translation: 裸体？什么...哦，对。双胞胎。
rows.raw: "\n\nNaked? What... oh, right. Twins. "

rows.original: The thought of billions of people seeing you naked, live, all at once sends shivers of excitement up your spine. How could she be embarrassed about that -- it’s totally hot!
rows.translation: 想到数十亿人同时观看你的现场裸体，一阵兴奋的战栗便沿脊椎窜过。她怎么会为此尴尬——这明明超级火辣！
rows.raw: "The thought of billions of people seeing you naked, live, all at once sends shivers of excitement up your spine. How could she be embarrassed about that -- it’s totally hot!"

rows.original: Yeah, you guess you can see her point.
rows.translation: 是啊，你大概能理解她的观点。
rows.raw: "Yeah, you guess you can see her point."

rows.original: Now that she mentions it, though, it’s suddenly real easy to mentally undress the sexy blonde. You’ve already seen all those supple curves, seen her body jiggling in all the right places, just on another person. Your mind automatically fills in the blanks left by Nat’s heavy coat and tight shirt.
rows.translation: 不过经她这么一说，脑海里忽然很容易就能扒光这位性感金发女郎。那些柔软曲线你都已经见过，也见过她的身体在所有恰当部位晃动，只不过长在另一个人身上。你的思绪自动填补了娜特厚重外套与紧身衬衫遮住的空白。
rows.raw: " Now that she mentions it, though, it’s suddenly real easy to mentally undress the sexy blonde. You’ve already seen all those supple curves, seen her body jiggling in all the right places, just on another person. Your mind automatically fills in the blanks left by Nat’s heavy coat and tight shirt."

rows.original: There’s an audible thunk as your [pc.cockBiggest] throbs with interest, bouncing off the table’s underside.
rows.translation: 随着你的[pc.cockBiggest]兴奋地跳动，撞上桌子底面，发出清晰可闻的砰声。
rows.raw: " There’s an audible thunk as your [pc.cockBiggest] throbs with interest, bouncing off the table’s underside."

rows.original: Nat squirms under your continued gaze. “That’s why I took this posting. Get away from people for a bit, till Steph’s season is over.”
rows.translation: 娜特在你持续的注视下不安地扭动。“所以我才接下这里的职位。暂时躲开人群，等斯蒂芬这一季节目结束。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat squirms under your continued gaze. “That’s why I took this posting. Get away from people for a bit, till Steph’s season is over.”"

rows.original: Figuring you ought to change the subject before poor Nat goes permanently red in the face, you ask what posting that is: who’s she working for?
rows.translation: 你觉得最好在可怜的娜特整张脸永久变红之前换个话题，于是问她接的是什么职位：她在为谁工作？
rows.raw: "\n\nFiguring you ought to change the subject before poor Nat goes permanently red in the face, you ask what posting that is: who’s she working for?"

rows.original: “The Confederate Scout Authority,” she answers quickly. “I just finished my master’s in xeno-zoology, and the last scientist they had here just got married, so when I heard the station was open, I jumped at it! It’s not glorious frontier work, but there’s so many species here on Uveto that we still know next to nothing about! The inner ocean is just teeming with life, at least some of which is sapient... and completely out of communication even after centuries of colonization.”
rows.translation: “邦联侦察管理局。”她迅速回答。“我刚拿到异种动物学硕士学位，而这里上一位科学家恰好结婚了，所以听说岗位空缺时，我立刻就申请了！这不算光彩的边疆工作，但乌维托有太多我们几乎一无所知的物种了！内海简直充满生命，其中至少有一些具备智慧...可即便经过数百年殖民，我们仍然完全无法与它们交流。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Confederate Scout Authority,” she answers quickly. “I just finished my master’s in xeno-zoology, and the last scientist they had here just got married, so when I heard the station was open, I jumped at it! It’s not glorious frontier work, but there’s so many species here on Uveto that we still know next to nothing about! The inner ocean is just teeming with life, at least some of which is sapient... and completely out of communication even after centuries of colonization.”"

rows.original: Get her talking, and that nasty stutter just vanishes! You grin and nod
rows.translation: 只要让她谈起这些，那恼人的结巴就彻底消失了！你笑着点头
rows.raw: "\n\nGet her talking, and that nasty stutter just vanishes! You grin and nod"

rows.original: , trying not to stare into her cleavage
rows.translation: ，努力不去盯着她的乳沟
rows.raw: ", trying not to stare into her cleavage"

rows.original: , glad to have her talking. She keeps going for a good long while once you get her wound up, delving into technicalities of undersea life that you have a damn hard time following -- all about evolving sapience in the harsh conditions of the moon’s inner sea. The terminology she’s using alone leaves you swimming, completely lost. You can barely get a word in edgewise, practically drowning in the verbal deluge until her drink’s vanished, and you can practically hear her talking her throat dry.
rows.translation: ，很高兴她愿意说下去。一旦打开话匣，她便滔滔不绝地讲了很久，深入讨论海底生命的技术细节，你实在很难跟上——全是关于智慧如何在这颗卫星内海的严酷环境中演化。光是她使用的术语就让你如坠云雾，彻底迷失。你几乎插不进一句话，简直快淹没在言语洪流里；直到她喝光饮料，你几乎都能听出她已经说得口干舌燥。
rows.raw: ", glad to have her talking. She keeps going for a good long while once you get her wound up, delving into technicalities of undersea life that you have a damn hard time following -- all about evolving sapience in the harsh conditions of the moon’s inner sea. The terminology she’s using alone leaves you swimming, completely lost. You can barely get a word in edgewise, practically drowning in the verbal deluge until her drink’s vanished, and you can practically hear her talking her throat dry."

rows.original: When she finally had to pause to order another drink, you take the opportunity to butt in and try and change the subject while you have the chance...
rows.translation: 等她终于不得不停下来再点一杯时，你抓住机会插话，趁机试着换个话题...
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she finally had to pause to order another drink, you take the opportunity to butt in and try and change the subject while you have the chance..."

rows.original: Nothing happened!
rows.translation: 什么也没发生！
rows.raw: "Nothing happened!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: none
rows.raw: "none"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: leave
rows.raw: "leave"

rows.original: You shift out of the booth, telling Nat that you’ve gotta go.
rows.translation: 你从卡座中起身，告诉娜特自己得走了。
rows.raw: "You shift out of the booth, telling Nat that you’ve gotta go."

rows.original: “O-oh! Okay,” she sighs. “See you around, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “哦、哦！好吧。”她叹息道。“回头见，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh! Okay,” she sighs. “See you around, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: talk
rows.raw: "talk"

rows.original: “So, tell me a little about you, Nat,” you prompt.
rows.translation: “那么，说说你自己吧，娜特。”你提示道。
rows.raw: "“So, tell me a little about you, Nat,” you prompt."

rows.original: “M-me?” she stammers, blinking in surprise. “What do you wanna know?”
rows.translation: “我、我？”她吃惊地眨着眼，结结巴巴地问。“你想知道什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“M-me?” she stammers, blinking in surprise. “What do you wanna know?”"

rows.original: You think for a moment before saying,
rows.translation: 你思考片刻后说道：
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think for a moment before saying,"

rows.original: “So, I notice you don’t have much of an accent.”
rows.translation: “我注意到，你好像没什么口音。”
rows.raw: " “So, I notice you don’t have much of an accent.”"

rows.original: Natalie laughs shyly “Oh, that. Uh, well, that’s just cuz I kinda suppress it. Back when I first went to university, a lot of the girls made fun of me and Steph for sounding like space bumpkins. Which, I mean, I guess we are. Were. But we didn’t have to give it away. Ended up just not talkin’ for a while. A long while. Almost all the way through Junior year, really. After I stopped flapping my dumb mouth, nobody paid much attention to me. Gave me plenty of time to learn how everyone else talked.”
rows.translation: 娜塔莉腼腆地笑了。“哦，那个啊。呃，其实只是我平时会刻意压住口音。刚上大学时，很多女孩取笑我和斯蒂芬，说我们听起来像太空乡巴佬。这个嘛，我想我们的确是。曾经是。但也没必要让别人一听就知道。后来我有一阵子干脆不说话。很长一阵子。其实几乎一直持续到大三。等我闭上这张蠢嘴后，就没什么人注意我了。这给了我充足时间学习其他人怎么说话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNatalie laughs shyly “Oh, that. Uh, well, that’s just cuz I kinda suppress it. Back when I first went to university, a lot of the girls made fun of me and Steph for sounding like space bumpkins. Which, I mean, I guess we are. Were. But we didn’t have to give it away. Ended up just not talkin’ for a while. A long while. Almost all the way through Junior year, really. After I stopped flapping my dumb mouth, nobody paid much attention to me. Gave me plenty of time to learn how everyone else talked.”"

rows.original: “That’s awful!”
rows.translation: “那也太过分了！”
rows.raw: "“That’s awful!”"

rows.original: “Haha, wow, that’s pretty rough,”
rows.translation: “哈哈，哇，那可真够难熬的。”
rows.raw: "“Haha, wow, that’s pretty rough,”"

rows.original: “That sucks,”
rows.raw: "“That sucks,”"

rows.original: Nat shrugs and sips on her drink. “Hey, if you haven’t noticed, I’m, um, not much for talking anyway. I swear I-I didn’t stutter so much before, though. I always did a little, but not so bad. Guess I forgot how to talk a little!”
rows.translation: 娜特耸耸肩，喝了一口饮料。“嘿，你要是还没发现，我，呃，本来就不太爱说话。不过我发、发誓，以前没这么结巴。我一直有一点，但没这么严重。大概是我有点忘记该怎么说话了！”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat shrugs and sips on her drink. “Hey, if you haven’t noticed, I’m, um, not much for talking anyway. I swear I-I didn’t stutter so much before, though. I always did a little, but not so bad. Guess I forgot how to talk a little!”"

rows.original: She chuckles wryly and continues: “Going to school on Vesperia meant I picked up a Gal-standard accent after a while, though. Started to fit in a lot better after that. Pretty good, eh?”
rows.translation: 她苦笑一声，继续说道：“在维斯佩里亚上学，意味着过了一段时间后，我学会了银河标准口音。那之后就更容易融入大家了。挺不错的，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles wryly and continues: “Going to school on Vesperia meant I picked up a Gal-standard accent after a while, though. Started to fit in a lot better after that. Pretty good, eh?”"

rows.original: accent
rows.raw: "accent"

rows.original: “Wanna tell me a little more about what you’re doing here on Uveto? Without getting too technical, maybe.”
rows.translation: “想不想再多说说你在乌维托做什么？也许别讲得太专业。”
rows.raw: " “Wanna tell me a little more about what you’re doing here on Uveto? Without getting too technical, maybe.”"

rows.original: The blonde bombshell perks up immediately when you mention her work.
rows.translation: 你一提到她的工作，这位金发尤物立刻来了精神。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe blonde bombshell perks up immediately when you mention her work."

rows.original: “Sure! Uh, l-let’s see, me specifically? Well, mostly I go out and catalogue different species. Not sapient ones, usually, but actual animals like the local ghen’sterra -- they’re those cute little floofy fuzzballs with six eyes you mighta seen around the walls? -- or the huge macro predators out on the Rift. I collect specimens, study behaviors, create data entries and analysis. If you’ve ever read a CODEX entry on a local species, it’s probably got at least some of my data written into it,” she beams proudly.
rows.translation: “当然！呃，让、让我想想，就说我自己具体做什么？嗯，我主要会外出记录不同物种。通常不是智慧生物，而是真正的动物，比如本地的根斯特拉——就是那些有六只眼、毛茸茸又可爱的小毛球，你可能在城墙附近见过？——或是裂谷上的巨型掠食者。我收集标本、研究行为、建立数据条目并进行分析。如果你读过本地物种的CODEX条目，其中大概至少有一些数据是我写进去的。”她自豪地笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure! Uh, l-let’s see, me specifically? Well, mostly I go out and catalogue different species. Not sapient ones, usually, but actual animals like the local ghen’sterra -- they’re those cute little floofy fuzzballs with six eyes you mighta seen around the walls? -- or the huge macro predators out on the Rift. I collect specimens, study behaviors, create data entries and analysis. If you’ve ever read a CODEX entry on a local species, it’s probably got at least some of my data written into it,” she beams proudly."

rows.original: “Of course, that’s just, like, the most mundane part of the job! The real exciting stuff is getting to look at never-before-seen species, or try and figure out the real mysterious ones. What I’m most interested of anything here on the planet is what the locals call the ‘frostwyrms,’ these huge dragon-like beasties that’re supposed to be bigger than Terran blue whales, and whose roars can shatter the ice for miles!”
rows.translation: “当然，这只是工作里最平凡的部分！真正令人兴奋的，是研究前所未见的物种，或试着弄懂那些真正神秘的生物。在这个星球上，我最感兴趣的是本地人所谓的‘霜龙’，这些巨大的类龙野兽据说比泰伦蓝鲸还大，吼声能震碎方圆数英里的冰层！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, that’s just, like, the most mundane part of the job! The real exciting stuff is getting to look at never-before-seen species, or try and figure out the real mysterious ones. What I’m most interested of anything here on the planet is what the locals call the ‘frostwyrms,’ these huge dragon-like beasties that’re supposed to be bigger than Terran blue whales, and whose roars can shatter the ice for miles!”"

rows.original: Yeah, you’ve seen one of those. Huge and terrifying is right.
rows.translation: 是啊，你见过其中一只。它的确既巨大又恐怖。
rows.raw: "Yeah, you’ve seen one of those. Huge and terrifying is right."

rows.original: “Yeah, about that...” you chuckle awkwardly. Whoops. There’s probably more than that one wyrm, though, right?
rows.translation: “是啊，关于那个...”你尴尬地笑了笑。糟糕。不过霜龙大概不只那一只，对吧？
rows.raw: "“Yeah, about that...” you chuckle awkwardly. Whoops. There’s probably more than that one wyrm, though, right?"

rows.original: Wow, that sounds like something out of
rows.translation: 哇，那听起来简直像是出自
rows.raw: "Wow, that sounds like something out of "

rows.original: syribooks
rows.raw: "syribooks"

rows.original: one of Syri’s
rows.raw: "one of Syri’s"

rows.original: some
rows.raw: "some"

rows.original: fantasy books.
rows.translation: 奇幻小说。
rows.raw: " fantasy books."

rows.original: Nat chuckles, brushing a loose lock of hair behind an ear. <i>“Yeah, so, I’ve been trying to track a live one down every chance I get, but no luck. I coulda sworn I’ve caught glimpses of one out on the Rift, but...
rows.translation: 娜特轻笑着，把一绺散落的头发拨到耳后。<i>“是啊，所以每逢有机会，我都会试着追踪一只活体，但始终没能成功。我敢说自己曾在裂谷上瞥见过一只，但...
rows.raw: "\n\nNat chuckles, brushing a loose lock of hair behind an ear. <i>“Yeah, so, I’ve been trying to track a live one down every chance I get, but no luck. I coulda sworn I’ve caught glimpses of one out on the Rift, but..."

rows.original: I guess you took care of that one, huh? Damn, what a shame. B-b-but I know you probably didn’t have a ch-choice, right?
rows.translation: 我想那只已经被你解决了，对吧？该死，真可惜。不、不、不过我知道，你大概也是别、别无选择，对吧？
rows.raw: " I guess you took care of that one, huh? Damn, what a shame. B-b-but I know you probably didn’t have a ch-choice, right?"

rows.original: I can never get c-close enough to be sure. Always flies off.
rows.translation: 我一直没法靠、靠得足够近来确认。它总会飞走。
rows.raw: " I can never get c-close enough to be sure. Always flies off."

rows.original: Out of curiosity, you have to ask: she saw the latest episode of her sister’s show, right?
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你不得不问：她看过姐姐节目的最新一集，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nOut of curiosity, you have to ask: she saw the latest episode of her sister’s show, right?"

rows.original: “Steph’s? Oh God no, I don’t watch that! I saw the Mhen’ga episode live and... never again. If Steffy wants to go sticking her hands in poor natives’ cooters, that’s, uh, that’s her business I guess. But I don’t have to watch it!”
rows.translation: “斯蒂芬的节目？哦，天啊，才没有，我不看那个！我现场看过姆亨加那一集，然后...再也不看了。如果小斯蒂芬想把手伸进可怜原住民的骚穴里，那，呃，我想那是她自己的事。但我可不必看！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steph’s? Oh God no, I don’t watch that! I saw the Mhen’ga episode live and... never again. If Steffy wants to go sticking her hands in poor natives’ cooters, that’s, uh, that’s her business I guess. But I don’t have to watch it!”"

rows.original: You suppose you’ll spare her the knowledge that her sister might have found the wyrm first...
rows.translation: 你想，还是别让她知道，她姐姐可能比她更早找到那条霜龙吧...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suppose you’ll spare her the knowledge that her sister might have found the wyrm first..."

rows.original: work
rows.raw: "work"

rows.original: “What do you do for fun, Nat? Surely you do something other than work.”
rows.translation: “你平时有什么消遣，娜特？你肯定不会除了工作什么都不做吧。”
rows.raw: " “What do you do for fun, Nat? Surely you do something other than work.”"

rows.original: She giggles pleasantly, sipping on her drink. “Um, not much, I guess. I kinda live my work. If I’m not clocked in with the Authority, I’m reading scientific journals or working on my own articles for publication. I don’t even really watch TV or anything these days...”
rows.translation: 她愉快地轻笑，喝了一口饮料。“呃，我想没什么。我几乎把工作当成生活。如果不是在管理局上班，我就在读科学期刊，或撰写自己准备发表的论文。我这些日子甚至不怎么看电视之类的东西了...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe giggles pleasantly, sipping on her drink. “Um, not much, I guess. I kinda live my work. If I’m not clocked in with the Authority, I’m reading scientific journals or working on my own articles for publication. I don’t even really watch TV or anything these days...”"

rows.original: Oh, come on, she’s gotta have fun sometime!
rows.translation: 哦，得了吧，她总该偶尔找点乐子！
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, come on, she’s gotta have fun sometime!"

rows.original: “Work is fun!” she pouts. You give her a look. “I... I guess I’m starting to like ice skating? I picked it up just to get around a little easier outside of town, but sometimes now I go out just to skate around in the evenings. Helps me clear my mind, you know? Just getting away from everything for a couple hours, in the fresh air, all by myself. It’s nice.”
rows.translation: “工作就是乐趣！”她撅嘴说道。你看了她一眼。“我...我想我开始喜欢滑冰了？起初学它只是为了在城外更方便地移动，但现在有时傍晚我也会特意出去滑一会儿。这样能帮我理清思绪，你懂吧？离开一切几个小时，在新鲜空气里独自待着。感觉很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Work is fun!” she pouts. You give her a look. “I... I guess I’m starting to like ice skating? I picked it up just to get around a little easier outside of town, but sometimes now I go out just to skate around in the evenings. Helps me clear my mind, you know? Just getting away from everything for a couple hours, in the fresh air, all by myself. It’s nice.”"

rows.original: Sounds nice, sure... except for the sub-zero weather and constant threat of attack outside the city walls. How does she deal with that?
rows.translation: 听起来确实不错...只要不考虑零下气温和城墙外随时可能遇袭的威胁。她是怎么应付这些的？
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds nice, sure... except for the sub-zero weather and constant threat of attack outside the city walls. How does she deal with that?"

rows.original: “Oh! Well, a heat belt mostly solves the first problem. Plus my big ol’ coat here, and a thermos of soup or three, and the cold doesn’t bother me too much anymore. Getting attacked out there, though, t-that’s a big deal! When I’m working I usually have some Authority drones with me, or I’m working in the shadow of the city’s defense guns, so I’m safe enough. But when I’m all on my own, yeah, it’s, um, scary sometimes I guess.”
rows.translation: “哦！嗯，一条保温腰带基本就能解决第一个问题。再加上我这件大外套，还有一保温瓶或三瓶汤，严寒现在已经不太困扰我了。不过在外面遇袭，那、那可是大问题！工作时我通常会带几架管理局无人机，或在城市防御炮的掩护范围内行动，所以足够安全。但独自一人时，是啊，我想有时还是，呃，挺吓人的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh! Well, a heat belt mostly solves the first problem. Plus my big ol’ coat here, and a thermos of soup or three, and the cold doesn’t bother me too much anymore. Getting attacked out there, though, t-that’s a big deal! When I’m working I usually have some Authority drones with me, or I’m working in the shadow of the city’s defense guns, so I’m safe enough. But when I’m all on my own, yeah, it’s, um, scary sometimes I guess.”"

rows.original: Natalie idly plays with a stray lock of hair, avoiding your gaze for a moment. “It’s fine though. Most of the local korgonne and milodan just ignore me, or at worst, just come over and try flirting. There’s a few that make a little game of it, I think, or else they’re just way more persistent than any boy back in the core. It would almost be flattering -- almost -- if the whole point wasn’t to just get away from everything. Everyone. Just for a little bit.”
rows.translation: 娜塔莉心不在焉地拨弄一绺散发，片刻间避开你的目光。“不过没关系。大多数本地科尔贡人和米洛丹人都会无视我，最糟也只是过来搭讪。我觉得有几个会把这当成小游戏，要不然他们就是比核心区的任何男孩都执着得多。如果我来这里的目的不是为了暂时逃离一切——逃离所有人——这几乎会让人受宠若惊。只是暂时逃开一会儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNatalie idly plays with a stray lock of hair, avoiding your gaze for a moment. “It’s fine though. Most of the local korgonne and milodan just ignore me, or at worst, just come over and try flirting. There’s a few that make a little game of it, I think, or else they’re just way more persistent than any boy back in the core. It would almost be flattering -- almost -- if the whole point wasn’t to just get away from everything. Everyone. Just for a little bit.”"

rows.original: interests
rows.raw: "interests"

rows.original: “Tell me about some of the creatures you’ve worked with.”
rows.translation: “跟我说说你接触过的一些生物吧。”
rows.raw: " “Tell me about some of the creatures you’ve worked with.”"

rows.original: “But there’s so many!” Nat laughs. “I’m really lucky: I’ve gotten to handle thousands of different species from across the galaxy. The Vesperian Royal Zoo had the most amazing collection, and they’d let us students come over pretty much whenever to handle them. I think the staff appreciated the help, and we loved getting to handle the exotic species.”
rows.translation: “但实在太多了！”娜特笑道。“我真的很幸运：我接触过来自银河各地的数千种不同物种。维斯佩里亚皇家动物园拥有最惊人的收藏，而且他们几乎随时都允许我们这些学生前去接触。我想工作人员也很感谢有人帮忙，而我们则很喜欢接触那些异域物种。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But there’s so many!” Nat laughs. “I’m really lucky: I’ve gotten to handle thousands of different species from across the galaxy. The Vesperian Royal Zoo had the most amazing collection, and they’d let us students come over pretty much whenever to handle them. I think the staff appreciated the help, and we loved getting to handle the exotic species.”"

rows.original: She hums happily to herself, thinking back with a growing smile. “Let’s see... probably the most interesting critter I ever got to work with was this huge, blue silicon-based life form. It was kind of like a dog, but with spikes all over, teeny little vestigial eyes, and a tail longer than it’s body and covered with razor spines. Looked like something out of a horror movie... but oh, she was just the sweetest little thing! Give her some android-grade silicone to munch on, and she’d just be putty in your arms. Those beauties really make friends for life, too: they imprint like ducks, see, and their memory lasts for decades! Every time I go back to Vesperia I swing by the zoo, and they all recognize me like we saw each other yesterday!”
rows.translation: 她愉快地轻哼着，回想往事时笑容愈发灿烂。“让我想想...我接触过最有趣的生物，大概是这种巨大的蓝色硅基生命。它有点像狗，但全身都是尖刺，退化的眼睛小得不得了，尾巴比身体还长，上面还长满剃刀般的棘刺。看起来就像恐怖电影里跑出来的...但天啊，她其实是最甜心的小家伙！只要给她一些安卓级硅胶嚼着，她就会在你怀里乖得像团软泥。这些漂亮生物也真的会交上一辈子的朋友：你看，它们会像鸭子一样产生印随行为，记忆还能持续几十年！每次回到维斯佩里亚，我都会顺道去动物园，而它们全都认得我，就像我们昨天才见过一样！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hums happily to herself, thinking back with a growing smile. “Let’s see... probably the most interesting critter I ever got to work with was this huge, blue silicon-based life form. It was kind of like a dog, but with spikes all over, teeny little vestigial eyes, and a tail longer than it’s body and covered with razor spines. Looked like something out of a horror movie... but oh, she was just the sweetest little thing! Give her some android-grade silicone to munch on, and she’d just be putty in your arms. Those beauties really make friends for life, too: they imprint like ducks, see, and their memory lasts for decades! Every time I go back to Vesperia I swing by the zoo, and they all recognize me like we saw each other yesterday!”"

rows.original: These creatures she’s talking about... “They’re not from New Texas, are they?”
rows.translation: 她说的这些生物...“它们不是来自新德克萨斯吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThese creatures she’s talking about... “They’re not from New Texas, are they?”"

rows.original: “They are!” Nat nods, eagerly. “Varmints, the New Texans call ‘em. Apparently they’re descended from a species of macro predators that fought against the colonists for decades. Really changed the way the whole planet’s ecology and terraforming process went, since the ‘varmints’ were almost impossible to kill. The col-”
rows.translation: “就是！”娜特热切地点头。“新德克萨斯人叫它们害兽。它们的祖先似乎是一种与殖民者鏖战数十年的巨型掠食者。因为这些‘害兽’几乎杀不死，它们彻底改变了整个星球的生态和地球化进程。殖——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They are!” Nat nods, eagerly. “Varmints, the New Texans call ‘em. Apparently they’re descended from a species of macro predators that fought against the colonists for decades. Really changed the way the whole planet’s ecology and terraforming process went, since the ‘varmints’ were almost impossible to kill. The col-”"

rows.original: Before she can launch off into the story in full, you put a hand up to indicate you’d like to speak. Natalie trails off, muttering “-lo. nists....” into her mug before falling silent. You take the opportunity to mention a little blue problem you’ve left aboard your ship. While the varmint hasn’t caused too much trouble, it certainly isn’t comforting having a snarling, razor-toothed beast stalking around the corridors.
rows.translation: 她还没来得及把整个故事讲开，你便抬手示意自己想说话。娜塔莉的声音渐渐低下去，对着杯子嘟囔“——民。者....”，随即安静下来。你趁机提到自己留在飞船上的那个蓝色小麻烦。虽然那只害兽没惹出太多乱子，但有一头咆哮着、长满利齿的猛兽在走廊里徘徊，肯定还是让人难以安心。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore she can launch off into the story in full, you put a hand up to indicate you’d like to speak. Natalie trails off, muttering “-lo. nists....” into her mug before falling silent. You take the opportunity to mention a little blue problem you’ve left aboard your ship. While the varmint hasn’t caused too much trouble, it certainly isn’t comforting having a snarling, razor-toothed beast stalking around the corridors."

rows.original: “Crikey, how’d you get it off New Texas?” Nat gawks. “You’ve gotta have a permit, and special dispensation, and-”
rows.translation: “老天，你怎么把它带离新德克萨斯的？”娜特目瞪口呆。“你得有许可证，还要特殊许可，而且——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Crikey, how’d you get it off New Texas?” Nat gawks. “You’ve gotta have a permit, and special dispensation, and-”"

rows.original: You shrug, saying that you sort of just walked off the planet with it. Customs didn’t exactly stop you... then again, you vaguely recall Amma was busy snowballing one of her bull-man’s loads with some ginger spacer sprawled over her desk when you wandered past. Ogram might have been a little distracted.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，说自己差不多就是带着它直接走出了那颗星球。海关并没有拦你...不过话说回来，你依稀记得自己经过时，阿玛正忙着和某个趴在她桌上的姜发太空人交换她那牛头人伴侣射出的精液。奥格拉姆可能也有点分心。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug, saying that you sort of just walked off the planet with it. Customs didn’t exactly stop you... then again, you vaguely recall Amma was busy snowballing one of her bull-man’s loads with some ginger spacer sprawled over her desk when you wandered past. Ogram might have been a little distracted."

rows.original: Nat blushes, covering her mouth with a hand to suppress a laugh. “O-oh wow. Um, that’s New Texas alright. So you’ve just got a varmint running wild on your ship, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 纳特脸上一红，用手掩住嘴忍笑。“哦-哦，哇。呃，确实很有新德州的作风。所以你就任由一只害兽在船上到处乱跑，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat blushes, covering her mouth with a hand to suppress a laugh. “O-oh wow. Um, that’s New Texas alright. So you’ve just got a varmint running wild on your ship, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You nod, and Nat grimaces. “You, uh, you should probably do something about that. Varmints can eat through machinery if they get too hungry. Or scared. Making a warp jump probably traumatized the poor thing, too! Go find a tub of silicone or something -- I can help you if you want.”
rows.translation: 你点点头，纳特皱起脸来。“你，呃，你最好处理一下。害兽太饿或太害怕时，能把机械设备啃穿。进行跃迁大概也把这个可怜的小家伙吓坏了！去找一桶硅胶之类的东西吧 -- 你愿意的话，我可以帮忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and Nat grimaces. “You, uh, you should probably do something about that. Varmints can eat through machinery if they get too hungry. Or scared. Making a warp jump probably traumatized the poor thing, too! Go find a tub of silicone or something -- I can help you if you want.”"

rows.original: monsters
rows.raw: "monsters"

rows.original: “You’re from New Brisbane, right?”
rows.translation: “你来自新布里斯班，对吧？”
rows.raw: " “You’re from New Brisbane, right?”"

rows.original: Natalie nods, “Sure am, born and raised! You ever been?”
rows.translation: 娜塔莉点点头，“没错，我在那里土生土长！你去过吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNatalie nods, “Sure am, born and raised! You ever been?”"

rows.original: You shake your head. N.B. is deep core-ward, and Steele Tech never had a real presence there.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。新布里斯班深入星核方向，斯蒂尔科技在那里一直没有真正的业务。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. N.B. is deep core-ward, and Steele Tech never had a real presence there."

rows.original: “Shame. It’s a real beauty, the old homeworld,” Nat muses, looking far away. You catch a hint of accent creeping into her voice, though it vanishes quickly: “Well, it’s got its own kinda beauty, I guess. See, New Brisbane was a real early colony, the kind they had to slow-boat to with a generation ship. But when our ancestors got there, they found the planet was this huge jungle world, completely overrun with enormous toxic plants and flesh-eating creatures. One of the deadliest worlds Mankind had ever encountered... and it was the only habitable world in the system, or anywhere nearby. It came down to a single-digits break in the vote to actually try and settle there rather than just keep going.”
rows.translation: “真可惜。那颗古老的家园星球确实很美，”纳特若有所思地说道，目光飘向远方。你听出她的声音中悄然流露出一丝口音，不过很快便消失了：“嗯，我想它自有一种美。你看，新布里斯班是个非常早期的殖民地，殖民者得搭乘世代飞船，慢悠悠地航行过去。但我们的祖先抵达后，却发现那颗星球是个巨大的丛林世界，到处都是庞大的有毒植物和食肉生物。那是人类遇到过最致命的世界之一...偏偏它又是那个星系乃至附近区域唯一的宜居世界。最终，决定尝试在那里定居、而不是继续前进的投票，只以个位数票数的微弱差距通过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shame. It’s a real beauty, the old homeworld,” Nat muses, looking far away. You catch a hint of accent creeping into her voice, though it vanishes quickly: “Well, it’s got its own kinda beauty, I guess. See, New Brisbane was a real early colony, the kind they had to slow-boat to with a generation ship. But when our ancestors got there, they found the planet was this huge jungle world, completely overrun with enormous toxic plants and flesh-eating creatures. One of the deadliest worlds Mankind had ever encountered... and it was the only habitable world in the system, or anywhere nearby. It came down to a single-digits break in the vote to actually try and settle there rather than just keep going.”"

rows.original: Yikes. It was really that bad?
rows.translation: 嚯。情况真的有那么糟？
rows.raw: "\n\nYikes. It was really that bad?"

rows.original: “Still is!” Nat admits, taking a long draught from her mug. “The planet’s only got a few cities on it today, big walled mega-cities so packed full of people you can’t stretch without rubbing up on a dozen strangers. And polluted, too, no matter how hard they work the atmospheric processors. But take one step outside the city walls, and it’s like this sudden rush of freedom -- it’s amazing. And then you get eaten by earth-eating worms the size of your space ship. Everything outside the walls wants to kill you: plants, animals, bacteria... I’m an expert in the subject, a-and I don’t know how my ancestors settled the place! Nowadays we don’t go outside the walls without armored suits, packed like sardines into ground-crawlers.”
rows.translation: “现在还是那么糟！”纳特承认道，从杯中喝了一大口。“如今那颗星球上只有寥寥几座城市，全是筑有高墙的巨型都市，人口密集到你伸个懒腰都能蹭到十几个陌生人。而且污染也很严重，无论他们怎么努力运转大气处理器都无济于事。但只要跨出城墙一步，就会突然感受到一股自由 -- 简直妙不可言。接着你就会被和太空船一样大的食土蠕虫吃掉。城墙外的一切都想杀了你：植物、动物、细菌...我可是这方面的专家，可-可我都不知道祖先当年是怎么在那里定居的！如今我们没有装甲服绝不出城，还得像沙丁鱼一样挤进地面爬行车里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Still is!” Nat admits, taking a long draught from her mug. “The planet’s only got a few cities on it today, big walled mega-cities so packed full of people you can’t stretch without rubbing up on a dozen strangers. And polluted, too, no matter how hard they work the atmospheric processors. But take one step outside the city walls, and it’s like this sudden rush of freedom -- it’s amazing. And then you get eaten by earth-eating worms the size of your space ship. Everything outside the walls wants to kill you: plants, animals, bacteria... I’m an expert in the subject, a-and I don’t know how my ancestors settled the place! Nowadays we don’t go outside the walls without armored suits, packed like sardines into ground-crawlers.”"

rows.original: Anything else she can tell you about the planet? Maybe something less depressing?
rows.translation: 关于那颗星球，她还有别的能告诉你吗？最好是没这么令人沮丧的事？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnything else she can tell you about the planet? Maybe something less depressing?"

rows.original: “Oh, it’s not that bad,” Nat groans. “I mean, it sounds bad I admit. B-but it was an okay place to grow up, at least as long as you lived above ground. The ground-siders had it pretty rough, but I was born mid-tier. Uh, middle class, I guess you’d say anywhere else. It wasn’t so bad. We have the best technology in the galaxy, and you grow up with so many friends... when I went to Vesperia later, it seemed so barren with only a few thousand people on campus. I still keep in touch with, gosh, a couple hundred people from my home block.”
rows.translation: “哦，也没那么糟，”纳特呻吟道。“我是说，我承认它听起来很糟。可-可那里还算适合长大，至少只要你住在地面以上。住在地面的人日子很苦，但我出生在中层。呃，放在其他地方，大概就是所谓的中产阶级吧。其实没有那么坏。我们拥有全银河最先进的技术，而且你从小就会有许多朋友...后来我去了维斯佩里亚，校园里只有几千人，感觉简直空空荡荡。我现在还和老家街区的，天啊，大概两百个人保持联系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’s not that bad,” Nat groans. “I mean, it sounds bad I admit. B-but it was an okay place to grow up, at least as long as you lived above ground. The ground-siders had it pretty rough, but I was born mid-tier. Uh, middle class, I guess you’d say anywhere else. It wasn’t so bad. We have the best technology in the galaxy, and you grow up with so many friends... when I went to Vesperia later, it seemed so barren with only a few thousand people on campus. I still keep in touch with, gosh, a couple hundred people from my home block.” "

rows.original: She smiles and flicks her fingers across a small wrist device, bringing up a scrolling holographic display of face after face. “Well, anyway, what about you? What was your homeworld like?”
rows.translation: 她微笑着用手指划过腕上的小型设备，调出滚动显示着一张张面孔的全息画面。“好啦，说起来，你呢？你的家园星球是什么样的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles and flicks her fingers across a small wrist device, bringing up a scrolling holographic display of face after face. “Well, anyway, what about you? What was your homeworld like?”"

rows.original: Not much to tell, there. Every human ought to know what good old Terra’s like, after all. Still, you don’t mind spending a few minutes talking about where you and Dad spent your early life, the places you went, the people there... though compared to the adventures you and the Irsons go on now, well, it seems so mundane in comparison!
rows.translation: 这方面没什么可说的。毕竟每个人类都该知道亲爱的老地球是什么样子。不过，你并不介意花几分钟谈谈你和父亲度过童年时光的地方、去过的地点和遇见的人...只是与如今你和厄森姐妹经历的冒险相比，那一切显得实在太平凡了！
rows.raw: "\n\nNot much to tell, there. Every human ought to know what good old Terra’s like, after all. Still, you don’t mind spending a few minutes talking about where you and Dad spent your early life, the places you went, the people there... though compared to the adventures you and the Irsons go on now, well, it seems so mundane in comparison!"

rows.original: home
rows.raw: "home"

rows.original: “So, how are you liking Uveto?” As you speak, you glance around the Freezer’s nordic-themed walls. This is certainly the warmest place in the city, despite the name -- anywhere outside is a frozen wasteland, as far as you can tell.
rows.translation: “那么，你觉得乌维托怎么样？”说话时，你环顾冷冻库北欧风格的墙壁。尽管名字如此，这里无疑是城里最温暖的地方 -- 据你所见，外面任何地方都是冰封荒原。
rows.raw: " “So, how are you liking Uveto?” As you speak, you glance around the Freezer’s nordic-themed walls. This is certainly the warmest place in the city, despite the name -- anywhere outside is a frozen wasteland, as far as you can tell."

rows.original: “It’s wonderful!” Nat answers immediately. “I-I mean, I know it doesn’t look like much. Actually less than that, if you don’t like the constant cold and dark and rowdy furries. But I don’t mind! The snow and ice are beautiful in the light of the gas giant, I think, and the people here have been nothing but friendly. I expected a place this harsh to be full of gruff assholes, the kind of wouldn’t give an outsider the time of day. But really, I guess ausar are ausar wherever you go: they’re sweeties. Even that weirdo human cult here, the Stormwhatevers, are pretty friendly as long as you don’t try and act all tough. Otherwise they just wanna fight you!”
rows.translation: “这里太棒了！”纳特立刻回答。“我-我是说，我知道这里看起来没什么了不起。其实，要是你不喜欢永无止境的寒冷、黑暗和吵闹的毛茸茸居民，那还不如没什么可看呢。但我不介意！我觉得在气态巨行星的光芒下，冰雪美极了，而且这里的人一直都非常友善。我原以为环境如此恶劣的地方会住满粗鲁的混蛋，就是那种根本不搭理外来者的人。不过我想，无论去到哪里，奥萨尔终究是奥萨尔：他们都是甜心。就连这里那个古怪的人类教派，那些什么风暴来着，只要你别装得特别强硬，他们也挺友善的。否则他们只会想跟你打一架！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s wonderful!” Nat answers immediately. “I-I mean, I know it doesn’t look like much. Actually less than that, if you don’t like the constant cold and dark and rowdy furries. But I don’t mind! The snow and ice are beautiful in the light of the gas giant, I think, and the people here have been nothing but friendly. I expected a place this harsh to be full of gruff assholes, the kind of wouldn’t give an outsider the time of day. But really, I guess ausar are ausar wherever you go: they’re sweeties. Even that weirdo human cult here, the Stormwhatevers, are pretty friendly as long as you don’t try and act all tough. Otherwise they just wanna fight you!”"

rows.original: She chuckles. “I dunno. I like it here. Though I miss the suns from back home...”
rows.translation: 她轻笑一声。“我也不知道。我喜欢这里。不过我很想念故乡的太阳...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles. “I dunno. I like it here. Though I miss the suns from back home...”"

rows.original: You nod understandingly. The atmosphere around the planet is certainly... different.
rows.translation: 你理解地点点头。这颗星球周围的氛围确实...与众不同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod understandingly. The atmosphere around the planet is certainly... different."

rows.original: uveto
rows.raw: "uveto"

rows.original: monsters
rows.raw: "monsters"

rows.original: varmint
rows.raw: "varmint"

rows.original: “Hey, think you could help me with that varmint problem?”
rows.translation: “嘿，你能帮我解决那只害兽的问题吗？”
rows.raw: "“Hey, think you could help me with that varmint problem?”"

rows.original: Nat blinks. “O-oh, you were serious? Wow, uh, yeah I guess, sure. Do you have any silicone? A lot of it -- like, an entire bag. Varmints think with their stomachs first, brains second. Feeding ‘em will make them love you faster than anything, but if the poor darling’s already traumatized...”
rows.translation: 纳特眨眨眼。“哦-哦，你是认真的？哇，呃，好吧，我想可以，当然。你有硅胶吗？要很多 -- 比如整整一袋。害兽思考时胃排第一，脑子排第二。喂饱它们，比什么都能更快让它们喜欢上你；但如果那个可怜的小宝贝已经受了惊吓...”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat blinks. “O-oh, you were serious? Wow, uh, yeah I guess, sure. Do you have any silicone? A lot of it -- like, an entire bag. Varmints think with their stomachs first, brains second. Feeding ‘em will make them love you faster than anything, but if the poor darling’s already traumatized...”"

rows.original: “Sure do,” you answer, tapping the bag sticking out of your pack. “Let’s go.”
rows.translation: “当然有，”你一边回答，一边轻点从背包里露出的袋子。“走吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure do,” you answer, tapping the bag sticking out of your pack. “Let’s go.”"

rows.original: Nat nods, pounds back the rest of her drink, and waves towards the door. “After you, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 纳特点点头，一口喝光剩余的饮料，朝门口挥了挥手。“你先请，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNat nods, pounds back the rest of her drink, and waves towards the door. “After you, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You slip out of the booth and turn towards the door. Back into orbit you go...
rows.translation: 你从卡座中钻出来，转身走向门口。又得回到轨道上了...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slip out of the booth and turn towards the door. Back into orbit you go..."

rows.original: You shake your head. You don’t have enough silicone on hand to feed the big blue beast.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头。手头的硅胶不够喂饱那只蓝色巨兽。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shake your head. You don’t have enough silicone on hand to feed the big blue beast."

rows.original: “Okay,” Nat says. “No problem. Go find some, and bring ‘er back here. I’ll help you sort the little guy out, but we’re gonna need the r-r-raw materials, first.”
rows.translation: “好吧，”纳特说道。“没问题。去找一些，再把它带回这里。我会帮你安顿好那个小家伙，但首先我们需要原-原-原材料。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay,” Nat says. “No problem. Go find some, and bring ‘er back here. I’ll help you sort the little guy out, but we’re gonna need the r-r-raw materials, first.”"

rows.original: Taming the Varmint
rows.translation: 驯服害兽
rows.raw: "Taming the Varmint"

rows.original: After a quick stop by Nat’s apartment to gather some things she claims she’ll need, the two of you make your way up the space elevator and through the docking arm back to your vessel. You lead Natalie aboard, and over towards the small recess in your ship’s supply stash where the blue-plated varmint’s made its nest. Natalie gasps when she sees the creature, but it’s one of giddy joy rather than fear.
rows.translation: 你们先在纳特的公寓短暂停留，拿上她声称会用到的一些东西，随后两人乘太空电梯上行，穿过对接臂，回到你的飞船。你领着娜塔莉登船，走向船上储藏区的一处小凹室，披着蓝色甲壳的害兽已在那里筑起巢穴。娜塔莉看到这只生物时倒吸一口气，不过那是欣喜若狂，而非恐惧。
rows.raw: "After a quick stop by Nat’s apartment to gather some things she claims she’ll need, the two of you make your way up the space elevator and through the docking arm back to your vessel. You lead Natalie aboard, and over towards the small recess in your ship’s supply stash where the blue-plated varmint’s made its nest. Natalie gasps when she sees the creature, but it’s one of giddy joy rather than fear."

rows.original: You hand over the silicone bag and let your partner get to work.
rows.translation: 你递过硅胶袋，让同伴开始忙活。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hand over the silicone bag and let your partner get to work."

rows.original: “Hey there, darlin’,” Natalie coos, putting a friendly hand out towards the varmint. It snarls and hoots softly, recoiling towards the bulkhead until it’s pressed flat against the cold metal, bearing its teeth. “Don’t be scared, sweetie. I’m not gonna hurt you.”
rows.translation: “嘿，小宝贝，”娜塔莉柔声哄道，友善地向害兽伸出一只手。它低声咆哮并发出轻柔的咕咕声，朝舱壁退去，直到身体紧贴冰冷金属，露出尖牙。“别害怕，甜心。我不会伤害你的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there, darlin’,” Natalie coos, putting a friendly hand out towards the varmint. It snarls and hoots softly, recoiling towards the bulkhead until it’s pressed flat against the cold metal, bearing its teeth. “Don’t be scared, sweetie. I’m not gonna hurt you.”"

rows.original: She takes a step forward, then immediately yanks herself back when the varmint snaps. Nat doesn’t skip a beat, though, but rather lunges forward and grabs two of its head-spikes, holding its head so that its snapping fangs can’t get near her.
rows.translation: 她向前迈出一步，害兽一口咬来时又立刻抽身后退。不过纳特毫不停顿，反而猛扑上前，抓住它头上的两根尖刺，牢牢固定住它的脑袋，不让咬合的尖牙接近自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a step forward, then immediately yanks herself back when the varmint snaps. Nat doesn’t skip a beat, though, but rather lunges forward and grabs two of its head-spikes, holding its head so that its snapping fangs can’t get near her."

rows.original: “There we go! Good girl,” Nat murmurs, so softly you can barely hear her over the creature’s owl-like cries. “Shhh now. Shh. Here...”
rows.translation: “就是这样！好姑娘，”纳特低声呢喃，声音轻得几乎被这只生物猫头鹰般的叫声盖住。“嘘，安静。嘘。来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There we go! Good girl,” Nat murmurs, so softly you can barely hear her over the creature’s owl-like cries. “Shhh now. Shh. Here...”"

rows.original: Using her foot, Nat rolls the silicone bag over, sliding it right under the varmint’s forelegs. It stops snarling almost immediately, sniffs at the air, and then hoots softly. Nat pushes it back by the horns, angling its snout down towards the metallic casing, and then releases it. Rather than attacking her, the varmint grabs the bag in its fangs and scrambles back. One good bite punches through the casing, and liquid silicone pours out into its mouth. Just like a dog, it starts lapping the stuff up off the deck, seemingly contented and completely ignoring you and Nat.
rows.translation: 纳特用脚把硅胶袋滚过去，正好送到害兽的前腿下方。它几乎立刻停止咆哮，嗅了嗅空气，随后轻声咕叫。纳特按着它的角把脑袋往后推，又将吻部朝金属外壳压下，然后松开手。害兽没有攻击她，而是用尖牙叼住袋子，迅速退了回去。它狠狠一口咬穿外壳，液态硅胶随即涌入口中。它像狗一样开始舔食洒在甲板上的东西，看起来心满意足，完全无视了你和纳特。
rows.raw: "\n\nUsing her foot, Nat rolls the silicone bag over, sliding it right under the varmint’s forelegs. It stops snarling almost immediately, sniffs at the air, and then hoots softly. Nat pushes it back by the horns, angling its snout down towards the metallic casing, and then releases it. Rather than attacking her, the varmint grabs the bag in its fangs and scrambles back. One good bite punches through the casing, and liquid silicone pours out into its mouth. Just like a dog, it starts lapping the stuff up off the deck, seemingly contented and completely ignoring you and Nat."

rows.original: “Good girl,” Natalie chuckles, taking a leash and collar out of her pack. “Now just remember our faces. Remember who feeds you... there’s a girl.”
rows.translation: “好姑娘，”娜塔莉轻笑着从背包里取出牵引绳和项圈。“现在要记住我们的脸。记住是谁喂你...真乖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good girl,” Natalie chuckles, taking a leash and collar out of her pack. “Now just remember our faces. Remember who feeds you... there’s a girl.”"

rows.original: “Are you sure it’s a girl?” you ask, watching Nat slowly work the collar around the varmint’s tree-trunk neck. The varmint makes a sound somewhere between a husky moan and a bovine braying, but doesn’t object to Natalie’s collaring it.
rows.translation: “你确定它是母的吗？”你问道，看着纳特慢慢把项圈套上害兽树干般粗壮的脖颈。害兽发出一种介于沙哑呻吟与牛叫之间的声音，但并未抗拒娜塔莉给它戴上项圈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you sure it’s a girl?” you ask, watching Nat slowly work the collar around the varmint’s tree-trunk neck. The varmint makes a sound somewhere between a husky moan and a bovine braying, but doesn’t object to Natalie’s collaring it."

rows.original: She turns and gives you a wink. “Call it... feminine instinct. Also females have these little tail-ridges here, see?”
rows.translation: 她转过身朝你眨眨眼。“就当是...女性直觉吧。而且雌性的尾巴上会有这些小棱脊，看见了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns and gives you a wink. “Call it... feminine instinct. Also females have these little tail-ridges here, see?”"

rows.original: She laughs at your reaction, and hands the leash over to you. “Just let her eat for a bit and try and stay with her. She should have imprinted on both of us -- it’s this weird feeding instincts they keep from when they’re little. Anybody that feeds ‘em is basically mommy and daddy now. Let ‘er eat up, and she should come and snuggle like a puppy. Just, uh, ignore the smell -- they excrete gasses through those pores around the... never mind. Here ya go.”
rows.translation: 她被你的反应逗笑，把牵引绳交给你。“先让她吃一会儿，你也尽量陪在身边。她应该已经对我们两个产生了印随行为 -- 这是它们幼年时期保留下来的一种奇怪进食本能。现在只要谁喂过它们，谁基本上就是妈妈和爸爸了。让她吃饱，之后她就会像小狗一样过来依偎。只是，呃，别理会那股气味 -- 它们会通过那些气孔排出气体，就在...算了。给你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs at your reaction, and hands the leash over to you. “Just let her eat for a bit and try and stay with her. She should have imprinted on both of us -- it’s this weird feeding instincts they keep from when they’re little. Anybody that feeds ‘em is basically mommy and daddy now. Let ‘er eat up, and she should come and snuggle like a puppy. Just, uh, ignore the smell -- they excrete gasses through those pores around the... never mind. Here ya go.”"

rows.original: You take the leash, leaning tentatively down to pet the varmint on its big, plated brow. It murmurs at you, making hooting sounds and wagging its spiked tail across the deck.
rows.translation: 你接过牵引绳，小心地俯身抚摸害兽覆着大片甲壳的额头。它朝你低鸣，发出咕咕声，同时让长满尖刺的尾巴在甲板上来回摇摆。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the leash, leaning tentatively down to pet the varmint on its big, plated brow. It murmurs at you, making hooting sounds and wagging its spiked tail across the deck."

rows.original: Looks like you have a new friend.
rows.translation: 看来你交到了一个新朋友。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like you have a new friend."

rows.original: “Well, there you go,” Nat grins, watching the two of you bond over a breached silicone bag. “That was fun, [pc.name]! Lemme know if you ever get another spooked critter aboard -- I’m always happy to help.”
rows.translation: “好了，搞定，”纳特笑着看你们俩借由破开的硅胶袋建立感情。“真有意思，[pc.name]！以后船上要是又来了受惊的小动物，记得告诉我 -- 我随时乐意帮忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, there you go,” Nat grins, watching the two of you bond over a breached silicone bag. “That was fun, [pc.name]! Lemme know if you ever get another spooked critter aboard -- I’m always happy to help.”"

rows.original: She certainly seems so. Nat was more in her element the last few minutes than you’ve ever seen her before. Adjusting the hem of her jacket, Natalie turns towards the airlock. “I, uh, I’ll leave you two to it. See you around, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 看来确实如此。过去几分钟里的纳特，比你以前见过的任何时候都更如鱼得水。娜塔莉整理了一下外套下摆，转身走向气闸。“我，呃，就不打扰你们俩了。回头见，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe certainly seems so. Nat was more in her element the last few minutes than you’ve ever seen her before. Adjusting the hem of her jacket, Natalie turns towards the airlock. “I, uh, I’ll leave you two to it. See you around, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Nat starts walking, but stops beside you, hesitating just long enough to decide to give you a quick, air-light hug before hustling towards the airlock.
rows.translation: 纳特迈步离开，却在你身旁停下；她迟疑片刻，最终决定给你一个轻若空气的短暂拥抱，随后匆匆赶往气闸。

rows.original: You notice a blonde woman sitting in one of the booths near the back of the bar, cradling a mug of something frothy and steaming. Unlike most of the natives’ cold color palettes, she’s wearing a khaki button-up shirt and trousers underneath a wool-padded jacket and pulled-up hood. She’s sitting quietly and alone, looking very much like she doesn’t want to be disturbed. Your attention almost wanders right by her, until you realize... she looks an awful lot like Steph Irson. Could it be...?
rows.translation: 你注意到酒吧后方附近的一处卡座里坐着一个金发女人，双手捧着一杯冒着热气、浮着泡沫的饮料。与大多数本地居民的冷色装束不同，她在带羊毛衬垫的外套和拉起的兜帽下，穿着卡其色纽扣衬衫与长裤。她独自安静地坐着，一副非常不想受人打扰的样子。你的注意力差点从她身上掠过，直到你意识到...她长得非常像斯蒂芬·厄森。难道是...？
