rows.translation: 这名兔女郎强健地绷紧肌肉，双腿与她所酷似的地球兔子一样有力。新点子冒出来时，她强壮得足以在欣喜若狂中绕着房间蹦跳；若你惹她发怒，她也能轻蔑而轻松地一脚把你踹下楼梯。
rows.raw: "\n\nFlexing powerfully, the lapine woman’s legs are every bit as powerful as the terran creature’s she resembles. She’s strong enough to hop around the room in the throes of gleeful mania when a new idea strikes her - or punt you down the stairs with contemptuous ease, should you raise her ire."

rows.original: Those plus-sized snow-boots look like they’d smart.
rows.translation: 那双超大号雪地靴踹起来肯定很疼。
rows.raw: " Those plus-sized snow-boots look like they’d smart."

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Nayna’s ears perk up a little higher. “Oh, do you want to talk some more?” Suddenly, she seems terribly, almost violently lonely - and grateful for the companionship.
rows.translation: 奈娜的耳朵又竖高了一些。“噢，你想再聊一会儿吗？”她突然显得孤独得可怕，几乎到了强烈的程度，同时又对有人陪伴满怀感激。
rows.raw: "Nayna’s ears perk up a little higher. “Oh, do you want to talk some more?” Suddenly, she seems terribly, almost violently lonely - and grateful for the companionship."

rows.original: “Actually, I’d like to talk.”
rows.translation: “其实，我想聊聊天。”
rows.raw: "“Actually, I’d like to talk.”"

rows.original: Nayna cocks her head to the side, staring at you blankly. “Why... why would you want to talk with me? I’m not permitted to share the finer details of my project until we’ve published, and well, I’m just a dumpy little laquine. Surely you can make better use of your time entertaining beautiful rahn dancers and adorable ausar.”
rows.translation: 奈娜把头歪向一旁，茫然地盯着你。“为什么...你为什么想跟我聊天？在发表成果以前，我不能透露项目的具体细节；而且，我只是一只又矮又胖的兔族。你肯定可以把时间花在陪伴漂亮的拉恩舞娘和可爱的奥萨人上，更有价值。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNayna cocks her head to the side, staring at you blankly. “Why... why would you want to talk with me? I’m not permitted to share the finer details of my project until we’ve published, and well, I’m just a dumpy little laquine. Surely you can make better use of your time entertaining beautiful rahn dancers and adorable ausar.”"

rows.original: “Don’t say that! You’re so fucking cute! I mean... look at that bunny bootie! The boys would eat it right up in a heartbeat.” You walk around behind her and bend low, making exaggerated chomping motions with your mouth.
rows.translation: “别这么说！你他妈可爱极了！我是说...看看这只兔兔翘臀！那些男人转眼间就会恨不得把它吃掉。”你绕到她身后弯下腰，故意夸张地做出大口啃咬的动作。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t say that! You’re so fucking cute! I mean... look at that bunny bootie! The boys would eat it right up in a heartbeat.” You walk around behind her and bend low, making exaggerated chomping motions with your mouth."

rows.original: “Oh come on, I’m sure there are plenty of people that would absolutely love an adorable bunny like you to snuggle up against.” You walk in a circle around her, mock examining her. “Yeah, you’ve just got to be more confident about yourself.”
rows.translation: “噢，得了吧，我敢肯定有很多人会非常乐意搂着你这样可爱的兔子依偎。”你绕着她走了一圈，装模作样地审视她。“没错，你只需要对自己更有信心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh come on, I’m sure there are plenty of people that would absolutely love an adorable bunny like you to snuggle up against.” You walk in a circle around her, mock examining her. “Yeah, you’ve just got to be more confident about yourself.”"

rows.original: “Well, let me check.” You circle around her, scratching your chin and nodding to yourself, occasionally muttering, ‘mmhmm’. After a minute of this, you stop in front of her and proclaim, “Definitely worth my time. Sorry, Nayna. You can’t get away from me that easily.”
rows.translation: “好吧，让我检查一下。”你绕着她转圈，一边挠下巴一边自顾自地点头，偶尔嘟囔几声“嗯哼”。一分钟后，你停在她面前宣布：“绝对值得我花时间。抱歉，奈娜。你可没那么容易甩掉我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, let me check.” You circle around her, scratching your chin and nodding to yourself, occasionally muttering, ‘mmhmm’. After a minute of this, you stop in front of her and proclaim, “Definitely worth my time. Sorry, Nayna. You can’t get away from me that easily.”"

rows.original: “I’ll be the judge of what’s worth my time, Nayna.” You nod curtly, “but if you insist on being evaluated by your mere physical attributes, I find you to be acceptable company. Now let’s talk.”
rows.translation: “什么值得我花时间，由我自己判断，奈娜。”你简短地点头，“不过既然你坚持要人仅凭外貌来评价，我认为你是可以接受的聊天对象。现在我们聊聊吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll be the judge of what’s worth my time, Nayna.” You nod curtly, “but if you insist on being evaluated by your mere physical attributes, I find you to be acceptable company. Now let’s talk.”"

rows.original: “Oh.” Covering her mouth in embarrassment, the white-haired hare quietly asks, “So... um... what did you want to talk about?”
rows.translation: “噢。”白发兔女郎尴尬地捂住嘴，小声问道：“所以...呃...你想聊些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh.” Covering her mouth in embarrassment, the white-haired hare quietly asks, “So... um... what did you want to talk about?”"

rows.original: Nayna’s ears perk halfway up. “Really? You want to talk again?” She seems genuinely surprised by your request. “But what are we going to talk about? I’m so boring.” Flopping back, she drops her Codex and looks up at you, expecting you to save her with a topic.
rows.translation: 奈娜的耳朵竖起一半。“真的？你还想聊天？”她似乎真心对你的请求感到惊讶。“可我们要聊什么呢？我太无趣了。”她向后一倒，CODEX终端也随之掉下，随后仰头望着你，等你找个话题来拯救她。
rows.raw: "\n\nNayna’s ears perk halfway up. “Really? You want to talk again?” She seems genuinely surprised by your request. “But what are we going to talk about? I’m so boring.” Flopping back, she drops her Codex and looks up at you, expecting you to save her with a topic."

rows.original: Her
rows.translation: 她本人
rows.raw: "Her"

rows.original: Education
rows.translation: 教育
rows.raw: "Education"

rows.original: Uveto
rows.translation: 乌维托
rows.raw: "Uveto"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “What about you? I don’t even know your full name.”
rows.translation: “聊聊你吧？我甚至还不知道你的全名。”
rows.raw: "“What about you? I don’t even know your full name.”"

rows.original: Nayna grabs onto your conversational lifeline with both hands. “Oh, of course! Sorry about that. My full name is Nayna Triverre. I’ve gotten so used to interfacing the crude mining folk here that I guess civilized courtesy has escaped me.” She blinks innocently at you, then gasps once she realizes you expect more, floundering around as she searches for more to say. “Oh, and I’m a laquine, I guess, but you know that, right? I mean, I have these big dumb ears and this stupid little twitchy nose. It’d be hard to miss.”
rows.translation: 奈娜像抓住救命稻草般双手攥住你抛出的话题。“噢，当然！抱歉。我的全名是奈娜·特里韦尔。我已经习惯了和这里粗俗的矿工打交道，大概连文明社会的礼貌都忘了。”她天真地眨眨眼，直到发现你还在等她继续才倒吸一口气，慌忙搜肠刮肚地寻找更多话说。“噢，而且我想，我是兔族，不过你知道吧？我是说，我长着这对又大又蠢的耳朵，还有这个傻乎乎、会抽动的小鼻子。很难看不出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNayna grabs onto your conversational lifeline with both hands. “Oh, of course! Sorry about that. My full name is Nayna Triverre. I’ve gotten so used to interfacing the crude mining folk here that I guess civilized courtesy has escaped me.” She blinks innocently at you, then gasps once she realizes you expect more, floundering around as she searches for more to say. “Oh, and I’m a laquine, I guess, but you know that, right? I mean, I have these big dumb ears and this stupid little twitchy nose. It’d be hard to miss.”"

rows.original: You nod
rows.translation: 你点点头
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod"

rows.original: , hoping she’ll tell you something a little less obvious.
rows.translation: ，希望她能告诉你些没那么显而易见的事。
rows.raw: ", hoping she’ll tell you something a little less obvious."

rows.original: , but mention that there’s nothing dumb or stupid about the way she looks.
rows.translation: ，但也提到她的外表一点也不蠢，更不显得笨。
rows.raw: ", but mention that there’s nothing dumb or stupid about the way she looks."

rows.original: Nayna blunders right on. Now that she’s gotten started, it seems like her mouth is ready to go on autopilot. “And since I’m a laquine hermaphrodite, everybody pushed me into science. What kind of weird culture expects that sort of thing, anyway? Just because you get born with a vagina and an under-sized penis doesn’t mean you’re going to be better at science.” She looks away and gasps, realizing what she just said. “You aren’t offended, are you? I know some coreward folks get uncomfortable about stuff like this.”
rows.translation: 奈娜不管不顾地继续说了下去。既然已经开了头，她的嘴似乎便准备进入自动驾驶模式。“而且，因为我是拉奎因双性人，所有人都把我往科学领域里推。到底是什么怪异文化会期待这种事？出生时既有小穴又有一根尺寸偏小的阴茎，并不代表你就会更擅长科学。”她移开目光，意识到自己刚才说了什么后倒吸一口气。“你没觉得被冒犯吧？我知道有些来自核心星域的人会对这种话题感到不自在。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNayna blunders right on. Now that she’s gotten started, it seems like her mouth is ready to go on autopilot. “And since I’m a laquine hermaphrodite, everybody pushed me into science. What kind of weird culture expects that sort of thing, anyway? Just because you get born with a vagina and an under-sized penis doesn’t mean you’re going to be better at science.” She looks away and gasps, realizing what she just said. “You aren’t offended, are you? I know some coreward folks get uncomfortable about stuff like this.”"

rows.original: Openly grinning, you let her know that you’ve seen far worse in your journeys.
rows.translation: 你毫不掩饰地咧嘴一笑，告诉她自己在旅途中见过比这过分得多的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nOpenly grinning, you let her know that you’ve seen far worse in your journeys."

rows.original: “Oh... okay then.” Nayna sits a little straighter and explains. “A lot of the other kids thought I won the genetic lottery, getting to be a hermaphrodite. The best of both worlds right? Well, I think I lost it, twice. I’d be just as good of a scientist if I was a normal girl or boy. And maybe I wouldn’t have wound up so stunted and fat.” Blushing, she adds, “I didn’t even get a normal sized dick! It should be twice as long. Who would even want to use a nine incher? Not me, that’s for damned sure, but who needs sex, anyway?”
rows.translation: “哦...那就好。”奈娜坐得稍微挺直了些，解释道：“很多其他孩子都觉得我中了大奖，天生就是双性人。两全其美，对吧？可我觉得自己输了，而且输得两次。就算我是普通女孩或男孩，也一样能成为优秀的科学家。说不定还不会长得这么矮胖。”她红着脸补充道：“我连正常尺寸的肉棒都没长出来！它本该有现在两倍长。谁会想用一根九英寸的小玩意？反正我绝对不想，不过谁又需要性爱呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh... okay then.” Nayna sits a little straighter and explains. “A lot of the other kids thought I won the genetic lottery, getting to be a hermaphrodite. The best of both worlds right? Well, I think I lost it, twice. I’d be just as good of a scientist if I was a normal girl or boy. And maybe I wouldn’t have wound up so stunted and fat.” Blushing, she adds, “I didn’t even get a normal sized dick! It should be twice as long. Who would even want to use a nine incher? Not me, that’s for damned sure, but who needs sex, anyway?”"

rows.original: You raise an eyebrow but let her keep ranting.
rows.translation: 你挑起一边眉毛，但还是任她继续发牢骚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise an eyebrow but let her keep ranting."

rows.original: “It’s fine. Thanks to the stupid genetic plague, I’m basically infertile anyhow. So what’s the point in wasting time on sex? I’m going to make the galaxy a better place with my time. That’s what I’m going to do. Honestly, people would be a lot better off if they’d stop thinking with their junk and pumping up their libidos. Have you seen the people on New Texas? They’re basically turning themselves into fuck-robots.” Nayna shakes her head, sending her ears flapping. “But yeah, that’s me, just a little bunny with too much in her pants and no intention of using any of it.”
rows.translation: “没关系。拜那场愚蠢的遗传瘟疫所赐，反正我基本也没有生育能力。既然如此，何必把时间浪费在性爱上？我要用自己的时间让银河系变得更美好。这才是我要做的。老实说，要是人们不再用下半身思考，也别总想着把性欲推高，日子会好过得多。你见过新德州的人吗？他们基本是在把自己改造成性爱机器人。”奈娜摇了摇头，双耳随之扑扇。“不过没错，这就是我：一只裤裆里装得太多、却完全没打算使用它们的小兔子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s fine. Thanks to the stupid genetic plague, I’m basically infertile anyhow. So what’s the point in wasting time on sex? I’m going to make the galaxy a better place with my time. That’s what I’m going to do. Honestly, people would be a lot better off if they’d stop thinking with their junk and pumping up their libidos. Have you seen the people on New Texas? They’re basically turning themselves into fuck-robots.” Nayna shakes her head, sending her ears flapping. “But yeah, that’s me, just a little bunny with too much in her pants and no intention of using any of it.”"

rows.original: Talk More
rows.translation: 继续交谈
rows.raw: "Talk More"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: “How’d you train for a gig like this?”
rows.translation: “你是怎么为这种工作接受训练的？”
rows.raw: "“How’d you train for a gig like this?”"

rows.original: Bouncing up onto a sturdy-looking console, Nayna gives you a curious look. “You really don’t know?”
rows.translation: 奈娜蹦上一台看起来很结实的控制台，好奇地看着你。“你真的不知道？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBouncing up onto a sturdy-looking console, Nayna gives you a curious look. “You really don’t know?”"

rows.original: You let her know that don’t.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己的确不知道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let her know that don’t."

rows.original: Bouncing up onto a sturdy-looking console, Nayna sighs, “Again?”
rows.translation: 奈娜蹦上一台看起来很结实的控制台，叹道：“又要讲一次？”
rows.raw: "\n\nBouncing up onto a sturdy-looking console, Nayna sighs, “Again?”"

rows.original: You nod.
rows.translation: 你点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod."

rows.original: “Wow, okay. It isn’t easy, really. You can’t just go to a technical school or learn by doing. You’ve got to go to an academy - one of the big, planetary institutions if you can help it. The more impressive the school, the better. Then you have to select a field of study and master it. Me? I pursued climatology, though I also studied a bit of biology on the side. Mom and Dad would’ve crucified me if I didn’t.” Nayna shakes her head, then stares
rows.translation: “哇，好吧。说真的，这并不容易。你不能只是去技术学校读书，或者靠实践慢慢学会。你必须进入一所学院——如果条件允许，最好是那些大型行星级学府之一。学校越有名越好。然后你得选择一个研究领域并精通它。至于我？我主修气候学，另外也辅修了一点生物学。要是不这么做，爸妈非把我钉上十字架不可。”奈娜摇摇头，随后凝视着
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, okay. It isn’t easy, really. You can’t just go to a technical school or learn by doing. You’ve got to go to an academy - one of the big, planetary institutions if you can help it. The more impressive the school, the better. Then you have to select a field of study and master it. Me? I pursued climatology, though I also studied a bit of biology on the side. Mom and Dad would’ve crucified me if I didn’t.” Nayna shakes her head, then stares "

rows.original: out the window
rows.translation: 窗外
rows.raw: "out the window"

rows.original: at the closed shutters
rows.translation: 紧闭的百叶窗
rows.raw: "at the closed shutters"

rows.original: . “I think, deep down, they still think this is just a phase - that I’ll come to my senses and finally pursue a real career.” Laughing, the long-eared lapine wipes a tear from her eyes.
rows.translation: 。“我觉得，他们内心深处仍然认为这只是一时兴起——觉得我终有一天会醒悟，最后去追求一份真正的事业。”这名长耳拉平族笑着擦去眼角的一滴泪。
rows.raw: ". “I think, deep down, they still think this is just a phase - that I’ll come to my senses and finally pursue a real career.” Laughing, the long-eared lapine wipes a tear from her eyes."

rows.original: You push her, asking why her parents would do such a thing.
rows.translation: 你继续追问，问她的父母为何会那样做。
rows.raw: "You push her, asking why her parents would do such a thing."

rows.original: You ask her if she could recount why they would do that.
rows.translation: 你问她能不能再讲讲，他们为什么会那样做。
rows.raw: "You ask her if she could recount why they would do that."

rows.original: “The genetic plague!” Nayna honestly seems surprised that you didn’t figure it out on your own. “About thirty years back, laquine fertility starting nose diving, and it’s only gotten worse with time. I’m basically sterile, for example. Most of our top minds are tackling the issue. Every laquine with more than a few brain cells to rub together thinks she’s going to be the one to cure, the one to save our people. Well, every laquine aside from me.”
rows.translation: “遗传瘟疫啊！”奈娜似乎真的很惊讶，你居然没能自己想明白。“大约三十年前，拉奎因人的生育率开始急剧下滑，而且随时间推移只会越来越糟。比如说，我基本上就没有生育能力。我们大多数最顶尖的头脑都在研究这个问题。每个多少有几个脑细胞能互相摩擦的拉奎因人，都觉得自己会成为治愈瘟疫、拯救族人的那个人。嗯，除了我以外的每一个拉奎因人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The genetic plague!” Nayna honestly seems surprised that you didn’t figure it out on your own. “About thirty years back, laquine fertility starting nose diving, and it’s only gotten worse with time. I’m basically sterile, for example. Most of our top minds are tackling the issue. Every laquine with more than a few brain cells to rub together thinks she’s going to be the one to cure, the one to save our people. Well, every laquine aside from me.”"

rows.original: “Why not you?”
rows.translation: “为什么不是你？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why not you?”"

rows.original: Nayna shrugs. “It just didn’t appeal to me. Why would I want to pick apart cells when I could learn about the fabulous little crystals that make up snow? Who wants to dissect a dead animal when you could load up a simulated blizzard on your holo and see how the clouds spin around each other? It may not make much scientific sense, but I was born with white fur. It’s like I was made to play in the snow. For a short, dumpy bunny, I wrecked at snowball fights, and I wreck at reading weather data just as hard.”
rows.translation: 奈娜耸耸肩。“我就是对它提不起兴趣。当我可以研究组成雪花的奇妙小晶体时，为什么要去拆解细胞？当你可以在全息设备上加载一场模拟暴风雪，看着云层彼此环绕旋转时，谁还想解剖死去的动物？这或许没什么科学道理，但我天生就有白色毛发。就好像我生来便该在雪中玩耍。虽然我只是只又矮又胖的兔子，可打雪仗时我能横扫所有人；读取气象数据时，我也一样厉害。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNayna shrugs. “It just didn’t appeal to me. Why would I want to pick apart cells when I could learn about the fabulous little crystals that make up snow? Who wants to dissect a dead animal when you could load up a simulated blizzard on your holo and see how the clouds spin around each other? It may not make much scientific sense, but I was born with white fur. It’s like I was made to play in the snow. For a short, dumpy bunny, I wrecked at snowball fights, and I wreck at reading weather data just as hard.”"

rows.original: You press the issue. “But didn’t you feel some kind of obligation to help your people?”
rows.translation: 你紧追不舍。“可你难道没有觉得，自己有某种义务帮助族人吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou press the issue. “But didn’t you feel some kind of obligation to help your people?”"

rows.original: “What help would I be? There are thousands of laquine scientists putting their all into solving that problem. At best, I might make a useful lab assistant. At worst, I’d just be in everyone’s way. No, it’s better that they can focus without my distractions, and I can pursue my passion. Besides, laquines aren’t the only sapients in the galaxy. Even with the rush, habitable planets fill up fast. If I can make it possible to terraform a few dozen more, billions of lives could be saved - or improved. Imagine how many conflicts could have been avoided if everyone just had a little more room?”
rows.translation: “我能帮上什么忙？有成千上万名拉奎因科学家正竭尽全力解决那个问题。往好里说，我或许能当个有用的实验室助理；往坏里说，我只会碍所有人的事。不，让他们不受我的干扰、专心研究，而我去追求自己的热情，这样更好。况且，拉奎因人又不是银河系中唯一的智慧物种。即便经历过行星开拓热潮，宜居行星也很快就会住满。如果我能让另外几十颗行星具备改造条件，就可能拯救或改善数十亿条生命。想象一下，要是所有人都能多拥有一点空间，多少冲突原本可以避免？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What help would I be? There are thousands of laquine scientists putting their all into solving that problem. At best, I might make a useful lab assistant. At worst, I’d just be in everyone’s way. No, it’s better that they can focus without my distractions, and I can pursue my passion. Besides, laquines aren’t the only sapients in the galaxy. Even with the rush, habitable planets fill up fast. If I can make it possible to terraform a few dozen more, billions of lives could be saved - or improved. Imagine how many conflicts could have been avoided if everyone just had a little more room?”"

rows.original: Nodding, you can’t help but agree.
rows.translation: 你点点头，不由得表示赞同。
rows.raw: "\n\nNodding, you can’t help but agree."

rows.original: She sounds way too smart to disagree with!
rows.translation: 她听起来实在太聪明，让人根本无法反驳！
rows.raw: " She sounds way too smart to disagree with!"

rows.original: More than one war has broken out over colonization disputes.
rows.translation: 殖民争端已经引发过不止一场战争。
rows.raw: " More than one war has broken out over colonization disputes."

rows.original: Nayna smiles warmly at you. “I’m glad you agree. Back on topic, I went to ZPI: Zinor Planetary Institute. They have one of the best weather studies programs in the sector, and I got in. There was only one other laquine that made the cut; Zinor is a terran world that doesn’t take a lot of off-world admission. We may have started out as the resident ‘dumb bunnies’ and ‘furry trash,’ but we also clawed our way to the top of the academic scoreboard.” Smiling wider, she reveals the whole of her lapine buckteeth. “Don’t get me wrong, I was a clumsy mess back then. The first nickname never really went away, but I got my revenge by being better where it mattered - in class.”
rows.translation: 奈娜朝你温暖地微笑。“很高兴你同意。说回正题，我就读的是ZPI——齐诺行星学院。他们拥有本星区最出色的气象研究课程之一，而我成功考了进去。当时只有另一名拉奎因人也通过了选拔；齐诺是一颗泰伦人的星球，不怎么招收外星学生。我们入学时或许只是校内的‘蠢兔子’和‘毛茸茸的垃圾’，但最后同样靠自己的爪子爬到了学业排行榜顶端。”她笑得更加灿烂，露出整排拉平族大门牙。“别误会，那时的我确实是个笨手笨脚的灾难。第一个绰号一直没真正消失，但我在真正重要的地方——课堂上——表现得比他们更好，也算报了仇。”

rows.original: Nayna sighs, pleased smile fading in an instant. “My ex. Cute little fox-girl cop that moved on campus not long before I graduated. It turns out she was a terran originally, but we faced a fair number of identical issues. Just because someone shares a few traits with some small terran creature does not mean that they can be treated like one. She liked to listen to me bitch about the weather reports too. I miss her.”
rows.translation: 奈娜叹了口气，愉快的笑容瞬间消失。“我的前任。是个可爱的小狐狸姑娘，也是名警察，在我毕业前不久搬进了校园。后来我才知道，她原本是泰伦人，不过我们遇到过许多一模一样的问题。某个人仅仅与泰伦的某种小动物有几项共同特征，并不代表别人就能把她当成那种动物对待。她也喜欢听我抱怨气象报告。我很想她。”

rows.original: “Lover? I don’t know if... I mean...” Nayna blushes crimson, shading her fur pink from below. “We never really got past kissing. She was probably just tolerating me for companionship, waiting for a cuter laquine to show up, but it was nice all the same.” She straightens, realizing how far off base she’s gotten. “Uhm... back on topic, there wasn’t much more to it. Go to a great school, get good grades, and push the science as far as it will go.” She nods a little too vigorously, ears flapping.
rows.translation: “恋人？我不知道这算不算...我是说...”奈娜满脸通红，从皮肤下透出的红晕把毛发都染成了粉色。“我们从来没发展到接吻以后。她大概只是需要有人陪伴，所以才容忍我，等着更可爱的拉奎因人出现，但那段时光依然很美好。”她挺直身体，意识到自己已经偏题太远。“呃...说回正题，其实也没别的了。进一所好学校，取得好成绩，然后尽可能推动科学进步。”她点头点得太过用力，双耳随之扑扇。

I can’t go into the specifics until after I get it published, but suffice to say that it is going to revolutionize cold weather modeling as well as terraforming. Nothing feels quite like cool crisp air. No night sky ever seems as clear as one after a fresh snowfall. There’s beauty in the starkness of it all. ...And, lucky me, I’ll be visiting a half-dozen more before this study is done.”

rows.original: I’ll make you a deal. We don’t need to trade anything; I’ll give you anything in my stock for free. But you need to do something for me in return.
rows.translation: 我跟你做笔交易。我们不用交换任何东西；我的存货里，你想要什么我都可以免费给你。但你得替我做一件事。
rows.raw: "I’ll make you a deal. We don’t need to trade anything; I’ll give you anything in my stock for free. But you need to do something for me in return."

rows.raw: "Dealing: no need trade. Giving planties for free! But, something done for me."

rows.original: Given what you know about the Korgonne, and how Nenne is damn-near humping you with her eyes, you can guess what she might want from you in exchange. Still, you play along; you relax your body and lean against a stony wall, and ask her what you could possibly offer her in return.
rows.translation: 根据你对科尔贡人的了解，再加上嫩妮几乎正用目光把你狠狠干了一遍，你大概猜得出她想用什么来交换。不过你还是配合着演下去；你放松身体，倚在石墙上，问她自己究竟能拿什么回报她。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiven what you know about the Korgonne, and how Nenne is damn-near humping you with her eyes, you can guess what she might want from you in exchange. Still, you play along; you relax your body and lean against a stony wall, and ask her what you could possibly offer her in return."

rows.original: Nobody ever comes to my shop to speak with me anymore. I haven’t had a good sit-down conversation with anyone in years, much less have anyone enjoy what... ‘good company’ an experienced Korgonne like myself can ‘provide.’ If you spend some time with me, I’ll give you any one thing from my selection for free. Sound good to you?
rows.translation: 如今再也没人来我的店里和我说话了。我已经好多年没和谁坐下来好好聊过，更别提有人享受我这样经验丰富的科尔贡人所能“提供”的...“愉快陪伴”了。如果你愿意陪我一会儿，我就从这些货物里免费送你一样。听起来怎么样？
rows.raw: "Nobody ever comes to my shop to speak with me anymore. I haven’t had a good sit-down conversation with anyone in years, much less have anyone enjoy what... ‘good company’ an experienced Korgonne like myself can ‘provide.’ If you spend some time with me, I’ll give you any one thing from my selection for free. Sound good to you?"

rows.original: Nenne lonely old Korgonne. Nobody enjoy talky talk no more; nobody appreciate Nenne’s... ‘company.’ You time being with Nenne, and Nenne reward with free herb or plant. Good hearing?
rows.translation: 嫩妮是孤单的老科尔贡。没人再来聊聊天；没人欣赏嫩妮的...“陪伴”。你陪嫩妮一会儿，嫩妮就免费奖励草药或植物。听起来好？

rows.original: While she’s saying she just wants to enjoy a decent company, you’re also hearing her undertones loud and clear. If you want something for free from Nenne, you’ll need to ‘satisfy’ her ‘need’ for some good ‘conversation.’ That doesn’t sound like such a bad deal to you.
rows.translation: 她嘴上说只是想享受一番愉快陪伴，但话里的暗示你也听得一清二楚。若想从嫩妮这里免费拿走东西，你就得“满足”她对一场愉快“交谈”的“需求”。这听起来倒不算什么坏交易。

rows.raw: "I don’t have a permanent mate, no. The father of my puppies lives in the hold, but he never wanted to make our love an official thing."

You bet that, if there’s any one thing that Nenne would enjoy more than anything, it would be to feel young again. And sure, you could fuck her, but you have something a little more immediate in mind.
rows.translation: 你打量着嫩妮：疲惫的灰色毛发，略微佝偻的姿势。她的年纪确实有些大了。你敢打赌，若有什么比其他一切都更能让嫩妮开心，那一定是让她再次感到年轻。当然，你可以操她，不过眼下心里还有个更直接的主意。
rows.raw: "You look Nenne over; at her tired gray fur and her slightly-bent posture. She’s getting up there in years a little bit. You bet that, if there’s any one thing that Nenne would enjoy more than anything, it would be to feel young again. And sure, you could fuck her, but you have something a little more immediate in mind."

rows.original: “Hey Nenne,” you ask her. Her ears perk up at the sound of her name, and her tail begins swishing quickly behind her. “Who’s a good girl?”
rows.translation: “嘿，嫩妮，”你叫了她一声。听到自己的名字，她的耳朵竖了起来，尾巴也开始在身后飞快摇动。“谁是乖女孩？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey Nenne,” you ask her. Her ears perk up at the sound of her name, and her tail begins swishing quickly behind her. “Who’s a good girl?”"

rows.original: Nenne tilts her head, her mouth shut as she contemplates the question. <i>“
rows.translation: 嫩妮歪着脑袋，闭着嘴思考这个问题。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nNenne tilts her head, her mouth shut as she contemplates the question. <i>“"

rows.original: I suppose the matter of what is ‘good’ is a matter of perspective
rows.translation: 我想，什么算“乖”取决于看问题的角度
rows.raw: "I suppose the matter of what is ‘good’ is a matter of perspective"

rows.original: ‘Good-being’ perspective matters, supposing
rows.translation: “乖不乖”取决于角度，我想
rows.raw: "‘Good-being’ perspective matters, supposing"

rows.original: ,” she answers, choosing her words carefully. “
rows.translation: ,”她斟酌着措辞回答。“
rows.raw: ",” she answers, choosing her words carefully. “"

rows.original: It wouldn’t be right of me to judge whether anyone is good. What is good by me and my perspective might not be good by others.
rows.translation: 我不该评判任何人是否善良。在我看来是善的，对别人来说也许并非如此。
rows.raw: "It wouldn’t be right of me to judge whether anyone is good. What is good by me and my perspective might not be good by others."

rows.original: Unright of Nenne judging to anyone of goodness of them. Gooding for Nenne not being gooding of others, might.
rows.translation: 嫩妮评判任何人善不善良，不对。嫩妮觉得好，对别人可能不好。
rows.raw: "Unright of Nenne judging to anyone of goodness of them. Gooding for Nenne not being gooding of others, might."

rows.original: You step forward, stepping beside Nenne. You ignore her philosophical answer and ask again. “Who’s a good girl, Nenne?”
rows.translation: 你上前一步，来到嫩妮身边。你无视她充满哲理的回答，又问了一遍。“谁是好女孩呀，嫩妮？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou step forward, stepping beside Nenne. You ignore her philosophical answer and ask again. “Who’s a good girl, Nenne?”"

rows.original: But then you have to ask, what is ‘evil?’ It’s a classic problem: is it alright to steal a loaf of bread to feed a starving family? Does the intent to commit evil matter more than the evil act itself? When and where does the word of the law beat the spirit of the law?
rows.translation: 可这样一来，你又得问什么才算“邪恶”？这是个经典难题：为了养活挨饿的一家人，偷一条面包是否可以接受？作恶的意图是否比恶行本身更重要？法律的字面规定何时、又该在何处凌驾于法律精神之上？
rows.raw: "But then you have to ask, what is ‘evil?’ It’s a classic problem: is it alright to steal a loaf of bread to feed a starving family? Does the intent to commit evil matter more than the evil act itself? When and where does the word of the law beat the spirit of the law?"

rows.original: Asking then, gooding of not? Classic problem: okay to stealing of bread to feeding family of starved? Intent to committing gooding of not matters more than action? Where law of word more meaning than law of spirit?
rows.translation: 那再问，不善良是什么？经典问题：偷面包喂饿肚子家人，可以吗？想做不善良的事，比做的事更重要吗？什么时候法律字面比法律精神更重要？
rows.raw: "Asking then, gooding of not? Classic problem: okay to stealing of bread to feeding family of starved? Intent to committing gooding of not matters more than action? Where law of word more meaning than law of spirit?"

rows.original: “It’s you!” you announce suddenly!
rows.translation: “就是你！”你突然宣布！
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s you!” you announce suddenly!"

rows.original: “Really?!” Nenne nearly shouts, her eyes lighting up in surprise and pure glee. Her tail wags furiously behind her in surprise, completely elated at the news that she is, in fact, a good girl.
rows.translation: “真的吗？！”嫩妮几乎喊出了声，双眼因惊讶与纯粹的喜悦而亮起。得知自己确实是个好女孩，她惊喜万分，身后的尾巴疯狂摇摆，整个人欣喜若狂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?!” Nenne nearly shouts, her eyes lighting up in surprise and pure glee. Her tail wags furiously behind her in surprise, completely elated at the news that she is, in fact, a good girl."

rows.original: You launch your attack, bringing your hand to Nenne’s belly, and vigorously start rubbing it with your open palm. At first, Nenne is surprised, but then her left leg starts to kick furiously; her tongue lolls out of her mouth and she begins panting and laughing in surprise.
rows.translation: 你发动突袭，把手伸向嫩妮的肚子，张开手掌使劲揉了起来。嫩妮起初吃了一惊，随后左腿开始疯狂蹬动；舌头从嘴里垂下，一边喘气，一边惊喜地笑起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou launch your attack, bringing your hand to Nenne’s belly, and vigorously start rubbing it with your open palm. At first, Nenne is surprised, but then her left leg starts to kick furiously; her tongue lolls out of her mouth and she begins panting and laughing in surprise."

rows.original: She quickly loses her balance with her kicking leg; you use your other hand to brace her and ease her to the floor of her shop gently. Now that she’s laying on her back, you use both hands to rub at her slightly-flabby belly, everywhere from just above her crotch to just below her breasts, getting your ticklish hands everywhere in between.
rows.translation: 她很快便因蹬腿失去平衡；你用另一只手扶住她，轻轻将她放倒在店铺地面上。如今她仰面躺着，你便用双手揉搓她略显松软的肚子，从胯部上方到乳房下方无一遗漏，一双怕痒的手在其间四处游走。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe quickly loses her balance with her kicking leg; you use your other hand to brace her and ease her to the floor of her shop gently. Now that she’s laying on her back, you use both hands to rub at her slightly-flabby belly, everywhere from just above her crotch to just below her breasts, getting your ticklish hands everywhere in between."

rows.original: “It’s you! Yes, Nenne, it’s you!” you repeat loudly, watching her leg kick impiously. Nenne leans her head back, her tongue wagging in the air and her tail thrashing ecstatically underneath her. Joining her left leg, her two arms paw aggressively at nothing above her, all while panting in happy exhaustion at the tactile sensations you’re bombarding her with.
rows.translation: “就是你！没错，嫩妮，就是你！”你大声重复，看着她的腿肆无忌惮地乱蹬。嫩妮向后仰头，舌头在空中晃荡，尾巴在身下狂喜地拍动。继左腿之后，她的双臂也朝上方空无一物之处猛烈挥挠；你不断施加的触觉刺激令她幸福得筋疲力尽，不住喘息。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s you! Yes, Nenne, it’s you!” you repeat loudly, watching her leg kick impiously. Nenne leans her head back, her tongue wagging in the air and her tail thrashing ecstatically underneath her. Joining her left leg, her two arms paw aggressively at nothing above her, all while panting in happy exhaustion at the tactile sensations you’re bombarding her with."

rows.original: After a few minutes of this, you give the exhausted old Korgonne a break, removing your hands from her worn belly. She lays on the floor for a moment longer, her limbs still twitching in delight, before her eyes blink open and lock onto yours.
rows.translation: 这样闹了几分钟后，你让筋疲力尽的老科尔贡休息一下，双手离开她饱经岁月的肚腹。她又在地上躺了一会儿，四肢仍因喜悦而抽动，随后才眨开双眼，牢牢望向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few minutes of this, you give the exhausted old Korgonne a break, removing your hands from her worn belly. She lays on the floor for a moment longer, her limbs still twitching in delight, before her eyes blink open and lock onto yours."

rows.original: You’re good too!
rows.translation: 你也是好人！
rows.raw: "You’re good too!"

rows.original: You too good!
rows.translation: 你也好！
rows.raw: "You too good!"

rows.original: ” she says happily, drawing her tongue back into her mouth. It takes her another moment to roll onto her shaky limbs, and then another to pull herself back up. “
rows.translation: ”她开心地说道，把舌头收回嘴里。她又花了一会儿才翻身撑起颤抖的四肢，接着又花了一会儿才重新站起来。“
rows.raw: "” she says happily, drawing her tongue back into her mouth. It takes her another moment to roll onto her shaky limbs, and then another to pull herself back up. “"

rows.original: I didn’t know the Korgonne could do that! I liked it a lot; don’t be afraid to give me another one!
rows.translation: 我以前不知道科尔贡还能这样！我非常喜欢；别怕，再给我来一次！
rows.raw: "I didn’t know the Korgonne could do that! I liked it a lot; don’t be afraid to give me another one!"

rows.original: Knowing didn’t Korgonne could doing that! Liked! Afraiding not to doing again!
rows.translation: 不知道科尔贡能做这个！喜欢！别害怕再做一次！
rows.raw: "Knowing didn’t Korgonne could doing that! Liked! Afraiding not to doing again!"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Nenne’s not hard on the eyes. Why not let her know as much?
rows.translation: 嫩妮长得可不难看。何不把你的想法告诉她？
rows.raw: "Nenne’s not hard on the eyes. Why not let her know as much?"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: It seems a little silly to flirt with her while you don’t have any proper genitals.
rows.translation: 你连像样的生殖器都没有，这时候跟她调情似乎有点傻。
rows.raw: "It seems a little silly to flirt with her while you don’t have any proper genitals."

rows.original: Belly Rub!
rows.translation: 揉肚子！
rows.raw: "Belly Rub!"

rows.original: BellyRub!
rows.translation: 揉肚子！
rows.raw: "BellyRub!"

rows.original: You already discussed that.
rows.translation: 你已经谈过这个了。
rows.raw: "You already discussed that."

rows.original: You ask Nenne how she got into practicing botany and how she came to selling her all-natural wares. There aren’t a lot of plants in Uveto to begin with; getting into the practice must have been a challenge.
rows.translation: 你询问嫩妮是如何开始钻研植物学，又是如何做起全天然商品生意的。乌维托本来就没有多少植物；投身这门学问想必很有挑战。
rows.raw: "You ask Nenne how she got into practicing botany and how she came to selling her all-natural wares. There aren’t a lot of plants in Uveto to begin with; getting into the practice must have been a challenge."

rows.original: It actually wasn’t as hard as you’d think,
rows.translation: 其实没你想得那么难，
rows.raw: "It actually wasn’t as hard as you’d think,"

rows.original: Fewer hardships than thinking!
rows.translation: 没想的那么多困难！
rows.raw: "Fewer hardships than thinking!"

rows.original: ” she starts, taking a seat and folding her paws beneath her muzzle. “
rows.translation: ”她开口说道，坐下来，把双爪叠在口鼻下方。“
rows.raw: "” she starts, taking a seat and folding her paws beneath her muzzle. “"

rows.original: Sure, Uveto is snowy and cold rather than verdant and warm. You’re not wrong in thinking that plants are difficult to find. But the environment is different in the Korg’ii hold.
rows.translation: 没错，乌维托白雪皑皑、寒冷刺骨，而非绿意盎然、温暖宜人。你认为植物难以寻觅，这一点并没错。但科尔吉要塞里的环境不一样。
rows.raw: "Sure, Uveto is snowy and cold rather than verdant and warm. You’re not wrong in thinking that plants are difficult to find. But the environment is different in the Korg’ii hold."

rows.original: Planet white and cold, not green and warm. Thinking plants hard of finding not wrong. Korg’ii hold much different!
rows.translation: 星球白又冷，不绿也不暖。觉得植物很难找，没错。科尔吉要塞很不一样！
rows.raw: "Planet white and cold, not green and warm. Thinking plants hard of finding not wrong. Korg’ii hold much different!"

rows.original: ” To demonstrate, she reaches for one of her wares, a long, spindly vine growing straight out of one of the holes in the wall, and gives it a tug. The vine becomes taut, but doesn’t yield – because it’s rooted in place.
rows.translation: ”为了证明这一点，她伸手抓住自己的一件商品：一条细长纤弱的藤蔓，径直从墙上的一个孔洞中长出。她用力一扯，藤蔓绷得笔直，却丝毫没有松动，因为它就扎根在这里。
rows.raw: "” To demonstrate, she reaches for one of her wares, a long, spindly vine growing straight out of one of the holes in the wall, and gives it a tug. The vine becomes taut, but doesn’t yield – because it’s rooted in place."

rows.original: If Uveto couldn’t support plantlife, how would you expect the Korgonne to survive here? Or anything, for that matter? The Korg’ii hold is a good place to live, not just for us, but for plants, too.
rows.translation: 如果乌维托无法供养植物，你觉得科尔贡又该如何在这里生存？或者说，任何生物又该如何生存？科尔吉要塞是个宜居之地，不仅适合我们，也适合植物。
rows.raw: "If Uveto couldn’t support plantlife, how would you expect the Korgonne to survive here? Or anything, for that matter? The Korg’ii hold is a good place to live, not just for us, but for plants, too."

rows.original: If planet no living good for planties, expecting Korgonne to living here, how? Or living of any? Korg’ii hold living good place for all!
rows.translation: 如果星球不能让植物好好活，怎么能指望科尔贡住在这里？或者任何活物？科尔吉要塞是大家都能好好生活的地方！
rows.raw: "If planet no living good for planties, expecting Korgonne to living here, how? Or living of any? Korg’ii hold living good place for all!"

rows.original: ” She strokes idly at the warm walls of her living space, and wordlessly invites you to do the same. You place your hand on the Savicite wall, next to her paw. “Warmth,” she says. “
rows.translation: ”她漫不经心地抚摸着住处温暖的墙壁，无声邀请你也照做。你把手放在她爪子旁边的萨维石墙上。“温暖，”她说道。“
rows.raw: "” She strokes idly at the warm walls of her living space, and wordlessly invites you to do the same. You place your hand on the Savicite wall, next to her paw. “Warmth,” she says. “"

rows.original: The ground here is soft; the air is warm; and there’s plenty of water to go around. Wherever you can find Korgonne, you can find plant life.
rows.translation: 这里的土地松软，空气温暖，也有充足的水源。凡是科尔贡能够生活的地方，植物也能生长。
rows.raw: "The ground here is soft; the air is warm; and there’s plenty of water to go around. Wherever you can find Korgonne, you can find plant life."

rows.original: Good ground for Korgonne; good air for Korgonne; water plenty for Korgonne. All good for plantings too!
rows.translation: 土地对科尔贡好，空气对科尔贡好，科尔贡有很多水。对种植物也都好！
rows.raw: "Good ground for Korgonne; good air for Korgonne; water plenty for Korgonne. All good for plantings too!"

rows.original: She straightens herself and reestablishes eye-contact with you once more. <i>“
rows.translation: 她挺直身子，再次与你四目相对。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nShe straightens herself and reestablishes eye-contact with you once more. <i>“"

rows.original: As for me,
rows.translation: 至于我，
rows.raw: "As for me,"

rows.original: And Nenne!
rows.translation: 还有嫩妮！
rows.raw: "And Nenne!"

rows.original: ” she begins, answering your other question, “
rows.translation: ”她开始回答你的另一个问题，“
rows.raw: "” she begins, answering your other question, “"

rows.original: I just found botany to be interesting. Different plants interact with us in different ways, and I was always interested in why this moss burns to the touch, while the pollen from this flower elicits a hormonal response. No other Korg’ii has taken up the hobby like I have, and this is a good way to share my knowledge with the hold.
rows.translation: 我只是觉得植物学很有趣。不同的植物会以不同方式影响我们，我一直很想知道为什么这种苔藓碰起来会灼伤皮肤，而那朵花的花粉却会引发荷尔蒙反应。没有其他科尔吉像我一样把它当作爱好，而这是我与要塞分享知识的好办法。
rows.raw: "I just found botany to be interesting. Different plants interact with us in different ways, and I was always interested in why this moss burns to the touch, while the pollen from this flower elicits a hormonal response. No other Korg’ii has taken up the hobby like I have, and this is a good way to share my knowledge with the hold."

rows.original: plant-studying very smart-making for Nenne! Many plant do many things; good learning for which plant doing one thing and other plant doing other thing. Very learning! Help Korg’ii with plant-learning!
rows.translation: 研究植物让嫩妮变得很聪明！很多植物会做很多事；弄懂这种植物做一件事、另一种植物做另一件事，很适合学习。学到很多！用植物知识帮助科尔吉！
rows.raw: "plant-studying very smart-making for Nenne! Many plant do many things; good learning for which plant doing one thing and other plant doing other thing. Very learning! Help Korg’ii with plant-learning!"

rows.original: You ask Nenne if the rest of the hold feels similarly. The Korgonne are an industrious race that show respect and favoritism to its hardest workers; how well is Nenne treated for her chosen profession?
rows.translation: 你问嫩妮，要塞里的其他居民是否也有同样看法。科尔贡是个勤劳的种族，会尊敬并偏爱最卖力工作的人；嫩妮选择了这份职业后，得到了怎样的待遇？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Nenne if the rest of the hold feels similarly. The Korgonne are an industrious race that show respect and favoritism to its hardest workers; how well is Nenne treated for her chosen profession?"

rows.original: Alright, I guess. My botany isn’t as well-respected as some other professions, maybe; fishing, mining, and protecting the royalty or the hold all get the real adoration. I’ve never been treated poorly or anything, and I’ve never wanted for anything in particular, but nobody in the hold shares my appreciation for Uveto’s plantlife.
rows.translation: 还行吧，我想。也许我的植物学不如其他一些职业受尊敬；捕鱼、采矿，以及保护王室或要塞的人才真正受人爱戴。我从没受过虐待之类的，也从不缺什么特别想要的东西，但要塞里没人像我一样欣赏乌维托的植物。
rows.raw: "Alright, I guess. My botany isn’t as well-respected as some other professions, maybe; fishing, mining, and protecting the royalty or the hold all get the real adoration. I’ve never been treated poorly or anything, and I’ve never wanted for anything in particular, but nobody in the hold shares my appreciation for Uveto’s plantlife."

rows.original: Okay. Maybe not as many lovings or attentions as others. Fishing, mining, guarding, all many lovings and attentions. Never wanting for anything, Nenne, but plant-knowings not wanting as many as others.
rows.translation: 还好。也许没有别人得到那么多喜爱和关注。捕鱼、采矿、守卫，都有很多喜爱和关注。嫩妮从来不缺东西，但想了解植物的人没有别的事情那么多。
rows.raw: "Okay. Maybe not as many lovings or attentions as others. Fishing, mining, guarding, all many lovings and attentions. Never wanting for anything, Nenne, but plant-knowings not wanting as many as others."

rows.original: She lovingly strokes at the same ivy vine, her paw curling down the green stem delicately. <i>“
rows.translation: 她充满爱意地抚摸着同一条常春藤，爪子轻柔地沿绿色茎秆向下蜷曲。<i>“
rows.raw: " She lovingly strokes at the same ivy vine, her paw curling down the green stem delicately. <i>“"

rows.original: I’m fine with it, though, and I understand that I’m the odd one out among the Korgonne. I made my decision a long time ago.
rows.translation: 不过我不介意，也明白自己在科尔贡中是个异类。我很久以前就作出了选择。
rows.raw: "I’m fine with it, though, and I understand that I’m the odd one out among the Korgonne. I made my decision a long time ago."

rows.original: Okay with this! Decision making for Nenne made ago-ago.
rows.translation: 这样也好！嫩妮很久很久以前就作了决定。
rows.raw: "Okay with this! Decision making for Nenne made ago-ago."

rows.original: You can’t think of anything else specific to the shop and her profession to ask Nenne about. She smiles at you, wagging her tail. <i>“
rows.translation: 关于商店和她的职业，你想不出还有什么具体问题可问。她朝你微笑，尾巴不停摇摆。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t think of anything else specific to the shop and her profession to ask Nenne about. She smiles at you, wagging her tail. <i>“"

rows.original: Thanks for asking, by the way! I appreciate your curiosity; it’s so rare nowadays for a Korg’ii to ask me about my profession. I’d love to tell the story again if you’d ask!
rows.translation: 顺便说一句，谢谢你愿意问！我很欣赏你的好奇心；如今已经很少有科尔吉会询问我的职业了。只要你再问，我很乐意把这些故事再讲一遍！
rows.raw: "Thanks for asking, by the way! I appreciate your curiosity; it’s so rare nowadays for a Korg’ii to ask me about my profession. I’d love to tell the story again if you’d ask!"

rows.original: Asking is being thanked! Nenne love alien for curiousness; Korg’ii not being of curious asking anymore. Ask again, will tell!
rows.translation: 谢谢你问！嫩妮喜欢外星人的好奇；科尔吉现在不再好奇提问。再问，嫩妮还会讲！
rows.raw: "Asking is being thanked! Nenne love alien for curiousness; Korg’ii not being of curious asking anymore. Ask again, will tell!"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Flirt
rows.translation: 调情
rows.raw: "Flirt"

rows.original: Nenne’s not hard on the eyes. Why not let her know as much?
rows.translation: 嫩妮长得可不难看。何不把你的想法告诉她？

rows.original: Life on Uveto isn’t difficult. It may be easier to live elsewhere, but I’m happy living here in the hold. Sure, it can be cold, cramped, and there isn’t much company apart from other Korgonne and the other Uvetan natives, so it can get a little lonely, knowing there’s a whole other universe out there. But when you live for as long as I have, you learn that life’s adventures aren’t always away from home; starting a family may be the end of one adventure, but it’s the beginning of another. And I’m okay with that.
rows.translation: 在乌维托生活并不困难。住在别处也许更轻松，但我很乐意住在这座要塞里。当然，这里可能寒冷、拥挤，除了其他科尔贡和乌维托原生居民外也没多少人作伴；知道外面还有整个宇宙，偶尔难免会感到孤独。但活到我这个岁数，你就会明白人生的冒险不总在远离故乡之处；组建家庭或许是一场冒险的终点，却也是另一场冒险的起点。而我对此并不介意。
rows.raw: "Life on Uveto isn’t difficult. It may be easier to live elsewhere, but I’m happy living here in the hold. Sure, it can be cold, cramped, and there isn’t much company apart from other Korgonne and the other Uvetan natives, so it can get a little lonely, knowing there’s a whole other universe out there. But when you live for as long as I have, you learn that life’s adventures aren’t always away from home; starting a family may be the end of one adventure, but it’s the beginning of another. And I’m okay with that."

rows.translation: 生活不难。别处可能更好住，但嫩妮住这里开心；冷、挤，只有科尔贡和其他原住民，所以有时会孤单。嫩妮活了很多年，学会人生冒险不总要离开家；有家庭是一场冒险结束，也是另一场冒险开始。这样很好。

rows.original: What you enter is a small personal area: it contains a bed with simple fabrics containing some kind of fluffy down (perhaps Korgonne shavings? Is that weird?), and a table with two more stone chairs, their seats smoothed to perfection to contain almost any bottom. There’s a simple fire pit with a lit fire and a number of stone bowls nearby; above the pit and etched into the wall are large circular grooves bored deep into the stone, similar to her storefront, containing several kitchen tools. Atop the fire is a deep bowl with high edges, and sounds like bubbling water inside it.
rows.translation: 你走进的是一处不大的私人空间：里面摆着一张铺有朴素织物的床，填料是某种蓬松绒毛（也许是科尔贡刨花？这么想会不会很奇怪？），还有一张桌子和两把石椅，椅面被打磨得极其光滑，几乎能容纳任何臀部。旁边有一个燃着火的简易火坑，周围放着数只石碗；火坑上方的墙壁被深深凿出几个大圆槽，与她店面里的类似，里面放着各种厨具。火上架着一只边缘高耸的深碗，里面传来水沸腾的声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you enter is a small personal area: it contains a bed with simple fabrics containing some kind of fluffy down (perhaps Korgonne shavings? Is that weird?), and a table with two more stone chairs, their seats smoothed to perfection to contain almost any bottom. There’s a simple fire pit with a lit fire and a number of stone bowls nearby; above the pit and etched into the wall are large circular grooves bored deep into the stone, similar to her storefront, containing several kitchen tools. Atop the fire is a deep bowl with high edges, and sounds like bubbling water inside it."

rows.original: “Sit,” she instructs, motioning to the chairs. You pick the further one and get yourself comfortable.
rows.translation: “坐。”她指着椅子吩咐道。你挑了较远的那一把，让自己舒舒服服地坐下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sit,” she instructs, motioning to the chairs. You pick the further one and get yourself comfortable."

rows.original: Nenne reaches into one of the large compartments and withdraws a pawful of mushy, crumbly plants; she gives it a quick sniff, then drops it into the pot. <i>“
rows.translation: 嫩妮把手伸进其中一个大隔间，抓出一爪黏软易碎的植物；她迅速嗅了嗅，便将其丢进锅里。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nNenne reaches into one of the large compartments and withdraws a pawful of mushy, crumbly plants; she gives it a quick sniff, then drops it into the pot. <i>“"

rows.original: I’m going to make a drink for us both. The secret ingredient is this moss. Does your kind have something similar?
rows.translation: 我要给咱们俩做杯饮料。秘密配料就是这种苔藓。你们种族也有类似的东西吗？
rows.raw: "I’m going to make a drink for us both. The secret ingredient is this moss. Does your kind have something similar?"

rows.original: Drink of making for us. Special ingredient is moss! Idea ever have by alien?
rows.translation: 做饮料，给我们。特殊配料是苔藓！外星人也有这种想法？
rows.raw: "Drink of making for us. Special ingredient is moss! Idea ever have by alien?"

rows.original: ” She pulls a stirring stick out from among her bowls and gives the water in the pot a few stirs.
rows.translation: ”她从碗具间抽出一根搅拌棒，在锅里的水中搅了几下。
rows.raw: "” She pulls a stirring stick out from among her bowls and gives the water in the pot a few stirs."

rows.original: You reply that there is a drink that’s shared all over the universe called ‘tea.’ It involves adding special plants to boiling water; what type of plant, and how much you use, can change how strong the tea is and its taste.
rows.translation: 你回答说，全宇宙都流行一种叫作“茶”的饮料。它的做法是在沸水里加入特殊植物；所用植物的种类和分量不同，会改变茶的浓度与味道。
rows.raw: "\n\n You reply that there is a drink that’s shared all over the universe called ‘tea.’ It involves adding special plants to boiling water; what type of plant, and how much you use, can change how strong the tea is and its taste."

rows.original: Nenne hums affirmatively as you answer her. <i>“
rows.translation: 嫩妮听完你的回答，赞同地哼了一声。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nNenne hums affirmatively as you answer her. <i>“"

rows.original: That’s a good word; we’ll be drinking some of this ‘tea’ today. It’s a Korg’ii specialty, made with a thick type of moss that grows along deep-rooted Savicite. It’ll make our experience much better.
rows.translation: 这个词不错；今天咱们就喝一些这种‘茶’。这是科尔吉的特产，用一种沿深根萨维石生长的厚实苔藓制成。它会让我们的体验美妙得多。
rows.raw: "That’s a good word; we’ll be drinking some of this ‘tea’ today. It’s a Korg’ii specialty, made with a thick type of moss that grows along deep-rooted Savicite. It’ll make our experience much better."

rows.original: Good word. Tea having by us! Special Korg’ii tea, growing moss along deep Savicite. Experience making much better!
rows.translation: 好词。我们喝茶！科尔吉特制茶，苔藓长在深处萨维石旁。让体验好很多！
rows.raw: "Good word. Tea having by us! Special Korg’ii tea, growing moss along deep Savicite. Experience making much better!"

rows.original: ” She taps the end of her stirring stick against the rim of the pot, and then puts it back. Satisfied that her concoction is complete, she pulls two stone bowls out from their shelves, and, careful not to burn herself, dips their edges into the water, filling them with the tea.
rows.translation: ”她用搅拌棒末端敲了敲锅沿，随后将其放回原处。她对自己的调制成果颇为满意，从架子上取下两只石碗，小心不让自己烫伤，将碗沿探入水中，盛满茶水。
rows.raw: "” She taps the end of her stirring stick against the rim of the pot, and then puts it back. Satisfied that her concoction is complete, she pulls two stone bowls out from their shelves, and, careful not to burn herself, dips their edges into the water, filling them with the tea."

rows.original: She gives you your bowl first, then sets one out for herself. <i>“
rows.translation: 她先把你的碗递给你，随后也给自己盛了一碗。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you your bowl first, then sets one out for herself. <i>“"

rows.original: This tea will help ease your nerves. It’ll change the way you experience the world, in a good way: you’ll feel things more sharply; you’ll smell things more strongly; and you’ll taste things more intensely.
rows.translation: 这种茶能舒缓你的神经。它会以好的方式改变你体验世界的方式：你的触觉会更敏锐，嗅觉会更强烈，味觉也会更浓郁。
rows.raw: "This tea will help ease your nerves. It’ll change the way you experience the world, in a good way: you’ll feel things more sharply; you’ll smell things more strongly; and you’ll taste things more intensely."

rows.original: Tea helping nerves with ease. Changes you, goodly in ways. World experienced newly; make feelings more sharply, smells more smelly, tastes more tasty.
rows.translation: 茶帮助神经放松。用好方式改变你。重新体验世界；感觉更敏锐，气味更有味，味道更好吃。
rows.raw: "Tea helping nerves with ease. Changes you, goodly in ways. World experienced newly; make feelings more sharply, smells more smelly, tastes more tasty."

rows.original: ” She gives her bowl a blow to cool the liquid, and takes a quick sip. “
rows.translation: ”她朝碗里吹气冷却茶水，迅速抿了一口。“
rows.raw: "” She gives her bowl a blow to cool the liquid, and takes a quick sip. “"

rows.original: And, it tastes pretty good! You should give it a try.
rows.translation: 而且味道相当不错！你应该尝尝。
rows.raw: "And, it tastes pretty good! You should give it a try."

rows.original: Tasting of good already! Trying of you!
rows.translation: 已经尝着很好！你也试试！
rows.raw: "Tasting of good already! Trying of you!"

rows.original: You grip the bowl, careful to not let the heat hurt your hands, and mimic her, blowing away the steam to cool the liquid, before tipping it to your [pc.lipsChaste]. It tastes a little earthier than you had expected – unprocessed and unfiltered, straight from the Savicite it was harvested from. It goes down smooth; you can barely feel the moss in the water as it slides into your mouth.
rows.translation: 你握住碗，小心不让热度烫伤双手，学着她吹散蒸汽、冷却茶水，然后将碗凑到[pc.lipsChaste]边。味道比预想中更带泥土气息——未经加工，也没有过滤，仿佛刚从采集它的萨维石上取下。茶水顺滑入喉；苔藓随水滑入口中时，你几乎感觉不到它的存在。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grip the bowl, careful to not let the heat hurt your hands, and mimic her, blowing away the steam to cool the liquid, before tipping it to your [pc.lipsChaste]. It tastes a little earthier than you had expected – unprocessed and unfiltered, straight from the Savicite it was harvested from. It goes down smooth; you can barely feel the moss in the water as it slides into your mouth."

rows.original: You ask Nenne if the tea has any side effects. Is there any reason to not drink the tea? “
rows.translation: 你询问嫩妮这种茶是否有副作用。有没有什么理由让人不该喝它？“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Nenne if the tea has any side effects. Is there any reason to not drink the tea? “"

rows.original: It’ll make you lethargic. You’ll be able to feel all these good feelings and smell all these amazing smells, but you won’t have the inclination to do much feeling or smelling. It’s a good tea to have to relax with, but you really shouldn’t have it if you’re thinking of doing any adventuring. We’re not allowed to take it outside the Korg’ii hold.
rows.translation: 它会让你倦怠。你能感受到所有这些美妙触感，闻到所有这些惊人气味，却不会有多少兴致去触摸或嗅闻。它很适合用来放松，但如果打算去冒险，就真的不该喝。我们不准把它带出科尔吉要塞。
rows.raw: "It’ll make you lethargic. You’ll be able to feel all these good feelings and smell all these amazing smells, but you won’t have the inclination to do much feeling or smelling. It’s a good tea to have to relax with, but you really shouldn’t have it if you’re thinking of doing any adventuring. We’re not allowed to take it outside the Korg’ii hold."

rows.original: Lazy making. Good feels and good smells, but energy having none to feeling or smelling. Relaxing for goodly; adventuring for badly. Removing from Korg’ii unallowing.
rows.translation: 让人懒。感觉好，气味好，但没有力气去感觉或嗅闻。放松很好；冒险很坏。不许带出科尔吉。
rows.raw: "Lazy making. Good feels and good smells, but energy having none to feeling or smelling. Relaxing for goodly; adventuring for badly. Removing from Korg’ii unallowing."

rows.original: Nenne eyes you once more, from your collar to your [pc.feet], noting your clothing. <i>“
rows.translation: 嫩妮再次打量你，视线从衣领一路落到[pc.feet]，留意着你的衣物。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nNenne eyes you once more, from your collar to your [pc.feet], noting your clothing. <i>“"

rows.original: On that note, you should probably take your clothes off now. It’ll be a little tough to do it later if you don’t.
rows.translation: 说到这里，你现在大概应该把衣服脱掉。否则晚些时候再脱会有点困难。
rows.raw: "On that note, you should probably take your clothes off now. It’ll be a little tough to do it later if you don’t."

rows.original: Noting, should removing be of clothing. Difficulty removing later if not!
rows.translation: 说到，应该脱掉衣服。不现在脱，之后很困难！
rows.raw: "Noting, should removing be of clothing. Difficulty removing later if not!"

rows.original: ” You do as she recommends and strip naked; Nenne’s eyes are on you the entire time, her eyes quenched for a show as her mouth grows parched despite the tea. When you’re good and naked, you resume your tea time with her.
rows.translation: ”你听从她的建议，脱得一丝不挂；整个过程中嫩妮始终盯着你，渴望欣赏这场表演的目光如饥似渴，尽管喝着茶，她的嘴还是越来越干。等你彻底脱光，便继续与她品茶。
rows.raw: "” You do as she recommends and strip naked; Nenne’s eyes are on you the entire time, her eyes quenched for a show as her mouth grows parched despite the tea. When you’re good and naked, you resume your tea time with her."

rows.original: You two continue your tea time and make short talk while you wait for the effects of the tea to kick in. You don’t talk about anything really substantial, and it doesn’t take long for the tea to work its magic. Before long, your senses begin to change:
rows.translation: 你们继续喝茶，一边闲聊，一边等待茶效发作。谈话没有什么实质内容，茶也很快便施展了魔力。不久之后，你的感官开始变化：
rows.raw: "\n\nYou two continue your tea time and make short talk while you wait for the effects of the tea to kick in. You don’t talk about anything really substantial, and it doesn’t take long for the tea to work its magic. Before long, your senses begin to change:"

rows.original: Your peripheral vision gets blurry and unfocused, though your primary vision grows sharper and more precise. Your hearing gets a little blurred, and you have a harder time making out some of the nuances in Nenne’s speech, making it sound to you like she’s slurring her words. You feel the warmth of the apartment’s air against your skin and the heat from your bowl emanate toward you. The taste of the tea explodes against your tongue, lighting up every bud along its length. And, most importantly, the musk from earlier... it overshadows the tea easily and pervades your nostrils, controlling where your face looks, where your eyes focus, and which sounds you hear.
rows.translation: 你的周边视野变得模糊失焦，正面视野却愈发锐利精准。听觉稍显朦胧，让你更难辨清嫩妮话语中的细微差别，听来仿佛她正含糊不清地说话。你能感到房间里的温暖空气拂过肌肤，也能感到碗中热量朝你散发。茶味在舌头上轰然绽放，点亮沿途每一个味蕾。而最重要的是先前那股麝香...它轻易盖过茶香，充斥你的鼻腔，支配着你的脸转向何处、双眼聚焦何方，以及耳朵捕捉哪些声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour peripheral vision gets blurry and unfocused, though your primary vision grows sharper and more precise. Your hearing gets a little blurred, and you have a harder time making out some of the nuances in Nenne’s speech, making it sound to you like she’s slurring her words. You feel the warmth of the apartment’s air against your skin and the heat from your bowl emanate toward you. The taste of the tea explodes against your tongue, lighting up every bud along its length. And, most importantly, the musk from earlier... it overshadows the tea easily and pervades your nostrils, controlling where your face looks, where your eyes focus, and which sounds you hear."

rows.original: Nenne recognizes all the symptoms, and, with a warm smile, gently takes your hand in hers. <i>“
rows.translation: 嫩妮认出了所有症状，带着温暖的微笑，轻轻将你的手牵入掌中。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nNenne recognizes all the symptoms, and, with a warm smile, gently takes your hand in hers. <i>“"

rows.original: It’s time for your first lesson,
rows.translation: 该上你的第一课了，
rows.raw: "It’s time for your first lesson,"

rows.original: Timing be for lessons to you,
rows.translation: 到给你上课的时候了，
rows.raw: "Timing be for lessons to you,"

rows.original: ” she says as she stands, lifting your arm with her.
rows.translation: ”她一边说着一边起身，同时牵起你的手臂。
rows.raw: "” she says as she stands, lifting your arm with her."

rows.original: Your body is lazy and uncooperative; your head (and your crotch) wants to follow Nenne, but your arm is heavy and your legs are stiff; you feel as though you weigh twice as much as you do when you muster the strength to stand, and so much as moving forward is as arduous as a workout. You’d collapse beneath yourself if it didn’t mean moving your body to the floor.
rows.translation: 你的身体懒散而不听使唤；脑袋（还有胯下）想跟随嫩妮，可手臂沉重，双腿僵硬；当你鼓起力气站起来时，感觉自己的体重仿佛翻了一倍，就连向前移动都像锻炼般艰难。要不是倒下也意味着必须把身体移到地板上，你早就支撑不住了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour body is lazy and uncooperative; your head (and your crotch) wants to follow Nenne, but your arm is heavy and your legs are stiff; you feel as though you weigh twice as much as you do when you muster the strength to stand, and so much as moving forward is as arduous as a workout. You’d collapse beneath yourself if it didn’t mean moving your body to the floor."

rows.original: Thankfully, Nenne understands, and from the way she moves her own body, she’s experiencing something similar. You only need to move a few steps, thankfully enough, before Nenne flops you onto her soft bed, face-up – and she flops onto you.
rows.translation: 幸好嫩妮很理解，而从她移动身体的方式来看，她也正经历相似的感受。好在你只需走上几步，嫩妮便把你仰面扑倒在柔软的床上——随后她也扑到你身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThankfully, Nenne understands, and from the way she moves her own body, she’s experiencing something similar. You only need to move a few steps, thankfully enough, before Nenne flops you onto her soft bed, face-up – and she flops onto you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

The older Korgonne has straddled your [pc.hips], her moist cunt grinding against your groin, slickening your body with her musky, heady lube. rows.original: “Touch me,” Nenne says – not as a command, nor as a request, but as a suggestion. The words enter your ears a little muffled, like before, so it takes you a moment to understand them. You were so immersed in surrendering yourself to her expertise that you forgot to return the favor, and as soon as the thought enters your head, you comply.
rows.translation: “摸我。”嫩妮说道——既非命令，也非请求，只是建议。和先前一样，话音略显模糊地传入耳中，你花了一会儿才听懂。你太沉浸于把自己交给她的娴熟技巧，忘了回报她；念头一进入脑海，你便照做。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Touch me,” Nenne says – not as a command, nor as a request, but as a suggestion. The words enter your ears a little muffled, like before, so it takes you a moment to understand them. You were so immersed in surrendering yourself to her expertise that you forgot to return the favor, and as soon as the thought enters your head, you comply."

rows.original: Your fingers ruffle through Nenne’s shaggy fur; your tips dig into the bristles and lightly scratch at her skin underneath. You’re directionless, at least compared to her: all you concern yourself with is the sensation of Nenne’s fur against you. The movement reminds you of wavy grass during a windy day; your palms travel along her back, groping and pulling gently at her fur wherever they land.
rows.translation: 你的手指拨弄着嫩妮蓬乱的毛发；指尖探入硬毛，轻轻抓挠下面的皮肤。至少与她相比，你毫无章法：你只关心嫩妮毛发贴在身上的触感。那动作令你想起风中起伏的草浪；手掌沿她背部游走，落到哪里，便轻轻抓揉拉扯那里的毛发。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour fingers ruffle through Nenne’s shaggy fur; your tips dig into the bristles and lightly scratch at her skin underneath. You’re directionless, at least compared to her: all you concern yourself with is the sensation of Nenne’s fur against you. rows.translation: 但图瓦根本不吃这一套。她用空着的手抓住嫩妮的手腕，把她猛地拉向自己。嫩妮被那股力道惊得尖叫一声，却没有反抗；她与图瓦鼻尖相抵、胸膛相贴，并未继续维持那场欲擒故纵的游戏，而是跨坐到图瓦腿上，将逐渐湿润的肉丘正压在图瓦双腿之间不断隆起的鼓包上。

rows.original: Tuuva turns her head to the side and chugs the remainder of her tea, all at once – there’s a lot left in there, and the drink makes her cheeks bulge, but she doesn’t swallow. Once the bowl is empty, she tosses it aside, and as it hits the ground, she leans into Nenne and kisses her, full on the lips. You can see her cheeks narrow out and Nenne’s own start to balloon, followed by both of their throats working to swallow what’s between them.
rows.translation: 图瓦把头转向一边，一口气灌下剩余的茶——碗里还剩很多，饮料令她双颊鼓起，但她没有咽下。碗一见底，她便随手将其扔到一旁；就在碗落地的同时，她俯向嫩妮，吻住对方的双唇。你看见图瓦鼓起的双颊逐渐瘪下，而嫩妮的脸颊开始膨胀，随后两人的喉咙同时蠕动，将夹在她们之间的茶水咽下。
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva turns her head to the side and chugs the remainder of her tea, all at once – there’s a lot left in there, and the drink makes her cheeks bulge, but she doesn’t swallow. Once the bowl is empty, she tosses it aside, and as it hits the ground, she leans into Nenne and kisses her, full on the lips. You can see her cheeks narrow out and Nenne’s own start to balloon, followed by both of their throats working to swallow what’s between them."

rows.original: They don’t stop once it’s clear to you that there’s no more tea in their mouths. Nenne’s eyes flutter shut; she’s as naked as could be, and Tuuva takes full advantage of that by running her hands through her soft fur, clawing lines down her back until they come to a rest on her wide, motherly ass, where she unabashedly grabs two thick handfuls and gives them a big heft.
rows.translation: 即便你已经看出她们嘴里再没有茶水，她们也没有停下。嫩妮闭上双眼；她浑身赤裸，而图瓦充分利用这一点，双手穿过她柔软的皮毛，爪尖沿着她的后背划下，最终停在那宽大而充满母性的屁股上，毫不羞涩地各抓住厚实的一团，用力向上托起。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey don’t stop once it’s clear to you that there’s no more tea in their mouths. Nenne’s eyes flutter shut; she’s as naked as could be, and Tuuva takes full advantage of that by running her hands through her soft fur, clawing lines down her back until they come to a rest on her wide, motherly ass, where she unabashedly grabs two thick handfuls and gives them a big heft."

rows.original: Nenne, far from motionless, snakes her right hand underneath Tuuva’s apron and palms at her thick, black, pebbly nipple; she uses her left to grasp the back of Tuuva’s head and keep her in place; and, fuelled by the tea, she starts humping and rutting herself against the fabric of Tuuva’s apron, leaving wet stains along its base. And, to top it all off, they’re both using a borderline-excessive amount of tongue.
rows.translation: 嫩妮也绝非一动不动。她将右手探进图瓦的围裙下，揉弄她厚实、漆黑而布满颗粒的乳头；左手则抓住图瓦的后脑，让她留在原处。受到茶水驱使，她开始隔着图瓦的围裙挺胯磨蹭，在围裙下摆留下一片片湿痕。更不用说，她们两个都在使用近乎过量的舌头。

rows.original: You enter what appears to be a shop, chiseled into the stone of the Korg’ii hold; outside is a simple, finger-painted sign displaying some grass, or perhaps herbs, followed by some alien text that you had difficulty translating. You surmised it to be some kind of herbal shop – perhaps this place offers natural medicines and the like? Only one way to find out.
rows.translation: 你走进一间似乎是商店的地方，它被凿进科尔吉要塞的岩石中；外面挂着一块简陋的指绘招牌，上面画着些青草，也可能是药草，后面跟着一串你难以翻译的外星文字。你推测这里是某种草药店——也许提供天然药物之类的东西？只有一个办法能够弄清楚。
rows.raw: "You enter what appears to be a shop, chiseled into the stone of the Korg’ii hold; outside is a simple, finger-painted sign displaying some grass, or perhaps herbs, followed by some alien text that you had difficulty translating. You surmised it to be some kind of herbal shop – perhaps this place offers natural medicines and the like? Only one way to find out."

rows.original: The room just beyond the entrance is a little cozier than you had anticipated: it is little more than a foyer for a larger residential apartment. Another opening to your right, chiseled into the stone, leads and bends into where the shopkeeper must live. Before you is a crude stone chair that’s a little small, but the seat’s been carefully smoothed and rounded to provide as much comfort as possible; behind it is a number of small holes, carefully drilled and pockmarked into the stone, where mosses, herbs, plants, grasses and vines are stored and spill out of.
rows.translation: 入口后方的房间比你预想中舒适一些：这里不过是更大住宅套间的门厅。右侧另一道凿在岩石上的开口拐向里面，那里想必就是店主居住的地方。你面前放着一把略显矮小的粗糙石椅，不过椅面被仔细磨平并做成圆弧，尽可能提高舒适度；椅子后方的岩壁上精心钻出许多小孔，遍布凹坑，其中储存着苔藓、药草、植物、青草和藤蔓，并从洞口垂落出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe room just beyond the entrance is a little cozier than you had anticipated: it is little more than a foyer for a larger residential apartment. Another opening to your right, chiseled into the stone, leads and bends into where the shopkeeper must live. Before you is a crude stone chair that’s a little small, but the seat’s been carefully smoothed and rounded to provide as much comfort as possible; behind it is a number of small holes, carefully drilled and pockmarked into the stone, where mosses, herbs, plants, grasses and vines are stored and spill out of."

rows.original: Standing before all of that is a Korgonne, fussing beneath the holes in the walls, carefully sorting the spilled greens with her pawed hands. She turns to look at her customer, and you see the greying lines around the mouth of her snout and the frayed, limp tips of her ears. She’s clearly a bit older than some of the other Korgonne around the hold.
rows.translation: 一名科尔贡站在那些植物前，在墙上的孔洞下忙碌着，用带爪的双手仔细整理散落的绿植。她转身看向自己的顾客，你看见她吻部周围泛灰的纹路，以及耳朵磨损而低垂的尖端。显然，她比要塞里的其他科尔贡年长一些。

She turns to look at her customer, and you see the greying lines around the mouth of her snout and the frayed, limp tips of her ears. She’s clearly a bit older than some of the other Korgonne around the hold."

rows.translation: 接近地面时，她头尾翻转，撞进附近雪堆。不过这一动作是有意为之：惯性带着她一路向你滑来，全程扬起大片雪花。停下时，她已摆出一副放松姿态，一手托头、双腿交叠，仿佛早已坐在那里等候你回来数小时。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she’s nearer to the ground, she flips, tail-over-head, and crashes into the nearby snow bank. The move was intentional, however: her momentum carries her the rest of the way towards you, kicking up snow the whole distance, and when she comes to a rest, she’s lounging in a relaxed, head-on-her-hand, legs-crossed posture, as if she had been sitting there for hours, waiting for you to return."

rows.original: “Hey there,” she says, patting the snow next to her, inviting you to take a seat. “Room for one more right here, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “嘿，”她说道，拍了拍身旁积雪，邀请你坐下。“这里正好还能坐一个人，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there,” she says, patting the snow next to her, inviting you to take a seat. “Room for one more right here, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You lounge with Nykke at the base of a snow dune. Normally, laying in the snow wouldn’t be your idea of a relaxing time, but Nykke gives off so much ambient heat that you’re actually fine, no matter the conditions - provided you stay with her. You’d have thought that Frostwyrms were cold-blooded, but if they were, they probably wouldn’t be on Uveto.
rows.translation: 你和奈可悠闲地躺在雪丘脚下。通常而言，躺在雪里绝非你放松身心的首选方式；但奈可散发出如此充足的热量，只要待在她身旁，无论环境如何你都很舒适。你原以为霜龙是冷血动物，可若真如此，它们大概也不会生活在乌维托。
rows.raw: "You lounge with Nykke at the base of a snow dune. Normally, laying in the snow wouldn’t be your idea of a relaxing time, but Nykke gives off so much ambient heat that you’re actually fine, no matter the conditions - provided you stay with her. You’d have thought that Frostwyrms were cold-blooded, but if they were, they probably wouldn’t be on Uveto."

rows.original: Nykke is extremely tall, standing at ten feet tall from sole to scalp, not counting her wings. Similar to any pureblood Frostwyrm, she has six limbs, although they’re shaped quite differently: she walks on two plantigrade feet, and she has four arms: two each sprouting from her left and right shoulders. She has five toes on each foot and five fingers on each hand, although each digit is capped with a razor sharp talon, no less lethal than a Frostwyrm’s, although they’re considerably shorter.
rows.translation: 尼琪极其高大，从脚底到头顶足有十英尺，这还不算她的翅膀。和任何纯血霜龙一样，她有六肢，不过形态颇为不同：她用两只跖行足行走，并有四条手臂——左右肩膀各长出两条。她每只脚有五根脚趾，每只手有五根手指，不过每根趾指末端都带着剃刀般锋利的爪子，杀伤力丝毫不逊于霜龙之爪，只是短了许多。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke is extremely tall, standing at ten feet tall from sole to scalp, not counting her wings. Similar to any pureblood Frostwyrm, she has six limbs, although they’re shaped quite differently: she walks on two plantigrade feet, and she has four arms: two each sprouting from her left and right shoulders. She has five toes on each foot and five fingers on each hand, although each digit is capped with a razor sharp talon, no less lethal than a Frostwyrm’s, although they’re considerably shorter."

rows.original: Her body is covered in pitch-black scales that glisten darkly in the reflective light of the snow; each scale is about the size of a fingernail, and each scale is as hard as metal. Along her front, going from her lower jaw to the inside of her thighs, she has softer, yielding, malleable dark-gray scales. Although you doubt many conventional weapons would be able to wound her, she has a number of battle scars dotting her frame, from her arms to her legs – she’s lived a wild life on Uveto for over two hundred years, so it only makes sense.

Although you doubt many conventional weapons would be able to wound her, she has a number of battle scars dotting her frame, from her arms to her legs – she’s lived a wild life on Uveto for over two hundred years, so it only makes sense."

rows.original: She has a long, thick tail at her coccyx; it’s as thick as her waist at its trunk and it only tapers slightly at the tip, where it’s adorned with blunter spikes, better for bludgeoning than piercing. She has only one set of teeth in her mouth, but like a Frostwyrm, they are each sharp enough to rip apart any armor. Nykke is the perfect hybrid combination of the svelte, flexible, stealthy humanoid form and the power and ferocity of a Frostwyrm; there are few creatures in the universe that would be able to best her in combat, with some appropriate training.
rows.translation: 她尾骨处长着一条粗长尾巴；尾根和腰身一样粗壮，直到尾尖也只略微变细，末端生有较钝的尖刺，比起穿刺更适合重击。她嘴里只有一排牙齿，但和霜龙一样，每颗都锋利得足以撕开任何护甲。尼琪完美结合了纤巧、灵活而善于潜行的人形体态与霜龙的力量和凶猛；只要接受适当训练，宇宙中能在战斗中胜过她的生物寥寥无几。

Nykke is the perfect hybrid combination of the svelte, flexible, stealthy humanoid form and the power and ferocity of a Frostwyrm; there are few creatures in the universe that would be able to best her in combat, with some appropriate training."

rows.original: Focusing on her gentler features, Nykke’s eyes have pink sclera, ruby-red irises and jet-black pupils. She has a humanoid face, with gentle, smooth cheeks, more similar to skin rather than scales, and an upturned, button nose and two nostrils. She has two thin, jet-black lips that can curl into the most precious – or mischievous – of smiles. Growing from her forehead are a pair of horns that curve sharply over her skull, but don’t reach very far and are blunt at the tip, useless for attacks. And beneath those, she has thin, shoulder-length, dull-blue hair.
