rows.original: You ask Nykke if she’s put any thought into what sort of person she’d want in a mate. If [frostwyrm.name] and her example is anything to go by, Frostwyrms aren’t a disparaging species; being a Frostwyrm is more of a bonus than a necessity, and each Frostwyrm has a different idea of what makes an ideal mate.
rows.translation: 你问尼琪是否想过自己会想要怎样的伴侣。若[frostwyrm.name]和她的例子具有参考价值，霜龙并不是会歧视其他种族的物种；伴侣也是霜龙只能算加分项，而非必要条件，且每条霜龙对理想伴侣都有不同看法。
rows.raw: "You ask Nykke if she’s put any thought into what sort of person she’d want in a mate. If [frostwyrm.name] and her example is anything to go by, Frostwyrms aren’t a disparaging species; being a Frostwyrm is more of a bonus than a necessity, and each Frostwyrm has a different idea of what makes an ideal mate."

rows.original: “Uh... I can’t say I have, I guess,” she says, her two left index fingers tapping on her chin in thought. “I’ve had so many ideas over the Sky Cycles that they’ve all kind of meshed together over time. I guess my first priority would be a mate that can give me an ideally endless number of kips. I’m sure your own Qim wouldn’t disagree.”
rows.translation: “呃...我想，我确实没怎么想过，”她说道，左侧两根食指若有所思地轻点下巴。“这些天轮以来我有过太多想法，久而久之全混在了一起。我想，第一要务应该是找一个能让我生下最好永无止境那么多幼崽的伴侣。相信你自己的琪姆也不会反对。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... I can’t say I have, I guess,” she says, her two left index fingers tapping on her chin in thought. “I’ve had so many ideas over the Sky Cycles that they’ve all kind of meshed together over time. I guess my first priority would be a mate that can give me an ideally endless number of kips. I’m sure your own Qim wouldn’t disagree.”"

rows.original: You like to think that that’s kind of a blasé way of describing your relationship with [frostwyrm.name]. At the word, you feel Nykke’s psionics probe your mind – she isn’t quite as quick or refined on her skills, and it takes her a moment to understand the definition of the word ‘blasé.’ You tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] having lots of offspring is just one of the many qualities you fulfill as her mate.
rows.translation: 你觉得用这种轻描淡写的方式描述自己与[frostwyrm.name]的关系有点不妥。听到这个词，你感觉尼琪的灵能力量探入脑海——她的技巧还不够迅速精炼，过了一会儿才理解“轻描淡写”的定义。你告诉她，和[frostwyrm.name]生育许多后代只是你作为其伴侣所履行的诸多职责之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou like to think that that’s kind of a blasé way of describing your relationship with [frostwyrm.name]. At the word, you feel Nykke’s psionics probe your mind – she isn’t quite as quick or refined on her skills, and it takes her a moment to understand the definition of the word ‘blasé.’ You tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] having lots of offspring is just one of the many qualities you fulfill as her mate."

rows.original: “How did your Qim decide for you to be her mate?” she asks. “I could look in your memories and see for myself, but I understand that non-Frostwyrms don’t like that so much.”
rows.translation: “你的琪姆是怎么决定让你成为她伴侣的？”她问道。“我可以查看你的记忆，亲自弄清楚，但我知道非霜龙不太喜欢那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How did your Qim decide for you to be her mate?” she asks. “I could look in your memories and see for myself, but I understand that non-Frostwyrms don’t like that so much.”"

rows.original: You explain that you two met in combat. Nykke hums – she gathered that much at first. It must not surprise her that there can be a bit of a ‘ritual’ when Frostwyrms find a potential mate. You regale that you unknowingly wandered into her territory once, and she mistook that you were trying to invade her space. You never actually asked [frostwyrm.name] why she attacked you; it seems to unimportant, now.
rows.translation: 你解释说，你们是在战斗中相遇的。尼琪哼了一声——她最初便猜到了这一点。霜龙发现潜在伴侣时可能会举行某种“仪式”，她对此想必并不惊讶。你娓娓道来：自己曾在不知情的情况下闯入她的领地，她误以为你想侵犯她的地盘。你其实从未问过[frostwyrm.name]为何袭击自己；如今看来，那已经不重要了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain that you two met in combat. Nykke hums – she gathered that much at first. It must not surprise her that there can be a bit of a ‘ritual’ when Frostwyrms find a potential mate. You regale that you unknowingly wandered into her territory once, and she mistook that you were trying to invade her space. You never actually asked [frostwyrm.name] why she attacked you; it seems to unimportant, now."

rows.original: Anyway, you bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat. “You, really?” Nykke asks in bewilderment. You answer that you had done it several times, not just once. “But you’re so much smaller than her! And her teeth – how did you avoid getting eaten in one big–”
rows.translation: 总而言之，你在战斗中击败了[frostwyrm.name]。“你？真的？”尼琪困惑地问。你回答说自己不止一次做到过，而是好几次。“但你比她小那么多！还有她的牙——你怎么没被她一大口——”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyway, you bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat. “You, really?” Nykke asks in bewilderment. You answer that you had done it several times, not just once. “But you’re so much smaller than her! And her teeth – how did you avoid getting eaten in one big–”"

rows.original: She finishes the sentence by leaning at you and loudly chomping at the air between you, showing off her own pointed teeth. You insist that it’s true; maybe one day she can ask [frostwyrm.name] herself. There’s more to combat than whether one kind is smaller than another, or whether one kind has larger, sharper teeth and claws. You can go into deeper detail later, if she wants.
rows.translation: 她猛地向你探身，对着你们之间的空气响亮地咬了一口，露出自己的尖牙，以此补完那句话。你坚持这是真的；也许有一天，她可以亲自去问[frostwyrm.name]。战斗的胜负不只取决于某一方是否比另一方矮小，也不只取决于谁的牙齿与爪子更大、更锋利。如果她愿意，你之后可以讲得更详细。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe finishes the sentence by leaning at you and loudly chomping at the air between you, showing off her own pointed teeth. You insist that it’s true; maybe one day she can ask [frostwyrm.name] herself. There’s more to combat than whether one kind is smaller than another, or whether one kind has larger, sharper teeth and claws. You can go into deeper detail later, if she wants."

rows.original: In any case, [frostwyrm.name] had established her territory along a route that you regularly traveled, meaning you and she were at odds a number of times. And every single time you won, you let her go, because you didn’t want the blood of something as beautiful as herself on your hands.
rows.translation: 无论如何，[frostwyrm.name]将领地设在你常走的一条路上，因此你与她多次发生冲突。每一次获胜后，你都放她离开，因为你不愿让双手染上如此美丽生物的鲜血。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn any case, [frostwyrm.name] had established her territory along a route that you regularly traveled, meaning you and she were at odds a number of times. And every single time you won, you let her go, because you didn’t want the blood of something as beautiful as herself on your hands."

rows.original: But, one day, [frostwyrm.name] managed to get the better of you. And when she had the upper-hand and was in a position to kill you – she didn’t. She recognized you and the fact that you kept sparing her, and she extended the same mercy to you.
rows.translation: 不过有一天，[frostwyrm.name]占了上风。而当她掌握优势、能够杀死你时——她没有下手。她认出了你，也记得你一次次饶她性命，于是同样对你施以仁慈。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, one day, [frostwyrm.name] managed to get the better of you. And when she had the upper-hand and was in a position to kill you – she didn’t. She recognized you and the fact that you kept sparing her, and she extended the same mercy to you."

rows.original: Nykke, despite her halfway-bored expression telling you she’s only modestly interested in your story, is hanging on your every word, her bright red eyes impatiently watching yours every time you pause for effect. To finish your story, you tell her that [frostwyrm.name] recognized your strength, and pined that she hadn’t found another pureblood Frostwyrm like herself, so she decided that you were worthy to breed with her.
rows.translation: 尼琪脸上半是无聊的神情，仿佛只对故事略感兴趣，实际上却没有漏听你说的任何一个字；每当你为了效果停顿，她明亮的红眼睛便急不可耐地盯着你。作为故事结尾，你告诉她，[frostwyrm.name]认可了你的力量，也哀叹自己没有找到另一条纯血霜龙，于是认定你有资格与她繁殖。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke, despite her halfway-bored expression telling you she’s only modestly interested in your story, is hanging on your every word, her bright red eyes impatiently watching yours every time you pause for effect. To finish your story, you tell her that [frostwyrm.name] recognized your strength, and pined that she hadn’t found another pureblood Frostwyrm like herself, so she decided that you were worthy to breed with her."

rows.original: “Hmm,” Nykke hums, processing your story. You can feel her large heart beat through her chest in excitement – she must like the idea that, if a pureblood Frostwyrm like [frostwyrm.name] would accept you, then she isn’t in the wrong for looking for non-Frostwyrms as well. You ask her if she has any ideas on what her mate should be.
rows.translation: “嗯。”尼琪低哼着消化这个故事。你能透过她胸膛感觉到那颗硕大心脏兴奋地跳动——她一定很喜欢这个想法：既然像[frostwyrm.name]这样的纯血霜龙都能接受你，那她寻找非霜龙伴侣也并没有错。你问她现在是否想到伴侣应该具备什么条件。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm,” Nykke hums, processing your story. You can feel her large heart beat through her chest in excitement – she must like the idea that, if a pureblood Frostwyrm like [frostwyrm.name] would accept you, then she isn’t in the wrong for looking for non-Frostwyrms as well. You ask her if she has any ideas on what her mate should be."

rows.original: “Well, the strength to stand next to a Frostwyrm, for sure,” she says, hugging your form, unsubtly testing how taut your body is. “A proper mate must be able to defend their dwelling and protect their clutch, and if you had the strength to fell someone like your Qim so many times over, I wouldn’t settle for anyone lesser.”
rows.translation: “首先，肯定要有足以与霜龙并肩的力量，”她说道，一边抱住你，一边毫不掩饰地试探你的身体有多结实。“合格的伴侣必须能保卫住处、保护后代；既然你能一次又一次击倒你那样的琪姆，我就不会接受比你弱的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, the strength to stand next to a Frostwyrm, for sure,” she says, hugging your form, unsubtly testing how taut your body is. “A proper mate must be able to defend their dwelling and protect their clutch, and if you had the strength to fell someone like your Qim so many times over, I wouldn’t settle for anyone lesser.”"

rows.original: You thank her for the compliment, but tell her that you’re not nearly the strongest of your own kind. Like you had said earlier, there’s more to combat than just bulk. “Did you outsmart her, then?” Nykke asks, and you say that, in a manner of speaking, you certainly used the right tools for the job. “And you’re so young compared to us! A proper mate should be cunning and intelligent enough to stand with a Frostwyrm, as well.”
rows.translation: 你感谢她的称赞，却告诉她自己远不是同族中最强壮的。正如你先前所说，战斗并不只看体格。“那么你是靠智慧胜过她的吗？”尼琪问。你说，从某种意义上讲，自己的确为这份工作使用了正确工具。“而且和我们相比，你还那么年轻！合格的伴侣也应该足够狡猾、聪慧，才能与霜龙并肩。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank her for the compliment, but tell her that you’re not nearly the strongest of your own kind. Like you had said earlier, there’s more to combat than just bulk. “Did you outsmart her, then?” Nykke asks, and you say that, in a manner of speaking, you certainly used the right tools for the job. “And you’re so young compared to us! A proper mate should be cunning and intelligent enough to stand with a Frostwyrm, as well.”"

rows.original: You implore her to continue. “A good, proper mate would show compassion, like you had shown to your Qim. You didn’t kill her, even when you could, and when she asked you to help her repopulate her species, you didn’t hesitate. It reminds me of my own Qal and how he met my Qim. A good mate would know when to protect a kind that needs help, and when a battle is over.”
rows.translation: 你鼓励她继续。“优秀而合格的伴侣会像你对待琪姆那样展现同情心。即使能杀死她，你也没有下手；当她请求你帮助自己的物种恢复繁衍时，你也毫不犹豫。这让我想起自己的卡尔，以及他与我琪姆相遇的经过。好伴侣应当知道何时保护需要帮助的种族，也应当知道战斗何时已经结束。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou implore her to continue. “A good, proper mate would show compassion, like you had shown to your Qim. You didn’t kill her, even when you could, and when she asked you to help her repopulate her species, you didn’t hesitate. It reminds me of my own Qal and how he met my Qim. A good mate would know when to protect a kind that needs help, and when a battle is over.”"

rows.original: Nykke breathes sharply through her nose, the air hissing into her nostrils. “And a good mate,” she continues, her six limbs constricting you tighter as her fantasies start to get away from her, her fingers getting a little exploratory, “would be close with every single one of their many, many kips, and spend lots of time with them. They’d ensure that their kips grew up strong enough, and wise enough, to stand with a proper Frostwyrm. And a proper mate would ensure they have a strong sense of the world around them. And... a good mate would never shy away from making more kips with their mate. And a good mate–”
rows.translation: 尼琪猛地用鼻子吸气，空气嘶嘶涌入鼻孔。“而且好伴侣，”她继续说道。随着幻想开始失控，她的六肢把你箍得更紧，手指也开始有些不安分，“会亲近自己许许多多的每一个幼崽，花很多时间陪伴它们。他们会确保幼崽成长得足够强壮、足够聪明，能够与真正的霜龙并肩。合格的伴侣还会确保孩子们对周围世界有深刻认识。而且...好伴侣绝不会逃避与自己的伴侣生育更多幼崽。还有，好伴侣——”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke breathes sharply through her nose, the air hissing into her nostrils. “And a good mate,” she continues, her six limbs constricting you tighter as her fantasies start to get away from her, her fingers getting a little exploratory, “would be close with every single one of their many, many kips, and spend lots of time with them. They’d ensure that their kips grew up strong enough, and wise enough, to stand with a proper Frostwyrm. And a proper mate would ensure they have a strong sense of the world around them. And... a good mate would never shy away from making more kips with their mate. And a good mate–”"

rows.original: You interrupt Nykke and tell her – with her bright-red eyes locked squarely onto yours, her breath shallow, her fingers still rubbing at you, and her nostrils flaring, likely smelling [frostwyrm.name] on you and driving her wild – that you have a pretty close idea of what, or who, she would consider to be a viable mate.
rows.translation: 你打断尼琪，告诉她——她明亮的红眼睛直勾勾盯着你，呼吸浅促，手指仍在你身上摩挲，鼻孔不断翕动，大概是闻到了你身上[frostwyrm.name]的气息，因而欲火中烧——你已经很清楚她会把什么样的人，或者说谁，视为合适伴侣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou interrupt Nykke and tell her – with her bright-red eyes locked squarely onto yours, her breath shallow, her fingers still rubbing at you, and her nostrils flaring, likely smelling [frostwyrm.name] on you and driving her wild – that you have a pretty close idea of what, or who, she would consider to be a viable mate."

rows.original: “Then enough with the games, already,” she begs, her voice lilting. It sounded like a particularly... vulnerable request: if you had a stronger psionic link with her, you don’t doubt you’d be inundated with lust, and you’re not sure if you’d be able to restrain yourself as much as she must be now. “It’s torture sitting next to such a viable mate and they won’t
rows.translation: “那就别再玩游戏了，”她用声调上扬的声音恳求。听起来这是个格外...脆弱的请求：如果你与她有更强的灵能链接，你无疑会被情欲淹没，也不确定自己能否像她现在这样克制。“这简直是折磨，坐在如此合适的伴侣旁边，对方却不肯
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then enough with the games, already,” she begs, her voice lilting. It sounded like a particularly... vulnerable request: if you had a stronger psionic link with her, you don’t doubt you’d be inundated with lust, and you’re not sure if you’d be able to restrain yourself as much as she must be now. “It’s torture sitting next to such a viable mate and they won’t"

rows.original: let me get started on a massive clutch with them!
rows.translation: 让我开始和对方生下一大窝孩子，这简直是折磨！
rows.raw: " let me get started on a massive clutch with them!"

rows.original: let me put a kip in them!
rows.translation: 让我把幼崽塞进对方体内！
rows.raw: " let me put a kip in them!"

rows.original: put a kip in me!
rows.translation: 把幼崽塞进我体内！
rows.raw: " put a kip in me!"

rows.original: Nykke, as a Frostwyrm herself, knows better than anyone that Frostwyrms mate monogamously. Starting a second family altogether would be taboo among her culture.
rows.translation: 身为霜龙，尼琪比任何人都清楚霜龙奉行一夫一妻。另组一个家庭在她的文化中会是禁忌。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke, as a Frostwyrm herself, knows better than anyone that Frostwyrms mate monogamously. Starting a second family altogether would be taboo among her culture."

rows.original: She huffs and bites into her lower lip, her eyes scanning the ocean without another word.
rows.translation: 她哼了一声，咬住下唇，双眼扫视着海面，再也没有说话。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe huffs and bites into her lower lip, her eyes scanning the ocean without another word."

rows.original: But, you continue, if she can be a little more patient... your kind has invented a way to mate without it involving conception, if that’ll at least help her with her urges.
rows.translation: 不过你继续说道，如果她能再耐心一点...你的种族已经发明了不会导致受孕的交配方式，至少可以帮助她缓解冲动。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, you continue, if she can be a little more patient... your kind has invented a way to mate without it involving conception, if that’ll at least help her with her urges."

rows.original: “Why in the world would your kind invent that?” she asks, bewildered. “What’s the point of mating if you don’t want kips?”
rows.translation: “你的种族为什么会发明那种东西？”她困惑地问。“如果不想要幼崽，交配还有什么意义？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why in the world would your kind invent that?” she asks, bewildered. “What’s the point of mating if you don’t want kips?”"

rows.original: For the pleasure of it, you answer matter-of-factly.
rows.translation: 为了享受快感，你理所当然地回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor the pleasure of it, you answer matter-of-factly."

rows.original: She crosses her legs again. You catch the distinct whiff of her musk in the salty oceanic air as she does so. “Fine,” she says. “I’ll wait a bit more.”
rows.translation: 她再次交叠双腿。动作间，咸涩海风里飘来一缕清晰可辨的麝香。“好吧，”她说。“我再等一阵。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe crosses her legs again. You catch the distinct whiff of her musk in the salty oceanic air as she does so. “Fine,” she says. “I’ll wait a bit more.”"

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: You already have a pretty good idea on what Nykke considers to be the perfect mate...
rows.translation: 你对尼琪心目中完美伴侣的样子已经有了相当清楚的概念...
rows.raw: "You already have a pretty good idea on what Nykke considers to be the perfect mate..."

rows.original: You ask Nykke how her handle on her psionic strengths are. If she’s a Frostwyrm, and she’s as old as [frostwyrm.name], she must have a strong handle on them by now.
rows.translation: 你问尼琪，她对自己的灵能力量掌握得怎样。既然她是霜龙，而且和[frostwyrm.name]一样年长，现在肯定已经运用自如了。
rows.raw: "You ask Nykke how her handle on her psionic strengths are. If she’s a Frostwyrm, and she’s as old as [frostwyrm.name], she must have a strong handle on them by now."

rows.original: The question is met with a quizzical pause. “I’m... not sure what you’re asking me,” she admits.
rows.translation: 这个问题只换来一阵困惑的沉默。“我...不太明白你在问什么。”她承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question is met with a quizzical pause. “I’m... not sure what you’re asking me,” she admits."

rows.original: You recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now.
rows.translation: 你想起[frostwyrm.name]看待灵能的方式也与你不同。用她的话说，你所谓的“灵能”，就是霜龙无需语言便能交流的能力，就像你们现在这样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now."

rows.original: Oh, like this? Nykke asks, her voice projecting into your mind directly. You concur: exactly like that. [frostwyrm.name] also said that Frostwyrms don’t necessarily communicate in words: they communicate in ideas and emotions, and are able to project feelings directly into whoever they’re connected with. You’re still new to the whole thing, yourself.
rows.translation: 像这样？尼琪问道，声音直接投射进你的脑海。你表示没错，正是这样。[frostwyrm.name]还说，霜龙交流时未必使用词语：她们传递的是想法与情绪，并能将感受直接投射给链接对象。你自己对这一切也还很陌生。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, like this? Nykke asks, her voice projecting into your mind directly. You concur: exactly like that. [frostwyrm.name] also said that Frostwyrms don’t necessarily communicate in words: they communicate in ideas and emotions, and are able to project feelings directly into whoever they’re connected with. You’re still new to the whole thing, yourself."

rows.original: My own Qal had the same reaction to our ability to communicate. I thought he was just incapable, for one reason or another, and I didn’t believe him when he said that communicating like this was a unique skill. Nykke focuses her gaze on you, and you can tell that she’s trying to ‘impress’ something into your psyche – like an idea, or an emotion – but all you wind up feeling is a dull thud in the front of your head. Do you feel anything?
rows.translation: 我自己的卡尔对于我们的交流能力也有相同反应。我原以为他只是由于某种原因做不到；他说这种交流方式是独特能力时，我也不相信。尼琪将目光集中在你身上，你看得出她正试图把某种东西“压印”进你的精神——像是想法或情绪——可最终你只感觉额头内部传来一记沉闷撞击。你感觉到什么了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nMy own Qal had the same reaction to our ability to communicate. I thought he was just incapable, for one reason or another, and I didn’t believe him when he said that communicating like this was a unique skill. Nykke focuses her gaze on you, and you can tell that she’s trying to ‘impress’ something into your psyche – like an idea, or an emotion – but all you wind up feeling is a dull thud in the front of your head. Do you feel anything?"

rows.original: You answer that you don’t. She grunts out loud and stops her attempts. “Talking with our mouths is so awkward!” she curses to the ocean. “And using ‘words?’ What’s the point of communicating at all if you’re going to hide your intentions behind ‘words?’”
rows.translation: 你回答没有。她出声低吼，停止尝试。“用嘴说话太别扭了！”她对着大海咒骂。“而且还要用‘词语’？如果要把意图藏在‘词语’背后，交流还有什么意义？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou answer that you don’t. She grunts out loud and stops her attempts. “Talking with our mouths is so awkward!” she curses to the ocean. “And using ‘words?’ What’s the point of communicating at all if you’re going to hide your intentions behind ‘words?’”"

rows.original: She turns to you, her eyes arching and her lips flat, trying to mask her expression as best as she could. “You know, I never questioned my Qim’s affection for my Qal. I could feel it whenever they spoke of him. But neither of us could feel it from him back. He always told us that he’d go to the ends of the ‘universe,’ whatever that was, for us. But we never felt his sincerity.” Her expression quickly sours, as if you had just personally wronged her. “What if your ‘words’ could be used to say something you don’t feel? How do I know that every single word you’ve ever said didn’t truly mean what you felt?”
rows.translation: 她转向你，眉眼弯起，双唇紧抿，竭力掩饰自己的表情。“你知道吗，我从未怀疑琪姆对卡尔的感情。每当她提起他，我都能感觉到。但我们谁也无法从他那里感觉到同样的东西。他总说愿意为我们走到‘宇宙’尽头，不管那是什么。可我们从没感受到他的真诚。”她的神情迅速阴沉下来，仿佛你刚刚亲自冒犯了她。“如果你们的‘词语’能用来表达自己并不真正感受的事情呢？我怎么知道你说过的每个字是不是都真正代表你的感受？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns to you, her eyes arching and her lips flat, trying to mask her expression as best as she could. “You know, I never questioned my Qim’s affection for my Qal. I could feel it whenever they spoke of him. But neither of us could feel it from him back. He always told us that he’d go to the ends of the ‘universe,’ whatever that was, for us. But we never felt his sincerity.” Her expression quickly sours, as if you had just personally wronged her. “What if your ‘words’ could be used to say something you don’t feel? How do I know that every single word you’ve ever said didn’t truly mean what you felt?”"

rows.original: Funny enough, there’s a word in your language for that exact sort of question: you tell Nykke that being unable to inherently trust anyone at their word, and assuming that everyone is a liar because they have the potential to be a liar, is called ‘paranoia.’ It’s true, you can’t convey your emotions as well as she or [frostwyrm.name] can to you, but that doesn’t make you untrustworthy. [frostwyrm.name] relies on you despite of that, and... well, there isn’t a word in your language that can describe how that makes you feel about her.
rows.translation: 有趣的是，你的语言恰好有个词描述这种疑问：你告诉尼琪，因为无法本能地相信任何人的话，就认定所有人都是骗子，只因他们有可能撒谎，这叫作“偏执”。的确，你无法像她或[frostwyrm.name]那样清晰地向对方传递情绪，但这不代表你不值得信任。[frostwyrm.name]尽管如此仍信赖你，而且...好吧，你的语言里没有任何词能描述这令你对她怀有怎样的感受。
rows.raw: "\n\nFunny enough, there’s a word in your language for that exact sort of question: you tell Nykke that being unable to inherently trust anyone at their word, and assuming that everyone is a liar because they have the potential to be a liar, is called ‘paranoia.’ It’s true, you can’t convey your emotions as well as she or [frostwyrm.name] can to you, but that doesn’t make you untrustworthy. [frostwyrm.name] relies on you despite of that, and... well, there isn’t a word in your language that can describe how that makes you feel about her."

rows.original: You consider Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] to be gifted and privileged; being able to communicate to each other so purely is a real gift that should be shared with the world, if they could. There are an untold number of languages out there: if everyone could skip the words and jump straight to the ideas, a lot of barriers would be taken down in a hurry.
rows.translation: 你认为尼琪与[frostwyrm.name]都拥有天赋与特权；能够如此纯粹地彼此交流是一份真正的礼物，如果可以，理应与全世界分享。外界有数不清的语言：若所有人都能跳过词语，直接传递想法，许多隔阂都会迅速消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] to be gifted and privileged; being able to communicate to each other so purely is a real gift that should be shared with the world, if they could. There are an untold number of languages out there: if everyone could skip the words and jump straight to the ideas, a lot of barriers would be taken down in a hurry."

rows.original: Nykke’s eyes stay on yours, and you unflinchingly stare back, hoping that she’ll find your earnestness in them. Apparently satisfied, she relaxes back into her snowy seat, her tail wagging once beneath her, content in what she found. Do you think you could learn? To communicate like my kind could?
rows.translation: 尼琪始终盯着你的眼睛，而你毫不退缩地与她对视，希望她能从中看出你的真诚。她似乎满意了，重新放松地靠回雪地座位，身下尾巴惬意地摇了一下。你觉得自己能学会吗？像我的种族那样交流？
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s eyes stay on yours, and you unflinchingly stare back, hoping that she’ll find your earnestness in them. Apparently satisfied, she relaxes back into her snowy seat, her tail wagging once beneath her, content in what she found. Do you think you could learn? To communicate like my kind could?"

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] had put it best, when you asked her. In her own words, you are as equally equipped as any Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t seem to think you can’t be taught.
rows.translation: 你问过[frostwyrm.name]时，她已经说得再清楚不过。用她的话说，你和任何霜龙拥有同样的条件；[frostwyrm.name]似乎不认为你无法学会。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] had put it best, when you asked her. In her own words, you are as equally equipped as any Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t seem to think you can’t be taught."

rows.original: I could try to teach you, she offers. It catches you by surprise – you hadn’t expected Nykke to be so accommodating.
rows.translation: 我可以试着教你。她主动提议。这令你颇为惊讶——没想到尼琪会如此迁就。
rows.raw: "\n\nI could try to teach you, she offers. It catches you by surprise – you hadn’t expected Nykke to be so accommodating."

rows.original: You reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two.
rows.translation: 你回答说自己应该是卡尔，而据你所知，这意味着你才应该当老师。你猜，如果尼琪费心教会你像霜龙一样交流，那就会使她成为你们两人之间的卡尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two."

rows.original: “Hmmph,” Nykke hums, her hips squirming in the snow beneath her. “That sounds like a great idea to me. Maybe we should skip the lessons.” Her eyes are on you again, narrowed predatorily, and her lips split apart by her tongue, wetting them in a long, languid swipe. “I’m giving you one chance to back out.”
rows.translation: “哼嗯。”尼琪低哼着，臀胯在身下雪地里不安地扭动。“我觉得这是个绝妙主意。也许我们应该跳过课程。”她再次望向你，眼睛像捕食者般眯起，舌头分开双唇，缓慢而慵懒地舔湿它们。“我只给你一次退出的机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmph,” Nykke hums, her hips squirming in the snow beneath her. “That sounds like a great idea to me. Maybe we should skip the lessons.” Her eyes are on you again, narrowed predatorily, and her lips split apart by her tongue, wetting them in a long, languid swipe. “I’m giving you one chance to back out.”"

rows.original: You laugh, and say that you’ll take the lessons. Maybe you can save the happy ending for whether it works out or not.
rows.translation: 你笑了起来，说自己愿意上课。也许可以把快乐结局留到看看课程是否奏效之后。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh, and say that you’ll take the lessons. Maybe you can save the happy ending for whether it works out or not."

rows.original: The next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her.
rows.translation: 接下来一个小时左右，尼琪都在试图用语言说明自己集中灵能力量时做了什么：她会专注于什么，又如何从一种念头中过滤出另一种——这过程远比你最初想象的复杂。心智会极其迅速地接收大量信息，同时产生自己的思绪、想法与表达；如果尼琪不够谨慎而有所选择，只是将所有思绪一股脑灌进链接，你很容易就会把自己错当成她。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her."

rows.original: However, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them.
rows.translation: 然而，尽管你竭力学习，尼琪也竭力教导，最终你仍未更接近理解灵能如何运作，更不用说掌握它。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them."

rows.original: You have a link to [frostwyrm.name], and a minor one to Nykke, but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her.
rows.translation: 你与[frostwyrm.name]之间有一条链接，与尼琪之间也有一条较弱的链接；不过虽然你能接收任何思绪、想法、表达或灵感，对你而言这始终是单向连接，你无法将自己的思想沿链接传回去。每当你产生念头，尼琪都能捕捉并理解，但这与由你主动向她投射并不相同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a link to [frostwyrm.name], and a minor one to Nykke, but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her."

rows.original: “Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. “If you can’t do it, and my Qal couldn’t do it, it’s hard not to think that us Frostwyrms might be alone.”
rows.translation: “世上还有其他种族能像我们一样交流吗？”尼琪问道。勤奋尝试整整一小时却一无所获，令她十分沮丧。“如果你做不到，我的卡尔也做不到，就很难不认为我们霜龙是孤独的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. “If you can’t do it, and my Qal couldn’t do it, it’s hard not to think that us Frostwyrms might be alone.”"

rows.original: You respond that, as far as you know, Frostwyrms are one of the only kinds that can. Maybe it’s simply a uniquely-Uvetan trait.
rows.translation: 你回答说，据你所知，霜龙是少数能做到这一点的种族之一。也许这只是乌维托独有的特征。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond that, as far as you know, Frostwyrms are one of the only kinds that can. Maybe it’s simply a uniquely-Uvetan trait."

rows.original: “No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what your Qim meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”
rows.translation: “不，我不同意。”尼琪斩钉截铁地说道，一边向你靠近，眼睛坚定地眯起，紧盯着你。“我明白你的琪姆是什么意思：我们拥有相同的条件。你应该能像我这样交流。只是....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what your Qim meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”"

rows.original: It’s just that you can’t?
rows.translation: 只是你做不到？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s just that you can’t?"

rows.original: “I don’t know how to explain it. Argh, this is all very frustrating!” she exclaims to the ocean. “It’s not like it’s some secret. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way that another kind that can understand–” In her frustration, she picks up two fistfuls of snow with both her left hands, and hurls them as hard as she can into the water. “‘Words’ were a mistake!”
rows.translation: “我不知道该怎么解释。啊，这一切太令人沮丧了！”她对着大海喊道。“这又不是什么秘密。我明白自己在做什么；无论问哪个同族，对方也会明白。但我没法用另一个种族能够理解的方式解释——”她沮丧地用左侧两只手各抓起一把雪，用尽全力将其掷进海里。“‘词语’就是个错误！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know how to explain it. Argh, this is all very frustrating!” she exclaims to the ocean. “It’s not like it’s some secret. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way that another kind that can understand–” In her frustration, she picks up two fistfuls of snow with both her left hands, and hurls them as hard as she can into the water. “‘Words’ were a mistake!”"

rows.original: You lean into Nykke, snuggling yourself against her enormous form to get her to calm down. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explaining what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before.
rows.translation: 你靠向尼琪，贴着她硕大的身体依偎，希望她冷静下来。你感谢她为自己如此努力，也明白这并不容易。你将其比作用语言向一个从未见过蓝色的人解释什么是蓝色。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean into Nykke, snuggling yourself against her enormous form to get her to calm down. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explaining what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before."

rows.original: Nykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations.”
rows.translation: 尼琪探查你的心智，试图理解你的意思，不过很快便退了出去。“对！完全就是那样！”她说道，兴奋地拍打自己的腿，因为至少终于能将挫败感说出口。“在伟大琪姆的阴影下，你究竟要怎么向别人解释如此基础的东西？”她靠向你，回以依偎，同时试着让自己平静。“至少你们的种族知道该如何传达这种挫败感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations.”"

rows.original: There, you see? Words aren’t all bad.
rows.translation: 你看吧？词语也不全是坏事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere, you see? Words aren’t all bad."

rows.original: That gets her to laugh, which is good: you’ve gotten her to calm down a bit. You suggest that you two can try again later, if she’d like.
rows.translation: 这句话逗笑了她，很好；你已经让她稍微冷静下来。你提议，如果她愿意，你们之后可以再试。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat gets her to laugh, which is good: you’ve gotten her to calm down a bit. You suggest that you two can try again later, if she’d like."

rows.original: She ‘tch’s’ at the suggestion, but doesn’t immediately dismiss it. “Maybe in a Light’s Rise or two,” she says. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”
rows.translation: 她听到提议后咂了咂舌，却没有立刻否定。“也许等一两个光升之后，”她说道。“这会给我一些时间思考。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe ‘tch’s’ at the suggestion, but doesn’t immediately dismiss it. “Maybe in a Light’s Rise or two,” she says. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little peeved over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now.
rows.translation: 你们刚刚才为此折腾了一整场！尼琪仍因无法教会你使用灵能而有些恼火，所以现在最好不要再得寸进尺。
rows.raw: "You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little peeved over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now."

rows.original: Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world.
rows.translation: 你冷不防地问尼琪，她对这个世界了解多少。
rows.raw: "Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world."

rows.original: She has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across the ocean’s horizon, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “I had been wandering ever since I left my Qim’s lair. If the world has an end to it, I’m not sure if I’ll ever find it. Although there are fewer mates in the world than I was expecting to find.”
rows.translation: 她得花点时间思考答案：她轻点下巴，视线扫过海平线，思索该如何组织回答。“我听说它非常大，”片刻后她说道。“自从离开琪姆的巢穴，我便一直四处游荡。如果世界有尽头，我不确定自己是否永远能找到。不过世上的伴侣比我原以为的要少。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across the ocean’s horizon, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “I had been wandering ever since I left my Qim’s lair. If the world has an end to it, I’m not sure if I’ll ever find it. Although there are fewer mates in the world than I was expecting to find.”"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm, or, at least, you weren’t always; you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]. You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”
rows.translation: 你告诉尼琪，自己不是霜龙，至少过去并不一直是；你生来是[pc.aOriginalRace]。你让她猜猜你有多少同族。“几百？”她问，你告诉她远不止。“几千？”比那还多。她专心地眯起眼睛。“嗯....”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm, or, at least, you weren’t always; you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]. You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm, you’re a [pc.race]. You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”
rows.translation: 你告诉尼琪，自己不是霜龙，而是[pc.race]。你让她猜猜你有多少同族。“几百？”她问，你告诉她远不止。“几千？”比那还多。她专心地眯起眼睛。“嗯....”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm, you’re a [pc.race]. You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”"

rows.original: There are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist.
rows.translation: 你的同族数量多到她可能无法真正想象；那个数字大得令她也许根本无法理解其数量级。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist."

rows.original: And, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there. Your kind have named the world as Nykke knows it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it.
rows.translation: 除了你的同族数量如此庞大，外面还有其他世界。你的种族把尼琪所知的这个世界命名为“乌维托”；如今你去过许多其他行星，也与许多其他种族打过交道，甚至很难将一切都分门别类。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there. Your kind have named the world as Nykke knows it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it."

rows.original: You start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “I do,” she says, and you can tell that she’s relieved that you’re finally using words she understands. “‘Warm’ is what I would feel when I curled up against my Qal.” She leans into you, her two, thick right arms curling around you and pulling her into her muscular frame. “Although I’m sure you can find a way to make me warmer than that, in all your wisdom, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 你从简单的开始：问尼琪是否明白温暖是什么意思。“明白，”她说。你看得出，她终于听到自己能理解的词，顿时松了口气。“‘温暖’就是我蜷在卡尔身旁时的感受。”她靠向你，两条粗壮的右臂绕住你，将她拉进自己肌肉结实的身躯。“不过以你的智慧，[pc.name]，我相信你能找到办法让我比那时更加温暖。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “I do,” she says, and you can tell that she’s relieved that you’re finally using words she understands. “‘Warm’ is what I would feel when I curled up against my Qal.” She leans into you, her two, thick right arms curling around you and pulling her into her muscular frame. “Although I’m sure you can find a way to make me warmer than that, in all your wisdom, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You tell her that it’s something you’ll consider, but right now, you’re trying to be a teacher to her. To continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己会考虑，不过现在正试着当她的老师。你继续问尼琪是否明白“炎热”是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that it’s something you’ll consider, but right now, you’re trying to be a teacher to her. To continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’"

rows.original: You feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Uh...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? There’s no such thing, is there?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breath; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it.
rows.translation: 你感觉心智再次受到牵引，却让她用自己的话回答。“呃...，”她结巴着。“不明白。”你教她，简单地说，“炎热”就是过于温暖。“过于温暖？不会有那种事吧？”确实会有：当你太热时，会感觉像在窒息，被困在自己的身体里。周围空气过热，呼吸会疼；脚下地面过热，行走会疼。当热量无处不在，你会感觉自己简直...无处可逃。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Uh...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? There’s no such thing, is there?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breath; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it."

rows.original: “But it feels that way if we’re too cold, as well,” she notes. That’s right! If it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot.
rows.translation: “可是太冷时也会有那种感觉，”她指出。没错！天气过冷同样会让人感觉受限而痛苦。正如乌维托这样永远极寒的地方，也会有永远极热的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But it feels that way if we’re too cold, as well,” she notes. That’s right! If it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot."

rows.original: Nykke considers your words, but from the expression on her face and the low, contemplative growl in her throat, she’s not liking what you’re telling her. “Is there any place that is neither?” she asks; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if Nykke is truly the daughter of an Ausar, she’ll be able to adapt and survive in any environment, too.
rows.translation: 尼琪思索着你的话，可从她脸上的表情和喉咙中低沉而沉思的咆哮来看，她并不喜欢你所说的内容。“有没有既不冷也不热的地方？”她问道；她很难相信世界——或者说诸多世界——竟会如此艰难而残酷。你回答，有些地方可能过热，有些地方可能过冷，但能够克服障碍，在这样的环境中存活甚至繁荣，正是你的种族如此坚韧的原因。而且，如果尼琪确实是奥萨人的女儿，她也能够适应任何环境并活下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke considers your words, but from the expression on her face and the low, contemplative growl in her throat, she’s not liking what you’re telling her. “Is there any place that is neither?” she asks; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if Nykke is truly the daughter of an Ausar, she’ll be able to adapt and survive in any environment, too."

rows.original: Now that you’ve properly gotten Nykke hooked on your stories, you continue enthusiastically; you start with your parentage and that you’re an heir to... well, it’d be a difficult to explain in a way she understands, but, in the very barest, lamest terms you can, you explain that your own parent had passed away some time ago, and you’re on a journey to reclaim his own lair for yourself.
rows.translation: 既然已经成功勾起尼琪对故事的兴趣，你便兴致勃勃地继续；先从自己的出身讲起，说自己是某个...好吧，要用她能理解的方式解释会很困难，不过用最简陋、最乏味的说法，你解释说自己的父亲在一段时间前去世，而你正踏上旅途，要为自己夺回他的巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you’ve properly gotten Nykke hooked on your stories, you continue enthusiastically; you start with your parentage and that you’re an heir to... well, it’d be a difficult to explain in a way she understands, but, in the very barest, lamest terms you can, you explain that your own parent had passed away some time ago, and you’re on a journey to reclaim his own lair for yourself."

rows.original: “You did not stay with your Qim and your Qal until they were summoned?” Nykke asks, and you confirm; your kind typically only stay with their parents until they’re fully matured, and then they set out on their own, to find their own lairs and their own mates. “Now that you mention it,” she says, “my Qal did say something about that. He found it unusual that Frostwyrms would stay with their Qim and Qal until their summoning.”
rows.translation: “你没有一直和琪姆、卡尔住在一起，直到他们受召唤吗？”尼琪问道，你予以确认；你的种族通常只与父母生活到完全成熟，之后便独自出发，寻找自己的巢穴与伴侣。“现在你这么一提，”她说道，“我的卡尔的确说过类似的事。他觉得霜龙会一直与琪姆、卡尔同住，直至他们受召唤，很不寻常。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You did not stay with your Qim and your Qal until they were summoned?” Nykke asks, and you confirm; your kind typically only stay with their parents until they’re fully matured, and then they set out on their own, to find their own lairs and their own mates. “Now that you mention it,” she says, “my Qal did say something about that. He found it unusual that Frostwyrms would stay with their Qim and Qal until their summoning.”"

rows.original: When your own father was, as Nykke would understand it, ‘summoned,’ you had set out on a mission to claim what was his for your own. That’s taken you to planets full of lush, dense, green jungle; planets of trashy, difficult, desert terrain and wasteland; deep into dark, rocky caves; and even to very small, man-made planets called ‘stations.’ Uveto is just one of the more recent stops in your mission to claim your inheritance.
rows.translation: 当你自己的父亲，用尼琪能够理解的话说，“受召唤”以后，你便踏上任务，要将属于他的东西据为己有。这趟旅程带你去过长满茂密翠绿丛林的行星；遍布垃圾、难以通行的沙漠地形与荒原的行星；深入过黑暗的岩石洞穴；甚至造访过名为“空间站”的极小型人造行星。乌维托只是你追寻遗产途中较为近期的一站。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen your own father was, as Nykke would understand it, ‘summoned,’ you had set out on a mission to claim what was his for your own. That’s taken you to planets full of lush, dense, green jungle; planets of trashy, difficult, desert terrain and wasteland; deep into dark, rocky caves; and even to very small, man-made planets called ‘stations.’ Uveto is just one of the more recent stops in your mission to claim your inheritance."

rows.original: You feel something pulling at your mind; a curious, probing sensation, rummaging through your memories, almost the same way that [frostwyrm.name] plucks at your head when you use a word she doesn’t understand. As interested as Nykke is on your stories, she doesn’t understand half the things you’re saying. She probably doesn’t even know what a ‘green’ is, never mind a ‘jungle.’
rows.translation: 你感觉有什么东西在拉扯自己的心智；那是一种好奇而探寻的感觉，翻检着你的记忆，几乎就像每当你使用[frostwyrm.name]不懂的词时，她在你脑中翻找一样。尼琪虽然对故事很感兴趣，却有一半内容都听不懂。她可能连“绿色”是什么都不知道，更不用说“丛林”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel something pulling at your mind; a curious, probing sensation, rummaging through your memories, almost the same way that [frostwyrm.name] plucks at your head when you use a word she doesn’t understand. As interested as Nykke is on your stories, she doesn’t understand half the things you’re saying. She probably doesn’t even know what a ‘green’ is, never mind a ‘jungle.’"

rows.original: Nykke’s eyes widen in her head when she finds your conjured images of what a jungle looks like, and what a station looks like. “I could never have imagined that the world would be such a diverse place. I thought that everywhere was like this,” she pauses, gesturing to the snow and ice around you, “everywhere.” Her psionic ‘pulling’ becomes especially intense when you share the image of a cave with her – something about the darker environment has her attention. “Could I travel to any of these places as well?”
rows.translation: 尼琪从你想象出的画面里看见丛林与空间站的模样时，双眼惊讶地睁大。“我从没想过世界会如此丰富多样。我以为所有地方都像这里一样，”她停顿下来，指了指你们周围的冰雪，“到处都是。”当你与她分享洞穴的景象时，灵能的“拉扯”尤其强烈——那种黑暗环境中的某些东西吸引了她。“我也能去这些地方旅行吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s eyes widen in her head when she finds your conjured images of what a jungle looks like, and what a station looks like. “I could never have imagined that the world would be such a diverse place. I thought that everywhere was like this,” she pauses, gesturing to the snow and ice around you, “everywhere.” Her psionic ‘pulling’ becomes especially intense when you share the image of a cave with her – something about the darker environment has her attention. “Could I travel to any of these places as well?”"

rows.original: You can feel her imagination running wild in your own head: she doesn’t like the idea of being somewhere that’s too hot, or someplace that’s somehow even colder than Uveto, but she nonetheless wants to explore them for her own. You tell her that she could – there’s nothing saying she couldn’t travel the stars with you, and visit all these new locations with you – but... well, one thing at a time.
rows.translation: 你能感觉她的想象力在自己脑海中肆意驰骋：她不喜欢身处过热之地的想法，也不喜欢某个不知为何比乌维托还要寒冷的地方，但仍想亲自探索。你告诉她当然可以——没有任何规定说她不能与你遨游群星，和你一起造访这些新地点——不过...好吧，事情得一步一步来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can feel her imagination running wild in your own head: she doesn’t like the idea of being somewhere that’s too hot, or someplace that’s somehow even colder than Uveto, but she nonetheless wants to explore them for her own. You tell her that she could – there’s nothing saying she couldn’t travel the stars with you, and visit all these new locations with you – but... well, one thing at a time."

rows.original: Nykke relaxes her body against you, pulling your cheek up against her firm right boob, as she idly fantasizes about leaving Uveto with you and traveling with you on your adventures. The two of you would travel to these ‘hot’ places; she could fly over the tops of the ‘jungles’ and she would help you navigate the dark ‘caves,’ and then, when you two find a spot that isn’t too warm, or too cold, or too jungle or too cave, she finds the perfect lair, one as big as could be, where she and her mate can raise their own clutch.
rows.translation: 尼琪放松身体靠在你身上，将你的脸颊拉到她坚挺的右乳旁，漫不经心地幻想着与你一起离开乌维托、伴随你展开冒险。你们会前往那些“炎热”的地方；她可以飞越“丛林”顶端，帮助你穿行黑暗“洞穴”；之后，你们会找到一个既不太热也不太冷、既不太丛林也不太洞穴的地方，她在那里找到完美巢穴，尽可能宽广，让她和伴侣能够养育属于自己的后代。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke relaxes her body against you, pulling your cheek up against her firm right boob, as she idly fantasizes about leaving Uveto with you and traveling with you on your adventures. The two of you would travel to these ‘hot’ places; she could fly over the tops of the ‘jungles’ and she would help you navigate the dark ‘caves,’ and then, when you two find a spot that isn’t too warm, or too cold, or too jungle or too cave, she finds the perfect lair, one as big as could be, where she and her mate can raise their own clutch."

rows.original: Of course, this imaginary mate of hers is unmistakably you: every time she takes a breath through her nose, your scent sharply defines yourself in her fantasies, and in those fantasies, it’s you that she settles down with and makes a clutch with. A huge one. One that fills the jungles and the caves until they’re full of nothing but your clutch; you two would find a world that has no Frostwyrms in it, and you’d spread your kind until you are the dominant species.
rows.translation: 当然，她想象中的伴侣显然就是你：每当她用鼻子吸气，你的气味都会在幻想中鲜明地勾勒出你的存在；在那里，与你定居、与你共同孕育后代的人正是她。一窝无比庞大的后代。多到填满丛林与洞穴，直到那里除了你们的子嗣以外什么都没有；你们会找到一个没有霜龙的世界，散播自己的种族，直到成为优势物种。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, this imaginary mate of hers is unmistakably you: every time she takes a breath through her nose, your scent sharply defines yourself in her fantasies, and in those fantasies, it’s you that she settles down with and makes a clutch with. A huge one. One that fills the jungles and the caves until they’re full of nothing but your clutch; you two would find a world that has no Frostwyrms in it, and you’d spread your kind until you are the dominant species."

rows.original: Then, she, in her fantasy, and projected to you through your psionic connection, looks right into your eyes. “I know you can see all this,” she says to you. “It would take time... but we could make all this real, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 随后，幻想中的她通过灵能连接将这一切投射给你，并直视你的双眼。“我知道你能看见这一切，”她对你说道。“这需要时间...但我们可以让这一切成为现实，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, she, in her fantasy, and projected to you through your psionic connection, looks right into your eyes. “I know you can see all this,” she says to you. “It would take time... but we could make all this real, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: Her psionic projection of herself grabs you by the hand and takes you to the mouth of your cave, overlooking an expansive jungle, reaching as far into the horizon as any ocean. Imagine it, she says, her hand waving over your visage of the treetops. An entire world, dominated by our progeny. And once our kips establish themselves as the apex predator of one world, we go and propagate the next.
rows.translation: 她的灵能投影牵起你的手，把你带到洞口，俯瞰广袤丛林；林海如大洋一般一直延伸到地平线尽头。想象一下，她说道，手掌扫过你视野中的树冠。整个世界都由我们的后代统治。等我们的幼崽成为一个世界的顶级掠食者，我们再前往下一个世界繁衍。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer psionic projection of herself grabs you by the hand and takes you to the mouth of your cave, overlooking an expansive jungle, reaching as far into the horizon as any ocean. Imagine it, she says, her hand waving over your visage of the treetops. An entire world, dominated by our progeny. And once our kips establish themselves as the apex predator of one world, we go and propagate the next."

rows.original: Her body turns towards you, and her Frostwyrmling cock is as erect as could possibly be, bobbing
rows.translation: 她的身体转向你，那根幼霜龙肉棒已经硬到极致，正在弹动
rows.raw: "\n\nHer body turns towards you, and her Frostwyrmling cock is as erect as could possibly be, bobbing"

rows.original: between your bodies, dripping its pre to the ground.
rows.translation: 在你们身体之间，前列腺液滴落到地面。
rows.raw: " between your bodies, dripping its pre to the ground."

rows.original: right between your eyes, dripping its pre onto your nose.
rows.translation: 就在你双眼之间，前列腺液滴落在鼻子上。
rows.raw: " right between your eyes, dripping its pre onto your nose."

rows.original: above your head, dripping its pre onto your [pc.hair].
rows.translation: 悬在你头顶上方，将前液滴落在你的[pc.hair]上。
rows.raw: " above your head, dripping its pre onto your [pc.hair]."

rows.original: Do not pretend you would not enjoy every last second of it, either.
rows.translation: 也别装作自己不会享受其中的每一秒。
rows.raw: " Do not pretend you would not enjoy every last second of it, either."

rows.original: The psionic vision ends abruptly, and you’re back on cold, unforgiving Uveto, sitting in the snowbank next to Nykke. Her legs and thighs shift against each other, and you can see the beginnings of a half-chub peek from between her thick, muscular thighs. She’s putting in the token effort to hide it, but... you can tell, she wants you to start imagining on your own terms.
rows.translation: 灵能幻象戛然而止，你回到了寒冷无情的乌维托，和妮凯一起坐在雪堆旁。她的双腿和大腿彼此摩擦，你能看见半硬的肉棒开始从她粗壮结实的双腿之间探出来。她象征性地试着遮掩它，但...你看得出来，她希望你开始按照自己的想法去想象。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe psionic vision ends abruptly, and you’re back on cold, unforgiving Uveto, sitting in the snowbank next to Nykke. Her legs and thighs shift against each other, and you can see the beginnings of a half-chub peek from between her thick, muscular thighs. She’s putting in the token effort to hide it, but... you can tell, she wants you to start imagining on your own terms."

rows.original: Well... it’s working.
rows.translation: 好吧...确实奏效了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell... it’s working."

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: You’ve just talked about this! The idea of traveling the stars and seeing new cultures and peoples is an exciting idea for Nykke. She probably wouldn’t be against going with you some day.
rows.translation: 你们刚刚才谈过这个！在群星间旅行、见识新的文化和种族，这个想法令妮凯兴奋不已。或许有一天，她不会反对和你一起出发。
rows.raw: "You’ve just talked about this! The idea of traveling the stars and seeing new cultures and peoples is an exciting idea for Nykke. She probably wouldn’t be against going with you some day."

rows.original: Lying as you are next to Nykke, you snake your hand down one of her large, muscular arms, until your hand meets hers. You intermingle your fingers with her claws, and give her hand an affectionate squeeze. Nykke recognizes the action – she probably learned it from her Ausar Qal – and she squeezes back, although you can sense the wonder in why you’d do that.
rows.translation: 你和妮凯并肩躺着，手沿着她一条粗壮结实的手臂滑下，直到碰到她的手。你将手指穿入她的利爪之间，亲昵地握了握她的手。妮凯认出了这个动作——她大概是从自己的奥萨人Qal那里学到的——于是也回握住你，尽管你能感到她不明白你为何要这么做。
rows.raw: "Lying as you are next to Nykke, you snake your hand down one of her large, muscular arms, until your hand meets hers. You intermingle your fingers with her claws, and give her hand an affectionate squeeze. Nykke recognizes the action – she probably learned it from her Ausar Qal – and she squeezes back, although you can sense the wonder in why you’d do that."

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you’d like to talk to her about something, but she doesn’t need to answer if she isn’t ready. You recognize that it’s a bit of a sensitive topic for her.
rows.translation: 你告诉妮凯，自己想和她谈一件事，不过如果她还没准备好，也不必回答。你知道这对她而言是个有些敏感的话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you’d like to talk to her about something, but she doesn’t need to answer if she isn’t ready. You recognize that it’s a bit of a sensitive topic for her."

rows.original: “It’s about my scales, isn’t it?” she asks defensively. You respond affirmatively.
rows.translation: “是关于我的鳞片，对吧？”她戒备地问道。你给出了肯定的回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s about my scales, isn’t it?” she asks defensively. You respond affirmatively."

rows.original: Nykke says nothing further, and instead lets out a long, heavy sigh, in through her nose and out through her mouth. With the three arms you’re not holding, she lifts her hands to her eyes, so she can get a closer look at her own body. Her onyx-black scales reflect the light of the ocean with a brilliant dark sheen, making it easy to focus on her compared to the whites of the snow and ice and the blues of the water.
rows.translation: 妮凯没有再说什么，只是长长地沉重叹息一声，从鼻子吸气，再从嘴里呼出。她用没被你握住的三条手臂把手举到眼前，以便更仔细地端详自己的身体。她那缟玛瑙般漆黑的鳞片反射着海面光芒，泛起耀眼的暗色光泽；与雪冰的洁白和海水的湛蓝相比，这让她格外醒目。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke says nothing further, and instead lets out a long, heavy sigh, in through her nose and out through her mouth. With the three arms you’re not holding, she lifts her hands to her eyes, so she can get a closer look at her own body. Her onyx-black scales reflect the light of the ocean with a brilliant dark sheen, making it easy to focus on her compared to the whites of the snow and ice and the blues of the water."

rows.original: “You haven’t had to live a life like mine, so you wouldn’t understand,”
rows.translation: “你没过过我这样的生活，所以你不会明白，”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You haven’t had to live a life like mine, so you wouldn’t understand,”"

rows.original: “You’re not a Frostwyrm, so you wouldn’t understand”
rows.translation: “你不是霜龙，所以你不会明白。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re not a Frostwyrm, so you wouldn’t understand”"

rows.original: she says sombrely. Rather than contest her, you remain silent, patiently waiting for her to continue. “Frostwyrms... we develop our connections – you call them ‘psionics’ – when we’re still in the egg. We can feel everything our Qims and Qals feel before we’re even really born. I don’t remember a lot from when I hatched, but....” Her fingers shake in her three outstretched hands. She lowers them, folding them over her stomach, so she doesn’t have to look at them anymore. “I remember what they felt when they first saw me.”
rows.translation: 她阴郁地说道。你没有反驳，只是沉默地耐心等她继续。“霜龙...我们还在蛋里时，就会建立彼此的联系——你们称之为‘灵能’——。我们甚至还没真正出生，就能感受到自己的Qim和Qal感受到的一切。我不太记得刚孵化时的事，但....”她伸出的三只手微微颤抖。她把手放下，交叠在腹部，这样就不用再看着它们。“我记得他们第一次看到我时的感受。”
rows.raw: " she says sombrely. Rather than contest her, you remain silent, patiently waiting for her to continue. “Frostwyrms... we develop our connections – you call them ‘psionics’ – when we’re still in the egg. We can feel everything our Qims and Qals feel before we’re even really born. I don’t remember a lot from when I hatched, but....” Her fingers shake in her three outstretched hands. She lowers them, folding them over her stomach, so she doesn’t have to look at them anymore. “I remember what they felt when they first saw me.”"

rows.translation: 一窝幼崽

rows.original: , you can imagine what they had felt. Concern over her health; worry over her development; but, most of all, total, unyielding, unconditional love for their kip.
rows.translation: ，因此你能想象他们当时的感受：担忧她的健康，忧虑她的发育；但最重要的是，对自己幼崽绝对、坚定、无条件的爱。
rows.raw: ", you can imagine what they had felt. Concern over her health; worry over her development; but, most of all, total, unyielding, unconditional love for their kip."

rows.original: “Frostwyrms are a very emotional kind,” she says. “I, uh... it was tough for me to look at my Qim and wonder why I was so different from them. The first few Sky Cycles, it was hard for me not to look at my reflection in the ocean and not consider myself a f-... a freak.”
rows.translation: “霜龙是一个非常感性的种族，”她说道。“我，呃...看着我的Qim，思考自己为什么和他们如此不同，对我来说很难受。最初几个天轮里，我每次看见自己映在海里的倒影，都很难不觉得自己是个怪...怪物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Frostwyrms are a very emotional kind,” she says. “I, uh... it was tough for me to look at my Qim and wonder why I was so different from them. The first few Sky Cycles, it was hard for me not to look at my reflection in the ocean and not consider myself a f-... a freak.”"

rows.original: Nykke takes another, longer, deeper sigh through her nose. She’s mastered her psionics, but... perhaps because of her half-Ausar upbringing, you can feel her control on herself slipping. You can feel a sort of cutting pain in your heart – it’s very slight, but if you’re feeling it, you can only imagine what Nykke has been suppressing for the last two hundred years.
rows.translation: 妮凯又从鼻腔中发出一声更长、更深的叹息。她已经掌握了灵能，但...或许是因为她有一半奥萨人的成长经历，你能感觉到她对自身的控制正在松动。你心中传来一种刀割般的疼痛——非常轻微；可既然连你都能感觉到，就只能想象妮凯在过去两百年间压抑了多少痛苦。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke takes another, longer, deeper sigh through her nose. She’s mastered her psionics, but... perhaps because of her half-Ausar upbringing, you can feel her control on herself slipping. You can feel a sort of cutting pain in your heart – it’s very slight, but if you’re feeling it, you can only imagine what Nykke has been suppressing for the last two hundred years."

rows.original: “Why did your Qim choose you?” she asks suddenly. “[frostwyrm.name] had her choice of any Frostwyrm in the world, but she chose you. Do you think she gets... I don’t know, lonely? Knowing she’s the only pureblood Frostwyrm in her clutch?”
rows.translation: “你的Qim为什么选择你？”她突然问道。“[frostwyrm.name]本可以从全世界任何一条霜龙中挑选，却选择了你。你觉得她会不会...我不知道，感到孤独？知道自己是这一窝里唯一的纯血霜龙？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why did your Qim choose you?” she asks suddenly. “[frostwyrm.name] had her choice of any Frostwyrm in the world, but she chose you. Do you think she gets... I don’t know, lonely? Knowing she’s the only pureblood Frostwyrm in her clutch?”"

rows.original: You respond, with all sincerity, that [frostwyrm.name] has never once wanted for company since she took you on as her mate, and she had you as her Qal. <i>“Even though you’re not
rows.translation: 你无比真诚地回答，自从[frostwyrm.name]收你为伴侣、让你成为她的Qal后，她从来不缺陪伴。<i>“即使你并非
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond, with all sincerity, that [frostwyrm.name] has never once wanted for company since she took you on as her mate, and she had you as her Qal. <i>“Even though you’re not "

rows.original: pure-blooded,
rows.translation: 纯血，
rows.raw: "pure-blooded, "

rows.original: like her?”
rows.translation: 像她那样？”
rows.raw: "like her?”"

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] sometimes likes to remind you that you weren’t her first choice in mate. She had spent much of her life searching for another Frostwyrm like herself, but in all her searching, she couldn’t find one, and she had to ‘settle’ for you.
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]有时喜欢提醒你，你并不是她选择伴侣时的首选。她一生中的大部分时间都在寻找另一条和自己相同的霜龙，但寻遍各处也没能找到，只得‘将就’着选择了你。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] sometimes likes to remind you that you weren’t her first choice in mate. She had spent much of her life searching for another Frostwyrm like herself, but in all her searching, she couldn’t find one, and she had to ‘settle’ for you."

rows.original: But, you continue, she also likes to remind you that she doesn’t regret her choice in the very least. If she could go back in time, and she knew everything she knows now, and she found a pure-blooded Frostwyrm to mate with, she’d choose to mate with you, every single time.
rows.translation: 但你继续说道，她也喜欢提醒你，她对自己的选择丝毫不后悔。如果能够回到过去，仍然知道现在所知的一切，又找到了一条纯血霜龙作为配偶，她每一次都会选择和你交配。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, you continue, she also likes to remind you that she doesn’t regret her choice in the very least. If she could go back in time, and she knew everything she knows now, and she found a pure-blooded Frostwyrm to mate with, she’d choose to mate with you, every single time."

rows.translation: 你告诉妮凯，对[frostwyrm.name]而言，你和她有所不同根本无关紧要；你或许不是
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that it doesn’t matter to [frostwyrm.name] that you’re different than her; you may not be a "

rows.translation: 纯血
rows.raw: "pure-blooded "

rows.translation: 霜龙，但你给了她美丽、健康而强壮的
rows.raw: "Frostwyrm, but you’ve given her a beautiful, healthy, strong "

rows.translation: 幼崽
rows.raw: "kip"

rows.original: clutch
rows.translation: 一窝
rows.raw: "clutch"

rows.original: , and you’ve filled the gap in her heart with your affection and attention as a doting mate.
rows.translation: ，并以宠爱伴侣的情意与关怀填补了她心中的空缺。
rows.raw: ", and you’ve filled the gap in her heart with your affection and attention as a doting mate."

rows.original: And, you say as you squeeze Nykke’s hand, it doesn’t matter what she looks like, either. [frostwyrm.name] wanted a clutch, and she knew she was taking a risk committing herself to you – neither of you were sure you’d be able to make it work. Nykke said it best: Frostwyrms are a highly emotional kind. You’re confident that [frostwyrm.name] would tell her that ‘compatibility’ isn’t a priority: what Nykke should want in a mate is someone that can provide her with the same affection she’s capable of putting out.
rows.translation: 而且，你一边握紧妮凯的手一边说道，她长什么样也无关紧要。[frostwyrm.name]想要一窝幼崽，而她知道把自己托付给你是在冒险——你们两人当时都不确定能否成功。妮凯自己说得最好：霜龙是高度感性的种族。你相信[frostwyrm.name]会告诉她，‘相容性’并不是首要条件；妮凯真正该从伴侣身上寻求的，是一个能回报她所付出的同等情意的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, you say as you squeeze Nykke’s hand, it doesn’t matter what she looks like, either. [frostwyrm.name] wanted a clutch, and she knew she was taking a risk committing herself to you – neither of you were sure you’d be able to make it work. Nykke said it best: Frostwyrms are a highly emotional kind. You’re confident that [frostwyrm.name] would tell her that ‘compatibility’ isn’t a priority: what Nykke should want in a mate is someone that can provide her with the same affection she’s capable of putting out."

rows.original: Your words are having an effect on Nykke, but she’s not totally convinced.
rows.translation: 你的话对妮凯产生了影响，但她仍未完全信服。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour words are having an effect on Nykke, but she’s not totally convinced."

rows.original: “I haven’t found a mate in fifty Sky Cycles, [pc.name],” she says, with a bit of punch behind her voice. It’s a difficult, emotional topic for her, and she’s forcing herself to talk about it. “Imagine wandering the world for that long, with no mate and no lair to settle in. Every song I sung died in the winds. For fifty Sky Cycles! It–” She chokes at her next word, and then starts again. “I couldn’t find any other Frostwyrms anywhere. My Qim had told me that we were a plentiful kind, with no shortage of potential mates. I had to–”
rows.translation: “我已经五十个天轮没找到伴侣了，[pc.name]，”她说道，话音中带着几分冲劲。这对她而言是个艰难而感性的话题，她正逼着自己谈下去。“想象一下，在世间游荡那么久，没有伴侣，也没有可以安顿的巢穴。我唱出的每一首歌都消逝在风中。整整五十个天轮！我——”她被下一个词哽住，随后重新开口。“我在任何地方都找不到其他霜龙。我的Qim曾告诉我，我们这个种族数量众多，潜在伴侣根本不缺。我不得不——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I haven’t found a mate in fifty Sky Cycles, [pc.name],” she says, with a bit of punch behind her voice. It’s a difficult, emotional topic for her, and she’s forcing herself to talk about it. “Imagine wandering the world for that long, with no mate and no lair to settle in. Every song I sung died in the winds. For fifty Sky Cycles! It–” She chokes at her next word, and then starts again. “I couldn’t find any other Frostwyrms anywhere. My Qim had told me that we were a plentiful kind, with no shortage of potential mates. I had to–”"

rows.original: Her voice lilts, and pitches upward. You had never seen a dragon cry before today.
rows.translation: 她的嗓音颤抖着拔高。直到今天以前，你从未见过龙落泪。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer voice lilts, and pitches upward. You had never seen a dragon cry before today."

rows.original: “Either my Qim was wrong – or even worse – or all the Frostwyrms in the world were ignoring me. And if my Qim was being false to me, and if the Frostwyrms were ignoring me, it would be because I looked like this.” She stretches two of her hands in front of herself, and then slaps the back of her own hand. “Who would – who would want to mate with a freak like me?”
rows.translation: “要么我的Qim错了——又或者更糟——世上所有霜龙都在无视我。而如果我的Qim真的骗了我，而且霜龙们真的在无视我，那就一定是因为我长成这样。”她把两只手伸到身前，随后用力拍打自己的手背。“谁会——谁会愿意和我这样的怪物交配？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Either my Qim was wrong – or even worse – or all the Frostwyrms in the world were ignoring me. And if my Qim was being false to me, and if the Frostwyrms were ignoring me, it would be because I looked like this.” She stretches two of her hands in front of herself, and then slaps the back of her own hand. “Who would – who would want to mate with a freak like me?”"

rows.original: She raises her hands to slap herself again, but you grab her by the wrist.
rows.translation: 她抬起手，想再次打自己，但你一把抓住了她的手腕。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe raises her hands to slap herself again, but you grab her by the wrist."

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you’re a Qal, and from everything you’ve learned from Frostwyrm culture, you’d know exactly what her own Qal thought of her. It doesn’t matter if her scales were white, or black, or green or purple or whatever; he wouldn’t let something as small as the tone of her scales get in the way of him loving his kip. Her scales may not be white, and you and he may not be
rows.translation: 你告诉妮凯，自己是一位Qal；从你对霜龙文化的一切了解来看，你非常清楚她自己的Qal会如何看待她。她的鳞片是白色、黑色、绿色、紫色还是别的什么都无关紧要；他绝不会让鳞片色调这种小事妨碍自己爱他的幼崽。她的鳞片也许不是白色，而你和他也许并非
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you’re a Qal, and from everything you’ve learned from Frostwyrm culture, you’d know exactly what her own Qal thought of her. It doesn’t matter if her scales were white, or black, or green or purple or whatever; he wouldn’t let something as small as the tone of her scales get in the way of him loving his kip. Her scales may not be white, and you and he may not be "

rows.translation: 纯血
rows.raw: "pure-blooded "

rows.original: Frostwyrms, but none of that would matter to either of you.
rows.translation: 霜龙，但这些对你们任何一人都不重要。
rows.raw: "Frostwyrms, but none of that would matter to either of you."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] and her own Qim threw ‘standards’ and ‘traditions’ to the wind when they chose their mates, and, you can tell her with all positivity, you’d much rather have [frostwyrm.name] as your mate, and Nykke’s Qal would rather have her as her kip, as you both are than to have you be ‘normal’ just for the sake of being ‘normal.’
rows.translation: [frostwyrm.name]和她自己的Qim在选择伴侣时，都把‘标准’与‘传统’抛诸脑后；而你可以完全肯定地告诉她，你宁愿让现在的[frostwyrm.name]成为自己的伴侣，妮凯的Qal也宁愿让现在的她成为自己的幼崽，也不愿你们只是为了所谓的‘正常’而变得‘正常’。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] and her own Qim threw ‘standards’ and ‘traditions’ to the wind when they chose their mates, and, you can tell her with all positivity, you’d much rather have [frostwyrm.name] as your mate, and Nykke’s Qal would rather have her as her kip, as you both are than to have you be ‘normal’ just for the sake of being ‘normal.’"

rows.original: It’s not about what she looks like. [frostwyrm.name] has proven to you that being a pure-blooded Frostwyrm is more of a bonus than a prerequisite. You don’t know what happened that made Frostwyrms such an endangered species after all this time, but Nykke is living proof that there is no shortage of potential mates in the world for her to choose from. Mating isn’t just about the sex: it’s about togetherness with someone that loves you and accepts you. You tell Nykke that she can find love on Uveto – hell, it might even be closer than she thinks. She might just have to follow her Qim’s, and [frostwyrm.name]’s, examples and look outside her species.
rows.translation: 这与她的外貌无关。[frostwyrm.name]已经向你证明，成为纯血霜龙更多是一项加分，而不是先决条件。你不知道经历了这么长时间后，究竟发生了什么才令霜龙成为濒危种族；但妮凯就是活生生的证据，证明世上并不缺少供她选择的潜在伴侣。交配不只关乎性，还关乎与一个爱你、接受你的人相伴。你告诉妮凯，她能在乌维托找到爱情——见鬼，对方甚至可能比她想象的更近。她或许只需要效仿自己的Qim和[frostwyrm.name]，把目光投向种族之外。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s not about what she looks like. [frostwyrm.name] has proven to you that being a pure-blooded Frostwyrm is more of a bonus than a prerequisite. You don’t know what happened that made Frostwyrms such an endangered species after all this time, but Nykke is living proof that there is no shortage of potential mates in the world for her to choose from. Mating isn’t just about the sex: it’s about togetherness with someone that loves you and accepts you. You tell Nykke that she can find love on Uveto – hell, it might even be closer than she thinks. She might just have to follow her Qim’s, and [frostwyrm.name]’s, examples and look outside her species."

rows.original: The sensation of relief comes through much more clearly, now that you’ve given her some perspective on your love for [frostwyrm.name] and the love she had from her own Qim and Qal. You can still sense just a tinge of apprehension, like a tick that refuses to let go, and you’re not certain if you’ll ever be able to get that out of her, but, apart from that, you can tell that Nykke is satisfied with your answer.
rows.translation: 如今你已让她从自己对[frostwyrm.name]的爱，以及她从自己的Qim和Qal那里得到的爱中获得新的视角，那股如释重负的感觉便清晰了许多。你仍能感觉到一丝忧虑，像一只拒绝松口的蜱虫；你不确定自己是否永远都无法将它从她心中除去。不过除此之外，你看得出妮凯对你的回答感到满意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sensation of relief comes through much more clearly, now that you’ve given her some perspective on your love for [frostwyrm.name] and the love she had from her own Qim and Qal. You can still sense just a tinge of apprehension, like a tick that refuses to let go, and you’re not certain if you’ll ever be able to get that out of her, but, apart from that, you can tell that Nykke is satisfied with your answer."

rows.original: She rests her head against yours, gazing out to the sparkling ocean before you two, and her hand squeezes yours tighter. There are a couple of obvious questions she wants to ask you, but they’re for another time – right now, she just wants to think about her parents.
rows.translation: 她把头靠在你头上，凝望你们面前波光粼粼的海洋，手也将你的手握得更紧。她显然有几个问题想问你，但那些要留到以后——此刻，她只想思念自己的父母。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rests her head against yours, gazing out to the sparkling ocean before you two, and her hand squeezes yours tighter. There are a couple of obvious questions she wants to ask you, but they’re for another time – right now, she just wants to think about her parents."

rows.translation: 黑色鳞片
rows.raw: "Black Scales"

rows.original: Black Scales
rows.translation: 黑色鳞片
rows.raw: "Black Scales"

rows.original: You aren’t sure if Nykke will ever truly be satisfied with the color of her scales... but now she knows that, to you, and to her own Qim and Qal, it never mattered what she looks like.
rows.translation: 你不确定妮凯是否有朝一日会真正满意自己的鳞片颜色...但现在她明白了，对你以及她自己的Qim和Qal而言，她长什么样从来都不重要。
rows.raw: "You aren’t sure if Nykke will ever truly be satisfied with the color of her scales... but now she knows that, to you, and to her own Qim and Qal, it never mattered what she looks like."

rows.original: You regard Nykke, her body curled and cuddled up against you; her naked, powerful form rocks and breathes against you, her scales brushing against your [pc.skinFurScales] gently. You admire her Amazonian muscles and the tightness of her body; your hand idly strokes at the muscles at her thigh, slowly making its way towards the cleft of her crotch. When your fingers tickle at a part of her leg that’s warmer than the rest, she fidgets in the snow.
rows.translation: 你端详着妮凯，她蜷起身体，依偎在你身旁；她赤裸而强健的身躯贴着你起伏呼吸，鳞片轻轻摩擦你的[pc.skinFurScales]。你欣赏着她亚马逊般的肌肉和紧实身材；你的手漫不经心地抚过她大腿上的肌肉，缓缓移向她胯间的缝隙。当你的手指挠到她腿上一处比其他地方更温暖的部位时，她在雪地里扭动起来。
rows.raw: "You regard Nykke, her body curled and cuddled up against you; her naked, powerful form rocks and breathes against you, her scales brushing against your [pc.skinFurScales] gently. You admire her Amazonian muscles and the tightness of her body; your hand idly strokes at the muscles at her thigh, slowly making its way towards the cleft of her crotch.
