Although we have welcomed her in my dwelling, she yearns for a dwelling all her own – a desire I could never fault her for. I would not aim to stifle her instincts. I have acquiesced to a dwelling of her own within my own."

rows.original: You hear the occasional chipping sound reverberate from within the cave; it sounds like a rock against another rock, followed by a loud clanging of ice breaking apart and falling to the floor of the lair. You ask [frostwyrm.name] if you’re allowed to go inside. It is not my nest, my Qal. That is not for me to decide, [frostwyrm.name] responds, with a particular lilt to her tone, as if she were daring you to go and invite yourself into Nykke’s abode without permission.
rows.translation: 洞穴深处偶尔传来凿击声，像是石头敲打另一块石头，随后又响起冰块碎裂、坠落到巢穴地面的巨大铿锵声。你问[frostwyrm.name]自己能否进去。那不是我的巢，我的Qal。此事不由我决定，[frostwyrm.name]回答，语调中带着特别的起伏，仿佛正激你未经许可便自行闯进妮可的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear the occasional chipping sound reverberate from within the cave; it sounds like a rock against another rock, followed by a loud clanging of ice breaking apart and falling to the floor of the lair. You ask [frostwyrm.name] if you’re allowed to go inside. It is not my nest, my Qal. That is not for me to decide, [frostwyrm.name] responds, with a particular lilt to her tone, as if she were daring you to go and invite yourself into Nykke’s abode without permission."

rows.original: Well, you decide, she might have a bedroom, but she’s still living in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. You approach the mouth of the cave.
rows.translation: 好吧，你心想，她或许有自己的卧室，却仍住在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴里。你走向洞口。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you decide, she might have a bedroom, but she’s still living in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. You approach the mouth of the cave."

rows.original: What is a ‘bedroom?’ [frostwyrm.name] asks you curiously.
rows.translation: “卧室”是什么？[frostwyrm.name]好奇地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat is a ‘bedroom?’ [frostwyrm.name] asks you curiously."

rows.original: You tell her that you’ll explain later.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，稍后再解释。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ll explain later."

rows.original: The floor of the small cave curves downward and to the left slightly before opening into a much wider, though still minuscule, living space. The light of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair doesn’t reach very well into the room, making it a bit darker than the lair proper. The icy walls are jagged and unrefined, gnashed apart almost aimlessly by tough nails and claws, although it still appears to be a work-in-progress: while it’s tall enough for your ten-foot-tall Qim to stand upright, there isn’t much in the way of wiggle room, and it’s only about ten feet deep.
rows.translation: 小洞穴的地面微微向下并向左弯曲，随后通入一处宽敞得多、尽管仍然极其狭小的生活空间。[frostwyrm.name]巢穴中的光线很难照进房间，因此这里比主巢穴昏暗一些。冰墙参差不齐、未经修整，仿佛被坚硬指甲和利爪毫无章法地啃凿开来；这里显然仍在施工。空间虽高得足以让你十英尺高的Qim直立，却几乎没有转身余地，深度也只有约十英尺。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe floor of the small cave curves downward and to the left slightly before opening into a much wider, though still minuscule, living space. The light of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair doesn’t reach very well into the room, making it a bit darker than the lair proper. The icy walls are jagged and unrefined, gnashed apart almost aimlessly by tough nails and claws, although it still appears to be a work-in-progress: while it’s tall enough for your ten-foot-tall Qim to stand upright, there isn’t much in the way of wiggle room, and it’s only about ten feet deep."

rows.original: Standing at the far end of the little cave is, unmistakably, Nykke, diligently clawing at the ice with her razor-sharp Frostwyrm talons. The ice is hard and unyielding, but with every three or four grating swipes against it, her claws manage to catch, and with a flex of her powerful biceps, she rips the ice straight from the walls in huge swaths. Then she starts again.
rows.translation: 站在小洞穴最深处的无疑正是妮可；她用锋利如剃刀的霜巨龙利爪，勤恳地刨凿坚冰。冰层坚硬顽固，但每当她刺耳地抓挠三四下，利爪便能嵌入其中；随后她绷紧有力的肱二头肌，一大片一大片地将冰从墙上直接撕下，再重新开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding at the far end of the little cave is, unmistakably, Nykke, diligently clawing at the ice with her razor-sharp Frostwyrm talons. The ice is hard and unyielding, but with every three or four grating swipes against it, her claws manage to catch, and with a flex of her powerful biceps, she rips the ice straight from the walls in huge swaths. Then she starts again."

rows.original: The cave is littered and messy with shavings of ice coating the floor; you watch your step as you come inside, and you clear your throat to get her attention. It startles her, and she yips on the spot as she whips around; her strong, blunt tail swishes just a few feet from you, then crashes into the right-hand wall, knocking off another loose chunk of ice.
rows.translation: 洞内杂乱不堪，地面覆满冰屑。你走进来时小心落脚，又清了清嗓子吸引她的注意。这把她吓了一跳；她猛地转身，原地发出一声尖叫，强壮钝重的尾巴从你身旁几英尺处扫过，接着撞上右侧墙壁，又震落一块松动的冰。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cave is littered and messy with shavings of ice coating the floor; you watch your step as you come inside, and you clear your throat to get her attention. It startles her, and she yips on the spot as she whips around; her strong, blunt tail swishes just a few feet from you, then crashes into the right-hand wall, knocking off another loose chunk of ice."

rows.original: At first, she only glances over her shoulder, but once she realizes it’s you, she turns her whole body to face you. [pc.name], she says psionically, then stops. “I mean, my Qal,” she says, verbally. “My Qal.” Her cheeks lift and widen, and her eyes can’t help but roam around the little living space she’s carved out of the ice for herself. “Sorry, my Qal. I’m, uh... still getting used to the phrase, my Qal.”
rows.translation: 起初她只是回头瞥了一眼；可一认出是你，便转过整个身体面对你。[pc.name]，她以灵能说道，随即停住。“我是说，我的Qal，”她开口改正。“我的Qal。”她的双颊向上扬起并向两侧舒展，目光忍不住在自己从冰中凿出的这处小小生活空间里游移。“抱歉，我的Qal。我，呃...还在适应这个称呼，我的Qal。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first, she only glances over her shoulder, but once she realizes it’s you, she turns her whole body to face you. [pc.name], she says psionically, then stops. “I mean, my Qal,” she says, verbally. “My Qal.” Her cheeks lift and widen, and her eyes can’t help but roam around the little living space she’s carved out of the ice for herself. “Sorry, my Qal. I’m, uh... still getting used to the phrase, my Qal.”"

rows.original: You laugh well-meaningly and tell her that it’s alright. She’ll grow out of it eventually. Instead of badgering the point, you ask her what she’s doing.
rows.translation: 你善意地笑了笑，告诉她没关系，迟早会适应的。你没有继续纠缠这一点，而是询问她正在做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh well-meaningly and tell her that it’s alright. She’ll grow out of it eventually. Instead of badgering the point, you ask her what she’s doing."

rows.original: “It’s obvious, isn’t it, my Qal?” she says, then catches herself at overusing the phrase and giggles under her breath. “[frostwyrm.name] has opened her lair to me, and don’t get me wrong, I’m more grateful than I can put into your language, and it’s hard not to think that we really have been blessed by the Grand Qim, but... something feels wrong about it, my Qal. My kind don’t normally double-up into a single lair.” She glances around the tiny hovel of a cave she’s bored into the ice for herself. “This isn’t a lot, I realize. But as soon as I got the idea to make a lair inside [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, I just knew that I’d never be comfortable unless I did it.”
rows.translation: “这不是很明显吗，我的Qal？”她说道，随即意识到自己又过度使用了这个称呼，便低声咯咯笑起来。“[frostwyrm.name]向我开放了她的巢穴；别误会，我心中的感激根本无法用你的语言表达，而且很难不认为我们确实受到了大Qim的赐福。但是...这件事感觉很不对，我的Qal。我的种族通常不会两只共住一座巢穴。”她环顾自己在冰中钻凿出的简陋小洞。“我知道，这里算不了什么。但自从想到可以在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴里建造自己的巢穴后，我便明白，不把它建成，自己永远都无法安心。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s obvious, isn’t it, my Qal?” she says, then catches herself at overusing the phrase and giggles under her breath. “[frostwyrm.name] has opened her lair to me, and don’t get me wrong, I’m more grateful than I can put into your language, and it’s hard not to think that we really have been blessed by the Grand Qim, but... something feels wrong about it, my Qal. My kind don’t normally double-up into a single lair.” She glances around the tiny hovel of a cave she’s bored into the ice for herself. “This isn’t a lot, I realize. But as soon as I got the idea to make a lair inside [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, I just knew that I’d never be comfortable unless I did it.”"

rows.original: You run your hand along the ice wall, feeling how craggy and misshapen the surface is.
rows.translation: 你用手抚过冰墙，感受表面是多么粗糙而凹凸不平。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou run your hand along the ice wall, feeling how craggy and misshapen the surface is."

rows.original: “It’s a work in progress, okay?” Nykke insists.
rows.translation: “这里还在施工，好吗？”妮可坚持道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a work in progress, okay?” Nykke insists."

rows.original: You ask her if there’s anything you can do to help.
rows.translation: 你问她是否有什么能让自己帮忙的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if there’s anything you can do to help. "

rows.original: You may not be a purebred Frostwyrm yourself, but your own claws are just as strong as hers, and cutting through the ice would go twice as quickly with two Frostwyrms working on it.
rows.translation: 你自己虽不是纯种霜巨龙，利爪却与她的一样强壮；若有两头霜巨龙一起动手，凿穿冰层的速度肯定能快上一倍。
rows.raw: "You may not be a purebred Frostwyrm yourself, but your own claws are just as strong as hers, and cutting through the ice would go twice as quickly with two Frostwyrms working on it."

rows.original: You may not be a Frostwyrm, but if kinds like yours are known for any one thing, it’s your ingenuity and your ability to use the right tool for the job.
rows.translation: 你虽不是霜巨龙，但像你这样的种族若有什么闻名之处，那便是聪明才智，以及懂得为工作选用合适工具的能力。
rows.raw: "You may not be a Frostwyrm, but if kinds like yours are known for any one thing, it’s your ingenuity and your ability to use the right tool for the job."

rows.original: Nykke sighs wistfully through her nose as she regards her hovel again. “I appreciate it, my Qal, but this is something I need to do myself. The Qim is supposed to be the provider – it’s the Qim that hunts and gives shelter and protection. Making a dwelling suitable for my own clutch is my duty.”
rows.translation: 妮可再次望向简陋住处，从鼻中发出一声怅然叹息。“我很感激，我的Qal，但这件事必须由我亲自完成。Qim理应是供养者；负责狩猎、提供住所和保护的正是Qim。打造一处适合自己幼崽生活的居所，是我的职责。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke sighs wistfully through her nose as she regards her hovel again. “I appreciate it, my Qal, but this is something I need to do myself. The Qim is supposed to be the provider – it’s the Qim that hunts and gives shelter and protection. Making a dwelling suitable for my own clutch is my duty.”"

rows.original: You notice Nykke almost subconsciously rub at her stomach when she says the word ‘clutch.’ When you and [frostwyrm.name] first copulated, you remember that she could tell that the sex had taken almost immediately, and you ask Nykke if she knows that she’s pregnant right now.
rows.translation: 你注意到，妮可说出“幼崽”一词时，几乎下意识地揉了揉腹部。你和[frostwyrm.name]初次交配时，她几乎立刻便能判断受孕成功；于是你询问妮可，她是否知道自己现在已经怀孕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice Nykke almost subconsciously rub at her stomach when she says the word ‘clutch.’ When you and [frostwyrm.name] first copulated, you remember that she could tell that the sex had taken almost immediately, and you ask Nykke if she knows that she’s pregnant right now."

rows.original: Nykke, uncharacteristically, is bashful at the question: her cheeks practically lift right off her face at the question, and she has a hard time keeping her eyes on anything, much less yourself. “I mean,” she says, struggling to find the words, “I don’t think there’s any way I’m not.” She rubs at her stomach again. “It’s not like I’ve ever had a kip of my own, my Qal, but....” She doesn’t finish the statement, and instead, bounds on her feet several times in giddy excitement.
rows.translation: 面对这个问题，妮可反常地害羞起来：双颊几乎都要从脸上扬起，目光很难停留在任何东西上，更不用说看着你了。“我是说，”她努力组织语言，“我觉得自己根本不可能没怀上。”她再次揉了揉腹部。“我以前从没有过自己的幼崽，我的Qal，但是....”她没有说完，反而兴奋得原地蹦跳了好几次。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke, uncharacteristically, is bashful at the question: her cheeks practically lift right off her face at the question, and she has a hard time keeping her eyes on anything, much less yourself. “I mean,” she says, struggling to find the words, “I don’t think there’s any way I’m not.” She rubs at her stomach again. “It’s not like I’ve ever had a kip of my own, my Qal, but....” She doesn’t finish the statement, and instead, bounds on her feet several times in giddy excitement."

rows.original: You notice Nykke’s eyes flit to your stomach when she says the word ‘clutch,’ if only for a split second. When you and [frostwyrm.name] first copulated, you remember that she could tell that the sex had taken almost immediately, and you ask Nykke if she knows if you’re pregnant right now.
rows.translation: 你注意到，妮可说出“幼崽”一词时，目光飞快地掠过你的腹部，虽然只有短短一瞬。你和[frostwyrm.name]初次交配时，她几乎立刻便能判断受孕成功；于是你询问妮可，她是否知道你现在已经怀孕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice Nykke’s eyes flit to your stomach when she says the word ‘clutch,’ if only for a split second. When you and [frostwyrm.name] first copulated, you remember that she could tell that the sex had taken almost immediately, and you ask Nykke if she knows if you’re pregnant right now."

rows.original: Nykke cocks her head to one side at the question. “You mean you can’t tell?” she asks, bewildered. You tell her that it normally takes several days for your kind to know for sure if they’re pregnant; you aren’t as ‘in-tune’ with your body’s rhythms as a Frostwyrm’s.
rows.translation: 妮可听见问题后，把脑袋歪向一边。“你是说，你感觉不出来？”她困惑地问道。你告诉她，你的种族通常需要几天才能确定是否怀孕；你对身体节律的感知不像霜巨龙那般“敏锐”。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke cocks her head to one side at the question. “You mean you can’t tell?” she asks, bewildered. You tell her that it normally takes several days for your kind to know for sure if they’re pregnant; you aren’t as ‘in-tune’ with your body’s rhythms as a Frostwyrm’s."

rows.original: Nykke, uncharacteristically, is bashful at the question, once she learns that you can’t tell as quickly as she can: her cheeks practically lift right off her face at the question, and she has a hard time keeping her eyes on anything, much less yourself. “I mean,” she says, struggling to find the words, “I don’t think there’s any way you can’t be. It’s definitely not [frostwyrm.name]’s. I can feel the heart of our kip stirring within you already.” Her eyes can’t stay on yours for longer than a moment before they drift to your [pc.belly]. “It’s not like I’ve ever had a kip of my own, my Qal, but....” She doesn’t finish the statement, and instead, bounds on her feet several times in giddy excitement.
rows.translation: 得知你无法像她一样迅速察觉后，妮可面对这个问题反常地害羞起来：双颊几乎都要从脸上扬起，目光很难停留在任何东西上，更不用说看着你了。“我是说，”她努力组织语言，“你根本不可能没有怀上。肯定也不是[frostwyrm.name]的；我已经能感觉到我们幼崽的心脏正在你体内苏醒。”她的目光与你对视不过片刻，便又飘向你的[pc.belly]。“我以前从没有过自己的幼崽，我的Qal，但是....”她没有说完，反而兴奋得原地蹦跳了好几次。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke, uncharacteristically, is bashful at the question, once she learns that you can’t tell as quickly as she can: her cheeks practically lift right off her face at the question, and she has a hard time keeping her eyes on anything, much less yourself. “I mean,” she says, struggling to find the words, “I don’t think there’s any way you can’t be. It’s definitely not [frostwyrm.name]’s. I can feel the heart of our kip stirring within you already.” Her eyes can’t stay on yours for longer than a moment before they drift to your [pc.belly]. “It’s not like I’ve ever had a kip of my own, my Qal, but....” She doesn’t finish the statement, and instead, bounds on her feet several times in giddy excitement."

rows.original: You look around Nykke’s dwelling once more. You don’t want to dissuade her or put down her efforts, but... this isn’t going to be large enough to raise a clutch. It may be best to keep your kips within [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, where your family will have a chance to grow.
rows.translation: 你再次环顾妮可的居所。你不想打击她或贬低她的努力，但是...这里不足以养育一窝幼崽。最好还是把幼崽留在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴内，让家人有成长的空间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look around Nykke’s dwelling once more. You don’t want to dissuade her or put down her efforts, but... this isn’t going to be large enough to raise a clutch. It may be best to keep your kips within [frostwyrm.name]’s lair, where your family will have a chance to grow."

rows.original: “I know,” Nykke says, slumping her shoulders, “and I agree.” But before she has a chance to start wallowing in her own self-pity, her claws flex again, just as sharp as before she had started carving out her own little cave. “But that only makes me want to get back to work, my Qal! If I’m to be a proper Qim, I need to hurry and get my own lair started!”
rows.translation: “我知道，”妮可垂下双肩说道，“而且我同意。”不过她还没来得及沉浸于自怜，利爪便再次张开，仍如开始凿建小洞前一样锋利。“但这只会让我更想赶快回去工作，我的Qal！要成为称职的Qim，我必须赶紧把自己的巢穴建起来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know,” Nykke says, slumping her shoulders, “and I agree.” But before she has a chance to start wallowing in her own self-pity, her claws flex again, just as sharp as before she had started carving out her own little cave. “But that only makes me want to get back to work, my Qal! If I’m to be a proper Qim, I need to hurry and get my own lair started!”"

rows.original: If you remember right, the Qal of the pair is the teacher. You ask Nykke if she’d be against you teaching her how to use a tool to make cutting out her cave a bit easier.
rows.translation: 如果你没记错，一对伴侣中的Qal负责教导。你问妮可，是否反对由你教她使用工具，让开凿洞穴变得轻松一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you remember right, the Qal of the pair is the teacher. You ask Nykke if she’d be against you teaching her how to use a tool to make cutting out her cave a bit easier."

rows.original: She hums, her two uppermost arms crossing underneath her breasts as she considers it. “If you have such a tool, sure.” She turns her back to you, returning to her craggy wall. “In the meantime, my lair isn’t going to carve out itself.”
rows.translation: 她哼吟一声，最上方的两条手臂交叉在乳房下方，认真考虑起来。“如果你真有这样的工具，当然可以。”她转过身，重新面对粗糙的墙壁。“在那之前，我的巢穴可不会自己凿好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hums, her two uppermost arms crossing underneath her breasts as she considers it. “If you have such a tool, sure.” She turns her back to you, returning to her craggy wall. “In the meantime, my lair isn’t going to carve out itself.”"

rows.original: She flexes her arm, ready to strike at the ice wall again, before she hesitates. You can feel her apprehension over your psionic link with her. As soon as the thought crosses her mind, she turns back to you.
rows.translation: 她绷紧手臂，准备再次砸向冰墙，却忽然迟疑。你通过彼此的灵能连接感受到了她的忧虑；这个念头刚一掠过脑海，她便转身看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe flexes her arm, ready to strike at the ice wall again, before she hesitates. You can feel her apprehension over your psionic link with her. As soon as the thought crosses her mind, she turns back to you."

rows.original: You wish her luck and excuse yourself to be with [frostwyrm.name] in her section of the lair.
rows.translation: 你祝她好运，随后告辞，回到巢穴另一部分陪伴[frostwyrm.name]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wish her luck and excuse yourself to be with [frostwyrm.name] in her section of the lair."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: NykkePregnancy
rows.raw: "NykkePregnancy"

rows.original: You can feel a number of emotions pour through Nykke and into you, ranging anywhere from relief at seeing you, her Qal, once again, to pure affection, not unlike what [frostwyrm.name] regularly broadcasts to you. Being here, on the icy floor, embraced by your Qim, almost makes you feel like you haven’t moved at all.
rows.translation: 你能感觉到各种情绪从妮可体内涌入自己：既有再次见到她Qal的如释重负，也有纯粹的爱意，与[frostwyrm.name]经常向你传来的情绪颇为相似。待在冰冷地面上，被自己的Qim拥抱，几乎让你觉得自己从未离开过。
rows.raw: "You can feel a number of emotions pour through Nykke and into you, ranging anywhere from relief at seeing you, her Qal, once again, to pure affection, not unlike what [frostwyrm.name] regularly broadcasts to you. Being here, on the icy floor, embraced by your Qim, almost makes you feel like you haven’t moved at all."

rows.original: She hugs you back, and for the moment, there’s silence in her little lair. The world is gone: it’s just you and her right now. You could just stay there and hug her for a little while longer, if you wanted.
rows.translation: 她也回抱住你；此刻，她的小巢穴一片寂静。整个世界都消失了，现在只剩你和她。如果愿意，你可以就这样留下来，再抱她一会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hugs you back, and for the moment, there’s silence in her little lair. The world is gone: it’s just you and her right now. You could just stay there and hug her for a little while longer, if you wanted."

rows.original: Of course, you could, alternatively, engage with her a bit. She’s your Qim, after all.
rows.translation: 当然，你也可以换种方式与她互动。毕竟，她是你的Qim。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, you could, alternatively, engage with her a bit. She’s your Qim, after all."

rows.original: You excuse yourself from [frostwyrm.name]’s warm embrace and tell her that you have other duties that you must be seeing to as the Qal of the lair. She doesn’t argue or resist – you are the Qal to two Qims, after all.
rows.translation: 你从[frostwyrm.name]温暖的怀抱中告辞，告诉她，作为巢穴的Qal，你还有其他职责需要履行。她既没有争辩，也没有挽留；毕竟，你是两位Qim共同的Qal。
rows.raw: "You excuse yourself from [frostwyrm.name]’s warm embrace and tell her that you have other duties that you must be seeing to as the Qal of the lair. She doesn’t argue or resist – you are the Qal to two Qims, after all."

rows.original: Nykke’s ‘lair’ is large enough to accommodate herself and her Qal comfortably, but beyond its adequate size, there isn’t much in the way of features or sights: it’s just a circular room that’s been carved out of the ice. Since she’s started, though, Nykke’s taken the time to smooth the walls and the floor, making it far less craggy and jagged on every surface. The floor is smooth as glass, but the walls still need a bit of work before you could comfortably lean on them.
rows.translation: 妮可的“巢穴”足够让她和她的Qal舒适相处，但除去尚可的大小，里面几乎没有什么设施或景致；这只是一间从冰层中凿出的圆形房间。不过从开工至今，妮可已经花时间磨平墙壁和地面，使各处都不再那么粗糙尖锐。地面光滑如镜，墙壁却还需要再加工一番，你才能舒服地靠在上面。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s ‘lair’ is large enough to accommodate herself and her Qal comfortably, but beyond its adequate size, there isn’t much in the way of features or sights: it’s just a circular room that’s been carved out of the ice. Since she’s started, though, Nykke’s taken the time to smooth the walls and the floor, making it far less craggy and jagged on every surface. The floor is smooth as glass, but the walls still need a bit of work before you could comfortably lean on them."

rows.original: At the far end of the lair is Nykke, still chipping away at the ice. She’s taking smaller, finer cuts of the ice away, filing the ice down into a powder and making the place smoother: she’s focusing on making it more homely before she goes back to renovating it. You aren’t sure how large she intends to make her lair, but, surely, larger than this.
rows.translation: 妮可仍在巢穴最深处凿冰。她现在切下的冰块更小、更精细，将冰层磨成粉末，让这里更加平整；在继续扩建前，她正专心让住处变得更有家的感觉。你不知道她最终打算把巢穴建得多大，但肯定会比现在更大。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt the far end of the lair is Nykke, still chipping away at the ice. She’s taking smaller, finer cuts of the ice away, filing the ice down into a powder and making the place smoother: she’s focusing on making it more homely before she goes back to renovating it. You aren’t sure how large she intends to make her lair, but, surely, larger than this."

rows.original: “Oh, my Qal!” Nykke chirps happily once she realizes you’re there, her eyes lighting up once she sees you. She hardly seems like the same Frostwyrmling you met on the beach so long ago, now.
rows.translation: “哦，我的Qal！”妮可一发现你便开心地叫道，双眼在看见你的瞬间亮了起来。如今的她，看起来几乎已经不像很久以前你在海滩上遇见的那头霜幼龙。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, my Qal!” Nykke chirps happily once she realizes you’re there, her eyes lighting up once she sees you. She hardly seems like the same Frostwyrmling you met on the beach so long ago, now."

rows.original: She stops what she’s doing and steps towards you, grabbing you by the wrist with both her right arms. As she pulls you into her body for a hug,
rows.translation: 她停下手里的工作，向你走来，用右侧两条手臂抓住你的手腕。她把你拉进怀中拥抱时，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stops what she’s doing and steps towards you, grabbing you by the wrist with both her right arms. As she pulls you into her body for a hug,"

rows.original: she holds you gently to herself as she sets herself down, falling to one knee, then the other, and then leaning backward until she tips onto her rump, using her wings and her tail to brace the impact.
rows.translation: 她温柔地将你搂在身前，同时坐下；先单膝跪地，再放下另一条腿，然后向后仰倒，直至坐上臀部，并用翅膀和尾巴缓冲冲击。
rows.raw: " she holds you gently to herself as she sets herself down, falling to one knee, then the other, and then leaning backward until she tips onto her rump, using her wings and her tail to brace the impact."

rows.original: You can feel a number of emotions pour through Nykke and into you, ranging anywhere from relief at seeing you, her Qal, once again, to pure affection, not unlike what [frostwyrm.name] regularly broadcasts to you. Being here, on the icy floor, embraced by your Qim, almost makes you feel like you haven’t moved at all.
rows.translation: 你能感觉到各种情绪从妮可体内涌入自己：既有再次见到她Qal的如释重负，也有纯粹的爱意，与[frostwyrm.name]经常向你传来的情绪颇为相似。待在冰冷地面上，被自己的Qim拥抱，几乎让你觉得自己从未离开过。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can feel a number of emotions pour through Nykke and into you, ranging anywhere from relief at seeing you, her Qal, once again, to pure affection, not unlike what [frostwyrm.name] regularly broadcasts to you. Being here, on the icy floor, embraced by your Qim, almost makes you feel like you haven’t moved at all."

rows.original: She hugs you back, and for the moment, there’s silence in her little lair. The world is gone: it’s just you and her right now. You could just stay there and hug her for a little while longer, if you wanted.
rows.translation: 她也回抱住你；此刻，她的小巢穴一片寂静。整个世界都消失了，现在只剩你和她。如果愿意，你可以就这样留下来，再抱她一会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hugs you back, and for the moment, there’s silence in her little lair. The world is gone: it’s just you and her right now. You could just stay there and hug her for a little while longer, if you wanted."

rows.translation: 当然，你也可以换种方式与她互动。毕竟，她是你的Qim。

rows.translation: 你现在已经非常熟悉自己的Qim，不过她大概不会介意让Qal再仔细端详一遍。

rows.original: Nykke, despite her appearance, is rather old and experienced. Surely she has a unique perspective on life and the world around her, being a Frostwyrmling, and with such a distinct scale condition.
rows.translation: 尽管外表如此，妮可其实年长且阅历丰富。作为霜幼龙，又有如此独特的鳞片状况，她对生活和周遭世界想必有着独到见解。
rows.raw: "Nykke, despite her appearance, is rather old and experienced. Surely she has a unique perspective on life and the world around her, being a Frostwyrmling, and with such a distinct scale condition."

rows.original: Nykke’s been alone for two centuries. She’s probably got one hell of a backlog to work through – why not give her a hand, or maybe some other appendages, to help her out?
rows.translation: 妮可已经独处了两个世纪，肯定积攒了一大堆需求等待解决。何不帮她一把，或者用其他什么肢体帮她排解？
rows.raw: "Nykke’s been alone for two centuries. She’s probably got one hell of a backlog to work through – why not give her a hand, or maybe some other appendages, to help her out?"

rows.original: Nykke’s parents passed away fifty years ago, and she’s been alone ever since. Frostwyrms are a highly emotional species – she’d appreciate a real, genuine show of physical intimacy.
rows.translation: 妮可的双亲在五十年前去世，此后她便一直孤身一人。霜巨龙是情感极其丰富的种族；她会珍惜一次真正而真挚的身体亲昵。
rows.raw: "Nykke’s parents passed away fifty years ago, and she’s been alone ever since. Frostwyrms are a highly emotional species – she’d appreciate a real, genuine show of physical intimacy."

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name]
rows.raw: "[frostwyrm.name]"

rows.original: You ask Nykke if she’s willing to spare some insight with you. As a Frostwyrmling, she undoubtedly has had unique experiences and approaches to the world as she knows it, and despite her looks, she’s about as old as [frostwyrm.name] is. Learning to see the world through not only [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes, but Nykke’s as well, would broaden your own horizons by quite a bit.
rows.translation: 你询问妮可是否愿意分享一些见解。作为霜幼龙，她对自己所知的世界无疑有着独特经历和理解方式；而且别看她的外表，她的年纪与[frostwyrm.name]几乎一样大。除了[frostwyrm.name]的视角，若还能学会透过妮可的双眼看待世界，必定能大幅拓宽你的眼界。
rows.raw: "You ask Nykke if she’s willing to spare some insight with you. As a Frostwyrmling, she undoubtedly has had unique experiences and approaches to the world as she knows it, and despite her looks, she’s about as old as [frostwyrm.name] is. Learning to see the world through not only [frostwyrm.name]’s eyes, but Nykke’s as well, would broaden your own horizons by quite a bit."

rows.original: Nykke, in response, squeezes you tighter to her, holding you closer to her body. “If you were to ask me that before we were Qim and Qal, I probably would have gotten impatient with you,” she says. “But now, I feel like I have everything I could have ever wanted, [pc.name]. My Qal.” She squeezes you again, affectionately laying her cheek against yours and taking a long, deep sigh through her nose, taking in your scent. “Every moment I have with my Qal is another moment to cherish. Ask me whatever you want. The first thing that comes to mind.”
rows.translation: 妮可以更大的力道把你搂紧，让你更贴近她的身体作为回应。“如果在我们成为Qim与Qal之前这样问，我大概早就对你不耐烦了，”她说道。“可现在，我觉得自己已经拥有了一切梦寐以求的东西，[pc.name]。我的Qal。”她再次深情地收紧怀抱，将脸颊贴上你的脸，用鼻子缓缓深吸一口气，品味你的气味。“与我的Qal相处的每一刻，都值得珍惜。想问什么都可以，就问你第一个想到的问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke, in response, squeezes you tighter to her, holding you closer to her body. “If you were to ask me that before we were Qim and Qal, I probably would have gotten impatient with you,” she says. “But now, I feel like I have everything I could have ever wanted, [pc.name]. My Qal.” She squeezes you again, affectionately laying her cheek against yours and taking a long, deep sigh through her nose, taking in your scent. “Every moment I have with my Qal is another moment to cherish. Ask me whatever you want. The first thing that comes to mind.”"

rows.original: The arrangement you, Nykke, and [frostwyrm.name] have is highly unique – the first and only of its kind among Frostwyrms. On top of that, only one of you is a fully-fledged Frostwyrm. Ask Nykke what her opinion is on this dizzying change in her life.
rows.translation: 你、妮可和[frostwyrm.name]之间的关系极为独特，是霜巨龙之中前所未有、也仅此一例的组合。更何况，你们之中只有一位是真正成熟的霜巨龙。询问妮可，她如何看待生命中这场令人目眩的巨变。
rows.raw: "The arrangement you, Nykke, and [frostwyrm.name] have is highly unique – the first and only of its kind among Frostwyrms. On top of that, only one of you is a fully-fledged Frostwyrm. Ask Nykke what her opinion is on this dizzying change in her life."

rows.translation: 灵能

rows.translation: 询问妮可对自身灵能力量的掌控情况。毕竟你可不能说自己亲身体验过拥有灵能是什么感觉！
rows.raw: "Ask Nykke about her control over her psionic powers. You can’t say you’ve experienced what it’s like to have them first-hand, after all!"

rows.translation: 你对灵能的了解远不及妮可；在展开这场讨论前，最好先从[frostwyrm.name]那里得到一些看法。
rows.raw: "You’re far less educated about psionics than Nykke would be, and you probably shouldn’t go into this discussion without at least a little bit of forethought from [frostwyrm.name] first."

rows.original: You’ve been to all manner of planets and places by now, while Nykke’s been trapped on Uveto all her life. Maybe she’d like to hear a few stories about your travels.
rows.translation: 你如今已经造访过形形色色的行星与地点，而妮可一生都被困在乌维托。也许她会想听听你的旅行故事。
rows.raw: "You’ve been to all manner of planets and places by now, while Nykke’s been trapped on Uveto all her life. Maybe she’d like to hear a few stories about your travels."

rows.translation: 询问妮可那独特的黑色素状况。你能感觉到她并不适应自己的身体；但若能帮助她化解心中的挫败，也许她会更容易接纳自己。
rows.raw: "Ask Nykke about her unique melanin condition. You get the sense she isn’t comfortable with her own body, but maybe, if you help her work through her frustrations with it, she’ll have an easier time accepting herself."

rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You lie with Nykke, snuggled up against her in her little cave of a lair.
rows.translation: 你和妮可躺在一起，在她那小小洞穴巢穴中依偎着她。
rows.raw: "You lie with Nykke, snuggled up against her in her little cave of a lair."

rows.original: That one little sentence has more packed into it than it appears. You and Nykke are now officially mates, and Frostwyrms mate for life – but you’re also the mate to another Frostwyrm, which is an adaptation [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke had to make to overcome the sudden endangerment of their species. And the ‘lair’ you’re in is a hole dug out of [frostwyrm.name]’s own, rather than a natural outcropping that Nykke’s purposed for her own.
rows.translation: 这句短短的话所包含的意义远比表面看起来更多。你和妮可如今已经正式成为伴侣，而霜巨龙终身只认一位伴侣；可你同时还是另一头霜巨龙的伴侣。这是[frostwyrm.name]与妮可为了应对种族骤然濒危而不得不作出的适应。你们所在的“巢穴”也只是从[frostwyrm.name]自己的巢穴中挖出的洞，而非妮可找到并据为己有的天然岩洞。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat one little sentence has more packed into it than it appears. You and Nykke are now officially mates, and Frostwyrms mate for life – but you’re also the mate to another Frostwyrm, which is an adaptation [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke had to make to overcome the sudden endangerment of their species. And the ‘lair’ you’re in is a hole dug out of [frostwyrm.name]’s own, rather than a natural outcropping that Nykke’s purposed for her own."

rows.original: Your life with [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke has taken several, dizzying turns in order for the three of you to end up where you are. It’s almost enough for you to believe that it really was divine intervention from the Grand Qim. And none of that is even touching on the fact that you’re crossbreeding with them both.
rows.translation: 为了让你们三个走到今天这一步，你与[frostwyrm.name]和妮可的生活已经历数次令人目眩的转折。这几乎足以让你相信，一切确实是大Qim的神圣干预；而这甚至还没提到你正在与她们两位进行跨种族繁衍。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour life with [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke has taken several, dizzying turns in order for the three of you to end up where you are. It’s almost enough for you to believe that it really was divine intervention from the Grand Qim. And none of that is even touching on the fact that you’re crossbreeding with them both."

rows.original: “What’s on your mind?” Nykke asks, squeezing your shoulders closer to her. “You’ve gone quiet on me.”
rows.translation: “你在想什么？”妮凯问道，将你的双肩搂得更紧，让你贴近她。“你突然不说话了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s on your mind?” Nykke asks, squeezing your shoulders closer to her. “You’ve gone quiet on me.”"

rows.original: You ask her if she’s not reading your mind. She’s normally the type of Frostwyrm to skip the words and jump straight to the psionics, leaving you at a bit of a disadvantage.
rows.translation: 你问她是不是没有读取你的思绪。她通常是那种会跳过言语、直接诉诸灵能的霜龙，这让你多少有些处于劣势。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if she’s not reading your mind. She’s normally the type of Frostwyrm to skip the words and jump straight to the psionics, leaving you at a bit of a disadvantage."

rows.original: “I guess [frostwyrm.name] is rubbing off on me a bit,” she responds with a half-hearted shrug. “She doesn’t like it when I comm – uh, when I ‘read your mind’ without your permission.” She flaps her lips a bit, sticking her tongue out from between them. “And as much as I prefer to communicate with our emotions, I... well, I figured that it might be unfair to you, since you can’t communicate like we can, and if you’re going to be my mate and my Qal, and you are my Qal,” she detours, squeezing you closer to her again, “I should probably try and do what I can to make you not feel... I don’t know... lonely? Excluded?”
rows.translation: “我大概有点受[frostwyrm.name]影响了，”她漫不经心地耸耸肩回答。“她不喜欢我没得到你的允许就交——呃，就‘读取你的思绪’。”她扑棱了几下嘴唇，将舌头从唇间吐出。“虽然我更喜欢用情绪交流，但我...嗯，我觉得那样对你可能不公平，毕竟你没法像我们一样交流；而且既然你要成为我的伴侣和我的Qal，并且你就是我的Qal，”她说着说着岔开话题，再次将你搂紧，“我大概应该尽我所能，让你别觉得...我不知道...孤单？被排除在外？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess [frostwyrm.name] is rubbing off on me a bit,” she responds with a half-hearted shrug. “She doesn’t like it when I comm – uh, when I ‘read your mind’ without your permission.” She flaps her lips a bit, sticking her tongue out from between them. “And as much as I prefer to communicate with our emotions, I... well, I figured that it might be unfair to you, since you can’t communicate like we can, and if you’re going to be my mate and my Qal, and you are my Qal,” she detours, squeezing you closer to her again, “I should probably try and do what I can to make you not feel... I don’t know... lonely? Excluded?”"

rows.original: That’s a sweet sentiment for her to make, that she would go through the effort of trying to make you feel more comfortable with her, and you reciprocate the squeeze, nestling yourself against her. That’s something that a proper mate would do for another.
rows.translation: 她愿意费心让你和她相处得更自在，这份心意很贴心。你也回抱她，依偎在她身上。这正是一个合格的伴侣会为另一个伴侣所做的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a sweet sentiment for her to make, that she would go through the effort of trying to make you feel more comfortable with her, and you reciprocate the squeeze, nestling yourself against her. That’s something that a proper mate would do for another."

rows.original: “I’m off to a good start, then,” she muses, resting her cheek against your scalp. You two enjoy each other’s company for another, silent moment. “But seriously,” she says, “what’s got you so quiet?”

rows.original: You recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now.
rows.translation: 你回想起来，[frostwyrm.name]看待灵能的方式也和你不同。用她自己的话来说，你所谓的“灵能”，就是霜龙无需使用言语便能交流的能力，正如你们现在这样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now."

rows.original: Oh, like this? Nykke asks, her voice projecting into your mind directly. You concur: exactly like that. rows.original: My own Qal had the same reaction to our ability to communicate. I thought he was just incapable, for one reason or another, and I didn’t believe him when he said that communicating like this was a unique skill. Nykke focuses her gaze on you, and you can tell that she’s trying to ‘impress’ something into your psyche – like an idea, or an emotion – but all you wind up feeling is a dull thud in the front of your head. Do you feel anything?
rows.translation: 我自己的Qal对我们这种交流能力也有同样的反应。我一度以为他只是出于某种原因做不到，而且当他说这种交流方式是一项独特能力时，我并不相信。妮凯将目光集中在你身上；你能感觉到她正试图把某种东西“压印”进你的精神——像是一个想法，或一种情绪——但最终你只觉得额头内部传来一记沉闷的撞击。你感觉到什么了吗？

Do you feel anything?"

rows.original: You answer that you don’t. She grunts out loud and stops her attempts. “Talking with our mouths is so awkward!” she curses to the walls of her lair. “And I never liked using ‘words.’ What’s the point of communicating if you can hide your intentions behind ‘words?’ I could have introduced myself as anyone, and you wouldn’t be able to tell if it was true or not.”
rows.translation: 你回答说没有。她发出一声低吼，停止了尝试。“用嘴说话太别扭了！”她冲着巢穴的墙壁咒骂道。“而且我从来都不喜欢使用‘言语’。如果你能把真实意图藏在‘言语’后面，交流还有什么意义？我本可以冒充任何身份向你介绍自己，而你根本无法判断是真是假。”

rows.original: Suddenly, the fight drains from her body, and she slumps against the ice wall of her miniature lair. “You know, I never questioned my Qim’s affection for my Qal. I could feel it whenever they spoke of him. But neither of us could feel it from him back. He always told us that he’d go to the ends of the ‘universe,’ whatever that was, for us. But we never felt his sincerity.” She rests her cheek against your shoulder and sighs through her nose – a long-winded, exasperated sigh, almost like she was defeated. “And I don’t want to question your affection for me, but you have to understand – when Frostwyrms like [frostwyrm.name] and myself go from feeling emotions directly to needing to put trust in something that could be untrue, it’s... it’s enough to make us wonder. We aren’t used to the very concept of insincerity.”
rows.translation: 突然间，她身上的斗志尽数消退，整个人瘫靠在小型巢穴的冰墙上。“你知道吗，我从未怀疑过我的Qim对我的Qal怀有怎样的感情。每当她们谈起他时，我都能感受到。可我们谁也无法从他那里感受到同样的回应。他总告诉我们，他愿意为我们走到‘宇宙’尽头，无论那是什么地方。但我们从未感受到他的真诚。”她将脸颊靠在你肩上，从鼻中长长叹气——那是一声漫长而恼怒的叹息，仿佛她已经认输。“我不想怀疑你对我的感情，但你必须明白——当[frostwyrm.name]和我这样的霜龙从直接感受情绪，转而必须去相信某种可能并不真实的东西时，这...这足以令我们心生怀疑。我们甚至不习惯‘不真诚’这一概念。”

You know that she knows that, but sometimes, it’s better to put it to words anyway.
rows.translation: 有趣的是，你的语言里恰好有一个词能描述这种心态：你告诉妮凯，如果一个人天生无法相信任何人的话，而且仅仅因为每个人都有说谎的可能，便认定所有人都是骗子，这就叫作“偏执”。没错，你无法像她或[frostwyrm.name]那样清楚地向对方传达情绪，但这并不意味着你不值得信任。你知道她也明白这一点，不过有时还是把话说出来比较好。

rows.raw: "\n\nI could try to teach you, she offers. It catches you by surprise, only because you didn’t expect her to offer."

rows.original: You reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two.
rows.translation: 你回答说，你才应该是Qal，而根据你的了解，这意味着你理应担任老师。你猜想，如果妮凯费心教会你像霜龙一样交流，那么在你们两者之间，她反倒会成为Qal。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two."

rows.original: “Hmmph,” Nykke hums, her hips squirming in the snow beneath her. “That sounds like a great idea to me. Maybe we should skip the lessons.” Her eyes are on you again, narrowed predatorily, and her lips split apart by her tongue, wetting them in a long, languid swipe. “I’m giving you one chance to back out.”
rows.translation: “哼嗯，”妮凯哼了一声，臀部在身下的雪地里扭动。“我觉得这主意棒极了。也许我们应该跳过课程。”她再次盯着你，双眼如猎食者般眯起，舌头从唇间探出，缓慢而慵懒地舔湿嘴唇。“我只给你一次反悔机会。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmmph,” Nykke hums, her hips squirming in the snow beneath her. “That sounds like a great idea to me. Maybe we should skip the lessons.” Her eyes are on you again, narrowed predatorily, and her lips split apart by her tongue, wetting them in a long, languid swipe. “I’m giving you one chance to back out.”"

rows.original: You laugh, and say that you’ll take the lessons. Although, if she wants to try some role-reversal later, you suppose you’d be okay with that. You wonder if the sex will feel any different for the Qim than it does for the Qal.
rows.translation: 你笑着说自己会接受课程。不过，如果她以后想试试角色互换，你想自己也不会介意。你不禁好奇，Qim在性爱中的感受是否会与Qal有所不同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh, and say that you’ll take the lessons. Although, if she wants to try some role-reversal later, you suppose you’d be okay with that. You wonder if the sex will feel any different for the Qim than it does for the Qal."

rows.original: The next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her.
rows.translation: 接下来的一个小时左右，妮凯一直试图用言语向你描述，她集中灵能时究竟做了什么：她专注于什么，又如何从一个思绪中过滤出另一个——这个过程远比你起初以为的复杂。心智会以极快速度接收大量信息，同时不断产生自己的思绪、想法和表达；如果妮凯不谨慎筛选，而是将整套思绪一股脑传过连接，你很容易把自己误认为她。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her."

rows.original: However, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them.
rows.translation: 然而，尽管你竭尽全力学习，妮凯也竭尽全力教导，最终你仍没能更进一步理解灵能如何运作，更遑论掌握它。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them."

rows.original: You have a link to both [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke, but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her.
rows.translation: 你与[frostwyrm.name]和妮凯都建立了连接；但尽管你能接收到任何思绪、想法、表达或灵感，对你而言，这条连接仍是单向的，你无法将自己的思绪反向传递过去。每当你产生一个念头，妮凯都能捕捉并理解，但这与由你主动将其投射给她并不相同。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a link to both [frostwyrm.name] and Nykke, but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her."

rows.original: “Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. “If you can’t do it, and my Qal couldn’t do it, it’s hard not to think that us Frostwyrms might be alone.”
rows.translation: “世上还有其他种族能像我的种族一样交流吗？”妮凯问道。一小时勤奋努力却毫无成果，令她十分沮丧。“如果你做不到，我的Qal也做不到，那就很难不让人觉得，或许我们霜龙是孤独的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. “If you can’t do it, and my Qal couldn’t do it, it’s hard not to think that us Frostwyrms might be alone.”"

rows.original: You respond that psionics are a well-known and documented form of communication among some known races within the universe, similar to Frostwyrms, but you’ve never heard of them communicating purely through emotion similar to how she and her kind do. Maybe their method of communication is wholly unique to them.
rows.translation: 你回答说，在宇宙中的一些已知种族里，灵能是一种广为人知且有文献记载的交流方式，与霜龙相似；但你从未听说她们会像妮凯及其同类一样，纯粹通过情绪交流。也许这种交流方式确实为霜龙所独有。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond that psionics are a well-known and documented form of communication among some known races within the universe, similar to Frostwyrms, but you’ve never heard of them communicating purely through emotion similar to how she and her kind do. Maybe their method of communication is wholly unique to them."

rows.original: “No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what [frostwyrm.name] meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”
rows.translation: “不，我不同意，”妮凯斩钉截铁地说着，身体向你靠近，双眼坚定地眯起，直视你的眼睛。“我明白[frostwyrm.name]的意思：我们拥有同等条件。你应该能够像我一样交流。只是....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what [frostwyrm.name] meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”"

rows.original: It’s just that you can’t?
rows.translation: 只是你做不到？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s just that you can’t?"

rows.original: “I don’t know how to explain it. Argh, this is all very frustrating!” she exclaims, her voice echoing off the icy walls of her lair. “It’s not like it’s some secret. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way that another kind that can understand–” She flexes all four hands in aggravation, her sharp claws jutting from each of her fingers, and she releases that pent-up stress by slamming them all into the floor beside her, driving her claws into the ice. “‘Words’ were a mistake!”
rows.translation: “我不知道该怎么解释。啊，这一切太让人恼火了！”她喊道，声音在巢穴的冰墙间回荡。“这又不是什么秘密。我明白自己在做什么；换成我的任何同类，只要我问，她们都会明白。可我就是没法用另一个种族能理解的方式解释——”她恼怒地屈伸四只手，锋利爪子从每根手指伸出；随后将所有手掌猛砸在身旁地面，把爪子插进冰层，以此释放积压的压力。“‘言语’根本就是个错误！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know how to explain it. Argh, this is all very frustrating!” she exclaims, her voice echoing off the icy walls of her lair. “It’s not like it’s some secret. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way that another kind that can understand–” She flexes all four hands in aggravation, her sharp claws jutting from each of her fingers, and she releases that pent-up stress by slamming them all into the floor beside her, driving her claws into the ice. “‘Words’ were a mistake!”"

rows.original: You lean into Nykke, snuggling yourself against her enormous form to get her to calm down. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explain what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before.
rows.translation: 你靠向妮凯，将自己依偎在她庞大的身躯上，好让她平静下来。你感谢她愿意为你付出这番努力，也明白这并不容易。你将其比作向一个从未见过蓝色的人解释蓝色究竟是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean into Nykke, snuggling yourself against her enormous form to get her to calm down. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explain what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before."

rows.original: Nykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations.”
rows.translation: 妮凯探入你的思绪，试图理解你的意思，但并未停留多久。“对！正是这样！”她说道，兴奋地拍了一下自己的腿，至少终于能把挫败感说出口了。“在伟大Qim的影子下，你究竟该怎么向别人解释如此根本的东西？”她靠向你，回以依偎，同时努力平复情绪。“至少你的种族懂得如何表达这种挫败感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations.”"

rows.original: There, you see? Words aren’t all bad.
rows.translation: 你看，明白了吧？言语也不全是坏事。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere, you see? Words aren’t all bad."

rows.original: That gets her to laugh, which is good: you’ve gotten her to calm down a bit. You suggest that you two can try again later, if she’d like.
rows.translation: 这让她笑了起来，情况不错：你已经让她平静了一些。你建议，如果她愿意，你们以后可以再试一次。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat gets her to laugh, which is good: you’ve gotten her to calm down a bit. You suggest that you two can try again later, if she’d like."

rows.original: She ‘tch’s’ at the suggestion, but doesn’t immediately dismiss it. “Maybe in a Light’s Rise or two,” she says. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”
rows.translation: 她对这个建议“啧”了一声，却没有立即否决。“也许再过一两个光升周期吧，”她说道。“这样我就有时间好好想想。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe ‘tch’s’ at the suggestion, but doesn’t immediately dismiss it. “Maybe in a Light’s Rise or two,” she says. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little peeved over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now.
rows.translation: 你们刚刚才为这件事折腾过一番！妮凯仍因无法教会你使用灵能而有些恼火，所以现在最好别再试探运气，要求更多。
rows.raw: "You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little peeved over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now."

rows.original: Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world.
rows.translation: 你冷不丁地问妮凯，她对这个世界了解多少。
rows.raw: "Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world."

rows.original: She has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across her dugout lair, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “I had been wandering ever since I left my Qim’s lair. If the world has an end to it, I’m not sure if I’ll ever find it. But, then again, I was also told that there were many more of my kind than I found.”
rows.translation: 她不得不思考片刻：她轻敲下巴，目光扫过自己挖出的巢穴，思索如何组织回答。“我听说它非常辽阔，”片刻后她说道。“自从离开Qim的巢穴后，我一直四处游荡。如果世界存在尽头，我不确定自己是否永远找得到。不过话说回来，我也曾被告知我的同类远比我实际找到的更多。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across her dugout lair, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “I had been wandering ever since I left my Qim’s lair. If the world has an end to it, I’m not sure if I’ll ever find it. But, then again, I was also told that there were many more of my kind than I found.”"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm
rows.translation: 你告诉妮凯，自己并不是霜龙
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm"

joinAfter.expression:
window.nykkeFrostwyrmTF()
                ? ", or, at least, you weren’t always; you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]"
                : "; you’re [pc.aRace]"

rows.original: , or, at least, you weren’t always; you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]
rows.translation: ，或者至少并非一直都是；你生来是[pc.aOriginalRace]
rows.raw: ", or, at least, you weren’t always; you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]"

rows.original: ; you’re [pc.aRace]
rows.translation: ；你现在是[pc.aRace]
rows.raw: "; you’re [pc.aRace]"

rows.original: . You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”
rows.translation: 。你让她猜猜你的同类有多少。“几百？”她问道，你告诉她远不止。“几千？”还要更多。她聚精会神地眯起眼睛。“嗯....”
rows.raw: ". You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Hmm....”"

rows.original: There are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist.
rows.translation: 你的同类数量之多，可能已经超出她能够正确想象的范围：那是一个庞大到她也许无法理解其规模的数字。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist."

rows.original: And, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there. Your kind have named the world as Nykke knows it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it.
rows.translation: 除了你的同类数量极多之外，外面还存在其他世界。你的种族把妮凯所知的这个世界命名为“乌维托”；你已经去过许多其他行星，也与众多其他种族打过交道，以至于很难将这一切全部归类。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there. Your kind have named the world as Nykke knows it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it."

rows.original: You start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “I sure do,” she says, pulling on you and squeezing you tighter against her. “‘Warm’ is what I would feel when I curled up against my Qal, just like this.” She leans into you, her two, thick right arms curling around you and pulling her into her muscular frame. “Although this feels different, somehow.”
rows.translation: 你从简单的开始：你问妮凯是否明白温暖意味着什么。“当然明白，”她说道，将你拉得更近、更紧地贴在自己身上。“‘温暖’就是我蜷在Qal身边时感受到的东西，就像现在这样。”她靠向你，两条粗壮的右臂环住你，将你拉进她肌肉结实的身躯。“不过不知为何，这感觉有些不同。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “I sure do,” she says, pulling on you and squeezing you tighter against her. “‘Warm’ is what I would feel when I curled up against my Qal, just like this.” She leans into you, her two, thick right arms curling around you and pulling her into her muscular frame. “Although this feels different, somehow.”"

rows.original: ‘I should hope so,’ you think to yourself. To continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’
rows.translation: “那当然最好如此。”你暗自想到。为了继续，你问妮凯是否明白“炎热”意味着什么。
rows.raw: "\n\n‘I should hope so,’ you think to yourself. To continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’"

rows.original: You feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Uh...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? There’s no such thing, is there?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breath; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it.
rows.translation: 你感觉思绪再次受到牵引，却让她用自己的话作答。“呃...，”她结巴着说道。“不明白。”你教她，简单来说，“炎热”就是太过温暖。“太过温暖？哪有这种事，对吧？”有的，确实存在：当你太过温暖时，会感觉仿佛无法呼吸，被困在自己的身体里。如果周围的空气太暖，呼吸会很痛；如果脚下地面太暖，行走会很痛。当热意无处不在时，你会觉得自己就是...根本无处可逃。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Uh...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? There’s no such thing, is there?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breath; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it."

rows.original: “But it feels that way if we’re too cold, as well,” she notes. That’s right! If it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot.
rows.translation: “可如果太冷，也会有同样的感觉，”她指出。没错！如果过于寒冷，同样会令人束手束脚、痛苦难耐。正如乌维托这样永远极寒的地方，也存在永远极热的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But it feels that way if we’re too cold, as well,” she notes. That’s right! If it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot."

rows.original: Nykke considers your words, but from the expression on her face and the low, contemplative growl in her throat, she’s not liking what you’re telling her. “Is there any place that is neither?” she asks; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if Nykke is truly the daughter of an Ausar, she’ll be able to adapt and survive in any environment, too.
rows.translation: 妮凯思索着你的话，但从她脸上的表情和喉中低沉而沉思的咆哮来看，她并不喜欢你所描述的一切。“有没有既不冷也不热的地方？”她问道；她很难相信世界——或者说许多世界——竟会如此艰难而无情。你回答说，有些地方可能太暖，有些地方可能太冷，但能够克服这些障碍，在这样的环境中生存、甚至繁荣，正是令你的种族如此坚韧的原因。而且，如果妮凯确实是奥萨人的女儿，她也能适应任何环境并生存下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke considers your words, but from the expression on her face and the low, contemplative growl in her throat, she’s not liking what you’re telling her. “Is there any place that is neither?” she asks; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if Nykke is truly the daughter of an Ausar, she’ll be able to adapt and survive in any environment, too."

rows.original: Now that you’ve properly gotten Nykke hooked on your stories, you continue enthusiastically; you start with your parentage and that you’re an heir to... well, it’d be a difficult to explain in a way she understands, but, in the very barest, lamest terms you can, you explain that your own parent had passed away some time ago, and you’re on a journey to reclaim his own lair for yourself.

rows.original: “Care if I join you two?” a half-ausar man asks and gives your shoulder a friendly squeeze. He’s ruggedly handsome, standing just over six feet with broad shoulders, lightly tanned skin and toned musculature. Short gray hair with a matching close-cropped beard frame his masculine face and sharp blue eyes. A noticeable dueling scar adorns his left cheek. “I see the two of you have already met.”
rows.translation: “介意我加入你们吗？”一名半奥萨男人问道，同时友好地捏了捏你的肩膀。他有种粗犷的英俊，身高刚过六英尺，肩膀宽阔，肤色微褐，肌肉匀称。与短短灰发同色的络腮胡修剪得很短，衬托着他阳刚的面庞与锐利的蓝眼睛。左脸颊上饰着一道显眼的决斗伤疤。“看来你们俩已经认识了。”

rows.original: “Well, yeah. She said you were Victor Steele’s kid, [pc.name], on a quest for your inheritance, but I also wanted to hear it from you, too. Just trying to start a conversation here, you know.” He pulls out a wooden pipe from his jacket, packs it, lights it, and takes a few puffs.

rows.original: “Can do.” He causally relaxes into his chair, rocking it back so it’s balanced on the two rear legs, in stark contrast to his wife’s formal, ladylike posture. “The name’s Traven Reasner, as you’ve heard, but you can just call me Traven. I’m not really one for titles, so no need to call me ‘Sir’ or ‘Commander’.”
rows.translation: “没问题。”他悠然地靠进椅背，将椅子向后摇起，只用两条后腿保持平衡；这与他妻子正式而淑女的坐姿形成鲜明对比。“我叫特拉文·里斯纳，你已经听说了，不过叫我特拉文就好。我不太在乎头衔，所以不用叫我‘先生’或‘指挥官’。”

I’m not really one for titles, so no need to call me ‘Sir’ or ‘Commander’.”"

rows.original: “You should take pride in your titles, dear.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你应该为自己的头衔感到自豪。”

rows.raw: "\n\n“What about ‘Mr. Reasner’?” you add."

rows.original: Traven grins, “Ah, now there’s a title I’ve been more than happy to have since joining the Reasner family. Still, it’s a bit more than I’m used to.”
rows.translation: 特拉文咧嘴一笑，“啊，自从加入里斯纳家族以来，我一直很乐意拥有这个称呼。不过对我来说还是有点太正式了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTraven grins, “Ah, now there’s a title I’ve been more than happy to have since joining the Reasner family. Still, it’s a bit more than I’m used to.”"

rows.translation: 你问他以什么谋生。

rows.original: “Oh, right now I’m a simple carpenter and the XO on Inexorable.” He sets his pipe down. “But before that I was an adventurer, much like yourself. That is,” he lifts his wife’s hand up and puts a gentlemanly kiss atop it, “until I put a ring on this finger.”
rows.translation: “哦，我现在只是个普通木匠，也是不屈号的大副。”他放下烟斗。“但在那之前，我和你一样是个冒险者。也就是说，”他抬起妻子的手，绅士地在手背上吻了一下，“直到我把戒指戴上这根手指。”

rows.original: Traven has to wrest his eyes away from his wife’s backside before responding. “Yeah, shit happens.” He start smoking his pipe again. “We just got our asses handed to us in the Rush, burnt through the rest of our fuel getting the hell out of there.” There’s a bitterness to his voice; you get the impression that Traven’s not the kind of man who runs away easily. “We’ve already got a good amount of D and H-3, but still need some savicite to make it to Tavros. Our machine shops can only repair the ship so much.”
rows.translation: 特拉文不得不将目光从妻子的臀部上扯开，才作出回答。“是啊，倒霉事总会发生。”他又开始抽烟斗。“我们刚在行星开拓潮里被打得屁滚尿流，为了逃出那个鬼地方，还烧光了剩下的燃料。”他的声音带着苦涩；你感觉特拉文不是那种会轻易逃跑的人。“我们已经弄到了不少氘和氦-3，但要抵达塔弗罗斯还需要一些萨维石。我们的机械工场能修复飞船的程度终究有限。”

rows.original: “And she’s not only capable but also fiercely independent, so it’s hard for her to ask for help. That doesn’t mean she’ll refuse any; she’d simply prefer others to depend on her rather than the other way around.” He looks around to make sure his wife’s not right behind him. “I know I really shouldn’t be saying this - so don’t tell her I did - but she can also hold her own in a fight.”
rows.translation: “而且她不仅能力出众，还极其独立，所以很难开口求助。这并不意味着她会拒绝帮助；她只是更愿意让别人依赖她，而不是反过来。”他环顾四周，确认妻子没有站在身后。“我知道自己实在不该说这些——所以别告诉她是我说的——但她打起架来也很厉害。”

rows.original: “Really?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?”"

rows.original: Traven taps the scar on his cheek. “Really. Before we married, believe it or not, the missus was quite the hardass.” He pauses and strokes his beard thoughtfully. “Nah, that’s a bit too harsh. She was always a nice person, just way too serious and career focused. That made her a great officer, but she didn’t know how to relax.” He crosses his arms as a fond expression spreads across his face. “Just some of the many reasons I fell in love with her.”
rows.translation: 特拉文点了点自己脸上的伤疤。“真的。信不信由你，在我们结婚前，太太可是个相当强硬的人。”他停下来，若有所思地抚摸胡须。“不，这么说有点太刻薄。她一直都是个好人，只是太严肃，也太专注于事业。这让她成了一名优秀的军官，却不知道该如何放松。”他抱起双臂，脸上浮现出深情的神色。“这只是我爱上她的众多理由之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTraven taps the scar on his cheek. “Really. Before we married, believe it or not, the missus was quite the hardass.” He pauses and strokes his beard thoughtfully. “Nah, that’s a bit too harsh. She was always a nice person, just way too serious and career focused. That made her a great officer, but she didn’t know how to relax.” He crosses his arms as a fond expression spreads across his face. “Just some of the many reasons I fell in love with her.”"

rows.original: returns a minute later, glasses in hand. “I have a sneaking suspicion that you were talking about me.” She sets them down on the table: whiskey - neat - for her husband, brandy for herself, and whatever you ordered. “I hope it was something pleasant, at least.”

rows.translation: 你一眼便认出了她；她身旁是一位白发、留着短胡须的英俊半奥萨人，父母之间还坐着一个有着明亮蓝眼睛的小女孩。你正觉得女孩看起来很年幼——大概八岁——却发现照片标注的日期已是十多年前，应该摄于他们仍住在地球的时候。

rows.translation: ——你向来爱听飞船的故事——
rows.raw: " - you always love hearing about starships -"

rows.original: as well as her crew, and her job as skipper of her own ship.
rows.translation: ，以及她的船员和担任自己飞船舰长的工作。
rows.raw: " as well as her crew, and her job as skipper of her own ship."

rows.original: “Her name is Inexorable. She’s an old girl, but still a magnificent example of a starship,” she states proudly. “We rescued her from the shipbreakers about ten years ago. In fact, when I started restoring her I didn’t even intend to make her space worthy again, merely to refurbish her and perhaps turn her into a museum ship. Eight hundred thousand tonnes of hulk is a lot to repair, after all.”
rows.translation: “她叫不屈号。她年纪虽大，却依旧是星舰中的杰作。”她自豪地说道。“大约十年前，我们从拆船厂手里救下了她。事实上，我刚开始修复时甚至没打算让她重新适航，只想翻新一下，或许改成博物馆舰。毕竟，修复八十万吨的船壳可不是小工程。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Her name is Inexorable. She’s an old girl, but still a magnificent example of a starship,” she states proudly. “We rescued her from the shipbreakers about ten years ago. In fact, when I started restoring her I didn’t even intend to make her space worthy again, merely to refurbish her and perhaps turn her into a museum ship. Eight hundred thousand tonnes of hulk is a lot to repair, after all.”"

rows.original: What changed, you ask.
rows.translation: 你问，是什么让她改变了主意。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat changed, you ask."

rows.original: “My husband,” a fond smile spreads across her scarlet lips as she caresses her wedding ring, “he knew how important this was to me, so he went out of his way to gather more people to join and more credits to fund it all - far more than I could have hoped for. It still took two years and millions of man-hours to get her flying again.”
rows.translation: “我的丈夫。”她轻抚婚戒，猩红的嘴唇浮现温柔笑意。“他知道这件事对我有多重要，所以竭尽全力召集更多人加入，又筹集了远超我期望的资金。即便如此，我们仍花了两年和数百万工时，才让她重新飞起来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My husband,” a fond smile spreads across her scarlet lips as she caresses her wedding ring, “he knew how important this was to me, so he went out of his way to gather more people to join and more credits to fund it all - far more than I could have hoped for. It still took two years and millions of man-hours to get her flying again.”"

rows.original: “When we first started, I used my contacts and pulled favors to get a mostly former Navy crew; today it’s almost entirely civilian. Back then, I needed competent and trustworthy people who already knew what to do. At first, we were understaffed, overworked and taking every job we could get just to pay off the bank loans.”
rows.translation: “刚起步时，我动用人脉、四处托关系，才组建起一支成员大多来自海军的船员队伍；如今则几乎全是平民。当时我需要能力出众、值得信赖，而且已经知道该怎么做的人。最初我们人手不足、工作过量，还得接下所有能找到的差事，只为还清银行贷款。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“When we first started, I used my contacts and pulled favors to get a mostly former Navy crew; today it’s almost entirely civilian. Back then, I needed competent and trustworthy people who already knew what to do. At first, we were understaffed, overworked and taking every job we could get just to pay off the bank loans.”"

rows.original: “I was already recruiting new members since the beginning - almost a thousand a year - but it took time to train them. These people usually aren’t permanent as well, they stay for a couple years. New children join the family and the older ones move out; I don’t expect anyone to remain forever, however a few choose to stay. Though whether they decide to leave or not, I love every single one just as much.”
rows.translation: “从一开始我就在招募新成员——每年近一千人——但培训他们需要时间。这些人通常也不会永久留下，而是待上几年。新的孩子加入家庭，年长的孩子搬出去；我不指望任何人永远留下，不过确实有少数人选择长住。无论他们最终决定离开与否，我对每一个人的爱都分毫不减。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was already recruiting new members since the beginning - almost a thousand a year - but it took time to train them. These people usually aren’t permanent as well, they stay for a couple years. New children join the family and the older ones move out; I don’t expect anyone to remain forever, however a few choose to stay. Though whether they decide to leave or not, I love every single one just as much.”"

rows.original: How many people, you ask, does she have on her ship right now.
rows.translation: 你问她，飞船上目前究竟有多少人。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow many people, you ask, does she have on her ship right now."

rows.original: “Over three thousand two hundred officers and crew,” she says with obvious pride.
rows.translation: “超过三千二百名军官和船员。”她语气中满是自豪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Over three thousand two hundred officers and crew,” she says with obvious pride."

rows.original: You blink. “Why so many?”
rows.translation: 你眨了眨眼。“为什么要这么多人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink. “Why so many?”"

rows.original: She chuckles at your reaction. “Because I choose to employ minimal automation on Inexorable. I want those onboard to truly feel responsible for the ship’s wellbeing, and it allows more people to join in on our adventure. All are welcome aboard my ship as long as they’re willing to learn.”
rows.translation: 她被你的反应逗笑了。“因为我选择让不屈号尽量少用自动化。我希望船上的人真正对飞船的安危负责，这也能让更多人加入我们的冒险。只要愿意学习，任何人都可以登上我的船。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles at your reaction. “Because I choose to employ minimal automation on Inexorable. I want those onboard to truly feel responsible for the ship’s wellbeing, and it allows more people to join in on our adventure. All are welcome aboard my ship as long as they’re willing to learn.”"

rows.original: When she says minimal automation, you ask, does that mean she has them do everything by hand?
rows.translation: 她说尽量少用自动化；你问，这是否意味着所有事情都由船员亲手完成。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she says minimal automation, you ask, does that mean she has them do everything by hand?"

rows.original: “Yes, it does. Almost everything from mopping the deck, food preparation, shoe repair and tailoring to carrying laundry from their berths to the laundromat. I think highly of my crew so I know they can handle it.” She smiles dotingly. “Like most children, they tend to complain about the chores. But when VIPs come aboard, and they put on their dress uniforms and stand at attention to welcome them, knowing that the ship is in pristine condition due to their own hard work, the pride they feel is indescribable.”
rows.translation: “没错。从拖洗甲板、准备食物、修鞋和裁衣，到把衣物从铺位送去洗衣房，几乎一切都由他们亲手完成。我很看重自己的船员，也知道他们应付得来。”她宠溺地笑了。“和大多数孩子一样，他们往往会抱怨家务。但当贵宾登舰，他们穿上礼服制服、立正迎接对方，并知道飞船能保持一尘不染全凭自己的辛勤劳动时，那份自豪感根本无法用言语形容。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes, it does. Almost everything from mopping the deck, food preparation, shoe repair and tailoring to carrying laundry from their berths to the laundromat. I think highly of my crew so I know they can handle it.” She smiles dotingly. “Like most children, they tend to complain about the chores. But when VIPs come aboard, and they put on their dress uniforms and stand at attention to welcome them, knowing that the ship is in pristine condition due to their own hard work, the pride they feel is indescribable.”"

rows.original: Tacit
rows.raw: "Tacit"

rows.original: You lean over, resting your elbows on the table, and ask her why she’s on this backwater ice ball.
rows.translation: 你俯身将手肘撑在桌上，问她为什么会来到这颗偏僻的冰球。
rows.raw: "You lean over, resting your elbows on the table, and ask her why she’s on this backwater ice ball."

rows.original: She sets her drink down and smiles, appreciative of your interest. “This is where we replenish our savicite every few months of travel. Actually, this is the first time we’ve been back since we set out on the Planet Rush.”
rows.translation: 她放下酒杯，对你的关心报以微笑。“我们每旅行几个月，都会来这里补充萨维石。事实上，这是我们踏上行星开拓潮后第一次回来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sets her drink down and smiles, appreciative of your interest. “This is where we replenish our savicite every few months of travel. Actually, this is the first time we’ve been back since we set out on the Planet Rush.”"

rows.original: You chime in, asking why come all the way here when she could refuel at most other stations.
rows.translation: 你插话问道，既然大多数空间站都能补充燃料，她为什么还要大老远跑到这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou chime in, asking why come all the way here when she could refuel at most other stations."

rows.original: “My ship has a very high operating cost, so if we can save a few million credits by skipping the distributor and buying straight from the refinery, we’ll do so. But this time we ran into a problem.” You raise an eyebrow. “You see, our arrival here was... unexpected, so there weren’t any shipments of savicite reserved for us, and it would be unwise to leave orbit until we get something. Burning deuterium and helium-3 alone might not be enough, so I’m down here right now with a legal team to negotiate with Steele Industries for an emergency resupply. We need just enough to make it to Tavros Station.”
rows.translation: “我的飞船运营成本非常高，所以只要能跳过经销商、直接向炼化厂采购，省下几百万信用点，我们就会这么做。但这次遇到了问题。”你扬起眉毛。“我们的到来...事先没有安排，所以没有为我们预留任何萨维石货运；而在弄到一些之前离开轨道并不明智。只燃烧氘和氦-3可能还不够，所以我现在带着法务团队来到地面，和斯蒂尔工业协商紧急补给。我们只需要足够抵达塔弗罗斯空间站的量。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My ship has a very high operating cost, so if we can save a few million credits by skipping the distributor and buying straight from the refinery, we’ll do so. But this time we ran into a problem.” You raise an eyebrow. “You see, our arrival here was... unexpected, so there weren’t any shipments of savicite reserved for us, and it would be unwise to leave orbit until we get something. Burning deuterium and helium-3 alone might not be enough, so I’m down here right now with a legal team to negotiate with Steele Industries for an emergency resupply. We need just enough to make it to Tavros Station.”"

rows.original: “Oh, I appreciate the thought, sweetie, I really do, but I don’t think there’s any way you can help.” She gives you an apologetic look, not enjoying having to turn you down. “Our new contract is being drafted right now. It should be enough to get us to Tavros for repairs and a complete refueling, after which we’ll head back into the Rush.”
rows.translation: “哦，我很感谢你的心意，亲爱的，真的，不过我想你恐怕帮不上忙。”她歉意地看着你，显然不喜欢拒绝你的好意。“我们的新合同正在起草，应该足够让我们抵达塔弗罗斯，完成维修和全面补充燃料，之后我们就会重返行星开拓潮。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I appreciate the thought, sweetie, I really do, but I don’t think there’s any way you can help.” She gives you an apologetic look, not enjoying having to turn you down. “Our new contract is being drafted right now. It should be enough to get us to Tavros for repairs and a complete refueling, after which we’ll head back into the Rush.”"

rows.original: But you tell her there is something you can do. You volunteer to be that alternate supply by gathering savicite for her out in the frozen wilderness.
rows.translation: 但你告诉她，自己确实能帮上忙。你主动提出去冰封荒野为她收集萨维石，充当那份替代补给。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut you tell her there is something you can do. You volunteer to be that alternate supply by gathering savicite for her out in the frozen wilderness."

rows.original: “Oh, I could never ask that of you! It’s too dangerous out there and whatever deposits are on the surface might not be enough, especially for one person to carry.”
rows.translation: “哦，我绝不能让你为我做这种事！外面太危险了，而且地表的矿藏未必足够，尤其不是一个人能带回来的量。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I could never ask that of you! It’s too dangerous out there and whatever deposits are on the surface might not be enough, especially for one person to carry.”"

rows.original: Diplomatically, you tell her that you’re already going out into the wilds and that you’ll probably pick up any savicite you’ll find anyway, so why not give it to her if she needs it.
rows.translation: 你委婉地告诉她，自己本来就要深入荒野，反正看到萨维石大概也会捡起来；既然她需要，何不交给她呢。
rows.raw: "\n\nDiplomatically, you tell her that you’re already going out into the wilds and that you’ll probably pick up any savicite you’ll find anyway, so why not give it to her if she needs it."

rows.original: “I’m sorry, sweetie, I just didn’t want you to get hurt on account of me. But if that’s what you want to do, then I’ll accept your offer. If you bring me any savicite you find, I’ll pay extra for your services.”
rows.translation: “对不起，亲爱的，我只是不希望你因我而受伤。不过，如果这真是你想做的事，我就接受你的提议。你把找到的萨维石带给我，我会为你的服务额外付钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m sorry, sweetie, I just didn’t want you to get hurt on account of me. But if that’s what you want to do, then I’ll accept your offer. If you bring me any savicite you find, I’ll pay extra for your services.”"

I doubt any of the athletes here really expected to.” Roxy shrugs. “But the money is here and I get paid on time, so I can’t complain.”
rows.translation: “嗯，”她翻了翻眼睛，脑袋也跟着眼珠转动。“我不讨厌乌维托。当然，这里冷得要命，不过真得感谢那些发明室内供暖的天才！”她轻笑。“有些队友不太喜欢这里，我也能理解。我自己也绝没想到会被调到某颗冰冷卫星上。这里的运动员恐怕谁都没预料到。”罗克茜耸耸肩。“不过钱在这里，薪水也准时到账，所以我没什么好抱怨的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hm,” she rolls her eyes, her head following the movements of her irises. “I don’t hate Uveto. It’s damn cold, sure, but thank you to the geniuses behind indoor heating!” She chuckles. “Some of my teammates aren’t big on the place, and I can understand that. I sure as hell didn’t expect to get moved out to some frigid moon. I doubt any of the athletes here really expected to.” Roxy shrugs. “But the money is here and I get paid on time, so I can’t complain.”"

rows.original: Her head tilts, one ear slumps, and she smirks mischievously. “‘Least that’s what my contract says.”
rows.translation: 她歪起脑袋，一只耳朵耷拉下来，顽皮地坏笑。“至少合同上是这么写的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer head tilts, one ear slumps, and she smirks mischievously. “‘Least that’s what my contract says.”"

rows.original: “I guess the other downside of living on Uveto is I’m not a hop-skip-and-a-jump away from family anymore. Like, I still keep in touch with my mom, mother, and siblings. I kinda just miss getting to physically see them. Wouldn’t want them struggling against the cold here just for that, though.”
rows.translation: “我猜住在乌维托的另一个缺点，就是再也不能蹦两步就回家见家人了。我依然和妈妈、母亲还有兄弟姐妹保持联系，只是有点想亲眼看看她们。不过我也不希望她们只为见我一面，就得来这里受冻。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess the other downside of living on Uveto is I’m not a hop-skip-and-a-jump away from family anymore. Like, I still keep in touch with my mom, mother, and siblings. I kinda just miss getting to physically see them. Wouldn’t want them struggling against the cold here just for that, though.”"

rows.original: Roxy places her hands on her hips when you give her a quizzical look. “That face your making is about my use of words ‘mom’ and ‘mother’ right? My parents are both [herms|npc|f], girly as can be. I grew up calling the one who gave birth to me ‘mom’ and my sire ‘mother’. Easy as that.”
rows.translation: 看到你疑惑的表情，罗克茜双手叉腰。“你这副表情，是因为我同时用了‘妈妈’和‘母亲’这两个词，对吧？我的双亲都是[herms|npc|f]，而且要多女性化有多女性化。我从小把生下我的那位叫‘妈妈’，把我的生父叫‘母亲’。就这么简单。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRoxy places her hands on her hips when you give her a quizzical look. “That face your making is about my use of words ‘mom’ and ‘mother’ right? My parents are both [herms|npc|f], girly as can be. I grew up calling the one who gave birth to me ‘mom’ and my sire ‘mother’. Easy as that.”"

rows.original: Come to think of it, that’s the company behind one of the local offices. Met one of the employees a while back. You work there?
