rows.raw: " Come to think of it, that’s the company behind one of the local offices. Met one of the employees a while back. You work there?"

rows.original: “Nope,” you say in a dramatically low voice, building up to the reveal. “I’m gonna run Steele Tech someday! Just have to go out and earn it like dad wanted! It’s the best! Meeting all sorts of cute guys and girls is just one of the perks.”
rows.translation: “还没有，”你故意压低声音，为揭晓答案制造悬念。“但总有一天我要执掌斯蒂尔科技！只要像爸爸希望的那样出去赢得它就行！这感觉棒极了！在路上遇见各种可爱的男孩女孩，不过是附带福利之一。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope,” you say in a dramatically low voice, building up to the reveal. “I’m gonna run Steele Tech someday! Just have to go out and earn it like dad wanted! It’s the best! Meeting all sorts of cute guys and girls is just one of the perks.”"

rows.original: “Not yet,” you smile proudly, “but I’ll be in charge someday. Dad’s got me running around to win the company, but none of that is as interesting as the people I meet getting there.”
rows.translation: “现在还没有，”你自豪地微笑，“但总有一天我会掌权。爸爸让我四处奔波来赢得公司，不过这一路遇见的人可比那些事有趣多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not yet,” you smile proudly, “but I’ll be in charge someday. Dad’s got me running around to win the company, but none of that is as interesting as the people I meet getting there.”"

rows.translation: “我就是‘那个’斯蒂尔，”你娇声说道，“我爸爸曾是首席执行官，但我还没掌权。我一直在边疆旅行，争取实现这个目标。总有一天我会执掌公司。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am ‘that’ Steele,” you simper, “my dad was the CEO, but I’m not in charge yet. I’ve been traveling the frontier in that endeavor. Someday I’ll run the place.”"

rows.original: “Oh yeah, I ‘work’ there,” you grin, “but not in any official capacity. For now. Gotta earn the company first before I go around saying I’m a bigshot CEO.”
rows.translation: “哦，对，我是在那里‘工作’，”你咧嘴一笑，“不过目前还没有任何正式身份。只是目前而已。得先赢得公司，我才好到处宣称自己是位了不起的首席执行官。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah, I ‘work’ there,” you grin, “but not in any official capacity. For now. Gotta earn the company first before I go around saying I’m a bigshot CEO.”"

rows.original: “Woah, you sure don’t look like a busybody executive. I’d know one, you should have seen my seventh agent.”

rows.translation: “对，我想也是...不过总得有个值得追求的目标。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah I’ll bet... gotta have goals to aim for, though.”"

rows.translation: 罗克茜点点头，比刚才弹跳得更快了些。“没什么比和朋友聊天更棒了，”她一如既往地兴奋，还模仿了几个滑稽动作，“总胜过那些‘能给我签个名吗？’之类的话！”
rows.raw: " Roxy nods, bouncing a little faster than before. “Nothing like a chat with a friend,” she says, excitable as ever, mimicking a few silly gestures, “beats the usual ‘can I have an autograph?’ stuff!”"

rows.translation: 她停下来，颇为专注地看着你。“话说，你家里怎么样？最近有什么事吗？有没有想念谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses, looking at you rather intently. “Say, what about your family? Anything going on there? Miss anyone?”"

rows.raw: "\n\nYour lips spread to automatically answer, but you realize that’s a bit of a loaded question for you. Roxy stares expectantly, awaiting any type of answer."

rows.translation: “嘿，你不想回答就不用回答。我们之间说的话，只留在我们之间，”罗克茜用更轻柔、更令人安心的声音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you don’t have to answer if you don’t wanna. What’s between us stays ‘tween us,” Roxy says in a lighter, more reassuring voice."

rows.original: “Daw, it’s no big deal. Not much to say either. My mom’s not around, haven’t seen her in a really long time. My dad’s really gone, too, and all I’ve got is a mean cousin ‘n uncle !” You look downcast at saying that, but perk right back up when Roxy pats your shoulder.
rows.translation: “唉，没什么大不了的，也没多少可说。妈妈已经不在身边了，我很久没见过她。爸爸也真的离开了，而我只剩下一个刻薄的表亲和叔叔！”说到这些时，你神情低落；但罗克茜拍了拍你的肩膀，你很快又振作起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Daw, it’s no big deal. Not much to say either. My mom’s not around, haven’t seen her in a really long time. My dad’s really gone, too, and all I’ve got is a mean cousin ‘n uncle !” You look downcast at saying that, but perk right back up when Roxy pats your shoulder."

My dad’s passed on, wasn’t too long ago either. And then there’s my ‘cousin’...” In a liquid movement too smooth to see, Roxy pats your shoulder sympathetically.

rows.original: I’m glad I was able to meet her, too. Knowing I have family to turn to means a lot to me.
rows.translation: 我也很高兴能够遇见她。知道自己还有可以依靠的家人，对我意义重大。
rows.raw: "I’m glad I was able to meet her, too. Knowing I have family to turn to means a lot to me."

rows.original: Sadly, we’re not what you’d call close. I’m hoping it doesn’t stay like that forever.

rows.raw: "Sadly, we’re not what you’d call close. I’m hoping it doesn’t stay like that forever."

rows.original: “No biggie,” you say, looking across the room. “Haven’t seen mom in a really long time, but I’m sure she’s doing fine. My dad’s passed on already. Wasn’t too long ago, still kinda missing him. Only immediate family who’s around is my jerk-ass cousin.” You’re taken by surprise when Roxy pats your shoulder empathically.
rows.translation: “没什么大不了的，”你望向房间另一侧说道。“已经很久没见妈妈了，但我相信她过得很好。爸爸已经去世，就在不久前，我还是有点想念他。现在还在身边的直系家人，只有我那个混蛋表亲。”罗克茜体贴地拍了拍你的肩膀，令你有些意外。

rows.raw: "\n\n“Won’t bother me,” you shrug. “All there is to say is my mom’s been out of my life for a long time. Don’t know where she is. Dad’s gone for good, though, leaving me with an asshole cousin.” Roxy nods along with your words, tapping your shoulder sympathetically."

rows.original: I’m just glad she’s not as bad as my uncle.
rows.translation: 我只庆幸她不像我叔叔那么糟糕。
rows.raw: "I’m just glad she’s not as bad as my uncle."

rows.original: Hate to say that our relationship’s in a ditch though.
rows.translation: 但不得不说，我们的关系已经跌入谷底。

rows.original: Curious as to what goes on around the stadium, you ask about the inner workings, who runs the place, what else takes place besides the races.

rows.original: “The stadium, huh?” Roxy tilts her head grunting cutely from a stretch. “It’s a big place sponsored by big companies. With all the money to be made around here, not just at the stadium, it’s been growing.” She looks to the furthest corner of the room at a small window. “‘Sides, gotta keep people’s minds off the storms somehow. What better way than a bunch of guys and girls sweatin’ for entertainment?”
rows.translation: “竞技场，是吧？”罗克茜歪着脑袋，在伸展身体时可爱地哼了一声。“这是个由大公司赞助的大地方。这一带可赚的钱很多，不只是在竞技场，所以它一直在扩建。”她望向房间最远角落的一扇小窗。“再说，总得设法让人们别老想着那些风暴。还有什么比看一群男女挥汗表演更好的办法？”

rows.original: “There are a lot of games that go on around here. Race track’s the crowd favorite right now.” Roxy leans in with an unimpressed look on her face, “Which if you ask me is mainly ‘cause you can bet on those races. Bet you, heh, a lot of sports would be more popular if the laws on gambling weren’t so wonky. Eh, but I don’t think I’d like the pressure of knowing someone else’s money rides on my performance. Last thing I need is some dick taking his bad decisions out on me or my team.”
rows.translation: “这里会举办很多比赛。赛道目前最受观众欢迎。”罗克茜探身靠近，脸上露出不以为然的神情，“要我说，主要是因为那些比赛可以下注。很多运动只要赌博法没那么古怪，肯定会更受欢迎，我敢打赌，嘿。不过，要是知道别人的钱押在我的表现上，我大概不会喜欢那种压力。我最不需要的，就是某个混蛋把自己做出的烂决定怪到我或我的队伍头上。”

rows.original: “Oh, that’s not a problem. Usually.” She chuckles nervously. “Roller derbies are a year-round sport. Every month we have at least one game, hopefully two, so I kinda live monthly paycheck to monthly paycheck.” She errantly scratches the back of her head. “I live off as little as I can in case of a rainy day. If money ever got tight I’d just take a few sewing jobs. Haven’t had to do that yet, so I must be doin’ somethin’ right.”
rows.translation: “哦，那不是问题。通常不是。”她紧张地笑了笑。“轮滑德比是全年运动。每个月至少有一场比赛，运气好能有两场，所以我差不多是按月领薪、按月过活。”她漫不经心地挠挠后脑。“我尽量省吃俭用，以防哪天有急用。如果手头真紧，我就接几份缝纫活。到现在还没必要这么做，所以我肯定有些事做对了。”

That question, among others, dominates your synapses."

rows.original: Even though the staff told you how many kids Roxy was going to have, it still throws you for a loop seeing it all happen. Four kids, five kids, they flop out into the waiting arms of your retainers, expressed away for quick health checks. The sixth gets stuck for a few seconds too long, Roxy driving herself to tears just to push it out. Her once prominent gut is receding into taut muscle again, but there’s still one coming down the line... seven kids!
rows.translation: 尽管工作人员早已告诉你罗克茜会生多少个孩子，亲眼目睹整个过程仍令你目瞪口呆。第四个、第五个孩子接连软绵绵地落入侍从等候的怀中，被抱走做快速健康检查。第六个卡住了好几秒，久得令人不安；罗克茜拼命使劲，甚至哭了出来，才终于把孩子生下。她原本高耸的肚子正在重新收紧为结实的肌肉，但还有一个正沿产道下来...七个孩子！
rows.raw: "\n\nEven though the staff told you how many kids Roxy was going to have, it still throws you for a loop seeing it all happen. Four kids, five kids, they flop out into the waiting arms of your retainers, expressed away for quick health checks. The sixth gets stuck for a few seconds too long, Roxy driving herself to tears just to push it out. Her once prominent gut is receding into taut muscle again, but there’s still one coming down the line... seven kids!"

rows.original: Your eyes cross and your whole [pc.arm] goes numb from her painful treatment, but an eighth and final newborn is brought into the galaxy, ending Roxy’s pregnancy!
rows.translation: 她痛苦的折磨令你两眼发直，整条[pc.arm]都失去了知觉，但第八个、也是最后一个新生儿终于来到银河，结束了罗克茜的孕期！
rows.raw: " Your eyes cross and your whole [pc.arm] goes numb from her painful treatment, but an eighth and final newborn is brought into the galaxy, ending Roxy’s pregnancy!"

rows.original: That seems to be it... her breathing stabilizes, and her pregnancy comes to an end.
rows.translation: 看来这就是全部了...她的呼吸逐渐平稳，孕期就此结束。
rows.raw: " That seems to be it... her breathing stabilizes, and her pregnancy comes to an end."

rows.original: It’s almost impossible to contain your excitement when you see one bunny more come out, then another... and a sixth! There’s a sixth! You have to hold Roxy’s leg and pull it back so she doesn’t crush the poor thing out of reflex! That said, it seems to be over, and she’s given birth to two sets of triplets!
rows.translation: 当你看见又一只小兔子出生，接着再来一只...然后是第六只时，你几乎无法抑制兴奋！有第六只！你不得不按住罗克茜的腿往后拉，以免她条件反射地夹伤那个可怜的小家伙！话虽如此，分娩似乎已经结束，她生下了两组三胞胎！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s almost impossible to contain your excitement when you see one bunny more come out, then another... and a sixth! There’s a sixth! You have to hold Roxy’s leg and pull it back so she doesn’t crush the poor thing out of reflex! That said, it seems to be over, and she’s given birth to two sets of triplets!"

rows.original: From the bulge in her tummy, you’d say that two bunnies vying for space to be born. Indeed it’s true, as they are both born within a second of each other. Afterward, her abdomen recedes, the pain of birthing compressing away.
rows.translation: 从她腹部的鼓起程度来看，你会说有两只小兔子正在争抢出生的空间。事实的确如此，他们前后相隔不到一秒便双双出生。随后，她的腹部瘪了下去，分娩的痛苦也随之消退。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the bulge in her tummy, you’d say that two bunnies vying for space to be born. Indeed it’s true, as they are both born within a second of each other. Afterward, her abdomen recedes, the pain of birthing compressing away."

rows.original: In some small way you find it disappointing that Roxy’s pregnancy ends at the fourth birth, her stomach finally relieved of its mewling payload.
rows.translation: 在某种程度上，罗克茜的孕期在第四次生产后便告结束，肚子终于卸下了这群喵喵叫的乘客，竟让你感到有些失落。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn some small way you find it disappointing that Roxy’s pregnancy ends at the fourth birth, her stomach finally relieved of its mewling payload."

rows.original: Into the amniotic-washed nexus between Roxy’s nethers a second, gore-covered child is deposited, wrapped and taken for a brief health check and quick clean.
rows.translation: 罗克茜两腿间被羊水冲刷的交汇处又落下第二个浑身血污的孩子；孩子被裹好抱走，接受简短的健康检查和快速清洁。
rows.raw: "\n\nInto the amniotic-washed nexus between Roxy’s nethers a second, gore-covered child is deposited, wrapped and taken for a brief health check and quick clean."

rows.original: Even though the staff told you how many kids Roxy was going to have, the passage of time and their bodies throws you for a loop all over again. Two kids, three kids, they flop out into the waiting arms of your retainers, expressed away for genial purpose. Roxy is in tears, crying her heart out now as four and five make their way into the galaxy. You clutch her paw tight -- there goes the sixth! Her once prominent gut is receding into taut muscle again, but there’s still one coming down the line... seven kids!
rows.translation: 尽管工作人员早已告诉你罗克茜会生多少个孩子，时间的流逝和一具具小身体仍再次让你目瞪口呆。第二个、第三个孩子接连软绵绵地落入侍从等候的怀中，随后被抱走妥善照料。第四个和第五个来到银河时，罗克茜已经泪流不止，哭得撕心裂肺。你紧紧握住她的爪子——第六个出来了！她原本高耸的肚子正在重新收紧为结实的肌肉，但还有一个正沿产道下来...七个孩子！
rows.raw: "\n\nEven though the staff told you how many kids Roxy was going to have, the passage of time and their bodies throws you for a loop all over again. Two kids, three kids, they flop out into the waiting arms of your retainers, expressed away for genial purpose. Roxy is in tears, crying her heart out now as four and five make their way into the galaxy. You clutch her paw tight -- there goes the sixth! Her once prominent gut is receding into taut muscle again, but there’s still one coming down the line... seven kids!"

rows.original: Your eyes cross and your whole [pc.arm] goes numb from her painful treatment, but an eighth and final newborn is brought into the galaxy, ending Roxy’s pregnancy!
rows.translation: 她痛苦的折磨令你两眼发直，整条[pc.arm]都失去了知觉，但第八个、也是最后一个新生儿终于来到银河，结束了罗克茜的孕期！
rows.raw: " Your eyes cross and your whole [pc.arm] goes numb from her painful treatment, but an eighth and final newborn is brought into the galaxy, ending Roxy’s pregnancy!"

rows.original: That seems to be it... her breathing stabilizes, and her pregnancy comes to an end.
rows.translation: 看来这就是全部了...她的呼吸逐渐平稳，孕期就此结束。
rows.raw: " That seems to be it... her breathing stabilizes, and her pregnancy comes to an end."

rows.original: It’s almost impossible to contain your excitement when you see one bunny more come out, then another...! Four... five... six! Somehow for Roxy, passing six half-laquines was easy! Her abdomen deflates into its natural state, ending her labor.
rows.translation: 当你看到又一只小兔子出生，接着再来一只...！第四只...第五只...第六只！不知怎的，罗克茜轻松生下了六个半拉奎因孩子！她的腹部恢复到自然状态，分娩就此结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s almost impossible to contain your excitement when you see one bunny more come out, then another...! Four... five... six! Somehow for Roxy, passing six half-laquines was easy! Her abdomen deflates into its natural state, ending her labor."

rows.original: From the bulging in her tummy, you’d say that two bunnies vying for space to be born. Indeed it’s true, as they are both born within a second of each other. Three so far, and still more coming! Four, then five! Afterwards, her belly recedes, the suffering compressing away.
rows.translation: 从她隆起的肚子来看，你会说有两只小兔子正在争抢出生的空间。事实的确如此，他们前后相隔不到一秒便双双出生。到目前为止已经三个，而且还有更多！第四个，接着第五个！随后，她的肚子瘪了下去，痛苦也随之消退。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the bulging in her tummy, you’d say that two bunnies vying for space to be born. Indeed it’s true, as they are both born within a second of each other. Three so far, and still more coming! Four, then five! Afterwards, her belly recedes, the suffering compressing away."

rows.original: Child after child flops out of Roxy’s dirtied canal, two, three, and finally a fourth. When her quintuplets have been birthed, her tummy recedes into natural, muscly flatness, signaling the end of her labor.
rows.translation: 一个又一个孩子从罗克茜脏乱的产道里软绵绵地滑出，第二个、第三个，最后是第四个。等五胞胎全都出生后，她的肚子恢复为自然、肌肉紧实的平坦模样，宣告分娩结束。
rows.raw: "\n\nChild after child flops out of Roxy’s dirtied canal, two, three, and finally a fourth. When her quintuplets have been birthed, her tummy recedes into natural, muscly flatness, signaling the end of her labor."

rows.original: Your laquine lover’s stomach flattens out with the birth of a second, and completely compresses as a third and final bulge makes its way through her dirtied tunnel, bringing her pregnancy to its close.
rows.translation: 你的拉奎因爱人生下第二个孩子时，肚子随之变平；第三个、也是最后一个隆起穿过她脏乱的通道后，腹部彻底收紧，孕期就此告终。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour laquine lover’s stomach flattens out with the birth of a second, and completely compresses as a third and final bulge makes its way through her dirtied tunnel, bringing her pregnancy to its close."

rows.original: You’re left feeling genuinely disappointed that her pregnancy ends so abruptly, having given birth to twins!
rows.translation: 她的孕期如此突然地结束，只生下了一对双胞胎，让你感到由衷失望！
rows.raw: " You’re left feeling genuinely disappointed that her pregnancy ends so abruptly, having given birth to twins!"

rows.original: “Oh my... fuck fuck aaahahhhh...” Roxy pants, chest heaving against her simple shirt. “Ffffff it hurts, it feels so... empty now...” Gods, she looks like she’s about to cry!

rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my... fuck fuck aaahahhhh...” Roxy pants, chest heaving against her simple shirt. “Ffffff it hurts, it feels so... empty now...” Gods, she looks like she’s about to cry!"

rows.original: Roxy is fast asleep, curled up in sheets that could keep someone toasty in the direst of winters. The quiet hums of flying cars and civilian-shunting turbolifts can be heard at varying distances beyond the comfy enclosure of this room’s walls - white noise thrums that soothe you into a half-fugue state. Just standing here in near darkness makes you want to fall asleep. How fortunate that your bedded bun has plenty of room to spare.
rows.translation: 罗克茜睡得很沉，蜷缩在厚实的被褥里，即便最严酷的寒冬也能让人暖融融的。房间舒适的墙壁之外，远近不一地传来飞车与运送平民的高速电梯发出的低沉嗡鸣——如同白噪音般震荡，让你陷入半恍惚状态。光是站在这片近乎漆黑的环境里，你就想倒头睡去。幸好，床上的兔女郎还留有充足空间。
rows.raw: "Roxy is fast asleep, curled up in sheets that could keep someone toasty in the direst of winters. The quiet hums of flying cars and civilian-shunting turbolifts can be heard at varying distances beyond the comfy enclosure of this room’s walls - white noise thrums that soothe you into a half-fugue state. Just standing here in near darkness makes you want to fall asleep. How fortunate that your bedded bun has plenty of room to spare."

rows.original: You find Roxy knitting alone in that spot. She seems a lot more relaxed than she was during her first stay at the nursery. The lighting is cozy and inviting, and your pregnant bun looks to be more than satisfied, having adapted well to her peaceful surroundings. That smug smile you know her for is flashed your way when her radar-like ears zero in on you. “Hey, about time you showed up!”
rows.translation: 你发现罗克茜独自在那个位置织东西。她看起来比第一次住进育儿室时放松多了。灯光温暖宜人，你怀孕的兔女郎似乎已经完全适应这片宁静环境，显得十分满足。雷达般的耳朵锁定你后，她朝你露出那抹熟悉的得意笑容。“嘿，你总算来了！”
rows.raw: "You find Roxy knitting alone in that spot. She seems a lot more relaxed than she was during her first stay at the nursery. The lighting is cozy and inviting, and your pregnant bun looks to be more than satisfied, having adapted well to her peaceful surroundings. That smug smile you know her for is flashed your way when her radar-like ears zero in on you. “Hey, about time you showed up!”"

rows.original: The space given to your pregnant lover isn’t lavish, but it is most assuredly a cozy one. Fresh-scented wood floors end at conservatively designed walls. A few soundproof windows with fancy blinders look out into Tavros at large -- currently, they’re shut. In a comfy chair you see Roxy, two needles in either hand. She’s knitting, occasionally grimacing from a random tummy ache.
rows.translation: 为你怀孕的爱人提供的空间并不奢华，却无疑十分温馨。散发清新气味的木质地板一路延伸至设计朴素的墙壁。几扇装有精致百叶帘的隔音窗俯瞰着整个塔弗罗斯——此刻都紧闭着。罗克茜坐在舒适的椅子里，双手各拿着一根织针。她正织着东西，偶尔因突如其来的腹痛而皱起脸。
rows.raw: "The space given to your pregnant lover isn’t lavish, but it is most assuredly a cozy one. Fresh-scented wood floors end at conservatively designed walls. A few soundproof windows with fancy blinders look out into Tavros at large -- currently, they’re shut. In a comfy chair you see Roxy, two needles in either hand. She’s knitting, occasionally grimacing from a random tummy ache."

rows.original: Her radar-like ears zone in on you and she gives you a relieved smile. “Hey, [pc.name]... what’s up?”
rows.translation: 她雷达般的耳朵锁定你，露出如释重负的笑容。“嘿，[pc.name]... 最近怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer radar-like ears zone in on you and she gives you a relieved smile. “Hey, [pc.name]... what’s up?”"

rows.original: While it’s quiet and homely here, she seems a bit on edge.

rows.translation: 眼下你实在无法拒绝她，于是又一次开始这场舒缓酸痛的按摩，带着你们不知休息了几十分钟还是几小时后恢复的全部精力。你找出她腹部最为敏感的部位，用手掌抚过；罗克茜那被喜悦淹没的神经系统在你手中如油泥般柔软。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t bring yourself to say no to her right now, launching back into that strain-soothing massage anew and with the vigor of... however many minutes or hours of power rest you both earned. Roxy’s joy-inundated nervous system is putty in your hands as you find the tenderest regions of her midriff to palm over."

rows.original: Her soft paws rub your belly back; the laquine touches you as if she had a part in creating the life inside of you right now.
rows.translation: 她柔软的爪子也抚摸着你的肚子；拉奎因触碰你的样子，仿佛此刻你体内孕育的生命也有她的一份功劳。
rows.raw: " Her soft paws rub your belly back; the laquine touches you as if she had a part in creating the life inside of you right now."

rows.original: The two of you spend hours laughing, cuddling, falling in and out of naps... who cares if there’s an inheritance out there for you to earn. Who cares that you have a whole frontier to explore.
rows.translation: 你们花上数小时欢笑、依偎，时睡时醒...谁还在乎外面是否有一份遗产等着你继承？谁又在乎你还有整片边疆等待探索？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two of you spend hours laughing, cuddling, falling in and out of naps... who cares if there’s an inheritance out there for you to earn. Who cares that you have a whole frontier to explore."

rows.original: All you need is right here, and that floppy eared lovebun will always be there...
rows.translation: 你需要的一切就在这里，而那只垂耳爱兔会永远陪伴着你...
rows.raw: "\n\nAll you need is right here, and that floppy eared lovebun will always be there..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “...and then Charlie threw him right across the field. That’s what I love about the game.”
rows.translation: “...然后查理把他直接扔过了整片球场。这就是我喜欢这项运动的原因。”
rows.raw: "“...and then Charlie threw him right across the field. That’s what I love about the game.”"

rows.original: “...should have seen the goalie after that, guy’s pants were ripped all the way open!”
rows.translation: “...你真该看看那之后的守门员，那家伙的裤子从头到尾都被扯开了！”
rows.raw: "“...should have seen the goalie after that, guy’s pants were ripped all the way open!”"

rows.original: “...man that was the best game of that year, me ‘n Charlie hucking the other team lead through their own goal!”
rows.translation: “...老天，那是那年最棒的一场比赛，我和查理把对方的队长直接扔进了他们自己的球门！”
rows.raw: "“...man that was the best game of that year, me ‘n Charlie hucking the other team lead through their own goal!”"

rows.original: “I slipped one time and accidentally pantsed some girl on the enemy team. Didn’t get called though. Guess the ref liked purple puss!”
rows.translation: “有一次我滑倒了，不小心把敌队某个姑娘的裤子扒了下来。裁判倒没吹哨。大概他喜欢紫色小穴吧！”
rows.raw: "“I slipped one time and accidentally pantsed some girl on the enemy team. Didn’t get called though. Guess the ref liked purple puss!”"

rows.original: You and Roxy are laughing so uproariously by now that you’ve forgotten to snuggle. “[pc.name],” she says, stroking your cheek, “I feel a lot better. Thanks for spending some time with me.”
rows.translation: 你和罗克茜此时已经笑得太过厉害，连依偎都忘了。“[pc.name]，”她抚摸你的脸颊说道，“我感觉好多了。谢谢你陪我。”
rows.raw: " You and Roxy are laughing so uproariously by now that you’ve forgotten to snuggle. “[pc.name],” she says, stroking your cheek, “I feel a lot better. Thanks for spending some time with me.”"

rows.original: Rejuvenated and reenergized, Roxy rises and extricates herself from your bed, slapping your [pc.ass] as she hops off. “Come back soon, alright? Gonna get some grub. See ‘ya.”
rows.translation: 重新焕发活力与精神后，罗克茜站起身，从你的床上脱离开来，跳下床时还拍了拍你的[pc.ass]。“记得快点回来，好吗？我要去弄点吃的。回头见。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRejuvenated and reenergized, Roxy rises and extricates herself from your bed, slapping your [pc.ass] as she hops off. “Come back soon, alright? Gonna get some grub. See ‘ya.”"

rows.original: She steps out quickly. Now that you’re thinking about it, you could use a bite to eat, too...
rows.translation: 她迅速走了出去。现在想来，你也有点想吃东西了...
rows.raw: "\n\nShe steps out quickly. Now that you’re thinking about it, you could use a bite to eat, too..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “What can you do?” you stolidly state.
rows.translation: “你又能怎么办呢？”你平静地说道。
rows.raw: "“What can you do?” you stolidly state."

rows.original: “I see...” you whisper, offering to help her up.
rows.translation: “我明白了...”你轻声说，并提出扶她起来。
rows.raw: "“I see...” you whisper, offering to help her up."

rows.original: “Don’t strain yourself helping others, Steele,” she sighs and struggles a bit getting back up
rows.translation: “别为了帮助别人把自己累坏了，斯蒂尔。”她叹了口气，颇费力气地重新站起来
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t strain yourself helping others, Steele,” she sighs and struggles a bit getting back up"

rows.original: waving you off when you try to help
rows.translation: ，在你试图帮忙时挥手拒绝
rows.raw: " waving you off when you try to help"

rows.original: “I’m going for a walk, don’t wait up.” Roxy leaves in a huff. “At least I had someone to talk to...”
rows.translation: “我要出去走走，不用等我。”罗克茜气冲冲地离开。“至少还有个人能听我说话...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m going for a walk, don’t wait up.” Roxy leaves in a huff. “At least I had someone to talk to...”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Roxy gives you the inquisitive eye, waiting to hear more.
rows.translation: 罗克茜用探询的目光看着你，等待你继续说下去。
rows.raw: "Roxy gives you the inquisitive eye, waiting to hear more."

rows.original: “Mind if we have a talk?” you ask.
rows.translation: “介意我们聊聊吗？”你问道。
rows.raw: "“Mind if we have a talk?” you ask."

rows.original: “Sure, yeah, sounds great,” Roxy sighs, “anything to take my mind off this.”
rows.translation: “当然，好啊，听起来不错。”罗克茜叹气道，“只要能让我暂时不去想这件事，什么都行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure, yeah, sounds great,” Roxy sighs, “anything to take my mind off this.”"

rows.original: Pregnancy
rows.translation: 怀孕
rows.raw: "Pregnancy"

rows.original: Pregnancy
rows.translation: 怀孕
rows.raw: "Pregnancy"

rows.original: Ask Roxy how she’s holding up.
rows.translation: 问问罗克茜现在感觉怎么样。
rows.raw: "Ask Roxy how she’s holding up."

rows.original: Plans
rows.translation: 计划
rows.raw: "Plans"

rows.original: Plans
rows.translation: 计划
rows.raw: "Plans"

rows.original: Ask Roxy what she’s going to do after having your kids.
rows.translation: 问问罗克茜生下你的孩子后打算做什么。
rows.raw: "Ask Roxy what she’s going to do after having your kids."

rows.original: Children
rows.translation: 孩子
rows.raw: "Children"

rows.original: Children
rows.translation: 孩子
rows.raw: "Children"

rows.original: Ask Roxy how the kids are doing!
rows.translation: 问问罗克茜孩子们的情况！
rows.raw: "Ask Roxy how the kids are doing!"

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: ASTRA_NUDE
rows.raw: "ASTRA_NUDE"

rows.original: ASTRA
rows.raw: "ASTRA"

rows.original: intro
rows.raw: "intro"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: intro lover
rows.raw: "intro lover"

rows.original: Taking a deep breath, you fortify yourself and make your way over to where Shade’s sitting. She glances up from her drink, eyeing you warily until you’re beside her.
rows.translation: 你深吸一口气，鼓起勇气，朝暗影坐着的地方走去。她从饮料上方抬眼，在你来到身旁前一直警惕地打量着你。
rows.raw: "Taking a deep breath, you fortify yourself and make your way over to where Shade’s sitting. She glances up from her drink, eyeing you warily until you’re beside her."

rows.original: “Hi,” you say, sitting when she indicates the stool beside her.
rows.translation: “嗨。”你说道，并在她示意身旁的凳子后坐下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi,” you say, sitting when she indicates the stool beside her."

rows.original: “Hey,” Shade echoes. You can hear the fatigue in her voice even after a single syllable. For the first time, the huntress looks positively haggard. “Thanks... thanks for meeting me, [pc.name]. And for giving me a little space. My mind’s been racing ever since Myrellion.”
rows.translation: “嘿。”暗影回应道。哪怕只有一个音节，你也能听出她声音中的疲惫。女猎手第一次显得如此憔悴。“谢谢...谢谢你来见我，[pc.name]。也谢谢你给了我一点空间。自从米瑞利昂之后，我的思绪就一直停不下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey,” Shade echoes. You can hear the fatigue in her voice even after a single syllable. For the first time, the huntress looks positively haggard. “Thanks... thanks for meeting me, [pc.name]. And for giving me a little space. My mind’s been racing ever since Myrellion.”"

rows.original: For what it’s worth, you find yourself apologizing once again. This really isn’t what you had intended to happen.
rows.translation: 不管是否有用，你发现自己又一次道了歉。这真的不是你原本希望发生的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor what it’s worth, you find yourself apologizing once again. This really isn’t what you had intended to happen."

rows.original: Shade sighs. “Yeah. Me neither. But the more I think about it, the more I want to... the more I realize I want this - us - to keep going. It’s been too good to let it go without a fight, but I just don’t know if I can trust you anymore, [pc.name]. And I can’t be with someone I can’t trust.”
rows.translation: 暗影叹了口气。“是啊。我也不想。但我越是仔细思考，就越想要...也越能意识到，我希望这一切——我们之间的一切——能够继续。我不愿不战而降地放弃如此美好的关系，可我已经不知道自己还能不能信任你了，[pc.name]。而我没法和一个自己无法信任的人在一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade sighs. “Yeah. Me neither. But the more I think about it, the more I want to... the more I realize I want this - us - to keep going. It’s been too good to let it go without a fight, but I just don’t know if I can trust you anymore, [pc.name]. And I can’t be with someone I can’t trust.”"

rows.original: Then what can you do to prove yourself to her?
rows.translation: 那么，你要怎样才能向她证明自己？
rows.raw: "\n\nThen what can you do to prove yourself to her?"

rows.original: The huntress looks you up and down a moment, like she’s sizing you up again just like in that bar on Myrellion, before she continues. “First, I want to be honest with you, too, so we don’t leave anything up in the air. You know who I work for, now -- not all the time, but Amara is my daughter’s sire. If she calls me for help, I answer. Period. Nobody in this galaxy’s more important to me than my baby girl, and keeping Amara happy keeps her in Astra’s life. If you can accept that about me, then I can accept... whatever it was you and that cobalt cat were up to. Keep her away from my girl’s sire, and I’ll keep her away from you. We can all let this fade out behind us.”
rows.translation: 女猎手打量了你片刻，仿佛又像当初在米瑞利昂的酒吧里那样重新评估你，随后才继续说道。“首先，我也想对你坦诚，这样我们之间就不会留下任何悬而未决的问题。你现在知道我为谁工作了——虽然不是一直如此，但阿玛拉是我女儿的生父。只要她打电话求助，我就会回应。就这么简单。这座星系里没有任何人比我的宝贝女儿更重要；让阿玛拉开心，她才会继续留在阿斯特拉的生命里。如果你能接受这样的我，那我也能接受...你和那只钴蓝色猫咪不管在搞些什么。别让她接近我女儿的生父，我也会让她远离你。我们都可以把这件事抛在身后，让它慢慢淡去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe huntress looks you up and down a moment, like she’s sizing you up again just like in that bar on Myrellion, before she continues. “First, I want to be honest with you, too, so we don’t leave anything up in the air. You know who I work for, now -- not all the time, but Amara is my daughter’s sire. If she calls me for help, I answer. Period. Nobody in this galaxy’s more important to me than my baby girl, and keeping Amara happy keeps her in Astra’s life. If you can accept that about me, then I can accept... whatever it was you and that cobalt cat were up to. Keep her away from my girl’s sire, and I’ll keep her away from you. We can all let this fade out behind us.”"

rows.original: So no more helping Kara against the Black Void?
rows.translation: 所以，你以后不能再帮助卡拉对抗黑色虚空了？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo no more helping Kara against the Black Void?"

rows.original: Not much of an ask, considering Kara’s dead...
rows.translation: 这要求倒不算过分，毕竟卡拉已经死了...
rows.raw: " Not much of an ask, considering Kara’s dead..."

rows.original: “Yeah, but she had friends. Powerful friends. Stay away from them, for our sake. Okay?”
rows.translation: “是啊，但她还有朋友，而且都是些很有权势的朋友。为了我们着想，离他们远点，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, but she had friends. Powerful friends. Stay away from them, for our sake. Okay?”"

rows.original: Promise
rows.translation: 承诺
rows.raw: "Promise"

rows.original: lover promise
rows.raw: "lover promise"

rows.original: Promise
rows.translation: 承诺
rows.raw: "Promise"

rows.original: Promise Shade that you’ll stop fighting against Amara’s Void. God help you if you break your promise...
rows.translation: 向暗影承诺，你会停止对抗阿玛拉的黑色虚空。要是你违背诺言，愿上帝保佑你...
rows.raw: "Promise Shade that you’ll stop fighting against Amara’s Void. God help you if you break your promise..."

rows.original: Sorry
rows.translation: 抱歉
rows.raw: "Sorry"

rows.original: lover sorry
rows.raw: "lover sorry"

rows.original: Sorry, Shade...
rows.translation: 抱歉，暗影...
rows.raw: "Sorry, Shade..."

rows.original: As much as you wish this wasn’t how it had to end, you can’t make that promise. You doubt Shade will want to see you after this answer...
rows.translation: 尽管你多么希望事情不必这样结束，你也无法作出那个承诺。你怀疑暗影听到这个回答后还会不会愿意见你...
rows.raw: "As much as you wish this wasn’t how it had to end, you can’t make that promise. You doubt Shade will want to see you after this answer..."

rows.original: lover promise
rows.raw: "lover promise"

rows.original: “Alright. I promise,” you say solemnly.
rows.translation: “好吧。我答应你。”你郑重地说道。
rows.raw: "“Alright. I promise,” you say solemnly."

rows.original: Shade releases a heavy breath and smiles, reaching over to take your hand. “I’m glad. Really. I think you and I got off to an unfortunate start, [pc.name], but we’re better than that. If you and I can be honest with each other from here on out, I know we can make this work.”
rows.translation: 暗影长长地呼出一口气，露出笑容，伸手握住你的手。“我很高兴，真的。[pc.name]，我觉得你和我的开始不太走运，但我们不止如此。只要从今往后彼此坦诚，我知道我们能让这段关系继续下去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade releases a heavy breath and smiles, reaching over to take your hand. “I’m glad. Really. I think you and I got off to an unfortunate start, [pc.name], but we’re better than that. If you and I can be honest with each other from here on out, I know we can make this work.”"

rows.original: The huntress’s hand pulls you towards her, yanking you into a tight embrace. You smile and hug her back, feeling the palpable relief spilling off you. Maybe now you can put all of this...
rows.translation: 女猎手握着你的手将你拉近，一把把你拽进紧紧的拥抱。你微笑着回抱她，感到显而易见的释然从自己身上流露出来。也许现在，你终于可以把这一切...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe huntress’s hand pulls you towards her, yanking you into a tight embrace. You smile and hug her back, feeling the palpable relief spilling off you. Maybe now you can put all of this..."

rows.original: Before you can finish the thought, you feel Shade’s breath hot in your ear. “Cross me on this, though, and I’ll kill you in your sleep.”
rows.translation: 还没等你想完，暗影炽热的呼吸便拂过耳畔。“不过，要是你在这件事上背叛我，我会趁你睡觉时杀了你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can finish the thought, you feel Shade’s breath hot in your ear. “Cross me on this, though, and I’ll kill you in your sleep.”"

rows.original: She pulls back from you, just enough to lock eyes and show you just how stone cold hers are in that moment, before she smiles and pulls you into a kiss. “Don’t make it come to that.”
rows.translation: 她稍稍与你拉开距离，刚好足以与你四目相对，让你看清那一刻她的眼神有多么冷酷；随后她露出微笑，将你拉入一个吻中。“别逼我走到那一步。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pulls back from you, just enough to lock eyes and show you just how stone cold hers are in that moment, before she smiles and pulls you into a kiss. “Don’t make it come to that.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but shiver, unsure about this mix of danger and warmth the huntress is putting off. But then again, maybe that’s what attracted you to her in the first place. The kiss is long and lustful, giving Shade’s hands time to play down your chest and side, gripping you by the waist. When she pulls back, she rests her forehead against your brow and smiles.
rows.translation: 你不禁打了个寒颤，无法确定女猎手散发出的危险与温暖交织的气息究竟意味着什么。不过话说回来，也许最初吸引你的正是这一点。这个吻漫长而充满欲望，给了暗影足够的时间让双手游过你的胸膛和身体侧面，紧紧握住你的腰。她退开后，将额头抵在你的眉间，露出微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but shiver, unsure about this mix of danger and warmth the huntress is putting off. But then again, maybe that’s what attracted you to her in the first place. The kiss is long and lustful, giving Shade’s hands time to play down your chest and side, gripping you by the waist. When she pulls back, she rests her forehead against your brow and smiles."

rows.original: “Now that we’ve got that out of the way,” she grins, planting a parting kiss on your cheek, “let’s have a drink to celebrate, hmm?”
rows.translation: “既然我们已经把这件事解决了，”她咧嘴笑着，在你脸颊上留下告别的一吻，“不如喝一杯庆祝一下，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Now that we’ve got that out of the way,” she grins, planting a parting kiss on your cheek, “let’s have a drink to celebrate, hmm?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: lover sorry
rows.raw: "lover sorry"

rows.original: “Sorry,” you say, withdrawing from your once-lover’s touch. As much as it hurts you, you can’t make that promise to her. There’s no way you can stay out of the Black Void’s way just for her.
rows.translation: “抱歉。”你说道，从昔日恋人的触碰中退开。尽管这令你无比痛苦，你却无法向她作出那个承诺。你不可能仅仅为了她就永远避开黑色虚空。
rows.raw: "“Sorry,” you say, withdrawing from your once-lover’s touch. As much as it hurts you, you can’t make that promise to her. There’s no way you can stay out of the Black Void’s way just for her."

rows.original: She sighs and plants her elbows on the bar, refusing to meet your gaze for a long moment. When she does, Shade’s eyes look more weary than you think you’ve ever seen them - more fitting her true age, and full of sadness.
rows.translation: 她叹了口气，双肘撑在吧台上，许久都不肯与你对视。当她终于抬眼时，暗影的眼神比你记忆中任何时候都更为疲惫——这更符合她真实的年纪，其中还充满了悲伤。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sighs and plants her elbows on the bar, refusing to meet your gaze for a long moment. When she does, Shade’s eyes look more weary than you think you’ve ever seen them - more fitting her true age, and full of sadness."

rows.original: <i>“I understand. Can’t exactly blame you. You know what I’m involved in, after all, and that... well, if you and that kitten
rows.translation: <i>“我明白。也不能真的怪你。毕竟你已经知道我卷入了什么，而那...嗯，如果你和那只小猫
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“I understand. Can’t exactly blame you. You know what I’m involved in, after all, and that... well, if you and that kitten"

rows.original: ’s friends
rows.translation: 的朋友们
rows.raw: "’s friends"

rows.original: insist on keeping this up, that’s going to make us enemies again eventually. Next time, though, I’m not going to go easy on you. I want you to understand that.”
rows.translation: 坚持继续这样下去，我们迟早会再次成为敌人。不过下一次，我可不会对你手下留情。我希望你明白这一点。”
rows.raw: " insist on keeping this up, that’s going to make us enemies again eventually. Next time, though, I’m not going to go easy on you. I want you to understand that.”"

rows.original: Something tells you it doesn’t matter either way. You had your chance to fix things with Shade, but you’ve chosen another path. A path that can’t end well for you, or the huntress, or both. Time and blood will tell.
rows.translation: 某种直觉告诉你，无论如何都已经无所谓了。你曾有机会修复与暗影的关系，却选择了另一条道路——一条无论对你、对女猎手，还是对你们双方而言，都不可能迎来好结局的道路。时间与鲜血终将给出答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething tells you it doesn’t matter either way. You had your chance to fix things with Shade, but you’ve chosen another path. A path that can’t end well for you, or the huntress, or both. Time and blood will tell."

rows.original: “Well, you’ve made your choice,” Shade says, standing. “For both our sakes, I hope we don’t meet again.”
rows.translation: “好吧，你已经作出了选择。”暗影站起身说道。“为了我们双方着想，我希望我们别再见面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you’ve made your choice,” Shade says, standing. “For both our sakes, I hope we don’t meet again.”"

rows.original: She turns towards the door, but pauses before she leaves. With a slight chuckle, Shade leans down and plants a faint kiss on the top of your head before stuffing her hands in her duster’s pockets and stalking out of the bar.
rows.translation: 她转身走向门口，却在离开前停下脚步。暗影轻笑一声，俯身在你的头顶留下淡淡一吻，随后把双手塞进风衣口袋，大步走出酒吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns towards the door, but pauses before she leaves. With a slight chuckle, Shade leans down and plants a faint kiss on the top of your head before stuffing her hands in her duster’s pockets and stalking out of the bar."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: intro friend
rows.raw: "intro friend"

rows.original: Shade & Astra
rows.translation: 暗影与阿斯特拉
rows.raw: "Shade & Astra"

rows.original: “Hey, Shade,” you say, waving as you make your way over to the bar.
rows.translation: “嘿，暗影。”你一边说，一边挥手走向吧台。
rows.raw: "“Hey, Shade,” you say, waving as you make your way over to the bar."

rows.original: Your bounty huntress friend glances up from her drink, smiles, and pushes out the empty barstool beside her. “[pc.name]! Have a sit, kiddo!”
rows.translation: 你的赏金猎人朋友从酒杯上抬起目光，露出笑容，将身旁的空吧椅推了出来。“[pc.name]！坐吧，小家伙！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour bounty huntress friend glances up from her drink, smiles, and pushes out the empty barstool beside her. “[pc.name]! Have a sit, kiddo!”"

rows.original: The woman to her left leans around Shade to greet you with a smile, and you’re suddenly reminded Shade said something about bringing her kid...
rows.translation: 她左边的女人绕过暗影探出身子，微笑着向你问好；你突然想起，暗影之前似乎说过要带她的孩子来...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman to her left leans around Shade to greet you with a smile, and you’re suddenly reminded Shade said something about bringing her kid..."

rows.original: Now that you can see both at once, there’s no doubt about it: the resemblance is striking. She is a little taller and, if the firm chestplate on her uniform is any indication, even bustier than her mother, but has the same chiseled facial features and cunning cat-eyes as Shade... even if she’s got what look like ausar ears peeking up through her snow-silver hair.
rows.translation: 现在你能同时看见她们，便再也没有疑问：两人确实惊人地相似。她比母亲稍高一些；如果制服上那块坚硬胸甲能说明什么，她的胸部甚至比母亲还丰满。但她拥有和暗影一样棱角分明的面部轮廓与狡黠猫眼...虽然一对看似奥萨尔人的耳朵从她雪银色的头发间探了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you can see both at once, there’s no doubt about it: the resemblance is striking. She is a little taller and, if the firm chestplate on her uniform is any indication, even bustier than her mother, but has the same chiseled facial features and cunning cat-eyes as Shade... even if she’s got what look like ausar ears peeking up through her snow-silver hair."

rows.original: Still, she’s older than you expected! Your friend’s daughter must be your age, maybe a few months apart one way or the other. A full grown woman, either way.
rows.translation: 不过，她比你预想的年长！你朋友的女儿一定与你同龄，顶多前后差几个月。不管怎样，她已经是个成年女人了。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, she’s older than you expected! Your friend’s daughter must be your age, maybe a few months apart one way or the other. A full grown woman, either way."

rows.original: “Hi,” the younger woman says, giving you a little wave as you take the offered seat. “I’m Astra.”
rows.translation: “嗨。”年轻女子说道，在你坐上让给你的座位时轻轻挥了挥手。“我是阿斯特拉。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi,” the younger woman says, giving you a little wave as you take the offered seat. “I’m Astra.”"

rows.original: “My daughter,” Shade confirms, putting an arm around the half-breed’s shoulder. Astra’s tail wiggles behind her, and she extends a hand which you shake warmly. “You two are about the same age if I had to guess. Just turned eighteen a bit ago.”
rows.translation: “我的女儿。”暗影确认道，将一条手臂搭在混血儿的肩上。阿斯特拉的尾巴在身后摇摆，她伸出一只手，与你热情相握。“要我猜的话，你们两个差不多大。她前不久才刚满十八岁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My daughter,” Shade confirms, putting an arm around the half-breed’s shoulder. Astra’s tail wiggles behind her, and she extends a hand which you shake warmly. “You two are about the same age if I had to guess. Just turned eighteen a bit ago.”"

rows.original: Astra huffs and gives her mom a look, but Shade just laughs and hugs her girl closer. <i>“Don’t mind her, she’s just shy. So, Steele! How’ve the stars been treating you? Done with the planet of the bugs, yet?
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉不满地哼了一声，瞪了母亲一眼，暗影却只是大笑着把女儿抱得更紧。<i>“别介意，她只是害羞。所以，斯蒂尔！最近星辰待你如何？虫子星球上的事办完了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra huffs and gives her mom a look, but Shade just laughs and hugs her girl closer. <i>“Don’t mind her, she’s just shy. So, Steele! How’ve the stars been treating you? Done with the planet of the bugs, yet?"

rows.original: Or... judging by your appearance, have you just gone native?
rows.translation: 还是说...从你的外表来看，你已经彻底入乡随俗了？”
rows.raw: " Or... judging by your appearance, have you just gone native?"

rows.original: “Oh, mom was telling me about that. Myrellion, right? All those poor people!”
rows.translation: “哦，妈妈跟我说过那里。是米瑞利昂，对吧？那些可怜的人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, mom was telling me about that. Myrellion, right? All those poor people!”"

rows.original: Yeah, you’ve finished your search on Myrellion, though the planet’s far from peaceful regardless of your efforts. Now you’ve got the time to see what the kitties’ snowy world has to offer.
rows.translation: 是的，你已经结束了在米瑞利昂的搜索，尽管无论你付出多少努力，那颗星球都远称不上和平。现在，你终于有时间看看猫咪们的冰雪世界能提供些什么了。
rows.raw: "Yeah, you’ve finished your search on Myrellion, though the planet’s far from peaceful regardless of your efforts. Now you’ve got the time to see what the kitties’ snowy world has to offer."

rows.original: No, you’re just... taking a break, for now. Figured you might see what the kitties’ snowy world has to offer.
rows.translation: 没有，你只是...暂时休息一下。你想着，不妨看看猫咪们的冰雪世界能提供些什么。
rows.raw: "No, you’re just... taking a break, for now. Figured you might see what the kitties’ snowy world has to offer."

rows.original: “Hey, I’m only half kitty,” Astra grins, wobbling the big jackal-like ears sitting high on her head. “But welcome to Uveto anyway! Mom was saying you’re some kind of space adventurer - a rusher, right? You’ll fit right in here, if that’s the case.”
rows.translation: “嘿，我只有一半是猫咪。”阿斯特拉咧嘴一笑，晃了晃头顶高处那对豺狼般的大耳朵。“不过还是欢迎来到乌维托！妈妈说你是某种太空冒险家——一名行星开拓者，对吧？如果真是这样，你会非常适合这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, I’m only half kitty,” Astra grins, wobbling the big jackal-like ears sitting high on her head. “But welcome to Uveto anyway! Mom was saying you’re some kind of space adventurer - a rusher, right? You’ll fit right in here, if that’s the case.”"

rows.original: Oh, why so?
rows.translation: 哦，为什么这么说？
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, why so?"

rows.original: “Aside from most of our little moon being crawling with creatures just as fearsome as anything in Rush Space?” Shade answers, rapping a knuckle on Astra’s armor. “Uveto’s a pretty good place for we of a martial persuasion. Plenty of eager locals to practice on if you don’t mind putting your maidenhead on the line.”
rows.translation: “除了我们这颗小卫星的大部分区域都爬满了和行星开拓区任何怪物同样凶猛的生物之外？”暗影答道，用指节敲了敲阿斯特拉的盔甲。“对于我们这些崇尚武力的人而言，乌维托是个相当不错的地方。只要你不介意把自己的贞操押上，这里有大把热情的本地人供你练习。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aside from most of our little moon being crawling with creatures just as fearsome as anything in Rush Space?” Shade answers, rapping a knuckle on Astra’s armor. “Uveto’s a pretty good place for we of a martial persuasion. Plenty of eager locals to practice on if you don’t mind putting your maidenhead on the line.”"

rows.original: “Mom!” Astra groans, which only makes the older huntress guffaw. Astra’s cheeks redden, and she quickly grabs her drink and takes a long draught to hide it. “W-what I meant was that Uveto has the Stormguard’s biggest temple on it, where we Lancers train.”
rows.translation: “妈妈！”阿斯特拉呻吟道，却只惹得年长的女猎手放声大笑。阿斯特拉双颊泛红，连忙抓起酒杯大口喝下，以此掩饰。“我、我的意思是，乌维托拥有风暴卫士最大的神殿，我们这些枪骑兵就是在那里接受训练的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mom!” Astra groans, which only makes the older huntress guffaw. Astra’s cheeks redden, and she quickly grabs her drink and takes a long draught to hide it. “W-what I meant was that Uveto has the Stormguard’s biggest temple on it, where we Lancers train.”"

rows.original: You cock an eyebrow. “Lancers?”
rows.translation: 你挑起一边眉毛。“枪骑兵？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock an eyebrow. “Lancers?”"

rows.original: Astra nods eagerly. “Storm Lancers! The temple trains us in mixed martial arts, jumpjet combat, small arms from handguns to marksman rifles, even swordsmanship and spear fighting. Graduates are some of the most sought-after private security contractors and bodyguards in the galaxy,” she explains proudly.
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉兴奋地点头。“风暴枪骑兵！神殿会训练我们的综合格斗、喷射背包战斗、从手枪到精确射手步枪的轻武器运用，甚至还有剑术与长矛战斗。毕业生是全银河系最受追捧的私人安保承包商和保镖之一。”她自豪地解释道。
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra nods eagerly. “Storm Lancers! The temple trains us in mixed martial arts, jumpjet combat, small arms from handguns to marksman rifles, even swordsmanship and spear fighting. Graduates are some of the most sought-after private security contractors and bodyguards in the galaxy,” she explains proudly."

rows.original: Sounds more like a martial academy than a temple, if that’s the case.
rows.translation: 这么说来，那里听上去更像一所武术学院，而不是神殿。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds more like a martial academy than a temple, if that’s the case."

rows.original: Astra chuckles. “Well, sure. I mean, there’s faith behind it all, but knowing how to fight is a lot more valuable than a theology degree these days, huh? Besides, there are Stormguard temples that train priests and stuff, but our faith puts fighting skill on a pedestal more than anything.”
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉轻笑起来。“嗯，确实如此。我的意思是，这一切背后都有信仰支撑，但如今懂得如何战斗可比神学学位有价值得多，对吧？况且，确实有一些风暴卫士神殿会训练祭司之类的人，只不过我们的信仰把战斗技巧看得比任何事都重要。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra chuckles. “Well, sure. I mean, there’s faith behind it all, but knowing how to fight is a lot more valuable than a theology degree these days, huh? Besides, there are Stormguard temples that train priests and stuff, but our faith puts fighting skill on a pedestal more than anything.”"

rows.original: Turning to Shade, you ask if that’s where she learned her skills, too?
rows.translation: 你转向暗影，询问她是不是也在那里学会了这些本领？
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning to Shade, you ask if that’s where she learned her skills, too?"

rows.original: “No,” she answers flatly. “I learned the hard way... and I thank Astra’s storm god friend that she doesn’t have to.”
rows.translation: “不是。”她干脆地回答。“我是在苦难中学会的...而我感谢阿斯特拉那位风暴之神朋友，让她不必如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” she answers flatly. “I learned the hard way... and I thank Astra’s storm god friend that she doesn’t have to.” "

rows.original: Shade gives you a little wink and motions to the bartender for another round. “Besides, every time I step into the arena with her, I’m more and more convinced that in a few months she’s gonna be kicking my ass into the snow with one hand tied behind her back. I guess I gave her some fightin’ genes, but she’s honed ‘em to a razor edge.”
rows.translation: 暗影朝你眨了眨眼，示意酒保再来一轮。“况且，每次我和她一起走进竞技场，就会越发相信，再过几个月，她即使一只手绑在背后，也能把我揍进雪地里。我大概给了她几分好斗的基因，但她已经把这些天赋磨得如刀锋般锐利。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade gives you a little wink and motions to the bartender for another round. “Besides, every time I step into the arena with her, I’m more and more convinced that in a few months she’s gonna be kicking my ass into the snow with one hand tied behind her back. I guess I gave her some fightin’ genes, but she’s honed ‘em to a razor edge.”"

rows.original: “You’re just saying that,” Astra giggles, though her swishing tail can’t hide just how much she appreciates the compliment. “And don’t pretend you don’t believe! I know you wear your pendant everywhere you go.”
rows.translation: “你只是这么说而已。”阿斯特拉咯咯笑道，然而她来回摆动的尾巴根本掩饰不住自己有多喜欢这番赞美。“还有，别假装你不信！我知道你走到哪里都戴着那枚吊坠。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re just saying that,” Astra giggles, though her swishing tail can’t hide just how much she appreciates the compliment. “And don’t pretend you don’t believe! I know you wear your pendant everywhere you go.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, yeah,” Shade smirks. She runs a thumb along the svelte silver chain around her neck, smiling to herself. “I meant what I said though, pup. Tell you what, maybe [pc.name] here can prove it to you. [pc.HeShe]’s a rough and tumble spacer
rows.translation: “是，是。”暗影坏笑起来。她用拇指沿着颈间纤细的银链轻轻摩挲，独自微笑。“不过我刚才说的是真的，小家伙。这样吧，也许这里的[pc.name]能向你证明。[pc.HeShe]是个久经风浪的太空人
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, yeah,” Shade smirks. She runs a thumb along the svelte silver chain around her neck, smiling to herself. “I meant what I said though, pup. Tell you what, maybe [pc.name] here can prove it to you. [pc.HeShe]’s a rough and tumble spacer"

rows.original: , and I can attest to [pc.hisHer] badass-ness
rows.translation: ，我可以证明[pc.hisHer]有多厉害
rows.raw: ", and I can attest to [pc.hisHer] badass-ness"

rows.original: Astra bites her lip and gives you a little smile of her own. “Well, our arena’s open to the public. If you wanna swing by the temple sometime, I’d be happy to go a few rounds with you!”
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉咬住嘴唇，也朝你露出一丝微笑。“嗯，我们的竞技场向公众开放。如果你什么时候想顺路去神殿，我很乐意和你过上几招！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra bites her lip and gives you a little smile of her own. “Well, our arena’s open to the public. If you wanna swing by the temple sometime, I’d be happy to go a few rounds with you!”"

rows.original: Now that sounds like it could be fun!
rows.translation: 这听起来还真挺有趣！
rows.raw: "Now that sounds like it could be fun!"

rows.original: Spar with Shade’s daughter? Well, that could be fun you suppose.
rows.translation: 和暗影的女儿切磋？嗯，你觉得这或许会很有趣。
rows.raw: "Spar with Shade’s daughter? Well, that could be fun you suppose."

rows.original: Astra’s smile broadens, and her hybrid tail beats her seat so quickly that you can actually hear the thump-thump pattern.
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉的笑容越发灿烂，她那条混血尾巴飞快拍打着座位，快到你甚至能听见砰、砰的节奏。
rows.raw: " Astra’s smile broadens, and her hybrid tail beats her seat so quickly that you can actually hear the thump-thump pattern."

rows.original: “Speaking of rounds. Hana! Where’s my drinks!?” Shade bellows, loud enough to make her daughter wince. The ausar woman behind the bar scowls and comes over with a new pair of mugs for the Irons girls, and one full of the same frothy lager for you. “There we go! Wouldn’t mind waiting if it wasn’t for the same piss she’s been serving for the last decade.”
rows.translation: “说到再来一轮。花！我的酒呢！？”暗影大声吼道，音量大得令女儿都缩了一下。吧台后的奥萨尔女人皱着眉走来，为艾恩斯母女端上两只新酒杯，也给你端来一杯同样盛满泡沫拉格啤酒的杯子。“这就对了！要不是她过去十年一直端上同样的尿水，我倒不介意多等一会儿。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Speaking of rounds. Hana! Where’s my drinks!?” Shade bellows, loud enough to make her daughter wince. The ausar woman behind the bar scowls and comes over with a new pair of mugs for the Irons girls, and one full of the same frothy lager for you. “There we go! Wouldn’t mind waiting if it wasn’t for the same piss she’s been serving for the last decade.”"

rows.original: The bartender gives an audible “harrumph!” and turns to some other customers, leaving Shade to laugh and slap her knee. Astra whines, burying her face in her hands. “Moooom!”
rows.translation: 酒保清晰地“哼！”了一声，转身去招待其他客人，留下暗影大笑着拍打膝盖。阿斯特拉哀鸣着把脸埋进双手。“妈——妈！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bartender gives an audible “harrumph!” and turns to some other customers, leaving Shade to laugh and slap her knee. Astra whines, burying her face in her hands. “Moooom!”"

rows.original: Shade just keeps on laughing. “Sorry. I... might have had two or three... or seven... drinks before you got here, [pc.name].” The older huntress hiccups, chuckles, and starts chugging.
rows.translation: 暗影只是继续大笑。“抱歉。在你来之前，我...也许喝了两三杯...或者七杯...酒，[pc.name]。”年长的女猎手打了个嗝，轻笑一声，又开始大口灌酒。
rows.raw: "\n\nShade just keeps on laughing. “Sorry. I... might have had two or three... or seven... drinks before you got here, [pc.name].” The older huntress hiccups, chuckles, and starts chugging."

rows.original: You smile and join her, quickly followed by Astra. This promises to be a fun outing...
rows.translation: 你微笑着加入她，很快阿斯特拉也跟了上来。这次外出看来会很有趣...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and join her, quickly followed by Astra. This promises to be a fun outing..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: friend next
rows.raw: "friend next"

rows.original: friend next
rows.raw: "friend next"

rows.original: Shade & Astra
rows.translation: 暗影与阿斯特拉
rows.raw: "Shade & Astra"

rows.original: A few drinks later...
rows.translation: 又喝了几杯后...
rows.raw: "A few drinks later..."

rows.original: The next few hours pass in a tipsy blur, with you recounting some of your more recent adventures. Astra listens intently, eyes wide with wonder. Shade sometimes interjects, comparing your yarn to one of her old war stories, or even to some humorous moment in her more recent years, but seeing her daughter hanging on your every word keeps her from stealing the spotlight.
rows.translation: 接下来的几个小时在微醺的朦胧中度过，你讲述了一些最近经历的冒险。阿斯特拉睁大双眼，专心倾听。暗影偶尔会插嘴，把你的故事与她以前的战争经历比较，或是与近些年某个有趣时刻相提并论；不过看见女儿全神贯注地听你说每一个字，她便没有抢走你的风头。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next few hours pass in a tipsy blur, with you recounting some of your more recent adventures. Astra listens intently, eyes wide with wonder. Shade sometimes interjects, comparing your yarn to one of her old war stories, or even to some humorous moment in her more recent years, but seeing her daughter hanging on your every word keeps her from stealing the spotlight."

rows.original: Eventually, though, Astra glances at her holoband and grimaces. <i>“
rows.translation: 不过最终，阿斯特拉瞥了一眼自己的全息腕带，皱起脸来。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, though, Astra glances at her holoband and grimaces. <i>“"

rows.original: It’s getting late. I should turn in.
rows.translation: 时间不早了。我该休息了。
rows.raw: "It’s getting late. I should turn in."

rows.original: I’ve got a class to get to
rows.translation: 我得去上课了
rows.raw: "I’ve got a class to get to"

rows.original: ,” she says apologetically, hopping off her bar seat. “It’s been great to meet you, [pc.name]. Hope you stick around for a while - and think about dropping by the temple some time if you do! We’d love to have you!”
rows.translation: ，”她歉意地说道，从吧椅上跳了下来。“很高兴认识你，[pc.name]。希望你能在这里多待一阵——要是留下来，也考虑一下什么时候来神殿看看！我们会很欢迎你的！”
rows.raw: ",” she says apologetically, hopping off her bar seat. “It’s been great to meet you, [pc.name]. Hope you stick around for a while - and think about dropping by the temple some time if you do! We’d love to have you!”"

rows.original: She circles around to give you a fiercely tight hug, giving you a whiff of bourbon and a rosy perfume mixing around her. When she breaks the hug, she flashes you a toothy smile. “See you again soon!”
rows.translation: 她绕过来给了你一个异常用力的拥抱，让你闻到波本酒与玫瑰香水混合的气味。结束拥抱时，她朝你露出满是牙齿的笑容。“很快再见！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe circles around to give you a fiercely tight hug, giving you a whiff of bourbon and a rosy perfume mixing around her. When she breaks the hug, she flashes you a toothy smile. “See you again soon!”"

rows.original: Astra bounces out the door, tail wagging behind her. Shade calls a goodbye after her, then turns back to you with a half-drunken smile. “She’s a real sweetheart, isn’t she? Not like her grizzled old mother at all.”
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉蹦蹦跳跳地出了门，尾巴在身后摇摆。暗影在她身后喊了一声再见，随后带着半醉的笑容转向你。“她真是个甜心，对吧？一点也不像她那个饱经风霜的老妈。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra bounces out the door, tail wagging behind her. Shade calls a goodbye after her, then turns back to you with a half-drunken smile. “She’s a real sweetheart, isn’t she? Not like her grizzled old mother at all.”"

rows.original: Well, thank God for small miracles.
rows.translation: 好吧，感谢上帝赐予我们这样的小小奇迹。
rows.raw: "Well, thank God for small miracles."

rows.original: Oh, that’s not true!
rows.translation: 哦，才不是这样！
rows.raw: "Oh, that’s not true!"

rows.original: Shade rolls her eyes and plants her chin in her hands. “Eh, I’m just happy Astra’s found her place in the world... somewhere where she’s got friends, people to rely on. The temple’s been good for her.”
rows.translation: 暗影翻了个白眼，双手托住下巴。“呃，我只是很高兴阿斯特拉找到了自己在世间的位置...找到了拥有朋友、有人可以依靠的地方。神殿对她很不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade rolls her eyes and plants her chin in her hands. “Eh, I’m just happy Astra’s found her place in the world... somewhere where she’s got friends, people to rely on. The temple’s been good for her.”"

rows.original: She finishes her drink and sighs. “I dunno if you’re planning to stick around Uveto, kiddo, but if you do... heh, like I said, you and Astra are about to same age...”
rows.translation: 她喝完杯中酒，叹了口气。“我不知道你是否打算留在乌维托，小家伙，但如果你留下...嘿，就像我说的，你和阿斯特拉差不多大...”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe finishes her drink and sighs. “I dunno if you’re planning to stick around Uveto, kiddo, but if you do... heh, like I said, you and Astra are about to same age...”"

rows.original: Wait, is she... nah. You pass it off as drunken rambling - no way Shade’s thinking about setting you two up.
rows.translation: 等等，她难道...不可能。你把这当作醉酒后的胡言乱语——暗影不可能在考虑撮合你们两个。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, is she... nah. You pass it off as drunken rambling - no way Shade’s thinking about setting you two up."

rows.original: Then again, you did let slip that you’re on the way to being a trillionaire C.E.O. Between this and the huskar back on the station, maybe you ought to get used to this sort of treatment!
rows.translation: 不过话说回来，你确实说漏了嘴，透露自己正在成为一名万亿富翁首席执行官。再加上空间站里的那名赫斯卡，也许你该习惯这种待遇了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThen again, you did let slip that you’re on the way to being a trillionaire C.E.O. Between this and the huskar back on the station, maybe you ought to get used to this sort of treatment!"

rows.original: Shade sighs and rolls her shoulders, not quite looking at you anymore. “I think Astra has a point. I should probably get going... I know you’ve got that crazy quest of yours to go after, anyway.”
rows.translation: 暗影叹了口气，活动了一下肩膀，视线不再完全落在你身上。“我觉得阿斯特拉说得有道理。我大概该走了...反正我知道你还有那个疯狂的任务要继续。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade sighs and rolls her shoulders, not quite looking at you anymore. “I think Astra has a point. I should probably get going... I know you’ve got that crazy quest of yours to go after, anyway.”"

rows.original: She stands up, pounds back the rest of her drink, and cracks the empty mug down hard enough to make you blink. “Of course, if you are sticking around Uveto for a bit... hopefully I’ll see you around. My house is the one just north of the bar, next to the temple, if you ever want to come visit.”
rows.translation: 她站起身，将剩余的酒一饮而尽，又把空酒杯重重砸下，力道大得令你眨了眨眼。“当然，如果你确实打算在乌维托待上一阵...希望我能经常见到你。我的房子就在酒吧北边，紧挨着神殿；你要是想来拜访，随时都可以。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands up, pounds back the rest of her drink, and cracks the empty mug down hard enough to make you blink. “Of course, if you are sticking around Uveto for a bit... hopefully I’ll see you around. My house is the one just north of the bar, next to the temple, if you ever want to come visit.”"

rows.original: You glance at your Codex and suddenly realize what time it is. Damn, time flies. You tell Shade goodbye, and that maybe you will visit her--and Astra--if time permits. She gives you a farewell clap on the shoulder and shoves her hands into her duster’s pockets, heading for the stairs. You finish your own drink and excuse yourself from your seat, ready to see what else this frozen world has to offer.
rows.translation: 你瞥了一眼CODEX终端，突然意识到现在已经几点。该死，时间过得真快。你向暗影告别，并表示如果时间允许，也许会去拜访她——还有阿斯特拉。她在你肩上拍了一下作为道别，将双手塞进风衣口袋，朝楼梯走去。你喝完自己的酒，离开座位，准备看看这个冰冻世界还有什么可探索的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance at your Codex and suddenly realize what time it is. Damn, time flies. You tell Shade goodbye, and that maybe you will visit her--and Astra--if time permits. She gives you a farewell clap on the shoulder and shoves her hands into her duster’s pockets, heading for the stairs. You finish your own drink and excuse yourself from your seat, ready to see what else this frozen world has to offer."

rows.original: “Hey,” you say, sauntering up behind your half-sister and giving her shoulder an affectionate squeeze.
rows.translation: “嘿。”你说道，悠然走到同父异母的姐姐身后，亲昵地捏了捏她的肩膀。
rows.raw: "“Hey,” you say, sauntering up behind your half-sister and giving her shoulder an affectionate squeeze."

rows.original: “[pc.name]!” she grins, twisting in her seat to grab you in a hug. She’s as strong as ever, making you squirm before she laughs and lets you go, pulling out one of the bar stools next to her and beckoning you to sit. “Glad you could make it, little
rows.translation: “[pc.name]！”她咧嘴笑着，在座位上扭过身来将你抱住。她依然如此强壮，让你挣扎了几下，随后才笑着放开你，拉出身旁的一张吧椅，示意你坐下。“很高兴你能来，小
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]!” she grins, twisting in her seat to grab you in a hug. She’s as strong as ever, making you squirm before she laughs and lets you go, pulling out one of the bar stools next to her and beckoning you to sit. “Glad you could make it, little "

rows.translation: 兄弟
rows.raw: "brother"

rows.original: sister
rows.translation: 姐妹
rows.raw: "sister"

rows.original: . Oh, there’s someone I want you to meet...”
rows.translation: 。哦，还有个人我想让你认识...”
rows.raw: ". Oh, there’s someone I want you to meet...”"

rows.original: Now that you can see both at once, there’s no doubt about it: the resemblance is striking. Your niece is a little taller and, if the firm chestplate on her uniform is any indication, even bustier than her mother, but has the same chiseled facial features and cunning cat-eyes as Shade... even if she’s got what look like ausar ears peeking up through her snow-silver hair.
rows.translation: 现在你能同时看见她们，便再也没有疑问：两人确实惊人地相似。你的外甥女稍高一些；如果制服上那块坚硬胸甲能说明什么，她的胸部甚至比母亲还丰满。但她拥有和暗影一样棱角分明的面部轮廓与狡黠猫眼...虽然一对看似奥萨尔人的耳朵从她雪银色的头发间探了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you can see both at once, there’s no doubt about it: the resemblance is striking. Your niece is a little taller and, if the firm chestplate on her uniform is any indication, even bustier than her mother, but has the same chiseled facial features and cunning cat-eyes as Shade... even if she’s got what look like ausar ears peeking up through her snow-silver hair."

rows.original: Still, she’s older than you expected! Your niece must be your age, maybe a few months apart one way or the other. A full grown woman, either way.
rows.translation: 不过，她比你预想的年长！你的外甥女一定与你同龄，顶多前后差几个月。不管怎样，她已经是个成年女人了。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, she’s older than you expected! Your niece must be your age, maybe a few months apart one way or the other. A full grown woman, either way."

rows.original: She leans over and waves, giving you a shy smile. “Hey!” Her voice, at least, isn’t like her mother’s at all: higher, more feminine, gentler in tone. More girlish, and less like a husky temptress. “I’m Astra. You’re... wow, when mom said she’d met her
rows.translation: 她探身挥手，朝你露出害羞的微笑。“嘿！”至少她的嗓音一点也不像母亲：音调更高、更女性化，语气也更温柔。更像少女，而不像嗓音沙哑的魅惑者。“我是阿斯特拉。你是...哇，妈妈说她遇到了自己的
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans over and waves, giving you a shy smile. “Hey!” Her voice, at least, isn’t like her mother’s at all: higher, more feminine, gentler in tone. More girlish, and less like a husky temptress. “I’m Astra. You’re... wow, when mom said she’d met her "

rows.original: , I thought you’d be, um... a lot older.”
rows.translation: 时，我还以为你会，呃...年长得多。”
rows.raw: ", I thought you’d be, um... a lot older.”"

rows.original: Shade huffs, crossing her arms at her daughter. “It’s not like I’m a fossil here, pup. Though from what I’ve gathered, your grandfather might as well have been. Lived more than two hundred years... if the rumors are true, I wouldn’t be surprised if [pc.name] and I have generations of siblings out there.”
rows.translation: 暗影哼了一声，抱起双臂瞪着女儿。“我又不是什么活化石，小家伙。不过据我所知，你外祖父倒差不多算一个。他活了两百多年...如果那些传闻是真的，那么即使[pc.name]和我在外面还有好几代兄弟姐妹，我也不会惊讶。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade huffs, crossing her arms at her daughter. “It’s not like I’m a fossil here, pup. Though from what I’ve gathered, your grandfather might as well have been. Lived more than two hundred years... if the rumors are true, I wouldn’t be surprised if [pc.name] and I have generations of siblings out there.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: chuckle
rows.translation: 轻笑一声
rows.raw: "chuckle"

rows.original: shrug
rows.translation: 耸了耸肩
rows.raw: "shrug"

rows.original: , taking the seat Shade’s been offering. You admit, your dad was... well, he got around, you know that much. For a long time, too.
rows.translation: ，坐上暗影一直让给你的座位。你承认，父亲他...嗯，四处留情，至少这一点你很清楚，而且持续了很长时间。
rows.raw: ", taking the seat Shade’s been offering. You admit, your dad was... well, he got around, you know that much. For a long time, too."

rows.original: “So!” Astra interjects, cutting her mother off before the two of you can start talking about your father’s escapades. “Can I call you [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “所以！”阿斯特拉插嘴，在你和她母亲开始讨论父亲那些风流韵事之前打断了你们。“我可以叫你[pc.name]吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So!” Astra interjects, cutting her mother off before the two of you can start talking about your father’s escapades. “Can I call you [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You nod, reaching past Shade to
rows.translation: 你点点头，越过暗影，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, reaching past Shade to "

                    "shake Astra’s hand when it’s offered",
                    "give Astra a friendly hug",
                  )

rows.original: shake Astra’s hand when it’s offered
rows.translation: 在阿斯特拉伸出手时与她握手
rows.raw: "shake Astra’s hand when it’s offered"

rows.original: give Astra a friendly hug
rows.translation: 友好地拥抱阿斯特拉
rows.raw: "give Astra a friendly hug"

rows.original: . She giggles and flashes you a brighter smile than before, swishing her tail against the legs of her seat.
rows.translation: 。她咯咯笑着，朝你露出比之前更加灿烂的笑容，尾巴轻扫着座位的椅腿。
rows.raw: ". She giggles and flashes you a brighter smile than before, swishing her tail against the legs of her seat."

rows.original: While you’re busy with Astra, Shade calls the matronly ausar behind the bar over and gets drinks for the three of you: tall, frothy mugs of dark beer that are just bitter enough to make even your amazonian relatives grimace when they take their first sips.
rows.translation: 在你忙着与阿斯特拉打招呼时，暗影叫来吧台后那名慈祥的奥萨尔女人，为你们三人点了酒：装在高大酒杯里、泡沫丰盈的黑啤酒，苦味恰好浓到令你两位亚马逊亲戚喝下第一口时都皱起脸来。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re busy with Astra, Shade calls the matronly ausar behind the bar over and gets drinks for the three of you: tall, frothy mugs of dark beer that are just bitter enough to make even your amazonian relatives grimace when they take their first sips."

rows.original: “Ah! Like I said, I’m glad you came out, kiddo,” Shade laughs, putting an arm around your shoulder. “Welcome to the family.”
rows.translation: “啊！就像我说的，我很高兴你能来，小家伙。”暗影笑着，一条手臂搭住你的肩膀。“欢迎加入这个家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah! Like I said, I’m glad you came out, kiddo,” Shade laughs, putting an arm around your shoulder. “Welcome to the family.”"

rows.original: You smile. It’s strange, being so close to relatives again. With dad dead and your mother back in the core, you might never have had the chance again for years. Maybe ever. Now, though... now you have a chance to get to know them!
rows.translation: 你露出微笑。重新与亲人如此亲近的感觉有些奇怪。父亲已经去世，母亲又回到了核心区；你本可能要等上好几年才会再次获得这样的机会，甚至可能永远不会有。可现在...现在你有机会了解她们了！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile. It’s strange, being so close to relatives again. With dad dead and your mother back in the core, you might never have had the chance again for years. Maybe ever. Now, though... now you have a chance to get to know them!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "sibling next"

rows.original: Shade & Astra
rows.translation: 莎德与阿斯特拉
rows.raw: "Shade & Astra"

rows.original: Out of curiosity, you ask Astra between drinks if she lives here with her mom. Her outfit certainly suggests she’s local.
rows.translation: 出于好奇，你趁喝酒的间隙问阿斯特拉，她是否和母亲住在这里。她的装束看起来确实像是本地人。
rows.raw: "Out of curiosity, you ask Astra between drinks if she lives here with her mom. Her outfit certainly suggests she’s local."

rows.original: “Oh, I’m training at the temple,” she answers, pointing a thumb at the lightning bolt patterns on her armor’s pauldrons. The same as Shade’s almost. “I basically live there.”
rows.translation: “哦，我在神殿接受训练，”她回答道，用拇指指了指铠甲肩甲上的闪电图案，几乎和莎德身上的一模一样。“我基本都住在那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I’m training at the temple,” she answers, pointing a thumb at the lightning bolt patterns on her armor’s pauldrons. The same as Shade’s almost. “I basically live there.”"

rows.original: “Though you’ll always have a room at the house. Which is literally a stone’s throw from the temple door.”
rows.translation: “不过家里永远有你的房间，而且离神殿大门真的只有一箭之遥。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Though you’ll always have a room at the house. Which is literally a stone’s throw from the temple door.”"

rows.original: Astra rolls her eyes. “You keep saying that, I know. But I like living at the temple with the other novices. It’s like a sorority.”
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉翻了个白眼。“这话你一直在说，我知道。但我就是喜欢和其他见习生一起住在神殿。那里就像姐妹会一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra rolls her eyes. “You keep saying that, I know. But I like living at the temple with the other novices. It’s like a sorority.”"

rows.original: “You could just go to college if that’s what’s important to you,” Shade teases, scratching her fingers through her daughter’s snowy locks.
rows.translation: “要是你看重的是这个，直接去上大学不就好了，”莎德打趣道，手指穿过女儿雪白的发丝轻轻搔弄。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You could just go to college if that’s what’s important to you,” Shade teases, scratching her fingers through her daughter’s snowy locks."

rows.original: Before they can carry that on any further, you ask exactly what training Astra’s undergoing at the temple. If her attire’s anything to go by, you’re not sure she’s trying to become a nun.
rows.translation: 她们还没来得及继续说下去，你便问起阿斯特拉究竟在神殿接受什么训练。单看这身打扮，你可不觉得她是想当修女。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore they can carry that on any further, you ask exactly what training Astra’s undergoing at the temple. If her attire’s anything to go by, you’re not sure she’s trying to become a nun."

rows.original: “Not on your life!” she laughs, and raps her knuckles on the hardened breastplate strapped to her chest over her bodysuit. “It’s the Stormguard temple. I’m working to become a Storm Lancer, an elite warrior! There’s our faith behind it, sure, but I’m not trying to be a priestess. When I earn my jump jets, it’ll be easy to get a contract with any PMC on the fringe. Maybe even Nova!”
rows.translation: “想都别想！”她笑道，用指节敲了敲紧绑在紧身衣外、覆盖胸口的硬化胸甲。“那是风暴卫队的神殿。我正在努力成为风暴枪骑兵，一名精英战士！这背后当然有我们的信仰，但我可没想当女祭司。等我拿到喷气背包，想和边疆的任何私人军事公司签约都会轻而易举，甚至可能进新星证券！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not on your life!” she laughs, and raps her knuckles on the hardened breastplate strapped to her chest over her bodysuit. “It’s the Stormguard temple. I’m working to become a Storm Lancer, an elite warrior! There’s our faith behind it, sure, but I’m not trying to be a priestess. When I earn my jump jets, it’ll be easy to get a contract with any PMC on the fringe. Maybe even Nova!”"

rows.original: So it’s a religious combat school, basically?
rows.translation: 所以那里基本就是一所宗教战斗学校？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo it’s a religious combat school, basically?"

rows.original: She nods eagerly, still letting her mother scratch her head. “The Uvetan temple mostly trains Lancers, since there’s so many hostile natives for us to practice on. With stun weapons, of course! Other temples in the galaxy train more priests or scholars, but we’re more of a fighting school.”
rows.translation: 她热切地点头，依旧任由母亲挠着脑袋。“乌维托神殿主要培养枪骑兵，因为这里有很多充满敌意的原生生物供我们练手。当然，我们用的是电击武器！银河系其他地方的神殿会培养更多祭司或学者，但我们更像一所战斗学校。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods eagerly, still letting her mother scratch her head. “The Uvetan temple mostly trains Lancers, since there’s so many hostile natives for us to practice on. With stun weapons, of course! Other temples in the galaxy train more priests or scholars, but we’re more of a fighting school.”"

rows.original: Considering her mother’s talents, that seems a good enough fit for her.
rows.translation: 考虑到她母亲的本事，这条路似乎确实很适合她。
rows.raw: "\n\nConsidering her mother’s talents, that seems a good enough fit for her."

rows.original: “You should come by sometime!” Astra grins, wagging her tail a little more quickly. “Our arena’s open to the public - I could show you some of our moves.”
rows.translation: “你哪天也该过来看看！”阿斯特拉咧嘴笑道，尾巴摇得更快了一些。“我们的竞技场向公众开放，我可以给你展示几招。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You should come by sometime!” Astra grins, wagging her tail a little more quickly. “Our arena’s open to the public - I could show you some of our moves.”"

rows.original: That’d be something. Maybe when she’s done training, you might be able to set her up with some of your old contacts from your apprenticeship. That’s what family does, right?
rows.translation: 那肯定很有意思。等她结束训练后，也许你能借助自己学徒时期留下的旧人脉帮她牵线。这就是家人该做的，对吧？
rows.raw: "That’d be something. Maybe when she’s done training, you might be able to set her up with some of your old contacts from your apprenticeship. That’s what family does, right?"

rows.original: Maybe you will, at that!
rows.translation: 说不定你真会这么做！
rows.raw: "Maybe you will, at that!"

rows.original: Astra gives you a big thumb’s up and finishes her drink. “Lookin’ forward to it, [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: 阿斯特拉朝你竖起大拇指，喝完了杯中酒。“我很期待，[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAstra gives you a big thumb’s up and finishes her drink. “Lookin’ forward to it, [pc.name]!”"

rows.translation: 下一步

She closes the door behind you, and you hear a click of the lock engaging. The lights snap on a second later, bathing Shade’s bedroom in sultry dim glow.
rows.translation: 莎德把手放在你肩上，轻轻推着你走向她的卧室。咦。你顺着她的引导走进一片漆黑的房间。她在身后关上门，你听见门锁咔哒一声扣上。一秒后灯光亮起，让莎德的卧室沐浴在暧昧的昏暗光芒中。

rows.original: As promised, there’s somebody tied up... in the bed. It takes a second for you to recognize her in the mood lighting, especially half-naked and bound by a pair of big, fuzzy pink handcuffs hanging from over the headboard. The first thing you alight on is a wild mane of curly red hair, falling down the figure’s pale and freckled shoulders. A tail of the same bright ginger thrashes against the bedsheets between her legs, matching the coat on her forearms and legs. An ausar, with a pair of leaf-green eyes glowering at you from under her bangs, and a lush set of blue-painted lips sucking a geek ball firmly strapped around her face.
rows.translation: 如她所说，确实有人被绑着...就在床上。你花了一秒才在情调照明中认出她，尤其是她半裸着身体，被一副硕大、毛茸茸的粉色手铐铐在床头板上方。最先映入眼帘的是一头狂乱卷曲的红发，披落在苍白而长满雀斑的肩上。两腿之间，一条同样鲜艳的姜红色尾巴在床单上猛烈拍打，与她前臂和小腿上的毛色相呼应。那是一名奥萨人；一双叶绿色眼睛从刘海下怒瞪着你，涂成蓝色的丰满嘴唇则含着一颗牢牢绑在脸上的球形口塞。

rows.original: You step up to the front door of the tiny little hut bearing your lover’s name and tap the doorbell. An electronic chime echoes from inside, just barely audible over the howl of the frozen winds over the high walls of Irestead. A moment passes in the cold before a small holoscreen next to the door shudders to life, showing you the familiar, smiling face of a certain kaithrit huntress.
rows.translation: 你走到那栋挂着情人姓名的小屋门前，按响门铃。电子铃声从里面传来，在艾尔斯特德高墙上方冰冷狂风的呼啸中几乎听不见。你在严寒中等了片刻，门边的小型全息屏幕忽然亮起，显现出那位熟悉凯斯丽特女猎手的笑脸。

rows.original: “Hey!” she grins, angling the camera on her end up towards herself. Unlike the last time you met, Shade’s ditched her heavy blue duster and simply wrapped herself up in a dark tan sweater that hugs her ample curves loosely and a woolen sock stretched around her reptilian tail, sheathing its lurid sex from sight and its jade scales from the chill. For once she almost looks her age: more hot school mom than deadly space huntress, but the way she smiles invitingly at you, the appeal of your feline lover isn’t lost for a moment.
rows.translation: “嘿！”她咧嘴笑道，把自己那边的摄像头向上调整，对准自己。和上次见面不同，莎德脱掉了厚重的蓝色防尘大衣，只套着一件深棕褐色毛衣，宽松地贴着丰满曲线；爬行类尾巴则裹在羊毛尾套中，既把淫靡的性器藏在视线之外，也保护翡翠色鳞片不受寒冷侵袭。她难得显得符合自己的年龄：与其说是致命的太空女猎手，倒更像性感的学生妈妈。不过她朝你露出的邀请笑容，让这位猫科情人的魅力一刻也没有减弱。

rows.original: “Well, look who it is!” Shade chuckles, reaching up out of the camera’s view to unlock the door. “I was wondering when you were going to show up. Come on in out of the cold -- I was just cranking the oven on.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，看看是谁来了！”莎德轻笑着，把手伸到摄像头画面外解锁房门。“我还在想你什么时候才会出现。快进来躲躲寒风——我刚把烤箱打开。”

Looks like the hovel topside is nothing more than an entrance to an underground domicile. You step inside, scooting aside several pairs of fur-lined and steel-girded boots underneath a rack of heavy winter coats

rows.original: “Down here!” Shade’s voice sing-songs from within, and you’re suddenly aware of a lovely, cinnamon scent wafting up from below. That hurries you up, sure enough: you make your way down the spiraling stairs until you’re sure you’re at least a good ten feet under the icy surface. At the bottom, you’re greeted by colorfully patterned cloth curtains hanging from on high, parting easily to reveal the entrance to Shade’s subterranean abode.
rows.translation: “在下面！”莎德的声音从里面轻快传来，你忽然注意到一股宜人的肉桂香味正从下方飘来。这足以令你加快脚步：你沿着螺旋楼梯向下走，直到确信自己至少已深入冰面下十英尺。抵达底部时，色彩斑斓的花纹布帘从高处垂下；轻易将其分开后，莎德地下住所的入口便呈现在眼前。
