rows.original: The front room is a comfortable sitting room, with a leather couch curving around a glass coffee table and a holoscreen big enough to cover most of the eastern wall. A few datapads are scattered around the table and blankets are piled up on the arms of the couch, just enough to give the room a lived-in feel where it’s otherwise pristine as a showroom. The walls around you are painted a deep, sandy tan, arranged with shimmering holo-pics of distant worlds -- you recognize Rosha, Terra, and Ausaril among them -- with Shade striking cool and confident poses in most. In others, though, she’s alongside a much younger woman. A kaithrit/ausar hybrid, you guess at a glance, with the same silver-white hair as Shade’s, but fiery orange canine ears and a curling, bushy cat’s tail behind her. The further into the room you go, the older the mixed-race woman gets: from about ten years old, you guess, until she’s taller than Shade and even more voluptuous, with generous curves and sleek muscles underneath skin-tight ballistic armor patterned after the snow.
rows.translation: 前厅是一间舒适的起居室，一张皮沙发环绕着玻璃茶几弯曲摆放，还有一面大得足以覆盖东侧大部分墙面的全息屏。几块数据板散落在桌面，毛毯堆在沙发扶手上，恰到好处地令这间原本洁净得像样板间的屋子多了些生活气息。周围墙壁涂成深沙褐色，上面排列着来自遥远世界的闪烁全息照片——你认出了罗莎、泰拉和奥萨里尔——大多数照片里，莎德都摆着又酷又自信的姿势。但另一些照片中，她身边站着一名年轻得多的女子。乍看之下，那大概是凯斯丽特与奥萨的混血儿，有着和莎德一样的银白色头发，却长着火焰般橙红的犬耳，身后还有一条卷曲蓬松的猫尾。你越往房间深处走，照片里的混血女子年龄就越大：从你估计大约十岁，一直到比莎德还高、甚至更加丰满，曲线丰腴，流线型肌肉包裹在仿雪花纹的贴身防弹甲下。

rows.original: “Getting lost in there?” your lover teases, peeking her head around the corner from another room. You grin and turn your attentions toward Shade as she steps out, happily letting yourself be swept up into a hug that transitions into a long kiss, and then a grope of your [pc.butt] when her hands start wandering. When Shade steps back, she leaves her hands on your waist, a smile on her lips and her heavy breasts pressing against your chest, letting you feel the heat of her even through her sweater -- and, you note, that she’s not wearing anything under it...

Her natural, cool confidence is gone, replaced by a weary, sad look. Still, Shade forces a smile when she sees you on the holo."

rows.original: With one last self-steadying breath, you make your way down. The house itself must be a good ten feet underground, you guess, and the stairs dump you out into a small but cozy living room behind a colorful cloth curtain, dominated by a half-circle couch facing a glass table and a holoscreen that dominates the eastern wall. Shade’s sitting on the couch, one arm thrown over the back and her legs folded beneath her. Her dark blue duster is nowhere to be seen, nor her armor and guns -- she’s just wearing a simple tan sweater over her jeans, showing off much less alabaster cleavage than you remember, though her familiar -- and, you remind yourself, familial -- curves are no less apparent.
rows.translation: 你最后深吸一口气，稳住心神，沿楼梯向下走去。你估计房子本身至少位于地下十英尺，楼梯尽头则是一间小巧却舒适的客厅，入口处挂着色彩鲜艳的布帘。一张半圆形沙发朝向玻璃桌，东侧墙壁几乎被一块全息屏幕占满。暗影坐在沙发上，一条手臂搭在靠背上，双腿蜷在身下。她那件深蓝色长外套不见踪影，盔甲和枪械也没有带在身上，只在牛仔裤外套着一件简单的棕褐色毛衣，露出的雪白乳沟比你记忆中少了许多，不过那熟悉的曲线仍旧清晰可见，而你提醒自己，那也是亲人的曲线。

Shade’s sitting on the couch, one arm thrown over the back and her legs folded beneath her. Her dark blue duster is nowhere to be seen, nor her armor and guns -- she’s just wearing a simple tan sweater over her jeans, showing off much less alabaster cleavage than you remember, though her familiar -- and, you remind yourself, familial -- curves are no less apparent."

rows.original: Somehow, even knowing what you do now, you can’t deny the lingering attraction. She’s as beautiful as ever.
rows.translation: 不知为何，即使已经知道真相，你仍无法否认心中残留的吸引力。她依旧美丽如初。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow, even knowing what you do now, you can’t deny the lingering attraction. She’s as beautiful as ever."

rows.original: “Welcome to Uveto,” she says, with just a hint of a smile. “Come on in. Have a seat.”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到乌维托，”她带着一丝微笑说道，“进来吧，坐下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to Uveto,” she says, with just a hint of a smile. “Come on in. Have a seat.”"

rows.original: She pats the couch beside herself, beckoning you in. You do as she says, sinking into the leather at her side. A moment passes, with Shade eying you with sidelong glances, before she sighs and rests a hand on her temple.
rows.translation: 她拍了拍身旁的沙发，示意你过去。你照她说的做，在她身边坐进皮沙发。片刻过去，暗影不断从眼角偷偷打量你，随后叹了口气，将一只手按在太阳穴上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pats the couch beside herself, beckoning you in. You do as she says, sinking into the leather at her side. A moment passes, with Shade eying you with sidelong glances, before she sighs and rests a hand on her temple."

rows.original: “So... um... haha,” she starts, biting her lip to stifle an awkward little laugh. “Damn it. I had a whole thing I’ve been thinking since I left Myrellion, and now... now I can’t remember a word of it. Ha. Look, I... I don’t even know what to think about anything now. But I know that probe was right. I took a DNA test, looked up a few of Victor Steele’s more illustrious bastards, and... yeah. Somehow, of all the things I ever imagined my father to be, trillionaire playboy magnate wasn’t one of them. Honestly, the way mom never talked about him, I was sure he’d have been a whore or a -- well, something darker. Never thought well of him, whoever he was. But now that I know, all I can think about is you.”
rows.translation: “所以...呃...哈哈，”她开口说道，咬住嘴唇，压下一声尴尬的轻笑。“该死。我离开米瑞利昂后一直在脑子里准备着一大段话，可现在...现在一个字都想不起来了。哈。听着，我...我甚至不知道该怎么想这一切。但我知道那枚探针说得没错。我做了DNA检测，又查了维克托·斯蒂尔那些比较出名的私生子，然后...没错。在我想象过的所有父亲形象里，身家万亿的花花公子大亨可从来不在其中。老实说，母亲从来不提他，我一直确信他要么是个男妓，要么是，嗯，更阴暗的什么人。不管他是谁，我从没往好处想过。但现在知道真相后，我满脑子想的只有你。”

But now that I know, all I can think about is you.”"

rows.original: “Fair enough,” Shade sighs, reaching over and putting a hand on your shoulder. A friendly gesture, more than a lover’s touch. “I don’t really know how I feel. Can’t expect any different from you. But... for what it’s worth, if you’re not too disgusted with me and my feelings, I’d like to at least keep in touch. Until you’re sure what you want... either as my half-sibling, or... something else.”
rows.translation: “也对，”暗影叹息着，伸手搭上你的肩膀。那更像是朋友间的动作，而非爱人的触碰。“我自己也不太清楚我是什么感受，不能指望你有所不同。但是...不管怎么说，只要你还没有厌恶我和我的感情，我至少希望能继续保持联系。等你确定自己想要什么之前...无论是作为我同父异母的手足，还是...别的什么。”
rows.raw: "“Fair enough,” Shade sighs, reaching over and putting a hand on your shoulder. A friendly gesture, more than a lover’s touch. “I don’t really know how I feel. Can’t expect any different from you. But... for what it’s worth, if you’re not too disgusted with me and my feelings, I’d like to at least keep in touch. Until you’re sure what you want... either as my half-sibling, or... something else.”"

rows.original: “Something else?” you echo.
rows.translation: “别的什么？”你重复道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something else?” you echo."

rows.original: Shade’s cheeks flush a bit, but she answers steadily. “I mean that you and I are lovers. We can’t erase what we’ve done. What we were to each other first and foremost. I know we can’t ignore what we are now, either, but... that doesn’t mean what we had before has to end. Does it?”
rows.translation: 暗影的脸颊微微泛红，但回答得很平稳。“我是说，你和我确实是爱人。我们无法抹去已经做过的一切，无法抹去我们最初、最重要的那层关系。我知道我们也不能忽视如今的血缘，但...这并不意味着过去的一切必须结束。不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade’s cheeks flush a bit, but she answers steadily. “I mean that you and I are lovers. We can’t erase what we’ve done. What we were to each other first and foremost. I know we can’t ignore what we are now, either, but... that doesn’t mean what we had before has to end. Does it?”"

rows.original: You turn, looking Shade flat in the eye. She wants to keep seeing you as a lover, is that it? To revel in your incestuous union.
rows.translation: 你转过身，直视暗影的双眼。她想继续把你当作爱人，是这个意思吗？继续沉溺于你们的乱伦结合。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn, looking Shade flat in the eye. She wants to keep seeing you as a lover, is that it? To revel in your incestuous union."

rows.original: Her blush keeps strong, but she nods nevertheless. “I... I do. I don’t care if we’re siblings or not. It doesn’t change how I feel about you. Or how much I want you. Understand?”
rows.translation: 她脸上的红晕丝毫未退，却仍然点了点头。“我...我确实想。不管我们是不是兄妹，我都不在乎。这不会改变我对你的感情，也不会改变我有多么想要你。明白吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer blush keeps strong, but she nods nevertheless. “I... I do. I don’t care if we’re siblings or not. It doesn’t change how I feel about you. Or how much I want you. Understand?”"

rows.original: You nod. She’s made it plenty clear.

rows.translation: 不知为何，即使已经知道真相，你仍无法否认心中残留的吸引力。她依旧美丽如初。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomehow, even knowing what you do now, you can’t deny the lingering attraction. She’s as beautiful as ever."

rows.original: “Welcome back,” she says, with just a hint of a smile. “Come on in. Have a seat.”
rows.translation: “欢迎回来，”她带着一丝微笑说道，“进来吧，坐下。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back,” she says, with just a hint of a smile. “Come on in. Have a seat.”"

rows.original: She pats the couch beside herself, beckoning you in. You do as she says, sinking into the leather at her side. A moment passes, with Shade eying you with sidelong glances, before she sighs and rests a hand on her temple.
rows.translation: 她拍了拍身旁的沙发，示意你过去。你照她说的做，在她身边坐进皮沙发。片刻过去，暗影不断从眼角偷偷打量你，随后叹了口气，将一只手按在太阳穴上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pats the couch beside herself, beckoning you in. You do as she says, sinking into the leather at her side. A moment passes, with Shade eying you with sidelong glances, before she sighs and rests a hand on her temple."

rows.original: “So... decided what you want to do yet?”
rows.translation: “所以...你决定好该怎么办了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So... decided what you want to do yet?”"

rows.original: Want Shade
rows.translation: 想要谢德

rows.translation: 想要谢德

rows.original: No matter what revelations you two have had about each other, your desire for Shade remains unabated. You want her, now more than ever...
rows.translation: 无论你们对彼此有了怎样的新认识，你对暗影的欲望都丝毫没有减退。你想要她，如今甚至比以往更加渴望...
rows.raw: "No matter what revelations you two have had about each other, your desire for Shade remains unabated. You want her, now more than ever..."

rows.original: Want Sister
rows.translation: 想要姐姐
rows.raw: "Want Sister"

rows.raw: "lover sibling sister"

rows.translation: 想要姐姐

rows.original: If Shade wants your take on things, well... you want your sister more than your lover. Cut this sexual nature of your relationship off, try and put it behind you, and grow a deeper bond as siblings.
rows.translation: 如果暗影想知道你的看法，那么...比起爱人，你更想要一个姐妹。终止你们关系中的性意味，努力把过去抛在身后，以手足的身份建立更深的羁绊。
rows.raw: "If Shade wants your take on things, well... you want your sister more than your lover. Cut this sexual nature of your relationship off, try and put it behind you, and grow a deeper bond as siblings."

rows.raw: "No, you and Shade need to keep your distance after what you’ve done. For both your sakes."

rows.original: Shade nods when you make your desire clear, tightening her squeeze on your shoulder. “Alright. I understand. Listen, I’ll be at the bar or here at home most days for a while. Taking some time off for myself. If you want to talk...”
rows.translation: 暗影看到你表明意愿后点点头，搭在你肩上的手握得更紧了。“好吧，我明白。听着，接下来一段时间，大多数日子里我都会待在酒吧或家里。我要给自己放个假。如果你想谈谈...”
rows.raw: "Shade nods when you make your desire clear, tightening her squeeze on your shoulder. “Alright. I understand. Listen, I’ll be at the bar or here at home most days for a while. Taking some time off for myself. If you want to talk...”"

rows.translation: 你会来找她的。

rows.translation: “好吧，”暗影低声说道，站起身来。“希望很快能收到你的消息，[pc.name]。我...只是，照顾好自己。好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright,” Shade murmurs, standing. “I hope I hear from you soon, [pc.name]. I... just, take care. Alright?”"

rows.original: You nod and follow her up, turning to the stairs out. You’ve got a lot to think about...
rows.translation: 你点点头，跟着她上楼，转向离开的楼梯。你还有很多事情需要考虑...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and follow her up, turning to the stairs out. You’ve got a lot to think about..."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "lover sibling distance"

rows.original: “Ah,” Shade sighs, leaning back into the couch. “I... no, you’re right. I don’t want to push you, kiddo, you deserve better than that. If staying apart is what you need, then I’ll respect that. Even if it hurts.”
rows.translation: “啊，”暗影叹了口气，靠回沙发。“我...不，你说得对。我不想逼你，孩子，你值得更好的。如果分开是你需要的，那我会尊重。哪怕这会让我难受。”
rows.raw: "“Ah,” Shade sighs, leaning back into the couch. “I... no, you’re right. I don’t want to push you, kiddo, you deserve better than that. If staying apart is what you need, then I’ll respect that. Even if it hurts.”"

rows.original: You wanted to tell Shade how you felt. You do so, explaining your reasons for staying apart as best you can. She listens, though you’re not sure you’re making more impact than a proselytizer on the extranet. When you’ve finished, she’s quiet for a long moment.
rows.translation: 你想告诉暗影自己的感受。于是你尽力解释了保持距离的理由。她静静听着，尽管你不确定自己造成的影响是否比外网上传教的人更大。等你说完后，她沉默了很长一会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wanted to tell Shade how you felt. You do so, explaining your reasons for staying apart as best you can. She listens, though you’re not sure you’re making more impact than a proselytizer on the extranet. When you’ve finished, she’s quiet for a long moment."

rows.original: She rests her head back on the seat, running a hand through her silver hair. “For what it’s worth, just know you’ve got a sister out here who loves you. Who’s here for you, if you need it.”
rows.translation: 她把头靠回座椅，手指穿过银色长发。“不管怎样，你只要知道，你在这里有一个爱你的姐妹。只要你需要，我就会在。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe rests her head back on the seat, running a hand through her silver hair. “For what it’s worth, just know you’ve got a sister out here who loves you. Who’s here for you, if you need it.”"

rows.original: That’s something, you guess, though it doesn’t change the way you feel.
rows.translation: 你想，这至少算点什么，尽管它并没有改变你的感受。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s something, you guess, though it doesn’t change the way you feel."

rows.original: “I didn’t expect it to,” she says quietly. “It’s just the truth. If you change your mind, or just want to talk... well, you know where to find me.”
rows.translation: “我也没指望它能改变，”她轻声说道。“这只是事实。如果你改变主意，或者只是想聊聊...嗯，你知道在哪里能找到我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t expect it to,” she says quietly. “It’s just the truth. If you change your mind, or just want to talk... well, you know where to find me.”"

rows.original: You nod and stand, stepping away from your lover-turned-sister. She sighs, but doesn’t pursue with so much as a glance as you take your leave.
rows.translation: 你点点头，站起身，离开这位从爱人变成姐妹的女人。她叹了口气，却连一眼都没有追随，只任由你离去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod and stand, stepping away from your lover-turned-sister. She sighs, but doesn’t pursue with so much as a glance as you take your leave."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: lover sibling sister
rows.raw: "lover sibling sister"

rows.original: “So that’s it?” Shade says, half-shielding a smile from you. “Just wanna ignore what we were... what we’ve done?”
rows.translation: “所以就这样？”暗影说道，用手半遮着对你露出的微笑。“只想无视我们过去是什么关系...无视我们做过什么？”
rows.raw: "“So that’s it?” Shade says, half-shielding a smile from you. “Just wanna ignore what we were... what we’ve done?”"

rows.original: You nod. You’ll never be able to get the knowledge of your carnal past out of your mind, but the fact that you’re related takes absolute precedence in your mind. You can’t just ignore that... keep doing what you’ve been doing.
rows.translation: 你点点头。你永远无法把那段肉欲往事从脑海中抹去，但你们有血缘关系的事实在心中占据绝对优先。你不能直接忽略这一点...继续做一直以来的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod. You’ll never be able to get the knowledge of your carnal past out of your mind, but the fact that you’re related takes absolute precedence in your mind. You can’t just ignore that... keep doing what you’ve been doing."

rows.original: Shade sighs but nods her understanding, squeezing your shoulder. “I... I can understand that, I guess. Probably the best we can do, given the circumstances. I just... heh, I still can’t believe this really happened, you know? Just all of a sudden my lover turns out to be....”
rows.translation: 暗影叹息一声，但还是理解地点了点头，握紧你的肩膀。“我...我想自己能理解。考虑到现在的情况，这大概是我们能做出的最好选择。我只是...嘿，我还是不敢相信这真的发生了，你懂吗？我的爱人突然就变成了....”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade sighs but nods her understanding, squeezing your shoulder. “I... I can understand that, I guess. Probably the best we can do, given the circumstances. I just... heh, I still can’t believe this really happened, you know? Just all of a sudden my lover turns out to be....”"

A lot of yelling and crying, probably. But if you want to try and put things behind us, start over like real siblings, I can try. For you, little

rows.original: You smile reassuringly, saying that you’re sure the two of you can make it work. You’ve always known you had lots of siblings out there, but this is the first time you’ve really gotten to know one... even if it might be more intimately than you’d have liked.
rows.translation: 你安慰地笑了笑，说相信你们两个一定能处理好。你一直知道自己在外面有许多兄弟姐妹，但这还是第一次真正了解其中一个...哪怕了解的程度可能比你希望的更加亲密。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile reassuringly, saying that you’re sure the two of you can make it work. You’ve always known you had lots of siblings out there, but this is the first time you’ve really gotten to know one... even if it might be more intimately than you’d have liked. "

rows.original: “You can say that again,” Shade laughs, running a hand through her silvery hair. “Well, maybe not more than I’d have liked.”
rows.translation: “这话你可以再说一遍，”暗影笑着说道，一只手穿过银色长发。“不过，也许并没有比我希望的更加亲密。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can say that again,” Shade laughs, running a hand through her silvery hair. “Well, maybe not more than I’d have liked.”"

rows.original: Cocking an eyebrow at Shade, you have to ask: if you’d said something else -- that you wanted to keep your incestuous relationship going -- would she have wanted that?
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛看着暗影，不得不问：如果你当时说了别的话，表示想继续你们的乱伦关系，她会愿意吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nCocking an eyebrow at Shade, you have to ask: if you’d said something else -- that you wanted to keep your incestuous relationship going -- would she have wanted that?"

rows.original: For once, Shade blushes, quickly turning her eye from you. “I’m not saying that. It’s just that... if I had my way of things, I’d have never found out at all. Call me a lonely old hag if you want, but what we had was... it was good. Wrong, I know, but it never felt that way until I knew better. Not for a moment.”
rows.translation: 暗影难得地红了脸，迅速将视线从你身上移开。“我可没这么说。只是...如果凡事都能由我决定，我宁愿从来没有发现真相。你想叫我孤独的老妖婆也行，但我们曾经拥有的...真的很好。我知道那是错的，可在我知道真相以前，它从来没有让我觉得不对，一刻都没有。”
rows.raw: "\n\nFor once, Shade blushes, quickly turning her eye from you. “I’m not saying that. It’s just that... if I had my way of things, I’d have never found out at all. Call me a lonely old hag if you want, but what we had was... it was good. Wrong, I know, but it never felt that way until I knew better. Not for a moment.”"

rows.original: So she’d rather have never known. Could she have forgive you, if you’d kept the secret?
rows.translation: 所以她宁愿从未知道真相。如果你一直保守秘密，她能原谅你吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she’d rather have never known. Could she have forgive you, if you’d kept the secret?"

rows.translation: “不能，”她笑道。“呃，我也不知道。别误会，无论如何，我都很高兴自己有了一个小

rows.raw: " no matter what. To have you still in my life somehow. Maybe I just wish that probe had told me I was related to some stranger on the street, rather than a lover.”"

rows.translation: 你想，这也很容易理解。

rows.raw: "\n\n“So!” Shade says with a sudden smile, sitting up on the edge of her seat. “Let’s take all of that and put it behind us, huh? Just like you wanted? I’m dying to get to know my little "

rows.translation: 兄弟
rows.raw: "brother"

rows.original: as, well, that. Why don’t I make us some dinner, and we can talk. If you think you’re up to it, I’d love to hear more about my -- our -- father. Give me a little insight into the man who sired me, hm?”
rows.translation: ，嗯，就以那种身份。要不我给咱们做顿晚饭，我们边吃边聊。要是你觉得可以，我很想多听听我——我们——父亲的事。让我稍微了解一下那个生下我的男人，好吗？”
rows.raw: " as, well, that. Why don’t I make us some dinner, and we can talk. If you think you’re up to it, I’d love to hear more about my -- our -- father. Give me a little insight into the man who sired me, hm?”"

rows.original: Now that seems like a good idea...
rows.translation: 现在看来，这确实是个好主意...

rows.original: A good while passes in quiet companionship...
rows.translation: 两人安静相伴了好一阵子...
rows.raw: "A good while passes in quiet companionship..."

rows.original: Shade slips through a side door into the kitchen after a bit, cheerily talking around the corner as she starts to cook. She asks questions, mostly about your parents: what kind of man your father was, who your mother was and how they’d met. When you explain your rather unique origins, the plans that had been set ahead of you since before your very conception, she gives you what sympathetic encouragement she can: “Better to know you’re wanted, at least.”
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，暗影从侧门溜进厨房，一边开始做饭，一边隔着墙角愉快地与你交谈。她问了不少问题，大多与你的父母有关：你的父亲是怎样的人、你的母亲是谁，以及他们如何相识。当你解释自己颇为独特的来历，还有那些早在你受孕之前就为你安排好的计划时，她尽可能同情地鼓励道：“至少知道自己是被期盼着降生的，总归好些。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShade slips through a side door into the kitchen after a bit, cheerily talking around the corner as she starts to cook. She asks questions, mostly about your parents: what kind of man your father was, who your mother was and how they’d met. When you explain your rather unique origins, the plans that had been set ahead of you since before your very conception, she gives you what sympathetic encouragement she can: “Better to know you’re wanted, at least.”"

rows.original: Is it? Sometimes you’re not entirely sure.
rows.translation: 是吗？有时候你并不完全确定。
rows.raw: "\n\nIs it? Sometimes you’re not entirely sure."

rows.original: While you’re talking, sweet smells start wafting out from the kitchen. A sizzling chicken smell, hot bread, and something faintly hinting at cinnamon. Your stomach grumbles all of a sudden, awoken by the delicious scents starting to overtake the subterranean homestead. Somehow, after your first meeting with Shade way back on Myrellion, you’d never have imagined her snuggled up to you and cooking dinner. Never would have guessed Shade had a hidden domestic streak!
rows.translation: 你们交谈时，甜美的香气开始从厨房飘来。有煎鸡肉的滋滋香气、热面包的味道，还有一丝若有若无的肉桂气息。美味的气味逐渐充满地下居所，你的胃突然咕咕作响，仿佛被唤醒了一般。自从很久以前在米瑞利昂第一次遇见暗影后，你怎么也想不到她会依偎在你身边，为你烹制晚餐。更没料到暗影竟然还藏着如此居家的一面！
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile you’re talking, sweet smells start wafting out from the kitchen. A sizzling chicken smell, hot bread, and something faintly hinting at cinnamon. Your stomach grumbles all of a sudden, awoken by the delicious scents starting to overtake the subterranean homestead. Somehow, after your first meeting with Shade way back on Myrellion, you’d never have imagined her snuggled up to you and cooking dinner. Never would have guessed Shade had a hidden domestic streak!"

rows.original: She snickers when you mention it, leaning around the corner to stick her tongue out at you. “It may come as a surprise to you, but I’m quite the homemaker when I’m not out kicking interstellar ass. I can cook this chicken just as easy as I can clean my arc gun blindfolded.”
rows.translation: 你提起这点时，她嗤嗤笑了起来，从墙角探出身子朝你吐舌头。“你可能会觉得意外，但在我不出门痛揍星际混蛋的时候，我可是个很称职的持家好手。我能轻松烹好这只鸡，也能蒙着眼睛清理弧光枪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snickers when you mention it, leaning around the corner to stick her tongue out at you. “It may come as a surprise to you, but I’m quite the homemaker when I’m not out kicking interstellar ass. I can cook this chicken just as easy as I can clean my arc gun blindfolded.”"

rows.original: Shade refuses to let you help in the kitchen, citing something about kaithrit hospitality, so while she’s busy you find yourself wandering around the living room. The walls around you are painted a deep, sandy tan, arranged with shimmering holo-pics of distant worlds -- you recognize Rosha, Terra, and Ausaril among them -- with Shade striking cool and confident poses in most. In others, though, she’s alongside a much younger woman. A kaithrit/ausar hybrid, you guess at a glance, with the same silver-white hair as Shade’s, but fiery orange canine ears and a curling, bushy cat’s tail behind her. The further into the room you go, the older the mixed-race woman gets: from about ten years old, you guess, until she’s taller than Shade and even more voluptuous, with generous curves and sleek muscles underneath skin-tight ballistic armor patterned after the snow.
rows.translation: 暗影以凯斯里特人的待客之道为由，不肯让你进厨房帮忙；于是她忙碌时，你便在客厅里四处打量。周围墙壁被漆成深沉的沙褐色，上面排列着远方世界的闪烁全息照片——你认出了其中的罗莎、泰拉和奥萨瑞尔——大多数照片里，暗影都摆着帅气而自信的姿势。不过另一些照片中，她身旁还有一名年轻得多的女子。乍看之下，你猜她是凯斯里特人与奥萨人的混血儿；她有着和暗影一样的银白头发，却长着火焰般橙红的犬耳，身后还卷着一条蓬松浓密的猫尾。你越往房间深处走，照片里的混血女子年纪就越大：从你估计十岁左右的模样，一直到比暗影还高、身材也更丰腴的少女；她曲线饱满，贴身防弹甲下的肌肉线条流畅，装甲上还饰有雪地迷彩。
rows.raw: "\n\nShade refuses to let you help in the kitchen, citing something about kaithrit hospitality, so while she’s busy you find yourself wandering around the living room. The walls around you are painted a deep, sandy tan, arranged with shimmering holo-pics of distant worlds -- you recognize Rosha, Terra, and Ausaril among them -- with Shade striking cool and confident poses in most. In others, though, she’s alongside a much younger woman. A kaithrit/ausar hybrid, you guess at a glance, with the same silver-white hair as Shade’s, but fiery orange canine ears and a curling, bushy cat’s tail behind her. The further into the room you go, the older the mixed-race woman gets: from about ten years old, you guess, until she’s taller than Shade and even more voluptuous, with generous curves and sleek muscles underneath skin-tight ballistic armor patterned after the snow."

rows.original: Shade’s daughter, you guess?
rows.translation: 你猜，这是暗影的女儿？
rows.raw: "\n\nShade’s daughter, you guess?"

rows.original: “You mean the beautiful red-ears? You got it: that’s my baby girl, Astra. She’s about your age, now that I think about it -- just turned eighteen a couple months ago.”
rows.translation: “你是说那个漂亮的红耳朵姑娘？猜对了：那是我的宝贝女儿阿斯特拉。仔细想想，她跟你差不多大——几个月前刚满十八岁。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You mean the beautiful red-ears? You got it: that’s my baby girl, Astra. She’s about your age, now that I think about it -- just turned eighteen a couple months ago.”"

rows.original: Any chance of you getting to meet your niece some time? The way she’s kitted up, Astra strikes the appearance of an adventurer like yourself. Considering how you and Shade hit it off, you’d probably get along.
rows.translation: 你以后有机会见到自己的外甥女吗？看她那身装备，阿斯特拉似乎也是与你相仿的冒险者。考虑到你和暗影如此投缘，你们大概也会相处得很好。
rows.raw: "\n\nAny chance of you getting to meet your niece some time? The way she’s kitted up, Astra strikes the appearance of an adventurer like yourself. Considering how you and Shade hit it off, you’d probably get along."

rows.original: Silently, you add that you’re glad you found out now, otherwise you might have ended up flirting with her had you ever met.
rows.translation: 你暗自在心里补充：幸好现在就知道了，否则哪天遇上她时，你说不定会跟她调情。
rows.raw: "\n\nSilently, you add that you’re glad you found out now, otherwise you might have ended up flirting with her had you ever met."

rows.original: “Uhh... She’s off in the Cielovia system, right now. Her sire got put in the hospital by some punks, apparently, so she’s off visiting for a bit. Should be home tomorrow, she said. I’ll introduce you, if you’re staying.”
rows.translation: “呃...她现在去了西洛维亚星系。听说她的生母被几个混混打进了医院，所以她过去探望一阵子。她说自己明天就能回家。要是你留下，我就介绍你们认识。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uhh... She’s off in the Cielovia system, right now. Her sire got put in the hospital by some punks, apparently, so she’s off visiting for a bit. Should be home tomorrow, she said. I’ll introduce you, if you’re staying.”"

rows.original: “Well, her pop’s in the hospital after you got done with her. She’s recovering back in the Cielovia system, and Astra’s off visiting. Should be home tomorrow, I think. I’ll introduce you.”
rows.translation: “嗯，她妈妈被你收拾完后住进了医院。她正在西洛维亚星系休养，阿斯特拉也过去探望了。我想她明天就会回家。到时候我介绍你们认识。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, her pop’s in the hospital after you got done with her. She’s recovering back in the Cielovia system, and Astra’s off visiting. Should be home tomorrow, I think. I’ll introduce you.”"

rows.original: You grimace at the sneer Shade gives you when she mentions Amara, but otherwise she doesn’t bring up your... accidental altercation back on Myrellion. You guess your sibling revelation has mollified her distrust of you, for now at least.
rows.translation: 暗影提起阿玛拉时朝你露出一抹讥笑，令你不禁皱起脸；不过除此之外，她并未再提你们在米瑞利昂那场...意外冲突。你猜，发现彼此的手足关系暂时缓和了她对你的不信任。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grimace at the sneer Shade gives you when she mentions Amara, but otherwise she doesn’t bring up your... accidental altercation back on Myrellion. You guess your sibling revelation has mollified her distrust of you, for now at least."

rows.original: “I didn’t want her around for this. Lucky her, my ex was in the neighborhood, so they’re spending the day together. She’ll be home tomorrow, I think -- I’ll introduce you, if you’re staying.”
rows.translation: “这件事我不想让她在场。她运气不错，我前任刚好在附近，所以她们一起过一天。我想她明天就会回家——要是你留下，我就介绍你们认识。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t want her around for this. Lucky her, my ex was in the neighborhood, so they’re spending the day together. She’ll be home tomorrow, I think -- I’ll introduce you, if you’re staying.”"

rows.original: “Are they close?” you ask, settling in on the couch. “Astra and her father, I mean?”
rows.translation: “她们关系亲密吗？”你在沙发上坐稳后问道。“我是说阿斯特拉和她的父亲？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are they close?” you ask, settling in on the couch. “Astra and her father, I mean?”"

rows.original: Shade chuckles. “Her sire --
rows.translation: 暗影轻笑一声。“是她的生母——
rows.raw: "\n\nShade chuckles. “Her sire --"

rows.original: a woman. Or a hermaphrodite, more accurately. Hunky ausar babe; you’d like her.
rows.translation: 一位女性。更准确地说，是双性人。那是个健壮性感的奥萨姑娘；你会喜欢她的。
rows.raw: " a woman. Or a hermaphrodite, more accurately. Hunky ausar babe; you’d like her."

rows.original: Amara’s a woman, remember? I know that gorilla armor of hers isn’t exactly flattering on her figure, but she’s a she. At least above the belt.
rows.translation: 别忘了，阿玛拉是女性。我知道她那身猩猩般的装甲实在衬不出身材，但她确实是女人。至少腰带以上是。
rows.raw: " Amara’s a woman, remember? I know that gorilla armor of hers isn’t exactly flattering on her figure, but she’s a she. At least above the belt."

rows.original: But yeah, they are. Amara’s got a lot of kids, but I think she took to Astra the most of any. Part of why I insist on staying friends with her, even if the... well, I don’t know if I’d have called it romance, but the lust of it... died off years ago. It’s been good for Astra, for sure.”
rows.translation: 不过没错，她们很亲近。阿玛拉有很多孩子，但我觉得她最疼阿斯特拉。这也是我坚持和她保持朋友关系的一部分原因，即使那种...嗯，我也不知道该不该称之为爱情，但其中的欲望早在多年前就...消退了。至少这对阿斯特拉很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBut yeah, they are. Amara’s got a lot of kids, but I think she took to Astra the most of any. Part of why I insist on staying friends with her, even if the... well, I don’t know if I’d have called it romance, but the lust of it... died off years ago. It’s been good for Astra, for sure.”"

rows.original: So Shade and Amara don’t have anything going...?
rows.translation: 所以暗影和阿玛拉之间已经没什么了...?
rows.raw: "\n\nSo Shade and Amara don’t have anything going...?"

rows.original: She laughs from the kitchen, and you’re sure you hear her almost choke on something she was tasting. “Uh... no, we don’t. Not unless we’re drunk and lonely, anyway, but that’s just a night’s fun -- nothing serious anymore.”
rows.translation: 她在厨房里笑了起来，你确信自己听见她差点被正在品尝的东西呛到。“呃...不，我们没有。除非我们喝醉了又很寂寞，不过那也只是玩一晚——现在早就不是什么认真的关系了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs from the kitchen, and you’re sure you hear her almost choke on something she was tasting. “Uh... no, we don’t. Not unless we’re drunk and lonely, anyway, but that’s just a night’s fun -- nothing serious anymore.”"

rows.original: “I’d say something about you being the jealous type, but... I guess it doesn’t matter anymore, does it?” Shade murmurs from the other room. “Agh. Sorry, that was... I don’t want to start that. Yeah, Amara and I are pretty much done. I guess for the moment, that makes me single again. Gonna have to start e-dating again if this keeps up.”
rows.translation: “我本来想说你很爱吃醋，但...我想现在已经无所谓了，对吧？”暗影在另一个房间里低声说道。“唉。抱歉，刚才那话...我不想挑起这种事。总之，阿玛拉和我基本结束了。至少眼下，我又算是单身。再这样下去，我恐怕得重新开始网上约会了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d say something about you being the jealous type, but... I guess it doesn’t matter anymore, does it?” Shade murmurs from the other room. “Agh. Sorry, that was... I don’t want to start that. Yeah, Amara and I are pretty much done. I guess for the moment, that makes me single again. Gonna have to start e-dating again if this keeps up.”"

rows.original: You let the comment pass, fairly sure Shade’s not trying to be nasty... though she’s not making this easy, either. The way she keeps talking, though, you’re not convinced she’s happy with your choice. Could she really have wanted to keep on as lovers, or is this just her way of coping? Guess you’ll have to see.
rows.translation: 你没有接这句话，因为你相当确定暗影不是故意刻薄...不过她也没让这件事变得更容易。从她不断说话的方式来看，你并不相信她真的满意你的选择。她真想继续与你维持恋人关系，还是这只是她应对现实的方式？看来你只能拭目以待。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let the comment pass, fairly sure Shade’s not trying to be nasty... though she’s not making this easy, either. The way she keeps talking, though, you’re not convinced she’s happy with your choice. Could she really have wanted to keep on as lovers, or is this just her way of coping? Guess you’ll have to see."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: sibling sister finish
rows.raw: "sibling sister finish"

rows.original: sibling sister finish
rows.raw: "sibling sister finish"

rows.original: Shade keeps cooking, and you keep getting hungrier. The conversation turns pleasant again soon enough, at least, and you find yourself laughing as Shade regales you with some of her own adventures: capturing a famous pirate who’d accidentally given herself the New Texan Treatment, or finding herself face to face with a drunken planetary governor who insisted on being her sidekick on a deadly jetbike chase.
rows.translation: 暗影继续烹饪，你也越来越饿。至少谈话很快又变得愉快起来；暗影兴致勃勃地讲述起自己的冒险，让你不时开怀大笑：她曾抓住一名不慎让自己接受了新德州改造的著名海盗，也曾与一名醉醺醺的行星总督面对面；后者坚持要在一场致命的喷气摩托追逐战中充当她的搭档。
rows.raw: "Shade keeps cooking, and you keep getting hungrier. The conversation turns pleasant again soon enough, at least, and you find yourself laughing as Shade regales you with some of her own adventures: capturing a famous pirate who’d accidentally given herself the New Texan Treatment, or finding herself face to face with a drunken planetary governor who insisted on being her sidekick on a deadly jetbike chase."

rows.original: Still, you find yourself putting a hand on your [pc.belly], feeling it rumble under your touch. While you’re trying to ignore the growling Shade’s preparations are drawing up from your gut, your attention is caught by a mechanical grinding coming from the other of the two doors leading out.
rows.translation: 尽管如此，你还是不由得把手放在[pc.belly]上，感觉它在掌下咕咕作响。你正试图忽略暗影的准备工作从腹中引出的阵阵饥鸣，另一扇通向外面的门后却传来机械摩擦声，吸引了你的注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, you find yourself putting a hand on your [pc.belly], feeling it rumble under your touch. While you’re trying to ignore the growling Shade’s preparations are drawing up from your gut, your attention is caught by a mechanical grinding coming from the other of the two doors leading out."

rows.original: You glance over in time to see a tall, sleek canine-shaped drone clicking out from the other room, drawn your way by the smell of food or the commotion of its mistress’s laughing. The doggy-bot is colored pitched black and deep gold on its underbelly, made to look like a Doberman with razor-sharp teeth tucked in its maw. Despite the feral look of it, the drone makes a yawning emote and pads over to you, nuzzling its snout against your [pc.leg].
rows.translation: 你转头看去，正好看见一只高大而流线型、形似犬类的无人机从另一个房间咔嗒走出；不知是食物的香气，还是女主人开怀大笑的动静将它吸引了过来。这只机器狗通体漆黑，腹部呈深金色，外形仿照杜宾犬，血盆大口中藏着剃刀般锋利的牙齿。尽管外表凶猛，它却显示出一个打哈欠的表情，踱到你身边，用鼻吻蹭了蹭你的[pc.leg]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance over in time to see a tall, sleek canine-shaped drone clicking out from the other room, drawn your way by the smell of food or the commotion of its mistress’s laughing. The doggy-bot is colored pitched black and deep gold on its underbelly, made to look like a Doberman with razor-sharp teeth tucked in its maw. Despite the feral look of it, the drone makes a yawning emote and pads over to you, nuzzling its snout against your [pc.leg]."

rows.original: “Greetings, [pc.master],” the drone says in a deeply mechanical voice.
rows.translation: “向您问好，[pc.master]。”无人机用低沉的机械嗓音说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Greetings, [pc.master],” the drone says in a deeply mechanical voice."

rows.original: Tam-wolf perks up at the other Fenris drone’s approach, loping over to sniff at its sister-bot. The two drones poke at each other with their noses for a moment before, seemingly satisfied, they both plant their butts on the ground and wag their tails at you.
rows.translation: 另一台芬里斯无人机靠近时，塔姆狼顿时精神一振，慢跑过去嗅闻自己的姐妹机。两台无人机用鼻子互相戳了片刻，似乎终于满意了，随后双双把屁股坐到地上，朝你摇起尾巴。
rows.raw: "\n\nTam-wolf perks up at the other Fenris drone’s approach, loping over to sniff at its sister-bot. The two drones poke at each other with their noses for a moment before, seemingly satisfied, they both plant their butts on the ground and wag their tails at you."

rows.original: You reach down and pat Shade’s drone on the head, earning a happy, mechanical pant from it. While you’re distracted by the robo-dog, Shade finishes cooking with a resounding POP! of a wine-bottle uncorking. The Fenris drone hops away, startled, and you turn on your seat to see your sister sauntering in with a pair of bubbling wine glasses.
rows.translation: 你弯腰拍了拍暗影无人机的脑袋，换来一阵愉快的机械喘息。就在你被机器狗吸引注意时，暗影也做好了饭；酒瓶木塞伴着响亮的砰！声弹开。芬里斯无人机受惊地跳到一旁，你则在座位上转过身，看见姐姐端着两杯冒泡的葡萄酒悠然走来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reach down and pat Shade’s drone on the head, earning a happy, mechanical pant from it. While you’re distracted by the robo-dog, Shade finishes cooking with a resounding POP! of a wine-bottle uncorking. The Fenris drone hops away, startled, and you turn on your seat to see your sister sauntering in with a pair of bubbling wine glasses."

rows.original: “Thirsty?” she offers, sauntering over with a wiggle of her sock-wrapped tail. “Been saving this bottle since a job on the wine-world itself.”
rows.translation: “渴了吗？”她一边问，一边摇着裹在袜套里的尾巴款款走来。“自从在葡萄酒世界完成一份委托后，我就一直留着这瓶酒。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thirsty?” she offers, sauntering over with a wiggle of her sock-wrapped tail. “Been saving this bottle since a job on the wine-world itself.”"

rows.original: You have no idea what that is, but you can assume it means good liquor! Shade passes you one of the glasses with a promise of plenty more to come - if you’ll clear a spot for her to lay out the food. “Almost done,” she promises.
rows.translation: 你完全不知道那是什么地方，但可以想见这意味着酒一定很棒！暗影把其中一只酒杯递给你，并保证后面还有很多——前提是你得给她腾出摆饭菜的地方。“马上就好。”她保证道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have no idea what that is, but you can assume it means good liquor! Shade passes you one of the glasses with a promise of plenty more to come - if you’ll clear a spot for her to lay out the food. “Almost done,” she promises."

rows.original: You quickly stack up the datapads, grinning when a few of them activate to reveal pages from Gunslinger Monthly, Sensual Interrogation, and Heavy Weight Ballistics -- the latter two showing off more cleavage than firepower, though neither are in short supply on Shade’s reading list it looks like!
rows.translation: 你迅速把数据板叠起来；其中几块启动时，你忍不住咧嘴一笑，上面分别显示着《枪手月刊》、《感官审讯》和《重型弹道学》的页面——后两本露出的乳沟比展示的火力还多，不过看起来暗影的阅读清单里两样都不缺！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly stack up the datapads, grinning when a few of them activate to reveal pages from Gunslinger Monthly, Sensual Interrogation, and Heavy Weight Ballistics -- the latter two showing off more cleavage than firepower, though neither are in short supply on Shade’s reading list it looks like!"

rows.original: You manage to stifle a chuckle and clear them off to the side, just in time for Shade to return with what looks like a steaming wok gripped between a pair of mittens. Two pairs of chopsticks are sticking out of the top, propped up between what turns out to be a piping plate of sauce-slathered noodles mixed with chicken and plenty of herbal garnish.
rows.translation: 你强忍住笑声，把它们清到一旁；暗影恰好在这时回来，双手戴着隔热手套，捧着一只看似热气腾腾的炒锅。两双筷子从锅顶伸出，斜搭在一盘滚烫的面条之间；面条裹满酱汁，混着鸡肉和大量香草点缀。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou manage to stifle a chuckle and clear them off to the side, just in time for Shade to return with what looks like a steaming wok gripped between a pair of mittens. Two pairs of chopsticks are sticking out of the top, propped up between what turns out to be a piping plate of sauce-slathered noodles mixed with chicken and plenty of herbal garnish."

rows.original: Shade sets the dish out in front of you with a flourish, followed by a plate of steaming bread, cheeses, and salad, then swings herself into a seat across from you and curls her legs up underneath her. The Fenris drone plops its head right in her lap, sniffing at her hands until she shoos it off.
rows.translation: 暗影潇洒地把菜肴摆在你面前，接着又放下一盘热腾腾的面包、奶酪和沙拉，然后甩身坐到你对面，把双腿蜷到身下。芬里斯无人机扑通一声把脑袋搁在她腿上，不断嗅她的双手，直到她将它赶开。
rows.raw: "\n\nShade sets the dish out in front of you with a flourish, followed by a plate of steaming bread, cheeses, and salad, then swings herself into a seat across from you and curls her legs up underneath her. The Fenris drone plops its head right in her lap, sniffing at her hands until she shoos it off."

rows.original: “My signature dish,” she explains with a smile. “A kaithrit favorite. Hope you like it.”
rows.translation: “我的招牌菜。”她微笑着解释。“凯斯里特人的最爱。希望你喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My signature dish,” she explains with a smile. “A kaithrit favorite. Hope you like it.”"

rows.original: Your stomach’s grumbling so much that you don’t have much reservation about grabbing a pair of sticks and digging in. Shade’s eyes linger on you a moment, watching your reaction until she too turns her attention to the feast.
rows.translation: 你的肚子叫得如此厉害，根本没怎么犹豫便抓起一双筷子大快朵颐。暗影的目光在你身上停留了一会儿，观察你的反应，直到她也把注意力转向这顿盛宴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour stomach’s grumbling so much that you don’t have much reservation about grabbing a pair of sticks and digging in. Shade’s eyes linger on you a moment, watching your reaction until she too turns her attention to the feast."

rows.original: Turns out she wasn’t kidding about cooking as well as she slings a gun: the food’s damn good, but the company’s better. Shade’s happy to make small talk while you eat, letting you talk again this time: before long, your belly is full and your dinner companion has sprawled back out on the couch, sipping at her wineglass while you tell of the first probe you found, and your climactic meeting with [rival.name] and Dane.
rows.translation: 看来她说自己的厨艺和枪法一样好并非玩笑：饭菜好吃得要命，但有人相伴更为美妙。吃饭时暗影很乐意与你闲聊，这次则让你多说一些。不久，你已经填饱肚子，与你共进晚餐的人也舒展身体躺回沙发；她一边啜饮葡萄酒，一边听你讲述找到第一枚探针，以及最终与[rival.name]和戴恩相遇的经过。
rows.raw: "\n\nTurns out she wasn’t kidding about cooking as well as she slings a gun: the food’s damn good, but the company’s better. Soon it pops free and you stare at the thing that’s come out of you. You’ve given birth to a large, blue egg. Holding your ear against the surface, a tiny heartbeat, is audible. You cradle the egg in your arms, caressing it, whispering soothing words of comfort even if you are unsure if your newborn can hear them. The arrival of the nursery drone breaks you out of your stupor. You secure your egg inside with the utmost of care and kiss your child goodbye before sealing the drone. You watch it go with a heavy heart. It’s time to continue your adventure.

rows.translation: ，以便仔细观察下面的东西。它似乎并非完全由金属制成，而是某种更柔韧的材料，上面布满电路和导线。好奇心被勾起后，你伸手探向那团奇怪的电子装置。
rows.raw: " to get a better look at whatever it is that’s under there. It seems as though it’s not entirely metal, but some sort of more pliable material covered in circuitry and wiring. With your curiosity piqued you extend a hand to reach for the strange mess of electronics."

rows.original: Straightening yourself again, you bring the device a bit closer to your face in order to get a better look: It’s a collar, no doubt, made of leather, all black and shiny. It’s covered in complex circuitry,
rows.translation: 你重新直起身，把装置拿近脸庞仔细端详：毫无疑问，这是一个项圈，由皮革制成，通体乌黑，泛着亮泽。上面布满复杂的电路，
rows.raw: "\n\nStraightening yourself again, you bring the device a bit closer to your face in order to get a better look: It’s a collar, no doubt, made of leather, all black and shiny. It’s covered in complex circuitry, "

rows.original: all leading to what appears to be acoustical equipment,
rows.translation: 所有线路都通向看似声学设备的部件，
rows.raw: "all leading to what appears to be acoustical equipment, "

rows.original: and where you’d expect a normal buckle to be is an electro-magnetic seal. On one of the larger pieces of wiring, you’re able to make out the words “Sub-Tuner” stamped into the metal.
rows.translation: 而本该装着普通扣环的位置则是一道电磁锁。在其中一块较大的线路组件上，你看清了压印在金属上的“从属调谐器”字样。
rows.raw: "and where you’d expect a normal buckle to be is an electro-magnetic seal. On one of the larger pieces of wiring, you’re able to make out the words “Sub-Tuner” stamped into the metal."

rows.original: Weird.
rows.translation: 真奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nWeird."

rows.original: If you were the adventurous sort you could probably try this thing on, and if you’re not: you could always just put the collar back where it was, safe and sound.
rows.translation: 如果你富有冒险精神，大可以试着戴上这东西；如果不是，也可以把项圈安安全全地放回原处。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf you were the adventurous sort you could probably try this thing on, and if you’re not: you could always just put the collar back where it was, safe and sound."

rows.original: Put It On
rows.translation: 戴上
rows.raw: "Put It On"

rows.original: Put It On
rows.translation: 戴上
rows.raw: "Put It On"

rows.original: Try this thing on. Obviously something could go very, VERY wrong.
rows.translation: 试着戴上这东西。显然，事情可能会变得非常、非常糟糕。
rows.raw: "Try this thing on. Obviously something could go very, VERY wrong."

rows.original: Leave It
rows.translation: 别管它
rows.raw: "Leave It"

rows.original: Leave It
rows.translation: 别管它
rows.raw: "Leave It"

rows.original: Put the collar back where you found it.
rows.translation: 把项圈放回你发现它的地方。
rows.raw: "Put the collar back where you found it."

rows.original: SUBTUNER
rows.raw: "SUBTUNER"

rows.original: Subtuner
rows.translation: 从属调谐项圈
rows.raw: "Subtuner"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: Abandoning whatever caution you may have had before, you bring the collar to your neck, slowly wrapping it around your nape until the two ends of its buckle are right next to each other. Well, you’ve come this far already, no turning back now. You let the two electro-magnets snap closed together with a metallic ca-thunk, and as soon as the buckle is well and shut, a small red light turns on. Shortly after the crimson beacon starts blinking in the corner of your eye, the collar starts to emit a soft metallic hum. You feel your thoughts growing hazy as that gentle noise floods your mind.
rows.translation: 你抛开先前可能残存的一切谨慎，把项圈举到颈边，慢慢绕过后颈，直到扣环两端彼此相邻。好吧，都已经走到这一步了，现在可不能回头。你任由两块电磁铁啪地吸合，发出金属般的咔嗒声。扣环牢牢闭合的瞬间，一盏红色小灯亮了起来。那点猩红的光芒开始在你眼角闪烁后不久，项圈便发出轻柔的金属嗡鸣。随着那柔和的声响淹没思绪，你感觉意识逐渐变得朦胧。
rows.raw: "Abandoning whatever caution you may have had before, you bring the collar to your neck, slowly wrapping it around your nape until the two ends of its buckle are right next to each other. Well, you’ve come this far already, no turning back now. You let the two electro-magnets snap closed together with a metallic ca-thunk, and as soon as the buckle is well and shut, a small red light turns on. Shortly after the crimson beacon starts blinking in the corner of your eye, the collar starts to emit a soft metallic hum. You feel your thoughts growing hazy as that gentle noise floods your mind."

rows.original: It’s as if your own body is becoming heavier under the weight of the sound, almost to the point where you consider sitting down before a static-filled voice coming from the collar breaks your focus.
rows.translation: 那声音的重量仿佛让你的身体也变得越来越沉，几乎令你想要坐下；就在这时，项圈里一道夹杂静电杂音的声音打断了你的思绪。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s as if your own body is becoming heavier under the weight of the sound, almost to the point where you consider sitting down before a static-filled voice coming from the collar breaks your focus."

rows.original: “Well, well,” is the first thing you hear; the voice is poised, and most definitely feminine, “Looks like someone other than me finally found my collar.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，哎呀，”这是你最先听见的话；那声音沉着自若，而且无疑属于女性，“看来终于有我以外的人找到我的项圈了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, well,” is the first thing you hear; the voice is poised, and most definitely feminine, “Looks like someone other than me finally found my collar.”"

rows.original: You try to respond but nothing comes out. All you feel is that static hum compelling you to stand there and wait for that voice again.
rows.translation: 你试图回应，却发不出任何声音。你只能感受到那阵静电嗡鸣，驱使你站在原地，等待那个声音再次响起。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to respond but nothing comes out. All you feel is that static hum compelling you to stand there and wait for that voice again."

rows.original: “Just be a dear and stay there for a moment,” the voice calls out from the collar again, “I’ll be there soon to get my property back.”
rows.translation: “乖乖待在那里一会儿，”那个声音再次从项圈中传来，“我很快就会过去取回我的财产。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just be a dear and stay there for a moment,” the voice calls out from the collar again, “I’ll be there soon to get my property back.”"

rows.original: That... that sounds exactly like what you want to do. Once again that steady humming makes your body feel heavy and you think you should take a seat some- no, no... that won’t do; you need to lower yourself, and wait for whoever’s voice that was to come get you.
rows.translation: 那...那听起来正是你想做的事。稳定的嗡鸣再次令身体变得沉重，你觉得自己应该找个地方坐下——不，不...那可不行；你得俯下身子，等待声音的主人前来接你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat... that sounds exactly like what you want to do. Once again that steady humming makes your body feel heavy and you think you should take a seat some- no, no... that won’t do; you need to lower yourself, and wait for whoever’s voice that was to come get you."

rows.original: You quickly fall to the ground on all fours; yeah, that feels good.
rows.translation: 你迅速四肢着地趴到地上；对，这感觉真好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou quickly fall to the ground on all fours; yeah, that feels good."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SUBTUNER
rows.raw: "SUBTUNER"

rows.original: Subtuner
rows.translation: 从属调谐项圈
rows.raw: "Subtuner"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: Knowing full well that this thing is not your average collar, you carefully place the ring of leather and wires back where you found it, right under the chair.
rows.translation: 你很清楚这东西绝非普通项圈，于是小心翼翼地把这圈皮革与导线放回发现它的位置，就在椅子下方。
rows.raw: "Knowing full well that this thing is not your average collar, you carefully place the ring of leather and wires back where you found it, right under the chair."

rows.original: Maybe someone meant to leave it there?
rows.translation: 也许有人是故意把它留在那里的？
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe someone meant to leave it there?"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: You wait there for a while, not feeling any need to move from where you are. Resting here on your hands and knees feels perfect. A few passersby give you strange looks, but you can’t really bring yourself to care; all you can really do is wait here on all fours, feeling happy more than anything else.
rows.translation: 你在那里等了一阵子，丝毫不觉得有必要挪动。这样以双手和膝盖撑地休息简直再舒服不过。几名路人向你投来古怪的目光，但你实在无法在意；你所能做的只有四肢着地等在这里，心中充满喜悦。
rows.raw: "You wait there for a while, not feeling any need to move from where you are. Resting here on your hands and knees feels perfect. A few passersby give you strange looks, but you can’t really bring yourself to care; all you can really do is wait here on all fours, feeling happy more than anything else."

rows.original: Only a little more time passes before you hear the same voice you heard from the collar, though this time it’s free of the static from earlier.
rows.translation: 又过了一小会儿，你听见了先前从项圈中传来的同一个声音，只是这次已没有先前的静电杂音。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnly a little more time passes before you hear the same voice you heard from the collar, though this time it’s free of the static from earlier."

rows.original: “Ah, there you are,” the voice says, causing you to turn your gaze towards what looks to be a human woman. She’s got a very wide set of hips that only draw attention to an even more impressive derriere... along with the enormous bulge opposite that. You move your gaze up past her slim waist and comparatively large breasts, double-Ds at the least, to a jaw-droppingly feminine face: pouty lips and green eyes. Her long, black hair is being kept in a ponytail, keeping it away from her fair skin and the lab coat she’s wearing. All you can feel looking at her is an overwhelming want, your whole body eagerly awaiting whatever it is she has to say.
rows.translation: “啊，你在这里，”那个声音说道，令你将目光转向一名看似人类的女人。她的胯部非常宽阔，反而更衬得臀部格外丰满...以及与之相对的那处巨大隆起。你的视线越过她纤细的腰肢和相对硕大的双乳——至少有双D罩杯——一路移向那张美得令人屏息的女性面庞：丰润的嘴唇与碧绿的双眼。她将黑色长发束成马尾，远离白皙的肌肤和身上的实验服。看着她时，你只感到一股压倒性的渴望，全身都在急切等待她接下来要说的话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, there you are,” the voice says, causing you to turn your gaze towards what looks to be a human woman. She’s got a very wide set of hips that only draw attention to an even more impressive derriere... along with the enormous bulge opposite that. You move your gaze up past her slim waist and comparatively large breasts, double-Ds at the least, to a jaw-droppingly feminine face: pouty lips and green eyes. Her long, black hair is being kept in a ponytail, keeping it away from her fair skin and the lab coat she’s wearing. All you can feel looking at her is an overwhelming want, your whole body eagerly awaiting whatever it is she has to say."

rows.original: “Mmmm,” she coos, letting her eyes run up and down your form, “What do we have here?”
rows.translation: “嗯哼，”她娇声哼道，目光上下打量着你的身体，“看看我们这里有什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmmm,” she coos, letting her eyes run up and down your form, “What do we have here?”"

rows.original: You try to speak, but nothing’s coming out of your mouth, your [pc.lipsChaste] refusing to move. No, silence will do for now.
rows.translation: 你试图开口，却发不出任何声音，你的[pc.lipsChaste]拒绝动弹。不，现在保持沉默就好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to speak, but nothing’s coming out of your mouth, your [pc.lipsChaste] refusing to move. No, silence will do for now."

rows.original: The woman suddenly reaches a hand down toward your head followed by a sense of growing eagerness on your part. You close your eyes in anticipation, awaiting her touch, no longer worrying about that pesky collar
rows.translation: 女人突然朝你的头顶伸下一只手，你心中的期待也随之愈发强烈。你满怀期待地闭上双眼，等待她的触碰，再也不去担心那只讨厌的项圈
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman suddenly reaches a hand down toward your head followed by a sense of growing eagerness on your part. You close your eyes in anticipation, awaiting her touch, no longer worrying about that pesky collar"

rows.original: ; your [pc.tail] even start
rows.translation: ；你的[pc.tail]甚至开始
rows.raw: "; your [pc.tail] even start"

rows.original: s
to wag without you noticing
rows.translation: 在你毫无察觉的情况下摇摆
rows.raw: " to wag without you noticing"

rows.original: Then your [pc.ears] are greeted by the gentle clink of metal on metal.
rows.translation: 随后，你的[pc.ears]听见金属相碰时轻柔的叮声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen your [pc.ears] are greeted by the gentle clink of metal on metal."

rows.original: You open your eyes to reveal your mystery woman straightening herself, holding a leash in her hand as you come to the realization that you’ve just been thoroughly collared and tethered; but that’s not really a bad thing is it?
rows.translation: 你睁开眼，发现那名神秘女子正直起身，手中握着一条牵引绳；你这才意识到自己已被彻底套上项圈并拴了起来；不过这也不算坏事，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open your eyes to reveal your mystery woman straightening herself, holding a leash in her hand as you come to the realization that you’ve just been thoroughly collared and tethered; but that’s not really a bad thing is it?"

rows.original: “Unfortunately for you,” the woman says with more than a bit of condescension in her voice, “Before I can take the collar off, I’m going to have to bring you back to my lab and you’re going to have to participate in a few... experiments, but by the looks of things you don’t mind that. Do you?”
rows.translation: “很遗憾，”女人的语气中带着相当明显的轻蔑，“在替你摘下项圈之前，我得先把你带回实验室，让你参加几项...实验。不过看你的样子，你应该并不介意。对吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Unfortunately for you,” the woman says with more than a bit of condescension in her voice, “Before I can take the collar off, I’m going to have to bring you back to my lab and you’re going to have to participate in a few... experiments, but by the looks of things you don’t mind that. Do you?”"

rows.original: No! Of course you don’t mind. You don’t think you could find a way to mind with such a lovely lady holding your leash, and you shake your head to tell her such.
rows.translation: 不！你当然不介意。如此可爱的女士正握着你的牵引绳，你根本想不出自己有什么办法能够介意，于是你摇头向她表明这一点。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo! Of course you don’t mind. You don’t think you could find a way to mind with such a lovely lady holding your leash, and you shake your head to tell her such."

rows.original: The woman smiles before reaching a hand down to give you a pat on the head, causing a wave of ecstasy to shoot down your spine when her hand makes contact, “Good, then come along, pet.”
rows.translation: 女人微微一笑，随后伸手轻拍你的头顶；她的手掌一接触，一阵狂喜便沿着你的脊柱疾驰而下，“很好，那就跟我来吧，宠物。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman smiles before reaching a hand down to give you a pat on the head, causing a wave of ecstasy to shoot down your spine when her hand makes contact, “Good, then come along, pet.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SUBSHIT
rows.raw: "SUBSHIT"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: You are led around by this wonderful woman around the wabeship that is Uveto station, crawling along the floor until you reach what must be the scientist’s lab.
rows.translation: 你被这位美妙的女人牵着，在乌维托空间站这艘韦布舰里四处走，沿着地板爬行，直到抵达想必是那位科学家的实验室。
rows.raw: "You are led around by this wonderful woman around the wabeship that is Uveto station, crawling along the floor until you reach what must be the scientist’s lab."

rows.original: Finally walking inside behind the scientist, your eyes are greeted by a wealth of scientific equipment: blinking lights and computers, and bundles of wires lining the walls of the small lab. Though, beyond that most of the equipment seems to be related to audio: radios and speakers, various instruments lined up next to microphones, even a row of wine glasses and spoons placed carefully near a group of transceivers.
rows.translation: 终于跟着科学家走进室内后，映入你眼帘的是大量科学设备：闪烁的灯光与计算机，以及沿小型实验室墙壁铺设的一束束电线。不过除此之外，大部分设备似乎都与声音有关：收音机和扬声器、排列在麦克风旁的各种乐器，甚至还有一排酒杯和勺子，被小心地放在一组收发器附近。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally walking inside behind the scientist, your eyes are greeted by a wealth of scientific equipment: blinking lights and computers, and bundles of wires lining the walls of the small lab. Though, beyond that most of the equipment seems to be related to audio: radios and speakers, various instruments lined up next to microphones, even a row of wine glasses and spoons placed carefully near a group of transceivers."

rows.original: “Welcome,” the lady-scientist exclaims, extending an arm, “To Accu-Pitch labs, or my lab, if you want to get specific.” She turns around to look down at you, “What you’re wearing there is one of my inventions. I call it the Sub-Tuner. It releases a series of harmonic frequencies that alter brain patterns, making the wearer more submissive and... suggestible, but I’m sure you’ve already noticed that.”
rows.translation: “欢迎，”女科学家伸出一只手臂，高声说道，“欢迎来到精准音调实验室；或者说得具体一点，是我的实验室。”她转过身低头看着你，“你戴着的是我的一项发明。我称它为从属调谐器。它会释放一系列谐波频率来改变脑波，使佩戴者变得更加顺从，并且...更容易受到暗示，不过我相信你已经注意到了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome,” the lady-scientist exclaims, extending an arm, “To Accu-Pitch labs, or my lab, if you want to get specific.” She turns around to look down at you, “What you’re wearing there is one of my inventions. I call it the Sub-Tuner. It releases a series of harmonic frequencies that alter brain patterns, making the wearer more submissive and... suggestible, but I’m sure you’ve already noticed that.”"

rows.original: Well, that does explain a lot, but you can’t work up the drive to question anything that’s going on right now. All you want to do is await more orders, so you content yourself to sitting there on your hands and knees, looking up at the black-haired woman with a smile on your face
rows.translation: 这的确解释了许多事情，但你现在完全提不起劲质疑正在发生的一切。你只想等待更多命令，于是心满意足地四肢着地坐在那里，面带笑容仰望那名黑发女子
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that does explain a lot, but you can’t work up the drive to question anything that’s going on right now. All you want to do is await more orders, so you content yourself to sitting there on your hands and knees, looking up at the black-haired woman with a smile on your face "

rows.original: , [pc.tails] swaying gently
rows.translation: ，[pc.tails]轻轻摇摆着
rows.raw: ", [pc.tails] swaying gently"

rows.original: She grins back down at you before continuing, “The specific collar you’re wearing is one of my latest prototypes, and it has a few new features which you’re going to help me test; isn’t that right?”
rows.translation: 她低头朝你咧嘴一笑，随后继续说道：“你戴着的这款项圈是我最新的原型之一，而且还加入了一些新功能，需要你帮我测试；没错吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grins back down at you before continuing, “The specific collar you’re wearing is one of my latest prototypes, and it has a few new features which you’re going to help me test; isn’t that right?”"

rows.original: Of course! That’s what you’re here for. You turn to gaze up at the lady-scientist, giving her a nod and a big grin.
rows.translation: 当然！你来这里就是为了这个。你转头仰望女科学家，朝她点点头，露出灿烂笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course! That’s what you’re here for. You turn to gaze up at the lady-scientist, giving her a nod and a big grin."

rows.original: “Good,” she begins, “I assure you I will have that collar off you once all my tests are complete, but in the meantime, I suppose we should get started.” The wide-hipped woman takes a few strides closer to you, “I’m Belle, by the way, and you... you’re my little pet, for now.”
rows.translation: “很好，”她开口说道，“我保证，等所有测试结束后就会替你摘掉项圈；不过现在，我们该开始了。”这名胯部宽阔的女人朝你走近几步，“顺便说一句，我叫贝尔，而你...暂时是我的小宠物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good,” she begins, “I assure you I will have that collar off you once all my tests are complete, but in the meantime, I suppose we should get started.” The wide-hipped woman takes a few strides closer to you, “I’m Belle, by the way, and you... you’re my little pet, for now.”"

rows.original: That sounds wonderful.
rows.translation: 听起来太棒了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounds wonderful."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: UVS F9
rows.raw: "UVS F9"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: Belle keeps a tight grip on your leash, tracing a circle around you and stroking her chin. “Hmmm,” she deliberates, “No, these clothes you’re wearing won’t do at all. They’ll obstruct my readings, so I guess we’ll have to get them off won’t we?”
rows.translation: 贝尔紧紧攥住你的牵绳，绕着你走了一圈，同时抚摸下巴。“嗯，”她思索着，“不行，你身上这些衣服完全不合适。它们会妨碍我的读数，所以我想我们得把它们脱掉，对吧？”
rows.raw: "Belle keeps a tight grip on your leash, tracing a circle around you and stroking her chin. “Hmmm,” she deliberates, “No, these clothes you’re wearing won’t do at all. They’ll obstruct my readings, so I guess we’ll have to get them off won’t we?”"

rows.translation: 几乎任何时候，贝尔身边都有萨克相伴；她是这名人类女性忠诚的阿萨尔宠物，金发美丽，随时准备听从主人的命令。
rows.raw: "\n\nNearby Belle at almost anytime is Saec, the human woman’s loyal ausar pet, all blonde and pretty and ready to heed her master’s commands."

rows.original: As you’ve seen before, Saec is a very beautiful bitch, with her womanly visage, curves, and those lovely golden locks flowing around her face, parted briefly by her big, fluffy puppy ears. She’s very well-endowed, even compared to Belle, her big E-cups dwarfing her master’s bust by comparison. With the ausar bent over on all fours almost all the time, it’s very easy to see her big, squishy butt and shapely thighs put on display, all topped with her swishing, fluffy blonde tail, colored the same hue as the fur on her limbs. Though, even on her hands and knees, it’s easy to tell Saec is a very big girl, a foot taller than her master at the least.
rows.translation: 如你先前所见，萨克是条极为美丽的母狗，拥有女性化的面容与曲线，那头可爱的金色长发披散在脸旁，又被一对蓬松的大狗耳分开。即便与贝尔相比，她也十分丰满，那对硕大的E罩杯乳房让主人的胸部相形见绌。萨克几乎一直四肢着地，因此她又大又柔软的屁股和线条优美的大腿一览无余，顶端还有一条来回摆动的蓬松金色尾巴，与四肢上的毛发同色。不过，即使趴伏在地，也很容易看出萨克是个非常高大的姑娘，至少比主人高出一英尺。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’ve seen before, Saec is a very beautiful bitch, with her womanly visage, curves, and those lovely golden locks flowing around her face, parted briefly by her big, fluffy puppy ears. She’s very well-endowed, even compared to Belle, her big E-cups dwarfing her master’s bust by comparison. With the ausar bent over on all fours almost all the time, it’s very easy to see her big, squishy butt and shapely thighs put on display, all topped with her swishing, fluffy blonde tail, colored the same hue as the fur on her limbs. Though, even on her hands and knees, it’s easy to tell Saec is a very big girl, a foot taller than her master at the least."

rows.original: Her skin is tanned and fair, but you can spot a few small scars on her near blemishless flesh, hard to see and very old from the looks of them, definitely from before Belle met the pup.
rows.translation: 她皮肤呈健康的小麦色，光洁的肌肤上仅有几道不显眼的小疤痕；它们看起来年代久远，显然是在贝尔遇见这只小狗之前留下的。

rows.original: “I’m from Terra, if you couldn’t tell, and I was born into a rather wealthy family,” she pauses and smiles, giving a light chuckle before she continues, “I remember when I grew up my parents had archived some old articles exclaiming that the ‘heir to the Baslocvicz fortune’ was born. Most of them were tabloids, really, but it was just an odd experience to see myself get so much recognition just because my parents decided to have a child. I certainly grew up like the daughter of a wealthy couple: parties, dresses, long visits to places I didn’t particularly care about, you name it.”
rows.translation: “我来自泰拉，你应该看得出来。我出生在一个相当富裕的家庭，”她停下来微笑，轻笑一声后继续道，“我记得小时候，父母保存了一些旧报道，宣称‘巴斯洛克维茨家族财富的继承人’诞生了。其实大多是小报，但仅仅因为父母决定要个孩子，我就受到如此多的关注，那种体验实在奇怪。我确实过着富裕人家女儿的生活：参加宴会、穿礼服、长时间造访我根本不感兴趣的地方，应有尽有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m from Terra, if you couldn’t tell, and I was born into a rather wealthy family,” she pauses and smiles, giving a light chuckle before she continues, “I remember when I grew up my parents had archived some old articles exclaiming that the ‘heir to the Baslocvicz fortune’ was born. Most of them were tabloids, really, but it was just an odd experience to see myself get so much recognition just because my parents decided to have a child. I certainly grew up like the daughter of a wealthy couple: parties, dresses, long visits to places I didn’t particularly care about, you name it.”"

rows.original: Belle takes a deep breath and adjust her poster before setting her gaze on you, “Well, I didn’t like the thought of just sitting around being my parents’ daughter all my life, so I did what I always wanted to do and became a scientist. It took quite a while, but, here I am today, my own lab and everything.”
rows.translation: 贝尔深吸一口气，调整坐姿后望向你，“不过，我不喜欢一辈子只做父母的女儿，于是便去做了自己一直想做的事，成为一名科学家。这花了相当长的时间，但如今我就在这里，有了自己的实验室和一切。”

rows.original: The lady scientist is left smiling wide after that, content in her own achievements, but it prompts you to ask her what she actually specialized in, what kind of education she got, and what got her this lab.
rows.translation: 说完，这位女科学家因自己的成就而露出灿烂而满足的笑容；不过，这也促使你询问她究竟专攻什么、受过怎样的教育，又是如何获得这间实验室的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe lady scientist is left smiling wide after that, content in her own achievements, but it prompts you to ask her what she actually specialized in, what kind of education she got, and what got her this lab."

rows.original: “My parents insisted I got the best money could buy,” Belle starts to explain, “and no matter how much I told them that I would pay my own tuition at a much less... prestigious university, mother and father sent me all the way to Luna Polytechnic, on the lunar colonies. While I was there I got my doctorate in acoustical engineering, my degrees xenobiology and neurobiology, specializing in how the brain receives audio feedback, of course, and learned to play piano quite a bit. Accu-Pitch employed me almost immediately after I graduated, no doubt partly due to my parents’ reputation, but I like to think my thesis did most of the work.” The woman gives you a little wink after that, almost like you know something you probably don’t, “And, after a few secured grants and hefty patents, Accu-Pitch gave me my own lab here on Uveto, mostly so I could keep to myself.”
rows.translation: “父母坚持要给我金钱所能买到的最好教育，”贝尔开始解释，“无论我多少次告诉他们，我会自己付学费去一所没那么...声名显赫的大学，父母还是把我送到了月球殖民地的月神理工学院。我在那里取得声学工程博士学位，还获得了异种生物学和神经生物学学位，当然，专攻大脑如何接收声音反馈；此外，我还颇为认真地学过钢琴。毕业后Accu-Pitch几乎立刻雇用了我，部分原因无疑是父母的名望，但我更愿意相信主要是论文的功劳。”她朝你眨眨眼，仿佛你知道某件其实并不知道的事，“后来，在拿到几项有保障的资助和价值不菲的专利后，Accu-Pitch便在乌维托给了我自己的实验室，主要是为了让我能独自工作。”

While I was there I got my doctorate in acoustical engineering, my degrees xenobiology and neurobiology, specializing in how the brain receives audio feedback, of course, and learned to play piano quite a bit. Accu-Pitch employed me almost immediately after I graduated, no doubt partly due to my parents’ reputation, but I like to think my thesis did most of the work.” The woman gives you a little wink after that, almost like you know something you probably don’t, “And, after a few secured grants and hefty patents, Accu-Pitch gave me my own lab here on Uveto, mostly so I could keep to myself.”"

rows.original: ,” Belle explains leaning to the side in her chair, resting her chin on her fingers in a very practiced, poised manner, “The Sub-Tuner is more of a proof of concept, a thesis of sorts on how sound can make a person more... compliant. The real purpose of the technology embedded in that collar is non-lethal weaponry, crowd-control, riot pacification without casualties, that kind of thing. Of course, I made the Sub-Tuner to help me test specific programs and frequencies on individuals rather than full crowds of people this technology would most likely be used on... and I’m very fond of collars.”
rows.translation: ，”贝尔解释道，身子侧靠在椅中，手指托着下巴，姿态熟练而端庄，“服从调谐器更像是一种概念验证，一篇关于声音如何让人变得更加...顺从的论文。项圈里嵌入技术的真正用途，是制造非致命武器、控制人群、在不造成伤亡的情况下平息骚乱，诸如此类。当然，我制作服从调谐器，是为了在个体身上测试特定程序和频率，而不是在这项技术最可能被用于的整群人身上测试...另外，我确实非常喜欢项圈。”

rows.original: Belle smiles and leans forward in her seat, taking up a less elegant post and resting a cheek in her own hand, “It’s amazing, isn’t it, what simple vibrations in the air can do to the brain? Order notes in a song just the right way and you can bring an entire crowd to tears, or applause... that was just the beginning of what got me interested in this particular field of study. I always wondered how far sound alone could push the mind, and now I’m learning. The simplest of tones played at the right frequencies can have a very calming effect on subjects, as I’ve found out with my little prototype that you’re wearing, but I’ve yet to explore the other side of the spectrum, with...”
rows.translation: 贝尔微笑着在座位上前倾，不再维持优雅姿势，而是用一只手托住脸颊，“空气中简单的振动竟能对大脑产生如此影响，真是不可思议，对吧？只要把一首歌里的音符以恰当顺序排列，就能让整群人流泪，或是鼓掌...这只是我对这个研究领域产生兴趣的开端。我一直想知道单凭声音能把心智推动到什么程度，而现在我正在寻找答案。我发现，以正确频率播放最简单的音调，也能对实验对象产生极强的镇静效果；你戴着的小原型机已经证明了这一点。但频谱的另一端我还未探索，也就是...”
rows.raw: "\n\nBelle smiles and leans forward in her seat, taking up a less elegant post and resting a cheek in her own hand, “It’s amazing, isn’t it, what simple vibrations in the air can do to the brain? I always wondered how far sound alone could push the mind, and now I’m learning. rows.original: “Such a good girl, isn’t she?” Belle asks, looking fondly upon her pet as she nuzzles against you, “I first met Saec when this project was just getting started. I had put out notices for willing test subjects: notified them of the risks, the pay, and she was one of the few who were willing to aid me in my experiments. Poor girl was desperate for credits, homeless, abandoned, so we went through the tests and I paid her accordingly, but then she asked to stay with me... begged me, and what else could I do besides let her?” She lets out a long sigh before calling the ausar over to her again, petting her gently and looking down at her pet, “So, here she is, right where she belongs, happy with her master.”
rows.translation: “她真是个乖女孩，对吧？”贝尔深情地望着依偎你的宠物，问道，“这个项目刚起步时，我第一次遇见萨克。我发布了招募自愿实验对象的通知，告知风险和报酬，而她是少数愿意协助实验的人之一。可怜的姑娘急需信用点，无家可归又遭人遗弃；于是我们完成测试，我也按约付钱，可后来她请求留下...甚至苦苦哀求。除了答应她，我还能怎么办？”她长叹一声，又把阿萨尔唤回身边，温柔地抚摸她并低头望着自己的宠物，“所以，她就在这里，待在自己应在的地方，和主人幸福地生活。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Such a good girl, isn’t she?” Belle asks, looking fondly upon her pet as she nuzzles against you, “I first met Saec when this project was just getting started. I had put out notices for willing test subjects: notified them of the risks, the pay, and she was one of the few who were willing to aid me in my experiments. Poor girl was desperate for credits, homeless, abandoned, so we went through the tests and I paid her accordingly, but then she asked to stay with me... begged me, and what else could I do besides let her?” She lets out a long sigh before calling the ausar over to her again, petting her gently and looking down at her pet, “So, here she is, right where she belongs, happy with her master.”"

rows.original: “Imagine for a moment, [pc.name],” Belle instructs, running a finger along the edge of one of Saec’s big fluffy ears, “How happy everyone would be if they could have something like this, a master or a pet, someone to love or someone to take care of...” The woman lets out a long sigh and looks back up at you, Saec following suite and beaming up at you, her tail wagging gently, “So, yes, you could say I’m privy to this lifestyle, and I love all my pets dearly.”
rows.translation: “想象一下，[pc.name]，”贝尔用手指沿萨克一只蓬松大耳的边缘划过，指示道，“如果每个人都能拥有这样的关系，会有多幸福：一个主人或一只宠物，一个去爱的人，或一个可以照顾的人...”她长叹一声，重新抬头望向你；萨克也跟着抬头，灿烂地对你微笑，尾巴轻轻摆动，“所以，是的，你可以说我熟悉这种生活方式，而且我深爱自己的每一只宠物。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Imagine for a moment, [pc.name],” Belle instructs, running a finger along the edge of one of Saec’s big fluffy ears, “How happy everyone would be if they could have something like this, a master or a pet, someone to love or someone to take care of...” The woman lets out a long sigh and looks back up at you, Saec following suite and beaming up at you, her tail wagging gently, “So, yes, you could say I’m privy to this lifestyle, and I love all my pets dearly.”"

If it wasn’t for your master being here, you’d be very tentative about going into this room, but you follow her in bravely."

rows.raw: "\n\nAlmost as soon as you’re through the door, a voice starts to fill your thoughts, but you’re not thinking of it. The sounds are in your head but coming from some outside source, and it feels very, very odd."

rows.original: “Belle!” it cries out, sounding jubilant and almost playful, “Are we gonna play today Belle? I could use a snack! Oh, and you brought a new friend! What’s [pc.hisHer] name?!”
rows.translation: “贝尔！”那个声音欢欣雀跃、几乎带着玩闹的语气喊道，“贝尔，我们今天要一起玩吗？我正想吃点零食！哦，你还带了位新朋友！[pc.hisHer]叫什么名字？！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Belle!” it cries out, sounding jubilant and almost playful, “Are we gonna play today Belle? I could use a snack! Oh, and you brought a new friend! What’s [pc.hisHer] name?!”"

rows.original: Wait, is that voice coming from the tentacles?! You gaze up at your master looking for answers, only to see her chuckle and extend an arm towards you. “This is [pc.name],” she says with her usual poised tone, but sounding very gentle towards that mass of tendrils, “And you’re going to be having a lot of fun with [pc.hisHer] today.”
rows.translation: 等等，那声音是从触手那里传来的吗？！你抬头望向主人寻求答案，却只见她轻笑着朝你伸出一条手臂。“这是[pc.name]，”她用一贯沉着的语调说道，但面对那团卷须时声音却十分温柔，“今天你会和[pc.hisHer]玩得非常开心。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, is that voice coming from the tentacles?! You gaze up at your master looking for answers, only to see her chuckle and extend an arm towards you. “This is [pc.name],” she says with her usual poised tone, but sounding very gentle towards that mass of tendrils, “And you’re going to be having a lot of fun with [pc.hisHer] today.”"

rows.original: A joyous cry of “Yaaaaaay!” fills your mind as the mass of squirming appendages wiggles happily.
rows.translation: 一声欢快的“好耶——！”充满你的脑海，那团扭动的附肢也高兴地摆动起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nA joyous cry of “Yaaaaaay!” fills your mind as the mass of squirming appendages wiggles happily."

rows.original: Belle turns to look at your clearly confused face, clasping her hands before getting ready to speak, “This is Roswell, [pc.name], and he’s... well, he’s my son.” Your eyes go wide at that, and you cock your head to the side, expecting some answers to your confusion, not that masters have to answer to their pets. The lady scientist smiles and sighs, “You see, [pc.boyGirl], when I first started this project, the Sub-Tuner, I needed some sort of spark, inspiration for this technology.” She pauses, and looks towards the mass of tentacles sitting in the room, “Roswell’s species is naturally psionic, able to manipulate matter and transmit thoughts with their minds, so I thought them an excellent starting point for my research. After I procured Roswell’s egg through... less legal means, I failed to take the proper precautions with him and ended up ‘impregnated’ for his incubation period after he hatched.”
rows.translation: 贝尔转身看向你满是困惑的脸，双手交握，准备开口解释：“这是罗斯韦尔，[pc.name]，而他...嗯，他是我的儿子。”你闻言睁大双眼，歪着脑袋，期待她解答你的困惑，倒不是说主人必须向宠物解释。女科学家微笑着叹了口气，“是这样的，[pc.boyGirl]，我最初着手从属调谐器这个项目时，需要某种火花，也就是这项技术的灵感。”她顿了顿，望向房间里的那团触手，“罗斯韦尔的种族天生拥有灵能，能够用意念操纵物质、传递思想，所以我认为他们是研究的绝佳起点。我通过...不太合法的途径弄到罗斯韦尔的卵后，没有采取妥善的防护措施，结果他孵化后，我在他的育成期里被‘怀孕’了。”

rows.original: “What about Roswell?” Belle ponders for a moment, rapping a finger on her chin, “I’d like to further investigate the effect of psionic vocalization on the Sub-Tuner’s suggestion protocols... and I’m sure he’s feeling hungry this time of day.” The lady scientist looks back at you again, “Well, [pc.boyGirl], I guess now is a good time as any to test out my hypothesis, follow me.”
rows.translation: “那罗斯韦尔怎么样？”贝尔用手指敲着下巴，思索了片刻，“我想进一步研究灵能发声对从属调谐器暗示协议的影响...而且这个时间，他肯定也饿了。”女科学家再次回头看向你，“好了，[pc.boyGirl]，现在正是检验我假设的好时机。跟我来。”
