rows.original: You give Belle another smile and nod, and Saec does the same before looking at you with a still-blushing face, clearly eager for your date. After that little exchange of glances, you’re both making your way out the door, your mutual master waving goodbye and calling out, “Be safe you two!”
rows.translation: 你再次朝贝尔微笑并点点头，赛克也做出同样的回应，随后仍红着脸望向你，显然很期待这场约会。短暂地交换目光后，你们一起走出门去，而你们共同的主人挥手告别，高声说道：“你们俩注意安全！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give Belle another smile and nod, and Saec does the same before looking at you with a still-blushing face, clearly eager for your date. After that little exchange of glances, you’re both making your way out the door, your mutual master waving goodbye and calling out, “Be safe you two!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: HugsAlright
rows.raw: "HugsAlright"

rows.original: Almost as soon as you’re out of the lab and walking away, you can feel warm fur brushing against your hand. You turn to see Saec facing away from you, but quickly realize that her fur-covered digits are wrapping around your own, taking hold of the same hand that’s holding her leash.
rows.translation: 刚离开实验室没走几步，你便感觉有温暖的毛发蹭过手掌。你转头一看，发现赛克正把脸转向别处，但很快便察觉她毛茸茸的手指正缠上你的手，握住了你拿着她牵绳的那只手。
rows.raw: "Almost as soon as you’re out of the lab and walking away, you can feel warm fur brushing against your hand. You turn to see Saec facing away from you, but quickly realize that her fur-covered digits are wrapping around your own, taking hold of the same hand that’s holding her leash."

rows.original: The gesture makes you smile, and you return the display of affection by firming up your grip and rubbing a thumb along the back of the ausar’s fluffy hand, making her blush all the more.
rows.translation: 这个举动令你微微一笑。你收紧手掌作为回应，拇指轻抚奥萨尔毛茸茸的手背，惹得她脸颊愈发绯红。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gesture makes you smile, and you return the display of affection by firming up your grip and rubbing a thumb along the back of the ausar’s fluffy hand, making her blush all the more."

rows.original: So, the two of you walk hand-in-hand through the halls in a blissful silence, making your way to an elevator and dropping a few levels, hoping to find that restaurant Belle told you about.
rows.translation: 于是，你们手牵着手，幸福而安静地穿过走廊，走进一部电梯，下降了几层，希望能找到贝尔提到的那家餐馆。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo, the two of you walk hand-in-hand through the halls in a blissful silence, making your way to an elevator and dropping a few levels, hoping to find that restaurant Belle told you about. "

rows.original: Luckily, it seems Saec knows the place, or has been there before with her master,
rows.translation: 幸运的是，赛克似乎知道那地方，或者以前曾和她的主人来过，
rows.raw: "Luckily, it seems Saec knows the place, or has been there before with her master,"

rows.original: Luckily, it seems Saec remembers where it is from when you last went there,
rows.translation: 幸运的是，赛克似乎还记得你们上次去那里时走的路，
rows.raw: "Luckily, it seems Saec remembers where it is from when you last went there,"

rows.original: because when you meet a quaint, rustic looking building standing out amongst the sleek structures of Uveto station, she taps on your shoulder and points it out.
rows.translation: 因为当你们遇到一栋古朴而富有乡村风情的建筑，突兀地立于乌维托空间站那些流线型结构之间时，她拍了拍你的肩膀，指向那里。
rows.raw: " because when you meet a quaint, rustic looking building standing out amongst the sleek structures of Uveto station, she taps on your shoulder and points it out."

rows.original: You turn to look at the building, standing out like a single colored hair among a head of gray strands, complete with a wooden sign labeling it as “Manni’s Too”. Saec smiles wide next to you at the simple fact that she’s
rows.translation: 你转头望向那栋建筑，它就像满头灰发中唯一一根彩发般醒目，木制招牌上还写着“曼尼二店”。赛克在你身旁笑得十分开心，只因为她
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn to look at the building, standing out like a single colored hair among a head of gray strands, complete with a wooden sign labeling it as “Manni’s Too”. Saec smiles wide next to you at the simple fact that she’s "

rows.original: here with you
rows.translation: 和你一起来到了这里
rows.raw: "here with you"

rows.original: here with you again
rows.translation: 又一次和你来到了这里
rows.raw: "here with you again"

rows.original: . Seeing that look on her face makes your heart flutter, and you’re eager to get on with this date, so you quickly lead your pet in through the entrance.
rows.translation: 。她脸上的神情令你心头一颤；你迫不及待想继续这场约会，便迅速牵着宠物走进入口。
rows.raw: ". Seeing that look on her face makes your heart flutter, and you’re eager to get on with this date, so you quickly lead your pet in through the entrance."

rows.original: Walking in, you spot a podium with who must be the day’s gray-skinned, tauric hostess standing behind. She greets you with a practiced, business-like grin as you approach.
rows.translation: 走进店里，你看到一座接待台，后面站着一位灰皮肤的牛兽女招待，想必正是今天的迎宾。你走近时，她挂着训练有素的职业笑容向你问好。
rows.raw: "\n\nWalking in, you spot a podium with who must be the day’s gray-skinned, tauric hostess standing behind. She greets you with a practiced, business-like grin as you approach."

rows.original: “Hello,” the leithan girl says, “Table for two today or picking an order up?”
rows.translation: “您好，”莱坦姑娘说道，“今天要一张双人桌，还是来取餐？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello,” the leithan girl says, “Table for two today or picking an order up?”"

rows.original: As you’re telling the girl you’d like a booth for two, she turns towards your date and smile a bit more genuinely, “Oh, hey there Saec! Is Doctor Baslocvicz not with you today?”
rows.translation: 你告诉姑娘想要一间双人卡座时，她转向你的约会对象，笑容也真诚了几分，“哦，赛克，你好呀！巴斯洛维奇博士今天没和你一起来吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you’re telling the girl you’d like a booth for two, she turns towards your date and smile a bit more genuinely, “Oh, hey there Saec! Is Doctor Baslocvicz not with you today?”"

rows.original: Your ausar companion shakes her head in response, but still keeps a happy look on her face, from ear to big, fluffy ear.
rows.translation: 你的奥萨尔同伴摇头作答，脸上仍挂着从一只耳朵延伸到另一只毛茸茸大耳朵的幸福笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour ausar companion shakes her head in response, but still keeps a happy look on her face, from ear to big, fluffy ear."

rows.original: So Saec has been here before, which would explain why the hostess isn’t too intrigued by the collar and leash around the canine girl’s neck.
rows.translation: 看来赛克以前来过这里，这就解释了为什么女招待对犬女脖子上的项圈和牵绳并不怎么好奇。
rows.raw: " So Saec has been here before, which would explain why the hostess isn’t too intrigued by the collar and leash around the canine girl’s neck."

rows.original: “Oh, well, good to see a good customer like you around anyways!” she exclaims, grabbing a couple of menus before extending a hand, “I’ll take you to your seats.”
rows.translation: “哦，好吧，不过能见到你这样的老顾客总是件好事！”她高声说道，拿起两份菜单后伸出一只手，“我带你们去座位。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, well, good to see a good customer like you around anyways!” she exclaims, grabbing a couple of menus before extending a hand, “I’ll take you to your seats.”"

rows.original: The leithan hostess maneuvers the comparatively-narrow aisles of the restaurant’s booths with surprising grace, trailing her large, tauric half behind her until she reaches a clear table and place a menu on either side of it, “Here’s your seats, your waitress will be with you shortly!” With that she smiles and makes her way back to her place near the building’s entrance, leaving you and Saec alone again.
rows.translation: 莱坦女招待以惊人的优雅穿行于餐馆卡座间相对狭窄的过道，身后拖着庞大的牛兽下半身，直到来到一张空桌前，把菜单分别放在桌子两侧。“这里就是二位的座位，服务员马上就来！”她微笑着回到建筑入口附近的岗位，再次留下你和赛克独处。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe leithan hostess maneuvers the comparatively-narrow aisles of the restaurant’s booths with surprising grace, trailing her large, tauric half behind her until she reaches a clear table and place a menu on either side of it, “Here’s your seats, your waitress will be with you shortly!” With that she smiles and makes her way back to her place near the building’s entrance, leaving you and Saec alone again."

rows.original: You invite your date to take a seat and she does,
rows.translation: 你请约会对象入座，她照做了，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou invite your date to take a seat and she does, "

rows.original: with you following her into the booth soon after, quickly picking up your menus. Looking around between glances at your choices, you take in the sight of the eatery around you; it’s quite old fashioned: everything seems to be made of lacquered wood, with nice tinted glass obstructing views between booths and brass lighting fixtures keeping the whole restaurant at quite a cozy level of dimness. Leather-covered cushions squeak beneath your [pc.ass] as you shift in your seat.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你也跟着她坐进卡座，迅速拿起菜单。你在浏览选项的间隙环顾四周，欣赏着周围餐馆的景象；这里十分复古：所有东西似乎都是漆木制成，漂亮的有色玻璃遮挡着不同卡座间的视线，黄铜灯具则让整家餐馆笼罩在一种舒适的昏暗光线中。你在座位上挪动身体时，皮革包裹的坐垫在[pc.ass]下吱吱作响。
rows.raw: "with you following her into the booth soon after, quickly picking up your menus. Looking around between glances at your choices, you take in the sight of the eatery around you; it’s quite old fashioned: everything seems to be made of lacquered wood, with nice tinted glass obstructing views between booths and brass lighting fixtures keeping the whole restaurant at quite a cozy level of dimness. Leather-covered cushions squeak beneath your [pc.ass] as you shift in your seat."

rows.original: After a little while a tall, thin kaithrit waitress comes to take your order of drinks and food before walking off again.
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，一名高挑纤瘦的凯斯里特女服务员前来记下你们点的饮料和食物，随后又离开了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a little while a tall, thin kaithrit waitress comes to take your order of drinks and food before walking off again."

rows.original: Well, it looks like you and Saec are gonna be waiting her for a bit, so you figure you should break the ice and ask the ausar if she’d like to talk with you until your meals get here.
rows.translation: 看来你和赛克还得在这里等上一会儿，于是你觉得应该打破沉默，问问这名奥萨尔是否愿意在餐点送来前和你聊聊天。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, it looks like you and Saec are gonna be waiting her for a bit, so you figure you should break the ice and ask the ausar if she’d like to talk with you until your meals get here."

rows.original: “O-oh, sure!” she says with a tone so soft and warm it could melt an Uveto glacier,
rows.translation: “哦——哦，当然！”她答道，语气轻柔温暖得足以融化乌维托的冰川，
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, sure!” she says with a tone so soft and warm it could melt an Uveto glacier, "

rows.original: reminding you that this is the first time you’ve actually heard Saec’s voice outside of it being a moan or pleasured whimper,
rows.translation: 令你想起这是第一次真正听到赛克在呻吟与欢愉呜咽之外发出的说话声，
rows.raw: "reminding you that this is the first time you’ve actually heard Saec’s voice outside of it being a moan or pleasured whimper, "

rows.original: “I usually don’t talk unless Belle gives me permission, though... so I guess I need yours now, right?”
rows.translation: “不过，贝尔不允许的话，我通常不会说话...所以我现在应该需要得到你的允许，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“I usually don’t talk unless Belle gives me permission, though... so I guess I need yours now, right?”"

rows.original: You give the ausar a nod, and she smiles in return, her posture relaxing a bit at receiving that little gesture.
rows.translation: 你朝奥萨尔点点头，她回以微笑；收到这个小小的表示后，她的姿态放松了些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the ausar a nod, and she smiles in return, her posture relaxing a bit at receiving that little gesture."

rows.original: You tell the ausar beauty she’s always free to talk with you, and that seems to relax her posture more than it already was.
rows.translation: 你告诉这位奥萨尔美人，在你身边她随时都可以说话，这让她本就放松的姿态变得更加自在。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell the ausar beauty she’s always free to talk with you, and that seems to relax her posture more than it already was."

rows.original: “Yay!” she exclaims before settling down and resting her hand in her lap
rows.translation: “太好了！”她欢呼一声，随后安静下来，把手放在腿上
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yay!” she exclaims before settling down and resting her hand in her lap"

rows.original: , “So what should we talk about?”
rows.translation: ，“那我们该聊些什么呢？”
rows.raw: ", “So what should we talk about?”"

rows.original: Thinking about it for a moment, you realize you and Saec don’t know each other that well and tell her she ought to speak about herself for a bit.
rows.translation: 思索片刻后，你意识到自己和赛克还不太了解彼此，便告诉她，不妨先谈谈她自己。
rows.raw: "\n\nThinking about it for a moment, you realize you and Saec don’t know each other that well and tell her she ought to speak about herself for a bit."

rows.original: “Oh, okay, yeah... I guess we should get to know each other,” the blonde pup ponders for a moment, “Alright... so I didn’t grow up here on Uveto, but you probably figured that out when you didn’t see any of that huskar fluff-stuff on my neck!” She pauses and smiles, rubbing her indeed-furless neck before continuing again, “I was born on Ausaril... but I didn’t know my parents, and I was raised in a shelter for most of my life, and I didn’t get out until I was sixteen.”
rows.translation: “哦，好吧，嗯...我想我们确实该互相了解一下，”金发小狗思索片刻，“好吧...我不是在乌维托长大的，不过你没在我脖子上看到那些哈斯卡毛茸茸的东西时，应该就猜到了！”她停下来笑了笑，摸了摸自己确实没有毛发的脖子，然后继续说道，“我出生在奥萨里尔...但我不认识父母，人生的大部分时间都在收容所长大，直到十六岁才离开那里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, okay, yeah... I guess we should get to know each other,” the blonde pup ponders for a moment, “Alright... so I didn’t grow up here on Uveto, but you probably figured that out when you didn’t see any of that huskar fluff-stuff on my neck!” She pauses and smiles, rubbing her indeed-furless neck before continuing again, “I was born on Ausaril... but I didn’t know my parents, and I was raised in a shelter for most of my life, and I didn’t get out until I was sixteen.”"

rows.original: Saec looks a bit down after regaling that part of her tale, and you can understand why, being abandoned by your parents and having to raise yourself like that for years. You ask the ausar if she had any other family that she knew.
rows.translation: 讲到这段往事时，赛克显得有些低落；你能理解其中缘由，被父母抛弃，又不得不那样独自长大多年。你问这名奥萨尔，她是否还认识其他家人。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaec looks a bit down after regaling that part of her tale, and you can understand why, being abandoned by your parents and having to raise yourself like that for years. You ask the ausar if she had any other family that she knew."

rows.original: She quickly shakes her head, “No, well... there was my brother, we were both put into the shelter together, and he got adopted when we were both still young. He probably wasn’t even a year old then.” Saec smiles warmly and twiddles her thumbs, “I still remember what he looks like, he was so small and cute, even for a pup... blonde fur and blue eyes just like me... I wonder how he’s doing now... or where he is.”
rows.translation: 她迅速摇头，“没有，呃...我确实有个弟弟。我们一起被送进收容所，后来在我们都还很小的时候，他就被人领养了。当时他可能连一岁都不到。”赛克温暖地笑了笑，摆弄着两根拇指，“我还记得他的样子。他那么小，那么可爱，哪怕在幼犬里也是如此...和我一样有金色毛发和蓝眼睛...不知道他现在过得怎么样...又身在何方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe quickly shakes her head, “No, well... there was my brother, we were both put into the shelter together, and he got adopted when we were both still young. He probably wasn’t even a year old then.” Saec smiles warmly and twiddles her thumbs, “I still remember what he looks like, he was so small and cute, even for a pup... blonde fur and blue eyes just like me... I wonder how he’s doing now... or where he is.”"

rows.original:
Wait... she couldn’t be talking about Lia- nah, no way. The galaxy’s a big place with a lot of blonde ausar, but then again, there’s always that chance.

Shaking that thought from your head, you
rows.translation:
等等...她说的不会是莉娅——不，不可能。银河这么大，金发奥萨尔又很多，但话说回来，总归存在那种可能。

你把这个念头甩出脑海，
rows.raw:
"

Wait... she couldn’t be talking about Lia- nah, no way. The galaxy’s a big place with a lot of blonde ausar, but then again, there’s always that chance.

Shaking that thought from your head, you"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou"

rows.original: think on Saec’s words for a moment then ask her what exactly brought her to Uveto after leaving the shelter.
rows.translation: 思索了一会儿赛克的话，随后问她离开收容所以后，究竟是什么让她来到了乌维托。
rows.raw: " think on Saec’s words for a moment then ask her what exactly brought her to Uveto after leaving the shelter."

rows.original: She takes a deep breath, puffing out her chest and releasing, clearing her thoughts before she continues, “After I got out... actually ‘kicked out’ is what I should’ve said, I needed to work, so I worked. I couldn’t really hold anything down for long, so I had a lot of different jobs, and then one day I got an offer from a place on Uveto that I applied to, an actual full-time job.” Saec sighs heavily and looks down at her feet under the table, “That was all a scam. I got there, they got my information, and then they took all the money I had saved up over the past eight years. I didn’t have anything, and I couldn’t even get off this stupid moon.” The ausar turns back towards you, her face quite a bit warmer now that that part of her story is over, “That’s when I met Belle. I was looking for some way to make a little money, at least enough to rent a warm room, and I found an ad for Accu-Pitch saying they were hiring test subjects. I didn’t have anywhere else to go, so I went there. The doctor was just... so nice to me. No one had ever treated me like she did, and I loved it... the whole ‘pet’ thing.” Saec pauses and looks right into your eyes, “And then I met you... and I like you a lot... I don’t think I’ve ever had a ‘playmate’ before, so it’s nice to see someone else happy with Belle, and me.”
rows.translation: 她深吸一口气，挺起胸膛，再缓缓吐出，理清思绪后继续说道：“我离开以后...其实应该说是‘被赶出去’以后，我需要工作，所以就去工作了。我在哪儿都干不长，因此换过很多不同的工作，直到有一天，我收到乌维托一家应聘单位的邀请，是一份真正的全职工作。”赛克重重叹了口气，低头看着桌下自己的脚，“那完全是个骗局。我到了那里，他们拿走我的个人资料，随后卷走了我过去八年攒下的全部钱财。我一无所有，甚至连这颗该死的卫星都离不开。”这部分故事终于讲完后，奥萨尔重新转向你，脸色也温暖了许多，“就是在那时，我遇见了贝尔。我当时正想方设法挣一点钱，至少得够租间温暖的房间，后来看到精准音调发布了招聘实验对象的广告。我无处可去，所以便去了那里。博士对我实在...太好了。从来没有人像她那样对待我，而我很喜欢...整套‘宠物’生活。”赛克停下来直视你的双眼，“后来我遇到了你...而且我很喜欢你...我以前好像从来没有过‘玩伴’，所以看到还有别人能和贝尔还有我一起开心，感觉真好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a deep breath, puffing out her chest and releasing, clearing her thoughts before she continues, “After I got out... actually ‘kicked out’ is what I should’ve said, I needed to work, so I worked. I couldn’t really hold anything down for long, so I had a lot of different jobs, and then one day I got an offer from a place on Uveto that I applied to, an actual full-time job.” Saec sighs heavily and looks down at her feet under the table, “That was all a scam. I got there, they got my information, and then they took all the money I had saved up over the past eight years. I didn’t have anything, and I couldn’t even get off this stupid moon.” The ausar turns back towards you, her face quite a bit warmer now that that part of her story is over, “That’s when I met Belle. I was looking for some way to make a little money, at least enough to rent a warm room, and I found an ad for Accu-Pitch saying they were hiring test subjects. I didn’t have anywhere else to go, so I went there. The doctor was just... so nice to me. No one had ever treated me like she did, and I loved it... the whole ‘pet’ thing.” Saec pauses and looks right into your eyes, “And then I met you... and I like you a lot... I don’t think I’ve ever had a ‘playmate’ before, so it’s nice to see someone else happy with Belle, and me.”"

rows.original: The girl’s whole story brings a smile to your face, all those hardships persevered then rewarded with a good place at Belle’s side
rows.translation: 姑娘讲述的整段故事让你露出了笑容。她挺过了那么多艰难困苦，最终得到回报，在贝尔身边找到了一个好归宿
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girl’s whole story brings a smile to your face, all those hardships persevered then rewarded with a good place at Belle’s side"

rows.original: You thank her for telling you all that.
rows.translation: 。你感谢她把这一切告诉你。
rows.raw: " You thank her for telling you all that."

rows.original: This time, you decide to take the initiative and tell Saec a bit about your journeys since you’ve last met. She watches and listens with great attention until you finish, and once you’re done the blonde pup takes her turn to tell you her latest stories: some movies she saw, a few nice places she’s been, and some stories from the lab that you don’t think Belle would tell you herself.

rows.original: You [pc.walk] your way up to the bright-green girl, taking note of the feathery appearance of her hair... along with what appears to be plates of bones or chitin on her face, closing around her eyes like a mask, and ending at her upper lip.
rows.translation: 你一路[pc.walk]到那名亮绿色的姑娘面前，注意到她的头发有种羽毛般的外观...脸上似乎还长着骨板或甲壳般的结构，如面具般合拢在眼睛周围，并一直延伸到上唇。
rows.raw: "You [pc.walk] your way up to the bright-green girl, taking note of the feathery appearance of her hair... along with what appears to be plates of bones or chitin on her face, closing around her eyes like a mask, and ending at her upper lip."

rows.original: “Oh, hello! Welcome to U7,” she says with what sounds to be perfectly-practiced corporate jubilance, “I don’t believe I’ve seen you here before, new to the track?”
rows.translation: “哦，你好！欢迎来到U7，”她以一种仿佛经过完美排练的企业式欢快语调说道，“我好像以前没见过你。第一次来赛场吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, hello! Welcome to U7,” she says with what sounds to be perfectly-practiced corporate jubilance, “I don’t believe I’ve seen you here before, new to the track?”"

rows.original: Seeing her talk, you notice some of those bony plates on her face moving, like mandibles, folding outward with each syllable until her mouth closes. You manage to tear yourself from the woman’s alien appearance and tell her that you haven’t been here before.
rows.translation: 看她说话时，你注意到她脸上的一些骨板竟然会移动，如同下颚一般，每说一个音节便向外展开，直到她闭上嘴巴。你好不容易才将注意力从女人异星般的外貌上移开，并告诉她自己以前从未来过这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nSeeing her talk, you notice some of those bony plates on her face moving, like mandibles, folding outward with each syllable until her mouth closes. You manage to tear yourself from the woman’s alien appearance and tell her that you haven’t been here before."

rows.original: “Well, if you have any questions then, or want to bet on any of our contestants, feel free to talk to me or any of the other cashiers!” the alien girl responds, “of course, we open our races to free viewings certain times of the day.”
rows.translation: “那么，如果你有任何问题，或者想给我们的任何参赛者下注，都可以来找我或其他收银员！”外星姑娘答道，“当然，我们每天也会在某些时段开放比赛，供大家免费观看。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, if you have any questions then, or want to bet on any of our contestants, feel free to talk to me or any of the other cashiers!” the alien girl responds, “of course, we open our races to free viewings certain times of the day.”"

rows.original: Still not to sure what U7 is about, you ask the cashier exactly what they race here.
rows.translation: 你仍不太确定U7究竟经营什么，于是询问收银员这里比赛的究竟是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill not to sure what U7 is about, you ask the cashier exactly what they race here."

rows.original: “Oh, we race people,” she answers with a smile on her face, or as much of a smile as her species’ faces can make.
rows.translation: “哦，我们让人比赛，”她面带笑容回答道——至少已经是她这个种族的脸所能做出的最大笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, we race people,” she answers with a smile on her face, or as much of a smile as her species’ faces can make."

rows.original: After imagining ausar and humans on all-fours running through a racetrack, you give the cashier a confused look.
rows.translation: 你想象着奥萨尔人与人类四肢着地在赛道上奔跑的画面，困惑地望向收银员。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter imagining ausar and humans on all-fours running through a racetrack, you give the cashier a confused look."

rows.original: You cock an eyebrow.
rows.translation: 你扬起一边眉毛。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou cock an eyebrow."

rows.original: “Our more... tauric citizens,” the woman explains, mandibles moving in and out as her reptilian eyes stay fixed on you, “With RhenWorld around, leithans have become popular contestants in out races, for instance.”
rows.translation: “是我们那些更加...牛兽化的公民，”女人解释道。她爬行动物般的双眼始终盯着你，下颚则不断开合，“例如，有雷恩世界在，莱坦人已经成为我们比赛中的热门选手。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our more... tauric citizens,” the woman explains, mandibles moving in and out as her reptilian eyes stay fixed on you, “With RhenWorld around, leithans have become popular contestants in out races, for instance.”"

rows.original: After giving her an understanding nod, the cashier offers her services to you again.
rows.translation: 你理解地点了点头，收银员再次表示可以为你提供服务。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter giving her an understanding nod, the cashier offers her services to you again."

rows.original: You [pc.walk] your way up to the familiar, reptilian cashier nearby, her small green scales shimmering in the artificial light of the racetrack.
rows.translation: 你一路[pc.walk]到附近那名熟悉的爬行动物收银员面前，她细小的绿色鳞片在赛道的人造光线下闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: "You [pc.walk] your way up to the familiar, reptilian cashier nearby, her small green scales shimmering in the artificial light of the racetrack."

rows.original: “Ah, welcome back!” the alien woman says with a click of her bony mandibles, “Can I help you with anything today?”
rows.translation: “啊，欢迎回来！”外星女人咔哒一声开合骨质下颚，“今天有什么需要我帮忙的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, welcome back!” the alien woman says with a click of her bony mandibles, “Can I help you with anything today?”"

rows.original: “Of course,” she says with some sort of faux-smile, “Just make your way up the stairs to our lower stadium seating.”

rows.original: Entering the stadium, you come to the realization that this place is huge; miles of synthetic-earth in a pill-shape beneath you forms the track of the stadium, while the fully-enclosed ceiling stretches high and far above you.
rows.translation: 进入赛场后，你才意识到这里大得惊人；下方绵延数英里的胶囊形人造土地构成了赛道，而完全封闭的穹顶则高悬于上方，横跨极远。
rows.raw: "Entering the stadium, you come to the realization that this place is huge; miles of synthetic-earth in a pill-shape beneath you forms the track of the stadium, while the fully-enclosed ceiling stretches high and far above you."

rows.original: Entering the stadium, you find yourself less surprised by the sheer size of the building, but still find it impressive by the standards of a small, frozen moon in terms of infrastructure.
rows.translation: 进入赛场后，你已不再那么惊讶于建筑本身的庞大规模，但以一颗冰封小卫星的基础设施标准而言，这里依然令人印象深刻。
rows.raw: "Entering the stadium, you find yourself less surprised by the sheer size of the building, but still find it impressive by the standards of a small, frozen moon in terms of infrastructure."

rows.original: You walk your way through the rows and rows of chairs for quite some time, and after reaching a suitable seat
rows.translation: 你在一排又一排座椅间走了好一阵，终于找到一个适合
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk your way through the rows and rows of chairs for quite some time, and after reaching a suitable seat "

rows.original: for your tauric body
rows.translation: 你牛兽身体

rows.original: to watch the races from, you sit your [pc.ass] down and get yourself comfortable before the next race starts.
rows.translation: 观看比赛的座位，于是将[pc.ass]坐下，舒舒服服地等待下一场比赛开始。
rows.raw: "to watch the races from, you sit your [pc.ass] down and get yourself comfortable before the next race starts."

rows.original: Cheering and clapping fills the air when the races begin, and you lean forward in your chair to get a better look at what’s going on. As you expected, a buzzer rings and you can already see tauric people charging out the gates: leithans mainly, with many a other species thrown in, even a few modded humans.
rows.translation: 比赛开始时，欢呼与掌声响彻四周。你在椅子上探身向前，想看清发生了什么。如你所料，蜂鸣器一响，牛兽选手便已冲出闸门：其中主要是莱坦人，也混杂着许多其他种族，甚至还有几个经过改造的人类。
rows.raw: "\n\nCheering and clapping fills the air when the races begin, and you lean forward in your chair to get a better look at what’s going on. As you expected, a buzzer rings and you can already see tauric people charging out the gates: leithans mainly, with many a other species thrown in, even a few modded humans."

rows.original: What you didn’t expect to see though is the racer’s jockeys, all of them are bipedal... and riding under their respective contestant. Even more interesting, though, is the fact that they’re all naked, riders and racers alike... and if you were to wager a guess
rows.translation: 然而，你没想到的是选手们的骑师全都以双足行走……而且骑在各自参赛者的身下。更有意思的是，骑师和选手全都一丝不挂……若让你猜一猜
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat you didn’t expect to see though is the racer’s jockeys, all of them are bipedal... and riding under their respective contestant. Even more interesting, though, is the fact that they’re all naked, riders and racers alike... and if you were to wager a guess "

rows.original: (since you aren’t even betting on this race)
rows.translation: （毕竟你甚至没有为这场比赛下注）
rows.raw: "(since you aren’t even betting on this race) "

rows.original: there’s definitely something going on between their bodies. Though you can’t really hear or see it, there’s probably a few taurs packing and well-sheathed inside their riders.
rows.translation: ，他们的身体之间肯定正在发生些什么。虽然你听不真切，也看不清楚，但多半有几名牛兽正将性器严丝合缝地插在骑师体内。
rows.raw: "there’s definitely something going on between their bodies. Though you can’t really hear or see it, there’s probably a few taurs packing and well-sheathed inside their riders."

rows.original: What
rows.translation: 真是
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat "

rows.original: a great sport!
rows.translation: 一项精彩的运动！
rows.raw: "a great sport!"

rows.original: an odd sport.
rows.translation: 一项古怪的运动。
rows.raw: "an odd sport."

rows.original: Cheering and clapping fills the air when the races begin, and you lean forward in your chair to get a better look at what’s going on. Just like last time, the buzzer sounds and the tauric racers shoot from their gates like bullets, jockeys riding underneath. They maneuver the turns of the track like veterans of the track, and the riders beneath seem to be enjoying being along for the ride.
rows.translation: 比赛开始时，欢呼与掌声响彻四周。与上次一样，蜂鸣器一响，牛兽选手便如子弹般冲出闸门，骑师则骑在他们身下。他们像赛道老手般娴熟地驶过弯道，而身下的骑手似乎也很享受这趟旅程。
rows.raw: "\n\nCheering and clapping fills the air when the races begin, and you lean forward in your chair to get a better look at what’s going on. Just like last time, the buzzer sounds and the tauric racers shoot from their gates like bullets, jockeys riding underneath. They maneuver the turns of the track like veterans of the track, and the riders beneath seem to be enjoying being along for the ride."

rows.original: Once the contestants finish their loop around the track, the ruckus of the stadium quiets down, aside from a few unhappy cusses from those upset with the outcome of their bets.
rows.translation: 选手们跑完一圈后，赛场的喧嚣逐渐平息，只剩下几名因下注结果不如意而咒骂的观众。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce the contestants finish their loop around the track, the ruckus of the stadium quiets down, aside from a few unhappy cusses from those upset with the outcome of their bets."

rows.original: Well, it looks like you could take your leave.

rows.original: You ask the girl if there’s any races available that you could place a bet on, prompting a warm look from the alien cashier.
rows.translation: 你询问这名女孩，目前有没有可以下注的比赛，外星收银员闻言露出了热情的神情。
rows.raw: "You ask the girl if there’s any races available that you could place a bet on, prompting a warm look from the alien cashier."

rows.original: “We certainly do!” she exclaims, flipping on a holo-pad that’s imbedded into the counter in front of her, “Here’s a list of our upcoming races! Once you feel like you’ve made a choice on your racer, just tell me and we can work out a credit transfer.”
rows.translation: “当然有！”她高声说道，开启了嵌在身前柜台里的全息面板，“这里是即将开始的比赛列表！选定参赛者后告诉我，我们就能办理信用点转账。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We certainly do!” she exclaims, flipping on a holo-pad that’s imbedded into the counter in front of her, “Here’s a list of our upcoming races! Once you feel like you’ve made a choice on your racer, just tell me and we can work out a credit transfer.”"

rows.original: Looking at the list of names on the holographic screen before you, you locate the racer with the cutest, prettiest name and pick them, a good a choice as any.
rows.translation: 你看着面前全息屏幕上的名字列表，找出名字最可爱、最漂亮的参赛者并选中对方，反正这项选择并不比其他选择差。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooking at the list of names on the holographic screen before you, you locate the racer with the cutest, prettiest name and pick them, a good a choice as any."

rows.original: You scan the list of names and statistics before you, balancing out your best shot at winning a bet with some hefty mental-math.
rows.translation: 你浏览面前的姓名与数据列表，进行一番繁复的心算，权衡怎样才能最大限度提高赌赢的机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scan the list of names and statistics before you, balancing out your best shot at winning a bet with some hefty mental-math."

rows.original: After the woman finishes speaking, you do your best to pick out a likely winner from the list of names before you.
rows.translation: 等女子说完后，你尽力从面前的名单中挑选一位最有可能获胜的选手。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter the woman finishes speaking, you do your best to pick out a likely winner from the list of names before you."

rows.original: Once you’ve made your choice, you inform the cashier and take out your Codex, ready to make a transfer.
rows.translation: 作出选择后，你告知收银员并取出CODEX终端，准备转账。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce you’ve made your choice, you inform the cashier and take out your Codex, ready to make a transfer."

rows.original: “Perfect!” she says, “Now I should inform you that most bets carried out officially in this establishment are those for high-rollers” She hits a button behind her counter and a list of prices appears on the holo-pad in the counter.
rows.translation: “太好了！”她说道，“不过我得先提醒你，本店正式承办的赌局大多面向豪赌客。”她按下柜台后方的按钮，一份价格表随即出现在柜台的全息面板上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perfect!” she says, “Now I should inform you that most bets carried out officially in this establishment are those for high-rollers” She hits a button behind her counter and a list of prices appears on the holo-pad in the counter."

rows.original: Before too long cheering and clapping fills the air when as the race begins. The buzzer sounds and the tauric racers shoot from their gates like bullets, jockeys riding underneath. They maneuver the turns of the track like veteran racers, and the riders beneath seem to be enjoying being along for the ride.
rows.translation: 没过多久，比赛开始，欢呼与掌声响彻四周。蜂鸣器一响，牛兽选手便如子弹般冲出闸门，骑师则骑在他们身下。他们像经验丰富的赛手般驶过弯道，而身下的骑手似乎也很享受这趟旅程。

rows.original: You keep your eyes fixed on the mass of contestants as they round corners and reach the finish line. Your grip tightens with anticipation as your number starts to pull ahead of the pack, gaining a lead until you’re practically screaming and cheering loud enough for the whole stadium to hear. Sure enough, they cross the finish line first with a cry of victory from you, and the rest of the crowd that bet on them.
rows.translation: 你目不转睛地盯着大群参赛者，看着他们转过弯道、奔向终点。你押中的号码开始冲出队伍、逐渐领先，你满怀期待地握紧双手，最后几乎尖叫着欢呼起来，声音大得整座赛场都能听见。果不其然，对方第一个越过终点线，你和其他押中这名选手的观众都发出了胜利的欢呼。

It’s a little jarring, having spent so long on the frontier and risking life and limb, only now to be packed in with so many carefree people, all smiles and laughs and silly costumes they’ve poured their hearts into. You barely see any weapons without a red muzzle, and all the armor is clearly made of cardboard and plastic. Against the backdrop of your recent adventures, you feel just a little awkward. [flags.SYRI_CHEER |A little naked, too, without your [pc.gear]. At least you’re getting some appreciative glances in Syri’s outfit. Seems she chose well! |Kitted up like a proper Rusher as you are, you get more than a few glances — some wary, but mostly envious. You’re living their fantasy. ] With the hall open now open, you join the hustle and bustle of people squeezing in, guiding to your assigned seat by your ID band. A couple of nerds get busted at the door for fakies, pinged by an unseen sensor and quickly nabbed by huskar men in security uniforms, but most of the commotion is just the overpowering din of people yammering on excitedly. The hall has been modeled almost like a sports arena, with stands for the audience surrounding a circular stage in the middle with twenty four consoles all facing each other. The VidyaMonster logo is painted loud and proud beneath them, and every holo-rig is covered in JoyCo stickers and other sponsor logos. A couple of techs are still out on the stage doing last-moment checks. There’s no sign of the gamers themselves yet, so you [pc.bipedTaurNaga |take your seat |awkwardly wedge yourself into your seat |awkwardly wedge yourself into your seat ] and hurry up and wait. "

rows.original: “Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls and galotians, welcome to the fifty-fifth annual galactic Call of Valor tournament, hosted by JoyCo and VidyaMonster. Today is the first time anywhere in the galaxy where you’ll be able to see the hype new hit from Wintervision, the eighth installment in the reboot of the reboot of Call of Valor, live on the competitive scene! We’ve brought the cream of the tactical crop from all across the known universe to slug it out in land, sea, and air — and returning to the franchise for the first time in two hundred years, space!” The lights dim as the announcer drawls on. The consoles light up, spooling to life with flashing Call of Valor logos. “Tonight’s tournament is a free-for-all battle royale. In honor of the first DLC release tomorrow, and since it’s a new map none of the players have had a chance to get their hands on and explore, we have chosen the fully-realized and beautifully photo-digitized warzone of Thragabad, deep in the Thraggen demilitarized systems. Every inch from the shattered moons to the bombed out colonies are fully explorable and randomly populated with friends and foes! Who among our challengers can navigate an unfamiliar solar system, hunt down the other players, and claim dominance — who will answer the-” “CALL! OF! VALOR!!!” the audience cheers raucously. “Let’s introduce our cyberspace commandos, the best of the best this side of the Rush! All the way from Terra itself, give it up for [silly |TinyTanuki69 |ChrissyCoon69 ]!” [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Hey, that’s Chrissy! The tiny tanuki herself |A small, brown-haired half-nuki ] bounces onto the stage, waving at the audience before grabbing one of the holographic rigs off its console. “And representing its sister world of Ausaril, please welcome last year’s runner-up, BlastMaster1!” There’s your girl! Syri comes jogging out of the green room, tail going a thousand miles a minute, with a huge grin on her face. She spies you instantly, giving you a wink that your entire quarter of the audience must think is meant just for them the way they all croon and cheer — but you know better. You jump up and cheer for her, throwing your heart into it like nobody else. You see just a hint of a blush creep onto Syri’s cheeks before she has to turn away and grab one of the machines, too, though she’s deliberate in choosing a console that leaves her facing your way. Twenty two other competitors are brought out, introduced by their monikers instead of names, and from just as many different worlds and races — gryvains, leithans, and spinarrans are the least exotic of them, and they come in all shapes and sizes. The crowd cheers for them one and all, each with his or her own little cult of fans. There’s a bit more ceremony and announcements and a word from the tourney’s sponsors while the competitors gear up and customize their characters. The holoscreen above the stage cycles through their creations — half look like hideous gremlins, compared to the cute [silly |waifus |babes ] the rest of them make. Syri’s looks like a tacti-cool version of the current Prime Minister of the Confederacy, wearing a top hat and pair of large goggles that when paired together look like a penis. Syri looks inordinately proud of herself before the focus shifts away, and the MC gets ready to kick things off. [var0 |Just before things kick off, somebody takes the open seat next to you, and a particularly thick, red wolf’s tail flicks into your lap. “Wha— Kaede?” “Heeeeey!” the ginger half-ausar smiles, nuzzling up and offering a paper popcorn bag. “I’m glad I could swing a contract out here in time. I know this means a lot to Syri, and-” She’s cut off as a[anno.isHuskar | particularly plump ] snowy she-wolf flops down in her lap, smooshing Kaede into the seat. “Hey boss! We could only score one ticket, sooo we’re just gonna have to make do, huh? Don’t tell the staff!” Kaede squirms, buried under white hair and callipygian ass. “H-hey, I’m smaller, I ought to be on top. I can’t see!” “Babe, you’re never on top,” Anno teases, grinding her hips down into her lover. “Wouldn’t know what to do if you got there! B’yeah, boss, wouldn’t miss this for the world. Gonna cheer my lil’ sis on while she kicks ass all the way to the big leagues![flags.SYRI_CHEER | Aren’t we, babe?” It’s only then that you recognize that you aren’t the only one dressed for the occasion. Anno has through some miracle of science squeezed herself into her college cheer uniform, proudly rocking the brilliant purple colors of Ausaril’s most prestigious university. While you can’t see much of Kaede, it looks like she’s been dolled up in a similar outfit, complete with a pair of pompoms hanging off her extremely short skirt. “[anno.isCrew |I heard Syri giving you your present, and I just so happened to still have this from the good old days... and something I bought Kaede for fun. We decided we ought to join in, give my sister her own personal cheer squad. |Guess we both had the same idea, huh? I just so happened to still have this from the good old days... and something I bought Kaede for fun. Thought we’d come and be my sister’s own personal cheer squad. Guess we’re roping you in, too! ] Whadda ya say?” Kaede gasps, “I say I can’t breathe down here!” Sounds like a plan! “It is going to be so magical when she sees us!” Anno giggles, tail muffling Kaede’s complaints under the sheer ferocity of its wagging. |Only then do you realize Anno’s wearing a cheerleader’s outfit, in the purple colors of the prestigious Ausaril Tech university. “Like the outfit? I knew I saved these for a good reason. Today we’re gonna be Syri’s personal cheer squad! It’s gonna be so magical when she sees me, haha!” ] |Just before things kick off, somebody takes the open seat next to you, and a particularly thick, snowy wolf’s tail flicks into your lap. “Heyya, Boss!” Anno grins, sidling up real close and offering you her bag of popcorn. “Figured I’d take the next elevator down. Give you two lovebirds some breathing room. Sad Kaede couldn’t make it, she got wrapped up in some [flags.KAEDE_CANADA_MET |Myrellion contract |business on Canadia ] I guess. But I wouldn’t miss this for the world. Gonna cheer my lil’ sis on while she kicks ass all the way to the big leagues!” [flags.SYRI_CHEER |“Guess we’re gonna be Syri’s personal cheer squad!” Anno giggles, giving you a wink. “What a coincidence, huh? Oh this is gonna be so magical when she notices us both all dolled up. Heheh...” |Only then do you realize Anno’s wearing a cheerleader’s outfit, in the purple colors of the prestigious Ausaril Tech university. “Like the outfit? I’m gonna be Syri’s personal cheer squad today! It’s gonna be so magical when she sees me, haha!” ] ]
rows.translation: “女士们、先生们、男孩们、女孩们以及加洛提安人，欢迎来到由欢乐公司与电玩怪兽主办的第五十五届银河年度使命召唤锦标赛。今天，你们将首次在银河任何地方看见冬景公司的热门新作——重启之重启版使命召唤的第八部作品——登上竞技舞台！我们从已知宇宙各处请来了战术精英中的精英，让他们在陆地、海洋和天空激战——并且在阔别本系列二百年后，再次回到太空！” 播报员拖长声音继续讲述，灯光随之暗下。主机亮起，闪烁的使命召唤标志逐一启动。“今晚的锦标赛是一场全员混战的大逃杀。为了纪念明天发布首个可下载内容，也因为这是一张全新地图，没有任何选手有机会亲手游玩探索，我们选择了斯拉格根非军事星系深处、完全还原并以精美照片数字化呈现的斯拉加巴德战区。从破碎的卫星到遭轰炸的殖民地，每一寸空间都可自由探索，并随机分布着盟友与敌人！挑战者中谁能探索陌生的太阳系、猎杀其他选手并夺得统治权——谁将回应——” “使！命！召！唤！！！”观众喧闹地欢呼。 “让我们介绍这些网络空间突击队员，星球淘金热这边最顶尖的高手！她远道来自泰拉本土，让我们为[silly |小狸猫69 |克丽茜浣熊69 ]喝彩！” [flags.CHRISSY_MET |嘿，那是克丽茜！正是那只小狸猫 |一名棕发小半狸猫人 ]蹦上舞台，朝观众挥手，随后拿起主机上的一套全息设备。 “接下来代表其姐妹世界奥萨里尔出战，请欢迎去年的亚军，爆破大师1！” 你的姑娘来了！ 希莉从选手休息室小跑出来，尾巴以每分钟千英里的速度摆动，脸上挂着灿烂笑容。她立刻发现你，朝你眨了眨眼；你所在区域的所有观众都以为这是送给他们的，纷纷柔声赞叹、放声欢呼——但你更清楚。你跳起来替她欢呼，投入的热情无人能及。你看见希莉脸颊泛起一丝红晕，随后她不得不转身拿起一台设备；不过她特意选择了一个能让自己面向你的主机。 另外二十二名参赛者陆续登场，介绍时使用代号而非真名，分别来自同样众多的不同世界与种族——格里文人、莱坦人和斯皮纳兰人反而是其中最不稀奇的，而且他们体型形态各异。人群为每一位选手欢呼，各自都有一小群忠实粉丝。选手穿戴设备、自定义角色时，又进行了一些仪式、公告和赛事赞助商致辞。舞台上方的全息屏幕轮流展示他们的创作——与其他人制作的可爱[silly |老婆 |美女 ]相比，其中一半看起来像丑陋的小妖怪。希莉的角色则像战术酷炫版的现任邦联总理，戴着一顶礼帽和一副大号护目镜，两者搭配起来形似阴茎。 希莉看起来自豪得不同寻常，随后镜头移开，主持人准备宣布开始。 [var0 |就在比赛即将开始前，有人坐上你身旁的空位，一条格外粗大的红色狼尾甩进你怀里。“什——枫？” “嘿————！”姜黄色的半奥萨尔人微笑着贴近你，递出一个纸质爆米花袋。“真高兴我及时接到一份来这里的合同。我知道这对希莉意义重大，而且——” 一只[anno.isHuskar |格外丰满的 ]雪白母狼瘫坐进她怀里，把枫压在座位上，打断了她。“嘿，老大！我们只搞到一张票，所————以只能将就一下，对吧？别告诉工作人员！” 枫在白发和圆润美臀下挣扎。“嘿-嘿，我比较小，应该让我坐上面。我看不见！” “宝贝，你从来都不在上面，”安诺调侃着，用髋部向下碾磨情人。“就算上去了，你也不知道该做什么！对了，老大，这种事我绝不会错过。我要替小妹加油，看她一路大杀四方，冲进顶级联赛！[flags.SYRI_CHEER |对吧，宝贝？” 这时你才发现，并非只有自己为今天精心打扮。安诺凭借某种科学奇迹，把身体塞进了大学时代的啦啦队服，自豪地展示奥萨里尔最负盛名大学那鲜艳的紫色。虽然看不见枫的大部分身体，但她似乎也被打扮成类似模样，极短裙摆上甚至挂着一对绒球。 “[anno.isCrew |我听见希莉把礼物交给你，而我恰好还留着美好旧日里的这套衣服...以及为了好玩给枫买的东西。我们决定一起加入，给我妹妹组建她自己的私人啦啦队。 |看来我们想到一起去了，对吧？我恰好还留着美好旧日里的这套衣服...以及为了好玩给枫买的东西。我想我们可以来组建妹妹自己的私人啦啦队。看来也得把你拉进来！ ]你觉得怎么样？” 枫喘息道：“我觉得自己在下面喘不过气！” 听起来是个好计划！ “等她看见我们，场面一定超级梦幻！”安诺咯咯笑道，尾巴猛烈摇动，硬是盖住了枫的抱怨。 |这时你才发现安诺穿着啦啦队服，采用名校奥萨里尔科技大学的紫色。“喜欢这身衣服吗？我就知道自己留着它们是有理由的。今天我们要组成希莉的私人啦啦队！她看见我时，场面一定超级梦幻，哈哈！” ] |就在比赛即将开始前，有人坐上你身旁的空位，一条格外粗大的雪白狼尾甩进你怀里。“嘿呀，老大！” 安诺咧嘴笑着紧贴过来，把爆米花袋递给你。“我想着搭下一班电梯下来，给你们这对情侣一点喘息空间。可惜枫来不了，她好像被一桩[flags.KAEDE_CANADA_MET |米雷利恩合同 |加拿大空间站的生意 ]缠住了。不过这种事我绝不会错过。我要替小妹加油，看她一路大杀四方，冲进顶级联赛！” [flags.SYRI_CHEER |“看来我们要组成希莉的私人啦啦队了！”安诺眨眨眼，咯咯笑道。“真巧，对吧？哦，她看见我们两个都打扮得漂漂亮亮时，场面一定超级梦幻。嘿嘿...” |这时你才发现安诺穿着啦啦队服，采用名校奥萨里尔科技大学的紫色。“喜欢这身衣服吗？今天我要组成希莉的私人啦啦队！她看见我时，场面一定超级梦幻，哈哈！” ] ]

rows.original: The final stage lights flick off, replaced by holographic mirrors of the various players’ screens floating and rotating above the platform — just out of sight from the players themselves. Have to keep everyone honest, you suppose. The screens all flash with game dev and engine logos, and then explode into fields of stars — a whole solar system, rendered in excruciating detail. Every player starts on their own starships, choosing where on the main habitable planet to drop down onto... or onto one of the planet’s satellites, in the case of one player, seeking out an early game powerful weapon at the cost of speed and stealth. You haven’t had the chance to play this new game of Syri’s — it’s hard to keep up with the exact what and why of the action, but it barely takes more than a couple minutes from the match’s beginning before the exhibition hall thunders with the roar of simulated gunfire and explosions. Firefights break out between players and legions of mindless robots on the planet’s surface, filling experience bars and grabbing ever-stronger weapons. There’s a lot of buildup, flashy and loud, before any of the players ever meet each other. The ‘nuki and leithan are the first to have hard contact: the tacti-taur gallops headlong into a withering hail of plasma bolts coming from the ruins of a building, leaning into his shields’ protection until he can close the distance and launch a rocket into the windows. By the time he realizes that was only an auto-turret, [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the kui-tan] has already jumped on his back from behind and unloaded her weapon into his skull. His avatar collapses in an exaggerated pile of gore, only to receive the customary teabagging before his slayer slips back into the shadows. “First blood! And plenty of it!” the MC laughs. The leithan pulls his headset off and spikes it into the stage, swearing up a storm as he canters off. [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the kui-tan] grins sadistically, thrusting her massive nads at his backside ‘till he’s off stage. Your girl gets the second frag just a few moments later, though it’s far less visually impressive. Another player, a particularly lengthy naga, gets herself pinned down by a legion of the kill-bot NPCs. She takes just enough fire to drop her shields, pushing her to break contact, but the second she’s safely in cover from the robots, her avatar ragdolls onto the deck with a smoking crater in an eye. The readout of “KILLED BY BLASTMASTER1” flashing on her HUD is the only clue as to what happened — that, and watching Syri’s hands mime the motion of racking a sniper rifle’s bolt. “Ice cold!” the MC announces. “She never knew what hit her!” [var0 |“Wait is that seriously still her tag?” Anno groans beside you, munching popcorn. “I told her that was lame when we were in elementary school. Whatever. Let’s do the thing!” ] [flags.SYRI_CHEER |You hop up and cheer, jumping around and shouting Syri’s name. The ravenette glances up your way and smiles, pumping her fist and wagging her tail.[var0 | And then her eyes just about pop out of her head when she sees your backup, tits bouncing under straining fabric. ] ] “Go Syri, Go! Goooooo Syri!” Your gamer-pup’s cheeks flush red when several other members of the crowd join in, cheering her precision kill on. But there’s still plenty more carnage left to wreak on that virtual world, and judging from the screens rotating over the stage, the players are all starting to close in on each other.
rows.translation: 最后的舞台灯光熄灭，取而代之的是悬浮旋转于平台上方、映照各位选手画面的全息屏——恰好处在选手自己的视野之外。你想，这大概是为了保证所有人诚实参赛。所有屏幕闪过游戏开发商与引擎标志，随后爆发成一片星海——整个太阳系都以令人痛苦的细节精度呈现。每位玩家都从自己的星舰上开始，选择要降落在主要宜居星球的什么地方...其中一位选手则选择了星球的卫星，以牺牲速度与隐蔽性为代价，寻找游戏早期的一件强力武器。 你还没有机会玩希莉这款新游戏——很难准确理解场上究竟发生了什么、又为何如此；但比赛开始不过几分钟，展厅便因模拟枪声与爆炸的轰鸣而震动。玩家与星球表面成群无脑机器人爆发枪战，填充经验条，抢夺越来越强的武器。在任何玩家真正相遇之前，经历了大量华丽而喧闹的铺垫。 狸猫人与莱坦人率先发生正面接触：战术牛兽迎着建筑废墟射来的密集等离子枪弹全速冲锋，依靠护盾保护逼近距离，随后朝窗口发射火箭。等他意识到那只是一座自动炮塔时，[flags.CHRISSY_MET|克丽茜|那名狸猫人]已经从背后跳上他的身体，将武器对准头骨倾泻火力。他的角色以夸张的血肉堆倒下，杀死他的对手照例在尸体上蹲起羞辱，随后重新潜入阴影。 “第一滴血！而且血可不少！”主持人大笑。莱坦人摘下头戴设备，猛砸在舞台上，一路破口大骂着疾驰离开。[flags.CHRISSY_MET|克丽茜|那名狸猫人]残虐地咧嘴笑，不断朝他的背影挺动硕大睾丸，直到他离开舞台。 片刻后，你的姑娘拿下第二个人头，不过视觉效果远没有那么震撼。另一位选手——一条格外修长的娜迦——被一群杀戮机器人非玩家角色压制。她遭受的火力刚好击破护盾，迫使她脱离接触；然而刚刚躲进掩体避开机器人，她的角色便像布偶般倒在地板上，一只眼睛留下冒烟的弹坑。她抬头显示器上闪烁的“被爆破大师1击杀”是事情经过的唯一线索——另一个线索则是希莉双手模仿拉动狙击步枪枪栓的动作。 “冷酷无情！”主持人宣布。“她根本不知道是什么击中了自己！” [var0 |“等等，她真的还在用那个代号？”安诺在你身旁一边吃爆米花一边呻吟。“我们还在小学时，我就告诉她这很逊了。算了。开始做那件事吧！” ] [flags.SYRI_CHEER |你跳起来欢呼，一边蹦跳，一边高喊希莉的名字。黑发女孩抬头看向你这边，露出微笑，挥动拳头、摇起尾巴。[var0 |随后她看见你的后援，紧绷布料下乳房不断弹动，双眼几乎瞪出眼眶。 ] ] “加油希莉，加油！希————莉加油！” 另外几名观众也加入进来，为她精准的击杀欢呼，你那位玩家小狗的脸颊顿时泛红。但那个虚拟世界仍有更多杀戮有待制造；从舞台上方旋转的屏幕判断，玩家正在彼此逼近。
rows.raw: " The final stage lights flick off, replaced by holographic mirrors of the various players’ screens floating and rotating above the platform — just out of sight from the players themselves. Have to keep everyone honest, you suppose. The screens all flash with game dev and engine logos, and then explode into fields of stars — a whole solar system, rendered in excruciating detail. Every player starts on their own starships, choosing where on the main habitable planet to drop down onto... or onto one of the planet’s satellites, in the case of one player, seeking out an early game powerful weapon at the cost of speed and stealth. You haven’t had the chance to play this new game of Syri’s — it’s hard to keep up with the exact what and why of the action, but it barely takes more than a couple minutes from the match’s beginning before the exhibition hall thunders with the roar of simulated gunfire and explosions. Firefights break out between players and legions of mindless robots on the planet’s surface, filling experience bars and grabbing ever-stronger weapons. There’s a lot of buildup, flashy and loud, before any of the players ever meet each other. The ‘nuki and leithan are the first to have hard contact: the tacti-taur gallops headlong into a withering hail of plasma bolts coming from the ruins of a building, leaning into his shields’ protection until he can close the distance and launch a rocket into the windows. By the time he realizes that was only an auto-turret, [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the kui-tan] has already jumped on his back from behind and unloaded her weapon into his skull. His avatar collapses in an exaggerated pile of gore, only to receive the customary teabagging before his slayer slips back into the shadows. “First blood! And plenty of it!” the MC laughs. The leithan pulls his headset off and spikes it into the stage, swearing up a storm as he canters off. [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the kui-tan] grins sadistically, thrusting her massive nads at his backside ‘till he’s off stage. Your girl gets the second frag just a few moments later, though it’s far less visually impressive. Another player, a particularly lengthy naga, gets herself pinned down by a legion of the kill-bot NPCs. She takes just enough fire to drop her shields, pushing her to break contact, but the second she’s safely in cover from the robots, her avatar ragdolls onto the deck with a smoking crater in an eye. The readout of “KILLED BY BLASTMASTER1” flashing on her HUD is the only clue as to what happened — that, and watching Syri’s hands mime the motion of racking a sniper rifle’s bolt. “Ice cold!” the MC announces. “She never knew what hit her!” [var0 |“Wait is that seriously still her tag?” Anno groans beside you, munching popcorn. “I told her that was lame when we were in elementary school. Whatever. Let’s do the thing!” ] [flags.SYRI_CHEER |You hop up and cheer, jumping around and shouting Syri’s name. The ravenette glances up your way and smiles, pumping her fist and wagging her tail.[var0 | And then her eyes just about pop out of her head when she sees your backup, tits bouncing under straining fabric. ] ] “Go Syri, Go! Goooooo Syri!” Your gamer-pup’s cheeks flush red when several other members of the crowd join in, cheering her precision kill on. But there’s still plenty more carnage left to wreak on that virtual world, and judging from the screens rotating over the stage, the players are all starting to close in on each other. "

rows.original: It’s a free for all deathmatch, last man standing wins — and the longer the match goes on, the fewer players are left standing. One by one, competitors are worn down and eliminated by other players. Nobody suffers the ignominious end of death to NPCs, at least, but once the players start closing in on each other, the gaps between thunderous bursts of virtual violence grow shorter and shorter. Half the players are eliminated by the 20 minute mark, by which time it becomes clear that Syri and [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki-girl ] are in a league of their own compared to the others. The two of them have nearly all the kills split evenly between them, methodically hunting down and slaying player after player. Syri only pulls ahead at the climax of a four-way firefight. [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |The kui-tan ] is using the same turret-and-flank attack on a pair of players that had seemingly partnered up, scoring a couple of kills by tag-teaming. They’d wised up to the turret trick, too, working together to silence the automatic cannon without leaving themselves open to a back attack. They manage to fight off their shortstack aggressor, leaving her to escape with just a few points of health left. But the paired-up victors are so weakened from the fight that they have no answer for Syri leaping into the middle of them from the ruins overhead, firing wildly into one of the pair. His shields pop, then so does his skull, before his partner can twist around to engage the new threat. By the time he gets his machinegun to his shoulder, Syri’s already ducked in and jammed a knife into his armpit, earning an instant fatality. [var0 |“One, two, three, four, Syri’s got the high score! Get ready to go down in defeat, cause we know our pup can’t be beat! She’s Syri! S-Y-R-I! Gooooooo Syri!” ] The crowd goes wild at the double kill, cheering raucously. Syri pumps a fist into the air and flashes you a wolf’s grin. [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |The kui-tan ], though, nearly tears her headset off in frustration. “Kill-stealer!” “It’s last man standing, shortstack, what’re you complaining about?” Syri laughs back. “I’m just gettin’ us both closer to winning.” “We’ll see about that!” There’s barely any competition left after that. Every kill gets harder, more tense, but the two canids are clearly above and beyond the other players. It’s only a few minutes left until it’s just the two of them left, playing a deadly game of cat and mouse through a maze of industrial ruins. They exchange fire until their shields fall, then pull back to recover, evading the dominant player’s pursuit until the tables turn. The announcer is just as on edge as the audience, giving a breathless play-by-play you barely hear — your attention is totally taken up by the supersized version of Syri’s screen floating overhead, watching her duck and weave between cover points while exchanging fire with the ‘nuki girl and her techno toys.[var1 | It damn well reminds you of fighting Captain Khorgan and her mech, leaping between points of cover while rockets rained down on you. ] With no fear for her real-life person, though, both girls are willing to take nail-biting jumps and dives to inch closer to her rival. [var0 |“Come on Syri, she’s our girl, if she can’t frag ‘em nobody can!” ] And then it comes to a head: [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] makes it to the top of the ruins first, scattering her remaining load of traps and tech constructs behind her as she seizes the high ground. Syri walks into a hellacious cascade of crossfires and explosions a second later, tumbling into cover behind a rusted pillar. Your fingers whiten around the arms of your seat when her shields pop, but the virtual pup manages to get out of the line of fire before she’s taken down. Shit, she’s getting too reckless! She’s gonna- Syri shouts a curse, slamming another magazine into her rifle. [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |The kui-tan ] just smirks wickedly, calling across the stage, “Come on, kill stealer, what’re you afraid of? A little shortstack like me?” Syri growls, leaning into her cover. “I’m just afraid of making you run crying back to your mommy. Is this all you got?” Gunfire erupts again, kicking up a duststorm around your pup. Her screen’s obscured by dust and plasma explosions, tinting red as her health plummets. The action is confused for a moment — not just for the audience, but for [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] as well. The kui-tan curses and unloads everything she has into Syri’s cover, closing in for the kill while her weapon belches plasma nonstop. You recognize Syri’s ploy the moment before she executes it — the same one she’s favored in her first matches against you all the way back on Mhen’ga. While [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] is focused on the dust-wreathed rubble, searching for any sign of a surviving ausar... [flags.SYRI_CHEER|and she’s so absorbed in the search that by the time she realizes Syri’s nowhere to be found, a gun barrel’s pressed into the back of her head. “Good game!” Syri shouts over the blast. The MC howls with delight. “Absolutely outta nowhere!” The audience goes wild with applause and shouts of adoration[var0 |, helped along by Syri’s personal cheer squad of course ]. Her final opponent throws her headset off in frustration, snarling about cheating dogs — but that unladylike pouch in the front of her jeans seems quite a bit weightier now, jiggling as she storms off the stage. Syri shrugs and pulls up her visor, turning her attention to you with a great big wolf’s grin. She pumps her fist in the air, triggering another eruption of cheering from the audience... but you know her eyes are only on you. |in a moment of finely honed experience her character hocks a grenade at a nearby wall and takes off into a dead sprint with no warning, the explosive landing right back where she was stood only moments ago... right at Syri’s feet. There’s just enough time to register what the fuck just happened before it explodes to fill every inch of the display tracking Syri’s view. “Gee-fucking-gee!” [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the ‘nuki] shouts over the blast. The MC howls with delight. “Holy shit, what a read!” The audience goes wild with applause and shouts of adoration. The frustration is palpable in Syri’s face the instant she slips up the front of her visor, the pain of being so fucking close to victory and having it snatched away in a moment of near omnipotent game-sense from her opponent. [var2|Anno crashes into her side and snatches her sis up with a smothering hug, easing her out of the tournament-issued gear and giving[var3| all of| both of] you a chance to|You] sidle out of one of the side doors near the stage to escape the crowd thrumming closer around the stage. [var4|Syri comes bursting through behind you only a scant few seconds later. She|Syri] seems dejected, but still chipper, if the lazy drape of her tail slowly picking up an energetic to-ing and fro-ing has anything to say about it.]
rows.translation: 这是一场所有人互相厮杀的死亡竞赛，最后存活者获胜——而比赛持续得越久，仍站着的玩家就越少。参赛者一个接一个被其他玩家消耗、淘汰。至少没人耻辱地死在非玩家角色手里，但当玩家们开始彼此接近，虚拟暴力震耳欲聋的爆发间隔也变得越来越短。到二十分钟时，已有一半玩家遭到淘汰；这时已经很明显，希莉和[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名‘狸猫姑娘’ ]与其他人完全不在同一水平。几乎所有击杀都由她们两人平分，她们有条不紊地追猎并杀死一个又一个玩家。 直到一场四方交火的高潮，希莉才取得领先。[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名奎坦人 ]正对两名似乎已经结盟的玩家采用同样的炮塔加包抄战术；那两人通过联手击杀，已经拿到了几个人头。他们也吸取了炮塔花招的教训，齐心协力让自动火炮哑火，同时又不给敌人从背后攻击的机会。他们成功击退了这个矮个子袭击者，迫使她在只剩几点生命值的情况下逃走。但这对胜利者也在战斗中被削弱得太厉害，根本无力应对希莉从头顶废墟跃入他们中间，对其中一人疯狂开火。那人的护盾爆裂，随后头骨也同样炸开；他的同伴甚至来不及转身迎战新的威胁。等他终于将机枪举到肩头，希莉已经俯身逼近，将刀捅进他的腋窝，直接取得致命击杀。 [var0 |“一、二、三、四， 希莉得分冲到最高值！ 准备迎接惨败吧， 我们的小狗无人能敌！ 她是希莉！S-Y-R-I！ 希莉——冲啊！” ] 观众因这次双杀而疯狂，发出喧闹的欢呼。希莉一拳举向空中，朝你露出狼一般的笑容。 [flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名奎坦人 ]则气得差点扯下头戴设备。“抢人头！” “这是最后一人生还赛，小矮子，你在抱怨什么？”希莉笑着回敬道，“我只是让咱俩都更接近胜利而已。” “那就走着瞧！” 此后几乎再也没有值得一提的竞争。每次击杀都变得更困难、更紧张，但这两名犬科姑娘显然远远凌驾于其他玩家。仅仅几分钟后，场上便只剩下她们两人，在工业废墟构成的迷宫中展开致命的猫鼠游戏。她们相互交火，直到护盾倒下，随后后撤恢复；一方躲避占据优势者的追击，直到局势逆转。 播报员和观众一样紧张，以几乎喘不过气的速度逐招解说，而你几乎什么也没听进去——你的注意力完全被悬浮在头顶、放大数倍的希莉屏幕吸引，看着她一边与狸猫姑娘及其科技玩具交火，一边在各处掩体间闪躲穿行。[var1 |这他妈简直让你想起了与科尔甘船长及其机甲战斗的经历：火箭从天而降，而你在一处处掩体间跳跃。 ]不过，由于不必担心现实中的身体，两名姑娘都愿意做出令人屏息的跳跃和飞扑，一点点逼近对手。 [var0 |“加油，希莉，她是咱们的姑娘， 如果她都不能爆头，没人能做到！” ] 接着，决战终于来临：[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名狸猫姑娘 ]率先登上废墟顶端，将剩余的陷阱和科技造物一路散布在身后，抢占高地。一秒之后，希莉便踏入一片可怕的交叉火力与爆炸瀑布中，翻滚着躲到一根锈蚀立柱后。她的护盾爆裂时，你紧抓座椅扶手的手指也因用力而发白，但虚拟小狗还是在被击倒前逃出了火力线。该死，她越来越鲁莽了！她要—— 希莉大骂一声，将另一只弹匣猛地拍进步枪。[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名奎坦人 ]只是邪恶地冷笑着，隔着舞台喊道：“来啊，抢人头的，你在怕什么？怕我这个小矮子吗？” 希莉低吼着，紧贴掩体。“我只是怕把你弄哭，让你跑回去找妈妈。这就是你的全部本事？” 枪火再次爆发，在你的小狗周围掀起一场尘暴。她的屏幕被尘土和等离子爆炸遮蔽，随着生命值骤降而染成红色。一时间，战况变得混乱——不只观众看不明白，[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名狸猫姑娘 ]也同样如此。奎坦人咒骂着，将手中一切火力倾泻到希莉的掩体上；武器不断喷出等离子体，她也一步步逼近，准备完成击杀。 希莉执行战术前一瞬，你便认出了她的计谋——早在门加与你进行最初几场对战时，她便偏爱同一招。当[flags.CHRISSY_MET |克丽丝 |那名狸猫姑娘 ]全神贯注于被尘土笼罩的瓦砾，寻找仍然存活的奥萨尔人踪迹时... [flags.SYRI_CHEER|她太过专注于搜索，以至于等她意识到希莉早已不见踪影时，一支枪管已经抵在了她后脑。 “打得好！”希莉在爆炸声中喊道。 主持人兴奋地嚎叫起来。“完全是凭空冒出来的！” 观众爆发疯狂的掌声与爱慕的呼喊[var0 |——当然，希莉的私人啦啦队也帮了不少忙 ]。她最后的对手沮丧地甩掉头戴设备，咆哮着骂她是作弊狗——不过她牛仔裤正面那个不太淑女的鼓包如今似乎沉重了许多；她怒气冲冲走下舞台时，那东西也在不停晃动。希莉耸耸肩，掀起面罩，带着灿烂的狼式笑容将注意力转向你。她一拳举向空中，再度引爆观众的欢呼...但你知道，她的目光只落在你身上。 |凭借千锤百炼的经验，她的角色突然朝附近墙壁掷出一枚手榴弹，毫无预兆地拔腿狂奔；爆炸物反弹回她片刻前站立的位置...正好落在希莉脚边。 你刚来得及理解到底发生了什么，它便轰然爆炸，将追踪希莉视角的整块显示屏全部填满。 “真——他妈——的——精彩！”[flags.CHRISSY_MET|克丽丝|那名狸猫姑娘]隔着爆炸声喊道。 主持人兴奋地嚎叫起来。“我操，她完全看穿了！” 观众爆发疯狂的掌声与爱慕的呼喊。希莉掀起面罩前部的瞬间，挫败清楚写在脸上；胜利已经他妈的如此接近，却被对手近乎全知的游戏意识在刹那间夺走，令她痛苦不已。[var2|安诺撞到她身旁，一把将妹妹抱进令人窒息的怀抱，帮她脱下赛事配发的装备，也给了[var3|你们所有人|你们两人]机会从舞台附近的一扇侧门|你]悄悄溜走，避开不断向舞台周围涌来的观众。[var4|仅仅几秒后，希莉便从你身后冲了出来。她|希莉]看起来有些沮丧，但依然精神不错——如果那条懒洋洋垂着、随后逐渐开始充满活力地来回摇摆的尾巴能说明什么的话。]

By the time he gets his machinegun to his shoulder, Syri’s already ducked in and jammed a knife into his armpit, earning an instant fatality. [var0 |“One, two, three, four, Syri’s got the high score! Get ready to go down in defeat, cause we know our pup can’t be beat! She’s Syri! S-Y-R-I! Gooooooo Syri!” ] The crowd goes wild at the double kill, cheering raucously. Syri pumps a fist into the air and flashes you a wolf’s grin. [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |The kui-tan ], though, nearly tears her headset off in frustration. “Kill-stealer!” “It’s last man standing, shortstack, what’re you complaining about?” Syri laughs back. “I’m just gettin’ us both closer to winning.” “We’ll see about that!” There’s barely any competition left after that. Every kill gets harder, more tense, but the two canids are clearly above and beyond the other players. It’s only a few minutes left until it’s just the two of them left, playing a deadly game of cat and mouse through a maze of industrial ruins. They exchange fire until their shields fall, then pull back to recover, evading the dominant player’s pursuit until the tables turn. The announcer is just as on edge as the audience, giving a breathless play-by-play you barely hear — your attention is totally taken up by the supersized version of Syri’s screen floating overhead, watching her duck and weave between cover points while exchanging fire with the ‘nuki girl and her techno toys.[var1 | It damn well reminds you of fighting Captain Khorgan and her mech, leaping between points of cover while rockets rained down on you. ] With no fear for her real-life person, though, both girls are willing to take nail-biting jumps and dives to inch closer to her rival. [var0 |“Come on Syri, she’s our girl, if she can’t frag ‘em nobody can!” ] And then it comes to a head: [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] makes it to the top of the ruins first, scattering her remaining load of traps and tech constructs behind her as she seizes the high ground. Syri walks into a hellacious cascade of crossfires and explosions a second later, tumbling into cover behind a rusted pillar. Your fingers whiten around the arms of your seat when her shields pop, but the virtual pup manages to get out of the line of fire before she’s taken down. Shit, she’s getting too reckless! She’s gonna- Syri shouts a curse, slamming another magazine into her rifle. [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |The kui-tan ] just smirks wickedly, calling across the stage, “Come on, kill stealer, what’re you afraid of? A little shortstack like me?” Syri growls, leaning into her cover. “I’m just afraid of making you run crying back to your mommy. Is this all you got?” Gunfire erupts again, kicking up a duststorm around your pup. Her screen’s obscured by dust and plasma explosions, tinting red as her health plummets. The action is confused for a moment — not just for the audience, but for [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] as well. The kui-tan curses and unloads everything she has into Syri’s cover, closing in for the kill while her weapon belches plasma nonstop. You recognize Syri’s ploy the moment before she executes it — the same one she’s favored in her first matches against you all the way back on Mhen’ga. While [flags.CHRISSY_MET |Chrissy |the ‘nuki girl ] is focused on the dust-wreathed rubble, searching for any sign of a surviving ausar... [flags.SYRI_CHEER|and she’s so absorbed in the search that by the time she realizes Syri’s nowhere to be found, a gun barrel’s pressed into the back of her head. “Good game!” Syri shouts over the blast. The MC howls with delight. “Absolutely outta nowhere!” The audience goes wild with applause and shouts of adoration[var0 |, helped along by Syri’s personal cheer squad of course ]. Her final opponent throws her headset off in frustration, snarling about cheating dogs — but that unladylike pouch in the front of her jeans seems quite a bit weightier now, jiggling as she storms off the stage. Syri shrugs and pulls up her visor, turning her attention to you with a great big wolf’s grin. She pumps her fist in the air, triggering another eruption of cheering from the audience... but you know her eyes are only on you. |in a moment of finely honed experience her character hocks a grenade at a nearby wall and takes off into a dead sprint with no warning, the explosive landing right back where she was stood only moments ago... right at Syri’s feet. There’s just enough time to register what the fuck just happened before it explodes to fill every inch of the display tracking Syri’s view. “Gee-fucking-gee!” [flags.CHRISSY_MET|Chrissy|the ‘nuki] shouts over the blast. The MC howls with delight. “Holy shit, what a read!” The audience goes wild with applause and shouts of adoration. The frustration is palpable in Syri’s face the instant she slips up the front of her visor, the pain of being so fucking close to victory and having it snatched away in a moment of near omnipotent game-sense from her opponent. [var2|Anno crashes into her side and snatches her sis up with a smothering hug, easing her out of the tournament-issued gear and giving[var3| all of| both of] you a chance to|You] sidle out of one of the side doors near the stage to escape the crowd thrumming closer around the stage. [var4|Syri comes bursting through behind you only a scant few seconds later. She|Syri] seems dejected, but still chipper, if the lazy drape of her tail slowly picking up an energetic to-ing and fro-ing has anything to say about it.] "

rows.original: Several scantily-clad stage bunnies come out with a trophy and bags of swag, loading Syri down with bling before she’s escorted off the stage and into a little gaggle of gaming press. You slip out of the crowd while you can[anno.isCrew |, followed shortly by Anno[flags.KAEDE_MET_ON_UVETO | and Kaede ] ], heading towards the door she’d gone through to get backstage. Syri emerges a few minutes later, tail still wagging hard with the adrenalin from her clutch play at the end there. She’s beaming radiantly, holding her faux-gold trophy to her chest. The moment Syri sees you, her free hand sweeps you up into a great big hug that very quickly becomes a passionate, tongue-filled kiss. [var0 |[var1 |Anno and Kaede clap |Anno claps ], piling into the hug as soon as there’s an opening. ]You hold Syri tight, gushing out your congratulations and laughing as her cheeks flush with that familiar mix of pride and embarrassment. “Aww, it was... no it wasn’t nothing. That was about the hardest fuckin’ game I ever played. If I hadn’t [flags.SYRI_CHEER |had you there to motivate me |gotten all that practice with you ], Steele, I’d have been dead meat.” “No, you’re great-” “Shh. I’m serious. If I didn’t have you lighting a fire under my ass I’d probably still be sitting around on Mhen’ga putting bridges together for Pyrite. Now I’m a champion[silly | of the arena! Now I just need to collect my complementary adoring shortstack and I’m set. ]! Those pressers were asking me when I was competing next — when and where I stream. I don’t even stream! Some guy from VidyaMonster shoved a card in my hand and told me to call his office about sponsorships! Holy wow.” “Seems like everything’s turning up Syri, then!” [var0 |“I’m so proud of you, little sister!” Anno squeals, going in for another hug. “You’re in the big leagues now!” ] [var1 |Kaede grins. “Way to go, Syri, that was awesome! You deserve this!” “Aww, thanks, Red.” ] Syri sighs, planting her paws on your shoulders. “Okay. I am... gonna go pass out, now. Didn’t get a wink of sleep last night... heh, watch out, world, next time I might just show up well-rested!” Yeah, the world’s gonna tremble before her alright. Just after a power nap. She nods. “Damn right. Swing by the bar in a bit... after I’ve caught some shut eye, I owe you a dinner with some of these winnings!” [var0 |“What about me?” Anno whines, tail wagging expectantly. Syri grabs her sister around the waist, pulling her in. “You... get the best sister in the galaxy trophy for showing up in that outfit. God damn. I’ll talk to you real soon, okay? For real this time.” “I’ll hold you to it!” ] “Now... I’ve got to find somewhere to put this thing!” Syri laughs, hefting up her trophy. “Maybe find somewhere in this new streaming setup thing they’re trying to get me into...”
rows.translation: 几名衣着暴露的舞台兔女郎带着奖杯和几袋赠品走出来，给希莉挂上一大堆闪亮饰品，随后护送她离开舞台，进入一小群游戏媒体记者之中。你趁机溜出人群[anno.isCrew |，安诺不久后也跟了上来[flags.KAEDE_MET_ON_UVETO |，还有枫 ] ]，前往她先前走入后台的那扇门。几分钟后，希莉现身了；最后那次关键操作带来的肾上腺素仍令她的尾巴用力摇摆。她容光焕发，将仿金奖杯抱在胸前。希莉一看见你，空着的手便将你揽入一个大大的拥抱，而这个拥抱很快就变成了充满舌头的热烈亲吻。 [var0 |[var1 |安诺和枫鼓起掌来 |安诺鼓起掌来 ]，一有空隙便挤进这个拥抱之中。 ]你紧紧抱住希莉，滔滔不绝地祝贺她；她的脸颊因那种熟悉的骄傲与尴尬交织而泛红，让你笑了起来。“啊，那没什么...不，那绝不是什么小事。那大概是我这辈子打过最他妈艰难的一局。要不是[flags.SYRI_CHEER |有你在场激励我 |和你一起进行了那么多练习 ]，斯蒂尔，我早就死透了。” “不，是你自己厉害——” “嘘。我是认真的。要不是你在我屁股底下点起一把火，我现在大概还坐在门加给黄铁矿工业拼装桥梁。如今我可是冠军[silly |——竞技场的冠军！现在只要领取免费附赠的矮个崇拜者，我就圆满了。 ]！那些记者还在问我下一次什么时候参赛——什么时候、在哪里直播。我根本就不直播！一个电玩怪兽的家伙往我手里塞了张名片，让我打电话去他办公室谈赞助！天哪。” “看来所有好事都落到希莉头上了！” [var0 |“我太为你骄傲了，妹妹！”安诺尖声喊道，又冲上去抱了一次。“你现在进入顶级联赛了！” ] [var1 |枫咧嘴笑道。“干得漂亮，希莉，刚才太厉害了！这是你应得的！” “啊，谢谢你，红毛。” ] 希莉叹了口气，将双爪搭在你肩膀上。“好了。我...现在要去昏睡了。昨晚一刻都没合眼...嘿，世界小心了，下次我或许会休息充足地登场！” 对，她肯定会让世界在面前颤抖。只要先小睡一会儿充充电。 她点点头。“当然。过一阵子来酒吧找我...等我睡一会儿之后。我欠你一顿晚餐，就用这些奖金请客！” [var0 |“那我呢？”安诺抱怨道，尾巴满怀期待地摇摆着。 希莉一把搂住姐姐的腰，将她拉近。“你嘛...穿着那套衣服赶来，当然能获得银河系最佳姐姐奖杯。老天，真他妈绝了。我很快就会找你聊天，好吗？这次说真的。” “我可记住了！” ] “现在...我得找个地方放这东西！”希莉大笑着举起奖杯。“或许能在他们想让我使用的那套新直播设备上找个位置...”

rows.original: You give Syri a big grin. For her, this is the least you’re willing to do. She pumps a fist into the air so hard that she hops off the deck entirely, wagging her tail and throwing her arms around your neck on the way down. “You’re the best! And the sexiest! C’mon, let’s get your [pc.mf|suited up|dolled up] and jet. I gotta be down there in like 20 minutes.” Lucky her you’re just an elevator ride away. Syri pulls your new top over your arms from behind, taking the opportunity to feel up your [pc.chest] before the gets your new shirt snugly fit around it. It’s a perfect fit... well, maybe a little tight, but that just shows off your body all the more. You tell her she ought to be careful — she needs to keep her attention on the games, not her personal cheer squad in stands. “Come on, you know me better than that,” Syri huffs, sticking her tongue out. “I’m gonna bring home the gold, don’t you doubt it for a second!” You don’t doubt her for a second.
