“我真高兴你来了！”她微笑着，用双手握住你的手。“天啊，我睡得像块木头。刚走进酒店房门就一头栽倒了。醒来时，我的个人终端简直要爆炸了。消息多得不得了...[syri.isLover |但老实说，我脑子里想的全是你。” 希莉凑过来亲吻，你欣然回应...尤其当你感觉她的双手滑向背后，手指陷入[pc.butt]时，更是如此。你紧紧抱住心爱的小狗，心头怦然悸动。 |我甚至完全数不过来。就像...这么多年以后，我终于真正存在于世了。太疯狂了。” ] 希莉叹了口气，靠在吧台桌边，尾巴轻轻摇摆。“我不知道接下来该怎么办。有人给我提供赞助，想让我在不参赛时开始直播——而且他们还想让我参加更多比赛，这点你尽管相信。我还在努力理清这一切。不过，有一件事我确实知道：你一路赶来，还给了我获胜所需的信心，我欠你一顿晚餐。来吧，我在火车站附近找到一家可爱的小店，供应正宗泰伦汉堡。” 虽然算不上最浪漫的菜肴，但她已经很努力了。你跟着[flags.SYRI_CHEER|凯旋而归的|差一点凯旋的]小狗，快步穿过雪地，来到城门火车站旁的一家乡村咖啡馆；距离正好足够远，让希莉有借口贴近你，用胳膊搂住你取暖。她让你坐下，等女服务员记下饮料后，便骄傲地宣布只需要一张账单。 你们安静闲聊，直到饮料和食物相继送来。等待期间，希莉很想听你的冒险故事，让你讲述自很久以前初次降落门加以来，在边疆亲眼见证的所有精彩经历。 不过，在大口咬下一块半生汉堡后，她把剩下的汽水一饮而尽，滔滔不绝地说了起来。“所以！现在决战结束了，展会为我们包下的酒店也很快会退掉房间。没关系，反正用他们那破烂的外联网连接，我也根本搭不起直播！” “那你接下来打算怎么办[syri.isLover |，亲爱的 ]？” 希莉靠回椅背，像头饥饿的狼一样打量着你。“嗯，我现在算是居无定所。我已经退掉了门加的住处。随时都能回去——其实我还挺喜欢那地方，懂吧？甚至可以再给黄铁工业做外包，挣些外快。或者...” 你向前倾身[syri.isLover |，心脏怦怦直跳。来吧，希莉.. ]。“或者？” “嗯，我不必被固定在银河地图上的任何地方。只要能在比如说某艘豪华星舰上有个房间，直播本来就是走到哪儿都能做的事。最好还是由一位[pc.mf |健壮 |火辣 ]的[pc.race]船长掌舵，而我恰好对其勃起得[silly |[pc.isFeminine |又弯 ] ]不得了。不知道你能不能向我推荐什么...” |你离希莉还有十步远，酒精与未清洗毛发的臭味便扑面而来；当你走近趴在老位置桌上的小狗时，罪魁祸首一目了然：她周围堆起一座空啤酒瓶城堡，数量多到哈娜显然已经放弃收拾。 你走过去，把一只手放在希莉肩上；至少这让她的深色尾巴振作起来。尾巴犹豫地摇了几下，主人则呻吟着用手肘撑起身体。“嘿呀，屌包，”她口齿不清地说，双眼几乎斗到一起。“你来干什么？来看失败者的笑话？” “失败者？看来你没赢，是吧？” 醉醺醺的小狗只是怒目而视。是啊，这绝不是胜者的眼神。 希莉的耳朵贴在凌乱的头发上，她叹了口气。“差一点...最后差一点就赢了，直到那边那个狸猫小婊子把我逼进死角。到处都是等离子体，什么都看不见。我...像只小狗一样慌了，提前打光弹药。操她。全都去他妈的。这下知道我有多没用了。连他妈一场游戏都撑不住...” 希莉抬起一条胳膊，似乎还想再骂，却没能继续。她发出一声响亮且毫无淑女风范的饱嗝，整个人泄了气；爪子碰倒一只啤酒瓶后，又把脸埋回原先的臂弯。可怜的姑娘。你滑进她旁边的座位，安慰地拍了拍肩膀。“[pc.isAss |好吧，继续练习。你会变得更强。让她为这次踢你屁股付出代价。 |能一路打进最后关头已经很厉害了！别为此责怪自己。 ]” “你说起来倒轻松，[pc.mf |太空英雄先生 |太空英雄女士 ]。” 是啊，是啊。你招手叫来一名服务员，请她处理一下这座空瓶堡垒，随后重新专心安慰犬科同伴。她宿醉得太严重，从那以后，大多数含糊的半句回答都是从双臂下传来的，她正用手臂遮挡酒馆的光线。不过，接下来几分钟里，你设法让她透露：乌维托锦标赛结束后，希莉将返回门加。看来，亚军奖金只够支付返程和这场狂饮。 “打算给黄铁工业那个混蛋打电话，看看能不能拿回工作，”她叹息道。“呃，肯定能。除了我，他妈还能去哪里找这种水平的书呆子...” 好吧，真遗憾；不过，总有一天希莉肯定还会得到追求名利的机会。至于现在，以她这种状态，你也问不出更多东西了。等回到门加，就能见到清醒的她，对吧？ ]
rows.raw: " [flags.SYRI_SUPPORT |“[pc.name]!” You’re nearly knocked off your feet by an incoming hug, propelled back by a fiercely-wagging raven tail. Syri nuzzles in, fluffy arms clutched around your waist[pc.isBiped| as she spins you around]. Aww. You return the embrace, [pc.mf |laughing |giggling ] into your lover’s mane of dark hair. “I’m glad you came!” she smiles, taking your hands in hers. “God, I slept like a log. Barely made it through my hotel door before I face-planted. And my Codex was just exploding when I woke up. So many messages... [syri.isLover |but honestly, all I’ve been thinking about is you.” Syri goes in for a kiss, which you happily reciprocate... even more so when you feel her hands sliding down your back, fingers sinking into your [pc.butt]. Your heart flutters as you hold your beloved pup tight. |I can’t even keep track of it all. It’s like... like I finally exist at all after all these years. It’s crazy.” ] Syri sighs, leaning back against the bar table and wagging her tail. “I don’t know what’s next for me now. People are offering me sponsorships, trying to get me to start streaming when I’m not competing — and they want me to compete more, you better believe it. I’m still trying to sort it all out. What I do know, though, is that I owe you dinner for coming all the way out here and giving me the confidence I needed to win. C’mon, I found a cute little place down by the train station that serves authentic Terran hamburgers.” Not the most romantic of cuisines, but she’s trying. You follow your [flags.SYRI_CHEER|victorious|near-victorious] pup through a quick jaunt in the snow to a rustic cafe beside the station at the town gates, just far enough away that Syri has an excuse to press in and put her arm around you for warmth. She sits you down and, once the waitress has taken your drink orders, proudly announces that it’ll just be one check. The two of you make quiet smalltalk until your drinks, and then food, have been brought out. Syri’s eager to talk about your adventures while you wait, letting you recount all the excitement you’ve gotten to see on the frontier since you first landed on Mhen’ga so long ago. Once she’s gotten a faceful of rare burger, though, she chugs down the rest of her soda and launches off. “So! Now that the big showdown’s over, the hotel the con rented out for us is gonna be closing out our rooms pretty soon. Which is fine, it’s not like I can really set up a streaming thing with their shitty extranet connection anyway!” “So what’s next for you then[syri.isLover |, my love ]?” Syri leans back in her chair, looking you over like a hungry wolf. “Well. I’m kind of between homes right now. I closed out my place on Mhen’ga. Could always go back — actually kind of like the place, you know? Could even make some spare cash contracting with Pyrite again. Or...” You lean forward[syri.isLover |, heart throbbing. Come on, Syri.. ]. “Or?” “Well, I don’t need to be tied down anywhere on the galaxy map. Streaming’s kind of a go-anywhere thing as long as I’ve got a room on, say, a swanky starship. Preferably the kind captained by a [pc.mf |hunky |hot ] [pc.race] that I just have the biggest[silly |[pc.isFeminine |, gayest ] ] boner for. Was hoping you might have some recommendations for me...” |You’re assaulted by the reek of alcohol and unwashed fur while you’re still ten paces back from Syri, and as you draw closer to where the pup’s face-down on her usual table, you can clearly see the culprits: she’s surrounded by a castle of empty beer bottles, so many that Hana’s apparently given up on cleaning them off. You walk over and put a hand on Syri’s shoulder, which prompts her dark tail to perk up, at least. It gives a couple of hesitant wags as its owner groans, pushing herself up onto her elbows. “Heyya, dickbag,” she slurs, eyes half-crossed. “What’re you doin’ here? Come to laugh at the failure?” “Failure? Guess you didn’t win, huh?” The drunken pup just glowers. Yeah, not the look of a winner. Syri’s ears flatten against her messy hair and sighs. “Got so close... so close at the end there, ‘till this little tanuki bitch over there cornered me. Plasma everywhere. Couldn’t see shit. I... panicked like a puppy and shot my wad early. Fuck ‘er. Fuck it all. Shows what a lotta good I am. Can’t even keep it together in a fuckin’ game...” Syri makes to curse again, raising one of her arms, but can’t follow through. She deflates with a loud and unladylike belch, flicking one of the beer bottles over with a claw before planting her face back in her arms whence it came. Poor girl. You slide into the seat next to her and give her a reassuring pat on the shoulder. “[pc.isAss |Well, keep practicing. You’ll get better. Make her pay for kicking your ass this time. |Making it all the way to the end is pretty good! Don’t beat yourself up about it. ]” “Easy for you to say, [pc.mf |mister |miss ] space hero.” Yeah, yeah. You wave a waitress over and ask her to do something about fort empty-bottle here, then return your attentions to comforting your canine companion. She’s so hungover that most of her grumbled half-answers from that point on are made from under her arms, shielding her eyes from the tavern’s light. But over the next several minutes, you manage to coax out of her that now that she’s finished at the Uveto tournament, Syri is heading back the Mhen’ga. Her second-place winnings will just cover her trip back and her bender, it seems. “Gonna call that jackass at Pyrite, see if I can get my job back,” she sighs. “Ehhh sure I can. Where the fuck else is he gonna get a nerd of my caliber...” Well, that’s a shame, but surely Syri’ll get another chance at fame and glory someday. In the meantime, you aren’t going to get much more out of her in this state. You can find her sobered up back on Mhen’ga, right? ] "

rows.original: You happen to know a spacer that perfectly fits your gamer-girl’s bill. “How about you move in with me, then?” Syri has to clap her hands over her mouth to keep from squealing, but her tail wags hard enough that everyone in the cafe still ends up staring. A dark blush creeps into view between her fingers before she finally regains enough composure to speak. “Y-you really mean it?” “Of course I do.” She can’t contain the joyous squeal this time, kicking her feet and wagging her tail and just about knocking over everything on the table in her hurry to lean over and grab you up into a big kiss. “Oh god oh fuck I love you yesssssss!” “Okay!” she gasps, flopping back into her chair. “Right. I uh, I gotta go... go pack my stuff. Thank you, [pc.name]. I can’t wait to... to start really living. No more of this stupid engineering crap living in a prefab bunker all by myself. Now for the first time I’ve got some money, a career about to start, and most importantly, my best fuckin’ friend in the whole galaxy wants me by [pc.hisHer] side. Ah, I feel like I ought to go howl at the moon like some kinda cavewoman haha.” “Alright, alright. How about we get the bill and get out of here?” “Hey, I’m getting the bill. But yeah. I’ll meet you at the ship as soon as I can. Don’t leave without me!” “Never.”
rows.translation: 你恰好认识一名完美符合这位游戏女孩要求的太空客。“那你搬来和我一起住怎么样？” 希莉不得不用双手捂住嘴，才忍住尖叫；但尾巴摇得如此剧烈，咖啡馆里的每个人最后还是全都看了过来。深深的红晕从她指间显露，过了好一会儿，她才重新镇定到足以开口。“你——你是认真的吗？” “当然是。” 这次她再也抑制不住欢快的尖叫，双脚乱踢，尾巴狂摇；她匆忙俯身把你拉入一个深吻，差点撞翻桌上的一切。“哦天啊，操，我爱你，是ssssssss的！” “好！”她喘息着跌坐回椅子。“对。我，呃，我得去...去收拾东西了。谢谢你，[pc.name]。我等不及要...真正开始生活。再也不用一个人住在预制掩体里，干那些愚蠢的工程破事。现在我第一次有了些钱，有一份即将开始的事业；最重要的是，整个银河里最好的他妈朋友希望我陪在[pc.hisHer]身边。啊，我觉得自己应该像某种洞穴女人那样对着月亮嚎叫，哈哈。” “好了，好了。我们结账离开这里怎么样？” “嘿，账单由我来付。不过没错，我会尽快去飞船找你。别丢下我就走！” “永远不会。”

rows.original: “Not... right now, Syri,” you say.[fullCrew| “My ship’s already full to the brim.”] Syri winces, tail falling limp behind her. “Ah. Oh. Okay. Well, guess it’ll be back to Mhen’ga for me then. Can’t have sold my old place yet, right? I’ll, uh... I’ll see you there sometime, right space cowboy? If you can pry yourself away from the furthest frontiers once in a while you for ol’ pal Syri...” “Of course I will. Wouldn’t have come all this way for you if I couldn’t.” She forces herself to smile, though the let-down’s still clear on her face. “Yeah, I know. I just... y’know. A girl can dream.” Syri falls glumly silent for a while, pecking at the rest of her burger. Luckily for you both, a milkshake chaser is enough to brighten her back up, and a big hug gets that tail wagging again before you know it. “Alright,” she sighs, retrieving her credit chit from the waitress’s hand terminal. “I am... gonna go get packed up and head back to Mhen’ga. Next thing you know, I’ll be an all-star streamer! The first in the Fourteenth Rush!” That’s the spirit. You give Syri a parting hug and send her back to her hotel before ducking back into the bar for warmth.
rows.translation: “现在...还不行，希莉，”你说道。[fullCrew| “我的飞船已经塞得满满当当了。”] 希莉畏缩了一下，尾巴无力地垂在身后。“啊。哦。好吧。那我看来要回门加了。我的旧住处还不可能已经卖掉，对吧？我，呃...总有一天会在那里见到你吧，太空牛仔？只要你偶尔能从最遥远的边疆抽身，去看看老朋友希莉...” “当然会。要是做不到，我也不会为你千里迢迢来到这里。” 她强迫自己露出微笑，失望之情却仍清楚写在脸上。“是啊，我知道。我只是...你明白的。女孩总可以做梦。” 希莉沮丧地沉默了一会儿，有一下没一下地吃着剩下的汉堡。幸好对你们俩来说，随后喝下的一杯奶昔足以让她重新振作；一个大大的拥抱也很快就让尾巴再次摇了起来。“好吧，”她叹息道，从服务员的手持终端取回信用点卡。“我...要去收拾东西，然后返回门加。用不了多久，我就会成为全明星主播！第十四次星际大拓荒中的第一人！” 这才像话。你与希莉拥抱道别，送她返回酒店，随后钻回酒吧取暖。

rows.original: You ask the little pink creature about the station itself.
rows.translation: 你向这只粉色小生物询问空间站本身的情况。
rows.raw: "You ask the little pink creature about the station itself."

rows.original: The small creature tilts her head back, taking a deep breath, closing her outermost eyes, then chirping out a brief history.
rows.translation: 小生物仰起脑袋，深吸一口气，闭上最外侧的眼睛，接着啾啾讲出一段简短历史。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe small creature tilts her head back, taking a deep breath, closing her outermost eyes, then chirping out a brief history."

rows.original: “Initial surveys of Uveto VII deemed it a frozen wasteland, but Akkadi Company investigations revealed it to be both rich in minerals and teeming with marine life below its frozen surface. Subsequent mining operations by both Akkadi and Steele Tech have resulted in near-zero-sum gains, as the planet’s inhospitable atmosphere and hitherto undiscovered wildlife makes mining both difficult and dangerous.”
rows.translation: “对乌维托七号的初步勘测认定这里是一片冰封荒原，但阿卡迪公司的调查发现，它不仅矿产丰富，冰封表面下还充满海洋生物。此后，阿卡迪与斯蒂尔科技开展的采矿作业都几乎毫无收益，因为这颗行星恶劣的环境和此前尚未发现的野生动物，让采矿既困难又危险。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Initial surveys of Uveto VII deemed it a frozen wasteland, but Akkadi Company investigations revealed it to be both rich in minerals and teeming with marine life below its frozen surface. Subsequent mining operations by both Akkadi and Steele Tech have resulted in near-zero-sum gains, as the planet’s inhospitable atmosphere and hitherto undiscovered wildlife makes mining both difficult and dangerous.”"

rows.original: “Akkadi offered Steele Tech a contractual buyout, putting Steele Tech in charge of maintenance and mining operations on the planet’s surface, a job that Steele Tech relegated to its partially-owned subsidiary, RhenWorld.”
rows.translation: “阿卡迪向斯蒂尔科技提出合约收购，让斯蒂尔科技负责行星地表的维护与采矿作业；而斯蒂尔科技又把这项工作交给部分持股的子公司雷恩世界。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Akkadi offered Steele Tech a contractual buyout, putting Steele Tech in charge of maintenance and mining operations on the planet’s surface, a job that Steele Tech relegated to its partially-owned subsidiary, RhenWorld.”"

rows.original: “As actual planetfall is dangerous in the extreme, the Camarilla built Uveto Station to facilitate planetary incursion via a retrofitted Wabeship Station, with space elevator access to the planet’s surface. Thanks to the Camarilla, all travellers can come and go as they please!” she says with a smile.
rows.translation: “由于真正登陆行星极其危险，卡玛利拉将一艘韦布舰空间站改造成乌维托空间站，以便通过连接行星地表的太空电梯展开行星探索。多亏卡玛利拉，所有旅行者都能随心所欲地往来！”她微笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“As actual planetfall is dangerous in the extreme, the Camarilla built Uveto Station to facilitate planetary incursion via a retrofitted Wabeship Station, with space elevator access to the planet’s surface. Thanks to the Camarilla, all travellers can come and go as they please!” she says with a smile."

rows.original: Given the mountain of paperwork you navigated to dock here, you’re uncertain if using the station was actually easier. You ask what the Camarilla gets out of it.
rows.translation: 想到自己为了在这里停靠而应付的堆积如山的文件，你不确定使用空间站是否真的更方便。你询问卡玛利拉能从中得到什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nGiven the mountain of paperwork you navigated to dock here, you’re uncertain if using the station was actually easier. You ask what the Camarilla gets out of it."

rows.original: Tlako chirps and smooths down her bustier with all four hands. “In order to maintain Uveto Station, the Camarilla levies a small tax on all incoming and outgoing traffic... with variances based on cargo load,” she adds.
rows.translation: 特拉科啾叫一声，用四只手抚平自己的紧身胸衣。“为了维护乌维托空间站，卡玛利拉会向所有进出交通征收少量税款...并根据货物载量有所调整，”她补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\nTlako chirps and smooths down her bustier with all four hands. “In order to maintain Uveto Station, the Camarilla levies a small tax on all incoming and outgoing traffic... with variances based on cargo load,” she adds."

rows.original: You frown, and she adds in hurriedly. “Primarily for large-scale mining transport. In general, you won’t be charged very much for private transport.”
rows.translation: 你皱起眉头，她连忙补充。“主要针对大型采矿运输。一般而言，私人交通不会被收取太多费用。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou frown, and she adds in hurriedly. “Primarily for large-scale mining transport. In general, you won’t be charged very much for private transport.”"

rows.original: “Here aboard Uveto Station, you can enjoy many of the amenities of a colonized planet. Shops, food, and even, um...” she pulls a small, circular disk from the top of her bustier, scrolling her finger across its screen, “...forniculations are possible here on Uveto Station. Of course, the engineering levels are not accessible for you - as they are built to tove aquatic standards, and exist primarily below the walking deck.”
rows.translation: “在乌维托空间站上，你可以享受殖民行星的许多便利设施。商店、食物，甚至，呃...”她从紧身胸衣顶部取出一枚小圆盘，手指划过屏幕，“...在乌维托空间站上还可以进行性交。当然，工程层不对你开放——那里按照托芙的水栖标准建造，而且主要位于步行甲板下方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Here aboard Uveto Station, you can enjoy many of the amenities of a colonized planet. Shops, food, and even, um...” she pulls a small, circular disk from the top of her bustier, scrolling her finger across its screen, “...forniculations are possible here on Uveto Station. Of course, the engineering levels are not accessible for you - as they are built to tove aquatic standards, and exist primarily below the walking deck.”"

rows.original: You ask Tlako about the Camarilla.
rows.translation: 你向特拉科询问卡玛利拉。
rows.raw: "You ask Tlako about the Camarilla."

rows.original: She blinks, and takes a deep breath, her feathers puffing up around her headband and she recites in a pleasant, almost musical voice.
rows.translation: 她眨眨眼，深吸一口气，头带周围的羽毛蓬松起来，随后用悦耳得近乎歌唱的声音背诵起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks, and takes a deep breath, her feathers puffing up around her headband and she recites in a pleasant, almost musical voice."

rows.original: “The Camarilla is a united species governmental corporation for toves,” she says with a beatific smile. “The Camarilla encourages competitive business practices both between Camarilla members and with parties outside of the Camarilla. Regulation of the Camarilla is dictated by private vote, bought by a publically available sliding scale of prices. While profits are our primary concern, rest assured that your safety and comfort are also considered.”
rows.translation: “卡玛利拉是托芙的物种联合政企，”她带着安详的微笑说道。“卡玛利拉鼓励成员之间以及成员与卡玛利拉外部各方开展竞争性商业活动。卡玛利拉的监管由私人投票决定，选票可按公开的浮动价格购买。利润是我们首要关注的问题，但请放心，您的安全与舒适也在考虑之中。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Camarilla is a united species governmental corporation for toves,” she says with a beatific smile. “The Camarilla encourages competitive business practices both between Camarilla members and with parties outside of the Camarilla. Regulation of the Camarilla is dictated by private vote, bought by a publically available sliding scale of prices. While profits are our primary concern, rest assured that your safety and comfort are also considered.”"

rows.original: “Should you wish to file a complaint with the Camarilla, please transmit your complaint via ship-to-ship transmission. As the Camarilla handles a high volume of interstellar communication, we are forced by situation to charge for the processing of your complaints and you will be billed based on the amount of effort needed to resolve your problem. Know that the Camarilla Cares About You.”
rows.translation: “如果您希望向卡玛利拉提出投诉，请通过舰对舰通信发送。由于卡玛利拉需要处理大量星际通信，情势所迫，我们必须对投诉处理收费；账单金额将根据解决问题所需的工作量计算。请牢记，卡玛利拉关心您。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Should you wish to file a complaint with the Camarilla, please transmit your complaint via ship-to-ship transmission. As the Camarilla handles a high volume of interstellar communication, we are forced by situation to charge for the processing of your complaints and you will be billed based on the amount of effort needed to resolve your problem. Know that the Camarilla Cares About You.”"

rows.original: You ask to meet with Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, and Tlako’s face goes blank for a moment.
rows.translation: 你要求与副夫人索奇·扎尔会面，特拉科的表情有一瞬间变得茫然。
rows.raw: "You ask to meet with Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, and Tlako’s face goes blank for a moment."

rows.original: “You want to speak to the Sub-madam?” gulps Tlako. “I d-don’t think she’s available, but l-let me see if she’s in ...” The little, pink tove taps her clipboard, and a familiar voice squawks something unintelligible through a speaker.
rows.translation: “你想和副夫人谈话？”特拉科吞了口唾沫。“我——我觉得她可能没空，不过让——让我看看她在不在...”粉色小托芙敲击写字板，一个熟悉的声音通过扬声器尖叫着说了些什么，令人无法听懂。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to speak to the Sub-madam?” gulps Tlako. “I d-don’t think she’s available, but l-let me see if she’s in ...” The little, pink tove taps her clipboard, and a familiar voice squawks something unintelligible through a speaker."

rows.original: “Oh no-I mean-oh good, she’s available!” says Tlako, glancing nervously around the room. “She’s on her way. I’ll just go ... retriculate some agendocuments ...” she says. In a flurry of scattered papers, she gathers up her stack of forms and dashes out through one of the floor-level shutters.
rows.translation: “哦不——我是说——哦太好了，她有空！”特拉科说道，紧张地环顾房间。“她正在过来。我这就去...重新整理一些议程文件...”她说道。在漫天飞舞的散乱纸张中，她收拢一摞表格，冲出一扇贴近地板的百叶门。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh no-I mean-oh good, she’s available!” says Tlako, glancing nervously around the room. “She’s on her way. I’ll just go ... retriculate some agendocuments ...” she says. In a flurry of scattered papers, she gathers up her stack of forms and dashes out through one of the floor-level shutters."

rows.original: Barely a minute or two has passed when another door whooshes open and [xotchi.name] stalks into the room. The two-foot-tall tove is dressed in her usual black corset, and holding her folding-tablet fan. Her blood-orange feathers bristle, and she glares at the scattered papers on the floor, snatching one up in a scaled talon.
rows.translation: 才过了一两分钟，另一扇门便呼地打开，[xotchi.name]大步走进房间。这名两英尺高的托芙仍穿着惯常的黑色紧身胸衣，手持可折叠的平板扇。她血橙色的羽毛根根竖起，怒视散落一地的文件，用覆鳞利爪一把抓起其中一张。
rows.raw: "\n\nBarely a minute or two has passed when another door whooshes open and [xotchi.name] stalks into the room. The two-foot-tall tove is dressed in her usual black corset, and holding her folding-tablet fan. Her blood-orange feathers bristle, and she glares at the scattered papers on the floor, snatching one up in a scaled talon."

rows.original: ” she snarls. She glances around at the other papers littering the room. “I swear by my profit margin I’m going to staple that dryborn to the wall and make her vend her hole for all the money she’s lost me.”
rows.translation: ”她咆哮道。她环顾散落满房间的其他文件。“我以利润率发誓，我要把那个旱生种钉在墙上，让她出卖自己的洞，把害我损失的钱全都赚回来。”
rows.raw: "” she snarls. She glances around at the other papers littering the room. “I swear by my profit margin I’m going to staple that dryborn to the wall and make her vend her hole for all the money she’s lost me.”"

rows.original: You clear your throat, and she looks up at you.
rows.translation: 你清了清嗓子，她抬头看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clear your throat, and she looks up at you."

rows.original: “Y-yes, of course,” she says, sounding nervous. She reaches into the top of her white bustier and pulls out a small, white disk. Holding it in one hand, her three other hands dance across its surface, scrolling in three different directions at once.
rows.translation: “是——是的，当然，”她说道，听上去有些紧张。她把手伸进白色紧身胸衣上方，取出一枚白色小圆盘。她用一只手托住圆盘，另外三只手则在表面飞舞，同时朝三个不同方向滚动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y-yes, of course,” she says, sounding nervous. She reaches into the top of her white bustier and pulls out a small, white disk. Holding it in one hand, her three other hands dance across its surface, scrolling in three different directions at once."

rows.original: “Understand that the Sub-Madam is a very busy woman and may simply not be... oh debt and pinion rot...” she mutters, as the little white compact begins to beep loudly.
rows.translation: “请理解，副夫人非常忙碌，可能根本没法...哦，债务和羽翼腐烂啊...”她喃喃说道，白色小圆盘开始大声鸣叫。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Understand that the Sub-Madam is a very busy woman and may simply not be... oh debt and pinion rot...” she mutters, as the little white compact begins to beep loudly."

rows.original: The central door across the room whooshes open and a larger tove stalks into the room. Instead of Tlako’s candy-pink color, this one is covered in yellow-orange feathers, her waist bound with a black corset. A small cluster of black flowers sits pinned atop the blood-red swath of feathers atop her head. Her beak and claws are deep orange, as are her eyes, focused on Tlako as the new tove stalks across the room.
rows.translation: 房间对面的中央大门呼地打开，一个体型更大的托芙昂首阔步地走进房间。她不像特拉科那样呈糖果粉色，而是全身覆盖黄橙色羽毛，腰间束着黑色紧身胸衣。她头顶那片血红色羽毛上别着一小簇黑花。她的喙与利爪呈深橙色，眼睛也是如此；这名新来的托芙大步穿过房间时，目光始终锁定特拉科。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe central door across the room whooshes open and a larger tove stalks into the room. Instead of Tlako’s candy-pink color, this one is covered in yellow-orange feathers, her waist bound with a black corset. A small cluster of black flowers sits pinned atop the blood-red swath of feathers atop her head. Her beak and claws are deep orange, as are her eyes, focused on Tlako as the new tove stalks across the room."

rows.original: She’s radiating anger one minute, but the second she turns to you, her face is the picture of kindly gratitude. All four of her eyes shine up at you as she smiles. <i>“Salutations and greetings! I hope your trip to Uveto Station was as pleasant as possible
rows.translation: 前一刻，她还散发着怒火；但转向你的瞬间，面庞便化作亲切感激的典范。她微笑着，四只眼睛全都闪亮地仰望你。<i>“向您致意并问好！希望您前来乌维托空间站的旅程尽可能愉快，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s radiating anger one minute, but the second she turns to you, her face is the picture of kindly gratitude. All four of her eyes shine up at you as she smiles. <i>“Salutations and greetings! I hope your trip to Uveto Station was as pleasant as possible "

rows.original: Mister
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mister"

rows.original: Miss
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Miss"

rows.original: --...” She touches a finger to the cluster of black flowers atop her head, and you see the faintest image of an HUD appearing over one of her eyes, “[pc.name]. I am Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, the Camarilla liaison here aboard Uveto Station.”
rows.translation: ——...”她用一根手指触碰头顶那簇黑花，你看到一幅极淡的HUD影像浮现在其中一只眼睛上方，“[pc.name]。我是副夫人索奇·扎尔，卡玛利拉驻乌维托空间站的联络员。”
rows.raw: "--...” She touches a finger to the cluster of black flowers atop her head, and you see the faintest image of an HUD appearing over one of her eyes, “[pc.name]. I am Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, the Camarilla liaison here aboard Uveto Station.”"

rows.original: You greet her, glancing at Tlako, who seems to be gradually sidling over to her stack of papers, trying to slip behind them.
rows.translation: 你向她问好，同时瞥了特拉科一眼；她似乎正逐渐侧身挪向自己的文件堆，试图躲到后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou greet her, glancing at Tlako, who seems to be gradually sidling over to her stack of papers, trying to slip behind them."

rows.original: “My time is very limited, and unfortunately, I can’t chat long. But please know that if you have any questions about the Camarilla while you’re here aboard Uveto Station, please talk to Tlako, my assistant.” She puts the slightest hiss on the last word and the stack of paper flinches.
rows.translation: “我的时间非常有限，很遗憾不能久聊。不过请记住，如果您在乌维托空间站期间对卡玛利拉有任何疑问，请询问我的助理特拉科。”她在最后一个词上略微加重嘶声，那摞文件随之抖了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My time is very limited, and unfortunately, I can’t chat long. But please know that if you have any questions about the Camarilla while you’re here aboard Uveto Station, please talk to Tlako, my assistant.” She puts the slightest hiss on the last word and the stack of paper flinches."

rows.original: “Please know that while the Camarilla maintains the workings of Uveto station, Anyxine Rhenesuune, the Vice President of RhenWorld Stellar Excavations, is the standing station manager.” Her smile is sweeter than aspartame, but there’s an edge to her tone. “As a Sub-Madam, I manage my people aboard this ship, but do not actually captain any of the residents.” If there was an edge to her voice before, it’s a razor now.
rows.translation: “请知悉，卡玛利拉虽然负责维持乌维托空间站运作，但雷恩世界星际采掘公司副总裁安妮克辛·雷内桑才是现任空间站经理。”她的笑容比阿斯巴甜还甜，语气中却暗藏锋芒。“作为副夫人，我管理本舰上的族人，但并不实际统领任何居民。”如果她之前的话音还只是有些锐利，现在便已锋利如剃刀。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Please know that while the Camarilla maintains the workings of Uveto station, Anyxine Rhenesuune, the Vice President of RhenWorld Stellar Excavations, is the standing station manager.” Her smile is sweeter than aspartame, but there’s an edge to her tone. “As a Sub-Madam, I manage my people aboard this ship, but do not actually captain any of the residents.” If there was an edge to her voice before, it’s a razor now."

rows.original: “Regardless,” she says with another smile, “I hope your trip here is a profitable one! I encourage you make generous use of the various stores aboard Uveto Station.”
rows.translation: “无论如何，”她再次微笑着说道，“希望您此行收获丰厚！我鼓励您多多光顾乌维托空间站上的各家商店。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Regardless,” she says with another smile, “I hope your trip here is a profitable one! I encourage you make generous use of the various stores aboard Uveto Station.”"

rows.original: She bids you farewell, and leaves, shooting a poisonous glance at Tlako on her way out.
rows.translation: 她向你告别并离开，出门时朝特拉科投去一道恶毒的目光。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe bids you farewell, and leaves, shooting a poisonous glance at Tlako on her way out."

rows.original: You ask to buy a Welcome Basket.
rows.translation: 你提出购买一个迎宾篮。
rows.raw: "You ask to buy a Welcome Basket."

rows.original: “Oh yay!” says Tlako, clapping two of her hands together as the other two fish a white compact from her white bustier. “Thank you so very, very much! You don’t even know what it means that you’d buy from me!” she babbles as her pink feathers poof out.
rows.translation: “哦，太好了！”特拉科说道，两只手拍在一起，另外两只手则从白色紧身胸衣中摸出一枚白色小圆盘。“真的、真的非常感谢！你都不知道愿意从我这里购买意味着什么！”她喋喋不休地说着，粉色羽毛蓬松起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yay!” says Tlako, clapping two of her hands together as the other two fish a white compact from her white bustier. “Thank you so very, very much! You don’t even know what it means that you’d buy from me!” she babbles as her pink feathers poof out."

rows.original: The low door on the far left whooshes open, and a low, hovering table drifts in, bearing a small, plastic basket. It’s wrapped in a crinkly, translucent covering, tied at the top with a bow. Its surface is covered with brightly-colored word balloons, expressing such sentiments as “WOW!” and “AWESOME!” and “AMPHIBIOUS!”
rows.translation: 最左侧的低矮舱门呼地打开，一张低空悬浮桌飘了进来，上面放着一个小塑料篮。篮子裹着一层沙沙作响的半透明包装，顶部系着蝴蝶结。表面遍布色彩鲜艳的文字气泡，表达着“哇哦！”、“太棒了！”和“两栖！”之类的感叹。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe low door on the far left whooshes open, and a low, hovering table drifts in, bearing a small, plastic basket. It’s wrapped in a crinkly, translucent covering, tied at the top with a bow. Its surface is covered with brightly-colored word balloons, expressing such sentiments as “WOW!” and “AWESOME!” and “AMPHIBIOUS!”"

rows.original: Tlako holds out her white compact to you, and you tap it, noting that while one side is featureless white, the other is a rapidly-scrolling display of layered symbols.
rows.translation: 特拉科朝你递出白色小圆盘，你在上面轻触一下，注意到它的一面纯白无物，另一面则显示着飞速滚动的多层符号。
rows.raw: "\n\nTlako holds out her white compact to you, and you tap it, noting that while one side is featureless white, the other is a rapidly-scrolling display of layered symbols."

rows.original: “I came up with the idea of a welcome basket for new arrivals a year ago!” she says, holding the basket up to you. “Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall didn’t think it was a good idea,” she says, her ears drooping a bit. “She said that it was a non-profitable venture.”
rows.translation: “一年前，我想到了为新来者准备迎宾篮的主意！”她说着，把篮子举到你面前。“副夫人索奇·扎尔觉得这不是个好主意，”她说道，双耳略微耷拉下来。“她说这是一项不盈利的事业。”
rows.raw: " “I came up with the idea of a welcome basket for new arrivals a year ago!” she says, holding the basket up to you. “Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall didn’t think it was a good idea,” she says, her ears drooping a bit. “She said that it was a non-profitable venture.”"

rows.original: She makes a face. “I don’t know how much you know about toves, but that’s pretty much the worst thing you can say around us.”
rows.translation: 她做了个鬼脸。“我不知道你对托芙了解多少，但在我们身边，这基本上是你能说出的最糟糕的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe makes a face. “I don’t know how much you know about toves, but that’s pretty much the worst thing you can say around us.”"

rows.original: You take the basket and her face lights up. As you begin unwrapping it, you ask her how many she’s sold.
rows.translation: 你接过篮子，她的脸顿时亮了起来。你一边开始拆开包装，一边问她卖出了多少。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take the basket and her face lights up. As you begin unwrapping it, you ask her how many she’s sold."

rows.original: “You’re the first - I mean, that’s the first!” she chirps happily, clasping her four hands together, her pink tail swishing up and down. “I absolutely KNEW they’d eventually take off! It just needed some time!”
rows.translation: “你是第一个——我是说，这是第一个！”她开心地啾叫着，四只手握在一起，粉色尾巴上下甩动。“我就知道它们最后肯定会畅销！只是需要一点时间！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re the first - I mean, that’s the first!” she chirps happily, clasping her four hands together, her pink tail swishing up and down. “I absolutely KNEW they’d eventually take off! It just needed some time!”"

rows.original: You finally get the wrappings off and pull out a trio of items.
rows.translation: 你终于拆掉包装，从中取出三件物品。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finally get the wrappings off and pull out a trio of items."

rows.original: “It’s Kalocrunch!” she says, pointing up at the silver bag. “Walking through snow and exploring frozen hellscapes can burn you out fast. Kalocrunch has the highest calorie-to-mass index of any food in existence. It’s PERFECT for someone trekking across tundras,” she trills happily.
rows.translation: “这是卡洛脆片！”她指着银色袋子说道。“在雪地行走和探索冰封地狱很快就会耗尽体力。卡洛脆片的热量质量比是现存所有食物中最高的。它最适合徒步穿越苔原的人，”她快乐地颤声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s Kalocrunch!” she says, pointing up at the silver bag. “Walking through snow and exploring frozen hellscapes can burn you out fast. Kalocrunch has the highest calorie-to-mass index of any food in existence. It’s PERFECT for someone trekking across tundras,” she trills happily."

rows.original: “That’s a Thermal Pack!” she says, as you lift out a small metallic egg. “It’ll generate a microwave field around you for 24 hours. It’ll keep off the worst of the cold down there on Uveto VII. I figured that most people coming through the station are going down there for some reason or another.”
rows.translation: “那是保温包！”当你取出一枚金属小蛋时，她说道。“它会在你周围产生持续24小时的微波场，抵挡乌维托七号地表最恶劣的严寒。我想，大多数经过空间站的人都会因为某种原因去下面。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a Thermal Pack!” she says, as you lift out a small metallic egg. “It’ll generate a microwave field around you for 24 hours. It’ll keep off the worst of the cold down there on Uveto VII. I figured that most people coming through the station are going down there for some reason or another.”"

rows.original: “And that’s Yibb-Tstll’s Reflexive Lube! It’s ‘Good for What Rails You!’” she says as you investigate the last item. The small, green capsule bears a picture of a tove with four thumbs up and an unsettling grin across his face. “YTR Lube is the best in defensive lubrication. Pop it in your orifice, and you’ll more easily accommodate girthier insertion for a few days. You know, in case of...” she leans in and whispers conspiratorially, “...surprising anal insertions.”
rows.translation: “那是伊波-兹特尔反射式润滑剂！它‘专治铁轨难题！’”你检查最后一件物品时，她说道。绿色小胶囊上画着一名竖起四根拇指的托芙，脸上挂着令人不安的笑容。“YTR润滑剂是防御性润滑领域的最佳产品。把它塞进孔洞，接下来几天里，你就能更轻松地容纳更粗的插入物。你知道，以防发生...”她凑近过来，像同谋一样低声说道，“...出人意料的肛门插入。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s Yibb-Tstll’s Reflexive Lube! It’s ‘Good for What Rails You!’” she says as you investigate the last item. The small, green capsule bears a picture of a tove with four thumbs up and an unsettling grin across his face. “YTR Lube is the best in defensive lubrication. Pop it in your orifice, and you’ll more easily accommodate girthier insertion for a few days. You know, in case of...” she leans in and whispers conspiratorially, “...surprising anal insertions.”"

rows.original: “You know you didn’t have to buy one again,” she says, a reproachful look briefly on her beaked face. “But I’m very glad you did!” she says with a grin. “Every basket bought means I get a little closer to paying back Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall!”
rows.translation: “你知道自己不必再买一个的，”她说道，鸟喙状的脸上短暂掠过责备的神情。“不过我很高兴你买了！”她咧嘴笑道，“每卖出一只篮子，就意味着我距离还清索奇·扎尔副夫人的钱更近一点！”
rows.raw: " “You know you didn’t have to buy one again,” she says, a reproachful look briefly on her beaked face. “But I’m very glad you did!” she says with a grin. “Every basket bought means I get a little closer to paying back Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall!”"

rows.original: “I don’t know if word got out, but since you bought one, people have been actually coming in to buy them! Thank you so much! If this keeps up, I won’t have to worry about Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall making me sell my body!” she says, leaning forward to wrap all four of her arms around
rows.translation: “我不知道消息是不是传开了，但自从你买过一只后，真的有人开始进来购买了！太感谢你了！如果继续这样下去，我就不必担心索奇·扎尔副夫人逼我出卖身体！”她一边说，一边向前探身，用四条手臂一同搂住
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know if word got out, but since you bought one, people have been actually coming in to buy them! Thank you so much! If this keeps up, I won’t have to worry about Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall making me sell my body!” she says, leaning forward to wrap all four of her arms around "

rows.original: your [pc.legOrLegs].
rows.translation: 你的[pc.legOrLegs]。
rows.raw: "your [pc.legOrLegs]."

rows.original: your midsection.
rows.translation: 你的腰身。
rows.raw: "your midsection."

rows.original: She’s actually flat against you, looking a little awkward. “Am I doing this right? Toves don’t do physical affection. I’m still researching how you touchy-feely races do it.”
rows.translation: 她整个人紧贴着你，看上去有些笨拙。“我这样做对吗？托芙不会用身体表达亲昵。我还在研究你们这些喜欢肢体接触的种族是怎么做的。”
rows.raw: " She’s actually flat against you, looking a little awkward. “Am I doing this right? Toves don’t do physical affection. I’m still researching how you touchy-feely races do it.”"

rows.original: You give her a look, but she’s too cheerful to notice. “Thank you again!” Tlako burbles! “I owe Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall a lot for the first run of these, so you can believe what a relief it is to finally start to move them! You’re a
rows.translation: 你看了她一眼，但她太过兴高采烈，根本没有注意。“再次谢谢你！”特拉科咕噜说道！“为了生产第一批货，我欠了索奇·扎尔副夫人很多钱，所以你肯定能想象，终于开始卖出去让我多么如释重负！你真是个
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give her a look, but she’s too cheerful to notice. “Thank you again!” Tlako burbles! “I owe Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall a lot for the first run of these, so you can believe what a relief it is to finally start to move them! You’re a "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "credit"

rows.original: saver!”
rows.raw: " saver!”"

rows.original: TLAKO_BASKETS
rows.raw: "TLAKO_BASKETS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You take a seat and ask the little pink creature about herself.
rows.translation: 你坐下来，询问这个粉色小生物关于她自己的事情。
rows.raw: "You take a seat and ask the little pink creature about herself."

rows.original: “Me? I’m just a run-of-the-mill bureaucrat!” Tlako says, looking up at you.
rows.translation: “我？我只是个普普通通的官僚！”特拉科仰望着你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me? I’m just a run-of-the-mill bureaucrat!” Tlako says, looking up at you."

rows.original: You pat the seat next to you and ask her what she means by that.
rows.translation: 你拍了拍身旁的座位，问她这是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pat the seat next to you and ask her what she means by that."

rows.original: “Oh, in tove society, it’s considered a poor investment to raise more than two children,” she begins as she clambers up onto the bench next to you, her legs kicking as she takes her seat. “So when a third child is born, they’re given to the government to raise,” she says, looking up at you with a smile. “I’m a third child.”
rows.translation: “哦，在托芙社会，养育两个以上的孩子被视为糟糕的投资，”她一边开口，一边爬上你身旁的长凳；坐下时，她的双腿仍在晃动。“所以第三个孩子出生后，就会交给政府抚养，”她仰望着你微笑道，“我就是第三个孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, in tove society, it’s considered a poor investment to raise more than two children,” she begins as she clambers up onto the bench next to you, her legs kicking as she takes her seat. “So when a third child is born, they’re given to the government to raise,” she says, looking up at you with a smile. “I’m a third child.”"

rows.original: You reflect on your own childhood and how big a role your father played in it.
rows.translation: 你回想自己的童年，以及父亲在其中扮演的重要角色。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reflect on your own childhood and how big a role your father played in it."

rows.original: You remember kicking off the wall of a zero-g court, and the burst of joy at catching the ricocheting grav ball that your father threw to you.
rows.translation: 你记得自己从零重力球场的墙面蹬出，也记得接住父亲向你掷来、经过反弹的重力球时，那股骤然涌现的喜悦。
rows.raw: " You remember kicking off the wall of a zero-g court, and the burst of joy at catching the ricocheting grav ball that your father threw to you."

rows.original: Quite suddenly you recall the faint buzz of the old lamp in your father’s library, being picked up by him and carried to your bed after falling asleep in a pile of books.
rows.translation: 你突然回想起父亲书房里旧台灯的微弱嗡鸣，以及自己在书堆里睡着后，被他抱起来送回床上的经历。
rows.raw: " Quite suddenly you recall the faint buzz of the old lamp in your father’s library, being picked up by him and carried to your bed after falling asleep in a pile of books."

rows.original: You run your thumb across your fingernails, remembering the spa days you and your father would schedule. You remember the long hours of talking about nothing in particular over massages, saunas, and manicures.
rows.translation: 你用拇指抚过指甲，回想着自己与父亲定期安排的水疗日。你记得按摩、桑拿和美甲期间，那些漫长而漫无目的的闲谈。
rows.raw: " You run your thumb across your fingernails, remembering the spa days you and your father would schedule. You remember the long hours of talking about nothing in particular over massages, saunas, and manicures."

rows.original: You remember the cabin by the purple lake on Dorlin IV, the long hours spent with your father, enjoying the silence of the woods around you, and all those times he fished you out of the lake.
rows.translation: 你记得多林四号紫色湖泊旁的小屋，记得与父亲共度的漫长时光、环绕身边的寂静树林，以及他一次次将你从湖里捞出来的经历。
rows.raw: " You remember the cabin by the purple lake on Dorlin IV, the long hours spent with your father, enjoying the silence of the woods around you, and all those times he fished you out of the lake."

rows.original: Unbidden, your fingers touch a small spot on your midsection. You remember a year spent building a treehouse under the twin suns of a garden planet. You fell, hitting several branches on your way down. Your father was there in a flash, picking you up and carrying you to the nearest med station.
rows.translation: 你的手指不由自主地触碰腰间的一小块位置。你记得在一颗花园行星的双子太阳下，用一年时间建造树屋。你跌落下来，途中撞上好几根树枝。父亲转眼便赶到身边，抱起你，将你送往最近的医疗站。
rows.raw: " Unbidden, your fingers touch a small spot on your midsection. You remember a year spent building a treehouse under the twin suns of a garden planet. You fell, hitting several branches on your way down. Your father was there in a flash, picking you up and carrying you to the nearest med station."

rows.original: You try to imagine life without that memory, and you wince.
rows.translation: 你试着想象缺失这段记忆的人生，不禁皱起脸来。
rows.raw: " You try to imagine life without that memory, and you wince."

rows.original: “Oh, it’s really not that bad,” she says, gesturing energetically. “You see, tove children that grow up with their parents get billed for the cost of raising them once they’re adults. Bureaucrats don’t get billed - we just work for the government. That’s my job here on Uveto Station - I’m a Camarilla-assigned assistant for Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, since this is largely a government endeavor.”
rows.translation: “哦，其实没那么糟，”她精力十足地比划着说道，“你看，由父母养大的托芙孩子成年后，会收到抚养费用的账单。官僚不会收到这种账单，我们只需为政府工作。那就是我在乌维托空间站的工作；由于这里基本属于政府项目，我被卡玛利拉指派给索奇·扎尔副夫人担任助理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’s really not that bad,” she says, gesturing energetically. “You see, tove children that grow up with their parents get billed for the cost of raising them once they’re adults. Bureaucrats don’t get billed - we just work for the government. That’s my job here on Uveto Station - I’m a Camarilla-assigned assistant for Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall, since this is largely a government endeavor.”"

rows.original: You ask her if she likes working for her.
rows.translation: 你问她是否喜欢为对方工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her if she likes working for her."

rows.original: “It’s an assigned job,” she says, making a face. “Whether I like it or not, I have to do it. The Welcome Basket project was my ticket for a promotion. If it had worked, I might have gotten promoted. As it stands, I just owe Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall a LOT of money.” Her ears droop at the last statement.
rows.translation: “这是分配给我的工作，”她做着鬼脸说道，“无论喜不喜欢，我都得做下去。迎宾篮计划本来是我晋升的门票。如果计划成功，我或许能得到提拔。但照现在的情况，我只欠下了索奇·扎尔副夫人一大笔钱。”说出最后一句时，她的耳朵耷拉下来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s an assigned job,” she says, making a face. “Whether I like it or not, I have to do it. The Welcome Basket project was my ticket for a promotion. If it had worked, I might have gotten promoted. As it stands, I just owe Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall a LOT of money.” Her ears droop at the last statement."

rows.original: You pat the small creature on the head, and surprisingly, she makes a musical trill. “Ooh! That’s nice! It feels like preening!” she says, smiling brightly.
rows.translation: 你拍了拍这个小生物的头；出乎意料的是，她发出了悦耳的颤鸣。“哦！真舒服！感觉就像在梳理羽毛！”她灿烂地微笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pat the small creature on the head, and surprisingly, she makes a musical trill. “Ooh! That’s nice! It feels like preening!” she says, smiling brightly."

rows.original: “It wouldn’t be so bad, but Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall was going to make me start working it off next. I had some savings, but I still had to take a loan from her for the rest of it. She figured I wasn’t going to sell any, so she made me mod my body so that I can start working it off.”
rows.translation: “本来也不会那么糟，可索奇·扎尔副夫人接下来准备让我开始用工作偿还。我有些积蓄，不过为了补足余款，还是不得不向她借钱。她认定我什么也卖不出去，所以让我改造身体，以便开始工作还债。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It wouldn’t be so bad, but Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall was going to make me start working it off next. I had some savings, but I still had to take a loan from her for the rest of it. She figured I wasn’t going to sell any, so she made me mod my body so that I can start working it off.”"

rows.original: “I mean... it’s not a bad modification,” she says, when she catches your expression. “It’s just a little one that doesn’t even show,” her feathers poof out a bit. “And it makes sense. I mean, if I lost her money, the least I could do is make it up to her by servicing visitors with a fuck hole.” She shrinks down, her head tucked against her ruffled feathers, eyes looking off to the side.
rows.translation: “我是说...那并不是什么糟糕的改造，”她察觉你的表情后说道，“只是个甚至不会显露出来的小改造，”她的羽毛略微蓬起，“而且这也合理。我的意思是，如果我害她损失了钱，自己至少可以用一个肉洞服务访客，以此为她弥补损失。”她缩起身体，头颅埋在凌乱的羽毛间，双眼望向一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean... it’s not a bad modification,” she says, when she catches your expression. “It’s just a little one that doesn’t even show,” her feathers poof out a bit. “And it makes sense. I mean, if I lost her money, the least I could do is make it up to her by servicing visitors with a fuck hole.” She shrinks down, her head tucked against her ruffled feathers, eyes looking off to the side."

rows.original: “I’m... I’m only telling you this because you were nice enough to buy the first Welcome Basket. You don’t need to buy any more. I just know more people will want one!” she says, clenching a fist and looking determined.
rows.translation: “我...我只是因为你人很好，愿意买下第一只迎宾篮，才告诉你这些。你不用再买了。我知道会有更多人想要一只！”她握紧拳头，神情坚定地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m... I’m only telling you this because you were nice enough to buy the first Welcome Basket. You don’t need to buy any more. I just know more people will want one!” she says, clenching a fist and looking determined."

rows.original: Frogapus
rows.raw: "Frogapus"

rows.original: You bid the little pink tove goodbye and leave the gaudy and oddly-humid office.
rows.translation: 你向粉色的小托芙告别，离开这间花哨而异常潮湿的办公室。
rows.raw: "You bid the little pink tove goodbye and leave the gaudy and oddly-humid office."

rows.original: You keep your amusement to yourself to keep the tove from feeling bad and happily agree that florking her would be a fun way to celebrate her windfall.
rows.translation: 你为了不让这名托芙难过而将笑意藏在心底，并愉快地同意，弗洛克她会是庆祝这笔意外之财的有趣方式。
rows.raw: "You keep your amusement to yourself to keep the tove from feeling bad and happily agree that florking her would be a fun way to celebrate her windfall."

Despite its hurry, it moves slowly on thick hind legs, its broad tail dragging behind it as it scoots to one of the benches. A short leg stomps twice on the floor. The floor clicks as a circular section rises up from it, forming a low desk. The tove dumps the stack of forms on the table and lets out a sigh of relief before looking up at you."

rows.original: This tove wears a simple, white bustier, forming the suggestion of feminine hips and a chest on her body. She’s covered in candy-pink feathers from the tips of her rabbit-like ears to her thick, raccoon-like tail. The only other color on her is the pale gold tips of the plumage atop her head, matched by her beak and bird-like talons. Standing about three feet high she looks up at you, adjusting the white headband holding her head plumes back, tucking them into place behind an ear.
rows.translation: 这名托芙人穿着简单的白色紧身胸衣，在身体上勾勒出女性髋部和胸膛的轮廓。从兔子般的耳尖到浣熊般的粗尾，她全身覆盖着糖果粉色羽毛。身上仅有的另一种颜色，是头顶羽毛的淡金色尖端，与鸟喙和鸟类利爪相互呼应。她身高约三英尺，抬头看着你，一边调整束住头羽的白色发带，一边把羽毛塞回一只耳朵后面。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis tove wears a simple, white bustier, forming the suggestion of feminine hips and a chest on her body. She’s covered in candy-pink feathers from the tips of her rabbit-like ears to her thick, raccoon-like tail. The only other color on her is the pale gold tips of the plumage atop her head, matched by her beak and bird-like talons. Standing about three feet high she looks up at you, adjusting the white headband holding her head plumes back, tucking them into place behind an ear."

rows.original: Catching her breath, she turns to look at you.
rows.translation: 她喘匀气息，转头看向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nCatching her breath, she turns to look at you."

rows.original: She gapes up at you in stunned silence as her four eyes travel up your towering frame. “Wow! Wow! I didn’t know sapients came that big!”
rows.translation: 她的四只眼睛沿着你高耸的身体向上移动，震惊地张嘴仰望，沉默不语。“哇！哇！我不知道智慧生物能长这么大！”
rows.raw: " She gapes up at you in stunned silence as her four eyes travel up your towering frame. “Wow! Wow! I didn’t know sapients came that big!”"

rows.original: “Oh goodness! You’re tall, aren’t you?” she chirps in surprise, her four, rose-colored eyes wide.
rows.translation: “天哪！你很高，对吧？”她惊讶地啁啾，四只玫瑰色眼睛睁得大大的。
rows.raw: " “Oh goodness! You’re tall, aren’t you?” she chirps in surprise, her four, rose-colored eyes wide."

rows.original: She glances upwards at you, tilting her head. “You’re a bit shorter than the other sapients on board Uveto Station. You’re almost a tove!” She says with a tweeting giggle.
rows.translation: 她歪着头向上瞥你。“你比乌维托空间站里的其他智慧生物矮一点。你都快算托芙人了！”她叽叽咯咯地笑道。
rows.raw: " She glances upwards at you, tilting her head. “You’re a bit shorter than the other sapients on board Uveto Station. You’re almost a tove!” She says with a tweeting giggle."

rows.original: She blinks, letting out a small squawk.

rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks, letting out a small squawk."

rows.original: “Awk! I’m sorry! That was terrible customer relations! Let me - let me try that again!” she says, her feathers ruffling up. She stands up to her full three feet of height and closes her eyes as if reciting from memory.
rows.translation: “嘎！对不起！刚才的客户关系处理太糟糕了！让我——让我再来一次！”她说道，羽毛纷纷竖起。她挺直身体，达到完整的三英尺身高，闭上双眼，仿佛在背诵记忆中的台词。

Alternatively, I am authorized to offer to you for purchase a Camarilla Welcome Basket full of Wonderful Things that will brighten your stay here on Uveto VII for only 200 credits.”

rows.translation: ”你拿起长矛刺了几下，赞叹冰制矛尖令它如此轻盈。你衷心感谢她的礼物，表示自己会善加使用。
rows.raw: "” You pick up the spear and give it a few thrusts, admiring just how light the ice tip makes it. You deeply thank her for the gift, saying you’ll use it very well."

rows.original: She smiles wide and heads back to work, a new spring in her step after what happened.
rows.translation: 她灿烂地笑着回去工作，经历刚才的事后，脚步也重新变得轻快。
rows.raw:
"

She smiles wide and heads back to work, a new spring in her step after what happened.

"

rows.original: “You’ve never been off world, have you?”
rows.translation: “你从来没有离开过这颗星球，对吧？”
rows.raw: "“You’ve never been off world, have you?”"

rows.original: She shakes her head. <i>“
rows.translation: 她摇摇头。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head. <i>“"

rows.original: I found a lot of things in my scavenging days, but I never found a spaceship
rows.translation: 我拾荒的那些年找到了很多东西，却从未找到过宇宙飞船
rows.raw: "I found a lot of things in my scavenging days, but I never found a spaceship"

rows.original: Tuuva scavenge lots, but never find space goer
rows.translation: 图瓦拾荒很多，但从没找到太空行者
rows.raw: "Tuuva scavenge lots, but never find space goer"

rows.original: You ask if she ever even thought about it.
rows.translation: 你问她是否哪怕想过这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask if she ever even thought about it."

rows.original: <i>“Sometimes, but
rows.translation: <i>“偶尔想过，但
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Sometimes, but "

rows.original: I’ll never be able to do it
rows.translation: 我永远也做不到
rows.raw: "I’ll never be able to do it"

rows.original: Tuuva never able to do it
rows.translation: 图瓦永远做不到
rows.raw: "Tuuva never able to do it"

rows.original: .” She says dismissively.
rows.translation: 。”她不以为意地说道。
rows.raw: ".” She says dismissively."

rows.original: “What if I took you?” Her ears perk up and her tail goes crazy.
rows.translation: “如果我带你去呢？”她双耳竖起，尾巴疯狂摇摆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if I took you?” Her ears perk up and her tail goes crazy."

rows.original: Lover
rows.translation: 爱人
rows.raw: "Lover"

rows.original: You’d
rows.translation: 你愿意
rows.raw: "You’d"

rows.original: do that?”
rows.translation: 这么做？”
rows.raw: " do that?”"

rows.original: You have a ship, and there’s nothing stopping you, you tell her. Of course, you also tell her that she’ll need to be wearing more than an apron. She looks down at her worn, dirty apron and nods softly.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己有一艘飞船，而且没有什么能阻止你。当然，你也告诉她不能只穿一条围裙。她低头看看自己又旧又脏的围裙，轻轻点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a ship, and there’s nothing stopping you, you tell her. Of course, you also tell her that she’ll need to be wearing more than an apron. She looks down at her worn, dirty apron and nods softly."

rows.original: I forgot that you outsiders were so dang picky. Don’t worry, I got something; go wait at the front gate and I’ll meet you there.
rows.translation: 我忘了你们外人这么该死的挑剔。别担心，我有办法；去大门等着，我会在那里和你会合。
rows.raw: "I forgot that you outsiders were so dang picky. Don’t worry, I got something; go wait at the front gate and I’ll meet you there."

rows.original: Tuuva forget outsiders so picky. Have fix, go wait at gate and Tuuva meet.
rows.translation: 图瓦忘了外人这么挑。图瓦有办法，去大门等，图瓦会来。
rows.raw: "Tuuva forget outsiders so picky. Have fix, go wait at gate and Tuuva meet."

rows.original: ” She hops back to her room and you hear a bit of a commotion going on as she does something. You have no idea what she’s doing, but you decide that you’ll see it when you see it and head out to the meeting spot.
rows.translation: ”她跳回房间，你听见她在里面忙活时传出一阵骚动。你完全不知道她在做什么，但决定到时候自然会知道，便前往会合地点。
rows.raw: "” She hops back to her room and you hear a bit of a commotion going on as she does something. You have no idea what she’s doing, but you decide that you’ll see it when you see it and head out to the meeting spot."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: SIRETTA.UVETO VII.KORGII B14
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.UVETO VII.KORGII B14"

rows.original: About twenty minutes pass before you see Tuuva again. She bounds up to you with a huge smile on her face, and a much more trim and clean appearance. Her fur is finely combed and washed free of the usual soot. Even her hair is a bit more styled, for what little she could do with such a short cut. She has a few pieces of jewelry too; some earrings, and a few bracelets. Her big, hide coat is still very tribal, but maybe that’s just for the trip to your ship.
rows.translation: 大约二十分钟后，你再次看见图瓦。她满脸灿烂笑容地朝你蹦来，外表也整洁利落了许多。毛皮经过细致梳理和清洗，不见平日的煤灰。就连头发也稍加打理，虽然短发能做的造型有限。她还戴着几件首饰：一些耳环和几只手镯。那件宽大的毛皮外套仍极具部落风格，不过或许只是在前往飞船途中穿着。
rows.raw: "About twenty minutes pass before you see Tuuva again. She bounds up to you with a huge smile on her face, and a much more trim and clean appearance. Her fur is finely combed and washed free of the usual soot. Even her hair is a bit more styled, for what little she could do with such a short cut. She has a few pieces of jewelry too; some earrings, and a few bracelets. Her big, hide coat is still very tribal, but maybe that’s just for the trip to your ship."

rows.original: I
rows.translation: 我

rows.original: Tuuva
rows.translation: 图瓦
rows.raw: "Tuuva"

rows.original: feel weird, but pretty.
rows.translation: 感觉怪怪的，但很漂亮。
rows.raw: " feel weird, but pretty. "

rows.original: Do you like it
rows.translation: 你喜欢吗
rows.raw: "Do you like it"

rows.original: Lover like
rows.translation: 爱人喜欢吗
rows.raw: "Lover like"

rows.original: ?” You give her a quick kiss and tell her that she looks stunning. She squirms happily at that, even more so when she spies the gate guards checking her out too. “U-uh,
rows.translation: ？”你迅速吻了她一下，告诉她看起来美极了。她开心地扭动身体，发现大门守卫也在打量自己时更是如此。“呃-呃，
rows.raw: "?” You give her a quick kiss and tell her that she looks stunning. She squirms happily at that, even more so when she spies the gate guards checking her out too. “U-uh, "

rows.original: can we head out now,
rows.translation: 我们现在能走了吗，
rows.raw: "can we head out now,"

rows.original: we go now,
rows.translation: 我们现在走，
rows.raw: "we go now,"

rows.original: please.” You chuckle, put your hand around her shoulder and lead her out, getting an approving gesture from the two guards.
rows.translation: 拜托。”你轻笑着把手搭上她的肩膀，领着她离开，两名守卫还朝你们做出赞许的手势。
rows.raw: " please.” You chuckle, put your hand around her shoulder and lead her out, getting an approving gesture from the two guards."

rows.original: The trip is stressful due to the dangers of the Uvetan tundra, but that doesn’t stop you from taking in some of the sights. The huge mountains, the massive glaciers, the towering spires of polished obsidian, it’s quite the spectacle. Even Tuuva seems to think so.
rows.translation: 乌维托苔原危机四伏，令这段路程颇为紧张，却不妨碍你们欣赏沿途风景。巨大的山脉、庞大的冰川、高耸的光滑黑曜石尖塔，实在蔚为壮观。就连图瓦似乎也这么认为。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe trip is stressful due to the dangers of the Uvetan tundra, but that doesn’t stop you from taking in some of the sights. The huge mountains, the massive glaciers, the towering spires of polished obsidian, it’s quite the spectacle. Even Tuuva seems to think so."

rows.original: I can’t believe I forgot how beautiful it was out here. It’s been so long since I’ve gotten out, aside from...
rows.translation: 真不敢相信我都忘了外面有多美。除了...我已经很久没出来了。
rows.raw: "I can’t believe I forgot how beautiful it was out here. It’s been so long since I’ve gotten out, aside from..."

rows.original: Tuuva not remember how pretty-pretty here was. Been so long, except for...
rows.translation: 图瓦不记得这里这么漂漂亮亮。好久没出来，除了...
rows.raw: "Tuuva not remember how pretty-pretty here was. Been so long, except for..."

rows.original: ” She looks over into the distance, and when you look, you see a large hole, partially filled in by a massive pile of snow. That must be where she fell into the caves.
rows.translation: ”她望向远方，你随之看去，发现一个被巨大雪堆部分填满的大洞。那里一定就是她掉进洞穴的地方。
rows.raw: "” She looks over into the distance, and when you look, you see a large hole, partially filled in by a massive pile of snow. That must be where she fell into the caves."

rows.original: You move past that bad memory and reach Irestead. Tuuva cowers behind you when she sees the guards, but you assure her that they won’t hurt her. Indeed, you’re able to enter town without any trouble. She looks around, curious, but not particularly impressed.
rows.translation: 你抛开那段糟糕回忆，抵达艾尔斯特德。图瓦看见守卫时缩到你身后，但你向她保证，他们不会伤害她。你们的确顺利进城。她好奇地环顾四周，却没有特别惊叹。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou move past that bad memory and reach Irestead. Tuuva cowers behind you when she sees the guards, but you assure her that they won’t hurt her. Indeed, you’re able to enter town without any trouble. She looks around, curious, but not particularly impressed."

rows.original: So this is your outsider city? ... Interesting
rows.translation: 所以这就是你们外人的城市？...挺有意思
rows.raw: "So this is your outsider city? ... Interesting"

rows.original: This outsider city? ... Neat
rows.translation: 这是外人城市？...不错
rows.raw: "This outsider city? ... Neat"

rows.original: .” You admit, it’s not the most impressive place, but it’s just an appetizer for what you’re going to show her. She smiles as you lead her through the streets and toward the central hub. If there’s one thing she does marvel at, it’s the space elevator. “So big!
rows.translation: 。” 你承认这里算不上最令人印象深刻的地方，但只是接下来要展示之物的开胃菜。 你领她穿过街道前往中央枢纽，她面带微笑。真有一样东西令她惊叹，那就是太空电梯。“好大！
rows.raw: ".” You admit, it’s not the most impressive place, but it’s just an appetizer for what you’re going to show her. She smiles as you lead her through the streets and toward the central hub. If there’s one thing she does marvel at, it’s the space elevator. “So big! "

rows.original: I’ve only seen this thing from far away before now. That I’m right here... just, wow!
rows.translation: 以前我只从很远的地方看过它。现在就站在这里...简直，哇！
rows.raw: "I’ve only seen this thing from far away before now. That I’m right here... just, wow!"

rows.original: Tuuva only see it from long away. Now that close... wow!
rows.translation: 图瓦只从远远的地方看过。现在这么近...哇！
rows.raw: "Tuuva only see it from long away. Now that close... wow!"

rows.original: She keeps aweing at it until the point where you finally reach it. She’s apprehensive about getting on, but you give her an encouraging tug and she hops on. She yelps as the lift rockets up, but goes almost silent when she sees the view out the window.
rows.translation: 她一路惊叹，直到你们终于抵达电梯。她不太敢上去，但你鼓励地拉了她一下，她便跳上电梯。升降梯飞速上升时，她尖叫了一声，但看见窗外景色后几乎彻底安静。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe keeps aweing at it until the point where you finally reach it. She’s apprehensive about getting on, but you give her an encouraging tug and she hops on. She yelps as the lift rockets up, but goes almost silent when she sees the view out the window."

rows.original: Watching the only thing she’s ever known shrink rapidly before her eyes must be hard to process. She seems caught between wonder and fear as she gazes out the window, until, almost as soon as it started, the ride ends.
rows.translation: 看着自己熟知的唯一世界在眼前迅速缩小，一定很难理解。她凝视窗外，似乎徘徊在惊奇与恐惧之间；几乎和开始一样突然，旅程结束了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWatching the only thing she’s ever known shrink rapidly before her eyes must be hard to process. She seems caught between wonder and fear as she gazes out the window, until, almost as soon as it started, the ride ends."

rows.original: She looks back at you, unsure of what to do now, but you take her hand and encourage her to keep going.
rows.translation: 她回头看你，不知接下来该做什么；你握住她的手，鼓励她继续前进。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe looks back at you, unsure of what to do now, but you take her hand and encourage her to keep going."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You lead the pup-out-of-water through the station, helping keep her from having too much sensory overload from the experience. She even almost scurries away when she sees the gun turrets near the hangar, but you keep her steady.
rows.translation: 你领着这只离水小狗穿过空间站，尽力避免这番体验带来过度的感官刺激。她看见机库附近的炮塔时甚至险些逃走，但你稳住了她。
rows.raw: "You lead the pup-out-of-water through the station, helping keep her from having too much sensory overload from the experience. She even almost scurries away when she sees the gun turrets near the hangar, but you keep her steady."

rows.original: <i>“Why
rows.translation: <i>“为什么
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Why "

rows.original: do you people have so many guns
rows.translation: 你们这些人有这么多枪
rows.raw: "do you people have so many guns"

rows.original: outsiders have so many shooties
rows.translation: 外人有这么多射射
rows.raw: "outsiders have so many shooties"

rows.original: ?” She whispers in your [pc.ear]. For protection, you tell her. “
rows.translation: ？”她贴着你的[pc.ear]低声问道。你告诉她，这是为了防护。“
rows.raw: "?” She whispers in your [pc.ear]. For protection, you tell her. “"

rows.original: You outsiders need to learn how to be more subtle, and not just put guns everywhere and shoot everything!
rows.translation: 你们外人得学会更隐蔽些，不能只是到处摆枪、什么都开火！
rows.raw: "You outsiders need to learn how to be more subtle, and not just put guns everywhere and shoot everything!"

rows.original: Outsiders need learn to be more sneaky, not just shooty everything!
rows.translation: 外人需要学会更偷偷摸摸，不只是什么都射！
rows.raw: "Outsiders need learn to be more sneaky, not just shooty everything!"

rows.original: ” She has a point, but that’s something for another day. For now, you’re at your ship.
rows.translation: ”她说得有道理，不过那是改天再考虑的事。现在，你们已经来到飞船。
rows.raw: "” She has a point, but that’s something for another day. For now, you’re at your ship."

rows.original: You take her in and show her around, introducing her to all the various bits and workings of your spacecraft.
rows.translation: 你带她进去参观，向她介绍航天器的各种部件与工作原理。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take her in and show her around, introducing her to all the various bits and workings of your spacecraft."

rows.original: You also introduce her your crew, mostly letting her hit it off, herself.
rows.translation: 你也把她介绍给船员，主要任由她自己与众人相处。
rows.raw: " You also introduce her your crew, mostly letting her hit it off, herself. "

rows.original: Finally, you take her to the cockpit, sitting her down while you prepare the launch sequence.
rows.translation: 最后，你带她来到驾驶舱，让她坐下，自己准备起飞程序。
rows.raw: "Finally, you take her to the cockpit, sitting her down while you prepare the launch sequence."

rows.original: She sits and watches while you finish entering the sequence, and jumps a bit when she feels the ship lift off. She stares out in awe as you leave the planet’s atmosphere. She’s speechless as you completely exit the planet, face almost pressed against the glass of your view-screen.
rows.translation: 你完成程序输入时，她坐着观看；感觉飞船升空时，她轻轻一跳。你们离开星球大气层，她惊叹地凝视窗外。完全脱离星球后，她已经说不出话，脸几乎贴在观察屏玻璃上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe sits and watches while you finish entering the sequence, and jumps a bit when she feels the ship lift off. She stares out in awe as you leave the planet’s atmosphere. She’s speechless as you completely exit the planet, face almost pressed against the glass of your view-screen."

rows.original: It’s at this point that you remember that you didn’t actually pick out a destination for this date! You flip through the extranet, looking for nearby events. Tuuva turns to you and notices what you’re doing.
rows.translation: 这时你才想起，自己根本没有为这场约会选好目的地！你浏览星网，寻找附近的活动。图瓦转头看你，注意到你正在做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s at this point that you remember that you didn’t actually pick out a destination for this date! You flip through the extranet, looking for nearby events. Tuuva turns to you and notices what you’re doing."

rows.original: “Something wrong?”
rows.translation: “出什么事了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Something wrong?”"

rows.original: “Um, no. Just getting the coordinates of where we’re going.”
rows.translation: “呃，没有。只是在获取目的地的坐标。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Um, no. Just getting the coordinates of where we’re going.”"

rows.original: <i>“Ooooh!
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ooooh! "

rows.original: Where are we going
rows.translation: 我们要去哪里
rows.raw: "Where are we going"

rows.original: Where we go
rows.translation: 我们去哪里
rows.raw: "Where we go"

rows.original: ?” She rushes up to you to see what you’re doing, prompting you to tap the first thing that isn’t a strip club. “OOOOH, THAT
rows.translation: ？”她冲到你身旁看你在做什么，促使你点下第一个不是脱衣舞俱乐部的项目。“哦哦哦哦，那个
rows.raw: "?” She rushes up to you to see what you’re doing, prompting you to tap the first thing that isn’t a strip club. “OOOOH, THAT "

rows.original: LOOKS SO NICE
rows.translation: 看起来真漂亮
rows.raw: "LOOKS SO NICE"

rows.original: LOOK SUPER NICE
rows.translation: 看起来超级漂亮
rows.raw: "LOOK SUPER NICE"

rows.original: !” You look down and see that you’ve landed on the page for a garden festival on Verifore Two. You’ve heard great things about Verifore, and it seems like the perfect contrast to show her the wonders of alien worlds. It’s a bit exclusive, but lucky for you, your family name gives you enough pull to get a spot immediately. Off to Verifore, you exclamate, causing her to cheer out.
rows.translation: ！”你低头发现，自己打开的是维里弗二号星的花园节页面。你听说过很多关于维里弗的好事，这似乎正是向她展示异星世界奇观的完美对比。活动有些排外，但幸运的是，你的家族姓氏拥有足够影响力，让你立刻得到席位。你高呼前往维里弗，她也随之欢呼。
rows.raw: "!” You look down and see that you’ve landed on the page for a garden festival on Verifore Two. You’ve heard great things about Verifore, and it seems like the perfect contrast to show her the wonders of alien worlds. It’s a bit exclusive, but lucky for you, your family name gives you enough pull to get a spot immediately. Off to Verifore, you exclamate, causing her to cheer out."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The warp trip to Verifore seems to be the most exciting part of the trip for the enraptured doggo; the myriad of colors flying past as you enter warp, all the different kinds of ship she sees, the idea that you’re going faster than should be physically possible. It all sets her off like a little kid on her first plane trip.
rows.translation: 对这只着迷的狗狗而言，跃迁前往维里弗似乎是途中最激动人心的部分：进入跃迁时飞掠而过的万千色彩、看见的各式飞船，还有速度超过物理法则理应允许范围的概念。这一切令她像第一次坐飞机的小孩般兴奋。
rows.raw: "The warp trip to Verifore seems to be the most exciting part of the trip for the enraptured doggo; the myriad of colors flying past as you enter warp, all the different kinds of ship she sees, the idea that you’re going faster than should be physically possible. It all sets her off like a little kid on her first plane trip."

rows.original: Finally, you reach Verifore, and both marvel at the lushness on display, even from so far up. To call the planet lush is an understatement; the trees and flowers in some areas must be at least two hundred kilometers tall! It’s fascinating just to look at from up here, you can’t imagine how it is on the ground.
rows.translation: 你们终于抵达维里弗，即使身在如此高处，两人仍惊叹于眼前繁茂的景象。称这颗星球繁茂都是轻描淡写；有些区域的树木与花朵至少高达二百公里！仅从这里观看就已十分迷人，完全无法想象地面上是什么样。
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, you reach Verifore, and both marvel at the lushness on display, even from so far up. To call the planet lush is an understatement; the trees and flowers in some areas must be at least two hundred kilometers tall! It’s fascinating just to look at from up here, you can’t imagine how it is on the ground."

rows.original: Actually landing is a thing onto itself. The lines are so long that it takes at least an hour for you to get to the hangar. However, this just gives you time to hang out with your date more. She finally takes off the heavy coat she was wearing, revealing a backless, knee-length, dark blue dress. It’s obviously been modified to fit her diminutive but wide size, but it still looks good on her.
rows.translation: 真正着陆本身就是一件大事。队伍长得让你至少花了一小时才抵达机库。不过，这也给你更多时间与约会对象相处。她终于脱下厚重外套，露出一件深蓝色露背及膝连衣裙。它显然经过修改，以适应她矮小却宽阔的体型，不过穿在身上依旧很好看。
rows.raw: "\n\nActually landing is a thing onto itself. The lines are so long that it takes at least an hour for you to get to the hangar.
