rows.raw: "\n\nYou call out her name to see if you get a response. The crying sound stops, and you hear a faint call."

rows.original: “H-hello?” It’s definitely Tuuva. You follow her voice, calling out for her to help guide you. Eventually you find a small fissure in the ground, and, looking down, you see Tuuva at the bottom. “H-help, p-please...” You yell down that you’re here and that you’re going to help her. Of course, you don’t really know how you’re going to get down the fissure. It’s not deep enough that you’d die if you fell, but you certainly don’t want to go jumping in any big, deep holes, that aren’t attached to a magnificent ass.
rows.translation: “你——你好？”肯定是图瓦。你循着她的声音前进，不断呼喊，让她帮忙引导方向。最终，你发现地面上有一道小裂缝；低头望去，只见图瓦就在底部。“救——救救我，求你...”你朝下大喊，说自己已经来了，而且会帮助她。当然，你其实不知道该怎样下到裂缝里。这里并没有深到摔下去便会丧命，但你当然不想随便跳进任何又大又深、而且还没有连接在美妙屁股上的洞。
rows.raw: "\n\n“H-hello?” It’s definitely Tuuva. You follow her voice, calling out for her to help guide you. Eventually you find a small fissure in the ground, and, looking down, you see Tuuva at the bottom. “H-help, p-please...” You yell down that you’re here and that you’re going to help her. Of course, you don’t really know how you’re going to get down the fissure. It’s not deep enough that you’d die if you fell, but you certainly don’t want to go jumping in any big, deep holes, that aren’t attached to a magnificent ass."

rows.original: You don’t want to, but nature has different plans. The ledge you’re standing on gives way, and you fall through before you can react. Lucky you manage to grab onto a ledge midway down, allowing you to make the rest of the fall with much less force. It still hurts when you land, but at least you didn’t break anything.
rows.translation: 你并不想这样，但大自然另有安排。脚下的岩架突然坍塌，你还没来得及反应便跌了下去。幸运的是，你成功抓住半途的一块岩架，让剩余坠落的冲击小了很多。落地时仍然很疼，不过至少没有摔断任何东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t want to, but nature has different plans. The ledge you’re standing on gives way, and you fall through before you can react. Lucky you manage to grab onto a ledge midway down, allowing you to make the rest of the fall with much less force. It still hurts when you land, but at least you didn’t break anything."

rows.original: Are you
rows.translation: 你还
rows.raw: "Are you"

rows.original: Friend
rows.translation: 朋友
rows.raw: "Friend"

rows.original: a-alright?” Tuuva asks, her voice very weak. You tell her that you aren’t the one who needs worrying about here. You turn on your Codex light and look over her. She’s beat up pretty bad, even still bleeding in certain spots. You pull out the medical kit that the scavenger gave you and start to work. Lucky her wounds aren’t that complex, and you have your codex to fill in any details you need.
rows.translation: 好——好吗？”图瓦问道，声音十分虚弱。你告诉她，这里需要担心的人并不是自己。你打开个人终端的灯光，检查她的情况。她伤得相当严重，有些地方甚至仍在流血。你取出拾荒者交给你的医疗包，开始治疗。幸运的是，她的伤口并不复杂，而个人终端可以补充你所需的任何细节。
rows.raw: " a-alright?” Tuuva asks, her voice very weak. You tell her that you aren’t the one who needs worrying about here. You turn on your Codex light and look over her. She’s beat up pretty bad, even still bleeding in certain spots. You pull out the medical kit that the scavenger gave you and start to work. Lucky her wounds aren’t that complex, and you have your codex to fill in any details you need."

rows.original: W-why did you come save me?
rows.translation: 你——你为什么来救我？
rows.raw: "W-why did you come save me?"

rows.original: F-friend save Tuuva, why?
rows.translation: 朋——朋友救图瓦，为什么？
rows.raw: "F-friend save Tuuva, why?"

rows.original: ” You say that she’s your friend, of course you’re not just going to leave her to die, if you can help it. “F-friend... thank you.” You finish tending to her wounds, and bring her to her feet. She still needs to be propped up by you, but the two of you can move.
rows.translation: ”你说她是自己的朋友，只要能够帮忙，当然不可能把她留在这里等死。“朋——朋友...谢谢你。”你处理完她的伤口，扶她站起来。她仍需要依靠你的支撑，不过你们两人已经可以移动。
rows.raw: "” You say that she’s your friend, of course you’re not just going to leave her to die, if you can help it. “F-friend... thank you.” You finish tending to her wounds, and bring her to her feet. She still needs to be propped up by you, but the two of you can move."

rows.original: And move you have to. You hear a pair of feet walking toward the fissure. What you think might be a search party quickly reveals its true form with the familiar growls of male milodans. <i>“
rows.translation: 而你们必须立刻移动。你听见一双脚朝裂缝走来。起初还以为可能是搜救队，但熟悉的雄性米洛丹低吼很快暴露了其真正身份。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd move you have to. You hear a pair of feet walking toward the fissure. What you think might be a search party quickly reveals its true form with the familiar growls of male milodans. <i>“"

rows.original: Milodans! We gotta hide, quick, into the cave!
rows.translation: 米洛丹！我们得躲起来，快，进洞穴！
rows.raw: "Milodans! We gotta hide, quick, into the cave!"

rows.original: D-dumb cats! Quick, go into cave!
rows.translation: 笨——笨猫！快，进洞穴！
rows.raw: "D-dumb cats! Quick, go into cave!"

rows.original: ” You run deeper into the cave system, out of sight from the opening of the fissure.
rows.translation: ”你向洞穴系统深处跑去，离开裂缝入口的视野。
rows.raw: "” You run deeper into the cave system, out of sight from the opening of the fissure."

rows.original: There’s a few tense minutes where you can see the two hunter’s shadows in the fissure opening. They probably followed Tuuva’s voice, just like you did. You keep as quiet as possible, barely even wanting to breathe in fear that the pair will come down and attack you and the injured korgonne. You breathe a sigh of relief after they pass, still cautious about making too much sound.
rows.translation: 紧张的几分钟里，你能看到两名猎手的影子出现在裂缝入口。他们大概和你一样，是循着图瓦的声音而来。你尽可能保持安静，几乎不敢呼吸，生怕两人下来袭击你和受伤的科尔贡。等他们经过后，你如释重负地松了口气，但仍谨慎地避免发出太大声响。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a few tense minutes where you can see the two hunter’s shadows in the fissure opening. They probably followed Tuuva’s voice, just like you did. You keep as quiet as possible, barely even wanting to breathe in fear that the pair will come down and attack you and the injured korgonne. You breathe a sigh of relief after they pass, still cautious about making too much sound."

rows.original: Tuuva suddenly starts tugging you deeper into the cave. <i>“
rows.translation: 图瓦突然拉着你向洞穴更深处走去。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva suddenly starts tugging you deeper into the cave. <i>“"

rows.original: I’ve been in these caves before, so I know a way out. I wouldn’t have been able to make it without your help.
rows.translation: 我以前来过这些洞穴，所以知道一条出去的路。没有你的帮助，我根本走不出去。
rows.raw: "I’ve been in these caves before, so I know a way out. I wouldn’t have been able to make it without your help."

rows.original: Tuuva been here, know way out. No able to make it without help.
rows.translation: 图瓦来过这里，知道出去路。没有帮助，走不出去。
rows.raw: "Tuuva been here, know way out. No able to make it without help."

rows.original: ” That sounds like a plan. You walk with her while she leads you.
rows.translation: ”这听起来是个不错的计划。你陪她行走，由她带路。
rows.raw: "” That sounds like a plan. You walk with her while she leads you."

rows.original: Korgonne Medical Kit
rows.raw: "Korgonne Medical Kit"

rows.original: (Key Item Used: Korgonne Medical Kit.)
rows.translation: （已使用关键物品：科尔贡医疗包。）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Used: Korgonne Medical Kit.)"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The inside of the blacksmith’s shop is the definition of rustic. The walls are made of worn, uneven stone, with only small, bone sconces bearing dim torches to break it up. The floors are more polished, but are still notably worn and gritty, with only a few scattered pelts to keep walking on it from being painful. The store is separated into at least two chambers; the one you’re in, which is largely empty, sans a set of training dummies and a few sets of weapons and armor put on display, and what you can only assume is the forge, separated from the front room by a solid wall with a small door and a serving window.
rows.translation: 铁匠铺内部堪称乡村风格的典范。墙壁由磨损而凹凸不平的石头砌成，只有几盏装着昏暗火把的小型骨制壁灯打破单调。地面打磨得更光滑，但仍明显磨损且布满沙砾，只有零星铺着几张毛皮，才让人在上面行走时不至于疼痛。商店至少被分成两个房间；你所在的这一间基本空无一物，除了一组训练假人与几套展示的武器和护甲；另一间只能推测是锻造室，与前厅隔着一堵坚固墙壁，墙上开有一扇小门和一个服务窗口。
rows.raw: "The inside of the blacksmith’s shop is the definition of rustic. The walls are made of worn, uneven stone, with only small, bone sconces bearing dim torches to break it up. The floors are more polished, but are still notably worn and gritty, with only a few scattered pelts to keep walking on it from being painful. The store is separated into at least two chambers; the one you’re in, which is largely empty, sans a set of training dummies and a few sets of weapons and armor put on display, and what you can only assume is the forge, separated from the front room by a solid wall with a small door and a serving window."

rows.original: Tuuva Affection Cooldown
rows.raw: "Tuuva Affection Cooldown"

rows.original: Empty?
rows.translation: 没人？
rows.raw: "Empty?"

rows.original: Tuuva doesn’t seem to be in at the moment. Strangely, the door into the forge area is slightly open, and you can hear something stirring in the back. Maybe you should go investigate?
rows.translation: 图瓦此刻似乎不在。奇怪的是，通往锻造区的门微微敞开，而你能听见后面有什么东西在活动。也许应该进去调查一下？
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva doesn’t seem to be in at the moment. Strangely, the door into the forge area is slightly open, and you can hear something stirring in the back. Maybe you should go investigate?"

rows.original: Backroom
rows.translation: 后屋
rows.raw: "Backroom"

rows.original: Backroom
rows.translation: 后屋
rows.raw: "Backroom"

rows.original: Go into the forge area to investigate the strange noises.
rows.translation: 进入锻造区，调查奇怪的声响。
rows.raw: "Go into the forge area to investigate the strange noises."

rows.original: Tuuva Affection Cooldown
rows.raw: "Tuuva Affection Cooldown"

rows.original: You walk in to the shop and see a bit of a commotion. Several other korgs are gathered in the shop, looking geared up for a serious trek, and carrying mugs of some kind of brew. Tuuva is behind the counter handing equipment over to one of the men, but also seems to be kitted out, herself. She waves you over when she spots you, scooting the man getting equipment out of the way after he grabs what he needs.
rows.translation: 你走进商店，发现里面颇为热闹。其他几名科尔贡聚集在店里，似乎全副武装，准备进行一次严肃的远征，手中还拿着装有某种饮品的杯子。图瓦在柜台后把装备交给一名男子，不过她自己看起来也已整装待发。发现你后，她挥手示意你过去；等那名男子取走所需装备，她便把他推到一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk in to the shop and see a bit of a commotion. Several other korgs are gathered in the shop, looking geared up for a serious trek, and carrying mugs of some kind of brew. Tuuva is behind the counter handing equipment over to one of the men, but also seems to be kitted out, herself. She waves you over when she spots you, scooting the man getting equipment out of the way after he grabs what he needs."

rows.original: You walk up and ask exactly what’s going on. <i>“
rows.translation: 你走上前去，询问究竟发生了什么。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk up and ask exactly what’s going on. <i>“"

rows.original: My old scavenger friends came over and told me that they were low on people for a big expedition, so they asked me come with to help find some big ore deposits. It’s gonna be a dangerous trip, so I made a ton of equipment for all of us.
rows.translation: 从前的拾荒伙伴过来告诉我，他们要进行一次大型远征，但人手不足，所以请我一起去帮忙寻找大型矿脉。这趟旅程会很危险，于是我为大家制作了大量装备。
rows.raw: "My old scavenger friends came over and told me that they were low on people for a big expedition, so they asked me come with to help find some big ore deposits. It’s gonna be a dangerous trip, so I made a ton of equipment for all of us."

rows.original: Scavenge friends short on people, ask Tuuva to come help find big ores. Very danger though, so much equipment need.
rows.translation: 拾荒朋友人手少，请图瓦一起找大矿石。非常危险，所以需要很多装备。
rows.raw: "Scavenge friends short on people, ask Tuuva to come help find big ores. Very danger though, so much equipment need."

rows.original: One of the men slides a drink across the counter, toward Tuuva. She grabs it and chugs it down, causing the group to let out a collective cheer and drink down their own.
rows.translation: 一名男子把饮料沿柜台推向图瓦。她抓起来一饮而尽，引得众人齐声欢呼，也纷纷喝光自己的饮料。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the men slides a drink across the counter, toward Tuuva. She grabs it and chugs it down, causing the group to let out a collective cheer and drink down their own."

rows.original: We’ll be gone for a day and come back with tons of materials! See ya later!
rows.translation: 我们会离开一天，然后带着成吨材料回来！回头见！
rows.raw: "We’ll be gone for a day and come back with tons of materials! See ya later!"

rows.original: Gone for day, back later with loot, bye bye!
rows.translation: 离开一天，带战利品回来，拜拜！
rows.raw: "Gone for day, back later with loot, bye bye!"

rows.original: ” She doesn’t give you a chance to argue before she hops over the counter and leaves with the group.
rows.translation: ”她不给你争辩的机会，便跳过柜台，跟随众人离开。
rows.raw: "” She doesn’t give you a chance to argue before she hops over the counter and leaves with the group."

rows.original: Part of you wonders if it’s a good idea for her to go out, despite being out of it for so long. You suppose that even if she’s a bit rusty, she does have the rest of the team to help her out.
rows.translation: 你不禁怀疑，她离开拾荒生活这么久后再外出是否明智。不过想来，即使她有些生疏，至少还有队伍里的其他人可以帮忙。
rows.raw: "\n\nPart of you wonders if it’s a good idea for her to go out, despite being out of it for so long. You suppose that even if she’s a bit rusty, she does have the rest of the team to help her out."

rows.original: ...You really hope the fact that you’re thinking this isn’t some kind of foreshadowing.
rows.translation: ...你真的希望自己想到这些，并不是什么预示。
rows.raw: "\n\n...You really hope the fact that you’re thinking this isn’t some kind of foreshadowing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: KORGONNE_MALE
rows.raw: "KORGONNE_MALE"

rows.original: Korgonne
rows.translation: 科尔贡
rows.raw: "Korgonne"

rows.original: OH NO!
rows.translation: 哦，不！
rows.raw: "OH NO!"

rows.original: You enter the shop, expecting to see Tuuva, but instead it’s still cold and empty. You yell out to see if she’s just sleeping, but get no answer. You start to leave, hoping that it’s just a delay, rather than the worst, only to be met by one of the men from the expedition party.
rows.translation: 你走进商店，本以为会看到图瓦，里面却依旧寒冷空荡。你大声呼喊，想知道她是不是只在睡觉，却没有得到回应。你开始离开，希望这只是耽搁，而不是最糟糕的情况；这时，远征队中的一名男子迎面走来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou enter the shop, expecting to see Tuuva, but instead it’s still cold and empty. You yell out to see if she’s just sleeping, but get no answer. You start to leave, hoping that it’s just a delay, rather than the worst, only to be met by one of the men from the expedition party."

rows.original: Y-you’re Tuuva’s friend from the other day, right?
rows.translation: 你——你就是前几天图瓦的朋友，对吧？
rows.raw: "Y-you’re Tuuva’s friend from the other day, right?"

rows.original: Y-you Tuuva friend, yes?
rows.translation: 你——你是图瓦朋友，对？
rows.raw: "Y-you Tuuva friend, yes?"

rows.original: ” You nod, a sense of worry bubbling up in your gut, one that’s justified by his next words. “
rows.translation: ”你点点头，一股忧虑在腹中翻涌，而他接下来的话证明这种担忧完全合理。“
rows.raw: "” You nod, a sense of worry bubbling up in your gut, one that’s justified by his next words. “"

rows.original: W-we lost her. A few of us got caught in an avalanche. Tuuva managed to save me, and the rest got out alright, but she fell down into a hole that was uncovered by the shaking. We’ve sent out search parties, but none of them have found her yet. Please, help find her, you’re her friend after all!
rows.translation: 我——我们把她弄丢了。我们几个人遭遇了雪崩。图瓦成功救了我，其他人也都顺利脱险，但她掉进了震动暴露出来的一个洞里。我们派出了搜救队，可至今仍没人找到她。求你帮忙找到她吧，毕竟你是她的朋友！
rows.raw: "W-we lost her. A few of us got caught in an avalanche. Tuuva managed to save me, and the rest got out alright, but she fell down into a hole that was uncovered by the shaking. We’ve sent out search parties, but none of them have found her yet. Please, help find her, you’re her friend after all!"

rows.original: S-she gone, big snow slide! Tuuva save me, but she fall in big hole. We make look parties, but none find yet. Please help!
rows.translation: 她——她不见了，大雪滑下来！图瓦救了我，但她掉进大洞。我们派寻找队，但还没找到。请帮忙！
rows.raw: "S-she gone, big snow slide! Tuuva save me, but she fall in big hole. We make look parties, but none find yet. Please help!"

rows.original: Well great, turns out you’re clairvoyant, but only about the worst shit! Looks like you’re going to need to track Tuuva down. You ask for more information about where she could be, but all he tells you that she probably fell into an underground cave system, and that those can span a few miles. He does give you a medical kit for when you do find her, so that’s something at least.
rows.translation: 好极了，原来你有预知能力，却只对最糟糕的破事有效！看来你得追踪图瓦的下落。你询问她可能身在何处的更多信息，但他只告诉你，她大概掉进地下洞穴系统，而那些洞穴可能延伸数英里。不过，他确实交给你一个医疗包，以便找到她后使用；至少也算有所帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell great, turns out you’re clairvoyant, but only about the worst shit! Looks like you’re going to need to track Tuuva down. You ask for more information about where she could be, but all he tells you that she probably fell into an underground cave system, and that those can span a few miles. He does give you a medical kit for when you do find her, so that’s something at least."

rows.original: Korgonne Medical Kit
rows.raw: "Korgonne Medical Kit"

rows.original: (Key Item Gained: Korgonne Medical Kit!)
rows.translation: （获得关键物品：科尔贡医疗包！）
rows.raw: "\n\n(Key Item Gained: Korgonne Medical Kit!)"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Tuuva is still out on her expedition, and nobody has taken her place. You won’t be able to use the shop until she gets back.
rows.translation: 图瓦仍在外出远征，也没有人代替她。她回来之前，你无法使用商店。
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva is still out on her expedition, and nobody has taken her place. You won’t be able to use the shop until she gets back."

rows.original: There doesn’t seem to be anyone here, however there is a small bell hung in the window that you could ring.
rows.translation: 这里似乎没有任何人，不过窗口挂着一只可以摇响的小铃。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere doesn’t seem to be anyone here, however there is a small bell hung in the window that you could ring."

rows.original: Bell
rows.translation: 铃铛
rows.raw: "Bell"

rows.original: Bell
rows.translation: 铃铛
rows.raw: "Bell"

rows.original: Ring the bell.
rows.translation: 摇铃。
rows.raw: "Ring the bell."

rows.original: Tuuva is still recovering from your last encounter.
rows.translation: 图瓦仍在从你们上次的遭遇中恢复。
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva is still recovering from your last encounter."

rows.original: Tuuva
rows.translation: 图瓦
rows.raw: "Tuuva"

rows.original: Tuuva
rows.translation: 图瓦
rows.raw: "Tuuva"

rows.original: She’s going to need a little time to rest before talking with you again.
rows.translation: 她需要休息一段时间，才能再次与你交谈。
rows.raw: "She’s going to need a little time to rest before talking with you again."

rows.original: Tuuva peers at you over the counter,
rows.translation: 图瓦从柜台后探头看着你，
rows.raw: "\n\nTuuva peers at you over the counter, "

rows.original: seeing if you approach or not
rows.translation: 观察你是否靠近
rows.raw: "seeing if you approach or not"

rows.original: cracking a smile as she watches you
rows.translation: 看着你时露出微笑
rows.raw: "cracking a smile as she watches you"

rows.original: looking at you with wide eyes as you hear her stout tail swinging rapidly
rows.translation: 睁大双眼望着你，你听见她粗短的尾巴快速摆动
rows.raw: "looking at you with wide eyes as you hear her stout tail swinging rapidly"

rows.original: Hnnurrungun ven goor Cruff is a 6' 1" Kalabast. He dresses simply and tightly in a white t-shirt and black jeans, out of which the well-padded bulk of his tawny, short-furred body fairly bursts. That fur grows in wavy abundance from his head and jaw, adding to his lion-like profile. He’s got it combed back out of the way, although there’s still a certain wildness to it all; savannah in motion. Out of it his two big, lynx-like ears reach. Although he lacks the saber teeth and his nose is probably too broad, here on Uveto it might just be able to mistake him for a milodan were it not for his four eyes. Although the kalabast generally has an affable, purposeful manner about him, those pale yellow orbs with their round black pupils have an odd solemnity to them.
rows.translation: 赫努伦贡·文·古尔·克拉夫是一名身高6英尺1英寸的卡拉巴斯特。他穿着简单而紧身的白色T恤与黑色牛仔裤，结实而厚实的棕黄色短毛身体几乎要从衣物中撑出来。毛发从脑袋和下颚波浪般浓密生长，更突显狮子般的轮廓。他把毛发向后梳开，不过整体依然带着某种野性，仿佛流动的草原。两只山猫般的大耳朵从中伸出。虽然没有剑齿，鼻子或许也太宽，但在乌维托，要不是长着四只眼睛，人们也许真会把他误认为米洛丹。卡拉巴斯特通常待人和蔼、行事果断，不过那四颗浅黄色眼球与圆形黑色瞳孔却带着一股奇异的庄严。
rows.raw: "Hnnurrungun ven goor Cruff is a 6' 1\" Kalabast. He dresses simply and tightly in a white t-shirt and black jeans, out of which the well-padded bulk of his tawny, short-furred body fairly bursts. That fur grows in wavy abundance from his head and jaw, adding to his lion-like profile. He’s got it combed back out of the way, although there’s still a certain wildness to it all; savannah in motion. Out of it his two big, lynx-like ears reach. Although he lacks the saber teeth and his nose is probably too broad, here on Uveto it might just be able to mistake him for a milodan were it not for his four eyes. Although the kalabast generally has an affable, purposeful manner about him, those pale yellow orbs with their round black pupils have an odd solemnity to them."

rows.original: Cruff’s digitigrade legs and the heavy musculature in his back and shoulders give the impression that he could start padding around on all fours at any moment. Out of his pants a short, fluffy tail hangs. What might be in his pants is difficult to tell beyond a respectable bulge at crotch level, but you’d have to assume a kalabast owning a coterie of healthy fhan’i would have to have the equipment to back it up.
rows.translation: 克拉夫的趾行腿，以及后背与肩膀上的厚重肌肉，让人觉得他随时可能趴下，用四肢走动。一条毛茸茸的短尾巴垂在裤子外。除了胯间体面的隆起，很难判断裤子里面可能藏着什么；不过，一名拥有一群健康梵伊的卡拉巴斯特，想必也得有配得上的装备。

Out of his pants a short, fluffy tail hangs. What might be in his pants is difficult to tell beyond a respectable bulge at crotch level, but you’d have to assume a kalabast owning a coterie of healthy fhan’i would have to have the equipment to back it up."

rows.original: Estie is a 5' 2" Fhan’i. She dresses in a plain, pale green t-shirt with short, wide sleeves and matching long trousers. To this model of classic veterinarian garb her DD breasts add a considerable strain. Her nipples stand out quite clearly, evidently engorged by the rubbing material.
rows.translation: 埃丝蒂是一名身高5英尺2英寸的梵伊。她穿着一件朴素的浅绿色T恤，袖子短而宽大，下身搭配同色长裤。DD罩杯的乳房让这套经典兽医服装承受着相当大的压力。乳头格外清晰地凸显出来，显然被摩擦衣料刺激得充血。

To this model of classic veterinarian garb her DD breasts add a considerable strain. Her nipples stand out quite clearly, evidently engorged by the rubbing material."

rows.original: Estie’s skin is a ghostly, hairless white all across her body except at the tips of her webbed digits and shoulder-length tentacle hair, where it turns a bright purple. She’s got her tentacle hair styled in an asymmetric fashion, three or four of them slicing down one side of her face, the rest of them combed neatly behind her ear. Above the cute bottom giving some shape to her loose trousers, her long, limber tail curves outwards. With its horizontal fork at the end, it looks rather like a dolphin’s, but by its movements considerably more flexible.
rows.translation: 埃丝蒂全身肌肤呈幽灵般无毛的白色，只有带蹼手指的末端与齐肩触手发梢转为鲜艳紫色。她把触手头发整理成不对称样式，其中三四根斜垂在脸庞一侧，其余则整齐梳到耳后。她可爱的臀部为宽松长裤勾勒出些许形状，上方伸出一条柔韧的长尾，向外弯曲。末端呈水平分叉，看上去很像海豚尾巴，但从动作来看，柔韧性要高得多。

She’s got her tentacle hair styled in an asymmetric fashion, three or four of them slicing down one side of her face, the rest of them combed neatly behind her ear. Above the cute bottom giving some shape to her loose trousers, her long, limber tail curves outwards. With its horizontal fork at the end, it looks rather like a dolphin’s, but by its movements considerably more flexible."

rows.original: The fhan’i has a pretty, flat-nosed face with black, half-lidded eyes. She rarely turns to face the person she’s addressing; not quite sightless, but close. Her finned ears, constantly craning and twitching, are obviously doing most of her sensory work. She seems possessed by a tireless, perky energy, beaming at every person who enters the ship as if each were a beloved, seldom seen friend. Around her neck there is a slim, tight-fitting silver collar, with clasps both to the front and back.
rows.translation: 这名梵伊长着一张漂亮而扁鼻的脸，黑色双眼半阖。她很少转头面向谈话对象；还没有完全失明，但也相差不远。带鳍的耳朵不断伸展抽动，显然承担了大部分感知工作。她似乎拥有永不疲倦的活泼精力，对每个进入飞船的人灿烂微笑，仿佛对方都是自己深爱却罕见的朋友。她脖子上戴着一条纤细紧身的银色项圈，前后两侧都有搭扣。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fhan’i has a pretty, flat-nosed face with black, half-lidded eyes. She rarely turns to face the person she’s addressing; not quite sightless, but close. Her finned ears, constantly craning and twitching, are obviously doing most of her sensory work. She seems possessed by a tireless, perky energy, beaming at every person who enters the ship as if each were a beloved, seldom seen friend. Around her neck there is a slim, tight-fitting silver collar, with clasps both to the front and back."

rows.original: Again, there is nothing to indicate what kind of business she’s got going on genitalia-wise, but everything about her suggests she is a very normal young adult fhan’i.
rows.translation: 同样，没有任何迹象表明她的生殖器究竟是什么情况；但她身上的一切都说明，这是一名非常普通的年轻成年梵伊。

rows.original: “We take care of all pets,” replies Cruff, meeting your querying gaze steadily. “If you have a cat that needs spaying, a sloveatte that needs house training, a pexiga that needs declawing - we can do all of these things, kindly and efficiently.”
rows.translation: “我们照顾所有宠物，”克拉夫回答，平静地迎上你询问的目光。“如果你的猫需要绝育，斯洛维特需要如厕训练，佩克西加需要去除爪子——我们都能亲切高效地完成。”
rows.raw: "“We take care of all pets,” replies Cruff, meeting your querying gaze steadily. “If you have a cat that needs spaying, a sloveatte that needs house training, a pexiga that needs declawing - we can do all of these things, kindly and efficiently.”"

rows.original: “You got a big doggie? They get a free treat when they come in and they’re good. Because they’re such good dogs!” Estie puts in.

rows.raw: "\n\n“You got a big doggie? They get a free treat when they come in and they’re good. Because they’re such good dogs!” Estie puts in."

rows.original: “But yes, what we’re best known for are is our sapient pet tending,” Cruff says. “My people have a long tradition of owner-pet relationships - we believe they’re an incredibly healthy and fulfilling way for partners to express their love for one another, so long as they’re well managed.”
rows.translation: “不过没错，我们最出名的是照料有智慧的宠物，”克拉夫说道，“我的族人拥有悠久的主宠关系传统——我们相信，只要妥善管理，这种关系便是伴侣彼此表达爱意的一种极为健康、令人满足的方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But yes, what we’re best known for are is our sapient pet tending,” Cruff says. “My people have a long tradition of owner-pet relationships - we believe they’re an incredibly healthy and fulfilling way for partners to express their love for one another, so long as they’re well managed.”"

rows.original: “Don’t despair,” the kalabast replies, in a low, comforting growl. “Something we do here is to match prospective pets and owners up. We pride ourselves on not stopping until we’ve found perfect matches. It’s a big galaxy out there, after all.”

rows.raw: "\n\n“I love animals,” says Cruff simply. He moves across to one of the tanks, flourishing his hand so that holographic displays circle three of his claws. A mouthless, undulating creature somewhere between a moray and a long piece of coral slinks out of the rocks, luminescent antlers glittering curiously. Cruff flashes a series of colors at it with twitches of his paws; the marine creature responds excitedly, a rainbow flashing across its appendages."

rows.original: “Upon every planet we visit, I try and obtain something tameable and unique,” he continues, doing whatever it is he’s doing. Communicating? Petting? Feeding? “Something that will be a challenge, if possible. So I can try out new techniques, see what works across different physiologies and types of mind, keep our food synthesizer guessing. I have to say that in this respect, Uveto has been a... challenge.” He barks with laughter. “There is a creature I’d heard rumours of, the Lureling, that sounded promising. Now I know slightly more about it, I’m going to have to set my sights a lot lower.”
rows.translation: “每到一个星球，我都会设法获得某种可驯服又独特的生物，”他继续做着那件不知是什么的事。交流？爱抚？喂食？“最好还具有挑战性。这样我就能尝试新技巧，看看哪些方法适用于不同生理结构与心智类型，也让食物合成器猜个不停。不得不说，就这一点而言，尤维托一直是个... 挑战。”他放声大笑。“我曾听说过一种叫诱灵族的生物，听起来颇有希望。现在多了解了一些后，我只得把目标降得低得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Upon every planet we visit, I try and obtain something tameable and unique,” he continues, doing whatever it is he’s doing. Communicating? Petting? Feeding? “Something that will be a challenge, if possible. So I can try out new techniques, see what works across different physiologies and types of mind, keep our food synthesizer guessing. I have to say that in this respect, Uveto has been a... challenge.” He barks with laughter. “There is a creature I’d heard rumours of, the Lureling, that sounded promising. Now I know slightly more about it, I’m going to have to set my sights a lot lower.”"

rows.original: He withdraws his hand. The creature extends a bony pedipalp to tap against the glass soulfully, before retracting back into its lair.
rows.translation: 他收回手。那生物伸出一根骨质触肢，深情地轻敲玻璃，随后缩回巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe withdraws his hand. The creature extends a bony pedipalp to tap against the glass soulfully, before retracting back into its lair."

rows.original: “There is some cross-over of course, between caring for animals and sapient beings,” Cruff says, looking back over at you. “Instinctively recognising animal reactions, what’s making something unhappy or unhealthy - that’s an incredibly useful skill. Looking after sapient pets is a hundred times more rewarding, though. The joy of making the most of someone’s intelligence and personality by getting them to obey you, or helping others achieve such a thing - you can’t ever know it if you are merely a vet. Too many people retreat into themselves using animals, give up on their fellow beings as too complicated or cruel. It’s a sad thing.”
rows.translation: “照顾动物与智慧生物之间当然有些共通之处，”克拉夫回头看向你，“本能辨认动物反应，弄清是什么令某物不快或不健康——这是极其实用的技能。不过照料智慧宠物，回报要高上百倍。让某人服从你，从而充分发挥其智慧与个性；或帮助别人实现这一点——如果只做兽医，你永远无法体会这种喜悦。太多人借动物退缩进自己的世界，认为同类太复杂或残酷，便放弃他们。这很可悲。”

Looking after sapient pets is a hundred times more rewarding, though. The joy of making the most of someone’s intelligence and personality by getting them to obey you, or helping others achieve such a thing - you can’t ever know it if you are merely a vet. Too many people retreat into themselves using animals, give up on their fellow beings as too complicated or cruel. It’s a sad thing.”"

rows.original: “He’s just saying that, you know,” Estie giggles. “I think if he could spend all of his time with his quags and his varmints, he would. They’re good quags.”
rows.translation: “他只是嘴上这么说，你知道的，”埃丝蒂咯咯笑道，“我觉得如果能把全部时间都花在夸格和害兽身上，他肯定会这么做。它们可是乖夸格。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He’s just saying that, you know,” Estie giggles. “I think if he could spend all of his time with his quags and his varmints, he would. They’re good quags.”"

rows.original: You ask if this sort of relationship is common between the kalabast and fhan’i.
rows.translation: 你询问卡拉巴斯特与梵伊之间的这种关系是否常见。
rows.raw: "You ask if this sort of relationship is common between the kalabast and fhan’i."

rows.original: “The only way it was, used to be,” replies Cruff. “The only way our two races could get along.”
rows.translation: “过去只有这一种方式，”克拉夫回答，“我们的两个种族只有这样才能相处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The only way it was, used to be,” replies Cruff. “The only way our two races could get along.”"

rows.original: “Denkozenne is our home, but fhan’i aren’t native to it,” Estie says. “Took us a while to figure that out, but it makes sense, since we’re different to pretty much everything else that lives there. Our crazy ancestors crash-landed there a long, long time ago, but couldn’t produce males for some reason. Still dunno why. So we stole other race’s males. Mostly the kalabast, owing to them not being feral like everything else.”
rows.translation: “登科泽恩是我们的家乡，但梵伊并非原生种，”埃丝蒂说道，“我们花了很久才弄明白，不过这很合理，因为我们和那里几乎所有其他生物都不一样。很久很久以前，我们疯狂的祖先坠毁在那里，却不知为何无法生出雄性。现在仍不知道原因。所以我们偷走其他种族的雄性，主要是卡拉巴斯特，因为他们不像其他生物那样野蛮。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Denkozenne is our home, but fhan’i aren’t native to it,” Estie says. “Took us a while to figure that out, but it makes sense, since we’re different to pretty much everything else that lives there. Our crazy ancestors crash-landed there a long, long time ago, but couldn’t produce males for some reason. Still dunno why. So we stole other race’s males. Mostly the kalabast, owing to them not being feral like everything else.”"

rows.original: “The early history of our planet is one of endless strife,” Cruff goes on. “Wars of attrition. Terrible actions carried out by both sides. Look it up if you wish, I do not wish to talk of it. What you learn and see in school as a cub is enough to tell you that the end result - of the kalabast keeping the fhan’i as possessions, so that both races could endure - was better than what came before it. Perverse yes, wrong in many ways, but only when it became the norm did Denkozenne know planet-wide peace.”
rows.translation: “我们星球的早期历史充满无尽纷争，”克拉夫继续说道，“消耗战。双方都犯下骇人暴行。想知道就自己查，我不愿谈论。幼崽在学校里学到和看到的事情，足以告诉你最终结果——卡拉巴斯特把梵伊当作财产，使两个种族都能延续——比此前局面更好。是的，它很反常，在许多方面都错误，但直到这成为常态，登科泽恩才终于迎来全球和平。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The early history of our planet is one of endless strife,” Cruff goes on. “Wars of attrition. Terrible actions carried out by both sides. Look it up if you wish, I do not wish to talk of it. What you learn and see in school as a cub is enough to tell you that the end result - of the kalabast keeping the fhan’i as possessions, so that both races could endure - was better than what came before it. Perverse yes, wrong in many ways, but only when it became the norm did Denkozenne know planet-wide peace.”"

rows.original: “The kalabast were mad as heck cuz we wiped out all their females for all time,” Estie says with a heartfelt sigh. “You can kinda understand it.”
rows.translation: “卡拉巴斯特气疯了，因为我们永远消灭了他们所有雌性，”埃丝蒂由衷叹息，“这多少可以理解。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The kalabast were mad as heck cuz we wiped out all their females for all time,” Estie says with a heartfelt sigh. “You can kinda understand it.”"

rows.original: “Are things still the same way?” you ask.
rows.translation: “现在还是这样吗？”你问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are things still the same way?” you ask."

rows.original: “Stars no. The anatae wouldn’t allow sexual slavery just for starters.”
rows.translation: “星辰啊，当然不是。首先，安纳泰不会允许性奴役。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stars no. The anatae wouldn’t allow sexual slavery just for starters.”"

rows.original: Anatae
rows.raw: "Anatae"

rows.original: You give him a querying look. “Whole different kettle of feathers. All you need to know is: they uplifted us, and that means something very different than being discovered by humans or the ausar.”
rows.translation: 你向他投去疑问目光。“完全是另一回事。你只需知道：他们提升了我们，而这和被人类或奥萨发现有着截然不同的意义。”
rows.raw: " You give him a querying look. “Whole different kettle of feathers. All you need to know is: they uplifted us, and that means something very different than being discovered by humans or the ausar.”"

rows.original: Anatae
rows.raw: "Anatae"

rows.original: Cruff shrugs, ponderous gold bulk in corn-like motion. “The fhan’i have the same rights we do nowadays. The owner and pet roles are simply what we are used to, a cultural default if you like. As the kaithrit continue their matriarchal chauvinism, and humans continue their fifteen year long trysts the taboos and conditions of which are dictated by one party’s mother.”
rows.translation: 克拉夫耸耸肩，沉重金色身躯像玉米般晃动。“如今梵伊拥有和我们一样的权利。主人与宠物的角色只是我们的习惯，或者说文化默认。就像凯斯利特继续奉行母系沙文主义，而人类继续维持长达十五年的恋情，其中禁忌和条件全由其中一方的母亲决定。”
rows.raw: " Cruff shrugs, ponderous gold bulk in corn-like motion. “The fhan’i have the same rights we do nowadays. The owner and pet roles are simply what we are used to, a cultural default if you like. As the kaithrit continue their matriarchal chauvinism, and humans continue their fifteen year long trysts the taboos and conditions of which are dictated by one party’s mother.”"

rows.original: “Call us traditionalists, if you like!” Estie squeezes Cruff’s arm. “It was definitely kinda weird to begin with, flying around and discovering what you’re told is true - what’s just normal for us is kinky and dirty for most others. People will ask why I’m ok with being owned and ordered around by big mean ol’ Cruff, and I’m like um? That ring around your finger, that means there’s things you aren’t allowed to do, right? Do you not do them because you’re forced to, or because you feel a duty towards the person you love? You can take it off and walk away if you don’t like it, right?”
rows.translation: “喜欢的话，就叫我们传统主义者吧！”埃丝蒂抱紧克拉夫的手臂。“起初四处飞行、发现自己被告知的事实，确实有点奇怪——对我们只是正常的事，对多数人而言却很变态又肮脏。人们会问，我为什么愿意被凶巴巴的大块头克拉夫拥有和使唤，而我就会想，嗯？你手指上的戒指，意味着有些事不允许做，对吧？你不做那些事，是因为被迫，还是因为觉得自己对所爱的人负有责任？不喜欢的话，你也能摘掉戒指离开，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Call us traditionalists, if you like!” Estie squeezes Cruff’s arm. “It was definitely kinda weird to begin with, flying around and discovering what you’re told is true - what’s just normal for us is kinky and dirty for most others. People will ask why I’m ok with being owned and ordered around by big mean ol’ Cruff, and I’m like um? That ring around your finger, that means there’s things you aren’t allowed to do, right? Do you not do them because you’re forced to, or because you feel a duty towards the person you love? You can take it off and walk away if you don’t like it, right?”"

rows.original: You ask them how long they’ve been here on Uveto.
rows.translation: 你询问他们在尤维托停留了多久。
rows.raw: "You ask them how long they’ve been here on Uveto."

rows.original: “Longer than we would usually stay,” says Cruff. “The huskar are big, they have a lot of fur, the mining operations provide them with a fair amount of income and there isn’t a massive amount else going on. Isolation aside, this is an ideal spot for us.”
rows.translation: “比我们通常停留的时间更久，”克拉夫说道，“哈斯卡人体型大、毛发多，采矿业给他们带来不少收入，这里也没有太多其他活动。除开与世隔绝，这对我们而言是个理想地点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Longer than we would usually stay,” says Cruff. “The huskar are big, they have a lot of fur, the mining operations provide them with a fair amount of income and there isn’t a massive amount else going on. Isolation aside, this is an ideal spot for us.”"

rows.original: “Except for the weather.” Estie’s tentacles shudder. “My studies told me that pet/owner relationships are only pronounced amongst ausar when humans are present too, but that’s soooo not the case. They’re at it with each other all the time on these remote colonies! I think human culture has imprinted the idea on them really strongly. It’s super cute - and, uh, really useful as far as we’re concerned.”
rows.translation: “除了天气。”埃丝蒂的触手颤抖起来。“我的研究说，奥萨之间的宠物与主人关系只有在人类也在场时才明显，但事实完——全不是这样。他们在这些偏远殖民地一直彼此这么做！我觉得人类文化把这个观念深深烙进他们心里。超级可爱——而且，呃，就我们而言也真的很实用。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Except for the weather.” Estie’s tentacles shudder. “My studies told me that pet/owner relationships are only pronounced amongst ausar when humans are present too, but that’s soooo not the case. They’re at it with each other all the time on these remote colonies! I think human culture has imprinted the idea on them really strongly. It’s super cute - and, uh, really useful as far as we’re concerned.”"

rows.original: “Do the toves visit, too?”
rows.translation: “托维人也会来吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do the toves visit, too?”"

rows.original: “Oh yes!” Estie claps her hands excitedly. “They aren’t interested in the sexy stuff at all, but omistars are they fixated with their feathers or what? Luckily I had a lot of practice with anatae before we came here.”
rows.translation: “噢，会的！”埃丝蒂兴奋拍手。“他们对色情部分完全没兴趣，但我的星辰啊，他们是不是太执着于羽毛了？幸好来这里前，我和安纳泰练习过很多次。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yes!” Estie claps her hands excitedly. “They aren’t interested in the sexy stuff at all, but omistars are they fixated with their feathers or what? Luckily I had a lot of practice with anatae before we came here.”"

rows.original: “We have special dispensation to freely travel outside of the Empire,” Cruff says, gesturing at one of the many signed and sealed documents on the wall. “‘To Promote and Foster Imperial Values in the Hinter Regressia.’ The anatae like people like us travelling around the U.G.C. offering colourful goods and services, they believe it fights their public image of repressive lovers of massive concrete buildings. The money we earn returning home is obviously a bonus.”
rows.translation: “我们获特别许可，可以自由前往帝国外部，”克拉夫指着墙上众多签署盖章的文件之一，“‘在偏远落后地区宣传并培育帝国价值观。’安纳泰喜欢我们这样的人在联合银河邦联各处旅行，提供丰富多彩的商品与服务；他们认为这能对抗自己作为迷恋巨型混凝土建筑的压迫者之公众形象。我们回国时带回的收入当然也是额外好处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We have special dispensation to freely travel outside of the Empire,” Cruff says, gesturing at one of the many signed and sealed documents on the wall. “‘To Promote and Foster Imperial Values in the Hinter Regressia.’ The anatae like people like us travelling around the U.G.C. offering colourful goods and services, they believe it fights their public image of repressive lovers of massive concrete buildings. The money we earn returning home is obviously a bonus.”"

rows.original: “Any reason you aren’t touring the frontier?”
rows.translation: “你们为什么不去边疆巡游？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Any reason you aren’t touring the frontier?”"

rows.original: “Beyond the fact that rough, infant colonies rarely have much use for beauty treatments? I don’t like leading my pets into real danger, and the political situation on recently founded worlds is always a worry. Native opinion might turn in an instant, opportunistic pirates can come sweeping through, whichever power is in charge can hand down quarantines or confiscations at a moment’s notice. U.G.C. held worlds in particular... I don’t like the thought of it at all.” Cruff sighs heavily. “However, I’ve promised Estie we will visit the planet Mhen’ga at some point, because...”
rows.translation: “除了粗陋的新生殖民地很少需要美容护理之外？我不喜欢把宠物带进真正危险的地方，而且新近建立的世界政治局势总令人担忧。原住民态度可能瞬间改变，投机海盗可能席卷而来，掌权势力随时可能颁布隔离或没收令。尤其是联合银河邦联控制的世界... 我完全不喜欢这个念头。”克拉夫沉重叹息。“不过，我答应过埃丝蒂，总有一天会造访门加，因为...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Beyond the fact that rough, infant colonies rarely have much use for beauty treatments? I don’t like leading my pets into real danger, and the political situation on recently founded worlds is always a worry. Native opinion might turn in an instant, opportunistic pirates can come sweeping through, whichever power is in charge can hand down quarantines or confiscations at a moment’s notice. U.G.C. held worlds in particular... I don’t like the thought of it at all.” Cruff sighs heavily. “However, I’ve promised Estie we will visit the planet Mhen’ga at some point, because...”"

rows.original: “Because we’ve gotta see the vanae!” Estie drums her fists on the desk with even greater excitement. “You promised Master, c’mon! We’re gonna get there way before any of our scientists do, it’s gonna be so awesome! Imagine if I can communicate with them - the things we might be able to discover from them!”
rows.translation: “因为我们必须去看看瓦妮！”埃丝蒂更加兴奋地用拳头敲桌。“你答应了，主人，拜托！我们会比任何科学家都早到那里，肯定棒极了！想想看，如果我能与她们交流——也许能从她们身上发现多少东西！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because we’ve gotta see the vanae!” Estie drums her fists on the desk with even greater excitement. “You promised Master, c’mon! We’re gonna get there way before any of our scientists do, it’s gonna be so awesome! Imagine if I can communicate with them - the things we might be able to discover from them!”"

rows.original: “They are lethal, savage kidnappers, Estie. If we go looking for them at all it’s going to be in the company of at least five sentry droids. If.”
rows.translation: “她们是致命、野蛮的绑架者，埃丝蒂。如果真去找她们，至少要有五台哨戒机器人随行。只是如果。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They are lethal, savage kidnappers, Estie. If we go looking for them at all it’s going to be in the company of at least five sentry droids. If.” "

rows.original: A pleasant herbal smell engulfs you as you enter. Warm light suffuses the room, and the walls crawl with dark green vines. Are they real? The rustle of leaves and sounds of a deep, sultry jungle surely can’t be. About twenty plush pads of various sizes float in the middle of the room like a giant, untethered mobile.
rows.translation: 进入时，一股宜人草药香气将你包围。温暖灯光充满房间，深绿色藤蔓爬满墙壁。它们是真的吗？树叶沙沙声与深邃闷热丛林的声响肯定不可能是真的。约二十块大小各异的柔软垫子漂浮在房间中央，仿佛一座没有系绳的巨型悬挂饰品。

rows.original: You gingerly sit down on one of the larger floating pads, and instantly the rest form a chair for you, contouring perfectly to suit your frame and [pc.legs].
rows.translation: 你小心坐在一块较大的漂浮软垫上，其余软垫立即组成座椅，完美贴合你的体形与[pc.legs]。
rows.raw: " You gingerly sit down on one of the larger floating pads, and instantly the rest form a chair for you, contouring perfectly to suit your frame and [pc.legs]."

rows.original: You gingerly sit down on one of the larger floating pads, and instantly the rest form a chair for you, contouring perfectly to suit your frame. Smaller pads place themselves underneath your tail and lift it up, so eventually your whole serpentine frame is languorously stretched out.
rows.translation: 你小心坐在一块较大的漂浮软垫上，其余软垫立即组成座椅，完美贴合你的体形。较小的软垫自行垫在尾巴下方将其托起，最终让你整副蛇形身躯慵懒地舒展开来。
rows.raw: " You gingerly sit down on one of the larger floating pads, and instantly the rest form a chair for you, contouring perfectly to suit your frame. Smaller pads place themselves underneath your tail and lift it up, so eventually your whole serpentine frame is languorously stretched out."

rows.original: As you ooze over to the pads, they disperse to form buffers around you. You’re soon in the middle of a wide armchair-like arrangement perfect for your slimy bulk. You sigh as you relax back into it. Why don’t you have anything like this on your ship?
rows.translation: 你朝软垫缓缓流去时，它们散开，在周围形成缓冲结构。很快，你便置身于宽阔的扶手椅式布局中央，完美容纳黏滑庞大的身体。你向后放松，叹了口气。飞船上为什么没有这样的东西？
rows.raw: " As you ooze over to the pads, they disperse to form buffers around you. You’re soon in the middle of a wide armchair-like arrangement perfect for your slimy bulk. You sigh as you relax back into it. Why don’t you have anything like this on your ship?"

rows.original: As you trot over to the pads, they disperse, larger ones sliding themselves underneath your lower body, smaller ones swaddling themselves behind your joints. When you gingerly relax, you find the harness-like structure they’ve formed takes your weight easily. It probably looks very weird, but it’s relaxing to take the weight off your [pc.feet] for once.
rows.translation: 你小跑向软垫时，它们分散开来；较大的滑到下半身下面，较小的则包裹在关节后方。你小心放松时，发现它们组成的挽具式结构轻易承住体重。看起来大概非常古怪，不过难得让[pc.feet]卸下负担，确实令人放松。
rows.raw: " As you trot over to the pads, they disperse, larger ones sliding themselves underneath your lower body, smaller ones swaddling themselves behind your joints. When you gingerly relax, you find the harness-like structure they’ve formed takes your weight easily. It probably looks very weird, but it’s relaxing to take the weight off your [pc.feet] for once."

rows.original: “Stage one, then,” says Cruff. You experience a slight lurch in your belly as the pads rearrange themselves, slipping and sliding you carefully around as if you were a piece of gourmet food being transferred from tray to plate. You wind up on your stomach, back up, arms and [pc.legOrLegs] held level.
rows.translation: “那么，第一阶段，”克鲁夫说道。软垫重新排列时，你腹中略感摇晃；它们小心地滑动、搬运你，仿佛把一道珍馐从托盘移到餐盘。最终你俯卧着，背部朝上，双臂与[pc.legOrLegs]平稳托起。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Stage one, then,” says Cruff. You experience a slight lurch in your belly as the pads rearrange themselves, slipping and sliding you carefully around as if you were a piece of gourmet food being transferred from tray to plate. You wind up on your stomach, back up, arms and [pc.legOrLegs] held level."

rows.original: Cruff spends a long moment silently considering your [pc.skinFurScales], before turning to the selection of unguents Estie brought in. You sigh and empty your mind of niggling worry as you feel the soft, warm pads of his hands lay themselves upon your flanks, working the oil they’re slathered in into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with firm, sweeping movements. As he’s doing that, Estie pops up in front of you with a jar of pale cream and circular pads.
rows.translation: 克鲁夫沉默许久，仔细端详你的[pc.skinFurScales]，随后转向艾丝蒂带来的软膏。感觉他柔软温暖的掌垫落在身体两侧，以坚定宽大的动作把掌上油液揉入[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]时，你叹息着放空思绪，不再为细小忧虑烦扰。与此同时，艾丝蒂拿着一罐浅色乳霜和圆形敷片出现在面前。
rows.raw: "\n\nCruff spends a long moment silently considering your [pc.skinFurScales], before turning to the selection of unguents Estie brought in. You sigh and empty your mind of niggling worry as you feel the soft, warm pads of his hands lay themselves upon your flanks, working the oil they’re slathered in into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with firm, sweeping movements. As he’s doing that, Estie pops up in front of you with a jar of pale cream and circular pads."

rows.original: “No silly faces, please,” she warns, her jovial smile the last thing you see before the pads are pressed over your [pc.eyes] and the rest of your face is caked in the cool cream. The fhan’i’s slim digits spread across your face at the same time as the kalabast’s wide paws massage your back, and the effect is one of deep relaxation - of all the knots of tension in your muscles and mind slowly being unwound and smoothed over. With your eyes covered and the peaceful jungle sounds in your ears you find yourself entering a pliant, dozy state, happy for the four masterful hands to roam around and touch your body as they wish.
rows.translation: “请别做鬼脸，”她警告道；那愉快笑容是敷片压在[pc.eyes]上、清凉乳霜涂满脸前，你最后看到的东西。芬伊纤细手指在你脸上摊开，卡拉巴斯宽阔爪掌同时按摩背部，带来深度放松——肌肉和思绪里的紧张结扣都缓缓解开、抚平。双眼被遮住，耳畔回响宁静丛林声，你逐渐进入顺从困倦的状态，乐于让四只技艺高超的手随心游走、触碰身体。

In the soft state you’ve sunken into, you kind of just want to lie here and let him do that forever. Because you’ve been good, haven’t you? You’re a good [pc.boy].

Orroah takes a long whiff of her cup before telling you, “You might have noticed we’re rather unusual for thraggen.” Well, you’re not sure you’d go that far, it’s not like all thraggen are... “Savage barbarians that can only think of fighting or fucking all the time?” she laughs. “That would be going too far, yes, but it’s not entirely wrong either. Thraggen are built to fight, much like how a bird is built to fly. It’s simply a matter of instincts, really. Even if your mind objects, your instincts will still give rise to aggressive tendencies. And ours were particularly strong.” The two seem almost solemn as they speak of this (though Horkenn mostly just nods every time his wife speaks), but it seems clear that they have long since made their peace with whatever suffering came from their problem. “I grew up in an orphanage, you see,” Orroah explains. “One filled with kids of all kinds of races, and I was the only thraggen. And even for a thraggen, I was pretty violent. You can’t really help it, especially when you’re a kid. Emotions overwhelm you, whether you get excited or angry, and you lash out. With other thraggen kids, it would have been fine, but... Well, I ended up injuring a number of my siblings, and everytime I calmed down and saw how badly I hurt them, I felt horrible! I ended up growing up to hate violence and my own nature, doing everything I can to try and suppress myself with little success.” She nodded towards Horkenn, who continues. “Me, I just had an abusive mom. Not as bad as it is for one of you, since, y’know, we can deal with pain better. Still, it was mostly the yelling and always being angry at me and everything that I hated the most. We still got angry or horny and hit each other sometimes, but we knew the other could take a punch, and we were both glad to take it so that our loved one wouldn’t end up hurting someone else.” “But still, even if we grew to accept that it’s okay to hurt someone who’s okay with it, we wanted some better control over ourselves,” the motherly thraggen huffs. “We tried all kinds of medicine, went to see expert psychologists, tried all kinds of phony remedies, and eventually stumbled upon tea.” Tea? Just, simple tea? “Yeah. Of course, that alone didn’t do that much, but it put us on the right track. We started getting all kinds of tea leaves, thought to try growing our own, realized we could grow some flowers next to them for fun and open a flower shop in a place where there weren’t any, then realized meditating and tea made from flowers were just about the best thing we could find to calm ourselves. And there we are!” Wow. You have to admit, you didn’t expect them to pour their heart out to you like that, but you feel genuinely glad that they did find a solution to their problem. And they managed to make a living out of it, too. “Well, mostly we’re living off the veggie patch,” Horkenn says. The two gardeners chuckle, then with a sigh Orroah turns back to you. “Was there anything else you wanted to talk about?”
rows.translation: 这样很惬意。不过，虽然你确实很享受这杯茶，他们先前所说“拯救”了自己的“避风港”仍令你略感在意。打破笼罩三人的舒适沉默几乎令你内疚，但你还是问，他们是否愿意解释那是什么意思？ 奥罗娅与霍肯互望一眼，安抚地微笑。奥罗娅深深闻了闻杯中香气，然后说道：“你或许注意到了，我们在特拉根中很不寻常。” 这个嘛，你不确定是否有那么夸张，又不是所有特拉根都... “只会整天想着战斗或交配的野蛮人？”她笑道，“这样说确实太过，但也并非完全错误。特拉根天生适合战斗，就像鸟儿天生适合飞行。说到底只是本能问题。即使理智反对，本能依然会催生攻击倾向，而我们的本能尤其强烈。” 两人谈起此事时近乎肃穆（不过霍肯大多只在妻子说话时点头），但显然早已接受这个问题曾带来的一切痛苦。 “我在孤儿院长大，”奥罗娅解释道，“那里有各种种族的孩子，而我是唯一的特拉根。即使在特拉根中，我也相当暴力。你其实控制不了，尤其还是孩子时。无论兴奋还是愤怒，情绪都会将你淹没，让你攻击别人。若身边是其他特拉根孩子，或许没事，可是... 我最后伤了不少兄弟姐妹；每次冷静下来，看见自己把他们伤得多重，我都难受极了！长大后，我开始憎恨暴力和自己的天性，竭尽所能压抑自己，却鲜有成效。” 她朝霍肯点头，后者接着说：“我嘛，只是有个虐待人的母亲。对我们来说没你们那么糟，毕竟，你知道，我们更能忍痛。但我最讨厌的，还是那些吼叫，还有她总是对我和一切发火。起初我一直反抗，直到某天朋友告诉我，我开始变得像母亲。这真的刺痛了我。我太容易对任何事发火，也变得和她一样暴力。意识到这点后，我有点厌恶自己，也明白自己根本从未享受过憎恨事物。所以我开始竭力不再生气，就和奥罗娅一样。”他转向她微笑。“刚认识时，我们谁都不擅长。” “确实完全不擅长，”奥罗娅赞同道，“这或许反而最好，因为我们正是这样相遇的：莫名其妙打了一架，尘埃落定后，两人看起来都更悲伤而非兴奋。我们聊过后发现彼此有同样的问题，于是共同尽力寻找解决办法。” 霍肯轻笑。“坦白说，那样我们已经很幸福。我们仍会生气或发情，有时也会打对方，但我们知道彼此受得住一拳，也都乐意承受，好让爱人不至于伤害其他人。” “不过，即使我们逐渐接受伤害一个愿意承受的人并无不可，仍想更好地控制自己，”这位母亲般的特拉根哼声道，“我们尝试各种药物，拜访专家心理学家，试过各种骗人的疗法，最终偶然发现了茶。” 茶？就只是普通的茶？ “对。当然，光靠它作用不大，但它引我们走上了正确道路。我们开始收集各种茶叶，想着自己种植，又发现可以在旁边种些花取乐，并在没有花店的地方开一家花店，然后才发现冥想与花茶几乎是我们所能找到的最佳镇静手段。于是就有了现在的一切！” 哇。你不得不承认，没料到他们会如此向你倾诉心声，但真心为他们找到解决办法而高兴，而且还靠它谋生。 “其实我们的生活主要靠菜地，”霍肯说道。 两位园丁轻笑起来，随后奥罗娅叹息一声，转回你身上。“还有别的事情想聊吗？”
rows.raw: " This is quite nice. But, while you really are enjoying this cup of tea, you do feel ever so slightly bothered by what they meant by a ‘haven’ that ‘saved’ them earlier. Almost feeling guilty for breaking the comfortable blanket of silence that lays on the three of you, you still ask if they wouldn’t mind explaining what they meant? Orroah and Horkenn glance at each other and smile reassuringly. Orroah takes a long whiff of her cup before telling you, “You might have noticed we’re rather unusual for thraggen.” Well, you’re not sure you’d go that far, it’s not like all thraggen are... “Savage barbarians that can only think of fighting or fucking all the time?” she laughs. “That would be going too far, yes, but it’s not entirely wrong either. Thraggen are built to fight, much like how a bird is built to fly. It’s simply a matter of instincts, really. Even if your mind objects, your instincts will still give rise to aggressive tendencies. And ours were particularly strong.” The two seem almost solemn as they speak of this (though Horkenn mostly just nods every time his wife speaks), but it seems clear that they have long since made their peace with whatever suffering came from their problem. “I grew up in an orphanage, you see,” Orroah explains. “One filled with kids of all kinds of races, and I was the only thraggen. And even for a thraggen, I was pretty violent. You can’t really help it, especially when you’re a kid. Emotions overwhelm you, whether you get excited or angry, and you lash out. With other thraggen kids, it would have been fine, but... Well, I ended up injuring a number of my siblings, and everytime I calmed down and saw how badly I hurt them, I felt horrible! I ended up growing up to hate violence and my own nature, doing everything I can to try and suppress myself with little success.” She nodded towards Horkenn, who continues. “Me, I just had an abusive mom. Not as bad as it is for one of you, since, y’know, we can deal with pain better. Still, it was mostly the yelling and always being angry at me and everything that I hated the most. At first I fought back all the time, ‘til one day a friend told me I was starting to act like my mom. That really got to me. I was getting angry at everything so easily and I got pretty violent too, just like her. Got kinda grossed out at myself when I realized that, and I also realized that I never even enjoyed hating stuff. So I started doing my best to never get angry, just like Orroah.” He turned to her and smiled. “Neither of us were any good at it when we first met.” “We really weren’t,” Orroah agrees. “Which is probably for the best, since it’s how we met: randomly getting into a fight, then both looking more sad than aroused when the dust settled. We talked and found out we had the same problem, and we did our best together to find a solution.” Horkenn chuckles. “To be frank, we were already happy like that. We still got angry or horny and hit each other sometimes, but we knew the other could take a punch, and we were both glad to take it so that our loved one wouldn’t end up hurting someone else.” “But still, even if we grew to accept that it’s okay to hurt someone who’s okay with it, we wanted some better control over ourselves,” the motherly thraggen huffs. “We tried all kinds of medicine, went to see expert psychologists, tried all kinds of phony remedies, and eventually stumbled upon tea.” Tea? Just, simple tea? “Yeah. Of course, that alone didn’t do that much, but it put us on the right track. We started getting all kinds of tea leaves, thought to try growing our own, realized we could grow some flowers next to them for fun and open a flower shop in a place where there weren’t any, then realized meditating and tea made from flowers were just about the best thing we could find to calm ourselves. And there we are!” Wow. You have to admit, you didn’t expect them to pour their heart out to you like that, but you feel genuinely glad that they did find a solution to their problem. And they managed to make a living out of it, too. “Well, mostly we’re living off the veggie patch,” Horkenn says. The two gardeners chuckle, then with a sigh Orroah turns back to you. “Was there anything else you wanted to talk about?” "

rows.original: So, you have to ask, do the two of them have any kids? They certainly have a parental feel to them. “Why, are you saying we look old?” says Orroah, a blatantly fake look of hurt on her face. “We are old,” Horkenn says plainly, confused that there should be any doubt. “And you’re more beautiful every year that passes.” “Oh, you oaf, I was making a joke,” his wife tells him, though her tone and face are clearly full of a deep fondness for the thick-headed man. “Ah, I’m never good at second degree,” the husband admits. “Don’t even know what temperature has got to do with it. But yes, we do have two children.” Right, but you haven’t seen a sign of them at all. Are they at school, or simply keeping out of the shop? Horkenn raises an eyebrow, but Orroah just laughs. “At school! Sweetie, they left the nest years ago! If anything, we’re waiting on them to have kids of their own to send to school.” You have to admit that it surprises you to hear that. They do look like they’re in their early-forties, so it’s not that weird when you really think about it, but still. “Aw, sweetie. Seems I’m surrounded by flatterers today,” the motherly thraggen says, looking fondly at you and her husband again. “We’re getting into our fifties now.” What. That means they’re both well over twice your age! But that, along with the fact that they did have kids, certainly does explain why they feel so, well, like a mom and dad. “I should hope so,” Orroah snickers. “I’m pretty sure our kids are about as old as you.” [var0 |There was another thing. Considering what you did and might get up to, is there any chance that... Y’know. Orroah snickers harder. “My, could you perhaps be hoping to knock up this old lady here? Or carrying my husband’s child?” she says teasingly. “Well, sorry to disappoint, but we’re permanently on Sterilex now. We had all the kids we wanted, and we aren’t going to have any kids and not raise them ourselves. So, no, there’s no chance of anyone here being knocked up when we fool around.” ] “Mhm,” Horkenn grunts in agreement. “Anything else you wanted to talk about?”

好了，这次短暂的下午茶休息虽然愉快，你确实得继续上路。两名斯拉根试图用续杯的茶和更多零食劝你留下，但你抵抗诱惑，站起身来。
	
	他们仍设法让你多吃几份“路上享用”的零食，扶你离开椅子，领回花店入口。抵达门前时，你细细品味这一刻，以及最后几口充满花香的空气。两名斯拉根拍拍你，向你送上[var0|甜蜜的告别之吻|每人一次温柔拥抱]，一边道别，一边嘱咐“要照顾好自己，听见了吗”、“记得好好吃饭”、“过马路要两边都看”，还说永远不要犹豫，随时都可以回来，哪怕只是像这次一样稍作休息。
	
	你离开商店时，内心远比进来时温暖，随后回到街道。
rows.raw:
"
	Well, as pleasant as this little teatime break was, you do have to get going. The two thraggen try to coax you with another tea refill and more snacks, but you resist the temptation and get up. 
	
	They still manage to make you eat a few more snacks ‘for the road’, helping you up from your chair and leading you back to the flower shop’s entrance. You savor the moment and these last few breaths full of flowery fragrances, before you reach the door. The two thraggen pat you and give you [var0|sweet goodbye kisses|a gentle hug each] as they bid you farewell, and to ‘take care, you hear,’ and to ‘remember to eat well,’ and to ‘watch both ways before crossing,’ and also that you shouldn’t ever hesitate to come back, if only for another little break like this one.
	
	You leave the shop feeling much warmer on the inside than you did when you came in, and get back to the streets.
	"
