rows.original: The mainframe chamber is in ruins after your battle with Typhon. Between the shot-up servers and the ruined sentry turrets the room reeks of burning plastic and metal. At least the AI’s insane babbling has stopped, and the closed door gives you a blessed moment of security. Still, it’s probably best to get out of here as soon as possible.
rows.translation: 与堤丰战斗后，主机室已成废墟。被射烂的服务器和毁坏的哨戒炮塔令房间弥漫塑料与金属烧焦的气味。至少AI疯狂的胡言乱语已停止，关上的门也给了你片刻可贵安全感。不过最好还是尽快离开。
rows.raw: "The mainframe chamber is in ruins after your battle with Typhon. Between the shot-up servers and the ruined sentry turrets the room reeks of burning plastic and metal. At least the AI’s insane babbling has stopped, and the closed door gives you a blessed moment of security. Still, it’s probably best to get out of here as soon as possible."

rows.original: With Janeria defeated the generator has come back online. There’s still an uncomfortably large hole in the wall, but the shields are holding back any more water from flooding the room and the pumps seem to be doing their job. The scorched remains of the creature have left a nasty stench in the room, and the emergency lights are still on due to the damage, but at least the planet’s no longer in danger of being assimilated by an oversized jellyfish. All in a day’s work.
rows.translation: 贾内利亚被击败后，发电机重新上线。墙上仍有个大得令人不适的洞，不过护盾挡住更多海水，水泵也似乎正在工作。怪物焦黑残骸给房间留下恶臭，损坏使应急灯仍然亮着，但至少这颗星球不再面临被巨型水母同化的危险。又是普通的一天。
rows.raw: "With Janeria defeated the generator has come back online. There’s still an uncomfortably large hole in the wall, but the shields are holding back any more water from flooding the room and the pumps seem to be doing their job. The scorched remains of the creature have left a nasty stench in the room, and the emergency lights are still on due to the damage, but at least the planet’s no longer in danger of being assimilated by an oversized jellyfish. All in a day’s work."

rows.original: The dull glow of the facility’s emergency lighting barely reaches you from here. It’s almost impossible to see anything but the trail of light posts ahead of you, and the water mutes all sounds of any kind. Even your own breathing seems faint and muffled because of the suit you’re wearing. It’s as close as you’ve ever experienced to utter sensory deprivation. You can only hope the trail leads you in the right direction.
rows.translation: 设施应急灯的暗淡光芒几乎照不到这里。除前方一列光柱外，几乎什么都看不见，海水也吞没了所有声音。因为身穿这套服装，甚至自己的呼吸都微弱含混。这是你所体验过最接近彻底感官剥夺的感觉。你只能希望道路通往正确方向。

rows.original: A cloud of swirling mist clings to this icy weapon at all times, nearly occluding the alien glyphs spelled out across its surface. Your Codex claims they translate as the “the Sleet Staff”, though it cannot tell you the strange script’s origin. Nevertheless, the source of its name is self-evident. The staff is freezing cold to the touch and so slick that wielding feels like a gamble, even with a pair of survival gloves from your pack. Maybe it’s not worth the difficulty. You dismiss the echoing thought from the back of your mind that suggests staying warm might not be worth it.
rows.translation: 这件冰冷武器始终笼罩在旋转薄雾中，几乎遮住表面拼写的外星字形。百科终端称其意为“雨夹雪法杖”，却无法判断奇异文字的来源。不过名称出处一目了然。法杖触感冰冷，光滑得即使戴着背包里的求生手套，挥舞起来也像在赌博。或许不值得如此费力。你忽略脑海深处回响的念头：也许保持温暖才不值得。
rows.raw: "A cloud of swirling mist clings to this icy weapon at all times, nearly occluding the alien glyphs spelled out across its surface. Your Codex claims they translate as the “the Sleet Staff”, though it cannot tell you the strange script’s origin. Nevertheless, the source of its name is self-evident. The staff is freezing cold to the touch and so slick that wielding feels like a gamble, even with a pair of survival gloves from your pack. Maybe it’s not worth the difficulty. You dismiss the echoing thought from the back of your mind that suggests staying warm might not be worth it."

rows.original: Once again, you board the Irestead space elevator - this time, going up. Unlike your trip down, the elevator’s barely occupied: only a couple of other spacers join you aboard, though the ever-present cargo remains aboard. Raw minerals from the Uvetan mines, you’d guess. A few moments after you embark, the station controller seals the doors, and you feel a sudden heft of gravity under your [pc.feet].
rows.translation: 你再次登上艾尔斯泰德太空电梯——这回向上。和下行时不同，电梯几乎空无一人：只有另外几名太空旅人与你同行，不过永远存在的货物仍在。你猜是尤维托矿区的原矿。登乘片刻后，空间站控制员封闭舱门，你感觉[pc.feet]下的重力骤然加重。
rows.raw: "Once again, you board the Irestead space elevator - this time, going up. Unlike your trip down, the elevator’s barely occupied: only a couple of other spacers join you aboard, though the ever-present cargo remains aboard. Raw minerals from the Uvetan mines, you’d guess. A few moments after you embark, the station controller seals the doors, and you feel a sudden heft of gravity under your [pc.feet]."

rows.original: It isn’t long before you’re racing upwards, hurtling through the atmosphere and into the heavens. The swirling colors of the Uvetan gas giant rise over the curves of the moon as you leave, bathing you in radiance for the brief trip back into orbit. The temperature drops rapidly as you ascend, at least in comparison to the control station, settling into a comfortable chill when the elevator locks into place at the space station’s center.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你便飞速上升，冲过大气层，进入天空。离开时，尤维托气态巨行星的旋转色彩从卫星弧面上升起，为返回轨道的短暂旅程沐浴光辉。随着上升，温度迅速下降，至少与控制站相比如此；电梯锁定在空间站中心时，气温稳定为舒适凉意。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt isn’t long before you’re racing upwards, hurtling through the atmosphere and into the heavens. The swirling colors of the Uvetan gas giant rise over the curves of the moon as you leave, bathing you in radiance for the brief trip back into orbit. The temperature drops rapidly as you ascend, at least in comparison to the control station, settling into a comfortable chill when the elevator locks into place at the space station’s center."

rows.original: The elevator locks in place with a distinctive ding, flashing its internal lights off and back into the sterile glow of the station interior.
rows.translation: 电梯伴随独特的叮声锁定位置，内部灯光闪灭，再切换成空间站内部无菌般的光芒。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe elevator locks in place with a distinctive ding, flashing its internal lights off and back into the sterile glow of the station interior."

rows.translation: “欢迎返回尤维托空间站，”你走出时，一个人工声音吟诵道，“祝您停留愉快。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back to Uveto Station,” an artificial voice intones as you disembark. “Please enjoy your stay.”"

rows.original: As you step off the elevator and back into the familiar, sterile atmosphere of Uveto Station, the normal quiet bustle of the station center is broken by a chorus of bubbly, girlish laughter. You glance around, vaguely thinking that at least one of those voices sounds familiar, and find your attention drawn to the open cafe just down the way.
rows.translation: 你走出电梯，重新进入尤维托空间站熟悉而无菌的环境，空间站中心平日安静的忙碌被一阵活泼少女笑声打破。你环顾四周，隐约觉得至少一个声音很熟悉，注意力随即被不远处开放式咖啡厅吸引。

You glance around, vaguely thinking that at least one of those voices sounds familiar, and find your attention drawn to the open cafe just down the way."

rows.original: Sure enough, a certain snowy-haired ausar babe is sitting at the nearest table, eagerly chatting away with a pair of husky huskar... aren’t those the two who “greeted” you before you first went moon-side? One in a Steele Tech jumpsuit just like Anno’s, if a bit more plus-sized, and the other in a sleek blue Akkadi uniform. Now that you’ve got a look at them from a distance, though, the change in clothes is about the only thing distinguishing one from the other: they’ve got the same voluptuously hourglass figure, the same long silver hair and manes of fluff around the neck... even the same mirthful blue eyes. Either those two are twins, or they’ve got some awesome tandem mod-work done.

rows.original: “Well, Galina here is one of Steele Tech’s top geologists,” Anno answers. “We might be in different divisions, but all us top brains are part of a shared extranet message hub. For bouncing ideas off each other and sharing data, that sort of thing. Easy to get to know each other.”

rows.translation: 电梯不断加速，仿佛你随时会飞离地板；它沿金属竖井雷鸣般冲向行星表面。你感觉自己像枪管里的子弹，等待着射入无垠漆黑的太空。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe elevator’s speed picks up until it seems like you could fly off the deck at any moment, thundering down the metallic shaft towards the planet’s surface. You feel like a bullet through a gun’s barrel, waiting to erupt into the endless black of space."

rows.original: Then, suddenly, you’re overwhelmed with light. You’re forced to shield your eyes against the unexpected glare, recoiling for a moment before opening your eyes and taking in the grandeur of space itself. The metallic coating of the elevator has given way to a translucent material, revealing the titanic gas giant Uveto in the distance, cresting the curving surface of the icy moon below. A planet rise, not a sunrise, but still just as radiant as anything you’ve seen before.
rows.translation: 随后，耀眼光芒突然将你淹没。意外的强光迫使你遮住双眼，后退片刻后才重新睁眼，领略太空本身的壮丽。电梯外层的金属覆层已让位于透明材质，露出远方庞大的乌维托气态巨行星，正从下方冰月弧形地平线升起。那不是日出，而是行星升起，却依旧如你见过的任何景象一样辉煌。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen, suddenly, you’re overwhelmed with light. You’re forced to shield your eyes against the unexpected glare, recoiling for a moment before opening your eyes and taking in the grandeur of space itself. The metallic coating of the elevator has given way to a translucent material, revealing the titanic gas giant Uveto in the distance, cresting the curving surface of the icy moon below. A planet rise, not a sunrise, but still just as radiant as anything you’ve seen before."

rows.original: The roiling gasses of the Uvetan giant cast brilliant colors across the surface of the tether’s shaft, not unlike a dark rainbow. Below you, the icy seventh moon rises towards you rapidly, reaching up to embrace you. The elevator begins to slow, machinery whirring underneath you to control the car’s descent as you begin to pass through the moon’s upper atmosphere. A moment later and you’re passing through the clouds, vision becoming obscured by ice and mist.
rows.translation: 乌维托巨行星翻腾的气体在系缆竖井表面投下绚丽色彩，犹如一道暗色彩虹。下方，第七冰月迅速向你升来，仿佛伸手迎接你。电梯开始减速，脚下机械嗡鸣着控制轿厢下降；你也开始穿过卫星的高层大气。不久，你穿入云层，视野被冰晶与雾气遮蔽。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe roiling gasses of the Uvetan giant cast brilliant colors across the surface of the tether’s shaft, not unlike a dark rainbow. Below you, the icy seventh moon rises towards you rapidly, reaching up to embrace you. The elevator begins to slow, machinery whirring underneath you to control the car’s descent as you begin to pass through the moon’s upper atmosphere. A moment later and you’re passing through the clouds, vision becoming obscured by ice and mist."

rows.original: The elevator screeches loudly, making your stomach lurch as it slows to a crawl at the top of a large, domed complex in the middle of a sprawling, snow-covered city. When the car finally comes to a halt, the door slides open with a hiss and a rush of air, depositing you in the middle of a metal-walled, heated complex.
rows.translation: 电梯刺耳尖啸着减至爬行速度，令你的胃一阵翻腾；它停向一座庞大穹顶建筑的顶部，建筑坐落在一片广阔的雪城中央。轿厢终于停稳后，门伴随嘶声与气流滑开，把你送进一座有金属墙壁、内部供暖的建筑群。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe elevator screeches loudly, making your stomach lurch as it slows to a crawl at the top of a large, domed complex in the middle of a sprawling, snow-covered city. When the car finally comes to a halt, the door slides open with a hiss and a rush of air, depositing you in the middle of a metal-walled, heated complex."

rows.original: A sign nearby simply states, “Welcome to Irestead.”
rows.translation: 附近一块牌子只写着：“欢迎来到伊尔斯泰德。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA sign nearby simply states, “Welcome to Irestead.”"

rows.original: Once more you board the Station-Irestead space elevator, joining a handful of other colonists and spacers, and what looks like a ton of industrial cargo heading down. A few moments after you board, the station controller seals the elevator shaft and sends the cart downwards. Speed picks up rapidly, making you feel as though you could go flying off at any moment. The metal shield around the shaft gives way half way down, bathing you once more in stellar light, a rainbow of colors reflecting off the Uvetan gas giant.
rows.translation: 你再次登上空间站—伊尔斯泰德太空电梯，与少数殖民者和太空旅客一道，还有看起来足足一吨、正运往地面的工业货物。你上车片刻后，空间站控制员封闭电梯井，让轿厢向下运行。速度迅速攀升，让你感觉自己随时会被甩飞。下降到一半时，竖井周围的金属护罩退去，你再度沐浴星光；乌维托气态巨行星反射出彩虹般的色泽。
rows.raw: "Once more you board the Station-Irestead space elevator, joining a handful of other colonists and spacers, and what looks like a ton of industrial cargo heading down. A few moments after you board, the station controller seals the elevator shaft and sends the cart downwards. Speed picks up rapidly, making you feel as though you could go flying off at any moment. The metal shield around the shaft gives way half way down, bathing you once more in stellar light, a rainbow of colors reflecting off the Uvetan gas giant."

rows.original: It’s a long ride down, growing colder by the moment as you pass through Uveto VII’s atmosphere and into the stormy world’s embrace. The Irestead control building reaches up to embrace you, though, a nest of warmth and safety. Your ride ends inside it, and the elevator doors open with a hiss and a rush of warm air.
rows.translation: 下降过程十分漫长。穿过乌维托七号的大气、投入这个暴风世界怀抱时，气温每分每秒都在降低。不过伊尔斯泰德控制大楼向上伸展着迎接你，如同一处温暖安全的巢穴。旅程在楼内结束，电梯门伴随嘶声与暖风开启。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a long ride down, growing colder by the moment as you pass through Uveto VII’s atmosphere and into the stormy world’s embrace. The Irestead control building reaches up to embrace you, though, a nest of warmth and safety. Your ride ends inside it, and the elevator doors open with a hiss and a rush of warm air."

rows.original: A sign near where you disembark simply states, “Welcome to Irestead.”
rows.translation: 下电梯处附近的一块牌子只写着：“欢迎来到伊尔斯泰德。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA sign near where you disembark simply states, “Welcome to Irestead.”"

rows.translation: 乌维托空间站
rows.raw: "Uveto Station"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: An hour passes...
rows.translation: 一小时过去了...
rows.raw: "An hour passes..."

rows.original: Just as you’re getting through with the mountain of legal gobbledygook the tove sent you, your proximity sensors alert you to the approach of a large ship bearing the trade IDs of the Camarilla. You respond to a message blip ordering you to power down weapons and shields and follow the “wabeshift” to Uveto Station’s docking terminal. You do as you’re ordered and switch the autopilot on, letting it dog the Camarilla ship in towards the station.
rows.translation: 你刚看完托芙人发来的那一大堆法律废话，近距传感器便提醒你：一艘带有秘会贸易识别码的大型飞船正在接近。你收到一条简讯，命令你关闭武器与护盾，跟随那艘“韦布什夫特”前往乌维托空间站的停靠区。你遵照命令开启自动驾驶，让飞船紧跟秘会舰船驶向空间站。
rows.raw: "\n\nJust as you’re getting through with the mountain of legal gobbledygook the tove sent you, your proximity sensors alert you to the approach of a large ship bearing the trade IDs of the Camarilla. You respond to a message blip ordering you to power down weapons and shields and follow the “wabeshift” to Uveto Station’s docking terminal. You do as you’re ordered and switch the autopilot on, letting it dog the Camarilla ship in towards the station."

rows.original: Uveto Station is a small affair, one of the pre-fab low-orbit control stations common on frontier worlds too inhospitable to support a full colony. Why it’s in what has been a core world for centuries, you have no idea. A thick tether connects it to the planet below - a space elevator, you imagine - and several long, curving arms extend from the central unit of the station, providing a great deal of docking space. You suppose there must not be a spaceport on the surface of the planet.
rows.translation: 乌维托空间站规模不大，是边境世界常见的预制式低轨控制站，通常用于环境过于恶劣、无法支撑完整殖民地的星球。它为何会出现在一个数百年来始终属于核心地带的世界，你完全摸不着头脑。一条粗大的系缆把它与下方行星相连——你猜是太空电梯——空间站中央单元则伸出数条弯曲长臂，提供大量停靠空间。看来行星表面大概没有太空港。
rows.raw: "\n\nUveto Station is a small affair, one of the pre-fab low-orbit control stations common on frontier worlds too inhospitable to support a full colony. Why it’s in what has been a core world for centuries, you have no idea. A thick tether connects it to the planet below - a space elevator, you imagine - and several long, curving arms extend from the central unit of the station, providing a great deal of docking space. You suppose there must not be a spaceport on the surface of the planet."

rows.original: The
rows.translation: 那艘
rows.raw: "\n\nThe "

rows.translation: 韦布舰

rows.translation: 韦布什夫特

rows.original: guides you to one of the docking arms, and shunts you into one of the many empty berths. Most of the other ships you can see look like heavy freighters, the kind used to haul thousands of tonnes of cargo across Confederate space - usually raw materials or industrial equipment. You allow the station to extend a docking clamp and access tunnel to your airlock, sealing with an audible thump that shudders through your ship.
rows.translation: 引导你驶向一条停靠臂，把你送入众多空泊位之一。你能看到的其他飞船大多像重型货船，是那种用来在邦联空间运送数千吨货物的船只——通常载着原材料或工业设备。你允许空间站把对接夹具和通道延伸到气闸上；接口伴随清晰可闻的砰声密封，震动传遍你的飞船。
rows.raw: " guides you to one of the docking arms, and shunts you into one of the many empty berths. Most of the other ships you can see look like heavy freighters, the kind used to haul thousands of tonnes of cargo across Confederate space - usually raw materials or industrial equipment. You allow the station to extend a docking clamp and access tunnel to your airlock, sealing with an audible thump that shudders through your ship."

rows.original: You grab your gear
rows.translation: 你拿起装备
rows.raw: "\n\nYou grab your gear"

rows.original: and head onto the station.
rows.translation: ，走进空间站。
rows.raw: " and head onto the station."

rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "Bitterly Cold"

rows.original: Bitterly Cold
rows.raw: "Bitterly Cold"

rows.original: Icon_Snowflake
rows.raw: "Icon_Snowflake"

rows.original: The bitter, piercing cold of Uveto’s icy tundra threatens to chill you to the bone. Better wrap up nice and tight, maybe even find something to heat you up to better stave off the freezing winds.
rows.translation: 乌维托冰原凛冽刺骨的寒意威胁着要将你冻透。最好裹严实些，或许还得找点能给身体加热的东西，才能更好抵御冰冻寒风。
rows.raw: "The bitter, piercing cold of Uveto’s icy tundra threatens to chill you to the bone. Better wrap up nice and tight, maybe even find something to heat you up to better stave off the freezing winds."

rows.original: A burst of cold air reminds you of the surface’s natural weather conditions.
rows.translation: 一阵冷风提醒你地表天然的天气状况。
rows.raw: "\n\nA burst of cold air reminds you of the surface’s natural weather conditions."

rows.original: It’s cold out here! You’ve got to find shelter or some way to warm yourself up as soon as you can.
rows.translation: 外面真冷！你必须尽快找到庇护所，或想办法让自己暖和起来。
rows.raw: " It’s cold out here! You’ve got to find shelter or some way to warm yourself up as soon as you can."

rows.original: Even with the warmth provided by your heat belt, it’s still freezing cold out here.
rows.translation: 即使有加热腰带提供温度，外面仍旧冷得要命。
rows.raw: " Even with the warmth provided by your heat belt, it’s still freezing cold out here."

rows.original: You drop the charm back where you found it.
rows.translation: 你把护符放回发现它的地方。
rows.raw: "You drop the charm back where you found it."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You slide down into the blasted-out basin the probe’s sitting in and wrench off the remnants of its protective shell. Most of it was scattered around the snow topside, so there’s not much you have to contend with to get at the meaty contents of the MAXCORP probe.
rows.translation: 你滑进探针所在的爆坑，扯下防护外壳的残骸。大部分外壳都散落在上方雪地里，所以要接触马克斯公司的探针核心并没有多少障碍。
rows.raw: "You slide down into the blasted-out basin the probe’s sitting in and wrench off the remnants of its protective shell. Most of it was scattered around the snow topside, so there’s not much you have to contend with to get at the meaty contents of the MAXCORP probe."

rows.original: Ah, looks like an easy fix. You flip your laser spanner out of your pack and give the probe a solid WHACK on the side. A moment passes, and then you hear the tell-tale booting noise of the electronics systems coming online.
rows.translation: 啊，看起来很好修。你从背包里抽出激光扳手，在探针侧面结结实实地敲了一下。片刻后，你听见电子系统上线时那熟悉的启动声。
rows.raw: "\n\nAh, looks like an easy fix. You flip your laser spanner out of your pack and give the probe a solid WHACK on the side. A moment passes, and then you hear the tell-tale booting noise of the electronics systems coming online."

rows.original: You give the machine a long, thorough once-over, looking up parts and connections in your Codex, trying to deduce what went wrong... other than it explosively crashing, anyway. With a few helpful forum posts, you’re able to dig into the probe’s mechanical guts and start pulling and rearranging things, trying to reboot it.
rows.translation: 你花很长时间把这台机器彻底检查一遍，在终端中查阅零件与连接方式，试图判断究竟出了什么问题...当然，除了它爆炸般坠毁这件事。借助几篇有用的论坛帖子，你得以深入探针的机械内部，开始拆动并重新排列部件，尝试将其重启。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the machine a long, thorough once-over, looking up parts and connections in your Codex, trying to deduce what went wrong... other than it explosively crashing, anyway. With a few helpful forum posts, you’re able to dig into the probe’s mechanical guts and start pulling and rearranging things, trying to reboot it."

rows.original: Eventually, you manage to get it sorted out, and punch the power button inside it again. It takes a moment, but eventually the probe starts whirring and the systems begin coming online.
rows.translation: 最终，你成功把问题处理好，再次按下内部的电源按钮。它花了一点时间，但探针最终开始嗡鸣，各套系统也陆续上线。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, you manage to get it sorted out, and punch the power button inside it again. It takes a moment, but eventually the probe starts whirring and the systems begin coming online."

rows.original: The probe reboots, tooting a cheery digital tune, and starts broadcasting. You easily link your Codex with it, letting you use it like a big relay to send and receive messages in the region.
rows.translation: 探针重启，发出一段欢快的电子提示音，随后开始广播。你轻松将自己的终端与它连接起来，可以把它当作大型中继器，在这片区域发送和接收信息。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe probe reboots, tooting a cheery digital tune, and starts broadcasting. You easily link your Codex with it, letting you use it like a big relay to send and receive messages in the region."

rows.original: You can call for transit here now!
rows.translation: 现在可以在这里呼叫交通服务了！
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can call for transit here now!"

rows.translation: 下一步

rows.original: A loud crinkling noise draws you back from the brink, a regular rustle akin to a metronome tapping on the side of your near-unconsciousness. You feel yourself shift in time with the noise, something dragging you along as your body resists for a moment before following suit.
rows.translation: 一阵响亮的窸窣声把你从失去意识的边缘拉回；规律的沙沙声仿佛节拍器，敲打着近乎昏迷的意识。你感觉身体随着声响移动，仿佛有什么东西正拖着你前进；身体短暂抗拒后，才跟着移动起来。
rows.raw: "A loud crinkling noise draws you back from the brink, a regular rustle akin to a metronome tapping on the side of your near-unconsciousness. You feel yourself shift in time with the noise, something dragging you along as your body resists for a moment before following suit."

rows.original: It’s a struggle to peel open your eyes, the endless freezing winds having battered any exposed [pc.skinFurScales] so completely your [pc.face] is covered in outcroppings of icicles hanging from your features. You have to work your face a little, stretching and tugging against the icy buildup, as sensation slowly creeps back in - bringing with it the deep, throbbing pain of penetrating cold having set into the core of your body - before you can open them, finding yourself looking up at
rows.translation: 你费了好大力气才睁开双眼。无休无止的凛冽寒风早已彻底侵袭所有裸露在外的[pc.skinFurScales]，让你的[pc.face]覆满从五官垂下的冰凌。你不得不活动一下脸部，拉伸并挣脱积冰；知觉慢慢恢复，同时也带回深入身体核心的刺骨严寒所造成的强烈抽痛。终于睁开眼睛时，你发现自己正仰望着
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a struggle to peel open your eyes, the endless freezing winds having battered any exposed [pc.skinFurScales] so completely your [pc.face] is covered in outcroppings of icicles hanging from your features. You have to work your face a little, stretching and tugging against the icy buildup, as sensation slowly creeps back in - bringing with it the deep, throbbing pain of penetrating cold having set into the core of your body - before you can open them, finding yourself looking up at"

rows.original: an angry, vengeful sky
rows.translation: 一片愤怒而充满报复意味的天空
rows.raw: " an angry, vengeful sky"

rows.original: a crystal clear sky
rows.translation: 一片清澈无云的天空
rows.raw: " a crystal clear sky"

rows.original: Something is moving on the edge of your sight above you - no, in front, you realize. With no small amount of discomfort you look up and make out the shape of a large, nearly formless blob through your fuzzy vision. A person, you reason slowly, given how the shapes moving around; large, lumbering steps, each one taken tugging you forward on what must be some kind of sled through the snow.
rows.translation: 有什么东西正在你上方的视野边缘移动——不，你意识到那是在前方。你忍着强烈不适抬头望去，透过模糊的视线辨认出一个巨大而几乎没有形状的轮廓。你迟钝地推断那是个人，因为那个轮廓正在移动；每一步都沉重而蹒跚，同时拉着你在雪地上向前滑行，你身下想必是某种雪橇。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething is moving on the edge of your sight above you - no, in front, you realize. With no small amount of discomfort you look up and make out the shape of a large, nearly formless blob through your fuzzy vision. A person, you reason slowly, given how the shapes moving around; large, lumbering steps, each one taken tugging you forward on what must be some kind of sled through the snow."

rows.original: You suck down an icy cold breath of air before trying to attract your rescuers attention, only to be rewarded with a lightning bolt of pain as your lungs complain - as more warmth seeps back into your body, the less numb everything feels... and the more pain seeps through.
rows.translation: 你吸入一口冰冷的空气，试图引起救命恩人的注意，结果肺部立刻抗议，闪电般的疼痛贯穿全身——随着更多暖意渗回身体，一切都不再那么麻木...而疼痛也越发清晰。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou suck down an icy cold breath of air before trying to attract your rescuers attention, only to be rewarded with a lightning bolt of pain as your lungs complain - as more warmth seeps back into your body, the less numb everything feels... and the more pain seeps through."

rows.original: You let your eyes drift closed, falling back into fitful slumber amidst the frozen tundra....
rows.translation: 你任由眼睛缓缓闭上，在冰封苔原之中再次陷入断断续续的沉睡....
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let your eyes drift closed, falling back into fitful slumber amidst the frozen tundra...."

rows.original: UVETO_JEROME_RESCUES
rows.raw: "UVETO_JEROME_RESCUES"

rows.original: Jerome
rows.raw: "Jerome"

rows.original: Jerynn
rows.raw: "Jerynn"

rows.original: LUNA
rows.raw: "LUNA"

rows.original: Luna
rows.translation: 露娜
rows.raw: "Luna"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You waken with a start, gasping for breath. Though your insides still throb with the vestigial ache of the Uvetan cold, you can feel heat washing over your limbs, bathing you in dry warmth. Never before has a space heater felt so good.
rows.translation: 你猛然惊醒，大口喘息。虽然体内仍因乌维托的严寒而隐隐抽痛，但你能感觉到热气冲刷四肢，将身体浸在干燥的暖意中。你从未觉得暖风机如此美好。
rows.raw: "You waken with a start, gasping for breath. Though your insides still throb with the vestigial ache of the Uvetan cold, you can feel heat washing over your limbs, bathing you in dry warmth. Never before has a space heater felt so good."

rows.original: Groggily, you open your eyes, long enough to see that you’re in the back of a vehicle, bumping along the snowy outskirts of the plains. Ice has formed on the windows, but you can just make out Irestead in the distance, growing closer by the moment. Glancing at the front of the vehicle, you see metal bars separating you from the driver’s cabin, and an old slug shotgun bolted to the cage. A pair of cute little chibi ausar tokens hang from the rear view mirror, both dressed in too-tight Peacekeeper blouses and pointing finger guns at you.
rows.translation: 你昏昏沉沉地睁开眼睛，勉强看出自己正躺在一辆车的后部，车辆颠簸着驶过平原白雪覆盖的外围。车窗上结了冰，但仍依稀能看见远处的艾尔斯泰德，而且每一刻都在接近。你望向车辆前部，发现驾驶室与你之间隔着金属栏杆，笼架上固定着一把老式独头弹霰枪。后视镜上挂着一对可爱的奥萨尔人Q版挂饰，两者都穿着过紧的维和人员衬衫，还用手指比作枪朝你瞄准。
rows.raw: "\n\nGroggily, you open your eyes, long enough to see that you’re in the back of a vehicle, bumping along the snowy outskirts of the plains. Ice has formed on the windows, but you can just make out Irestead in the distance, growing closer by the moment. Glancing at the front of the vehicle, you see metal bars separating you from the driver’s cabin, and an old slug shotgun bolted to the cage. A pair of cute little chibi ausar tokens hang from the rear view mirror, both dressed in too-tight Peacekeeper blouses and pointing finger guns at you."

rows.original: Hey, you. You’re finally
rows.translation: 嘿，你。你终于
rows.raw: "Hey, you. You’re finally"

rows.original: You’re
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "You’re"

rows.original: awake!” a woman’s voice says from the driver’s seat, drawing your attention to a head of blue hair and a pair of floppy canid ears peeking out of a Peacekeeper helmet.
rows.translation: 醒了！”驾驶座上传来一个女人的声音，将你的注意力引向一头蓝发，以及从维和人员头盔下露出的一对软塌犬耳。
rows.raw: " awake!” a woman’s voice says from the driver’s seat, drawing your attention to a head of blue hair and a pair of floppy canid ears peeking out of a Peacekeeper helmet."

rows.original: “What were you thinking, wandering around outside town without a heat belt. Lucky you I was around, or you’d have been dead for sure!”
rows.translation: “你没带保温腰带就在城外乱逛，到底在想什么。算你走运，正好有我在附近，不然你肯定已经死了！”
rows.raw: " “What were you thinking, wandering around outside town without a heat belt. Lucky you I was around, or you’d have been dead for sure!”"

rows.original: “You gotta stop wandering around outside town, [pc.name]!” Luna chides.
rows.translation: “你不能再在城外乱逛了，[pc.name]！”露娜责备道。
rows.raw: " “You gotta stop wandering around outside town, [pc.name]!” Luna chides."

rows.original: UVETO_LUNA_RESCUES
rows.raw: "UVETO_LUNA_RESCUES"

rows.original: You groan a hazy acknowledgement, but already you can feel your eyes growing heavy once more. It isn’t long before the gentle rocking of the Peacekeeper’s truck and the soothing warmth of the heater put you back to sleep...
rows.translation: 你迷迷糊糊地哼了一声表示听见了，但眼皮已经再次变得沉重。没过多久，维和人员卡车轻柔的摇晃和暖风机令人安心的热意便让你重新入睡...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou groan a hazy acknowledgement, but already you can feel your eyes growing heavy once more. It isn’t long before the gentle rocking of the Peacekeeper’s truck and the soothing warmth of the heater put you back to sleep..."

rows.original: Luna
rows.raw: "Luna"

rows.original: Uveto Wilderness
rows.raw: "Uveto Wilderness"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Gedan
rows.raw: "Gedan"

rows.original: “[pc.name]? [pc.name], c-can you hear me?”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]？[pc.name]，你、你能听见我吗？”
rows.raw: "“[pc.name]? [pc.name], c-can you hear me?”"

rows.original: You scrunch your eyes closed and try to ignore the voice.
rows.translation: 你紧紧闭上双眼，试图无视那个声音。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scrunch your eyes closed and try to ignore the voice."

rows.original: “[pc.name]!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.name]!”"

rows.original: A pair of rubber-coated fingers press against your face with precisely measured force before spreading apart, pulling an eyelid open in the process. Light streams into your eye and you recoil against it, trying to squint it back closed to shut out the painful brightness - a brightness that only grows more intense as your tormentor shines something right at your [pc.eye], flicking it back and forth.
rows.translation: 两根覆着橡胶的手指以精确控制的力道按住你的脸，随后向两边撑开，同时掀开一侧眼皮。光线涌入眼中，你本能地向后躲避，想眯眼重新闭上以隔绝刺痛的亮光——可折磨你的人把某样东西正对着你的[pc.eye]来回晃动，光芒反而越发强烈。
rows.raw: "\n\nA pair of rubber-coated fingers press against your face with precisely measured force before spreading apart, pulling an eyelid open in the process. Light streams into your eye and you recoil against it, trying to squint it back closed to shut out the painful brightness - a brightness that only grows more intense as your tormentor shines something right at your [pc.eye], flicking it back and forth."

rows.original: “Welcome back-k-k to the land of the living, [pc.name],” the voice informs you as the digits leave your [pc.skinFurScales] and the owner of the voice moves off somewhere else in the room.
rows.translation: “欢、欢、欢迎回到活人的世界，[pc.name]，”手指离开你的[pc.skinFurScales]时，那个声音告诉你，随后声音的主人走向房间的别处。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome back-k-k to the land of the living, [pc.name],” the voice informs you as the digits leave your [pc.skinFurScales] and the owner of the voice moves off somewhere else in the room."

rows.original: You blink away the light a few more times as the room starts to come into focus, medical equipment and the usual paraphernalia associated with an emergency care center lining various shelves. Through one of the tiny window slits at the top of the wall, you can just barely make out the top of the survey tower in Irestead.
rows.translation: 你又眨了几次眼，驱散强光，房间逐渐清晰起来。各种医疗设备和急救中心常见的器材摆满层层架子。透过墙顶的一道狭窄窗缝，你勉强能看见艾尔斯泰德勘测塔的顶部。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink away the light a few more times as the room starts to come into focus, medical equipment and the usual paraphernalia associated with an emergency care center lining various shelves. Through one of the tiny window slits at the top of the wall, you can just barely make out the top of the survey tower in Irestead."

rows.original: “You were very lucky that one of Iresteads rescue personnel managed to find you and bring you back here when they did.”
rows.translation: “你非常幸运，艾尔斯泰德的一名救援人员及时找到了你，并把你带回这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You were very lucky that one of Iresteads rescue personnel managed to find you and bring you back here when they did.”"

rows.original: You try to reply but only manage a savage cough; your throats so dry.
rows.translation: 你试图回答，却只发出一阵剧烈咳嗽；喉咙实在太干了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to reply but only manage a savage cough; your throats so dry."

rows.original: “Careful now; you’ve been out quite a while.”
rows.translation: “慢一点；你已经昏迷很久了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Careful now; you’ve been out quite a while.”"

rows.original: The VI closes in on you again, this time with a large, steaming mug in her hands. “It’s dangerous out there, you know; didn’t you get the warning?”
rows.translation: 这位虚拟智能再次靠近，这次手中端着一只冒热气的大杯子。“你知道外面很危险；难道你没收到警告吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe VI closes in on you again, this time with a large, steaming mug in her hands. “It’s dangerous out there, you know; didn’t you get the warning?”"

rows.original: She hands you the mug and you all but coo as glorious warmths seeps into your fingers through the insulated walls of the container. You clutch the source of heat close, slowly sipping at the almost-too-hot liquid contained within.
rows.translation: 她把杯子递给你，容器的隔热杯壁将美妙的暖意传入手指，你几乎舒服得咕哝出声。你把热源紧紧抱在怀里，慢慢啜饮其中近乎烫口的液体。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hands you the mug and you all but coo as glorious warmths seeps into your fingers through the insulated walls of the container. You clutch the source of heat close, slowly sipping at the almost-too-hot liquid contained within."

rows.original: <i>“You really must be more careful [pc.name].
rows.translation: <i>“你真的必须更小心，[pc.name]。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“You really must be more careful [pc.name]."

rows.original: If a storm were to have broken out
rows.translation: 要是当时突然刮起风暴
rows.raw: " If a storm were to have broken out"

rows.original: then
rows.translation: 那么
rows.raw: " then "

rows.original: may not have been lucky enough to find you in time.”
rows.translation: 或许就没那么幸运，无法及时找到你了。”
rows.raw: " may not have been lucky enough to find you in time.”"

rows.original: The V-Ko almost sounds like it’s trying to admonish a child with the way it’s talking to you -
rows.translation: V-Ko 对你说话的口吻，听起来几乎像在训斥小孩——
rows.raw: "\n\nThe V-Ko almost sounds like it’s trying to admonish a child with the way it’s talking to you -"

rows.original: you’d set it straight for talking to you like that but
rows.translation: 你本该纠正它这种对你说话的态度，但
rows.raw: " you’d set it straight for talking to you like that but"

rows.original: you’re too busy enjoying the blissful warmth of the mug to really care all that much.
rows.translation: 你正忙着享受杯子带来的幸福暖意，根本没那么在意。
rows.raw: " you’re too busy enjoying the blissful warmth of the mug to really care all that much."

rows.original: “Your equipment is in the locker next to the door; I trust you will see yourself out when you’re done, yes?”
rows.translation: “你的装备在门旁的储物柜里；我相信你结束后会自行离开，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your equipment is in the locker next to the door; I trust you will see yourself out when you’re done, yes?”"

rows.original: You give the VI a nod and set about finishing the last of the drink doing such an amazing job of perking you up and returning feeling to your limbs.
rows.translation: 你朝虚拟智能点点头，接着喝完剩下的饮料。它让你迅速恢复精神，也让四肢重新有了知觉，效果好得惊人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give the VI a nod and set about finishing the last of the drink doing such an amazing job of perking you up and returning feeling to your limbs."

rows.original: Finishing the drink off quickly, you clamber out of the bed onto
rows.translation: 你迅速喝完饮料，从床上爬下来，落在
rows.raw: "\n\nFinishing the drink off quickly, you clamber out of the bed onto"

rows.translation: 出租无人机将你送到目的地。

rows.translation: ，对那些不得不费力沿着

rows.translation: 绳索爬下去的可怜地面生物露出得意笑容。你反而能够

rows.translation: 着沿冰川峭壁下降，
rows.raw: " down the side of the glacial cliff, "

joinAfter.expression: kG() ? "right down to where the rope ends at" : "where you see"

rows.original: right down to where the rope ends at
rows.translation: 径直来到绳索末端所在之处
rows.raw: "right down to where the rope ends at"

rows.original: where you see
rows.translation: 来到你看见
rows.raw: "where you see"

rows.original: a gaping hole in the cliff-face. A cave! You swoop in and land, ready to see what’s in store.
rows.translation: 峭壁表面裂开一个巨大洞口的地方。是个洞穴！你俯冲进去落地，准备看看里面有什么。
rows.raw: " a gaping hole in the cliff-face. A cave! You swoop in and land, ready to see what’s in store."

rows.original: UVGR O42
rows.raw: "UVGR O42"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: This can’t be smart, can it? After all, whoever put this down obviously never came back for their supplies. Still, the temptation is too much to just ignore: you’ve got to see where this rappelling line goes. You secure yourself to the line with a clip and belt from inside one of the half-frozen crates and prepare to descend.
rows.translation: 这么做不可能明智，对吧？毕竟，放下这条绳索的人显然再也没有回来取走补给。不过诱惑实在太大，根本无法无视：你一定要看看这条垂降绳通向哪里。你用一个半冻结箱子里的挂扣和腰带把自己固定在绳索上，准备下降。
rows.raw: "This can’t be smart, can it? After all, whoever put this down obviously never came back for their supplies. Still, the temptation is too much to just ignore: you’ve got to see where this rappelling line goes. You secure yourself to the line with a clip and belt from inside one of the half-frozen crates and prepare to descend."

rows.original: Here goes nothing. You take a running jump off the edge of the glacier and hurtle off into the vast abyss. The rope, thankfully, catches you just a few feet later, and your [pc.feet] crunch into the ice, bracing you against the vertical ice plain. After a moment to catch your breath, you start to climb. Down and down you go, sliding and clambering down the rappelling line for what seems like an eternity.
rows.translation: 豁出去了。你助跑后从冰川边缘一跃而下，冲入广阔深渊。幸好绳索在你下坠几英尺后便将你拉住，[pc.feet]嘎吱一声踩进冰面，支撑你抵住垂直冰壁。稍作喘息后，你开始攀爬。你一路向下，沿垂降绳滑落、攀行，仿佛过了无穷无尽的时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nHere goes nothing. You take a running jump off the edge of the glacier and hurtle off into the vast abyss. The rope, thankfully, catches you just a few feet later, and your [pc.feet] crunch into the ice, bracing you against the vertical ice plain. After a moment to catch your breath, you start to climb. Down and down you go, sliding and clambering down the rappelling line for what seems like an eternity."

rows.original: Though it’s hard going, you eventually scramble down to what turns out to be a rather large cleft in the ice -- a cave maybe fifty feet above the water, leading into the heart of the glacier. You make sure the rope is secure and swing yourself into the hole...
rows.translation: 尽管过程艰难，你最终还是爬到冰层中一道相当巨大的裂口——那是一个高出水面约五十英尺、深入冰川腹地的洞穴。你确认绳索牢固后，荡进洞口...
rows.raw: "\n\nThough it’s hard going, you eventually scramble down to what turns out to be a rather large cleft in the ice -- a cave maybe fifty feet above the water, leading into the heart of the glacier. You make sure the rope is secure and swing yourself into the hole..."

rows.original: You really weren’t in shape for this, you realize after just a couple of minutes. You’re huffing and puffing, muscles burning as you slowly lower yourself towards the rope’s end -- what appears to be a small hole in the ice, about man-height, some fifty feet from the water’s surface. Wheezing with effort, you scramble into the hole and flop onto the icy floor.
rows.translation: 才过几分钟，你就意识到自己的体能根本不足以应付这件事。你气喘吁吁，肌肉灼痛，缓缓向绳索末端下降——那里似乎是冰层中的一个小洞，大约一人高，距离水面五十英尺左右。你累得呼哧作响，爬进洞口，一头瘫倒在冰冷地面上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou really weren’t in shape for this, you realize after just a couple of minutes. You’re huffing and puffing, muscles burning as you slowly lower yourself towards the rope’s end -- what appears to be a small hole in the ice, about man-height, some fifty feet from the water’s surface. Wheezing with effort, you scramble into the hole and flop onto the icy floor."

rows.raw: "UVGR O42"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "KITSUNE_TRADERS"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Essyra Traders
rows.translation: 埃西拉商人
rows.raw: "Essyra Traders"

rows.original: You approach the pair of pale pink fox-women, putting up a hand in greeting. The closer of the two, somewhat shorter but more muscular than her companion, steps forward to lean against the support pole in the middle of the tent.
rows.translation: 你走向那对浅粉色毛发的狐女，举手打招呼。两人中离你较近的那位比同伴稍矮，却更为健壮；她向前一步，靠在帐篷中央的支撑杆上。
rows.raw: "You approach the pair of pale pink fox-women, putting up a hand in greeting. The closer of the two, somewhat shorter but more muscular than her companion, steps forward to lean against the support pole in the middle of the tent."

rows.original: “Greetings, [pc.raceCute],” she says evenly, eyeing you with unabashed curiosity. “Welcome to our home and trading post. I am Kazra, and this is my mate, Lorre.”
rows.translation: “你好，[pc.raceCute]，”她语气平稳，毫不掩饰地好奇打量着你。“欢迎来到我们的家和贸易站。我叫卡兹拉，这是我的伴侣洛尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Greetings, [pc.raceCute],” she says evenly, eyeing you with unabashed curiosity. “Welcome to our home and trading post. I am Kazra, and this is my mate, Lorre.”"

rows.original: Kazra nods back to the heavily pregnant Essyra behind her, who regards you with a much warmer smile than her mate. “Hello,” she says shyly, putting a hand over the hefty belly straining the front of her leather shirt.
rows.translation: 卡兹拉朝身后身怀六甲的埃西拉人点点头，后者给你的笑容远比自己的伴侣温暖。“你好，”她羞涩地说，一只手覆在撑紧皮衬衫前襟的硕大肚腹上。
rows.raw: "\n\nKazra nods back to the heavily pregnant Essyra behind her, who regards you with a much warmer smile than her mate. “Hello,” she says shyly, putting a hand over the hefty belly straining the front of her leather shirt."

rows.original: “Have anything you’d like to trade? We keep a store of heat packs and other supplies for explorers like you, if you’d like to take a look.”
rows.translation: “有什么想交易的吗？我们为你这样的探险者储备了加热包和其他补给，如果愿意，可以看看。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Have anything you’d like to trade? We keep a store of heat packs and other supplies for explorers like you, if you’d like to take a look.”"

rows.original: Kazra sweeps a hand towards a small metal footlocker at the side of the tent, inviting you to see what the pair have to offer...
rows.translation: 卡兹拉抬手指向帐篷一侧的小型金属储物箱，邀请你看看她们能提供什么...
rows.raw: "\n\nKazra sweeps a hand towards a small metal footlocker at the side of the tent, inviting you to see what the pair have to offer..."

rows.original: Kazra & Lorre
rows.translation: 卡兹拉与洛尔
rows.raw: "Kazra & Lorre"

rows.original: “Hello again, [pc.name],” Kazra says, striding up to you with a hint of a smile on her ice-blue lips.
rows.translation: “又见面了，[pc.name]，”卡兹拉说道，大步向你走来，冰蓝色嘴唇上带着一丝笑意。
rows.raw: "“Hello again, [pc.name],” Kazra says, striding up to you with a hint of a smile on her ice-blue lips."

rows.original: Lorre struggles to her feet with both hands on her gravid belly. The pregnant Essyra gives you a shy little smile from behind her mate. “Back to trade again?”
rows.translation: 洛尔双手托着隆起的孕肚，吃力地站起身。这位怀孕的埃西拉人从伴侣身后朝你露出羞涩的微笑。“又来交易吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nLorre struggles to her feet with both hands on her gravid belly. The pregnant Essyra gives you a shy little smile from behind her mate. “Back to trade again?”"

rows.original: Kazra chuckles and waves you in. <i>“Come, warm yourself by the fire.
rows.translation: 卡兹拉轻笑着招呼你进去。<i>“来吧，到火边暖暖身子。
rows.raw: "\n\nKazra chuckles and waves you in. <i>“Come, warm yourself by the fire."

rows.original: The weather outside is frightful, after all...
rows.translation: 毕竟外面的天气糟透了...
rows.raw: " The weather outside is frightful, after all..."

rows.original: You look like you’re about to turn blue.
rows.translation: 你看起来都快冻成蓝色了。
rows.raw: " You look like you’re about to turn blue."

rows.original: Buy
rows.translation: 购买
rows.raw: "Buy"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You lift off and soar out of the hidden cave, back up to the surface of the Rift.
rows.translation: 你腾空而起，飞出隐蔽的洞穴，回到裂谷表面。
rows.raw: "You lift off and soar out of the hidden cave, back up to the surface of the Rift."

rows.original: UVGR S40
rows.raw: "UVGR S40"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You grasp the rope and give it an experimental tug -- now that you’re down here, it doesn’t seem so secure... it might break if you try and climb up. Better take care of any business you have down here before you leave.
rows.translation: 你抓住绳子试着拽了拽——既然已经下到这里，它似乎没那么牢固了...要是试图爬上去，可能会断。离开之前，最好先处理完你在这里要办的所有事情。
rows.raw: "You grasp the rope and give it an experimental tug -- now that you’re down here, it doesn’t seem so secure... it might break if you try and climb up. Better take care of any business you have down here before you leave."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Time to leave. You grab the rope and haul yourself out of the cave, bracing your [pc.feet] on the ice. It’s a slow, laborious journey upwards that leaves you gasping for breath and shivering in the oppressive cold by the time you near the top.
rows.translation: 该离开了。你抓住绳索，把[pc.feet]抵在冰面上，拖着身体爬出洞穴。这趟向上的路程缓慢而费力，等接近顶端时，你已经气喘吁吁，在压倒性的严寒中瑟瑟发抖。
rows.raw: "Time to leave. You grab the rope and haul yourself out of the cave, bracing your [pc.feet] on the ice. It’s a slow, laborious journey upwards that leaves you gasping for breath and shivering in the oppressive cold by the time you near the top."

rows.original: Finally, you approach a ledge and climb the rest of the way, up and over the cliffside.
rows.translation: 最后，你接近一处岩架，爬完剩余距离，翻过峭壁边缘。
rows.raw: " Finally, you approach a ledge and climb the rest of the way, up and over the cliffside."

rows.original: And then you hear a snap from above. Oh, shit.
rows.translation: 然后你听见上方传来啪的一声。糟了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd then you hear a snap from above. Oh, shit."

rows.original: You have just enough time to grab a handhold in the ice before a rain of snow, ice, and rope comes crashing down on your head. Fuck! You hug the cliffside tight until the deluge passes by you, crashing down into the water below. Luckily, you’re near enough to the top that it’s easy to climb the rest of the way yourself, but there’s no going back down there unless you
rows.translation: 你只来得及在冰面上抓住一处着力点，积雪、冰块和绳索便劈头盖脸地砸落下来。操！你紧紧贴住峭壁，直到这场洪流从身旁掠过，坠入下方水中。幸好你离顶端已经足够近，能轻松自行爬完剩下的路，但除非你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have just enough time to grab a handhold in the ice before a rain of snow, ice, and rope comes crashing down on your head. Fuck! You hug the cliffside tight until the deluge passes by you, crashing down into the water below. Luckily, you’re near enough to the top that it’s easy to climb the rest of the way yourself, but there’s no going back down there unless you"

rows.original: use your
rows.translation: 使用自己的
rows.raw: " use your"

rows.original: sprout
rows.translation: 长出
rows.raw: " sprout"

rows.original: wings.
rows.translation: 翅膀，否则再也下不去了。
rows.raw: " wings."

rows.original: UVGR Q40
rows.raw: "UVGR Q40"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Uveto Cloudy
rows.raw: "Uveto Cloudy"

rows.original: Intense Sudden Blizzard!
rows.translation: 突发猛烈暴风雪！
rows.raw: "Intense Sudden Blizzard!"

rows.original: Though Uveto’s always cold and snowy, you can’t help but notice it’s getting worse... and worse... and worse. You wrap your arms around yourself
rows.translation: 虽然乌维托总是寒冷多雪，但你还是忍不住注意到天气正变得越来越糟...越来越糟...还在变糟。你用双臂抱紧自己
rows.raw: "Though Uveto’s always cold and snowy, you can’t help but notice it’s getting worse... and worse... and worse. You wrap your arms around yourself"

rows.original: thankful that you have a heat belt to keep out the brunt of the chill. Even so, it’s getting unbearably cold.
rows.translation: ，庆幸有保温腰带挡住最猛烈的寒意。即便如此，天气也冷得让人难以忍受。
rows.raw: " thankful that you have a heat belt to keep out the brunt of the chill. Even so, it’s getting unbearably cold."

rows.original: , now really wishing you had a heat belt. You don’t know how long you’re gonna last out here!
rows.translation: ，此刻无比希望自己带了保温腰带。你不知道还能在外面撑多久！
rows.raw: ", now really wishing you had a heat belt. You don’t know how long you’re gonna last out here!"

rows.original: You glance around for shelter, or a clear path to let you get going a little faster... you don’t want to be out in the open much longer.
rows.translation: 你四下寻找藏身之处，或是一条能让你走得更快的通畅路径...你不想继续暴露在外太久。
rows.raw: " You glance around for shelter, or a clear path to let you get going a little faster... you don’t want to be out in the open much longer."

rows.original: Uveto Blizzard
rows.raw: "Uveto Blizzard"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lightning Strike!
rows.translation: 雷击！
rows.raw: "Lightning Strike!"

rows.original: There’s a storm brewing. You glance up into the darkening sky, shielding your eyes against the glare of the endless snow and ice.
rows.translation: 一场风暴正在酝酿。你抬头望向逐渐变暗的天空，抬手遮挡无尽冰雪反射出的刺眼光芒。
rows.raw: "There’s a storm brewing. You glance up into the darkening sky, shielding your eyes against the glare of the endless snow and ice."

rows.original: No sooner have you looked up than a bolt of searing white light strikes down from on high, slamming into you like a divine smite.
rows.translation: 你才刚抬头，一道灼热白光便从高空劈落，宛如神罚般重重轰在身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo sooner have you looked up than a bolt of searing white light strikes down from on high, slamming into you like a divine smite."

rows.original: Your shields light up with a spiderweb of crackling color, soaking the bolt of lightning before overloading in a concussive blast that echoes across the plains. The reek of ozone surrounds you in the aftermath, but after a moment of looking yourself over, you find that you’re more or less unharmed -- aside from a ringing in your ears, anyway.
rows.translation: 护盾亮起蛛网般噼啪作响的彩色纹路，吸收闪电后因过载而轰然爆炸，巨响回荡在平原上。事后，刺鼻的臭氧味包围着你，但检查片刻后，你发现自己基本毫发无伤——当然，耳中仍在嗡嗡作响。
rows.raw: " Your shields light up with a spiderweb of crackling color, soaking the bolt of lightning before overloading in a concussive blast that echoes across the plains. The reek of ozone surrounds you in the aftermath, but after a moment of looking yourself over, you find that you’re more or less unharmed -- aside from a ringing in your ears, anyway."

rows.original: The blast sends you flying back, screaming and smoking and blinded by a brilliant flash of light. Thankfully, you land ass-first in the snow, though you’re wracked by pain for a long, long time afterwards. It’s several minutes before your limbs stop twitching, and you recover back onto your [pc.feet].
rows.translation: 爆炸将你掀飞出去，你尖叫着、冒着烟，被耀眼闪光晃得什么也看不见。幸好你屁股先着地摔进雪中，不过之后很长很长一段时间里，你都痛苦不堪。足足过了几分钟，四肢才停止抽搐，你重新用[pc.feet]站了起来。
rows.raw: " The blast sends you flying back, screaming and smoking and blinded by a brilliant flash of light. Thankfully, you land ass-first in the snow, though you’re wracked by pain for a long, long time afterwards. It’s several minutes before your limbs stop twitching, and you recover back onto your [pc.feet]."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Slippery Ice!
rows.translation: 湿滑冰面！
rows.raw: "Slippery Ice!"

rows.original: You notice just a little too late that the snow you’re walking across is nothing more than a paper thin veneer over a slick sheet of ice. Your [pc.feet] skid
rows.translation: 你发现得稍微晚了一点：脚下的积雪只是在一整片光滑冰面上覆着薄如纸张的表层。你的[pc.feet]猛地打滑
rows.raw: "You notice just a little too late that the snow you’re walking across is nothing more than a paper thin veneer over a slick sheet of ice. Your [pc.feet] skid"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 了

rows.original: and slip
rows.translation: ，滑向一旁
rows.raw: " and slip"

rows.original: s
rows.translation: 了

rows.original: , and after a vertigo-inducing moment of teetering, you slip backwards and land hard on your [pc.butt]. Ouch!
rows.translation: 。你令人眩晕地摇晃片刻后向后滑倒，[pc.butt]重重摔在地上。好痛！
rows.raw: ", and after a vertigo-inducing moment of teetering, you slip backwards and land hard on your [pc.butt]. Ouch!"

rows.original: You hear a tell-tale crunch under the snow as you walk, cluing you in to slow down and take it easy -- there’s brittle, slippery ice just underfoot
rows.translation: 行走时，你听见雪下传来特有的嘎吱声，立刻意识到应该放慢脚步、小心行走——脚下就是脆弱而湿滑的冰层
rows.raw: "You hear a tell-tale crunch under the snow as you walk, cluing you in to slow down and take it easy -- there’s brittle, slippery ice just underfoot"

rows.original: ... or under-tail, in your case
rows.translation: ...或者对你而言，是尾巴下面
rows.raw: "... or under-tail, in your case"

rows.original: . You don’t want to slip and fall, after all.
rows.translation: 。毕竟，你可不想滑倒。
rows.raw: ". You don’t want to slip and fall, after all."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: encounter
rows.raw: "encounter"

rows.original: encounter
rows.raw: "encounter"

rows.original: A Chunk of Savicite!
rows.translation: 一块萨维石！
rows.raw: "A Chunk of Savicite!"

rows.original: Your nog’wich suddenly rears back and mewls softly, ruffling its round ears. It looks like it found
rows.translation: 你的诺格维奇突然向后仰起，轻声喵叫，圆耳朵也随之抖动。看来它发现了
rows.raw: "Your nog’wich suddenly rears back and mewls softly, ruffling its round ears. It looks like it found"

rows.original: As you’re wandering, you notice
rows.translation: 四处游荡时，你注意到
rows.raw: "As you’re wandering, you notice"

rows.original: something dark and rough-looking sticking up out of the snow. You stop
rows.translation: 雪地里露出一块颜色深暗、表面粗糙的东西。你停下来
rows.raw: " something dark and rough-looking sticking up out of the snow. You stop"

rows.original: , dismount
rows.translation: ，从坐骑上下来
rows.raw: ", dismount"

rows.original: and bend down, dusting it off to see what the strange object is.
rows.translation: ，弯腰拂去上面的雪，看看这件怪东西究竟是什么。
rows.raw: " and bend down, dusting it off to see what the strange object is."

rows.original: It’s a rock, about the size of your fist, colored a dark and luminous green. Its fuzzy to the touch, but when you wrap your fingers around the strange stone, you feel a wave of unexpected heat rush through your arm... and right to your loins! You recoil back, shuddering uncontrollably as
rows.translation: 那是一块拳头大小的岩石，泛着深沉明亮的绿色。触感有些毛茸茸的；可当手指握住这块奇石时，一股出乎意料的热流猛然冲过手臂...直奔胯下！你猛地缩手，不受控制地颤抖起来，同时
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a rock, about the size of your fist, colored a dark and luminous green. Its fuzzy to the touch, but when you wrap your fingers around the strange stone, you feel a wave of unexpected heat rush through your arm... and right to your loins! You recoil back, shuddering uncontrollably as"

rows.original: your [pc.cock] jumps to attention
rows.translation: 你的[pc.cock]顿时挺立
rows.raw: " your [pc.cock] jumps to attention"

rows.original: and
rows.translation: ，而且
rows.raw: " and"

rows.original: your [pc.cunt] clenches hungrily
rows.translation: 你的[pc.cunt]饥渴地收缩
rows.raw: " your [pc.cunt] clenches hungrily"

rows.original: your barren groin burns with desire, undiminished by your neutered state
rows.translation: 你空无一物的胯下欲火中烧，丝毫未因被阉割而减弱
rows.raw: " your barren groin burns with desire, undiminished by your neutered state"

rows.original: . Your Codex beeps a confirmation of what you already knew: this is savicite, a psionically-active local mineral, valuable as a fuel source. Could be worth something back at Irestead...
rows.translation: 。Codex发出提示音，证实了你早已知道的事：这是萨维石，一种具有灵能活性的本地矿物，也是贵重燃料。带回艾尔斯特德或许能卖点钱...
rows.raw: ". Your Codex beeps a confirmation of what you already knew: this is savicite, a psionically-active local mineral, valuable as a fuel source. Could be worth something back at Irestead..."

rows.original: Take It
rows.translation: 带走
rows.raw: "Take It"

rows.raw: "take it"

rows.translation: 别管它

rows.raw: "leave it"

rows.raw: "take it"

rows.original: You guess it’ll be worth the price.
rows.translation: 你觉得它应该值这个价。
rows.raw: "You guess it’ll be worth the price."

rows.original: leave it
rows.raw: "leave it"

rows.original: You decide to leave the savicite where you found it.
rows.translation: 你决定把萨维石留在原处。
rows.raw: "You decide to leave the savicite where you found it."

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.raw: "encounter"

rows.translation: 一块露西石！
rows.raw: "A Chunk of Lucinite!"

rows.original: Your nog’wich suddenly rears back and mewls softly, ruffling its round ears. It looks like it found a small, oddly-colored protrusion sticking out from the ground.
rows.translation: 你的诺格维奇突然向后仰起，轻声喵叫，圆耳朵也随之抖动。看来它发现了地面上露出的一小块颜色奇异的凸起。
rows.raw: "Your nog’wich suddenly rears back and mewls softly, ruffling its round ears. It looks like it found a small, oddly-colored protrusion sticking out from the ground."

rows.original: You notice a small, oddly-colored protrusion sticking out from the ground out of the corner of your eye.
rows.translation: 你眼角瞥见地面上露出一小块颜色奇异的凸起。
rows.raw: "You notice a small, oddly-colored protrusion sticking out from the ground out of the corner of your eye."

rows.original: Curiosity getting the better of you, you stop in your tracks and
rows.translation: 好奇心占了上风，你停下脚步并
rows.raw: " Curiosity getting the better of you, you stop in your tracks and"

rows.original: hop off from your mount
rows.translation: 从坐骑上跳下
rows.raw: " hop off from your mount"

rows.original: carefully walk over to it
rows.translation: 小心走过去
rows.raw: " carefully walk over to it"

rows.original: to investigate.
rows.translation: 调查。
rows.raw: " to investigate."

rows.original: Another piece of teal rock lays in the snow by your footprints. Your codex chirps, confirming what you already know: the rock is a piece of lucinite, a psionically charged material capable of heat absorption. Keeping it in your inventory would leave you to be more vulnerable to the harsh environs of the Uvetian moon, though this will still fetch a pretty
rows.translation: 你的脚印旁，雪中躺着另一块蓝绿色岩石。Codex鸣叫着证实了你早已知道的事：这是一块露西石，一种能吸收热量的灵能充能材料。将它放在行囊里会令你更容易受到乌维托卫星严酷环境的影响，不过它依然能卖个好
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother piece of teal rock lays in the snow by your footprints. Your codex chirps, confirming what you already know: the rock is a piece of lucinite, a psionically charged material capable of heat absorption. Keeping it in your inventory would leave you to be more vulnerable to the harsh environs of the Uvetian moon, though this will still fetch a pretty "

rows.original: dogecoin
rows.translation: 狗狗币
rows.raw: "dogecoin"

rows.original: credit
rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: "credit"

rows.original: because of how rare it is.
rows.translation: ，因为实在太稀有了。
rows.raw: " because of how rare it is."

rows.original: A teal-colored rock the size of your hand sticks up slightly just about the start of the skidmark. When you bend down to pick it up, a dreadful chill surges through your fingers. It is somehow much colder to the touch than the already frigid surroundings. Before your fingers wind up frostbitten, you hurriedly drop the metallic rock back onto the snow.
rows.translation: 滑痕起点附近，一块手掌大小的蓝绿色岩石微微露出。你弯腰捡起它时，刺骨寒意猛然冲入手指。它摸起来竟比周围本就严寒的环境还冷。赶在手指冻伤前，你连忙把这块金属质感的岩石扔回雪地。
rows.raw: "\n\nA teal-colored rock the size of your hand sticks up slightly just about the start of the skidmark. When you bend down to pick it up, a dreadful chill surges through your fingers. It is somehow much colder to the touch than the already frigid surroundings. Before your fingers wind up frostbitten, you hurriedly drop the metallic rock back onto the snow."

rows.original: Your codex chirps immediately afterwards, identifying the strange ore as lucinite, one of several known psionically-charged materials. It also warns that it has heat siphoning powers, and that without proper handling and protection, prolonged exposure with this ore will run the risk of hypothermia. Great. As if the already freezing conditions weren’t enough to worry about! On the plus side, this is also a very valuable material considering how rare it is.
rows.translation: 紧接着，Codex发出鸣叫，将这种奇异矿石识别为露西石——数种已知灵能充能材料之一。它还警告这种矿石能吸走热量；若缺乏妥善处理和防护，长时间接触会带来失温风险。好极了，仿佛这片冰天雪地还不够令人担心似的！好处是，这种材料极其稀有，因此也非常值钱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour codex chirps immediately afterwards, identifying the strange ore as lucinite, one of several known psionically-charged materials. It also warns that it has heat siphoning powers, and that without proper handling and protection, prolonged exposure with this ore will run the risk of hypothermia. Great. As if the already freezing conditions weren’t enough to worry about! On the plus side, this is also a very valuable material considering how rare it is."

rows.original: Do you want to risk taking it with you?
rows.translation: 你愿意冒险把它带走吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you want to risk taking it with you?"

rows.original: Take It
rows.translation: 带走
rows.raw: "Take It"

rows.original: take it
rows.raw: "take it"

rows.original: Nope
rows.translation: 不要
rows.raw: "Nope"

rows.original: leave it
rows.raw: "leave it"

rows.original: take it
rows.raw: "take it"

rows.original: Gingerly, you pick the lucinite ore up and throw it hurriedly into your inventory before it can affect you too much. You can still feel its heat-siphoning effects through your bag...
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地捡起露西石，在它产生太大影响前迅速扔进行囊。隔着包袋，你仍能感觉到它吸走热量的效果...
rows.raw: "Gingerly, you pick the lucinite ore up and throw it hurriedly into your inventory before it can affect you too much. You can still feel its heat-siphoning effects through your bag..."

rows.original: leave it
rows.raw: "leave it"

rows.original: You decide to leave the ore where it is. After few more moments, the Uvetian winds completely cover it in a thin layer of snow.
rows.translation: 你决定把矿石留在原地。没过多久，乌维托的寒风便用一层薄雪将其彻底覆盖。
rows.raw: "You decide to leave the ore where it is. After few more moments, the Uvetian winds completely cover it in a thin layer of snow."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: AWOOOOO-OOOOOO
rows.translation: 嗷呜——呜呜呜
rows.raw: "AWOOOOO-OOOOOO"

rows.original: You recall the Korgonne’s words and count out the holes: the third hole from the right along the top. It’s easy to find, but you feel a bit self-conscious about leaning close and howling into it. Sucking in a lungful of air, you give your best imitation of a korgonne howl, though not a long one.
rows.translation: 你回忆起科尔贡人的话，数着那些孔洞：顶排从右往左第三个。位置很好找，可凑近朝里面嚎叫还是让你有些难为情。你深吸一口气，尽力模仿科尔贡人的嚎叫，不过没有拖得太长。
rows.raw: "You recall the Korgonne’s words and count out the holes: the third hole from the right along the top. It’s easy to find, but you feel a bit self-conscious about leaning close and howling into it. Sucking in a lungful of air, you give your best imitation of a korgonne howl, though not a long one."

rows.original: You approach the industrial space elevator, glancing the reinforced cart up and down within the gun barrel tube it’s tracked to. You could see the tube going all the way down on your way in, a measure of some several miles exposed to space with nothing but a thin veneer of super-hardened metal and plasteel between you and the vacuum of space. Comforting thought.

rows.original: “Keep it in your pants, please,” the synthetic sighs before returning her attention to you. “My compatriots and I simply wanted to express a warning: the surface of Uveto is extraordinarily hostile.
