rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod your understanding and pocket the Codex again. Anything else?"

rows.original: “Nope!” the black-dressed huskar smiles, wagging her silver tail. “Just wanted to touch base while we’re on break! If you need anything, Dr. Lessau and Director Rhenesuune manage most of Steele’s interest here on the planet. They can give you the hook up!”
rows.translation: “没啦！”黑衣赫斯卡摇着银色尾巴笑道。“我们只是趁休息来打声招呼！如果需要什么，莱索博士和雷内苏恩主管负责斯蒂尔在这里的大部分事务。她们能替你安排！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope!” the black-dressed huskar smiles, wagging her silver tail. “Just wanted to touch base while we’re on break! If you need anything, Dr. Lessau and Director Rhenesuune manage most of Steele’s interest here on the planet. They can give you the hook up!”"

rows.original: “As an unbiased, non-Steele Tech affiliated intelligence,” the robotic woman adds, fixing you with her black-eyed gaze. “Be careful around the Director. She’s a real-”
rows.translation: “作为不带偏见、也不隶属于斯蒂尔科技的智能，”机器人女人用黑色双眼盯着你补充道，“面对主管时要小心。她可是个真正的——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As an unbiased, non-Steele Tech affiliated intelligence,” the robotic woman adds, fixing you with her black-eyed gaze. “Be careful around the Director. She’s a real-”"

rows.original: “Ball-buster,” the man finishes with a guffaw. “That about sum it up?”
rows.translation: “母老虎，”男人大笑着接话。“差不多就是这个意思吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ball-buster,” the man finishes with a guffaw. “That about sum it up?”"

rows.original: The robot nods sharply. “Yes. A ‘ball-buster.’”
rows.translation: 机器人干脆地点头。“是的。一个‘母老虎’。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe robot nods sharply. “Yes. A ‘ball-buster.’”"

rows.original: Well, you’ll certainly keep that in mind. You thank the quartet for their advice - and the rescue protocol - and turn back to the elevator.
rows.translation: 好吧，你当然会牢记在心。你感谢四人的建议——还有救援协议——随后转回电梯。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’ll certainly keep that in mind. You thank the quartet for their advice - and the rescue protocol - and turn back to the elevator."

rows.original: “See ya, cutie!” the Akkadi ausar giggles, blowing you a kiss.
rows.translation: “再见啦，小可爱！”阿卡迪奥萨人咯咯笑着，送来一个飞吻。
rows.raw: "\n\n“See ya, cutie!” the Akkadi ausar giggles, blowing you a kiss."

rows.original: The other woman blushes, but still wags her tail as you turn to leave. Over your shoulder, you hear her whispering, “Stop flirting with my maybe-boss! I get first dibs!”
rows.translation: 另一个女人脸红了，可你转身离开时，她仍摇着尾巴。你听见身后传来她的低语：“别再勾引我可能的老板了！我有优先权！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other woman blushes, but still wags her tail as you turn to leave. Over your shoulder, you hear her whispering, “Stop flirting with my maybe-boss! I get first dibs!”"

rows.original: “Ladies. We can all share.”
rows.translation: “女士们，我们可以共享。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ladies. We can all share.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: UVETO
rows.raw: "UVETO"

rows.original: Uveto Station
rows.translation: 乌维托空间站
rows.raw: "Uveto Station"

rows.original: DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY
rows.raw: "DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: The fringe of the Siretta system is quite unlike the heartlands, the frosty resort worlds nearer to the sun where you remember your father would often take his lover of the week to ski. Here, the Black is dominated by a massive belt of asteroids, shielding the furthest planet from the sun from sight. Your destination is not the tremendous, Jovian gas giant standing sentinel at the edge of the system, however, but one of its twelve moons: the frozen ice ball of Uveto VII.
rows.translation: 西雷塔星系边缘与核心地带截然不同。更靠近太阳的地方有许多冰雪度假世界；你记得父亲常带当周的情人去那里滑雪。而在这里，黑暗空间由一条庞大小行星带主宰，把距离太阳最远的行星遮在视线之外。不过，你的目的地并非那颗守卫在星系边缘、体积惊人的木星型气态巨行星，而是它的十二颗卫星之一：冰封的乌维托七号。
rows.raw: "The fringe of the Siretta system is quite unlike the heartlands, the frosty resort worlds nearer to the sun where you remember your father would often take his lover of the week to ski. Here, the Black is dominated by a massive belt of asteroids, shielding the furthest planet from the sun from sight. Your destination is not the tremendous, Jovian gas giant standing sentinel at the edge of the system, however, but one of its twelve moons: the frozen ice ball of Uveto VII."

rows.original: Your screen buzzes to life as you near your destination. “Good day to you, traveler!” announces the odd creature on screen.
rows.translation: 接近目的地时，你的屏幕嗡地亮了起来。“日安，旅行者！”屏幕上的奇怪生物宣布道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour screen buzzes to life as you near your destination. “Good day to you, traveler!” announces the odd creature on screen."

rows.original: You recognize the creature as a tove, the tiny, stuffed-animal-like race.
rows.translation: 你认出这个生物是托芙人——一个身材娇小、如同毛绒玩具般的种族。
rows.raw: " You recognize the creature as a tove, the tiny, stuffed-animal-like race."

rows.original: You’re not sure what this plush-furred, squat creature is, but its beak clacks open and shut comically as it speaks.
rows.translation: 你不确定这个身披柔软绒毛的矮胖生物究竟是什么，但它说话时，鸟喙滑稽地咔哒开合。
rows.raw: " You’re not sure what this plush-furred, squat creature is, but its beak clacks open and shut comically as it speaks."

rows.original: “You’ve entered into privately-owned orbital space. If you would like to dock with Camarilla station number six-three-two-oh-one, a wabeshift will intercept your path in approximately 1 hour. Please use the time to fill out all waivers and declarations for quick and easy processing.”
rows.translation: “你已进入私人所有的轨道空间。如果你想与卡玛利拉六三二〇一号空间站对接，一艘韦布什夫特将在大约一小时后拦截你的航线。请利用这段时间填写所有免责书和申报表，以便快速便捷地完成手续。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve entered into privately-owned orbital space. If you would like to dock with Camarilla station number six-three-two-oh-one, a wabeshift will intercept your path in approximately 1 hour. Please use the time to fill out all waivers and declarations for quick and easy processing.”"

rows.original: You hear multiple bings as a side monitor opens a cascade of pure-text forms and contracts. “If you do not have business with the Camarilla at this time, I encourage you to adjust your orbit elsewhere, as any undocumented entry onto this planet will be construed as a breach of corporate treaty and we will be forced to sue with extreme prejudice.”
rows.translation: 一旁的显示器发出一连串提示音，打开了瀑布般涌出的纯文本表格与合同。“如果你目前没有事务要与卡玛利拉办理，建议调整轨道前往别处，因为任何未经备案而进入该星球的行为都将被视为违反企业条约，我们将被迫以最严厉的手段提起诉讼。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear multiple bings as a side monitor opens a cascade of pure-text forms and contracts. “If you do not have business with the Camarilla at this time, I encourage you to adjust your orbit elsewhere, as any undocumented entry onto this planet will be construed as a breach of corporate treaty and we will be forced to sue with extreme prejudice.”"

rows.original: Camarilla
rows.raw: "Camarilla"

rows.original: You ask if there’s a tove colony of Uveto. You certainly weren’t expecting one.
rows.translation: 你问尤维托是否有托芙殖民地。这可完全出乎你的意料。
rows.raw: " You ask if there’s a tove colony of Uveto. You certainly weren’t expecting one."

rows.original: You ask for more information about the planet. Does this creature’s species live there?
rows.translation: 你询问更多关于这颗星球的信息。这个生物的种族住在那里吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask for more information about the planet. Does this creature’s species live there?"

rows.original: “On that ice ball? High Executives, no! You couldn’t pay me to set foot on that hellsphere!”
rows.translation: “住在那个冰球上？高管在上，当然不！给我再多钱，我也不会踏上那颗地狱星球！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“On that ice ball? High Executives, no! You couldn’t pay me to set foot on that hellsphere!”"

rows.original: From what you’ve seen of the monetary penalties mentioned on every line of these documents, you’re pretty sure that means a lot coming from him.
rows.translation: 从这些文件每一行提到的罚款金额来看，你很确定，这话由他来说分量十足。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom what you’ve seen of the monetary penalties mentioned on every line of these documents, you’re pretty sure that means a lot coming from him."

rows.original: “Nono, no Tove sets down on there for more than a day or so. However, we are the official representatives of the multi-corporate trade conglomerate that owns Uveto, pursuant to Confederate Mega-Corporate bylaws. The Camarilla is also of course responsible for the safety and security of a nativized race of ausar, who we care for greatly.”
rows.translation: “不不，没有托芙人会在那里停留超过一两天。不过，根据邦联大型企业章程，我们是拥有尤维托的多企业贸易集团的官方代表。当然，卡玛利拉也负责一个已归化奥萨种族的安全保障，我们非常关心他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nono, no Tove sets down on there for more than a day or so. However, we are the official representatives of the multi-corporate trade conglomerate that owns Uveto, pursuant to Confederate Mega-Corporate bylaws. The Camarilla is also of course responsible for the safety and security of a nativized race of ausar, who we care for greatly.”"

rows.original: His beaked, four-eyed face is very hard to read, but you have your suspicions about that last part.
rows.translation: 他那长着鸟喙与四只眼睛的脸实在难以解读，但你对最后那句话颇有怀疑。
rows.raw: "\n\nHis beaked, four-eyed face is very hard to read, but you have your suspicions about that last part."

rows.original: You give a resigned sigh and cut the comms, starting to fill out your mountain of paperwork...
rows.translation: 你无奈地叹了口气，切断通讯，开始填写堆积如山的文件...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give a resigned sigh and cut the comms, starting to fill out your mountain of paperwork..."

rows.original: As you near Uveto, a familiar bing echos from your comm station, and a fluffy tove appears on your holoprojector, greeting you once again. “Welcome back to Uveto, Captain Steele. If you have business with the GGC or its subsidiaries located on the surface of Uveto, please fill out the attached forms and waivers. Remember that any undocumented entry onto this planet will be construed as a breach of corporate treaty and we will be forced to sue with extreme prejudice.”
rows.translation: 接近尤维托时，通讯站传来熟悉的提示音，一名毛茸茸的托芙人出现在全息投影仪上，再次向你问候。“欢迎返回尤维托，斯蒂尔船长。如果你要与位于尤维托地表的GGC或其子公司办理事务，请填写随附的表格和免责书。请记住，任何未经备案而进入该星球的行为都将被视为违反企业条约，我们将被迫以最严厉的手段提起诉讼。”
rows.raw: "As you near Uveto, a familiar bing echos from your comm station, and a fluffy tove appears on your holoprojector, greeting you once again. “Welcome back to Uveto, Captain Steele. If you have business with the GGC or its subsidiaries located on the surface of Uveto, please fill out the attached forms and waivers. Remember that any undocumented entry onto this planet will be construed as a breach of corporate treaty and we will be forced to sue with extreme prejudice.”"

rows.original: You sigh as several forms rush onto your computer’s terminals. Thankfully, the pile’s significantly reduced since your first encounter with the planet’s sue-happy owners. You cut the comms and resign yourself to filling out the forms until their escort ship intercepts you.
rows.translation: 几份表格涌上电脑终端，你叹了口气。所幸，自从首次遭遇这颗星球动辄起诉的所有者后，文件数量已经大幅减少。你切断通讯，认命地填写表格，直到他们的护航船拦截你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou sigh as several forms rush onto your computer’s terminals. Thankfully, the pile’s significantly reduced since your first encounter with the planet’s sue-happy owners. You cut the comms and resign yourself to filling out the forms until their escort ship intercepts you."

rows.original: DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY
rows.raw: "DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY
rows.raw: "DO UVETO ICEQUEEN ENTRY"

rows.original: SIRETTA.UVETO STATION.UVS F15
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.UVETO STATION.UVS F15"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Bitterly Cold
rows.raw: "Bitterly Cold"

rows.original: Bitterly Cold
rows.raw: "Bitterly Cold"

rows.original: frostwyrm
rows.raw: "frostwyrm"

rows.original: The Uvetan cold chills you to your
rows.translation: 尤维托的严寒一直冷进你的
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Uvetan cold chills you to your"

rows.original: gooey core
rows.translation: 黏液核心
rows.raw: " gooey core"

rows.original: bones
rows.translation: 骨髓
rows.raw: " bones"

rows.original: , making you shiver uncontrollably. No matter where you go, there’s no stopping the incessant, numbing cold. It physically hurts to be out here, and the longer you stay, the more your vision blurs and blurs...
rows.translation: ，令你无法控制地发抖。无论走到哪里，都逃不过这持续不断、令人麻木的寒冷。待在外面甚至会让身体感到疼痛，而且逗留得越久，你的视线就越发模糊...
rows.raw: ", making you shiver uncontrollably. No matter where you go, there’s no stopping the incessant, numbing cold. It physically hurts to be out here, and the longer you stay, the more your vision blurs and blurs... "

rows.original: Suddenly, your [pc.foot] catches, and before you can realize what’s happening you pitch forward, planting your face in the thick snow. You gasp, flailing your arms for a moment, but... you can’t seem to find the energy -- the vital strength -- to pick yourself up again. Snow settles onto your back, still blowing over you with heartless, frigid force. Try as you might, you find yourself fading, eyes starting to close. So sleepy...
rows.translation: 突然，你的[pc.foot]被什么绊住，还没反应过来便向前扑倒，一头栽进厚厚的积雪。你倒抽一口气，双臂挣扎片刻，可是... 你似乎找不到力气——那股维系生命的力量——再次爬起来。雪花落在背上，仍带着无情刺骨的力量吹打着你。无论如何挣扎，你的意识都在逐渐远去，眼睛开始合拢。好困...
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, your [pc.foot] catches, and before you can realize what’s happening you pitch forward, planting your face in the thick snow. You gasp, flailing your arms for a moment, but... you can’t seem to find the energy -- the vital strength -- to pick yourself up again. Snow settles onto your back, still blowing over you with heartless, frigid force. Try as you might, you find yourself fading, eyes starting to close. So sleepy..."

rows.original: Blackness takes you.
rows.translation: 黑暗将你吞没。
rows.raw: "\n\nBlackness takes you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You wrap your arms around yourself, desperately trying to fend off the overwhelming cold. The planet’s freezing you to your bones
rows.translation: 你用双臂抱紧自己，拼命抵挡压倒性的寒冷。这颗星球正把你一直冻进骨髓
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wrap your arms around yourself, desperately trying to fend off the overwhelming cold. The planet’s freezing you to your bones"

rows.original: -- and being naked, you’ve got next to no defense against the chill
rows.translation: ——而且你赤身裸体，几乎没有任何抵御严寒的手段
rows.raw: " -- and being naked, you’ve got next to no defense against the chill"

rows.original: , no matter how much clothing you wear
rows.translation: ，无论你穿了多少衣服
rows.raw: ", no matter how much clothing you wear"

rows.original: . You feel like you might collapse if you don’t take shelter soon!
rows.translation: 。要是再不尽快找到庇护所，你觉得自己可能会倒下！
rows.raw: ". You feel like you might collapse if you don’t take shelter soon!"

rows.original: The cold on Uveto is absolutely piercing out here, with no walls or fluffy ausar to block the howling winds and free-flying shards of ice tearing across the rolling plains of ice and alien obsidian. You clutch your arms around yourself, trying to shield your body from the frigid cold, but to no avail. Shivering madly, you glance around in desperation: you need to find shelter fast, or you’re going to freeze!
rows.translation: 尤维托户外的寒意刺骨至极，没有墙壁或毛茸茸的奥萨帮你挡住呼啸狂风，以及横扫起伏冰原与异星黑曜石地面的冰屑。你用双臂抱紧自己，试图保护身体免受严寒侵袭，却毫无用处。你疯狂发抖，绝望地环顾四周：必须尽快找到庇护所，否则你会冻死！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cold on Uveto is absolutely piercing out here, with no walls or fluffy ausar to block the howling winds and free-flying shards of ice tearing across the rolling plains of ice and alien obsidian. You clutch your arms around yourself, trying to shield your body from the frigid cold, but to no avail. Shivering madly, you glance around in desperation: you need to find shelter fast, or you’re going to freeze!"

rows.original: A caramel-skinned ausar woman is sitting behind the counter, pumping iron. Unlike most ausar here, she’s ripped, and wearing a white tank top to show off her glistening muscles while she works. A pair of brilliant, almost glowing, orange eyes regard you warily between reps. Their owner gives you a slight nod of recognition when you enter the shop, but she seems otherwise content to keep working out in peace.
rows.translation: 一名焦糖肤色的奥萨女子坐在柜台后举铁。和这里大多数奥萨不同，她肌肉发达，还穿着白色背心，在锻炼时展示闪着汗光的肌肉。一双明亮得近乎发光的橙色眼睛在每组动作间警惕地打量你。你走进店里时，她微微点头表示认出了你，除此之外似乎只想安静地继续锻炼。
rows.raw: "\n\nA caramel-skinned ausar woman is sitting behind the counter, pumping iron. Unlike most ausar here, she’s ripped, and wearing a white tank top to show off her glistening muscles while she works. A pair of brilliant, almost glowing, orange eyes regard you warily between reps. Their owner gives you a slight nod of recognition when you enter the shop, but she seems otherwise content to keep working out in peace."

rows.original: Approach
rows.translation: 接近
rows.raw: "Approach"

rows.original: Nerrasa is sitting behind the counter as usual, pumping iron and bobbing her head to the beat of the thrashy metal playing over the shop’s speakers. The way she’s sitting, leaning forward with her sweat-slicked tank top hugging her half-bared cleavage and exposing her rippling muscle, she’s clearly content to let you watch her work.
rows.translation: 内拉萨像往常一样坐在柜台后举铁，随着商店扬声器里播放的激烈金属乐点头打拍。她身体前倾坐着，汗湿的背心紧贴半露的乳沟，显出起伏的肌肉；显然，她完全不介意让你看着她锻炼。
rows.raw: "\n\nNerrasa is sitting behind the counter as usual, pumping iron and bobbing her head to the beat of the thrashy metal playing over the shop’s speakers. The way she’s sitting, leaning forward with her sweat-slicked tank top hugging her half-bared cleavage and exposing her rippling muscle, she’s clearly content to let you watch her work."

rows.original: The hellhound owner has bolted a bar to the ceiling over the counter, and is using it to do rapid-fire pull-ups. Her head’s obscured by the heater, but she’s perfectly positioned to show off her big breasts bouncing up and down under her tank top with every motion. No sports bra can keep a rack like that restrained!
rows.translation: 这名地狱犬店主在柜台上方的天花板装了一根横杆，正用它飞快地做引体向上。她的头被暖风机遮住，但这个姿势恰好让硕大乳房随着每次动作在背心下上下弹跳。任何运动胸罩都束缚不住如此丰满的一对乳房！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hellhound owner has bolted a bar to the ceiling over the counter, and is using it to do rapid-fire pull-ups. Her head’s obscured by the heater, but she’s perfectly positioned to show off her big breasts bouncing up and down under her tank top with every motion. No sports bra can keep a rack like that restrained!"

rows.original: Nerrasa’s kicking her feet up for now, crossed on the countertop and supporting a dataslate she’s reading between long gulps of a New Texan-branded protein shake.
rows.translation: 内拉萨此刻正翘着双脚，交叉搭在柜台上，托着一块数据板；她一边阅读，一边大口喝着新德州品牌的蛋白奶昔。
rows.raw: "\n\nNerrasa’s kicking her feet up for now, crossed on the countertop and supporting a dataslate she’s reading between long gulps of a New Texan-branded protein shake."

rows.original: Oooh, that smells like cum! Yummy!
rows.translation: 噢，这闻起来像精液！真美味！
rows.raw: " Oooh, that smells like cum! Yummy!"

rows.original: “Sup,” she says, barely paying you any mind.
rows.translation: “哟，”她说道，几乎没把你放在心上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sup,” she says, barely paying you any mind."

rows.original: Nerrasa
rows.translation: 内拉萨
rows.raw: "Nerrasa"

rows.original: This place has been abandoned for some time. Whoever was here before isn’t coming back, you decide. You spend a few minutes tossing the tents, looking for anything of value the previous occupants might have left behind. There’s nothing inside, save emptied containers and tattered scraps of cloth. Only when you glance into the fire pit do you catch a glimpse of something worthwhile: you lean over and pull a small, black amulet out of the dusty covering of snow.
rows.translation: 这里已经荒废了一段时间。你判断，先前住在这里的人不会回来了。你花了几分钟翻找帐篷，寻找前住户可能留下的值钱东西。里面除了空容器和破布碎片，什么也没有。直到瞥向火坑，你才捕捉到一丝有价值的东西：你俯下身，从覆着薄雪的灰尘中取出一枚黑色小护符。
rows.raw: "This place has been abandoned for some time. Whoever was here before isn’t coming back, you decide. You spend a few minutes tossing the tents, looking for anything of value the previous occupants might have left behind. There’s nothing inside, save emptied containers and tattered scraps of cloth. rows.original: The entrance to Korg’ii Hold, with all its many secret, whistling holes, is gone. A sturdy metal edifice has been plunked down in its place. Geddanium-reinforced armor renders it impervious to small-arms fire, and the muzzles of a dozen remote-control anti-tank weapons dismantle any ideas you have about breaking in as soundly as the hull of a T-3400 battle tank. The korgonne clearly aren’t in charge any longer. Some other force or entity has claimed the hold. Perhaps you should’ve helped out Ula. Now there’s nothing you can do but stare angrily at the Pyrite Industries logo stamped on a gun barrel.
rows.translation: 科尔吉要塞连同那些众多隐秘、呼啸作响的孔洞一起消失了。取而代之的是一座坚固的金属建筑。盖达合金强化装甲令它无惧轻武器火力，十几门遥控反坦克武器的炮口则像拆解T-3400主战坦克车体一样，彻底打消了你闯进去的念头。显然，科尔贡人已经不再掌权。某股其他势力或实体占领了要塞。也许你当初应该帮助乌拉。 如今你什么也做不了，只能愤怒地瞪着印在炮管上的黄铁矿工业标志。

Perhaps you should’ve helped out Ula.\n\nNow there’s nothing you can do but stare angrily at the Pyrite Industries logo stamped on a gun barrel."

rows.original: The Chieftain’s bedroom may have once been a spartan, traditional affair, but since Ula’s sudden promotion to unquestioned leader of her tribe, much has changed. The comfortable but primitive bed has gained a set of flannel sheets decorated with snowflakes and cartoonish seals, obviously purchased from somewhere in Irestead. The furniture from Ula’s old room joins it in sprucing up the place and lending it an air befitting of a more civilized people.
rows.translation: 酋长的卧室或许曾经简朴而传统，但乌拉突然晋升为部落无可争议的领袖后，许多事情都变了。舒适却原始的床铺添了一套法兰绒床单，上面装饰着雪花和卡通海豹，显然购自艾尔斯泰德的某个地方。乌拉旧房间里的家具也搬来点缀此处，使这里呈现出更符合文明民族的气息。
rows.raw: "The Chieftain’s bedroom may have once been a spartan, traditional affair, but since Ula’s sudden promotion to unquestioned leader of her tribe, much has changed. The comfortable but primitive bed has gained a set of flannel sheets decorated with snowflakes and cartoonish seals, obviously purchased from somewhere in Irestead. The furniture from Ula’s old room joins it in sprucing up the place and lending it an air befitting of a more civilized people."

rows.original:
Walls of whitish stone, worked into murals of ancient korgonne heroism, display the might of Korg’ii clan on all sides. Gold chains hold glowing crystals from the ceiling to light it amber radiance. You can see a single, armored korg fighting off three frostwyrms single-handled. Elsewhere, a horde of fluffy barbarians riding six-legged bears does battle with a swarm of bestial milodans.

Carefully hewn rock and skillfully carved bone decorate the rest of the interior. An enormous throne rises up in the center of it all, a place for the tribe’s undisputed leader. Dozens of cushions have been heaped upon it since Ula’s rise to power, and she’s even taken the luxury of piling furs and pillows into a high stack in the corner for when she can take more relaxed meetings. A large desk and chair sits at the opposite end, for use by scribes or the Chieftess herself when there’s paperwork to be done.
rows.translation:
四周的灰白石墙被雕成描绘古代科尔贡英雄事迹的壁画，处处彰显科尔吉氏族的威武。金链从天花板悬下发光水晶，以琥珀色光芒照亮大厅。你能看到一名披甲科尔贡人只身对抗三条霜龙。另一处，一大群骑着六足熊的毛茸野蛮人正与兽化米洛丹群激战。

精心凿出的岩石与巧妙雕刻的骨头装饰着其余内部空间。一座巨大王座耸立在正中央，属于部落无可争议的领袖。乌拉掌权后，上面堆起了数十个软垫；她甚至奢侈地在角落里把毛皮和枕头垒成高高一摞，供她举行较轻松的会面时使用。另一端摆着一张大书桌和椅子，供书记员或女酋长本人处理文书工作。
rows.raw: "Walls of whitish stone, worked into murals of ancient korgonne heroism, display the might of Korg’ii clan on all sides. Gold chains hold glowing crystals from the ceiling to light it amber radiance. You can see a single, armored korg fighting off three frostwyrms single-handled. Elsewhere, a horde of fluffy barbarians riding six-legged bears does battle with a swarm of bestial milodans.\n\nCarefully hewn rock and skillfully carved bone decorate the rest of the interior. An enormous throne rises up in the center of it all, a place for the tribe’s undisputed leader. Dozens of cushions have been heaped upon it since Ula’s rise to power, and she’s even taken the luxury of piling furs and pillows into a high stack in the corner for when she can take more relaxed meetings. A large desk and chair sits at the opposite end, for use by scribes or the Chieftess herself when there’s paperwork to be done."

rows.original: Your ship is docked here, connected by a short umbilical to one of Uveto Station’s four large arms. Several readouts beep noisily on the bulkhead just ahead of you. More impressively, though, you’re treated to a view of the icy planet below, courtesy of a large, reinforced window nearby. Uveto slowly rolls beneath you, a solid ball of pale blue and frozen whites.
rows.translation: 你的飞船停靠在这里，通过一条短接驳通道连接乌维托空间站四条大型支臂中的一条。前方舱壁上的几块显示器正嘈杂地发出提示音。不过更引人注目的是，附近一扇巨大的强化舷窗让你得以欣赏下方冰封星球的景色。乌维托在你脚下缓缓转动，宛如一颗由浅蓝与冰白构成的坚实球体。
rows.raw: "Your ship is docked here, connected by a short umbilical to one of Uveto Station’s four large arms. Several readouts beep noisily on the bulkhead just ahead of you. More impressively, though, you’re treated to a view of the icy planet below, courtesy of a large, reinforced window nearby. Uveto slowly rolls beneath you, a solid ball of pale blue and frozen whites."

rows.original: A central hub connects several docking tubes together on the southernmost arm of Uveto Station. A welcoming desk is set up here, with several out-facing screens for visitors to fill out even more paperwork for the Camarilla. A handful of other spacers are milling about, directing the flow of cargo through the corridors or arguing with the short, fuzzy tove running the place -- almost always unsuccessfully.
rows.translation: 乌维托空间站最南端支臂上的中央枢纽连接着数条对接管道。这里设有迎宾台，几块朝外的屏幕供访客为卡玛利拉填写更多表格。少数其他太空旅客在附近走动，引导货物流过走廊，或与管理此处的矮小毛茸托芙争论，而后者几乎总能占上风。

rows.original: A bank of moving sidewalks connect the heart of Uveto Station to the distant tips of its arms. Several heavy gun turrets are unsubtly planted at strategic intervals, quietly tracking the movements of the spacers riding to and from the station. Despite the ever-present threat, the largely ausar passers-by seem unfazed, and some even laugh and smile. You suppose this must all be normal here...
rows.translation: 一排自动步道将乌维托空间站中心与各条支臂遥远的末端连接起来。几座重型炮塔毫不掩饰地设置在关键位置，悄然追踪往返空间站的太空旅客。尽管威胁始终存在，路过的人大多是奥萨尔，却似乎毫不在意，有些人甚至谈笑风生。你猜这里大概一直如此...

rows.original:
The corridor south, leading back to the docking port, widens out into a row of shops. Most of them look like your average general stores and supply shops. One of the shops does catch your eye, though, with its neon blue sign advertising it as the “Last Chance”.

To the north is the heart of the station, a circle of wide corridors surrounding the massive behemoth that is the station’s space elevator.
rows.translation:
向南返回对接口的走廊逐渐拓宽，形成一排商店。大多数看起来都是普通杂货店和补给店。不过其中一家确实吸引了你的目光：霓虹蓝招牌宣称它名叫“最后机会”。

北边是空间站中心，由一圈宽阔走廊环绕着空间站电梯这一庞然大物。

rows.original: You’re inside a small, brightly lit merchant stall. The walls are a warm, inviting off-pink and plastered with posters advertising various survival gear companies. Ausar heavy metal is playing from within the stall, tuned down to be barely audible over the rumble of a heater bolted to the wall. Racks of equipment, ranging from shield belts and personal heaters to ropes and pitons and jetpacks hang on the walls. Several vials are arranged on the counter, advertising various ausar-related gene mods on their labels.
rows.translation: 你身处一个灯火明亮的小型商铺。墙壁呈温暖宜人的淡粉色，贴满各类求生装备公司的广告海报。摊位内播放着奥萨尔重金属音乐，音量调得很低，几乎被固定在墙上的暖气轰鸣盖过。墙上挂满装备架，从护盾腰带、个人加热器，到绳索、岩钉和喷气背包应有尽有。柜台上排列着几个小瓶，标签宣传着各类奥萨尔相关基因改造剂。

To the north is a small lounge where several spacers are milling about, drinking and watching a holoscreen. It is, appropriately, labeled “Spacer’s Lounge”.
rows.translation:
你正站在环绕乌维托空间站巨型太空电梯的环形长廊西南侧。南边是一排商店，其中一家取了个醒目却阴沉的名字：“最后机会”。无论向东还是向北，电梯门都只有几步之遥。

北边有一间小休息室，几名太空旅客在那里闲逛、饮酒并观看全息屏幕。它很贴切地标着“太空旅客休息室”。

rows.original: The shop’s interior is just as large as it looks on the outside. A number of aliens of varying gender peruse the racks and displays of warm looking clothes. Bright labels tie the different merchandise to a number of top fashion companies, with a separate section dedicated to clothing made on Uveto itself. There are a number of changing rooms in the back for trying on clothing, and mirrors just off to their side to show off for friends. The other half of the store is mostly taken up by the entrance to a large sauna. Heat radiates from the opening, bathing the counter in warmth and a thin layer of precipitation.
rows.translation: 商店内部和外观看起来一样宽敞。各种性别的外星人浏览着陈列架和展示台上的保暖服装。鲜亮标签将不同商品与多家顶级时装公司联系起来，另有一个独立区域专门销售乌维托本地制造的服装。后方设有多间试衣室，旁边还有镜子，方便向朋友展示。商店另一半大多被一座大型桑拿房的入口占据。热量从入口散发出来，使柜台沐浴在暖意与一层薄薄水汽中。

rows.original:
A small lounge has been set up here, centered around an Apollo’s Coffee shop and several holoscreens lining the walls. There’s even a massage parlor set up here. An access door to the station’s mighty space elevator is just to the east of you, and the shops are a few steps south. All around, a very convenient place to be.

Several security goons are standing to the north, preventing you from accessing the northern portions of the stations without proper clearance. You don’t need anything there anyway.
rows.translation:
这里设有一间小休息室，以阿波罗咖啡店为中心，墙壁上排列着几块全息屏幕。甚至还有一间按摩院。空间站雄伟太空电梯的入口门就在东边，商店则在南边几步之外。总体而言，这里十分便利。

几名安保打手站在北边，阻止没有适当许可的人进入空间站北部区域。反正你在那里也没有事情要做。

You don’t need anything there anyway."

rows.original:
A very plush, posh lobby is seated at the end of the eastern wing, behind several security doors and a very threatening pair of gun pods bolted to the ceiling. The door east is labeled “Station Manager”; the one to the south indicates it’s the office of one Anyxine Rhenesuune, a Vice President of RhenWorld Stellar Excavations.

Several tove are seated against the far walls, dug in behind computer banks and flickering holo-screens. Their beaked, fuzzy faces barely acknowledge you.
rows.translation:
东翼尽头设有一个极其柔软奢华的大厅，位于数道安保门和一对固定在天花板上、极具威胁感的炮舱之后。东边的门标着“空间站主管”；南边那扇门则表明，这里是雷恩世界恒星开采公司副总裁安妮克辛·雷内桑的办公室。

几名托芙坐在远处墙边，藏身于计算机组和闪烁的全息屏幕后。他们毛茸茸的鸟喙面孔几乎没有理会你。

rows.original: The office of Vice President Anyxine Rhenesuune is relatively spartan, especially compared to the warm and comfortable lobby outside. A large, metal desk curves around the south side, covered with a half dozen different holoscreens. A single painting hangs on the western bulkhead, displaying a large desert landscape with craggy cliffs and mountains in the distance. A single large, cushioned swivel chair sits behind the main desk. Three metal chairs are opposite the desk for visitors like yourself.
rows.translation: 副总裁安妮克辛·雷内桑的办公室相当简朴，尤其是与外面温暖舒适的大厅相比。一张大型金属办公桌沿南侧弯曲，上面摆着六块不同的全息屏幕。西侧舱壁上挂着唯一一幅画，描绘广阔沙漠景观，远处耸立着陡峭悬崖和山峦。主桌后方放着一张带厚垫的大型转椅。桌子对面则有三把金属椅，供你这样的访客使用。

rows.original:
The Uveto Station space elevator is a huge, flat cargo platform loaded down with crates and other spacers. Everyone on the elevator is bundled up with heavy coats, heat-generator belts, and anything else they can find to stave off the frigid cold of the icy world outside. A sign on the hallway to the east says, in big, friendly neon letters, ‘WELCOME TO UVETO’.

The door out of the elevator leads you into a large, sealed metal building with frosted glass windows letting in the light. Dozens of ausar are moving around inside, many of whom wander over to help unload the elevator.
rows.translation:
乌维托空间站的太空电梯是一座巨大的平坦货运平台，上面堆满货箱，还有其他太空旅客。电梯里的每个人都裹着厚重外套、发热腰带，以及任何能帮助抵御外面冰封世界严寒的东西。东边走廊上的标牌以巨大而亲切的霓虹字母写着：“欢迎来到乌维托”。

走出电梯的门通往一座巨大密封金属建筑，结霜的玻璃窗让光线照入。数十名奥萨尔在里面来回走动，其中许多人走过来帮忙卸下电梯货物。

The back of the Uveto VII central hub is a large, metal structure with vaulted ceilings and glass windows covered with frost. A great deal of cargo is stacked up all over, mostly showing Camarilla, Steele Tech, and RhenWorld markings.

The space elevator’s access is just to the west of you. To the north, you see markings indicating a Sheriff’s station. To the south you see an office building marked with the Steele Tech logo and a heading that labels it as the main office of the company’s biomedical division.

乌维托七号中央枢纽后方是一座大型金属建筑，拥有拱形天花板和覆满冰霜的玻璃窗。大量货物堆得到处都是，大多带有卡玛利拉、斯蒂尔科技和雷恩世界的标志。

太空电梯入口就在西边。北边的标记指向治安官警署。南边则有一座带斯蒂尔科技标志的办公楼，标题将其标为公司生物医学部门总部。

rows.original: Dr. Lessau’s office consists of a clean white room decorated with dark blue carpeting, joined at the edges by dark wood baseboards that look freshly waxed. Paintings hung on the walls sport matching dark wood frames and depict various murals of creatures from human and ausar mythology. One depicts a dragon spiraling through the air, another a beautiful unicorn in a tranquil forest clearing, a third a chimera roaring in triumph as it stands over a horde of other beasts. The back of the room is taken up by a large wooden desk sporting a holoterminal which spans nearly its entire width, most of the displays alight with various genomes and reports.
rows.translation: 莱索医生的办公室是一间整洁的白色房间，铺着深蓝色地毯，边缘与看起来刚打过蜡的深色木质踢脚线相接。墙上的画作配有同款深色木框，描绘人类和奥萨尔神话中的各种生物。一幅画着盘旋空中的巨龙，另一幅是宁静林间空地中的美丽独角兽，第三幅则是一头奇美拉站在群兽之上，胜利咆哮。房间后方被一张大型木桌占据，桌上全息终端几乎横跨全部宽度，大部分显示器都亮着各种基因组和报告。

rows.original:
Entering the survey station, you look around the inside of the tower. The main room is filled with a vast array of readouts, sensor screens, and monitors, all being constantly checked by a small group of technicians from a variety of races, though they predominantly appear to be huskar.

In the center of the room is a holographic map table outlining everything around Irestead, from the weather to the constant ice flows. A pair of techs move constantly to and from terminals to the map table, making sure that the weather reports and map information they’re receiving is checked and up to date.

Just ahead, there is a lift that can be taken up to the top-most floor, the station’s observatory.
rows.translation:
进入勘测站后，你环顾塔楼内部。主室里摆满各式读数器、传感器屏幕和监视器，一小群来自不同种族的技术员不断检查它们，不过其中大多数似乎是赫斯卡。

房间中央是一张全息地图桌，展示艾尔斯泰德周边的一切，从天气到不断移动的浮冰。两名技术员持续往返于终端和地图桌，确保收到的天气报告与地图信息经过核查并保持最新。

正前方有一部电梯，可以通往最顶层，也就是空间站的观测台。

rows.original: To the north, through a small tunnel, there is a building marked as the Geological Survey Station. It is a three story building with a glass hexagonal observation deck on top, similar to some landing control towers you’ve seen. Each glass pane appears to have armored shutters mounted to it, presumably to keep out Uveto’s extreme storms. Around the side of the building you can see a set of antennas and a sealed sensor dome. To the south, you can see a large elevator shaft that seems to go down. To the east, you see a pair of heavy doors.
rows.translation: 北边穿过一条小隧道，有一座标为地质勘测站的建筑。那是一栋三层建筑，顶部设有玻璃六角形观景台，与某些你见过的着陆控制塔相似。每块玻璃似乎都装有装甲百叶窗，想必是用来抵御乌维托的极端风暴。 建筑侧面可以看到一组天线和一个密封传感器圆顶。 南边有一条似乎通往下方的大型电梯井。东边则有一对重型门。

Each glass pane appears to have armored shutters mounted to it, presumably to keep out Uveto’s extreme storms. Around the side of the building you can see a set of antennas and a sealed sensor dome. To the south, you can see a large elevator shaft that seems to go down. To the east, you see a pair of heavy doors."

rows.translation: 北边穿过一条小隧道，有一座标为地质勘测站的建筑。那是一栋三层建筑，顶部设有玻璃六角形观景台，与某些你见过的着陆控制塔相似。每块玻璃似乎都装有装甲百叶窗，想必是用来抵御乌维托的极端风暴。 建筑侧面可以看到一组天线和一个密封传感器圆顶。 南边有一条似乎通往下方的大型电梯井。东边则有一对重型门。
rows.raw: "To the north, through a small tunnel, there is a building marked as the Geological Survey Station. It is a three story building with a glass hexagonal observation deck on top, similar to some landing control towers you’ve seen. Each glass pane appears to have armored shutters mounted to it, presumably to keep out Uveto’s extreme storms.\\n\\nAround the side of the building you can see a set of antennas and a sealed sensor dome.\\n\\nTo the south, you can see a large elevator shaft that seems to go down. To the east, you see a pair of heavy doors."

You’re buffeted by strong, icy winds that bite at your [pc.skinFurScales], forcing you to wrap your arms around yourself... and this is within the boundaries the protective walls that surround the city.

rows.original: A long, snow-encrusted street runs north to south just ahead. To the west is the warm, protective embrace of Uveto’s central hub.
rows.translation: 前方有一条覆满积雪的长街，南北延伸。西边则是乌维托中央枢纽温暖而安全的怀抱。
rows.raw: "\n\nA long, snow-encrusted street runs north to south just ahead. To the west is the warm, protective embrace of Uveto’s central hub."

rows.original: It’s all you can do to force yourself not to run for it... holy SHIT it’s cold here! You’ve got to get inside, or find some way to warm yourself up ASAP.
rows.translation: 你只能拼命强迫自己不要跑回去...我操，这里冷得要命！你必须赶紧进室内，或尽快想办法暖和起来。
rows.raw: " It’s all you can do to force yourself not to run for it... holy SHIT it’s cold here! You’ve got to get inside, or find some way to warm yourself up ASAP."

rows.original: Even with the warmth provided by your heat belt, it’s still freezing cold out here. Just not lethally so.
rows.translation: 即使发热腰带提供了温暖，外面依然寒冷刺骨，只是不再足以致命。
rows.raw: " Even with the warmth provided by your heat belt, it’s still freezing cold out here. Just not lethally so."

rows.original: Several shops are set up around the southern end of the main street, advertising their wares. Most are simple things like grocery stores, a computer shop, and the like. To the west, though, you spot a shop that catches your eye: the Hunter’s Dream. Opposite is a holographic sign above a storefront featuring a decal of a multi-legged, tauric alien and the words, “Spinarran Silk & Steel”. The display windows to the east show off samples: polished weapons, exotic body armor, and even mundane clothing.
rows.translation: 主街南端周围开着几家店铺，招牌宣传着各自的商品。大多只是杂货店、电脑商店之类的普通店面。不过西边有一家店吸引了你的目光：猎人之梦。对面店铺上方的全息招牌印着一个多足牛兽外星人的图案，以及“斯宾纳兰丝绸与钢铁”几个字。东边的橱窗陈列着样品：打磨光亮的武器、异域风格的护甲，甚至还有普通服装。

rows.original: To the south you can see a massive stadium with a holo-sign reading “Racetrack U7”. It’s completely enclosed by the looks of what you can see from out here, shielded from the cold, cold weather of this frozen iceball of a moon. The thing almost looks like one of those old coliseums from ancient Earth, with dozens of large, crescent-topped entrances along its circumference, and it looks like you could use one to get in if you wanted.
rows.translation: 南边能看到一座巨型体育场，全息招牌上写着“U7赛道”。从外面看，它似乎完全封闭，将内部与这颗冰冻卫星极其寒冷的天气隔绝。整个建筑很像古代地球的旧式斗兽场，周围排列着几十个顶部呈新月形的大入口；如果愿意，你似乎可以从其中一个进去。

The gate to the town is just a few yards east of you, underneath a pair of intimidating gun turrets on the walls. To the south, you see a large set of sliding glass doors under an awning with the words ‘MAGLEV STATION’ written in bright, cheerful letters.

rows.original: You’re underneath Irestead now, perhaps fifty feet underground. A large, two-track train station has been constructed here, connected to the town above via a bank of elevators and stairs. Safe and warm beneath the ground, the train station seems to be one of the most populated places in town: several dozen ausar and leithans are milling about, most dressed in heavily padded and furred coats bearing various corporate insignias: RhenWorld and Akkadi the most prevalent of them. You get the impression many of the people here are either coming from or going to the savicite mines outside of town.
rows.translation: 你现在位于艾尔斯特德下方，大约地下五十英尺处。这里修建了一座拥有两条轨道的大型火车站，通过一组电梯和楼梯与上方城镇相连。车站位于安全温暖的地下，似乎是镇上人口最密集的地方之一：几十名奥萨人与莱坦人在此往来，大多穿着带厚衬垫和毛皮、印有各公司标志的外套，其中以仁世界和阿卡迪最常见。你感觉这里许多人要么刚从镇外的萨维石矿回来，要么正准备前往那里。

rows.original:
The main street comes to a head here, leading up to a huge wooden building with a pair of blazing fires flickering in metal braziers outside. Wide marble steps lead up to a pair of metal-reinforced doors. A pair of armored humans are standing outside, clad in snow-white ceramic plates with dark scarves, capes, and kilts over them. Each has a longspear grasped in his hands, and an energy pistol on his hip.

A multi-level apartment complex can be found to the west. While it is a tower of roomhalls connected by an elevator, it has a small enough footprint and is positioned out of the way as to not overtake the view of the impressive temple.

To the east, you can see the nearest house to the temple. It’s a small, dark gray building that you imagine must be largely built underground. A small plate beside it gives the street address, and says in flowing letters ‘Shade and Astra Irons’.
rows.translation:
主街在此到达尽头，通向一栋巨大的木制建筑，门外两只金属火盆燃烧着熊熊烈焰。宽阔的大理石阶梯通向一对金属加固大门。两名全副武装的人类站在外面，身穿雪白陶瓷装甲，外罩深色围巾、披风与短裙。两人手中各握一柄长矛，腰间还佩有能量手枪。

西边是一座多层公寓楼。虽然它是一栋由电梯连接各层房间走廊的高塔，但占地不大，而且位置偏僻，不至于遮挡宏伟神殿的景观。

东边能看见距离神殿最近的房屋。那是一栋深灰色小楼，你猜大部分建筑都在地下。旁边的小牌子写着街道地址，并以流畅字体标注“谢德与阿斯特拉·艾恩斯”。

东边能看见距离神殿最近的房屋。那是一栋深灰色小楼，你猜大部分建筑都在地下。旁边的小牌子写着街道地址，并以流畅字体标注“谢德与阿斯特拉·艾恩斯”。
rows.raw: "The main street comes to a head here, leading up to a huge wooden building with a pair of blazing fires flickering in metal braziers outside. Wide marble steps lead up to a pair of metal-reinforced doors. A pair of armored humans are standing outside, clad in snow-white ceramic plates with dark scarves, capes, and kilts over them. Each has a longspear grasped in his hands, and an energy pistol on his hip.\\n\\nA multi-level apartment complex can be found to the west. While it is a tower of roomhalls connected by an elevator, it has a small enough footprint and is positioned out of the way as to not overtake the view of the impressive temple.\\n\\nTo the east, you can see the nearest house to the temple. It’s a small, dark gray building that you imagine must be largely built underground. A small plate beside it gives the street address, and says in flowing letters ‘Shade and Astra Irons’.\n\t\t\n\t\t"

rows.original: There is only a brief landing to kick the snow off your feet before the floor immediately plunges downwards in the form of a staircase, though the steps are mercifully wide and drunkard friendly. Each step downwards brings you further away from the biting chill and, instead, to the warm, cozy atmosphere of what is a tavern. Emphasis on warm, thankfully. Despite its name, the Freezer is actually a decidedly homely establishment. Heaters in nearly every corner of the room keep the air from dipping into Uveto’s usually frigid temperatures, and a scattering of cracked peanut shells on the floor lend the place a homey, if rustic, feel. There’s plenty of space between the various tables, varying from long bench seats to more intimate two seat square tables and everything in between - it feels a bit like a collection of various ways to do tables. There’s a subfloor to the east; slightly lower than the main tavern floor, but only by a few steps.
rows.translation: 门内只有一小块平台供人跺去脚上的雪，紧接着地面便化作楼梯陡然向下；好在台阶十分宽阔，对醉汉很友好。每下一级，你便离刺骨寒意更远，也更接近酒馆温暖舒适的氛围。谢天谢地，重点是温暖。 尽管名叫“冷库”，这里其实相当温馨。房间几乎每个角落都有取暖器，避免室温降到乌维托惯常的严寒程度；地板上散落的碎花生壳也让这里多了几分质朴的居家感。 各种桌子之间留有充足空间，从长椅桌到更私密的双人方桌应有尽有——感觉像是把各种摆弄桌子的方式集中展示出来。 东边有一片下沉区域，比酒馆主楼面低一些，不过只差几级台阶。

rows.original:
A subfloor to the tavern-proper, this part of the room serves to house a giant, circular firepit with hardy seating set all around a roaring fire.

The heat of marvelous, massive flames constantly licks at your [pc.face] as the barely-controlled fire keeps the interior of the tavern pleasantly warm at a distance, but the pit itself offers those fresh from a trek across the ice plains a place to really get some warmth back into their limbs.

There’s a small, unassuming door with a subtle ‘Staff Only’ notice on it tucked into the south corner of the room.
rows.translation:
这里比酒馆主楼面低一层，中央是一座巨大的圆形火坑，熊熊火焰周围摆着结实座椅。

壮观巨焰的热浪不断舔过你的[pc.face]；这团勉强受控的火焰让远处的酒馆内部保持宜人温度，而火坑本身则给刚穿越冰原归来的人提供了真正暖回四肢的地方。

房间南角藏着一扇不起眼的小门，上面低调地写着“仅限员工”。

rows.original: A wide path has been cleared in the accumulated snow and ice outside the Irestead gates, packed down by the constant traffic of heavy treaded vehicles and bundled up huskar. It opens up rapidly to the east, letting out into the wide and seemingly endless fields of feathery snow. The plains stretch off into the eastern horizon, any end lost to the vast distance.
rows.translation: 艾尔斯特德城门外的积雪与冰层中清出了一条宽阔道路，来往的重型履带车辆与裹得严严实实的赫斯卡将其压得坚实平整。道路向东迅速开阔，通往广袤得仿佛没有尽头的蓬松雪原。平原一直延伸到东方地平线，尽头消失在遥远距离中。

rows.original:
The ice and snow packed down outside of Irestead sweeps open into northward and southern passages, chasms through the accumulation worn down by traffic. The path ahead seems to dip downward the further east you go, though you’re sure Irestead didn’t seem to be built on a hill... or maybe it is, and the snow’s just so damn high that it looks like the ground’s ten feet higher than it ought to be.

The only way you’re going to get anywhere in this snowbound hell is through these pathways, that’s for sure. One wrong step up top and you’d go plummeting to your doom, no doubt.
rows.translation:
艾尔斯特德外被压实的冰雪向北、向南分出通道，像交通在积雪中磨出的峡谷。越向东走，前方道路似乎越往下倾斜；可你确信艾尔斯特德看起来并非建在山丘上...或许确实是，只是积雪高得离谱，让地面看起来比实际高了十英尺。

可以肯定，要在这片冰封地狱里前进，你只能沿这些通道走。若在上方踏错一步，毫无疑问会坠落送命。

The path ahead seems to dip downward the further east you go, though you’re sure Irestead didn’t seem to be built on a hill... or maybe it is, and the snow’s just so damn high that it looks like the ground’s ten feet higher than it ought to be.\n\nThe only way you’re going to get anywhere in this snowbound hell is through these pathways, that’s for sure. One wrong step up top and you’d go plummeting to your doom, no doubt."

rows.original: You’re barely outside the gates of Irestead, and you’ve already found someone -- or rather, something the snow’s gotten the best of. There used to be a path south of here, it looks like, but a big fat sphere of a droid has crashed into the snow, causing a snow-slide over itself, blocking the way. The drone looks old, and it’s so frozen that it’s almost ice blue now. You can just barely make out ‘Irestead Geolo-’ printed on the side.
rows.translation: 你才刚离开艾尔斯特德城门，就已经发现有谁——更准确说，是某个东西——败给了风雪。这里过去似乎有条向南的路，但一个又大又圆的机器人撞进雪地，引发雪崩将自己掩埋，也堵住了去路。无人机看起来很旧，冻得几乎已经变成冰蓝色。你勉强能辨认出侧面印着“艾尔斯特德地质——”。

rows.original:
You’re making your way through shallow paths winding through the snow, faint trails to follow towards what you hope is some worthy destination -- or at least somewhere warm. The snowy vale you’re following leads east to west, and seems to have seen vehicular travel recently. Maybe this is the way researchers use when going out to the Glacial Rift?

A metal platform is precariously balanced overhead, bolted onto some sort of hard surface underneath the snow here. Several fuel canisters are strapped down, and a ladder leads up to the surface. An emergency supply cache, you guess. A quick peek up at it reveals the logo the Confederate Peacekeepers emblazoned on a metal sign.

rows.translation: 你站在一座隐秘小洞穴中，它藏在偏僻山谷深处，与外面的风暴隔绝。这里出乎意料地温暖，不过也许只是因为洞穴挡住了永不停歇的寒风。 即使没有热能腰带，在这里睡觉也很安全。

rows.original: A long, winding path through ice and snow leads back from the Rift to the snowy fields closer to Irestead, back westward. To the east is a vast, endless, and nearly featureless sheet of ice: the glacial plain of the Rift. You could easily get lost there, swallowed by by the snow-flurries and storms with nothing to guide you. Best to stick to the handful of vague footpaths worn into the ice...
rows.translation: 一条蜿蜒穿过冰雪的漫长道路从裂谷向西延伸，通往更靠近艾尔斯特德的雪原。东方则是一片辽阔无垠、几乎毫无特征的冰层：裂谷的冰川平原。你很容易在那里迷路，被飞雪和暴风吞没，周围没有任何事物可供辨认方向。最好还是沿着冰面上为数不多、模糊不清的小径前进...

rows.original: Though you can still see Irestead faintly in the distance, the city is quickly fading from view. rows.translation: 尽管远处仍依稀可见艾尔斯特德，这座城市却正迅速淡出视野。前方，频繁的往来在雪堆中磨出了一条窄路——考虑到这种天气，应该不是殖民者留下的。本地人或许经常由此来往，也许是在进出城镇？

rows.original: You stand in a snowy cave, clearly dug out by hand from the titanic snowbank around you. An animal pelt is spread out on the ground, providing some relief from the constant cold should you desire it. Perhaps whoever made this cave intended it to be a waystation between Irestead and the Rift? Or are you treading in someone’s home...? It’s safe to sleep in here, even without a heat belt.
rows.translation: 你站在一座雪洞里，显然有人亲手从周围庞大的雪堆中将其挖出。地面铺着一张兽皮；如果你愿意，可以借此稍稍摆脱无休止的寒意。也许挖洞的人想把它作为艾尔斯特德与裂谷之间的驿站？还是说，你正闯进某人的家中...？ 即使没有加热腰带，在这里睡觉也很安全。

rows.raw: "You stand in a snowy cave, clearly dug out by hand from the titanic snowbank around you. An animal pelt is spread out on the ground, providing some relief from the constant cold should you desire it. Perhaps whoever made this cave intended it to be a waystation between Irestead and the Rift? Or are you treading in someone’s home...?\\n\\nIt’s safe to sleep in here, even without a heat belt."

rows.original: You’re standing in the mouth of a gaping cavern, a natural formation in the ice by the looks like things. Shards of a half-sunken black pillar can be seen through the northern wall, creating a kind of archway around a tunnel leading deeper. The way out is back west, up a slight incline. rows.translation: 你站在一座巨大洞窟的入口，从外观判断，这是冰层中的天然构造。北侧洞壁间可见一根半沉黑柱的碎片，在通往深处的隧道周围形成拱门。出口在西边，沿缓坡向上。 即使没有加热腰带，在这里睡觉也很安全。

rows.original: You’ve ventured deep into an icy cavern, a dozen feet or more beneath the Uvetan moon’s surface. Spears of ice hang ominously from the ceiling above, and the floor is slick -- too slick for comfort. Still, you’re well shielded from the piercing winds up above. It’s safe to sleep in here, even without a heat belt.
rows.translation: 你已深入冰窟，位于乌维托卫星地表下方十几英尺甚至更深处。冰矛不祥地悬在头顶，地面湿滑——滑得令人不安。不过，你也因此很好地避开了上方刺骨寒风。 即使没有加热腰带，在这里睡觉也很安全。

rows.original: You find yourself approaching a small valley between two towering snowbanks. Pillars of black mineral rise like claws all around you, growing thicker the further west you look. The path that way looks narrow but well traveled, with many pawprints etched in the snow. A settlement of some kind must be nearby.
rows.translation: 你发现自己正在靠近两座高耸雪堆间的小山谷。黑色矿物柱如利爪般在周围升起，越往西看就越密集。那边的道路狭窄却似乎经常有人经过，雪地刻满爪印。附近一定有某种聚落。
rows.raw: "You find yourself approaching a small valley between two towering snowbanks. Pillars of black mineral rise like claws all around you, growing thicker the further west you look. The path that way looks narrow but well traveled, with many pawprints etched in the snow. A settlement of some kind must be nearby."

rows.original: A pillar of volcanic rock juts up out of the permafrost and into the western sky, tall as a skyscraper. Black and gray streaks race along the sides. Jagged spires stretch out against the cold winds, sparkling with hints of faded green. A city block could be contained within its circumference. No wonder Uveto is a mining planet. With minerals like that, a fortune is waiting to be collected!
rows.translation: 一根火山岩柱从永冻土中拔地而起，伸向西方天空，高度堪比摩天大楼。黑灰条纹沿侧面飞驰。参差尖塔迎着寒风伸展，闪烁着褪色绿光。它的周长足以容纳一个街区。难怪乌维托是采矿星球。拥有这种矿物，等待开采的就是一笔财富！
rows.raw: "A pillar of volcanic rock juts up out of the permafrost and into the western sky, tall as a skyscraper. Black and gray streaks race along the sides. Jagged spires stretch out against the cold winds, sparkling with hints of faded green. A city block could be contained within its circumference. No wonder Uveto is a mining planet. With minerals like that, a fortune is waiting to be collected!"

rows.original: This close to the enormous pillar, you feel a hint of vertigo whenever you glance up. No naturally occurring rock formation should stand quite so straight and tall! Yet here it is, daring to reach for the sky, standing strong against Uveto’s chill winds. The smooth, sparkling surface glitters with deposits of exotic ores. Drifts of snow obscure the east, but a path has been worn in the drifts to the north, alongside the rocky growth.
rows.translation: 如此接近巨柱时，你每次抬头都会感到些许眩晕。天然岩层绝不该如此笔直高耸！可它就矗立在这里，傲然伸向天空，抵挡乌维托寒风。光滑闪亮的表面因奇异矿藏而熠熠生辉。积雪遮住东方，但北面沿岩石突起有一条道路从雪堆间磨出。
rows.raw: "This close to the enormous pillar, you feel a hint of vertigo whenever you glance up. No naturally occurring rock formation should stand quite so straight and tall! Yet here it is, daring to reach for the sky, standing strong against Uveto’s chill winds. The smooth, sparkling surface glitters with deposits of exotic ores. Drifts of snow obscure the east, but a path has been worn in the drifts to the north, alongside the rocky growth."

rows.translation: 你面对一片冰雪缓坡，看起来足够坚固，向东通往裂谷无尽白原。脚下还算稳固，但你在这里毫无遮蔽——无论面对恶劣天气还是潜在袭击者。赶快走吧！

rows.original: A long, winding path through ice and snow leads back from the Rift to the snowy fields closer to Irestead, back westward. To the east is a vast, endless, and nearly featureless sheet of ice: the glacial plain of the Rift. You could easily get lost there, swallowed by by the snow-flurries and storms with nothing to guide you. Best to stick to the handful of vague footpaths worn into the ice...
rows.translation: 一条穿越冰雪的漫长蜿蜒道路从裂谷向西延伸，通往更靠近伊尔斯泰德的雪原。东边则是一片广阔、无尽而近乎毫无特征的冰盖：裂谷的冰川平原。你很容易在那里迷路，被飞雪和风暴吞没，而且没有任何东西可供辨认方向。最好沿着冰面上那几条模糊的足迹前进...
rows.raw: "A long, winding path through ice and snow leads back from the Rift to the snowy fields closer to Irestead, back westward. To the east is a vast, endless, and nearly featureless sheet of ice: the glacial plain of the Rift. You could easily get lost there, swallowed by by the snow-flurries and storms with nothing to guide you. Best to stick to the handful of vague footpaths worn into the ice..."

Somewhere in the middle distance, though, you can see a tower reaching up into the sky. Definitely Confederate-made, no doubt about it.
rows.translation: 一条结实的压实雪道从中央高原弯出，曲折通向东南。你认为它最终可能通往裂谷，不过路途漫长。中等距离之外，你能看到一座高塔刺向天空。那绝对是邦联建造的，毫无疑问。

rows.original: The path branches here, veering off directly east and up towards the relay tower. This close, you can see that it seems to have fallen into disrepair. Man-sized icycles dangle from its groaning support beams. North and south are the paths forward, back up the plateau or towards the Rift, whichever way you want to go.
rows.translation: 道路在这里分岔，一条径直向东上行，通往中继塔。靠近后，你看出它似乎已经年久失修。人身大小的冰柱悬挂在吱呀作响的支撑梁上。南北方向则分别通往高原和裂谷，任你选择。

rows.original: This relay tower used to see heavy traffic, judging by the old snow-and-ice packed road you used to get here, but it’s fallen into disrepair. The structure groans under Uveto’s often fierce winds. Its blocky outbuilding sits half-buried beneath growing mountains of snow. Inches of thick ice bury the door into impenetrability.
rows.translation: 从你来时那条被冰雪压实的旧路判断，这座中继塔过去交通繁忙，但如今已经年久失修。建筑在乌维托时常肆虐的强风中呻吟。方正的附属建筑半埋在不断堆高的雪山下，数英寸厚的冰层彻底封死了大门。
rows.raw: "This relay tower used to see heavy traffic, judging by the old snow-and-ice packed road you used to get here, but it’s fallen into disrepair. The structure groans under Uveto’s often fierce winds. Its blocky outbuilding sits half-buried beneath growing mountains of snow. Inches of thick ice bury the door into impenetrability."

rows.original: More pressing is the unnerving sight in front of the door: a staff of solid ice, buried partway into the ice. It bears ancient alien runes that seem to shimmer inside the freezing cloud that surrounds it. Just standing this close to it makes the air feel even colder. Your breath billows denser more visible clouds. A chill races up your spine, warning of danger... and power.
rows.translation: 更紧迫的是门前那幅令人不安的景象：一根坚冰法杖部分埋在冰中。杖身刻有古老的异星符文，似乎在环绕它的冰冷云雾中闪烁。仅仅站得这么近，空气便仿佛更加寒冷，呼吸化作更浓、更清晰的白雾。一股寒意沿脊背窜过，警告着危险...以及力量。
rows.raw: "\n\nMore pressing is the unnerving sight in front of the door: a staff of solid ice, buried partway into the ice. It bears ancient alien runes that seem to shimmer inside the freezing cloud that surrounds it. Just standing this close to it makes the air feel even colder. Your breath billows denser more visible clouds. A chill races up your spine, warning of danger... and power."

rows.translation: 你位于中继塔稍南处；那座由太空旅客建造的巨大金属金字塔在持续不断的风中摇摆。东边是裂谷，平滑冰面无尽延伸，通往世界尽头。西边则是冰湖，地势低得多，也更加平静，受到保护而免遭风暴侵袭。

The ice plains are beginning to live up to their name, becoming less about towering snowbanks and winding passages, and more an open stretch of solid ice stretching eastwards to the horizon.

Here you are, the edge of the Glacial Rift. It’s been a long time in coming, but you’re finally here.
rows.translation:
冰原逐渐变得名副其实：高耸雪堆和蜿蜒通道越来越少，取而代之的是向东延伸至地平线的开阔坚冰。

你到了，冰川裂谷的边缘。一路走了这么久，你终于抵达这里。
rows.raw: "The ice plains are beginning to live up to their name, becoming less about towering snowbanks and winding passages, and more an open stretch of solid ice stretching eastwards to the horizon.\n\nHere you are, the edge of the Glacial Rift. It’s been a long time in coming, but you’re finally here."

rows.original: A long, winding path through ice and snow leads back from the Rift to the snowy fields closer to Irestead, back westward. To the east is a vast, endless, and nearly featureless sheet of ice: the glacial plain of the Rift. You could easily get lost there, swallowed by by the snow-flurries and storms with nothing to guide you. Best to stick to the handful of vague footpaths worn into the ice...
rows.translation: 一条穿越冰雪的漫长蜿蜒道路从裂谷向西延伸，通往更靠近伊尔斯泰德的雪原。东边则是一片广阔、无尽而近乎毫无特征的冰盖：裂谷的冰川平原。你很容易在那里迷路，被飞雪和风暴吞没，而且没有任何东西可供辨认方向。最好沿着冰面上那几条模糊的足迹前进...

To the east is a vast, endless, and nearly featureless sheet of ice: the glacial plain of the Rift. rows.translation: 一条被踩得十分明显的小径从冰原向西通往冰川裂谷那片广阔开阔地带；这座巨型冰川标志着这片“大陆”的海岸地带。这条道路似乎交通频繁，持续踩踏甚至磨低了冰面。

rows.original: You stand at the heart of the glacier, far east of Irestead. Ice and snow stretch out as far as the eye can see -- which isn’t far, given the weather. The path you’re on curves from north to east here, bending around a snowman sculpted in the shape of a particularly rotund huskar. Someone’s stuck a rock carved into the shape of a canid dick into the snowman’s mouth, and it looks like someone’s mashed their face in between the effigy’s prodigious, plump tits.
rows.translation: 你站在冰川腹地，远在伊尔斯泰德以东。冰雪一直延伸到视线尽头；不过这种天气下，你也看不了多远。脚下道路在此由北转东，绕过一个塑成格外肥胖哈斯卡人模样的雪人。有人把一块雕成犬类肉棒形状的石头塞进雪人嘴里，看起来还有人把脸埋进了雕像那对硕大丰软的乳房之间。

rows.original:
A narrow footpath is worn into the ice here, connecting the way past the spire garden to a small mound of ice-blocks formed into a low wall, protecting the moorings of a tall, broad tent made of tanned hides and strung out between carved pillars of that black stone you keep seeing. Around it is a vast expanse of flat ice, as far as the eye can see to the north and west.

Attached to the tent’s little entranceway is a sign chiseled out of rock that your microbes translate as “Greetings! Traders welcome!”
rows.translation:
这里有一条踩在冰面上的狭窄小径，连接着经过尖柱花园的道路和一圈由冰块堆成的矮墙。矮墙保护着一顶宽大高耸的帐篷系泊处；帐篷由鞣制兽皮制成，拉在由那种随处可见的黑石雕成的柱子之间。四周是一望无际的平坦冰原，向北向西都延伸到视线尽头。

帐篷的小入口旁挂着一块石刻招牌，你的微生物将其翻译为：“你好！欢迎商人！”
rows.raw: "A narrow footpath is worn into the ice here, connecting the way past the spire garden to a small mound of ice-blocks formed into a low wall, protecting the moorings of a tall, broad tent made of tanned hides and strung out between carved pillars of that black stone you keep seeing. Around it is a vast expanse of flat ice, as far as the eye can see to the north and west.\n\nAttached to the tent’s little entranceway is a sign chiseled out of rock that your microbes translate as “Greetings! Traders welcome!”"

rows.original: In the distance to the east, you can make out a shimmering, misty coastline: a sheer dropoff from the edge of the ice into the eastern ocean. The path back to safety, of course, lies to the west. North of you is a deep chasm in the ice, invisible from a distance, which is filled with thousands of slender black spires.
rows.translation: 远处东边能看出一道闪烁朦胧的海岸线：冰层边缘笔直坠入东部海洋。当然，返回安全区域的道路在西边。北边则有一道远处看不见的冰层深渊，里面布满成千上万根细长黑色尖柱。

rows.original:
You’re moving along a narrow path carved through the ice -- or more likely, worn into it through frequent traffic. The local milodan and korgonne probably come this way pretty often, though you wonder how they all knew to follow the same route.

The way back to the ice fields is to the west, and the worn path continues through a gentle southern curve.
rows.translation:
你正沿一条凿穿冰层的狭窄道路前进；更可能是频繁通行将它踩磨出来。本地米洛丹人和科尔贡人大概经常走这里，不过你很好奇他们是怎么全都知道要走同一条路线的。

返回冰原的方向在西边，被踩出的道路则沿平缓弧线继续向南。

The local milodan and korgonne probably come this way pretty often, though you wonder how they all knew to follow the same route.\n\nThe way back to the ice fields is to the west, and the worn path continues through a gentle southern curve."

rows.original:
A chunk of ice to the north of the floes has been carved out with a laser, leaving a smooth, narrow incline. Ropes have been pitoned into the sides of the glacial ice, giving whoever needs to come and go from the plateau overhead some handholds to work with. Without them, it’d be a slippery mess trying to get up. The passage itself is narrow, walled on either side by sheer ice, barely wide enough for two people to squeeze through abreast.

On either side of the incline’s top, you can see a pair of snow-camo turrets sitting low to the ice, long barrels sweeping steadily from side to side in search of hostile targets. When you enter their line of sight, both barrels snap over to you, scanning... and then beep quietly and resume their watch.
rows.translation:
浮冰北边的一块冰层被激光切开，留下一道平滑狭窄的斜坡。绳索用岩钉固定在冰川两侧，给需要进出上方高原的人提供抓握点。没有这些绳索，想爬上去会滑得一塌糊涂。通道本身十分狭窄，两侧都是笔直冰墙，勉强能让两人并肩挤过。

斜坡顶部两侧各有一座雪地迷彩炮塔低伏在冰面上，长炮管持续左右扫动，寻找敌对目标。当你进入射界时，两根炮管同时猛然转向你，进行扫描...随后轻声鸣响，又恢复警戒。

rows.original: You’re standing in the middle of a wide, flat plateau of ice overlooking the northern-most reaches of the Rift. Several pillars of obsidian-black rock jut up from the ice and snow, forming a sort of henge around the center of plateau. A spindly Q-COMM beacon is sitting in the middle of all of them, pulsing with a red light every few seconds.
rows.translation: 你站在一片宽阔平坦的冰原高台中央，俯瞰裂谷最北端。几根黑曜石般的岩柱从冰雪中刺出，在高台中央围成某种巨石阵。它们正中放着一座细长的量子通讯信标，每隔数秒便闪动一次红光。
rows.raw: "You’re standing in the middle of a wide, flat plateau of ice overlooking the northern-most reaches of the Rift. Several pillars of obsidian-black rock jut up from the ice and snow, forming a sort of henge around the center of plateau. A spindly Q-COMM beacon is sitting in the middle of all of them, pulsing with a red light every few seconds."

rows.original: You’re standing on a cliffside, looking down over the rest of the Rift -- some twenty feet down, you’d guess. There’s a foot-worn path north from here, leading towards a sheer drop -- the eponymous Rift.

rows.original: To the immediate north of where you stand is the very coast of the glacier you’ve been exploring. A great gulf separates yours from the next, a deep cleft in the ice leading into a seemingly bottomless abyss. Southwards lies the interior of the glacier, back to safety.
rows.translation: 你所在位置正北方便是一直探索的冰川海岸。一条巨大深沟将你所在冰川与下一块冰川分隔开来；那是冰层中的深裂口，通向看似无底的深渊。南边则是冰川内部，可返回安全地带。

rows.original: You stand on the very western-most edge of the Glacial Rift, a massive cleft in the ice separating your glacier from the northern one. Looking over the edge presents a dizzying view of the bottomless abyss, the sheen of ice giving way to impenetrable darkness far before the water swallows the heart of the ice. There’s a safe path south from here, back towards the center of the ice plain.
rows.translation: 你站在冰川裂谷最西端；一道巨大的冰层裂口将你所在冰川与北方冰川分隔。俯瞰边缘时，无底深渊令人目眩；冰面的微光在远早于海水吞没冰层核心之处便没入不可穿透的黑暗。这里有一条安全道路向南延伸，返回冰原中央。

rows.original:
You stand on the very western-most edge of the Glacial Rift, a massive cleft in the ice separating your glacier from the northern one. Looking over the edge presents a dizzying view of the bottomless abyss, the sheen of ice giving way to impenetrable darkness far before the water swallows the heart of the ice. The coastlands stretch west as far as the eye can see.

East of here, on the other hand, is the vastness of the Uvetan ocean. Overhead hangs the oppressive sphere of the gas giant you’re orbiting, reflecting in a cascade of oranges and reds across the water’s surface, broken only by smaller icebergs and tiny, drifting islands of ice. The coastlands stretch on southwards for miles of smooth, seemingly safe walking.
rows.translation:
你站在冰川裂谷最西端；一道巨大的冰层裂口将你所在冰川与北方冰川分隔。俯瞰边缘时，无底深渊令人目眩；冰面的微光在远早于海水吞没冰层核心之处便没入不可穿透的黑暗。海岸地带向西延伸到视线尽头。

而东边则是辽阔的乌维托海洋。头顶悬着你所环绕的气态巨行星那令人压抑的球体，在水面反射出层层橙红色光彩，只有较小的冰山和漂流冰岛将其打断。海岸向南延伸数英里，路面平滑，看似可以安全行走。

rows.original:
To the east stretches a vast and endlessly beautiful stretch of ocean, reaching far past the horizon. Uveto Prime, the swirling gas giant in the sky, reflects in a brilliant rainbow of reds and oranges across the water’s surface, as if in perpetual twilight. The ocean is marred only by small islands of ice, drifting with the currents and tidal pulls of the immense body high above.

The coastland stretches north and south, as far as the eye can see.
rows.translation:
东边是一片广阔而美得无边无际的海洋，一直延伸到地平线之外。天空中翻腾的气态巨行星乌维托主星在水面投下灿烂的红橙彩虹，仿佛永恒黄昏。海面只有少数小型冰岛点缀，它们随洋流以及高悬上空那庞大天体引发的潮汐漂动。

海岸向南北两侧延伸，直至视线尽头。

东方是一片广阔无垠、美不胜收的海洋，一直延伸到地平线之外。天空中翻腾的气态巨行星乌维托主星倒映在水面上，化作绚烂的红橙彩虹，仿佛永恒的暮色。海面上只有一座座小冰岛破坏了这份完美，它们随着洋流和高空那颗庞大天体引发的潮汐漂荡。

海岸线向南北延伸，一眼望不到尽头。
rows.raw: "To the east stretches a vast and endlessly beautiful stretch of ocean, reaching far past the horizon. Uveto Prime, the swirling gas giant in the sky, reflects in a brilliant rainbow of reds and oranges across the water’s surface, as if in perpetual twilight. The ocean is marred only by small islands of ice, drifting with the currents and tidal pulls of the immense body high above.\n\nThe coastland stretches north and south, as far as the eye can see."

rows.original:
The entrance to Korg’ii Hold is quite brisk thanks to the endless holes that the dog-folk drilled into the door. Warmer breezes waft in from the west, humid and comfortable. The door out lies just to the east, presently closed.

Two guards stand alongside the entranceway, manning the lever and handles necessary to open it wide.
rows.translation:
科尔吉要塞入口处颇为凉爽，因为犬族人在门上钻了无数孔洞。温暖、湿润而舒适的微风从西边飘来。出口就在正东，目前关着。

两名守卫站在入口两旁，负责操作将大门完全开启所需的拉杆和把手。

rows.original: Korg’ii Hold’s main thoroughfares look to have been carved from the rock by hand. You can only imagine how long it took, tunneling through the hard stone, all to find a stable shelter from Uveto’s biting cold. Their labors paid off, as warm drafts of humid air waft by continually. You could walk around naked inside here without feeling an ounce of chill. In fact, most of the korgonne do.
rows.translation: 科尔吉要塞的主要通道看起来全是手工从岩石中开凿出来的。你只能想象，为了在乌维托的刺骨严寒中找到稳定的庇护所，他们花了多久才凿穿坚硬岩层。劳作得到了回报，温暖潮湿的气流不断吹过。在这里裸体行走也不会感到一丝寒意。事实上，大多数科尔贡人正是如此。

Korgs of all shapes and sizes push past you toward the obvious scent of cooking. A simple dwelling lies east, closed tight.

rows.original: Scanning your locale, you spot a granite door to the east. By the look of it, it guards a single domicile. The tunnel leads on to the north and south through the resource-rich pillar. Just looking at the walls, you can tell that Korg’ii Hold is worth a fortune. The material they excavated to dig this tunnel could purchase a decent-sized starship, maybe more, depending on how pure the veins of Savicite run.
rows.translation: 环顾四周，你发现东边有一扇花岗岩门。看起来它守着一户独立住所。隧道穿过资源丰富的石柱，向南北延伸。只看墙壁就知道科尔吉要塞价值连城。开凿这条隧道挖出的材料足以购买一艘大小不错的星舰；若萨维石矿脉纯度够高，甚至不止如此。

rows.original: Wrapping around the circumference of Korg’ii Hold, this passage forms a sort of primitive beltway for the subterranean settlement. Carved by hand generations ago, hundreds of years of foot traffic have polished the stone floor to a mirror shine. A gap in the wall to the south exposes a curling staircase that provides access to the floors above and below. Toss in a couple of elevators, and this place would be as nice as a classy hotel.
rows.translation: 这条通道环绕科尔吉要塞外缘，形成地下定居点某种原始的环路。它由数代以前的人手工开凿，数百年的脚步将石质地面磨得亮如镜面。南墙的缺口露出一道盘旋楼梯，可通往上下楼层。要是再装几部电梯，这里就能媲美高级酒店。

rows.original: Tails wagging, the citizens of Korg’ii Hold politely squeeze past you on their various errands. Jangly bracelets, necklaces, and piercings click and clack to the beat of their flouncing gaits, almost drowning out the hushed whispers that follow your path. An inscription alongside the northern door depicts a type of mortar and pestle.
rows.translation: 科尔吉要塞的居民摇着尾巴，礼貌地从你身旁挤过，各自忙着办事。叮当作响的手镯、项链和穿刺饰品随着他们蹦跳的步伐喀哒作响，几乎盖过一路跟随你的低声私语。北门旁的铭文描绘着某种研钵和研杵。
rows.raw: "Tails wagging, the citizens of Korg’ii Hold politely squeeze past you on their various errands. Jangly bracelets, necklaces, and piercings click and clack to the beat of their flouncing gaits, almost drowning out the hushed whispers that follow your path. An inscription alongside the northern door depicts a type of mortar and pestle."

rows.original: The ceiling of this stairwell is almost claustrophobically low compared to the coreward facilities you’re used to, designed for tiny korgonne instead of varied galactic citizens. Someone carved railings into the walls, rather than bolting on something that might protrude out, the tool-toughened texture long ago worn into smooth comfort. Korgonne smile at you as they walk by. It would seem your presence is welcome.
rows.translation: 与习惯的核心世界设施相比，这座楼梯间的天花板低得几乎令人幽闭恐惧，因为它是为娇小的科尔贡人而非体形各异的银河公民设计的。有人把扶手直接凿进墙里，而不是装上可能凸出的构件；曾经粗糙坚硬的工具痕迹早已被磨得光滑舒适。路过的科尔贡人对你微笑。看来你的到来很受欢迎。

rows.original: Just as you’ve seen elsewhere within Korg’ii Hold, these stairs were carved with great attention to detail. Artfully patterned metal inlays glitter beneath the light of ceiling-suspended crystals. Comfortable handgrips provide something for the young, drunk, or weak to hold on to. Landings spaced every dozen or so steps provide you a place to rest. An opening to the north vents back to the main floor of the hold.
rows.translation: 正如你在科尔吉要塞其他地方所见，这些楼梯同样对细节极其讲究。富有艺术感的金属镶嵌纹样在天花板悬挂的水晶光芒下闪烁。舒适的扶手可供年幼者、醉汉或体弱者抓握。每隔十来级台阶便有一处平台可供休息。北边的开口通回要塞主层。

rows.original:
The corridors of Korg’ii Hold’s second level are narrower than the first, less suitable for large amounts of foot traffic and more easily defended. Slots in the walls provide places for sentries to lay in ambush while grooves in the floor offer traction and an easy drain for spilled blood. The tunnel continues in similar fashion north.

A staircase to the south offers passage back to the first floor.
rows.translation:
科尔吉要塞二层的走廊比一层狭窄，不适合大量人流，却更容易防守。墙壁上的凹槽让哨兵能够伏击，地板上的沟纹则提供抓地力，也方便排走泼洒的鲜血。隧道以同样的形态继续向北。

南边的楼梯可返回一层。

Slots in the walls provide places for sentries to lay in ambush while grooves in the floor offer traction and an easy drain for spilled blood. The tunnel continues in similar fashion north.\n\nA staircase to the south offers passage back to the first floor."

rows.original: Squeezing past korgonne, shoulder to shoulder, you silently curse whoever dug this particular passage. It’s simply too narrow to comfortably traverse. The floor is grooved for traction, even when wet, and arrow slits in the walls make you uncomfortably aware that these seemingly simple dog-people could likely end your life in a hurry. Feeling a little outside chill in spite of the Korg’ii Hold’s inner warmth, you feel like you should be on your way.
rows.translation: 你与科尔贡人肩并肩挤着通过，心里默默咒骂开凿这条通道的人。这里实在太窄，无法舒适通行。地面刻有沟纹，即使湿润也能提供抓地力；墙上的箭孔让你不安地意识到，这些看似朴素的犬族人很可能迅速取你性命。尽管科尔吉要塞内部温暖，你仍感到一丝外界寒意，觉得自己最好赶紧离开。

rows.original:
This narrow east-west passage bears more ornamentation than you’re used to. Artfully carved bone sconces cradle faintly glowing crystals. Carpets woven from the coarse fibers of Uvetan beasts line the floor, and hunting trophies of all descriptions proudly present themselves as proof of korgonne determination. One particularly impressive specimen appears to have originated from some kind of great lizard. Luminous crystals sit in the empty eye sockets, staring balefully out at you.

A door of solid silver blocks passage to the south. A bit to the west, there’s another door. This one faces north.
rows.translation:
这条狭窄的东西向通道比你习惯的地方装饰更多。精雕细琢的骨制壁灯托着微微发光的水晶。由乌维托野兽粗纤维编织的地毯铺满地面，各式猎物纪念品骄傲地展示科尔贡人的坚毅。其中一个格外惊人的标本似乎来自某种巨蜥，发光水晶嵌在空洞眼窝里，恶狠狠地瞪着你。

一扇纯银门封住南边通道。稍偏西还有另一扇门，朝向北方。

rows.original: Solid stone blocks the way north, hung on hinges so thick they make the korgonne seem thin by comparison. The blocky door is all is swarming with pictographs of every kind of korgonne: fishermen, craftsmen, warriors, hunters, and even some kind of primitive alchemist, to name a few. On the opposite side is a weapon rack stuffed full of pilfered technological weapons, prizes taken from the unwary. The narrow passage itself stretches away to the east and west.

rows.original: Curling, purple impurities in Korg’ii Hold’s stonework race along the stairs here, on the hold’s second level. Unfortunately, a burly body blocks further travel higher. You can step down the impeccably carved staircase or head out to the south into a well-defended passage. The vague scent of food wafts up from below.
rows.translation: 科尔吉要塞石材中盘旋的紫色杂质沿二层楼梯奔流。可惜一个壮硕身躯挡住了继续向上的道路。你可以沿雕刻得无可挑剔的楼梯向下，或向南进入一条防守严密的通道。下方飘来隐约食物香气。

rows.original: Savicite deposits in the walls bathe the staircase in sickly green light, though the natives of Korg’ii Hold seem unbothered by its presence. One female korgonne stops to examine it, running her furry paws up and down the luminescent mineral in wonder. Other citizens pay more attention to the floor - and your own exotic presence. For instance, a guard above refuses to allow you higher into the hold, steadfastly blocking you with his spear. You’ll have to leave the staircase or climb back down from here.
rows.translation: 墙壁中的萨维石矿藏让楼梯沐浴在病态绿光中，但科尔吉要塞居民似乎毫不在意。一名科尔贡女性停下来观察，用毛茸茸的爪子惊奇地上下抚摸发光矿物。其他居民更关注地面——以及你这个异乡人的存在。例如，上方一名守卫拒绝让你进入要塞更高处，坚定地用长矛挡住去路。你只能离开楼梯或从这里爬回下方。

rows.original: Defensive recesses line to passage to either side, providing convenient places for Korg’ii warriors to hold in the event of an invasion. The tunnel itself is quite narrow, especially with the presence of stout-bodied natives. Squeezing past a pair of them requires the absence of any personal space whatsoever. A few paces north will place you in a stairwell.

rows.original: A narrow tunnel splits off from the broader north-south passage to connect the east and west sides of Korg’ii Hold. You can see two doors that way, one silver and one stone. Further north and south there are naught but staircases, each offering passage to the ground floor. Weapon-toting warriors are a common sight. You’d best be on your best behavior.

rows.original:
The architecture in this part of the hold is similar to that of old Terran castles. Scattered nooks line the walls to provide cover. Grooves in the floor provide better traction. Even soaked in the results of a bloody battle, you’d have no problem finding your footing. Darkened slits in some of the walls suggest the presence of hidden passages from which to lay an ambush.

A staircase to the south offers passage to the other floors of Korg’ii Hold. In the distance to the north, you spy another.
rows.translation:
要塞这部分的建筑风格类似古代地球城堡。墙边散布着可供掩护的壁龛，地板沟槽则提供更好抓地力。即使浸满血战后的污物，你也能站稳脚跟。部分墙壁上的黑暗狭缝暗示着隐藏通道，可以从中发动伏击。

南边楼梯通往科尔吉要塞其他楼层，远处北边还能看到另一座。

In the distance to the north, you spy another."

rows.original: Climbing the seemingly endless stairs seems the only way to move up or down in Korg’ii Hold. The dog-folk either don’t have the know-how to make an elevator or don’t care. You’re almost grateful that they won’t let you climb any higher. The fluffy folk seem intent on keeping you to the lower levels for now. You can climb down to the ground floor or step out into a narrow passage to the north.
rows.translation: 在科尔吉要塞里，要上下移动似乎只能攀登仿佛无穷无尽的楼梯。犬族人不是不会制造电梯，就是根本不在乎。你几乎庆幸他们不让你爬得更高；这些毛茸茸的居民目前似乎坚持把你限制在较低楼层。你可以下到一层，或向北进入狭窄通道。

rows.original:
Weapons and armor of every shape, size, and origin are collected together here, meticulously arranged should the tribe have need of them. KihaCorp laser rifles occupy a shelf next some ancient-looking Reaper powder-bangers. A few inches away, korgonne-crafted crossbows hang alongside wickedly barbed savicite bolts. There’s too much to list. You could outfit a small army in the finest gear Uveto’s dog-folk have to offer and still have enough stolen kit leftover to outfit the next generation of hunters.

Two guards flank either side of you to make sure your fingers stay off the merchandise. A narrow passage to the south returns to the Chieftain’s throne room.
rows.translation:
各种形状、尺寸和来源的武器与护甲都收集在这里，仔细排列，以备部族需要。KihaCorp 激光步枪占据一层架子，旁边放着几把看似古老的收割者火药枪。几英寸外，科尔贡制造的弩与带有凶狠倒钩的萨维石弩箭并排悬挂。东西太多，无法尽数列举。你可以用乌维托犬族能提供的最好装备武装一支小军队，剩余的赃物依然足以装备下一代猎人。

两名守卫分立你两侧，确保你的手指不会碰商品。南边狭窄通道可返回酋长的王座厅。

rows.original: A hunter gives you a wary look on his way up the stairs, carrying a pack stuffed with provisions. He’s dressed for the cold, doubtless on his way out of the hold. There’s no way he would be wearing such thick garments down here otherwise; the air is too hot and humid. You wipe your brow and look to the staircase. It stretches further up and down into the hold. The tunnel north opens up prodigiously, though it bends away to prevent you from seeing too much.
rows.translation: 一名猎人背着塞满补给的背包，沿楼梯向上时警惕地看了你一眼。他穿着御寒服，毫无疑问正准备离开要塞；否则绝不会在这里穿如此厚重的衣服，因为空气太过炎热潮湿。你擦擦额头，望向楼梯。它继续向要塞上下延伸。北边隧道豁然开阔，但随即转弯，遮住了大部分景象。

rows.original: No wonder the korgonne are so comfortable strutting around their hold in the nude. It’s quite toasty down here beneath the surface of Uveto. You stand at the west side of a long east-west tunnel. A stairwell to the south provides access to the upper levels. There’s an archway a little ways to the east, leading into a large chamber.
rows.translation: 难怪科尔贡人能舒服地裸体在要塞里昂首阔步。乌维托地表下相当暖和。你站在一条东西向长隧道的西端。南边楼梯间可通往上层。东边不远处有一道拱门，通向一座大房间。

rows.original: This wide-open tunnel is so much bigger than most of Korg’ii Hold’s passageways. You can see the reason why: through an archway to the north lies what must be the hold’s primary storeroom. Plenty of boxes and hide-wrapped bundles can be seen, though you’ll need to walk in for a closer look at any of it. The tunnel in which you stand stretches east and west toward two of Korg’ii Hold’s many stone-carved staircases.
rows.translation: 这条开阔隧道远比科尔吉要塞大多数通道宽大。原因一目了然：北边拱门后显然是要塞主要储藏室。能看见大量箱子和兽皮包裹，不过想仔细查看就得走进去。你所在的隧道向东西延伸，通往科尔吉要塞众多石雕楼梯中的两座。

rows.original: Down in the belly of Korg’ii Hold, the air is warmer, and the korgonne even more likely to be naked than elsewhere in the hold. Sure, the odd hunter strides by, carrying a bundle to or from a nearby storeroom, but the everyday citizens you spot on your journey are unanimously nude, save for jewelry. This particular passage stretches east-west through the hold toward a pair of staircases. Midway to the west, there’s an archway on the north wall, leading to a stockroom of some kind.
rows.translation: 在科尔吉要塞腹地，空气更加温暖，科尔贡人也比要塞其他地方更常裸体。当然，偶尔会有猎人扛着包裹往返附近储藏室，但旅途中看见的普通居民除了饰品，无一例外都赤身裸体。这条通道东西贯穿要塞，通往一对楼梯。西边中段的北墙上有一道拱门，通向某种库房。

rows.original: Intricately worked metal inlays follow these stairs as they go deeper and higher into the hold. The artwork seems reflective of the destinations, with the pathway up flanked by depictions of various korgonne at rest in cuddly abodes. Meanwhile, the way down is filled with patterns of embedded gemstones and aquamarine gaps indicative of fishing holes. An opening to the north of this landing provides access to a rather large tunnel.
rows.translation: 精巧的金属镶嵌图案沿楼梯深入和升高。图案似乎呼应各自目的地：向上的道路两侧描绘着在温馨住所休息的科尔贡人；向下的道路则布满嵌入宝石的纹样和代表捕鱼洞的海蓝色空隙。平台北边的开口通向一条相当宽阔的隧道。

rows.original:
To call Korg’ii Hold’s storeroom massive would be an understatement. The vaulted ceiling stretches up at least twenty or thirty feet. High enough for even the largest of core races to comfortably stand and then some. Boxes and fur-wrapped bundles are stacked in neat piles every few paces, ostensibly organized by the incomprehensible carvings on the floor that surround them. You estimate a stockpile like this could provide sustenance for the tribe for at least a year, assuming a decent portion of the stockpile is preserved food.

A faint red glow emanates from the west, and gusts of hot air billow out from that direction, heating the room well enough to make Irestead seem positively chilly.
rows.translation:
说科尔吉要塞的储藏室巨大都显得轻描淡写。拱顶至少高二三十英尺，即使核心种族中最高大的成员也能舒适站立，甚至还有余裕。箱子和毛皮包裹每隔几步便整齐堆放，似乎按周围地面上难以理解的刻纹分类。你估计，假如其中相当一部分是保存食物，这批储备至少足以供养部族一年。

西边散发出微弱红光，灼热气流从那里滚滚涌出，把房间烘得足以让艾尔斯泰德显得格外寒冷。

rows.original:
Spears and other primitive weapons are piled into metal racks in this part of the storeroom. Most fighting styles are represented by this armory - from swords to hammers to the oddly shaped bow. There’s even one pile of assorted stolen technology, though a cold-eyed guard watches over it impassively. His lip curls threateningly when you get too close. You suppose the scarceness of more refined technology makes the korgonne a little more cautious about who gets access to it.

A comically small doorway stands on the west wall, hanging halfway open. Alien runes above it designate the place as something called “Earthshapers,” likely the village blacksmith.
rows.translation:
长矛和其他原始武器堆在储藏室这一区域的金属架里。这座军械库涵盖了大多数战斗风格——从剑、锤到形状奇特的弓。甚至还有一堆各种偷来的科技，不过一名目光冷峻的守卫面无表情地看守着。你靠得太近时，他威胁地卷起嘴唇。精制科技较为稀少，想必让科尔贡人更谨慎地决定谁能接触。

西墙上有一道小得可笑的门，半开着。上方异星符文将这里标为所谓的“塑地者”，很可能就是村里的铁匠铺。
