rows.original:
Spending time inside this storeroom is a nice break from the otherwise claustrophobic interior of the rest of the hold. The ceiling is at least twenty or thirty feet high. For a moment, you wonder how the diminutive korgonne managed to hollow out this chamber. The mental image of a tower of craftsmen stacked upon each other’s shoulders, stumbling around while trying to chisel out the ceiling nearly sends you into a fit of giggles.

A wide archway to the north provides access to a roomy access tunnel. The storeroom itself continues on for quite a ways to the south and the west. With all the piled up boxes, Korg’ii Hold could supply itself for some time in the event of a siege or famine.

A small doorway stands on the east wall. Alien runes above it designate the place as something called “Kiona’s Kiosk”.
rows.translation:
待在这座储藏室里，可以暂时摆脱要塞其他地方令人幽闭恐惧的内部环境。天花板至少高二三十英尺。你一时好奇，娇小的科尔贡人究竟如何挖空这座大厅。想象一座工匠人塔彼此踩着肩膀，在试图凿天花板时摇摇晃晃地走动，你差点笑出声。

北边宽阔拱门通向宽敞的连接隧道。储藏室本身则向南、向西延伸很远。有了这些堆积的箱子，科尔吉要塞即使遭遇围困或饥荒也能自给一段时间。

东墙上有一道小门。上方异星符文将这里标为所谓的“琪奥娜的小亭”。

rows.original: A whiff of salt and fish wafts by your nostrils as you stride through this part of the storeroom, and looking closely at the nearby bundles, you realize why. Dried, salted meat is stockpiled in abundance, flanked by small piles of herbs. A smaller pile of what you assume to be land-based meat rests nearby, wrapped in sheer cloth. Turning around, you realize that similar arrangements of stored food are all over. Korg’ii Hold could feed its citizens for months, if not years. The storeroom continues north and west.
rows.translation: 走过储藏室这一区域时，一股盐和鱼的气味掠过鼻端；仔细查看附近包裹后，你明白了原因。这里大量储存着风干盐渍肉，旁边是几小堆香草。附近还有一小堆你猜是陆生动物的肉，用薄布包裹。转身一看，你发现类似的食物储备随处可见。科尔吉要塞足以供养居民数月乃至数年。储藏室继续向北和向西延伸。

rows.original: This perfectly carved stairwell is zebra-striped with purplish striations, both in the wall and the steps themselves. The air down here is warm, and it feels like it would get even warmer further down. You can exit south into a wide tunnel or travel up back to the main floor of Korg’ii Hold.
rows.translation: 这座雕刻完美的楼梯间无论墙壁还是台阶本身，都被紫色纹理染成斑马条纹。下面空气很暖，越往深处似乎越热。你可以向南进入宽阔隧道，也可向上返回科尔吉要塞主层。

rows.original: This tunnel is taller and wider than those higher up in the hold, easily eight or nine feet high and just as wide across. It would seem the tribe took care to carve out a broad thoroughfare, which makes sense considering you can see a storeroom entrance a little ways to the west. An archway in the wall to north provides access to a colorful staircase, if you’d like to journey elsewhere into the hold.
rows.translation: 这条隧道比要塞上层通道更高更宽，轻易达到八九英尺高，宽度也相仿。看来部族特意凿出宽阔干道，考虑到西边不远处就是储藏室入口，这很合理。北墙上的拱门通向一道色彩斑斓的楼梯，如果想去要塞其他地方，可以从那里走。

rows.original: The walls here are pitted in places, the holes filled with glass to transform flaws into reflective art. You can spy where korgonne miners made the decision to chisel valuable minerals out of the wall, and the subsequent attempts to improve the look with skillful craftsmanship. This large tunnel leads east and west toward stairwells at each end. An entrance to a storeroom lies a little ways east.
rows.translation: 这里的墙壁有些地方凹凸不平，孔洞中填着玻璃，将缺陷化作反光艺术。你能看出科尔贡矿工曾决定从墙里凿走贵重矿物，之后又以精湛工艺努力改善外观。这条大隧道向东西延伸，通往两端楼梯间。储藏室入口位于东边不远处。

rows.original: Warm air lazily blows through this large tunnel on its way to the stairwell to the north. Korg’ii Hold’s natural geothermal heat must make living here quite comfortable for the many, many nude korgonne that prowl its halls. You’re glad for the extra room the size of this tunnel affords as you do your best to maintain your personal space in the well-used tunnel. It would seem the only path leads east, unless you want to head north, back into the staircase.
rows.translation: 暖风懒洋洋地穿过这条大隧道，吹向北边楼梯间。科尔吉要塞的天然地热一定让生活在走廊里的许许多多裸体科尔贡人十分舒适。你竭力在繁忙隧道里维持私人空间，因此很庆幸它足够宽敞。除了向北返回楼梯外，唯一道路似乎通往东方。
rows.raw: "Warm air lazily blows through this large tunnel on its way to the stairwell to the north. Korg’ii Hold’s natural geothermal heat must make living here quite comfortable for the many, many nude korgonne that prowl its halls. You’re glad for the extra room the size of this tunnel affords as you do your best to maintain your personal space in the well-used tunnel. It would seem the only path leads east, unless you want to head north, back into the staircase."

rows.original: Raw Savicite speckles the stairs and walls, bathing the entire area in a lovely green glow. A male sits against a particularly concentrated spot, apparently taking a break and looking down in disbelief at the erection jutting out of his sheath. He clearly doesn’t quite comprehend the effects of Savicite radiation. You’d best move on if you don’t want similarly affected. The stairs themselves are a little on the narrow side - perfect for small korgonne feet. You can climb up, back to the hold’s ground floor, or journey deeper, into the depths.
rows.translation: 萨维石原矿点缀台阶与墙壁，让整个区域沐浴在可爱的绿光中。一名男性靠坐在矿物特别集中的地方，似乎正在休息，难以置信地低头看着从鞘中挺出的勃起肉棒。他显然不太明白萨维石辐射的作用。若不想受到类似影响，最好继续前进。楼梯本身略显狭窄——恰好适合科尔贡人的小脚。你可以向上返回要塞一层，或继续深入地下。

rows.original:
The floor of this crudely hewn tunnel is perhaps the only area to receive attention from Korg’ii Hold’s builders; it’s flat and smooth, with nary a divot to stumble on. The walls aren’t so lucky, and if the surrounding minerals weren’t so strong, the lack of braces on the ceiling might worry you. You can follow the tunnel east and west from here.

A huge door made of leather stretched over iron bars blocks the way north. The runes neatly scrawled onto its surface indicate the entrance to “Tamed Tamelings.”
rows.translation:
这条粗凿隧道的地面或许是科尔吉要塞建造者唯一用心处理的地方；它平坦光滑，几乎没有会让人绊倒的凹坑。墙壁就没这么幸运；若非周围矿物足够坚固，天花板没有支撑架会令人担忧。你可以从这里沿隧道向东或向西。

一扇由皮革绷在铁条上制成的巨门封住北边道路。表面整齐书写的符文表明这里是“驯服的塔姆灵”入口。

The walls aren’t so lucky, and if the surrounding minerals weren’t so strong, the lack of braces on the ceiling might worry you. You can follow the tunnel east and west from here.\n\nA huge door made of leather stretched over iron bars blocks the way north. The runes neatly scrawled onto its surface indicate the entrance to “Tamed Tamelings.”"

rows.original: Furnace-like heat blasts into you the moment you step into the room. Shielding your face, you observe that the chamber itself is naturally formed, not a product of korgonne tunneling. The more pressing concern is the bubbling pool of lava in the very center. A scan with your Codex reports the lava to be a mineral rich heat-vent from Uveto’s small but highly-active core, many miles below its liquid oceans.
rows.translation: 你一踏进房间，熔炉般的热浪便迎面轰来。你遮住脸，观察到这座大厅是天然形成，而非科尔贡人挖掘的产物。更紧迫的问题是正中央翻滚冒泡的熔岩池。CODEX终端扫描显示，这些熔岩来自乌维托小而极其活跃的地核，是富含矿物质的热喷口，位于液态海洋下方许多英里处。

rows.original: The bottom half of this staircase is a perfect example of rough tunneling, while the upper half is refined, decorated with artful inlays and inscriptions that depict the presence of many dwellings up above. The barrier between the two is obviously the result of simple pragmatism. In places where the korgonne spend most of their time, they’ve taken the time to create masterwork from their native stone. In less important locales, tunneling fast is more important. A rough-hewn tunnel leads away to the north.
rows.translation: 这道楼梯下半段是粗糙挖掘的完美范例，上半段却十分精致，装饰着富有艺术感的镶嵌与铭文，描绘上方众多住所。两者之间的界线显然源于朴素的实用主义：科尔贡人经常活动的地方，他们会花时间将本地石材制成杰作；较不重要之处，快速开凿更为重要。北边延伸出一条粗凿隧道。

rows.original: Bits of shiny but useless quartz sparkle in the walls and ceiling, left behind by miners intent on more valued prizes. The tunnel itself is carved straight along an east-west axis without much care for polish. They took the time to smooth the floor for comfort and safety but little else.
rows.translation: 闪亮却毫无用处的石英碎片在墙壁和天花板上闪烁，被一心寻找更贵重目标的矿工留了下来。隧道本身沿东西轴笔直开凿，几乎不讲究打磨。他们只花时间磨平地面，以求舒适安全，除此之外便没有了。

A few that seem to be nothing more than simple livestock, fuzzy things that shift around when you approach. A thin curving passage to the west leads back to the animal tamer’s place of business.

The curving tunnel to the south provides an exit, should you need to escape from a rampaging animal.

rows.original: Bolted-together metal bars brace this tunnel’s ceiling. You don’t see any particular reason why, but a Codex scan reveals the rock overhead to be comprised of a weaker mineral formulation. Evidently the keen-eyed dog-folk noticed something you didn’t - without the aid of a computer. A sturdy door, reinforced by gleaming titanium, offers entrance to the south. rows.original: You stand at the landing for a narrow staircase. Speckled Savicite in the walls provides dim but eerie green light to guide travelers on their way. Apparently the korgonne would rather admire its beauty than dig it out of the walls for its numerous industrial uses. Going any further down seems pointless, but if you’d like to climb higher into the hold, this is the place. A cramped doorway on the south wall offers access to a glassy passageway.
rows.translation: 你站在一座狭窄楼梯的平台上。墙中斑驳的萨维石散发昏暗而诡异的绿光，为旅人照亮道路。科尔贡人显然宁愿欣赏它的美，也不愿为了众多工业用途将其从墙里挖走。继续向下似乎毫无意义，但如果想爬往要塞更高处，这里就是入口。南墙上一道狭窄门洞通向玻璃质通道。

One pulls out a chalky rock, about to make his mark, when a scowling guard shoos them both off. You can duck into a stairwell’s landing through an opening on the north or follow this reflective passage to its conclusion, westward.
rows.translation: 两只科尔贡幼崽在墨黑的火山岩地面上跑过，把鼻子贴在玻璃般的墙上欣赏倒影。其中一只掏出一块粉笔状石头，正要留下印记，一名怒视的守卫便把它们都赶走了。你可以从北边开口钻进楼梯平台，或沿这条反光通道向西走到尽头。
rows.raw: "A pair of korgonne pups scamper by on the inky, volcanic floor, pressing their noses to the glass-like wall to admire their reflections. One pulls out a chalky rock, about to make his mark, when a scowling guard shoos them both off. You can duck into a stairwell’s landing through an opening on the north or follow this reflective passage to its conclusion, westward."

For a half-second, you consider skating around in a pair of socks.

rows.original: B

The floor of the small cave curves downward and to the left slightly before opening into a much wider, though still minuscule, living space. The light of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair doesn’t reach very well into the room, making it a bit darker than the lair proper. The icy walls are jagged and unrefined, gnashed apart almost aimlessly by tough nails and claws, although it still appears to be a work-in-progress: while it’s tall enough for your ten-foot-tall daughter to stand upright, there isn’t much in the way of wiggle room, and it’s only about ten feet deep.
rows.translation: 小洞穴的地面略微向下、向左弯曲，随后通入一个宽敞得多、但依然极小的生活空间。[frostwyrm.name]巢穴里的光线很难照进这个房间，因此这里比主巢穴稍暗。冰墙锯齿嶙峋、未经修整，仿佛被坚硬指甲和爪子漫无目的地撕咬开来，不过显然仍是未完工状态：这里足够让你十英尺高的女儿直立，却没有多少活动余地，深度也只有约十英尺。
rows.raw: "The floor of the small cave curves downward and to the left slightly before opening into a much wider, though still minuscule, living space. The light of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair doesn’t reach very well into the room, making it a bit darker than the lair proper. The icy walls are jagged and unrefined, gnashed apart almost aimlessly by tough nails and claws, although it still appears to be a work-in-progress: while it’s tall enough for your ten-foot-tall daughter to stand upright, there isn’t much in the way of wiggle room, and it’s only about ten feet deep."

rows.original: Standing at the far end of the little cave is, unmistakably, your first and oldest kip, diligently clawing at the ice with her razor-sharp Frostwyrm talons. The ice is hard and unyielding, but with every three or four grating swipes against it, her claws manage to catch, and with a flex of her powerful biceps, she rips the ice straight from the walls in huge swaths. Then she starts again.
rows.translation: 毫无疑问，站在小洞穴最深处的是你第一个、也是最年长的幼崽。她正用剃刀般锋利的霜龙利爪勤奋抓挠冰层。冰层坚硬顽固，但每刮擦三四下，她的爪子便能咬住；接着强壮的肱二头肌一绷，她便从墙上整片撕下大块冰层。然后重新开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nStanding at the far end of the little cave is, unmistakably, your first and oldest kip, diligently clawing at the ice with her razor-sharp Frostwyrm talons. The ice is hard and unyielding, but with every three or four grating swipes against it, her claws manage to catch, and with a flex of her powerful biceps, she rips the ice straight from the walls in huge swaths. Then she starts again."

rows.original: The cave is littered and messy with shavings of ice coating the floor; you watch your step as you come inside,
rows.translation: 洞穴凌乱不堪，地面铺满冰屑；你走进来时小心留意脚下，
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cave is littered and messy with shavings of ice coating the floor; you watch your step as you come inside, "

rows.original: and you loudly knock on the nearest wall, respecting her privacy, but nonetheless asserting your authority as her parent by entering without her permission.
rows.translation: 然后大声敲了敲最近的墙壁，既尊重她的隐私，又以父母身份不经允许便走进来，彰显自己的权威。
rows.raw: "and you loudly knock on the nearest wall, respecting her privacy, but nonetheless asserting your authority as her parent by entering without her permission."

rows.original: and you clear your throat to get her attention.
rows.translation: 然后清清嗓子，引起她的注意。
rows.raw: "and you clear your throat to get her attention."

rows.original: It startles her, and she yips on the spot as she whips around. Her strong, blunt tail swishes just a few feet from you, then crashes into the right-hand wall, knocking off another loose chunk of ice.
rows.translation: 她吓了一跳，猛地转过身，当场发出一声惊叫。强壮而钝粗的尾巴在离你几英尺处一扫，随后撞上右侧墙壁，又震落一块松动的冰。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt startles her, and she yips on the spot as she whips around. Her strong, blunt tail swishes just a few feet from you, then crashes into the right-hand wall, knocking off another loose chunk of ice."

rows.original: “My Qal!” she says, surprised at your presence. “I’m sorry, I didn’t realize you were with me.”
rows.translation: “我的Qal！”她惊讶地说道。“抱歉，我没意识到你和我在一起。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My Qal!” she says, surprised at your presence. “I’m sorry, I didn’t realize you were with me.”"

rows.original: You forgive her, and ask her what she’s doing.
rows.translation: 你原谅了她，并问她在做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou forgive her, and ask her what she’s doing."

rows.original: “Well,” she says, looking at the walls of her makeshift nest. “It’s not done yet, but, I’m in the middle of making myself a nest, like my Qim’s.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，”她望着临时巢穴的墙壁说道。“还没完工，不过我正在给自己建一个巢，像Qim的巢一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well,” she says, looking at the walls of her makeshift nest. “It’s not done yet, but, I’m in the middle of making myself a nest, like my Qim’s.”"

rows.original: You admire her handiwork, running your hand along the nearest wall. It’s rough and uneven all over, as though she had constantly started at one part of the cave and then changed her aim to focus on another part. But, that aside, you admire her diligence and initiative: there aren’t a lot of kips out there that can say that they fashioned their own nest straight out of the ice.
rows.translation: 你欣赏着她的手艺，伸手抚过最近的墙壁。到处都粗糙不平，仿佛她总是从洞穴某一处开始，随后又改变目标，转去处理另一处。除此之外，你很欣赏她的勤勉与主动：没多少幼崽能说自己直接从冰层里凿出了巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou admire her handiwork, running your hand along the nearest wall. It’s rough and uneven all over, as though she had constantly started at one part of the cave and then changed her aim to focus on another part. But, that aside, you admire her diligence and initiative: there aren’t a lot of kips out there that can say that they fashioned their own nest straight out of the ice."

rows.original: “Thank you”, your daughter says lowly. Through your psionic link with her, you feel a tinge of pride: it’s clear to you that your opinion means a lot to her.
rows.translation: “谢谢你”，女儿低声说道。通过与她的灵能连接，你感到一丝自豪：显然，你的看法对她十分重要。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you”, your daughter says lowly. Through your psionic link with her, you feel a tinge of pride: it’s clear to you that your opinion means a lot to her."

rows.original: You ask her what gave her the idea to make her own nest so soon. At the question, your daughter glances out of the cave, towards [frostwyrm.name]’s proper lair, and when she sees that [frostwyrm.name] is not listening in, she approaches you and lowers her voice to a whisper. “Our Qim would never express it like this, but... she wants to repopulate our species with you, my Qal.”
rows.translation: 你问她为什么这么早就想到要建自己的巢。听到问题，女儿向洞外望去，看向[frostwyrm.name]真正的巢穴；确认[frostwyrm.name]没有偷听后，她靠近你，压低声音耳语。“我们的Qim绝不会这样表达，但... 她想和你一起繁衍我们的种族，我的Qal。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her what gave her the idea to make her own nest so soon. At the question, your daughter glances out of the cave, towards [frostwyrm.name]’s proper lair, and when she sees that [frostwyrm.name] is not listening in, she approaches you and lowers her voice to a whisper. “Our Qim would never express it like this, but... she wants to repopulate our species with you, my Qal.”"

rows.original: You reply that it’s going to be an arduous undertaking, for sure, but [frostwyrm.name] has chosen you as her mate, and you’ll do whatever you need to satisfy your mate.
rows.translation: 你回答说，这肯定是一项艰巨的事业，但[frostwyrm.name]已经选择你作为伴侣，而你会做任何需要做的事来满足伴侣。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that it’s going to be an arduous undertaking, for sure, but [frostwyrm.name] has chosen you as her mate, and you’ll do whatever you need to satisfy your mate."

rows.original: You aren’t sure if this is an appropriate topic to be discussing with your daughter, but... hell, when [frostwyrm.name] asked you to mate with her, you knew what you were getting into.
rows.translation: 你不确定这是否适合与女儿讨论，不过... 见鬼，当[frostwyrm.name]请你与她交配时，你早就知道自己会面对什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou aren’t sure if this is an appropriate topic to be discussing with your daughter, but... hell, when [frostwyrm.name] asked you to mate with her, you knew what you were getting into."

rows.original: And, you think to yourself (careful to not broadcast it over your psionic links), a lifetime of abstinence has made your dragon a bit of a banshee in the sack. Repopulating a species has never been so much fun.
rows.translation: 而且你暗自想道，小心不让这个念头通过灵能连接传出去：终身禁欲已经让你的龙在床上变成了一头尖叫的猛兽。繁衍一个种族从未如此有趣。
rows.raw: " And, you think to yourself (careful to not broadcast it over your psionic links), a lifetime of abstinence has made your dragon a bit of a banshee in the sack. Repopulating a species has never been so much fun."

rows.original: “And, well, I’m looking forward to it, of course, but... our Qim is hoping to have hundreds of kips. If I’m going to be the eldest kip out of hundreds, I’d like to set myself apart. Having a nest of my own would be a good start, I thought.”
rows.translation: “而且，当然，我也很期待，可是... 我们的Qim希望拥有数百只幼崽。如果我要成为数百只幼崽中最年长的那一个，我想让自己显得与众不同。我觉得，拥有自己的巢是个好开始。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And, well, I’m looking forward to it, of course, but... our Qim is hoping to have hundreds of kips. If I’m going to be the eldest kip out of hundreds, I’d like to set myself apart. Having a nest of my own would be a good start, I thought.”"

rows.original: You respond that
rows.translation: 你回答说
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond that "

rows.original: she
rows.translation: 她
rows.raw: "she"

rows.original: Nykke
rows.translation: 妮凯
rows.raw: "Nykke"

rows.original: is well and away the most unique of her sisters, and she doesn’t need her own dwelling to stand apart from the crowd. You’re referring, of course, to the increased melanin in her scales, turning them black.
rows.translation: 无疑是姐妹中最独特的一个，不需要自己的住所也能从众人中脱颖而出。当然，你指的是她鳞片中较多的黑色素，让鳞片变成了黑色。
rows.raw: " is well and away the most unique of her sisters, and she doesn’t need her own dwelling to stand apart from the crowd. You’re referring, of course, to the increased melanin in her scales, turning them black."

rows.original: She, however, isn’t as ecstatic about her physical difference from her family as you apparently are; you feel an emotion similar to regret and frustration leak over your psionic link with your kip.
rows.translation: 然而，她对自己与家人在外貌上的差异，并不像你显然表现得那么兴奋；通过与幼崽的灵能连接，你感到一股近似遗憾与沮丧的情绪泄漏过来。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe, however, isn’t as ecstatic about her physical difference from her family as you apparently are; you feel an emotion similar to regret and frustration leak over your psionic link with your kip."

rows.original: In an effort to rectify your mistake, you agree that it’s a good way to get a head start on establishing her position within the lair and the clutch as the first and eldest kip. [frostwyrm.name] tells you that it’s peculiar that any kip would be so forward-thinking, but you’re proud to see that your first daughter is already taking such initiative. You can’t say you built your first room from scratch.
rows.translation: 为了弥补错误，你赞同这是个好办法，能让她作为第一只、也是最年长的幼崽，尽早确立自己在巢穴和同窝幼崽中的地位。[frostwyrm.name]告诉你，幼崽如此深谋远虑十分罕见，但你很骄傲地看到第一个女儿已经展现出这般主动性。你可不能说自己第一间房是从零开始建造的。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn an effort to rectify your mistake, you agree that it’s a good way to get a head start on establishing her position within the lair and the clutch as the first and eldest kip. [frostwyrm.name] tells you that it’s peculiar that any kip would be so forward-thinking, but you’re proud to see that your first daughter is already taking such initiative. You can’t say you built your first room from scratch."

rows.original: “Uh, yeah! What you said!” your daughter chirps happily, satisfied that you’re agreeing with her in your own, non-Frostwyrm way.
rows.translation: “呃，对！就是你说的那样！”女儿高兴地欢呼，满意于你以自己那种非霜龙的方式赞同她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, yeah! What you said!” your daughter chirps happily, satisfied that you’re agreeing with her in your own, non-Frostwyrm way."

rows.original: But there’s another, better way to set herself apart from the rest of the clutch. “Is there?” she asks, sitting herself on her knees and looking
rows.translation: 不过，还有另一个更好的方法，能让她从同窝幼崽中脱颖而出。“有吗？”她问道，跪坐下来，目光
rows.raw: "\n\nBut there’s another, better way to set herself apart from the rest of the clutch. “Is there?” she asks, sitting herself on her knees and looking "

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 向上
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: straight
rows.translation: 直视
rows.raw: " straight"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 向下
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: into your [pc.eyes]. “Teach me, my Qal.”
rows.translation: 你的[pc.eyes]。“请教导我，我的Qal。”
rows.raw: " into your [pc.eyes]. “Teach me, my Qal.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You ask your daughter if she knows why you refer to [frostwyrm.name] as [frostwyrm.name], and not as your Qim, or by any other designation.
rows.translation: 你问女儿，她是否知道为什么你称[frostwyrm.name]为[frostwyrm.name]，而不是称她为Qim或其他任何称谓。
rows.raw: "You ask your daughter if she knows why you refer to [frostwyrm.name] as [frostwyrm.name], and not as your Qim, or by any other designation."

rows.original: “Our Qim told me it’s because you had difficulty pronouncing what others refer to her by,” your daughter answers. You laugh and say that, yes, that’s true, but that’s not quite the question you had asked. “Then I’m afraid I don’t know.”
rows.translation: “我们的Qim告诉我，是因为别人对她的称呼很难让你发音，”女儿回答。你笑着说，没错，这是真的，但并不完全是你问的问题。“那恐怕我不知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our Qim told me it’s because you had difficulty pronouncing what others refer to her by,” your daughter answers. You laugh and say that, yes, that’s true, but that’s not quite the question you had asked. “Then I’m afraid I don’t know.”"

rows.original: Well, first of all, you tell her that she should never be ‘afraid’ to admit that she doesn’t know something. One of life’s greatest adventures is asking questions, and from the answers you get, asking newer, smarter questions. It’s better to not know something and learn it than to know everything.
rows.translation: 首先，你告诉她，永远不该“害怕”承认自己不知道某件事。人生最伟大的冒险之一就是提出问题，并从得到的答案出发，提出更新、更聪明的问题。与其无所不知，不如有所不知后再去学习。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, first of all, you tell her that she should never be ‘afraid’ to admit that she doesn’t know something. One of life’s greatest adventures is asking questions, and from the answers you get, asking newer, smarter questions. It’s better to not know something and learn it than to know everything."

rows.original: You worry that what you just said came out as platitudinous, but your words seem to have their effect on your daughter, and, through your psionic connection with her, you can tell that she’s trying to commit them to memory. You hope, as a parent, that your wisdom comes off as such.
rows.translation: 你担心刚才的话听起来像陈词滥调，但这番话似乎确实影响了女儿；通过与她的灵能连接，你能感觉到她正努力把它们记在心里。身为父母，你希望自己的智慧听起来确实像智慧。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou worry that what you just said came out as platitudinous, but your words seem to have their effect on your daughter, and, through your psionic connection with her, you can tell that she’s trying to commit them to memory. You hope, as a parent, that your wisdom comes off as such."

rows.original: You tell her that there’s a lot that goes into a name. You giving your Qim and your mate the name [frostwyrm.name] is, simultaneously, a way to give her a true, quantifiable sense of identity and familiarity with you; it’s a sign of endearment, because the name you had picked out for her, and the name she continues to respond to, means something to you both; and it’s a way to set her apart. Your own parents gave you the name [pc.name], and while there might be other [pc.name]s in the world, there is only one of you, and you wouldn’t be you if you weren’t [pc.name].
rows.translation: 你告诉她，一个名字蕴含着许多东西。你给自己的Qim和伴侣取名[frostwyrm.name]，既是为了赋予她真实、明确的身份认同，以及与你之间的熟悉感；也是爱意的象征，因为你为她选择的名字、她一直回应的名字，对你们两人都有意义；同时还是让她显得与众不同的一种方式。你的父母给你取名[pc.name]，世界上或许还有其他[pc.name]，但你只有一个；如果你不是[pc.name]，你便不再是你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that there’s a lot that goes into a name. You giving your Qim and your mate the name [frostwyrm.name] is, simultaneously, a way to give her a true, quantifiable sense of identity and familiarity with you; it’s a sign of endearment, because the name you had picked out for her, and the name she continues to respond to, means something to you both; and it’s a way to set her apart. Your own parents gave you the name [pc.name], and while there might be other [pc.name]s in the world, there is only one of you, and you wouldn’t be you if you weren’t [pc.name]."

rows.original: It takes a moment for your daughter to process your line of thinking. Perhaps you had worded it inadequately, but all the same, after the sentences sink into her, you can see the inspiration alight in her eyes. “A name would set me apart,” she says determinedly, standing back onto her feet. “Would you name me, my Qal?”
rows.translation: 女儿花了一会儿才理解你的思路。也许你的措辞不够恰当，但这些话沉淀下来后，你看见灵感在她眼中点亮。“名字能让我与众不同，”她坚定地说着，重新站起身。“你愿意为我取名吗，我的Qal？”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a moment for your daughter to process your line of thinking. Perhaps you had worded it inadequately, but all the same, after the sentences sink into her, you can see the inspiration alight in her eyes. “A name would set me apart,” she says determinedly, standing back onto her feet. “Would you name me, my Qal?”"

rows.original: You could, if she wanted you to, but this is also her opportunity to name herself if she wanted. She’s already shown initiative in creating her own nest; what better way to truly make herself special as a Frostwyrm than to create her own identity?
rows.translation: 如果她希望，你当然可以，但这也是她自行命名的机会。她已经主动建造自己的巢穴；还有什么比创造自己的身份，更能让她真正成为独一无二的霜龙呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou could, if she wanted you to, but this is also her opportunity to name herself if she wanted. She’s already shown initiative in creating her own nest; what better way to truly make herself special as a Frostwyrm than to create her own identity?"

rows.original: You didn’t get a say in making your own name – some asshole named you and that was that – and you don’t want her to be stuck with the same fate.
rows.translation: 你没能参与决定自己的名字——某个混蛋随手给你取了一个，事情就这么定了——你可不希望她也被同样的命运束缚。
rows.raw: " You didn’t get a say in making your own name – some asshole named you and that was that – and you don’t want her to be stuck with the same fate."

rows.original: You sometimes wish you could have made your own name to go by.
rows.translation: 你有时真希望当初能自己决定日后使用的名字。
rows.raw: " You sometimes wish you could have made your own name to go by."

rows.original: She stands idly as she thinks, her eyes narrowed and focused, her four arms crossed. You can feel her psionic grip on your mind occasionally prod at you, and you let her; she’s likely looking for inspiration on what to name herself.
rows.translation: 她静静站着思考，眯起眼睛，神情专注，四条手臂交叉在胸前。你偶尔感觉她的灵能触须试探着碰触你的思维，而你任由她这么做；她大概是在寻找为自己取名的灵感。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe stands idly as she thinks, her eyes narrowed and focused, her four arms crossed. You can feel her psionic grip on your mind occasionally prod at you, and you let her; she’s likely looking for inspiration on what to name herself."

rows.original: “I think,” she says lowly, her head hanging on her neck as she considers it. “I think... I like the name Nykke.”
rows.translation: “我想，”她低声说道，思索时脑袋从脖颈垂下。“我想... 我喜欢妮凯这个名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think,” she says lowly, her head hanging on her neck as she considers it. “I think... I like the name Nykke.”"

rows.original: “Nykke?” you repeat.
rows.translation: “妮凯？”你重复道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nykke?” you repeat."

rows.original: nykke
rows.raw: "nykke"

rows.original: It’s, uh... you hesitate to call your daughter unimaginative, but clearly she didn’t put as much effort into it as you were expecting.
rows.translation: 这个嘛，呃... 你不愿说女儿缺乏想象力，但她显然没有像你预期的那样花费太多心思。
rows.raw: " It’s, uh... you hesitate to call your daughter unimaginative, but clearly she didn’t put as much effort into it as you were expecting."

rows.original: “I like the name Nykke because it’s a beautiful name,” she says simply. “Giving it to our Qim was a good decision. If I took the name Nykke for myself, it would mean that my Qim and my Qal are never too far away from me.”
rows.translation: “我喜欢妮凯这个名字，因为它很美，”她直率地说道。“把它送给我们的Qim是个很好的决定。如果我也为自己取名妮凯，就意味着我的Qim和Qal永远不会离我太远。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I like the name Nykke because it’s a beautiful name,” she says simply. “Giving it to our Qim was a good decision. If I took the name Nykke for myself, it would mean that my Qim and my Qal are never too far away from me.”"

rows.original: This may get confusing for you later, but if your daughter really is set on the name Nykke, then who are you to stop her?
rows.translation: 以后你可能会因此混淆，但如果女儿真的认定了妮凯这个名字，你又凭什么阻止她呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nThis may get confusing for you later, but if your daughter really is set on the name Nykke, then who are you to stop her?"

rows.original: “Well, that, and,” she says sheepishly, laughing a bit to herself, “I don’t exactly... know any other names.”
rows.translation: “嗯，除此之外，”她有些不好意思地说，自顾自轻笑起来，“我其实... 不知道其他名字。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, that, and,” she says sheepishly, laughing a bit to herself, “I don’t exactly... know any other names.”"

rows.original: “It sounds... unique. Special. I feel like, with a name like that, I can accomplish anything. It... feels like, if I were to ever leave my Qim’s lair, that the world would know that I belong to [frostwyrm.name] and to [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “它听起来... 独特而特别。我觉得，有了这样的名字，我便能完成任何事情。感觉... 如果有一天我离开Qim的巢穴，全世界都会知道我属于[frostwyrm.name]和[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: " “It sounds... unique. Special. I feel like, with a name like that, I can accomplish anything. It... feels like, if I were to ever leave my Qim’s lair, that the world would know that I belong to [frostwyrm.name] and to [pc.name].”"

rows.original: It’s a good name, you agree. And, once you and [frostwyrm.name] have those hundreds of kips, she can be confident that none of them will ever have the name Nykke. Your oldest daughter would be the only one with that name.
rows.translation: 你赞同这是个好名字。等你和[frostwyrm.name]有了数百只幼崽后，她也可以确信其中任何一只都不会叫妮凯。你最年长的女儿将是唯一拥有这个名字的人。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a good name, you agree. And, once you and [frostwyrm.name] have those hundreds of kips, she can be confident that none of them will ever have the name Nykke. Your oldest daughter would be the only one with that name."

rows.original: Nykke’s expression breaks into a wide, giddy smile, and she leans into you, nuzzling her smooth face against yours, showing her affection the same way [frostwyrm.name] does. “Thank you, my Qal,” she says, giving your cheek a long, exaggerated, loving lick with her flat, draconic tongue. “For... everything. For being my Qal. I was worried what you might think when you saw my dwelling. Knowing that you’re so supportive gives me strength.”
rows.translation: 妮凯脸上绽放出灿烂而兴奋的笑容，靠向你，用光滑的脸颊蹭着你的脸，像[frostwyrm.name]一样表达爱意。“谢谢你，我的Qal，”她说道，用扁平的龙舌长久而夸张地舔过你的脸颊，饱含爱意。“为了... 一切。谢谢你成为我的Qal。你看到我的住所时，我一直担心你会怎么想。知道你如此支持我，让我充满力量。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s expression breaks into a wide, giddy smile, and she leans into you, nuzzling her smooth face against yours, showing her affection the same way [frostwyrm.name] does. “Thank you, my Qal,” she says, giving your cheek a long, exaggerated, loving lick with her flat, draconic tongue. “For... everything. For being my Qal. I was worried what you might think when you saw my dwelling. Knowing that you’re so supportive gives me strength.”"

rows.original: You hug her and say that it’s just what any Qal would do for their kip.
rows.translation: 你抱住她，说任何Qal都会为自己的幼崽这样做。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hug her and say that it’s just what any Qal would do for their kip."

rows.original: But, naming your daughter was just the first step. She still has a nest to chisel out of the ice.
rows.translation: 不过，给女儿命名只是第一步。她还得从冰层里凿出一个巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, naming your daughter was just the first step. She still has a nest to chisel out of the ice."

rows.original: “Right,” Nykke laughs, pulling away to resume her work. “Thank you again, my Qal.”
rows.translation: “对，”妮凯笑着离开你，继续干活。“再次谢谢你，我的Qal。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right,” Nykke laughs, pulling away to resume her work. “Thank you again, my Qal.”"

rows.original: You show yourself out and leave her to her work.
rows.translation: 你自行离开，让她继续工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou show yourself out and leave her to her work."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Head back into the main cave
rows.translation: 返回主洞穴
rows.raw: "Head back into the main cave"

rows.original: You excuse yourself from [frostwyrm.name]’s warm embrace and say to Nykke that you’d like to join her privately in the personal dwelling she’s made for herself.
rows.translation: 你离开[frostwyrm.name]温暖的怀抱，向妮凯表示，想在她为自己建造的私人住处与她单独相处。
rows.raw: "You excuse yourself from [frostwyrm.name]’s warm embrace and say to Nykke that you’d like to join her privately in the personal dwelling she’s made for herself."

rows.original: “Of course, my Qal!” Nykke says happily, eager to show you into her abode. [frostwyrm.name] sees you both off
rows.translation: “当然可以，我的Qal！”妮凯愉快地说，迫不及待要带你参观住处。[frostwyrm.name]目送你们离开
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, my Qal!” Nykke says happily, eager to show you into her abode. [frostwyrm.name] sees you both off"

rows.original: , and allows the vacancy between her front legs to be filled with your younger progeny
rows.translation: ，让前腿之间的空位由更年幼的后代填补
rows.raw: ", and allows the vacancy between her front legs to be filled with your younger progeny"

rows.original: You settle into the corner of Nykke’s little lair, resting on your rump; Nykke, your doting daughter, joins you, wrapping her large body around yours once again.
rows.translation: 你在妮凯的小巢穴角落安顿下来，臀部着地休息；孝顺的女儿妮凯也靠了过来，再次用庞大的身体环绕着你。
rows.raw:
"

You settle into the corner of Nykke’s little lair, resting on your rump; Nykke, your doting daughter, joins you, wrapping her large body around yours once again.

"

rows.original: You’re alone with Nykke in her smaller lair; you two won’t be disturbed by [frostwyrm.name]
rows.translation: 你和妮凯独处在她较小的巢穴里；你们在这里时，不会受到[frostwyrm.name]
rows.raw: "You’re alone with Nykke in her smaller lair; you two won’t be disturbed by [frostwyrm.name]"

rows.original: or the rest of the clutch
rows.translation: 或其余同窝幼崽
rows.raw: " or the rest of the clutch"

rows.original: while you’re here. Now that you two have some privacy, what would you like to do?
rows.translation: 的打扰。既然你们有了一些隐私，你想做什么？
rows.raw: " while you’re here. Now that you two have some privacy, what would you like to do?"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Nykke’s proven to be a rather forward-thinking and driven kip. If you were to ask for her opinions on some topics, surely she’d provide some unique insight.
rows.translation: 妮凯已经证明自己是一只相当有远见和进取心的幼崽。如果询问她对某些话题的看法，她肯定会提供独特见解。
rows.raw: "Nykke’s proven to be a rather forward-thinking and driven kip. If you were to ask for her opinions on some topics, surely she’d provide some unique insight."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Fulfill your role as Qal and spend some personal, quality time with your Frostwyrmling daughter during a celebratory ‘inner circle coupling’ session.
rows.translation: 履行Qal的职责，在庆祝“内圈交合”的过程中，与霜龙幼女共度一段私密而宝贵的时光。
rows.raw: "Fulfill your role as Qal and spend some personal, quality time with your Frostwyrmling daughter during a celebratory ‘inner circle coupling’ session."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You’ve currently elected to not celebrate the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ You should Talk with Nykke if you want to change that.
rows.translation: 你目前选择不庆祝霜龙的“内圈交合”传统。如果想改变决定，就该与妮凯交谈。
rows.raw: "You’ve currently elected to not celebrate the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ You should Talk with Nykke if you want to change that."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You ask your Frostwyrmling daughter if she’s up for a bit of a chat. You’d love to hear her opinion on some topics.
rows.translation: 你问霜龙幼女是否愿意聊一会儿。你很想听听她对某些话题的看法。
rows.raw: "You ask your Frostwyrmling daughter if she’s up for a bit of a chat. You’d love to hear her opinion on some topics."

rows.original: “Of course, my Qal,” she says happily, nuzzling herself against you, her six limbs squeezing you affectionately. “What’s on your mind?”
rows.translation: “当然可以，我的Qal，”她高兴地说着，用身体蹭你，六条肢体亲昵地抱紧你。“你在想什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of course, my Qal,” she says happily, nuzzling herself against you, her six limbs squeezing you affectionately. “What’s on your mind?”"

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: Ask Nykke what qualities her ideal mate should have. Should they be strong, or smart, or just cute?
rows.translation: 询问妮凯，她理想的伴侣应该具备什么品质。强壮、聪明，还是只要可爱？
rows.raw: "Ask Nykke what qualities her ideal mate should have. Should they be strong, or smart, or just cute?"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Ask Nykke about her budding control over her psionic powers. You can’t say you’ve experienced what it’s like to have them first-hand, after all!
rows.translation: 询问妮凯，她对灵能力量的掌控进展如何。毕竟，你可不能说自己亲身体验过拥有灵能力量是什么感觉！
rows.raw: "Ask Nykke about her budding control over her psionic powers. You can’t say you’ve experienced what it’s like to have them first-hand, after all!"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: You’re far less educated about psionics than Nykke would be, and you probably shouldn’t go into this discussion without at least a little bit of forethought from [frostwyrm.name] first.
rows.translation: 你对灵能的了解远不如妮凯，或许不该在事先至少向[frostwyrm.name]了解一点情况前展开讨论。
rows.raw: "You’re far less educated about psionics than Nykke would be, and you probably shouldn’t go into this discussion without at least a little bit of forethought from [frostwyrm.name] first."

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: You have a life outside of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair – one that’s rather adventurous, especially compared to the domestic life that Nykke has. Maybe she’d like to hear a few stories about your travels.
rows.translation: 你在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴之外还有自己的生活——尤其和妮凯的居家生活相比，那可充满冒险。也许她想听几个关于你旅途的故事。
rows.raw: "You have a life outside of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair – one that’s rather adventurous, especially compared to the domestic life that Nykke has. Maybe she’d like to hear a few stories about your travels."

rows.original: Incest
rows.translation: 乱伦
rows.raw: "Incest"

rows.original: Incest
rows.translation: 乱伦
rows.raw: "Incest"

rows.original: Maybe it’s time you reconsider your stance on ‘inner circle coupling.’
rows.translation: 也许是时候重新考虑你对“内圈交合”的态度了。
rows.raw: "Maybe it’s time you reconsider your stance on ‘inner circle coupling.’"

rows.original: Black Scales
rows.translation: 黑色鳞片
rows.raw: "Black Scales"

rows.original: Black Scales
rows.translation: 黑色鳞片
rows.raw: "Black Scales"

rows.original: Ask Nykke about her unique melanin condition. She clearly doesn’t like talking about it, but maybe, if you help her work through her frustrations with it, she’ll have an easier time accepting herself.
rows.translation: 询问妮凯独特的黑色素状况。她显然不喜欢谈论，但也许，只要帮助她化解由此产生的挫败感，她就能更轻松地接纳自己。
rows.raw: "Ask Nykke about her unique melanin condition. She clearly doesn’t like talking about it, but maybe, if you help her work through her frustrations with it, she’ll have an easier time accepting herself."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You ask Nykke if she’s put any thought into what sort of person she’d want in a mate. There are all sorts of people in the world; if she gets a little lucky, she might find a mate that fulfills her every need and desire.
rows.translation: 你问妮凯是否想过，自己会希望什么样的人成为伴侣。世上有形形色色的人；只要运气好一点，她或许能找到满足自己一切需求与欲望的伴侣。
rows.raw: "You ask Nykke if she’s put any thought into what sort of person she’d want in a mate. There are all sorts of people in the world; if she gets a little lucky, she might find a mate that fulfills her every need and desire."

rows.original: “Uh... I can’t say I have, I guess,” she says, her two left index fingers tapping on her chin in thought. “The only experience I have with mates are you and our Qim. So, I guess I’d want a mate that just gives me lots and lots of kips.”
rows.translation: “呃... 我想，我还真没考虑过，”她说道，两只左手的食指若有所思地轻点下巴。“我对伴侣的全部经验就只有你和我们的Qim。所以，我想要一个能给我许许多多幼崽的伴侣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh... I can’t say I have, I guess,” she says, her two left index fingers tapping on her chin in thought. “The only experience I have with mates are you and our Qim. So, I guess I’d want a mate that just gives me lots and lots of kips.”"

rows.original: That’s kind of a blasé way of describing your relationship with [frostwyrm.name]. At the word, you feel Nykke’s psionics probe your mind – she isn’t quite as quick or refined on her skills, and it takes her a moment to understand the definition of the word ‘blasé.’ You tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] having lots of offspring is just one of the many qualities you fulfill as her mate.
rows.translation: 这未免把你和[frostwyrm.name]的关系描述得太过淡然。这个词一出现，你便感觉妮凯的灵能探入你的思维——她的技巧还不够迅速娴熟，花了一会儿才理解“淡然”一词的定义。你告诉她，和[frostwyrm.name]生育许多后代，只是你身为她伴侣所具备的众多品质之一。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s kind of a blasé way of describing your relationship with [frostwyrm.name]. At the word, you feel Nykke’s psionics probe your mind – she isn’t quite as quick or refined on her skills, and it takes her a moment to understand the definition of the word ‘blasé.’ You tell her that you and [frostwyrm.name] having lots of offspring is just one of the many qualities you fulfill as her mate."

rows.original: “How did our Qim decide for you to be her mate? Or... was it the other way around?” she asks, inviting you to explain how [frostwyrm.name] decided that you would be her ideal mate.
rows.translation: “我们的Qim是怎么决定让你成为伴侣的？还是说... 反过来？”她问道，请你解释[frostwyrm.name]如何认定你是理想伴侣。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How did our Qim decide for you to be her mate? Or... was it the other way around?” she asks, inviting you to explain how [frostwyrm.name] decided that you would be her ideal mate."

rows.original: You explain that you two met in combat. Nykke gasps, only slightly, through her nose; it never occurred to her that her parents were once enemies. You regale that you had unknowingly wandered into her territory once, and she mistook that you were trying to invade her space. You never actually asked [frostwyrm.name] why she attacked you; it seems so unimportant now.
rows.translation: 你解释说，你们是在战斗中相遇的。妮凯用鼻子轻轻倒抽一口气；她从未想到父母曾经是敌人。你讲述自己曾无意间闯入她的领地，而她误以为你要侵占她的地盘。你其实从没问过[frostwyrm.name]为什么袭击你；如今看来，这件事已毫不重要。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou explain that you two met in combat. Nykke gasps, only slightly, through her nose; it never occurred to her that her parents were once enemies. You regale that you had unknowingly wandered into her territory once, and she mistook that you were trying to invade her space. You never actually asked [frostwyrm.name] why she attacked you; it seems so unimportant now."

rows.original: Anyway, you had bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat. “You, really?” Nykke asks in bewilderment. You answer that you had done it several times, not just once. “But she’s so much larger than you! And her teeth – she could have eaten you with one bite!” You tell Nykke to ask her herself if she doesn’t believe you. There’s more to combat than whether one kind is smaller than another, or whether one kind has larger, sharper teeth and claws. You can go into deeper detail later, if she wants.
rows.translation: 总之，你在战斗中击败了[frostwyrm.name]。“你，真的吗？”妮凯难以置信地问道。你回答说，不止一次，而是好几次。“可她比你大那么多！还有她的牙齿——一口就能吃掉你！”你告诉妮凯，如果不相信，可以亲自去问她。战斗的胜负并不只取决于某个种族是否比另一个小，也不只取决于谁有更大、更锋利的牙齿和爪子。如果她愿意，你以后可以进一步详细说明。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnyway, you had bested [frostwyrm.name] in combat. “You, really?” Nykke asks in bewilderment. You answer that you had done it several times, not just once. “But she’s so much larger than you! And her teeth – she could have eaten you with one bite!” You tell Nykke to ask her herself if she doesn’t believe you. There’s more to combat than whether one kind is smaller than another, or whether one kind has larger, sharper teeth and claws. You can go into deeper detail later, if she wants."

rows.original: In any case, [frostwyrm.name] had established her territory along a route that you regularly traveled, meaning you and she were at odds a number of times. And every single time you won, you let her go, because you didn’t want the blood of something as beautiful as herself on your hands.
rows.translation: 无论如何，[frostwyrm.name]把领地设在你经常经过的路线沿线，这意味着你们发生过多次冲突。而每次获胜后，你都会放她离开，因为你不愿让如此美丽的生物之血沾在手上。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn any case, [frostwyrm.name] had established her territory along a route that you regularly traveled, meaning you and she were at odds a number of times. And every single time you won, you let her go, because you didn’t want the blood of something as beautiful as herself on your hands."

rows.original: But, one day, [frostwyrm.name] managed to get the better of you. And when she had the upper-hand and was in a position to kill you – she didn’t. She recognized you and the fact that you kept sparing her, and she extended the same mercy to you.
rows.translation: 但有一天，[frostwyrm.name]成功胜过了你。而当她占据上风、有机会杀死你时——她没有动手。她认出了你，也意识到你一直饶她性命，于是以同样的仁慈回报你。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut, one day, [frostwyrm.name] managed to get the better of you. And when she had the upper-hand and was in a position to kill you – she didn’t. She recognized you and the fact that you kept sparing her, and she extended the same mercy to you."

rows.original: Nykke is hanging on your every word, her bright [pc.eyeColor] eyes lighting up every time you pause for effect. To finish your story, you tell her that [frostwyrm.name] recognized your strength, and pined that she hadn’t found another pureblood Frostwyrm like herself, so she decided that you were worthy to breed with her. You turn to Nykke and nudge her as you say that the rest is living, breathing history.
rows.translation: 妮凯全神贯注地听着你的每句话；每当你故意停顿时，她明亮的[pc.eyeColor]眼睛都会闪闪发光。作为故事的结尾，你告诉她，[frostwyrm.name]认可了你的力量，又哀叹自己找不到另一只像她一样的纯血霜龙，于是决定你有资格与她繁衍。你转向妮凯，轻轻推了推她，说接下来的部分便是活生生的历史。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke is hanging on your every word, her bright [pc.eyeColor] eyes lighting up every time you pause for effect. To finish your story, you tell her that [frostwyrm.name] recognized your strength, and pined that she hadn’t found another pureblood Frostwyrm like herself, so she decided that you were worthy to breed with her. You turn to Nykke and nudge her as you say that the rest is living, breathing history."

rows.original: “My goodness,” Nykke says breathlessly, hinging herself tightly to you throughout your story. You can feel her large, Frostwyrmling heart beat through her chest in excitement at your story. You ask her if she has any ideas on what her mate should be.
rows.translation: “我的天，”妮凯屏息说道，在你讲述期间一直紧紧依偎着你。你能隔着胸膛感到她硕大的霜龙幼崽心脏因故事而兴奋跳动。你问她是否想到伴侣应该是什么样子。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My goodness,” Nykke says breathlessly, hinging herself tightly to you throughout your story. You can feel her large, Frostwyrmling heart beat through her chest in excitement at your story. You ask her if she has any ideas on what her mate should be."

rows.original: “I,” she starts, and stops, several times as she tries to word her thoughts. Blood rushes to her cheeks, tingeing them a deep-sea-blue in embarrassment. “I want to mate – I want a mate like you, my Qal.” She hiccups in surprise at her own word-slip,
rows.translation: “我，”她开口又停下，反复几次，努力组织思绪。血液涌上面颊，令脸颊因尴尬染成深海蓝色。“我想交配——我想要一个像你一样的伴侣，我的Qal。”她因自己的口误而惊讶地打了个嗝，
rows.raw: "\n\n“I,” she starts, and stops, several times as she tries to word her thoughts. Blood rushes to her cheeks, tingeing them a deep-sea-blue in embarrassment. “I want to mate – I want a mate like you, my Qal.” She hiccups in surprise at her own word-slip,"

rows.original: and it’s not lost on you. You shift your [pc.hips] slightly towards her, but make no other obvious movement, other than
rows.translation: 而你并未忽略这一点。你把[pc.hips]稍稍向她挪近，却没有做出其他明显动作，除了
rows.raw: " and it’s not lost on you. You shift your [pc.hips] slightly towards her, but make no other obvious movement, other than"

rows.original: and she knows what your stance on the subject is. You don’t press it any further, though, and motion for her
rows.translation: ，而她知道你对这件事的态度。不过你没有继续逼迫，只示意她
rows.raw: " and she knows what your stance on the subject is. You don’t press it any further, though, and motion for her"

rows.original: to continue – what qualities do you have that she finds desirable in a mate?
rows.translation: 继续说下去——你有哪些品质，让她觉得适合作为伴侣？
rows.raw: " to continue – what qualities do you have that she finds desirable in a mate?"

rows.original: “The strength, for sure,” she says, hugging your form a bit tighter, testing how taut your body is. “A proper mate must be able to defend their dwelling and protect their clutch, and if you had the strength to fell someone like our Qim so many times over, I wouldn’t settle for anyone lesser.”
rows.translation: “首先肯定是力量，”她说道，把你的身体抱得更紧，试探你的身体有多结实。“合格的伴侣必须能够保卫住所、保护同窝幼崽；如果你有力量一次又一次击倒我们的Qim，我绝不会接受比你差的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The strength, for sure,” she says, hugging your form a bit tighter, testing how taut your body is. “A proper mate must be able to defend their dwelling and protect their clutch, and if you had the strength to fell someone like our Qim so many times over, I wouldn’t settle for anyone lesser.”"

rows.original: You thank her for the compliment, but tell her that you’re not nearly the strongest of your own kind. Like you had said earlier, there’s more to combat than just bulk. “Did you outsmart her, then?” Nykke asks, and you say that, in a manner of speaking, you certainly used the right tools for the job. “Then a proper mate must be intelligent and witty enough to outperform any opponent.”
rows.translation: 你感谢她的赞美，但也告诉她，自己远不是同族中最强壮的。正如先前所说，战斗不仅取决于体格。“那你是靠智慧胜过她的吗？”妮凯问道；你说，从某种意义上讲，你确实使用了适合任务的工具。“那么，合格的伴侣必须足够聪明机敏，能够胜过任何对手。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou thank her for the compliment, but tell her that you’re not nearly the strongest of your own kind. Like you had said earlier, there’s more to combat than just bulk. “Did you outsmart her, then?” Nykke asks, and you say that, in a manner of speaking, you certainly used the right tools for the job. “Then a proper mate must be intelligent and witty enough to outperform any opponent.”"

rows.original: You implore her to continue. “And... a good, proper mate would show compassion, like you had shown to our Qim. You didn’t kill her, even when you could, and when she asked you to help her repopulate her species, you didn’t hesitate. A good mate would know when to protect a kind that needs help, and when a battle is over.”
rows.translation: 你请她继续。“而且... 优秀而合格的伴侣应该表现出同情心，就像你对我们的Qim那样。即使有机会，你也没有杀死她；当她请求你帮助繁衍种族时，你也没有犹豫。优秀的伴侣应该知道何时保护需要帮助的种族，也知道战斗何时已经结束。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou implore her to continue. “And... a good, proper mate would show compassion, like you had shown to our Qim. You didn’t kill her, even when you could, and when she asked you to help her repopulate her species, you didn’t hesitate. A good mate would know when to protect a kind that needs help, and when a battle is over.”"

rows.original: “And a good mate,” Nykke continues, her six limbs constricting you tighter as her fantasies start to get away from her, “would be close with their kips, and spend lots of time with them. They’d ensure that their kips grew up strong, and wise, and with a strong sense of the world around them. And... a good mate would be able to listen, and share their ideas and stories with their mate and their kips. And a good mate–”
rows.translation: “优秀的伴侣，”妮凯继续说道，随着幻想逐渐失控，六条肢体把你勒得更紧，“还会亲近自己的幼崽，花许多时间陪伴她们。伴侣会确保幼崽成长得强壮、睿智，并对周围世界有清晰认识。而且... 优秀的伴侣会倾听，与伴侣及幼崽分享自己的想法和故事。优秀的伴侣还——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And a good mate,” Nykke continues, her six limbs constricting you tighter as her fantasies start to get away from her, “would be close with their kips, and spend lots of time with them. They’d ensure that their kips grew up strong, and wise, and with a strong sense of the world around them. And... a good mate would be able to listen, and share their ideas and stories with their mate and their kips. And a good mate–”"

rows.original: Nykke’s eyes lock onto yours, staring deeply into you, as she struggles with the last little bit she wants to say.
rows.translation: 妮凯的目光锁住你的双眼，深深凝视着你，努力说出最后那一点想法。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s eyes lock onto yours, staring deeply into you, as she struggles with the last little bit she wants to say."

rows.original: You implore her to continue: she has your undivided attention. What else should a good mate be?
rows.translation: 你请她继续：你正全神贯注地听着。优秀的伴侣还应该怎样？
rows.raw: " You implore her to continue: she has your undivided attention. What else should a good mate be?"

rows.original: “You,” she whimpers, and you feel a number of emotions flood into you through her untrained psionic link with you. Happiness that you’re everything she could want in a partner; lust for you and the offspring she wishes you could give her; but, curiously, there’s also regret and frustration that [frostwyrm.name] has already claimed you, and that she couldn’t have you all to herself.
rows.translation: “应该是你，”她呜咽着说道；通过尚未训练成熟的灵能连接，你感到无数情绪涌入体内。她为你符合自己对伴侣的一切期望而幸福；因渴望你以及希望由你赋予的后代而充满欲火；但奇怪的是，其中也有遗憾和挫败，因为[frostwyrm.name]已经占有了你，她无法独享你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You,” she whimpers, and you feel a number of emotions flood into you through her untrained psionic link with you. Happiness that you’re everything she could want in a partner; lust for you and the offspring she wishes you could give her; but, curiously, there’s also regret and frustration that [frostwyrm.name] has already claimed you, and that she couldn’t have you all to herself."

rows.original: Your hands trail down your daughter’s scaly, muscled, powerful back, tickling at the crease between her wings. You lean into her and kiss her on the lips, and you linger there far longer than what most would consider ‘parental.’ When you pull away, you tell her that, if she has any other fantasies as to what the perfect mate should be like, you’ll be here to listen.
rows.translation: 你的双手沿女儿覆盖鳞片、肌肉发达而强健的后背向下滑，在双翼之间的沟壑处轻挠。你靠近她，吻住她的双唇，停留的时间远超大多数人认为的“亲子”尺度。分开后，你告诉她，如果对完美伴侣还有任何其他幻想，你会在这里倾听。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hands trail down your daughter’s scaly, muscled, powerful back, tickling at the crease between her wings. You lean into her and kiss her on the lips, and you linger there far longer than what most would consider ‘parental.’ When you pull away, you tell her that, if she has any other fantasies as to what the perfect mate should be like, you’ll be here to listen."

rows.original: You feel something hot, thick, and a little wet prod against your [pc.thigh] at your words, your message clear as could be to her. “Okay, my Qal,” she says breathlessly, barely able to contain her excitement.
rows.translation: 听到这番话，你感觉某个滚烫、粗大而略显湿润的东西抵住[pc.thigh]，你的意思已经传达得再清楚不过。“好的，我的Qal，”她气喘吁吁地说，几乎压抑不住兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel something hot, thick, and a little wet prod against your [pc.thigh] at your words, your message clear as could be to her. “Okay, my Qal,” she says breathlessly, barely able to contain her excitement."

rows.original: You tell her that it’s quite alright: you’ve heard all that you’ve needed to hear, and she’s made her wants for a proper mate clear to you.
rows.translation: 你告诉她完全没关系：需要听的内容你已经都听到了，她也已经把自己对合格伴侣的期待表达得很清楚。
rows.raw: " You tell her that it’s quite alright: you’ve heard all that you’ve needed to hear, and she’s made her wants for a proper mate clear to you."

rows.original: “Okay, my Qal,” she says, exhaling a long, burning breath, thankful that you had interrupted her before she blurted out something she might regret saying to you.
rows.translation: “好的，我的Qal，”她说道，吐出一口漫长而灼热的气息，庆幸你在她脱口说出某些可能后悔的话之前打断了她。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, my Qal,” she says, exhaling a long, burning breath, thankful that you had interrupted her before she blurted out something she might regret saying to you."

rows.original: Although, given your psionic link with her, and how she had trouble keeping it in check as her imagination got the better of her... you have a couple ideas as to what she wanted to say to you.
rows.translation: 不过，考虑到你们之间的灵能连接，以及幻想占据上风时，她很难控制这道连接... 你已经大概猜到她想对你说些什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nAlthough, given your psionic link with her, and how she had trouble keeping it in check as her imagination got the better of her... you have a couple ideas as to what she wanted to say to you."

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: Mates
rows.translation: 伴侣
rows.raw: "Mates"

rows.original: You already have a pretty good idea on what Nykke considers to be the perfect mate...
rows.translation: 你已经相当清楚妮凯认为什么样的人才是完美伴侣...
rows.raw: "You already have a pretty good idea on what Nykke considers to be the perfect mate..."

rows.original: You ask Nykke how her handle on her psionic strengths are coming along. She hasn’t had nearly the time or the training to handle it the way her Qim does, but with enough practice, she’ll get there.
rows.translation: 你询问妮凯对灵能力量的掌控进展如何。她拥有这股力量的时间还不长，也没有像Qim那样接受过训练，但只要多加练习，终究会掌握。
rows.raw: "You ask Nykke how her handle on her psionic strengths are coming along. She hasn’t had nearly the time or the training to handle it the way her Qim does, but with enough practice, she’ll get there."

rows.original: The question is met with a quizzical pause. “I’m... not sure what you’re asking me,” she admits.
rows.translation: 她困惑地停顿了一下，回应你的问题。“我... 不太明白你在问什么，”她承认道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe question is met with a quizzical pause. “I’m... not sure what you’re asking me,” she admits."

rows.original: You recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now.
rows.translation: 你想起[frostwyrm.name]理解灵能的方式也与你不同。用她自己的话说，你所谓的“灵能”，就是霜龙无需言语便能交流的能力，就像你们现在这样。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recall that [frostwyrm.name] didn’t have the same approach to psionics as you did, either. In her own words, what you call ‘psionics’ is the skill that Frostwyrms have that allow them to communicate without using words, like you are now."

rows.original: “Oh, like this?” Nykke asks, her voice projecting into your mind directly. You concur: exactly like that. [frostwyrm.name] also said that Frostwyrms don’t necessarily communicate in words: they communicate in ideas and emotions, and are able to project feelings directly into whoever they’re connected with.
rows.translation: “噢，像这样吗？”妮凯问道，声音直接投射进你的思维。你表示赞同：正是如此。[frostwyrm.name]还说，霜龙不一定用语言交流：她们以想法与情绪沟通，能够把感受直接投射给与自己连接的人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, like this?” Nykke asks, her voice projecting into your mind directly. You concur: exactly like that. [frostwyrm.name] also said that Frostwyrms don’t necessarily communicate in words: they communicate in ideas and emotions, and are able to project feelings directly into whoever they’re connected with."

rows.original: Taking that as a sort of challenge, Nykke focuses on you intently, attempting to channel her psionic skills into you. “Are you feeling anything yet?” she asks, and you laugh – you can, but all you’re getting is a bit of a headache, and if that’s what you are feeling, then she must be feeling it, too. You tell her to stop before she hurts herself.
rows.translation: 妮凯把这当成某种挑战，专注地凝视你，试图把灵能力量导入你的思维。“现在有感觉了吗？”她问，而你笑了起来——你确实有感觉，但只有一点头痛；如果你感受到的是这个，那她肯定也一样。你让她在伤到自己前停下。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking that as a sort of challenge, Nykke focuses on you intently, attempting to channel her psionic skills into you. “Are you feeling anything yet?” she asks, and you laugh – you can, but all you’re getting is a bit of a headache, and if that’s what you are feeling, then she must be feeling it, too. You tell her to stop before she hurts herself."

rows.original: “I guess that answers that question, then,” Nykke says somberly. You tell her to not get her hopes down: when she was still inside her egg, she was communicating rather ‘verbosely,’ for lack of a better term, and she was already capable of projecting her emotions on a tremendous spectrum to you and [frostwyrm.name]. So, she has the skills and the strength; it’s just a matter of learning to use it correctly.
rows.translation: “看来这就回答了那个问题，”妮可忧郁地说道。你告诉她别灰心：她还在蛋里时，就已经用相当“冗长”的方式交流了——实在找不到更合适的说法——而且那时她已能把极其丰富的情绪投射给你和[frostwyrm.name]。所以，她既有天赋也有力量，只需要学会正确使用。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I guess that answers that question, then,” Nykke says somberly. You tell her to not get her hopes down: when she was still inside her egg, she was communicating rather ‘verbosely,’ for lack of a better term, and she was already capable of projecting her emotions on a tremendous spectrum to you and [frostwyrm.name]. So, she has the skills and the strength; it’s just a matter of learning to use it correctly."

rows.original: “Could you teach me, my Qal?” she asks. Unfortunately, races like yours aren’t psionically adept like Frostwyrms are. You can’t communicate like [frostwyrm.name] does. “Why is that? I thought that all creatures could do it, and it was a matter of attuning yourself to each other in order to establish connections.”
rows.translation: “您能教我吗，我的卡尔？”她问道。遗憾的是，你这样的种族不像霜龙那样擅长灵能。你无法像[frostwyrm.name]那样交流。“为什么？我以为所有生物都能做到，只要彼此调谐就能建立联系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Could you teach me, my Qal?” she asks. Unfortunately, races like yours aren’t psionically adept like Frostwyrms are. You can’t communicate like [frostwyrm.name] does. “Why is that? I thought that all creatures could do it, and it was a matter of attuning yourself to each other in order to establish connections.”"

rows.original: Perhaps you are capable of it; you just never learned how to do it. You consider Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] to be gifted and privileged; being able to communicate to each other so purely is a real gift that should be shared with the world, if they could. There are an untold number of languages out there: if everyone could skip the words and jump straight to the ideas, a lot of barriers would be taken down in a hurry.
rows.translation: 或许你确实能做到，只是从未学过。你认为妮可和[frostwyrm.name]天赋异禀、得天独厚；能如此纯粹地彼此交流是一份真正的礼物，若能做到，就该与全世界分享。宇宙中有数不清的语言；如果人人都能跳过言辞，直接交流想法，许多障碍都会迅速消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps you are capable of it; you just never learned how to do it. You consider Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] to be gifted and privileged; being able to communicate to each other so purely is a real gift that should be shared with the world, if they could. There are an untold number of languages out there: if everyone could skip the words and jump straight to the ideas, a lot of barriers would be taken down in a hurry."

rows.original: Nykke ponders what you’re saying for a moment, and you occasionally feel her probe at your connection, searching your mind for inspiration. “Do you think you could learn? To communicate like my kind could?”
rows.translation: 妮可思考片刻，偶尔试探你们之间的联系，在你的思绪中寻找灵感。“您觉得自己能学会吗？像我的种族那样交流？”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke ponders what you’re saying for a moment, and you occasionally feel her probe at your connection, searching your mind for inspiration. “Do you think you could learn? To communicate like my kind could?”"

rows.original: [frostwyrm.name] had put it best, when you asked her. In her own words, you are as equally equipped as any Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t seem to think you can’t be taught.
rows.translation: 你问过[frostwyrm.name]时，她说得最好。用她的话说，你拥有与任何霜龙同等的条件；[frostwyrm.name]似乎并不认为你无法受教。
rows.raw: "\n\n[frostwyrm.name] had put it best, when you asked her. In her own words, you are as equally equipped as any Frostwyrm; [frostwyrm.name] doesn’t seem to think you can’t be taught."

rows.original: “I could try to teach you, my Qal,” she says, and you feel a tinge of anxiety across the spectrum of your connection – you can’t tell if she’s secretly hoping that you’d say yes, or that she immediately regrets offering.
rows.translation: “我可以试着教您，我的卡尔，”她说道。你从联系的情绪光谱中感觉到一丝焦虑——分不清她是暗自希望你答应，还是刚说出口就后悔了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I could try to teach you, my Qal,” she says, and you feel a tinge of anxiety across the spectrum of your connection – you can’t tell if she’s secretly hoping that you’d say yes, or that she immediately regrets offering."

rows.original: You reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two.
rows.translation: 你回答说，你才应该是卡尔；按你所了解的含义，卡尔本该是老师。假如妮可费心教会你像霜龙一样交流，那么在你们两人之间，她反而会成为卡尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reply that you’re supposed to be the Qal, and from what you’ve learned, that means you’re supposed to be the teacher. You’d suppose that, if Nykke went through the effort to teach you to communicate like a Frostwyrm, that would make her the Qal between you two."

rows.original: A myriad of ideas and emotions leak across the connection simultaneously, and you can tell that Nykke is trying her best to restrict them from flowing to you. They’re all positive emotions, ranging from happiness that she’d be given the opportunity to be put in your position and help you the way you’ve helped her; to ideas as to how she might be able to impart what limited skill she has with her own psionics to you; to some... other, more personal fantasies about the sudden change in the relationship dynamic between you two, where she is the Qal and you are the kip.
rows.translation: 无数想法与情绪同时从联系中泄露出来，你能感觉到妮可正竭力阻止它们流向你。它们全是正面情绪：既有因获得机会站到你的位置、像你帮助她那样帮助你而产生的喜悦，也有如何把自己有限的灵能技巧传授给你的构想，还有一些...更加私密的幻想，关于你们关系突然倒转——她成为卡尔，而你成为基普。
rows.raw: "\n\nA myriad of ideas and emotions leak across the connection simultaneously, and you can tell that Nykke is trying her best to restrict them from flowing to you. They’re all positive emotions, ranging from happiness that she’d be given the opportunity to be put in your position and help you the way you’ve helped her; to ideas as to how she might be able to impart what limited skill she has with her own psionics to you; to some... other, more personal fantasies about the sudden change in the relationship dynamic between you two, where she is the Qal and you are the kip."

rows.original: “Uh,” Nykke stutters verbally, once she realizes that her emotions are getting carried away over the psionic link with you. “We can get started right now, if you wanted, my Qal. I can try teaching you what I know.”
rows.translation: “呃，”妮可意识到自己的情绪正通过灵能连接失控外溢后，结结巴巴地出了声。“如果您愿意，我们现在就可以开始，我的卡尔。我可以试着把知道的东西教给您。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh,” Nykke stutters verbally, once she realizes that her emotions are getting carried away over the psionic link with you. “We can get started right now, if you wanted, my Qal. I can try teaching you what I know.”"

rows.original: Why not; it’d be a fun bonding experience with your daughter, and [frostwyrm.name] can fill in the blanks for you both later.
rows.translation: 何乐而不为呢？这会是你和女儿增进感情的有趣经历，之后[frostwyrm.name]还能替你们补充遗漏之处。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhy not; it’d be a fun bonding experience with your daughter, and [frostwyrm.name] can fill in the blanks for you both later."

rows.original: The next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her.
rows.translation: 接下来大约一小时里，妮可努力用语言解释自己集中灵能时究竟做了什么：她专注于什么，又如何从一个念头中过滤出另一个——这个过程远比你最初想象的复杂。心智会在极短时间内接收海量信息，同时又产生自身的思绪、构想与表达；如果妮可不谨慎筛选，而把全部思绪一股脑送过联系，你很容易把自己错认成她。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next hour or so between you two is spent with Nykke trying to put to words what she does when she uses her psionic focus. What she concentrates on, and how she can filter one thought from another – it’s a far more involved process than you initially thought. The mind takes in so much information so quickly, all while coming up with its own thoughts, ideas, and expressions, that if Nykke weren’t careful and selective and simply let the whole gamut of thoughts across the link, you’d easily confuse yourself for her."

rows.original: However, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them.
rows.translation: 然而，尽管你竭力学习、妮可也竭力教导，你最终仍未更接近理解灵能如何运作，更别提掌握它。
rows.raw: "\n\nHowever, despite your best effort to learn, and Nykke’s best effort to teach, you ultimately don’t come any closer to understanding how psionics work, much less mastering them."

rows.original: You have a link to [frostwyrm.name], and to Nykke
rows.translation: 你与[frostwyrm.name]、妮可之间都有联系
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have a link to [frostwyrm.name], and to Nykke"

rows.original: , and to the entire clutch
rows.translation: ，也与整窝幼崽相连
rows.raw: ", and to the entire clutch"

rows.original: , but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her.
rows.translation: ，可你虽然能接收任何思绪、构想、表达或灵感，这种联系对你而言却是单向的，无法将自己的思想反向传递。每当你产生念头，妮可都能察觉并理解，但那不等于你主动把它投射给她。
rows.raw: ", but while you are able to receive any thought, idea, expression, or inspiration, it’s a one-way connection for you, and you aren’t able to communicate your own thoughts back across it. Whenever you have a thought, Nykke is able to pick up on it and understand it, but that’s not the same as you projecting it to her."

rows.original: “Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. You respond that, as far as you know, Frostwyrms are the only kind. Maybe it’s simply a uniquely-Frostwyrm trait.
rows.translation: “世上还有其他种族能像我的种族一样交流吗？”妮可问道。一个小时的勤奋努力毫无成果，让她倍感挫败。你回答说，据你所知，霜龙是唯一能做到的种族。或许这只是霜龙独有的特质。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are there other kinds in the world that can communicate the way my kind can?” Nykke asks, exasperated from an hour’s worth of diligence with nothing to show for it. You respond that, as far as you know, Frostwyrms are the only kind. Maybe it’s simply a uniquely-Frostwyrm trait."

rows.original: “No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what our Qim meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”
rows.translation: “不，我不同意，”妮可斩钉截铁地说道，靠向你，双眼坚定地眯起。“我明白我们的齐姆是什么意思：我们拥有同样的条件。您应该能像我一样交流。只是....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, I don’t agree with that,” Nykke says with some finality, leaning into you, her eyes narrowing determinedly on yours. “I understand what our Qim meant: we’re equally equipped. You should be able to communicate like I can. It’s just....”"

rows.original: “It’s just that you can’t?”
rows.translation: “只是你做不到？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s just that you can’t?”"

rows.original: “I don’t know how to explain it. This is all very frustrating!” she exclaims into her nest. “It’s not like it’s some secret among my kind. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way another kind, like yourself, my Qal, could understand... I feel so powerless and conflicted!”
rows.translation: “我不知道该怎么解释。这一切太令人沮丧了！”她朝巢穴喊道。“这又不是我们种族之间的秘密。我明白自己在做什么；问任何同族，它们也都会明白。可我无法用另一个种族——比如您，我的卡尔——能够理解的方式解释...我感到如此无力、如此矛盾！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know how to explain it. This is all very frustrating!” she exclaims into her nest. “It’s not like it’s some secret among my kind. I understand what I’m doing; any of my kind would understand if I asked them. But being unable to explain it in a way another kind, like yourself, my Qal, could understand... I feel so powerless and conflicted!”"

rows.original: You lean into your daughter, snuggling yourself against her enormous form. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explaining what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before.
rows.translation: 你靠向女儿，依偎在她庞大的身体旁。你感谢她愿意为你努力，也明白这并不容易。你说，这就像向从未见过蓝色的人解释蓝色是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean into your daughter, snuggling yourself against her enormous form. You thank her for going through the effort for you, and you understand that it’s not easy to do. You liken it to explaining what the color blue is to anyone that hasn’t seen it before."

rows.original: Nykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone that cannot grasp it?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations, my Qal.”
rows.translation: 妮可探入你的思绪，试图理解你的意思，不过停留时间不长。“对！正是那样！”她兴奋地拍了拍自己的腿，至少终于能把挫败感说出来。“在伟大齐姆的阴影下，到底要怎样向无法领会的人解释如此根本的东西？”她靠向你，回以依偎，努力让自己冷静。“至少您的种族懂得如何表达这种挫败，我的卡尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke probes your mind, in an effort to understand what you mean, but she isn’t in there for long. “Yes! Exactly like that!” she says, clapping herself on the leg, excited that she can at least vocalize her frustrations. “How in the Grand Qim’s shadow do you explain something so fundamental to someone that cannot grasp it?” She leans into you, reciprocating the snuggle as she tries to calm herself down. “At least your kind knows how to communicate such frustrations, my Qal.”"

rows.original: You stroke at her scalp, and the motion has a rather immediate effect: the tension you had felt over the link with your daughter dissipates immediately, and she leans into your scratching fingers affectionately. You two can try again later, if she’d like.
rows.translation: 你抚摸她的头皮，动作立刻产生效果：你从与女儿的联系中感受到的紧张顿时消散，她亲昵地把脑袋贴向你抓挠的手指。如果她愿意，你们以后可以再试。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stroke at her scalp, and the motion has a rather immediate effect: the tension you had felt over the link with your daughter dissipates immediately, and she leans into your scratching fingers affectionately. You two can try again later, if she’d like."

rows.original: “I think I’d like that, my Qal,” she says drearily, the frustration taking a lot out of her energy. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”
rows.translation: “我想我愿意，我的卡尔，”她无精打采地说道，挫败感耗去了她许多精力。“这样我也有时间想一想。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think I’d like that, my Qal,” she says drearily, the frustration taking a lot out of her energy. “It’ll give me some time to think about it.”"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: Psionics
rows.translation: 灵能
rows.raw: "Psionics"

rows.original: You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little upset over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now.
rows.translation: 你们刚刚才为此折腾了那么久！妮可仍因没能教会你使用灵能而有些难过，现在最好别得寸进尺。
rows.raw: "You had just had a whole ordeal about this! Nykke is still a little upset over her inability to teach you to use psionics, so it’d be best to not press your luck for more right now."

rows.original: Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world outside of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair.
rows.translation: 你忽然问妮可，她对[frostwyrm.name]巢穴之外的世界了解多少。
rows.raw: "Out of turn, you ask Nykke what she knows about the world outside of [frostwyrm.name]’s lair."

rows.original: She has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across the ceiling of her little room, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “There is no shortage of potential mates out there, although our Qim says that she was searching for another of her own kind before she met you.”
rows.translation: 她必须思考片刻才答得出来：她敲着下巴，目光在小房间的天花板上游移，琢磨该如何组织回答。“我听说外面非常大，”过了一会儿，她说道。“那里不缺潜在配偶，不过我们的齐姆说，在遇见您以前，她一直在寻找另一个同族。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe has to think about her answer for a moment: she taps at her chin and roams her eyes across the ceiling of her little room, considering how to formulate her response. “I’m told that it’s very large,” she says, after a moment. “There is no shortage of potential mates out there, although our Qim says that she was searching for another of her own kind before she met you.”"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm
rows.translation: 你告诉妮可，你并不是霜龙
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you aren’t a Frostwyrm"

rows.original: , or, at least, you weren’t always, you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace].
rows.translation: ，或者至少并非一直如此；你出生时是[pc.aOriginalRace]。
rows.raw: ", or, at least, you weren’t always, you were born as [pc.aOriginalRace]."

rows.original: , you’re [pc.aRace].
rows.translation: ，你是[pc.aRace]。
rows.raw: ", you’re [pc.aRace]."

rows.original: You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Um....”
rows.translation: 你让她猜一猜世上有多少你的同族。“几百个？”她问，你告诉她远不止。“几千个？”还要更多。她集中精神眯起双眼。“呃....”
rows.raw: " You ask her to guess how many of your kind exist. “Hundreds?” she asks, and you tell her there are more. “Thousands?” More than that. Her eyes squint in concentration. “Um....”"

rows.original: There are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist.
rows.translation: 你的同族数量远超她能够正确想象的程度：那数字大到她或许根本无法理解其规模。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are more of your own kind than she might be able to properly envision: a number so large that she might not be able to understand the magnitude of how many exist."

rows.original: And, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there.
