Your kind have named the world as Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] know it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it.
rows.translation: 除了你的同族数量如此庞大，外面还有其他世界。你的种族把妮可和[frostwyrm.name]所知的这个世界称为“乌维托”；你已经去过许多其他星球、与许多其他种族接触，多到很难全部归类。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd, on top of there being so many of your own kind, there are other worlds out there. Your kind have named the world as Nykke and [frostwyrm.name] know it as ‘Uveto;’ you’ve been to so many other planets and interacted with so many other kinds by now, that you’d have a hard time categorizing all of it."

rows.original: You start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “Yes!” she says excitedly, happy that she’s catching up to your discussion. “‘Warm’ is what we feel when we curl up with each other, my Qal. Although, and forgive me for saying, but... our Qim is much better at making us warm than you are.”
rows.translation: 你从简单的开始：问妮可是否知道“温暖”是什么意思。“知道！”她兴奋地说道，为终于跟上你的话题而高兴。“‘温暖’就是我们彼此蜷缩依偎时的感觉，我的卡尔。不过，请原谅我这样说，但...我们的齐姆比您更擅长让大家暖和。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou start simple: you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be warm. “Yes!” she says excitedly, happy that she’s catching up to your discussion. “‘Warm’ is what we feel when we curl up with each other, my Qal. Although, and forgive me for saying, but... our Qim is much better at making us warm than you are.”"

rows.original: With a laugh, you forgive her, and agree: [frostwyrm.name] is very good at keeping her clutch warm. But, to continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’
rows.translation: 你笑着原谅她，并表示赞同：[frostwyrm.name]确实很擅长让整窝幼崽保持温暖。不过，为了继续话题，你问妮可是否知道“炎热”是什么意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a laugh, you forgive her, and agree: [frostwyrm.name] is very good at keeping her clutch warm. But, to continue, you ask Nykke if she knows what it means to be ‘hot.’"

rows.original: You feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Um...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? Is there truly such a thing?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breathe; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it.
rows.translation: 你感觉到同样的思绪拉扯，却让她用自己的话回答。“呃...，”她结巴道。“不知道。”你告诉她，简单来说，“炎热”就是温暖过了头。“太温暖？真的会有这种事吗？”是的，确实会：太温暖时，你会觉得窒息，仿佛困在自己的身体里。周围空气太热，呼吸便会疼；脚下地面太热，行走便会疼。当热意无处不在时，你会觉得...根本无处可逃。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel the same tugging at your mind, but ask her to answer in her own words. “Um...,” she stutters. “No.” You teach her that, basically, ‘hot’ is what happens when you’re too warm. “Too warm? Is there truly such a thing?” There is, yes: when you’re too warm, it feels like you’re suffocating, and that you’re trapped in your own body. If the air around you is too warm, it hurts to breathe; if the ground beneath you is too warm, it hurts to walk. When the warmth is all-pervasive, you can feel like there’s just... nothing you can do to escape it."

rows.original: “But, my Qal, it can feel that way if we are too cold, as well,” she notes. You’re proud that she’s thinking like that! And she’s right: if it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot.
rows.translation: “可是，我的卡尔，如果太冷，不也会有这种感觉吗？”她指出这一点。她能这样思考令你自豪！她说得没错：太冷时也会同样受限、同样痛苦。正如乌维托这样永远严寒的地方，也会有永远酷热的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But, my Qal, it can feel that way if we are too cold, as well,” she notes. You’re proud that she’s thinking like that! And she’s right: if it’s too cold, then it can feel just as limiting and painful. Just as there are places like Uveto that are always very cold, there can be places that are always very hot."

rows.original: “Is there any place that is neither?” Nykke asks disdainfully; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if your daughter is anything like you, she’ll have the strength and the knowledge to survive any environment, too.
rows.translation: “有没有两者都不是的地方？”妮可不满地问；她很难相信这个世界——或者这些世界——竟会如此艰苦无情。你回答，有些地方可能太热，有些地方可能太冷；但能克服这些阻碍，在这样的环境中生存、甚至茁壮成长，正是令你的种族如此坚韧的原因。若你的女儿有任何地方像你，她也会拥有在任何环境中生存的力量与知识。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is there any place that is neither?” Nykke asks disdainfully; she’s finding it hard to believe that the world – or worlds – can be such difficult, unforgiving places to be. You answer that some places may be too warm, and some places may be too cold, but being able to overcome those obstacles and survive, and even thrive, in such environments is what makes kinds like your own so hardy. And, if your daughter is anything like you, she’ll have the strength and the knowledge to survive any environment, too."

rows.original: Now that you’ve properly gotten Nykke hooked on your stories, you continue enthusiastically; you start with your parentage and that you’re an heir to... well, it’d be a difficult to explain in a way she understands, but, in the very barest, lamest terms you can, you explain that your own parent had passed away some time ago, and you’re on a journey to reclaim his own lair for yourself.
rows.translation: 妮可已经彻底被你的故事吸引，你便兴致勃勃地继续；从自己的身世讲起，说你是某个东西的继承人...好吧，要用她能理解的方式解释很困难，但你用最粗略、最乏味的说法告诉她：你的父亲不久前去世，而你正踏上旅程，要为自己夺回他的巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n\nNow that you’ve properly gotten Nykke hooked on your stories, you continue enthusiastically; you start with your parentage and that you’re an heir to... well, it’d be a difficult to explain in a way she understands, but, in the very barest, lamest terms you can, you explain that your own parent had passed away some time ago, and you’re on a journey to reclaim his own lair for yourself."

rows.original: “You did not stay with your Qim and your Qal until they were summoned?” Nykke asks, and you confirm; your kind typically only stay with their parents until they’re fully matured, and then they set out on their own, to find their own lairs and their own mates. And, for reasons you’re not about to go into too much detail about, you never celebrated ‘inner circle coupling’ with your parents, either.
rows.translation: “您没有和自己的齐姆、卡尔待在一起，直到他们受到召唤吗？”妮可问。你予以确认：你的种族通常只与父母生活到完全成熟，之后便独自出发，寻找自己的巢穴和配偶。而且，出于一些你不准备详细解释的原因，你也从未和父母庆祝过“内圈交合”。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You did not stay with your Qim and your Qal until they were summoned?” Nykke asks, and you confirm; your kind typically only stay with their parents until they’re fully matured, and then they set out on their own, to find their own lairs and their own mates. And, for reasons you’re not about to go into too much detail about, you never celebrated ‘inner circle coupling’ with your parents, either."

rows.original: But anyway, you’re getting a bit sidetracked. When your own father was, as Nykke would understand it, ‘summoned,’ you had set out on a mission to claim what was his for your own. That’s taken you to planets full of lush, dense, green jungle; planets of trashy, difficult, desert terrain and wasteland; deep into dark, rocky caves; and even to very small, man-made planets called ‘stations.’ Uveto is just one of the more recent stops in your mission to claim your inheritance.
rows.translation: 不过，你有些跑题了。当你的父亲——用妮可能理解的说法——“受到召唤”后，你便踏上任务，要把他的一切据为己有。旅途带你去过遍布茂密翠绿丛林的星球；充斥垃圾、遍地荒漠与废土、环境艰苦的星球；深入黑暗岩石洞穴；甚至去过被称为“空间站”的极小人造星球。乌维托只是你夺取遗产之旅中较近的一站。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut anyway, you’re getting a bit sidetracked. When your own father was, as Nykke would understand it, ‘summoned,’ you had set out on a mission to claim what was his for your own. That’s taken you to planets full of lush, dense, green jungle; planets of trashy, difficult, desert terrain and wasteland; deep into dark, rocky caves; and even to very small, man-made planets called ‘stations.’ Uveto is just one of the more recent stops in your mission to claim your inheritance."

rows.original: You feel something pulling at your mind; a curious, probing sensation, rummaging through your memories, almost the same way that [frostwyrm.name] plucks at your head when you use a word she doesn’t understand. As interested as Nykke is on your stories, she doesn’t understand half the things you’re saying. She probably doesn’t even know what a ‘green’ is, never mind a ‘jungle.’
rows.translation: 你感觉某种东西在拉扯思绪；那是一种好奇而探索的触感，在记忆中翻找，几乎与[frostwyrm.name]听见不理解的词时拨弄你脑海的方式一样。妮可虽然对故事很感兴趣，却有一半内容都听不懂。她或许连“绿色”是什么都不知道，更别说“丛林”。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou feel something pulling at your mind; a curious, probing sensation, rummaging through your memories, almost the same way that [frostwyrm.name] plucks at your head when you use a word she doesn’t understand. As interested as Nykke is on your stories, she doesn’t understand half the things you’re saying. She probably doesn’t even know what a ‘green’ is, never mind a ‘jungle.’"

rows.original: “Could any of us travel to any of these places as well?” Nykke asks. You can feel her imagination running wild in your own head: she doesn’t like the idea of being somewhere that’s too hot, or someplace that’s somehow even colder than Uveto, but she nonetheless wants to explore them for her own. You tell her that she could – there’s nothing saying she couldn’t travel the stars with you, and visit all these new locations with you – but... well, one thing at a time.
rows.translation: “我们也能去这些地方吗？”妮可问。你能在自己脑中感受到她的想象力尽情驰骋：她不喜欢去太热的地方，也不喜欢比乌维托还冷的地方，但依然想亲自探索。你告诉她当然可以——没有什么规定她不能与你遨游群星、一起造访这些新地点——但是...好吧，一件事一件事来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Could any of us travel to any of these places as well?” Nykke asks. You can feel her imagination running wild in your own head: she doesn’t like the idea of being somewhere that’s too hot, or someplace that’s somehow even colder than Uveto, but she nonetheless wants to explore them for her own. You tell her that she could – there’s nothing saying she couldn’t travel the stars with you, and visit all these new locations with you – but... well, one thing at a time."

rows.original: Nykke relaxes her body against you, her cheek against your collarbone, as she idly fantasizes about leaving the lair with you and traveling with you on your adventures. The two of you would travel to these ‘hot’ places; she could fly over the tops of the ‘jungles’ and she would help you navigate the dark ‘caves,’ and then
rows.translation: 妮可放松身体靠着你，脸颊贴在锁骨上，漫不经心地幻想与你离开巢穴、共同冒险。你们会前往那些“炎热”的地方；她可以飞过“丛林”顶端，也会帮助你穿越黑暗“洞穴”，然后
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke relaxes her body against you, her cheek against your collarbone, as she idly fantasizes about leaving the lair with you and traveling with you on your adventures. The two of you would travel to these ‘hot’ places; she could fly over the tops of the ‘jungles’ and she would help you navigate the dark ‘caves,’ and then"

rows.original: , when you two find a spot that isn’t too warm, or too cold, or too jungle or too cave, she finds the perfect lair, one as big as [frostwyrm.name]’s, where she and her mate can raise their own clutch.
rows.translation: ，当你们找到一处不太热、不太冷、既不太丛林也不太洞穴的地方，她会找到完美巢穴——一个和[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴一样大，能让她与配偶养育自己一窝幼崽的巢穴。
rows.raw: ", when you two find a spot that isn’t too warm, or too cold, or too jungle or too cave, she finds the perfect lair, one as big as [frostwyrm.name]’s, where she and her mate can raise their own clutch."

rows.original: Of course, this imaginary mate of hers is unmistakably you: in Nykke’s personal, unbridled fantasies, it’s you that she settles down with and makes a clutch with. A huge one. One that fills the jungles and the caves until they’re full of nothing but your clutch; you two would find a world that has no Frostwyrms in it, and you’d spread your kind until you are the dominant species.
rows.translation: 当然，她想象中的配偶毫无疑问就是你：在妮可私密而毫无拘束的幻想中，她与你安定下来，和你孕育一窝幼崽。一窝极其庞大的幼崽，多到塞满丛林与洞穴，直到那里除你们的后代外什么都不剩；你们会找到一个没有霜龙的世界，不断繁衍自己的种族，直至成为优势物种。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course, this imaginary mate of hers is unmistakably you: in Nykke’s personal, unbridled fantasies, it’s you that she settles down with and makes a clutch with. A huge one. One that fills the jungles and the caves until they’re full of nothing but your clutch; you two would find a world that has no Frostwyrms in it, and you’d spread your kind until you are the dominant species."

rows.original: You let Nykke entertain herself and her fantasies, up until you feel something hard, hot, and squishy poke against your [pc.thigh]; her own legs grind wantonly against you, until she’s unquestionably humping you. At that, you clear your throat, and she stops everything immediately.
rows.translation: 你任由妮可沉浸在自己的幻想中，直到某个坚硬、滚烫又柔软的东西顶住[pc.thigh]；她的双腿淫荡地蹭着你，毫无疑问已在骑着你摩擦。你清了清嗓子，她立刻停下一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let Nykke entertain herself and her fantasies, up until you feel something hard, hot, and squishy poke against your [pc.thigh]; her own legs grind wantonly against you, until she’s unquestionably humping you. At that, you clear your throat, and she stops everything immediately."

rows.original: Sorry, she says to you over your psionic connection.
rows.translation: 对不起，她通过灵能连接对你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nSorry, she says to you over your psionic connection."

rows.original: You don’t chide her, but you remind her: one thing at a time.
rows.translation: 你没有责骂她，只提醒她：一件事一件事来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t chide her, but you remind her: one thing at a time."

rows.original: that’s for sure.
rows.translation: 那倒是肯定的。
rows.raw: " that’s for sure."

rows.original: She fidgets slightly, as she realizes that her fantasies are pouring through her and into you. Just as you begin to feel a tinge of what is unmistakably lustful longing, she catches herself, and ceases her rampant, unbridled psionic fantasies.
rows.translation: 意识到自己的幻想正从体内涌出、流进你的意识，她微微局促起来。就在你开始感受到一丝毫无疑问属于情欲的渴望时，她及时回过神，停止了那肆意奔放的灵能幻想。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe fidgets slightly, as she realizes that her fantasies are pouring through her and into you. Just as you begin to feel a tinge of what is unmistakably lustful longing, she catches herself, and ceases her rampant, unbridled psionic fantasies."

rows.original: “I’d like to do that with you someday, my Qal. If I can.”
rows.translation: “总有一天，我也想和你一起做那件事，我的Qal。如果可以的话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’d like to do that with you someday, my Qal. If I can.”"

rows.original: One thing at a time, Nykke.
rows.translation: 一步一步来，妮可。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne thing at a time, Nykke."

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: Adventuring
rows.translation: 冒险
rows.raw: "Adventuring"

rows.original: You’ve just talked about this! The idea of traveling the stars and seeing new cultures and peoples is an exciting idea for Nykke
rows.translation: 你们刚刚才谈过这个！遨游群星、见识新的文化与民族，对妮可而言是个令人兴奋的想法
rows.raw: "You’ve just talked about this! The idea of traveling the stars and seeing new cultures and peoples is an exciting idea for Nykke"

rows.original: You nudge at Nykke, getting her attention. “Yes, my Qal?” she says attentively, her eyes locking onto yours. You get the feeling that she already knows what you’re going to talk about.
rows.translation: 你轻推妮可，引起她的注意。“怎么了，我的Qal？”她专注地说道，目光与你相接。你感觉她已经知道你想谈什么。
rows.raw: "You nudge at Nykke, getting her attention. “Yes, my Qal?” she says attentively, her eyes locking onto yours. You get the feeling that she already knows what you’re going to talk about."

rows.original: You’re currently choosing to participate in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ In other words, you’re consciously choosing to have sex with your daughters. Are you going to change your stance on this and opt out?
rows.translation: 你目前选择参与霜龙的“内圈交配”传统。换句话说，你有意识地选择与自己的女儿发生性关系。你要改变立场并退出吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re currently choosing to participate in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ In other words, you’re consciously choosing to have sex with your daughters. Are you going to change your stance on this and opt out?"

rows.original: You’re currently choosing not to participate in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ In other words, you’re consciously choosing to not have sex with your daughters. Are you going to change your stance on this and opt in?
rows.translation: 你目前选择不参与霜龙的“内圈交配”传统。换句话说，你有意识地选择不与自己的女儿发生性关系。你要改变立场并加入吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re currently choosing not to participate in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling.’ In other words, you’re consciously choosing to not have sex with your daughters. Are you going to change your stance on this and opt in?"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: Change your stance on ‘inner circle coupling’.
rows.translation: 改变你对“内圈交配”的立场。
rows.raw: "Change your stance on ‘inner circle coupling’."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Do not change your stance on ‘inner circle coupling’.
rows.translation: 不要改变你对“内圈交配”的立场。
rows.raw: "Do not change your stance on ‘inner circle coupling’."

rows.original: You tell Nykke that, as much as you enjoyed participating in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling’ up until this point, you think you need a bit of a break from it, and to not engage in the act with you for the time being.
rows.translation: 你告诉妮可，尽管你一直很享受参与霜龙的“内圈交配”传统，但现在觉得需要稍微休息一下，暂时不要再与你进行这种行为。
rows.raw: "You tell Nykke that, as much as you enjoyed participating in the Frostwyrm tradition of ‘inner circle coupling’ up until this point, you think you need a bit of a break from it, and to not engage in the act with you for the time being."

rows.original: “Aw,” she pouts, her hand snaking its way up your [pc.chest]. “Can I not convince you to stay, my Qal?” You tell her that you’ve made up your mind, and, with some authority, you tell her to respect the decision of her Qal.
rows.translation: “啊，”她撅起嘴，手沿你的[pc.chest]向上游走。“我不能说服你留下吗，我的Qal？”你告诉她自己已经下定决心，并以几分威严命令她尊重Qal的决定。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Aw,” she pouts, her hand snaking its way up your [pc.chest]. “Can I not convince you to stay, my Qal?” You tell her that you’ve made up your mind, and, with some authority, you tell her to respect the decision of her Qal."

rows.original: “Alright, then, if you say so.” Her hand stops its questing up your body, and she resumes her platonic snuggling up against you. “Be sure to let me know if you change your mind, of course.”
rows.translation: “好吧，既然你这么说。”她的手停止在你身上探索，重新以单纯亲昵的方式依偎着你。“当然，如果改变主意，一定要告诉我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, then, if you say so.” Her hand stops its questing up your body, and she resumes her platonic snuggling up against you. “Be sure to let me know if you change your mind, of course.”"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you’ve changed your mind: it feels inappropriate to be surrounded by Frostwyrms, in a Frostwyrm lair, and not be a part of their traditions. You’d like begin participating in these ‘inner circle couplings.’
rows.translation: 你告诉妮可，你改变主意了：身处霜龙巢穴、被霜龙围绕，却不参与她们的传统，感觉并不合适。你想开始参与这些“内圈交配”。
rows.raw: "You tell Nykke that you’ve changed your mind: it feels inappropriate to be surrounded by Frostwyrms, in a Frostwyrm lair, and not be a part of their traditions. You’d like begin participating in these ‘inner circle couplings.’"

rows.original: Nykke’s eyes gleam with joy, and her mouth splits into a wide, excited grin - but, then, the corners crook upward slightly, making her look almost devilish and predatory. “I was hoping you’d change your mind, my Qal,” she says lasciviously, her long, flat tongue snaking out to lick at her chops. “I’ll make sure you won’t regret it.”
rows.translation: 妮可眼中闪烁喜悦，嘴角咧成兴奋的灿烂笑容——可紧接着，嘴角又略微上挑，令她几乎显得邪恶而充满掠食性。“我一直希望你会改变主意，我的Qal，”她淫荡地说道，长而扁平的舌头伸出来舔了舔嘴角。“我保证你不会后悔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke’s eyes gleam with joy, and her mouth splits into a wide, excited grin - but, then, the corners crook upward slightly, making her look almost devilish and predatory. “I was hoping you’d change your mind, my Qal,” she says lasciviously, her long, flat tongue snaking out to lick at her chops. “I’ll make sure you won’t regret it.”"

rows.original: From the way she eyes you like a piece of meat, you’re not sure if you should be worried or aroused.
rows.translation: 看她像盯着一块肉般打量你，你不知道自己该担忧还是兴奋。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the way she eyes you like a piece of meat, you’re not sure if you should be worried or aroused."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You tell Nykke that it’s nothing, and for her to never mind herself.
rows.translation: 你告诉妮可没什么，让她别放在心上。
rows.raw: "You tell Nykke that it’s nothing, and for her to never mind herself."

rows.original: “Okay, my Qal, if you say so,” she says, lowering her head and resuming her platonic snuggling against you.
rows.translation: “好吧，我的Qal，既然你这么说，”她低下头，继续单纯地依偎着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, my Qal, if you say so,” she says, lowering her head and resuming her platonic snuggling against you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Lying as you are next to Nykke, you snake your hand down one of her large, muscular arms, until your hand meets hers. You intermingle your fingers with her claws, and give her hand an affectionate squeeze. You feel Nykke probe your mind for a moment, likely trying to find the significance of the action – and when she finds it, she squeezes back. A little too hard, at first, but then she eases up.
rows.translation: 你躺在妮可身旁，手沿她一条粗壮有力的手臂向下滑，直到与她的手相触。你将手指与她的利爪交错，亲昵地握了握她的手。你感觉妮可短暂探查了你的心智，大概是在寻找这个动作的含义——找到后，她也回握了你。起初用力稍大，随后便放轻了。
rows.raw: "Lying as you are next to Nykke, you snake your hand down one of her large, muscular arms, until your hand meets hers. You intermingle your fingers with her claws, and give her hand an affectionate squeeze. You feel Nykke probe your mind for a moment, likely trying to find the significance of the action – and when she finds it, she squeezes back. A little too hard, at first, but then she eases up."

rows.original: You tell Nykke that you’d like to talk to her about something, but she doesn’t need to answer if she isn’t ready. You recognize that it’s a bit of a sensitive topic for her.
rows.translation: 你告诉妮可，自己想和她谈件事，但如果她还没准备好，就不必回答。你知道这对她而言是个有些敏感的话题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell Nykke that you’d like to talk to her about something, but she doesn’t need to answer if she isn’t ready. You recognize that it’s a bit of a sensitive topic for her."

rows.original: “It’s about my scales, isn’t it?” she asks dejectedly. You respond affirmatively.
rows.translation: “是关于我的鳞片，对吗？”她沮丧地问道。你肯定地回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s about my scales, isn’t it?” she asks dejectedly. You respond affirmatively."

rows.original: Nykke says nothing further, and instead lets out a long, heavy sigh. With the three arms you’re not holding, she lifts her hands to her eyes, so she can get a closer look at her own body. Her onyx-black scales reflect the light of her lair with a brilliant dark sheen, making it easy to focus on her compared to the whites and off-blues of the rest of the lair.
rows.translation: 妮可没有再说什么，只发出一声沉重悠长的叹息。她用没被你握住的三条手臂把手抬到眼前，以便更仔细地观察自己的身体。黑玛瑙般的鳞片反射着巢穴中的光，泛出耀眼的暗色光泽；与巢穴其他地方的白色和淡蓝色相比，她格外醒目。
rows.raw: "\n\nNykke says nothing further, and instead lets out a long, heavy sigh. With the three arms you’re not holding, she lifts her hands to her eyes, so she can get a closer look at her own body. Her onyx-black scales reflect the light of her lair with a brilliant dark sheen, making it easy to focus on her compared to the whites and off-blues of the rest of the lair."

rows.original: “Sometimes, I think about how awkward our Qim must feel in her own lair,” Nykke says suddenly, her tone still sombre. You wait patiently for her to continue. “She has you, the most wonderful Qal in the world, and she has me
rows.translation: “有时候，我会想我们的Qim在自己的巢穴里一定觉得很不自在，”妮可突然说道，语气依然低落。你耐心等她继续。“她有你，世上最出色的Qal，也有我
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sometimes, I think about how awkward our Qim must feel in her own lair,” Nykke says suddenly, her tone still sombre. You wait patiently for her to continue. “She has you, the most wonderful Qal in the world, and she has me"

rows.original: , and she has the rest of her clutch
rows.translation: ，还有她其余的这一窝孩子
rows.raw: ", and she has the rest of her clutch"

rows.original: – but she’s the only pure-blooded of her kind in the lair. I’d do anything for her, and I couldn’t imagine having anyone else as my Qim, but....”
rows.translation: ——可她是巢穴里唯一的纯血同族。我愿意为她做任何事，也无法想象让别人当我的Qim，可是....”
rows.raw: "– but she’s the only pure-blooded of her kind in the lair. I’d do anything for her, and I couldn’t imagine having anyone else as my Qim, but....”"

rows.original: Instead of finishing the thought, Nykke turns to you, to look into your eyes. “Do you think our Qim ever gets... I don’t know... lonely? That there aren’t others of her pure-blooded kind here?”
rows.translation: 妮可没有把话说完，而是转向你，望进你的眼睛。“你觉得我们的Qim会不会有时感到...我不知道...孤独？因为这里没有其他纯血同族？”
rows.raw: "\n\nInstead of finishing the thought, Nykke turns to you, to look into your eyes. “Do you think our Qim ever gets... I don’t know... lonely? That there aren’t others of her pure-blooded kind here?”"

rows.original: You respond, with all sincerity, that [frostwyrm.name] has never once wanted for company since she took you on as her mate, and she had you as her kip. <i>“Even though we’re not
rows.translation: 你无比真诚地回答，自从[frostwyrm.name]把你收为伴侣、拥有你这个幼崽后，她从未缺少陪伴。<i>“即使我们不是
rows.raw: "\n\nYou respond, with all sincerity, that [frostwyrm.name] has never once wanted for company since she took you on as her mate, and she had you as her kip. <i>“Even though we’re not"

rows.original: pure-blooded,
rows.translation: 纯血，
rows.raw: " pure-blooded,"

rows.original: like her?”

rows.original: NYKKE_FUCK_YOUR_CUNT
rows.raw: "NYKKE_FUCK_YOUR_CUNT"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: frostwyrm
rows.raw: "frostwyrm"

rows.original: SIRETTA.FROSTWYRM LAIR.FROSTWYRM LAIR
rows.raw: "SIRETTA.FROSTWYRM LAIR.FROSTWYRM LAIR"

rows.original: B

You go through your typical ritual of removing your effects and setting them safely in the corner of the lair as [frostwyrm.name] makes her way towards her familiar, elevated ice platform. When your vision focuses on the lair and its whole, dome-shaped entirety, you can’t help but feel that... something is different. You can’t quite put your finger on it.
rows.translation: 你依照往常的仪式，卸下随身物品并安全放到巢穴角落，而[frostwyrm.name]则前往熟悉的高架冰台。当视线聚焦于巢穴以及它完整的穹顶状空间时，你忍不住感觉...有些地方不同了，却无法准确指出。
rows.raw: "You go through your typical ritual of removing your effects and setting them safely in the corner of the lair as [frostwyrm.name] makes her way towards her familiar, elevated ice platform. When your vision focuses on the lair and its whole, dome-shaped entirety, you can’t help but feel that... something is different. You can’t quite put your finger on it."

rows.original: “Our first kip has proven rather... industrious, my Qal, in the time since you had last left us,” [frostwyrm.name] says to you, sensing your unease and knowing what has your curiosity. “Perhaps a trait inherited from its Qal. My kind are not typically so assiduous with their lairs.”
rows.translation: “从你上次离开我们之后，我们的第一个幼崽已经证明自己颇为...勤奋，我的Qal，”[frostwyrm.name]察觉你的不安，也清楚好奇的来源，向你说道，“或许这是从它的Qal继承的特质。我的种族通常不会如此勤勉地经营巢穴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our first kip has proven rather... industrious, my Qal, in the time since you had last left us,” [frostwyrm.name] says to you, sensing your unease and knowing what has your curiosity. “Perhaps a trait inherited from its Qal. My kind are not typically so assiduous with their lairs.”"

rows.original: In the far corner of the lair, you see a large opening that you hadn’t noticed before – if it was there to begin with. You eyeball the opening to be maybe fourteen feet in diameter: too small for [frostwyrm.name] to fit through, but just large enough for a Frostwyrmling.
rows.translation: 在巢穴远处角落，你看见一个以前不曾注意的大型开口，如果它最初就存在的话。你目测直径大约十四英尺：[frostwyrm.name]无法穿过，但刚好足以容纳一只霜龙幼体。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn the far corner of the lair, you see a large opening that you hadn’t noticed before – if it was there to begin with. You eyeball the opening to be maybe fourteen feet in diameter: too small for [frostwyrm.name] to fit through, but just large enough for a Frostwyrmling."

rows.original: “Our first toils within,” [frostwyrm.name] says, motioning towards the cave. “Our first is much too young yet to survey for its own nest, and yet, our first yearns for a dwelling all their own. It is unusual that any offspring would show such desires so early, though I would not aim to stifle their instincts. I have acquiesced to a personal dwelling within my own.”
rows.translation: “我们的第一个幼崽正在里面劳作，”[frostwyrm.name]朝洞穴示意道，“它还远远没有成长到能够勘探自己巢穴的年龄，却已经渴望拥有独属自己的住所。后代如此年幼便表现出这种欲望很不寻常，不过我不打算压抑它的本能。我已经同意让它在我的居所内拥有一处私人住所。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Our first toils within,” [frostwyrm.name] says, motioning towards the cave. “Our first is much too young yet to survey for its own nest, and yet, our first yearns for a dwelling all their own. It is unusual that any offspring would show such desires so early, though I would not aim to stifle their instincts. I have acquiesced to a personal dwelling within my own.”"

rows.original: You hear the occasional chipping sound reverberate from within the cave; it sounds like a rock against another rock, followed by a loud clanging of ice breaking apart and falling to the floor of the lair. You ask [frostwyrm.name] if you’re allowed to go inside. “It is not my nest, my Qal. That is not for me to decide,” [frostwyrm.name] responds, with a particular lilt to her tone, as if she were daring you to go and invite yourself into your eldest kip’s abode without permission.
rows.translation: 你偶尔能听见洞内传出凿击声，在洞穴中回荡；听起来像岩石撞击岩石，随后是冰块碎裂坠落到巢穴地面的响亮铿锵声。你询问[frostwyrm.name]是否允许进入。“那不是我的巢穴，我的Qal。这不该由我决定，”[frostwyrm.name]回答，语调带着特别的起伏，仿佛正在激你不经允许便自行进入最年长幼崽的住处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hear the occasional chipping sound reverberate from within the cave; it sounds like a rock against another rock, followed by a loud clanging of ice breaking apart and falling to the floor of the lair. You ask [frostwyrm.name] if you’re allowed to go inside. “It is not my nest, my Qal. That is not for me to decide,” [frostwyrm.name] responds, with a particular lilt to her tone, as if she were daring you to go and invite yourself into your eldest kip’s abode without permission."

rows.original: Well, you decide, she might have a bedroom, but she’s still living in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. You approach the mouth of the cave.
rows.translation: 好吧，你作出决定，她或许拥有一间卧室，却仍住在[frostwyrm.name]的巢穴里。你走近洞口。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you decide, she might have a bedroom, but she’s still living in [frostwyrm.name]’s lair. You approach the mouth of the cave."

rows.original: “What is a ‘bedroom?’” [frostwyrm.name] asks you curiously.
rows.translation: “‘卧室’是什么？”[frostwyrm.name]好奇地问你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What is a ‘bedroom?’” [frostwyrm.name] asks you curiously."

rows.original: You tell her that you’ll explain later.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，以后再解释。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that you’ll explain later."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Hazard Team
rows.translation: 危险处理小队
rows.raw: "Hazard Team"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: You hand the two key cards to the hazard team leader. He takes them and thanks you.
rows.translation: 你把两张钥匙卡交给危险处理小队队长。他接过卡片，向你道谢。
rows.raw: "You hand the two key cards to the hazard team leader. He takes them and thanks you."

rows.original: Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card
rows.raw: "Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card"

rows.original: Steele Biomedical Lab Storage Card
rows.raw: "Steele Biomedical Lab Storage Card"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Hazard Team
rows.translation: 危险处理小队
rows.raw: "Hazard Team"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: You decide to keep the key cards.
rows.translation: 你决定留下钥匙卡。
rows.raw: "You decide to keep the key cards."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Removing your armor would have the effect of quickly subjecting you to a truly gruesome simultaneous death by crushing and drowning. That would not be the most illustrious end to the adventures of Captain Steele.
rows.translation: 脱下护甲会让你很快同时遭到挤压和溺水，以极其惨烈的方式死去。这可不是斯蒂尔船长冒险生涯最光彩的结局。
rows.raw: "Removing your armor would have the effect of quickly subjecting you to a truly gruesome simultaneous death by crushing and drowning. That would not be the most illustrious end to the adventures of Captain Steele."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: UVETO_DEEPSEALAB_STEPS
rows.raw: "UVETO_DEEPSEALAB_STEPS"

rows.original: You can hear scuttling noises echoing throughout the halls, making it hard not to shiver. What is that?
rows.translation: 你能听见爬动声在各处走廊回荡，令人不由自主地发抖。那到底是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can hear scuttling noises echoing throughout the halls, making it hard not to shiver. What is that?"

rows.original: You can hear the jellyfish infesting the facility all around you, though with all the echoing it’s hard to tell exactly where they might be.
rows.translation: 你能听见侵占设施的水母遍布四周，不过回声太多，很难判断它们究竟在哪里。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can hear the jellyfish infesting the facility all around you, though with all the echoing it’s hard to tell exactly where they might be."

rows.original: The sounds of the remaining jellyfish are fainter now than before, but you know you haven’t gotten them all. One could pop out at any moment.
rows.translation: 剩余水母发出的声音比之前微弱，但你知道自己并未消灭全部。随时都可能有一只突然冒出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sounds of the remaining jellyfish are fainter now than before, but you know you haven’t gotten them all. One could pop out at any moment."

rows.original: You’re pretty sure you’ve killed most of the jellyfish, but there’s still the occasional noise of one’s presence somewhere nearby. It’s almost worse when there’s just one left.
rows.translation: 你很确定自己已经杀死大部分水母，但附近某处偶尔仍会传来表明其中一只存在的声响。只剩一只时几乎更加糟糕。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re pretty sure you’ve killed most of the jellyfish, but there’s still the occasional noise of one’s presence somewhere nearby. It’s almost worse when there’s just one left."

rows.original: The hallways are mercifully quiet. You think you’ve managed to kill all of the jellyfish roaming the facility.
rows.translation: 走廊终于安静下来。你觉得自己已经消灭了设施里游荡的所有水母。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hallways are mercifully quiet. You think you’ve managed to kill all of the jellyfish roaming the facility."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Although the shaft is now open, the maintenance crews shoo you away. Large signs and cordon tape warn that the area is under repairs. It looks like you won’t be able to go back down for a while.
rows.translation: 虽然竖井已经开放，维修人员却把你赶走。巨大的标志和警戒带警告此区域正在维修。看来一段时间内你都无法再次下去。
rows.raw: "Although the shaft is now open, the maintenance crews shoo you away. Large signs and cordon tape warn that the area is under repairs. It looks like you won’t be able to go back down for a while."

rows.original: The ID card you’ve been given will allow you access to the shaft, if you’re ready for whatever’s lurking down there.
rows.translation: 拿到的身份卡可以让你进入竖井，前提是你准备好面对潜伏在下面的任何东西。
rows.raw: "The ID card you’ve been given will allow you access to the shaft, if you’re ready for whatever’s lurking down there."

rows.original: A sign warns that anyone wishing to gain access to the research shaft should contact Dr. Lessau at the surface office.
rows.translation: 一块告示警告，任何希望进入研究竖井的人都应联系地面办公室的莱索医生。
rows.raw: "A sign warns that anyone wishing to gain access to the research shaft should contact Dr. Lessau at the surface office."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: UVI J36
rows.raw: "UVI J36"

rows.original: The ride back up the elevator is mercifully calmer than the ride down. Nothing bars your ascent, though you don’t feel fully safe until you’re off the platform and back on solid ground.
rows.translation: 乘电梯返回上方的过程幸好比下降时平静。没有东西阻挡你上升，不过直到离开平台、重新踏上坚实地面，你才真正感到安全。
rows.raw: "The ride back up the elevator is mercifully calmer than the ride down. Nothing bars your ascent, though you don’t feel fully safe until you’re off the platform and back on solid ground."

rows.original: A paramedic team is waiting, taking you in as you step off to ensure that you’re unharmed. Dr. Lessau and several members of his team are with them, looking relieved.
rows.translation: 一支急救小队正在等候。你走出电梯时，他们立刻把你接过去，确认你没有受伤。莱索医生和他的数名团队成员也在场，全都如释重负。
rows.raw: "\n\nA paramedic team is waiting, taking you in as you step off to ensure that you’re unharmed. Dr. Lessau and several members of his team are with them, looking relieved."

rows.original: “We just received notice that the power came back online. Are you alright, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: “我们刚收到电力恢复的通知。你没事吧，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We just received notice that the power came back online. Are you alright, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: You reassure Lessau that you’re fine, relaying the events underwater to him.
rows.translation: 你向莱索保证自己没事，并把水下发生的事情告诉他。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou reassure Lessau that you’re fine, relaying the events underwater to him."

rows.original: You briefly hesitate when it comes time to describe Typhon’s fate, opting to leave out the gory details, though there’s no skirting around the fact that you ended his suffering as his last words requested.
rows.translation: 说到堤丰的命运时，你短暂迟疑，决定略过血腥细节。不过，你遵照他最后的遗言终结了他的痛苦，这一点无法回避。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou briefly hesitate when it comes time to describe Typhon’s fate, opting to leave out the gory details, though there’s no skirting around the fact that you ended his suffering as his last words requested."

rows.original: “I see...if that’s what you thought was best, [pc.name]. Thank you.”
rows.translation: “我明白了...如果你认为那是最好的选择，[pc.name]。谢谢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I see...if that’s what you thought was best, [pc.name]. Thank you.”"

rows.original: You also hand over the data bead containing the broken Typhon AI, leaving out the gory details but describing the general mess that had been made of him. Lessau pockets the data bead with a sigh.
rows.translation: 你还交出装有损坏堤丰 AI 的数据珠，略过血腥细节，但大致描述了他遭到的严重破坏。莱索叹着气把数据珠收进口袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou also hand over the data bead containing the broken Typhon AI, leaving out the gory details but describing the general mess that had been made of him. Lessau pockets the data bead with a sigh."

rows.original: “Thank you, [pc.name]. I’ll try to make sure he doesn’t suffer.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你，[pc.name]。我会尽量确保他不再受苦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, [pc.name]. I’ll try to make sure he doesn’t suffer.”"

rows.original: “The hazard team will be here shortly, they’ll make sure the conduit that started this mess is sealed. I’ve sent notice about ensuring we take care to use sturdier insulation in the future when working down at the seabed.”
rows.translation: “危险处理小队很快就会抵达，他们会确保引发这场混乱的导管被封住。我已经发出通知，要求以后在海床作业时务必采用更坚固的绝缘材料。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The hazard team will be here shortly, they’ll make sure the conduit that started this mess is sealed. I’ve sent notice about ensuring we take care to use sturdier insulation in the future when working down at the seabed.”"

rows.original: You’re taken away by the paramedics shortly after, subjected to a thorough decontamination process to ensure that there’s no remains of the creature anywhere on you. Eventually you’re given a clean bill of health and let go, with the promise that both Akkadi and Steele Tech will be showing their appreciation in the near future.
rows.translation: 不久后，你被急救人员带走，接受彻底的净化程序，以确保身上任何地方都没有残留那种生物的组织。最终，你获准确认身体健康并被放行；阿卡迪和斯蒂尔科技承诺近期都会表达谢意。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re taken away by the paramedics shortly after, subjected to a thorough decontamination process to ensure that there’s no remains of the creature anywhere on you. Eventually you’re given a clean bill of health and let go, with the promise that both Akkadi and Steele Tech will be showing their appreciation in the near future."

rows.original: Do you turn in the two key cards you collected or keep them?
rows.translation: 你要上交收集到的两张钥匙卡，还是留下它们？
rows.raw: "\n\nDo you turn in the two key cards you collected or keep them?"

rows.original: Turn In
rows.translation: 上交
rows.raw: "Turn In"

rows.original: Keep
rows.translation: 留下
rows.raw: "Keep"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: SBRF LIFT
rows.raw: "SBRF LIFT"

rows.original: The elevator shaft looms above you, the surface a tiny pinprick of light in the distance.
rows.translation: 电梯竖井耸立在头顶，远处地表只是一点针尖大小的光。
rows.raw: "The elevator shaft looms above you, the surface a tiny pinprick of light in the distance."

rows.original: The elevator is operational again, you can return to the surface at any time. You should finish any business you have here, there probably won’t be any coming back.
rows.translation: 电梯已恢复运行，你随时可以返回地表。 你应该处理完这里的一切事务，因为很可能再也回不来了。
rows.raw: " The elevator is operational again, you can return to the surface at any time. You should finish any business you have here, there probably won’t be any coming back."

rows.original: The elevator descends swiftly down the research shaft, the clear tube giving you a view of the water outside. It starts out a calming blue, but gradually shifts to pitch-black as you leave the surface behind, moving towards the lightless depths of the ocean floor. You have a few miles to go, leaving you some time alone with your thoughts. This is seeming more and more a fool’s errand by the moment, but it’s too late to back out now.
rows.translation: 电梯沿研究竖井迅速下降，透明管壁让你看见外面的海水。起初是令人平静的蓝色，但随着你远离地表、驶向海床没有光线的深处，它逐渐变得漆黑。前方还有几英里，让你有时间独自思考。这件差事每一刻都显得更加愚蠢，但现在已经来不及退出。
rows.raw: "The elevator descends swiftly down the research shaft, the clear tube giving you a view of the water outside. It starts out a calming blue, but gradually shifts to pitch-black as you leave the surface behind, moving towards the lightless depths of the ocean floor. You have a few miles to go, leaving you some time alone with your thoughts. This is seeming more and more a fool’s errand by the moment, but it’s too late to back out now."

rows.original: Halfway down the shaft, you hear an unsettling clunk. You make a dash for the handrail, grabbing it just as the bright lights of the platform give way to the red of emergency lighting and the smooth descent of the elevator gives way to freefall. You hold on for dear life, your [pc.feet] almost lifting off the floor as you pick up speed, plummeting down thousands of feet in minutes. Your life flashes before your eyes: is this really how it ends, trapped in a collapsing elevator miles below the surface of a frozen wasteland?
rows.translation: 下降到竖井中途时，你听见一声令人不安的哐响。你冲向扶手，刚抓住它，平台的明亮灯光便变成红色应急照明，电梯平稳的下降也变成自由落体。你拼命抓紧，随着速度不断增加，[pc.feet]几乎离开地板，短短几分钟便坠落数千英尺。你的一生在眼前闪过：难道真要这样结束，被困在冰封荒原地表下数英里的坠毁电梯里？
rows.raw: "\n\nHalfway down the shaft, you hear an unsettling clunk. You make a dash for the handrail, grabbing it just as the bright lights of the platform give way to the red of emergency lighting and the smooth descent of the elevator gives way to freefall. You hold on for dear life, your [pc.feet] almost lifting off the floor as you pick up speed, plummeting down thousands of feet in minutes. Your life flashes before your eyes: is this really how it ends, trapped in a collapsing elevator miles below the surface of a frozen wasteland?"

rows.original: Pressure hits your [pc.legs] as your descent suddenly slows, which is much better than suddenly stopping. Your speed gradually decreases to something a little less frightening, the emergency inertial compensators doing their job of preventing you from turning into paste as the elevator makes its landing at the bottom.
rows.translation: 下降速度突然减缓，压力冲击你的[pc.legs]，但这总比突然停止好。紧急惯性补偿器发挥作用，防止你在电梯降落到底部时变成一摊肉泥，你的速度逐渐降低到没那么吓人的程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nPressure hits your [pc.legs] as your descent suddenly slows, which is much better than suddenly stopping. Your speed gradually decreases to something a little less frightening, the emergency inertial compensators doing their job of preventing you from turning into paste as the elevator makes its landing at the bottom."

rows.original: It’s dark down here, the emergency lights the only thing you can see by. The console reports no power in the bottom half of the shaft, the entire facility is on emergency power only. You grab a welding torch from the elevator’s emergency supply cabinet, just in case.
rows.translation: 下面一片漆黑，只能依靠应急灯看清东西。控制台报告竖井下半段没有电力，整座设施仅靠应急电源运行。你从电梯的应急用品柜里拿了一把焊枪，以防万一。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s dark down here, the emergency lights the only thing you can see by. The console reports no power in the bottom half of the shaft, the entire facility is on emergency power only. You grab a welding torch from the elevator’s emergency supply cabinet, just in case."

rows.original: No turning back now; time to see if you can restore power and get out of here.
rows.translation: 现在已经无法回头；该看看能否恢复电力并离开这里了。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo turning back now; time to see if you can restore power and get out of here."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The elevator shaft looms above you, the surface a tiny pinprick of light in the distance.
rows.translation: 电梯竖井耸立在头顶，远处地表只是一点针尖大小的光。
rows.raw: "The elevator shaft looms above you, the surface a tiny pinprick of light in the distance."

rows.original: Power has been restored to the elevator, but now the systems are locked down. There must be something else keeping you here.
rows.translation: 电梯电力已经恢复，但系统现在处于封锁状态。一定还有别的东西把你困在这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nPower has been restored to the elevator, but now the systems are locked down. There must be something else keeping you here."

rows.original: The elevator console still has power, but reports the shaft is nonfunctional. You’ll need to restore power if you don’t want to be trapped down here.
rows.translation: 电梯控制台仍然有电，但报告竖井无法运作。如果不想被困在下面，你需要恢复电力。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe elevator console still has power, but reports the shaft is nonfunctional. You’ll need to restore power if you don’t want to be trapped down here."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: With your depthsuit you should be able to get out onto the ocean floor. Hopefully there’s a way into the generator room from there.
rows.translation: 有了深海服，你应该能走上海床。希望那里有办法进入发电机室。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith your depthsuit you should be able to get out onto the ocean floor. Hopefully there’s a way into the generator room from there."

rows.original: Going out there without appropriate equipment would be suicide, but if you can find one you might be able to find a route into the generator room.
rows.translation: 没有适当装备就出去无异于自杀，不过若能找到一套装备，或许就能找到进入发电机室的路线。
rows.raw: "\n\nGoing out there without appropriate equipment would be suicide, but if you can find one you might be able to find a route into the generator room."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card
rows.raw: "Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card"

rows.original: There’s something glinting on one of the counters.
rows.translation: 某个柜台上有东西在闪光。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s something glinting on one of the counters."

rows.original: Examine
rows.translation: 检查
rows.raw: "Examine"

rows.original: Couch

rows.original: There’s another access card lying on top of the main console.
rows.translation: 主控制台顶部还放着另一张访问卡。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s another access card lying on top of the main console."

rows.original: Examine
