rows.original: Examine Card
rows.translation: 检查卡片
rows.raw: "Examine Card"

rows.original: Get the Storage Access Card.
rows.translation: 取得储藏室访问卡。
rows.raw: "Get the Storage Access Card."

rows.original: Attack Drone
rows.raw: "Attack Drone"

rows.original: Hm, the laser turrets don’t look all that badly damaged. Maybe you can scavenge something from them.
rows.translation: 嗯，激光炮塔看起来损坏得并不严重。也许可以从中回收点东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nHm, the laser turrets don’t look all that badly damaged. Maybe you can scavenge something from them."

rows.original: Laser
rows.translation: 激光
rows.raw: "Laser"

rows.original: Take Laser Drone
rows.translation: 拿走激光无人机
rows.raw: "Take Laser Drone"

rows.original: Get a laser drone.
rows.translation: 取得一架激光无人机。
rows.raw: "Get a laser drone."

rows.original: Laser
rows.translation: 激光
rows.raw: "Laser"

rows.original: Take Laser Drone
rows.translation: 拿走激光无人机
rows.raw: "Take Laser Drone"

rows.original: Your inventory is full.
rows.translation: 你的物品栏已满。
rows.raw: "Your inventory is full."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: With power restored the water leakage in this corridor seems to have stopped for the moment, and you can get back into the generator room if you need to. It would be fastest to go west if you want to get out of here as soon as possible.
rows.translation: 电力恢复后，这条走廊的漏水似乎暂时停止了，有需要的话可以再次进入发电机室。如果想尽快离开这里，向西走最快。
rows.raw: "With power restored the water leakage in this corridor seems to have stopped for the moment, and you can get back into the generator room if you need to. It would be fastest to go west if you want to get out of here as soon as possible."

rows.original: Water is flowing along the floor of this hallway from the cracked south door leading to the main generator room. Try as you might, you can’t pry it open from this side. Thankfully the east and west doors are still operational.
rows.translation: 水正从通往主发电机室、已经开裂的南门沿走廊地面流淌。无论怎么努力，你都无法从这一侧撬开它。幸好东西两侧的门仍能运作。
rows.raw: "Water is flowing along the floor of this hallway from the cracked south door leading to the main generator room. Try as you might, you can’t pry it open from this side. Thankfully the east and west doors are still operational."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Steele Biomedical Lab Storage Card
rows.raw: "Steele Biomedical Lab Storage Card"

rows.original: To the east is a door leading into a storage closet, which the card you picked up in the mainframe chamber can hopefully unlock.
rows.translation: 东边有一扇门通往储藏间，你在主机室拾到的卡片应该能将其解锁。
rows.raw: " To the east is a door leading into a storage closet, which the card you picked up in the mainframe chamber can hopefully unlock."

rows.original: To the east is a door leading into a storage closet, which you don’t have the key for right now. Maybe someone left it behind somewhere?
rows.translation: 东边有一扇门通往储藏间，但你现在没有钥匙。也许有人把它遗落在某个地方？
rows.raw: " To the east is a door leading into a storage closet, which you don’t have the key for right now. Maybe someone left it behind somewhere?"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card
rows.raw: "Steele Biomedical Lab Mainframe Card"

rows.original: To the west is the door into the central mainframe, which the key you found in the lab is able to unlock.
rows.translation: 西边是通往中央主机的门，你在实验室找到的钥匙可以将其解锁。
rows.raw: " To the west is the door into the central mainframe, which the key you found in the lab is able to unlock."

rows.original: To the west is the door into the central mainframe, which you don’t have a key for.
rows.translation: 西边是通往中央主机的门，但你没有钥匙。
rows.raw: " To the west is the door into the central mainframe, which you don’t have a key for."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: On the far wall you see a real sight for sore eyes: an armored depthsuit, one of Akkadi’s newest models at that. Pity about the orange color, but right now it’ll do just fine.
rows.translation: 远墙边有个景象实在令人欣慰：一套装甲深海服，而且还是阿卡迪最新的型号之一。橙色有点可惜，不过现在完全够用了。
rows.raw: " On the far wall you see a real sight for sore eyes: an armored depthsuit, one of Akkadi’s newest models at that. Pity about the orange color, but right now it’ll do just fine."

rows.original: Depthsuit
rows.translation: 深海服
rows.raw: "Depthsuit"

rows.original: Depthsuit
rows.translation: 深海服
rows.raw: "Depthsuit"

rows.original: Take Armored Depthsuit.
rows.translation: 拿走装甲深海服。
rows.raw: "Take Armored Depthsuit."

rows.original: Depthsuit
rows.translation: 深海服
rows.raw: "Depthsuit"

rows.original: Depthsuit
rows.translation: 深海服
rows.raw: "Depthsuit"

rows.original: Your inventory is full.
rows.translation: 你的物品栏已满。
rows.raw: "Your inventory is full."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: Rounding the bend in the path you can see the invader, a giant glowing jellyfish wrapped around the generator room. Electricity crackles along its body in time with the rise and fall of its glow, coming in pulses from the generator up and into its main body. What the hell is this monster?
rows.translation: 绕过道路转弯处后，你看见了入侵者：一只巨大发光水母缠在发电机室周围。电流随它光芒的明暗起伏在体表噼啪作响，一阵阵从发电机涌入主体。这怪物到底是什么鬼？
rows.raw: "Rounding the bend in the path you can see the invader, a giant glowing jellyfish wrapped around the generator room. Electricity crackles along its body in time with the rise and fall of its glow, coming in pulses from the generator up and into its main body. What the hell is this monster?"

rows.original: Rounding the bend in the path you can see the generator room where you fought the giant jellyfish.
rows.translation: 绕过道路转弯处后，你看见了自己与巨型水母战斗过的发电机室。
rows.raw: "Rounding the bend in the path you can see the generator room where you fought the giant jellyfish."

rows.original: Couch
rows.raw: "Couch"

rows.original: The giant jellyfish hasn’t noticed you yet, but you’re pretty sure it will as soon as you enter. This is your last chance to back out, you’d better be ready to fight.
rows.translation: 巨型水母还没有发现你，但你很确定，只要进入就会被察觉。这是最后一次退出的机会，你最好做好战斗准备。
rows.raw: " The giant jellyfish hasn’t noticed you yet, but you’re pretty sure it will as soon as you enter. This is your last chance to back out, you’d better be ready to fight."

rows.original: Fishing
rows.translation: 钓鱼
rows.raw: "Fishing"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Sauntering up to the big old hole in the ice, you peer down inside and into the water. It’s placid, but dark: pitch blackness that reveals nothing but inky blackness stares back up at you. You can’t even see your reflection.
rows.translation: 你慢悠悠地走到冰面上的大洞旁，低头窥视水下。水面平静，却十分黑暗：一片什么都不显露的漆黑深渊回望着你，甚至看不见自己的倒影。
rows.raw: "Sauntering up to the big old hole in the ice, you peer down inside and into the water. It’s placid, but dark: pitch blackness that reveals nothing but inky blackness stares back up at you. You can’t even see your reflection."

rows.original: Still, though, this is obviously an artificial fishing hole: it’s too perfectly rounded to be otherwise. When on Uveto, do as the Uvetans do! You clear off somewhere to sit in the snow and plop down, taking out your fishing rod and apply your bait of choice from your pack before casting off into the shadowy depths of the ocean below.
rows.translation: 不过，这显然是个人工捕鱼洞：不然不可能如此浑圆。在乌维托就要入乡随俗！你清理出一块雪地作为座位，一屁股坐下，取出鱼竿，从背包里装上选好的鱼饵，随后把钓线甩入下方海洋幽暗的深处。
rows.raw: "\n\nStill, though, this is obviously an artificial fishing hole: it’s too perfectly rounded to be otherwise. When on Uveto, do as the Uvetans do! You clear off somewhere to sit in the snow and plop down, taking out your fishing rod and apply your bait of choice from your pack before casting off into the shadowy depths of the ocean below."

rows.original: You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-
rows.translation: 你以前钓过鱼，不过爸爸带你到屋外湖边享受一段父
rows.raw: "You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-"

rows.original: son
rows.translation: 子
rows.raw: "son"

rows.original: daughter
rows.translation: 女
rows.raw: "daughter"

rows.original: time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite.
rows.translation: 时光，似乎已经是多年前的事了。回忆往日令你心情愉快。你把钓线甩进捕鱼洞，满足地向后靠着，等待鱼儿咬钩。
rows.raw: " time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite."

rows.original: It doesn’t take long for the fish to start biting. You reel in a few small fish and lay them in the ice to freeze for later. You’ve got your metaphorical eye on bigger game, and you have more than enough patience to get it. Time passes, leaving you to yawn and nestle into your little snow-swept seat, almost falling asleep in the peaceful, meditative task.
rows.translation: 鱼儿没过多久便开始咬钩。你收上几条小鱼，放在冰面上冷冻起来留待以后。你真正盯上的是更大的猎物，而且耐心绰绰有余。时间流逝，你打着哈欠，蜷进自己那席卷着雪花的小座位，几乎在这平静而冥想般的活动中睡着。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t take long for the fish to start biting. You reel in a few small fish and lay them in the ice to freeze for later. You’ve got your metaphorical eye on bigger game, and you have more than enough patience to get it. Time passes, leaving you to yawn and nestle into your little snow-swept seat, almost falling asleep in the peaceful, meditative task."

rows.original: After a bit, though, you feel a particularly strong tug on the line - strong enough to draw you out of your reverie, making you leap upright and pull back on the rod lest your quarry yank it right out of your hand! Whatever’s down there is incredibly strong, threatening to throw you right off your [pc.feet] at any moment. You dig your
rows.translation: 不过片刻后，你感觉钓线受到一股格外强劲的拉扯——力道之大，令你从沉思中惊醒，猛然站起并向后拉住鱼竿，免得猎物直接将它从手中拽走！水下的东西强得不可思议，随时都可能把你从[pc.feet]上掀翻。你把
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a bit, though, you feel a particularly strong tug on the line - strong enough to draw you out of your reverie, making you leap upright and pull back on the rod lest your quarry yank it right out of your hand! Whatever’s down there is incredibly strong, threatening to throw you right off your [pc.feet] at any moment. You dig your "

rows.original: tail
rows.translation: 尾巴
rows.raw: "tail"

rows.original: hooves
rows.translation: 蹄子
rows.raw: "hooves"

rows.original: claws
rows.translation: 爪子
rows.raw: "claws"

rows.original: heels
rows.translation: 脚跟
rows.raw: "heels"

rows.original: in and fight back, throwing all your weight behind the effort to pull your prey out of the depths.
rows.translation: 稳稳扎住并奋力反击，将全身体重都压上去，试图把猎物拉出深处。
rows.raw: " in and fight back, throwing all your weight behind the effort to pull your prey out of the depths."

rows.original: Whatever it is must be massive. You can see a dark shape wriggling around in the water, just under the surface now, making the once-placid surface bubble and churn.
rows.translation: 无论那是什么，体形一定非常庞大。你能看见一道黑影在水中扭动，如今就在水面下方，让原本平静的水面翻滚冒泡。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever it is must be massive. You can see a dark shape wriggling around in the water, just under the surface now, making the once-placid surface bubble and churn."

rows.original: It doesn’t take much longer before you finally get a good grip and bring all your strength to bear, hauling the underwater beast up out of the water! It flops onto the ice at your [pc.feet], flailing and screeching until its... its hands finally grab your fishing line and rip the hook out of a puncture in what now appears to be a latex diving suit.
rows.translation: 没过多久，你终于牢牢站稳，倾尽全力把水下野兽拖出水面！它扑通落在你[pc.feet]旁的冰上，一边挣扎一边尖叫，直到它的...它的双手终于抓住钓线，把鱼钩从如今看来是乳胶潜水服的破孔里扯了出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t take much longer before you finally get a good grip and bring all your strength to bear, hauling the underwater beast up out of the water! It flops onto the ice at your [pc.feet], flailing and screeching until its... its hands finally grab your fishing line and rip the hook out of a puncture in what now appears to be a latex diving suit."

rows.original: The fight is long and brutal, taking what seems like an eternity before suddenly you’re tumbling back amidst a huge splash. Your ass slaps into the snow, leaving you dazed and reeling. Your fishing rod vanishes into the ice hole, slipping into the depths along with your would-be quarry. You curse, watching the water go calm once more... before suddenly erupting in a shower of frigid water and crystals of ice.
rows.translation: 这场角力漫长而惨烈，仿佛持续了永恒。突然间，随着巨大的水花，你向后摔了出去，屁股拍进雪中，头晕目眩。鱼竿消失在冰洞里，和本来要成为猎物的东西一同滑入深处。你咒骂着，看着水面再次平静...随后它突然爆开，喷出一片冰冷海水与冰晶。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fight is long and brutal, taking what seems like an eternity before suddenly you’re tumbling back amidst a huge splash. Your ass slaps into the snow, leaving you dazed and reeling. Your fishing rod vanishes into the ice hole, slipping into the depths along with your would-be quarry. You curse, watching the water go calm once more... before suddenly erupting in a shower of frigid water and crystals of ice."

rows.original: Your eyes go wide as what can only be a pale latex diving suit rolls out of the water, yanking your fishing hook out of a small puncture.
rows.translation: 你睁大双眼，只见一件显然是浅色乳胶潜水服的东西从水里滚出来，并从一个小破孔中扯出你的鱼钩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes go wide as what can only be a pale latex diving suit rolls out of the water, yanking your fishing hook out of a small puncture."

rows.original: “Agh, god dammit!” a muffled, metallic voice grunts from inside the suit. “Thank fuck I’m so numb from the cold I can’t fucking feel fucking fish hooks in my fucking ribs.”
rows.translation: “啊，该死！”潜水服里传出沉闷的金属嗓音。“幸亏我他妈冻得这么麻，连他妈鱼钩扎进我他妈肋骨都他妈感觉不到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Agh, god dammit!” a muffled, metallic voice grunts from inside the suit. “Thank fuck I’m so numb from the cold I can’t fucking feel fucking fish hooks in my fucking ribs.”"

rows.original: The figure turns to you, staring at you from underneath an opaque visor in its metallic headpiece. “Hey. Hey buddy. Guess what?”
rows.translation: 那个人转向你，从金属头盔下的不透明面罩后盯着你。“嘿。嘿，伙计。猜怎么着？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe figure turns to you, staring at you from underneath an opaque visor in its metallic headpiece. “Hey. Hey buddy. Guess what?”"

rows.original: A moment of silence passes.
rows.translation: 沉默持续了片刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment of silence passes."

rows.original: “What?” you finally venture.
rows.translation: “怎么了？”你终于试探着问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” you finally venture."

rows.original: “I’m not a fucking fish! Congratulations!” the diver snaps, throwing your fishing rod back into your hands. “Ass-jacket piece of backwater shit.”
rows.translation: “我他妈不是鱼！恭喜你！”潜水员厉声说，把鱼竿扔回你手中。“你这个乡巴佬屎坑里爬出来的屁眼混账。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not a fucking fish! Congratulations!” the diver snaps, throwing your fishing rod back into your hands. “Ass-jacket piece of backwater shit.”"

rows.original: Your would-be dinner keeps grumbling, unsteadily standing and pulling the metal bucket helmet off. Long, thick green hair spills out from inside, followed by unnaturally dark red skin, almost the color of dried blood. Finally, sitting atop the figure’s head are a pair of curling white horns, swept back over their scalp and adorned with sapphire studs.
rows.translation: 本来要成为你晚餐的家伙仍在嘟囔，摇摇晃晃地站起来，摘下金属桶状头盔。浓密修长的绿色头发从里面倾泻而出，紧接着露出异常暗红、近似干涸血液颜色的皮肤。最后，她头顶还有一对向后卷过头皮的白角，角上装饰着蓝宝石钉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour would-be dinner keeps grumbling, unsteadily standing and pulling the metal bucket helmet off. Long, thick green hair spills out from inside, followed by unnaturally dark red skin, almost the color of dried blood. Finally, sitting atop the figure’s head are a pair of curling white horns, swept back over their scalp and adorned with sapphire studs."

rows.original: “What?” a now decidedly feminine voice barks as the diving helm thunks into the snow at her feet. Her eyes are golden-copper, and glowing ever so slightly; at first you think in annoyance, but quickly you realize they’re artificial... as is the rest of her; too smooth and perfect to be anything but the body of a synthetic. “Stop starin’, you weirdo. Not enough to reel me outta the water like a thriska, now you gotta gawk, too?”
rows.translation: “干嘛？”潜水头盔砰地落在她脚边雪地里时，如今明确是女性的嗓音吼道。她的眼睛呈金铜色，散发着极微弱的光；起初你以为那是恼怒所致，但很快便意识到它们是人工制品...她的其余部分也一样；太过光滑完美，只可能是合成人的身体。“别盯着看，怪胎。把我像条斯里斯卡鱼一样钓出水还不够，现在还得瞪着我？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” a now decidedly feminine voice barks as the diving helm thunks into the snow at her feet. Her eyes are golden-copper, and glowing ever so slightly; at first you think in annoyance, but quickly you realize they’re artificial... as is the rest of her; too smooth and perfect to be anything but the body of a synthetic. “Stop starin’, you weirdo. Not enough to reel me outta the water like a thriska, now you gotta gawk, too?”"

rows.original: You blink, standing and setting your fishing rod aside.
rows.translation: 你眨眨眼，站起来，把鱼竿放到一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou blink, standing and setting your fishing rod aside."

rows.original: Apologize
rows.translation: 道歉
rows.raw: "Apologize"

rows.original: Brush Off
rows.translation: 不予理会
rows.raw: "Brush Off"

rows.original: Keep Staring
rows.translation: 继续盯着
rows.raw: "Keep Staring"

rows.original: You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-
rows.translation: 你以前钓过鱼，不过爸爸带你到屋外湖边享受一段父
rows.raw: "You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-"

rows.original: son
rows.translation: 子
rows.raw: "son"

rows.original: daughter
rows.translation: 女
rows.raw: "daughter"

rows.original: time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite.
rows.translation: 时光，似乎已经是多年前的事了。回忆往日令你心情愉快。你把钓线甩进捕鱼洞，满足地向后靠着，等待鱼儿咬钩。
rows.raw: " time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite."

rows.original: It doesn’t take long for the fish to start biting. You reel in a few small fish and lay them in the ice to freeze for later. You’ve got your metaphorical eye on bigger game, and you have more than enough patience to get it. Time passes, leaving you to yawn and nestle into your little snow-swept seat, almost falling asleep in the peaceful, meditative task until a sudden, mighty yank ripples through your line. You start, blinking the sleep out of your eyes and gripping the fishing rod for dear life. The bastard makes you fight hard for it, struggling for freedom for what seems like an hour before finally you manage to get your [pc.feet] dug in and reel him out.
rows.translation: 鱼儿没过多久便开始咬钩。你收上几条小鱼，放在冰面上冷冻起来留待以后。你真正盯上的是更大的猎物，而且耐心绰绰有余。时间流逝，你打着哈欠，蜷进自己那席卷着雪花的小座位，在这平静而冥想般的活动中几乎睡着，直到钓线突然受到一股猛烈拉扯。你猛然惊醒，眨掉睡意，拼命握紧鱼竿。那混账拼死挣扎着争取自由，让你苦战了仿佛足足一小时，最后才终于把[pc.feet]扎稳，将它拉出水面。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t take long for the fish to start biting. You reel in a few small fish and lay them in the ice to freeze for later. You’ve got your metaphorical eye on bigger game, and you have more than enough patience to get it. Time passes, leaving you to yawn and nestle into your little snow-swept seat, almost falling asleep in the peaceful, meditative task until a sudden, mighty yank ripples through your line. You start, blinking the sleep out of your eyes and gripping the fishing rod for dear life. The bastard makes you fight hard for it, struggling for freedom for what seems like an hour before finally you manage to get your [pc.feet] dug in and reel him out."

rows.original: When you’ve finally got the bastard, it quickly becomes apparent how it put up such a struggle. The pale, flat, tentacled fish is nearly as long as you are tall, and thrashes violently in the cold wind until you put it down with your [pc.meleeWeapon]. God damn, is this thing ugly... but according to a Codex scan, it’s good eating!
rows.translation: 终于逮住那混账时，你很快便明白它为何如此难缠。这条浅色、扁平、长有触手的鱼几乎和你的身高一样长，在冷风中剧烈挣扎，直到你用[pc.meleeWeapon]将它杀死。老天，这东西真丑...不过据CODEX终端扫描，它很好吃！
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you’ve finally got the bastard, it quickly becomes apparent how it put up such a struggle. The pale, flat, tentacled fish is nearly as long as you are tall, and thrashes violently in the cold wind until you put it down with your [pc.meleeWeapon]. God damn, is this thing ugly... but according to a Codex scan, it’s good eating!"

rows.original: You pack up your aquatic gains and turn your attentions back to adventuring, much refreshed.
rows.translation: 你收好水中获得的收获，精神焕发地重新投入冒险。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pack up your aquatic gains and turn your attentions back to adventuring, much refreshed."

rows.original: You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-
rows.translation: 你以前钓过鱼，不过爸爸带你去屋外的湖边享受一段父
rows.raw: "You’ve been fishing before, though it seems like years ago that Dad took you out on the lake outside the house for a little father-"

rows.original: son
rows.translation: 子
rows.raw: "son"

rows.original: daughter
rows.translation: 女
rows.raw: "daughter"

rows.original: time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite.
rows.translation: 时光，仿佛已经是多年前的事。回想往昔令你心情愉悦，你把鱼线甩进冰窟窿，惬意地向后靠着，等待鱼儿上钩。
rows.raw: " time. Thinking back to the old days puts you in a pleasant mood as you cast your line into the fishing hole, content to lean back and wait for a bite."

rows.original: The fish down below take their time responding to your bait. You get a few little nibbles, but it’s a long, long time before you get one that strong enough to jolt you out of your nostalgic reverie. When it finally comes, you lurch upright, blinking the sleep out of your eyes, and pull back on the rod. The line goes taut, struggling against your hold for long minutes. You nearly lose it time after time, but your willpower prevails over the meager xeno-fish, and eventually you manage to pull the wriggling mass of tentacles and scales free!
rows.translation: 下面的鱼儿迟迟没有回应你的诱饵。你感觉到几次轻微啃咬，但过了很久很久，才终于有一口强得足以把你从怀旧遐思中惊醒。它终于出现时，你猛地坐直，眨去眼中睡意，用力向后拉起鱼竿。鱼线瞬间绷紧，与你角力了好几分钟。你一次又一次差点失手，但意志力最终胜过了这条弱小异星鱼，终于把那团蠕动的触手与鳞片拖出水面！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fish down below take their time responding to your bait. You get a few little nibbles, but it’s a long, long time before you get one that strong enough to jolt you out of your nostalgic reverie. When it finally comes, you lurch upright, blinking the sleep out of your eyes, and pull back on the rod. The line goes taut, struggling against your hold for long minutes. You nearly lose it time after time, but your willpower prevails over the meager xeno-fish, and eventually you manage to pull the wriggling mass of tentacles and scales free!"

rows.original: It’s hideous, and big, and keeps thrashing about until you give it a smack with your [pc.meleeWeapon]. Once it’s stopped flailing around, you give it a quick scan with your Codex to make sure it’s actually edible before you get to work on your new meal...
rows.translation: 它又丑又大，不停挣扎，直到你用[pc.meleeWeapon]敲了一下。它终于停止扑腾后，你迅速用Codex扫描，确认真的可以食用，随后开始料理这顿新鲜大餐...
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s hideous, and big, and keeps thrashing about until you give it a smack with your [pc.meleeWeapon]. Once it’s stopped flailing around, you give it a quick scan with your Codex to make sure it’s actually edible before you get to work on your new meal..."

rows.original: You lean back and relax, taking a drink out of your pack and reclining on the snow
rows.translation: 你向后靠着放松下来，从背包里取出饮料喝了一口，躺在雪地上，
rows.raw: "You lean back and relax, taking a drink out of your pack and reclining on the snow "

rows.original: Wooly
rows.raw: "Wooly"

rows.original: taking advantage of your thick fur
rows.translation: 充分利用自己的厚实毛皮
rows.raw: "taking advantage of your thick fur"

rows.original: without much discomfort at all thanks to your heat belt
rows.translation: 多亏保温腰带，完全没感到多少不适
rows.raw: "without much discomfort at all thanks to your heat belt"

rows.original: without a care in the world thanks to your accumulated cold resistances
rows.translation: 多亏累积的寒冷抗性，根本无忧无虑
rows.raw: "without a care in the world thanks to your accumulated cold resistances"

rows.original: . You know fishing’s a long, drawn-out activity, so there’s no point in waiting on the edge of your seat. You keep your rod nice and steady, letting the currents move your wriggling bait around while you patiently wait.
rows.translation: 。你知道钓鱼是一项漫长活动，没必要一直紧张地守在边上。你稳稳握着鱼竿，任由水流带着蠕动的诱饵移动，耐心等待。
rows.raw: ". You know fishing’s a long, drawn-out activity, so there’s no point in waiting on the edge of your seat. You keep your rod nice and steady, letting the currents move your wriggling bait around while you patiently wait."

rows.original: And wait... and wait.
rows.translation: 继续等... 继续等。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd wait... and wait."

rows.original: After what seems like an eternity, though, you finally feel a strong tug on your fishing line. A bite! You lurch upright, blinking the sleep out of your eyes, pull back on the rod. The line goes taut, struggling against your hold. It takes some effort to pull in your biter, but after a minute’s work, a dark red shape breaks the surface in an eruption of frigid water.
rows.translation: 不过，仿佛过了永恒之后，你终于感到鱼线被猛地一扯。上钩了！你猛地坐直，眨去眼中睡意，向后拉起鱼竿。鱼线瞬间绷紧，挣扎着对抗你的力量。把咬钩的家伙拉上来费了些力气，但忙活一分钟后，一个暗红色身影终于伴随冰冷水花破出水面。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter what seems like an eternity, though, you finally feel a strong tug on your fishing line. A bite! You lurch upright, blinking the sleep out of your eyes, pull back on the rod. The line goes taut, struggling against your hold. It takes some effort to pull in your biter, but after a minute’s work, a dark red shape breaks the surface in an eruption of frigid water."

rows.original: The fish you pull out isn’t terrible big, and it doesn’t much look like an early fish, but it’s something! The creature is flat and wide, with several fins and a row of sharp teeth that snap at you before it expires in the cold.
rows.translation: 你拉出的鱼不算太大，看起来也不太像早期鱼类，不过总算有所收获！这只生物扁平宽阔，长着几片鳍和一排锋利牙齿，在严寒中咽气前还朝你咬了几下。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe fish you pull out isn’t terrible big, and it doesn’t much look like an early fish, but it’s something! The creature is flat and wide, with several fins and a row of sharp teeth that snap at you before it expires in the cold."

rows.original: A quick Codex scan confirms it’ll make good eating, at least...
rows.translation: Codex快速扫描确认，至少它吃起来应该不错...
rows.raw: "\n\nA quick Codex scan confirms it’ll make good eating, at least..."

rows.original: You stay seated for a few minutes, idly watching your fishing rod and staring into the inky blackness of the inner ocean. As the minutes drag past and past, you get a few nibbles, but nothing big and juicy ever seems to want a piece of you. You wish you could see what was going on under the ice, but it’s so damn dark that you can’t make anything out. With a sigh, you pack up your fishing rod and get back to work.
rows.translation: 你继续坐了几分钟，漫不经心地看着鱼竿，凝视内海墨黑的幽暗。时间一分一秒流逝，你感到几次轻微啃咬，但似乎没有任何肥美大鱼愿意咬你一口。你真希望能看清冰层下发生了什么，可那里实在太黑，什么都分辨不出。你叹了口气，收起鱼竿，重新开始工作。
rows.raw: "You stay seated for a few minutes, idly watching your fishing rod and staring into the inky blackness of the inner ocean. As the minutes drag past and past, you get a few nibbles, but nothing big and juicy ever seems to want a piece of you. You wish you could see what was going on under the ice, but it’s so damn dark that you can’t make anything out. With a sigh, you pack up your fishing rod and get back to work."

rows.original: You stay seated for a few minutes, idly watching your fishing rod and staring into the inky blackness of the inner ocean. Nothing happens. You yawn and move the rod, trying to tempt anything inside to take a nibble, but... there’s just nothing biting today.
rows.translation: 你继续坐了几分钟，漫不经心地看着鱼竿，凝视内海墨黑的幽暗。什么也没发生。你打着哈欠晃动鱼竿，试图引诱里面的东西咬上一口，可是... 今天根本没有鱼上钩。
rows.raw: "You stay seated for a few minutes, idly watching your fishing rod and staring into the inky blackness of the inner ocean. Nothing happens. You yawn and move the rod, trying to tempt anything inside to take a nibble, but... there’s just nothing biting today."

rows.original: Whatever. You reel in and put the rod away, feeling rather demoralized.
rows.translation: 管它呢。你收线放好鱼竿，颇受打击。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhatever. You reel in and put the rod away, feeling rather demoralized."

rows.original: Try Again
rows.translation: 再试一次
rows.raw: "Try Again"

rows.original: “Sorry,” you say, collecting your rod. “I thought you were a fish.”
rows.translation: “抱歉，”你一边收鱼竿一边说道。“我以为你是一条鱼。”
rows.raw: "“Sorry,” you say, collecting your rod. “I thought you were a fish.”"

rows.original: The gynoid huffs and crosses her arms under her quite-ample bust. “Well, say hello to the prettiest damn fish you ever saw. I... ack, dammit, fine. Apology accepted. Sorry for, uh, yelling at you. That hook getting in my suit just about killed me. This suit fails, and my industrial-grade ass is sinking to the bottom. Or whatever happens on this iceball since the water’s all over down there.”
rows.translation: 人造女性哼了一声，双臂交叉在相当丰满的胸部下方。“好吧，向你见过最漂亮的该死鱼儿问好。我... 啊，该死，好吧。我接受道歉。抱歉，呃，刚才冲你大吼。鱼钩扎进潜水服，差点害死我。要是这套衣服失效，我这工业级屁股就会沉到底。或者在这个水全都位于下方的冰球上，会发生别的什么事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid huffs and crosses her arms under her quite-ample bust. “Well, say hello to the prettiest damn fish you ever saw. I... ack, dammit, fine. Apology accepted. Sorry for, uh, yelling at you. That hook getting in my suit just about killed me. This suit fails, and my industrial-grade ass is sinking to the bottom. Or whatever happens on this iceball since the water’s all over down there.”"

rows.original: You wave it off. It’s an understandable reaction to almost dying. Or being destroyed, in her case.
rows.translation: 你挥挥手表示没关系。险些丧命后出现这种反应可以理解。对她而言，应该说是险些被摧毁。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave it off. It’s an understandable reaction to almost dying. Or being destroyed, in her case."

rows.original: She nods firmly. “Good. Right. So who are you, anyway? Not one of the local hut-dwellers, by the looks of it.”
rows.translation: 她坚定地点点头。“很好。对了，你到底是谁？看起来不像本地住棚屋的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods firmly. “Good. Right. So who are you, anyway? Not one of the local hut-dwellers, by the looks of it.”"

rows.original: “Steele. [pc.name] Steele,” you say, extending a hand. The dragon-bot takes it warily, locking eyes with you. Like a gryvain’s, hers are vertically slitted, with dark veins extending around it. They glow softly, eyeing you up and down while you shake hands.
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔，”你伸出一只手说道。龙形机器人警惕地握住，与你四目相对。她的眼睛像格里文一样，瞳孔竖直，周围延伸出深色纹路。柔和微光从中透出，你们握手时，她上下打量着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele. [pc.name] Steele,” you say, extending a hand. The dragon-bot takes it warily, locking eyes with you. Like a gryvain’s, hers are vertically slitted, with dark veins extending around it. They glow softly, eyeing you up and down while you shake hands."

rows.original: “I’m Tanith. I’d say it’s a pleasure, but I’ve sprung a silicone leak and I’m freezing. But other than that...”
rows.translation: “我叫塔尼斯。我本想说很高兴认识你，可我正漏硅胶，而且快冻僵了。不过除此之外...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m Tanith. I’d say it’s a pleasure, but I’ve sprung a silicone leak and I’m freezing. But other than that...”"

rows.original: You laugh, and ask Tanith what she’s doing under the water there.
rows.translation: 你笑了起来，询问塔尼斯在水下做什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou laugh, and ask Tanith what she’s doing under the water there."

rows.original: She answers with a shrug, picking up her diver’s helmet. “Pleasure diving, actually. I’ve been to a hundred and change planets, but Uveto’s topped them all. The whole planet’s one big ball of ice to dive under; you can really get lost in all that darkness, blind and more alone than you’ve ever been. And since I’m a ‘bot, all the psychic fish-folk down there just leave me alone, like I’m not even there.”
rows.translation: 她耸耸肩回答，捡起潜水头盔。“其实是娱乐潜水。我去过一百多颗星球，但尤维托超过了所有地方。整颗星球就是个可以潜到下面的巨大冰球；在无边黑暗中，你真的会迷失方向，既看不见东西，又前所未有地孤独。而且我是机器人，下面那些有灵能的鱼人全都不理我，就像我根本不存在一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe answers with a shrug, picking up her diver’s helmet. “Pleasure diving, actually. I’ve been to a hundred and change planets, but Uveto’s topped them all. The whole planet’s one big ball of ice to dive under; you can really get lost in all that darkness, blind and more alone than you’ve ever been. And since I’m a ‘bot, all the psychic fish-folk down there just leave me alone, like I’m not even there.”"

rows.original: Tanith actually smiles, seemingly forgetting the venom she was all but frothing with a moment ago. “Anyway, I ought to head back to town. Get the hole you poked in me and my suit patched up. Careful where you’re throwing your line next time, alright?”
rows.translation: 塔尼斯竟然笑了，似乎忘了片刻前还几乎口吐毒液。“总之，我该回城里了。把你在我身上和潜水服上戳出的洞补好。下次甩线时小心点，行吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nTanith actually smiles, seemingly forgetting the venom she was all but frothing with a moment ago. “Anyway, I ought to head back to town. Get the hole you poked in me and my suit patched up. Careful where you’re throwing your line next time, alright?”"

rows.original: You nod, stepping out of the way as the gynoid hefts her helmet over her shoulder and trudges back west, towards Irestead.
rows.translation: 你点点头，让到一旁；人造女性把头盔扛到肩上，艰难地向西走回艾尔斯泰德。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, stepping out of the way as the gynoid hefts her helmet over her shoulder and trudges back west, towards Irestead."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Whatever,” you say, stepping back. You collapse your rod and start packing up.
rows.translation: “随便吧，”你退后一步说道。你收起鱼竿，开始打包。
rows.raw: "“Whatever,” you say, stepping back. You collapse your rod and start packing up."

rows.original: The gynoid scowls at you. “Wow, not even an apology for ruining my suit. Thanks a bunch, prickweasel. Don’t trip over your own big dick fisherman skills and fall in.”
rows.translation: 人造女性怒视着你。“哇，弄坏我的潜水服，连句道歉都没有。真是谢了，贱鼠。别被自己那根大屌级钓鱼技术绊倒，掉进水里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gynoid scowls at you. “Wow, not even an apology for ruining my suit. Thanks a bunch, prickweasel. Don’t trip over your own big dick fisherman skills and fall in.”"

rows.original: She huffs and collects her helmet, stomping off angrily into the white tundra.
rows.translation: 她气呼呼地拿起头盔，愤怒地跺着脚走进白色冻原。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe huffs and collects her helmet, stomping off angrily into the white tundra."

rows.original: Wow, what a bitch.
rows.translation: 哇，真是个泼妇。
rows.raw: "\n\nWow, what a bitch."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You keep staring, taking in all the curves and contours of her latex suit. It’s quite form fitting now that you take a moment to really look at her. She’s got long legs and broad hips, wider than her shoulders by a good fist’s width, and a long tail swaying behind her. The dragon-bot’s got tits, too: big, meaty breasts that strain against the front of her latex bodysuit, creating a wedge of slick cleavage that draws the eye like a target. The cold’s gotten a pair of marble-sized nipples poking through the material, an exaggerated and sexualized mirror of a real body.
rows.translation: 你继续盯着她，欣赏乳胶潜水服的每一道曲线和轮廓。真正仔细观察后，你发现它相当贴身。她双腿修长，胯部宽阔，比肩膀宽出足足一拳，一条长尾在身后摇摆。这台龙形机器人也有乳房：硕大厚实的一对乳房撑紧乳胶紧身衣前襟，挤出一道光滑乳沟，像靶心般吸引目光。严寒让两颗弹珠大小的乳头顶起布料，如同对真实肉体的夸张情色模仿。
rows.raw: "You keep staring, taking in all the curves and contours of her latex suit. It’s quite form fitting now that you take a moment to really look at her. She’s got long legs and broad hips, wider than her shoulders by a good fist’s width, and a long tail swaying behind her. The dragon-bot’s got tits, too: big, meaty breasts that strain against the front of her latex bodysuit, creating a wedge of slick cleavage that draws the eye like a target. The cold’s gotten a pair of marble-sized nipples poking through the material, an exaggerated and sexualized mirror of a real body."

rows.original: “Hey, asshole,” the gynoid growls, putting her hands on her wide hips. “Eyes up or cock out.”
rows.translation: “嘿，混蛋，”人造女性双手叉在宽胯上低吼道。“抬眼看，或者掏屌。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, asshole,” the gynoid growls, putting her hands on her wide hips. “Eyes up or cock out.”"

rows.original: Keep Staring
rows.translation: 继续盯着
rows.raw: "Keep Staring"

rows.original: Keep Staring
rows.translation: 继续盯着
rows.raw: "Keep Staring"

rows.original: You already are!
rows.translation: 你早就掏出来了！
rows.raw: "You already are!"

rows.original: Tanith
rows.translation: 塔尼斯
rows.raw: "Tanith"

rows.original: Gynoid
rows.translation: 人造女性
rows.raw: "Gynoid"

rows.original: GYNOID
rows.raw: "GYNOID"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “How can I help you?” she asks. There’s a sort-of smile on her face, but her tone is far from welcoming. You can tell that the tove is in a bad mood. You could ask her what’s got her bothered, or just come back later when she’s not here.
rows.translation: “有什么能帮你的吗？”她问道。脸上勉强带着微笑，语气却远远称不上欢迎。你看得出，这名托芙心情很糟。你可以问问什么事令她烦恼，也可以等她不在时再回来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How can I help you?” she asks. There’s a sort-of smile on her face, but her tone is far from welcoming. You can tell that the tove is in a bad mood. You could ask her what’s got her bothered, or just come back later when she’s not here."

rows.original: “Hello, [xotchi.pcName],” she squawks. “If you’re looking for my abysmal excuse for a secretary, I’ve sent her back down to Uveto VII.” She smiles and ruffles her feathers smugly. “That’ll teach the little dryborn to maloptimize my appointments,” she adds.
rows.translation: “你好，[xotchi.pcName]，”她尖声说道。“如果你在找我那个糟糕透顶的秘书，我已经把她遣回尤维托七号星了。”她得意地笑着抖了抖羽毛。“这下那个旱生小家伙就该学会别再把我的日程优化得一团糟了，”她补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello, [xotchi.pcName],” she squawks. “If you’re looking for my abysmal excuse for a secretary, I’ve sent her back down to Uveto VII.” She smiles and ruffles her feathers smugly. “That’ll teach the little dryborn to maloptimize my appointments,” she adds."

rows.original: [xotchi.name] looks busy, but you could ask her if she’s up for another bondage session.

Plus,” [rival.heShe] adds jerking [rival.hisHer] thumb to the kaithrit, “I’ve got a little bit of backup in case of any funny business.”"

rows.original: “So I’ve noticed. What happened to your last bodyguard, Steele? You seem to go through them at an alarming rate these days,” sniffs Mistress, holding a teacup delicately in her talons. You move to leave, but she pats the edge of her seat and after a moment’s hesitation, you kneel down on the floor at her feet. One of her talons runs across your
rows.translation: “我注意到了。你上一名保镖怎么了，斯蒂尔？最近你更换他们的速度快得惊人，”女主人轻哼，利爪优雅地端着茶杯。你正想离开，她却拍拍座位边缘；犹豫片刻后，你跪在她脚边的地板上。她的一根利爪安抚地划过你的
rows.raw: "\n\n“So I’ve noticed. What happened to your last bodyguard, Steele? You seem to go through them at an alarming rate these days,” sniffs Mistress, holding a teacup delicately in her talons. You move to leave, but she pats the edge of her seat and after a moment’s hesitation, you kneel down on the floor at her feet. One of her talons runs across your"

rows.original: [pc.hair]
rows.raw: " [pc.hair]"

rows.original: head
rows.translation: 头部
rows.raw: " head"

rows.original: in reassurance.
rows.raw: " in reassurance."

rows.original: “Vildarii assassin,” [rival.name] replies, narrowing [rival.hisHer] eyes at Mistress. “Snuck right up on me and nearly blew a hole through my chest. I don’t suppose you’d know anything about that, would you?”
rows.translation: “维尔达里刺客，”[rival.name]眯起[rival.hisHer]的眼睛看着女主人回答。“悄无声息地靠近我，差点在我胸口轰出一个洞。我猜你对此一无所知，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Vildarii assassin,” [rival.name] replies, narrowing [rival.hisHer] eyes at Mistress. “Snuck right up on me and nearly blew a hole through my chest. I don’t suppose you’d know anything about that, would you?”"

rows.original: “No more than you’d know about the drive core that went inexplicably critical on my ship last week,” says Mistress, coolly sipping her tea. “I wonder if your new employee knows what he’s in for.”
rows.translation: “就和你对上周我船上的驱动核心莫名达到临界状态一样一无所知，”女主人冷静地啜饮茶水。“不知道你的新员工是否清楚自己将面对什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No more than you’d know about the drive core that went inexplicably critical on my ship last week,” says Mistress, coolly sipping her tea. “I wonder if your new employee knows what he’s in for.”"

rows.original: “I pay them well enough,” says [rival.name], throwing his arms wide. “Koriss Deadeye here knew the risks when I hired him.”
rows.translation: “我付给他们的钱够多了，”[rival.name]说着，张开双臂。“这位‘死眼’科里斯受雇于我时就知道其中的风险。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I pay them well enough,” says [rival.name], throwing his arms wide. “Koriss Deadeye here knew the risks when I hired him.”"

rows.original: “It comes with benefits,” rumbles the kaithrit, fixing you with his slitted pupils. You suddenly realize how vulnerable you are, and lean back instinctively against Mistress’ hand.
rows.translation: “这工作也有好处，”凯斯瑞特人低声说道，用竖瞳盯住你。你突然意识到自己有多么脆弱，本能地向后靠进女主人的手中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It comes with benefits,” rumbles the kaithrit, fixing you with his slitted pupils. You suddenly realize how vulnerable you are, and lean back instinctively against Mistress’ hand."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Frankly, that’s what I mean to talk with you about, Steele,” says Mistress, clinking down her teacup. “The costs of this race are mounting. I’ve spent nearly half a million credits this month alone on security and leads. And I can’t imagine it’s been any cheaper for you.”
rows.translation: “坦白说，我正想和你谈谈这件事，斯蒂尔，”女主人说着，把茶杯叮的一声放下。“这场竞赛的花费越来越高。光这个月，我在安保和线索上就花了近五十万信用点。我想你的花销也不会少到哪里去。”
rows.raw: "“Frankly, that’s what I mean to talk with you about, Steele,” says Mistress, clinking down her teacup. “The costs of this race are mounting. I’ve spent nearly half a million credits this month alone on security and leads. And I can’t imagine it’s been any cheaper for you.”"

rows.original: “Hey, you’ve got to spend money to make money,” [rival.name] snarks, unsuccessfully hiding a flash of annoyance.
rows.translation: “嘿，想赚钱就得先花钱，”[rival.name]讥讽道，却没能掩住一闪而过的恼怒。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, you’ve got to spend money to make money,” [rival.name] snarks, unsuccessfully hiding a flash of annoyance."

rows.original: “And if you’ve spent anywhere near what I have, then you have to be wondering if it’s going to be worth it,” says Mistress in a wheedling tone.
rows.translation: “如果你的花销和我相差无几，那你一定也在怀疑这一切到底值不值得，”女主人用诱哄的语气说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And if you’ve spent anywhere near what I have, then you have to be wondering if it’s going to be worth it,” says Mistress in a wheedling tone."

rows.original: “Let’s say I have,” says your cousin, leaning forward, [rival.hisHer] arms on [rival.hisHer] knees. “You’re still going after it, and if a tove wants something that bad, then there’s gotta be a ton of money.”
rows.translation: “就当是吧，”你的表亲说着，身体前倾，[rival.hisHer]双臂支在[rival.hisHer]膝上。“你还在追寻它，而能让一个托芙如此渴求的东西，肯定价值连城。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s say I have,” says your cousin, leaning forward, [rival.hisHer] arms on [rival.hisHer] knees. “You’re still going after it, and if a tove wants something that bad, then there’s gotta be a ton of money.”"

rows.original: “Not always,” murmurs Mistress, almost inaudibly, her fingers sliding down to the back of your neck, and tugging absently on your collar. The rising sense of anxiety melts away at her words and her touch.
rows.translation: “未必，”女主人几不可闻地低语，手指滑到你的颈后，心不在焉地扯了扯你的项圈。她的话语与触碰令不断升起的焦虑消融无踪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not always,” murmurs Mistress, almost inaudibly, her fingers sliding down to the back of your neck, and tugging absently on your collar. The rising sense of anxiety melts away at her words and her touch."

rows.original: “A tove, exactly,” says Mistress, more loudly to [rival.name]. “And you understand how indeflappable we are in the pursuit of our goals. And I have the income from my wabeship to fund my pursuit of this fortune.”
rows.translation: “没错，是托芙，”女主人提高声音对[rival.name]说道。“你也明白我们追逐目标时有多么百折不挠。而且我还有韦布舰的收入，可以资助我追寻这笔财富。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A tove, exactly,” says Mistress, more loudly to [rival.name]. “And you understand how indeflappable we are in the pursuit of our goals. And I have the income from my wabeship to fund my pursuit of this fortune.”"

rows.original: “I’ve got resources, too, bitch,” snaps [rival.name].
rows.translation: “我也有资源，贱人，”[rival.name]厉声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve got resources, too, bitch,” snaps [rival.name]."

rows.original: You leap to your feet, not sure of what exactly you plan to do, but ready to jam those words back down your cousin’s throat. You’re so incensed that it takes Mistress’ firm touch on your back to make you realize that, smoothly and silently, Koriss-the hulking kaithrit-is holding five, razor-edged claws under your chin. You take a deep breath, and slowly sink back to the floor as the Kaithrit draws his arm back.
rows.translation: 你一跃而起，虽然不清楚自己究竟打算做什么，却已准备好把这些话塞回你表亲的喉咙。你怒不可遏，以至于女主人坚定地按住你的后背后，你才意识到，被称作科里斯的魁梧凯斯瑞特人已经悄无声息地把五根锋利如刀的爪子抵在你的下巴下。你深吸一口气，慢慢坐回地面，凯斯瑞特人也收回了手臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou leap to your feet, not sure of what exactly you plan to do, but ready to jam those words back down your cousin’s throat. You’re so incensed that it takes Mistress’ firm touch on your back to make you realize that, smoothly and silently, Koriss-the hulking kaithrit-is holding five, razor-edged claws under your chin. You take a deep breath, and slowly sink back to the floor as the Kaithrit draws his arm back."

rows.original: “Thank you, dear,” says Mistress, once you’re settled again. “And now, the short answer to that is,” she says, turning to [rival.name], “no, you don’t.”
rows.translation: “谢谢你，亲爱的，”等你重新安顿好后，女主人说道。“至于这个问题，简短的回答是，”她转向[rival.name]，“不，你没有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thank you, dear,” says Mistress, once you’re settled again. “And now, the short answer to that is,” she says, turning to [rival.name], “no, you don’t.”"

rows.original: “Maybe you don’t-” [rival.HeShe] starts, before Mistress cuts [rival.himHer] off.
rows.translation: “也许是你没有-”[rival.HeShe]刚开口，女主人就打断了[rival.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe you don’t-” [rival.HeShe] starts, before Mistress cuts [rival.himHer] off."

rows.original: “That half a million I mentioned? Half of that went into digging up thorough records on your father, Maximillian Steele, and running the numbers on your activities since this Rush began. You don’t have the resources to keep this up, Steele. You’re either critically in debt already, or rapidly approaching zero.”
rows.translation: “我刚提到的五十万？其中一半都用来彻查你父亲马克西米利安·斯蒂尔的记录，并计算这场星球大淘金开始以来你的各项活动。你没有资源继续撑下去了，斯蒂尔。你要么早已债台高筑，要么很快就会一无所有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That half a million I mentioned? Half of that went into digging up thorough records on your father, Maximillian Steele, and running the numbers on your activities since this Rush began. You don’t have the resources to keep this up, Steele. You’re either critically in debt already, or rapidly approaching zero.”"

rows.original: For the first time, [rival.name] is speechless, mouth agape.
rows.translation: [rival.name]第一次哑口无言，目瞪口呆。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor the first time, [rival.name] is speechless, mouth agape."

rows.original: “I’m making you a one-time offer, Steele. Four-point-two trillion credits to give up, pack your bags, and go home,” Mistress says, withdrawing a credit chip from her corset.
rows.translation: “我只给你这一次机会，斯蒂尔。拿上四点二万亿信用点，放弃竞赛，收拾行李回家，”女主人一边说，一边从紧身胸衣里取出一枚信用芯片。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m making you a one-time offer, Steele. Four-point-two trillion credits to give up, pack your bags, and go home,” Mistress says, withdrawing a credit chip from her corset."

rows.original: “You don’t have that kind of money!” [rival.heShe] sputters.
rows.translation: “你根本没有那么多钱！”[rival.heShe]结结巴巴地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t have that kind of money!” [rival.heShe] sputters."

rows.original: “I took out a loan,” Mistress says simply. Her tone is level, but your turn to her in shock. You’ve spent enough time among the toves to know what that means. Loans amongst toves are seen as massive social failings, and are generally critically predatory. “With my wabeship as collateral,” she adds.
rows.translation: “我借了贷款，”女主人平静地说道。她语调平稳，你却震惊地转向她。你和托芙人相处已久，很清楚这意味着什么。托芙人视贷款为重大的社会失败，而且贷款通常极具掠夺性。“抵押品是我的韦布舰，”她补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I took out a loan,” Mistress says simply. Her tone is level, but your turn to her in shock. You’ve spent enough time among the toves to know what that means. Loans amongst toves are seen as massive social failings, and are generally critically predatory. “With my wabeship as collateral,” she adds."

rows.original: You finally snap your mouth shut, worried that you’ve given something away, only to turn to see the same expression on your cousin’s face.
rows.translation: 你终于合上嘴，担心自己泄露了什么，却转头看见表亲脸上也是同样的表情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finally snap your mouth shut, worried that you’ve given something away, only to turn to see the same expression on your cousin’s face."

rows.original: “Well that just means the fortune has to be even more than that!” [rival.name] sputters. “I can scrounge up what I need and-”
rows.translation: “那只说明这笔财富肯定远不止这些！”[rival.name]急促地说道。“我能凑齐所需的一切，然后-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well that just means the fortune has to be even more than that!” [rival.name] sputters. “I can scrounge up what I need and-”"

rows.original: “No, you can’t,” says Mistress. “The other half of this month’s expenditures saw to that. I’ve bribed, paid-off, or bought-out every contact I could find in order to blacklist you for the rest of the year. No one’s going to do business with you.” She pauses, delicately sipping her tea. “Not forever, mind you,” she adds, “but long enough to put you terminally deep in the red.”
rows.translation: “不，你办不到，”女主人说道。“这个月另外一半开支正是为了确保这一点。我贿赂、收买或买断了能找到的每一位联系人，让你在今年余下的时间里被列入黑名单。不会再有人和你做生意。”她停下来，优雅地啜了一口茶。“当然，不会永远如此，”她补充道，“但足以让你彻底陷入赤字，再也翻不了身。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, you can’t,” says Mistress. “The other half of this month’s expenditures saw to that. I’ve bribed, paid-off, or bought-out every contact I could find in order to blacklist you for the rest of the year. No one’s going to do business with you.” She pauses, delicately sipping her tea. “Not forever, mind you,” she adds, “but long enough to put you terminally deep in the red.”"

rows.original: “Are you INSANE?!” yells [rival.name]. “You bankrupted yourself just to fuck me over?”
rows.translation: “你疯了吗？！”[rival.name]大喊。“你让自己破产，就只是为了整垮我？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you INSANE?!” yells [rival.name]. “You bankrupted yourself just to fuck me over?”"

rows.original: “I think I might be,” says Mistress, smiling. She tugs your collar, pulling you up into the chair with her. “And don’t flatter yourself, [rival.name]-this wasn’t for you.” Her arms wrap tight around you and squeeze.
rows.translation: “我想我或许真疯了，”女主人微笑道。她扯动你的项圈，把你拉上椅子，与她坐在一起。“别自作多情了，[rival.name]-我这么做并不是为了你。”她用双臂紧紧搂住你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think I might be,” says Mistress, smiling. She tugs your collar, pulling you up into the chair with her. “And don’t flatter yourself, [rival.name]-this wasn’t for you.” Her arms wrap tight around you and squeeze."

rows.original: [rival.name]’s eyes widen as [rival.hisHer] eyes snap back and forth between the two of you. “This-this... this is fucking BULLSHIT!” [rival.heShe] screams.
rows.translation: [rival.name]睁大双眼，[rival.hisHer]目光在你们二人之间来回跳动。“这-这... 这他妈全是狗屁！”[rival.heShe]尖叫道。
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name]’s eyes widen as [rival.hisHer] eyes snap back and forth between the two of you. “This-this... this is fucking BULLSHIT!” [rival.heShe] screams."

rows.original: “No, it’s simple,” says Mistress, petting you as she speaks, “You sign a contract renouncing any claim to the Steele fortune and then you get to walk away with 4.2 trillion.”
rows.translation: “不，这很简单，”女主人一边抚摸你一边说道，“你签署合同，放弃对斯蒂尔财富的一切主张，然后就能带着四点二万亿离开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, it’s simple,” says Mistress, petting you as she speaks, “You sign a contract renouncing any claim to the Steele fortune and then you get to walk away with 4.2 trillion.”"

rows.original: “Sounds like a good deal, boss,” says the kaithrit.
rows.translation: “听起来是笔好买卖，老板，”凯斯瑞特人说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like a good deal, boss,” says the kaithrit."

rows.original: “Shut the fuck up! What do you know?” snarls [rival.name]. “You’re just the dumb muscle!”
rows.translation: “他妈的闭嘴！你懂什么？”[rival.name]咆哮道。“你只不过是个没脑子的打手！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shut the fuck up! What do you know?” snarls [rival.name]. “You’re just the dumb muscle!”"

rows.original: “I did graduate at the top of my class, and I’m a certified galactic accountant,” Koriss replies. He pulls a small tablet out of his battle-worn bandolier and begins tapping numbers into it.. “And even based on the limited information I have now, I can tell you that the cost-benefit seems pretty clear-cut.”
rows.translation: “我确实以全班第一名毕业，而且还是持证的银河会计师，”科里斯答道。他从饱经战火的弹带里取出一块小型平板，开始往里面输入数字。“即便只根据我目前掌握的有限信息，也能看出这笔交易的成本收益非常明确。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I did graduate at the top of my class, and I’m a certified galactic accountant,” Koriss replies. He pulls a small tablet out of his battle-worn bandolier and begins tapping numbers into it.. “And even based on the limited information I have now, I can tell you that the cost-benefit seems pretty clear-cut.”"

rows.original: “Really?” says Mistress, her ears perking up. “Would you like a job after you’re done with your current contract?”
rows.translation: “当真？”女主人竖起耳朵说道。“等你完成现有合约后，愿意来为我工作吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?” says Mistress, her ears perking up. “Would you like a job after you’re done with your current contract?”"

rows.original: “All of you shut up! Just shut up! Shut! The Fuck! Up!” screams [rival.name]. [rival.HeShe] takes a few deep breaths before pointing a shaky finger at you.
rows.translation: “你们全都闭嘴！给我闭嘴！闭！他妈的！嘴！”[rival.name]尖叫道。[rival.HeShe]深呼吸了几次，随后用颤抖的手指向你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All of you shut up! Just shut up! Shut! The Fuck! Up!” screams [rival.name]. [rival.HeShe] takes a few deep breaths before pointing a shaky finger at you."

rows.original: “[pc.HimHer],” [rival.name] says finally. “I’ll sign your contract, and you can even keep your money-all four trillion of it-but I get [rival.HimHer] as my own property.”
rows.translation: “[pc.HimHer]，”[rival.name]终于说道。“我会签你的合同，你甚至可以留着那笔钱-整整四万亿-但我要把[rival.HimHer]变成我的私有财产。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HimHer],” [rival.name] says finally. “I’ll sign your contract, and you can even keep your money-all four trillion of it-but I get [rival.HimHer] as my own property.”"

rows.original: A long silence answers this offer.
rows.translation: 漫长的沉默回应了这个提议。
rows.raw: "\n\nA long silence answers this offer."

rows.original: “And what would you do with [pc.HimHer]?” asks Mistress quietly. You glance up at her in alarm, voicing your concern.
rows.translation: “那你打算怎么对待[pc.HimHer]？”女主人轻声问道。你惊慌地抬头看她，说出了自己的担忧。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And what would you do with [pc.HimHer]?” asks Mistress quietly. You glance up at her in alarm, voicing your concern."

rows.original: “Ruin [pc.HimHer],” says [rival.name] through bared teeth. “Just wreck [pc.HisHer] life the way you just wrecked mine.”
rows.translation: “毁掉[pc.HimHer]，”[rival.name]咬牙切齿地说道。“就像你刚刚毁掉我的人生一样，彻底毁掉[pc.HisHer]人生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ruin [pc.HimHer],” says [rival.name] through bared teeth. “Just wreck [pc.HisHer] life the way you just wrecked mine.”"

rows.original: “And this is worth a fortune to you?” Mistress asks.
rows.translation: “你觉得这值得用一笔财富来交换？”女主人问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And this is worth a fortune to you?” Mistress asks."

rows.original: “Yes,” [rival.heShe] says furiously.
rows.translation: “值得，”[rival.heShe]愤怒地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” [rival.heShe] says furiously."

rows.original: “I decline your counteroffer,” says Mistress, simply, pulling you back into her lap.
rows.translation: “我拒绝你的还价，”女主人直截了当地说，把你拉回她腿上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I decline your counteroffer,” says Mistress, simply, pulling you back into her lap."

rows.original: “What?” [rival.name] snarls. “You wouldn’t sell [pc.name] for that much?”
rows.translation: “什么？”[rival.name]咆哮道。“就算给你那么多钱，你也不肯卖掉[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?” [rival.name] snarls. “You wouldn’t sell [pc.name] for that much?”"

rows.original: “No,” says Mistress, looking down at you with a confused expression. “I honestly wouldn’t sell my painslut for any amount, I think,” she says. “How curious,” she murmurs, running her hands across your face. You smile up at her, your worry fading.
rows.translation: “不，”女主人神情困惑地低头看着你。“我想，无论多少钱，我都不会卖掉我的受虐骚货，”她说。“真奇妙，”她低声说着，双手抚过你的脸庞。你仰头朝她微笑，心中的忧虑逐渐消退。
rows.raw: "\n\n“No,” says Mistress, looking down at you with a confused expression. “I honestly wouldn’t sell my painslut for any amount, I think,” she says. “How curious,” she murmurs, running her hands across your face. You smile up at her, your worry fading."

rows.original: “What? WHAT?” fumes [rival.name].
rows.translation: “什么？什么？！”[rival.name]怒不可遏。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What? WHAT?” fumes [rival.name]."

rows.original: “What an un-tove-like thing for me to say,” she remarks, ignoring [rival.name]. “I do believe [pc.heShe]’s ruined me.” She smiles, nuzzling her beak against your lips.
rows.translation: “我竟然说出如此不像托芙人的话，”她无视[rival.name]，评论道。“看来[pc.heShe]真的把我毁了。”她微笑着，用鸟喙轻蹭你的双唇。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What an un-tove-like thing for me to say,” she remarks, ignoring [rival.name]. “I do believe [pc.heShe]’s ruined me.” She smiles, nuzzling her beak against your lips."

rows.original: Your cousin gapes at the two of you, running a hand through [rival.hisHer] hair. “The fuck?” [rival.heShe] finally manages to croak.
rows.translation: 你的表亲目瞪口呆地看着你们，用手梳过[rival.hisHer]头发。“搞什么鬼？”[rival.heShe]终于嘶哑地挤出一句。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour cousin gapes at the two of you, running a hand through [rival.hisHer] hair. “The fuck?” [rival.heShe] finally manages to croak."

rows.original: [rival.HeShe] blusters for a bit more, but the fight seems to have gone out of [rival.himHer]. After a half hour more of dire threats and exasperation, [rival.heShe] finally consents to the original terms. Koriss and your Mistress review the contract, arguing over the finer points, before [rival.name] signs it and Mistress hands [rival.himHer] the credit chip.
rows.translation: [rival.HeShe]又虚张声势了一阵，但[rival.himHer]似乎已经没了斗志。又经过半小时的严厉威胁和恼怒之后，[rival.heShe]终于同意了最初的条款。科里斯与你的女主人审阅合同，就细节争论一番，随后[rival.name]签下合同，女主人把信用芯片交给[rival.himHer]。
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.HeShe] blusters for a bit more, but the fight seems to have gone out of [rival.himHer]. After a half hour more of dire threats and exasperation, [rival.heShe] finally consents to the original terms. Koriss and your Mistress review the contract, arguing over the finer points, before [rival.name] signs it and Mistress hands [rival.himHer] the credit chip."

rows.original: When [rival.name] finally storms out of the room, [rival.heShe] stops to shoot you the most malignant glare [rival.heShe] can muster before he leaves. But it doesn’t really matter.
rows.translation: 当[rival.name]终于怒气冲冲地走出房间时，[rival.heShe]停下来，竭尽所能恶狠狠地瞪了你一眼，随后[rival.heShe]才离开。但那已经无关紧要。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen [rival.name] finally storms out of the room, [rival.heShe] stops to shoot you the most malignant glare [rival.heShe] can muster before he leaves. But it doesn’t really matter."

rows.original: What matters is your Mistress.
rows.translation: 重要的是你的女主人。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat matters is your Mistress."

rows.original: With the others finally gone, you sidle up next to her. “Are you going to be alright?” you ask.
rows.translation: 其他人终于离开后，你侧身靠到她身旁。“你不会有事吧？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith the others finally gone, you sidle up next to her. “Are you going to be alright?” you ask."

rows.original: “I think so,” she says, her eyes a bit distant. “The wabeship was the collateral, after all. I’ll lose that, but not my shuttle. We can still get around in that, even if it means smaller accommodations than we’re used to, while we search for your father’s fortune.”
rows.translation: “我想不会，”她说道，眼神有些恍惚。“毕竟抵押品是韦布舰。我会失去它，但不会失去穿梭机。我们仍然能靠它四处旅行，虽然在寻找你父亲财富的过程中，住处会比以前狭小一些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think so,” she says, her eyes a bit distant. “The wabeship was the collateral, after all. I’ll lose that, but not my shuttle. We can still get around in that, even if it means smaller accommodations than we’re used to, while we search for your father’s fortune.”"

rows.original: “What if it’s not enough?” you ask. “I mean, it can’t be as much as four trillion credits.”
rows.translation: “如果那笔钱不够呢？”你问。“我是说，它肯定没有四万亿信用点那么多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What if it’s not enough?” you ask. “I mean, it can’t be as much as four trillion credits.”"

rows.original: “I think... I actually think that would be okay,” Mistress says, her eyes focusing on you. She laughs suddenly, wrapping her feathered tail around you. You’re suddenly reminded of the long-ago aftercare sessions the two of you spent back on Uveto VII.
rows.translation: “我觉得... 我真的觉得那也没关系，”女主人的目光聚焦在你身上。她忽然笑起来，用覆羽的尾巴缠住你。你蓦然想起很久以前你们在乌维托七号上共度的那些事后安抚时光。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think... I actually think that would be okay,” Mistress says, her eyes focusing on you. She laughs suddenly, wrapping her feathered tail around you. You’re suddenly reminded of the long-ago aftercare sessions the two of you spent back on Uveto VII."

rows.original: “Oh my goodness, painslut!” she chortles. “I’ve spent so much time breaking you over and over, that I didn’t notice when you broke me. Can you believe it? I honestly don’t care about the money.”
rows.translation: “天哪，小骚货！”她咯咯笑道。“我花了那么多时间一次次摧毁你，却没注意到你何时也摧毁了我。你敢相信吗？我真的不在乎钱了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my goodness, painslut!” she chortles. “I’ve spent so much time breaking you over and over, that I didn’t notice when you broke me. Can you believe it? I honestly don’t care about the money.”"

rows.original: She wraps her arms around you hugging you close to her body. You return the embrace, your arms sinking into her plush feathers. “Just you,” she says.
rows.translation: 她张开双臂把你紧紧抱在怀里。你也回抱着她，双臂陷入她柔软蓬松的羽毛中。“我只在乎你，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe wraps her arms around you hugging you close to her body. You return the embrace, your arms sinking into her plush feathers. “Just you,” she says."

rows.original: “Follow me, then,” says [xotchi.name], turning toward the gaudy back wall. At her approach a panel WOOSH-es up.
rows.translation: “那就跟我来，”[xotchi.name]说着转向花哨的后墙。她一靠近，一块面板便嗖地升起。
rows.raw: "“Follow me, then,” says [xotchi.name], turning toward the gaudy back wall. At her approach a panel WOOSH-es up."

rows.original: You duck down a little to follow her.
rows.translation: 你稍稍低下身子，跟着她走进去。
rows.raw: " You duck down a little to follow her."

rows.original: She walks ahead of you, moving with the awkward shuffle of all toves walking bipedally. It’s kind of funny-such a domineering personality in a 3-foot creature that waddles so much that the black feather in her headdress bounces with every step. You stifle a laugh and follow behind
rows.translation: 她走在前面，迈着所有托芙人用双足行走时那种笨拙的碎步。一个身高三英尺、走起路来摇摇摆摆，连头饰上的黑色羽毛都随着每一步上下弹动的小生物，却有如此盛气凌人的性格，实在有些滑稽。你忍住笑，跟在她身后
rows.raw: " She walks ahead of you, moving with the awkward shuffle of all toves walking bipedally. It’s kind of funny-such a domineering personality in a 3-foot creature that waddles so much that the black feather in her headdress bounces with every step. You stifle a laugh and follow behind"

rows.original: , stooping to avoid hitting your head on the ceiling
rows.translation: ，弯腰以免脑袋撞上天花板
rows.raw: ", stooping to avoid hitting your head on the ceiling"

rows.original: The hallway is startlingly bare after the saturated tropical panorama of the main office. Gray, brushed steel makes up the walls, floor, and ceiling of a hallway only a few yards long. Small domes of light are placed in regular lines along the walls. Oddly enough, the hall seems as wide as it is tall, feeling more like a tunnel than a typical hallway. At the far end is a circular doorway, a metal iris spiraled shut.
rows.translation: 主办公室那片色彩浓烈的热带全景之后，这条走廊的空旷令人吃惊。仅有数码长的走廊，其墙壁、地板与天花板全由灰色拉丝钢构成。一排排小型穹顶灯沿墙面规律分布。奇怪的是，走廊宽度似乎与高度相同，感觉更像隧道而不是普通走廊。最远端是一扇圆形门，金属虹膜呈螺旋状紧紧闭合。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hallway is startlingly bare after the saturated tropical panorama of the main office. Gray, brushed steel makes up the walls, floor, and ceiling of a hallway only a few yards long. Small domes of light are placed in regular lines along the walls. Oddly enough, the hall seems as wide as it is tall, feeling more like a tunnel than a typical hallway. At the far end is a circular doorway, a metal iris spiraled shut."

rows.original: When she reaches the far end of the hall, [xotchi.name] snaps open her fan, her claw tips playing over a myriad of icons. A hollow beeping emits from some unseen speaker. You think you can hear-from the other side of the door-the sucking sound of water draining.
rows.translation: 抵达走廊尽头时，[xotchi.name]啪地展开扇子，爪尖在无数图标间游移。某个看不见的扬声器传出空洞的哔哔声。你似乎听见门的另一侧传来排水时的抽吸声。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen she reaches the far end of the hall, [xotchi.name] snaps open her fan, her claw tips playing over a myriad of icons. A hollow beeping emits from some unseen speaker. You think you can hear-from the other side of the door-the sucking sound of water draining."

rows.original: “I’m assuming that, like most of the sapients that come through here, you’re solely terrestrial,” she says with a disdainful sniff. “We’re entering the workstrata of the wabeship. It’s normally staffed solely with toves, and we much prefer swimming to walking.”
rows.translation: “我猜，你和大多数来这里的智慧生物一样，只能在陆地上活动，”她轻蔑地哼了一声。“我们正要进入韦布舰的工作层。那里通常只有托芙人员，而我们更喜欢游泳，不喜欢走路。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m assuming that, like most of the sapients that come through here, you’re solely terrestrial,” she says with a disdainful sniff. “We’re entering the workstrata of the wabeship. It’s normally staffed solely with toves, and we much prefer swimming to walking.”"

rows.original: “Fully half of this station is filled with water to accommodate the tove staff that keeps it running,” she explains, tapping a clawed foot against the steel floor as the draining sound continues. “What you terrestrials experience is the part of the ship we build for customers.”
rows.translation: “这座空间站有整整一半装满了水，以便维持其运转的托芙人员活动，”她解释道，排水声仍在持续，而她用带爪的脚轻敲钢制地板。“你们陆生种族所见的区域，是我们专门为顾客建造的部分。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fully half of this station is filled with water to accommodate the tove staff that keeps it running,” she explains, tapping a clawed foot against the steel floor as the draining sound continues. “What you terrestrials experience is the part of the ship we build for customers.”"

rows.original: You think back to the size of the satellite and the small amount of it you’ve been able to explore, the impact of her words settling on you. “We have a crew complement of 800 toves in the workstrata of Uveto Station, give or take 25 on leave at any given time. All working hard to keep it operating smoothly,” she adds.
rows.translation: 你回想起这颗卫星的大小，以及自己能够探索的那一小部分，她话中的分量渐渐沉入心底。“乌维托空间站工作层的编制是八百名托芙人，任何时候大约都有二十五人休假。所有人都在努力工作，以确保它顺畅运转，”她补充道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think back to the size of the satellite and the small amount of it you’ve been able to explore, the impact of her words settling on you. “We have a crew complement of 800 toves in the workstrata of Uveto Station, give or take 25 on leave at any given time. All working hard to keep it operating smoothly,” she adds."

rows.original: The metal iris opens, revealing a blue tunnel beyond it.
rows.translation: 金属虹膜开启，露出后方的一条蓝色隧道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe metal iris opens, revealing a blue tunnel beyond it."

rows.original: “Try not to make a fool of yourself,” says [xotchi.name] bafflingly, as she steps through it. You walk through the door, blinking at the sight before you.
rows.translation: “尽量别让自己出丑，”[xotchi.name]莫名其妙地说了一句，随后跨过门槛。你穿过门，眨眼看着眼前的景象。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Try not to make a fool of yourself,” says [xotchi.name] bafflingly, as she steps through it. You walk through the door, blinking at the sight before you."

rows.original: You’re in a tunnel again, but this is one appears to me made of an energy field, similar to your own shields. Outside of it, though, is a chamber easily 30 feet high and twice as a wide, filled with water. Toves drift overhead through it; their bodies-amusingly awkward on land-undulate gracefully through water. With their talons tucked, they’re surprisingly streamlined, moving like eels between massive satellite-shaped apparatuses hanging in the water.
rows.translation: 你再次身处隧道，但这一条似乎由类似你自身护盾的能量场构成。而在隧道之外，是一座足有三十英尺高、宽度更达其两倍的水下空间。托芙人从头顶漂游而过；他们在陆地上笨拙得令人发笑的身体，在水中却优雅地起伏。收起利爪后，他们的流线型身躯令人惊讶，像鳗鱼般穿梭于悬浮在水中的巨型卫星状设备之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re in a tunnel again, but this is one appears to me made of an energy field, similar to your own shields. Outside of it, though, is a chamber easily 30 feet high and twice as a wide, filled with water. Toves drift overhead through it; their bodies-amusingly awkward on land-undulate gracefully through water. With their talons tucked, they’re surprisingly streamlined, moving like eels between massive satellite-shaped apparatuses hanging in the water."

rows.original: Stationary toves cluster around the satellites, and you realize that the irregular spheres are consoles, covered in screens and keyboards. The four-armed toves work busily at them, their eyes flickering independently from screen to screen. You hear nothing in the tunnel but the impatient tapping of Xotchi’s talon on the steel floor. But you notice that the toves in the water overhead don’t seem to be talking-instead, when two toves meet, their feathery ears sway this way and that, gesturing meaning to one another.
rows.translation: 静止不动的托芙人聚集在那些卫星周围，你这才发现，那些不规则球体其实是布满屏幕与键盘的控制台。四臂托芙人在上面忙碌工作，双眼各自独立地从一块屏幕转向另一块。隧道里除了索奇不耐烦地用利爪敲击钢地板的声音外一片寂静。但你注意到，头顶水中的托芙人似乎并不说话；当两个托芙人相遇时，他们覆羽的耳朵便向各个方向摆动，以姿态向彼此传达含义。
rows.raw: "\n\nStationary toves cluster around the satellites, and you realize that the irregular spheres are consoles, covered in screens and keyboards. The four-armed toves work busily at them, their eyes flickering independently from screen to screen. You hear nothing in the tunnel but the impatient tapping of Xotchi’s talon on the steel floor. But you notice that the toves in the water overhead don’t seem to be talking-instead, when two toves meet, their feathery ears sway this way and that, gesturing meaning to one another."

rows.original: “Are you going to continue gaping like you’re sundazed?” asks [xotchi.name], snapping her fan open and tapping out several complex patterns on it. “Because I could be attending to other things in the meanwhile.”
rows.translation: “你打算继续像被阳光晒昏了一样张着嘴发呆吗？”[xotchi.name]问道，啪地展开扇子，在上面敲出几个复杂图案。“因为与此同时，我本来可以去处理别的事情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are you going to continue gaping like you’re sundazed?” asks [xotchi.name], snapping her fan open and tapping out several complex patterns on it. “Because I could be attending to other things in the meanwhile.”"

rows.original: She leads you across the floor to a wall on the opposite side. “The route will be a bit long, as you terrestrials are limited to two dimensions.”
rows.translation: 她领你穿过地板，走向对面的墙。“路线会稍微长一些，因为你们陆生种族只能在二维平面上移动。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leads you across the floor to a wall on the opposite side. “The route will be a bit long, as you terrestrials are limited to two dimensions.”"

rows.original: She takes you down several more corridors, some made of transparent tubes winding between gigantic, churning machines, others made of the same brushed steel of the first corridor, and through at least one other massive, water-filled room. Once or twice, you wait as [xotchi.name] adjusts the gravity in the following corridor to allow you to slide down it as a gentle slope. It might be your imagination, but her deep-orange feathers seem to be fluffing out more and more with each passing tunnel and tube, making the tove look both agitated and even more like a stuffed animal.
rows.translation: 她又领你穿过几条走廊，其中一些是盘绕在轰鸣巨型机器之间的透明管道，另一些则采用第一条走廊那样的拉丝钢结构，途中还至少经过另一座装满水的巨大房间。有一两次，[xotchi.name]调整下一条走廊的重力，让你能沿着和缓的斜坡滑下去。也许只是你的错觉，但每穿过一条隧道和管道，她深橙色的羽毛似乎就越发蓬起，使这名托芙人既显得烦躁，又更像一只毛绒玩具。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes you down several more corridors, some made of transparent tubes winding between gigantic, churning machines, others made of the same brushed steel of the first corridor, and through at least one other massive, water-filled room. Once or twice, you wait as [xotchi.name] adjusts the gravity in the following corridor to allow you to slide down it as a gentle slope. It might be your imagination, but her deep-orange feathers seem to be fluffing out more and more with each passing tunnel and tube, making the tove look both agitated and even more like a stuffed animal."

rows.original: “It would not be a good idea for you to wander off,” she notes.
rows.translation: “你最好不要擅自走开，”她提醒道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It would not be a good idea for you to wander off,” she notes."

rows.original: You weigh her words, considering that even if you could navigate your way through the tunnels of the workstrata, getting through the massive, water-filled chambers would be fairly difficult.
rows.translation: 你掂量着她的话，想到即便你能够在工作层的隧道中辨认方向，要穿过那些装满水的巨大空间也会相当困难。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weigh her words, considering that even if you could navigate your way through the tunnels of the workstrata, getting through the massive, water-filled chambers would be fairly difficult."

rows.original: After walking through what feels like a half mile of tunnels, you slide down a clear, plastic tube into a small, dark room.
rows.translation: 在仿佛走过半英里的隧道后，你沿一条透明塑料管滑进一个狭小昏暗的房间。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter walking through what feels like a half mile of tunnels, you slide down a clear, plastic tube into a small, dark room."

rows.original: It’s circular and maybe fifteen feet across, and looks nothing like the other rooms you’ve seen so far. The walls are pitch black, with faint lights glowing from them, like distant stars. The room is primarily lit by a large, blue ring set in the center of the floor.
rows.translation: 房间呈圆形，直径大约十五英尺，与此前见过的所有房间都截然不同。墙壁漆黑一片，表面有微弱光点闪烁，如同遥远群星。房间主要由地板中央嵌着的一道巨大蓝色圆环照亮。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s circular and maybe fifteen feet across, and looks nothing like the other rooms you’ve seen so far. The walls are pitch black, with faint lights glowing from them, like distant stars. The room is primarily lit by a large, blue ring set in the center of the floor."

rows.original: “I’ve had quite enough waiting,” says [xotchi.name], sliding through the tunnel and landing on floor behind you, she huffs. “As un-tove-like as it is, I’m going to generate a verbal contract.”
rows.translation: “我已经等得够久了，”[xotchi.name]说着滑出隧道，落在你身后的地板上，气恼地哼了一声。“尽管这很不像托芙人的作风，我还是要拟定一份口头合约。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve had quite enough waiting,” says [xotchi.name], sliding through the tunnel and landing on floor behind you, she huffs. “As un-tove-like as it is, I’m going to generate a verbal contract.”"

rows.original: You turn to face the little creature on the floor behind you as she taps her fan and clears her throat. “This is Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall of the Uveto VII Station Wabeship. I am engaging in a consensual sexual encounter that will include restraint, pain, electrical play, and pleasure denial. At any point, either party may terminate the encounter by stating so. Please state your name and consent to the encounter.”
rows.translation: 你转身面向身后地板上的小生物。她轻敲扇子，清了清嗓子。“本人是乌维托七号空间站韦布舰的索奇·扎尔副夫人。我将参与一次双方自愿的性行为，其中包括束缚、疼痛、电击游戏与快感剥夺。任何一方都可以随时声明终止此次行为。请说出你的姓名，并明确表示同意参与。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou turn to face the little creature on the floor behind you as she taps her fan and clears her throat. “This is Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall of the Uveto VII Station Wabeship. I am engaging in a consensual sexual encounter that will include restraint, pain, electrical play, and pleasure denial. At any point, either party may terminate the encounter by stating so. Please state your name and consent to the encounter.”"

rows.original: You consider her words, and then state your own name and willingness to participate.
rows.translation: 你思量片刻，随后报出自己的姓名，并表示愿意参与。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou consider her words, and then state your own name and willingness to participate."

rows.original: “Finally!” chirps [xotchi.name], the one word blending hunger, frustration, and eagerness in three short syllables.
rows.translation: “终于！”[xotchi.name]啁啾道，短短三个音节便融入了饥渴、挫败与急切。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Finally!” chirps [xotchi.name], the one word blending hunger, frustration, and eagerness in three short syllables."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: [xotchi.name] chirps instructions to you, then busies herself, punching in complex commands into her fan. You [pc.move] into the blue ring on the floor, and raise your hands above your head. A loud humming saturates the air as the blue ring glows with a dim, insistent light. You glance down, curious, as the ring rises up out of the floor, rising up to
rows.translation: [xotchi.name]啁啾着向你发出指示，随后忙着在扇子上输入复杂命令。你[pc.move]到地板上的蓝色圆环内，将双手举过头顶。响亮的嗡鸣充斥空气，蓝色圆环泛起暗淡却不容忽视的光芒。你好奇地低头看去，只见圆环从地板升起，一路升到
rows.raw: "[xotchi.name] chirps instructions to you, then busies herself, punching in complex commands into her fan. You [pc.move] into the blue ring on the floor, and raise your hands above your head. A loud humming saturates the air as the blue ring glows with a dim, insistent light. You glance down, curious, as the ring rises up out of the floor, rising up to"

rows.original: your ankles
rows.translation: 你的脚踝处
rows.raw: " your ankles"

rows.original: halfway up your tail
rows.translation: 你的尾巴中段
rows.raw: " halfway up your tail"

rows.original: . The ring stops, rotating slowly just as a flare of light above your head heralds another ring descending from the ceiling. It slides down around your wrists, spinning counter-motion to the one below you.

rows.raw: ". The ring stops, rotating slowly just as a flare of light above your head heralds another ring descending from the ceiling. It slides down around your wrists, spinning counter-motion to the one below you."

rows.original: Bemused, you try to drop your arms, wondering if the ring will follow your wrists. With a start, you realize that your hands are locked in place above your head. You look down, attempting to shift your [pc.feet], only to find that they’re not moving either. A tingle down your back and a sudden lurch in your gut announces something else as of yet unseen.
rows.translation: 你困惑地试着放下手臂，想看看圆环是否会跟随手腕。你猛然发现双手被锁定在头顶。你低头试图挪动[pc.feet]，却发现它们同样无法移动。背部掠过一阵刺麻，腹中忽然一沉，宣告着某种尚未显现的变化。
rows.raw: "\n\nBemused, you try to drop your arms, wondering if the ring will follow your wrists. With a start, you realize that your hands are locked in place above your head. You look down, attempting to shift your [pc.feet], only to find that they’re not moving either. A tingle down your back and a sudden lurch in your gut announces something else as of yet unseen."

rows.original: You turn this way and that, seeing nothing, but sure that something’s going on. It’s not until you become aware of a faint dizziness
