You don’t recall drifting off, and in truth, you don’t-not really anyway-slipping instead into a happy doze, lulled by the artificial tug of waves and the hissing sound of sand rolling underwater.
rows.translation: “它有助于麻痹并再生组织。”你靠在淡紫沙粒上，[xotchi.name]从头顶漂过，用小球沿身体上下滑动时，你不由自主地抽搐。你不记得自己何时睡着，而实际上，你并没有——至少不完全算——只是进入幸福的小憩，人工浪潮的牵引和沙粒在水下滚动的嘶响令你昏昏欲睡。
rows.raw: " “It helps to numb and regenerate tissue.” You lean back on the lavender sands, twitching involuntarily as [xotchi.name] drifts overhead, running the orb up and down your body. You don’t recall drifting off, and in truth, you don’t-not really anyway-slipping instead into a happy doze, lulled by the artificial tug of waves and the hissing sound of sand rolling underwater."

rows.original: “Not many can cope with the pain you endured, [xotchi.pcName],” she notes, massaging the tincture into you. You’re so relaxed that you barely notice when she curls up, cat-like, on your chest, her multitude of hands massaging softly against you.
rows.translation: “没多少人能承受你刚才经历的痛苦，[xotchi.pcName]，”她一边把药剂按摩进你的身体一边说道。你放松到了极点，甚至几乎没注意到她像猫一样蜷缩在胸膛上，无数双手柔和地按摩着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not many can cope with the pain you endured, [xotchi.pcName],” she notes, massaging the tincture into you. You’re so relaxed that you barely notice when she curls up, cat-like, on your chest, her multitude of hands massaging softly against you."

rows.original: “Perhaps we could do even more,” she notes. You blink your eyes open in alarm.
rows.translation: “也许我们可以做得更多，”她说道。你惊慌地睁开眼睛。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps we could do even more,” she notes. You blink your eyes open in alarm."

rows.original: She laughs, a curious sound like a dozen songbirds chattering. “At another time,” she clarifies, reading your expression. “And with your consent, of course,” she adds.
rows.translation: 她笑了起来，声音很奇特，仿佛十几只鸣禽同时啁啾。“改天再说，”她看懂你的表情，澄清道。“当然，也得征得你的同意，”她补充说。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs, a curious sound like a dozen songbirds chattering. “At another time,” she clarifies, reading your expression. “And with your consent, of course,” she adds."

rows.original: “That’s one of the secrets of domination-or maybe one of its curious ironies,” she sighs, nesting down against you. Her fluffy body is warm, and the heat feels even better than the regelatin against your bruised body.
rows.translation: “这就是支配的秘密之一——又或许，是它奇妙的讽刺之一，”她叹息着，靠在你身上蜷缩起来。毛茸茸的身体十分温暖，贴在伤痕累累的身体上时，这股热意甚至比再生明胶更舒服。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s one of the secrets of domination-or maybe one of its curious ironies,” she sighs, nesting down against you. Her fluffy body is warm, and the heat feels even better than the regelatin against your bruised body."

rows.original: “The Domme feigns control over the submissive, but the submissive is the one with all the power. If the submissive withdraws consent, then the session is over,” she explains. “It’s a poor Dominant who tries to push a submissive further than they agreed, or pressures a sub into something they don’t want. A good Dominant will do only what the sub agrees to, and not a thing more.”
rows.translation: “支配者假装掌控臣服者，但真正握有全部权力的其实是臣服者。如果臣服者撤回同意，游戏就结束了，”她解释道。“试图把臣服者逼到超过约定的程度，或强迫对方做不愿做的事，都是糟糕的支配者。优秀的支配者只会做臣服者同意的事情，一点也不会超过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Domme feigns control over the submissive, but the submissive is the one with all the power. If the submissive withdraws consent, then the session is over,” she explains. “It’s a poor Dominant who tries to push a submissive further than they agreed, or pressures a sub into something they don’t want. A good Dominant will do only what the sub agrees to, and not a thing more.”"

rows.original: “And I am a very good Dominant,” she preens, lifting her head regally, her crest of plumes arching up between her ears.
rows.translation: “而我是个非常优秀的支配者，”她得意地抬起脑袋，头顶羽冠在双耳之间高高竖起，仪态威严。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I am a very good Dominant,” she preens, lifting her head regally, her crest of plumes arching up between her ears."

rows.original: You take a chance and run your fingers under her chin, stroking her feathers in encouragement. Her eyes widen in surprise, before she smiles down at you. She reaches down with her front pair of hands, stroking your head.
rows.translation: 你冒险伸出手指，沿她下巴下方抚过羽毛，以示鼓励。她惊讶地睁大眼睛，随后低头朝你微笑。她伸下最前方的一双手，抚摸你的脑袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a chance and run your fingers under her chin, stroking her feathers in encouragement. Her eyes widen in surprise, before she smiles down at you. She reaches down with her front pair of hands, stroking your head."

rows.original: “And you are an excellent submissive,” she coos.
rows.translation: “而你是个出色的臣服者，”她娇声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you are an excellent submissive,” she coos."

rows.original: You stay in that position for a while, [xotchi.name] preening atop your chest as you pet her. The tove voicing her approval through words or happy trills of contentment. At one point, she scampers off to a wall panel and returns with a small, silver pouch.
rows.translation: 你们保持这个姿势待了一会儿；你抚摸[xotchi.name]时，她在胸膛上梳理羽毛。这名托芙以言语或满足的欢快颤鸣表达赞许。期间，她一度蹦向墙上嵌板，回来时带着一个银色小袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stay in that position for a while, [xotchi.name] preening atop your chest as you pet her. The tove voicing her approval through words or happy trills of contentment. At one point, she scampers off to a wall panel and returns with a small, silver pouch."

rows.original: She holds the nozzle of the pouch to your lips, encouraging you to drink. “Hydrate or you’ll cramp up,” she scolds gently. You sip gratefully, nestling happily against the warm fur of her embrace.
rows.translation: 她把袋子吸嘴送到你唇边，鼓励你饮用。“补充水分，否则会抽筋，”她温柔责备道。你感激地啜饮，幸福地依偎在她怀抱的温暖绒毛中。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe holds the nozzle of the pouch to your lips, encouraging you to drink. “Hydrate or you’ll cramp up,” she scolds gently. You sip gratefully, nestling happily against the warm fur of her embrace."

rows.original: An hour passes as the ache in your muscles fade, and the floating headspace dissolves, leaving you feeling more grounded. After making sure that you’re feeling like yourself again, [xotchi.name] gets you into a standing position, slowly turning the full gravity on.
rows.translation: 一个小时过去，肌肉的酸痛渐渐消退，漂浮恍惚感也随之消散，让你重新有了脚踏实地的感觉。确认你恢复正常后，[xotchi.name]扶你站起，慢慢恢复完整重力。
rows.raw: "\n\nAn hour passes as the ache in your muscles fade, and the floating headspace dissolves, leaving you feeling more grounded. After making sure that you’re feeling like yourself again, [xotchi.name] gets you into a standing position, slowly turning the full gravity on."

rows.original: Back under full gravity, [xotchi.name] is back to the stocky scampering that’s characteristic of toves, waddling ahead to open up the pathway ahead, leading you up through the labyrinth of tunnels. She gives you a reassuring pat on the hips. “Feel free to drop by again. Maybe we’ll try something a little more adventurous next time.”
rows.translation: 完整重力恢复后，[xotchi.name]再次以托芙特有的矮胖蹦跳姿态行动，摇摆着走在前面打开通道，带你穿过迷宫般的隧道向上。她安慰地拍了拍你的胯部。“随时欢迎再来。也许下次可以尝试更有冒险性的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBack under full gravity, [xotchi.name] is back to the stocky scampering that’s characteristic of toves, waddling ahead to open up the pathway ahead, leading you up through the labyrinth of tunnels. She gives you a reassuring pat on the hips. “Feel free to drop by again. Maybe we’ll try something a little more adventurous next time.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure if that’s a good thing or a bad thing, but you smile back at her, walking out of the Camarilla office.
rows.translation: 你不确定这究竟是好事还是坏事，但仍回以微笑，走出卡玛利拉办公室。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure if that’s a good thing or a bad thing, but you smile back at her, walking out of the Camarilla office."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’re really not feeling this, and you tell [xotchi.name] so.
rows.translation: 你实在不喜欢这样，于是把想法告诉[xotchi.name]。
rows.raw: "You’re really not feeling this, and you tell [xotchi.name] so."

rows.original: She blinks all four eyes together, and clicks her beak once.
rows.translation: 她同时眨了眨四只眼睛，又咔哒了一下鸟喙。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks all four eyes together, and clicks her beak once."

rows.original: “Well, that’s fine, I suppose” she says, twisting the base of the silver battery. The violet tendrils retract, and the electric crackle fades out. The orange tove definitely looks a little disappointed, and you comment on that.
rows.translation: “好吧，我想也没关系，”她一边说，一边转动银色电池底部。紫色触须缩回去，电流噼啪声也随之消失。橙色托芙显然有点失望，你对此发表了意见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, that’s fine, I suppose” she says, twisting the base of the silver battery. The violet tendrils retract, and the electric crackle fades out. The orange tove definitely looks a little disappointed, and you comment on that."

rows.original: “I suppose I am,” she says, tapping out a few commands on the battery in her hands. The seascape around you fades, leaving behind the silver walls of the holographic chamber. Your hardlight bindings dissolve in a spray of sparkles as you float free in the zero gravity.
rows.translation: “我想是的，”她说道，在手中电池上输入几个指令。周围海景渐渐消退，露出全息房间的银色墙壁。硬光束缚化作漫天火花消散，你自由地漂浮在零重力中。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I suppose I am,” she says, tapping out a few commands on the battery in her hands. The seascape around you fades, leaving behind the silver walls of the holographic chamber. Your hardlight bindings dissolve in a spray of sparkles as you float free in the zero gravity."

rows.original: “But that’s not your problem,” she says. It sounds passive aggressive, and you feel the need to respond to that. She cuts you off before you can, though.
rows.translation: “但那不是你的问题，”她说道。语气听起来有些消极攻击性，你觉得需要对此作出回应。不过，她在你开口前就打断了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But that’s not your problem,” she says. It sounds passive aggressive, and you feel the need to respond to that. She cuts you off before you can, though."

rows.original: “It is distinctly NOT your problem,” she chirps shortly. “A good Dominant respects a submissive’s boundaries, and a good tove respects a contract-even a verbal one.” She swims through the air to the locker panel, clipping her flowered headset back into place.
rows.translation: “那绝对不是你的问题，”她简短鸣叫道。“优秀的支配者尊重臣服者的界限，优秀的托芙尊重契约——即使只是口头契约。”她从空中游向储物嵌板，把带花纹的耳机重新夹回原位。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It is distinctly NOT your problem,” she chirps shortly. “A good Dominant respects a submissive’s boundaries, and a good tove respects a contract-even a verbal one.” She swims through the air to the locker panel, clipping her flowered headset back into place."

rows.original: You open your mouth to reply, but a flashing red light overhead interrupts you.
rows.translation: 你张嘴准备回答，但头顶闪烁的红灯打断了你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou open your mouth to reply, but a flashing red light overhead interrupts you."

rows.original: “People today ...” she mumbles, tapping her headset and speaking into it. “I told you to never interrupt me during a session!” she snaps.
rows.translation: “现在的人啊 ...”她嘟囔着，轻点耳机并对着它说话。“我说过，游戏期间绝对不要打扰我！”她厉声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“People today ...” she mumbles, tapping her headset and speaking into it. “I told you to never interrupt me during a session!” she snaps."

rows.original: As she converses, you take the time to stretch out your limbs. You weren’t restrained for very long, and your arms aren’t particularly stiff. It takes only a few zero-g exercises to get yourself feeling back to normal.
rows.translation: 趁她交谈，你活动了一下四肢。你被束缚的时间不长，手臂并没有特别僵硬。只需做几下零重力运动，你便恢复正常。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs she converses, you take the time to stretch out your limbs. You weren’t restrained for very long, and your arms aren’t particularly stiff. It takes only a few zero-g exercises to get yourself feeling back to normal."

rows.original: “[xotchi.pcName],” she says, tapping her headset off. “It’s terribly poor manners, but I’m going to have to leave without providing you any aftercare for our session. We’ve got a ‘dignitary’ visiting the station, and I need to greet him.” She uses all four hands for her finger quotes, doubling the amount of sarcasm that should be possible.
rows.translation: “[xotchi.pcName]，”她关掉耳机说道。“这实在很失礼，但我不得不离开，无法为刚才的游戏提供事后照护。空间站来了一位‘显贵’，需要我去迎接。”她用四只手同时做出引号手势，让讽刺程度足足翻倍。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[xotchi.pcName],” she says, tapping her headset off. “It’s terribly poor manners, but I’m going to have to leave without providing you any aftercare for our session. We’ve got a ‘dignitary’ visiting the station, and I need to greet him.” She uses all four hands for her finger quotes, doubling the amount of sarcasm that should be possible."

rows.original: “Even short sessions necessitate aftercare, though,” she says. “Recuperation time,” she explains, “care for your body and brain so that it can reset after experiencing a significantly altered state. I’ll send in someone you’re familiar with so that you’ll be comfortable adjusting.” Her explanation picks up speed as she goes. By the time she snaps her corset and accessories into place, her tone has taken on its usual irritated rasp.
rows.translation: “不过，即便短暂游戏也需要事后照护，”她说道。“恢复时间，”她解释道，“照顾身体和大脑，让它们在经历显著改变的状态后复原。我会派一个你熟悉的人进来，让你能够舒适地适应。”她越解释语速越快。等把束腰和配饰扣回原位时，语气已经恢复平日那种烦躁沙哑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even short sessions necessitate aftercare, though,” she says. “Recuperation time,” she explains, “care for your body and brain so that it can reset after experiencing a significantly altered state. I’ll send in someone you’re familiar with so that you’ll be comfortable adjusting.” Her explanation picks up speed as she goes. By the time she snaps her corset and accessories into place, her tone has taken on its usual irritated rasp."

rows.original: “Sincerest apologies again, [xotchi.pcName],” she says, darting out of the entry port. As she leaves you can hear her voice echoing behind her. “Fucking Scrote! If he mentions paying for his Dyson Sphere again, I’m going to peck out his eyes...!”
rows.translation: “再次向你致以最诚挚的歉意，[xotchi.pcName]，”她说着，飞快冲出入口。她离开时，你还能听见声音在身后回荡。“该死的屌蛋！要是他再提一次给戴森球付钱的事，我就把他的眼睛啄出来...！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sincerest apologies again, [xotchi.pcName],” she says, darting out of the entry port. As she leaves you can hear her voice echoing behind her. “Fucking Scrote! If he mentions paying for his Dyson Sphere again, I’m going to peck out his eyes...!”"

rows.original: A second later, the entry port to the room snaps open, and a familiar pink form darts in, undulating through the air.
rows.translation: 片刻后，房间入口啪地打开，一个熟悉的粉红色身影冲了进来，在空中波浪般游动。
rows.raw: "\n\nA second later, the entry port to the room snaps open, and a familiar pink form darts in, undulating through the air."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Oh my goshness! Saludatations again, S-s-s-s-steele!” chirps Tlako. Her greeting ends on a curious chatter, and you notice that the little pink tove is shivering so hard that she’s practically vibrating in mid air.
rows.translation: “我的天呀！再次向你问问问问候，斯、斯、斯、斯蒂尔！”特拉科啁啾道。她的问候以奇怪的牙齿打颤声结束，你注意到这只粉红色小托芙抖得如此厉害，几乎在半空中震动起来。
rows.raw: "“Oh my goshness! Saludatations again, S-s-s-s-steele!” chirps Tlako. Her greeting ends on a curious chatter, and you notice that the little pink tove is shivering so hard that she’s practically vibrating in mid air."

rows.original: “S-s-s-sub-madam Xotchi to me to assis-sis-sist you with your recuperacation,” she stutters. Her four arms are wrapped tight around her, and you can distinctly see frost on the edges of her feathers. Her four eyes look a little glazed, too. All-in-all, she looks like she’s on the edge of shock.
rows.translation: “索、索、索奇副女士叫我来协协协助你恢复复复，”她结结巴巴地说道。四条手臂紧紧抱住自己，你能清楚看见羽毛边缘结着霜。她的四只眼睛也有些呆滞。总而言之，她看起来濒临休克。
rows.raw: "\n\n“S-s-s-sub-madam Xotchi to me to assis-sis-sist you with your recuperacation,” she stutters. Her four arms are wrapped tight around her, and you can distinctly see frost on the edges of her feathers. Her four eyes look a little glazed, too. All-in-all, she looks like she’s on the edge of shock."

rows.original: You kick off the wall and grab her, the icy cold of her body against your naked form making you yelp.
rows.translation: 你蹬离墙壁，一把抓住她；冰冷的身体贴上赤裸肉体，令你惊叫出声。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou kick off the wall and grab her, the icy cold of her body against your naked form making you yelp."

rows.original: “Warm ...” she mumbles, as you wrap your arms around her, trying to brush the frost from her body. As you do, her feathers ruffle out, making her fluffier than usual, until she’s almost a lumpy pink ball of fuzz in your arms.
rows.translation: “温暖 ...”她低声呢喃；你用双臂抱住她，试图拂去身体上的冰霜。在此过程中，她的羽毛向外蓬起，比平时更加松软，直到怀中的她几乎变成一团凹凸不平的粉红毛球。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Warm ...” she mumbles, as you wrap your arms around her, trying to brush the frost from her body. As you do, her feathers ruffle out, making her fluffier than usual, until she’s almost a lumpy pink ball of fuzz in your arms."

rows.original: You can feel her shiver, still, and you hug her to you, trying to warm her.
rows.translation: 你仍能感觉她在发抖，于是将她紧紧抱住，努力给她取暖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can feel her shiver, still, and you hug her to you, trying to warm her."

rows.original: After a few moments, she chirps, the tiny sound emerging from her fluffiness. It takes her a few tries to actually form a string of coherent words. “Assistant Fourth Grade Tlako addressing the Limited Environment Neurostim Generator,” she peeps.
rows.translation: 过了片刻，她啾了一声，细小的声音从蓬松的绒毛间传出。她试了好几次，才真正组织出一串连贯的话。“四级助理特拉科呼叫有限环境神经刺激生成器，”她细声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a few moments, she chirps, the tiny sound emerging from her fluffiness. It takes her a few tries to actually form a string of coherent words. “Assistant Fourth Grade Tlako addressing the Limited Environment Neurostim Generator,” she peeps."

rows.original: The room lets out a low chime in response.
rows.translation: 房间以一声低沉的提示音回应。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe room lets out a low chime in response."

rows.original: “Y’quaa hot springs p-p-p-p-please,” she cheeps. “Real water.”
rows.translation: “请请请请启动伊夸温泉，”她啾啾叫道。“要真水。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y’quaa hot springs p-p-p-p-please,” she cheeps. “Real water.”"

rows.original: The room chimes again, and the zero-g fades, lowering the both of you to the floor. Hardlight lines sketch gentle curved shapes around you, turning the room around you into a marble basin. A splash announces the opening of a panel and a bubbling stream of water that slowly fills the basin.
rows.translation: 房间再次响起提示音，无重力状态随之消退，将你们两人缓缓放到地板上。硬光线条在你们周围勾勒出柔和的曲线，把房间变成一座大理石池。一声水花宣告着一块面板开启，冒泡的水流涌出，慢慢注满池子。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe room chimes again, and the zero-g fades, lowering the both of you to the floor. Hardlight lines sketch gentle curved shapes around you, turning the room around you into a marble basin. A splash announces the opening of a panel and a bubbling stream of water that slowly fills the basin."

rows.original: Steam rises from the hot water as the room converts into a miniature hot springs. The hot water is at your waist, and you cautiously lower Tlako into it. You pause briefly, then decide that you could probably use a soak, too. Your muscles are a little sore from being suspended by [xotchi.name].
rows.translation: 热水蒸腾起水汽，房间变成了一座微型温泉。热水齐至你的腰部，你小心翼翼地把特拉科放进去。你短暂停顿了一下，随后觉得自己大概也该泡一泡。被[xotchi.name]悬吊后，你的肌肉有些酸痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nSteam rises from the hot water as the room converts into a miniature hot springs. The hot water is at your waist, and you cautiously lower Tlako into it. You pause briefly, then decide that you could probably use a soak, too. Your muscles are a little sore from being suspended by [xotchi.name]."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: As you sink down to your shoulders in the hot water, the submerged blob of pink fur in front of you gradually uncurls. Below the surface, you can see Tlako stretch out, slowly turning this way and that.
rows.translation: 当你沉入热水，直至水面没过肩膀时，面前那团浸在水里的粉色绒球逐渐舒展开来。透过水面，你能看到特拉科伸展身体，缓缓地左扭右转。
rows.raw: "As you sink down to your shoulders in the hot water, the submerged blob of pink fur in front of you gradually uncurls. Below the surface, you can see Tlako stretch out, slowly turning this way and that."

rows.original: You’re relatively sure that toves are amphibious, and the amount of time she spends underwater confirms it.
rows.translation: 你相当确定托芙是两栖生物，而她待在水下的时长也证实了这一点。
rows.raw: " You’re relatively sure that toves are amphibious, and the amount of time she spends underwater confirms it."

rows.original: She finally surfaces, flinging her pink plumes back over her head and wiping her hands over her eyes.
rows.translation: 她终于浮出水面，把粉色羽冠甩回脑后，并用双手擦过眼睛。
rows.raw: " She finally surfaces, flinging her pink plumes back over her head and wiping her hands over her eyes."

rows.original: “Callooh, callay!” she chirps triumphantly, bobbing in the water in front of you. “Steele! It’s Steele! Hello! Hello, Steele! Did I forget to greet you? I’m so sorry!”
rows.translation: “好哇，好耶！”她胜利般啾叫着，在你面前的水中上下浮动。“斯蒂尔！是斯蒂尔！你好！你好呀，斯蒂尔！我是不是忘记向你问好了？真对不起！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Callooh, callay!” she chirps triumphantly, bobbing in the water in front of you. “Steele! It’s Steele! Hello! Hello, Steele! Did I forget to greet you? I’m so sorry!”"

rows.original: You smile and assure the excited little bird that she did already greet you.
rows.translation: 你微笑着向这只兴奋的小鸟保证，她已经问过好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smile and assure the excited little bird that she did already greet you."

rows.original: “Oh frabjous! Looks like even when on the edge of cold hardening, I’ve still got it!” she looks extremely pleased with herself.
rows.translation: “哦，妙极啦！看来即使濒临冷硬化，我也依然没忘！”她看起来对自己极为满意。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh frabjous! Looks like even when on the edge of cold hardening, I’ve still got it!” she looks extremely pleased with herself."

rows.original: Cold hardening? Does she mean freezing?
rows.translation: 冷硬化？她是说冻僵吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nCold hardening? Does she mean freezing?"

rows.original: “Similarish!” she chirps. “Cold is really bad for toves. It makes it hard to breathe, because our feathers start to tighten up,” she says, lifting a dripping arm from the water and running her hand across her pink feathers. She continues babbling, apparently VERY energetic now that she’s warm again. “Stiff feathers mean no breathing. I guess they’re more like leaves then, or maybe fronds... frondthers... feathonds... freathers...” She laughs. She splashes water at you and you respond in kind. Tlako giggles and dives underwater again, surfacing with another happy spray of mist.
rows.translation: “差不多啦！”她啾啾说道。“寒冷对托芙真的很糟糕。我们的羽毛会开始收紧，让我们难以呼吸，”她边说边从水中抬起一条滴水的手臂，用手抚过粉色羽毛。重新暖和起来后，她显然精力极其旺盛，继续喋喋不休。“羽毛僵硬就没法呼吸。我猜那时它们更像叶子，或者也许是叶片...叶毛...羽片...毛羽...”她笑了起来，向你泼水，你也以水还击。特拉科咯咯笑着再次潜入水下，浮出时又扬起一片欢快的水雾。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Similarish!” she chirps. “Cold is really bad for toves. It makes it hard to breathe, because our feathers start to tighten up,” she says, lifting a dripping arm from the water and running her hand across her pink feathers. She continues babbling, apparently VERY energetic now that she’s warm again. “Stiff feathers mean no breathing. I guess they’re more like leaves then, or maybe fronds... frondthers... feathonds... freathers...” She laughs. She splashes water at you and you respond in kind. Tlako giggles and dives underwater again, surfacing with another happy spray of mist."

rows.original: You ask her why she was out in the cold if it’s so bad for toves.
rows.translation: 既然寒冷对托芙这么糟糕，你问她为什么还要跑到严寒之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her why she was out in the cold if it’s so bad for toves."

rows.original: “I... may have accidentally and irrecontrieveably decalendared several important events from Sub-madam Xotchi’s agenda for the week,” she says sheepishly. “The sub-madam sent me down to survey Uveto VII as a punishment.”
rows.translation: “我...可能不小心且无可挽回地从索奇副夫人这周的日程中删掉了几项重要活动，”她羞赧地说道。“副夫人罚我下来勘察乌维托七号。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I... may have accidentally and irrecontrieveably decalendared several important events from Sub-madam Xotchi’s agenda for the week,” she says sheepishly. “The sub-madam sent me down to survey Uveto VII as a punishment.”"

rows.original: But surely she would have taken precautions, especially if cold is so bad for toves.
rows.translation: 但她肯定会采取防护措施，尤其是在寒冷对托芙如此有害的情况下。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut surely she would have taken precautions, especially if cold is so bad for toves."

rows.original: “We’re really senseptible to it. I had a thermal pack and I even bought a parka from a huskar who said she made it from her own fur, and it still didn’t keep all the cold out!” she squawks.
rows.translation: “我们对寒冷真的特别敏感。我带了保温包，甚至还从一名赫斯卡那里买了件派克大衣，她说那是用自己的毛做的，可它仍然没能把寒气全部挡在外面！”她尖声叫道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re really senseptible to it. I had a thermal pack and I even bought a parka from a huskar who said she made it from her own fur, and it still didn’t keep all the cold out!” she squawks."

rows.original: The thought of the itty-bitty pink fuzzball in an oversized parka makes you snort.
rows.translation: 想到这个娇小的粉色绒球套着一件过大的派克大衣，你忍不住噗嗤一声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thought of the itty-bitty pink fuzzball in an oversized parka makes you snort."

rows.original: “Hey, abiotic stress is nothing to laugh about!” she protests. “I even had mittens and a scarf!”
rows.translation: “喂，非生物胁迫可没什么好笑的！”她抗议道。“我甚至还戴了连指手套和围巾！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, abiotic stress is nothing to laugh about!” she protests. “I even had mittens and a scarf!”"

rows.original: The mental image is too much and you burst out laughing.
rows.translation: 脑中的画面实在太过滑稽，你顿时放声大笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mental image is too much and you burst out laughing."

rows.original: “Rude!” says Tlako indignantly, splashing you. “Impropritent!”
rows.translation: “没礼貌！”特拉科愤愤地说着，朝你泼水。“不得体！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rude!” says Tlako indignantly, splashing you. “Impropritent!”"

rows.original: You splash her back and she yelps, returning fire.
rows.translation: 你也向她泼回去，她惊叫一声，随即还击。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou splash her back and she yelps, returning fire."

rows.original: The next hour is spent helping Tlako to thaw out in the makeshift hot springs. Along the way, you feel a few muscles unclench, and the immediacy of [xotchi.name]’s torments fade away. Once you’ve both recovered, you Tlako dissolves the hardlight and drains the water from the room. Hot air vents blow you both dry, leaving the little pink tove extra poofy.
rows.translation: 接下来一个小时，你都在这座临时温泉里帮助特拉科暖回身体。在此期间，你感觉几处紧绷的肌肉放松下来，[xotchi.name]那番折磨带来的强烈感受也逐渐消退。等你们都恢复过来后，特拉科解除了硬光并排干房间里的水。热风口把你们两个吹干，让这只粉色小托芙变得格外蓬松。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe next hour is spent helping Tlako to thaw out in the makeshift hot springs. Along the way, you feel a few muscles unclench, and the immediacy of [xotchi.name]’s torments fade away. Once you’ve both recovered, you Tlako dissolves the hardlight and drains the water from the room. Hot air vents blow you both dry, leaving the little pink tove extra poofy."

rows.original: You trade jokes and chatter with her as she leads the way back up through the tunnels and up to the Camarilla office.
rows.translation: 她带你沿隧道一路返回卡玛利拉办公室，你们沿途互开玩笑、闲聊不断。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou trade jokes and chatter with her as she leads the way back up through the tunnels and up to the Camarilla office."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The doors to the Camarilla office ‘woosh’ open, revealing the usual flood of garish colors. Holoscreens display purple-sand beaches and some kind of translucent-green grass. Beyond the shore is a sparkling blue-green sea. Fish-like creatures soar in the distant skies. Balmy heat and tinny tropical music complete the scene, and you wonder briefly if this is supposed to be the tove homeworld.
rows.translation: 卡玛利拉办公室的门“嗖”地打开，露出一如往常的艳俗色彩洪流。全息屏幕展示着紫沙海滩和某种半透明的绿色草地。海岸之外是一片波光粼粼的蓝绿色海洋，鱼形生物翱翔在远方天空。温暖宜人的热气与音质单薄的热带音乐完善了这一幕，你短暂思忖这里是否意在模拟托芙的母星。
rows.raw: "The doors to the Camarilla office ‘woosh’ open, revealing the usual flood of garish colors. Holoscreens display purple-sand beaches and some kind of translucent-green grass. Beyond the shore is a sparkling blue-green sea. Fish-like creatures soar in the distant skies. Balmy heat and tinny tropical music complete the scene, and you wonder briefly if this is supposed to be the tove homeworld."

rows.original: Rather than the usual, excitable form of Tlako ready to greet you, another figure crouches behind a desk in the center of the room. The gregarious pink puff ball’s absence is made all the more prominent by the almost palpable impatience radiating off of the orange-and-black form of
rows.translation: 准备迎接你的并非一如往常、活力十足的特拉科，房间中央的桌子后反而蹲着另一个身影。那个爱交际的粉色绒球不见踪影，而橙黑色身影身上近乎实质的焦躁，更让她的缺席显得格外醒目。此人正是
rows.raw: "\n\nRather than the usual, excitable form of Tlako ready to greet you, another figure crouches behind a desk in the center of the room. The gregarious pink puff ball’s absence is made all the more prominent by the almost palpable impatience radiating off of the orange-and-black form of"

rows.original: Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall
rows.translation: 索奇·扎尔副夫人
rows.raw: " Sub-Madam Xotchi Tzall"

rows.original: Mistress
rows.translation: 女主人
rows.raw: " Mistress"

rows.original: The tove’s gaze is fixed on her desk, her sideways pupils flickering from screen to screen. Her blood-orange feathers are bristled, poofing out of the top of her black lace corset. Her fan sits open on the desk next to her, display screen flashing nonstop updates. As you step in, her outermost eyes glance up and she raises a single talon as her other three hands tap across the desk, presumably closing several windows.
rows.translation: 这名托芙的视线牢牢锁定在桌面上，横向瞳孔在一块块屏幕间迅速转动。她血橙色的羽毛根根竖起，从黑色蕾丝束腰上方蓬松地鼓出。她的扇子敞开放在桌边，显示屏不断闪烁着更新信息。你刚一进门，她最外侧的眼睛便向上瞥来；她抬起一只利爪，另外三只手则在桌面上敲击，想必是在关闭数个窗口。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tove’s gaze is fixed on her desk, her sideways pupils flickering from screen to screen. Her blood-orange feathers are bristled, poofing out of the top of her black lace corset. Her fan sits open on the desk next to her, display screen flashing nonstop updates. As you step in, her outermost eyes glance up and she raises a single talon as her other three hands tap across the desk, presumably closing several windows."

rows.original: You hesitate. You were expecting Tlako, and you’re unsure of how to deal with the sub-madam.
rows.translation: 你犹豫了。你原本以为会见到特拉科，如今却不确定该如何应付这位副夫人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hesitate. You were expecting Tlako, and you’re unsure of how to deal with the sub-madam."

rows.original: “If you’re looking for my worthless secretary, she’s not here. There was a problem with Seeder supply chains on Uveto VII, so I sent her down to inspect them personally,” [xotchi.name] explains. The task sounds innocuous enough, but there’s an unpleasant smile on the tove’s face.
rows.translation: “如果你来找我那个一无是处的秘书，她不在这里。乌维托七号的播种舱供应链出了问题，所以我派她亲自下去检查，”[xotchi.name]解释道。这任务听起来没什么危险，但这名托芙脸上挂着令人不悦的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you’re looking for my worthless secretary, she’s not here. There was a problem with Seeder supply chains on Uveto VII, so I sent her down to inspect them personally,” [xotchi.name] explains. The task sounds innocuous enough, but there’s an unpleasant smile on the tove’s face."

rows.original: “Unfortunately for me, she’s the only other tove on this ship with her Custommunication License. Mome knows how a bimbuoy like her managed that,” she continues. “So that means I lose several hours of my day running the lobbeach,” she pauses, the smile returning to her face. “Still... I suppose it’s worth it to frost the little ditz.” Her ears flip back and a forth for a moment, and she appears lost in thought.
rows.translation: “遗憾的是，她是这艘船上唯一一个同样持有客制通讯许可证的托芙。莫姆才知道她这种胸大无脑的浮标是怎么弄到那东西的，”她继续说道。“所以这意味着我要浪费我一天里的几个小时来管理大堂海滩，”她停顿片刻，笑容重新浮上脸庞。“不过...能让那个小傻妞挨冻，我想也算值得。”她的耳朵来回翻动了一会儿，似乎陷入了沉思。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Unfortunately for me, she’s the only other tove on this ship with her Custommunication License. Mome knows how a bimbuoy like her managed that,” she continues. “So that means I lose several hours of my day running the lobbeach,” she pauses, the smile returning to her face. “Still... I suppose it’s worth it to frost the little ditz.” Her ears flip back and a forth for a moment, and she appears lost in thought."
